title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Alchemists]]
description: The narrow street pulls back ever so slightly to allow enough room for the traffic to flow around a statue that has been given the place of honor in the middle of intersection.  Robed figures stride purposefully through the street, intent on their tasks for the day.  Unusual and occasionally caustic odors linger in the air, drifting out of the workshops and storefronts of the many practitioners that call this street home.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Alchemists]]
description: The narrow street snakes along between the buildings that lean far in over the way, lending a feeling of claustrophobia to the lane.  Small bundles of both familiar and exotic herbs sit behind glass windows in the many storefronts, next to cryptically labeled ceramic pots.  Strange aromas that tickle and tingle the senses waft out from doorways and linger throughout the street.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Alchemists]]
description: The way ends in a small dim square that the buildings overshadow so far as to give the impression of a man-made cave and the sky is little more than a patch of daylight high above.  With no breeze, the still air of the dead end seems to diminish the distinct odors of the street to a dull mustiness.  Lacking through traffic the end of the street is rather quiet, with only the occasional pedestrian moving directly towards their destination.

The way ends in a small dim square that the buildings overshadow so far as to give the impression of a man-made cave and the sky is little more than a dark patch of starlight high above.  With no breeze, the still air of the dead end seems to diminish the distinct odors of the street to a dull mustiness.  By night, traffic at the end of the street is almost nonexistent, with only the rare shopkeeper heading home after a long day.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Performers]]
description: Pale buildings line the street, reflecting the glow of the sunlight.  On the ground, bits of confetti swirl against the paving stones, occasionally lofting high into the air to perform a sprightly dance with an errant breeze.  The wind is fickle, however, quickly casting its partner aside to fall in colorful puddles of paper upon the ground, scuffed by passing feet until a streetsweeper's broom gathers it into oblivion.

Ribbons of light from hand blown lanterns mingle on the street, the colorful beams merrily dancing on entertainers and pedestrians alike at this gentle bend in the road.  Pieces of confetti occasionally rise to life, caught up by the wind to float gaily about in the air for a few brief moments before falling to earth again as part of the many paper puddles kicked by the stampede of passing feet, waiting for a streetsweeper's broom.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Performers]]
description: Always a festival of artwork and music, the Street of Performers is one of the liveliest streets in the city.  Peals of laughter and bursts of applause fill the air as wandering performers of all kinds amuse, entertain and delight the people who crowd the area at all hours.  Colorful silken awnings on poles help to keep off the hot sun and add splashes of bright decoration to the celebration.

Always a festival of artwork and music, the Street of Performers is one of the liveliest streets in the city.  Peals of laughter and bursts of applause fill the air as wandering performers of all kinds amuse, entertain and delight the people who crowd the area at all hours.  A rainbow of colorful blown glass lanterns add splashes of bright decoration to the celebration.

title: [[Muspar'i, North Wall Road]]
description: Sounds of clicking and rustling emerge from the city's outskirts as the infinite sands of the desert batter against the massive wall looming above.  The thin, snakelike trail is heavily occupied by homes and buildings pressed closely together.

title: [[Muspar'i, North Wall Road]]
description: Narrow alleyways spike through the crowded street like the quills of a dyrachis.  The road, filled with high stone buildings and tiny homes, clings desperately to the hillside, vainly clawing toward the wall for protection.  The wall, however, failing to reach these heights, offers no safety from the buffeting sands of the Golden Heights.

title: [[Muspar'i, North Wall Road]]
description: Along the side of the road, a small guardhouse clings to the scant portion of the wall reaching these heights on the hill.  Red and black uniformed guards slow the flow of traffic here, barring most of the city's poor from proceeding to the lower, wealthier depths of the city.

title: [[Muspar'i, Golden Heights]]
description: Curving away from the North Wall Road, a narrow byway slinks between crowds of shuttered buildings.  Overhead, a dingy awning stretched over keyhole arches straddling the alley provides escape from the harsh sun.  Holes poked through the fabric allow shafts of sunlight to pierce the gloom at irregular intervals.  Despite the shade, the air is hot and oppressive, each sweltering breeze tainted with the mingled odors of exotic spices, rotting garbage and decay.

title: [[Muspar'i, S'zella's Square]]
description: A few benches and enthusiastic food vendors fill this square, which often serves as a gathering spot for the people of the city.  To the east, the great boulevard of the Tuul Yamshuk Staho provides for every need of the city's newcomers and visitors.

title: [[Muspar'i, Tuul Yamshuk Staho]]
description: Whitewashed walls reflect the light from windows, giving them a strange ghostly hue in the night.  Occasional sounds of revelry carry on the air from somewhere to the west.  A wall topped with slate blue tiles separates the Carousel Square from the staho, but no gate blocks the wide archway leading through the wall to the square.

Whitewashed walls seem to pull the light down into the street, throwing small but sharp shadows away from people and objects.  Ignoring the traffic of everyday life passing upon the way, a cat naps upon the front step of a building.  A wall topped with slate blue tiles separates the Carousel Square from the staho, but no gate blocks the wide archway leading through the wall to the square.

title: [[Muspar'i, Peri'el's Retreat]]
description: A thin channel of water divides the sandstone cobbles of the square, lending a sense of calm movement to the residential area.  Night winds stir the towering palm trees, spreading their shadowy fronds back and forth over the rooftops.  Each palatial house has been angled to face the central masterpiece -- a fountain of the namesake goddess -- as if in permanent homage.

White limestone curbs border the golden sandstone cobbles of the square.  A marvel of artistic engineering, a thin channel of water flows through the direct center of the street, clearly indicating the residential area condones only foot traffic as opposed to the bustle of mercantile transport.  The palatial houses and towering palm trees lining the path are all angled to face the central masterpiece -- a fountain of the namesake goddess -- as if in permanent homage.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Shh'yris's Forge]]
description: Large windows ring the room, allowing a breeze to enter and cool Shh'yris as he labors at his forge.  The building, unlike most on Surlaenis, is made entirely of stone.  A large rack upon one wall is filled with tools of the smith's art.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Potters]]
description: The street broadens slightly at a terminus of variegated sandstone structures accented with pieces of glazed tile and fronted by smoothly curving clay jugs spilling over with hardy green vines.  Doors and arches punctuate the linked facades at intervals, giving passage into the various shops open for business in this quiet, drowsy part of the city.

The street broadens slightly at a terminus of variegated sandstone structures accented with pieces of glazed tile and fronted by smoothly curving clay jugs spilling over with hardy green vines.  Doors and arches punctuate the linked facades at intervals, giving passage into the various shops open for business in this quiet, drowsy part of the city.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Potters]]
description: The buildings arch out over the street from both sides, obscuring the sky and blocking most of the ambient light.  Barely visible within the darkness is a narrow doorway, set flush with the sandstone walls.

The buildings arch out over the street from both sides, providing a deeply shaded spot to rest for a moment away from the heat of the day.  Unobtrusively tucked into the shadows is a narrow doorway, set flush with the sandstone walls.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Potters]]
description: Tawny sandstone structures line the street, their rounded corners and irregular outlines vaguely resembling great cats huddled sleepily together against the chill desert night.  Set into the facade of one small shop is a hexagonal window, giving glimpses of the wares within.

title: [[Muspar'i, Peri'el's Retreat]]
description: Every now and then, a passerby flips a coin into the fountain and whispers requests for peace and luck to the limestone goddess rising from the watery depths.  The soft splashes mimic the water burbling through the dark furrow splitting the cobbled street.  Rows of dark palm trees shelter the houses at this point of the square, reinforcing the neighborhood's angled symmetry.

Lirums thrown for luck into the fountain's basin glint brightly, shooting flickers of reflected daylight onto the limestone goddess to freckle her body with fleeting motes.  The golden sandstone paving the street shimmers from the desert heat, creating the optical illusion of undulation along the ground akin to the watery furrow splitting the path.  As with the neighborhood's other three points, the curbs form a right angle to direct the houses and palm trees straight toward the square's main attraction.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: The road winds among low, rounded hills barely deserving of the name.  Clumps of trees around the base of the hills thin out rapidly as bare rock rises out of the good earth.  The ragged summits are worn and weathered with age.

title: [[Shh'yris's Forge, Bellows Room]]
description: Great piles of coal fill the corner of the room.  The forge fire burns with white-hot flames, fueled by the coal and the efforts of Shh'yris's apprentices who labor at the bellows.  Sweat pours from their bodies, only to sizzle as it strikes the hot stone floor.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Shoan Isenil'a]]
description: The courtyard is planted with low growing herbs that form a pleasing pattern of mounds set against small white pebbles.  The focal point of the garden is a small white statue of a unicorn, her head bowed and horn resting humbly upon the ground.  A bench rests beneath the shelter of the overhanging roof, and despite the traffic in and out of the healers' quarters, it is a peaceful spot, as the interior light filters softly through the paper screens.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Shoan Isenil'a]]
description: Light blue and green cushions cover the floor, placed there for guests waiting with friends and family to see the empath.  White paper walls glow in the light from several lanterns hanging from the ceiling.  An archway of white birch is set in the northern wall, leading to the empath.

title: [[Shoan Isenil'a, Raeshisen]]
description: Plump cushions, and the patients lying on top of them, litter the floor.  A section of the paper screen wall has been removed to allow a breeze to enter.  Bloody bandages fill a basket in the corner of the room.  A young Elothean woman tends the patients lying on the floor.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Willow Pond]]
description: Water splashes down a slick rock chute built into the hillside on the far side of the pond, tumbling into the dark green water to send ripples shimmering across the surface.  A weathered grey pier juts out into the pond, giving residents a launching point from which to dive.  At night, the sound of crickets mingles with the hoarse croaks of frogs serenading the moons.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Debt Office]]
description: Several sections of the paper walls have been removed, creating windows to let the cool breeze enter.  Beyond the windows lie the multicolored rock gardens that surround the government buildings, as well as the crushed shell path ringing the lake.  A clerk sits behind a white birch counter, waiting for those who need to pay their debts to the Tribunal.
tags: meta:mapname:Qi'Reshalia - Aesry Surlaenis'a Interiors, Misrel Lemicus'a Library, Tribunal Building
meta:mapshortname:Aesry Surlaenis'a Interiors, Misrel Lemicus'a Library, Tribunal Building

title: [[Muspar'i, Sanyrsen's Square]]
description: Tiered marble benches occupy a large portion of the square here, arranged in a half circle around an open expanse of darkened sandstone tiles.  Nearby, the central statue gives off a soft glow, bathing the area in a bluish light.

Tiered marble benches occupy a large portion of the square here, arranged in a half circle around an open expanse of dyed sandstone tiles that fan out around the base of the central statue.  Palm trees interspersed among them cast their long shadows downward over those who have gathered beneath, offering a bit of respite from the heat of the sun.

title: [[Muspar'i, Sanyrsen's Square]]
description: Wrapped in the tranquil embrace of night, an overwhelming quiet has descended upon the square.  Light emanates from the central statue, casting a soft, bluish glow over the now darkened sandstone tiles that encircle its base.

Branching off of Tuul Yamshuk Staho, this square is home to the Royal Library of the city, where all manner of scholars eventually make an appearance, congregating to exchange ideas and postulate on the latest theories.  Standing in the center is a marble statue of a robed figure, a look of fierce determination on his face, as if he alone will guard the way to the riches beyond.  At the base of the statue is a large mosaic, the sandstone tiles dyed a myriad of colors.

title: [[Muspar'i, Tuul Yamshuk Staho]]
description: The sound of fabric flapping in the night breezes comes down to the street from somewhere overhead, beyond the range of sight.  An inn to one side has seen better days, but still looks well off with what customers it manages to attract.  The crowds of the day have dissipated, leaving only the occasional patron stepping into the inn for the night.

Gauzy blue sunshades far above reach out from building eaves on either side of the way, shifting in slight desert breezes and shading the daytime strollers below.  An inn to one side has seen better days, but still seems to do a brisk business with all the traffic.  The constant crowd of the street makes it difficult going for merchant caravans on their way to the Great Gate to the southeast.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Performers]]
description: Discordant sounds roll out of an upper level window down to the street, shattering the quiet of night.  Hand blown lanterns, now the only source of light, cast their kaleidoscope of colors on the faces of passersby.  The flickering lights highlight an older S'Kra leaning drunkenly against an ironwork railing as he reels from the effects of his late visit to a local pub.

Discordant sounds roll out of an upper level window down to the street, blending with the noise to create a cacophonous symphony.  Sunlight filters through blown-glass lanterns that dangle from ropes strung across the street, sending a riot of color flickering over the faces of passersby.

title: [[Muspar'i, Sanyrsen's Square]]
description: Soft light from the central statue casts a bluish glow over this portion of the square, illuminating the darkened sandstone tiles.  Chiseled granite steps lead up towards the ornately carved doors of the Royal Library, beckoning all to enter within.

Shadows cast by the Royal Library looming nearby stretch across the dyed sandstone tiles, blanketing this section of the square in perpetual shade.  Standing in the center is a marble statue, its back facing the chiseled granite steps that lead up toward the ornately carved double doors which beckon all to enter within.

title: [[Muspar'i, Sanyrsen's Square]]
description: Light from the central statue casts its soft bluish glow over this portion of the square where sandstone tiles have been arranged in an intricate mosaic.  Several elegantly carved marble benches rest nearby, sitting solemnly beneath the canopy of some palm trees.

Several elegantly carved marble benches rest beneath some palm trees at the edge of the square, providing a spot for weary travellers to stop and rest, or for one of the library scholars to sit with a book in quiet contemplation.  Sandstone tiles fan out before the base of the central statue, arranged into an intricate mosaic.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Scribes]]
description: The Street of Scribes ends in a small cul-de-sac, where a wooden bench, the perfect comfort for errant readers, is set beside a stunning golden monument in the center of the circle.  Beyond the street's buildings, all huddled close together, the massive temples of the city blot out the northern horizon.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Scribes]]
description: In the midst of the narrow Street of Scribes stands a large silver obelisk, serving as an island that the crowd, bustling from shop to shop, must flow around.  Signs of scrolls, inkpots, and tomes hang in the windows of the shops bundled along the street.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Scribes]]
description: A narrow street branches off here from the expansive Square of Sanyrsen.  The elegant arches of the royal academy and the imposing towers of the Warrior Mage Guildhall, the square's major landmarks, are easily visible here, looming over the small buildings crowded in along this street.  The stores here are all well kept and decked in fineries not often seen on the poorer merchant streets, suggesting that the shopkeeps here cater to a wealthier clientele.

title: [[Muspar'i, Golden Heights]]
description: Several twisting passages meet in a labyrinthine tangle at the crest of the hill, where a steep cliff drops away into empty darkness, prohibiting further progress to the south.  Mournful gusts of wind sweep showers of fine sand across the crumbling remains of buildings lying shrouded in shadows.  One ancient stone construct, alone maintaining some semblance of its former glory, stands apart at the edge of the precipice.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west.

title: [[Muspar'i, Golden Heights]]
description: Hot, dry wind blows over the rocky promontory, spraying endless clouds of abrasive sand over eroded hovels that lean away from the edge of the precipice in a miserable cluster.  To the north, west and south, the cliff drops away sharply into a vast sea of darkness.

title: [[Muspar'i, Golden Heights]]
description: Perched high on the rocky hillside, windowless houses huddle together as if seeking protection from the elements, while far below, the lights of the city sparkle like a pool of starlight spilled onto the desert.  A tattered fabric awning, ripped from its moorings by the relentless winds, flaps listlessly in the sultry night breeze.  Shadows spill across the twisted alleyway, concealing its secrets within a shifting cloak of darkness.

title: [[Muspar'i, Golden Heights]]
description: Curving away from the North Wall Road, a dark, narrow byway slinks between crowds of shuttered buildings.  A guttering lantern casts strange, shifting patterns of light and shadow onto the surrounding walls and the dingy awning stretched overhead.  Even at night the air is hot and oppressive, each sweltering breeze tainted with the mingled odors of exotic spices, rotting garbage and decay.

title: [[Muspar'i, Peri'el's Retreat]]
description: A few residents meander through the square, though most of the neighborhood's tourists are absent due to night's darkness enshrouding the communal fountain.  A small manmade stream parts the sandstone street, and the water moves swiftly along its route like blood through a vein.  The houses and palm trees, all facing toward the square's middle, enclose the area and feature the dim city skyline as their backdrop.

Encouraged by the neighborhood's relaxing atmosphere, residents and sightseers alike meander through the square.  Many stop to gaze at the statue of Peri'el rising from the communal fountain's basin.  A small manmade stream parts the sandstone street, funneling the influx of pedestrians to either side, though never far apart.  The houses and palm trees, all facing toward the square's middle, enclose the area and feature the city skyline as their backdrop.

title: [[Temple of Hav'roth, Vista Portico]]
description: A wide arc of gold-veined white marble columns supports one of the many domes of the temple and marks the boundary between the portico and the greenery of the sacred gardens beyond.  Birds roost for the night near the roof, finding perches among the ornately scrolled stonework.  An artfully carved archway in the temple wall reveals a stairway leading down below the main level of the temple.

A wide arc of gold-veined white marble columns supports one of the many domes of the temple and marks the boundary between the portico and the greenery of the sacred gardens beyond.  Birds occasionally flutter into the wide space, seeking temporary shelter from the sun.  An artfully carved archway in the temple wall reveals a stairway leading down below the main level of the temple.

title: [[World Dragon Temple]]
description: Columns of purple quartz rise stoically toward the vaulted ceiling high above, supporting the rough-hewn obsidian walls of the Temple.  Embroidered gold carpeting marks a clear path beneath them, receding deeper into the shadowy confines of the structure.  Wooden torches rest within iron sconces set high upon the columns, casting a dim, flickering light upon the area.

title: [[Jail, Courtyard]]
description: The courtyard is barren of ornament, and black gritty sand is raked in a stark pattern over the enclosed yard.  The roof of the building overhangs to provide little shelter from wind and rain -- a most unpleasant place to be waiting in bad weather.  A sturdy metal door at the far end of the courtyard is the only entrance into the windowless building.

title: [[Muspar'i, Sh'kial's Square]]
description: Torches spaced along the length of the glittering golden wall cast a ruddy light along the temple path.  Dancing fitfully in the night air, they drape playful, ever-moving shadows across the intricate patterns of the dragon's-coil wall.

title: [[Muspar'i, Peri'el's Retreat]]
description: Gurgles from the central fountain follow the water as it flows into a narrow channel spanning the length of the street.  Lights from the windows of Shorka's Palace squeeze through the tall palm trees overhead to stripe both the houses and cobblestone.  Since all of the residences in the quiet neighborhood face inward, illumination dots the night from every angle of the square.

The quiet neighborhood basks in the presence of Shorka's Palace, which dominates the skyline at every point of the square.  All of the houses sit back from the golden sandstone road, the rows of verdant palm trees casting wavering shade upon not only the residences but the central fountain as well.  Clean water flowing from the sculpted basin diverts into a narrow channel spanning the length of the street, parting it into two walking lanes.

title: [[Izma Ru'ef University, Grand Hall]]
description: Inside the hollow trunk of a huge sequoia, nearly as old as Sana'ati Dyaus, is the Grand Hall of Izma Ru'ef University.  Along the curved, arching walls are carved bas reliefs in the native wood, scenes of the glory of the Elven Empires of Elanthia.  Busts sculpted of precious hardwoods stand on pedestals in a semi-circle along the hall, likenesses of eminent lorethews, Elven and non-Elven, who have taught at the University.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Cloth Weavers]]
description: Darkness muffles this normally bustling avenue in a cloak of subdued neutrality.  While the occasional hopeful crier still plies his wares by torchlight, most have retreated to their pallets, wherever those meager dwellings might be.

title: [[Jail, Guard Office]]
description: A single lamp burns brightly in the gloom of the tiny office, creating a claustrophobic feeling of eternal twilight.  A battered pine chair, a steel manacle dangling from one of its slats, sits next to a desk covered by stacks of dusty parchment.  Squeezed into a corner, a barrel has been set up as a makeshift table and holds the remains of the guards' last card game.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Nobles]]
description: A passing breeze occasionally stirs the heavy curtains bordering a long veranda here, bravely lifting and parting the hem of the heavy silk.  A soft glow from beyond the curtain, escaping in shards of light when the fabric is disturbed, indicates that its owners have not yet retired to sleep, but no sounds further betray their activities.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Nobles]]
description: Faint light shimmers off of the tiny pond set here, its surface dyed an inky black by night, and reflects upward to throw flickering patterns on the surrounding stone.  Small, expensively fragranced oil lamps, their wicks sheltered from nightly breezes by tiny panes of glass, strategically illuminate the languid water garden.

title: [[Deep Forest, Dilapidated Cabin]]
description: The trees thin slightly here, opening up around the ruins of a cabin.  The vine-choked structure struggles to stand under the weight of a fallen tree, with the occasional foreboding creak emanating from its boards.  Off to one side, a pile of rocks marks the location of a crumbling well.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin]]
description: A strong odor of rotting vegetation fills this small cabin, despite planks missing at varying intervals leaving the area open to the outside.  Dead branches reach through the broken ceiling above like long, bony fingers, in contrast to the tender seedlings pushing up through the floorboards.  A small, rotting area rug is pulled back in one corner, revealing a trapdoor.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Basement]]
description: A rusted lantern hanging from above shines a gentle glow over this space, which is little more than a cave carved in the vague shape of a room.  Makeshift tables and shelves line the walls, covered with an assortment of gears and metal scraps.  Heavy wooden supports stand at the north and south ends of the area, framing parts of the cavern that were left in their natural states.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Low Hillside]]
description: Water bubbles up from a crystal clear spring before overflowing into a smooth rock chute in the hillside.  The chute twists and turns as it runs down the slope until it finally ends a few feet above the deep green waters of Willow Pond.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: The path curves sharply to the southwest and southeast, hugging a cluster of stalactites and stalagmites.  A gear is deeply embedded in the rock, almost appearing as though it was naturally formed along with the stone.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: Deep gouges are cut in the walls, like scars in the stone, forming clean furrows as though the tool used was slicing through clay instead of hard rock.  A ruddy stain, vaguely resembling a handprint, mars the surface alongside the gash.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: Curving gently, the tunnel is shaped in such a way that it makes it difficult to tell which directions various skittering noises are coming from.  Overhead, roots squeeze through cracks, further dampening sounds.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: The coolness of the air is heightened by the addition of moisture and creating a scent similar to dust after the rain.  Droplets of water cling to the stone walls, making them look as though they're perspiring.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: Cracks spread across the stone walls in an intricate cobweb pattern, as if something with massive strength punched the rock.  A small clump of lichen clings to one of the fractures, following the jagged line like a tiny, greenish lightning bolt.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Lobby]]
description: Streaks from foot traffic cut through the grime to reveal cracked tiles composing the once majestic image of a dragon grasping Elanthia between massive jaws.  From the walls to the ceiling, the entire room is in a complete state of disrepair, ravaged by the onslaught of time and unwelcome looters, squatters and miscreants.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Lobby]]
description: Nearly splintered in two, what used to be an ironwood desk clutters the room's western side.  Crumpled papers and broken quills litter the floor, evidence that the broken furniture likely housed some of the complex's files.  The layers of shredded documents upon the ground resemble the covering of ripped parchments still clinging to the walls like flaky sheets of bark to a birch tree.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Lobby]]
description: With a table stationed between two couches, the room was likely a lounge area for residents while the building was in operation.  Now, however, the dilapidated furniture serves no more purpose than to exist as a perpetual eyesore in the collage of destruction.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Lobby]]
description: Overflowing bags of refuse border a broken door, the garbage left forever just footsteps from the dump neighboring the lot outside.  It makes no difference, since the rest of the halls and rooms harbor the same grunge and filth.  The rotting odor is also omnipresent, as if it oozes from all of the stained sandstone walls like an invisible slime.

title: [[World's End Apartments, West Landing]]
description: Looking more like trash flung haphazardly across the ground than an intentional embellishment, the shredded remains of a runner extend from the landing all the way to the end of the split-level hall.  Insect carcasses congregate along the edges, with the occasional rodent skeleton joining the morbid death party.  Wax drippings along the smoke-stained walls point to where candles used to light the area.

title: [[World's End Apartments, West Wing]]
description: The ratty carpet bunches unevenly in places, making travel inconvenient and precarious.  Massive chunks are missing from the ceiling, revealing patches of the sky not obscured by neighboring buildings.  The city's constant companion, sand, certainly does not shy away from imposing its presence here either.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, up, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, West Wing]]
description: Notes of urban life trickle into the hallway from several holes in the roof.  Every little noise echoes off the sandstone walls and travels in and out of the opened apartments.  The splotched, threadbare runner fails to buffer the sound, creating the false impression that the complex is alive with residential commotion once again.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, up, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: The room is completely empty, which proves slightly unnerving compared to the rest of the building's chaos.  No decorations line the walls, and no carpet softens the floor.  A single piece of paper adhered to the decimated door frame exists as the lone accoutrement.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Faint pastel paint coats the rough walls in spots.  A mangled crib with several splintered rods rests in one corner, as if prepared to cradle an undead infant due to the furniture's condition -- one of intense disrepair and overwhelming neglect.  Tastelessly completing the scene, a mobile crafted from sharp glass shards, limp cigarillo butts and rusty razor blades dangles over the petite bed.

title: [[World's End Apartments, West Wing]]
description: Surprisingly intact, an end table leaning against the wall supports a small cactus in a clay pot.  Though the vessel is chipped, the glazed facade still reflects the color of the drab runner flowing down the floor of the long hallway.  Salt stains along the ceiling indicate where the desert rain, infrequent as it may be, leaks through the building's decaying roof.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Pointy pieces of glass jut from the edges of the traumatized window pane, painting a contorted, almost dreamlike panorama of the Musparan skyline.  A bed rests against the wall at an unnatural angle, while a chair dangles from a sconce close to the ceiling.  Perhaps a squatter happened by and sculpted the furniture into artwork with the few bits that remained in the room after the building's abandonment.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Dozens of feathers litter the ground from the ripped mattress lumped into one corner.  The room is completely disheveled, with furniture upended and drawers unceremoniously uprooted from their stations.  One may deduce that someone conducted a thorough, albeit destructive, search of the premises in the past.

title: [[World's End Apartments, East Landing]]
description: A faded runner travels the length of the split-level hallway.  The rug's moth-bitten edges and multiple burn marks insinuate a lack of care for the fabric, much like the rest of the fixtures in the condemned building.  Uneven holes in the roof provide limited illumination, fulfilling the job once held by the candle-less sconces affixed to the walls near the crumbling ceiling.

title: [[World's End Apartments, East Wing]]
description: Crude graffiti sprawls across the dingy walls, probably tagged by transients with no regard for preventing further damage in the ramshackle building.  A pair of empty door frames, one on each side of the hall, exposes the abandoned flats beyond.  Sand fills in the ragged gaps of the floor's faded runner, causing it to almost look whole.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, up, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, East Wing]]
description: Missing doors, either stolen or destroyed, permit unrestricted access to the uninhabited flats on both sides of the hall.  A curious metal rack hangs from the middle of the ceiling here.  At first glance, the gnarled coils appear to be a piece of art, alien amongst the decidedly uncultured environment.  However, it proves to be no more than a chandelier with all of its valuable crystals removed, placing it much more in line with the theme of devastation dominating the complex.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, up, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Broken bottles on the floor mix with the glass from the room's shattered window.  Tattered curtains patterned with abstract dust images still grip a bent rod above the square hole, the edges of the fabric frayed from flapping unabated in the brutal desert winds.  No furniture outfits the living space, the pieces assumedly removed by looters looking for some quick coin.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Bursts of soot cover nearly every surface, alluding to a fire that fortunately seems to have been contained to this one room.  The charred corpses of furnishings rest in peace upon the floor, their dismembered remains strewn at odd angles.  Light patches on the walls contrast with the blackness, exposing where framed pictures and other mementos hung in the apartment while occupied by a full-time tenant.

title: [[World's End Apartments, East Wing]]
description: Dark stains mar the walls at the hallway's end and match the ominous puddle soaked into the sandstone floor.  Slight breezes filter in from the flats on either side of the corridor, their windows completely wrecked and their doors mysteriously absent.  Empty sconces dangle from the walls as if they attempted to flee the dire situation around them but gave up out of sheer hopelessness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, down.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Indubitably the deserted residence of a chronic hoarder, the room is cluttered with an eclectic variety of worthless junk.  A repugnant stench with unknown origins inherently worsens the already depressing situation.  The only light entering the area comes from the hallway, as the apartment's window is completely blocked from view due to the fortress of garbage.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: A few lopsided stools are situated around an overturned crate in the center of the sticky floor.  The scene implies the attendance of squatters who use the space for illicit activities, especially judging by the empty alcohol bottles piled nearly to the ceiling in one corner.  Unfortunately, one visitor seems to have emptied the contents of his stomach next to the busted door frame, forcing all who enter the apartment to pass by the stinking mess.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: No trace of greenery, no whiskers of grass and no clusters of color break the monotony in the seemingly never-ending darkness.  Instead, the sand covers anything and everything in a relentless attempt to assimilate any foreign objects into the monochromatic scenery.  There are no diamonds in the rough here, merely stones turned to dust before even having the chance to shine.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Tongues of chilled air flick the loose grains of sand from their temporary resting places to shower the neighboring dunes with new sediment.  Because of the shifting surroundings, many travelers prefer to avoid venturing here, knowing exploration carries a huge risk of getting lost or injured, especially at night.  As fickle and unpredictable as fate, the blustering sand recreates the shadows time and time again.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Cruel winds chill and maim the dunes, dispersing the sand carelessly and sloppily.  Any footprints are immediately erased by the constant churning of particle-filled wind, though the tracks would be nearly impossible to see in the dark anyway.  It is no wonder the S'Kra Mur refer to this place as the 'Lands of Evil,' for the terrain is truly inhospitable indeed.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Indistinguishable from one another at night, windswept dunes characterize the land from every possible viewpoint.  Only the whooshing sound of sand journeying from one spot to another fills the quiet air.  Despite the lack of life, there is never a dull moment, for the dust swirls in a tumultuous dance forever under the black sky.

Windswept dunes characterize the land from every possible viewpoint.  Only the whooshing sound of sand journeying from one spot to another fills the air aside from the rare scream of a bird in the faraway reaches of the desert.  Despite the lack of life, there is never a dull moment, for the dust swirls in a tumultuous dance forever under the hot sun.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Whorls of sand tumble over the shadowed dunes like trained acrobats.  Meanwhile, the night carries on, oblivious to the dusty mess kicked up in ribbons and sheets by the forceful winds that threaten to obscure the heavens.  Sudden blasts of cold air are more common than not in the dreary, treacherous expanse, the disruptions often strong enough to send one falling head over heels into the darkness.

Whorls of sand tumble over the dunes like trained acrobats.  Meanwhile, the sun blazes on, oblivious to the dusty mess kicked up in ribbons and sheets by the forceful winds that attempt to blot out the daylight.  Sudden blasts of hot air are more common than not in the dreary, treacherous expanse, the disruptions often strong enough to send one falling head over heels.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Cold replaces the usual desert clime as if night sucked all the warmth from the air and sand.  The landscape stands as a testament to the heat -- submissive to its punishment while staying barren and withered under the brutal temperatures and fierce winds.  No living thing stands a chance of survival for very long in the grueling environment.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: The absence of even the slightest hint of flora and fauna alludes to the environment's unfriendly and unwelcoming nature.  Animals wander in unknowingly at night after suffering the sun all day, only to die and have their remains swept into the shadows.  S'Kra Mur storytellers speak of a great curse upon the land, causing it to remain bereft of life until the end of days.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Funnels of sand barrel into each other and create translucent curtains that shroud the black horizon.  Every direction mimics the next in the hazy darkness.  Travel becomes increasingly difficult not only due to poor visibility, but also because one's feet are continuously swallowed by the voracious desert.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Wisps of sand swerve over the ground like mist hovering above a darkened bog.  The grains writhe and twitch to reconstruct the plane in ghost-like movements.  Thankfully, the lack of moisture anywhere in the vicinity limits the danger of potential fields of quicksand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Black and impenetrable, the desert night claims many victims foolish enough to wander into its grasp unprepared.  The grey heights of the towering dunes are matched equally in breadth and scope by the shadowy depths of the sunken depressions.  Cold wind molds the landscape with invisible fingers just as a potter shapes a vase, though the sand, while yielding, refuses to maintain any recognizable profile.

Lonely and arid, the desert claims many victims foolish enough to wander into its grasp unprepared.  The heights of the towering dunes are matched equally in breadth and scope by the depths of the sunken depressions.  Wind molds the landscape with invisible fingers just as a potter shapes a vase, though the sand, while yielding, refuses to maintain any permanent profile.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: A repetitive barrage of granules ricochets around the mounds like invisible crossbow fire in the night, the ceaseless torrent enough to make even the most steadfast traveler check his footing.  The swells of sand rise and fall like the chests of a slumbering army.  They face the chilling winds' assault with resigned dignity, accepting the inevitable truth that life is fleeting, especially for the likes of a desert dune.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Cold winds pummel the area, making breathing difficult and labored.  The horizon appears depressingly far away, and the blackness feels almost constrictive.  One must keep his wits about him at all times, lest he succumb to the desert's deadly deception.

Heat chokes the air, making breathing difficult and labored.  The horizon ripples into distorted mirages of imaginary places and beings.  One must keep his wits about him at all times, lest he succumb to the desert's malicious trickery.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Giant dunes perspire fine lines of sand down their sloping sides as if in fear of the desert's nighttime chill.  The real culprit, however, is likely a simple combination of gravity and wind.  Regardless, the mounds slowly fade into the blackness, diminished by their own dusty sweat, only to be rebuilt by the next heavy, replenishing gust.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Blotches of night sky occasionally emerge from their hiding places in the sandy clouds blanketing the land.  Bulimic dunes hack and cough themselves up into the air with the aid of the unforgiving wind, regurgitating particles that float noiselessly amid the darkness before rejoining their siblings on the ground.  The effect is disorienting but not without a hint of natural aesthetics only the desert can supply.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Migen'hhs Pat'shhry]]
description: Like the ebb and flow of the ocean tide, so moves the sand in waves upon itself in the desolate desert.  The stinging wind flip-flops its course as if trying to shake some nocturnal predator, resulting in varied patterns across the dunes.  Yet the currents of cold air never exhaust themselves and tirelessly trek across the hilly terrain, leaving only soft whispers in their wake.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: Darkness casts a deathly pallor across the rolling dunes to either side of the trade road.  Swirling sand, caught up by the ever-present wind, plays games with the shadowed recesses in the sand, changing the form of the hulking dunes grain by grain.

Rolling dunes rise to either side of the trade route, crowding in as if pressed for space in the wide desert.  Here the sun, when visible, reigns as emperor, god, and executioner, staring eminently down upon his meek subjects.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: Here the sand dunes rise again, pitching the travelers of the trade road back into a world of sand and sky.  The surfaces of the great sand hills are smooth and supple, their elegant curves as deceptively gentle as a veiled maiden's.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: The stars are obscured in the distance, where a far-away range of mountains cuts a jagged swath across the horizon.  Between here and there lies only sand, which sparkles with a subtle, quiet beauty under the hushed veil of night.

Distant mountains rise to the southwest, as if a dragon had raised the ridged back of its spine toward the sky.  Between here and there, however, there is only a seemingly endless expanse of golden sand, and the thick sun-haze that hangs over it.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: The dunes level out here into a brief stretch of even terrain, marked only by a single dusty purple cactus that squats stubbornly near a small collection of flat, rounded rocks.  Rounded dunes rise again in every direction, obscuring the winding path of the trade road to the north and south.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: A great blot of shadow engulfs an expansive stretch to one side of the trade road, tracing the edges of a massive rock.  Darker tufts of shadow mark out the presence of several tiny patches of sparse desert grass.

The sun-scorched surface of a massive red rock emerges behemoth-like from the sand to one side of the trade road.  Scraggly tufts of tough desert grass take tenuous root in its many cracks, many of which have been worn smooth by time and shifting sand.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road, Dirt Path]]
description: A small path branches off from the trade road, obviously less frequently used, with the highway's steady line of paved blocks slowly dying away here.  Canyon walls begin to form on the sides of the path, and the road's elevation begins to gradually slope downward.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road, Dirt Path]]
description: The last paving-stone vestiges of the Velakan Trade Road have vanished from this narrow sand path, and it opens up to a rocky canyon further below.  Large, unnatural webs cling to the rocks of the canyon walls.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: A huge, rounded shape rises to one side of the trade road, crosshatched with lighter and darker patches of shadow.  The available starlight plays dancing games across the pale sand to either side of the dune.

A great dune rises to one side of the path, its nearest face marked with parallel rippling lines carved into the surface of the sand by strafing desert winds.  The dune casts some meager shade over the trade road, but those parts cast in shadow seem no cooler than those beyond.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: The land here flattens out slightly in a low stretch between two massive dunes.  The ground is parched and cracked, creating a mosaic of small cakes of dried mud, the only remnant of a long since departed desert storm.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: Sparse, parched grasses line the edges of the paved trade road, their roots finding purchase beneath the sand-worn stones.  Sand continually attempts to envelop them, but they stubbornly persist.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: This arm of the trade road, truthfully little more than a sandy path packed down by continuous travel, winds between two rows of small dunes as it stretches out toward the palace gate of Muspar'i.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: The pale sand surrounding the trade road glitters by night, minute grains catching what starlight filters down from the open bowl of the dark sky overhead.  The dunes are marked by long, spidering fissures, their edges softened by harsh desert winds and their depths hiding tiny unknown inhabitants.

Great arcing fissures, carved by the harsh winds that sweep the desert, spider across the dunes to either side of the trade road.  The unrelenting sun casts dark shadows down inside them, creating shaded hiding places for the small -- and likely dangerous -- creatures that manage to eke by in the harsh terrain.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: The oppressive heat of the day lingers by night only in the lower layers of sand to either side of the path.  A great stillness keeps its grip on the shifting dunes that drift ever closer to engulf the trade road.  The air carries a biting chill, for the desert is a harsh mistress -- by day or by night.

The sun pelts down mercilessly overhead, slowly baking the sand-covered stones of the paved trade road.  Mounds of sand crowd in on the path, scattering grains that glitter in the sunlight across the worn expanse.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: Ever changing, the landscape of Velaka stretches out to the south and east beyond the border of the main trade road.  To the north stands the high wall of the city, beyond which can be seen the dome of the palace roof.  The dunes to the west, though small, are close enough to block further view in that direction.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: An acrid, briny scent drifts over the dunes to the west on an unrefreshing breeze, carrying with it grains of salt and sand.  The creeping dunes of the Velaka surround the road almost entirely, blocking passage north.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road]]
description: As if molded by Hav'roth himself, the dunes to the north part wide, leaving a sloping valley for travelers to approach the palace gate of Muspar'i.  Over the gate, the palace roof glitters in the darkness, just beyond the ominous silhouette of a tall tree.

As if molded by Hav'roth himself, the dunes to the north part wide, leaving a sloping valley for travelers to approach the palace gate of Muspar'i.  Over the gate, the palace roof gleams in the sunlight, just beyond the gently swaying fronds of a tall tree.

title: [[Velakan Trade Road, Before the Palace Gate]]
description: Great iron-banded gates stand tall within the otherwise unbroken barrier of limestone blocks that is the wall around Shorka's Palace.  Deep carving in the stone depicts a fearsome cobra, though much of the detail has been worn away by the harsh Velakan environment.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: Skirting along beside the tall stone walls of the palace courtyard, a barely passable trail is created by the bordering sand dunes that perpetually loom just outside of the city.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: A low point between two dunes affords a passing glimpse of the salt lake to the west, and the briny scent carries more freely from it on the wind.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: The dunes seem to shy away from the mighty wall as it curves outward, reaching father into the harsh desert landscape.  Far beyond the dunes, the southwestern arm of the Gemfire Mountains stands in the distance.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: Sloping away from the high wall, the mighty sand dunes recede into the ground, leveling out as they approach the shores of Lake Ratamipak.  The massive body of murky water stands motionless amidsts the shifting sands, hardly a ripple disturbing its surface.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: The imposing wall that surrounds the palace grounds slopes gently to the north and southwest, curving like the body of some great serpent.  A small sand dune collects near the crook of the path.

title: [[Velaka, Sandstone Bridge]]
description: To the west, the great expanse of black water that is Lake Ratamipak stretches toward the horizon, the vast salt flat that borders its northern shore emitting a ghostly glow in the darkness.  A sinuous river, appropriate for its namesake, passes beneath the sandstone bridge on its way westward to feed the salty lake.  The water trickles by quietly underfoot.

To the west, the great expanse of briny water that is Lake Ratamipak stretches toward the horizon, the vast salt flat that borders its northern shore glittering in the light of the sun.  A sinuous river, appropriate for its namesake, passes beneath the sandstone bridge on its way westward to feed the salty lake.  The water trickles by quietly underfoot.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: The nearly nonexistent trail to the northeast grows to a respectable path as it progresses to the south.  Stray pieces of crumbled sandstone mingle amongst the fine grains of sand underfoot.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: As it follows the curve of the palace wall, the lightly packed sand of the path suggests its purpose as a scenic byway.  Unlike the more heavily traveled trade roads that cross the desert, this trail allows for a leisurely pace while partially sheltered from the sand-laden winds by the wall of Shorka's Palace itself.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Palace Wall]]
description: A broad patch of ground beside the wall offers travelers a place to rest, away from the traffic of the main road.  Chunks of discarded limestone, possibly left here since the building of the city, serve as makeshift seats.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road]]
description: Even in the dark, the waters of Lake Ratamipak are visible from this promontory, although it has the illusionary appearance of a flat dark desert plain that is spoiled only by a slight movement of its surface.  Making its way to the lake, the road begins descending to the northwest away from the city's plateau and towards the murky waters.

The pewter-toned waters of Lake Ratamipak are visible from this promontory, hazy with the constant evaporation that makes it difficult to determine where it ends.  Making its way to the lake, the road begins descending to the northwest away from the city's plateau and towards the murky waters.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road]]
description: Despite its well-traveled and productive nature, any sign of civic maintenance upon the road abruptly ends, with little more than a rocky path continuing to the west.  Several large stones have been pushed or dragged off the path, but were never carted away.  Some idle soul has skillfully carved a stylized representation of a dragon onto the side of the largest stone.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road, Rocky Path]]
description: The hardy scrub pines that have managed to survive and spread on this rocky slope are nearly invisible by night, but their dark shapes soften the hard edges of the sharp rocks and the unmistakable scent of pine fills the air.  The area has proven attractive to the local wildlife as well -- rustling noises can be heard as small animals move about, and intermittent calls of night birds also break the silence.

Clinging desperately to the surrounding stones and life itself, twisted and stunted scrub pines have colonized the area, surviving off the rare gift of moisture from the lake to the west.  Ignoring the wonder of life's indomitable nature around them, destitute laborers carrying heavy packs of salt occasionally ascend the path, starting their long trudge back to the city gate.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road, Rocky Path]]
description: Just above the shoreline, an irregular patchwork pattern of saltern ponds spread out along the shore of the lake in spots of dull pewter, reflective blue, dun yellow, and bright white dependent on which stage the particular pond is in.  Surrounding the road are innumerable rocks covered with a fine edging of salt encrustation from water blown off the lake and deposited here.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road, Rocky Path]]
description: The road ends here where the salt flats begin, between the poorest of the salterns.  Low walls of clay-rich soil divide the irregularly shaped pools of water, fed by a system of tiny canals and moveable wooden chutes that carry salt water from the nearby Lake Ratamipak.  The ponds around the end of the road here are furthest from the lake, giving them the least access to water and going through fewer production cycles, making them marginal investments.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: At the northern end of the shore, only the most meager of ponds are present.  Ill-supplied by the complicated network of waterways, these salterns are among the poorest to be found here, some little more than troughs.  Even the crews on the ponds seem less professional, showing an edge of desperation or despair in their sluggish activity.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: A cluster of salterns is at the stage of moving its cargo back to the city.  Laborers occasionally approach the pathway next to stacks of heavy sacks stained a dusty white, awaiting their loads for the long trudge back to town.  In a pool next to the abrupt rise of hills to the east, workers shovel out a layer of sand that has cascaded down into the pond, ruining the current production cycle.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Junction]]
description: A strange contraption squats in the middle of the intersection -- a sort of tall round hut on stilts with a maze of wooden waterways radiating outward.  With three spouts along its sides, a large bronze pipe delivers water to the channels.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, west.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak, Shoreline]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Life seems rare even here, despite being the only large body of open water in the entire Velaka, no doubt repelled by the intense saltiness of the lake water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak, Shallows]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Smooth and level, the lakebed forms an even plane that leads deeper into the nearly stagnant tarn.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Here away from shore, the bottom drops off rapidly, making it difficult to move further out into the lake.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Courtyard]]
description: Darkly colored flagstones pave the courtyard, swept clean of any desert sands that may have blown in.  The featureless stones leave no cover for any intruder that might have breached the gate of the old fort, giving the arrow slits high up on the walls an ominous character.  A wide set of stone stairs leads up to the main entrance of the old keep.

A set of iron lamps has been hung from tripods to illuminate the dark flagstones between the gate and the stair for those that might traverse the courtyard.  Those that wander beyond the soft glow of the lamps have nothing more than the dim light that seeps down into the enclosure to show them the way across the bare stone.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  The lakebed dips lower, forcing the hardly moving water to form a small eddy that ebbs and flows into itself.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west.

title: [[Velaka, Beside the Heke'mhhg]]
description: In the shadow of the sandstone bridge, the waters of the Heke'mhhg seem tenebrous and oily.  A cluster of dead weeds sways restlessly at the river's edge, the dried husks persisting despite all odds.
The shelter of the sandstone bridge deflects most of the Velakan climate.  A cluster of dead weeds sways restlessly by the river, the dried husks persisting despite all odds.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Entryway]]
description: The tall main doors of the keep have been left open to allow the easy traffic of bank patrons to the wide stairs that lead down to the courtyard.  Equally lofty windows flank the door with their aged iron shutters propped open, permitting a view of the flagstone courtyard and the passage of breezes rather than footsteps.  Passageways lead both ways around the immutable stone core, drawing the visitor further into the old keep.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Passageway]]
description: The curved stone walls of the passageway are blank, save for a few strategically placed wall sconces bearing torches to light the way.  Old rugs have been stretched across the floor to absorb the noise of passage, but seem to do a better job capturing the dust of the desert tracked in by bank patrons.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak, Mouth of the Heke'mhhg]]
description: The cloudy water of the Heke'mhhg River pours into the dark and murky Lake Ratamipak, churning up silt and salt in the process.  The process causes a long, serpentine trail to form in the water, reaching toward the center of the lake like a narrow, forked tongue.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak, Shoreline]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Life seems rare even here, despite being the only large body of open water in the entire Velaka, no doubt repelled by the intense saltiness of the lake water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest.

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: A patchwork pattern of settling ponds blankets the area.  Dull and uninteresting to the average eye, they are nonetheless a continuing source of riches and wealth.  From these humble beginnings, the extracted salt travels to every corner of Kermoria, putting coin into the pockets of traders along the way.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Windmill]]
description: A stumpy windmill stands at the shore, its diminutive scale not preventing it from being the tallest object in the vicinity of the irregular geometry of settling ponds.  With a slow and quiet "thump, thump, thump," the pumps the windmill drives feed the complicated system of tiny canals and sluices that keep the ponds going.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: One of the most successful clusters of ponds is located here at the south end of the flat.  Workers carrying torches move quickly and efficiently between tasks, giving the scene an almost mechanical quality.  Seated on a raised platform in the center of it all, a plump foreman smiles benignly over his tiny kingdom.

Seated on a raised platform in the center of it all, a plump foreman smiles benignly over his tiny kingdom.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: Strangely organized and tightly packed ponds of various sizes force traffic into narrow, regulated pathways that twist and turn with sudden odd angles.  Nevertheless, the paths are often busy with the coming and going of gleaners and laborers carrying torches who walk unperturbed beneath the water channels and walkways suspended overhead.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: The hills end abruptly before the edge of Lake Ratamipak, leaving a narrow pocket of flatland that has been completely covered with ponds to recover salt from the waters of the grand lake.  Workers carrying torches routinely tend the salterns, filling them with water, removing debris from the ponds or harvesting the precious salt.

Workers routinely tend the salterns, filling them with water, removing debris from the ponds or harvesting the precious salt.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road]]
description: As it intersects with the Heke'mhhg river on its journey through the Velaka, the road rises here slightly to accommodate a great brass pipe that passes beneath it.  The cylinder allows the water to flow by unimpeded, passing out of sight under the path and palace wall alike.

title: [[Saltern Shore, Settling Ponds]]
description: After years of service, a large pond has been pulled out of the regular rotation for maintenance.  Workers repack the soil at the bottom of the pond to reduce leaking, while others laboriously scrape away at the yellow buildup of salt encrustations on the walls.  Bypassing the pool for now, water gurgles overhead in a wooden canal suspended on piles of rocks and the odd wooden pole.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak, Shoreline]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Life seems rare even here, despite being the only large body of open water in the entire Velaka, no doubt repelled by the intense saltiness of the lake water.

title: [[Heke'mhhg River]]
description: Briny water rushes by, sweeping through its narrow desert path like an oily snake.  The banks of the river bear telltale saline stains, collected over many years from the murky river that has left them thoroughly encrusted with salt.

title: [[Heke'mhhg River]]
description: Briny water rushes by, sweeping through its narrow desert path like an oily snake.  The banks of the river bear telltale saline stains, collected over many years from the murky river that has left them thoroughly encrusted with salt.
