title: [[The Crossing, Esplanade Eluned]]
description: Hustling businessmen mingle with grimy dockworkers and indolent strollers here, all proceeding at very different paces.  Handcarts filled with baskets and burlap bundles are pushed by stout, young lads past ladies decked in their finery.  Most of the well-heeled leisure set seems to be headed to and from the freshly painted dock here.  Some private boats and pleasure craft are moored to it.

title: [[The Crossing, Drayhorse Trace]]
description: The constant clamor of hooves on cobblestones echoes off the walls of the distribution centers, granaries, magazines, and storehouses that border the street in this part of town.  Horse-drawn flatbed wagons, mounted merchants on fine steeds, and carriages bearing regal ladies all clatter by, raising whorls of dust.

title: [[The Crossing, 3 Retainers' Crescent]]
description: Here the way diverges from the riverbank and is set off as it connects between major arteries leading to the commercial heart of the Crossing, the water transport hub, and Longbow Bridge.

title: [[The Crossing, 3 Retainers' Crescent]]
description: There seems to be great confusion along this narrow stretch of road, as folk of all races and professions pass by and overflow the curbs.  They spill into the street to better make their way, crisscrossing at no particular corner, and running in front of lumbering wagons, darting handcarts or mounted travelers.

title: [[The Crossing, 3 Retainers' Crescent]]
description: The Longbow Bridge is due east, as the river flows beneath it, just at the edge of your vision.  To the south is the Shipyard and The Strand, a pleasant beach where the two rivers that define the life of the Crossing meet.  To the west are the commercial institutions that are the centers of trade and finance.

title: [[The Crossing, Chieftain Walk]]
description: This busy threeway is a vital link.  The Longbow Bridge feeds into it from the northeast, and the warehouse and dock district which stand to the south and west bustle with activity.  The commercial district to the northwest, and the pleasant and populous beach resort are to the southeast, just at the mouth of the River Oxenwaithe, where it empties into the Segoltha.

title: [[The Crossing, Chieftain Walk]]
description: The warehouses and low buildings to the northwest resolve into a flat, open stretch of turf to the south, where the two rivers that shape the Crossing begin to come together.  This level alluvial delta is home to the Crossing's main shipyard, where many of the barges, ferries, frigates, merchant ships, and corsairs that ply the rivers and seas of Elanthia are built.  The weathered shipyard gate leads southeast.

title: [[The Crossing, Esplanade Eluned]]
description: The promenade here is a pleasant place to stroll along the riverbank and watch the activities on the broad and swift Segoltha River.  The walkway is broad and clean, paved with bright red bricks forming whimsical patterns and abstract designs.  The breeze off the river is invigorating.  Several young hawkers try to peddle snacks and flowers to families or couples out taking the air, while merchants and seamen rush by.

title: [[The Strand, Sandy Path]]
description: Light filters through a line of trees as you make your way down this cheerful dirt path.  A narrow clearing affords you a view of sandy embankments and the lapis-colored waters of the Oxenwaithe River.  A number of townsfolk and itinerant merchants greet you as you press along this thoroughfare.

The wind rustles through a stand of trees which line the path, their tops rising like dark shadows against the night sky.  Occasionally you encounter a lone traveller, but for the most part it is quiet here.

title: [[The Strand, Sandy Path]]
description: Following the roadside along the Oxenwaithe's bank, you are struck by the quiet beauty of the place.  Taking pause to breathe in the crisp, clean air, you reflect on your surroundings.  Sand, sparkling as if mixed with diamond dust, pours into deep blue undulating waters.  A lush copse of trees spreads to the north, while to the southeast, a series of delightful small buildings is set back from the river's edge.

You can hear the Oxenwaithe lapping gently at its bank, creating a soothing sound not unlike a lullaby.  The light reflected from the moons provide shimmery paths along the sandy embankments at water's edge.

timeto.8308: ;e unless (Account.subscription == 'PREMIUM' || UserVars.premium || ['DRF', 'DRX'].include?(XMLData.game)) then nil else 10 end

title: [[The Strand, Crystalline Beach]]
description: Several bungalows surround a large communal center sporting a long, wide veranda.  These form the heart of The Strand's resort area, providing respite from day-to-day concerns.  Each bungalow is a simple, single-story unit, positioned to afford an uninterrupted view of the delta where the Oxenwaithe and Segoltha meet.  Beyond the bungalows, sparkling sand stretches from a grassy knoll down a gentle incline, ending in a low ledge of rock pocked with tidal pools.

Several bungalows surround a large communal center sporting a long, wide veranda.  With the exception of a lighted window on the top floor of the center, all is silent and dark against the night sky.  The constant crash of waves upon a ledge of rocks at river's edge is the only sound you hear, save for the occasional bustle of a resort worker on the communal center's veranda.

title: [[The Strand, Crystalline Beach]]
description: Sand continues to stretch from east to west.  Children of all races can often be found at the water's edge, playing games or building ephemeral castles.  To one side, a grove of spreading Wyndwood trees provides the perfect spot for quiet meditation, while further off, several braziers set on piles of rock indicate that this is a favorite picnic location.

The gently rushing waters of the Segoltha fill the air with a pleasant drone.  Traveling along the riverbank, you chance upon a large picnic area dotted with iron braziers set neatly on low rock pillars.

title: [[The Strand, Crystalline Beach]]
description: Short grasses and flowering dirdel provide a carpet in the sand along this part of the Segoltha.  A jagged rock juts out of the water just beyond the river bank, its dark surface streaked with deep green moss.  A group of Nadira turn lazy circles just off shore, no doubt hunting for their next meal.  In the distance, lovers walk arm in arm along the river, while a lone beach-goer scours the sand for unique shells.

Short grasses and flowering dirdel provide a carpet in the sand along this part of the Segoltha.  A jagged rock breaks the surface of the water just off shore, obscuring part of the starry sky.  The intermittent chatter of a family of nesting Nadira birds reaches your ear.

title: [[The Strand, Old Pier]]
description: This short pier juts several yards into the Oxenwaithe.  There's a nice mix of recreational vessels bobbing up and down at their moorings, while a larger fishing boat is tied to its end.  A salty old fisherman, following his daily routine, sits at the end of the pier, whistling a merry tune as he repairs the holes in his net.  Occasionally he glances up, nods, and returns to his work.

This short pier juts several yards into the Oxenwaithe.  There's a nice mix of recreational vessels bobbing up and down at their moorings, while a larger fishing boat is tied to its end.  Beyond the pier, the Segoltha runs lazily by, glimmering in the light of the moons.

title: [[The Crossing Docks, South End]]
description: A cacophony of smells erupt from this bustling area, most notably those of ripe fish and new wood.  Created especially for handling passengers arriving from or departing to outlying towns and provinces, the dock is often lined with ships of varying types and sizes.

title: [[Crossing, West Gate Battlements]]
description: The fitted stone of the town walls intersects in a curved angle, one side becoming the western wall and the other stretching out against the northern border of the town.  From this vantage point above the West Gate, a warrior can watch for enemies breaking from the cover of the northern forest or sweeping up from the grassy plains to the southwest.

title: [[Crossing, West Wall Battlements]]
description: The cobbled pavement atop the walkway crumbles into the unfinished wall as it stretches south toward the Segoltha River.  The view over the wall of lush grassland and farms is a stark contrast to the sight of the slums and squalid buildings that line Kertigen Road.

title: [[Crossing, North Wall Battlements]]
description: Rounding the city's northwestern-most point, the cobbled walkway stretches a short distance before being interrupted by an unfinished section of the town wall.  Although a stack of felled trees evidences the logging in progress, the forest is still perilously close to the new defenses and provides would-be attackers protective cover.

title: [[Crossing, East Gate Battlements]]
description: From this height, Ulf'Hara Keep is visible in the far distance, and southward flows the churning Segoltha River.  Two of the wall's embrasures contain signal pots, an archaic backup should gwethdesuan or thoughtcast fail.  The cobbled walkway here is directly atop Crossing's eastern gate, overlooking the road into town.

title: [[Crossing, South Wall Battlements]]
description: The town wall turns southwest, following where the old earthen wall once stood.  In the distance, the cabins of Riverpine Circle are visible through the embrasures.  The Segoltha River runs near the town wall here, bringing with it the sound of rushing water and sailors' shouts.  Further south, the cobbled walk dissolves into the jagged rock of the unfinished town wall.

title: [[Crossing, East Wall Battlements]]
description: The roof of a tall oak tower abuts the town wall's inner side, just feet below the cobbled walkway.  Scattered stones and feathers among the droppings dappling the roof suggest that a favorite pastime of the soldiers stationed here is chucking rocks at roosting birds.  From the crenellated outer wall the view is uninspiring: broken hovels and barren land marking the biting poverty of the Middens.  Northward, the cobbled walkway abruptly ends at the jagged rock of the unfinished wall.

title: [[The Crossing, Bazaar Walkway]]
description: Gently sloping above the shops along the eastern side of town, this elegant acanth walkway connects the bustling bazaar to the Hodierna Way, providing merchants and shoppers a quick and guarded way to reach the local bank.  Gilded rails and posts protect the pedestrians from misstepping off the bridge, while adding an element of beauty that complements the rich acanth wood.

title: [[The Crossing, Bazaar Walkway]]
description: Bowing gracefully above the Town Green and the shops along Albreda Boulevard, the raised walkway leaps across the skyline, connecting the bazaar to Hodierna Way.  Merchants heavy with coin bustle quickly towards the bank, while more leisurely shoppers wander across the gilded walkway, pausing sometimes to admire the view of Crossing -- the spherical shape of the Temple majestically rising above the city proper.

title: [[The Crossing, Bazaar Walkway]]
description: Rising over the Mongers' Bazaar and Crossing's Town Green, this acanth walkway is expertly built with sturdy, thick planks and gold rails and posts.  Stretching north to south across the rooftops of the city, the walkway allows an excellent view of the surrounding area.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Square]]
description: Set into the center of the bazaar's main square is a bronzed fountain depicting the fatherly figure of Divyaush, his long chiseled beard covering the top of his robes and his painted azure eyes gazing into the water below.  Children and shoppers stop on their way past, often wetting their hands or their faces in the cool clear water.  To the southwest, brightly covered pennants sail above the sea of canvas that is the Traders' Market tent.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: Shoppers and merchants bustle through the bazaar, stopping every now and then at the call of a good price.  To the east, towards the center of the bazaar are several tents, beckoning thrifty buyers with their brightly colored canvas and beautifully painted pennants.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: Skirting the hedge surrounding the Town Green and lying just below the walkway, the somewhat shaded grounds of the southern bazaar are more subdued than the rest of the market, allowing shoppers to catch their breath before mingling back into the crowds.  The sound of splashing water draws attention to the tall bronzed figure of Divyaush to the north, all that is visible of the great fountain at the center of the bazaar.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: People mill about the market like scavenging rats, waiting to snatch up the best bargains before their money sieves out of their pockets.  Traders, merchants and freelancers scout the market with their goods in arms or in tow, hoping for a quick sell out.  To the northwest, the tent to the Traders' Market can be seen, its pennants a marker for the center of the bazaar's financial activity.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: The scent of pack animals and crowded people invade the nostrils, while the cries of sellers calling out their merchandise are forever prevalent within the marketplace.  Rising in a rainbow of color to the west are the large tents that mark the center of the bazaar.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: Set along the path where the east and north sides of the bazaar meet is a long, oaken bench, offering a respite for those needing to get off their feet after plodding their way through the bazaar.  Every so often a bird or two flutters down, hoping to grab a morsel left behind by an untidy passerby.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: The cries of hawkers fill the marketplace night and day, spinning stories about the history of their wares, or shouting secrets of their usefulness.  Shoppers steadily mill about, some wide-eyed and some skeptical, all looking for the perfect item on which to spend their money.

title: [[The Crossing, Mongers' Bazaar]]
description: Some ramshackle stalls and tattered tents comprise the informal flea market known as Mongers' Bazaar.  The springy grass of the Green has been trampled into foot-sucking muck by folk seeking bargains, black-market goods, or unusual trinkets.  Exotic items of rare power and value are sometimes sold here by the itinerant vendors who flock to The Crossing from all corners of Elanthia.

title: [[Riverfront Portage, Barge]]
description: The barge is flat and wide, though not very deep.  Tarpaulins and oilcloths are spread under and over heaps of commodities bound upriver, the pride of the town's diligent traders.  Several horses, a few goats and chickens raise a ruckus in the corner, right next to the only passenger seating, an empty crate.  The river laps against the barge as a few drops of spray brush your face and start the chickens to squawking again.

title: [[Riverfront Portage, Dock]]
description: The planks of this river dock float directly on the water's surface.  Tied together with thick ropes, they pitch and yaw as though you were already aboard a vessel.  Cold, greenish water sloshes up through the gaps and soaks your feet.  A group of Gor'Tog bargemen, garish tattoos on their bulging arms, scowl at you and laugh derisively.  A very discomfited dwarf stands at the water's edge of the dock, most anxious to return upriver to his mountain fastness by the swiftest means possible.

title: [[The Crossing, Alfren's Ferry]]
description: Alfren's Ferry is a privately owned and operated ferry that carries folks over the broad and swift Segoltha River.  The ferry does a brisk business, since the trade route to the Elven forest reaches lies south across the river.  In the face of hostile assaults, the river serves as a formidable barrier.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Entrance]]
description: The magnificent and renowned grey granite edifice of the Asemath Academy stands here before you.  Solid and impressive, the buildings surround a wooded courtyard.  Though severe in decor, there is no denying the high Elvish heritage in the design and execution of this learned establishment.  Famed far and wide for its scholarship and teaching, many come here but few are allowed to enroll in its varied courses.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Crossing Misc Interiors, Gaethrend's Court, and Asemath Academy
meta:mapshortname:Crossing Misc Interiors, Gaethrend's Court, and Asemath Academy

title: [[Asemath Academy, Porte-cochere]]
description: A flagstone pavement and a covered porte-cochere lead into the grounds of the Academy.  West of you the campus opens out into a series of lovely wooded gardens with the buildings arranged in a quadrangle all around it.  Students and professors stroll about, engaged in deep discussions or forming small study groups under the trees.  To either side of the entrance are the administration offices and the admissions center.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Eastern Walkway]]
description: A walkway paved with crushed stone in a soft blue-green hue runs between tastefully arranged copses of trees in a large central open area.  The trees show signs of Elvish life-sculpting and form harmonious groupings that display their dense foliage to perfect advantage.  Here and there, groups of flowering bushes or plantings of bright blossoms lend a serene touch of color to the scene.  Groups of students wander about or study quietly.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Central Fountain]]
description: Here in the center, at the very heart of the Academy, a fountain stands.  Carved with cunning and skill, it represents Knowledge pouring out her wisdom to a thirsty world and the academy's founder stooping to drink deeply of her gift.  Coins glitter in the pool, tossed there by superstitious students hoping for luck on an exam.  Walkways lead from here in several directions to other parts of the institution.
A fountain gurgles cheerfully somewhere nearby and the scent of plants and flowers fills the night air.  You stand in a large open space but you can sense the presence of buildings nearby.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Western Walkway]]
description: This walkway, shaded by trees, leads back to the kitchen and dining areas for the students and staff.  Believing that a full stomach aids the mind in learning, the founder provided that every student shall be well fed.  The cooks take this dictum to heart and there is always the smell of fresh pies or a good roast drifting on the breeze.  Several students sit nearby, working their way through their lessons and a large pile of fresh lemon cream tarts.
Trees block even the starlight and you see almost nothing.  Somewhere, someone is baking something wonderful to judge by the scent.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Western Hallway]]
description: This hallway divides the refectories from the kitchens.  There is a bustling of servants as they clear out the remains of the last meal and prepare for the next.  Students everywhere are perpetually hungry it seems.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Western Hallway]]
description: The hallway ends here with the school kitchen's pantries and staff dining area.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Staff Refectory]]
description: This compact and elegant room serves the teaching staff as their dining room.  Small tables seat either two or four and softly padded chairs covered with fine leather are placed at each.  Crystal globes hold candles on each table that shed a soft golden light.  Crisp white cloths cover the tables.  The walls are painted with scenes of legend with themes of education and learning predominating.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Student Dining Hall]]
description: This is the dining room for the students.  Plain trestle tables and long benches are racked up against the wall so the staff can scrub the flagstone flooring.  At meal times this place gets very crowded and noisy as the students relax from their studies and fill themselves with the fine food served here.  The walls are an off-white, scrubbed till it gleams and the tables are made from a light-colored wood, bleached almost white as part of their cleaning.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Southern Walkway]]
description: This path leads to the Performance and Arts wing.  Lined with low shrubs, alternating with small statues showing actors and other performers, the path is set with crushed white stone.  Many performances are held here to which the public is welcome and the art gallery is often open to the public for a small fee.
Dim humanoid shapes seem to rise up on both sides.  You tense for attack but realize with a start that they are but statues arrayed along a walkway.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Artists' Hallway]]
description: This hallway is wide and high-ceilinged.  Often crowded before a performance, it is heavily carpeted, with upholstered benches scattered about.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Path of Wisdom]]
description: The path here goes from the library entrance out to the quadrangle.  Low bushes line the walk and the path is smooth and well-paved.  The doors of the library gleam almost mystically here in the shaded light.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Admissions Center]]
description: This large room is busy at all hours of the day with hopeful people wishing to be admitted to this prestigious academy.  Harried clerks hand out application packets and explain rules and procedures to applicants.  Promising students are interviewed quietly at one side of the room and those who pass will be brought back for testing and more interviews.  The air is full of the smell of fresh parchment and nervous people.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Administration Office]]
description: The administration office is staffed mostly with students working off their rather steep tuition fees.  Rows of plain desks covered with stacks of papers and untidy piles of scrolls are crammed in everywhere.  The elegant stonework of the walls still delights the eye, but the necessity of paperwork and the burden of success make the atmosphere a trifle less than stimulating here.  A senior clerk perches on a high stool with a desk to match and oversees the chaos.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Freshman Walk]]
description: This path leads to the classroom used by the beginning students and has come by tradition to be called 'Freshman Walk'.  Scrupulously avoided by upperclassmen, it is an item of humor if a senior student has to go this way.  The path itself is laid out in soft green paving stones and the border is lined with benches for outdoor studying.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Freshman Library]]
description: Books lie piled, sometimes waist high, in irregular stacks along the walls, in corners, and on a few cluttered desks.  Multicolored pillows scattered across the floor provide students with a comfortable seat and add to the tiny library's casual atmosphere.  A shelf along the wall houses dozens of volumes, the works of the Crossing's own talented writers.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Freshman Classroom]]
description: Long tables in neat rows face a lectern made of ebony wood.  Straight-backed chairs with no padding sit closely together at the tables.  The walls are a dusty rose colored marble and high windows allow a pure light in for clarity of seeing.  A large sign hangs on the wall above the lectern.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Northern Walkway]]
description: This walkway leads to some of the classrooms of the Academy.  Lined with sweet-scented flowers, it is a pleasant place to be almost any day of the year.
You stand on some sort of stone walkway.  There are pleasantly scented flowers nearby and in the distance, you can hear a fountain splashing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Auditorium]]
description: This hall, used for lectures and other presentations, can hold the entire student body and faculty of the Academy.  Rows of benches for the students and chairs for the professors are arranged before a low platform for the speakers or guests.  The room is done in polished rosewood walls enlivened with woven hangings in abstract patterns.  Brass and crystal lightglobes hold candles for evening presentations.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Classroom]]
description: This classroom is done in tones of golden yellow and a gentle aqua.  Brightly varnished desks and chairs form neat rows facing the instructor's desk.  A large map of the world is hung from the front wall and a smaller map of some region unknown to you hangs next to it.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Classroom]]
description: This large classroom is used at various times for general instruction and the more specialized classes.  Worktables with chairs sit in rows facing a larger table and lectern.  The walls are painted a cheerful powder blue with cream accents  and the tables are painted a soft grey.  In one corner, a group of anatomical skeletons are grouped for comparison.  The students have nicknamed them "The Board of Regents".

This large classroom is used at various times for general instruction and the more specialized classes.  Worktables with chairs sit in rows facing a larger table and lectern.  The walls are painted a cheerful powder blue with cream accents, and the tables are painted a soft grey.  In one corner, a group of anatomical skeletons are grouped for comparison.  The students have nicknamed them "The Board of Regents".

title: [[Asemath Academy, Kitchens]]
description: These are the kitchens of the Academy.  Full of hustle and bustle most days, the cooks and scullery maids work long hours keeping the students and staff well-fed as the rules of the Founder dictate.  There is a large fireplace with several roasting spits and a huge cauldron for making soups and stews.  Heavy tables hold trays of fresh fruits and vegetables.  Racks of trays stand ready to hold their loads of breakfasts, lunches and dinners.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Pantries]]
description: This room is crowded with barrels and crates and sacks of food of all kinds.  Bins full of flour, ice-boxes with cold meats and perishables and all the other things needed to keep a large assembly of very hungry people fed are in here.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Gallery of Fine Arts]]
description: This room is a gallery for all manner of art.  Paintings adorn the walls and niches hold statues of many sorts.  Large skylights bring in a flattering light and the north end of the room is set aside for use as a studio for painting and sculpting.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Founder's Theatre]]
description: This theatre is large enough to hold the entire staff and student body as well as at least a hundred more.  Comfortable seating slopes down to a raised stage so that all have an excellent view.  Dedicated to Asemath the Founder, one seat in the front row is always left vacant as a tribute to his efforts in building the Academy named after him.

title: [[Asemath Academy, Library Hall]]
description: The library of the Academy is famed far and wide for its large collection of printed works on the Arts and Sciences.  A wall-long shelf holds this treasure securely against time and wearing.  Many comfortable chairs and low tables are scattered about for the ease of readers and several desks are available for the more serious scholar.  Several students are sprawled out in chairs reading and one is at a desk, crouched over a parchment, scribbling away on a notepad.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: An enormous tower of grey marble rises imposingly from the ground, its stones fitted so closely that it appears to be one seamless spear of earth.  The top of the tower gleams brightly, the light reflecting from the panes of a skylight set into the roof.  A set of gleaming ebonwood doors inlaid with gold lead into the tower.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: Rising above the surrounding lands, the stone walls of Arhat's tower end in jagged edges that pierce the sky.  The small path continues to the north, leading towards a larger tower of freshly-cut silvery-grey stone.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: The small path curves slowly northwards, heading farther and farther away from the protection of the Crossing's gates.  Arhat's tower, once home of the Warrior Mage Guild, lies in a crumbling heap of stone to the west.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: The small path skirts the shattered remains of Arhat's tower to the west, and branches off to the east.  The low mound that forms the ruins of Motte Fort lies to the southeast, and just east of that the solid stone walls of the Keep of the Ughtensgard.  Another tower, capped with a gleaming crystal dome, is visible farther southeast.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: The tower's immolation has opened the area to new lighting where once the mighty shadow lay.  A profusion of new growth will thrive amongst the rubble.  The circle of life repeats itself, creation from destruction.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: The once pristine tower of the Warrior Mages is now no more than a memorial.  The stresses of the great fire have shattered the crystalline spire.  The building stands broken and raw against the sky.  One onyx door tilts wildly to the side, its hinges melted to slag, while the other has been reduced to rubble.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Birder Lane]]
description: Flocks of screeching ravens cloud the sky overhead, and wrens, larks and other feathered creatures seem to be hovering about as if awaiting something.  An enormous black crow stoops and whooshes past your ear, only to land on the head of one of the more hideous gargoyles projecting from the facade of the black tower due east.  The crow appears to be watching your every move.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Birder Lane]]
description: One of the gates of the Crossing lies before you to the northwest, and a steady stream of adventurers flows by.  You notice a high proportion of wizards, grey-bearded and fierce-eyed, leaning on staves or muttering to themselves or their familiars.  A small lizard barely escapes death underfoot, and you pay more attention to where you tread, lest you inadvertently do in some Mage's favorite pet.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Outside Northeast Gate]]
description: You are before the Northeast Gate of the Crossing, surrounded by wayfarers and adventurers also in mid-journey.  Above, guardsmen stare down from the thick stone wall that encloses the city, wary for hostile visitors.  Whether they travel to destinations in town or farther west, or to the north and east, they all appear to be seeking something beyond themselves.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grimsage Way]]
description: The narrow path here is bounded on the south by mats of decomposing water plants and swamp grasses.  The stench of marsh gas and the thrashing of slimy, watery things in the rotting reeds keep you from exploring in that direction.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Bramble Thicket]]
description: A small, thin path meanders through an otherwise daunting thicket of brambles here.  Directly to the north is a dark, slate outcropping, while east lies a tall, attenuated tower.  The exterior of the tower is covered with carvings of fantastic and legendary beings and creatures, whose awesome and powerful visages you can discern even from this distance.  Through the foliage, you see the town gate to the west.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Farmlands]]
description: Rich farmland surrounds the road on both sides.  The fresh scent of the tilled soil rises all about you.  Southward, the walls of a fair-sized city rise near the banks of a glistening river.  A faint haze of smoke hovers over the town, blurring the outlines slightly.  To the north, distant hills rear up against the grey-blue horizon.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Farmlands]]
description: The scent of freshly-tilled earth rises from the farms on both sides of the road.  Heavily-loaded wagons and carts brimming with produce wend their way southward towards the walls of a city set near a glimmering river.  You note an amazing variety of races and types that are driving their goods into the town.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Farmlands]]
description: Neatly planted rows of grain mingle with tidy plots of vegetables covering the rich earth of well-tended farms along the wide road as it wanders across the land.  A farmer waves at you as he toils along behind a yoke of sturdy oxen that pull a heavy iron plow through the fertile soil.
Empty fields lie sleeping beneath the blanket of night.  The scent of plowed earth mingles with the fragrance of fresh growing things.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Farmlands]]
description: Open grassland mingles with small farmsteads as the wide road passes through a cut where a low hill rises.  The road is edged with tall hedges, apparently to keep cattle from wandering into the orchards and vegetable plots you see beyond the heavy, guarding branches.  Some distance to the south, you see the smoke and haze of a city of some size.  Northwards, low hills rise against the sky.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Grasslands]]
description: Cattle wander aimlessly across the road as they crop at the rich grass growing in the rolling fields.  You spy a lone cow-herd nodding under a shade tree off to one side as his charges amble into your path in large numbers, enormous brown eyes gazing soulfully at you as they pass.
Dark shapes of cattle stand, outlined against the night sky, as they huddle together in sleep.  Somewhere nearby you hear the bark of a dog -- the herd has not been left unguarded.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Grasslands]]
description: Open grassland mingles with a thinning forest from the north.  Here and there among the trees cattle wander.  They casually dine on the lush grass and occasionally reach up to consume the delicate leaves on the lower branches of the trees.  To the north, low hills rise up gently from the plains.  Southward, a heavy haze or smoke can be made out.

Open fields to either side can be dimly seen.  Faintly, there comes a trace of woodsmoke, perhaps from the campfires of local herdsmen warming themselves against the night chill.  Nearby, a rounded shape proves to be that of a sleeping cow.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Forest]]
description: Trees to both sides of the road thin out southward where the land changes to open grassland.  Large grey squirrels leap across the road overhead from branch to branch and chitter down at you as they regard you with curious eyes.
Trees rise dimly along the roadway and you can faintly hear a quiet chittering, perhaps from sleepy squirrels annoyed at your disturbing their rest.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Woods]]
description: Widely scattered trees stand aloof, like strangers at a party, barely noticing one another's presence.  Northwards, the open land nearby changes into a few low, rolling hills.  Like a bare head rising above thinning hair, the hills stand out from a fringe of trees about their base.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Open Forest]]
description: Growing in the shade of towering oak and fir trees, azalea bushes add bright splashes of color to the brown-green gloom of the forest.  Tangles of ivy creep alongside the trail and cloak the trees in jade filigree.

The darkness of night grips the forest tightly, like a black-gloved fist holding back the light of dawn.  The staccato questions of owls echo from the boughs far above, while lower to the ground the cries of unseen creatures ring through the trees.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Open Forest]]
description: Longleaf pine and spruce outnumbering the hardwoods in the area drip a sticky sap that sugars the underbrush, and litter the trail with needles that crunch underfoot.  Spanning the branches of a stunted sourwood tree, an orbweaver's web twitches slightly with the struggles of a small fly.
The air is heavy with the scent of pine and the sounds of scree littering the trail crunching underfoot.  A large web spanning the branches of a stunted sourwood tree glistens in the moonlight.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Edge of the Forest]]
description: Thin pine saplings, field laurel and shrub grass form a narrow border on the edge of the forest.  The darkness of the close-set trees to the northwest rustles with unseen movement, while the open grasslands stretching out to the west breathe quietly the open air.

Thin pine saplings, field laurel and shrub grass form a narrow border on the edge of the forest, a blending of life easily yielded to either side.  The darkness of the close-set trees to the northwest bustles with unseen movement, while the open grasslands stretching out to the west breathe quietly the open air.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Grassland]]
description: Swift breezes ruffle the tall grasses beneath the wind-scoured sky that stretches far above like a pale awning.  Sprays of orange and purple wildflowers attract the attention of a few butterflies, who flutter across the trail.
The rhythmic chirping of crickets hums from the tall wind-swept grasses pressing inward on the narrow trail.  Moths hover close, flying in looping patterns toward any glint of light.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Grassland]]
description: To the northwest, a copse of birch trees stand thin and stark against the sky, the swift breezes animating their skeletal forms in a gentle dance.
To the northwest, a copse of birch trees stands thin and stark against the sky, the swift breezes animating their skeletal forms in a gentle dance.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Forest]]
description: Trees grow tall here, but they are scattered enough to allow moonlight and a good view of the sky.  Northwards, the land rises into low hills that disappear against the black sky of the night.  To the south, a gentle plain opens outward.  A soft breeze rustles the leaves in the boughs overhead in a pleasant susurration.

Trees grow tall here, but they are scattered enough to allow sunlight and a good view of the sky.  Northwards, the land rises into low hills that disappear against the black sky of the night.  To the south, a gentle plain opens outward.  A soft breeze rustles the leaves in the boughs overhead in a pleasant susurration.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Near the Road]]
description: Rumbling carts from the North Turnpike lend a low bass to the sweet aria of field wrens, whose small choirs spot the meadow on either side of the trail.  Far to the north, a thick plume of grey smoke billows from the tall chimneys of a monastery.
The clatter of caravans on the turnpike rumbles low like thunder in the stillness of the night.  To the north, the lights of the monastery are visible, floating dimly in the darkness.
The clatter of caravans on the turnpike rumbles low like thunder in the stillness of the night.  To the north, the lights of the monastery are visible, floating dimly in the darkness.
The clatter of caravans on the turnpike rumbles low like thunder in the stillness of the night.  To the north, the lights of the monastery are visible, floating dimly in the darkness.
The clatter of caravans on the turnpike rumbles low like thunder in the stillness of the night.  To the north, the lights of the monastery are visible, floating dimly in the darkness.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: The road crests the highest of the low hills, wandering among the cracked and worn rocks scattered across it.  Removed from the road and set gently upon a hill, like a princess on her ivory pedestal, stands a rough circle of tall stones arranged in two concentric rings.  Rising unsteadily from the crown of the hill, many of the stones lean against one another or are completely toppled.  Perhaps a place of worship in ancient times, not even legend recalls who came here or what gods they served.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: Winding north and south over the brow of a low hill, the road is partly blocked by several roughly shaped stones that appear to have tumbled down from the hill crest above.  Small curls of a deep green vine have begun to wind the fallen stones into their embrace, and the tiny white flowers scattered among the leaves brighten the dull blue-grey of the stone.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: A series of low hills, barely worthy of note, rise to the south while northwards, wide open grasslands run unhindered into the distance.  Far off to the north, at the edge of the horizon, the faint shape of distant mountains can just be made out.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: Low hills to the south rise up from marshy land to the north.  Clouds of insects and tiny birds feeding upon them dart here and there.  The whine of millions of quivering wings combines with the thin rustle of the darting birds to form an annoying, discordant noise.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Marshy Meadows]]
description: The ground underfoot squishes with each movement, and moisture oozes into the traces left.  Low rocks set in ragged rows appear to mark a path along the swampy ground.  Gnats and midges clog your nostrils and fly into your eyes and ears in an endless cloud.  The air is thick with rotting vegetable matter and less identifiable odors.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Marshy Meadows]]
description: You travel in the midst of a boggy meadow.  The air is thick with a chill mist that blurs the outlines of anything not close by.  Pale rocks set along the path show the safest way to go among the almost trackless wastes.

title: [[Hilltop, Road]]
description: A peaceful valley, sheltered by the surrounding hills, is laid out before you like a patchwork quilt of flowery meadows and neatly arranged farmland.  Centered in this multicolored vista is a small village.  You pause on the hilltop to enjoy this delightful view.  A meadowlark circles overhead for a moment, warbling its song to you, before swooping down toward the village, following the line of a well-traveled road.

The moonlight reveals a small valley stretched out between the surrounding hills.  You can see a multitude of tiny lamplights twinkling in the darkness below, and faroff sounds of laughter and singing hover in the sweet evening air.  The faint outline of a road descends down into the night-cloaked valley.

title: [[Hillside, Road]]
description: A gentle breeze, carrying the sweet earthy scent of fresh herbs and flowers, rustles through the grass in the valley below you, making it flow like waves on an ocean.  A well-traveled road winds like a ribbon from a small village up to the top of the hill.

title: [[Valley, Village Gate]]
description: A large gate stands here, usually open to welcome travelers -- but wisely capable of closing to defend the residents within.  Traders, adventurers and farmers from the surrounding valley mingle here, moving in or out of the village at a leisurely pace, many of them Halflings.  A wooden wagon, carrying racks of freshly-baked meat pies, trundles into the gates, followed by several yapping dogs.  A neatly painted wooden sign is displayed in a prominent place.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Marshy Meadows]]
description: The ground beneath you is boggy and soft.  Swarms of flies close about you, and some land to drill into your flesh for a morsel of blood and to leave a stinging welt as a souvenir of your visit to their lands.  Northwards, the ground rises from the bog into open lands, while southward a mist obscures the view.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: Southward, the road dips into a boggy lowland, while to the north, open grasslands stretch.  No sign of habitation breaks the rippling waves of grass that grow shoulder-high to a tall Elf.  The air is alternately fresh with the smell of growing things and thick with the stench of the bog, as the wind veers aimlessly across the open land.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: Thick grass grows up to the edge of the road.  Despite the isolation and empty land, the road itself is in surprisingly good shape.  Large paving stones rest on a level bed, each one tightly fitted to its neighbor so that nary a weed or seedling can force a way between them.  Perhaps some vanished town lay near here that knew the value of good roads.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: The road runs straight as an arrow through the endless sea of tall grasses.  An occasional ripple among the stalks moving counter the wind shows there is life hidden beneath the green and gold surface.  The desperate flight of a covey of birds, as they break cover and scatter, shows that peace here is a shallow illusion.  For always the hunter awaits the careless and the weak.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: A ruined building sits alongside the tidy stone road.  The remains perhaps of an ancient tollhouse or inn, it lies at the edge of a forest that rises up from a wide swathe of grassland.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Forest]]
description: The trees grow about you in abundance, their tops brushing the sky, their leaves shimmering with the breeze.  The chirping of birds flows on the wind and there seems to be an almost sentient life to the wood, as if someone or something smiles beneficently on all the denizens and events that occur within the forest's boundaries.

The trees grow in abundance about you, their tops brushing the dark sky above, their leaves flittering against each other in the night breeze.  The soft sound of wings alerts you to the presence of a night hunter, and the broken-off cry that follows tells you that the hunter's prey has been found once more.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Forest]]
description: Low-lying taffelberry bushes grow about the tall deobar trees of the forest.  The scent of loam hangs thick and sweet in an almost tangible cloud.  The floor is carpeted with fallen leaves in the process of returning to the elements from whence they came, and some of the trees show evidence of having had their branches chopped off.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: The trees cluster close, weaving a dark green canopy through which light slants cautiously, making tiny pools that flaunt dancing motes of dust.  The air is heavy and still, thick with silence without even a birdsong to break the enclosing stillness.

The trees cluster close, weaving a dark green canopy through which no real light penetrates.  The eerie echoing cry of an owl as it hunts for prey threads through the latticework of the trees, shattering the deceptive peace of the forest.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: This is the heart of the wood, where the trees are the thickest and the outside world of skies and unforested land is the farthest away.  The trees grow close to each other, their leaves whispering back and forth, their crowns bowed in quiet conversation.  The silence is broken only by the sounds of a squirrel or similar creature's movements and the rush of a river coming from somewhere in the distance.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: Deobar trees tower over you, their leaves rustling in time with the sounds of the river to the north.  Quiet and serene, this part of the forest has a rich scent to it, the overlapping canopy making pools of gloom that collect beneath the trees.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Meadowlands]]
description: The forest to the south is thick and dark, a stark comparison to the open meadow around you.  Short, springy grass grows in soft mounds over hillocks and hollows.  Tiny white wildflowers peek out amongst the greenery, their petals open to accept the sunlight.

The forest to the south is thick and dark, a stark comparison to the open meadow around you.  Short, springy grass grows in soft mounds over hillocks and hollows.  Pale jes-roses dot the greenery, their sweet, nightblooming fragrance creating a heady perfume.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Meadowlands]]
description: The land here is open and welcome, the grass thinning on the western horizon as it makes way for a farmstead.  Nearby you can hear the babble of a river, and the vegetation shows signs that something, probably cattle, has been here recently to grab a quick snack.  The air is clean and sweet, inviting you to take deeper breaths.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Farmstead]]
description: Vast, empty fields lie fallow about you.  The remains of an abandoned farmhouse dominates your view to the northeast, its doorways gaping, its windows wide open like empty eye sockets.  Nearby, a plow lies rusting, its blade sunk a good two feet into dirt whose only future crop will be grass.  To the south the land is gradually returning to the meadow it originally was, the edge of creeping green vivid against the bare brown of exposed earth.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: The darker colors of the serrated wirgars grasses that grow in this particular part of the plains stand out against their lighter cousins.  You catch the scent of sirese on the wind, the fragrance of the tiny wildflower wrapping around you.  To the south the land turns a rough brown, shifting abruptly from plains to farming land.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: Blue sky and sweet winds mingle with vibrant greens and yellows to create a place that seems blessed by Hodierna herself.  Restless clouds chase each other through the sky, and the blithely cheerful songs of birds create a natural, if chaotic, symphony to be enjoyed by all.

The sky overhead creates an inky canvas upon which stars have been liberally splattered.  An evening wind, fragrant with the scent of night-blooming flowers, ruffles your clothing and cools the air.  Somewhere, a nightingale sings, whistling for its lover.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Kaerna Village Outskirts]]
description: The grasslands shimmer slightly, the gentle hand of the wind running its fingers through the plant life.  Here and there colorful wildflowers dare to peep their heads up through the endless browns and greens of the plains.  Dominating the gentle sighing of the grass can be heard the bustling sounds of the tiny village of Kaerna, surrounded by a wooden town wall which masks the village's graceless sprawl against the northern horizon.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: Under the shadow of eastern section of The Crossing's stone town wall, this footpath serves as a shortcut.  Barely wide enough for one person, thick brambles and brush allow passage in single file.   A few crevices in the wall make adequate handholds as you squeeze your way along the uneven ground and past thorny branches.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: The remains of a mudwren nest sits overhead in a rough section of the town's stone wall.  A newer nest is under construction just below it tucked within a chink of the wall.  Small birds dart through the tall brush, bustling as much as the citizens along the streets inside the gates.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: A gully eroded across the narrow way forces passage just next to the wall of the town.  Stagnant insect-infested water pools in muddy sections of the gully and a fetid odor of garbage saturates the air.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: The path turns from the city ramparts and forks south and west.  Toward the north it runs along the town's outer wall, the stone structure within reach.  Sheltered from wind and sun, little vegetation except for stray weeds manages to thrive.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: Crumbling mud bricks and loose rock lay in a pile near the sturdy stone town wall.  A small field mouse nibbles at a crust of bread, perhaps discarded from the wall workers' lunch portion.

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: The path winds in and out of a thick patch of stunted bushes near the exterior wall.  It emerges into an area of chipped rock where workers have dumped debris from the town wall's construction.

title: [[Eastern Tier, Footpath]]
description: Thin-leafed sedges and weeds grow densely enough to hide partially buried stones that can jarringly catch the toe of a boot.  The hiss of wind across the field creates a background for the music of a small cloud of midges buzzing at head height.
location: East Gate and Moon Mage Observatory

title: [[Outside East Wall, Footpath]]
description: A smooth, flat slate-grey outcropping abuts the stone rampart, the same slates that compose the hills and terrain to the west.  Bits of the slab have cracked and chipped, but for a few yards the path is wide enough to be called a path.

title: [[Eastern Tier, Footpath]]
description: Barely more than an animal track, this footpath can just be discerned through a field of sedge.  The weeds dull the sounds along the nearby road and city, leaving only the whisper of the wind all about.
location: East Gate and Moon Mage Observatory

title: [[Forest, A Quiet Path]]
description: A cool wind twists through the air, carrying the crisp scent of pine.   A generous carpet of needles and loam lines the ground, churning up dust that offsets the sharper smells with a sweet mustiness.  In the distance, a sparrow whistles, calling out an ancient melody that only others of its kind can recall the words to.

title: [[Forest, A Quiet Path]]
description: Solitary and overbearing, the trees of the forest loom over all they behold.  Caught in a game of one-upsmanship, the trees clump in groups that attempt to outgrow the other.  One particular tree, a massive blackwood, overtowers them all, its boughs extending outward in an embrace that gathers up the forest with arms of shadow and leaf.

title: [[Forest, Thinning Trees]]
description: A scattering of trees marks the edge of the forest as it fades away into a wide field to the north and thickens to the south.  Clumps of grass and wildflowers grow in smooth rolling hollows and hillocks of green, and a pleasant breeze cools the air to an amiable degree.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: Tawny grasses wave in a breeze rendered vocal by the whisper of the stalks rubbing together.  Here and there the field has been tramped down by the passage of careless feet, making paths that wind through the grasses in mazed patterns.  To the south a forest edges up against the horizon, clamoring for attention from the sky they would swallow whole.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: Weathered beams of wood poke up through the grass like children peering cautiously around for signs of a malevolent bully.  Bits of cloth and paper still cling to the greyed and splintered wood, remnants of a happier time now long gone.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: A sea of multi-hued grasses rises and falls all around.  From the deep greens of serrated seregrass to the tawny spun gold of common stalks, the panorama of color is incredible to consider, the palette of a crazed and yet highly imaginative painter.

title: [[Handfaster's Glade, Shrine to Saemaus]]
description: Soft-scented air fills the glade where patches of blooming tulips splash color against velvety grass tailor-made for bare feet.  A lattice arch, covered with the pink blooms of jasmine honeysuckle, embraces and frames a small altar created from a living plant.  Benches of polished wood invite couples to stop and bask in the beauty of the area and the warmth of heart's devotion.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Handfaster's Glade]]
description: The soft, subtle fragrance of pine and roses mingles in an intoxicating cloud that perfumes the air and lingers in hair and clothing.  A luxurious carpet of dark green unrolls within a circle of trees, the glowing reds, golds, and butter-yellow of dayroses adding color to the sea of emerald.  A small path winds away from the glade and back toward a small well that seems as far away as a dream.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Washing Well]]
description: Couched amidst a bed of shrubbery is an old stone and mortar well.  A rusted winch assures that the bucket that last descended down into the construction's depths remains a permanent resident.  Grasses grow up to spill down in streams around it, gathering in a thick crescent.  A small pool of water is cupped by the lush growth that collects at the foot of the well, the gossiping grounds of housewives long since gone.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grove]]
description: Slender aesaigo trees link their limbs and leaves together to form a loose screen of shade against the light.  The grass fades from amber to emerald as it sweeps west to east, its changing surface dotted with starflowers and buttercups.

Slender aesaigo trees link their limbs and leaves together to form a loose latticework through which the moonlight slips.  The grass is darkened to a monotone shade of grey, the flowers that dot its surface closed for the evening.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grove]]
description: Leaves dance in the swirl of a cool breeze as tall oaks and slim pines crowd against one another in a race for light and space.  Fallen pine needles and grass form a luxurious carpet, muffling footsteps and releasing sharp, clean scents into the air.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Grove]]
description: Vines curl around the trunks of the trees, displaying glossy green leaves with powdery grey underbellies.  The branches of the aesaigos shirk against one another, a mysterious sound.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: The grass stirs in slow patterns as a breeze -- the only permanent resident of the empty hinterland -- swirls over it.  Like a wave searching for a shore, the wind pushes back and forth over the changing shades and hues of the growth, hunting for a haven it will never find.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: Tiny, annoying gnats and flies whirr through the field, flying into faces and darting quickly away before they can meet their doom.  From time to time you catch a flash of movement as one of the local avians zooms in to snatch any particularly attractive or plump-looking bugs, but the sense of poetic justice is quickly erased as another buzzes in to take the place of the one that was consumed.
Cool breezes sweep the fields, visiting unto the parched vegetation release from the naked heat of day.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: An ocean of grass edges around the beaten-down path that curls precariously through the field's vastness.  With the wind steadily running its fingers through the grasses, the stalks rise and fall in a continual show of motion as inexorable and reflexive as a heartbeat.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: The soft chirr of insects hidden in the tall grasses mingles with the trilling of the nesting field larks that make their homes in the protective shade of the narrow-bladed but profuse growth.  You can catch glances of the tiny dun-colored creatures, their soft brown eyes peering up from between the criss-crossing stalks and their voices twittering questions that remain forever unanswered.

The inquisitive chirring of grasshoppers and the floating brilliance of glowbugs mingles in a complex dance through the air.  Moving to the sleepy tune of drowsing field larks, you can catch nothing but glances of the tiny creatures, their forms rendered shadowy and supple by the curtain of night.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: Great, rolling fields swallow up the world from one end of the sky to the next.  The natural perfection of the pristine grass is only marred by the paths that have been grudgingly trodden through them by the heavy feet of adventurers and their prey.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Fields]]
description: The subtle scent of hay and butter-yellow blossoms infuses the air with a fragrance that brings to mind summer breezes.  Crushed and tattered grasses form a ragged path through the growth, and the constant hum and buzz of insects lends a sense of drowsy solitude to the empty lands.

The subtle scent of hay and jes-rose blossoms infuses the air with a pungent scent.  Crushed and tattered grasses glimmer in the pale light of the stars as they form a ragged path through the growth.  The sense of solitude and emptiness is overwhelming.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Village Gate]]
description: A picturesque village extends north from the town gate.  Quaint buildings, built specifically for those of short stature, border the lanes.  A kaleidoscopic array of color is displayed in every direction ... in the clothing of the Halflings, the painted buildings, and the lushly-hued blossoms covering the neatly tended beds and flowering trees.  A house, constructed to accommodate the hired Human guard, is situated next to the gate.  He stands at ease, casually perusing the incoming traffic.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Taffelberry Path]]
description: Taffelberry Path, named after the favorite food of the Arthe Dale residents, is a straight, well-kept lane that heads further into the village to the north and back to the village gate to the south.  A group of rollicking Halfling lads passes you, laughing and elbowing each other, as they move eagerly toward an attractive red building to the east.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Inn Courtyard]]
description: This is the courtyard of an old-fashioned country inn, stoutly constructed of red brick.  Beds of cheery marigolds border the building, while a colorful signboard hangs from a sunflower-yellow awning above the door.  Sounds of laughter and happy conversation drift from an open window.  A little dirt path curves around toward the rear of the inn.

The door of this stout brick building stands open, and warm light pours out invitingly.  A large signboard hanging from an awning sways in the breeze, making creaking noises that accompany the sounds of laughter, singing and merriment coming from an open window.  A little dirt path curves around toward the rear of the inn.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Taffelberry Path]]
description: Open areas flank both sides of the path at this point.  A charming little park extends to the west, and an open-air marketplace is situated to the east.  A Halfling pushing a wheelbarrow filled with fresh vegetables heads toward one of the market's wooden stands.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Greensward]]
description: This charming park is alive with a medley of brilliant colors and sachet scents coming from the beds of primrose, hollyhock, larkspur and delphinium.  An iridescent green hummingbird darts from flower to flower, trying to avoid a group of giggling Halfling children who are rolling and somersaulting in the grass.  The carved garden bench looks like a pleasant spot to sit and enjoy the scene.  You can see a small shrine to the west, while a thumping sound comes from beyond the bushes to the north.

The park takes on a special magic at night when the tall spires of white delphinium and the beds of evening primrose luminously reflect the moonlight with a silvery glow, adding a delicate perfume to the night air.  A young Halfling couple passes you, strolling hand in hand and whispering softly to each other.  A carved garden bench provides a peaceful place to sit and enjoy the pleasant stillness of the night.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Shrine]]
description: A simple shrine has been erected in the niche of a large stony outcrop.  Moonflower vines climb the column, twining their way around the opening, their brilliant white blossoms providing a festive border.  A carved figure of Glythtide has been set inside the niche.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Greensward]]
description: A giant oak tree stands erect here, its massive branches reaching out to form a canopy over the local swimming hole.  Some sort of wooden structure is nestled in the foliage high up in the tree.  The grassy area surrounding the swimming hole appears to be a perfect spot for picnicking or lounging.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Farmers' Market]]
description: The Arthe Dale market is bustling with activity day and night.  Early morning travelers often stop in to chat with other adventurers, as they look over the local farmers' bountiful displays of fresh produce and home-baked treats, while late night visitors to the adjacent inn's common room usually come by for a sobering cup of hot coffee before heading home.  Plain wooden tables and benches offer a place for snacking, rest or conversation.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Taffelberry Path]]
description: The path continues north and south, lined with a row of colorful sicle trees to the east and low bushes to the west.  A small meadow mouse, alarmed by your approach, scurries through an opening in the bushes.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Greensward]]
description: This section of the park is an unadorned grassy strip, edged with low bushes.  At the far end a painted target has been set up.  A large number of rocks lay discarded at its base.  A Halfling man whirls his sling and sends a stone hurtling toward the target, hitting it dead center with a loud thunk.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Crossroads]]
description: The village's three main paths meet at this intersection.  Attractive shops with brightly colored awnings line Glaysker Lane to the east.  The quiet, shrub-bordered Tanglefoot Row heads north to the residential section, and you can see the village gate at the end of Taffelberry Path to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Cul-de-sac]]
description: The path circles around a bed of dark green ivy that has grown up over a white statue standing in the center.  A bright yellow building with blue shutters and colorful flowerboxes faces you.  There is a painted sign mounted next to the open doorway.  A Halfling female, her nose stuck in a notebook, wanders by, almost bumping into you as she heads toward the building.  She absentmindedly knocks on the sign (for luck?), as she enters the doorway, still concentrating on her notes.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: The pale lavender-pink glaysker flowers that have been planted along the length of this cobblestone street breathe a subtle sweet fragrance into the air.  Your eye is caught by an attractive display in the window of a simple white cottage with a thatched roof and a light purple awning.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Tanglefoot Row]]
description: Tall, neatly-pruned hedgerows line the street, providing some privacy for the homes beyond, where Halfling residents move about, absorbed in domestic chores.  On one side a small woman hangs freshly washed pink and yellow sheets from a line, and on the other a man works at whitewashing a fence.  A small dragonfly whirs past you, alighting on one of the hedges briefly before continuing on its journey.

Tall, neatly-pruned hedgerows line the street, providing some privacy for the homes beyond, where warm lights glow in the darkness.  In one window, you can see a small man playing a fiddle, and a foot-tapping tune is carried down the lane with the breeze.  Another frames a Halfling couple standing in a lit doorway, lovingly gazing at their sleeping children.  A radiant firebug hovers in front of you for a moment before continuing on its journey through the night.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Tanglefoot Row]]
description: A small dwelling has been built into the side of a hill here.  White curtains flutter in the windows that open out from the sod-covered walls.  Several small carving tools have been left on a wooden bench, and bits of wood shavings lay discarded below it.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Tanglefoot Row]]
description: The lane ends to the north at the eccentric home of Arthe Dale's oldest, largest and wealthiest family, the Tanglefoots.  A freshly-painted white picket fence surrounds the property, and you can see a large well-tended yard beyond it.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: A curious arrangement of objects has been grouped on either side of the doorway of a building, which is almost completely obscured by the entangled maiden's tress vines that grow up the sides and over the roof.  Stuffed animals, stone statues, pieces of furniture, a sundial, and assorted carved walking staves form a bizarre tableau.  A statue next to the door holds a plaque.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: Small shops line the lane that bends from the northeast to the west.  A shamrock green awning tops the doorway to a yellow building with a matching green sign mounted on the wall.  A single pure note from a melancholy flute floats out from the doorway.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: As you pause for a moment on the cobblestoned lane, your eye is caught by the entrance to a squat stone building with a blue awning.  A dazzling silver sword has been securely mounted to the arched entryway above a small engraved plaque.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: The festive glaysker blossoms that edge the lane provide a striking contrast to a homely wooden shack that sits unadorned and colorless at the side of the path.  A plain wooden signpost stands at the shack's entrance.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Taffelberry Trail]]
description: Large oak trees line this well-traveled trail as it winds its way towards a secluded community nestled among the surrounding low-lying hills.  Wind-borne glaysker seeds have found a cozy home at the base of some of the trees, growing in an array of lavender and pink blooms.  Clay pots of carefully tended taffelberry bushes sit at measured intervals along the path.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Glaysker Lane]]
description: A rounded building with a turf and flower-covered roof sits here at a sharp bend in the lane.  The round white door almost seems to provide entry into a small flowery hill.  Large beds of purple glaysker and bright yellow oralana flowers border the building.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Taffelberry Trail]]
description: The hills encircle diminutive knolls clustered about a small village green within the valley.  The hardened earth of the trail forks to meander its way past humble homes constructed within each knoll.  The scent of ripened berries wafts on the breeze.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Loganberry Place]]
description: Simple white arbors stand at the entrance of each path to the knolls.  Plump purple loganberries dangle amongst the deep green leaves of the bushes.  A copse of oak trees lines the back of the lots, creating pools of ever-changing shadows upon the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Blueberry Lane]]
description: Thick groves of oak trees lightly forest the surrounding hills of the valley.  Neatly trimmed blueberry hedges line this quiet lane that runs along the west side of the village green.  A thick carpet of lush green grass encases the cozy knoll homes that sit off the lane up stone-lined walkways.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Village Green]]
description: An immense oak tree shelters a clear, sparkling pond beneath its leafy branches that canopy the village green from the weather.  The thick roots of the tree have broken through the compacted earth in several places, lending themselves as places of rest to the local citizens.  Stone-lined dirt pathways, like spokes of a wheel, venture toward the surrounding knolls.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Blueberry Lane]]
description: The lane rises slightly to the northeast as is continues to circle around the edge of the valley.  A small circle of simple wooden chairs shelters beneath the boughs of a nearby oak, offering a place to sit at the day's end.  Trimmed mounds of blueberry bushes, laden with their deep blue pearls of sweetness, border the green to the southeast.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Loganberry Place]]
description: The stone-lined road continues from the northeast to the west, separating the grass-covered knolls to the south from an enormous tree at the center of the community.  Yellow and orange mums circle around the base of a a smaller oak at the side of the path, bobbing their bright, flowery heads in the breeze as if dancing in a merry child's game.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Strawberry Way]]
description: A strawberry patch has found its way from a nearby home to a white picket fence that borders the east side of the village green.  Weaving their way around each wooden picket, the strawberry vines create a tapestry of bright red teardrop fruits nestled among deep green leaves.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Strawberry Way]]
description: The scent of sweet strawberries fills the air surrounding the stone-lined path.  A cord of wood sits neatly stacked by one of the colorful round doors that decorate the surrounding knolls.  Near the woodpile, a hatchet sits partially buried in a stump, awaiting its next call to duty.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Boysenberry Crest]]
description: Skirting along the southwest base of a large hill, the road curves its way easterly past peaceful dwellings as it continues to wrap the edge of the village green.  Small tended gardens of herbs and flowers snuggle up to the walkways of the homes within the knolls.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Boysenberry Crest]]
description: Brightly painted round doors mark the entrances to the grassy knolls that border the northwest side of the road.  A single boysenberry plant in the corner of one yard has been trained to grow as a tree, its tangled branches reaching down to sweep along the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Olallieberry Circle]]
description: A large, round hill separates this exclusive part of the community from the daily hustle and bustle nearby.  The deep green grass on this side of the hill is carefully manicured to the perfect height, nary a blade poking above the heads of its neighbors.  An olallieberry bush with its large, ruby-red fruits weaves itself through a picket fence that borders the brick path.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Olallieberry Circle]]
description: Ornately carved round doors mark the entrances to the affluent homes set in perfectly manicured knolls of dark, grass-covered earth.  Well-tended gardens filled with an abundance of flowers hug closely to each doorway, showing a year-round display of bright colors and pleasant scents.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Olallieberry Circle]]
description: A paved brick road circles around the large hillside to meander through this affluent portion of the village.  Trained to grow over a pristine white wood arbor, a nearby olallieberry bush tempts passersby with its brightly colored fruits dangling amidst bright, green leaves.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Apple Blossom Lane]]
description: An old-fashioned country lane wends its way east beneath the sheltering overhang of flowering cherry trees.  Tiny thatched-roof cottages and other homes line the lane, surrounded by picket fences and neatly tended flower gardens.  The faint sound of children's laughter can be heard from some of the homes.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Apple Blossom Lane]]
description: Apple blossoms drift in the wind, fallen from the flower-laden branches of the gnarled trees which shade the narrow lane.  Neat cottages stand side by side, some of brick, others of weathered cedar shingles, others with whitewashed wooden clapboards.  A covered well, gathering place for local housewives, stands beside the road.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Gooseberry Road]]
description: The road runs alongside a sparkling brook that splashes as the water tumbles over smooth rocks lining the streambed.  Several homes nestle in the low-lying land around the brook, surrounded by neatly tended gardens.  A bench swing hangs from a tree branch beside the road, swaying gently in a passing breeze.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Apple Blossom Lane]]
description: A stunted apple tree stands beside the lane, blackened and broken by a lightning strike.  The splintered branches have been carefully trimmed and stacked, drying for use in the winter's fires.  Several cottages stand nearby, their neatly cropped lawns and tended gardens evidence of industry on the part of their owners.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Apple Blossom Lane]]
description: The lane ends at a shallow pond surrounded by weeping willow trees.  A weathered pier juts out over the water, where residents from nearby homes may relax near the cool water in the summertime or catch a fish or two for the evening's meal.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Gooseberry Road]]
description: A tangled thicket of gooseberry bushes lines the road to the south.  Nearby, several small homes are scattered about, some near the road, others set back a ways to offer a modicum of privacy.  Cheerful windowboxes filled with pansies and geraniums add a splash of color to the tiny houses.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Gooseberry Road]]
description: Pale white jasmine blossoms dangle amidst deep green waxy leaves on a whitewashed trellis, their fragrant nectar attracting a flock of brightly colored hummingbirds.  A low-pitched drone fills the air as chubby bumblebees float amidst the blossoms, their legs covered with a profusion of yellow pollen.  A local homeowner has taken advantage of the nearby flowers, erecting a beehive on the lawn to produce his winter's supply of honey.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Gooseberry Road]]
description: The road rises to the crest of a low hill, giving a view of the nearby town.  Farmland spreads out around the village, while neatly thatched cottages and brick homes line the streets.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Gooseberry Road]]
description: Several homes nestle in a hollow at the base of a hill, sheltered from the elements by tall poplars and fir trees.  A brook runs nearby, surrounded by mossy rocks and deep green ferns which thrive in the shady setting.  Lush patches of wild lady's slippers bob their pink and purple petals as a breeze gently brushes across the orchids.

title: [[Marja Tee, Tula Veraja]]
description: A well-worn road winds its way through the valley, between a small town and the adjoining farmlands.  A proliferation of berry bushes crowds the edges as if trying to reclaim the portion of land heavily rutted by wagon and cart wheels.  To the north a village gate beckons weary travelers.

title: [[Marja Tee, Tula Veraja]]
description: Berry bushes and green shrubs grow between the trunks of elm and birch trees.  Sparrows flutter out of the high branches to light gracefully on a twig, grab a ripe berry, and wing back to their perches.  In the distant northwest a small village can be seen.

title: [[Marja Tee, Musikaz Masi]]
description: Tracks left by wagons laden with heavy cargo mar the road with deep ruts.  A multitude of blackberry bushes, full of plump berries, mingle with a few scattered trees that line each side of this wide byway.

title: [[Marja Tee, Musikaz Masi]]
description: The road crests a small hill covered with ripe blackberry bushes.  Dozens of squashed berries have been imbedded into the packed earth by the wheels of overloaded wagons.  Occasionally a bird swoops down to greedily grab a tiny black treasure from a mature bush.

title: [[Marja Tee, Orjamakaz Niitto]]
