description: Small shrubs growing in tight clumps line the road on both sides.  Nestled in the brush are dense clusters of briarberry bushes with tiny berries hanging from woody stems.

title: [[Marja Tee, Orjamakaz Niitto]]
description: Meandering gently through a dense meadow, the road is evenly covered in tiny stones laid to smooth the rough terrain.  Endless rows of briarberry bushes, cultivated and harvested for their woody roots, border each side of the wide road.

title: [[Marja Tee, Orjamakaz Niitto]]
description: The road continues its trek through the lush meadow.  Flowers of all kinds grow haphazardly among dense groupings of briarberry bushes filled with bright red berries.  Irrigation ditches filled with rainwater line both sides of the road.

title: [[Marja Tee, Orjamakaz Niitto]]
description: A wooden cart filled with freshly dug briarberry bushes is parked on the side of the roadway.  Coveted for their woody roots in the making of tobacco pipes, briarberry bushes are carefully harvested annually by the local Olvi families of the area.  Deep in the meadow, you can see a small group of Olvi thinning the denser clumps.

title: [[Marja Tee, Orjamakaz Niitto]]
description: The road narrows a little here, as briarberry bushes laden with heavy plump berries mingle with wild cinnamon shrubs that fight to reclaim this well traveled byway.  Scattered amidst the dense brush are a few birch and elm trees, with occasional clumps of pink clover peeking through the heavy brambles.

title: [[Marja Tee, Girio Masi]]
description: Hardy, wild cinnamon shrubs grace both sides of the road as the path widens.  Their leathery leaves offer an open invitation to a mass influx of butterflies that migrate to this area in the spring.  Occasionally, the sound of small wildlife can be heard scurrying beneath the compact bushes.

title: [[Marja Tee, Girio Masi]]
description: The road crests a small hill flanked by dense clumps of wild cinnamon shrubs.  A multitude of migrating butterflies can be seen fluttering amidst the bushes, their beautifully colored wings complimenting the deep green of the leathery leafed shrubs.

title: [[Marja Tee, Marja Poosa Sappa]]
description: A shallow gully runs across the road at the bottom of a small hill.  Thick walls of bushes grow wildly like untamed hedgerows bordering the road.

title: [[Marja Tee, Marja Poosa Sappa]]
description: The road here snakes through some of the thickest bushes and brambles.  Fragrant cinnamon mixes with sweet raspberry in a panoply of earthy, spiced scents.

title: [[Marja Tee, Marja Poosa Sappa]]
description: Bushes and vines grow wildly, high enough to block out most of the sky.  The road dips and weaves through high bushes and snarls of vicious brambles.

title: [[Marja Tee, Marja Poosa Sappa]]
description: The narrow road rises up to the peak of a small hill, rife with tangled bushes.  A broken, berry-stained wooden pail lies shattered on the side of the road.

title: [[Marja Tee, Marja Poosa Sappa]]
description: The path glides gently down a low rise toward the open ocean.  A small step ladder stands to one side of the road, overcome by creeping vines of bramble and raspberry.

title: [[Marja Tee, Kaber Jise]]
description: A soft breeze carries the faint scent of the sea from the east.  The road begins to widen as if to hasten travelers towards the shore.  Interspersed with bramble and berry bushes are wild sirese flowers, their bright blooms swaying gently in the wind.

title: [[Marja Tee, Babukaz Masi]]
description: Dozens of wild raspberry bushes intermingled with clumps of sweet woodruff attempt to encroach upon the widening road.  Small woodland critters scamper beneath the brush, knocking ripe berries to the ground.

title: [[Marja Tee, Babukaz Masi]]
description: Atop a small hill, the road crests just high enough to see a bay to the east.  The fresh smell from the sea is strong and mingles with the scent of ripe raspberries that hang from the many bushes attempting to trespass upon the widening road.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Busar Saaf]]
description: A small harbor with several brightly painted docks cheerfully greets seafaring visitors to the small community of Arthe Dale.  A few seagulls can be seen greedily pecking at ripe berries pilfered from the many bushes that flank a road leading westward.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Bungles's Backyard]]
description: A cobblestone walk lined with lush taffelberry bushes points the way to a large greenhouse nestled amid colorful thornberry shrubs and maiden tress vines.  Brightly painted wooden benches are scattered around a small pond that rests at the base of a large mound dotted with fiddlehead ferns.  The greenhouse's glass door has been cheerfully painted with colorful flowers of all shapes and sizes.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Gooseberry Loop]]
description: A copse of brown, dried trees blocks all view of the community to the north.  The pot-holed path continues to the east, past abandoned knolls covered with patches of dried grass and the occasional tall, green weed.  Torn curtains flutter in the breeze through a nearby broken window.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Gooseberry Loop]]
description: Dry, matted grass and tall weeds cover the nearby abandoned knolls.  A gooseberry bush near the edge of the path has turned feral from neglect, becoming a wild tangle of thorny branches with nary a single berry in evidence among its browning leaves.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Gooseberry Loop]]
description: Islands of undaunted weeds appear in a sea of bare, parched earth along the path.  Broken pieces of furniture lie scattered across the yard of one home, some of them burned, others merely torn apart as if for sport.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Community Garden]]
description: Row upon row of cabbages, carrots, potatoes and turnips have been planted in this garden plot.  The industrious Halflings of Arthe Dale have maintained it well.  The rows are neatly arranged, and there is not a weed in sight.  A tiny ladybug flutters from plant to plant, sometimes thrown off her course by the gentle breeze.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Community Garden]]
description: A large section of the garden plot has been set aside for the small shrubs of deep green glossy leaves that bear the village's beloved taffelberries.  The branches of the low-growing bushes are laden with juicy black berries.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Community Garden]]
description: A modwyn vine arbor stands on the eastern edge of the garden.  Heavy clusters of grape-like modwyn fruit hang temptingly, waiting to be picked.  A large, low vat sits off to the side of the arbor.

title: [[Ruined Tollhouse, Interior]]
description: Heavy stone walls lean drunkenly on each other, like tipsy soldiers staggering into the night.  Somehow, the roof has remained mostly intact, providing a modicum of shelter and warmth.  The remains of a fire, now cold and lifeless, show that others have sought refuge here as well.  A broken stone table is the only furnishing yet left to this abandoned station.  In all, a sad reminder of busier times on this ancient road, when traffic and trade must have been much heavier.

title: [[The Militia Shack, Inside]]
description: Not much is left of this building except mice and a few ratty blankets.  It seems well and truly abandoned, of no significant notice whatsoever.

title: [[Kaerna Village, By the Well]]
description: The Northern Trade road runs like an arrow through the small town of Kaerna.  Composed mostly of ramshackle daub and wattle houses, the most distinguishing feature of Kaerna is its inn, which looms protectively over the other, smaller establishments.  Less a town and more a waystation than anything else, the tiny wooden-walled village hugs the road with a tenacious determination.

title: [[Kaerna Village, Intersection]]
description: Even in the cool of the night the village remains active.  A soft, cheery glow shines from the windows and open doorway of the Gilded Unicorn Inn, and a few traders are yet about; checking their camels, inspecting their wagons, or preparing for the morning's excursions to come.  The stars overhead seem to stretch on forever, the moons smiling benevolently down on the sleeping village.

The main activity of the town seems to be concentrated here where traders, villagers, and travellers from afar gather to exchange information or engage in a bit of bartering.  Presiding over all of this is the Gilded Unicorn Inn, the largest building in the village as well as the best kept.  Far from the bustle and turmoil of the big city, its doors are always open, a lantern or candle always lit.

title: [[Journalai Route, Kaerna Outskirts]]
description: The grasslands lap like waves at the edge of Kaerna Village to the east.  The small, dun-colored houses of the town endure silently, islands in a sea of green.  To the west the land begins to take on a more rolling form, an abrupt and unusual change from the endless plains that stretch to the north and south.

title: [[Journalai Route, Open Grasslands]]
description: The grasslands here are caught between the presence of rolling hills to the west and the small village of Kaerna to the east.  To the north and south is nothing but empty plains, wind-twisted and long ignored by humanity.

title: [[Kaerna Village, By the General Store]]
description: A few residences huddle here, alternately shouldered up against the back of the Gilded Unicorn Inn and the sides of the general store.  The store is squat but neat, its exterior newly whitewashed and a small garden carefully cultivated outside it.

title: [[Kaerna Village, At the Well]]
description: The well has been craftily made of smooth interlocking stones.  A closer look reveals that no mortar was used in its construction despite its circular shape.  A wooden roof protects it from dirt and debris, and a fruitless modwyn vine twines all around.  Dappled shadows created by the moonlight give this place a sense of mystery and wonder.

The well has been craftily made of smooth interlocking stones.  A closer look reveals that no mortar was used in its construction, despite its circular shape.  A wooden roof protects it from dirt and debris, and a fruitless modwyn vine twines all around.  The grass beneath you is springy and soft, inviting you to lie down and dream the days away in the warmth of the sun.

title: [[Kaerna Village, Near The Well]]
description: Meandering eastward from the village well, a grassy footpath follows a gentle decline away from the bustle of the Northern Trade road and through a small copse of oak and aspen trees.  Wildflowers grow in abundant banks on either side of the path, their delicate blossoms evolving with the seasons in an endless, ever-changing cycle of color and fragrance.

title: [[Kaerna Village, A Grassy Footpath]]
description: A chattering brook traverses the footpath in a stony bed, its crystal waters dancing and sparkling over smooth grey rocks and the deep brown remnants of long-fallen logs.  Embedded in the soft earth either side of the stream, a broad ironwood plank forms a narrow bridge, allowing visitors to balance across the brook and continue eastward toward the village gate.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Gate]]
description: A low sandstone wall runs around Lower Kaerna, the modest proportions of the perimeter suggesting the villagers have few enemies other than the occasional adventurous bovine.  The village gate struggles with the attentions of a voracious ivy that pokes its brazen fingers into every nook and cranny of the surrounding stone and clings determinedly to the pristine paintwork.  An ironwood plank leads west across a nearby stream.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Green]]
description: The gate opens onto a charming village green surrounded by quaint cottages and tranquil rural lanes.  In remarkable contrast with the fervent activity of Kaerna's west end, the rustic simplicity of Lower Kaerna envelopes the senses and blots out any memory of life on the trade routes.  No matter what activity might be taking place on or around the green, nothing here is done at any pace greater than an amble.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Green]]
description: Running along the south side of the green, a narrow path leads past a group of tiny cabins that almost disappear into a thick copse of aspen and sweet chestnut trees.  Despite their modesty, each humble dwelling appears spotlessly clean and diligently maintained, their secluded location in the village's only uncombed spot is clearly a careful choice made by fastidious and discerning people.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Green]]
description: The village pond occupies the best part of the northwest green, its brown waters rippling with the fussy antics of ducks and the occasional splash of a jumping fish.  Around the edge of the pond, tall bulrushes sway gently in the breeze, parting just enough to grant a glimpse of moorhens and a pair of haughty swans nesting silently in the shallows.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Green]]
description: An old wagon wheel idles in one corner of the Green, as if to remind visitors to leave their work behind them and succumb to a more placid way of life.  Between its spokes, the green-keepers have planted a variety of low shrubs, the contrasting hues of their foliage creating a fascinating monument to indolence resplendent with different textures and colors.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Green]]
description: Overlooking the carefully-tended lawns of the village green, a row of smart stone and thatch cottages enjoys a pleasing, scenic location.  Four vast oak trees stand aside the narrow road at the edge of the green, their thick trunks and spreading boughs dark with age.  Rooks' nests form a rambling roost along many of the branches, sending forth the occasional raucous squawk as one feathered resident disputes territory with another.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Blythe Lane]]
description: Between a pair of whitewashed lodges, the rustic beginnings of Blythe Lane lead off from the green to bring a pleasing impression of the surrounding countryside into the village.  The lane itself is actually a narrow, stony path bordered by vigorous cowslips and flowering nettles which flourish in cool, verdant banks outside snug homesteads and at the feet of overhanging sycamores.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Fourways]]
description: By Lower Kaerna standards, Fourways is a throbbing thoroughfare, given that the only two roads of any size meet here.  Even so, the pace of life is relaxing to say the least, and those few folk who do choose to pass a moment here do little more than watch the world go by.  A small bronze statue on a stone pedestal occupies the central point of the crossroads.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, High Street]]
description: A row of neat homes runs across the northern side of the green, the grandly-named High Street more of a country lane than the major artery its nomenclature might suggest.  Each dwelling here seems to take great pride in its prime location, presenting to the public a meticulously maintained facade complete with colorful curtains and window-boxes brimming with seasonal blooms.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, High Street]]
description: Overlooking the lilies and willows growing in and around the village pond, the homes here have a sleepy look about them, their light curtains blowing softly from the wide-open windows which typify this safe and peaceful hamlet.  There is little activity to disturb the tranquil silence, save for the intermittent chirp of a bird or a soft splash of fin or feather in the quiet waters.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, High Street]]
description: High Street continues its gentle progress to the east, its smooth sandstone paving diligently swept free of any dust and debris which might settle for half a moment.  The homes which claim this part of town are slightly larger than the average Lower Kaerna cottage, and each owner clearly takes great pride in preserving the superiority of the neighborhood.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: Just north of the comparative bustle of Fourways, Lady Alice Drive begins its easy dawdle around the upper end of the village.  Countless rows of neat cobbles run the length of the lane as it curves past immaculate cottages and snug lodges, each home a picture-perfect tribute to the houseproud families who populate this tiny town.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: Carefully planted in evenly spaced rows of fat wooden buckets, miniature fir and poplar trees line the drive with splashes of deep green.  Complementing the neat display, oaken planters bursting with seasonal blooms adorn the windowsills of many of the homes, combining the beauty of the wild with the modest gentility of the village.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: The tantalizing aroma of fresh-baked bread and cakes wafts about on a light breeze regardless of the time of day, as if many of the locals spend most of their time steadfastly producing confections in industrious and cozy kitchens.  A trestle table standing in the garden of one cottage bears a tempting selection of the day's culinary produce, proudly offered to passers-by for the sampling.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: A constant, fresh breeze slips around the crescent, its long journey down from the mountains and moorland beyond Kaerna drawing to a close in the sleepy hamlet.  From time to time, the sharp fragrance of pine and the peaty smell of damp earth wends its way into the village, giving a gentle reminder that there is indeed a wider, wilder world outside the encircling walls.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: The drive narrows to little more than a carriage width here, squeezing between two matching whitewashed cottages that stand aside the passageway as if expecting to take tolls from passers-by.  A lush modwyn vine climbs recklessly up the side of each building, attracting a wide variety of dazzling butterflies and tiny birds to the deep tangle of its foliage and slender branches.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Lady Alice Drive]]
description: A narrow, cobbled lane leads off from the quiet end of High Street and forms a gently arcing crescent from one side of the tiny village to the other.  Lined with quaint thatched cottages and charming sandstone dwellings, Lady Alice Drive meanders through the serene village like a lazy smile, encouraging travelers along its sedate curve to adopt a pleasureable, unhurried gait.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, High Street]]
description: Many of the homes here have matching curtains and gardens displaying identical selections of shrubs and blossoms, suggesting the sense of community in Lower Kaerna is particularly strong.  Large, wrought-iron flower baskets hang from tall blackwood poles at intervals along High Street, their lively displays of trailing ivy and seasonal wildflowers adding a simple yet elegant adornment to the street.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, High Street]]
description: High Street draws to a close in a crescent following the curve of the village wall.  A half-circle of homes occupies the spacious turnaround, their sparkling windows and glossy paintwork a gleaming reflection of their owners' pride.  A box privet hedge borders the walkway around the crescent, intermittently giving way to numerous white gravel paths that lead to the front door of each dwelling.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Blythe Lane]]
description: Enclosing the path, a tall hawthorn and beech hedge thins out periodically to allow passage through to the cottages and cabins which nestle peacefully in their woodsy lots.  Thin plumes of blue-grey smoke drift from squat chimneys and waft across the lane in a faintly shifting haze, bringing to mind reassuring memories of hearth and home.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Blythe Lane]]
description: Blythe Lane draws to a drowsy close inside the village wall, where a bank of aromatic thyme and lavender grows strong and robust beneath the vine-clad grey and yellow sandstone.  Several of the homes in this area boast a similar display of scented herbs in their front gardens, infusing the air with a memorably pungent perfume reminiscent of a warm, dewy morning in the countryside.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Kaerna Outskirts]]
description: The wooden wall surrounding the tiny waystop of Kaerna is a visible line drawn between the plains and hamlet.  Thick grasses and shrubs growing against the protective barrier seem intent upon reclaiming the village's side-by-side buildings for the prairie.  Off to one side stands an abandoned militia shack, a silent casualty to the ongoing war between civilization and nature.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: The wind rushes through the grass, making a soft shirring sound.  Occasionally you catch the crackle of movement or the twitterings of birds, but any sounds of civilization generated by something other than yourself seem like the sort of thing you would think up in a dream.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: Miles upon miles of uncivilized land lie before you, devoid of any sign of humanity.  A shifting sea of brown, green, and tan grasses rises about you, rustling with the movement of the occasional bird or butterfly that dares to plunge down into the vegetation.  A line of dark mountains rises to the north, shadowed and gloomy, they climb abruptly from the grasslands.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Foothills]]
description: The road rises along the curve of a low hill that slopes down to the south into open grasslands.  The rocky crest of the hill rises sharply above you as you toil along the well-kept roadway.  Local stones from the hillside have been smoothed and shaped to form the roadbed and the footing is good.  Northwards though, the hills shift quickly into steep mountains.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Foothills]]
description: You crest a low hill that gives a far-reaching view.  To the north a line of mountains rises steeply from the surrounding hills, while southward the hills fade out to forest and plain.  Far to the south, a heavy haze obscures the view, but you glimpse the occasional flash of open water.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Foothills]]
description: You travel through a small dell that rises northwards into a narrow pass.  You follow the path with your eyes until it fades from view among the steeply rising mountains.  Southward a low hill rises, bearing the roadway along its shoulders.  A Trader's Guild outpost sits alongside the stony trail.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Mountain Trail]]
description: The roadway is made from cracked stone that seems to have fallen from the steep rocky shoulders of a mountain whose flank forms a boundary along your path.  Rising steeply to the north and falling away to low hills to the south, the road cuts a narrow path among the mountains.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - NTR Vipers, and Rock Guardians

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Mountain Trail]]
description: You edge along a steep drop as the road narrows sharply in order to work its way along a narrow ridge of rock.  Snow-capped peaks tower overhead and an occasional eagle or hawk can be seen soaring on the high-road of the sky far overhead.  You envy them their direct routes as you gaze over the lip of the road and note the crumbling stone along its rim.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Mountain Pass]]
description: The road passes onto an almost level area as you work your way through a narrow gap in the mountains.  Huge boulders that have tumbled loose from the escarpments above you cause you to keep a wary eye out for more such unwelcome fellow-travellers.  A tiny roadside shrine has been erected here, perhaps by someone who made a lucky escape from such an avalanche of stone.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Mountain Trail]]
description: A huge boulder blocks much of the road, but room remains to squeeze by between it and the mountain wall.  One broken and shattered bone shows you that someone or something was far less fortunate in times past.  You look nervously up at the rock-strewn slopes above you and mutter a short prayer that the boulders rest easily these days.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Mountain Trail]]
description: The road rises sharply to the west as it wends among the steep mountains.  Eastward, it falls away into a narrow, heavily-wooded valley.  Evidence of frequent landslides shows in the piles of rock and small boulders that make passage here uneven and slightly risky.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wooded Valley]]
description: Thick woods grow heavily along the shoulders of the roadway, blocking both sky and sight after a short distance.  Several sets of wolf tracks are evident in the heavy leaf mould under some of the trees.  Troublesome travelers' tales describing the forest's dangers come to mind as the journey continues through the close-set trees.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wooded Valley]]
description: You come upon a small clearing in the heavy woods that allows a view of the sky.  A faint path can be made out that wanders into the trees, but it fades off before you can wonder about where it might lead.  There is an unnerving quiet here, even the wind seems to have died.  You feel a stranger in this wild place, perhaps an unwelcome stranger.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wooded Valley]]
description: Tall trees grow close along both sides of the road.  Small animals skitter among the branches overhead and dart among low-growing shrubs that eke out an existence in the deep shade of the forest.  Something taller than you has clawed the bark off a tree trunk several feet overhead and you wonder just where the beast that wore such claws is currently.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Foothills]]
description: Tall trees grow thickly to the south as the road climbs into a narrow valley.  Northwards, the land opens out into rolling hills that fade off into the looming shadow of several sharp mountain peaks, each distinct from the other.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Foothills]]
description: Heavily wooded hills rise on both sides as the roadway winds among them.  The air is dead and stale, any breeze is blocked by the trees and hills.  Clouds of gnats and worse seem to follow you, getting in your mouth and hair.  There is a faint smell of damp earth and rotting vegetation.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Rolling Hills]]
description: Massive flocks of small black birds wheel and dive among the low hills on either side.  They seem to be feeding on the dense swarms of midges and other insects that lurk in the heavy air.  A miasma of musty smells and unknown odors roils in your nostrils.  The ground to the north descends into a faint mist or cloud in the air.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Grasslands]]
description: A cloud of flint-dry dust rises on every breeze, making you sneeze.  For the most part, you see the grasslands about you in a state of decay and near death.  Mountains rising sharply in the south form a counterpoint to others, sharper yet, that loom northwards.  Saw-edged peaks and broken crowns indicate their origins as volcanoes in the not-so-distant past.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: Eroded wagon ruts cause you to notice that this road was once travelled with a greater frequency than it is now.  While safe from becoming overgrown by the dying grasses of the plains, this part of the trail is crumbling from disuse and the encroaching dust.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Grasslands]]
description: The winds veer around you, catching the grasses and your clothing in their grip and tugging like beggars vying for attention.   Flowers, closed for the evening, bob along in time with the lonely music the breezes create with the plains.  You can hear the babble of rushing water coming from the north.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, River's Bank]]
description: A narrow river rushes past you on its way southwest, its turbulent grey waters creating a deafening roar.  To the north the land changes dramatically from plains to the darker, more verdant green of meadows.  To the south stretches a narrow strip of grassland.  A sturdy wood and stone bridge spans the river, allowing safe passage.

title: [[Stream Bank]]
description: Smooth rounded pebbles, bleached by the sun to a pearly white, line the rocky bed of a sparkling stream.  Not much wider than a strong leap could carry you, the brook flows gently over clean stones, occassionally parting for a large rock thrust from its center.  Green clumps of reeds prospering along the grassy bank offer a safe haven to the shy water creatures which make their home here.

title: [[Silvery Pool, Waterfall]]
description: Cool tendrils of water slip down the rough surface of the mammoth stone outcropping, cascading to the rock's base with a sibilant whisper.  Water dances and leaps jubilantly beneath the waterfall, before rippling away in great waves, to finally die away and lie still at the pool's farthest reaches.  Along the banks, tall vilt reeds provide privacy for modest swimmers.

title: [[Foothills, Stony Incline]]
description: Taking the opportunity to examine the distant countryside, large green forests in the southwest, flatlands to the south and the large ocean expanse to the southeast all catch the eye.  All seem more attractive than the forbidding set of cliffs up ahead.

title: [[Lairocott Brach, Entrance]]
description: Placed in the wall of the sheer cliff that stands before you is a large stone door, currently blasted open.  Two large lifelike sentinels, one on either side of the door, have been scorched black.
Placed in the wall of the sheer cliff is a huge stone door with an arched top.  Two large lifelike sentinels, one on either side of the door, stand at attention in silence.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Abandoned Mine, and Stone Clan

title: [[Mountainous Route]]
description: Loose rocks from recent landslides cover the trail making progress slightly more precarious and slower.  A strong creeper seems to have won a battle with the steep cliff face and secured holds in the rock as far up as you can see.

wayto.7261: ;e fput 'stow left';fput 'stow right'; move 'climb creeper'; pause; waitrt?

title: [[Mountainous Route]]
description: Sparse scrub dots the landscape and the few bushes that manage to survive bear fruit that looks sickly.  A well worn path leads further up and back down the mountainside.  Though the path affords easy passage, the sheer cliff and the steep drop serve as reminders of the lack of escape routes.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Entrance]]
description: A large entrance looms in the cliffs ahead.  Round in shape, it seems to have been fashioned for easy passage.  Peering into the darkness yields little information about what may lie further in, since the rock walls quickly disappear into a faint blue glow.

title: [[Silvery Pool]]
description: Moonlight dances over the pool like a thousand stars among the dark ripples.  The cool water laps against your skin in a soothing repetitive rhythm, relaxing your muscles and drawing you out of the shallows.  Beneath your feet the pure white sand is smooth and clear of weeds.  A lulling, meditative aura settles over the water.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, On the Bridge]]
description: The deafening roar of the Journalai River below you drowns out all other sound as you make your way across the bridge.  Droplets of water hit your face, and every now and then the flash of silver scales in the water catches your eye.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Meadowlands]]
description: The grass is a thick, dark green carpet that spreads over the land in rolling abundance.  A few holes, large enough to admit a small animal, mar the landscape, creating openings that lead down into the dark home of burrowing creatures.  A river runs to the south, over which spans a sturdy wood and stone bridge.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Meadowlands]]
description: The tips and edges of the grass are slightly yellowed, and you get the vague feeling that there should be more flowers here.  To the south the meadows gradually shift into the lush emerald they should be, and to the north you see the beginning of a treeline.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Forest]]
description: The land has suffered from something malignant judging by the yellowish tinge to the grass and leaves of the trees.  Even the resilient deobar are having trouble in these conditions, and most of the trees are stunted, a sickly hue creeping through their bark.  The only thing that appears to be thriving is a grey-green woodmoss that covers the trees in abundance.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: Chalky green woodmoss drapes from the trees of the forest, falling in tiers that bring to mind waterfalls or a crone's hair.  There is a disturbing lack of birds and animals about.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: The trees grow close together, as if in fear of something.  The trail is free of debris and a tree, fallen across the road, has been carved through that the trail might continue despite the obstruction.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Forest Clearing]]
description: Jagged-edged grass grows thick about you, brushing and clinging to clothing and skin.  A fire ring has been built by the side of the road, evidence that someone felt the flat ground and relative safety of this area would make it the perfect place to stop and rest.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Forest Clearing]]
description: The grass is flourishing here despite the apparent blight of the rest of the wood.  Facing east beside the road is a squat stone monolith with an indentation in its top.  Some carvings adorn its polished gray surface, and an odd rust-colored residue stains it.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: The trees rise about you like looming tombstones in a graveyard, each one draped in shawls of sickly gray lichen.  The air is thick with a pressing sense of gloom, and you get the distinct impression that you are being watched.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Deep Forest]]
description: Heavy, still air hangs in pockets about you, weighing down sound and movement.  Silent in their misery, the trees hunch over each other, their boughs and trunks hidden by clinging moss.  They pull the sickly-colored stuff about them the way a Human child hides under a security blanket.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Open Forest]]
description: Moss dangles down from stunted, ill-looking trees, lending the impression that they are weeping.  The grass is dry and brittle beneath your feet, and the forest is still and silent, as if in mourning.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Stony Plains]]
description: Cracked boulders, gravel, and bare earth stretch about you, endlessly gray and grim.  Here and there brittle grasses struggle vainly to peek up, only to be choked by the uncaring stone.  To the south a dark forest blots the horizon.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Stony Plains]]
description: The ground is hard and unyielding underfoot, and the moonlight causes the stones to cast eerie shadows you don't like to think about.  Out of the corner of your eye you think you see something move, but when you turn to look, there is nothing there.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Stony Plains]]
description: An odd sight awaits you here: a single sirese flower, out of place and struggling to live, growing within the shade of a twisted wiir tree.  The tiny plant seems to be surviving on raw defiance alone.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wastelands]]
description: The land lies blasted, the earth revealed in forlorn despair about you.  Silence walks through here freely, accompanied in its journey only by the occasional click of a stone moving.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wastelands]]
description: Something has scoured this place of all life, or a harsh god created it with no life at all.  The rocks are oddly smooth and darker than normal agate and granite.  Nothing moves, no birds, no insects, no weeds or wind.  Having looked upon this land, you can easily imagine where evil souls go to when they depart this world.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wastelands]]
description: Blackened rocks and sandy soil that will never yield crops or flowers unfolds around you, encroaching like a spreading disease all the way to the horizon.  Overhead the sky is black, the celestial light filtered by a heavy haze that turns the clean light into a sickly parody of purity.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Wastelands]]
description: The lone call of a bird breaks the stillness, its cry sounding much like a helpless scream of rage and sadness.  A fine layer of black dust coats everything that lingers too long here, and toward the north, the beginnings of a blackened forest emerge.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Burned Forest]]
description: The scorched remains of trees stand all about you, clawing at the stars as if in complaint of the injustice done to them.  A chill wind winds around you and wails through the branches, sounding for all the world like the ghost of a sobbing child wandering, lost, through the night.

The scorched remains of trees stand all about you, their limbs clawing at the sky as if in complaint of the injustice done to them.  A chill wind wraps around you and wails through the branches, sounding for all the world like the ghost of a sobbing child wandering, lost, through the dreary grove.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Burned Forest]]
description: The blackened forms of trees rise up from the cracked earth like skeletons whose feet grew roots.  A scrap of cloth, tied to one of the trees, flutters in a cold wind, grey from years of exposure.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Cinder Cones]]
description: To the left and right rise massive cinder cones, the creations of the wind-born fires of Dirge.  Clouds of ash stir with every step you take, and you realize that much of what you mistook for hillocks are actually trees and stones so covered with the choking ash that they are nearly unrecognizable.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Cinder Cones]]
description: The cinder cones crowd in uncomfortably close on either side, their shadows throwing eerie shapes across your path.  A fine layer of ash drifts down about you, tickling your nose with its unusually acrid scent.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Broken Hills]]
description: The hills to either side are made of the broken remains of rock and debris.  You think you hear the skittering of creatures moving amongst them, but when you look up all you see is a tattered leaf being pushed along by the wind.  To the south the hills gradually turn into cones of ash and cinder, while to the north they continue on.

title: [[Northern Trade Road, Broken Hills]]
description: Cracked boulders, segments of large stones, and small pebbles compose the hills that rise up to either side of you, jealously guarding the path from the light of the stars and moons.  The hills gradually become larger as they march northward, growing into glassy, black volcanic hills that all but vanish into the night.

title: [[Northwest Road, Volcanic Hills]]
description: The road goes ever on, running northwest to southeast along the ragged shoulders of some black hills.  Erratic winds sweep down from their bare crests, bringing with them a constant irritation by means of minute particles of sand and grit and dust.  It gets in your mouth and you spit out a foul, bitter taste.  To one side a ruined cart lies abandoned and stripped of everything useful.

title: [[Northwest Road, Volcanic Hills]]
description: A raw, new road, scratched from the hard black rock of the hills and mountains, runs straight along from southeast to northwest.  Dead trees, charred to short stumps, form a dismal grove to one side of the pathway.  Up among the barren mounds of ash and cinders, something dislodges a small shower of stones that clatter loudly in the silent air.  A startled bird rises in uneven flight from behind a row of boulders, screeching its outrage and terror at being disturbed.

title: [[Northwest Road, Volcanic Hills]]
description: The uneven surface of the road bumps and jars at you as you pass among the lumps and furrows made by frozen lava flows.  Someone has hacked the outline of a path into the unyielding rock to guide you.  To the northwest, you can barely glimpse some huddled buildings that show faint signs of life, judging from the thin trickle of smoke rising from their chimneys.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary]]
description: The road runs northwest past a cluster of stone buildings and stables to one side.  A narrow path branches off to the east following a rough line of hills while another section continues southeast.  You hear the lowing of sheep and the bleating of goats from nearby and an errant breeze brings the smell of something roasting over a fire.  Elsewhere, you might wonder just what was being cooked that smells so strongly, but here and now you find you are both famished and in dire need of drink.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary]]
description: You stand amidst a small oasis among the rocks and gullies and blackened hills of this dead land.  A large building to one side has all the earmarks of an Inn.  Across from it are several outbuildings and what smells like a stable.  Behind the stable, a herd of goats bleats dispiritedly in a pen and a few sheep graze inside a small fenced area among some scrawny grass tussocks.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary]]
description: Several small buildings cluster here, huddled against the chill wind.  Set some distance away, near the edge of a steep slope, a tiny, unpainted shack stands by itself.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: Set apart from the other caravansary buildings and away from the hustle and bustle of the Northern Trade Road, this quiet campground provides a peaceful settlement for traders.  In the middle of the circle is a community campsite, where cabin owners can meet and discuss the news of the day.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: An old oak tree shades the houses along this side of the circle as feisty vines tangle around its trunk like young children around their mother's skirt.  Wildflowers line the woodchip path, thriving in the rich black soil of the area.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: Prickly, grey-leaved bushes smother the hill behind the north side houses, their tiny silver blossoms adding a subtle sweet fragrance into the air.  A plume of smoke rises to the south from the ever-blazing fire in the center of camp, reminding one of good food and agreeable company.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: The cabins here have been built right up against the stony mountain face, sheltering them against the harsh winds of the area and providing shade during the long summer months.  The face curves slightly away from the northernmost houses and forms a small indentation in the rock behind them.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: A bare rocky mountain lies to the northwest, curling very close to the cabins and causing large pockets of shadow to loom over them regardless of the hour.  Nestled in between the ridges of the mountains as they march towards the northern expanse, this cozy campsite provides a private sheltered area where residents can unwind after a hard day's trading.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: The cries of large birds of prey can be heard at times coming from the large rocky mountain to the northwest.  Occasionally one will take to the air and encircle the campsite, eyeing the central campfire as if attracted by the aromas of food that travel on the wind.  Wild roses twist along the edges of a wood-chip path in front of the houses, trailing dangerously out onto the path like mischievous welkins trying to trip or snag passing inhabitants.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: A large sunbleached fence bends around the southern edge, covered with the ropy green vines of morning glories that twist and turn to create a solid curtain of flowers.  Several overturned tree stumps have been placed in front of the fence to provide a place to sit and watch neighbors as they pass by on the woodchip path.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Campfire]]
description: A blazing fire cheerfully crackles in the center of the encampment, surrounded by aged wooden benches and chairs.  Set upon a small tower of chiseled stone overhanging the fire is a small grill where an enterprising young cook works to earn odd coin, chatting companionably to anyone who happens by.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Rustic Circle]]
description: Tantalizing aromas of food drift in the air from the northwest, mixing with the delicate smell of honeysuckle coming from the wild brush to the east.  Young spindly trees rise up through the hardy foliage, jutting out from the dark acidic soil as nature continues to replenish the once ash-smothered land.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary]]
description: Slabs of rock, roughly fashioned but serviceable, form a small barn for the few livestock and the occasional horse to be found here.  The roof is solid and seems weathertight.  The scent of hay and dried grass wafts from within, a counterpoint to the flinty odor in the wind.  Nearby is a larger building for the stables.

title: [[North Road]]
description: The sound of horses and camels calls your attention to a cluster of stone buildings to the south, bringing thoughts of warm food, cold drinks, and clean beds.  To the north, the route climbs over a small hillock of frozen lava and continues onwards toward two monstrous volcanoes barely visible through the dust and haze.

title: [[North Road, Lava Field]]
description: Heat rises in palpable waves from the black frozen ocean of lava, making this whole valley seem like some gargantuan oven.  Each step you take raises clouds of gritty yellow ash, coating your clothing and skin with a harsh abrasive layer of soot.  The only breaks in the bleak landscape are occasional spires of rock jutting through the black stone floor, and the menacing profiles of the great volcanoes off in the distance.

title: [[North Road, Lava Field]]
description: The land about you is still and lifeless.  The silence is broken only by the monotonous sound of your feet plodding through the pools of ash, and a low rumbling coming from under the earth.  A plume of thick white smoke rises from the summit of the mountain to the northeast.

title: [[North Road, Canyon Rim]]
description: The road north is blocked by a huge chasm carved by some ancient eruption.  The smoke rising from the canyon floor stinks of sulphur and ash, but there seems to be no other way to proceed northward.  To the south, the land slowly dips into a broad valley, and far off in the distance, you see what looks like a cluster of buildings.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Small Shack]]
description: You stand in front of a building barely large enough to hold even a couple of people.  A rickety wooden door dangles on dry leather hinges but does not seem locked.  A curious stench emanates from inside and there is a humming of insects as they swarm in and around the little shack.

title: [[The Noble's Barn, Central Walkway]]
description: The large double doors of the barn have been removed and lead into a cobbled walkway between two lines of shops, the walkway opening to the road on one side of the structure and a whitewashed carriage house on the other.  Seasoned cedar vaults the roof supporting the building, the only evidence remaining of its previous life housing animals instead of the merchants who once owned them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[The Noble's Barn, Exquisite Interiors ]]
description: Wall and floor samples line the outer edge of the shop.  Across the length of a beautiful riverstone floor, partially covered by an elegant ivory rug with platinum-banded tassels, is a plain oak desk filled with work orders.

title: [[The Noble's Barn, Quaint Exteriors for Posh Cabins]]
description: Wood and stone samples line the cedar panel walls.  Behind an open counter piled with plain, hand-sized house models is a courteous Halfling standing on a sturdy wooden stool, greeting everyone who enters while seeing to the various needs of his customers.

title: [[The Carriage House, Handcrafted Cases]]
description: Gentle breezes drift through the large open windows that cross the wide room.  The sound of footsteps echoes in the air as customers and the shopkeepers walk upon the plank pine flooring, bare and unpolished in appearance.  Displays of weapon racks, armor racks and cases cater to those in the market for home interiors.

title: [[The Carriage House, Loft, Elite Additions]]
description: Lamps hanging from the ceiling light up the small loft, pouring wan light onto the lovely merchandise offered.

title: [[The Noble's Barn, Fit for Royalty Furniture]]
description: Pristine marble floors with handwoven burgundy runners accent the fine furniture displayed around this corner of the barn.  Heavy velvet drapes line the windows preventing any light from getting in so as not to fade the lovely floor models.  Instead, a dozen standing candelabras, situated to bring out the color in the show items, light the room to a soft white glow.

title: [[The Noble's Barn, Fanciful Fireplaces]]
description: The floor has been lined with riverstone concrete and the walls covered with brick, creating the feeling of stepping inside the hearth of a fireplace.  A tickling hickory smell lingers in the room in an attempt to fill the customers with thoughts of cozy, comfortable moments beside a flickering fire.

title: [[North Roads Inn, Foyer]]
description: A tiny foyer leads from the entrance into the common room.  To one side, a small counter serves as front desk and, apparently, dry goods storage.  A steep stairway ascends to the upper story where the sleeping facilites are.  Under the stair, a narrow door leads into the back room of the inn.  The foyer is bare and long in need of paint but, in this wild land, it seems almost cheerful.

title: [[North Roads Inn, Common Room]]
description: The main room is almost cheery and cozy after the grim atmosphere of the surrounding areas.  A small fire, carefully tended, dispels the worst of the chill and sheepskins cover several wooden benches to give a modicum of comfort.  A stone table awaits the next meal and the air is full of the smell of roasting goat.  The proprietor, a sour-looking Dwarf, makes a show of disdain, though he seems most surprised to actually have guests and bustles about, brushing off the worst of the dust from the seats.

title: [[North Roads Inn, Alcove]]
description: This narrow room, almost an alcove off the common room, is meant for those requiring a quieter spot to converse.  Given the overall lack of noise, you must assume there was once a time when the inn was a tad livelier.  An uneven table of crudely shaped stone and a rickety wooden bench provide some small comfort.

title: [[North Roads Inn, Upper Floor]]
description: Much of the upper floor is one open room.  A line of bunks provides a place to sleep and a tiny iron stove gives off a feeble heat.  One small area has been partitioned off to allow a bit of privacy for those caring to pay the higher fee.  A small washstand with a cistern and some rough towels are the only other amenities besides a pair of slightly better beds.

title: [[North Roads Inn, Private Room]]
description: This small room is minimally furnished.  A window is covered with a panel of thick, oiled leather.  A wide but thin mattress stuffed with fresh straw is supported by a few leather straps from the rafters overhead so that it sways and rocks to a gentle touch.  An iron tripod supports a small brazier that has some coals burning in it to remove the worst of the chill from the room at the cost of a thin deposit of soot everywhere.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Barn]]
description: Wooden slats overhead provide a minute hayloft to store what little excess the barren lands here can offer.  While you have seen grander edifices, this is at least dry and clean and out of the weather.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Hayloft]]
description: A series of planks have been laid across the stone walls of the lower stalls to form a cramped hayloft.  The sweet smell of the hay clashes with the ever present sulfur dust as well as the odor of manure piled somewhere below.  It looks as if someone has slept here of late, perhaps to avoid the tariff at the inn or simply to escape notice.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Stableyard]]
description: The outdoor section of the stables is nothing more than a level patch of bare ground roughly fenced off with stonework augmented with a few warped and burned wooden planks.  Several dispirited horses wander about cropping at the few tufts of grass that can find root.  A feed trough holds the remnants of some hay as well and there is a good supply of water.  A wooden gate leads into the stable itself.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Clean Stall]]
description: This clean stall in the far corner of the stable has been converted into a small office with an old sturdy desk and fresh hay on the floor.  Painted red hinges mark where the stall door once was, and on the walls are amateur paintings of open pastures filled with colts and their mares.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Stables]]
description: This is a low stone building holding half a dozen or so stalls used by individual travellers who can pay to have accommodations for their mounts.  There is no sign of recent use and you wonder when the last lone traveller might have come by.  A roofless stone-walled pen juts out from one side of the building.

title: [[North Roads Caravansary, Stable Pen]]
description: This is a stone-walled pen meant to hold a caravan's camels apart from the horses,  The ground is dusty with dried manure that rises in clouds as you move.  An old watering trough sits at one end with a few inches of dirty liquid still in it.  There was once a slatted roof overhead for shade but the wooden slats have long since been taken for other uses.

title: [[North Rim, Canyon]]
description: Deep fissures in the canyon's floor vent steam and smoke into the air.  The haze and stench are so thick you can barely see or breathe, and the cracked uneven surface makes every step a chore.

title: [[North Road, Canyon]]
description: The reek of the gasses escaping the canyon floor is nearly unbearable here.  Although the lava you walk on is clearly ancient, it is still disconcertingly warm to the touch.  The way west is blocked, but the canyon opens up to the east, and a rockslide appears to offer a way up the northern wall.

title: [[Lava Fields, Narrow Trace]]
description: Close by, a primitive pathway has been scratched out of the hard rock and basalt to the east, where it wanders into grey shadows of dust and floating ash.  A narrow road lies between high boulders in the other direction.  Faint marks etched into the coarse dark stone point towards the path and away from the caravan road.

title: [[Lava Fields, Narrow Trace]]
description: The barest hint of a path undulates along the irregular crests of frozen rills of lava.  Here and there, the stump of a tree, burned and dead, pokes above the bleak landscape but does little to break the monotony of the lifeless scene.  The eerie desolation eats into your spirit and fills your mind with visions of death, while endless chill shadows and unnamed fears caper and dance at the edge of your senses.

title: [[Lava Fields, Narrow Trace]]
description: Faint markings etched into irregular boulders are your only guide in this trackless waste.  Static waves of rock rise high on either side, looking like a black ocean locked into an eternity of timeless rigidity.  Once this solid waste flowed with a thick and sullen life of its own, burning and destroying all before it.

title: [[Lava Fields, Narrow Trace]]
description: To the west, broken layers of lava and basalt rise in irregular piles.  To the east and north, a narrow plane opens out between steep mountain shoulders.  The black tide of volcanic destruction and molten has buried all that once was here and only a thick layer of ash remains, dancing in the erratic winds to give even a hint of life.  Off to the extreme north, you can make out a narrow valley.

title: [[Lava Fields]]
description: Acres of ruined farmlands stretch out on either side of the road here.  Dead and buried, they lie under ragged sheets of once-molten rock now chill and barren.  Flows of magma, once white hot and liquid, cover the road in places.  A stinging grit rides the wind, the only crop now grown in this sere and lifeless waste.

title: [[Lava Fields]]
description: The black stone hereabouts blends into the black night and you worry you may lose track of the shallow path labouriously carved into the unyielding rock.  Something white gleams faintly near your feet.

Rising shoulder high to a tall human, the magma forms rough walls that block the breezes.  The air smells of flinty dust and your feet kick up small clouds with each pace.  Someone has hacked a narrow path through the hard rock with great labor.  To one side, a smooth white protrusion rises from the lava.  It forms a sharp contrast to the drear and dark colors that abound in this deathscape.

title: [[Lava Fields, Ruins]]
description: Endless fields of magma stretch out to the surrounding mountains.  Nearby, the charred beams of a ruined farmhouse still erupt from the uneven landscape, as if striving mutely to free themselves from their cold tomb of lifeless stone.  A few scraggly bushes have found a precarious perch in pockets of wind-blown soil but they are grey and sickly.

title: [[Lava Fields, Ruins]]
description: Skirting a ruined farmhouse, you pass among boulders and mounds of ash.  Plumes of steam rise from the mounds and you smell a sulfur stink that makes your eyes water.  Everything is coated in a fine yellow dust.  To the west, the mountains run close together to form a narrow valley.  A few thin streams of smoke or vapor show pale grey against the black rock that surrounds it.

title: [[Lava Fields, Valley]]
description: Fields of broken lava give way to a relatively open valley tucked between two gigantic rock outcrops.  Almost mountains in themselves, the outcrops rise steeply from the valley floor.  Nestled between them sits a small, drab-looking town.  Buildings made of the same black rock as the mountains straggle across the tiny valley and back into the narrowing gorge behind it.

title: [[Volcanic Ruins, Dirge]]
description: Cinders and debris crunch beneath your feet as a cold wind stirs the ashes into small dust devils that dance about you in a curiously mocking way.  To the north, twin volcanic cones loom high into the sky.  The small town tucked between their towering masses seems to huddle in on itself.

title: [[Outside Dirge Town]]
description: The road beneath your feet was once well paved but now shows the marks of fire and time.  The stones were blackened and scorched by some great heat, warping some and breaking others.  There is a heavy grey ash everywhere that blows in your face and eyes.  Blocking the road north, a high stone wall guards a small group of buildings nestled between the volcanoes.

title: [[Dirge, Outside Gate]]
description: A road stops here at a ruined gate of charred and splintered wood.  Beyond it lies a small town of uniformly dark colors huddled beneath the towering volcanic heights.  To one side, a compact stone building stands watch over the infrequent traveller and the gate.

title: [[Lava Fields, Switchback Trail]]
description: Walls of cooled lava rise high above, seeming to melt downward in rounded flows.  Any footfalls which might echo through this canyon are muffled by the layers of ash which cover the twists and turns of the trail.

title: [[Lava Fields, Switchback Trail]]
description: The trail continues to twist and turn here, well out of sight of the Northern Trade Road.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Outside Gate]]
description: The terrain breaks slightly to reveal a wooden fort smeared with ash and mud to blend in with its surroundings.  A guard tower rises above the fortress gate, providing an eagle-eye view of any who approach.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Practice Yard]]
description: The ground in this open square is trampled flat and remarkably free of ash.  Ragged target dummies bearing crude parodies of the guild crests are tied in nooses from a wooden beam.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Mess Hall]]
description: Low benches are pulled up to long wooden tables.  Some sort of greyish crust stains the tables in spots.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Firepit]]
description: Two iron rods ending in hooks are planted in the ground next to a sooty bowl-shaped depression.  Judging from the trail of colorful splats and splotches on the ground leading west to the mess hall, this is where the Gorbesh prepared their food.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Meeting Room]]
description: High-backed chairs sit around a scarred table.  Blobs of candlewax discolor the table and floor, telling the story of long hours spent in planning, lasting deep into the night.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Officers' Quarters]]
description: Rank may have its privileges, but you wouldn't know it to look at this room.  A half-dozen cots are lined up neatly, with one table and washbasin to serve all the inhabitants.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Barracks]]
description: The bunks filling the barracks are huge, a testament to the sheer size of the Gorbesh warriors.  There is room for little else here, and the occupants must have had to crawl over each other to reach the door.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Storage]]
description: Empty hooped barrels are wedged into the corners of the room, nailed to the walls with metal spikes.  The ceiling is lined with dozens of hooks.  A sign in an unknown language is carved into the wall.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Stable]]
description: Facing out onto the practice yard, these few covered stalls once provided temporary shelter for the mounts of the officers.  A few bits of straw are caught in the slats of a hayrack.

title: [[Gorbesh Fortress, Guard Tower]]
description: The tower walls are notched and charred, apparently damaged in a pitched battle.  Deep gouges along the outside timbers of the guard tower tell the tale of a brutal assault -- one the archers who stood here could not withstand.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road]]
description: Among the cinders and ash, someone has raked a path leading along the outside of the walls.  Running from the town gate to a small hill to the west, the path wanders through a landscape even bleaker and emptier than that of the town itself.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road]]
description: A narrow path of relatively smooth cinders and crushed stone ambles aimlessly among dead grey ash-heaps and piles of stone that once were houses.  To the west and a bit north, a small hill rises, bleached white by the sun and the foul air until it resembles an exposed skull left unburied among the ruins.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road]]
description: A narrow lane of crushed rock and cinders kept raked by unknown hands passes among heaped ruins of stone.  Here and there, fragments of bone mingled among the rubble gleam whitely.  The air is still and there is a bitter tang to it that leaves you unsatisfied with the act of breathing.  It feels as if all vitality has been sucked out of the world, leaving only shades of grey and emptiness.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road]]
description: Jumbled rows of stone slabs, many stacked into untidy piles, catch your eye.  You wonder as to their purpose as you pass among them along this dead path of cinders.  Mixed among them are heaps of broken bones in no particular order or pattern that you can discern.  The land here is dead beyond your imaginings, as if life had never existed and you yourself were but some vague phantasm hovering above a landscape that was never meant to be.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road]]
description: Bones, piles of bones, heaps of bones, spill out across the cinder path.  Someone has stacked a hundred or more skulls into a gruesome pyramid to one side, each bony jaw grinning at you in mockery of life.  Slabs of stone with faintly etched lettering give a clue to the nature of this bizarre place.  The town cemetary it seems, has had as unquiet a time as the town itself.  Even death is without peace in this tormented land.  To the northwest, a small hill of bare rock rises.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: Here, at the base of a bare stone hill, a ruined cemetery sprawls in untidy heaps.  Bones and stones mingle together and grinning skulls perch on marble slabs, leering at you grimly.  The remains of the town cemetery it seems, ruined and scattered, holy ground no longer once fire and pain came to dwell.  Above the unliving scene, the stark white hill glowers, keeping its own secrets.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road South]]
description: Untidy piles of ruined headstones line both sides of this stony path.  A building of dark grey stone rises to the south.  Grit and dust grate beneath your feet and even between your teeth.  Dry as flint, it rises in clouds and settles over everything.  A chill wind moans between the broken stones and flings more grit into the heavy air.

title: [[Dirge, Hangman's Road South]]
description: Southward, a small building of grey stone surmounted by a broken chimney broods over mounds of dirty white ash.  The remains of a shattered wall surround it with heaps of rubble, topped here and there by grinning skulls set in ragged rows.

title: [[Dirge, Crematorium Building]]
description: Before you is a low, windowless building, squat and ugly, with heavy walls that resemble a fortress more than anything else.  The stub of a ruined chimney rises from the center, a broken finger aimed skyward.  Heaps of brick and stone lie tumbled all about from its fall.  A low fence of some dirty grey stone surrounds the edifice.  Here and there, grinning skulls colored a dingy yellow by the sulfur-laden airs, leer at each other in some private amusement.

title: [[Crematorium, Foyer]]
description: The stench of burning hangs in the air, despite the obvious fact that this place does not seem to have been used for its intended function in years.  Faded velvet draperies cover tatters of some once-rich wallpaper.  Dust and ash are thick on every surface, though there are well-worn paths in the dust.  A pile of broken and crushed wood and metal fragments are heaped in a corner where the dust seems most disturbed.

title: [[Crematorium, Retort Chamber]]
description: A huge iron and stone construction, large enough to hold several Gor'Tog rises up to the ceiling.  Heavy iron doors hang upon rusted hinges in front of an opening darker than the lowest pit of perdition.  The aura of death emanates from every nook and crevice in this place of flame and destruction.

title: [[Crematorium, Workroom]]
description: Tucked behind the massive retort, this was once the workroom and storage area.  A few sacks of coal, now split open and scattered, still remain.  A rusted and broken shovel rests beneath a massive pile of ash and bone fragments that seem strangely fresh and undisturbed by the passage of time.

title: [[Dirge, Ash Yard]]
description: Mounds of ash and piles of weathered bone are heaped in untidy rows.  In the time of the volcano, the dead came faster than they could be properly disposed of, and their remains now blow in the wind and grate beneath your feet.

title: [[Dirge, Ash Yard]]
description: There are no signs of life in this area, just shifting hills of grey, desiccated bones, deserted even by the city rats.  Tattered bits of clothing wave futilely in the breeze.  Even the stench of rotting flesh is gone, leaving behind only a dust that is as dry and empty as death itself.

title: [[Dirge, Dead Garden]]
description: Small stones once neatly divided this town garden into several colorful patches of herbs and vegetables.  Now the stones lie jumbled about.  The ground is covered with a permanant layer of suffocating ash.  It gets in the lungs, on the clothes.  It clogs the eyes.  Only when it rains does the bombardment of airborne ash cease.  Then it turns into a viscous river of oozing grey mud underfoot.

title: [[Dirge, Dead Garden]]
description: The cracked earth is pockmarked here by large, round holes.  Each bears a tightly closed, barely visible black blossom, which remains strangely unmolested as chittering scorpions scurry back and forth.

title: [[Dirge, Dead Garden]]
description: Death has not grown this garden.  Death is a void, but he sent his dog, Corruption, to breathe upon it.  The result is a vile jungle of suety weeds covered by green pustules.  The slightest movement of air causes some pustules to break, releasing a yellow ichor and fetid smell that fills the area.

title: [[Dirge, Ash Yard]]
description: What began as a graveyard rubbish dump has become a general garbage site for all the Dirge citizenry.  A vast quantity of unsightly debris stretches as far as the eye can see in squalid, ash-covered heaps.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: You pass gingerly among the hanging bones and swaying masses of rotted flesh.  Many stand empty, their occupants having long since crumbled away, or worse.  To judge from the splintered and gnawed bones beneath one partially dismembered corpse, few of the dear departed have been allowed to rest in peace.  A narrow path winds in two directions around the hill's middle.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: A dozen gibbets surround you, their corpses even more puzzling than they are gruesome.  Perhaps the town went mad in times past, for here they have executed numerous household and domestic animals.  The sight of half-mummified dogs and goats and other animals seems beyond explanation or reason.  The sight of recent feasting among them seems beyond comprehension.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: You stumble among the remains of a sickening feast.  A firepit has been dug and someone was roasting something unwholesome here recently.  A broken skull with glistening bits of brain remaining in it hints at the sort of meal you have interrupted.  Around you, dozens of gibbets hold their gruesome vigil.  A chill wind raises the hair on your neck as a bit of rock rattles down towards you from above.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: A path here leads to the barren summit of this bizarre hill.  Neatly arrayed along both sides, stand rows of gibbets, each with its unliving ornament.  One corpse nearest you was hanged with one arm nailed stiffly outwards across a post, its dead hand urging you upwards.

title: [[Dirge, Gibbet Hill]]
description: The hillcrest here once served the town in its more civilized days as a place for punishments and public executions.  The remains of a wooden gallows still rise above you, and around the rim of the hill stand several wooden stocks.  Each stock now holds a grinning mummified body, and surmounting the gallows, dangling from a silken noose, is a corpse arrayed in white linen robes.  Even in death, there is a suggestion of madness and power about this figure.

title: [[Gibbett Hill, Ur's Rest]]
description: Assorted roots and loose rock adorn the fetid walls which frame this deeply-spiraling path beneath the hill.  Tiny things creep, occasionally bite, and make incredible nuisances of themselves as they swarm to taste the warm flesh which has entered their darkened abode.  A tentative shimmer of light teases the lower edge of the passageway, never really promising to remain.

title: [[Gibbett Hill, Ur's Rest]]
description: Hundreds of lit tapers flicker from niches cut deep in the walls of this cavernous lair.  Pinpoints of light dance and waver, forcing the darkness between them into ominous shapes that dodge and strike across the moistened, blackened floor.  A confusion of footprints in the dirt at the center of the pit speaks of recent use, of stepping patterns rehearsed repeatedly in the pursuit of perfection.

title: [[Dirge, Gateway Road]]
description: You stand next to the ruins of the Town gate.  Little traffic disturbs the thick coat of grey dust that seems to be everywhere.  The town is tucked here between the cold peaks of the volcanoes and the outer wall of dull black stone.  To one side, a building still shows evidence of habitation and a sign painted with a large keg indicates that perhaps a drink or two may be had even in this desolation.

title: [[Dirge, Crossroads]]
description: A small east-west road crosses the larger one leading further into town.  Known as Merchant's Row, the few shops the town boasts can be found along its dusty length.  To the west, a small bit of greenery brightens an otherwise dull black landscape.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west.

title: [[Dirge, Merchant's Row West]]
description: The road here passes between a tiny shop on one side and a large stone building built against the town wall on the south side.  Farther west, the land rises sharply and you can make out some trees on a tall outcrop of stone.

title: [[Dirge, Merchant's Row West]]
description: The road ends here at the base of a steep pile of rocks leading up to a wide outcrop of the volcanic cone above.  The sounds of a hammer ringing on an anvil come from a large and well-kept stone building to the north.  A sign hangs on a polished brass rod above the shop.  The air is rich with the smell of heated iron and the tang of oil.

title: [[Dirge, Merchant's Row East]]
description: East of the town's main crossroads, the lane passes along the narrow, windowless flank of the Darkstone Inn.  A shop with heavily curtained windows stands to the north, while farther east, you can hear the whinnying of horses.

title: [[Dirge, Gateway Road North]]
description: Leading away from the gate and into the center of town, this stretch of road passes between a shop and one side of the Town Hall.  The bleak stone walls reflect the sound of your footsteps making you feel as if you were being followed with every move you make.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square South]]
description: The road here passes a row of worn but still-neat houses.  Small but with some attempt at keeping them tidy, they look less bleak than other parts of town.  One house has even managed to keep some flowers growing despite the dust and dryness.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square West]]
description: The road runs northeast here, following the narrowing line of the mountain as it hems in the town.  A few houses are scattered here facing the central Square, but room is left for a large cave entrance cut into the rock face.

title: [[Dirge, Merchant's Row East]]
description: You pass by a shop made of the inevitable dark stone used hereabouts.  One odd feature of the store is the doorway, which appears to have once been the door of a rather large and sturdy vault.  Made of heavy black iron, it stands open now but still looks quite serviceable.  Eastwards, you can see the road ending at the base of one of the volcanic hills.

title: [[Dirge, Merchant's Row East]]
description: The road ends here with a small store and the entrance to the town livery stables.  The outer wall curves in to meet the flank of the mountain but some of it has collapsed into a huge pile of unstable-looking rubble.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square East]]
description: A low, squat building containing the Town Hall fronts on this side of the square.  The narrowing valley hems in the town to the northeast with almost sheer walls rising steeply to unclimbable heights.  Faded greenery from the town's small park merges into the black dust of the road with no perceptible margin.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square North]]
description: The entire town narrows here, almost to a point.  This gives an odd emphasis to the peculiar pyramid shape that stands at the northern end of the town.  The building is not all that tall but it commands attention nonetheless.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square South]]
description: Gateway Road widens out here into the small Town Square.  The few houses the town boasts front along it as does Town Hall.  A tired fountain juts up from the center of the dusty square and a curiously shaped pyramidal structure rises north of it.  A pair of unwashed boys play a dispirited game of catch among the weeds and dirt of the once green Common.

title: [[Dirge, Town Square]]
description: The remains of a once-green central square are now sere and burned.  Here and there, paths of grass struggle to grow among the ashes and cinders that crunch underfoot.  In the center of the square, a small fountain still produces a trickle of water and offers a small spot of greenery from some bushes that have somehow survived.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Dirge, Temple of the Volcano]]
description: You are standing before the outer gate of the town's only temple.  The entire building, walls, paving and roof, is formed from dull black rock.  Built in a rough pyramid form, it was created when the former Temple on this spot was incinerated by one of the larger eruptions in the recent past.  Few in this town come here except when the fire mountains are troubled and the earth trembles.

title: [[Dirge, Livery Stables]]
description: The livery stables are as run-down as the rest of the town.  The stable building has partly collapsed and the few horses still to be found are corralled by makeshift fencing salvaged from the ruined stables.  The few stalls left standing indoors are being used to store hay and additional animal fodder to keep it dry.

title: [[Dirge, Temple Courtyard]]
description: The Temple's courtyard is flat and paved with dull black basalt blocks.  There is no decor and the place echoes emptily.  A dried-out tumbleweed skitters about in the uncertain winds that reach past the high walls.  The Temple itself stands in the midst of this bleak scene.

title: [[Dirge, Temple Altar]]
description: Less an altar than a dormant volcanic caldera, the central feature of this dark temple rises before you.  Some six feet high, it spews a thin stream of smoke.  Heat washes from it, hot enough to bring the sweat to your brow.  Trickles of lava have worked their way down the sides and out onto the stone floor, cracking and splitting the rock.  Rows of skulls of many races are set into the cone near the rim where the sulfurous fumes have stained them a sickly yellow.

title: [[Dirge, Temple Interior]]
description: The rough basalt blocks have been piled up so that they meet overhead to form a crude pyramidal shape.  The walls are sparsely decorated, mostly with scenes showing sacrifices being made to the volcanoes.  As these seem to involve unwilling participants being thrown in, you hope they are of historical interest rather than current events.

title: [[Dirge, House of Dying]]
