description: Dark buildings clutter the side of the street, all silent and no sign of the constant work of day.  Lanterns hanging from posts along the road give a faint wavering light, throwing shadows that make the area look nearly as alive as during the working hours.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Dirt Road]]
description: A small building, structured from logs and mud, stands on the side of the road.  Skins hanging from the windows, and the smell of curing hides rolling out could almost dizzy the weak.  Here and to the west the road looks a bit more trodden indicating that this is the business area of the village.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Dirt Road]]
description: People begin to crowd the road here, roaming in and out of various buildings.  A small cottage adorned with herbs hanging from the door sits down a small path.  The sounds of laughing and sporadic music begin to touch the air.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Dirt Road]]
description: Happy sounds come from a building that seems to be the center of this area.  Decorated more than any other building here it has been painted a dark green with a red door.  People coming out look happy and content while people going in look anxious and excited.  A sign hanging over the doorway is welcoming and colorful, the sight as a whole could put a smile on the hardest of adventurers.

title: [[Crolin's Skins, Main Room]]
description: Crolin's purchasing room smells and looks like a disorganized slaughter-house.  The tanner, Crolin, inspects bundles of newly arrived skins, nodding or shaking his head after carefully working them with his hands. His rough, shrewd appearance seems to fit into the atmosphere perfectly.  Strong smells of dead animals and substances of the tanning trade drift through a door behind a stained and battered counter.

title: [[Brigetta's Tanned Goods, Order Counter]]
description: A gated order counter blocks passage into a large work room.  Behind the counter can be seen a worktable and a series of shelves holding a large assortment of tanned dry goods.  A half open window provides a welcome breath of relief from the stench that permeates the rest of Crolin's shop.  Crolin's wife Brigetta, an attractive, strong looking woman with slender calloused fingers, greets potential customers with a pleasant nod as they enter her domain.

title: [[Randal's Repairs, Work Room]]
description: Mounds of leather and hides find themselves stacked in almost every corner of this small work area.  Wooden boxes of metal rings, studs and rivets claim the remaining space, prompting Randal to use two rolls of padding as a make-shift seat because there is no further room for them.  Behind a wood counter Randal sits smiling to himself as he works on a leather breastplate.  A large hide tacked to the wall has something written on it.

title: [[Crolin's Skins, Work Room]]
description: Work tables covered with different skins and tools take up most of the small room.  Small pools of sticky brown liquid gather at the edges of vats sitting against the wall.  Trapping equipment hangs from pegs on the wall, rusted and worn with years of use.  A window stands open offering the only ventilation against the stout fumes.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Worn Path]]
description: As the path meanders from the road forest dense with undergrowth begins to take over.  Animals scurry in the brush cracking leaves and small limbs, making an orchestra of sound more complex than any town.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Small Clearing]]
description: A beautiful clearing has seemingly been formed naturally in the middle of dense trees and brush.  The edges of the clearing look to be a barrier as sturdy as a wall yet unseen.  Lush grass bends softly with any stirring of the wind, and the occasional blue or red flower pop up giving splashing color to the green carpet.  In the middle a small stone pool has been built giving various birds of the area a water source for bathing and ridding of thirst.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Caravan Barn]]
description: Crudely constructed of rough-hewn planks, the stable appears as if it would fall over if pushed by a good wind.  An ancient pitchfork stands in the corner and leaning over it is an even more ancient Human, his body covered with old scars and puckered flesh.  The animals stabled here, contentedly munching their grain, seem untroubled by the disreputable state of the building.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Old Shed]]
description: Although the shed has been kept scrupulously clean, you detect the faint, unpleasant odor of chemicals and decayed flesh.  Several cured hides hang on the otherwise bare walls, and a large empty vat occupies the center of the small room.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Ironbeard Dwelling]]
description: The interior of this primitive abode is sparsely furnished with a floor of compacted dried mud.  A small fire glows in a stone pit in the center of the earth floor, and a pile of sawn logs and broken twigs lays beside it.  A shelf of unfinished lunat wood, containing a number of earthenware pots, cups and dishes, has been mounted on one wall.  The corner of the room is occupied by a large metal tub with a wooden crate placed next to it.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Ironbeard Dwelling]]
description: A large sleeping pallet covered with soft animal hides takes up most of the small room.  Above the pallet a short shelf has been mounted to proudly display a massive jawbone.  A deadly looking lance leans on the wall, resting against the shelf.  In the corner of the room sits a small carved wooden chest with two bronze handles. Its polished sheen seems out of place in this rustic setting.  A battered metal mirror has been hung on the wall above the chest.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Lodge Alcove]]
description: Heavy curtains block off the rest of the lodge from this small alcove.  A stern-looking clan guard stands alert, carefully scrutinizing each visitor before waving them through the curtains.  A young Barbarian boy, trying to sneak into the lodge, is caught by the guard, who lifts him up by the back of his shirt and gently sets him down outside.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A huge rocky outcrop breaks through the thick, loamy soil of the forest as the ground rises and roughens.  Fewer trees grow up here, and those that do cling to what soil they can find are smaller and twisted.  Graceful ferns and lacy grey moss spread across the exposed rocks, softening their harsh outlines.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Small, bent satinwoods cling to the rocky slope, their gnarled roots seeking patches of soil.  Tiny purple flowers spread across the ground, thriving and flourishing where the larger and greedier trees barely hang on.  A path levels out to the northwest, following the curve of the outcrop, while to the southwest the way continues on up.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A few stunted satinwood trees grow in the shallow soil up here on the outcrop.  Yellow-green grass and a few thornbushes fill in the space between the trees.  The bushes occasionally emit a rustling which isn't the product of the stiff breeze -- apparently some sort of small animal makes its home in this area, in whatever cover it can find.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A narrow stony shelf runs along one edge of the rocky outcrop, winding among boulders and gaps and the occasional stunted tree.  The view down to the east is green, a dense tree canopy only a short distance below.  Small grey birds dart back and forth between the trees, quarreling over something.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A gnarled satinwood tree grows jammed into a shadowy corner, its stunted branches reaching up to the sky.  Ferns rustle in the cold night breeze, punctuated by the call of a distant bird hunting somewhere in the blackness.

A gnarled satinwood grows jammed into a rocky corner, its stunted branches reaching up out of the shadow, seeking the sun.  Yellowish ferns carpet the ground wherever a patch of soil lies, in crevices around the bare grey rocks.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A deeper patch of soil is home to a stand of lush bushes with ruffled blue flowers the size of an orange.  Small paw prints lead in and out of the bushes, with an occasional larger paw print showing that predators live here too.  Scruffy looking weeds grow in the rocky soil a distance from the bushes, and very little at all grows up the trail to the west, higher on the outcrop.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A patch of white puffy flowers spreads out across the ground, their dark green tendrils seeking out soil and water.  One mound of flowers looks like it's been chewed on, and some small paw prints in the dirt confirm the impression.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: This arm of the trail is wide and relatively flat, running between the northern and southern domes of the rocky outcrop.  Tough grass grows all about, and some bushes and an occasional satinwood tree grow here and there about the landscape.  The soil isn't very deep, nor very fertile, and the satinwoods aren't the healthiest specimens, but they persevere, as life always does, and they manage to survive the harsh conditions.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The northern lobe of the outcrop rises high above, even though this intersection itself is nowhere near ground level.  A spindly looking satinwood tree grows on the slope below and to the east, blocking most of the view in that direction.  No birds flutter in its branches -- the only creatures immediately visible on the tree are some black ants, marching in a line along one of its nearer limbs.  Some large claw marks in the bark suggest that larger animals are about, however.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The two mounds of the rocky outcropping cast deep shadows on this narrow gap; hardly any light penetrates, even from the stars.  A few ferns and a scrubby bush rustle in the breeze.

Little light penetrates this narrow gap between the two mounds of the outcropping.  Grey rock soars toward the sky to the north and south, with a deep, treacherous looking crevasse in between to the immediate south of the trail.  A few sickly ferns grow in gaps and chinks in the rock, and a scrubby bush with poisonous looking berries clings to one side of the slope.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Piles of rubble indicate frequent rockslides on this side of the outcrop.  The loose boulders and rocks and pebbles make footing treacherous.  A narrow trail leads the eye up and to the northeast, toward the ridge crest.  Silhouetted trees whip back and forth in what appear to be strong winds.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Ridge]]
description: An intrepid bird has made a nest high up in one of the stunted trees.  The nest is a marvel of engineering, clinging to the branches with grass and vines and mud-plaster.  That it's survived the steady, strong winds way up here speaks well of the stubborn bird who built it.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Coarse vines like grey-green twine cling to what little soil is to be found in hollows and chinks of the rock.  Fireflies swirl and swoop in glowing spirals over the night-darkened vegetation, striving to attract mates with their luminous dance while at the same time avoiding night-hunting predators.

Tiny star-shaped flowers in purple and yellow dot coarse vines that cling, like grey-green twine, to what little soil is to be found in hollows and chinks of the rock.  A few hearty insects, always thriving wherever there's even a ghost of life, march among the flowers.  Some collect pollen or nectar, while others prey upon their neighbors.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Slope]]
description: The slope on this side of the outcrop is just barely navigable, about down to here.  The drop-off farther to the west is vertical, and the thought of climbing down it is unpleasant.  The view is spectacular, however, and the western lands spread out from one horizon to the other are awe-inspiring in their beauty and variety.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The view to the east, of lush, green forest and a glistening brook, is a sharp contrast to the harsher landscape in the immediate area.  The deep, fertile soil of the forest is only a wish up here, where the ground is rocky and dry, with little loam in it.  Plants are smaller, tougher, and less colorful than down on the flatlands.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The trail west leads up, higher onto the outcrop.  The breeze down here is cool and strong, but the branches of trees further up whip back and forth as though possessed by demons.  Just looking up at it makes one feel cold.  A smaller trail leading down to the southwest looks treacherous, but at least it doesn't look quite so chilly down there.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Crumbly Ledge]]
description: This ledge feels like it's about to fall off the rock face at any time.  Tough grass grows in the soil captured by cracks in the rock, and the roots of the plants pry, very slowly, at the stone, forcing it farther and farther apart.  Some day it'll give, and the ledge, and anything -- or any one -- on it will plunge down onto the flatlands below.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The wind up here finds every gap and chink in clothing, armor, and anything else one might wrap up in.  The plant life, at least, doesn't seem to mind and other plants grow low to the ground.  No extravagant explosions of leaf or flower here -- everything is small, sturdy, and functional.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A crooked intersection in the trail splits the way into three branches.  A flat path runs east, and seems to be the easiest way to go.  A narrower trail winds up the side of the outcrop to the south, while a gap between a couple of rocks to the southwest leads down into shadow.  The ground here is scoured clean of soil by the winds, and there are no tracks to indicate which path might be the more heavily travelled.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Hollow]]
description: This small hollow in the stone of the outcrop is surprisingly pleasant.  Dry rivulets in the ground suggest that rainwater carries loose dirt from higher on the mound and deposits it here, creating an oasis of both soil and water.  A variety of plants grow in this place -- little yellow bell-shaped flowers, puffy white ones, and tiny purple ones that grow scattered amongst all the others.  A vine with shiny leaves climbs up the walls, softening the otherwise harsh contours of the stone.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A wide spot in the trail invites a rest, and a clear view to the east invites a long, admiring look.  A verdant forest spreads out immediately below the rocky outcrop, stitched with the narrow thread of a glittering brook across its middle.  Beyond the forest lies cropland, planted in greens and browns and beiges, laid out like a game board.  A small village lies far to the east, nestled among the fields and orchards.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The path runs straight north and south here, scoured clean of dirt by the gusting wind.  A narrower trail, out of the wind but rough with loose stones, winds its way down the slope to the east.  Farther east and much closer to the ground, a deep green forest spreads across the land.  Farther yet, beyond the forest, are the regular, colored patches that mark croplands.  A tiny village is barely discernable as an irregular blotch in the rectangular blocks of fieldland.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A tangle of trees and shrubs growing in a deep patch of soil forces the path dangerously near the ledge to the east.  The rocky outcrop drops away, giving a view of a vast, dense forest.  Opposite the ledge, the rock rises up high overhead, the grey stone climbable only by spreading lichen and moss.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Stringy creepers spread out across the rock like a fisherman's net spread to dry.  Ragged bell-shaped blossoms in a pale yellow decorate the vines, their petals glowing in the starlight.  Fireflies swirl and dance above the flowers, leaving glowing afterimages in the blackness.  Down in the dry dirt among the creepers is a large paw print, suggesting that creatures larger than fireflies do frequent this place.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Notch]]
description: This narrow notch between two huge rocks is home to nothing more complex than some yellowish grass and a bit of lacy grey moss that blends nearly invisibly into the stone.  Little light penetrates here, and the atmosphere is bare and gloomy.  The only positive note about this place is that the same rocks which shade it also block the winds.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The view to the northwest is grand at this elevation, with the landscape spread out like a patchwork quilt.  An eagle soars in the distance, keeping a sharp eye out for prey on the distant ground.  Closer in, the path curves east and west around the boundary of the rocky outcrop.  Sea level is far below, and most of the surfaces within immediate reach are vertical.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The footing is treacherous here on this particularly steep stretch of winding path.  The trail turns south as it climbs higher, while the lower reaches are down to the east.  Not even bushes grow in this immediate area -- all is steep cliff and featureless rock, with a narrow trail made even more harrowing by gusting winds.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A cool breeze blows past the rocky outcrop and up the slope to the west.  Between the breeze and the perpetual shade here on the north side, it's rather chilly.  The trees don't seem to mind, though, nor do the scrubby bushes that cling to the rocky soil.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A pile of white bones and a few shreds of rotting hide suggest that something had a good meal not too long ago.  A scrap of what looks like a hare's ear lies to one side, and the bones are about the right size to have been a hare.  Large paw prints cover the ground around the carcass, but they're too overlapped to show where the predator went.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The trail winds around this northern lobe of the rocky outcrop, and a smaller path makes its way up to the eastern ridge.  Low bushes with grey-green leaves grow here and there on the slope, finding whatever pockets of soil there may be.  Occasional rustling sounds from the bushes suggest some sort of animal life, although if there are any small creatures here, they stay well hidden.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Ridge]]
description: The winds whip through the branches of the short, stunted trees up here on the ridge line.  It's uncomfortably cold, and eyes watering from the wind can't even properly appreciate the view.  Footing is good, since the wind has blown away loose stones and soil, leaving only what is well-anchored.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Millenia of streaming rain have cut vertical grooves into the solid rock of the outcrop.  Looking like the scored bark of some huge grey tree, the grooved stone runs down the rock face into a shadowy hollow.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Shaded Hollow]]
description: Lush green ferns line this hollow in the rock.  The soil is thicker here, with the dry bed of a tiny stream, probably carved by flowing rain water, running down from above and disappearing into a dry, cracked basin.  Towering stone rises high overhead in every direction, making this hollow uncomfortably cool even though it's protected from the wind.

title: [[Drathrok's Cave, Dance Training Area]]
description: A pungent animal odor pervades this somewhat cramped cave, with its moist dirt floor and undulating rock walls.  Several timbers placed end to end mark off a mounded patch of earth at the widest point in the room, where the light of several dim torches also reveals deep claw markings in stones leaning against a long, narrow table.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The steep trail takes a turn here, curving from the north to the southwest as it climbs.  Loose rock and pebbles make the footing uncertain, requiring complete concentration.  An occasional howling cry, blasting through the cold air, makes concentration difficult, however.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: The trail winds around a slab of grey rock that thrusts into the air like a watchtower.  The winds are sharp this high up, slicing like frozen knives into every chink and opening in clothing or armor.  The only plants are low-growing, strongly rooted, or both.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A single gnarled satinwood stands here, bent and twisted by the wind until it resembles nothing so much as a gnarled hand growing out of the rocky soil, all its fingers yearning toward the west.  A few low, mossy plants cling to its roots, sending up tiny purple flowers a bare fingerwidth above the ground.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Tiny purple flowers cover the rocky summit.  Their mossy green foliage grows low to the ground, their roots digging in deep in search of both water and anchorage.  A few patches of the mossy plants look crushed or nibbled, but no loose soil is allowed to collect here, and there are no tracks to indicate what might have been browsing.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Looking down from the crest of the rocky outcrop, the change of terrain between the rocks and the forest is obvious.  The dominant color on this side is grey -- grey rocks and grey-green foliage, spotted with occasional patches of dusty color where ever a plant has decided to put up flowers.  On the forest side the dominant color is a rich green, where lush trees and grass and ferns blend with larger and more colorful flowers.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: A patch of low thornbushes crowns the rock at the base of a taller spire.  Sheltered somewhat from the wind, the bushes have managed to spread out and grow to about waist high.  Despite the lack of wind on this side of the spire, however, the bushes sway and rustle -- apparently something else has also taken advantage of the calmer air and the shelter of the foliage.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop]]
description: Strong winds howl through the blackness of the night, finding unimagined gaps in clothing and armor.  Spread to the east is only more blackness, but lit by a few lights, here and there.  One is relatively close, east and a bit south, a small flicker indicating a band or perhaps a small village.  Slightly larger is the flickering glow from farther east, about halfway from here to the horizon.  And on the horizon itself is a spot that lights up a patch of land as broad as an outstretched hand.

The biting winds draw tears to the eyes, but the view to the east is worth some discomfort.  Directly below stands a lush forest, spread out like a deep green ribbon with a silver thread of water running through it.  Patches of fields and orchards stretch from the edge of the wood to the eastern horizon, marred only by a tiny blotch of town.  Far to the east, the smoke from dozens, or perhaps even hundreds of fires rises into the air, forming a foggy haze.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Main Road]]
description: A well-made road of tamped gravel runs in a straight line south from the gate to a ruined manor house some distance away.  Next to the gate itself, a partially demolished gatehouse stands, roof open to the elements.  Thickly overgrown trees run down to the road along the east side while a small path vanishes under the dark green canopy.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Main Road]]
description: The road runs straight and true through an area flanked by open grassland on one side, while a dark and foreboding stand of trees broods on the other.  To the south you catch a faint glimpse of a river beyond a ruined manor house.  Well-plowed fields to the west have now become thick grassland, heavily overgrown.  Green stalks tipped with long tassels flutter in the wind like ten thousand banners as a distant breeze ruffles the fields.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Grasslands]]
description: Grass, once of a type used for food but now grown wild, rises above a tall Human's head.  Your view here is limited to a few feet in any direction and it would be easy to become lost.  Claw marks in the gritty soil show that others have been here before you.  Perhaps they await you, lying silent in the grass, patiently waiting for you to blunder into their jaws.

Claw marks in the gritty soil show that others have been here before you.  Perhaps they await you, lying silent in the grass waiting for you to blunder into their jaws.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Wooded Grove]]
description: The rhythmic song of cicadas hums through the grove, welcoming the passerby's footfalls.  The silvery eyes of night peer down through the rustling canopy overhead, illuminating the bare soil of a thin trail that bends around the town wall to the northeast.

A rhythmic chittering amid feathery patches of fern welcomes you to this grove.  Tall wyndwood and oak trees, thickly cloaked in ivy, arch over a thin trail that bends around the town wall to the northeast.  Like a puppeteer, the leafy canopy directs a dance of sunlight and shadow across the ground.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor Drive]]
description: The road forms a circular drive directly in front of what once was an elegant manor house.  Formal stone steps lead up to a sheltered porch.  An ornamental flower garden marks the eye of the circle, though it has long since gone to seed and weeds.  To the east, a thick copse of trees has grown into a tangled knot and grass rises, high and heavy, to the west.  Beyond the house, runs a small river.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Wooded Grove]]
description: The sweet smell of wildflowers carried on the breeze mingles with the spicy scent of cedar and juniper.  At the sound of an owl, a startled woodmouse scurries across the trail toward a gnarled and broken oak tree.

The sweet smell of wildflowers carried on the breeze mingles with the spicy smell of cedar and juniper.  Sunlight dapples the mossy ground in golden hues and glistens on the dew-laden petals of tiny snowflowers.  A gnarled oak tree, cracked in two by a great tempest's fury, lays beside the trail.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Wooded Grove]]
description: The sounds of the river splash through the trees to the southeast, where the tangled trunks of a massive deadfall laying along the riverbank glow a ghostly pale in the moonlight.

The sounds of the river splash through the trees from the southeast, where the woods end abruptly in a tangle of felled trees.  The massive deadfall looks like the remains of some giant creature, its weather-bleached bones laying in a great heap beside the river.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Deadfall]]
description: Faint light reflecting off of the river outlines the natural bridge made by a tall poplar, the tree's roots still entangled in a great mass of deadwood on the western riverbank.  The splash and roll of the river's flow thunders loudly in the quiet of night.

A tall poplar forms a natural bridge across the swiftly moving river, its roots still entangled in a great mass of deadwood on the western riverbank.  A kingfisher perched on one of the silvered branches of the felled tree calmly watches the rushing waters for the glimmer of its next meal.

title: [[Temple Grounds, Entry Gates]]
description: The immense outer walls of the temple meet here, a thick lacquered mahogany gate acting as their mediator.  The hardwood entrance has been banded with sturdy bars of steel to ensure its stamina in the most dire of times.  A cobblestone path leads to the north, winding off into the various parts of the temple grounds.

title: [[Northwall Trail, River's Edge]]
description: Cattails and rushes border the river, softening the steep angle of the riverbank.  The lush grasses of a nearby meadow yield here to a thick mud that clutches at your feet, making each step difficult.  The deep croaking of bullfrogs punctuates the steady rush of the river, and the distant twitter of meadowlarks completes the arboreal symphony.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Meadow]]
description: The mournful wind gusts unheeded across the meadow, melding with the song of the river to the west.  The thick scent of grass and wildflowers lingers in the darkness.

Cornflowers, violets and poppies color the green velvet meadow in twilight shades and fill the air with a cloying fragrance.  The sound of the river burbling to the west blends with the mournful song of the wind's gust across the flatlands.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Phaedic's Field]]
description: The sound of digging echoes from somewhere across the field, broken occasionally by the ring of metal as it strikes stone.  Fresh mounds of dirt stand not far from the trail, while closer to the town wall the mounds have sunk to mere ripples in the meadow.  Paupers, street urchins, soldiers fallen short of glory, and anonymous travelers all meet their final destination here.  A large boulder stands beside the trail.

An uneven expanse of grass stretches to the south and west.  Fresh mounds of dirt stand not far from the trail, while closer to the town wall the mounds are sunken to mere ripples in the meadow.  Paupers, street urchins, soldiers fallen short of glory, and anonymous travelers all meet their final destination here.  Beside the trail, a broken shovel leans against a boulder.

title: [[Temple Grounds, Cobblestone Path]]
description: The astonishing sight of the grand temple lies to the north, atop a massive stairway.  Three towers flank the sides of the structure, a complex network of walkways stretching between them and the temple's top levels.  A smooth cobblestone path runs east and west here, curving around to the grounds areas on either side of the temple.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow]]
description: Clumps of tiny wild flowers hug the dirt road as it winds through the meadow.  Towards the northwest, rippling hills cloaked with greenish-brown fields and a large monastery are visible in the distance.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[North Turnpike, Forest]]
description: Dirt gradually replaces the remaining pavement stones to form a rutted earthen track.  The sweet smell of rotting leaves and pine needles wafts from the surrounding woods.  The road breaks through the forest, bending to the northeast towards open meadow and farmland.

title: [[North Turnpike, Forest]]
description: Plunging into the woods, the road deteriorates still further into a track of loose stones and cobbles.  Brambles, spike bushes, and poison fern line the edges of the turnpike, forming an impassable barrier to anyone who wished to explore the depths of the forest.

title: [[Zoluren Royal Mews, Gravel Path]]
description: A wall of tall boxwoods lines the gravel path leading toward a squat, square brick building.  The roof of a gatekeeper's cottage pokes above the line of shrubbery, and a few stray weeds huddle below the neatly clipped hedges.  The grey chipped stones are precise in their course, like a river of rock, flowing toward two wrought iron gates set into an imposing brick archway straddling the gravel path.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Grassland]]
description: A narrow trail, either cut or worn through grasses waist-high on a stout elf, winds northeast from the turnpike that rumbles with traffic.  The calls of caravan drivers hurrying their animals along can be heard from the road, while the quietude of the flatlands offers no such command but the whispering of the wind through the grass.

title: [[North Turnpike, Grassland]]
description: The scent of rotting vegetation rises from a cut by the road where loose rocks and stones mix with the weeds to mark the start of a small gully.  To the right of the road, a small herd of cows rests beneath a large oak tree as they chew their cuds and watch a spirited calf chase a butterfly fluttering across the pasture.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Grassland]]
description: As you move through the fragrant waves of grasses, small burrs catch on your clothing like the small hands of a child vying for attention.  The warm glow of the town rises in the night sky just above the horizon to the south.

As you move through the green-gold waves of tall grass, barley and dogbane, small burrs catch on your clothing like the hands of a child vying for attention.  The gilded spires and slate roofs of the town rise over the grey stone wall to the south.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Grassland]]
description: The winds skim through the tall grasses, whispering secrets to the constellations floating in the night sky.  A copse of birch trees rises to the northeast like a pale specter in the darkness.
The relentless winds bend the tall grasses in submission to the wide sky.  Birds of prey soar effortlessly far above and cry out as they pass, some landing in a copse of birch trees to the northeast.

title: [[North Turnpike, Grassland]]
description: A passing wind raises little swirls of dust from the deep ruts gouged in the road by heavily laden carts.  Off to one side among the weeds lie some fewmets, too withered to be identified, but a sure sign of game in the area.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: Despite the quiet, travellers have left their mark.  A sparrow pecks at a discarded canteen cover, pulls a thread from it, and flies off -- no doubt to add it to the lining of a nest.  To the northeast, the edge of the monastery's stone wall juts against the road, looming like a bold stroke drawn against the horizon.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: Spidery vines stretch from the road bank to climb the face of the fence, pausing only at a break in the stones.  Looking through the gap in the wall, row after row of blueberry bushes are visible.  Tatters of white netting sway from the shrubbery's slender branches like wispy shrouds snatched from the wraiths of long dead monks.  The road curves snugly eastward around the stonework.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: As the road bends sharply to the north, an ancient campsite is just visible through the trees.  The wind has scattered the long-cold ashes from the confines of the stone fire ring, and gnarled tree roots embrace the handle of a rusty pick.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: The road continues northward, embracing the edge of the monastery's fence.  Fields of green and gold stretch from the opposite side of the road, their rich stands of grain rippling beneath the soft touch of the breeze.  Barely visible lines betray the presence of paths between the fields.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: The monastery wall, blank as a blind giant, continues along the road, its unbroken expanse at once teasing and forbidding, concealing who knows what mysteries behind it.  Birds settle on the wall with avian unconcern and arise from it to feed in the fields across the road.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: The monastery's stone wall edges away from the road to follow its own meandering course.  A farmer, hardly more than a dot in the distance, leads a dray horse pulling a cart through the fields.  Northward, the skeleton of an old farmstead lies partially buried in weeds and grass.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: Northwest of the road, a burnt-out farmhouse stands, or perhaps lies is a better word, since all that time or war has left is a stone chimney, cold among the meadow grasses.  Bright splashes of color -- wild red roses, orange butterfly weed, yellow day-lilies -- surround the ruins, like nature's funeral wreath.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: As the road winds by the farmhouse, piles of grey stones, nearly swallowed by grass, trace the foundation of the farmhouse.  Some abandoned farming equipment sits rusting near the edge of an overgrown field.  A dull red stack of splintered planking set between the ruins and field marks the site of what was once a barn.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: Fields stretch away from the road, some fallow, others filled with sun-colored wheat and strong green stalks of corn.  Beyond the fields to the west, the monastery's buildings and stone-enclosed walls parallel the road.  To the southwest lie the scattered ruins of an old farmstead.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: Stone gives way to ruddy brick where the field-fencing wall adjoins the high walls enclosing the monastery complex.  A reddish patch on the monastery wall resolves into a bricked-up doorway.  At just about human eye-level, one of the bricks protrudes noticeably from the rest.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: The road wends close to the monastery, where ivy leaves soften the gray walls, dappling the stone with their color and shadow.  To the other side of the turnpike, fields ascend and descend gently rolling hills, their furrows lending an odd texture to the contours of the land.

title: [[North Turnpike, Farmland]]
description: To the southwest the stone wall curves around the building complex, stretching in an unbroken expanse westward.  A tower at the corner of the monastery looms high into the air, overlooking the turning road, its travelers, and the fields beyond with a stony impartiality.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow]]
description: The grey bulk of a monastery rises to the south, an obvious landmark on the route. Cultivated fields surround it to both sides of the road, the checkered browns, yellows, and soft greens of the fields arranged in this landscape with a natural grace that any artist would envy.

title: [[North Turnpike, Washed Out Bridge]]
description: A rotted wooden bridge partially spans a drying stream bed. The bridge footings descend into a mix of lush cattails and creekbroom -- a hint that some water remains.  Towards the center of the bridge, the planking has broken, leaving the bridge nearly impassable.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Birch Copse]]
description: The small copse of birch trees provides a welcome oasis of shade in the open grassland.  The trees stand thin and tall, their pale trunks catching the sunlight and glowing softly in the shade of their rustling canopy.  Oddly set amidst the birches is a curiously bent black willow tree.

Glowing a ghostly pale in the moonlight softly filtered through their rustling canopy, the birch trees lend credence to the old traveler's tale of the spirit of the birch.  The White Handed Ones could stop any heart or riddle with wicked visions any head their bony limbs touched.  Oddly set amidst the birch is a curiously bent black willow tree.

title: [[Temple Grounds, Cobblestone Path]]
description: The cobblestone road curves gently here, the round stones smooth and freshly-swept by the ever vigilant groundskeepers.  A broad expanse of thick brambles stretches to the northwest, obscuring any vision of what may lie beyond them.

title: [[Temple Grounds, Cobblestone Path]]
description: A thorny thicket of brambles obscures direct vision to the northeast, although the top half of the temple's massive orb is still visible.  Its lustrous black ironwood surface gleams in the sunlight, accented by polished silverwood window frames and sconces.  A bizarre contrast with the errant foliage, indeed.

title: [[Birch Copse, Aevren Mod]]
description: Towering above the shorter birch, the twisted limbs of the willow tree offer a breathtaking view of the landscape.  The leafless branches clatter and scrape against each other in the wind.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater, Ridge]]
description: Burnt shards of wood and bone are strewn outward from the ridge of a vast crater torn into the landscape.  The ragged pit gapes widely at the sky like a giant maw screaming in rage and sorrow.  An uneven trail littered with gravel and blasted rock weaves down the steep walls through thick layers of soil, sand and stone to the bottom of the great hole.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater, Wall]]
description: Stones charred and cracked from a great explosion jut from the jagged walls of the crater and alter the trail's course.  The sharp edges of silver-flecked stone glisten from the dark soil like the sword blades of a legion raised in battle.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater, Wall]]
description: Devoid of vegetation, the dark topsoil yields to a coarse grey loam.  Sand fused by fire crackles under foot, and the slippery grit sends shards of stone and unwary travelers alike hurtling down the slope.  A broken broadsword protrudes from a large sandstone, its blackened blade twisted like a coiled adder.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater, Wall]]
description: Fist-sized black stones carpet the narrow pass between two large shards of rock that rise from the base of the crater.  The stones glimmer with the dull iridescence of onyx and swallow the surrounding light.  As the carpet thickens nearer the bottom, the wall seems to fall off into darkness.

A stony black carpet glimmers slightly in the darkness, at once illuminating the trail and absorbing what light touches it.  Large shards of stone rise from the steep ground and bend the narrow pass in directions unpredictable in the sightless night.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater]]
description: Tall slopes tower overhead in every direction, casting long shadows across the stony floor and chasing sunlight from the great crater.  Small avalanches of stone and gravel rain down from above, startling small flocks of birds that flap off into the pale sky.

Darkness consumes the base of the crater, the towering walls swallowing the moonlight.  Only silver sparkles of stars peek in from above.  The stars themselves seem to rain down into the crater, as their light glints from small avalanches of stone that bounce down the walls.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater]]
description: The wind howls against the stony walls like braying hounds in the winter and whips up small whirlwinds of sand and skree.  Gossamer veils of shadow hover far above, casting a barren vista of monochrome greys and blacks.

title: [[Seord'moda Crater]]
description: The jagged base of the crater is run through with cracks in the black stone like open wounds in ebon flesh.  A buzzard perched atop mineral-flecked stone pecks at the stringy remains of a small meal.  It glances up occasionally to survey the vast pit littered with debris, and glare at the interlopers in its domain.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Glennview Lane]]
description: Whitewash and dark oak beams mix on the tiny half-timbered cottages which line the cobblestoned lane.  Granite-topped brick walls surround the houses, their hard outlines softened by deep green moss which clings to the mortar.  Kitchen gardens grow within the shelter of the walls -- herbs, fruit trees and vegetables all within easy reach of the door.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Glennview Lane]]
description: The tile roofs of the cottages along the lane are carefully laid out to channel rainwater away from the plaster walls and into barrels, where it may be collected for use in cooking and laundry.  A tangled mass of ivy sends winding tendrils out to wrap around the brick chimneys and walls of one cottage, leaving little to see but the diamond-shaped panes of glass in its windows.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Glennview Lane]]
description: A rishyarla bush grows close to the wall surrounding a nearby home, its pale yellow blossoms filling the air with an intense, sweet fragrance.  Like the other cottages which line the street, the half-timbered structure shows signs of careful upkeep.  The shrubs surrounding the house are carefully pruned, and cheesecloth netting protects the fruit trees from the ravages of the local birds.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, The Common]]
description: At the center of the close, a grassy square provides an open area where cattle graze during the day.  The hoarse bray of a mule mingles with the sharp noise of a chisel as a stonemason works on the other side of the square, shaping the stones for a new fence.  A gravel-lined path leads to a small rose-covered gazebo.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Poltrefanli Road]]
description: The dark oak beams of the cottages have been carved with fanciful figures of gargoyles and fae, or with intricate knotwork patterns which run along the front of the homes.  Other homes have stark white plaster walls broken by a decorative arrangement of the exposed oak beams.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Shar'hen Way]]
description: Diamond-shaped panes of thick, wavy glass attest to the age of the homes which line the cobblestoned streets.  Impurities in the glass have resulted in a faint violet tint to the glazing, an attractive contrast to the blackened solder which holds the windows together.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Du'hen Way]]
description: Housewives gather to gossip over the brick walls which divide the half-timbered cottages around the square.  Their sharp glances measure the probable worth of passersby, or take in the poorly mended sleeve of a neighbor's gown, all of which is discussed in low tones as they fold laundry or work in their tiny garden plots.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Poltrefanli Road]]
description: Nestled amidst the homes of the close, a tiny shop displays an assortment of carpets and other floor coverings hanging from its wall.  Imported from distant lands like Aesry Surlaenis'a and Mer'Kresh, the rugs feature wool dyed in vibrant shades of scarlet, blue and golden, and woven into intricate floral or geometric designs.

title: [[Rugglestone Close, Poltrefanli Road]]
description: Painted wooden planters filled with herbs or colorful flowers grow outside the windows of cottages lining the street.  Within the brick walls surrounding each house, tiny gardens grow in the limited space.  At one home, a row of pies cools on the window ledge sending a tantalizing aroma wafting across the cobblestone street.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Dense brambles press in on all sides, giving this place a claustrophobic feel.  The few narrow gaps in the bushes are barely navigable, and from each branch and twig long, sharp spines threaten scratches and punctures.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Crossing Northern Gate, The Brambles

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Tiny grey-green leaves grow in dense spirals around the branches of the brambles which surround the trail.  In actuality it's hardly a trail -- more a gap in the foliage, beyond which is another gap, and perhaps another.  The gaps are narrow, and look like they were made by animals rather than people.  This place belongs to its four-footed inhabitants, and the clinging, snagging thorns are a warning to all others who come here.

Tiny grey-green leaves grow in dense spirals around the branches of the brambles which surround the trail.  In actuality it's hardly a trail -- more a gap in the foliage, beyond which is another gap, and perhaps another.  The gaps are narrow, and look like they were made by animals rather than people.  This place belongs to its four-footed inhabitants, and the clinging, snagging thorns are a warning to all others who come here.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The bushes on either side of the track loom high, dense enough to obscure whatever lies beyond.  Every now and again they rustle, sometimes on one side, sometimes on the other.  Something is moving about within the depths of the bramble patch.  And considering the long, wicked thorns sticking out from the brambles in every direction, anything that would casually rustle its way through them must have an incredibly tough hide.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: A huge, spreading oak tree dominates the center of the clearing, lifting its great branches up into the sky.  The thorn bushes stop just outside the rounded perimeter, allowing grass and some flowers to grow beneath the great tree.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: Gaps of bare dirt in the grass around the oak tree have been smoothed over and patted down.  In one of the larger ones, someone drew a smiling face with a beard and a little round hat, using a stick or perhaps a small finger.  Buttercups grow here and there in the grass, along with a few other flowers.  The brambles form a nearly solid wall about the clearing, but haven't penetrated into it.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Mounds of spiny bushes press in from all sides, thorn-laden branches reaching in like skeletal fingers.  Dusty sunbeams pierce through the branches overhead, illuminating drifting motes and falling leaves, throwing twisted shadows upon the ground.

Mounds of spiny bushes press in from the darkness on all sides, thorn-laden branches reaching in like skeletal fingers, poking and brushing and stinging.  Tiny sounds echo from out of the shadows, rustlings and chirpings and poppings, and now and again a louder honk or crunch.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The sound of calling birds blends with the rustles and crackles coming from all around the bramble thicket.  Thorny branches tremble in the breeze, dense living walls forming painful barriers in all but a very few directions.  Some scuffled tracks in the moist ground lead away to the north.

The screeching of night-hunting birds punctuates the low rustles and crackles coming from all around the bramble thicket.  Dark, thorny branches tremble in the cool breeze, dense living walls forming painful barriers in all but a very few directions.

The sound of calling birds blends with the rustles and crackles coming from all around the bramble thicket.  Thorny branches tremble in the breeze, dense living walls forming painful barriers in all but a very few directions.  Some scuffled tracks in the moist ground lead away to the north.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Birds chirp and call back and forth to each other, up in the leafy canopy spreading between several trees on either side of the narrow track.  There's an edge of urgency to the bird calls, as though there were a predator about, or some other lurking danger.

Nocturnal birds hoot and screech to each other up in the leafy canopy.  Little scavengers rustle about in the bushes, unseen but always present.  Deep shadows draw a curtain of obscurity over the scene, leaving only the larger outlines to be avoided and hiding the smaller details to be tripped over.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The brambles converge on a small stand of trees to form a dead-end in the trail.  The greenery grows dense here, with the swagged branches of the trees competing for light and air with the tough little thorn bushes.  The leaf litter on the ground is thick and spongy, covering the dirt and all but a few of the larger rocks.

wayto.1709: ;e fput 'pull large branch'; fput 'push large rock'; move 'go hole'

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The brambles grow particularly dense here, leaving only a tiny pocket barely large enough to stand in.  In the leaves covering the ground are signs that some animal has made its nest here recently, leaving only scuffed ground and litter.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Small round leaves, grey-green with a white streak down the middle, cover the branches of the brambles which form this thicket.  Although the leaves grow in dense masses, they're unable to hide the sharp thorns which protect the bushes.  A pleasant, spicy scent emanates from the leaves, and when the breeze dies down and the air is still, the smell is sharp enough to sting one's sinuses.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The narrow track winds in and out among the brambles.  Its narrowness, along with its meandering path, suggest that it's a game trail, rather than anything built by or meant for people.  There certainly seem to be animals in here somewhere, if the hissing and honking noises coming from beyond the thicket walls are any clue.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The ground has been churned up by something.  It's dug and scored and turned over as though some one or some thing were searching for buried treasure.  The dug-up dirt is still dark and moist, so whatever was digging here left not too long ago.  Nearly hidden beneath a bush, the trampled remnant of something whitish is barely visible.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Something that hasn't bathed in far too long was here just a short time ago.  The pungent odor covers even the spicy scent of the bramble bushes, instilling in one a strong desire to be elsewhere.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The land rises to the north and east, and the brambles grow thicker.  Some kind of vine with striped green and white leaves spiraling up its length winds its way among the bushes, weaving them into a dense wall.  A squirrel would have a hard time finding a path in that direction, but the tangle of thorns is somewhat less dense in a couple of other places.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The ground pitches upward to the northeast, and dense, brambly foliage covers the hillside.  The rise is neither steep nor high, but the thickly spined vegetation makes it impossible to climb.  Mounds of thorny bushes grow in lush and painful profusion along the base of the hill as well, except for a narrow game trail which winds along its base.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A brisk breeze blowing up from the center of the bramble thicket to the southwest brings with it a number of strange sounds -- low hisses are occasionally pierced by outraged honks.  Something is in there, and it's probably not a group of picnickers.  The bushes shiver and rustle, marking the movements of whatever's back there.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A half-rotted corpse lies on -- and partially in -- the muddy, uneven ground.  One withered arm is stretched out in the direction of the low hill, its bony fingers clutching for a handhold that wasn't there.  Whatever killed it apparently gored it into immobility and then began to feast, beginning with the legs and working its way up.  The spicy scent of the brambles is overpowered by the foul stink of the decaying body, and even the cool breeze blowing up the hill isn't enough to disperse the stench.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A flowering vine winds its way among the thorny brambles, uncaring of the sharp spines.  Using the bushes as a living trellis, the vine sends its spiraling tendrils twining through the branches and twigs, decorating them with big trumpet-shaped flowers.  Arrowhead-shaped leaves provide a fresh green background for the pink and white striped blossoms.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: In the bend of the trail there are signs that an animal has passed by here recently, but the bushes are thick and make it difficult to distinguish.  The thorns press in close on every side, even meeting overhead where they block out the blue of the sky and cast a gloomy shade over the thicket.  Only a couple of gaps in the bushes suggest a way out.

The thorns press in close on every side, tall enough to meet overhead where they block out the twinkle of the stars, barring even their dim light from the gloom of the thicket.  Only a couple of dark gaps in the bushes suggest a way out.

The stars give off little light in the first place, and only a fraction of that manages to penetrate through the branches of the trees scattered about the thicket.  The dirt is trampled and dug up, making it important that one place one's feet carefully, the more so because a fall means a painful trip into the wicked thorns of the bramble bushes growing all around.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Something has passed this way recently, leaving tracks in the dark, loamy dirt.  Other spoor lie scattered about in the leaf litter covering the ground, and broken branches and shredded leaves indicate that whatever it was wasn't feeling terribly peaceful.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The bramble bushes aren't quite as dense in this spot, and there are a number of gaps big enough to slide through without doing too much damage to one's person.  This seems to be the intersection of a number of small trails, and judging by how churned and dug up the ground is, it sees a lot of use.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The trail curves through the bramble thicket, past some bushes of a different variety.  Foliage presses close all around, spreading both out and up in the competition for resources.  Birds rustle in the bushes, hunting for berries and small insects.  Something else that sounds much larger than a bird rustles through the brambles somewhere close by.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A stand of berry bushes holds its own on the western side of the track against the press of brambles.  The berries are greenish yellow with light brown veins, about the size of a large grape.  They don't look terribly appetizing, but judging by the stripped branches at the lower levels, something that lives in this thicket finds them yummy.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Mounds of thorny bushes press in on the narrow trail, leaving barely enough room to pass without getting stuck or scratched.  Rustling sounds occasionally drift by with the breeze, but it's hard to tell where the noises are coming from.  There's something moving around in here, though, just out of sight, behind the greenery.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A few stray sunbeams shine through the branches of the trees scattered about the thicket, illuminating the grey-green leaves of the brambles, and gleaming on the needle-sharp points of their thorns.  Here and there a clump of tough grass manages to grow around the base of the bushes, but most of the dirt is trampled and dug up, making it impossible for less hardy plants to survive.

The stars give off little light in the first place, and only a fraction of that manages to penetrate through the branches of the trees scattered about the thicket.  The dirt is trampled and dug up, making it important that one place one's feet carefully, the more so because a fall means a painful trip into the wicked thorns of the bramble bushes growing all around.

Dense bushes grow in irregular mounds, throwing grotesque silhouettes against the star-strewn sky.  The brambles are thick, with tough, woody branches and long, sharp thorns; pushing through them is impossible, and the only way to move in this thicket is to find natural gaps in the foliage.  It's hard to tell in the darkness, but there seem to be a couple of open spots, to the west and northwest.

Dense bushes grow in irregular mounds, throwing grotesque silhouettes against the star-strewn sky.  The brambles are thick, with tough, woody branches and long, sharp thorns; pushing through them is impossible, and the only way to move in this thicket is to find natural gaps in the foliage.  It's hard to tell in the darkness, but there seem to be a couple of open spots, to the west and northwest.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Tracks about the size of a large palm show clearly in the firmly packed dirt.  Grey-green leaves, liberally spiked with long, sharp thorns, spread out from either side.  The foliage casts deep shadows across the tracks, emphasizing their size and depth.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Something large tore a gap in the brambles to the northwest.  Broken branches and oozing sap define the edges of a hole nearly an armlength across.  Broken and missing thorns testify to the toughness of whatever came crashing through -- the long, sharp spines weren't much of a deterrent.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Signs of a scuffle are everywhere.  The dirt underfoot is streaked and spotted with dried blood.  Patches of hide and broken spines lie scattered about, and there's a huge hole in the brambles to the southeast where something large went crashing through in a hurry.  The bark of a large tree is scarred by deep grooves the width of a finger or better, and drying sap streaks the wood in long, viscous dribbles.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Crackles and rustles betray the presence of... something... moving in the brambles up the slope to the northwest.  The thorny bushes are so dense in that direction, however, that not even a Halfling child could manage to penetrate them.  Interspersed among the brambles are a few trees, spotted here and there, spreading their green canopies over the harsher undergrowth.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Palm-sized tracks pressed deeply into the ground stand out against the lighter colored leaf litter.  Broken branches and bruised foliage up to the height of a large Human's shoulder tell a tale of violence, as do the darkened spots and streaks of blood spattered about.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Spiderwebs festoon the branches of the trees up overhead, draped and swagged like festival bunting.  The brambles below the trees are bare of webbing, although well-trimmed with long, sharp thorns.  Grey-green leaves spiral up the branches, large and round closer to the roots, small and oval at the tips.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: There must be something good in the soil of the low rise to the northwest, because the brambles and other plants growing up there are lush and thick, forming an impenetrable barrier.  The thorn bushes spread across the slope in grey-green mounds, having penetrated into every available span of ground until they stand silhouetted against the sky at the top of the rise.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Signs of a mighty conflagration are everywhere.  Scarred furrows in the ground make footing uncertain.  Blackened thorn branches wave like spiny skeletons, stripped of leaves and hardened by fire.  Heat-fused lumps of something unidentifiable lie scattered about -- driven into the ground, entangled in the brambles, flattened across the backs of raw wounds in the bark of trees.  Something unimaginably hot has burned a huge gap in the undergrowth to the south, like a white-hot poker sizzling through flesh.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Dense brambles grow on the slope to the northwest, protecting the low rise with a wall of finger-length thorns.  The track underfoot has been churned up by passing feet, the leaf litter thrown about to reveal the rich dirt beneath.

Dense brambles grow on the slope to the northwest, protecting the low rise with a wall of finger-length thorns.  The track underfoot has been churned up by passing feet, the leaf litter thrown about to reveal the rich dirt beneath.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A huge burned clearing, half a dozen long strides across, lies bare and blackened.  Even the tough brambles gave way before the heat of whatever came into this place, incinerated by the fire and now doubtless lying unidentifiable among the charred rubble and blackened dust crunching underfoot.  In the center of the consumed circle is a pit, a dark hole burrowed deep into the ground at a steep angle.  An acrid smell fills the air, sharp and sour, penetrating everything.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: Dense, thorny bushes press in from all sides, grabbing at hair and clothing and dangling straps.  A single tree spreads its branches overhead, filtering out the sunlight and casting dancing shadows on the foliage below.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: A huge oak tree stands sentinel in the center of a large clearing.  The bramble bushes stop suddenly around the edges, as though someone had drawn a wavering line across which they're forbidden to pass.  Short green grass grows here, although it's torn up in places, and a few flowers manage to bloom in spots and crannies.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The narrow trail winds through the bramble patch, and around a number of trees.  Thorn bushes press hard up against the tree trunks, but the trees are taller and rise up above the underbrush with uncaring dignity.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Thick leaf litter covers the ground, making it both spongy and crunchy.  Shriveled berries and little round leaves from the brambles combine with long pointed leaves from the trees to form a dense insulating mulch.  Here and there in the mulch a few mushrooms show their pale heads, thriving in the moist decay.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Dense bushes grow in irregular mounds, throwing grotesque shapes across what little bare ground there is.  Bright orange berries nestle in the shadows among thorns as long as a finger.  Picking them would probably be painful, and would likely result in a certain amount of bloodletting, but they're not edible anyway, so it doesn't really matter.

Dense bushes grow in irregular mounds, throwing grotesque silhouettes against the star-strewn sky.  The brambles are thick, with tough, woody branches and long, sharp thorns; pushing through them is impossible, and the only way to move in this thicket is to find natural gaps in the foliage.  It's hard to tell in the darkness, but there seem to be a couple of open spots, to the west and northwest.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A few tall trees grow in the midst of the thorny brambles, rising high above the bushes.  Long, pointed leaves filter out much of the sun, but the tough thorn bushes do fine all the same.  The soil is rich and loamy, and there's plenty of water, so the bushes and the trees manage to coexist quite well.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A huge boulder rests in a crease between two gentle rises.  The slopes are covered with thick thornbushes, but nothing grows on the boulder except the occasional lichen.  Tall and steep, it looks like a giant's egg resting in a thorny basket.  Deep shadows obscure the niche beneath the lower curve of the boulder, which in any case is too low to put more than a hand into.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The soft sighing of the breeze blends with the chirrup of birds and the humm-buzz of insects to create some rather pleasant background noise.  The game trail curves from the east to the southwest, paralleling the base of the slope, through a dense thicket of brambles.  Tall purple grass grows in sprays here and there in the bushes, poking its narrow spears through the open lattice of the woody branches.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: The oak tree in the center of the clearing casts a large patch of shade here on its north side.  A few ferns grow at the base of the trunk, providing a feathery border to the expanse of green grass that covers the ground between the tree and the brambles.  Off on the eastern side of the clearing the brambles give way to dense, mounding berry bushes.

title: [[Brambles, Clearing]]
description: Bright green berry bushes grow in rounded piles to the east of the oak tree, only gradually giving way to the brambles on the southern curve of the clearing.  Patches of bare dirt show dark against the lighter green of the grass, places where the ground has been torn up and smoothed over.  A few grey-green sprouts grow here and there in the grass, but none more than a couple of inches tall.

title: [[Brambles, Treehouse]]
description: A rough platform perches at the intersection of three great branches.  Of different types of wood, and cut to different lengths and thicknesses, this obviously wasn't any kind of a professional job.  It's quite sturdy, though.  An old crate is nailed to one end, and a scrap of rug is similarly fastened to the middle.  You're high enough in the air to get a decent view of the bramble patch and the land surrounding it.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Fresh green tendrils carry a twisting vine through the thorny brambles and up into the swaying trees, cloaking the harsh thorns and tiny leaves in bright greenery.  Leaves shaped like arrowheads nod in the breeze, flanking trumpet-shaped flowers striped in pink and white.  Bees buzz and hum as they go about their work, collecting pollen from the gaudy blossoms.

Curling tendrils carry a twisted vine through the thorny brambles and up into the swaying trees, cloaking the harsh thorns and tiny leaves in greenery.  Leaves shaped like arrowheads nod in the breeze, casting oddly shaped shadows across the spines lurking just behind them.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A rutted animal track runs between and around a number of thorny brambles.  Little round leaves, dried to resemble nothing so much as oversized rolled oats, cover the ground, while their living green counterparts spiral their way up the branches of the bushes.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Several narrow tracks intersect here, in a spot that seems to get a lot of trampling.  A sickly-looking thorn bush grows in the middle of the intersection, trying to spread out and block passage, but bruises and scars and broken branches have prevented it from making much headway.  Some deep tracks in the dirt show that a large, heavy animal frequents this place, likely the cause of the bramble's misfortunes.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A crooked trail winds its way around a huge boulder.  Half buried in the soil, the great rock is rounded and smoothed, nearly polished in places.  Plush, green moss grows up the lower surfaces, and the top is carpeted in dead leaves and wind-blown dirt.  Enough of the rock itself shows that you can see it's made of a black and white flecked granite.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A low spot in the ground has collected water, creating a breeding ground for wriggling water bugs and spreading green growths.  Tracks in the mud indicate that a number of animals come here regularly to drink, although the slimy, bug-infested mud puddle looks anything but inviting to someone with fewer than four legs.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A few puffy yellow flowers have managed to force their way through the dense brambles in search of sunlight.  In among the tiny grey-green leaves of the bushes are a number of larger curled leaves, poking out here and there.  Only filtered light makes it through the leafy tree cover, but it's enough to support the scattering of flowers.

Filtered moonlight wafts its way through the leafy tree cover, separate beams gently illuminating a branch here, a leaf there.  The shadows are gentler, softened by the dim lighting, and seem somehow not as threatening as they otherwise might.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The game trail dead-ends here, surrounded by dense thorn bushes an all sides, with only a narrow gap in the foliage to the west.  Rustlings coming from the leafy shadows and the brambles sway back and forth, now here, now there.  Something is lurking in amongst the undergrowth.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The trail makes a sharp corner to avoid a particularly dense stand of brambles.  There's hardly enough space for a gnat to crawl through, or so it seems.  Something in the soil must be encouraging the unusually luxuriant growth.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The trail widens into a small clearing, surrounded by mature thorn bushes and carpeted with grass and a number of wildflowers.  Half a dozen thick stumps are spotted about the area, indicating that this used to be as thickly overgrown as any other part of the area, and indeed there are several hundred baby brambles, from tiny sprouts to couple of fat little bushes a foot or more tall.  Within a few years, this area will be impassable once more.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A large oak tree grows a short way south of the track, forcing its way up from among the thorny bushes pressing in all around it.  One of the thorn branches grew so close that the oak's bark has grown over it, trapping it forever against the gnarled trunk.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The narrow game trail runs from the northwest to the southeast, winding round and about the bramble bushes.  A smaller track pushes into the undergrowth to the northeast.  Cracked and splintered branches and scarred ground make it look like the northeastern track is of recent creation.  Broken thorns suggest that whatever made the new trail probably didn't have a good time doing it.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A flowering vine twines through the tangle of brambles, winding its tendrils around the woody branches, uncaring of their sharp thorns.  Large green leaves shaped like arrowheads decorate the vines, swaying in the breeze.  Here and there a flower lifts its head, trumpet shaped, striped in pink and white.  The blossoms show a delicate contrast to the tough bramble bushes with their small leathery leaves.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Something made its hurried way along this winding track, traveling northward as though driven by anger or fear.  The track has been forced through the brambles, and is none too wide.  Damaged bushes and blobs of hardened sap mark the passage of whatever did this.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Young oak trees fill what little space there is in between the thorn bushes, rising above the spiny undergrowth like giants striding through a cornfield.  Many years' accumulation of curled brown leaves blend on the ground with the crackly little grey leaves from the brambles, forming a thick, spongy loam.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Some small animal got itself caught on the long thorns of the bramble bushes.  Attempts to free itself only caught it more firmly, and it died pinned into that spiny prison.  Small scavengers have made of its body a hollow shell.  The skeleton is clean and white, doubtless picked over and polished by ants and beetles.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The thorn bushes in this area are half-naked and sick-looking.  Branches bare of leaves wave in the breeze, showing their thorns without the usual cover of little round leaves.  A number of leaves look half eaten, and here and there are tiny black worms, chewing and chewing, gorging themselves on the greenery, tough and leathery though it may be.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Tall brambles loom high on either side of the narrow track, their thorny limbs fluttering with little green leaves that spiral up the branches.  The breeze stirs the bushes, sending a soft rustle through the thicket, but every now and again a louder, harsher crackle and honk is heard, sounds made by no wind.  Something moves back in the thicket, in the densest parts where none, not even a Dwarf or Halfling, may venture.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The brambles are a bit thinner to the south, neither very high nor very dense.  Other types of plants grow intermixed with the thorn bushes, softening the appearance of the area into something approaching a gentle woodland.  A couple of tree ferns spread their feathery fronds over the thorns, while a stand of callas pushes its way in amongst them.  Here and there, tiny violets peek out from under larger leaves, hiding from the sun.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Most of the surrounding foliage is thornless, with only a few brambles mixed in.  The conglomerate of greenery is just as dense as the bramble thicket, but less painful when one brushes against it.  Tall, green bushes with leaves shaped like spearheads dominate, intermixed with leggy cane-like plants, huge grasses taller than a Tog's head, and a fibrous vine with straggly orange flowers.  A short clover covers the ground in fragrant patches, making this a pleasant little spot.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A deep gouge in the tough bark of a tree, about four feet above the ground, marks the place where the track makes an abrupt change in direction.  The gouge, a furrow the length of a Human's hand marked with a deep hole the length and width of a finger, is on the south side of the tree, indicating that whatever hit it was traveling north at some speed when it hit.  It seems to have wrenched itself free and then thundered on to the northeast.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: The trail, already narrow, comes to a stop here.  The bramble bushes grow more densely to the north, and although they show signs of splintering in places, they stand stout and firm.  There is little else here but a few bones, large enough to have survived the ministrations of temperature and weather and ants.  The ground has been churned up recently, so much so that no tracks are evident.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A stone the size of two fists together has been disturbed, kicked out of its home in the loamy soil, leaving behind a shallow hole filled with half rotten acorns.  Some squirrel must have chosen this stone to guard his winter cache, but someone else -- or something else -- came along and kicked the rock aside.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: A huge fallen tree trunk lies cradled in the embrace of a pair of relatively smaller trees, wedged tightly between them.  Soil has packed close about the lower curve of the trunk, burying it firmly -- it must have been resting here for a long time.  The game trail stops at the enormous trunk, which prevents movement to the east as the dense brambles block all other ways save the northwest.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Bramble Thicket]]
description: The bramble thicket is not very dense here, and its tangled, matted shrubs seem to shrink back from the north side of the clearing, almost as if shunning it.  Just beyond the clearing rises a massive gate.  Sere vines and dead vermin are scattered about its base, but nothing, not even moss, mars its surface.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Lich Gate]]
description: The ground beneath your feet is black and dead, as though it had once been engulfed in a great inferno.  Oddly enough, the Lich Gate before you appears pristine and intact, unscathed by the apparent waste and desolation that surround or perhaps radiate from it.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Inside Fence]]
description: A cold breeze blows through the area changing its direction when you turn, as if guided by some unseen force.  Several paths lead off to the north into the trees.  Along the perimeter, a low wrought-iron fence serves as a token boundary for the cemetery.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Winding Footpath]]
description: The path begins to weave its way through dense trees, snaking around small burial sites that contain several old stone grave markers.  The grounds have been kept clear and the grass is cut low around each tombstone.  Someone must visit this place regularly.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Graves]]
description: Each of the graves in this part of the cemetery is marked with a simple wax candle.  Despite the constant breeze, the flames of every candle continue to burn and flicker, lighting the ground with an eerie orange glow.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Winding Footpath]]
description: Just beyond the iron fence that runs along the path to the southeast, you hear something moving about in the underbrush.  Faint pinpoints of light fade in and out of the trees and you would swear the temperature just dropped.  The outline of a square structure lies to the south, while a faint trail heads northwest through low-hanging trees.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Worn Path]]
description: Branches reach out towards you, groping at your clothing.  Just beyond the path, misty vapors weave their way between the trees, seeking unknown prey.  A worn path bends around from the southwest to southeast.  To the northwest, you spot some sort of clearing.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Cenote]]
description: You are standing on the edge of a deep sinkhole, about eighty feet wide and perfectly round.  Peering into the deep hole, you find that it's filled with water, the surface about thirty feet below you.  Judging from the smoothness of the walls and a skeleton still clinging to the rocks below, you surmise that jumping into this cenote might be a bad idea.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Shady Path]]
