description: The trees hang low over the path along the westward curve, forming an eerie tunnel of foliage.  From somewhere in the darkness, the hoot of an owl echoes through the woods.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Ring of Stones]]
description: The tunnel of trees opens up into a round clearing where eight gravestones have been placed in a circle.  The stone markers face inward, towards a small stone altar resting in the center.  There are ash marks across its surface, leading you to believe something was once set aflame upon it.

title: [[Hilltop Cemetery, Before Mausoleum]]
description: The trees have given way to a mausoleum crafted from white marble.  The entrance is marked by two smooth columns and perched just above, a solemn-looking stone gargoyle surveys the surroundings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Graveyard, Inside Crypt]]
description: A low stone altar heaped with dried flowers, old rotted offerings of food and streaked with ancient pools of melted wax, stands opposite the heavy iron gateway which leads out of the crypt.  The walls are lined with closed graves, sealed with heavy marble facings, each bearing a polished bronze plaque with the name of one of the departed.  A lone flickering candle standing atop the stone fights a precarious battle against the heavy oppressive darkness of the crypt.

title: [[Graveyard, Tunnels]]
description: The ceiling and walls are mostly dirt aside from one bright patch of cracked marble overhead.  Two burning torches fixed to the ceiling in heavy iron brackets light up the tunnel with a deep reddish glow, glinting off bits of ivory bone and old wood in the walls.  The tunnel slopes downwards and to the east, fading into inky blackness beyond the light.

title: [[Bosque Deriel, Tunnel Below the Roots]]
description: Massive silvery roots weave in and out, forming the walls of this cavern-like area under the foot of a huge tree.  Slightly above and to the west, there is a fissure in the wall of the root cave.

title: [[Northeast Vineyard, Farmhouse]]
description: Nestled at the base of a terraced hillside, a small stone farmhouse seems caught in a struggle with the tendrils of ivy which seek to pull it down.  Though the farmhouse survives, the outcome of the battle is really not in doubt.  The ivy has already pulled over half the chimney, now a pile of rust-colored bricks lying in an untidy heap on the west side of the house.  To the north, a path leads to a small building behind the house, while a trail to the south leads back into the forest.

title: [[Northeast Vineyard, Pressing Vats]]
description: Wooden crushing vats clutter the ground, crusted with the remains of long evaporated grapes.  Dark stains discolor the wood, while unidentifiable lumps cling to the bottom.  Great aging barrels lie tumbled to one side, waiting for the vintner and his assistants to fill them before rolling them to the aging caves for storage.

title: [[Northeast Vineyard, Cooper's Shed]]
description: Narrow oak planks are stacked outside a small wooden shed, the door of which stands open invitingly.  Wooden mallets, planes, copper strips, odd looking clamps and other worn tools lie on the ground within easy reach of a rough bench.  A half-finished barrel lies on the ground, its staves warped by the time and the elements, while completed barrels have been stacked neatly against the side of the shed.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Just beyond a small wooden shed lies a sturdy fence which separates the farm from the garden.  A simple affair of wood, the fence nevertheless serves to keep livestock within the farmyard, and away from the garden on the other side.  A stile crosses the fence, allowing men to pass, but frustrating any animal seeking an unoffered meal.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Green grass and tufts of wildflowers blanket the southern exposure of the steep hill.  Terraces cut into the hillside allow the grape vines to flourish on their trellises without risking the health of the workers who tend them.  A path to the east wends its way through the lowest level of the terrace, while a steep climb downhill leads to the farmyard below.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A warm breeze wafts along the terrace, rustling the leaves around you, and carrying with it the scent of grapes and growing things.  Footprints leave faint scuff marks on the smooth green of the grass as you pass through the lush rows of grapevines which border the terrace.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: The smooth green turf has been torn up here, as though a struggle has taken place.  Tracks in the soil lead in all directions, and several vines have been pulled loose from their supporting trellises to be crushed underfoot.  The sharp, tangy scent of crushed grapes fills the air.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Wooden trellises line the walkway, one on each side of the terrace.  The wind or an animal has knocked down a section of the northern trellis, leaving an awkward tangle of wood and grape vines to be trampled by careless feet.  Proving the adage about an ill wind that blows no good, the break in the trellis provides a convenient place to climb up the hill to the next higher terrace.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A tangle of dried grapevines, evidently from the last time the vines were pruned, has been piled high at the east end of the walkway, blocking further travel in this direction.  Dried vines such as these would be burned at harvest time, their smoke seasoning the oaken barrels in which the wine will age.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A gap in the trellis on the outer edge of the terrace gives a view of the farmyard below.  Shadows seem to skitter about the yard, shifting like smoke before they can quite be seen.  A broken trellis on the terrace below provides a convenient place to scramble down the hill.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: The air is filled with a low drone as bees fly to and fro.  A swarm has built their hive on a trellis here, black and yellow insects working steadfastly to gather nectar from nearby flowers and return to the hive to transform it into honey.  The sweet scent from the hive permeates the air.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Wispy patches of wildflowers and herbs grow with careless abandon, carpeting the floor of the terrace.  Honeybees float lazily from flower to flower, gathering their nectar with a single-minded intensity.  The drone of the bees is relaxing, as is the delicate fragrance of crushed thyme and flowers.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A rock lies half buried in the middle of the path, requiring passers-by to walk close to the edge of the terrace.  Deep green grape vines shiver with each passing footstep, the motion revealing the bleached silvery wood of the trellis to which they cling.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A crude stone firepit has been constructed at this end of the middle terrace, providing workers with a convenient place to stop and eat a meal during the day.  Sun-bleached poultry bones have been snapped, and half buried beneath the outer trellis.  A steep climb up the hill leads to the topmost level of the terraces.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Tendrils of grape vines caress the skin with every movement through this walkway.  About four feet apart, the vines which grow on the trellises to each side reach out as if to clutch at those who pass by.  A lop-eared brown rabbit peers out from under the inner trellis, its tiny pink nose twitching curiously.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A broken rake leans against a trellis, grape vines curling about its length.  Flecks of rust fall from the weathered tines at each touch of a gentle breeze, while splinters catch at the clothing of unwary passers-by.  The philosophical might murmur platitudes about the return to the earth of an implement used to wrest a living from it.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A cat lies beneath a trellis, unconcernedly washing her paw as she basks in the cool breeze.  Dark green leaves provide a sharp contrast with her orange and white fur, and her eyes gleam softly in the shadows as she glances about with half shut eyes.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Wrens warble musically as they call out to each other from their perch in the vines.  Hidden from predators, they hop about, the leaves swaying with their movements.  A cluster of tail feathers littering the ground indicates that such safety is, at best, fleeting.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: The view from the upper terrace is breathtaking.  A small farmhouse nestles at the base of the hill, the red tile of its roof warm in the light.  A fence surrounds the farmyard, and a small stile allows workers to cross the fence to a field of grain which lies beyond.  The path leads east, and a steep climb leads down the hill to the middle terrace.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Morning glories compete with grape vines for space on the trellis, twining about each other as they grow.  The deep purple grapes provide a startling contrast to the pale blue of the morning glories as each climbs ever higher toward the sunlight.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A ladybug crawls along the trellis, her red carapace spotted with black.  Her progress from leaf to leaf is slow and steady, as she seeks out the tiny aphids which form a staple of her diet.  The vines which grow along the hillside thrive as a result of her patient hunting.

Dark shadows loom about as dim moonlight illuminates the vines.  Leaves move in a gentle breeze, allowing glimpses of the silvered wood of the trellis on which they climb.  From a hiding place within the leaves, a cricket gently chirps, calling to its mate.  The monotonous drone of the insect lends a sense of peace to the area.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: Grape leaves shiver in the wind, turning from deep green to a paler, greyish green as they move.  The shifting colors are dizzying, especially when combined with soft whistle of the wind past your ears, and the glimpses of the valley floor through the moving leaves, far, far below.  A dried leaf from last year's growth flutters past to drift over the terrace and off into oblivion.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: A mole peers about myopically from the protection of a shady trellis, his velvety grey skin blending with the shadows.  A passing motion has him diving beneath the ground to disappear without a trace, though a hint of raised earth visible beneath the grass indicates the path of his underground burrow.

title: [[Northeast Vineyards]]
description: The sun warms this sheltered bower, caressing it with light.  Crimson roses climb in a perfumed tangle up a wooden arbor, filling the air with their heavy fragrance.  At the center of the arbor, years of careful trimming have created a tiny topiary donkey, which contentedly crops the grass.  A low boulder, worn smooth by years of wind and rain, provides a convenient place to sit and relax in this peaceful setting.

title: [[Blackened Hills, Barren Path]]
description: A thin top layer of sifted black and russet brown soil covers the earth, sterile and void of life.  Withered remains of what once were plants litter the ground, and browned stalks of lifeless weeds protrude from the wasted earth, casting long, harsh shadows.

A faint ruddy glow lights the scape with a bloody aura.  Despite the night air, the wind that blows around you is warm and almost balmy.  Layers of shadow cover the ground, stripping it of life and leaving for the blasted earth's only inhabitants the dried out, brittle stalks of what once were plants.

title: [[Blackened Hills, Barren Path]]
description: A shadowy black lump of a hill broods on the horizon, like coal waiting in a child's Midwinter Day stocking.  A sere and scorching wind entangles itself with the air, parching your lungs and reminding you just how thirsty you are.

title: [[Blackened Hills, Barren Path]]
description: Scattered ashes and mounds of unidentifiable burnt paraphernalia lie scattered around the path which, oddly, appears to be swept clean.  Heat comes up in waves off the ground, causing the air to shimmer.

title: [[Blackened Hills, Barren Path]]
description: A looming hill rises to the north, its shadow falling heavily over you.  Covered in ashes that look as fine and thick as a new layer of snow, a deep channel of lava carves its way down one side of the hill, finally vanishing behind a steep embankment.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Path]]
description: A hill rises to the east, covered in ash and casting a long shadow over everything.  Blasted skeletal structures are all that remain of a handful of small homes that crouch against the hill and beside the road as if they were waiting in ambush.  Broken bones lie scattered within the empty homes, silently relaying the unspeakable.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Path]]
description: The path gradually rises to the northeast, sloping upward as it winds around an ash-coated flat-topped hill.  Smooth waves of hardened lava lash out amongst the ruins of what once were buildings, the basalt glittering coarsely in the sunlight.

The path gradually rises to the northeast, sloping upward as it winds around a flat-topped hill.  Smooth waves of hardened lava lash out amongst shadowy remains, the basalt shining glassily against the backdrop of night.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Path]]
description: A warm breeze blows dust off the blasted path that skirts the hill, tingling the flesh and parching the lungs.  Silence pervades all around, and here and there the trail is marked by runnels of frozen black that can only be old lava flows that hardened into basalt.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Winding Path]]
description: The path slopes upward to the southeast and winds gradually downward as it heads around a bend to the west.  Slick rivers of glassy black stripe the hill, darkening the path in a glittering runoff of cooled lava.  A sulfrous tang spikes the air, tracing the inside of your mouth with a metallic flavor.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Winding Path]]
description: The path steepens sharply as it climbs the hill, eventually vanishing from sight as it dips over the flat summit.  Slick smears of obsidian basalt make walking difficult, causing the path to become as treacherous as any ice-bound slope.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Winding Path]]
description: The path is almost totally consumed by black basalt, making climbing it a horrendous task.  Waves of frozen lava slip over the sharp lip of the flattened hilltop, creating waterfall structures that give little purchase and would be much more dangerous to clamber over if the slope were any steeper.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Hilltop]]
description: A desolate scape of shattered ruins scorched and covered in a thick layer of ashes rolls out all around you.  Flattened by forces at present unseen, a pale ruddy glow flows up through cracks in the hilltop, filling the air with a demonic light.  Wrecks of houses rest in peace amongst pools of frozen lava, skeletons of the former village of Crook.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Hilltop]]
description: The blasted remains of homes and their denizens lie scattered about you.  Composed of cinder and ash, the path of the lava can be clearly followed as it swept over the helpless villagers, incinerating them instantly and capturing what remained in rigid black glass.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Ruins]]
description: The hard black glass that covers the surface of the earth is cracked in several places, releasing a faint red glow that spills out and up, creating a hazy veil of blood-colored mist.  A black hill rises to the east, a cancerous lump waiting to be excised.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Ruins]]
description: The hill slopes down toward the southwest, too treacherous and glassy-slick to dare without risking breaking a few bones.  Fine clouds of ashes rise up around you when you walk, filling your nostrils with grit and the stench of death.  A steep channel of lava pushes its way down off the side of the hill, dusted with just enough grit to afford some moderate purchase.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Gate of Souls]]
description: Rising in a snubbed tower, the collapsed hill that broods in the center of Skeleton's Crook hilltop is covered in black basalt.  A strong ruddy light seeps from the arterial cracks breaking the mound's surface, each line connecting to one or the other until they form an arch-like pattern reminiscent of a doorway on the hill's north-facing side.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Hilltop]]
description: The flat ground is covered in a thick layer of glass that would be hard to maneuver over were it not for the ashes that cover it, supplying purchase to an otherwise frictionless surface.  A vast view of the lands to the east spreads out before you, unfurled like a map.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Ruins]]
description: A hazy red nimbus lights the horizon in a pale glow.  Emanating from a small black hill that flows up to the northwest, the light is steady and slightly evil looking.  A slick lava channel carves its way down the hillside to the southwest, looking just coarse enough to make it difficult but not necessarily dangerous climbing.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Ruins]]
description: A small circle of skeletal buildings are all that remains of the tiny village of Crook.  Blackened wooden beams now dig their foundations into a thick layer of cooled basalt and scorched earth, and the eyesockets of the skulls of those who did not escape the agony of the lava eruption stare blindly up at you.  Toward the west rises a second hill, gleaming dully with the everpresent ruddy glow of the shattered landscape.

title: [[Lava Channel, Basin]]
description: Roughly halfway between the top and bottom of Skeleton's Crook hill, this steep channel is made even more treacherous by the thick coating of hardened black glass that covers the ground and walls.  Large bubbles of cooled lava have burst up to the surface in places, and a few are shattered, revealing fragments of razor sharp basalt.

title: [[Hill Slope, Lava Channel]]
description: Roughly halfway between the top and bottom of Skeleton's Crook hill, this steep channel is made even more treacherous by the thick coating of hardened black glass that covers the ground and walls.  Large bubbles of cooled lava burst up to the surface in places, and a few are shattered, revealing fragments of razor sharp basalt.

title: [[Hill Slope, Lava Channel]]
description: Walls and floors of solid, glittering basalt rise and fall around you, creating the sense that one is walking on a completely still lake of pure liquid black.  The sides sweep up to the northeast and northwest in treacherous channels that look as if they would be harder to climb were it not for the fact that they were dusted in a fine layer of grit that lends friction to their surface.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Dried lava lines the roadside, the ground beneath your feet speckled with iridescent flakes of the cooled molten rock.  The dusky stone winds northwest to a distant volcano, and eastward back to the main road.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Tiv's Moon Mage Guild, and Trail
meta:mapshortname:Tiv's Moon Mage Guild, and Trail

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Rocks are pushed to one side of the road to make a slender path through debris.  It looks scarcely traveled, the way lined by sparse vegetation.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Patterns of leaves and paw prints are barely visible in the walls of stone nearby.  The fossilized remains are an eerie reminder of the life trapped forever within the ash.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: A withering flower rests to one side of the road.  Its dusk-colored leaves flail in the slight breeze, their color the brown of age and decay.

The evening smiles down on a small flower lingering near the road side.  It appears withered and dying at first glance, but as the night unfolds, so does a pure white snowblossom - one spot of beauty within a realm of decay and death.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Splintered wagon wheels lie alongside a corroding iron frame.  It appears as if a Trader ran into some difficulty -- difficulty he was unable to recover from.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: A dried watering hole stands forlorn amidst the skeletons of animals large and small.  All scraps of flesh have been worn or torn away leaving only the dusty ivory bone beneath.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: The silhouette of the Greater Fist looms in the far distant horizon.  The Lesser Fist lingers closer, its shadow rising almost haughtily before you.
Darkness trails over the shadows of both volcanoes - the Greater and Lesser Fists.  Standing tall and proud, they serve as silent sentinels beneath the night's unsleeping eye.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Coarse gravel lines the earth, a bed of sharp stones, like jagged teeth peering out of the earth.  Ready to pierce the foot of the unwary traveler, they stand sparkling against the spartan dirt.

title: [[Lava Flow, Rocky Path]]
description: Fronds of wilting palm trees scatter on the ground, the wind blowing them across the loose dirt.  Trunks and stalks lie half-buried by ash and crumbling stone.

title: [[Lava Flow, Standing Stones]]
description: Tall stones rise in small circular patterns, their forms eroded by wind and water both.  The designs they held have long since faded into invisibility, their meaning now undecipherable.

title: [[Lava Flow, Standing Stones]]
description: Pieces of once-tall pillars lie skewed and broken.  Debris from past volcanic eruptions blanket stone and statue, hearth and fallen home.

The dark side of evening seems to linger here, languidly basking over the ruins as if gloating.  The shadows seem to tug and pull at the fallen buildings, as if taunting them, whispering seeds of unrest to long-dead spirits.

title: [[Lava Flow, Standing Stones]]
description: The ancient frieze of a tall arch is slowly crumbling to dust, paint and tile flaking off.  Burn marks streak the mural, obscuring what images were once there.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Thorns]]
description: Dried and cracking brambles wrapped around a wrought iron fence line the road.  Flanking the dusky earth, the brackish thorns peek out from withering branches, daring to jab and stab at passers by.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Thorns]]
description: A heart-shaped wrought iron sculpture is overgrown, writhing vines coiled around it.  The thick spike-like thorns appear to pierce the center, the sharp points gleaming with moisture.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Thorns]]
description: A tangled mass of thorny bushes guard the roadside, making passage beyond the slender path impossible.  Small birds find ways to hide unscathed amidst the brambles, tiny forms huddled inside small cathedrals of withering vines.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Thorns]]
description: The masses of thorny growths thin to the north.  Wrought iron sculptures where vines of roses once grew stand bare, metal corroding and long untended.  The eerie shapes stand like hollow souls over the dead ash-covered earth below.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Jade]]
description: Flecks of shattered jade lie strewn amidst the rough gravel of the road.  Images etched into the flat panels of rock that were once a busy street are now worn to nothingness, their patterns long forgotten.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Jade]]
description: Slender jade obelisks mottled with dust and ash stand guard over the narrow road.  The way is clear, footprints from recent travel constantly being worn over one another in the soft earth below.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Jade]]
description: An ornate jade plant rests amidst a circle of pale white stones.  Each leaf is delicately carved from the blushing green stone.  Despite being covered in filth, it remains a beautiful work of art.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Jade]]
description: An elaborate golden stand is firmly bolted to the stone of the road.  Remnants of a jade-green glass sphere lie in sharp slivers on the surrounding grass.  Bits of coarse vegetation grow between the pieces of glass.

title: [[Lava Flow, Path of Jade]]
description: Prickly, spine-covered bushes grow close to the ground.  Ripe red fruit tauntingly dangles from behind long, sharp thorns.

title: [[Lava Flow, Wall of Swords]]
description: A tall barrier lines each side of the road, bladed edges topping the polished wooden beams that compose the wall.

title: [[Lava Flow, Wall of Swords]]
description: Wooden panels in the fence are carved into the jagged images of swords and weapons from lands far and near.  The barbed metal partitions holding them together make touching the wall a most unpleasant thought.

title: [[Lava Forge, Lobby and Book Store]]
description: Dust drifts through the archway over the cooled lava floor and piles in the corners of the stone building.  A bored Human attendant relaxes on a stool near a leather curtain that closes off the rest of the forge.

title: [[Lava Flow, Wall of Swords]]
description: The volcano of the Lesser Fist looms over the barricade.  It ominously shadows all below it.  A glimpse of something reflective glints from near the maw of the fortress.

title: [[Lava Flow, Way of Swords]]
description: Ashes and dust coat the stone wall, covering the rock with a granulated layer of grey that abates only near an inset bronze plaque.  A sparkling crystal hand is attached over the polished metal, also clear of the choking dust.

title: [[Lava Flow, Esouvar's Rest]]
description: The signs of ancient battle mark the area.  A tall statue, at least thirty feet in height, towers far above the parched landscape.  Eyes of faceted blue crystal sparkle brightly from the ash-streaked marble face.

title: [[Lava Flow, Esouvar's Rest]]
description: A red-veined marble fountain proudly shimmers with droplets of clear, cool water.  Small flameroses grow up its sides, their tender green tendrils bearing small jade-green leaves that perfume the air with a heady scent.

title: [[Lava Flow, Garden of Ash]]
description: Once a lovely garden, little remains of its original beauty.  Recent plantings line the roadside, clippings and trees freshly cultivated in an attempt to renew the land.

title: [[Lava Flow, Garden of Ash]]
description: A delicate moonflower bush, petals closed as the flowers sleep during the day, stands encircled by an almost fragile iron trellis.  The clean area and well-tended soil betray an unseen caretaker overseeing the beautiful plant.
The soft blue-white blossoms of a moonflower bush open their luminous faces to the night sky.

title: [[Lava Flow, Garden of Ash]]
description: The long shadow of the Lesser Fist of Heaven dominates the small garden.  The formidable fortress to the west rises high above the ground below, with the silhouette of the Greater Fist behind it towering yet farther into the reaches of the sky.

title: [[Lava Path, Dwindling Way]]
description: A volcano lies to the west.  Fortified and well-guarded, it serves as the Fortress of the Crystal Hand.  The dark path, made from hardened lava, is streaked with veins of polished obsidian that glisten with a dull satin sheen.

title: [[Lava Path, The Stone Stairway]]
description: A large stone staircase winds its way down the front of the volcano, carved into the face of the rock.  A glimmering crystal formation to the west seems to catch the scarce light, glowing with a scintillating aura.

title: [[Outside the Fortress, Obsidian Doors]]
description: The door to the volcanic fortress is comprised of two enormous obsidian panels, both ornately carved.  The slender path, chiseled from the lava, leads to a large stone staircase descending to the ground below.  Embedded in the dense rock above the entrance rests a crystal hand encircled by angular runes.

The once mighty obsidian doors are fallen, shattered, and the way clogged with ruin.  All that remains of its former occupants are bits of bone and the remnants of a large crystal hand, scattered when it was dashed to the ground.  A spartan staircase, chiseled from lava, winds down the face of the stony wall.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Atrium]]
description: Light floods in from above, the only outlet to the distant skies being the gaping mouth of the volcano.  The slender outline of a catwalk is thrown against the canvas of the sky, a barely noticeable line.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Atrium]]
description: A statue carved from a pale grey rock rests inside a circular path of dark stones at the center of the atrium.  Offerings of flowers and incense are left before it, testament to the monks' ever-enduring memories.  A rough obsidian path leads west toward the Guild library.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Stone Garden]]
description: Small iridescent grey rocks carpet the rough lava floor.  They are meticulously raked into ornate spiraling patterns.  A slender obsidian walkway winds geometrically through the garden, dividing the crushed stone into abstract triangular shapes.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Stone Garden]]
description: A dark walkway of obsidian frames the field of grey crushed stone at the center of the room.  Monks wander along the path, heads bowed in quiet contemplation.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Weapon Salle]]
description: Racks upon racks of weapons line the walls, most staves or keen-edged spears.  Some blades, well-polished and edged, gleam from among their wooden, practice counterparts.  The floor is clean and well-kept, the signs of monks recently training lingering about.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Rough Stairway]]
description: A tall stairway carved into the rock of the volcano winds its way precariously upwards, leading to a slender catwalk far above.  It appears impossibly steep, but several monks ascend the way with no problem.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Meditation Room]]
description: The walls and ceiling are featureless grey rock with a smooth polished surface.  Dark linen pillows, flat and hard to the touch, are placed around the area.  A small censer lets the potent scent of sweet incense drift lazily about.

title: [[On the Catwalk]]
description: The skies open above, visible through a crystal dome capping the volcano.  Daylight makes the slender catwalk seem extremely treacherous as it stretches most precariously over the vast expanse below.

title: [[On the Catwalk, Above the Foyer]]
description: The thin platform extends further west, the expansive sky above seeming close indeed.  The crystal dome capping the volcano exposes the vast horizon, hiding nothing.

title: [[Platform's Edge, Seat of the Guildmaster]]
description: A large circular stone platform rests suspended in mid-air over the center of the volcano.  The precarious catwalk extends to its edge.

title: [[Inside the Fortress, Guild Library]]
description: Monks kneel and sit on the charcoal gunny pillows scattered about the room.  In hushed whispers, they read and debate combative and mystical theory alike.  Glowing orbs of polished crystal illuminate the room, providing a gentle light for study and the gaining of wisdom.

title: [[Library, Archive Room]]
description: The silence of the archives is broken only by the soft sound of scratching pens as monks work copying ancient texts that have begun to decay.  Files, treatises and endless scrolls of parchment line the bookcases to aid visitors in their researches.

title: [[Archive Room, Museum Foyer]]
description: The foyer to the Guild museum is sparsely decorated.  Featureless walls of polished lava rise up to the crystal dome, the edge of the catwalk barely in sight.  A winding spiral staircase descends into the stronghold below.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hallway Foyer]]
description: An elegant staircase made from polished stone spirals upwards to the main level.  A passage north leads to a series of catacombs carved into the base of the volcano.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: The chambers of the museum appear to be carved from the basalt rock of the volcano.  A dark indigo silk runner lines the cold stone of the floor.  Silver sconces embracing small orbs of glowing tzgaa line the walls.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: A large glass panel flanks the wall, parchment pages held securely in place behind the protective display.  A small brass plaque is tacked to the wall beneath it.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: A large contraption, composed of many gears and glassine parts, focuses one thick crystal lens over an almost invisible specimen.  A sliver of something almost imperceptably small glitters beneath.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: This room is plain and spartan, containing only an enclosed glass case bearing a treasure from ancient days.  Even the obsidian walls are featureless, the black rock smooth and polished.  A silverwillow sign hangs from delicate chains over the display.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: Three panels of cloth hang from the walls depicting various scenes from the Guild's past.  One notable portrayal is that of Katzel's execution.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: A bold bright blue banner hangs above this exhibit.  Older monks pass by, nodding and winking at each other, the occasional one bowing reverently towards the large painting on display.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Promenade]]
description: Tapestries and paintings from various provinces of Elanthia cover the walls in this area.  Sculptures and other remnants from past civilizations attest to their age.

title: [[Beneath the Fortress, Hall of Relics]]
description: Swaths of velvet lie draped over this exhibit, one curtain drawn back to reveal a cracked oval mirror.  Ropes cordon off the display.  Most people lower their eyes as they pass, not daring to look, nervously shuffling onward.

title: [[North Road, Plains]]
description: An ancient ash tree crowns the top of a nearby hillside, spreading its branches outwards like long embracing arms.  A brilliant yellow spray of blooming mustard flowers grows beneath, shining like the early sun against the shaded green backdrop.

title: [[Forest Path]]
description: The trees seem to hold an aura of fragility about them, as if the burden of the moss that drips from their boughs weighs them down to the point of snapping.  Odd carvings have been hung from the branches of the trees, their stone and wooden visages stirring on the wind and clattering against one another.

title: [[Forest Path]]
description: Signs of sickening cling to the trees and the whisper of unseen creatures moving about alerts you to the fact that you are not alone.  The ground is a blasted, black color, and dry stalks of grass that hold no promise of life poke up from the barren earth.  To the northwest clamber a set of mountains that look less than a mile away, if that.

title: [[Forest Path]]
description: The trees that grow here just barely comprise a forest, their tortured, claw-like branches scraping the sky and rendering them so malformed it is impossible to tell what type of tree they are.  A matted layer of thick, molding leaves cover the floor, filling the air with a miasma-like stench that makes your stomach cringe.

title: [[Forest Path, Rocky Shore]]
description: The trees grow unsteadily along this rocky patch of ground, and in many places they have fallen.  The lapping of water greets your ears to the west, and glancing in that direction you can see a small lake the color of dull lead, its shores reaching all the way to the edge of a mountain range that makes an ugly black slash across the horizon.

title: [[Forest Path, Rocky Shore]]
description: The trees cling to a tedious life along the path that winds around the shore of the Silverwater Lake.  The ground is firmly packed, and ruts dig deeply into the earth on either side, remnants of a once thriving community.  The dead slap of water against water brings an eerie echo up from the lake shore.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: A slight breeze mingles fresh, damp air from the outside with the musty dryness of this ancient cave.  The ground rises slightly as it heads north into the center of the lair.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out.

title: [[Wilderness, Clearing]]
description: The trees and undergrowth stop abruptly at the edge of this small clearing, the hard, cracked soil underfoot showing no sign of vegetation.  A broken cart lies near a cold fire pit in the center of the clearing, several pieces of unused firewood poking their heads over its splintered sides.  A small cave leads into the rocky hillside.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Entrance]]
description: A jagged rip in the mountainside marks the entrance to the Silverwater Mines.  Broken support beams, shattered lanterns, and deep gouges in the fine sand that lie around the opening are all that remain of a once prosperous establishment.  You can barely make out what lies beyond, save for a few dark shapes and odd snickering noises.

title: [[Forest Path, Rocky Shore]]
description: A shattered wood beam crosses your path here, the remnants of a house that has now long since vanished.  Fragments of rocks lie scattered across the ground, turning treacherously underfoot.  The ground creates odd embankments, as if the hand of a god pushed it back with one quick, idle brush.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: Strange noises bounce off the ragged stone ceiling, amplified by the quiet air of the night.  The dark is so thick that you can hardly see ahead, and the only thing clueing you toward the exit is the lapping sound of the lake shore coming from the south.  To the north the tunnel is choked with debris, but maneuverable.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: Broken stones, abandoned tools, and wooden beams choke this bottleneck passageway.  The smooth stone walls rise up to either side, constricting movement and creating a pretty place for an ambush.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: The mine opens up into a somewhat larger room here, the walls extending up some fifty feet before shading off into darkness.  In the center of the chamber is a deep shaft that plunges as far down as the walls climb up.  The floor is oddly free of the debris that litters the rest of the mines.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, down.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Shaft]]
description: The smooth walls of the mine shaft rise up to either side, a glossy black color.  Some fifty feet of sheer wall rests between this platform, the opening above, and the next platform below.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: Luminescent fungi on the walls manages to lend light to this small, damp chamber.  Deep gouges cut through the ground, leaving glassy tracks and making the floor uneven.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: The tunnel dead-ends here, choked by a wall of rubble and stone that blocks all further passage.  Chunks of rock lie strewn around you, and from beyond the stones you can hear a faint snickering sound.  A fine layer of dust lies over everything, and here and there you notice the faint tracings of footprints.

title: [[Silverwater Mines, Tunnel]]
description: A rusting steel track is embedded into the cave floor here, running east ten feet before vanishing behind a wall of solid rock.  It is apparent from the stops at the visible end of the track that it began here, but hard to determine how it came to go through a wall, or how a wall came to grow up around it.  In the distance a repetitious dripping sound echoes through the cavern, doing nothing for the nerves.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: Ambient light dances across the face of a large crystalline formation that stretches from floor to ceiling, teasing ever-changing shadows across the room.  To the left of the crystals, a flow of smooth limestone has shaped itself into a natural staircase leading up to the rock lip encircling the chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: An array of intertwining crystalline vines laces the jagged rock walls, their smooth, dry surfaces gleaming dully in the ambient light.  Crude steps chiseled into the walls lead up to a wide stone ledge.  A fine patina of dust covers the floor, roiling into brown clouds with the slightest disturbance.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: Velvety limestone draperies flow down the far wall, adding a superficial appearance of softness to the rock's surface.  A number of flat, grey stones have been stacked into a tower of precarious steps leading up to a wide rock lip that encirles the entire cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: Milky-white deposits of limestone cascade down the northwest wall in formation created long ago but long since dried and dead.  A casualty of the near-total darkness, a spindly, single-leafed stalk hangs limply over the edge of a cracked clay pot that squats near one of the doors set into the walls of the cavern.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Fire Pit]]
description: Rows of stacked stones surround a deep firepit in the center of the dirt floor.  A mass of ash, pieces of blackened wood and small bits of fire-greyed bone fill the pit, their presence adding a slight scent of char to the air.  Several large stone benches line the walls, chiseled from the cave's native limestone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Grotto]]
description: Silent stalactites glint far overhead with an eerie iridescence that lights the entire cavern in a pale, green glow.  A pile of large boulders along one wall give shelter to a tiny opening nestled in the rock face.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Karik Rim]]
description: A stream of cool water trickles from a narrow crack in the rock wall and onto the floor, forming a small pool.  An even smaller rivulet dribbles from the other side of the pool, spreading across the nearby rock to evaporate into the warm, dry air.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Karik Rim]]
description: A painting of a huge, four-legged creature dominates the near wall of this section of the chamber.  A plethora of runic symbols encircle the figure, interspersed between them the outlines of several large handprints.  The entire piece has been painted in the same, unvarying ochre hue.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Karik Rim]]
description: A row of stalagmites form a natural railing along the lip of the stone walkway underfoot, lending a modicum of protection against falling to the cavern floor below.  The air is slightly warmer here than the rest of the cave.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Karik Rim]]
description: A pile of discarded skulls and bones lies at the base of one wall, gleaming dully in the dim light.  The walls here are stained a smokey grey, darker near the lower areas where an abandoned firepit is slowly being consumed by the steady accumulation of dust on the cavern's floor.

title: [[Gazit Lair, Karik Rim]]
description: This large stone ledge, wide enough for a yak caravan to travel, circles the entire rim of the cavern.  A series of crude drawings have been sketched along the walls, their images showing miniature Gor'Togs standing in an endless battle against creatures frozen in time.

title: [[Silverwater Lake, Shore]]
description: The dull, listless waters of Silverwater Lake spread out before you, a rippling matte mirror.  Except for the choppy slap of the waves against the black sands of the shore, the lake is quiet and devoid of any sign of fish or wildlife.

title: [[Silverwater Lake, Shore]]
description: A steep bank of rocks and dirt climbs up to the east, creating a short but unclimbable wall.  To the west the water of Silverwater Lake thrashes in its death throes, sucking away at the pebbled sands of the shore.  The stillness is unsettling, and a little frightening.

title: [[Silverwater Lake, Shore]]
description: Quarry piled along the shore and the remnants of a deep channel that leads up to the mines indicates that this may have once been the place where the miners dumped the remains of the day's excursions.  A fine, gritty layer of black covers everything, and the water is noticeably darker by comparison to the rest of the lake.

title: [[Silverwater Lake, Shore]]
description: The shoreline becomes more and more rocky until it finally turns into the treacherous mountainside.  Tall and majestic, the range cups the lake in a halfmoon shape.  An earthquake from time immemorial has split the part of the mountain's side that faces Silverwater, leaving a sheer wall of granite that dives straight down into the water with reckless abandon.  A splendid and awe-inspiring cataract topples aimlessly over the straightest cliff, feeding the lake but never dispelling its grim hue.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: A river-rock wall extends east to west, protecting the northern end of a rambling village.  The open village gate looks out across a vast stretch of the fields worked by the villagers.  A dirt pathway winds southward through a collection of cottages, shops and huts standing at odd angles, most with a fence or ditch fronting the path.  Farmers, returning from a day in the fields, find fellowship and food in the conveniently-located pub, The Pig's Pannage, its open doors just a short walk from the gate.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: The clang of a blacksmith's hammer comes from the doorway of a stone building fronted with a large shoeing yard.  A Gor'Tog farmer works at shoeing an ox suspended in a leather sling.  The uncomfortable ox rolls its eye to look at you and lets out a protesting bellow.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: A willow-framed building with a thatched broom roof faces the path.  Strutting proudly across the front of the house is a family of geese.  The youngest stops to peck at something on the ground, until he is nudged onward by his elders.  A carved signpost stands at the pathway.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: Colorful flowers and bushes laden with berries grow in a wild, brilliant display around a stone cottage topped with a roof thatched with heather.  A small grey donkey pokes its head out of the open doorway and gazes at you inquisitively.

Clumps of bushes grow around a stone cottage topped with a roof thatched with heather.  A night owl perches atop the cottage peering down at you, its white face luminous in the dark night.  It lets out a single hoot, then flaps its wings and vanishes into the darkness.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: A colorful wagon is parked alongside the pathway, red and gold banners flapping in the breeze, the rippling cloth nearly drowning out a faint snoring coming from within.  Clustered together at the nether end of the village are a small village green with an impressive manor house and an old mill just beyond it.

A wagon is parked alongside the pathway, banners flapping in the night breeze.  It appears to be closed up for the night.  You hear a faint snoring coming from within.  Just beyond the village green to the south, you can see the glowing windows of a large building and the dark silhouette of a mill.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: From somewhere off to the south you can hear the rumble and splash of the miller's waterwheel.  A straw thatched house is set off from the path with clay pots, bowls and urns displayed in its windows.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: A rickety wagon lurches past you, pulled by wide-horned oxen.  A Gor'Tog wagoneer walking alongside the rumbling vehicle nods and tips his hat as he passes by.  Clouds of dust eddy about the deep ruts left in the dirt roadway as the cart passes.  A sturdy wood and stone building marks the local Trader's Guild outpost.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Alcove]]
description: A booth with a wooden table and benches is tucked into the alcove, offering a quieter spot for private conversation.  Occasionally the loud thunk of a metal tankard being slammed onto the bar makes you aware of the activities in the central part of the pub.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Pub]]
description: A huge black and gold banner dominates the wall behind a massive stone bar.  Several Gor'Tog farmers are huddled together at one end, muttering to each other in low, rumbling voices.  Gurta, the alewife, slams a tankard on the bar and sends it sailing down to the farmers.  A platter of bacon and beans follows the tankard.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Havor's Forge]]
description: The smell of hot iron assails you as you enter the domain of Havor, the Gor'Tog blacksmith.  A massive anvil and stone forge stand side by side on the hard dirt floor, and tools of the blacksmith's craft lay neatly arranged on a wooden bench.  Several grinding wheels and a bin holding lengths of iron make up the rest of Havor's shop.

title: [[Tiger Clan, Trader's Guild Outpost]]
description: This outpost is a replica of the great Trader Guild buildings in the larger towns.  Designed for easy buying and selling of bulk goods by Guild members, it is crammed and jammed with crates, boxes and packages of all manner and value.  A worried-looking Guild trade minister is at hand to expedite transactions and to make sure none of the goods leave without the proper fees and monies being exchanged.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Peddler's Wagon]]
description: Every inch of this roomy covered wagon has been used efficently to store an amazing array of trinkets, colorful clothing and carryalls.  The peddler Posimur reclines against the back of the wagon half asleep midst a pile of discarded cloth, leather and string.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Village Green]]
description: Squeals and giggles come from a group of Gor'Tog children who are running around a small, blindfolded lad.  The lad stumbles around, flailing his arms, trying to tag one of the others.  A wooden bridge spans across a deep moat to the south, where a large manor house stands proudly overlooking the surrounding area.  The village stocks are set off in the far corner of the green.
The village green is filled with the night music of crickets and a lone owl who sits perched on a branch, hooting solemnly.  A wooden bridge spans a dark crevice to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: The dirt pathway ends at a small, neatly-kept toft that fronts a quaint cottage.  Bees buzz industriously around the tall shrubs of sage, rosemary and nutmeg geranium that border the yard, attracted by their spicy herbal fragrance.
The dirt pathway ends at a small toft fronting a cottage where candlelight shimmers from the windows.  Dark, herbal-scented shrubs border the yard.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Dirt Pathway]]
description: A column of smoke spirals out of the tall stone chimney of a simple brick building.  The dirt path to its door is trampled hard, and a delicious aroma wafts from the open doorway.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Old Mill]]
description: An old mill looks over the shoreline of the Segoltha River, its massive waterwheel splashing and churning the river's deep water.  Tall grasses and willows grow abundantly around the mill grounds.  Village women stand in groups collecting bundles of willow wands and grass.
An old mill looks over the shoreline of the Segoltha River, its massive waterwheel splashing and churning the river's deep water.  Tall grasses and willows grow abundantly around the mill grounds.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Churchyard]]
description: A neat line of flat white stones paves the pathway leading up to the door of an old church.  A small cemetery has been set off in the churchyard, bordered by low hedges of lavender.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Communal Ovens]]
description: A massive brick and iron oven fills the small shop, leaving barely enough space for the portly baxter Fernar, who stands behind a narrow wooden counter.  The delicious aroma of baking bread emanates from the oven, along with waves of intense heat.  The bulky Gor'Tog removes a tray of plump buns, and squirms back around to place them on the countertop.  A village woman enters the shop, hands Fernar a bowl of rising dough with brisk instructions, then lumbers purposefully out the door.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Cottage Croft]]
description: The croft behind the stone cottage is a bountiful herb garden overflowing with clumps of hyssop, angelica, liverwort, monkshood and sweet woodruff.  The abundant growth partially obscures a stone birdbath where a family of purple larks sit, sipping at the water and cheerfully chirping to each other.
Heady herbal scents rise from the dark clumps that fill the croft garden.  A stone birdbath sits silent and still in the center of the garden.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Small Cottage]]
description: The scents of aromatic smoke and drying herbs hang in the air in this tidy one-room cottage.  A tall drying cupboard stands against one wall, conveniently near the stone hearth.  An odd assortment of vials, flasks and copper pots line the mantel.  Bunches of herbs hang from wooden pegs mounted into the ceiling beams and window frames.  The floor is beaten earth covered with fresh rushes.  A stooped old woman works a set of bellows, keeping the hearth's fire going at full blast.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Cottage Toft]]
description: Chickens, pigs and donkeys roam freely in the yard, penned in by the high shrubs that surround them.  A quaint little stone cottage with a roof thatched with rushes sits at the far end of the toft.  Bunches of herbs hang in its open windows.  A purple lark hops back and forth along the roof's edge, eyeing you suspiciously.  Perhaps it guards a nest up there in the rushes?

title: [[Provincial Bank, Teller]]
description: A neat row of barred windows faces you along a marble counter.  Several patrons are already busy but there seems to be one window available.  The clerk smiles at you and beckons you over.

title: [[First Provincial Bank, Lobby]]
description: Marble tiled floors covered with heavy rugs and walls of polished jasper that gleam a cool blue mark this bank as solid and secure (and expensive).  An official money-changing booth is to one side and a row of tellers windows faces you.  Several guards, armed and armored, stand ready for trouble of any sort.  Near the tellers stands a table of fine wood for those who need to do some writing.

title: [[Provincial Bank, Money-changer]]
description: This small booth holds the official money-changing office for the town.  The clerk works behind a thickly barred window and you pass your money in and out via a small drawer that can only be worked by the clerk.  A well-padded chair is placed for your comfort while waiting for your money to be processed.

title: [[The Heavens]]
description: The ferry rocks gently as you step aboard.  Surrounded by the cool, briny air of the Segoltha, you take your place on the deserted deck and gaze up into the night sky.

title: [[Southern Trade Route, Segoltha South Bank]]
description: The southern bank of the Segoltha River presents a wide, flat flood plain far to the east and west.  The alluvial soil here is deep brown and fertile, nourished by the unpredictable rains that cause the river to rise rapidly and without warning.  Off in the distance to the south, you can spy the crests of trees.  This marks the boundary of the Endrus Forest, which surrounds the fabled Elven stronghold of Leth Deriel.
