description: Through the darkness, only the outline of the looming forest is visible.  From the distance, a lone howl floats out from deep within the darkened woods.

The field meets the edge of the forest here as mighty pine and oak trees reach upward, beginning to close off the view of the sky.  The ground is covered with branches and pinecones that have been blown off the nearby trees by a gust of wind.

title: [[Pinemast Field, Edge of the Forest]]
description: A rolling field covered in low verdant grass and branching animal trails falls away from the tree line, sloping down to the west only to rise gently again as it continues toward the river.  Tree stumps gradually give way to rockier loam, causing passage over land to be cautious at best and near impossible for anything other than foot traffic.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Pinemast Field, Narrow Track]]
description: The sheer size of the boulder here makes it impossible to miss in the dark of the night.  Scatterings of smaller rocks about its base, treacherous enough by day, are even more hazardous in the evening, which adds to the perils of the already rough and tricky terrain.

About the size of a mammoth sow and easily as difficult to shift, an enormous boulder dominates a depressed section of land, surrounded by a scattered litter of smaller rocks which the ravages of beasts and weather have caused to break off from the larger mass.  Coarse vegetation clings to the rocky soil, spread like a threadbare blanket.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Pinemast Field, Edge of the Forest]]
description: Standing like sentinels edging the forest, tops of tall pines are swallowed in the darkness of night.  Covering the ground, nature has laid a blanket of leaves that's soft underfoot, muffling the sound of travel.  Large golden-capped mushrooms shine through the darkness in clusters around thick tree roots, thriving in the compost that scents the air.

Standing like sentinels edging the forest, tall pines compete with white oaks in a never-ending race towards the sky.  Fallen needles blanket the ground, fragrant underfoot.  Large golden-capped mushrooms prized by local residents cluster around thick tree roots, thriving in the compost that scents the air.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Pinemast Field, Edge of the Forest]]
description: Staggered pine trees form a windbreak, which borders this vast rolling field of low grass and beaten animal tracks.  Low stumps pepper the landscape, suggesting in the past the forest once spread quite a bit further toward the river to the west.

title: [[Kukalakai's Grove, Dim Glade]]
description: Secluded and shaded by a circle of ban-minahle trees, this is the perfect place for contemplating deep thoughts -- which may be why it was the Lady Kukalakai's favorite place to do exactly that.  Thick grass grows up around a ring of benches in the center of the glade, and the vaguest hint of honeysuckle drifts through the air.  The quiet twittering of wrens completes the sense of relaxation.  Here even the over-agitated can be content to simply be.

title: [[The Great Tower, Kukalakai's Grove]]
description: Shadows have dimmed the silvery beauty of the precious ban-minahle trees that grow here, softening the metallic sheen on the leaves to a moonlit glow.  Tiny lights flicker through the air, vanishing and reappearing as they dart beneath the leaves, just barely illuminating the presence of a narrow tunnel leading through the trees to a dim glade.

A thicket of precious ban-minahle trees grow in a small and well-groomed clump here, their silvery, lirum coin-sized leaves shimmering in a lakeside breeze that causes them to make a soft fluttering sound reminescent to chimes.  A rich carpet of emerald green grass pads the ground, and a narrow tunnel leads through the trees into a dim glade.

title: [[The Great Tower, Courtyard South]]
description: The softly gleaming silver Great Tower eats up most of the ground of this darkened cobbled courtyard.  Twin globes of crystal illuminate the south entrance to the Great Tower, catching on the armor of the tower's guards.  A thicket of trees can be glimpsed to the east, and a curious rock formation silhouette catches the eye to the west.

The gleaming silver Great Tower eats up most of the ground of this small, cobbled courtyard.  Guards flank the south entrance to the Great Tower, their plate gleaming and their shields at the ready.  A thicket of trees can be glimpsed to the east, and a curious formation of rocks catches the eye to the west.

title: [[The Great Tower, Garden of Serenity]]
description: Several feet of ground have been cordoned off and covered with carefully raked sand in this part of the courtyard.  Torches on wrought iron poles light the rocks that have apparently been placed randomly on the sand.  Stone benches around the arrangement allow it to be viewed from a variety of angles.  A guard stands watch over the garden.

Several feet of ground have been cordoned off and covered with carefully raked sand in this part of the courtyard.  Rocks have apparently been placed randomly on the sand, and benches have been set about the area.  A guard stands watch over the garden, assuring that no one tampers with its arrangement.

title: [[The Great Tower, Courtyard West]]
description: Small blue pebbles have been embedded in the path that leads north and south around the Great Tower and west through a glittering crystal archway leading to Moonstone Street.  Closer examination reveals that tiny black moon-shaped carvings have been captured in the glass of the stones, floating amidst a sea of hard sapphire.

title: [[The Great Tower, Courtyard East]]
description: Squares of limestone the color of pale lapis lazuli split into a path that leads northward toward the sound of a fountain and southward to a stand of dark trees.  A gentle perfumed breeze wafts from north to south, surrounding the graceful ash arch that leads into this section of the courtyard of the Great Tower.

Yellow daffodils and purple crocuses bloom in front of dark green camellia bushes at the base of the tower.  A flagstone path through the flower beds leads south to a stand of dark trees and north from where the sound of splashing water can be heard.

Beds of chrysanthemums from darkest bronze through bright orange to the palest ivory bloom in front of dark green camellia bushes at the base of the tower. A flagstone path through the flowers leads south to a stand of dark trees and north from where the sound of splashing water can be heard.

title: [[The Great Tower, Garden of Lights]]
description: Rings of vibrant colors glow from the bottom of the water-filled pool that lies just off the path winding through this sedate garden.  The light illuminates the trunks and boughs of the half-circle of weeping silverwillows that rings the pool and glances off the thick, glossy leaves of the ivy that climbs over the walls and grounds.

A circular pool ringed partially with weeping silverwillows lies just off the path that winds through this sedate garden of honeysuckle, succulent ivy, and morning glories.  Water shoots up out of the center of the pool, falling down in a fan of droplets that sparkle in the light.  The lights for which this garden was named do not actually become apparent until after dark.

title: [[The Great Tower, Courtyard North]]
description: A softly glowing light filters in from the east, while deep shadows blot out the view to the west.  The delicately sweet perfume of night-blooming flowers and the gentle splash of fountains weaves its way through the air, harmonious and soothing.  A set of crystal globes filled with a luminescent mist illuminates the sweeping marble archway to the north leading back to Diamond Street.  The base of the Great Tower dominates the view to the south, its main entrance eternally open.

The musical splash of a fountain echoes through the courtyard from the east and west, while the perfume of constantly upkept plants and flowering vines floating with the sound through the air.  A sweeping marble archway to the north leads back to Diamond Street.  The base of the Great Tower dominates the view to the south, its main entrance eternally open.

title: [[The Great Tower, Garden of Shadows]]
description: Thorny black rose bushes and flowering purple lilacs decorate this dense and shadowy garden.  Only a good set of hedge clippers and a careful gardener have kept the path from becoming overgrown.  The only brightness in the dark foliage is the single cherry tree, dropping white petals like snowflakes.

title: [[Garden of Lights, Gazebo]]
description: Deep shadows wrap this hexagonal-shaped gazebo, draping down from the roof in the form of bougainvillea vines.  Padded benches and a living curtain of thickly growing honeysuckle ivy that weaves a latticework of privacy completes the sense of removal from the weary world.  Soft light blooms up from time to time from the garden beyond, warm and gentle.

Light pink bougainvillea flowers wrap around this hexagonal-shaped gazebo, draping down from the roof to drop soft, papery petals to the wooden floor.  Padded benches and a living curtain of thickly growing honeysuckle ivy that weaves in with the bougainvillea vines complete the total sense of removal from the world that lies beyond this small, dim enclosure.

title: [[The Great Tower, Entryway]]
description: Walls of gleaming white marble sweep like seagull's wings in a wide, massive circle.  A tile mosaic of dark material is embedded in the floor, the type of substance that releases a most satisfying *click* when walked across wearing metal-shod boots.  A short passage leads east, and there is a narrow corridor northwest.  Gleaming mahogany doors lead west, and a spiral stairway allows access to other levels.

title: [[The Great Tower, Debt Collector's Office]]
description: Dimly lit by a tiny crystal globe on a polished oak desk, this office is neat and tidy by nature of necessity -- the necessity in this case being the room's small size.  A locked box has been bolted into the ground next to the desk, an effort to keep the honest workers here honest.  Though no vents or open windows can be detected in any of the convex walls, there is a fresh breeze drifting through the air, flushing out the stale scent of money.

title: [[The Great Tower, Chamber of Voices]]
description: This room is a touch chilly despite the red carpet that has been laid down on the floor.  Aisles of polished wooden benches allow for around seventy Human adults to sit in comfortably.  A raised dais occupies the rear of the room, an ornate podium rising up in front of it.

title: [[The Great Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Cool and quiet, the walls of this small stairwell encourage silence and decorum.  A short passage to the south leads to the central library of Shard, the largest repository of books, scrolls and manuscripts in Ilithi.

title: [[The Great Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Cool and quiet, the walls of this small stairwell close in tightly -- a claustrophobic's nightmare.  Steps lead up to the next level and down to the main entrance.  A door on the south wall allows entry to the rest of this part of the tower.

title: [[The Great Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Cool and quiet, the walls of this small stairwell close in tightly -- a claustrophobic's nightmare.  Steps lead up to the next level and down to the museum level.  A door on the south wall allows entry to the rest of this part of the tower.

title: [[The Great Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Cool and quiet, the walls of this small stairwell close in tightly -- a claustrophobic's nightmare.  Steps lead up to the next level and down to the Corridor of Power.  A door on the south wall allows entry to the rest of this part of the tower.

title: [[The Great Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Cool and quiet, the walls of this small stairwell close in tightly -- a claustrophobic's nightmare.  Steps lead up to the next level and down to the chambers of the Ferdahl.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Aviary Stair]]
description: An ivory-banistered staircase, the steps paved with black-veined marble, opens up here onto the floor of a vast aviary.  The Elanthian sky is visible through an atrium ceiling far overhead, the roof of the Great Tower set with panes of nearly invisible crystal.  Ringed by somber pillars, a wide marble walkway circumnavigates the aviary and opens up onto a number of side passages.  A golden plaque is set into the floor.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Western Walkway]]
description: A marble walk encircles the open aviary to the east, the sounds of fluttering wings and musical bird-calls warbling through the humid air.  A tall archway opens to the northwest, and beyond it can be seen tall ironwood shelves lined with books.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Library]]
description: To protect the rare books here from the rays of the sun, a smooth marble canopy stretches over this clammy chamber.  Dark ironwood shelves stretch from floor to ceiling, their contents illuminated by softly glowing magical sconces on the walls.  Finely-carved tables and desks are scattered through the room, where scholars work dilligently at all hours.

To protect the rare books here from the rays of the sun, a smooth marble canopy stretches over this clammy chamber.  Dark ironwood shelves stretch from floor to ceiling, their contents illuminated by softly glowing magical sconces on the walls.  Finely-carved tables and desks are scattered through the room, where scholars work dilligently at all hours.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Eastern Walkway]]
description: This marble walkway encircles the open aviary to the west, the occasional student or elder mage quietly walking through.  An archway opens onto a short hallway to the southeast, and this walk curves around to the southwest and northwest.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Northern Walkway]]
description: This marble walkway encircles the open aviary to the south, running around to the southwest and southeast.  To the far south you can see the staircase leading down into the Great Tower, and an open archway leads north.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Aviary]]
description: Rare and exotic plants and trees stretch up from the soft loam of the aviary, nesting-places for tropical birds imported to the guild from many lands.  They soar from tree to tree and wheel through the air beneath the crystal skylights above, their bodies hued in every color of the rainbow.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Short Hallway]]
description: Barely ten feet long, this brief walk connects to the vast open chamber to the northwest, and opens onto smaller rooms to the northeast and southwest.  It ends in a sheer crystal wall, looking out over the city of Shard far below.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Guildmaster's Chamber]]
description: Tropical birds nest in marble creches flanking this wide hall, sometimes fluttering through the air beneath the crystal skylights far above.  Soft harp music can faintly be heard in the air, and a gentle breeze carries the scent of pears and pineapples.  A silver dais sits at the head of the hall, a throne for the city's Moon Mage guildleader.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Funeral Chamber]]
description: Set in the center of this rounded chamber, a sarcophagus of glistening limestone has been set out beneath the skylights far above.  Its lid is made of fine crystal so its occupant can, in some fashion, continue to watch the stars.  A golden plaque is set into the floor at the sarcophagus' base.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Atrium]]
description: The skylights curve down like a canopy over this small chamber, enclosing the northeastern hemisphere in a bubble of translucent, glittering crystal.  A polished bronze telescope is here for students of the stars, but most visitors come just for the breathtaking view.  From here, one can see for miles past the towers and streets of Shard, all the way to the walls of Leth Deriel in the far distance.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Maze Entrance]]
description: An odd mist swirls an inch above the ground of this small, dimly lit room.  Above, an unseen lightsource creates more shadows than it illuminates, painting the room hundreds of varying shades of grey.  A dark portal, guarded by a young woman in the white robes of Meraud, is cut into the north wall and leads into the maze.

title: [[The Great Tower, Library Cellar]]
description: Crystal globes have been imbedded in the ceiling, and cast a steady light for the readers who use Shard for their research.  Shelves of gleaming rosewood hold the treasures of scholars, and a lack of windows imparts the sense of timelessness that any good library conveys.

title: [[Shard, West Entrance of The Great Tower]]
description: Moonstone Street quietly empties into the west entryway of the Great Tower, the dark street flowing like a carefully diverted river north, south, and east.  A wall of bones -- rumored to be a mixture of dragon, Dragon Priests, and the Elven and Elothean heroes who laid down their lives in the last great war -- embraces an arch of glittering crystal, the skulls that mount its rim glaring down on all who would trespass upon the Ferdahl's garden.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: Dark grey stones cover the surface of Moonstone Street, creating artful whorls and spirals as the lane gradually fades away to the east.  A curious temple crouches quietly on the north side of the street, its front carved with thirteen faces that seem to fade when looked at directly.  The doors stand open despite the dark hour, and two guards wearing faceless hoods stand on either side of the door, wielding massive executioners' axes.

Dark grey stones cover the surface of Moonstone Street, creating artful whorls and spirals as the lane gradually narrows on its way east to the Great Tower.  A curious temple crouches quietly on the north side of the street, its front carved with the faces of the less beneficial aspects of the Thirteen.  A surprisingly steady traffic of curious visitors and dedicated followers keeps the temple a popular -- if uneasy -- attraction within the city.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: A splendid building composed of a fine blond wood supported by beams of crystal stands head above shoulders over all other establishments by the Bridge of Rooks on Moonstone Street.  Still more impressive is a completely crystal phoenix that seems to spring out of the doorway's lintel, its wings unfurling to sweep under the roof before curling up at the ends.  The sculpture's breathtaking beauty is only matched by the gleaming black elegance of the bridge to the west that rises up to embrace the air.

title: [[Shard, Yavash Circle]]
description: The wall of diamondique coming from the southeast bonds to the wall of bone that closes in from the north in a glittering lace that resembles a coating of frost upon an old battlefield.  The grass that edges the wall seems a little less green where it grows near the bones, as if it was lacking some vital nourishment.

title: [[Shard, Yavash Circle]]
description: Nebulous swirls of crimson mix with the glowing diamondique of the wall that encircles the Great Tower.  Jagged spikes of crystal jut up all along the rim of the protective structure, twinkling with the dangerous beauty of a starry thorn.  A careful trick of the light bends and twists the red traces within the translucent material, causing them to form faceless figures with mouths open wide in a rictus of torment that seems like no trick at all.

Traces of crimson mix with the glowing diamondique of the wall that encircles the Great Tower.  Jagged spikes of crystal jut up all along the rim of the protective structure, catching the light and bending it into sparkling rainbows.  Legend has it that the red tinge within the translucent material is the blood of those who have dared the razorsharp "thorns" of the walls -- and failed.

title: [[Shard, Yavash Circle]]
description: A wall of carved bone encircles the Great Tower on its west face, the skulls that mount its rim glaring down with watchful intent.  Bits of cloth and threads from clothing cling to the teeth of some of the hollow-eyed guardians, and whether they were carefully placed there by enterprising city guards, or the skulls actually came to life to bite into trespassers, is a mystery few wish to test.

title: [[Shard, Yavash Circle]]
description: The wall of bone that curves in from the southwest blends in with a wall of plaster from the east.  Green vines drape like a sylph's locks over one side of the white-washed plaster wall, the verdant life of nature a curious contrast to the morbid unlife of death.

title: [[Shard, North Entrance of The Great Tower]]
description: A high plaster wall marks the end of Diamond Street, the road narrowing down until it splits into three parts.  One leads up to a sweeping marble archway, while the other two paths circumvent the barrier.  The night reflects off the tower's polished surface, blurring its outline until it seems to melt into the stars.

A high plaster wall marks the end of Diamond Street, the road narrowing down until it splits into three parts.  One leads up to a sweeping marble archway, while the other two paths circumvent the barrier.  A shining silver tower rises up from beyond the walls, the brisk snap of banners hanging with all the colors of the Elothean Houses bright against the gleaming liquid silver surface.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Shard, Emerald Lane]]
description: Shadows line the street in patchy clumps, deep enough to hide anything from golden eggs to crafty thieves.  The street narrows as it empties to the southeast, the hypnotic, star-arm spiral pattern of the ebony and agate stones swirling up to the feet of the dully gleaming Great Tower.  The sound of chanting drones through the air, coming from somewhere to the southwest.

Patches of bright green grass grows around the pebbled street.  The street narrows as it empties out to the southeast, the hypnotic, spiral pattern of its blue and green stones swirling up to the feet of the Great Tower.  The sound of hawkers and the call of a street faire entices passersby to the north.

title: [[Shard, Emerald Lane Open Market]]
description: Uneasily empty, the only company for the daytime-busy market is a statue that seems to carefully guard rather than diminish the silence and stalking darkness.  The curve of a bridge allows passage to Moonstone Street to the southwest, and the glimpse of tall, peaked towers to the southeast mark the presence of the city's "alternative" temple.

Patched tents and booths formed of slats of wood that vary wildly in type and color bloom in clumps of full and myriad colors around the stiffer and more prestigious backs of the homes on Diamond Street to the north and northeast.  The curve of a bridge allows passage to Moonstone Street to the southwest.

title: [[Shard, Heart of the Emerald Lane Open Market]]
description: The soft whistling of nightbirds and the faint sound of footsteps lingers on the breeze, a pale echo of the open market activities during the day.  A bare circle of grass and benches intercepts the path, the wood of the worn seats glowing with a ghostly light in the eyes of the moons.

The ring of silver strings and the faint echo of Elven laughter weaves through the ever-changing makeshift alleys of the open market of Shard.  A bare circle of grass and benches is treated with sacred respect by the many merchants who pitch their tents here, leaving one place for people to gather and relax, safe from the push and clamor of the crowds.

title: [[Shard, Emerald Lane Open Market]]
description: Closed stalls and tightly sealed tents are the only vestiges of the market's lively daytime visage.  Amidst the maze-like "lanes" of the bazaar is one lone Human, seated with legs folded in a meditative position and clutching a grim black staff.  He is unnaturally still and silent, appearing to be a guard for a strange black tent that sits alone and unchallenged in the heart of the street.

Makeshift stalls and patchwork tents create a small village of various hagglers and item mongers.  A Human with bones woven into his beard and a grim black staff capped with a sluagh skull sits outside a tent, his eyes lit with a strange light.  Fruit carts laden with the season's best sit alongside blankets laid out on the grass and covered with various curios.

title: [[Shard, Emerald Lane]]
description: Dark stones pebble the street, bubbling up out of the earth as if the ground had been scraped away to reveal a slice of the World Dragon's sinister black underbelly.  The street is stripped down to little more than a few homes to the left and right, leaving a wide lane suitable for the passage of heavy carts and pack animals.

Bottle green stones pebble the street, bubbling up out of the earth as if the ground had been scraped away to reveal a slice of the World Dragon's left flank.  The crisp clicking of hooves rings through the air as Traders from the far corners of the Realms and farmers from a little closer to home lead their animals toward the open market to the southeast.

title: [[Shard, Emerald Lane]]
description: Shadows dapple the two graceful linden trees that grow up from the banks of the icy and swiftly moving water channel here.  Grass springs up thickly along the sides of the channel's bank, nature's own tapestry muted to the color of demon's blood.  A carved statue of a woman guards the Bridge of Linden Leaves that rises over the churning waters, her visage dimmed by the night into one of sorrow.

Two graceful linden trees grow up from the banks of a water channel that excises a chunk of land from the rest of the city here.  Emerald green grass grows in a carefully maintained spread that eventually thins out as the street widens to the southeast.  A carved statue of a woman guards the Bridge of Linden Leaves that rises over the water channel, her face gentle and her hands spread before her, as if reaching out to touch someone.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street via The Bridge of Rooks]]
description: Gleaming black railings of polished oak and planking of stained deobar compose the aptly named Bridge of Rooks.  To the east the warm glow of a building challenges the night for its control over the darkness, in no way aided by the shadow of the Great Tower that strikes out of the heart of the city further east.  The bridge connects the east and west ends of Moonstone Street, dividing near the center to meet up with Emerald Lane to the northeast and Sapphire Avenue to the southeast.

Gleaming black railings of polished oak and planking of stained deobar compose the aptly named Bridge of Rooks.  To the east the Great Tower challenges the sky for possession, its pennants rippling like a lady's ribbons in a gentle lakeside breeze.  The bridge connects the east and west ends of Moonstone Street, dividing near the center to meet up with Emerald Lane to the northeast and Sapphire Avenue to the southeast.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: The melodical chuckle of a fountain is the only sound to be heard echoing through the streets at this hour.  Immaculate homes make up much of the avenue, quiet with resting souls.  To the east, the Bridge of Rooks rises up from the street in a dark, sly arc of black wood that would be invisible were it sprinkled with stars.

There is a noticeable lack of streetwise peddlers in this part of town, and what children can be seen are kept under close watch by the appropriate guardians instead of set free to run free and underfoot.  The streets are immaculate, the gardens beautiful and ornate, kept so by heavy maintenance overseen by the city's lifesculptors.  To the east rises the dark Bridge of Rooks.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: The darkly gleaming beauty of the city's bank stands out even at night, its polished facade engraved with the image of Kertigen.  Although the doors are shut and the lights mostly extinguished, the sound of movement from the patrol that prowls the bank's grounds can still be heard making their rounds.  The three-story office of the Provincial Administrator of Orders watches over the lonely street.

An Elven overseer dressed smartly in rainbowed chain and plate watches as four Gor'Tog guards prowl about the city's bank, her arms folded over her chest and her jaw set with determination.  Composed of marble mined from the local mountains, the domed building is Elothean in design and exudes the kind of overbearing snobbery and strength that can only be bought with platinum.  The three-story office of the Provincial Administrator of Orders looms over the street.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: Deserted and lonely, a small, dark shop painted with strange gleaming markings is nearly dwarfed by the looming edifice of the nearby bank and the dramatic silhouette of the Great Tower.  A sign hangs over the doorway, swinging in the city's chilly lakeside breeze.

The glittering dome of the city's bank can be seen rising up to the east, the marble that composes it contrasting with the Great Tower that shoots up past it like a spear of silver breaking through a black cloud.  Judging by the number of people passing beneath its swinging sign to the goods that lie within, a shop painted a solemn dark blue and drawn in silver with stars and moons is the main attraction on the street.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: The dark ribbon of the road flows in a smooth line, one way rolling without a ripple toward the looming presence of Wyvern Mountain to the west, the other toward the magnificence of the dully glowing Great Tower to the east.

Cobblestones the color of chips of obsidian cover Moonstone Street, their smooth, unmarred surface revealing to be clearly much sturdier than the color they simulate.  Carts drawn by exquisitely groomed horses pass toward the east, some empty, some filled with perishables or sundries, all led by handsomely dressed young men and women infused with the bolstered pride born of the money that employs them.

title: [[Shard, Moonstone Street]]
description: The distant drone of chanting floats over the city from the west where Wyvern Mountain rises.  Held sacred by the true worshippers of the World Dragon, its primary shrine is open all year round, even if the gates that mark the end of Moonstone Street's journey west aren't.

The Bridge of Rooks rears up from the distant east like an exposed spine of black bone arching out of the dark river of cobblestones that is Moonstone Street.  Pilgrims in plain garments of woven linen move in a steady line from or to the west, heading for the city gates and the mountain that lies beyond the West Bridge where the famous shrine to the World Dragon -- built by Sh'kial -- lies.

title: [[Shard, West City Gates]]
description: The sound of chanting voices carries over the Lake of Tears and past the West Gate.  If the guards appear disturbed by the steady droning sound, they do not show it as they pace the wallwalks, eyes constantly scanning for any sign of danger in the night.

Glossy black and opaque, the diamondique West Gates of the city gleam alongside the brightly burnished armor of its guards.  The crystal walls are equally bright, all resulting in a whole that would be blinding were they any more perfect or the sun any more bright.

title: [[Shard, Xibar's Crescent Road]]
description: The city seems to pause in this small pocket side street, just apart from the mad traffic of Moonstone Street to the north and the overbearing grace of the Tower of Honor to the south.  Shaded homes sit in tranquil silence beside the path's side, content in their small slice of peace.

title: [[Shard, Katamba's Crescent Road]]
description: The sleek gleam of dark diamondique offers a tantalizing glimpse of the West Gates to the south, the shadow of Wyvern Mountain trying hard to steal the sunlight that would glance off the portal's softly rounded arch.  The lap of the water that surrounds the city is a lulling change from the sounds of Shard, carrying over through the walls and foundations that protect the city's denizens from the liquid's eroding power.

The dull glow of dark diamondique offers a tantalizing glimpse of the West Gates to the south, the shadow of Wyvern Mountain trying hard to steal what little light glances off the portal's softly rounded arch.  The lap of the water that surrounds the city is lulling, carrying over through the walls and foundations that protect Shard from the liquid's eroding power.

title: [[Shard, Bloodstone Way]]
description: Whitewashed wooden houses with colorfully painted porches line the cobblestone lane.  Copperleaf trees are planted along the side of the road, each centered neatly on the grassy verge before each house.  The precise spacing of houses and trees and the neatly trimmed grass and shrubs give the area an almost military air, as if no imperfection would be tolerated.

title: [[Shard, Katamba's Crescent Road]]
description: A thundercloud mutters ancient epithets to the sky to the northeast, its wrath focused on the tower that sits just beneath it.  To the southwest the street winds down toward the West Gate.

A thundercloud mutters ancient epithets to the night to the northeast, its wrath emitting lightning bolts that illuminate the tower that sits just beneath it.  To the southwest the street winds down toward the West Gate, the faint echo of chanting floating up from the Lake of Tears and the mountain shrine that abides beside it.

title: [[Shard, Katamba's Crescent Road]]
description: Stormwill Tower, home of the Warrior Mages and Empaths of Shard, dominates much of the view to the northwest, its ominous black and grey masonry permanently overshadowed by a single dark cloud that hovers over the keep like a bad memory.  Citizens of the city hurriedly get about their business here, either completely skirting the tower or running in or out with modest haste.  The Bridge of Linden Leaves creates safe passage over a water channel that rushes through to the south.

Stormwill Tower, home of the Warrior Mages and Empaths of Shard, dominates much of the view to the northwest, an ominous shadow that passes a heavy hand over the sky and stars.  Even more ominous is a cloud that hovers over the tower, churning and rumbling with thunder and lightning.  The babbling burble of water rushing brings comfort to the night's loneliness where the Bridge of Linden Leaves rises up, creating safe passage over one of Shard's many natural channels to the south.

title: [[Shard, Xibar's Crescent Road]]
description: The Tower of Honor -- home to the Paladins of Shard -- rises straight and tall out of the side of the glittering facets of the city walls.  The milky white stone that composes the keep is said to be imbued with the same powers as the legendary soulstones, changing color when the integrity of the guild begins to fail.  To the northeast, the Bridge of Suns braces its goldenoak feet against the bank of a water channel that would separate Xibar Street from Sapphire Avenue.

title: [[Shard, Katamba's Crescent Road]]
description: No grass grows within twenty feet of the city walls, and the homes are pulled back for at least forty.  The steep walls rise up high, their sides slick and smooth, unpitted by weather or wear.  To the southwest, Stormwill Tower bubbles up out of the walls, a small black-grey cloud hovering ominously above it.

title: [[Shard, Katamba's Crescent Road]]
description: The high walls of the city curve out of sight to the west, terminating at the city gates to the east.  Homes edge in on the trail, crowding up to the path before stopping their progression.  A small brass plaque is embedded into the walls, commemorating this place for some far away reason.

title: [[Shard, North City Gates]]
description: The massive gates of the city of Shard rise up to the north.  The twin doors of steel-braced ironwood give access to the North Bridge across the Lake of Tears.  Somber guards watch on the battlements above.
