description: Several statues have fallen down the stairs and now lay in a large heap, most of them rolled against the wall of the nearest tier.  Oddly, there is less randomness to their placement than the surrounding ruins, as if these had been moved out of the way under direction of some sentient power.  For what purpose they were moved remains unknown.

title: [[Old Throne City, Magic District]]
description: A lone tower stretches skyward, its blackened husk charred by an inferno.  Perhaps started by a careless mage fleeing Throne City or by some act of vengeful arson, nature is doing its best to reclaim the burnt structure by wrapping thin green tendrils around its form.  All around, the other buildings have been hollowed by their own catastrophies, though these have not been so unfortunate as to be ravaged by an ancient conflagration.

title: [[Old Throne City, Magic District]]
description: Even in ruination, the buildings are distinctly more utilitarian here than to the north, blending into the militant Southern Gate District.  Likely, this was once where Warrior Mages gathered to swap tales and scrolls, a choice spot to indulge in both arcane magics and combat prowess.  Precisely which building such gatherings occurred is a mystery, as all have had untold centuries of damage dealt by the passage of time.

title: [[Old Throne City, Magic District]]
description: The walls of the old city are nearby, though some sort of oddly shimmering, transparent field of subtle colors blurs the woods beyond.  Like viewing river stones beneath clear water, the world outside of Throne City shudders and ripples.  Yet within, there is no water, only the dusty remains of libraries and magical repositories, student dorms and wizards' towers.

title: [[Old Throne City, Southern Gate District]]
description: Arching slightly upward before suddenly dropping off, the remains of a ruined bridge head toward the south.  The supports have collapsed outward from beneath this behemoth structure, sending what was once an elevated and ornate walkway crashing into the forest to be consumed by seasonal growth.  An iconic pedestal stands near the spot where the travelers of years gone by would have begun their journeys to places now blocked by rubble.

title: [[Old Throne City, Southern Gate District]]
description: A massive wall of debris cuts the road in half, blocking any further progress.  Something uses this dead end as a makeshift lair, evidenced by the wide selection of bones and deep burrows beneath the mound.  Many of the remains appear to be of the Seven Races, stripped of all flesh in much the same way as the surrounding buildings have been stripped of decorum and color.

title: [[Old Throne City, Southern Gate District]]
description: Normally, passage to the southwest would have been possible through the wide ruined streets, but a series of tall columns and statues have collapsed, making the route impassable.  The debris has fallen on top of several small buildings to completely engulfs the area.  This must have occurred years ago, since a wide variety of grasses and weeds root on top of the piles in whatever sparse clumps of dirt the vegetation can find.

title: [[Old Throne City, Garden District]]
description: The lower tiers of the Garden District are cluttered with shops and small residences which have slid partially down towards the streets below.  It is possible that this area of the ruins will be among the last to be restored, as the work would be far greater than in other sections.  As testament to the extremes of time, a small fountain is shattered, the statue in its middle broken completely in half.

title: [[Old Throne City, Magic District]]
description: Towering over the ruins is the colosseum to the north, impressively bulky and mostly standing while all the tallest remains of wizard towers are mere slivers pointed skyward.  Several small trenches run parallel with the abandoned roadway, some cordoned off with small posts and yellow-dyed string.  A few rusted and useless tools remain, abandoned next to the excavation site.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Lower Tier]]
description: Ruddy brown stonework columns climb their way to the distant curving arches high overhead sheltering the large chunks of stone and marble that now litter the floor.  A testament to the ravages of time, iron sconces that once held brightly lit torches now hang in rusted pieces of twisted metal and tattered fragments of detailed tapestries dangle by mere threads along the cracking and broken walls.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Lower Tier]]
description: Crumbling stonework and shredded tapestries are all that remain of the grand architecture that once honored those who fought and died for the enjoyment of the crowd, and the honor of battle.  Lost in the decay and destruction are the grandly carved engravings and flowing banners, now little more than fragments of memories from times long past.  Beyond an immense cracked archway lies a city in ruins, victim of the ravages and constant abuse of the elements.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Lower Tier]]
description: The remains of heavy iron bars divide this large open area into small holding cells, where warriors once waited for their time to fight.  Despite the scent of dust and rock that pervades the area, a lingering aroma of blood and sweat can still be caught on the passing breezes as they wind in and around the stonework arches and broken walls.  Partially blocking access to the combat theater stands a crumbling stone wall, the jagged edges making for difficult passage to the arena above.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Combat Theater]]
description: Once covered by a thin layer of sand on rock, the floor of the combat theater is now little more than a massive pit with sparse areas of green grass growing in and around sink-holes and deep depressions left in the ground.  Nothing remains of the large granite columns that arose from the arena floor, their crumbling stonework now vanished into the gloomy darkness below.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Combat Theater]]
description: Boulders of broken stonework lay strewn about on the ground, fallen from the massive arch that once loomed high above.  Long granite pillars lay across one another like exhausted combatants, too tired to maintain the struggle against the pull of gravity, and the slowly decaying stone floor.  A decaying stairway, partially blocked by crumbling stone, offers a perilous climb to the arena wall above.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Combat Theater]]
description: Once the center point of the combat yard, this part of the arena is now the northernmost section due to the collapse of the seating areas above.  Protecting the spectators from the wind, rain and sun, poles supporting heavy canvas and leather now lean and hang in dreary, tattered condition.  The grand view of the sky is still available, ringed on all sides by the stone of the colosseum.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Northern Tier]]
description: The ravages of time and aimless vandalism have combined forces to weaken the faulty walls, leaving the above areas all the more weakened.  Red bricks and grey rubble lie scattered among piles of dust, all trailing down a now partially blocked stairway.  What memories this place could share of spectators cheerfully filling the seating areas in anticipation of a gladiatorial bloodshed, if only stone could speak.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Northern Tier]]
description: Piles of fragmented stone and block from the partial collapse of the upper tiers show signs of having been purposely cleared, as if to make movement along the northern tier more convenient.  Through the splits created as the rubble fell from above, the outside streets are visible and choked with bits of the foundations of shops and stalls.  A lone tangled vine snakes its way through one of these triangular holes, twitching in the breeze like an anxious spectator awaiting entry.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Northern Tier]]
description: The brick and mortar barricades that partition the various seating areas have collapsed, allowing access directly to the shattered top of the arena wall.  Hung overhead are a multitude of tattered tapestries, obviously recent additions as there is no way something so fragile as cloth would have survived centuries of exposure and abandonment.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Northern Tier]]
description: This was never the best seating in the colosseum, since massive structural supports made of stone obstruct large swathes of the combat theater from view.  Well removed from the better seats, this was probably considered by the rich to be an excellent place for the hordes of ragged commoners and the less-than-aristocratic to gather and chant for their heroes -- at least what they could see of them.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Upper Tier]]
description: Signs of residents abound, from the empty trunk and chests stacked in a disorganized heap to the pitted canvas stretched overhead.  Most obvious of some group's claim to these previously abandoned ruins is the large sign hanging from rusted chains.  These squatters are not a cleanly group, as a layer of grey filth from dirty boots tracks from the makeshift ladder toward the northwest.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Upper Tier]]
description: Planks of wood make a serpentine pattern on the floor, snaking around the many holes that were formed as portions of the lower tier collapsed.  In the places where the footing looks most stable, rows of scaly husks are piled, though many of the larger ones are instead nailed onto the walls.  Between the holes, planks and husks, splatters of red and black paint freckle the stone.

title: [[Colosseum Ruins, Upper Tier]]
description: Wide openings in the walls of the colosseum were once passages and solid stone, through which spectators hurried to now vanished seating areas.  Now, these shattered windows reveal the grandest urban schemes and designs of the Seven Races lie in ruins to the south, having crumbled and fallen to the ravages of time.  Northward, the structures are by far more dignified and repaired.

title: [[Old Throne City, Shakoepi Bridge]]
description: A wall of crates lines the stone railing of the bridge, reducing the expansive view southward to one of occasional unobstructed glimpses.  This bridge, whatever its original purpose, is now used as a way station for cargo and deliveries into Throne City.  All things passing through the gates of the city are subject to inspection, whether they be man, beast or mineral, and as such, those inanimate things that can not hurry their journey inside wait the longest.

title: [[Old Throne City, Shakoepi Bridge]]
description: Not far to the east, the elegant spires and massive columned homes of the Arcadius residential sector rise skyward in all their exotic and rich splendor.  These buildings are cordoned off by a long high wall of stone, leaving Shakoepi Bridge the only access into the sector.  Below, the waters of the Faldesu inlet gurgle and splash around the remains of one of the ancient Imperial Navy's ship hulls.

title: [[Old Throne City, Beneath Shakoepi Bridge]]
description: The sandy beach of a Faldesu inlet surrenders to thick vegetation and plant-life, which rises on a gentle incline to cover the solid walls protecting Throne City.  Pounded into mud by ascending and descending travelers, a slope angles up this hill and to the bridge above.  Nearby, several crates rest at the edge of the water, covered with tarps and canvas until they can be delivered to their destinations.

title: [[Outside Throne City, Forested Trail]]
description: The top of the covered stone dock which subtly feeds Throne City with supplies and exotic goods is visible to the north.  Oddly, the air between here and there shimmers slightly, reminiscent of the rippling of heat on stone during a hot summer's day.  A nagging sensation of being under close scrutiny hangs over the area, but the gently waving fronds of wide-leafed plants appear to be the only observers.

title: [[Forested Trail, Cobblestone Ruins]]
description: Heavy foliage presses in on the trail, a nearly irrepressible tide of nature that is awash with leaves, stems, and branches.  Crooked cobblestones poke up from the dirt, betraying the original nature of this pathway as a road.  These are mostly barren of the weeds that choke the trail's edges, as if something regularly bore them down beneath passing feet.  Where such travelers would go is unclear, since a wall of vegetation has turned this path into a dead-end.

title: [[Stone Docks, Covered Shore]]
description: Barely extending from the shore, the dock is little more than a short series of solid blocks of weather-battered stone.  Thick sheets of canvas are lashed in a tent-like fashion around this port, keeping the onslaught of the skies and winds at bay while also serving to mask its presence from passing ships.  With the excessive vegetation that creates yet another disguising layer outside the canvas, it's clear that many boats could pass along the Faldesu without ever knowing this place exists.

title: [[Old Throne City, Beneath Shakoepi Bridge]]
description: As much like a cave as anything, this portion of the trail is sheltered on the sides by thick foliage and above by the bridge.  The nearby inlet is barely visible through a screen of reeds and bamboo, but what brief glimpses can be had also reveal the remains of a ship's hull.

title: [[Outside Throne City, Faldesu Inlet]]
description: Wide-leafed plants fill the edges of the inlet like the spectators at a parade, waving their fronds as if in admiration of the gurgling waters.  Flowing on its course, the water is indifferent to this constant wind-driven attention, content to be the source of life for so much vegetation and then to offer it nothing more.  If adoring gazes are what the plants give, then stoic resistance is the only gift from a series of stone pillars, half submerged in the liquid.

title: [[Outside Throne City, Faldesu Inlet]]
description: Where once ancient feet trod upon interlocked cobblestones, now thickened grass and choking weeds grow, narrowing the remains of a major trade road to a mere footpath.  Rocks and light rubble lie buried in the thorny vegetation, an indication of a long-ago structure stretching toward a distant wall far into the woodland.  All this abandoned ruin is of no concern to nature, her attention spent in the years since to grow a particularly large tree that leans over the nearby waterway.

title: [[Thayergraben, Faldesu Inlet]]
description: A twist of thorns and spiny plants hinders passage north but fails to block it completely.  Dragonflies dart in and out of the tangle, back and forth between it and the neighboring reeds choking the inlet.  Not all obstacles here are natural, as a large granite block lies in the water as well, and almost completely buried in vegetation along the shore is a granite marker of some kind.

title: [[Along the Faldesu, Forested Shore]]
description: A tent of stretched canvas is visible just over the edge of wide, elephant-eared plants, though movement further west would quickly eliminate even these glimpses behind a curtain of greenery.  Tangled vines and nettles cascade over muddy banks, forming a natural wall southward, but the patches of sand and shoreline make passage west possible.

title: [[Along the Faldesu, Forested Shore]]
description: Heavy, thick clumps of reeds rise like miniature citadels, their sides curving bowl-like toward the muddy center of the sandy path.  Beetles and birds occasionally peek out from their homes in these fortified plants to spy on passersby, curious but too cautious to breach their safety.  Dangling vines reach down over many of the clumps, some so far as to make solid columns of vegetation from ground to overhead tree.

title: [[Along the Faldesu, Forested Shore]]
description: Odd and out of place, a row of petite white flowers peeks out from behind a wall of sharp grasses and nettles, adding a touch of delicate grace to an otherwise unremarkable tangle.  A constant swarm of insects hums and buzzes around this rare delight, uncaring of the razor-edged plants nearby.  Some of the small petals are caught in the breezes, sent swirling into the air to finally touch down upon the softly lapping waters of the river.

title: [[Along the Faldesu, Sandy Shore]]
description: As if inviting visitors, arches of thick branches and hanging vines route explorers toward this small opening and, further, to a long sandy trail.  Flat, open areas of dirt and sand are marked by multitudes of clawed footprints, also following the course of the arching vegetation as well as making their own paths to the water's edge.  If not for the hungry predators in the area, the scene would be nearly idyllic.

title: [[Along the Faldesu, Sandy Shore]]
description: The branches of intermingling water oaks create a thick canopy overhead, nearly as tangled and wide as the ground level vegetation.  Stumps and waterlogged trunks provide the basis for hundreds of varieties of mosses and mildew, behind which spring a curtain of high reeds.  This tiny cul-de-sac is a dead end for all but the smallest of birds and creatures.

title: [[The Faldesu River, Shallows]]
description: Leading away from this small, reed-cluttered shore, a long sandy trail winds its way through clumps of vegetation toward somewhat drier land.  The water here is merely ankle deep, though the mud beneath the surface makes movement difficult -- too shallow to actively swim, but too wet to actually walk.  Arboreal creatures, such as the occasional squirrel, have a much easier time traversing this area through the overhanging branches.

title: [[The Faldesu River, Shallows]]
description: Curving out into the water is a small, muddy extension of the bank, so choked with reeds that only the smallest of birds could find passage through it.  Eternally, the water laps away at this feature, sucking away the black mud to expose stubborn roots.  Though eventually the river may win, the tiny outlet of land will not go quietly into that dark water.

title: [[The Faldesu River, Shallows]]
description: A sandbar humps out of the Faldesu's waters, making it impossible to approach the shore by boat.  Driftwood jutting out of the mud is a tell-tale sign that at some point, at least one captain tried to beach a vessel here, though to what goal is impossible to guess.  In the time it took for nature to reduce the wreck into fragments, it would appear that no others lacked the sanity enough to try.

title: [[The Faldesu River, Shallows]]
description: Something has made several nests in the muddy banks, each spaced out some distance from one another and only partially excavated.  Broken reeds and brush kneel down around each indent, but aside from a scant few clawed footprints leading to and fro, there is no indication that any of these river-front residences are actively used -- or at least actively accessed from anywhere but the water.

title: [[The Faldesu River, Shallows]]
description: Reeds and cattails clog the shallow water, providing shelter for an assortment of small, wide-eyed fish that dart energetically just below the surface.  A steady rustle of wind off the Faldesu sets the thick tops of the cattails into motion, drumming off one another in the air's invisible caress and revealing glimpses of woodland vegetation further to the west.  From here, there is no access -- only knee-deep mud and nettles.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Foyer]]
description: Merchants and city patrons alike create a constant stream of traffic into the bank, their voices rising in a cacophony of sound that echoes loudly off the vaulted ceiling high above.  Several guards stand at key locations throughout the area, keeping a careful watch on all those who enter through the steel double doors.  On the marble floor just inside the entrance is an intricate tile mosaic, displaying a seven-pointed star pattern.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, out.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Atrium]]
description: Checkered designs and patterns cover the polished marble floor, marking off a deliberate path south that leads toward the exchange booths beyond.  Painted upon the south wall, and somewhat faded by the passage of time, is a stunningly detailed mural of the God Kertigen.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Currencies and Restitutions]]
description: Ringlets of gold filigree polished to a lustrous shine, swirl along the black-veined marble walls of this chamber.  Hasty repairs have been made to the ceiling above, where whitewashed paint scarcely hides the water stains that lie beneath.  Oblivious to the surroundings are the moneychangers behind the hardwood counter, quickly counting out and exchanging each patron's coin.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Lounge]]
description: Light streams down through the frosted-crystal skylight above, bathing everything in an ambient glow.  Soft music also fills the air, and together they create a soothing backdrop for the business deals being conducted at each table.  Off to one side rests a small sideboard of refreshments, ready to serve the merchants' and patrons' needs.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Atrium]]
description: Ornately carved marble columns rise from the highly polished floor towards the vaulted ceiling, supporting white plaster beams that stretch the length of the structure.  Two rather large exotic plants stand to either side of the passage that leads to the Teller windows beyond, creating the appearance of an archway.  Dominating the eastern wall through which the passage travels is a massive mural portraying many raven-drawn caravans as they make their arduous journey over the lands of the Empire.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Faldesu Exchequer, Teller]]
description: Iron bars circled by rings of brass and gold comprise the grills through which the clerks conduct the financial transactions.  Merchants and city patrons crowd this tiny area, hoping to complete their business quickly and make their leave.  In the corner stands a lone guard who watches everything in silence, anxiously waiting a moment in which to be of assistance.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Tear of Grazhir Exhibit]]
description: Rising and vanishing into darkness, the circular walls are home to four marble gargoyles that stare balefully from their perches at the silvery-white shard imbedded deeply into the floor's center.  A single plaque of brass and silver is fastened in the stones near the exit.  Otherwise unadorned, the room is thick with shadows, no sconces or torches to help shed illumination.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Downstairs]]
description: The small room is bare save for a series of hooks lining the plain whitewashed walls, from which hang various-sized drab smocks stained by unknown substances for academy students to borrow.  A tall scuffed cabinet in one corner contains several emergency medical kits and various pieces of safety equipment.  An unlit staircase leads below.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Storage Room]]
description: Dust blankets this cramped underground storage space like the snowy quilt of winter upon a pale field.  Wooden crates, securely nailed shut and decorated with vivid red paint, clutter the basement and make moving about difficult.  Nestled between two wobbling stacks of yellow and faded books, an obviously once-ornate altar shows the effects of brutal age and underground damp.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Alchemy Lab]]
description: The walls of this spacious laboratory are lined with large cabinets containing empty jars, mixing bowls, and various alchemical supplies.  A huge worktable dominates nearly half of the room, providing ample space for students and professors to work safely side by side.  In the corner a small water bin rests beside a pile of stacked unlonchai buckets.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Magic Lab]]
description: Scrolls and grimoires containing detailed descriptions of myriad spells fill the cabinets of this stone-walled lab, enclosed behind thick glass doors layered for protection against magical accidents.  A large cambrinth sphere rests atop a stone pillar in the center of the room, and several unfinished runestones are scattered across a small bench to one side.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Hallway]]
description: This wide hallway is decorated on both sides with polished wooden cases containing books and manuscripts.  A collection of magical artifacts is displayed in a cabinet under protective glass.  Nearby, a well-lighted stairwell leads to the academy's lower floor.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Entry Hall]]
description: The polished wooden floors of this large foyer shine with a permanent luster, remaining glossy and unscuffed even by the many pairs of feet which have passed through over the years.  A glass display case sits prominently to one side, exhibiting the prestigious certificates and awards of past graduates.

title: [[Therenborough, Lirum Square]]
description: A magnificent limestone building with double doors flanked by marble columns stands proudly before the square.  The Gealeranendae College of Magical History, famed throughout the five provinces, welcomes students, visitors, and teachers within its revered halls.  Hanging above the walnut doors is a blue banner with gold edging.

title: [[Therenborough, Mercantile Street]]
description: A paved roadway runs through a collection of small houses topped with red clay tiles.  A sturdy metal gate holds a wooden sign with elegant words scrawled in black paint.  The wind blows through the colorful acacia trees lining the boulevard, scattering purple and yellow flowers about.

title: [[Therenborough, Mercantile Street]]
description: A round little shop stands beside the street, its windows bearing several finely crafted tapestries made from imported Rathan silk.  The building's oak door is open, welcoming customers inside.  A few birds can be seen flying through the air around the crouching gargoyles of the great keep's towers.

title: [[Therenborough, Mercantile Street]]
description: The broad boulevard passes by a tiny building, its windows tightly shuttered, a sign proclaiming it the home of the mysterious sister Nongwen.  Piled outside of the home are rows of wooden crates, all nailed shut.  A pile of rubble has been pushed off the side of the roadway.

title: [[Therenborough, Escutcheon Boulevard]]
description: The long Escutcheon Boulevard ends at a massive steel gate breaching a large rock wall.  Upon the wall is a gold plaque bearing the crest of Trigomas, one of the wealthier Therengian Houses.  In the center of the road is a bronze statue of a young Human male holding a longsword in one hand and a scale in the other.  Encircling the statue is a ring of shrubs.

title: [[Therenborough, Telomin Lane]]
description: A small lane edges between the large edifices of the town's commercial district to halt before the doorway to a limestone building.  The rear entrance to the stately Telomin Hall, lights can be seen from within it at all hours, and a careful observer can detect the sounds of discussion and silver clinking against glass.

title: [[Therenborough, Lirum Square]]
description: Pigeons circle over the marble fountain, some landing and skittering across the ground pecking for food, only to flee back to the air when anything larger than a bug approaches them.  To the side of the fountain, a weathered oak tree stretches outward to cosset the clouds, occasionally dropping an acorn as an offering.

title: [[Therenborough, Lirum Square]]
description: A small stucco building with a red-tiled roof lies along the outskirts of the massive city square.  Displayed in the shop's window are several pieces of clothing, most of which bear the trappings of Therengian court.  The bustling square boasts a newly paved roadway, and is named after one of the Barony's idols.

title: [[Therenborough, Lirum Square]]
description: Surrounded by several sets of stained oak benches is a marble fountain filled with clear water pouring from three twin lion's heads.  A few children amuse themselves by running along the edge of the fountain, careful to avoid falling in while laughing at each other.

title: [[Therenborough, Kaudric's Gateway]]
description: An alabaster arch stretches over the roadway, its smooth surface carved with elegant words.  A brass plate attached to the arch gives directions to various sites in the capital.  Nearby can be heard the sound of rushing water.

title: [[Therenborough, Escutcheon Boulevard]]
description: A proud bronze lion rears up over the street from the marble pedestal it stands upon, his clawed paw slicing at the air.  A small cobbled path leads east from the main roadway, heading into a collection of quaint tile-roofed houses.

title: [[Therenborough, Mason's Circle]]
description: The cobbled path to the west circles large and elaborate houses, dwindling to a packed dirt road to the east.  In the center of the road stands a shining pole clutching a blue banner depicting a seven-pointed star above a tower.  Tall hedges line the sides of the road, animal shapes carved into their mass at even intervals.

title: [[Therenborough, Escutcheon Boulevard]]
description: Stone gargoyles loom above a large building, their faces frozen in snarls or grimaces.  Carved into the granite facade of the building are images of ancient heroes of Therengia and the Empire.  A massive lancet arch leads within, and above the arch a swan is depicted in meticulous stained glass.

title: [[Therenborough, Mason's Circle]]
description: Off of the packed dirt track, solid brick steps supported by a wooden railing lead up to a noisy building, the sounds of wood being sawed and hammered coming from within.  Thick letters engraved on the door proclaim the spot a carpenter's residence.

title: [[Therenborough, Well]]
description: In the midst of tile-roofed houses spewing grey smoke from stone chimneys stands a brick well surrounded by a cobbled walk.  Atop the well rests a knotted wooden bucket tied to a thick, worn rope, and a few decorative ceramic pots and vases are placed neatly by the side.

title: [[Therenborough, Mason's Circle]]
description: Outside one two-story dwelling dozens of children's toys are scattered, with striped red and blue balls, ornate hobbyhorses, and wooden wheels strewn across a fenced-in patch of grass.  A sign bearing methodically painted script hangs beside the whitewashed door.

title: [[Therenborough, Mason's Circle]]
description: A painted gateway marks the boundary between paved road and dirt track.  Alongside the path stands a weatherbeaten but sturdy stable, a few bundles of hay stacked by the door and a rusted steel pitchfork tossed carelessly to the side.

title: [[Therenborough, Mason's Circle]]
description: Small cottages cling to the stone walls of the city, the ominous shadows of the giant keep looming over them all.  The roadway, little more than a dust trail, wanders aimlessly through the homes like a snake, slithering around well-tended gardens and plots of trees.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Hallway]]
description: Conservative off-white walls, devoid of any decoration, surround you.  Thick, lush carpeting covers the floor and provides a damper on outside noise.  While starkly functional, there is nevertheless a feeling of security.  A thick oak door leads to the college's library.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Lecture Hall]]
description: A cavernous lecture hall stretches outward from a set of huge double doors with glossy curved handles.  Rows of seats extend down the aisles to a high stage platform at the front, each chair with a small wooden table resting on the arm for ease in taking notes.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Instructors' Office]]
description: The musky scent of fine pipe tobacco permeates this small office, which is blanketed with richly woven Ilithi carpets.  Across from the doorway sit a sturdy cherrywood desk and polished leather chair, and a stuffed owl with glass eyes perches on an engraved shelf to one side.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Registrar's Office]]
description: Every available flat surface in the office has been piled high with stacks of forms.  Along one wall is a row of large cabinets with several drawers pulled haphazardly open, spilling more paper into the chaos of the room.  A harried-looking clerk works busily behind the desk.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Recitation Room]]
description: This small classroom looks to have been designed for a modestly sized recitation class.  Several desks cluster in the center of the room and a large white ash rack hangs on the far wall.  Across from it is a slate board covered with arcane scribblings in various colors of chalk.

title: [[Gealeranendae College, Library]]
description: Tall oaken book cases line the walls of this enclosed room, giving off a pleasant woody scent which permeates the air.  Worn leather chairs are set at a large oak table, providing a place to read in comfort.

title: [[Gaeleranendae College, Dormitories]]
description: The wood panel floors are polished to a lustrous shine, their surface unblemished by any marks.  Decorating the blue wall is an oak-framed painting of the city of Therenborough, and beneath the painting hangs a wooden sign.  A carpeted staircase leads to the rest of the school.

title: [[Gaeleranendae College, Dormitories]]
description: The hallway, painted in pale blue hues, is dimly lit by candles held in wall sconces.  Along the walls hang portraits of notable figures from the college's history.  By one of the doors, there is some faint scuffing of the paint, as if scratched at by something.

title: [[Gaeleranendae College, Dormitories]]
description: Outside one dormitory room rests a glass tray, an earthenware jug and bowl and some silver utensils piled neatly on top of it.  An oil painting of the Zaulfung Stones hanging from a brass hook in the wall is slightly tilted at an odd angle.

title: [[Gaeleranendae College, Dormitories]]
description: Muffled sounds come from behind one door.  Harsh whisperings, the metallic jingle of coins, and the rattle of dice in a cup can all be heard, though the noises cease after a brief shuffling every time rapping footsteps pass down the hallway outside.

title: [[Gaeleranendae College, Dormitories]]
description: At the hallway's end stands a gold pedestal bearing a bust of the college's founder, and a blue tapestry bearing the Gaeleranandae crest covers the wall above the bust.  Like a cloak, a thick rug made from the fur of an island desumos lies on the floor.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Foyer]]
description: Broad oak double doors, flanked by a phalanx of fine green marble pillars, lead from the reflectively spotless floors of the austere civic building to the paved streets of Therenborough outside.  Walls of brilliant lapis blue marble, marked by tessellated flecks of black and white, offset the promenade of green columns marching from the doors to a long corridor northward.  To one side of the entry chamber, a crystalline staircase leads up to the hall's rooftop.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Walk of Heroes]]
description: Lifelike and elaborate statues formed of alabaster, plaster, and bronze stand upon ornate cerulean marble pedestals.  Proudly displayed upon each pedestal is a plaque of platinum, gold, or some other valuable material proclaiming the name of the hero and the bold and honorable deeds that earned them an eternal place in this hallowed hall.  Bringing a bit of uniqueness to the frozen guardians, each holds something in their right hand.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Walk of Heroes]]
description: Honored heroes, many now shrouded in the mystery of myth and legend, stand guard along the main passageway of this ancient hall, once a Paladin Guild, as though to repel any invader that would attempt to reach the inner sanctum just ahead.  Though silent and still, the sculptures are so expertly crafted as to appear ready to leap from their marble pedestals.  An elaborate shield mosaic of white and gold embellishes the tile floor.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Sanctum]]
description: The building opens up into a large, circular chamber.  Radiant rays of sunlight shine through the domed ceiling's glass skylights, exposing the goings-on of the beautiful sanctum to the vigilant eyes of the gods above.  The heart of the hall, two arches lead from this chamber to other rooms.  Displayed upon the floor in tile mosaic is a black tower with a golden star suspended above it.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Licensing Offices]]
description: Inamicable and surly clerks clad in livery plod about this cramped room leadenly, some delivering documents to the corner of the room, while some march their wards out of the room through a walnut door.  A few of the more engaging workers sit at unremarkable desks from which they issue various licenses, writs, and permits.  The corner of the room contains a dusty desk occupied by a cadaverous old scribe diligently recording in a massive tome every detail of the lives of the province's populace.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Homes Licensing Office]]
description: This small room is dominated by a walnut table, around which stand two clerks, heavy in their own discussion.  Upon the table is a small model of the city, with marks for future expansion, and special attention given to residential areas.  A large pile of documents rests beside the model, the scrolls within containing information on citizens and home occupants.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Passport Office]]
description: A finely crafted desk serves as the work space for a bedraggled licenser.  On one side of the desk wobbles a stack of documents, each bearing the wax seal of the Baron, granting travel rights throughout the province.  A mural of Lake Gwenalion decorates one wall of the room.

title: [[Ibec Hall, Genealogy Office]]
description: Forming a counter that divides the small room is a desk long enough to accommodate additional employees when things get hectic.  Everything is kept neat and tidy, from the stacks of record books to the genealogy charts hung along the walls, showing the resident clerk's attention to detail.  A padded bench sits near the door, encouraging citizens to sit and wait their turn instead of pacing around the office in hopes of hurrying the bureaucratic process along.

title: [[Therenborough, Derelict's Alley]]
description: Uneven and disheveled from irregular settling, the cobblestones are certainly in need of repair, or at least a good flattening to make the alley passable for delivery carts.  By the look of the surrounding buildings and homes, however, few if any deliveries are made here, and the ever present shadows -- which a cutpurse could easily make use of -- may be partly to blame.

title: [[Therenborough, Alley's End]]
description: Waves of some heady scent ripple through the alleyway, and though no drafts or breezes are apparently the cause of such an olfactory undulation, the street debris and discards of Therenborough life are obviously the source of odor.  The proximity of this alley to the north end of the moat also most certainly has something to do with the assault on the nostrils, but sight of it is hidden by the backs of buildings, shops and homes, their windows and doors sealed to this seedy back street.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: Abruptly, the boulevard comes to a halt, its granite paving making way for the cobblestones of the plaza facing the Amphitheatre.  Large enough to almost hold its own against the bulk of the nearby Keep, the Amphitheatre is where warriors test their prowess, create a reputation or lose their lives.  People hurry towards its marble arches, eager to fight or watch blood spill on the sand.  The cool marble sides and columns contradict the conflict that has been its livelihood for generations.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: Tangled vines of honeysuckle embrace the garden gate while low-growing maugwort bushes line either side of the avenue.  Shaded by tall oak trees, a low garden bench invites passersby to sit and enjoy the fragrances of sirese flowers and honeysuckle wafting through the air.  A white gate leads into the depths of the garden.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: The august walls of Telomin Hall rise before you.  Formed of massive limestone blocks joined without the aid of mortar, the building boasts slim colonnades supporting a grey slate roof.  A shining silver sword has been mounted over the hall entrance in honor of an unknown paladin hero.  Sounds from the nearby commercial district are strangely muted as if afraid to disturb the serious matters taking place behind these walls.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: The Bank of Therenborough sits at precise right angles to the street here.  The once sharp edges of its steps have been muted by the footfalls of countless customers, and time has weathered the marble walls to a faded blue.  A towering statue of Kertigen stands in a welcoming pose at the entrance, forever fastening his gaze upon the crowds hurrying beneath his feet.  The building thrums to the pulse of commerce as people arrive to settle their financial affairs.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: As the granite thoroughfare curves through this part of the city, it passes in front of the Alliance of Exchange building.  Created of serene blue marble, the aura of dignity surrounding it is somewhat disturbed by the constant throngs bustling in and out of a pair of towering acanth doors.  Knots of traders stand together quietly talking under the shade of neighboring trees while others make their way inside, eager to sell their pelts and goods.

title: [[Therenborough, Rutilor Boulevard]]
description: The wide boulevard paved with granite slabs stretches northeastward, providing a home for the town's official buildings.  The overall impression here is of elegance with beautiful marble structures that are graceful and well-proportioned in appearance.  The tall, leafy trees planted along the street enhance the gleaming expanses of pale marble.

title: [[Therenborough, Claymore Court]]
description: Alabaster marble columns designate the entrance to the busy Market Square.  The throngs of people moving in and out of the square represent all walks of life.  Fledgling paladins, still awkward in their heavy plate armor, mingle with weathered farmers wearing cloth caps, stout boots and tweed jackets.  A silk banner, decorated with paintings that depict items sold in the marketplace, ripples and flutters in the gentle breeze.

Pale marble columns stand out against the night sky, designating the entrance to the Market Square.  The thriving marketplace remains open all night, with noble knights mingling with young couples walking hand in hand.  A silk banner, decorated with paintings that depict items sold in the market, ripples and flutters in the night breeze.

title: [[Therenborough, Quadrangle]]
description: The vast quadrangle is paved with blocks of silver-speckled granite and bordered by rows of marble columns interspersed with matching benches.  Throngs of people congregate in this popular gathering spot.  Every so often an animated speaker addresses the crowds from the public orator's stand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Therenborough, Claymore Court]]
description: Beneath the spreading branches of an old chestnut tree stands a small cottage, its timbers bursting through whitewashed wattle and daub.  Densely cultivated gardens surround the dwelling, and bunches of hulnik grass and plovik stems hang in the front windows.

title: [[Therenborough, Arbalest Row]]
description: This shop-lined pedestrian thoroughfare travels around the western side of the towering keep that survives still in all its granite magnificence.  Passersby occasionally stop to gape up at the looming tower with its circlet of ferocious stone gargoyles.

title: [[Therenborough, Horseman's Run]]
description: Quiet backstreets lead off from this bridle path, overlooking gardens, old courtyards and a pleasant clutter of pink and white cottages with thatched or tiled roofs.  Several horses stand sedately at hitching posts, patiently awaiting their owner's return.

title: [[Therenborough, Horseman's Run]]
description: This wide dirt pathway borders the southern end of the town, providing riders with easy access to the main streets.  A vast square, paved with granite and filled with milling people, opens up to the north.  To either side of it, smaller buildings made from dusty red bricks and quaint thatched cottages are scattered between impressive marble structures.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Therenborough, Town Gate]]
description: The imposing turreted towers of Theren Keep dominate this inland town, standing proud against the sky and seen plainly from every vantage point in the area.  Walls of massive stone surround the small, but bustling community, and beyond the open gates to the south are rolling pastures and distant farmsteads.  The pedestrians milling around the gate are periodically forced to step aside as paladins in gleaming plate armor ride by on magnificent steeds, heading north toward the castle.

title: [[Therenborough, Horseman's Run]]
description: Tall structures of marble, sparkling in various pale hues, can be seen off to the northeast.  Although these magnificent buildings are imposing on their own, they are dwarfed by the towering castle walls that they surround.  The murmur of friendly conversation and the shout of a successfully bartered deal can be heard from beyond a high hedgerow that separates the Market Square from this bridle path.

title: [[Therenborough, Horseman's Run]]
description: The bridle path connects the elegant business district along Rutilor Boulevard with the more rustic Lower East Way with its compacted dirt surface and whitewashed fences.  Several hitching posts provide a convenient spot for travelers to leave their horses while they attend to business along either pedestrian thoroughfare.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Therenborough, Tournament Lane]]
description: Connecting the town's center with the massive stone wall that surrounds it, this rustic patch slices through a landscape lush with flowering shrubs and small trees that help to muffle some of the noise wafting from the nearby cosmopolitan streets surrounding Theren Keep.  Roughly carved from stone, a water trough sits off to the side waiting to slake the thirst of paladins and their mounts as they travel in search of jousting competitions.

title: [[Therenborough, Tournament Lane]]
description: Branching off from the main thoroughfare, this hoof-beaten path is wide enough to accommodate the mounted squads patrolling the town's border.  Wild rose bushes climb the front of a whitewashed stable, their pink petals not only decorating the building's stark exterior but also perfuming a variety of natural odors wafting from animals resting within its close quarters.  Off in the distance, equestrians wearing uniforms of the Therengian Cavalry march in and out of a stacked log outpost.

title: [[Therenborough, Lower East Way]]
description: Skinny homes of rough-hewn wood crowd each other for space along this narrow earthen streetfront.  An occasional granite cobblestone from the paving farther to the west lies embedded in the ground, ready to trip the unwary.  From the east comes the slightest hint of smoke to tickle the nostrils of those who pass.

title: [[Theren Keep, Approach]]
description: A timeworn gatehouse rises to the north, its twin towers bearing conspicuous scars from a long-standing siege.  The stone and mortar look patched in key places where catapult stones bombarded the stout facade, but there's no indication the gates have ever been breached.  A stagnant semi-filled moat impedes further progress towards the Keep, and the sickly-green slime bubbling inside looks and smells like it dates back to the Old Empire.

title: [[Therenborough, Arbalest Row]]
description: A large cottage made from honey-colored stone faces the street, its open doors emitting a savory aroma of roasted meat and herbs.  Climbing rose bushes intertwine over the front, the pure white blossoms enhancing its elegant appearance.

title: [[Therenborough, Arbalest Row]]
description: A red-tiled roof with flared eaves hangs over a stylish stacked-stone building.  Its bay windows show off colorful displays of fashionable clothing, attracting appraising glances from passing pedestrians.

title: [[Therenborough, Arbalest Row]]
description: Gleaming marble columns of the palest pink and blue support a veranda that circles a spacious structure.  An engraved bronze plaque is mounted on one of the front columns.

title: [[Therenborough, Arbalest Row]]
description: Arbalest Row ascends up the slope of a hill where it ends at the doors of a small brick theatre.  Bronze comedy and drama masks look down from their position above the doors, welcoming those who enter.  From this high point, the town of Therenborough spreads out to the south, watched over by the towering keep.

title: [[Therenborough, Shop Yard]]
description: The pressure of countless boots, hooves and sandals has beaten the dirt yard of a shingle-roofed general store to a hard packed finish.  Two squared wooden pillars frame a heavy pine door leading into the shop.

title: [[Therenborough, Lower East Way]]
description: A low-lying stone wall surrounds a wide, grassy yard shaded by a large oak tree.  Underneath the tree stands an anvil and forge which mark the nearby building as the home of the local blacksmith.

title: [[Therenborough, Lower East Way]]
description: An unpaved circular plaza lies to the east, dominated by a two-story chapel surrounded by a low wall of rough-hewn stone.  The wooden homes, stuffed one against another here at the edge of the plaza, thin somewhat to the west.

title: [[Therenborough, Chapel Plaza West]]
description: A small two story chapel, surrounded by a rough-hewn stone wall, rises here in the midst of a circular dirt plaza.  A double iron gate, swung wide and pegged open with two wooden stakes, beckons visitors to enter the confines of the walls to worship.  Several side streets meet at this central point to meander off to other parts of the town.

title: [[Therenborough, Chapel Plaza South]]
description: The stone wall surrounding the town chapel has crumbled in one corner.  Many of its stones appear to be missing, most likely carried away by peasants to be used elsewhere.  A sloppy patchwork of mortar has been slapped to the wall, but much of that has fallen too and lies scattered about the ground.

title: [[Therenborough, Chapel Plaza North]]
description: A neatly-trimmed hedgerow abuts the stone wall surrounding the chapel here in the town center.  To the northwest runs a small side street lined with houses of mud brick and thatch, while to the south and southeast one can rejoin the main city thoroughfare.

title: [[Therenborough, Alabaster Road]]
description: Nestled here among simple homes of wood and thatch is a slightly larger building of worked stone.  Wide steps lead up to a porch of virgin pine boards.  Hanging over the porch is a small sign which marks the place as the home of the local midwife.

title: [[Therenborough, Alabaster Road]]
description: Neat rows of small country homes line both sides of the street.  A building of dark pine squats in the dusty cul-de-sac at the end of the lane, well-ordered displays of wooden furniture gracing its porch.

title: [[Therenborough, Chapel Plaza East]]
description: The main thoroughfare of the city merges here with a wide earth plaza, in the midst of which stands a wall of rough-hewn stone.  The second story of the Therenborough chapel peeks over the top of the wall, as if eager to escape its stony confines.

title: [[Therenborough, Narrow Alleyway]]
description: A sharp bend in the street offers passage to a narrow alleyway which stretches off to the south and beyond.  A teeming mob of ramshackle homes have gathered along the way, jostling each other for space in what is obviously the poorer section of town.  To the northeast rises a small chapel surrounded by a low stone wall.

title: [[Therenborough, Narrow Alleyway]]
description: The street takes a sharp bend here, turning east into a narrow alleyway and widening to the north before disappearing around a bend to the northeast.  Most of the homes here are of mud brick and thatch rather than the more precious wood plank in evidence elsewhere in the village.

title: [[Therenborough, Alley's End]]
description: Dominating this end of the alley is a looming pile of boards which could only be called a building by the most optimistic of persons.  Nailed together at almost every angle imaginable, the motley assortment of timber used to build the place looks as if it could be blown over by the sneeze of a sickly Halfling.  What seems to be intended as the building's door lies ajar at a bizzare angle, as if it were never really meant to be closed but instead was added as an artistic afterthought.

title: [[Therenborough, Pikeman Lane]]
description: A cheery two-story building of sturdy oak stands tall here at the far eastern reaches of the city.  Grey smoke wafts pleasantly from a red brick chimney rising above the roof at the north wall, and in the glass windows of the second story can be seen curtains of simple white linen.  Thick double doors of smoke-stained wood stand swung wide at the south wall, welcoming travelers to enter from the street.

title: [[Therenborough, Tournament Lane]]
description: Crowning the widened path is an arch carved from alabaster, its somewhat translucent white stone standing out against the rural landscape.  Planted at the base of a brightly colored sign, large mounds of blue-green hosta hold their formal shape despite the occasional trampling by mischievous children hiding behind the thick leaves in an attempt to get a peek at their favorite champion riding by.

title: [[Therenborough, General Store]]
description: The interior of the small general store is neatly ordered and clean.  Well-crafted knotty pine shelves display a carefully selected inventory of dry good supplies.  The proprietor of the store, Keth Lavatt, is a thin, wrinkled sort of human with a pleasant expression.  He sits in a rocking chair behind a somewhat battered display counter nodding a smiling greeting to each customer who enters the shop.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Foyer]]
description: A strong scent of fresh-cut pine permeates the air, so pungent it almost makes the eyes water.  Sawdust covers the entire floor in a layer at least a hand deep, most of it white in color, though a strip emanating from the shop's entrance has been packed flat into a discolored brown.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest, out.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Odds-n-Ends]]
description: Large piles of wooden blocks, only the occasional piece recognizable as furniture, squat upon every inch of the floor.  Everything has a price tag, though it's not entirely clear all the items in the room were originally intended to look the way they do.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Tables]]
description: Tables of all shapes and sizes, all of them crafted from various types of pine, line the walls.  All of the pieces appear newly-created, their surfaces dust-free.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Chairs]]
description: The ever-present fragrance of freshly-stripped pine mingles in the air with a faint scent of amber polishing oil in this cluttered display area.  Stacks of chairs and stools lean against the walls, balanced carefully behind rows of sturdy pine benches which barely manage to contain the tangle of carved pine arms and legs.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Doors]]
description: Large piles of sawdust cover the floor of this obviously unused room.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Walls]]
description: The walls of this room are divided into neatly ordered sections, each paneled in a different type of pine.  A sales clerk waits expectantly in one corner, eyeing patrons carefully as they enter and exit his domain.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Beds]]
description: Dozens of pine bed frames sit in neat, ordered rows, each awaiting an owner.

title: [[Piny Pleasures, Floors]]
description: Long stripes of pine paneling hang from the walls, samples of flooring which Piny Pleasures has available for installation.  Each piece sports a small tag denoting its price.

title: [[Midwife's Cottage, Porch]]
description: A swing of smoothly sanded honey pine sways gently at the end of the covered porch.  Near the front door of the cottage, a padded rocker beckons with promises of a comfortable rest.  Wide steps lead down to the village road.

title: [[Midwife's Cottage, Front Room]]
description: The stringent smell of crushed herbs pervades the front room of the cottage.  Shelves positioned above a large, well-scrubbed pine table hold a neat assortment of jars and bottles that seem to be the source of the smell.  Across from the table is a tall white cabinet, two chairs, and a cot spread with clean white sheets, standing ready for use.

title: [[Midwife's Cottage, Storage Closet]]
description: Long cedar planks form shelving along both sides of this small closet.  Neat stacks of blankets and linen sheets cover most of the storage space but a few large portable basins are stacked on the bottom shelves.

title: [[Midwife's Cottage, Hallway]]
description: A thick rag rug runs down the hallway, coming to a stop at an arched opening at the end of the passage.  Wooden doors, each the home of an Empath or midwife-in-training apprenticing to the building's owner, line the walls.

title: [[Therenborough Inn, Common Room]]
description: A sense of welcome pervades the atmosphere of the common area of the inn.  Sturdy pine benches and tables provide seating for customers and a long serving bar extends along most of the wall to the east.  Exposed oak beams angle sharply up the slant of the vaulted ceiling to the second story and the tops of several doors can be seen above the railing of the balcony.  Steps lead down to a sunken fireplace that beckons with a promise of peaceful warmth.

title: [[Therenborough Inn, Hallway]]
description: The sturdy pine railing extending along the open second-story landing provides a view of the common room below.  Both walls are lined with a series of doors, each leading to a room belonging to one of the inn's long-term residents.  A curtain covers the eastern end of the passage.

title: [[Therenborough Inn, Hallway]]
description: Small, evenly spaced doors line the pine walls of this passage.  The floor underfoot, of a slightly lighter grain of pine, has been polished smooth by the passage of many slippered feet.  A light scent of cinnamon tickles the air, though its source is not readily apparent.

title: [[Therenborough Inn, Hallway]]
description: The hallway ends here, a large oil painting covering the west wall from floor to ceiling.  Doors to some of the inn's many private rooms line both walls, most bearing a placquard indicating they are currently being rented.

title: [[Krrish's Home, Front Room]]
description: Great heaps of garbage and broken furniture lie scattered about the floor of this tiny room.  Torn star charts drape mournfully from the walls, competing for space with dark stains of dried blood.  Several rat-size holes have been chewed through the mouldering floorboards, and the whole place smells as if it had just been disgorged from the belly of a troll.

title: [[Krrish's Home, Back Room]]
description: Sagging wooden shelves covered with a potpourri of mouldering books, dessicated animal parts, and jars filled with the crusts of unidentifiable liquids loom from every wall of this claustrophobe's nightmare of a room.  A tiny space on the rear wall holds a small wooden sign and a framed set of coins.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Arcade]]
description: Granite cobblestones laced with flecks of silver pave the arcade passing beneath a majestic alabaster arch leading the way towards the Barony's Tournament Field.  Brightly colored pennants, magnificently flapping in the slightest breeze, sport the blue and gold colors of Therenborough artfully interspersed with the crests of famous champions of the Morzindaen.

Under the cloak of night, stray footfalls of a lone guard on patrol break the eerie silence before fading as he walks toward Theren Keep.  Evening light reflects off fragments of silver lacing the granite cobblestones that pave the road passing beneath the majestic alabaster arch, creating a curiously illuminated path to the fields of competition.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Feat of Archery]]
description: Broken bow strings and pieces of shattered arrows lie strewn across a field trampled to hardened clay from countless displays of battle prowess with various ranged weapons.  One side of the field is dedicated to archery competitions, while the other is flat and devoid of any obstacles except a long bench for waiting contestants.  An occasional ribbon wafts down from the nearby viewing gallery, littering the ground with a festive splash of color.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Arcade]]
description: Set to one side of the cobble-stoned arcade, a large alabaster statue pays homage to the animals that have brought their riders fame in the joust.  Boxwood forms a ring at its base, the green hedge softening the stark white of the stone as well as discouraging children from attempting to climb its smooth surface.  Periodically, a melodic chirping can be heard from songbirds playfully hiding their identities amongst the frilly-needled pines growing together to form a screen in front of the practice field.

Off in the distance flickering lights dance through the darkness of night, casting shadows that appear to breathe life into the white stone of a large alabaster statue that rises up from its hedged corral.  Watered down after the day's activities, the aroma of the practice field's dampened soil intermingles with the lush scent of pine, creating an earthy perfume that wafts through the cooled evening air.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Practice Field]]
description: Well-beaten dirt paths circle the field, flowing in an oft-traveled route between fence, pole, wall and post.  Angled slightly from its most recent attack, a battered quintain dressed to resemble a rather tipsy looking marauder stands in the middle of the course.  Brightly painted splinters from shattered lances lie scattered amidst the branches of neatly trimmed hedges hemming the field.

Well-beaten dirt paths still damp from the evening's cleaning routine encircle the field, flowing in an oft-traveled route between fence, pole, wall and post.  Angled slightly from its most recent attack, a battered quintain dressed to resemble a rather tipsy looking marauder stands in the middle of the course awaiting the next day's activities.  The shadowy outline of neatly trimmed hedges hems the edge of the field.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Archery Practice Field]]
description: Rough-hewn poles form a tall stockade fence, which surrounds the field to keep wild animals from adjoining woods out and stray arrows safely within its boundaries.  Lined up a distance away from well-used targets, furrows scar an otherwise flat landscape, a memorial left from practicing archers trying to find their perfect stance.  Placed within a circle of stumps is a weathered wooden table that provides a rustic spot for instructors and students alike to discuss future adventures.

Rough-hewn poles form a tall stockade fence that surrounds the field, keeping curious nocturnal animals who may wander in search of food from the adjoining woods safely outside its boundaries.  Torches from the nearby competition range cast a soft flickering light that dances across the ground like playful fairies in the darkness of night.  Peeking through the shadows is a wooden table surrounded by what appears to be a ring of low growing stools, smelling faintly of pine in the cool evening air.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Arcade]]
description: Heralding the end of the granite-floored arcade, a pair of tall steel braziers proudly introduces the jousting field's entrance.  Carefully tended by the Barony's groundskeepers, the flames are never allowed to die out as they stand to welcome local and visiting participants to the competitions.  Flags wave atop a nearby tent, welcoming those in search of relief.  Through a wide, wooden arch the royal gallery provides tiers of gaily decorated boxes, offering comfortable seating for attending audiences.

Standing guard through the evening, a pair of tall steel braziers contain blazing fires that wage war against the darkness.  Crickets hide from view, forming an audience that cheers on a battle between night's nocturnal veil and the raging sword-like flames determined to defeat it.  Shadows dance between a wide wooden arch leading to the royal gallery and a dimly lit tent, where overworked pages socialize while they finish off chores assigned to them by their champions.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Jousting Field of Honor]]
description: During tournaments, the strident ring of shod hooves rises above the clink of the steel plated armor encasing hopeful combatants.  Dominating the center of the field, the double fences of the jousting lists stand unadorned and chillingly businesslike in the festive surroundings.  Brightly colored ribbons lie strewn haphazardly about the field.  Several bloodstained rosettes, unfortunate enough to be trampled into the hard packed earth, give mute testament to the dangers of this noble sport.

The occasional call of a lonesome owl breaks the stillness of night as flames from tall braziers at the field's entrance cast a formidable shadow over the double fences of the jousting lists.  Stray ribbons flutter and tumble across the ground, their once vivid colors now pale reminders of the day's victories.  Young squires pass silently through the darkened field gathering up the few discarded lances that are repairable before shuffling toward the armory with their night's workload tucked under one arm.

title: [[Amphitheatre, Viewing Stands]]
description: The many rows of seats encircle and gradually slope downwards to the arena.  Most seats are occupied with the local townfolks here to enjoy the combat games.  The amphitheatre's design gives each seat a clear view of the entire arena while the perfect acoustics permit even the slightest whisper to be heard from below.  Colorful banners drape gracefully from overhead and reach towards the arena below.

title: [[Amphitheatre, Entrance]]
description: These hallowed halls are where the brave come to prove their worth to their gods and peers.  The sounds of combat and cheering crowds filter in from the nearby entrance.

title: [[Amphitheatre, Hall of Champions]]
description: The highly polished oaken walls are covered with heroic crests of the brave knights who have won honors in the arena.  In each corner stands a lance with multi-hued streamers attached to them.

title: [[Amphitheatre, Waiting Room]]
description: While designed to be a staging area for combatants of the arena, this room has been converted into a makeshift triage station to keep from having to rush the bleeding wounded through the streets.  The pounding excitement of the arena pervades the room.

title: [[Amphitheatre, The Arena]]
description: This open space provides ample room for many combatants to do battle at the same time.  Clean white sand covers the hard-packed ground and most of the blood from prior battles.  Many multicolored banners trail down from the viewing stands above.

title: [[Therenborough Gardens, Blue Garden]]
description: The initial impression here is one of flowerbeds lavishly planted with brilliant blue, but on closer examination the artful blending of mauve, purple and varying shades of blue can be seen.  Midnight blue clematis climb through the cheerful blue globular blossoms of giant thistle, while pale mauve geranium and purple-leafed plantain cover the ground.  A marble statue stands in the center, overlooking the floral display.

title: [[Therenborough Gardens, Yellow Garden]]
description: Sunny yellow jonquils and orange marigolds grow around a small pond where large goldfish swim, their long trailing fins creating golden shimmers just below the water's surface.  A group of stone nymphs frolic at the edge of the pond.

title: [[Therenborough Gardens, White Garden]]
description: A higher elevation sets off this tranquil garden planted with simple patterns of lilies, white roses and pale feathergrasses.  A charming white trelliswork pavilion stands open at the far end.  The subdued planting of pale flowers high above the other gardens gives this area an ethereal feeling.

title: [[Pavilion]]
description: Neatly trimmed trellises dripping with honeysuckle surround a lush lawn on which roses are grown in elaborate, knotted circles.  Bees trek merrily about the colorful blooms, oblivious to everything but the task at hand.  At each corner of the pavilion, junipers sway majestically with the wind.

title: [[Bank of Therenborough, Lobby]]
description: A steady stream of people wander in and out, some beaming, others far from happy.  Oak floors squeak with age under the weight of the customer's strides.  The vaulted ceiling makes the room seem airy and spacious reinforced by sunlight flowing in through windows looking onto the street.  A guard roams around the room, peeking in others, watching for the slightest hint of trouble.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, out.

title: [[Bank of Therenborough, Foreign Exchange]]
description: A desk is littered with papers that are scratched with notes and numbers.  An abacus clicks loudly as a man slams the beads around muttering to himself.  Locked boxes marked with metal and currency sit within reach of the desk.  Some chairs lining a wall serve as relaxation for customers.

title: [[Bank of Therenborough, Debt Collector]]
description: The small office is barely large enough to hold the desk and chair for the clerk.  As each customer pays their debts the clerk smirks and secures the money in a drawer.  A tapestry behind the desk has the symbol of Therengia embroidered on it.

title: [[Bank of Therenborough, Teller]]
description: A small line of people waits in front of a small booth, many looking at strangers with a hint of distrust.  The teller stationed behind the booth talks shortly to each one counting money or flipping through a large ledger book.  A barred door behind the teller allows a glimpse of a corridor leading to vaults and safes.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Dorsot's Collectables]]
description: Shelves line the walls here, most of them stacked high with various merchandise that at one time was valuable.  Dorsot, a potbellied Halfling, is busy behind a counter, counting a large bag of beads.  Standing in one corner of the shop is a gigantic stuffed cave bear.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Main Hall]]
description: Dominating the center of this great hall is a granite sculpture of a Human in full plate armor.  A small engraving adorns the bottom of the statue.  Traders and other ilk flow through an elaborate door near the center of the north wall.  A large plaque is inset in the yellow marble walls near an arched opening which leads into a rather prosperous business.  A short passage leads deeper into the exchange.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Fur Trade]]
description: Fur-covered walls act as a backdrop to the shelves pressed against them, which are overflowing with various pelts, skins, claws, hooves, and horns.  Uncommonly tidy for a furrier's shop, each group of skins is neatly tied, stacked, labeled and ready for shipping.  The Elven fur buyer, Dartrise, stands behind a metal counter in flowing robes, waiting for her next transaction with eagerness.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Hallway]]
description: A nondescript wooden door stands directly across from a marble archway here.  Upon the door is tacked a white wolf pelt.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Gruk's Stones]]
description: Piles of rock and rubble stand in each corner of this shop.  From behind a granite slab stands a huge Gor'Tog with a large metal mallet in one hand and a steel chisel in his other hand.  A sign appears to be mounted on the stone slab.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Traders' Center]]
description: The yellow marble walls here have swirls of blue and grey flowing through them.  To the east you hear the low rumble of many people talking.  A large portrait dominates one wall.

title: [[Alliance of Exchange, Traders' Pit]]
description: Traders move about this room, talking and haggling.  The chatter in here is rather low, and tension can be felt in the air as deals are made and goods are traded.  Two large boards listing the commodities for trade are suspended from twin chains bolted to the ceiling.  A lithe Elf covered with chalk stands ready to change the boards at a moment's notice.

title: [[North Road, Barony Pass]]
description: With one final sweep, the road straightens out from the hilly pastures in the south to stop at a walled village.  Looming above the stone boundary is the majestic Theren Keep, its battered towers still an imposing sight to behold.
