title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: A curtain of undulating maiden's tresses is visible high in the treetops above, twitching about in search of warm flesh to devour in its deadly embrace.  All is quiet save for the rustling of the tress vines, as if the forest denizens avoid this area and the bizarre plant's seductive, predatory dance.  For now, it remains at its perch, granting passage to those who are swift.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: Silvery dew trickles off of the dark green vines dangling from the verdant patchwork sky, forming small pools of glassy crystal that echo their muted cries of disruption at each intermittent drop.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: A velvety carpet of flora explodes suddenly into being in this spot, bearing vibrant flowers and plants of all colors and shapes.  A sense of exuberance permeates the air here, as if it were charged with the essence of Life itself.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: A single tree lies rotting and shattered amidst a colony of its healthier brethren.  The omnipresent thorny red-tinted vines are curiously absent around it, although what is left of its bark has been scarred horribly with gouge marks.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: The sound of water dripping in the distance echoes quietly, steadily keeping the pulse of the forest.  The rhythm is fragile yet determined, as if the slightest tilt could shatter its equilibrium and end the balance of life in this oddly beautiful place.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: Desiccated amethyst vines hang limp off the side of a nearby tree, their delicate forms crushed and dominated by the thicker green vines armed with thorny red barbs.  The cycle of life in this habitat becomes clearer, and it is certain that all is not as it may appear.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: Tufts of dry, scraggly witchgrass nestle at the base of a nearby tree to garner shelter and shade.  This particular tree looks rather sickly, as if stricken with something that its neighbors have not yet caught.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Edge, Adder's Coil]]
description: The surroundings grow dimmer, the flora itself seeming more monotone than at the entrance to this bizarre garden.  Moving into the heart of the wood, everything seems to shift from vibrant, explosive colors into chalky, dull greys.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: A soft buzzing sound emanates from a hollow beneath one of the silverwillows crowding the banks of a small stream.  Grass grows throughout, thinning and losing color as it approaches the waterline.  A narrow trail leads southerly towards a healthier region of the forest.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Stunted trees press in from all sides, grabbing at hair and clothing.  Tatters of grey moss caught in the branches flutter like shrouds snatched from the restless dead.  In curious contrast to the distorted trees, a lush carpet of black widow's lace grass provides a gloriously dark setting for colorful mounds of flowering adder's tongue.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, northwest.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: The limbs of elder trees interweave overhead, blocking out any glimpse of the sky.  Somehow, a thick undergrowth of creeping vines and pale ferns thrive in the perpetual dusk, threatening to block the path at every turn.  Pale wisps of mists drift like aimless wraiths through the tangle of vines and trees.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Pallid streaks of daylight pierce the canopy to cast dappled shadows on the ground.  Crone's hair moss hangs in clumps from the barren, twisted limbs of a massive oak.  Gnarled roots reach out in all directions from the base of the hulking tree to trip the unwary.  From somewhere nearby comes the muted sound of running water.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: A huge oak tree dominates the center of the clearing, lifting its great branches up to the sky.  Crone's hair moss hangs in clumps from the barren limbs while gnarled roots snake out in all directions to trip the unwary.  Wan light filters down to cast dappled shadows on the ground.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Festooned with ropy grey blankets of moss, the gnarled limbs of an enormous oak stretch overhead.  Deep gouges, the width of a finger or more, mar the bark of the forest giant.  The edges of the gouges are weathered, proving the damage occurred some time ago, yet the tree still weeps viscous dribbles of sap.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Thorned vines slither up and around the ancient oak trees like fanged vipers.  Broken, rotting limbs lay scattered over the ground like gangrenous appendages.  Standing out in the drear wood, red-capped mushrooms push up through the carpet of decomposing leaves, thriving in the moist decay.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Barely audible, the trickling of water whispers seductively from its unseen source.  Lush green vines armed with red thorns smother the eastern flank of the massive oak tree, yielding grudgingly to the grey moss swaying from the leafless limbs.  Rocky soils shows dark amidst scraggly patches of thin grass.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Spidery vines smother the sloping ground, tangling about the trunks of browning pines.  Murky light barely penetrates the layers of leaves and boughs.  A whispering rustle accompanies the slightest disturbance in the air.  The air is ripe with the scent of damp earth and faint corruption.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Cloyingly thick, the omnipresent stench of the stream permeates the area with a sickening miasma.  Icy fingers of mist slither around once prospering trees, as if groping blindly for victims to choke.  Dim reflections float on the dark waters, shattering and reforming with the slow moving current.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Hollow with distance, throaty ululations worry at the edge of hearing and then vanish.  The gnarled and diseased limbs of oak trees are being slowly strangled by black-thorned vines covered with blooms resembling purple spiders.  A small patch of weeds clusters around a large rock jutting from the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Chill tendrils of mist rise from a malodorous stream coursing through the tangle.  The yellowish fog eddies eerily around the tree trunks, swirling in response to shifts in the air currents and movement of any living thing.  The bare limbs of sickly silverwillow trees stretch across the path, as if poised to scratch or ensnare the unwary.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Writhing like snakes, wisps of yellowish mist drift up off a rivulet to the east.  Half sunk in the soft boggy soil, storm-shattered trees lay strewn across the clearing; whether broken by wind or ice is hard to say.  Rotting stumps, covered with thick shelves of scabrous fungus, rear out of the deadfall.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Skeletons of once-thriving trees crowd together, their gnarled limbs sculpted by the harsh mountain winds.  Tangles of thorny red-tinted vines snake around the trunks and drape the chalky grey trees with a vibrant explosion of color.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: To the north, the immense mass of the mountain emerges from pale wisps of mist.  Icy fingers of water trickle down from the snowpack above into small pools.  Blighted trees huddle close together as if commiserating with one another over their plight.  Occasional blasts of frigid air set limbs clattering against one another, raining desiccated leaves down to the forest floor.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: A narrow track ends abruptly where a massive shoulder of black granite juts from the side of the mountain.  Part of the cliff has collapsed, leaving a great jumble of fallen rock that partially blocks a dark cave mouth.  Sheltered from the sun's cruel light by the stony slopes, a thick blanket of yellow-green lichen spreads over much of the area.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Grey and lifeless, a pervasive air of decay hangs over this region of the woods.  A number of trees lean precariously against one another, worn beyond endurance by the blight.  Limbs shattered, one pine has succumbed utterly and crashed to the forest floor.  A sickly growth of fungus has sprung up along its scaly bark.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: What light filters through the dense canopy scarcely penetrates the gloomy shadows beneath the trees.  The trunks of the towering trees are splotched with some type of sickly fungus.  Reeking of death and decay, the forest floor is carpeted with dismal grey-green leaves on top and black rot underneath.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Icy fingers of water trickle down the sheer cliff and form a fetid rivulet that wends its way sluggishly south.  Chill winds tear at the brittle branches of dying silverwillows huddling close to the slow moving water.  Rotting leaves and branches form a loose tangle of debris in the rivulet, caught on stones slick with slimy black moss.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Skeletal tree limbs stretch imploringly up to the sky, withered leaves clinging tenaciously despite strong mountain winds.  A roiling mist clings to the surface of the stream coursing through the oaks and silverwillows.  The slick rocks bordering the stream are streaked with strangely luminescent lichen.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Sickly yellow-green scum covers the surface of a small pool.  Skeletal trees, bereft of leaves and life, lean precariously over the water like drunkards about to fall into a gutter.  The blight is especially virulent here, coating the ground and trees with a thick, oozing fungus reeking of rot.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Thin veils of mist chill the air.  Riddled with splotches of fungus, the scaly black trunks of pine trees rise up all around.  Overhead, thick branches lock together and support a tangled mat of moss and vines.  Brown needles cover the ground, hiding tripping hazards like protruding roots and treacherous stones.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: A vast tangle of root and limbs, the wood is painted in shades of chalky grey splashed with splotches of reddish black where fungus oozes over the blighted trees.  Drifting up from the ground, yellowish mist thickens and thins inexplicably while carrying the scents of damp and decay.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Draped with tattered grey moss, the barren trees resemble skeletal black arms clad in the rotting remnants of winding sheets.  Reaching through the icy fog shrouding the forest, the dense tangle of vegetation forms an impenetrable barrier blocking passage at nearly every turn.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: A ridge heaves up sharply from the forest floor, a long rise of stone and earth curved like a claw.  Trees cling to its flanks, their leafy canopies shrouding the world in grey twilight.  Smelling of crisp pine and the less pleasant scent of decay, pale mists rise from the black earth and curl through the scatter of rocks and trees.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Canopied Trail]]
description: Towering ironwoods spread their canopies over the stunted oaks and scrubby pines, the sparsely leafed limbs interlacing in a web of rot-riddled wood that hangs low over the narrow ridge rising up from the forest floor.  A few of the lower branches of the trees are broken, as if something large had passed this way recently.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: Bent and twisted by strong mountain winds, an ambitious copse of witchclaw trees struggles along the sloping rise.  Huddled in solitude at the edge of the ridge overlooking the tangle, a scraggly pine draped with veils of crone's hair moss broods over its reflection in a dark pool.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: A stand of blanched and bare birch struggles to survive in the stony ground as the path climbs up the sparsely wooded rise.  The air lacks the rich scents of earth, loam and decay while underfoot the land is sere, showing evidence of a blight terrible enough to bleed the very life from the land.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: Curiously washed-out hues paint the landscape in stark and pallid detail.  Grass bleached to straw barely binds the soil together in the face of eroding winds and ice melt.  The trees growing on either side of the rutted track are stunted and spindly, roots exposed where exhausted earth has crumbled beneath the onslaught of the elements.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: With the ridge dropping sharply towards the forest below, the narrow track hugs the mountain looming to the north.  Tenacious scrub pines cling to the stony ground, growing in defiance of strong winds and occasional rockslides.  Stubborn ice fills shadowed clefts in the granite cliffs.

Clinging precariously to the stony ground, scrub pines sway and rustle in time with the fickle wind.  Pebbles shift alarmingly underfoot and a few skitter over the edge of the ridge, a perilous reminder of rockslides.  Stubborn ice glints dully from the shadowed clefts in the granite cliffs.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: Amidst this desolation of skeletal trees and barren crags, Asketi's Mount dominates the view as it thrusts skyward.  When the wind blows from the north, long plumes of snow fly from the high peak like banners.  A rough trail disappears beyond a switchback upslope from here.

The distant sound of falling rocks echoes faintly from above where something makes it way along the heights.  Amidst this desolation of skeletal trees and barren crags, a rough trail leads up the mountain, vanishing into the dark.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: A lone vela'tohr plant grows stoically amidst hard packed ground comprised of small pebbles and stone, tiny remnants from the mountain that looms above it.  It stands, a vigilant sentinel, before a rough trail that leads back to a denser part of the woods.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: Small rugged pebbles and sharp rock splinters scatter the area, runoff from the majestic mountain towering above.  Random spots of green -- vegetation battling with the debris it's buried in -- offer muted color amidst the drab shards.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Withered Foothills]]
description: Partially obscured by the rock and crushed stone is the beginning of a steep switchback trail ascending upwards.  High overhead, rocky shelves and occasional overhangs mar the treacherous sides of the looming cliff that rises skyward.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Rocky Cliff]]
description: A steep switchback trail from the foothills below ends abruptly on a small plateau.  Dead brush and thorny bushes partially obscure a crumbling path that continues the ascent up the mountainside.  The rocky ground is swept clean of the usual fallen debris by the strong gusts of wind whipping around the cliff edge.  No leaves or twigs crunch underfoot and the lack of scent normally associated with growing vegetation leaves the area feeling curiously sterile.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Overlook, Precarious Shelf]]
description: A crumbling path arises from the foothills below, opening onto a rather large rocky shelf.  Pieces of charred wood sitting within a circle of rocks give testament to previous hikers' campfires.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Overlook, Precarious Shelf]]
description: Scraggly clumps of sirese flowers, partially protected by the rising cliff, grow bravely amidst the accumulation of rubble scattered haphazardly on the hard ground.  Horizontal cracks striate the cliff -- strange handprints left by nature along the coarse stone wall.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Overlook, Rocky Cliff]]
description: Horizontal cracks rive the rock face below, offering scant finger- and toeholds.  The slope rising above this small ledge angles inward for a slightly easier climb.  Crumbling stone and small pebbles trickle down the cliff, careening and echoing noisily as they make their rapid descent.  The temperature begins to drop considerably in the higher altitude.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Overlook, Cliff's Edge]]
description: A thin layer of frost streaks the cliffside, creating a somewhat more treacherous climb on the rocky slope leading downwards.  The wind howls forlornly, lovingly embracing courageous climbers in an icy grasp as it fills the air with eerie laments.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Glimmers of blue-white frost soften the stark lines of the bare stone underfoot.  Nature's hand has carved a vast plateau from the cliffs that overlook the Vela'Tohr Woods.  Directly below, twisted skeletal trees huddle against the granite crags as if seeking protection from the icy winds that whistle down from the passes.  The Woods spread south and west, growing noticeably lusher further away from the mountain.  Far in the distance, the Liirewsag River can be seen winding its way towards Sawstwar Lake.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Narrow shelves and dark fissures riddle the jagged cliffs looming above, offering temporary relief for those who dare the ascent of the towering mountain.  Although the stone rises sheer here and offers no holds, an icy crevice that has opened in the mountain wall invites any would-be climbers to explore.  Strong winds buffet even the most tenacious traveler, threatening to remove all in its path in order to restore the sterile beauty of frozen stone.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Deep gouges formed by wind and ice mar the hard granite of the mountainside.  Rivulets of water that have dribbled down from these small crevices are forever frozen, forming strangely shaped ice sculptures upon the sleek rock.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: A massive rockslide hinders easy travel to the north, partially sheltering the area from the bitterly cold winds.  The ground has been cleared of rubble and a few flat boulders are scattered randomly in small groupings.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Frigid winds caress the area with icy fingertips, leaving traces of rimy fingerprints upon the hard rock.  Icy pebbles and small stones litter the frozen ground like shattered pieces of cut glass.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: The cold wind screams relentlessly, sending pebbled shards and icy gravel skittering across the frozen ground.  Powerful gusts cause even the strongest of hunters to sway precariously -- a false step would result in a very long fall.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Overhang]]
description: Dead timber, perhaps stacked by previous hunters, is encased in ice and creates a snowy fence.  Strategically placed in relation to the steady wind currents, it provides a formidable barricade on the western edge of the overlook.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Light dustings of snow swirl upwards in odd shapes as tiny eddies sporadically shift and spin the white particles in all directions.  Occasionally, several of these unusual shapes group together and sprint across the frozen ground like deformed rabbits fleeing from an angry beast.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: Shattered pieces of granite, finely dusted with tiny flecks of crystal, are strewn along the ground and encased in thin films of ice.  Occasionally, additional pieces careen down the mountainside, skittering to an abrupt halt to lie amidst the rocky debris that has accumulated.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Vela'Tohr Overlook]]
description: A set of rusted crampons with rotting leather straps is half buried beneath a large ice-covered granite boulder surrounded by oddly shaped clumps of snow.  Packed with particles of granite and frozen twigs, the wind has molded the hard-packed snow into sculptured creatures -- malformed and strangely menacing.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Cliff Base]]
description: A massive rockslide comprised of broken boulders and ice-covered granite rock ends abruptly against the mountainside.  Looming above is a completely vertical, unscalable cliff, its sides coated with solid ice.  Enclosed on three sides, this small area is sheltered from the omnipresent wind scouring the rest of the mountain.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Cave Mouth]]
description: The cave mouth opens into a broad interior passage that extends out of sight in the darkness to the north.  Slow drops of water fall from the ceiling, striking the floor with a splat that echoes off the rock walls.  A low, breathy chittering accompanies the rustling of leathery wings overhead.  Underfoot, bat guano covers the floor and holds the tracks of some large, bipedal creature.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: A shifting flock of large bats blankets the cavern's ceiling.  Occasionally, one of the creatures flexes its wings with a papery rustle.  Other, less readily identifiable sounds tease along the edge of hearing, distorted by the echoing tunnels.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Although lost to sight in the darkness shrouding the ceiling, the scratching of claws on rock and the quiet squeaks of bats can be clearly heard.  Every visible surface of tunnel is streaked with guano that fills the air with an acrid odor.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The rough granite walls of the cavern stretch into darkness.  The faint tang of guano is carried on a draft from some deeper part of the passage.  A crude rope braided from vines tacitly invites exploration of the area above.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Illuminating patches of lichen cling to the walls, giving off a pallid phosphorescent glow.  A soft scratching sound can be heard coming from somewhere nearby, although between the echo of dripping water and the dim surroundings, the source cannot be easily pinpointed.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Signs point to something or someone bent on improving upon nature's design, transforming these subterranean tunnels from an uninhabited warren into a permanent lair.  Crooked timbers reinforce stone walls and some attempt has been made to level the floor.  A ragged hide flap covers an opening in the north wall.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: A vile combination of wood smoke, unwashed bodies, rotting garbage and bat guano fills the area with a stomach-churning aroma.  The air itself has an oily feel, leaving a film on the skin and clothing of anyone attempting to pick their way through the piles that obstruct the burrow.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Dim light filters in through the opening.  The granite walls look different here, shifting from shades of black to light greys and blues.  The colors resolve into a faded mural emblazoned across the surface.  Though difficult to encompass with a casual glance, the image shows two groups: one is near the tunnel opening while the other is much farther away.  A two-headed adder separates the groups.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The tunnel narrows here, sloping sharply upwards to the north.  A thick layer of dust and guano coats the passage floor.  Tiny, glowing red eyes peer down from the cavern's ceiling, and a dry rustling fills the air like autumn leaves stirred by wind.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Narrowing significantly, the dark stone enclosing the tunnel seems to press inwards, and a whisper of chill air swirls through the area from above.  The high-pitched chittering of bats fills the tunnel, yet every so often the noise ceases abruptly for several heartbeats before resuming.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The tunnel slopes down to the south, gradually curving out of sight.  Trickles of icy water seep from the rock walls, collecting in thin rivulets that spill down the floor of the steeply slanted passage.  A broken spear shaft lies amidst a scattering of well-gnawed bones.  Faint scratching and rustling noises echo up the tunnel from below.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The geometrically precise tunnel forms a straight, if somewhat steep, passage through dark granite walls.  Scrapes mar the stone and disturb the dust lying thick on the floor, as if something large and heavy has been dragged this way.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The rough texture of the stone walls is further marred by gouges and scorch marks.  Splintered bones and broken axes give mute testimony to a battle here in the past.  Chipped columns support a lintel over an elaborately carved granite door.  Set heart-high on a tall Elf, a glowing crystal embedded in the door bathes the area with an eldritch light.

timeto.50242: ;e if UserVars.knowsuncurse == true then 0.2 else nil end

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Box Canyon]]
description: Gutted from the mountain by wind and ice, the granite walls of the canyon pinch inward overhead to create scant shelter from the elements.  Powdery grey moss dapples the lower surfaces and the ground is carpeted with wind-blown dirt and leaves.  Chilly gusts whistle through the narrow opening to the south, carrying a faint scent of pine sap.  To the north, the cleft narrows further to form a tunnel leading deeper into the mountain.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Various stone and steel mining equipment lies scattered around the room, bearing the dents and scars of frequent use.  Well-braced crossbeams are spaced out along this section of the tunnel, occasionally creaking in reminder of the tremendous weight they are supporting.  A ragged hide flap covers an opening in the south wall.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: The walls in this part of the cave are decorated with crude patterns.  Although primitive in design, the patterns are intricately painted in streaks of ash-black and rusty brown.  Bones have been attached to the walls, but the effect seems more decorative than structural.  Polished to a gleaming white, the bones glitter in the dim light of the banked fire in the center of the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Signs of intelligent life are apparent in the tunnels.  The ceiling of this roughly worked passage is more even, the cave floor more regular, than any natural fissure.  Long, sweeping femurs and radii reinforce the walls, cemented into place to give the impression of some gargantuan serpent's rib cage viewed from within.  A faint whiff of smoke drifts past, carrying the promise of heat to drive away the mountain's pervasive chill from weary limbs.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Chisel marks score the rock where ceiling and walls have been altered to enlarge the tunnel for easier passage.  Clumps of luminescent lichen illuminate the dark stone, causing flecks of mica to glint erratically like spirits trying to manifest just beneath the surface of the granite.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Spidery cracks run across the walls, and one of the larger fissures sports a small colony of moss.  The dust on the floor shows scuffed trails between a rickety ladder and the tunnel stretching to the northeast.  Anchored by a large boulder, a rope braided from vines leads down into the pit dominating the center of the room.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Compared to the rest of the living quarters, this area is neatly arranged.  A small pile of hay rests against one wall, and a pallet of furs is pushed up against the other.  Between the two sits a flat boulder covered with small bundles of twigs and a piece of flint.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Mounds of hides fill the modest sized cavern, each apparently a separate sleeping space.  The lumpy piles are all empty, with no sign of their residents' current whereabouts.  Crude boxes clutter the area, providing a modicum of storage.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Pile upon pile of poorly tanned hides cover the ground, making it nearly impossible to move about without finding some sort of skin underfoot.  In the center of the cave, an unscraped goatskin is stretched tautly over a makeshift frame.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Slow drops of water leak from the ceiling and strike the floor with soft splats that echo through the tunnel.  Luminescent lichen flourishes in the damp environment, splotching the wall with dimly glowing streaks of blue-green.  Tiny mushrooms poke up from the moss alongside the wall.  The top of a ladder rests against the ledge, secured to the rock with rusted iron spikes.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Sloping downward to the east, a narrow ledge runs along the wall.  Beneath it, a sheer drop-off plunges dizzyingly into darkness, offering no purchase to climb down into the depths.  Some steps have been crudely cut into the side of the cliff face above, rising in a series of narrow switchbacks.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Carved from the solid bedrock, a switchback of granite stairs zigzags up the northern wall while more steps cut into the cliff face lead down to the space below.  The wide ledge offers access to caves to the east and southwest.  Clusters of wickedly curved fangs decorated with black beads hang from the tops of poles leaning against the cavern walls along the ledge.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Swirls and scuffs in the dust on the floor testify to vigorous action by large feet.  Deep gouges inflicted by heavy objects wielded with unimaginable strength scar the walls of what can only be a training ground.  Riddled with broken arrows, a target dummy is wedged into a tight corner.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Wedged into the corners of the room, crude wooden bins hold withered carrots and moldy onions, wrinkled potatoes oozing reddish-brown liquid, and weevil-filled bags of coarsely ground flour.  Animal carcasses are slung from rusty hooks embedded in the ceiling.  The floor is sticky underfoot, though it's hard to tell in the dim light whether spilled food or blood is the cause.  Low benches surround a long granite block that serves as a table.  Some sort of brownish crust speckles the top of the rough stone.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Worn smooth over time, granite stairs lead down into the lower caverns.  A fraying rope ladder hangs against the wall, leading into the darkness overhead.  The corners of the cavern are filled with discarded rubbish.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Damp walls close in tightly, thin rivulets of water trickling and dripping into puddles on the stone floor.  The rough granite has been partially smoothed into angular planes of chiseled rock.  A flickering torch dimly illuminates the tunnel and provides evidence that this area is regularly traveled.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Various crude fletching tools and supplies lie scattered around the area, showing signs of frequent use.  Unstrung longbows are racked on the weapons stands lining the cavern walls.  Wood shavings and bone chips litter the floor around benches drawn up around the firepit in the center of the cavern.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Patches of lichen cling to the walls, giving off a pallid phosphorescent glow.  Deep gouges mar the surface of the rough stone where something made a futile attempt to extend this underground burrow.  Pile upon pile of ratty goatskins and straw cover the ground, making it nearly impossible to move about without finding some sort of makeshift bedding underfoot.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Moisture seeps through cracks in the tunnel's roof, filling the air with dampness and the sound of dripping water.  A rope ladder, lashed securely to a large outcropping, leads down into the lower tunnels.  Though frayed, it appears sturdy enough to allow more climbers to pass along its length.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Poorly tanned hides have been stretched over tall wooden poles to form a windbreak around a jagged fissure.  Dry flakes of snow swirl into the tunnel with each gust of wind.  Footprints on the dusty stone floor bear mute witness to others who have passed this way.  The passage narrows slightly as it inclines steeply downward, away from the fissure.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Damp walls close in tightly, thin rivulets of water trickling and dripping into puddles on the stone floor.  The rough granite has been partially smoothed into angular planes of chiseled rock.  A flickering torch dimly illuminates the tunnel and provides evidence that this area is regularly traveled.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: A single boulder, too large to lift or move, sits in the exact center of the cave.  Scraps of food litter the uneven floor between piles of makeshift straw bedding.  The low rocky ceiling and cramped quarters leave little room to move around.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Mounds of straw are arranged haphazardly around this dank cave, heaped with crudely tanned furs to form warm, if somewhat smelly, beds.  Moldering piles of refuse, tossed aside by now absent inhabitants, collect in the corners.  The visible portions of the stone floor are streaked with ash, leftovers from past fires and attempts at fires.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Glacial Precipice]]
description: Rocks and boulders slick with hoarfrost have made their home on a small shelf and partially obscure an icy crevice that leads to the overlook below.  Scant, unidentifiable vegetation -- blighted leaves entombed in a frosty glaze -- huddle against the leeward side of some of the larger boulders.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Glacial Precipice]]
description: Piercing winds have carved out a small sheltered area where remnants from previous travelers are scattered carelessly among the rock shards and sharp pebbles.  Shattered ice axes, rusted pitons, and broken crampons comprise most of the abandoned refuse discarded in disorganized ice-covered heaps.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Glacial Precipice]]
description: Overhead is a small icy ledge with frost-covered outcroppings and jagged edges.  Long icicles encrusted with dirt and pebbles grimly hang from its outer rim like the cuspidated upper fangs of a huge openmouthed creature.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Steep Cliff]]
description: Above an icy ledge is a slippery slope peppered with jagged notches.  Occasional branches and sticks, protruding from the sides of the steep cliff, offer additional handholds to tempt those who dare climb it.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Cliff Ledge]]
description: A small ledge offers minimal protection to the slippery slope beneath it.  Chunks of rock and stone are covered with hoarfrost, their sharp jagged surfaces hiding deceivingly under the white icy blanket.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Cliff Ledge]]
description: Nature's hand has carved out a steep escarpment that leads upwards.  Wind-filled tempests and natural elements have eroded and shaped it lovingly -- a harsh testament to the power they wield.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: Stunted evergreens with oddly shaped limbs guard a steep escarpment like hunchbacked Dwarven sentries protecting a forbidden pathway.  The deformed limbs are covered with withered, bent needles that are frozen solid, snapping easily with the slightest touch.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: Huge boulders, glazed with thick crusts of white frost, butt up against the cliffside like broken snowmen left by a child's play.  Other small rocks and pebbles litter the ground, runoff from the steep cliffs towering above.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: The cold bitter winds are turbulent, echoing loudly throughout the area with a ghostly lament.  Occasional gusts are filled with icy particles and tiny sharp stone fragments that tear at clothes and exposed skin.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: Dozens of deep tracks left by unidentifiable animals in the now-frozen ground are filled with ice and rubble, making the terrain rugged and treacherous.  Frost-covered rock slivers and chipped stone shards abundantly litter the area, covering some of the deep depressions.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Sheer Ascent]]
description: Looming upwards as far as the eye can see is Asketi's Mountain, its icy top hidden by vaporous white clouds.  The mountain walls, made even more difficult with ice and snow, seemingly dare climbers to attempt an ascent.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: A deep firepit has been hacked into the frozen earth.  It is protected from the howling mountain winds by a circlet of small craggy rocks.  Grouped close to the firepit are huge tree trunks that have been cut in half lengthwise to provide crude, uncomfortable benches.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Respite]]
description: A recent rockslide covered in ice and snow provides a formidable barrier to the northeast.  Splintered rocks and stones, runoff from the towering mountain looming above, cover the ground.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Widow's Claw]]
description: Huge boulders and large rocks slick with ice send smaller stones and jagged rubble tumbling down a rockslide to the southwest.  Ferocious winds surge through cracks and crannies, emitting a perpetual howl that echoes eerily off the cliffside.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Shallow Cave]]
description: Shrouded in frost and ice, the bones of some creature gleam pale against the dark stone.  There is no sign of what brought death to this desolate place, but the splintered remains indicate that it was no peaceful ending.  Fresh air enters the cave from a vertical crack, carrying with it a crisp chill that fogs the breath.  Incongruous in this natural setting, a carved granite door at the back of the cave leads into the unknown depths of the mountain.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Dark Burrows]]
description: Thin trickles of water creep down the walls, feeding the pool that fills most of this cavern.  The oily surface gleams faintly in the subdued glow of the reflected firelight from the south.  Despite the noxious odor of the water, the multitude of tracks on the muddy floor indicates that the pool is a popular place with the denizens of the tunnels.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Stark ironwood trees form a nearly impenetrable barrier around this small clearing, dark gaps open at each end to allow travelers to pass from the trade road to the Seord Kerwaith.  A squat inn sits just off of the narrow beaten path.  Built with thick timbers exposed against whitewashed walls, the two-story building appears rugged enough to withstand even the harshest of Forfedhdarian winters.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Dense forest closes in on either side of the path, creating an absolute darkness no matter how bright the stars above the trees.  The rustle of animals and the occasional howl of wolves permeate the night, the only evidence of life.

Dense forest closes in on either side of the path, creating the dimness of twilight no matter how bright the sun above the trees.  The rustle of animals can be heard in the distance, and the dark flash of the occasional leaping deer is the only visible sign of life.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Delicate and pale, a cluster of white snowdrops blooms in the hollow of a rotten log lying alongside the path.  The dead tree's fall opened the canopy of leaves and allows a limited view of the night sky.

Delicate and pale, a cluster of white snowdrops blooms in the hollow of a rotten log lying alongside the path.  The fallen tree's death seems to have caused the only spot of sky visible here, allowing a ray of sunshine to hit the fragile flowers.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Closing oppressively around the rocky path, overhanging pine branches provide a wake-up call to wanderers not paying attention to the landscape.  Overhead, birds twitter unseen.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Echoing through the leafy woods, the howl of the wind coming down the mountain is an ever-present reminder of the harsher, colder conditions to the south.  Pine needles cushion the path underfoot, fallen from the abundance of conifers that stretch towards the sky.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: A steep stretch of the path joins the lower route to the west with the rugged ascent across Himineldar Shel.  Craggy stone juts from between stalks of hardy scrub grass, the large chunks of granite reminiscent of blocks of black ice.  The forest thins here, only sparse adventurous pine trees sprouting further up, leaving their hardwood brethren behind.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Sparse patches of brambles dot the steep path which winds its way up the stony mountainside.  The rare patch of dirt reveals the prints of some kind of large feline.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Chill winds howl constantly along the mountain road.  Every now and then, a stray flurry of snowflakes swirls down the path from a sudden gust of wind somewhere upwards.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Here and there a fragile snowdrop pokes its head up through the thin layer of frost that covers everything from this part of the mountain up.  Among the delicate flowers is a single frostbane bush, its dull burgundy hue bright against the whiteness of the landscape.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Footprints in the snow are barely discernible, though quite a few congregate in the area of a small cave mouth nearby.  Animal bones, the same bland white as their surroundings, lie scattered about, only the dull stain of blood at the ends ruining their camouflage.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Short and scraggly, a cluster of pine trees huddles together like bent old men standing side by side for warmth.  Beneath the largest conifer lie the shredded remains of a rough sackcloth lean-to, now covered by a thin layer of dirty ice and completely unusable.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Amid the rocky crags and icy snowdrifts is a small area encircled by chunks of stone, the space just large enough for a Dwarf to lie down in.  At the fore is a small monument of crossed pickaxes, their blades dull and rusted and handles lashed together with heavy twine.  Placed just below it is a crude ice sculpture of a raven, with some black substance mixed into the water before freezing to give it a dusky hue.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Stretching out in all directions, the craggy mountainside's icy and monotonous pallor is in stark contrast to the view of Forfedhdar it presents from here.  A thin plume of smoke is barely visible from an inn at the mountain's northern foot, settled in the only visible clearing amidst the dense forest below.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: A gentle dusting of snow, like finely sifted powdered sugar, covers the surrounding landscape, growing in density towards the twisted summit of the Himineldar Shel.  Stooped trees jut randomly from the snowy ground underfoot, their partially bare canopies swaying in the chill breeze.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: The steeply angled, stone-strewn road weaves between several large boulders protruding from the snow.  Icy wind, speeding down the rough slope of the mountain, seems to cut into any exposed flesh like an invisible blade, bringing with it a dull howl.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: The roadway narrows slightly as it hugs the steep exterior of the mountain, its outer edge overlooking the sheer rock wall falling far below.  A few lifeless plants and miniature trees cling precariously to the slopes, their tangled roots weaving between the shallow cracks in the partially frozen facade.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Cutting a narrow swath into the rough exterior of the mountainside, the roadway weaves along the steep exterior of the rock face.  Little can be seen of what lies far below in the darkness.

The roadway weaves along the mountainside, cutting a narrow swath into the rock face.  Far below, dagger-like rocks jut from a grey stone basin midway down the sheer eastern face of the Himineldar Shel, their icy surfaces glistening in the sunlight.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Glistening icicles dangle from countless narrow ledges hanging from the sheer rock face above, peeping out from beneath the densely packed snow.  The air is filled with the howl of the deathly chill wind as it sweeps over weathered stone, spinning shimmering flakes snow about in a hurricane of white.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Curious shapes rise from the densely packed snow, concealing whatever might be lurking beneath the shifting sea of pristine white crystals.  The walkway cuts a narrow path into the Halfling-high snow, and the track's shoulders are covered in a thin layer of crystal-clear ice.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: As if rolling out a pristine white welcome mat, the summit of the Himineldar Shel spirals skyward to the west.  Howling blasts of bone-chilling wind curl downward from the peak of the mountain to sweep though the area, sending crystals of ice and snow dancing across the frozen landscape.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Several paces off the frozen pathway, a clawed ice-covered hand protrudes from somewhere beneath the snow, having paid the ultimate price for straying from the path formerly laid before the poor soul.  The landscape is a sea of snow and ice, the shimmering surface rolling along the uneven ground.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: The restless assault of the elements sweeps across the frozen landscape with an almost malevolent intelligence, as if driven to consume all living beings upon the icy slopes.  Howling mountain winds devour all other sounds with a brutal hunger, whipping across the craggy stone that protrudes from the smooth surface of snow.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Ice monoliths tower above the landscape.  Several crates and the shattered remnants of a gilded caravan rest in a heap alongside the manmade pathway cut into the shifting snow drifts, carelessly discarded in an attempt to escape the bitter cold elements of the Himineldar Shel.

Ice monoliths tower above the landscape, refracting the available light like mammoth prisms and casting rainbows of color upon the pristine driven snow.  Several crates and the shattered remnants of a gilded caravan rest in a heap alongside the manmade pathway cut into the shifting snow drifts, carelessly discarded in an attempt to escape the bitter cold elements of the Himineldar Shel.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Rising amidst the shifting mass of snow and ice, a jagged rock wall ascends to the foot of the twisted pinnacle that marks the summit of the mountain.  In the lee of the rock facade in a small niche carved out by the elements, a stunted sapling sits within a thick cocoon of white ice.  A gentle rain of shimmering snow crystals tail downward from the ledge high above, swirling along upon the bitterly cold wind.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Darkness creeps along the narrow mountain road with the stealth of an assassin.  Nightfall is the harbinger of bitter cold temperatures and treacherous footing as the lengthening shadows make the icy trail extremely hazardous.  Blinding snow storms occur frequently in this region, striking with little warning and greeting the unprepared traveler with an untimely demise.  In a futile war against the ancient mountains, howling winds punish the rock walls with incessant fury.

Covered in ice, a narrow trail hugs the sheer rock face as it winds through the mountains.  Fierce winds punish the pass with their incessant fury, a timeless war of element against element.  Blinding snow storms strike with little warning throughout the region.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Night falls quickly upon the region, plunging it into an inpenetrable veil of inky blackness.  In the darkness, the monotonous landscape that dulled the imagination during the day becomes a trail of traps and pitfalls.  Ascending and descending, each successive shadow-covered mountain lulls the traveler into a false sense of security.  It is when the mind is weakest that nature will strike, be it blizzard, avalanche or the slip of the foot -- each has its own perils.

Distant mountains loom along the horizon, their peaks lost in swirling clouds of windblown snow and ice crystals.  The monotonous landscape, consisting of unbroken, blinding white snow fields with scattered brown or grey rocky outcroppings, does little to stir the imagination.  Ascending and descending, each successive mountain lulls the traveler into a false sense of security.  It is when the mind is weakest that nature strikes with unbridled fury, be it blizzard, avalanche or the slip of the foot.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: As night descends upon this mountainous region, falling temperatures increase the wind's bitter fury.  Blinding clouds of snow race across the slopes, disappearing into the darkness of the night.  The awesome power of nature unleashed against the mountain's solid stone is spellbinding.  Shadowy peaks, barely visible in the dark, are a reminder of the endless procession of mountains.

Incessant storms rage throughout this region, the bitter cold winds a constant companion to travelers.  Blinding clouds of snow race across the slopes, covering everything in an ever-increasing blanket of white.  The awesome power of nature unleashed against the mountain's solid stone is spellbinding.  Towering mountains dominate the landscape and stretch as far as the eye can see, an endless procession of white-capped peaks.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Foyer]]
description: This large foyer looks the same as when it was used as a home by the family.  A small table holding a wide ledger that is propped open sits beside a high-backed bench.  Beside the door is a basket half-filled with muddy shoes and boots.  Through a darkened doorway, stairs leading downwards can be seen.  Large entries to the east and west lead into the actual living quarters.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Dining Room]]
description: Filling most of the room, a thick pine dining table with benches on each length always has place settings.  Made from cast iron, a stove in the corner has a large pot simmering on the back.  Swinging doors at the end of the room must lead to the kitchen, evidenced by the wear and tear on the floor.  A pine sideboard has been pushed into the corner opposite the stove.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Parlor]]
description: Low ceilings and darkened wall panels in this room make candles necessary throughout the night and day.  Everything is very tidy right down to the pine floor that has recently been swept.  Mismatched armchairs and stools have been arranged in an attempt to provide private seating areas.  Hung in a place of honor over the mantel of the fieldstone fireplace is a broken axe handle.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Hallway]]
description: A brown runner goes the length of the hallway.  Embroidered flowers in plain pine frames are mounted on the walls between the doorframes.  Small tables sit to the right of the doors, a water pitcher and chamberpot resting on a lace doily atop each one.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Guest Room]]
description: A sparkling white goose-down comforter and soft, plush pillows with embroidered slips adorn this high post bed.  Fresh flowers in a porcelain vase sit upon a dressing table.  Finishing off the furnishings of this room is an armoire with carving on the doors that almost seems out of place with the rest of the inn.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Dormitory]]
description: This room was clearly added onto the home in later years as evidenced by the newer wall panels and floor.  What must have been the master bedroom has been turned into a dormitory of bunk beds with little room between them to put anything.  A locker sits at the end of each row, a neatly folded towel and cloth on the top of each one.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Side Room]]
description: Neatly mended lace curtains have been pulled closed.  A soft blue quilt has been drawn up over the pillow on the single bed.  Polished pine, used in the building of the dresser and nightstand, matches the bed's wood.  The floor is immaculate and the white rag rug has been well beaten.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Momma's Room]]
description: What was clearly once a root cellar from the lingering earthly odor is now a small bedroom.  Pristine in its tidiness, the room is uncluttered by anything fancy.  Spartan to an extreme, a sleigh bed with a faded quilt and a pine dresser are the only pieces of furniture.  A small woven rug sits beside the bed where Momma must swing her feet out every morning.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, The Kitchen]]
description: Overly large, the stove has pots bubbling away on top and the smell of fresh baked bread fills the air.  A pie safe with punched tin doors faces a long counter piled high with cleaned plates.  Sitting next to the back door, a wood bin is filled to the top with roughly split logs.  Bundles of fresh herbs hang to dry from the low rafters, adding to the odors of the constant cooking.

title: [[Momma's Bed and Breakfast, Back Yard]]
description: A glow through the back door shows rocking chairs that have been set up under the extended eaves off the back of the house.  From the darkness, the occasional squawk of a chicken alarmed by something in the night can be heard.  The shape of a well can be seen in the middle of the yard.

Rocking chairs have been set up under the extended eaves off the back of the house.  In the far corner of the yard is a large meticulous garden plot, with needed tools stacked in a large wooden trough.  Through fencing in the other corner, the squawking of chickens can be heard.  With buckets ready, a well stands in the middle of the grass that is closely manicured in large patches.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Along the Trail]]
description: An occasional soft splash is heard in the darkness beyond a wall that runs alongside the trail.

A broken, ivy-covered dry stone wall can be seen alongside the trail in this small natural clearing.  Lines of pine trees encircle the last vestiges of grass and wildly growing flowers of what used to be a garden.  Beyond the wall the sun gleams off a small pond surrounded by tall reeds.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Trail's End]]
description: As the trail abruptly leaves the wooded area, a large cracked boulder almost completely blocks the path.  In the distance, the face of the mountain rises up out of the darkness.

As the trail abruptly leaves the wooded area, a large cracked boulder almost completely blocks the path.  In the distance, the winds and weather have left only the hardiest of pines and shrubs on this face of the mountain.

title: [[On the Mountainside, Stony Trail]]
description: Stones underfoot make traversing the trail precarious, as every step dislodges bits of rubble to bounce away into the darkness.  On one side of the trail, scrub and sturdy pines cling tenaciously to the boulders that jut out from the mountainside.  On the other is air, though a fall here would deal little damage.

Stones underfoot make traversing the trail precarious, as every step dislodges bits of rubble to send them skittering down the path.  On one side of the trail, scrub and sturdy pines cling tenaciously to the boulders that jut out of the mountainside.  On the other is air, though a fall here would deal little damage.

title: [[On the Mountainside, Cleared Flat]]
description: Three tall stone slabs, one resting across the other two, form a convenient bench -- for someone about three times as tall as a 'Tog, perhaps.  The ground around the boulders is bare of the rocks strewn along the rest of the trail, as if scuffed away.

title: [[On the Mountainside, High Trail]]
description: Though wide enough to hold several hikers walking abreast, the trail falls sharply off to the west.  Shifting rubble underfoot forces travelers to clutch at the branches of stunted pines, leaving bits of bark and broken brown needles to litter the ground.  An occasional faint glow can be seen sometimes in the darkness halfway up the summit.

Though wide enough to hold several hikers walking abreast, the trail falls sharply off to the west.  Shifting rubble underfoot forces travelers to clutch at the branches of stunted pines, leaving bits of bark and broken brown needles to litter the ground.  A large crevice can be seen in the distance halfway to the summit.

title: [[On the Mountainside, Plateau]]
description: The ground levels out and widens here, providing a safe area to rest.  A large depression in the ground has collected water from the last rainfall.  Skittering in the darkness is evidence of wildlife that might use this as a watering hole.

title: [[On the Mountainside, Rock Face]]
description: The trail narrows, forcing travelers to edge carefully along the overhanging rock face to avoid a painful fall.  Nothing can be seen in the darkness below, but the occasional rock that is dislodged seems to take forever before hitting solid ground.

title: [[On the Mountainside, The Flat]]
description: A large firepit filled with muddy ashes is in the center of what is clearly a campsite.  From this vantage point a crevice further up the trail can be seen.

title: [[On the Mountainside, The Trail]]
description: The trail is devoid of any real hazards to your footing -- a good thing, as a fall from this spot would surely be deadly.  From time to time, something rustles in the darkness, or sends a rock clattering down the slopes to startle the unwary.

title: [[On the Mountainside, The Crevice]]
description: Seismic force has sundered the mountain, splitting the summit to leave behind a vast crevasse.  Pine trees, gnarled and stunted at this altitude, grow in scattered clumps with fallen trunks littering the area.

title: [[Mountainside, Thin Path]]
description: The path thins here between a line of boulders on one side and trees and shrubs against the mountainside.  Occasionally an eerie scratching noise from the ledge above follows an errant breeze.

title: [[In the Mountain, The Crevice]]
description: Instead of the expected close walls of a crevice, the area opens up into a large crater that is not detectable from outside the pine-covered entrance.  The shapes of large boulders and trees growing along the sides can be made out in the darkness.  The path forks, each direction well traveled, possibly by the wild animals that come here for shelter.

title: [[In the Crater, The Pit]]
description: Moving around a line of pine trees, the rise in the ground prevents falling into the deep pit that fills the whole area.  A ledge overhangs the pit, allowing any available light to penetrate but still protecting it from weather.  The only passable path seems to be to the northwest, as other ways are blocked by looming obstacles in the darkness.

title: [[In the Crater, Sleeping Area]]
description: Occupants are sheltered from the weather by the ledge overhanging this flattened area.  Enormous piles littering the ground can be made out in the darkness.  The stench is almost unbearable as the rustle of small creatures can be heard from unknown sources.

title: [[Mountainside, The Ledge]]
description: The path ends abruptly on a ledge of crystalline stone that overlooks the canyons and lakes far below.  Across the expansive vista, the majestic Himineldar Shel -- peaks occasionally wreathed in clouds -- are visible in the distance.

title: [[In the Mountain, The Bone Yard]]
description: A large ledge overhangs what has clearly been used as a bone yard by the occupants of this crater.  Most piles are haphazardly arranged with no order, though the rim of the ledge has been carefully lined with a row of grinning skulls that range in size from field mouse to mammoth.  The path winds to the northeast through this macabre setting.

title: [[In the Crater, Kitchen]]
description: In the center of this cleared area is an enormous fire pit that is aflame even though no caretakers are visible.  Filled with a grey bubbling concoction, a grey mammoth skull lies on a pile of stones in the flames.  To one side of the fire pit, a pile of raw half-gnawed animal legs and rib cages rests, for those that can't wait for the stew to be ready.

title: [[In the Crater, Communal Area]]
description: Clearly composed of broken pieces of caravans and wagons, a large, disorganized semicircle of debris occupies the center of the area.  One oddly decorated caravan remains mostly intact, placed by itself beneath a small ledge.  Darkened areas on the ground are in the cleared area inside the circle.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Storage Area]]
description: This area was once a staging area of the old mine.  Meticulously carved sandstone tiles form a decorative veneer over the walls' crumbling mortar, hinting at former prosperity and natural artisanship.  Now, broken bottles, piles of debris and rotting food litter the floor surrounding a small fire pit.  To the south, ambient light from the entrance fades into murky grey shadows.
This area was once a staging area of the old mine.  Now broken bottles, piles of debris and rotting food litters the floor and surrounds a small fire pit.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Storage Area]]
description: Away from the uncertain light of the entrance, the walls are slick with greasy mold leaving the room dank and musty-smelling.  Shadows lurk along the corners, masking the progressive state of decay and the ragged gaps in the sandstone veneer.  Glittering glass shards cover the floor, fanning away from a ruined cupboard.  Keeping vigil beside the mine's door is a kneeling figure, its outstretched hands holding a black marble slab upon which to rest an offering.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Tunnel]]
description: The caliginous light makes it difficult to see far.  Broad timber struts partition the crumbling sedimentary walls and shore up the low ceiling joists.  One strut bears a blackened halo above a corroding metal bracket where the miners placed their torches.  Thick wooden beams, or track ties, lock a pair of pitted steel ridges into place as they disappear around a sharp curve into the shadows.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Tunnel]]
description: Following the bend, the old tracks continue through a square arch of splintered timbers, disappearing beneath a formidable mound of rubble.  The relic of an old rock fall, the tumbled stones and dirt make passage through the arch a tight squeeze.  A derelict mining cart, its wheels rusted tight, lies overturned below a torch bracket that hangs precariously by a corroded bolt.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Sloping Tunnel]]
description: An old lantern emits a faint glow to hold the suffocating darkness at bay.  The large hill of rubble and gravel peters out into sludge the consistency of porridge that sticks to boots, clothing, and skin, and makes the going quite difficult.  The tracks extend from a pile of rubble that partially blocks the arch to the north, only to drop away down a steep slope.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Sloping Tunnel]]
description: The damp and darkness have taken their toll on the wooden ties below the iron tracks, fostering a home for borers and beetles in the dark, crumbling wood.  Thankfully, the tracks have long ceased to need the ties and continue to mimic the dips and curves of the slope.  Debris of old washouts, roots, rocks and gravel caught between the tracks and sleepers makes the way perilous for the hasty.  The danger for travelers is somewhat alleviated by a rusted handrail loosely bolted into the fragmenting rock wall.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Rock Shelf]]
description: The tracks emerge from a declivitous tunnel onto this broad sandstone shelf before again disappearing down the slope of a wide, dark hole.  The spluttering light of a solitary lantern dimly catches the sumptuous colors of limestone shawls, delicately stained by mineral deposits.  Overhead, cracks in the ceiling continuously bleed drops of lime-rich water that fall with a "plop" around the hole, wearing away at the rock to form a smooth set of shallow pockmarks.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Rock Ledge]]
description: The slopes of a dark hole pierce the broad shelf above this narrow ledge.  Beyond the crumbling edge, vaulted cavern ceilings soar and staggering canyon depths plummet into shadowed depths, a vast emptiness surrounded by glory.  Magnificent limestone shawls drape the walls in multicolored splendor, twinkling as faceted crystals reflect the dim light.  The rust-laden tracks lie forlorn and forgotten veering off to the east, a dreary contrast to the resplendent backdrop.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Fractured Ledge]]
description: Careless mining practices have left the walls without reinforcement, resulting in rock falls that litter the ledge with mounds of rubble.  From time to time, a loose stone will clatter down the pile before tumbling over the edge into the abyss, leaving behind an expectant silence as you wait in vain to hear it strike the bottom.  A rope tied to an iron stake dangles over the precipice.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Cavern]]
description: In the dim light, the tracks are barely visible, hugging a jagged bend in the rock shelf's wall before they turn east onto a long, narrow bridge suspended from two immense wooden girders.  The workmanship of the aerial walkway speaks of experienced engineers, although the materials seem somewhat primitive.  Leading off to the northeast a rotting platform depends from a network of wrist-thick wires.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Bridge]]
description: Massive ropes, spliced and bound with steel wire, are pulled taut against the girders to support the weight of the bridge.  Between the steel wire and the rotting slats, zigzagged ropes reinforce the handhold and border the aerial walkway.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Rotting Platform]]
description: Suspended by rotting cable fixtures overhead, the platform bounces gently as air currents swirl, and the cable dips a little lower over the plummeting depths of the chasm.  It is not obvious why this platform is here but vacant cable fixtures seem to indicate aborted plans to extend it.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Rotting Platform]]
description: Tiny particles of dust continually drift down from the fittings.  Some are heavy enough to settle on and between the planks, eventually sifting away into the blackness below.  Others float away idly like tiny twinkling motes in the air.  To the south, you can see the long bridge, but the gap between this platform and the bridge is widening.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Rotting Platform]]
description: Supported by a rickety, makeshift trestle connecting it to a bridge, the platform comes to an abrupt end here.  Creaking timbers and shifting debris mingle with the high-pitched squeals of bats, sending echoes whispering through the sepulchral chasm.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Bridge]]
description: Rotting timbers tumble over the edge of a gaping hole, held to the bridge by fraying ropes.  Reinforced beams stand sentinel at the ledge, though cut marks mar their steel surface and most of the cables which once supported the bridge have long since snapped, leaving behind only a few strands.  Fallen rocks and other rubble litter the remaining planks, the debris growing denser to the east.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Cave-in]]
description: A mountainous cave-in has spewed huge rocks and tons of rubble toward the bridge, and blocks the way further east.  Curiously, a set of deep wheel ruts carve their way through the silted ground and stop abruptly at an enormous boulder.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Bridge]]
description: An ever-present air current from the chasm below causes the bridge to sway gently from side to side, sending small trickles of dust down between the wood to dissipate in mid-air.  The ropes creak and protest at the added stress and only the steel cable reinforcing the fist-thick rope serves as reassurance that the bridge will indeed not snap and break.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Bridge]]
description: The wooden planks stop short at a hole.  Damp air, borers and age have won their battle with the bridge, leaving behind a gaping hole that offers a wide view of the chasm below.  The far side of the breach is shrouded in darkness, with only vague shapes being visible from here.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Hollow]]
description: A cramped dugout has been carved into the crumbling cliff face, probably the handiwork of an exploration team.  A long rope suspended from an overhead spike swings gently from side to side, brushing against a ledge and fraying the fibers.  Below the hollow, the rope ends at a small wooden platform dangling precariously into the mouth of a yawning abyss.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Wooden Platform]]
description: This small platform hangs suspended a short way into the abyss, the old rope tied securely to the metal framework.  Although here the rope and frame are still in good order, the timber slats are beginning to rot.  Gaps in the flooring show only a sheer vertical cliff face shrouded in darkness.

title: [[The Starry Road]]
description: Fiery white boulders hover like stepping-stones over a dark sea.  Crashing waves of glassy black energy break with a spray of light and tiny sparkling crackles of fire.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Maker's Mark Shop]]
description: Damp walls of alternating limestone and dolomite do little to shield this entryway from the pounding deep inside the forge.  A thick oak door leads out onto the streets.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, West Hall]]
description: A pair of diamond-shaped windows clouded entirely by soot, face the city streets.  An occasional bang from the crafting rooms sets them rattling in their frames and tosses up small clouds of grey dust.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Fractured rocks, the shattered bones of the mountain, tell the tale of a recent slide and lie scattered about the trail.  Larger splinters thrust up through the deep drifts, the dull greys and browns in stark contrast to the purity of the white snow pack.  Howling winds rush down from the highest peaks, screaming through the pass with a banshee-like wail.  Majestic snowcapped mountains stretch across the horizon with regal splendor, their beauty belying their cold-hearted truth.

Creeping across the mountains, the deepening shadows slowly engulf the trail in darkness.  Fractured rocks, the shattered bones of the mountain, tell the tale of a recent slide and lie scattered about the path.  Howling winds, strengthened by nightfall and plunging temperatures, rush down from the highest peaks with a banshee-like shrieking.  Along the horizon rise the shadowy images of majestic snowcapped mountains, standing in silent judgment in the darkness.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Assaulted by an endless series of storms and brutal winds, the narrow trail slowly wends its way through the pass.  Sheer rock walls rise on either side of the path.  In the distant past a river raced through the tight confines of this gorge.  The raging gales frequently dislodge large boulders from the cliffs above.  With little warning these missiles plummet and shatter violently on impact with the bottom of the pass, showering the trail and snow drifts with debris.

Plunged into darkness and assaulted by brutal winds, the narrow trail slowly wends it way through the pass.  Sheer rock walls, rising to either side of the path, do nothing but increase the fury of nature.  The raging winds frequently dislodge large boulders from the cliffs above.  In the darkness, these missiles, with little warning, shatter violently on impact with the bottom of the pass and shower the trail and snow drifts with debris.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Jagged cliffs rise on each side of the twisting trail, the rock walls channeling and strengthening the fierce winds that race through the gorge.  Deep snow drifts, a constant presence through this region, cover the pass like the swells of a frozen sea.  Splintered fragments of rock, remnants of past slides, litter the blanket of snow making for a hazardous journey.  The crumbling stone and suffocating layer of white lend an eerie stillness to the pass broken only by the howling wind.

Channeled and strengthened by the confining rock walls, fierce winds race through the pass, their fury increased by falling temperatures.  In the darkness, the splintered remnants of past slides resemble the scenes of a battle, warriors and monsters frozen in time.  The crumbling stone and suffocating blanket of drifting snow lend an eerie stillness to the pass, broken only by the howling of the wind.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Majestic snowcapped peaks and an undisturbed blanket of snow are but a few of the treasures this region has to offer.  Rugged mountains form a protective circle around a small plateau, sparing it from the harshest weather.  In sharp contrast to the torturous winds and storms beyond, this sheltered spot is peaceful and serene.  Snow crystals, blown aloft from the heights, float lazily through the still air.  Their graceful flight lends a magical quality to the small fell.

Nightfall covers the region in a blanket of darkness, cloaking the area's scenic treasures until the arrival of day.  Rugged mountains, hidden in shadow, form a protective circle around a small plateau, sparing it from the harshest weather.  In sharp contrast to the torturous winds and storms beyond, this small spot is peaceful and serene.  Snow crystals, blown aloft from the highest peaks, float lazily through the still air, their occasional sparkle lending a magical quality to the small fell.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Imposing rock walls rise above the narrow trail, their incredible height blocking the feeble light of day from reaching the bottom of the gorge.  Water trickling down from a hidden spring freezes, forming hideous misshapen monstrosities that glare down upon the snowy passage.  Howling winds rip through the pass dislodging the icy growths, sending the figures flying in an awkward dance before shattering at the bottom of the gorge.

An inky blackness descends upon the narrow rugged trail, the fall of night sped by the imposing cliffs.  Water trickling from a hidden spring somewhere on the rugged rock walls freezes, forming hideous misshapen monstrosities.  Howling winds tear through the pass and occasionally dislodge the icy growths.  These bizarre ice sculptures plummet uncontrollably in the darkness, sending the figures flying in an awkward dance before shattering at the bottom of the gorge.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Cataclysmic events shattered this mighty mountain, creating a basalt wall that rises high into the sky.  A twisting trail, barely wide enough to walk along, hugs the sheer rock face overlooking a deep chasm that plunges into unseen depths.  Raging winds race through the narrow gorge, assaulting the ears and mind with their high-pitched shriek.

Winding its way along the shattered mountain, the twisting trail hugs a vertical rock wall overlooking a deep gorge that plunges into a fathomless blackness.  Unforgiving by day, the small path becomes treacherous at night with a darkness familiar only to the dead.  Raging winds race through the narrow chasm with a high-pitched shriek assaulting the ears and mind.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Along the sheer walls that surround the roadway, thick sheets of ice cling to the rough stone beneath.  Within it hang rocks, stones and various other debris, appearing to rest weightless in midair.  Sharp gusts of wind sweep down the mountainside, pulling shards of ice from the face of the glacier to send them careening into the gorge far below.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: The road curves sharply as it slides along the sheer walls of ice that coat the mountainside.  Along the outer side of the path, a deep chasm sweeps downward to end in a gorge filled with dagger-like rock protrusions littered with the remnants of wood and bone.  Rushing icy water spews down from a wide crack in the mountainside, the spray freezing instantly upon contact with the frigid air, making travel very hazardous.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Fortress Gate]]
description: The remnants of a massive stronghold set into the rock stand in disarray, having borne the brunt of the elements over countless years.  Massive gates with deep gold filigree lean against the crumbling archway that frames the enormous structure, pulled from their hinges.  Ice-covered skeletons, that of both S'Kra Mur and Dwarves, lie crumbled beneath the rubble, skeletal hands still clutching frozen weapons.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Far below, a lush valley is visible, framed within jagged peaks of icy black stone.  A gentle mist rises from the jungle as tropical birds sweep amongst the stone-grey canopies that push in close to a massive black spire set into the southeastern wall.  The low babble of water reverberates off the icy walls of the mountainside, slowly slipping downward in semicircular beds of ice that follow the contours of the roadway.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Mountain Road]]
description: Crystal fonts of spring water trickle from jagged crevices that streak across the stone facade of the Himineldar Shel, forming curious icy sculptures and giving the appearance of an enormous crystal fountain.  From time to time, shards of ice or rock tumble from the treacherous cliffs above, landing in the gorge below with a resounding impact.  The road tightly hugs the sheer cliffs as it cuts a pathway though the rugged landscape.
