title: [[Ratha, Port Road]]
description: The bustling dock areas provide a constant stream of traffic along the quays and up into the town proper along the main road.  Local militia, resplendent in plumed helms, their scales buffed and tinted with the town livery, keep a wary eye on foreign traveler and resident citizen alike.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: The shattered remains of a fluted alabaster fountain squat immobile and unmourned in the middle of this busy square.  Well-to-do merchants dressed in fur and silk step lively around beggars missing assorted limbs.  Dingy, ramshackle houses line both sides of the road, furnishing cheap and seedy quarters for the unsqueamish.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: The main road, broad and bumpy with ruts from thousands of wagon wheels, proceeds east and west between several large temporary storage areas.  Boxes, bales, barrels, chests and trunks of every kind are organized by lot and assigned their piece of ground.  Private guards stand watch, gazing suspiciously at every passerby.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: The harbor at this end of the walk is crowded with small craft -- rowboats mostly -- in which the fishermen of the city bring their catch to shore.  The pungent smell of the fish lingers long after they've been unloaded, and the discarded bait and offal in the water is much enjoyed by the gulls.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: Musclebound cargomen haul freight to and from the ships at this pier, using rusty chains suspended from twin poles of oak, stitched with sword moss.  They work under the watchful and none-too-friendly eyes of port overseers, who are quick to administer a warning lash when the cargo lists to one side.  Gangplanks creak, and the dock itself shudders beneath the onslaught of never-ceasing breakers.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: Frowning warehouses, several stories high with projecting cranes, front the winding road.  Covered with pale, peeling blue paint and caked white in places with encrusted salt, these shuttered buildings are barred and triple-locked against poachers.  Each lock bears the seal of the municipal guard, in some cases vigorously defaced with a knife by some previously frustrated burglar.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: A freshly scrubbed edifice of white brick lies to the north.  Above its stately teakwood gate is a sapphire blue shield bearing crossed yellow keys, the symbol of the Traders' Guild.  Many citizens of substance regularly enter and leave its premises, glancing around proudly at the well-trimmed hedge of peregan trees.  A stone statue poses majestically before the guildhall's entrance, gazing out over the open ocean.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: To the south looms a wooden building, painted a leering red.  Its gaudy, golden window shutters are closed, but the door has been jammed open.  Raucous screams of rage and pain and laughter, shouts for drink, and scraps of music flow unceasingly from inside the doss-house.  Guards glance away self-consciously as they pass by, and merchants perceptibly quicken their pace on the road northeast or west.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: To both sides of the path, tall, narrow houses with dark slits for windows lean precariously against one another, like old people gathering strength from close company in a blustering wind.  Their red-shingled roofs have rotted to brown, and their windows are boarded shut.  From somewhere to the southwest a ragged scar of jumbled music and laughter rises incoherently, then falls away to nothing.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: Sturdy longshoremen use hooked poles of iron and thick gorse ropes to lever ship cargoes onto and across this dock.  The constant wash of brine scrubs the pier and posts like a rough razor.  Tax assessment officers regularly appear, checking off arrivals and departures, blandly ignoring the stares and poorly hidden curses of passengers and crew alike.

title: [[Ratha, Port Walk]]
description: The road skirts its winding way between the roaring turquoise-colored surf to the south, and the weatherbeaten cliffs and scrag-oaks to the north.  A few piles of wooden debris would pass unnoticed if not for the tiny vegetable gardens outlined with small, irregular stones that adjoin each.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: The Port Walk's fractured cobblestone paving gives way to a broad sand path strewn with broken shells, strands of seaweed, and driftwood drying in the breeze.  A small trail heads north toward the cliffs that hem the narrow band between true earth and salt sea.  The ocean's voice, ranging from soft whisper to beast's roar, sounds across the beach.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: Shrill cries from ospreys nesting in the cliffs mix with the slap of the surf on the beach.  The huge nests, woven from driftwood, seaweed and assorted debris, are clearly visible against the light color of the cliff's face.  Every so often, one of the great birds launches itself into the breeze to soar over the waves.  Oceanward, pinnacles of rock carved by the sea's touch rise from the water.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: Sweeping between the ocean and cliffs, the serpentine curves of the beach reach toward a towering cliff in the distance.  Wind-sculpted dunes parallel the beach, but the tide prevents them from encroaching past the highwater level.  Burrows in the dunes and nests wedged in the tough grass provide homes for a variety of creatures.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: Small groups of sandpipers play tag with the waves as they dash along the beach.  The little birds occasionally pause in their game to investigate bits of seaweed or gobble up sand lice.  The waves, forced to travel around an offshore jumble of rocks, hit the beach at an angle.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: Delicate red and yellow sandflowers nestle among clumps of hardy dune grass.  Several stone slabs have been arranged, either by nature or landsmen, to form a table and seating.  Trash near one of the stone seats suggests that someone has dined here recently.  The beach narrows as it curves north toward the cliffs.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: The beach deadends at the cliff's face -- not even a thin ribbon of sand separates the water from the massive rock slabs that tumble against each other and into the ocean.  Spume washes the formations of stacked rocks as each wave strikes on their endless roll landward.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: A small shrine in the shape of a cobra, its hood flared wide, sits to one side.  Bits of feathers and fragments of skin show the remains of small animals sacrificed for one reason or another -- to gain favor perhaps, or to give thanks for some minor success in life.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: Cheap perfume and over-loud laughter wafts from behind deep-shaded windows hung with heavy curtains that line the upper story of a whitewashed stone building.  An almost exclusively male patronage seems intent on avoiding notice as they hurry into and out of the interior.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: The traffic swirls and forms small tangled knots as the road splits, one path leading to the solid facade of the Merchant's Bank, while the other roads lead down to the docks and up into the center of town and the higher tiers.  A brace of heavily armed guards watches over the roadway leading to the bank, keeping a wary eye out for trouble.  The throng of pedestrians mingles with the occasional dray or laden caravan in an ever-changing kaleidoscope of colors and textures.

title: [[Ratha, Bank Street]]
description: Guttering lanterns set high on poles shed a watery glow along the steep road leading to the Bank of Ratha.  In a land where business never sleeps, the bank keeps late hours for the convenience of all.  The wise traveler keeps well away from the deeper shadows along the wayside though, for legitimate business is not all that never sleeps.

A short stretch of road winds from Greater Cobra Road towards the gilded entrance to the Bank of Ratha.  Beggars and mountebanks and peddlers wheedle or proclaim or grasp at the hems of passersby, each trying to gain attention (and some coins) from the hurrying throng.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: The wide road leading from the docks to the lift makes a sharp bend as it passes a ruined pile of stones that was once a building.  Apparently ravaged by fire or some other disaster, the occupants have deserted the shell.  The remaining stones are cracked and blackened, the good ones having been removed by the local denizens to build their own houses.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: Dim candles flicker behind ill-fitting shutters on the few windows to be found on the squatter's shacks and run-down houses along the road.  The occasional burst of coarse, sibilant laughter, or the sleepy whine of a child rises into the night air as other travelers, cloaked or hooded against the sea damp, hasten past on their own errands.

Dull faces peer out with vacant curiosity from scattered shacks and generally ill-favored dwellings.  A few gap-toothed children stare openly and jeer and hoot at richly dressed travelers or non-S'kra Mur before their harried mothers drag them back behind tattered door hangings.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: The heavy stone slabs used to pave the road as it winds its way along the curving shoulder of a small rise have been painted in patterns of color meant to resemble the scales of a giant serpent.  The pavement, though faded and dusty, still shows a glimmer of brightness here and there.  This part of town once knew a better life it seems.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: From the east, the stink of death floats on the cool damp air.  The faint strains of a dirge echo among the stone walls of the nearby buildings.  Death comes to all, high and low, rich and poor, and all will end the same.
From the east, the stink of death wafts on the air.  The smoke of a funeral pyre drifts upwards where the ever-present sea winds tear it to tatters.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: This pleasant square marks the center of social life for the down and out of Ratha.  Despite the noise and confusion and occasional screams from the great intersection to the south, a certain calmness pervades this spot.  A tiny park forms a rare green space in this cramped city of stone.

title: [[Grisgonda's Gems and Jewels]]
description: As you step into the room, your feet sink into plush carpets.  The walls are set with numerous locked display cases.  A well-dressed guard gives you a polite visual once over and steps aside so you may enter.  Gems of every sort and size, from slivers of plain looking crystal to a massive heart-shaped gem the size of a Gor'Tog's fist are displayed.  Grisgonda herself sits at a plain black marble desk with a bright lamp upon it inspecting gems that have been brought in for sale by other adventurers.

title: [[Ratha, Dne Cut]]
description: This short, narrow alleyway is used by the merchants coming to the bazaar from the shipyards.  Just a step or two from the larger avenue, wheeled carts with heavy loads can avoid the long arduous trek up Mission street.  Children often gather at the intersection to wait for stray goodies to fall off the wagons.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: The crowds are thick here, near the lift which leads higher into the city.  Street vendors ply their wares while jugglers and musicians collide with people in a hurry in the eternal dance of life that is a crowded city.  To one side a crippled beggar shakes a leather cup, seeking alms with a certain air of quiet dignity.

title: [[Ratha, Dne Cut]]
description: Muffled sounds erupt into clamoring furor as the alley reaches the level of the bazaar's lower entrance.  The crowds that gather here are mostly visitors from other ports, and merchants who do business on this tier.  Among the throngs lurk the young pickpockets eagerly learning their craft.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: Sandy and loose, ancient cobbles amble past a white mud and stone house that sits back a few paces from the road.  Bleached by the sun and in stark contrast with other buildings in the vicinity, the old house and manicured gardens surrounding it appear orderly and well cared for.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: Steep cliffs rise high above, directing ones gaze toward the heavens.  Cliffside dwellings with dramatic ocean views can be seen from this vantage point.  Scanning the meager surroundings at this elevation, one can only imagine what it would be like to live the blessed lifestyle of Ratha's privileged class.  A rickety fence marks the northern boundary of this section of town.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: Wretched poverty, brazen and offensive, assaults visitors to this small plateau.  Wanderers head past toward the bazaar, as the homeless find rest under any number of trees.  The slums of the city loom larger than life, just a few hundred yards below.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: As the incline steepens further, solid granite cliffs loom larger than life just beyond the northern fenceline.  Removed from the rotting stench of the streets below, the breezes here are fresh and futures seem bright.  A stone wall provides a nice place to rest and enjoy the magnificent view.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: Old women with bundles and buckets labor up the hill toward the dwellings that lie below the cliff face.  Row upon row, these makeshift shelters taunt the ocean into challenging their worthiness.  The sweeping vistas here simply take the breath away, and many find the cares of the day diminished by the awesome power and beauty of the ocean.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Mission Street]]
description: Along the oceanside avenue, the gentle incline gives way to a more dramatic rise in elevation.  From this part of Upper Mission street one has a commanding view of the towering cliffs to the north.  An interesting little shop wraps itself around the trunk of an enormous ironwood tree, just this side of a large open field.

title: [[Ratha, Lower Mission Street]]
description: Long lines of indigent and hungry await a warming morsel outside Nadamian's Mission.  A thin gruel the usual fare, the delicious smells and promise of a meal are half the experience for many of them.  Of course, along with the meal comes a helping of the Nadamian family's tenets and teachings.

title: [[Ratha, Lower Mission Street]]
description: A low wall and a space between buildings here, offer the onlooker a view of the rugged shore and the crystal blue ocean beyond.  A few diligent souls comb the rocks for edible gifts from the mother sea.  Delicious smells coming from somewhere nearby are a welcome relief to the rotting stench to the south.

title: [[Ratha, Lower Mission Street]]
description: The sharp stench of putrefaction and raw sewage assails the nostrils, sending all but the comatose into fits of retching.  Making its way across the road, a deep trench lays claim to the awful smell.  Rats and flies abound while children frolic and naked babies toddle at their mother's sides.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The once crowded, chaotic bazaar now stands silent, both merchant and shopper resting with the sun.  The colorful pennants marking the marketplace are now nothing more than shades of black, waiting to regain their luster in a new day.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, northwest.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The scents of the day mingle with the silence of night as the smells of the bazaar linger long after the merchants have turned in.  Shards of lamp light sporadically pierce the confines of the marketplace, causing both illumination and shadow.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The festive tents are darkened, awaiting the chaos of a new day.  Workers saunter through the grounds, cleaning and raking the gravel walkways as they go.

The scents of the day mingle with the silence of night as the smells of the bazaar linger long after the merchants have turned in.  Shards of lamp light sporadically pierce the confines of the marketplace, causing both illumination and shadow.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: Scintillating aromas waft through the air.  Meats roasting, spicy concoctions brewing in some merchants stall, the scent of freshly cured tobacco and a thousand other olfactory offerings beckon even the weariest of shoppers to turn around and have another look.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Ratha, Malk Staho]]
description: The air is abuzz with the sounds of the bazaar.  Merchants of every description scream out the virtues of their wares while citizens try to dodge the more aggressive salesmen.  Scarlet-colored banners on the north side of the road point the way deeper into the bazaar.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west.

title: [[Temple of Hodierna, Holy Sanctuary]]
description: The main part of the temple is dedicated to the goddess herself.  Entering through the arch, the first thing your eyes rest upon is the wall directly opposite the entrance.  An awe-inspiring mural of Hodierna, made out of thousands of tiny colored tiles, covers the entire length of the sanctuary.  Each tile is carefully placed, detailing the goddess' features, giving her an almost life-like appearance.  The altar is made of a pure white marble and polished to a lustrous shine.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: The sounds of the bazaar, though faint, can be heard even this far away.  Citizens from all walks of life make their way to and from the merchant center of the city.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: Guardsmen patrol this area heavily since many of the city's wealthy frequent the shops along this road.  Nearby stone benches provide a place for weary shoppers to take a moment's rest.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: Children run up and down the sidewalks of this street, following parents that slowly make their way to the bazaar.  Whitewashed buildings line the cobblestone road like soldiers on parade while storekeepers stare out of their windows at travelers on the road.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: The road narrows here, but luckily the number of supply caravans has also dwindled, making the traffic easier to navigate.  The pavement itself looks to be of a much better condition, too, as it has seen little abuse from iron-shod wheels.

title: [[Ratha, Zsikiel Monument]]
description: The sounds of the nearby bazaar buzz in the background.  A gigantic memorial arch towers over the surrounding buildings.  The road continues south under this archway, which is supported by marble columns that line the sides of the street.

title: [[Ratha, Malk Staho]]
description: Guardsmen stand watch at every intersection, keeping a wary eye on all who pass in and out of the bazaar.  The mouth-watering scent of pastries and sweetmeats dazzles even the most finicky of palates.  A bright yellow banner hangs over the street to the north, pointing the way deeper into the bazaar.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west.

title: [[Ratha, Malk Staho]]
description: Worn out shoppers lounge about on wooden benches, taking a short rest before diving once again into the maelstrom.  Children play ball on the side of the road under the watchful eyes of their parents.  A shimmering green banner to the north directs citizens into the bazaar.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The once crowded, chaotic bazaar now stands silent, both merchant and shopper resting with the sun.  The colorful pennants marking the marketplace are now nothing more than shades of black, waiting to regain their luster in a new day.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: Treasures abound at every turn.  Among the throngs of prospective buyers lurk the shifty-eyed experts at sleight of hand, waiting in the shadows to share the wealth with the prosperous merchants.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The scents of the day mingle with the silence of night as the smells of the bazaar linger long after the merchants have turned in.  Shards of lamp light sporadically pierce the confines of the marketplace, causing both illumination and shadow.

title: [[Ratha, Malk Staho]]
description: The road is crowded with people making their way into the bazaar.  A community fountain at one intersection is a very popular spot for friends to meet before going off to shop.  Over the north road is a large blue banner that directs citizens into the bazaar.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west.

title: [[Ratha Bazaar, Grand Pavilion]]
description: Fabulous marble colonnades line a regal plaza of tremendous proportions.  Elegant fountains flow in a series down the exact center of the pavilion and provide a sparkling backdrop for enormous pots of ornamental palms and brilliant flowers.  Throngs of merchants and visitors mill about in the grand foyer of the Ratha Bazaar, waiting to reconcile bills of lading or gain entrance into the festive marketplace.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: Out of the west, sounds from the bazaar fade to a faint thrum.  Traffic is heavy as people travel the road to reach their favorite merchant.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The scents of the day mingle with the silence of night as the smells of the bazaar linger long after the merchants have turned in.  Shards of lamp light sporadically pierce the confines of the marketplace, causing both illumination and shadow.

title: [[Ratha, Greater Cobra Road]]
description: The great lift to the second tier rises from the humble beginnings of the first to the loftier levels above.  People of all classes and habits mingle, each intent on his or her own affairs.  A militia guard keeps an eye on the surroundings and occasionally dissuades some disreputable looking person or another from ascending without some proof of honest business above.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: The darkened facade of a large building casts a shadow on the street below.  A wall of wooden crates blocks passage along the walkway, forcing pedestrians into the street and the path of trotting hoofbeats.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: Buildings press in on both sides of the road.  Shoots of dark grass poke their way through the cracks of the cobblestone street.  A number of wealthy citizens stride along this thoroughfare, keeping a wary eye out for pickpockets.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: Bright awnings and colorful pennants adorn the facade of a neat mud and brick building.  A lovely portico dotted with delightful iron chairs and matching tables offer weary shoppers a place to stop and catch their breath.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: The road widens as it meets two others coming in at odd angles.  The resulting tangle of streets is set about with a curious variety of tiny shops mingled with somewhat ramshackle cottages and small storage yards for bulk goods.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Several small gardens, each with a tidy stone border, line the road along the edge of a genteel residential area.  Several tall stakes control long strands of curling vines, laden with pea-pods.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: The smells of cooking and the sound of cheerful laughter emanate from a rambling tavern on the west side of the road.  The otherwise drab stone of its roof has been worked along the edge into a series of brightly-painted cameos depicting comically absurd portraits.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: The backs of several large warehouses present a blank facade along the road.  Rough grey stone rises on both sides, cutting off any breeze and fencing in the noise and smells of a crowded town.  Faded chalk outlines on one wall are all that remain of some forgotten children's game or picture.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Traffic is quite heavy, despite the hour.  A few lanterns placed on rocky perches cast a feeble light on the crossroads.  A sleepy-looking guardsman leans on a pike, keeping half an eye on the road.

Two roads meet in a busy intersection.  It seems as if every person in the tier is trying to pass through the same crossing all at one time.  Several cracked and broken paving stones in the center of the roadway force traffic to veer around the area, creating a tiny island of empty space.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: As the throng of citizens heads north from the lifts, this delightful little road heads west over the ridge toward some of the most beautiful scenery Ratha has to offer.  Weeping bloodwood trees form a graceful arch over the roadway, while neat white pickets surround a cluster of tidy homes.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: Sweet scents float through the calm night air.  Glowing embers from the cooking fires die slowly, the residents long taken to their beds, and slumbering peacefully.

All around, the signs of a thriving community abound.  Young children, actively play in the streets and yards of the well kept homes, while women hang laundry out on lines to dry.  Conspicuously missing are the men, likely away at sea, the craft-halls or out hunting to stock the family larder.  On both sides of the lane, bright jadsem blossoms and freesia lend a pleasant sweet scent to the air.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: Spectres of the afternoon hustle and bustle are called forth by the soft whinny of a horse nearby.  The sparkling night view of the city below and the roiling ocean beyond is a joy to behold.

Horse drawn carts amble past, laden with goods from the marketplace to the north.  A driver stops to water his horse at one of the many troughs along the tree-lined route.  Toward the southwest, a beautiful unobstructed view of the ocean awaits the passerby, eager for a break from their daily chores.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: The neighborhood garden is silent, resting after a busy day of cultivation and activity.  A bustling center of activity by day, the garden lends quiet comfort to this quaint community in the long evening hours.

Bees buzz happily, finding a wealth of pollen in the neat rows of flowers and vegetables of a community garden.  Neighbors chat casually as they share in the toils of tending the plot.  Covered and protected against the elements, the more delicate of the fruits and flowers flourish under the added attention.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: Several people gather around a large brick firepit outside a neatly trimmed cottage.  Billowing smoke wraps around the stone chimney as a wild boar turns slowly over the coals, fat dripping into the flames.  On smaller spits, a number of plump birds roast slowly, and large pots of bubbling liquids add their steam and delicious smells to the atmosphere.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: The well worn stone wall nearly rings with the day's conversations.  Now quiet and peaceful, this delightful lane wends its way through the slumbering community.

Delicious smells permeate the air, creating an atmosphere of comfort and home.  All who stroll down this delightful lane are pulled aside to visit or partake in a sip of grog or cold spring water.  A trio of old women, leaning across a stone wall, are enrapt in a story telling session, oblivious to the world around them.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Fingers of starlight filter through the lush canopy of bloodwood and sana'ati trees as the avenue broadens.  Protected from the frequent wind and rain sweeping off the ocean, the drive takes on an almost dream-like quality.  On the north side of the reach, gentle rolling knolls are host to a variety of well kept homes with dramatic views of the sparkling sea beyond the cliffs.

Fingers of light filter through the lush canopy of bloodwood and sana'ati trees as the avenue broadens.  Protected from the afternoon sun or the wind and rain sweeping off the ocean, the drive takes on an almost dream-like quality.  On the north side of the reach, gentle rolling knolls are host to a variety of well kept homes with dramatic views of the crystal sea beyond the cliffs.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: The denseness of the arboreal adit gives way briefly, allowing an unobstructed view of the shipyards far below, and the jetty beyond.  From this vantage point one can clearly observe the traffic in and out of the harbor.  It is said that the Odalva family purchased property on this bluff to keep track of the vast Redthorne fleet.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Veering close to the precipice, the avenue broadens slightly to form a small viewpoint.  The sights, sounds and even the smells of the city below can be experienced when the wind is blowing just right.  Scuffing and footprints can be seen just over the sturdy retaining wall, not two feet from a very obvious warning sign.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Enveloping the avenue, spreading masses of lush greenery play about the gnarled wood and sinewy branches.  Long, protective arms reach downward, toward the decorative stones along the fenceline.  Just ahead, a rolling meadow unfolds, hugging the north side of the road.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: The softly rolling hillside whispers with the hushed sounds of grasses and flowers blowing in the gentle evening breeze.  Worn down by many a footfall, a trail meanders away from the road towards the quiet meadows.

Thousands of pale purple shalyria blossoms blanket the hillside in soft waves, complementing the deep tones of the taffelberries, ripe and tasty, that abound in the meadow.  Worn and winding, a trail meanders away from the road toward the sound of laughter and music.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Skirting along the meadow, the road ambles toward the cliff's edge and two large homes, perched precariously close to the precipice.  On the opposite side of the road, stables and gardens make best use of the grassy knoll and ample acreage.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Subtle fragrances waft through the air, hibiscus, cherry blossom, something else not quite identifiable.  Carstens, the florist, has gardens nearby and often roams the neighborhood selling his delicate and fresh-picked wares to the eager locals.

title: [[Ratha, Odalva Reach]]
description: Breezes blow stronger here, as the road approaches the western overlook and the windward side of the bluff.  The thick stand of sana'ati gives way to smaller, sculpted pine trees.  Though still ornamental and pleasant to look upon, the plants and flowers here have adapted to the elements, taking on a distinctly squat and sturdy posture.

title: [[Ratha, Cliffside Viewpoint]]
description: Diamonds of light sparkle off the surface of the ocean.  A stiff breeze blows constantly here, whipping the salt air against the side of the cliff in playful whorls.  Far out in the harbor, various ships lay at anchor, awaiting their turn in the busy port of Ratha.  Below, one needs only spy the griminess of the lower tier of the city to be reminded that all is not as unspoiled as this panorama proclaims.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: The road leading into the town from the great lift crosses a large east-west road that serves the merchant quarters that make up the bulk of the inhabitants of this level.  A continual rush of traffic scurries about in all directions, taking little heed of anyone foolish enough to stand and gape at the hubbub.  A tall flagpost rises in the center of the crossroad, pennon snapping in the sea-breeze.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: A tiny shed sits at quite a peculiar angle just off the avenue, adjoined to an equally peculiar little cottage.  Sumptuous smells often linger in the air here, making the cottage the frequent subject of local prattle.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Tall houses crowd together along both sides of the road, their half-timbered second stories leaning towards each other until they almost meet overhead.  The sky is nearly blocked, giving a gloomy feel to the passage between them that is offset by the cheery color schemes and sprays of greenery set in vases along the window ledges.  Somewhere, a sibilant voice is singing, accompanied by a less-than-skilled ocarina player.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: One and two-story houses press close along the avenue.  Through shuttered windows, one can hear people going about their night-time activities.  A small lantern hangs over each door, as required by local custom.  Somewhere, the heavy tread of a watchman on his rounds echoes in the night air.
One and two-story houses press close along the busy avenue.  Through open windows, one can see people going about their everyday lives, untroubled by the passing parade of travelers.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: The road winds a bit between tidy cottages set between neat stone hedges.  One or two appear to be shuttered and empty, but most show signs of being occupied and maintained.  Each has a small brass or bronze night lantern set over the door.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: A few houses, set back from the road, seem to brood in silence.  They are shuttered and look unkempt, their gardens gone to seed and their paint is peeling.  The damp night air thickens into fog and swirls about the dim wooden shapes.  There is evidence of a fire not too recently, to judge from the rain-streaked soot around the windows and doors and the smoke-stained walls of one house.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Two roads meet between rough-hewn stone buildings.  The obvious debris of a crowded roadway full of horses and mules have been swept to one side in untidy piles, awaiting the nightwagon's arrival.  The few pedestrians keep to the center of the way to avoid rude accidents to their footgear.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: From here, looking over the tops of the far buildings, one can see the eastern lift that travels between Ratha's second and third tier.  Most of the road's traffic is heading westerly towards the city's bazaar.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: The gravel road is tightly packed with citizens as they make their way through Ratha's merchant district.  Tall stone buildings line the thoroughfare.  A stone bench provides the weary a place to sit down amid the hustle of the city.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: Pedestrians must keep a sharp eye out for supply caravans as they move down the road with little regard for those on foot.  The occasional braying of a donkey shatters the otherwise quiet street.

title: [[Ratha, East Eslan Street]]
description: Tired laborers, craftsmen and merchants make their way towards some of the city's best inns that have their custom in this part of Ratha.  Some lean wearily against street lamps, resting in the pools of light, before continuing onward.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: A small grove of trees has been planted here, in soil carried at great expense from more fertile lands.  They have done well despite the salt winds off the sea.  Some enterprising vendors have set up stands beneath their branches, selling cool drinks and roasted meats and boiled candies.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: A pair of buildings appear to have been torn down, making a wide spot in the road just south of a busy intersection.  Some few stalls remain open despite the hour in what is a busy bazaar during the day, eager merchants hoping perhaps for a few more coppers before they turn in.  Then there are those whose primary business is best done in the dark of night or shadow.  Those hooded and cloaked figures that skirt the few guttering lanterns or grease-soaked rushlights, for example.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: From the east, the stink of death floats on the cool damp air.  The stink of ash as well, perhaps from a crematorium.  Death comes to all, high and low, rich and poor, and all will end the same.

"All that is good rises upward and all that is bad flows downward," it is said.  This would seem to be true as the rich and powerful mingle with the poor and unwashed where two busy roads intersect just south of the great lifts to the uppermost tier.  Few would gainsay that this nexus of roads comprises a cross-section of every strata of Rathan society.  Those with polished scales and jewelled tail bands predominate, but many a denizen has seen better days, with missing scutes and tattered clothing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Normally a quagmire of people, wagons and carriages, Zeh'ra Boulevard is uncomfortably empty.  A light dusting of ash on the ground reveals no other footprints or wheel tracks.  The surrounding stillness and an odd scent in the air makes loitering an unpleasant prospect and relaxation unattainable.  Long shadows reach from the cliff above to shroud the street in uneasy murkiness.

Just off of Upper Cobra Road, which offers access to the great lifts connecting the second and third tiers, Zeh'ra Boulevard swirls with people of all classes and statures.  Elegantly clad men and women jostle for position among dock workers and common tradesmen in a vain attempt to speed their progress.  A trio of hawkers face off in a contest of lung power to lure in prospective clientele.  They seem blissfully unaware that they drive off far more potential business than they draw in.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: A small cluster of stones juts above the boulevard's surface, which would make maneuvering through this area difficult in heavy traffic.  A slamming door can be heard off in the distance, which only serves to reinforce the complete absence of noise or light in this area.  The scent of seaweed is oddly intense for a location this deep in the city.

A small cluster of stones juts above the boulevard's surface, making maneuvering through this area difficult.  Merchants carefully work their carts and wagons around the stones, mindful of the hazard and the potential for a broken wheel and forfeited profit.  The noise of the Bazaar carries faintly over the rooftops from the west.

timeto.5072: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 310 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Barrels and crates line both sides of the boulevard, stacked haphazardly in front of narrow doorways and windows.  Mounds of used packing straw and sawdust spill from broken containers, muffling any sound of passage.  The distinctive odor of urine emanates from one particularly large pile of sawdust.  Utter silence reigns among the deep shadows that crisscross the road.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: The overpowering reek of rotting flesh wafts from a battered gull carcass kicked to the side of the boulevard in front of an abandoned looking warehouse liberally stained with streaks of white.  Several dozen gulls have gone to roost on the building's sagging rooftop.  The ill-fated gull apparently chose the wrong person to anoint during the hectic crush of the daytime.

An abandoned looking warehouse is liberally stained with streaks of white, most likely the work of the several dozen gulls resting on the rooftop.  Shattered and discarded seashells litter the street in front of the warehouse, testament that the gulls find this area of the city to be the height of fine dining.  Passersby cast wary glances in the gulls' direction, hoping to avoid any sudden gifts from above.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Bits of broken shell crunch underfoot, the sound reverberating hollowly between the stark line of buildings and the cliff face.  An eldritch glow filters down from above, limning the outlines of tightly locked windows and doors in a sickly yellow light.  A momentary inspection of the rock reveals the source of the glow to be thick encrustations of lichen that blanket the stone.

A group of S'kra Mur children dart through the morass of wagons, pack animals and pedestrians, yelling out to one another while playing a risky game of tag that brings them perilously close to death.  The rock to the north plays host to a startling variety of red, green and golden yellow lichen.  Bits of broken shell litter the boulevard, leftovers from the meals of gulls flying landward from the bay.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: The boulevard is nearly choked off between the ever-present stone to the north and a solid line of large warehouses to the south.  The high warehouse walls lend the street the look of a dark, narrow canyon, leaving any trace of moon or starlight far beyond reach.  A brisk wind howls from above, carrying the distinctive tang of salt along with the mournful cry of a solitary gull.

The crowd thickens as the boulevard is nearly choked off between the ever-present stone to the north and a solid line of large warehouses to the south.  The high warehouse walls give the street the look of a narrow canyon, leaving the sky and sunlight far overhead.  A brisk wind blows from above, carrying the distinctive tang of salt along with the faint squawking of seagulls.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Two rows of small warehouses crowd the boulevard as it curves southwards to avoid an impressive slab of stone slanting outward from the base of the cliff.  Three figures standing in front of a brightly lit doorway are cast into silhouette.  While it is impossible to make out their features, the shadowy outlines of weapons and armor coupled with their alert stances serve to discourage casual interest.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: A lengthy stretch of road running directly westwards is cast into perpetual shadow by the massive wall of rock to the north.  No light filters in from above, making passage precarious at best.  Heavy gloom collects under overhanging eaves, offering ideal concealment for those whose trade is best conducted in the strictest confidence -- and where shouts might go unheard.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Used primarily as a means to transport goods from one side of Ratha to the other without braving the mire of the Bazaar itself, the boulevard is an important link for the merchants located at either side of the city.  The heavy traffic of daylight is gone, leaving behind a more subtle rhythm of business and dealings ripe to catch the unwary and incautious.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Looming buildings built close to the cliff cast this narrow stretch of road into profound darkness.  Eerie echoes cascade down from above while furtive figures move quickly along the edges of the boulevard, giving each other a wide berth.  A sense of being watched is impossible to ignore.

Caught in perpetual shadow, the boulevard narrows to such a degree that cart traffic can pass in only one direction at a time.  The close proximity of unmovable stone to the north and the more common homes directly south preclude any future attempt to widen the roadway.  Raised voices echo back and forth as caravan and cart drivers argue heatedly about who will make way for whom and be on their way to market before the competition.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: Still predominantly residential at this point, Zeh'ra Boulevard curves languidly around a gigantic bulge of stone thrust out from the towering cliff to the north.  Without the distraction of the thick crowds found here during the day, the stench of refuse collecting in gutters is overpowering.  Fresh droppings from yaks, mules, ponies and other more exotic beasts of burden lend the odor an immediacy that quickens the step and makes deep breathing a thing best avoided.

title: [[Ratha, Zeh'ra Boulevard]]
description: A lissome S'kra Mur man stumbles up a short walkway leading to one of the townhouses built here.  Judging from his unsteady walk and the amount of trouble the latch causes, he's returning from more than a hard day's work.  No lights are visible in any of the windows facing the street and a cool wind blows in from the bay bringing with it the quiet susurration of the surf.

The incessant noise of the Bazaar is somewhat muted next to the sheer cliff face rising up to the most prosperous section of the city.  Tasteful etchings adorn the lintels of cozy townhouses built back from the street.  A steady flow of commercial traffic forces pedestrians to keep to the edges of the thoroughfare in order to keep life and limb intact.

timeto.4954: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 110 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Square]]
description: A solitary light glows from behind a sheer curtain in the upper story window of a neat townhouse offset from the street by a small sidewalk.  An occasional figure, indistinguishable in the darkness of the boulevard, passes on its way to or from the third tier.

A swirl of people mill and dance around one another as an influx of foot traffic from the third tier mixes with the crowds spreading outwards from the Bazaar.  Modest townhouses painted a reserved mocha or cream are offset from the street by a small sidewalk.

title: [[Ratha, Amakra Close]]
description: The road forks here, southeast toward the Ratha bazaar, still open at this late hour and southwest toward the quaint homes of Amakra close.  Weary townsfolk make their way toward the comfort of home.

The road forks here, southeast toward the bustling Ratha bazaar and southwest toward the splendor of Selridge road and the cliffside views.  Boisterous townsfolk wave and call out to comrades and neighbors passing along this busy byway.  Stalwart pilgrims make their way toward the lifts and the temples above.

title: [[Ratha, Amakra Close]]
description: Ornate fencelines, white-washed trellises replete with meandering rose vines and fragrant lily blossoms adorn the walkways.  Spectres of the day's traffic seem to hang in the still night air, ready to descend once more onto the streets below.

Sounds of squeaking wheels and clamoring hooves on the cobbled roadway herald the passing of a cart laden with goods as it heads toward the lift to the north.  Along this tree-lined street, homes, adorned with sculptured forecourts, allow one to escape the bustling traffic of the street beyond.  Ornate fencelines, white-washed trellises replete with meandering rose vines and fragrant lily blossoms brighten the walkways, their expectant faces turned in the direction of the sun.

title: [[Ratha, Amakra Close]]
description: Sparkling water commands the horizon beyond the cliffs to the west.  From these homes along the bluff, ships lanterns can be seen tracing a line toward the safety of the harbor below.  Fragrant jadsem blossoms lend a dream-like quality to the cool night air.

Crystal water and a distant shore can be seen beyond the cliffs to the west.  From these homes along the bluff, tall ships can be seen sailing toward the port in a line that extends well beyond the horizon.  Fragrant jadsem blossoms offer the passerby an additional treat, as the air is replete with sweet scents.

title: [[Ratha, Amakra Close]]
description: Whispers of a breeze linger in the trees that line the roadway, a stone archway leads to a dramatic overlook at the cliff's edge.  Elegant stone benches are placed on either side of the quaint roadway providing a pleasant place to sit and enjoy.  Enormous hanging baskets filled with weeping blood-red iera flowers and bright blue violets complete the picturesque walk.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: Over the top of the surrounding buildings there is a fairly decent view of the western lifts that ascend to Ratha's temple district.  The acrid scent of a tanner and the faint sound of a hammer striking metal comes from the south.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Carriage traffic is very sporadic during the quiet hours of the evening and early morning.  On occasion a group of drunken sailors ambles through, lost from the main thoroughfare and creating a disturbance in the quiet neighborhood awaking angry residents from their slumber.
Carriages trundle in both directions, barely enough time is had to avoid the hooves of the great equines as they prance at a feverish pace.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: A pair of stone nagas rise to either side of the great lifts that lead to the third tier and the seat of power.  Liveried messengers hurry past, bearing important documents for the traders and merchants who do business on this level.  A nearby barracks holds a complement of guards, ready day and night to secure the approaches if rioting or rebellion should break out among the lower classes and threaten the island's trade.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A young family makes their way along the stone walkway toward the south and the beautiful views of the ocean.  A sturdy stone wall abuts the walkway and provides a safe barrier from the treachery of the sheer cliff beyond.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A row of neatly trimmed buildings sits back off the road, warm lamplight radiating from the windows.  Most businesses, which are closed for the night, leave a lamp or candle burning to inform townsfolk that the owners are in residence and available for emergencies.
Neat and well kept buildings are set back from the road here.  Townsfolk scurry by, engaged in animated conversation, on their way to perform one errand or another.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A darkened home sits back from the road, surrounded by a high iron fence.  The gate is bolted shut as if the owner had been away for a long while.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Broad ironwoods grow tall on this side of the island protecting many small homes nestled under their protective foliage.  Like giants standing guard on this ocean-side knoll, they weave an eerie atmosphere as the shadows of moonlight play hide and seek.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: The avenue is broad and decidedly residential.  The homes are not overly large or elegant, but well kept and nicely appointed.  The children who often play in the gardens and along the walkways, are tucked into their beds slumbering now as the stars come out to play.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Charming cottages and small homes sit close together, tiled walkways and neat gardens setting one apart from the other.  Residents can often be seen sitting on porches late into the night, puffing on pipes, drinking cider or just watching the stars play upon the ocean.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A quiet, tree-lined lane meanders off toward the west.  Unable to wander past the confines of a locked gate, the passerby is left to wonder what manner of mystery lays beyond the iron scrollwork.  Birdsong and laughter are carried aloft on a soft breeze, reminders of a carefree existence somewhere closeby.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A wide brick walkway commands the eastern side of the bluff, as the drive takes a turn toward the most beautiful of scenic finery on Ratha.  Stretching as far as the eye can see, a sparkling crystal ocean lays like a blanket surrounding the island.

Deep gouges formed by wind and ice mar the hard granite of the mountainside.  Rivulets of water that have dribbled down from these small crevices are forever frozen, forming strangely shaped ice sculptures upon the sleek rock.

Deep gouges formed by wind and ice mar the hard granite of the mountainside.  Rivulets of water that have dribbled down from these small crevices are forever frozen, forming strangely shaped ice sculptures upon the sleek rock.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Fields and walkways are quiet and settled for another night's slumber.  Come morning, the eager voices of children at play will once again carry aloft on the gentle breezes.

Gentle breezes blow on this side of the island.  Beyond the low fence of a large field children are often seen at play, hiding behind large boulders or stone walls, they frequently imitate hunters who range far beyond the limits of the city.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Both spectacular and dangerous, the view at this point is nonetheless exhilarating.  The stone wall protects the average traveler from the perilous cliffs, but too eager a spectator could easily find themselves awash in the churning surf and the rocks below.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A cluster of homes is set back away from the traffic of the avenue, taking advantage of the view from atop a slight rise.  A dirt lane serves as a drive connecting the homes to the road, forming what could be construed as a cul-de-sac.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: The smell of straw and the occasional whinny of a horse heralds the presence of a livery service someplace closeby.  Hired out for pleasure or in service to specific delivery services, horses play an important part in the transportation of people and goods around town.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Beyond the safety of a low stone retaining wall, a cliff divides this level of the city from the lower warehouse district below.  With a slight adjustment of the eyes, the onlooker can forget the toil and chaos of the city below, and become lost in the depths of the crystal sea beyond.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: Interesting serpentine patterns adorn a low stone wall on the cliff side of the avenue.  With access to goods from distant ports of call, it's not surprising to find foreign art and cultures influencing much of the Rathan architecture.

title: [[Ratha, Tierskel Way]]
description: A small monument rests here, overlooking the busy port district of the city below.  To this day the Tierskel family, long involved in the development of seafaring trade in this region, controls the docks and shipyards.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: The avenue sweeps toward the south and east and a lovely view of the city below.  The sparkling ocean, ever present from nearly every spot in Ratha is a constant reminder of the hard working way of life the town has to offer.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: A few steps off the road, atop a slight rise, a bevy of small cottages beckon the weary home for the evening.  Clean and well cared for, the homes in this area are neither shabby nor elegant.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Traffic along this section of the busy road is typically limited to carriages and supply wagons destined for the homes on the tier.  The larger section of the road to the west and north, takes travelers toward the great lifts of the palace level or the portside district below.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: A row of small storage yards are neatly filled with crates and bales stacked two and three high.  Traffic in and out of the area suggests that it is used by merchants as a clearing house for goods sold at the famous Ratha bazaar.

title: [[Ratha, Upper Cobra Road]]
description: Cool sea-breezes sweep across the rocky precipice that divides lower Ratha from the higher class districts.  The massive lifts work day and night, hauling people and goods up and down between the levels.  The view from here is considerable, with many ships in the harbor below displaying all manner of construction and decoration, hailing from a dozen different ports of call.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: A brick and timber building rises three floors above the avenue, small paned windows taking advantage of the southwest exposure.  The muted clang of a ship's bell, belies the presence of the busy port somewhere in the distance.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: Several lovely homes find themselves ensconced amid neatly clipped shrubbery and tidy walkways.  Serviceable if not attractive fencing provides a bit of security to the urban neighborhood.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: The dark street is quiet except for a few Dwarves that are sitting around a cart, standing guard and warning off the curious.  Travelers avoid eye contact with one another as they swiftly move past.

The sounds of metal striking metal fill the air in this part of town.  Cartloads of iron ore line the roadside, making the already congested street almost impossible to navigate.  A group of Dwarves continuously survey the carts, checking the contents and warning off curious pedestrians.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: Many craftsmen gather on the stoops of their various shops to watch the passing citizens.  Others sit on nearby benches discussing the day's labor or just gossiping with their friends.

title: [[Ratha, West Eslan Street]]
description: The street is free of all but a few people, making it easy to get from place to place.  Most of the buildings that line the road are dark.  Travelers avoid eye contact as they swiftly move past.

The street traffic can only be described as congested while all types, merchants, craftsmen, and even the occasional Gor'tog dock worker, enter and exit the many buildings that line the paved thoroughfare.  At times it takes a well-placed elbow or a slightly zealous nudge to make one's way through the crowd.

title: [[Ratha, Amakra Close]]
description: A pair of stone nagas rise to either side of the great lifts that lead to the upper tiers.  The constant drone of the lift is only intermittent now during the quiet hours of night, and guards in nearby posts doze sporadically.  Sailors and merchants frequent the bazaar at this time of night, seeking trinkets for the lovely ladies that catch their fancy.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Couples from all over Ratha frequent the overlook, making it a favorite spot for a romantic afternoon or evening stroll.  Slowly and happily, most that visit here soon wander north toward the merchant district and the ever popular bazaar.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Windblown grasses cling to sandy cracks in the walkways that bypass several tidy homes along the road.  Iron gates and covered porticos offer security and protection from the evening elements.  Tall and stately street lamps perform their nightly ritual, offering a ray or two of warm light to the evening stroller.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Tempests and whorls of salty air whip past, sending sand and dust flying inland.  Gnarled and deformed by the constant wind, a stand of dwarf pine hum as if goading the spirits of the wind into a battle of wits.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Spicy and aromatic, the scents of a growing herb garden drift past.  Rich and loamy, the soil and climate here are perfect for growing everything from brilliant flowers to flavorful vegetables.  Just ahead the welcoming lights of the Carstens farmhouse can be seen towering over darkened gardens.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Wild grapevines along a rickety fence cast strange shadows from the lamplight in the dark.  Sweet smells from the gardens beyond lend to the intoxicating environment along the tree-lined road.

Vibrant lavender and wild grape vines adorn a rickety fence along the western edge of the Carstens place.  Folks amble past, stopping to smell the sweet flowers and admire the upcoming crop of unusual floral varieties that Carstens is famous for.  Dwarf pine and an occasional silverwood tree line the inlaid walkways along the road, a rich mosaic nearly lost in the sand from the cliff.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: A high stone wall, meant to protect the street from wind and erosion, blends with the outer walls of an impressive home at the cliff's edge.  For several hundred paces along the roadway the old fortress towers, appearing abandoned, yet ever watchful.  Folks say that the Odalva family owns the property and that sometimes, late at night, strange activities can be observed in and around the mysterious manse.

title: [[Ratha, Selridge Road]]
description: Continuing the inlaid stone motif, a high wall protects the street here from the whipping winds that frequent this side of the bluff.  In the distance, the tinkle of chimes plays an erratic melody in harmony with the constant drone of the city, and the crashing surf beyond the cliffs.

title: [[Amakra Close, Windward Overlook]]
description: Hand quarried stone, inlaid with onyx tiles, form a handsome pattern on the floor of the overlook.  This delightful viewpoint is enclosed with sturdy matching walls and the ancient stone archway to the east.  Benches line the walls, and an ancient telescope, atop a small raised dais, offers the viewer a chance to observe the heavens.

title: [[Onsuwayo's Clinic, Treatment Room Three]]
description: This room appears to hold the failures of the clinic's work.  Several shrouded forms lie stacked on metal shelves along the back wall next to a stone table that angles down to a large drain.  One dim sconce is the only light source, and the changing, flickering light makes the shrouded forms seem to waver or move.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: This open air porch looks to have been constructed by drunken Halflings.  Every plank of the deck creaks loudly.  The stoop sags low, making many a customer duck their head.  Benches on either side of the tavern's swinging doors give people a place to sit when it gets too hot inside.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: The bar's taproom has sawdust covered floors and dirty wood planks for walls.  Flies swarm around open ale casks and piles of trash.  A dirty counter is piled with unwashed ceramic mugs and tin cups.  Stools are set up around a few beat-up tables.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern, Back Room]]
description: The back room is falling apart along with the rest of the tavern.  Dirty wooden planks atop battered crates are the only seats, besides the floor.  A group of ragged S'Kra Mur throw daggers at the vermin which infest the shadows of the room.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: The roof slants down sharply, almost reaching to the floor on one side, showing that this room has been created by the simple expedient of leaning planks against the building and knocking out the wall leading to the tap room.  The ever-present breeze off the harbor whistles through the gaps in the walls, creating background music for the more raucous cries of the patrons.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: A lone table, propped under one leg with a wad of paper, sits under a hanging black iron lantern.  Rough wooden chairs with unidentifiable stains on the seats are scattered about, most of them covered in half-empty glasses and the knocked-out ashes from pipes.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: This room is full of empty crates and barrels.  A number of dead rats lay among the other refuse.  The sour smell of ale gone bad fills the air.

title: [[Old Rat's Tavern]]
description: Boxes and crates are stacked up solidly against the walls, and it appears that in places, they may be all that stands between you and the harbor.  The rough planks and logs from which the room was built seem to be random driftwood that has washed ashore and been scavenged for use as building materials.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Amakra]]
description: The ledge widens slightly, creating a resting spot and a high vantage point.  To one side, a very steep slope formed of tumbled gravel forms a precarious path upward.  Far in the distance, tiny golden lights glide on the shimmering black expanse of ocean, creating streaks of brightness on the night-lit water.

The ledge widens slightly, creating a resting spot and a high vantage point.  To one side, a very steep slope formed of tumbled gravel forms a precarious path upward.  Far in the distance, tiny ships and fishing boats move in and out of the harbor, their crews too far off to make out.

title: [[Shore Walk, Cliffs]]
description: Seaweed and algae coating the rocks make footing on the uneven surfaces even more treacherous.  Cracked shells lie scattered about, seemingly out of place, at this height above the tide line.  The stone mounds offshore reach toward the high slab ridges, further confusing where land ends and ocean begins.

title: [[Shore Walk, Cliffs]]
description: The cliff edge drops abruptly, plunging vertically into the ocean far below.  Frothy waves crash against the rocky footings.  Farther downshore, a thin band of sand reappears, hugging the cliffs as they wind northward.  The sea stretches east, unbroken to the curved blue-grey horizon.

title: [[Shore Walk, Rubble]]
description: The crevice widens to become a long channel of high-walled stone.  Stalks of dune grass push through the broken shells and splintered rock which clutter the sandy floor.  Faint impressions, barely recognizable as footprints, head off to the northwest.

title: [[Shore Walk, Shack]]
description: A tiny shack shoulders against the rocky wall at the back of the channel.  Thatched with sea oats, and constructed of vine-lashed driftwood embedded in mounds of stone and shells, the structure looks too frail to withstand the weather or offer much shelter.  A piece of scrap canvas hanging crookedly from a break in the driftwood serves as a door.

title: [[Ratha, Sandy Path]]
description: Strewn with sandstone and driftwood, the path heads off towards the base of the cliff.  Footprints in the sand appear recent.

title: [[Ratha, Base of the Cliff]]
description: Abruptly, the short path comes to an end at the base of a sheer cliff.  Sand and rock crumble with each step as scattered debris, rocks and, what appears to be crushed bone, lay strewn about.  From this vantage point, the cliff appears unclimbable, with barely a hint of a hand or foot-hold discernable.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Narrow Ledge]]
description: With a start you find yourself standing on the lip of the narrowest ledge imaginable.  The face of the cliff rises before you, disappearing as quickly under your feet.  The slightest movement causes a cascade of small stones to plummet the remaining distance to the rock strewn ground below.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Edge of Cliff]]
description: Despite the warning sign posted plainly at the cliff's edge, there are signs that a few foolhardy individuals have tested their climbing skills.  Peering over the edge of the cliff, one can imagine that a number of those fools have perished in the attempt.  Passersby linger just over a sturdy retaining wall, taking in the view.

title: [[Ratha, Zsikiel Monument]]
description: Tourists lounge under the monument's marble arches, enjoying the shade and the marvelous carvings on the memorial's columns.  The artwork depicts many points of Ratha's military history, particularly battles in which members of the Zsikiel family played an important role.

title: [[Ratha, Zsikiel Monument]]
description: An immense memorial arch looms high across the alleyway.  Built by the merchant guilds of Ratha, the monument is a testament to the military achievements and patriotic sacrifices of the Zsikiel family.  The street does not bypass this feat of architecture but actually runs under its sweeping columns.

title: [[Ratha, Puudu Alley]]
description: This part of the alley must run adjacent to some craft hall, because a number of barrels, filled with an assortment of scrap materials, line the side of the street.  Cured leather, pulped wood, and heated iron are the most prevalent scents that fill the air, all with the underlying aroma of mold and rust that comes from sitting out in the weather too long.

title: [[Ratha, Puudu Alley]]
description: Many owners of the nearby buildings seem to use the alley as an open trash barrel.  Piles of refuse further impede those that travel this route, and few fail to leave the area without smelling a bit worse than when they entered.

title: [[Ratha, Puudu Alley]]
description: The backsides of a number of shops and homes close in this road from both sides, throwing everything into shadows.  Traffic is thin, as most prefer the wide thoroughfares to the claustrophobic and perhaps more dangerous alleyway.  A few citizens still brave the passage, keeping a wary eye on all who pass near.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: The street lies desolate, ruined husks of buildings lining the street like giant skeletons.  Wide claw marks have been gouged into the scattered remains, further shredding the weather-damaged wood.  Massive wooden beams brace a wide barricade to the south.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: A large house has collapsed into the street, blocking most of the intersection.  A large skeleton, its huge skull bleached white against the darker wood, lies crushed under one particularly large beam.  The rough ground around the skeleton is scarred deeply, as if scraped by large claws.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: The road ambles north and south, but a small alley leads west between two crumbling houses.  Broken glass and chunks of worked stone litter the street, surrounding an upturned granite bench in the middle of the road.  A wide smear of dried blood leads from the bench, into the alley, and out of sight.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: Broken cobbles make up the road that surrounds a wide stone fountain.  Rubble lines the bottom edge of the dried-up reservoir, fallen from the exposed lip.  A large plaza, seemingly untouched by the weather, spreads out to the west, and collapsed in one of its corners is the wooden skeleton of a merchant's cart.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: The remains of tall ruined houses line the western side of the street, unable to withstand the constant ravages of the tropical weather.  Wind-worn beams lie crisscrossed amidst the wreckage, nearly obscuring a small hole underneath.  To the east, a dried-up fountain stands as a scarred memory of the former residents.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: Two overgrown strips of grass line a small gravel path leading up to a stone statue resembling a muscular Human grasping a shark.  Countless bone fragments contrast sharply against the lush grass and weeds, and a scattering of humanoid skulls serve as a grim suggestion of what may have happened here.  The street continues away from the statue to the northeast and southeast.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: To the east of the street, a small house lies in abject decay.  The face of the structure seems mostly secure and its door and small window still seem functional despite apparent abuse.  Near the roof, the southern wall has been destroyed, revealing another possible entrance to the house's loft.  A dried stone fountain rests in the plaza to the northwest, while the road continues north and west around it.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: A rusted iron fence lines the northern perimeter of the street, which continues south and west.  Weeds and briars have taken over what could have once been a viewing garden just through the fence.  A dried and aging fountain dominates the plaza, a cobbled pathway leading southwest through its center.

title: [[Ratha, Ruined Neighborhood]]
description: An oppressive heaviness weighs on the air here.  The crumbling remains of a white gazebo lean against the rusted iron fence lining the northern side of the street.  Several pieces of the lumber have been dragged about the area, some sporting unsightly crimson blotches or smears.  One particularly long post still bears a skeletal hand loosely wrapped around its base.

title: [[Ratha, Decaying Home]]
description: A thick oaken table dominates the center of this room and the skeleton of a small dog rests curled up on the middle of it.  Ash and partially burned logs lie scattered about the room but seem more concentrated in front of the open wood-burning stove sitting in a corner.  All of the cabinets have fallen off the walls, leaving shattered dishes and flatware strewn about the floor as well.  A large window looks north onto a garden overgrown with weeds.

title: [[Ratha, Decaying Home]]
description: A row of four rusted beds lines the back of the room, each covered in a dark red crust.  Two skeletons, sprawled across the pitted frames, are covered in stained crimson sheets.  The east wall bears a faded painting of a proud knight and a small window with a broken pane peers west onto the abandoned street outside.  A shoddy ladder leads to a loft, the entrance obscured by tattered grey curtains.

title: [[Decaying Home, Loft]]
description: The smell of refuse and molding linen clings to the still air in this loft.  Scattered piles of composting cloth are nested about the room, giving the impression that the space was once inhabitable.  Tattered grey curtains dangle from the west side of the ceiling, ending just above a shoddy ladder leading to the living quarters down below.  The south wall of the loft has collapsed, leaving an opening to the desolate street below.  A collection of rotting wood figurines lies jumbled in a corner.

title: [[The Sewers, Beneath the Drain]]
description: The sewer drop under the grating is a small, tile-lined room.  Rainwater from the street above flows into it and exits through a big bronze valve that seems oversized for that purpose.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: something noiselessly brushing past or an odd whiff of incense becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only the click of claws on stone breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the feel of soft, yielding mud or the stench of refuse and worse becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only a low-pitched rumble breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the slip of a loose brick underfoot or the smell of fish, fresh and otherwise, becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only a sound like a sigh breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the slip of a loose brick underfoot or the reek of mold long in the making becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only an occasional splash breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the touch of a drop of water -- surely it's water? -- or a pungent, spicy aroma becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only what might be a footstep breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, Beneath the Grating]]
description: A faint light from the grating above shows this small, tile-lined room, hardly more than a wide connection in the system of pipes that regulates the flow of water that cleanses and refreshes Ratha.  A big bronze valve is the only noteworthy feature in the place.

title: [[The Sewers, The Ferret Warren]]
description: The dim beams from the southwest, gleaming weakly on wet brick and rough walls, reveal three ominously dark entrances to the room.  They stand like the gaping mouths of monsters into whose gullet one would not willingly travel.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[The Sewers, The Ferret Warren]]
description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the touch of a drop of water -- surely it's water? -- or the tang of the salt sea becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only a sound like a sigh breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Ferret Warren]]
description: A large circular opening -- curiously shaped like a big pipe -- dominates the ceiling of the room.  From the southeast comes the light of flickering torches, contrasting sharply with the darkness to the northeast.

title: [[The Sewers, The Snail Warren]]
description: A light flickers to the southwest, its beams reflecting off the damp stones of the passage.  Compared to the black tunnels, no long night's dawn could be more welcome than this faint glimmer.

title: [[The Sewers, The Snailway]]
description: The tunnel broadens into a kind of anteroom where more care than usual has been taken to dress and smooth the walls and floor.  The opening to the east is flanked by flaring torches in bronze holders shaped like lions' heads.  It appears to pierce some kind of thick stone wall.

title: [[The Sewers, The Snail Warren]]
description: A red glow flickers in the distance to the northwest.  Its light lends a sense of motion and distance, and dispels the oppressive feeling that the walls are closing in.  The light, obviously from flames, wavers -- growing brighter one moment, dimmer the next.

title: [[The Sewers, Snail Hollow]]
description: A few glowing wicks in wall niches cast dim light and dark shadows in a circular room lined with red tiles.  From an opening in the ceiling big enough for a wagon, an occasional drop of water splashes to the floor.  It trickles over to a matching hole in the floor and runs down the steeply sloping channel.

title: [[The Sewers, Ferret Hollow]]
description: A few glowing wicks in wall niches cast dim light and dark shadows in a circular room lined with green tiles.  From an opening in the ceiling big enough for a wagon, an occasional drop of water splashes to the floor.  It trickles over to a matching hole in the floor and runs down the steeply sloping channel.

title: [[The Sewers, Beetle Hollow]]
description: A few glowing wicks in wall niches cast dim light and dark shadows in a circular room lined with yellow tiles.  From an opening in the ceiling big enough for a wagon, an occasional drop of water splashes to the floor.  It trickles over to a matching hole in the floor and runs down the steeply sloping channel.

title: [[The Sewers, The Ferretway]]

description: In the darkness, senses other than sight press for attention: the chill of a clammy breeze or the stench of refuse and worse becomes ominous when eyesight fails and only an occasional splash breaks the silence.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetle Warren]]
description: The tunnel turns at odd angles and disturbing slants, a distorted mirror-image -- if stone can be called a mirror -- of the room to the north.  Torchlight flickers to the northwest, while the darkness waits at two other yawning entrances.

title: [[The Sewers, The Beetleway]]
description: The tunnel broadens into a kind of anteroom where more care than usual has been taken to dress and smooth the walls and floor.  The opening to the east is flanked by flaring torches in brass holders shaped like trader logs.  It appears to pierce some kind of thick stone wall.

title: [[The Sewers, Tunnels]]
description: The tunnel walls have been built of a random mixture of brick and stone, as though the builders utilized whatever came to their hands at that moment.
