A small heap of bricks, stone, and dirt has fallen from the ceiling in one place, exposing raw dirt.  The stability of the rest of the ceiling seems questionable.

title: [[The Sewers, Tunnels]]
description: A chill wind brushes by, blowing softly past from the black-throated tunnels stretching off in several directions.  The rusted rungs of a ladder climb the north wall, disappearing into a narrow hole cut into the ceiling from which a constant stream of water falls to the floor.  From a distance can be heard soft rustlings and movements, but from which direction, or whether from all directions at once, is impossible to tell.

title: [[The Sewers, Tunnels]]
description: Water falling from a line of pipes along the wall echoes unbearably loudly in the almost total darkness.  The noise and lack of light make it difficult to either see or hear anything approaching until it is virtually next to you.

title: [[The Sewers, Tunnels]]
description: The atmosphere is icy cold, and tendrils of chill air seem to reach under clothing as if seeking warm flesh to feed upon.  The light is very dim, and the walls of the tunnel are lost in shadowy darkness.

title: [[The Sewers, Narrow Pipe]]
description: Water flows in from the north, falling into a hole in the floor leading straight down.  Iron rungs have been fastened to one wall of the dark pit, forming a slippery ladder.  The constant moisture has ensured that the rungs are well-rusted, in some places pulling out from the wall.

title: [[The Sewers, Narrow Pipe]]
description: The walls are narrowly within a dagger stroke to either side, curving seamlessly into the ceiling and barely giving enough room to stand upright.  Along the center of the floor a stream of dark water flows south.

title: [[The Sewers, Beneath the Grate]]
description: A fitful light filters through the bars of the grate overhead, and the air is unpleasant with odors probably best not identified.  The walls and floor of the cramped space are built out of tightly fitted stone.  A thin sheet of water flows southward down its center into a large pipe, just big enough to squeeze into.

title: [[Ratha, Eastern Promenade]]
description: The travel-worn road narrows, and the caravans that frequent it tangle in the crowded way.  Camels snort, donkeys bray and traders curse in the congestion as they all push for a place at the marble watering trough at the side of the road.

title: [[Ratha, Eastern Promenade]]
description: At this crossroads, travelers can choose to enjoy the splendor of the Palace to the west and southeast, or head on through the banking district to the northeast.  Guards stand rigid at their posts guarding the Palace grounds day and night.  Government officials and financial experts make their way southeast to the Palace entrance and the tax collectors.  To the west is the beginning of the grand Processional Way and the continuation of Promenade Way with its temples and shops.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: The south end of the great Processional opens onto the Palace grounds where the trees spread their branches as if in greeting.  They beckon one to take the pleasant stroll northward to the Great Waymeet and Angels Flights.  Several stores and guilds can be found down the Promenade to the east.  The west path leads off towards the temple grounds.

title: [[Ratha, Western Promenade]]
description: At this juncture, a traveler can choose to enjoy the splendor of the Palace to the southeast, or head on through the temple district to the northwest.  Guards stand rigid at their posts guarding the Palace grounds day and night.  Government officials make their way down to Regents Circle and the entrance to the Palace.  To the east is the beginning of the grand Processional Way and the continuation of Promenade Way with its guilds and shops.

title: [[Ratha, Western Promenade]]
description: Travelers move quickly along the weathered cobblestone road which bridges the palace district and the temple district.  The lush greenery and trees found to the north and east fall back to a more open-air route of grass and small bushes.  An occasional glimpse of the elegant temple gardens to the north is possible through the ivy covered fences.  A large, ornate ironwork facade decorated with the image of a panther marks the entrance to Damaris' Temple.

title: [[Ratha, Western Promenade]]
description: A favorite place for the clergy to gather, this section of the Promenade widens on the north side where it encroaches onto the temple grounds and provides a beautiful garden setting to sit and relax along one's journey, or to just find some quiet place for personal meditation.  Several small statues of local deities line the fence as if to bless those who pass.

title: [[Ratha, Western Promenade]]
description: Promenade Way opens to the east where it skirts the southern border of the Temple district and provides easy access for commoners, the elite and the clergy.  Well traveled by foot, as well as caravan, the cobblestone street is replete with ruts and holes desperately in need of repair.  The grass along the fenced edges, however, is well maintained and allows for easy foot access to the temple grounds to the east and north.

title: [[Ratha, West Regents Circle]]
description: Handsome brick walkways round the corner from the spaciousness of Palace Drive to the formality of Regents Circle.  Ornately wrought, iron balustrades are capped with gleaming brass and circumscribe the vast gardens that surround the palace.  Perfectly matched and richly appointed, the accoutrements of the palace guards are no less formal, lending a sense of impending royalty to the area.

title: [[Ratha, West Palace Drive]]
description: The drive is hushed now, as the business of the day is left behind in exchange for the peace of the evening hours.  Pilgrims are often seen huddled in groups just off the drive, silent and seeking warmth as they wait for the dawn of a new day and the missions they've come to complete.

In hushed reverence, pilgrims make their way down the beautiful avenue toward temples and shrines to their various deities.  Here to repent for sins untold, or seek the teaching of a great master, they come from all corners of Elanthia.  Just ahead, the great palace towers above Regents Circle and the lush gardens beyond.

title: [[Ratha, West Palace Drive]]
description: Great iron poles line the drive on either side, supporting brightly glowing lanterns.  The stately carriages and regal equines that traverse the drive during the day are now tucked safely into their stalls as even Ratha's royalty sleeps the night away.

Great iron poles line the drive on either side, supporting colorful banners with royal insignias and coats of arms that wave in the constant breeze.  Great stately carriages, pulled by perfectly matched equines, regularly make their way to and from the palace.  Through the fencing, children peer expectantly, waiting for a glimpse of some visiting dignitary or member of Ratha's ruling class.

title: [[Ratha, West Palace Drive]]
description: Wide and expansive, this elegant drive parades east toward Regents Circle and the magnificent Ratha Palace beyond.  Down the center of the avenue, a lantern lined median channels carriage traffic east and west in an orderly flow.  All along the regal boulevard, handsome wrought-iron fencing and sculptured topiaries create a formal garden-like atmosphere, as administrators and clergy mingle with Ratha's upper class citizenry along the wide plazas on either side of the street.

title: [[Ratha, Oakbow Road]]
description: Temples to the gods meet temples to paperwork where the districts of each coalesce.  Three roads converge in a small crossing among the stone and wooden buildings.  Far off, the sound of the sea echoes dimly and the bell of some ship rings faintly as it rocks at anchor.

title: [[Ratha, Oakbow Road]]
description: Government offices rise cheek by jowl, poking out above the road as their teetering upper stories lean toward each other for mutual support.  Somewhere nearby can be heard the heavy clanking of lift chains as uniformed couriers race by, each carrying some tiny bit of paper to add the ever-growing piles needed by any bureaucracy.

title: [[Ratha, Oakbow Road]]
description: The great oaken lift wends its way up and down, hauling people and cargo all the hours of the day and night.  Being closest to the government quarter, all manner of petty officials, couriers, hangers-on and an endless stream of petitioners make their way here, each wrapped in his or her concerns and heedless of the bustle all about.

title: [[Ratha, West Regents Circle]]
description: Imposing granite statuary casts eerie shadows along the grand drive.  The exquisite details so pronounced in the daylight are lost, as the inanimate sentinels loom larger than life in the half light.

Imposing granite statuary can be seen all along the grand drive.  One in particular, that of a young S'kra warrior with a sword raised in victory, appears strikingly realistic.  Stone benches dot the plaza, providing shaded places to rest and take in the beauty of the expansive palace grounds.

title: [[Ratha, West Regents Circle]]
description: The gardens are lit beyond the elaborate iron fencing, small brass lanterns ablaze along the pathways and courtyards.  Two massive S'kra guards, replete in their offical finery patrol the circle all through the night, monitoring entrance into the palace grounds.

Ornate brass standards fly colorful banners, each a different jewel tone, and embroidered with the crest of one of Ratha's ruling families.  Two massive S'kra guards, replete in their official finery, stroll the walkway, monitoring entrance into the palace grounds.

title: [[Ratha, East Regents Circle]]
description: The stately Palace Drive meets Regents Circle in a celebration of wide plazas and decadent appointments.  Tall brass standards bear baskets of hanging flowers and foliage while brass capped fences frame the perfect gardens of the palace to the west.

title: [[Glythtide's Shrine]]
description: Herbs and roses grow in a tangle along a bordering, low stone wall.  The shrine itself is built in the traditional Halfling style, as adapted to Ratha's rocky terrain.  The squat stone structure resembles a small bump of a hill, and a bright blue door leading inside stands ajar.  Three old island pines shelter and shade the shrine.

title: [[Ratha, Eastern Promenade]]
description: Bordered by a plethora of trees and bushes, a short walkway is visible that leads to the verandah of the Empath's Guild.  Somehow the dust of the roadway disappears, giving way to a welcome and pleasant spot in which to relax surrounded by the fragrant smells of herbs and potions from both the plants themselves and from their use by the guild members within.  One can usually find a kind member of this guild here to tend to any health problems.

title: [[By Glythtide's Shrine, A Pine Path]]
description: Whispering boughs overhead sway softly, and dried needles underfoot rustle with each step.  The path skirts the southern side of the small building dedicated to the god Glythtide.

title: [[Truffenyi's Green, Western Fields]]
description: A large common green stretches out over most of the northeastern section of the tier.  The grassy area is an excellent spot for athletic activities, for a meal on the soft grass, or contemplating the sky above.  Chadatru's temple lies to the south.  A narrow path winds under a row of pine trees on the western border of the field.

title: [[Truffenyi's Green]]
description: A large common green stretches out over most of the northeastern section of the tier.  The grassy area is an excellent spot for athletic activities, for a meal on the soft grass, or contemplating the sky above.  The western edge of the field backs on to the temples of Chadatru and Glythtide, and a fountain dedicated to Truffenyi stands to the east near the intersection of the eastern-most road and East Palace Drive.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Ratha, East Palace Drive]]
description: The great height of the palace looms to the west.  During the quiet of the evening hours, one can ponder the great structure in relative peace and safety.
In the shadow of the palace, one finds respite from the constant movement of people and horses, carriages and carts in one of many gardens and walkways in and around the various temples.

title: [[Ratha, East Palace Drive]]
description: Pilgrims and clergy alike mingle along this stretch of the drive.  Temples are situated througout this section of Ratha and offer the reverent a peaceful refuge wherein to learn and worship.

title: [[Ratha, East Regents Circle]]
description: Imposing granite statuary can be seen all along the grand drive.  One in particular, is that of a young S'kra Mur trader.  Dressed in flowing robes and precious gems, he appears remarkably life-like, examining the crates on a waiting caravan.

title: [[Ratha, East Regents Circle]]
description: Ornate brass standards fly colorful penants, in tribute to local heroes who have brought honor to the city and province.  Two massive S'kra guards glance about warily, alert to any sign of unwarranted entrance into the palace grounds.

title: [[Ratha, East Regents Circle]]
description: From the well kept stone of the walkways, to the ornate iron fencing surrounding the lush gardens of the palace, the atmosphere is one of utter order and beauty.  The amazing architecture of the palace itself is a joy to behold.

title: [[Ratha, Monument Square]]
description: Ivy covered iron fencing culminates in an elaborate gate that opens up onto a wide plaza.

title: [[Ratha, West Regents Circle]]
description: The vendors have gone for the evening, the circle is now quiet.  In the morning, they'll be back offering warm drinks and luscious treats to the privileged citizens who travel this route.

Roaming vendors are often seen along the expansive drive.  Offerings such as rare teas and sugared pastries are among the delicacies enjoyed by all who stroll the luxurious circle.  Birds and other small creatures often dart among the passersby, eager to covet a treasured ort.

timeto.4804: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 100 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Ratha, East Palace Drive]]
description: Wide and expansive, this elegant drive parades west toward Regents Circle and the magnificent Ratha Palace beyond.  Down the center of the avenue, a lighted median channels carriage traffic east and west in an orderly flow.

title: [[Truffenyi's Green, Eastern Fields]]
description: A large common green stretches out over most of the northeastern section of the tier.  The grassy area is an excellent spot for athletic activities, for a meal on the soft grass, or contemplating the sky above.  To the southeast a large circular fountain sprays water into the air with a hiss and soft patter of falling drops.

title: [[A Pine Thicket]]
description: The scent of pine resin and decaying wood permeates this dark stand of trees.  The sky is completely blocked from view by the overhanging boughs, and the air is still and suffocating.  There is a sense of being watched, by something.

title: [[Urrem'tier's Path, Pine Grove]]
description: The air is still and muggy beneath the drooping limbs of tightly meshed pine boughs.  Sounds deaden and echoes die at the approach to a shadowy doorway cut jaggedly into a jumble of black basalt boulders mounded as a solid mass as tall as the surrounding pine trees.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: Monks and clerics pass one another with nods or bows or barely concealed glares, depending on the relative state of relations amongst their deities and congregations.  Overhead, two grotesque gargoyles, one on each of two otherwise dissimilar buildings, seem to be glaring at each other in mimicry of the unspoken tensions below.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: Tucked snugly in among the high and mighty temples is a quaint and curious shop, from which wafts an inviting tendril of incense that tugs at passersby.  Nearby, a lone mystic sits in a curious posture, knees intertwined with legs in what seems an uncomfortable pose.  He seems almost asleep until the twitching of one nostril, as it is tickled by the smoke emanating from the shop, shows that some attention to the mundane world exists within that ascetic shell.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: Despite the general tone of wealth shown by the nearby Temples, the facade of the Clerics' Guild is modest to the point of being shabby.  Made of humble materials in a modest state of repairs, it sits alone, taking quiet pride in the essence of those it serves rather from the transience of mundane decoration and frippery.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The confluence of several disparate roads among the temples has been dubbed the "Threefold Path" by local wags.  The rich decor of the buildings and the many finely garbed holy workers reminds one that the business of serving the gods is oft a profitable endeavor.  The presence of the lavish Imperial Palm Inn also gives credence to the relative wealth of the Temples.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The tall, cool walls of the Imperial Palm Inn rise along the north side of the road.  Yards of shell-pink plaster cover the cold stone behind which twin towers, tiled in dark red, rise above the other lower buildings.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The stately entrance to the Imperial Palm Inn graces this stretch of roadway.  Pink stone walls surround this haven of charm and taste, frequented by the better classes of Rathan society as well as the discerning traveler with the coins to match his taste.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The road passes along the heavy, almost stolid flank of one of the city's many banks.  High leaded windows, set with stout bars, show glimpses of an elegant ceiling within.  City guards keep careful watch on the premises night and day.

title: [[Ratha, The Great Waymeet]]
description: Many roads converge here, north of Processional Way, the great route leading to the palace.  A large fountain rises at the center of the roads, and it serves as a gathering spot for all classes and races, a place where one can pause and enjoy the calming sounds of flowing waters and enjoy the marvelous aspect of the grand palace to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Ratha, Angels' Flight]]
description: A gold-trimmed lift carries its loads with quiet elegance.  Even the chains have been tinted a gold color in keeping with the high-ranking passengers who ride it.

title: [[Ratha, Bitter Angle Road]]
description: Tucked between the pretentious facade of the Warrior Mage Guild and the great Waymeet, this tiny angle of road holds little charm.  Throngs of people hurry this way and that, regardless of the hour, ready to trample the idler.  Meanwhile, horse- and mule-borne cargoes stand poised to crush the less agile or those who may take a moment to pause and observe the rush of daily life.

title: [[Ratha, Z'hutoya Way]]
description: Fluted stone towers rise towards the heavens, their surfaces engraved with images of twining snakes.  On the northern side of the street, a large wooden gate is bracketed by two defensive towers.  Engraved on the gate is the crest of the Warrior Mage Guild.

title: [[Ratha, Greensward Lane]]
description: A few straggly patches of grass seem to be the only reason for the somewhat pompous name given to this patch of road.  Rough gravel strangles the grass and what little grows here is scraggly and drear.  Somewhere though, the cheerful sound of birdsong resonates and there is just the faintest whiff of true greenery.

title: [[Ratha, Greensward Lane]]
description: A small, red tile-roofed shop sits deep within the shadows of a nearby grove of small trees.  A curious air pervades the tiny store, as if there were unseen comings and goings on some higher plane than normal senses could perceive.

A miniscule red tile-roofed shop sits alongside a small patch of greenery in this stone-bound city.  A curious sense of withdrawal surrounds the otherwise mundane little building, as if it were somehow removed from the ordinary world about it.

title: [[Ratha, Greensward Lane]]
description: From a small garden surrounding a curiously-shaped building comes the muted song of many birds.  A pleasant change from the omnipresent cry of gulls, it has a strangely soothing effect.  Cares and troubles seem to fade and a warm sense of security and warmth pervades the air.

title: [[Ratha, Guardian Naga Way]]
description: A few torches glimmer from a small park nearby.  The scent of growing foliage is rich in the moist sea air, a welcome change from the dusty air in the more crowded sections of town.
The path winds across a sandy patch of space past a startlingly green oasis in this rocky city.  A few people stroll about, enjoying the breeze and the scent of the nearby greenery.

title: [[Ratha, Guardian Naga Way]]
description: A rare bit of open land among the crowded tiers, this patch of sandy soil has been taken over by someone trying to grow herbs and such.  The ground is hard and rocky, the crop sparse and the return poor.  However, for some it may mean the difference between poverty and starvation on the one hand, and survival on the other.

title: [[Ratha, Guardian Naga Way]]
description: A small patch of open land among the drab backsides of nearby buildings offers a welcome bit of space.  A few straggly plants have found a way through the hard-packed, rocky soil, their tattered leaves making curious shadows against the darker background.

A small patch of open space among the drab backsides of nearby buildings offers a welcome bit of sun.  A few straggly plants have forced their way through the hard-packed, rocky soil and several bear oddly bright flowers among the grey stone and drab earth.

title: [[A Winding Path]]
description: A narrow path begins a winding descent from the streets down the western cliffs of the city.  Saltbrush and stiff grasses block the view to the south and the climb down takes some careful foot-placing.  The main avenues of the city lie further to the east.

title: [[A Winding Path]]
description: Below a steep section of the cliff, the path winds around some large bushes that glisten palely with white salt crystals on their thick leaves.  The city lies upwards over the cliff rocks, which rain a splattering of loose gravel with every movement over them.

title: [[Ratha, Guardian Naga Way]]
description: A narrow alley runs among the temples, providing service access for deliveries and such.  Even the gods need their trash hauled, it would seem.  Rats and such skitter amongst small piles of debris while rag-clad scavengers of the two-legged sort pick over scraps of food and stubs of candles that can be resold in the lower tiers.

title: [[Faenella's Shrine, A Small Park]]
description: A wooded area shielded by a hedge of firethorn shrubs surrounds a tall barrel-shaped building.  A bench huddles beneath a low bough of a small tree heavily laden with bright red berries.  Many different kinds of songbirds flutter through the dense shrubs, snatching from the tree's feast.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: The soft sounds of water from the fountain to the north create a peaceful and comfortable atmosphere as you saunter down this grand boulevard.  Lovely trees line the street almost creating an arch overhead and providing shelter from the elements, allowing a pleasant stroll at any hour of the day or night.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: The wide boulevard is impeccably maintained with clean, almost white cobblestones, bordered on each side with grassy walkways creating the feel of a small park.  Nestled between the ivy covered fences lies a small white house.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: This is a perfect place to sit and savor the grand splendor of this great processional.  Several benches, surrounded by small, delicate rose bushes giving off a heady, almost heavenly scent, abut the back fences of the temple grounds to the west and the bank to the east.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: During state events, this halfway point down the Processional is the perfect location from which to view the dignitaries and their entourages as they proceed grandly down the boulevard anticipating the great events to follow.  The elegant temple gardens are visible through the ivy covered fence to the west.

title: [[Ratha, Processional Way]]
description: Onlookers from all over the realms gather here to enjoy the spectacle of the Palace as well as all the official activities taking place around the Palace itself.  Even the trees seem to stand at attention, creating the atmosphere of great decorum.  Most people rarely speak over a whisper here so as not to disturb the natural beauty and awesome ambiance of this glorious setting.

title: [[Ratha, Eastern Promenade]]
description: The Oracle Veraclese's Cleric shop stands at this, the eastern end of Promenade Way.  More shops and guilds are found to the north on Three Fold Path along with an Inn which eagerly awaits the visit of folks in need of sustenance and sleep.  Journeying westward, the route borders the banking district and the Palace, and finally leads to the temple district.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The dome of Phelim's Temple rises against the sky in a gentle curve that offsets the harshness of this rock-bound city.  The air is rich with the sea tang from far below and the sound of sonorous chanting from within the sacred precincts blends with the distant wave song of the open ocean.

timeto.4858: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 245 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The Temples of Ratha rise on both sides of this immaculately clean roadway.  The sacred architecture of a dozen different sects and cults vie with each other in what could have been a tasteless clash but somehow has managed to blend itself into a curious harmony.  Even the varied clouds of incense that drift about manage to combine into a strangely invigorating scent.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The road forks as it passes near the Temple district.  High walls protect the estates and offices of the tax gatherers to the south, and heavily-armed guards stalk along the walls, secure behind stone and iron.  The street itself is spotlessly clean, each scale-shaped cobble has been set with consummate skill so that the path resembles the endless coils of some enormous serpent.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: The wide roadway wends between the blessed realms of the temples and the cursed domains of the tax gatherers.  Like the proverbial rock and a hard place, one must steer a difficult course between two such powerful entities.  To the south, the great lift descends to less heady heights.

title: [[Ratha, Golden Scale Road]]
description: Golden Scale Road leads from the lifts into the elite heart of Ratha.  The road is paved with stone blocks cleverly carved to resemble large scales, carefully set with gold-tinted mortar.  The effect is one of gaudy elegance.  The motif is reflected in the massive pillars that carry the iron chains that control the great lift.

title: [[Truffenyi's Fountain]]
description: The grassy green surrounds a large, sparkling white marble fountain.  At the fountain's center is a statue of the god Truffenyi, in mortal form, rendered by the carver as a strong muscular human warrior.  The water arcs from the rim of the fountain and rains down from above on the statue which gazes patiently on the mortal world.  Within the pool of the fountain are smaller carvings of the deity's aspects, the weasel and the magpie.

title: [[Everild's Temple, Outside]]
description: A simple building is designated as the temple to Everild by the threshold stone at the entrance.  Two carvings stand guard at the doorway, one of a centaur, the other of a wolverine.

title: [[A Winding Path]]
description: A slick, steep incline of shale is slippery with sand that has blown across the path, though a break of bushes gives some handholds for steadying.  A clatter of rocks from above frightens a rabbit hiding beneath the brush.

title: [[Kertigen's Temple, Approach]]
description: A tall, dark wooden building lies ahead through an avenue of cedars.  The approach is a mown grassy field bordered with white Ratha cliff thistles.  The wind blows through the trees, creating a rush of soft sound.

title: [[Kertigen's Temple, North Entrance]]
description: A six-tiered temple, still under construction, faces the bay to the south.  Made of wood, instead of stone, it resembles a large sailing ship, with its wooden timbers and tall crow's nest perched high above.  Each dormer of the roof holds a carved wooden raven, wings outspread, that appears to both guard the entrances and to catch the ocean winds and nearly bear the whole structure aloft.  The flag of the Nadamian family flaps briskly from the the highest "mast."

title: [[Kertigen's Temple, West Entrance]]
description: A six-tiered temple, still under construction, faces the bay to the south.  Made of wood, instead of stone, it resembles a large sailing ship, with its wooden timbers and tall crow's nest perched high above.  Each dormer of the roof holds a carved wooden raven, wings outspread, that appears to both guard the entrances and to catch the ocean winds and nearly bear the whole structure aloft.  The flag of the Nadamian family flaps briskly from the the highest "mast."

title: [[Kertigen's Temple, East Entrance]]
description: A six-tiered temple, still under construction, faces the bay to the south.  Made of wood, instead of stone, it resembles a large sailing ship, with its wooden timbers and tall crow's nest perched high above.  Each dormer of the roof holds a carved wooden raven, wings outspread, that appears to both guard the entrances and to catch the ocean winds and nearly bear the whole structure aloft.  The flag of the Nadamian family flaps briskly from the the highest "mast."

title: [[Ratha, Angels' Flight]]
description: A silver-trimmed lift carries its loads with quiet elegance.  Even the chains have been tinted a silver color in keeping with the many elegant personages who choose to ride it.

title: [[Ratha, Theater District]]
description: The red brick street runs eastward towards the prosperous theater which is one of the favorite entertainments of Ratha's upper class.  Colorful lamps, strung from pole to pole and kept burning around the clock, line the road.

title: [[Ratha, Theater District]]
description: Made of bleached granite, the Hotagi'rath theater is a renovated temple of sweeping arches and architectural flair.  Colorful pennants hang from every available outcrop on the building.

title: [[Ratha, Theater District]]
description: A large drainpipe, running up the side of the theater, connects to the roof's gutters.  The pipes empty out into mildew stained rain barrels that are placed conveniently beneath.

title: [[Ratha, Theater District]]
description: The brick street circles around the side of the Hotagi'rath theater.  Flower beds skirt the building, with a blaze of color and scents.  Benches amidst the small gardens provide a peaceful place to rest and contemplate.

title: [[Ratha, Theater District]]
description: The back of the theater looks to be in need of a bit of upkeep, with the bleached granite fading to its natural grey in many places.  The street is cluttered with debris.  Torn remnants of pennants, defaced by both the weather and vandals, hang on the building in need of replacement.

title: [[A Sandy Pathway]]
description: This pathway leads off towards the western cliffs and the sea beyond, and back towards the main streets of the city.  Sandlilies line the trail, their deep blue blossoms waving in the fresh sea air.  A gull cries in the distance, and the wind puffs in drafts blowing the sand in little clouds.

title: [[Eluned's Temple, Pathway]]
description: The path ends at a low building made of sandstone bricks, and the cliffs behind it fall off to the western sea below.  The temple's gently-sloping roof is made of slate tiles arranged in a fish-scale pattern.  A triangular-arched doorway, just tall enough for the tallest mortal to enter is capped with a splendid carving of a life-sized albatross.   Steps inside the doorway lead down into a cool, dark passageway.

title: [[Faenella's Temple, Sanctum]]
description: Smooth, dark wooden walls curve around this tall narrow room.  The only window is a skylight above a pale statue of Faenella, sculpted kneeling before a basin of water placed in the center of the space.  One half of the room is strung with golden wires that run from the floor to the ceiling, and sound in the chamber vibrates them to a pleasing tone.

title: [[Faenella's Temple, Priest's Quarters]]
description: This cluttered room is filled with rolls of sheet music and instruments.  A S'Kra Mur priest, his black scales painted with silver wrens, sits beside a large harp, humming a hymn to his goddess.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley]]
description: Littered with the forgotten remanent of former treasures, this brick pathway winds past some of the more fashionable parts of town.  Light flickers from lanterns above unmarked doorways as it battles against the darkness that forces it to remain a mere pool of warmth at the doorsteps.  Ominous shadows seem to lurk within every nook from the depth of the cold night.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley]]
description: The sounds of the city are muffled from the high walls that parallel the alleyway.  A sense of movement and soft whispers are imagined from deep within the dark shadows.  Warm light from the windows above fail to win over the powers of the night to illuminate the alley.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley]]
description: Weak pale blades of grass and weeds fight to break through portions of the red brick that have become cracked and broken along the alley's path.  Formerly a soft pink color, the granite walls have become faded to a grayish-pink from rain and lack of care.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley]]
description: The walls close in upon the alley rendering dark foreboding shadows even at the peak of the day.  Empty barrels and crates choke the passage to a mere trail through a forest of debris and refuse.   A small pool of muddy and scum covered water has become the final resting spot for the drainage of a broken gutter above.  Slow thick concentric ripples slowly radiate outward from the center of the pond with each drip of water.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley]]
description: Years of neglect have rended this former bricked alley to a rutted dirt path with scattered embedded shards of broken brick.  Stacks of broken crates lean precariously against a rain streaked granite wall.  A couple of cracked stone steps lead down to a shadowed alcove.

title: [[Narrow Alley, Alcove]]
description: An unmarked door is set within this dark alcove along the grey granite wall.  To the left of the door, a small dingy window hints of a brightly colored curtain on the inside.   A set of stone steps lead back up to the alley.

timeto.5087: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 165 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Phelim's Temple, Exterior]]
description: The temple to Phelim is a domed building silhouetted against the night sky.  The sound of the sea beyond rumbles far below nearby cliffs, and the treeless, expansive sky floats overhead.

The temple to Phelim is a domed building, made of black stone, that overlooks the eastern cliffs of the island.  The sea is visible beyond, where the horizon of ocean stretches far into the distance.  A treeless, open sky arches overhead.

title: [[Phelim's Temple, Planetarium]]
description: The domed roof of Phelim's temple is open to the night sky with a large telescope pointed towards the heavens.

The domed roof of the temple is closed and the constellations are projected on the ceiling and walls in a splendid display of the heavens.  The floor stones are black marble and glisten softly in the dim light, and the dark walls are cool and smooth to the touch.

title: [[Crescent Cove, Shrine to Phelim]]
description: Open to the sky above, this quiet enclosure is dedicated to Phelim, Lord of Dreams.  Odd sigils adorn the arches forming the shrine and a raised pedestal at the center of the shrine supports a Halfling-high statue of the deity.  Though no censers are apparent, the scent of sandalwood permeates the air.

title: [[Crescent Cove, Marble Shrine]]
description: An austere shrine of blue-veined marble stands at the edge of the lagoon's mouth.  Concentric rings of willow spread out from its circular base, the scent of spiced incense drifting from within.  To either side of the cove's entrance, jagged teeth of dark grey stone rise up to guard the northern shore.

title: [[Taisgath, Crescent Cove]]
description: This sheltered cove, bordered by a narrow stretch of white sand, offers an egress to the island for smaller sailing vessels.  To the northwest, at the tip of one of the lagoon's protective arms, lies a small outbuilding.  Southward, the spire of a conical building dominates the sky.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: Approaching the building, its true nature becomes apparent -- it is the horned shell of some enormous sea creature.  Dotted with windows and narrow terraces, the central portion of the shell spirals into the sky.  Towering glassine doors lead through the mouth of the deserted husk.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: The island trail rises from the east to turn and follow the coastline southwest just before plummeting into the sea.  A rocky cliff looks over the ocean toward the main continent, far from view.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: A small stand of trees lines the inland side of the pathway with a wall of tightly knit branches.  The ocean view is quite startling, with the sea spread like a thick azure carpet to the horizon.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: The trail is divided here, leading east toward the island's interior and continuing along the barren coastline.  Grey seabirds wheel against the heavens with faint screeching cries carried on a salt-tainted breeze.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: A particularly tall spire of granite rises from the waves at this corner of the isle like a frozen sentinel.  Thick coats of dark lichen over the weathered stone provide testimony to its age.  Smaller jagged teeth of grey rock along the shore prevent a suitable landing for any ocean travellers.

title: [[Taisgath, Grove of the Obelisk]]
description: A translucent obelisk, the small island's namesake, dominates the center of this silent grove.  Oddly, no sounds of wildlife penetrate the thick foliage surrounding the small meadow.  A slab of reddish-brown stone lies to one side of the obelisk.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: At the crest of the hill, an odd structure is visible beside a narrow stretch of beach.  The white sand is stark against the deep blue of a small lagoon.  Southward, the trail wanders back along the shoreline.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: Crushed stone grates softly underfoot as the path ascends a small hillock dotted with willow and brambles.  White-winged birds flit through the sky overhead, while gentle breezes whisper from offshore.  From somewhere out of sight, the faint sounds of a violin drift in the salty air.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: This pebbled trail winds roughly south and north, beside a high bamboo fence that stretches along the eastern shore.  Unseen woodland creatures scurry through the thick underbrush toward the west.

title: [[Taisgath, Eastern Gates]]
description: Manicured trails lined with small dark stones wind along the coastline of the small island.  Wide bamboo gates set in a matching fence to the east permit access to the sailing docks.

title: [[Taisgath, Pebbled Trail]]
description: The walkway winds through a small grove of willows and the sea glimmers through the foliage to the south.  The soft murmur of the ocean against the shore is muted by their trailing branches.

title: [[Taisgath, Sheltered Docks]]
description: There are several boats harbored here, all festooned with dangling bells, glass and gaethzen lamps, wooden figureheads, and assortments of colored cloth and canvas.  The uptempo strains of a violin drift across the salty air, rising and falling in conjunction with the sloshing waves.  Strands of smoke drift up from the brightly painted fleet of vessels, no doubt the origin of the potent scent of spiced meals cooking.

title: [[Taisgath, Docks]]
description: A long dock, lined with pillars made from delicately carved cherry wood, stretches along the eastern shoreline.  Surmounted by a sign lettered in silver script, a wide pair of bamboo gates stands open to visitors.

title: [[Taisgath Docks, Night Sky Landing]]
description: The celestial light of the heavens sparkles across the ocean waves even on the darkest of nights.  Seabirds occasionally wheel across the skies with a screech.

title: [[Crescent Cove, Lagoon]]
description: Bordered by a beach of silver-white sand, the small lagoon is just large enough for a relaxing swim to the edge of the open sea.  Currently guarded by a coarse bamboo gate, the lagoon provides safe harbor for smaller seacraft tied along one side of the shore.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Entryway]]
description: Smokeless burning torches emit a soft light, accompanied by a heady herbal scent, bathing the guild entrance in a soft glow.  Sounds of guild activity echo from farther along the broad corridor that curves out of sight to the northwest.  Two towering glassine doors lead out of the guildhall.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: The Walk of the Winds slopes upward gently as it winds clockwise through the interior of the guild.  Gleaming waves, created with an intricate pattern of blue and white tile on the floor, sweep toward the spire.  A soft breeze blows along the corridor from somewhere above carrying the scent of the sea and some faint musical tones.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: Another inner chamber is accessed here through a sweeping arch with a lintel of silverwood.  Faint lights glow beyond the doorway, but little else is visible in the subdued lighting of the corridor.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: A tall narrow window, very nearly like an arrow slit, overlooks the western arm of Crescent Cove.  An ocean breeze whispers along the opening, producing a faint melody.  In less convivial surroundings, the wind song would be haunting.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: A low corridor snakes off southwest between two ridges of gleaming shell.  The main passage begins to narrow and the walk steepens slightly as it continues to wind clockwise toward the spire.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: Waves of blue and white tile race along the hallway as it winds out of sight to the south.  The intricate floor mosaic gives the illusion of increased speed as the passage narrows, with gleaming white-capped waves bordered by rushing patterns of foam.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: One of the guild's tall windows sings softly along the corridor.  Just opposite, a particularly wide arch opens onto another central room.  The smells of fresh-baked bread drift from within.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: A small section of the outer wall has been carved away here, leading to a narrow terrace.  A brisk breeze blows through the opening and down along the passageway to the northeast.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: Overlooking the high bluffs along the western coast of the isle, a tall window whispers sea songs to passersby.  The corridor narrows even further as it ascends, but still not quite enough to make two-way foot traffic a problem.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: The salt-scented breeze along the corridor picks up as the grade of the climb increases, adding a slight chill to the air.  The walk passes another sweeping arch into the heart of the guild that has been boarded over.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Terrace]]
description: This narrow terrace, protected from the weather by a long overhang of horned shell, offers a breathtaking panorama of the island and the shimmering waters beyond.  Windswept grassy hillocks roll away from the guildhouse, and beyond it, a sailing ship glides slowly across the crystal waves.  A brass telescope has been mounted at the edge of the deck offering an enhanced view of the sea and sky.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: The glistening mosaic of tiles begins to rise on either side of the passage, covering the lower section of wall with whitecaps.  The passage glides upward and around another turn in the spiral of the shell to the southeast.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: Waves of azure rise up along the walls, threatening to engulf the passage as it funnels further into the heights of the guildhall.  Flecks of silver upon the blue, sparkle like tiny grains of sand caught in the fury of the rushing water.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: The wash of water closes in overhead and begins to turn in a dizzying funnel of waves.  Tiny fish of silver and gold are swept along with the maelstrom as it pours into a central chamber.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: The flood of blue and white spirals into the chamber and a mosaic whirlpool threatens to engulf those seeking knowledge as they cross the hall to the lectern of Guildmaster.  A natural curl of the shell curves up around the outer wall to an opening far above.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: From above, the swirling vortex of tile is incredibly lifelike, threatening to pull observers from the narrow walkway.  The thin ledge of shell has a slightly unnerving resiliency that belies its strength.  Just before dropping off into the eye of the whirlpool, it turns up through a natural opening in the ceiling.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Walk of the Winds]]
description: A slender spiraled horn of iridescence rises from the top of the guildhall to meet the sky.  Below, the island spreads out to the south and the lagoon is no more than a small puddle splashed upon the shore.  A narrow railing of brass guards the careless observer.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Dining Hall]]
description: Lined with long communal tables made from dark-stained cherry wood, the exotic scents of spiced meat and herbal concoctions fill this luxurious dining hall.  No kitchens are in sight, the builders having gone to some trouble to conceal any evidence of the mundane.  Nonetheless, servants periodically bustle in and out with heaping trays of food or empty dishes, coming and going through doorways that vanish from sight the moment they're closed.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Library]]
description: Light chases away the darkness of the room from highly polished niches along the walls.  An occasional rustling from among the rows of high bookcases betrays the presence of at least one researcher.  With every footstep, the scents of dust and moldering paper fill the air.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Contemplation Chamber]]
description: Windowless and dimly lit, a few scattered cushions provide seating for those who come to meditate and collate information they've gathered.  Incense slowly burns in hanging sconces, filling the dusky chamber with the soothing scent of sandalwood and a faint sheen of wispy grey smoke.

title: [[Taisgath Guildhouse, Reception Hall]]
description: This enormous chamber is a gathering spot for visitors and general meetings of guild interest.  Natural seating is formed by a low ridge of pearlescent shell that runs around the edge of the hall.  Glowing spheres in ornate sconces, set high along the walls, illuminate the azure carpet like sunlight on the island shoals.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: The walkways here become expansive plazas lined with potted trees and assorted floral finery.  All is quiet now, an occasional sweep sauntering by intent on ridding the area of unsightly refuse.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: The wondrous smells of a nearby kitchen mingle with a refreshing light breeze, tantalizing all who pass by.  Roving musicians are often seen along the avenue lending a festive environment to the otherwise busy thoroughfare.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: The tinkle of music and chimes intermingle with a pleasant breeze upon which floats the smell of something incredibly delicious.  Exclusive shops and artisans offer services to the privileged residents of the Shh'o'kumu Terrace.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: Perfectly polished walkways and matching marble balustrades reflect just a portion of the incredible finery found on this tier.  Liveried carriages roll past conveying their occupants toward the sumptuous estates on the eastern side of the terrace.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: The marble of the balustrade is used to create a series of arches that offer a bit of protection from the constant breeze.  Elegant rose vines climb their marbled surfaces and paint a pretty picture against the azure of the sea beyond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: The expansive facade of a large columnar building overshadows the elegance of the walkway.  Commanding a sweeping view of the eastern ocean and the bustling palace below, the building is set back from the roadway atop a small knoll.  Ornate fencing surrounds the property and a large gate, emblazoned with a royal coat of arms, marks the entrance to graceful driveway.

timeto.4603: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 600 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: Large marble arches shelter the walkway from the brisk evening breezes.  Crystal highlights glance off the ocean to the west lending an almost dreamlike quality to this section of the promenade.
Swirling winds howl through the marble arches as the walkway turns toward the northeast.  Shielded from much of the wind, families stroll comfortably along the walk enjoying the dramatic views.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: A pair of stone nagas rise to either side of the great lifts that lead to the upper tiers.  The constant drone of the lift is only intermittent now during the quiet hours of night, and guards in nearby posts doze sporadically.  Sailors and merchants frequent the bazaar at this time of night, seeking trinkets for the lovely ladies that catch their fancy.
A tree lined drive winds up the manicured hillside toward a magnificent estate.  A quaint carriage house sits just back from the road, enclosed by elegant iron fencing.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: The occasional drone of giant pulleys is heard over the howl of the evening breeze.  Even in the wee hours of the morning, carts and wagons wearily enter or depart the lift heading toward the ports or the city gates to the north.

The constant drone of giant pulleys is almost lost amidst the pleasant breeze that blows atop the terrace.  Carts and carriages exchange places on the lift either returning to the terrace with supplies or headed for the great gates of Ratha and distant points beyond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: Perfectly patterned brickwork adorns this wide avenue that pierces the heart of the terrace.  Tall, gold trimmed lamp posts display large, colorful hanging baskets filled with sumptuous flowers and variegated ivy.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: The neatly trimmed hedges and arboreal canopy frame the wide avenue that channels the majority of traffic north and south.  This is a favorite spot of neighborhood ruffians who enjoy sneaking away from their rigorous studies and nosy nannies to throw rocks at passing wagons.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: The lane dips here to pass under the main arterial above.  Brass lanterns cast a warming glow that completely illuminates the lane, casting long shadows on cascades of draping foliage.

The lane dips here slightly to pass under the main arterial above.  Thick boxwood, ironwood, and ivy completely hide the wagon and foot traffic from view, helping to preserve the quiet, peaceful atmosphere of the area.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: A jewel encrusted escutcheon adorns a large gate leading into the Zsikiel estate.  Jade and lapis have been crushed and inlaid into the stone walkway, forming a colorful sea-green mosaic.  The Zsikiel family plays host to hundreds of visitors a year, the elegant walks and grand entrance a showcase for Ratha's sterling upper class.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: Lingering smells of the evenings repast waft through the air, the scent of cinnamon and coffee still strong.  Somewhere closeby, warming fires and relaxed conversation enfold the hard-working staff of any of the nearby estates, as they relax a bit and focus on their own families.

Delicious smells of roasting meats, spices and freshly baked bread waft past on a luscious breeze.  Somewhere closeby, the kitchen staff of a nearby estate prepares a sumptuous meal for the family and their guests.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: The soft tinkle of chimes and the scent of roses mingles on a breeze.  Alongside the lane, a low white fence marks the sumptuous boundary of a formal garden.  A series of elaborate fountains punctuates the sculpted greenery as it spans east toward some incredibly beautiful homes.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Deversham Place]]
description: Lovely brass lanterns light this portion of the lane, near the beloved park that is now a likely subject of many a child's dream.
The lane takes a turn downward to give clearance to the main roadway above.  This spot is a busy byway for local nannies who take their charges to the lovely Deversham park to the east.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: The bustle and chaos of the day is now only a distant memory.  Traffic continues along this stretch of avenue all through the night, but the pace is more relaxed.

Brisk wagon traffic and streams of people move north and south along this wide avenue.  Bordered with tall silverwillow trees and low sculpted hedges, the avenue is pleasing to the eye, yet extremely functional.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Nadamian Avenue]]
description: Ivy draped walls rise to contain the clamorous traffic along the avenue, protecting nearby property from the sights and sounds of one of Ratha's busiest thoroughfares.

wayto.4794: ;e DRC.bput('open door',/already open/,/slowly lifting the door/);DRC.bput('climb steep tunnel in door','Ratha')

timeto.4794: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 295 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Deversham Place]]
description: Brightly colored pennants on polished brass poles herald the entrance to the much loved Deversham Park.  During the day, the park is filled with delighted children and their guardians who enjoy the festive accoutrements, and roving artisans.  In the evening hours it is a popular spot for romantic picnics by the pond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Gateway Drive]]
description: Chaos and confusion is typical at this intersection between the main gates to the city.  A large sign directs the traveler to one of two possible exits.  Nadamian Avenue to the south is the main thoroughfare leading to the lifts and the city below.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Gateway Drive]]
description: A handsome stone and timber kiosk stands back from the road, the crossed swords identifying it as the guard station.  Wagonloads of goods arrive in a steady stream heading toward the Sur'oson gate and the distant towns beyond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Sur'oson Gate]]
description: Tall timbers and rough-hewn stone form a giant gate in the great wall.  Standing open for the streams of wagon and foot traffic to pass through, the entrance to Ratha is carefully guarded by observant sentinels who watch every passerby with trained eyes.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Sur'oson Drive]]
description: Traffic is kept to a minimum along the drive as guards siphon the majority of travelers through to Nadamian Road.  The large wall opens up to the east allowing an expansive view of the lush greenery of the terrace.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Sur'oson Drive]]
description: The low half wall is replaced by a high, stone and timber wall which serves as a barrier to the great wilderness beyond the city limits.  To the east, the regal drives are darkened, and soft lights dot the expansive acreage as the community slumbers.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Sur'oson Drive]]
description: Shining tiled roofs, lush topiary gardens and manicured grounds present the onlooker with a beautiful view.  As gorgeous as the surrounding neighborhoods are, they all pale in comparison to the timeless beauty of the ocean to the west.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Sur'oson Drive]]
description: A stiff breeze blows here constantly, on the windward side of the terrace.  A gentle slope rises from the road toward the east covered with softly waving grasses and wild flowers.  An old stone bench allows travelers a chance to sit and enjoy the view.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade West]]
description: Fine marble arches of the promenade loom to the south, their polished surfaces glinting with reflected light.  Families often stroll here, taking in the crisp air and the remarkable sights.  Several exquisite homes are nestled back from the road amid lush, manicured lawns.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: A delightful lane is paved in perfectly matched cobbles, and bordered by low whitewashed fencing and sculpted hedges.  Draping willows form an arch over the roadway.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Gateway Drive]]
description: The drive is quiet this time of night, an occasional traveller wearily plodding down the drive toward the lower reaches of the city and the comforts of home.  Soft lamplight radiates from the polished lanterns burning along the great wall.

Workers laden with baskets and carts head toward the Por'oson gate and the agricultural fields beyond.  Children mingle among the throng of travelers and it is a wonder that more are not lost in the shuffle.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Por'oson Gate]]
description: The great wall culminates here with the large and stately Por'oson Gate.  Day and night, streams of travelers find paths through the gate to the agricultural lands and great forests to the northeast, or find access to the ports of the city below.  A pair of wary guards watches the comings and goings here, constantly alert to potential trouble.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Por'oson Drive]]
description: The pace of traffic is chaotic at times as the drive approaches the Por'oson Gate.  Travelers mill about asking directions to their destinations or seeking transportation to the distant locales beyond the city limits.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Por'oson Drive]]
description: Bleached timbers and stone form the retaining wall that channels a constant flow of travelers to and from the great city gates.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Por'oson Drive]]
description: A low ivy covered wall brings the expansive greenery of the terrace into view as the drive skirts the northeast border of the lovely Deversham park.  Toward the southwest the beauty of the ocean catches the eye of all who traverse this section of town.

timeto.5013: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 155 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Por'oson Drive]]
description: Swirls of smoke drift upwards from the stone chimney of an odd open air building.  As the cook fires are banked for the night, the site often attracts weary travelers who stop to warm themselves by the fire and partake of a steaming mug of coffee.

Swirls of smoke drift upwards from the stone chimney atop an odd open air building.  Several people gather around a blazing cook fire tending two large spits.  Turning slowly over the coals the glorious contents sizzle and roast sending splendid aromas airborne.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: An expansive drive veers off toward the west and the lovely surroundings of a towering mansion.  The elaborate gate is manned by a uniformed servant who allows only those people with business on the property to gain entrance.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: Several lovely homes are set back from the road, framed in a backdrop of rolling green acres and towering trees.  The views from this vantage point are breathtaking, whether it be the lovely terrace itself or the sparkling ocean beyond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Cherrywood Lane]]
description: A simple fountain commands the center of the lane emitting an intermittent geyser of sparkling water that catches and reflects the moonlight.  Stone benches placed around the fountain are often occupied by happy couples out for a romantic stroll.

A simple fountain commands the center of the lane emitting an intermittent geyser of sparkling water that spills cheerfully into a pool below.  Smooth cobbles lend a feeling of quaint simplicity to an otherwise elegant neighborhood.  Stone benches have been placed around the fountain on each side of the lane offering the passerby a chance to sit and enjoy.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Cherrywood Lane]]
description: Several lovely homes are set back from the lane.  Large cherrywood trees span the lane creating a cathedral-like effect, hence the lane's name.  The driveways, landscaping and finishing touches of every home in the area speak of the tremendous wealth found in this privileged community.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Pantel Estate]]
description: The neatly trimmed lawns of Deversham park blend seamlessly with the sprawling grounds of a large estate.  A long drive, bordered by sprawling diamondwood trees, leads to a house of magnificent proportions.  The Pantel family is familiar with sprawling real estate, owning nearly all the agricultural land outside the city gates to the north.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: The rows of windswept willows and stately ironwood shade the walkways along the promenade.  Tantalizing smells wend their way toward appreciative bystanders and fade into the salt-sea air and the city beyond.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: Beautiful topiaries by day take on strange, almost monstrous shapes by night.  Far beyond the elaborate balustrades and the sheer cliffs, the velvet sea shimmers with tiny points of reflected light.

Beautiful topiaries adorn the expansive walkway, in striking contrast to the simple beauty of the sparkling sea.  Large wagons laden with provisions traverse the cobbled avenue, drivers anxious to make deliveries on time to any one of several large estates in the vicinity.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: Elegant willows drape comforting arms over the pristine walkway.  Lending a hand to stir a cooling breeze or filter the sparkling moonlight, the ancient trees enhance the loveliness of the promenade.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Promenade East]]
description: Large pots of flowers that are vibrant by day, cast long elegant shadows on the perfect brickwork of the walkway by night.  Beyond the marble balustrades, the lights of the palace and gardens present a luminous spectacle beyond measure.
Large pots of flowers dot the perfect promenade.  Along the elegant balustrades, passersby stop to enjoy the view of the ocean far beyond and the bustling palace district below.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Deversham Place]]
description: A broad plaza, framed by manicured lawns forms the central portion of the park.  Three brightly lit gazebos serve as showplaces for a variety of wandering artists and performers who come here nightly to entertain the privileged children of the terrace.

title: [[Shh'o'kumu Terrace, Zsikiel Lane]]
description: Stone steps lead up a neatly trimmed hillock toward a stone manse.  Ancient bentwood pines flank the walkway with polished brass lanterns lighting the way.

title: [[Ratha, Outside Sur'oson Gate]]
description: All manner of travelers mill about the gate, either waiting their turn to enter or pushing through the crowds in the opposite direction if they're leaving.  Farmers pass through with wagonloads of produce and grain, fishermen with their catches, and rangers with bundles of hides.  The gate guards look on, watching everyone.

Cloaked travelers slip in and out of the gate, wrapped up against the chill of the night and carrying torches and lanterns to light their way.  Although there are relatively few folk passing through at this hour, the gate guards seem particularly alert as they assess each person, keeping one eye on the shadows.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road]]
description: The well-maintained gravel road connects the farmland to the northwest with the walled city to the southeast.  The city doesn't appear to cover much territory when viewed from this direction, but judging by the noise drifting this way it has to be quite a bit larger than it appears.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road]]
description: The land near the city has been denuded of all vegetation save for weeds, and even the useful among their number have been rooted up and foraged into extermination.  All that's left are some scrubby grasses and a few patches here and there of a particularly ugly creeper.  An occasional insect creeps, hops or buzzes about its business, but even the bugs have largely sought more hospitable terrain.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The land to the east and northeast lies under heavy cultivation.  Neither trees nor rocks mar the neatly rowed flatness of the fields, and even the occasional farmhouse huddles about itself, giving the impression of having pulled in its skirts so as to leave as much land as possible to the crops.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The road runs close by the edge of the barley fields to the west.  On the opposite side of the way the land resembles a rural garbage heap.  The farmers apparently dumped stumps and boulders dug out of the fields across the road, and then continued dumping anything else they didn't want there in subsequent years.  Beyond the narrow strip of rocks and refuse the land rises in a steep slope, a berm covered with grass and weeds and loose-looking rocks.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Birds flutter back and forth, alternating between raiding the barley fields to the west, and hopping about the refuse piles to the east in search of whatever might be in there that is of interest to birds.  They seem to prefer the barley fields, but farm children with slings make raiding that particular cornucopia somewhat hazardous.

Rustling in the dark fields indicates that someone, or some thing, is doing some night harvesting, and it's probably not the farmer who crops this land.  The occasional barking of a dog identifies the source of at least some of the rustling, but dogs don't eat barley.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The steep berm rising to the east blocks the view in that direction, but a cool breeze blowing down the slope bears the scent of water.  A narrow path winds through the rubbish on the east side of the road, past a rotting cart with no wheels and around an unstable pile of boulders, but there's no fixed path up the berm.  Its rocky slope is only partially anchored by foliage, and the rest looks very shifty.  The path continues to the west, disappearing into the barley.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Flat, open fields stretch out to the west, broken occasionally by small farmhouses.  Beyond the fields rises a huge cindercone.  The volcano dominates the western skyline, tall and broad.  Its sides are old and weathered and craggy, with no sign of any lava or hot ash having flowed in this direction for quite some time.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Rippling barley fills the fields to the west, from the road all the way to the base of the volcano.  The fields appear to be very fertile and the crop bountiful.  Children with slings run back and forth driving away hungry birds, while their elders move slowly through the grain, their concentration on their work.

The dark fields along the west side of the road rustle softly in the night air.  A huge, dark mound looms over the scene as though watching over all under its looming eye.  At night, even more so than in the daytime, the volcano dominates the landscape.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The crops in the fields change here, with barley to the south and kord to the north.  The barley fields are low, smooth and rustling, while the kord plants are taller, stringy and rather tangled looking.  Between the barley for beer and the kord for rope, this area is well suited to support ocean trade and its sailors.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Farmers work in the fields on the west side of the road, moving slowly along the rows with a wagon trailing them.  Someone is singing a slow song in S'Kra, and a number of farmers in one area are swaying slightly in time with the tune.

Night birds flap and squawk around a large farm wagon which was left out in the fields.  Judging by the calls and twitters, there are at least two kinds of birds out there, but it's too dark to see more than an occasional dark flutter of a silhouette against the starry black of the sky.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: A small patch of orange flowers grows along the side of the road in the shadow of the stringy yellow kord plants.  More flowers, both the orange ones and some tiny white ones, grow scattered on the opposite side of the road, peeping out from between the discarded tree stumps and wagon wheels and bushel baskets.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Stand]]
description: The children of a farmer have set up a little stand in the bend of the road.  Both farm folk and travellers gather here to have a cup of ale or a piece of bread and while away as much time as they can take from their labors, making this stretch of the track rather congested.

A shuttered and empty stand sits in the bend of the road.  Judging by the scuffled footprints, and the deep ruts where wagons and caravans seem to have sat for some time, the stand enjoys a brisk flow of business in the daytime.  But in the night it's closed and still, just a boxy shadow in the dark.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: A scattering of daaknut trees grows haphazardly in the jumble of rocks and logs and refuse on the east side of the road.  Indigestible to humans, the nuts are believed to be particularly tasty by pigs of all sorts, and judging by the tracks in the dirt the farmers of the area take their pigs across the road to fatten up on the free largesse which falls from the trees at all seasons of the year.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Just to the northeast the road is rutted, with an obvious track passing crosswise over it.  This is where the farmers usually cross with wagons of refuse, and take their pigs to feed on the daaknuts, often in depressingly large herds.  Depressing for any travellers caught on the wrong side of the stream of porcine livestock, that is.  The farmers are doubtless quite happy with the fertility of their pigs.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Just to the southwest the road is rutted, with an obvious track passing crosswise over it.  This is where the farmers usually cross with wagons of refuse, and take their pigs to feed on the daaknuts, often in depressingly large herds.  Depressing for any travellers caught on the wrong side of the stream of porcine livestock, that is.  The farmers are doubtless quite happy with the fertility of their pigs.

Just to the southwest the road is rutted, with an obvious track passing crosswise over it.  This is where the farmers usually cross with wagons of refuse, and take their pigs to feed on the daaknuts, often in depressingly large herds.  Depressing for any travellers caught on the wrong side of the stream of porcine livestock, that is.  The farmers are doubtless quite happy with the fertility of their pigs.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The tangled kord bushes bend and wave, although not in neat ripples as one would expect if it were the breeze moving them.  Something is apparently moving in there.  Whether it is children hiding out, though, or some sort of animal one can't really say.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Yellowish kord dominates the landscape from the road to the base of the volcano looming on the horizon.  The fibrous plant has never been known as a particularly valuable crop, but this near to a busy port town on the ocean there must be quite a steady demand for it.  Growing it is a sign of conservative responsibility in the farmers, rather than any dreams of being some day wealthy.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: A few scrubby trees and some low, tangled bushes are all that grow on the rocky berm to the east.  Rising high and steep above the long and narrow junk heap on that side of the road, it's regular enough to appear artificial.  The low call of water birds is heard from that direction, and every now and then a soaring shape appears in the sky.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: It looks like someone discarded an entire stove on the east side of the road among the rotting stumps and shriveled kord stems.  Shaped like a flattened pyramid, it looks like it was originally of sturdy but unornamented construction.  The wrought iron is well rusted now, with gaping holes that were never made by the smith.  Some sort of small animal apparently nests inside, and twittering birds occasionally swoop down to perch and call.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The road takes a sharp turn here at the corner of a field.  The farmer who tends this land is a little overly enthusiastic about filling the drainage ditches, and water spills over onto the road somewhere to the northwest, making this stretch soggy.  A wide variety of slimes and mosses have taken over different ruts and corners, making all this mud most interesting for a dedicated natural philosopher, and a slippery nuisance for everyone else.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Two large Gor'Togs, a male and a female, work side by side on a pedal-mill.  Constructed of old lumber lashed together, the rickety contraption lifts water out of the flowing irrigation ditch and dumps it into the smaller ditch leading off into the kord field west of the road.  One of the small buckets on the male's side of the machine is cracked, causing it to spill water onto the road whenever it comes around.
A pedal mill stands astride the irrigation ditch to one side of the road.  The surface of the road here is wet and muddy -- it looks like water slops over out of the ditch on a regular basis.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The occasional crunch underfoot is caused by gravel strewn in the road, apparently in an attempt to improve the footing in the muddy ruts.  It's a futile effort, however, since the gravel simply sinks into the mud and vanishes whenever it's walked on.  The road is wet and slippery, and the gravel only serves to bring to mind the likelihood of a few nasty cuts if one takes a spill, in addition to the inevitable mud on one's clothes.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: To the west, in a corner where two kord fields meet at an angle, is a small rocky spot where the farmers have built a wooden shrine.  A path planted on either side with daisies and ornamental grasses leads to the cozy structure.  Two stone cows lie on either side of the path, their necks garlanded with wilted daisy wreaths, their carved eyes flat and glazed looking.

title: [[Shrine to Berengaria]]
description: Although constructed simply and lacking any costly materials, it's obvious this shrine was built with deep devotion.  Finely fitted boards of elm form the walls of the small structure, while the plank floors are covered with a freshly woven oat-straw matting.  The murals on the walls are simple but painstakingly done.  Copper cowbells hang around the perimeter, and sound low clungs in the breeze that blows in the door.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: A large pile of decomposing weeds lies fetid on the east side of the road.  Judging by the mound they rest on, the farmer across the way has been dumping weeds here for many years.  The pile is decomposing -- slowly -- and the ripe, earthy stench is overwhelming.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The night has drawn its cloak over the quiet fields to the southwest.  You hear an occasional soughing of wind or rustling of vegetation, but other than that all is quiet.  It's too dark to tell what might be planted only a few armlengths away, or what stage of life the plants might be in.

About a dozen farmers are doing something incomprehensibly farmish in the broad field to the southwest.  They're walking back and forth to and from a large cart loaded with something you can't quite make out, carrying baskets.  Scores of birds, black and brown and white and grey, wheel and swoop over the land, prevented from landing anywhere for long by a swarm of children with slings.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Bees circle busily about a huge old oak tree on one side of the road.  Too big to dig out of the field, the farmer apparently thought it better to succumb to the inevitable and leave it.  There are signs that he's harvested honey from the hive, so he's reaped some benefit from his mercy, although the bees, were they capable of considering the matter, would most likely not see it that way.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Two crops meet here at this bend in the road, which follows the boundaries of two different fields ploughed at a slight angle with each other.  The fields to the north are planted in beans, a tall, spreading variety which grows up twined stakes.  Those to the south are planted in kord, a shorter, fibrous plant, yellowish and tangled looking.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
