Its opulent stitchery depicts a kneeling, plate-clad warrior humbly offering his blade to an Alfar whose blazing, unearthly beauty surrounds him with radiance.  A stained glass roundel depicting Elanthia graces the ceiling, traced in gold with the major trade routes of land and sea.  A bright flicker in one corner reveals an extraordinary sculpture -- a crystal phoenix rising amidst real flames.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: The dulcet sound of chanted devotions fills this space, its steady rhythm keeping time with the quiet footsteps that circle the granite Rim.  Cradled within the cauldron of Ve Aevan Gaenan, the temple's High Altar rests beneath the watchful gaze of the Thirteen.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: A red granite arch parts the delicate wall of white plaster, stone meeting stone as the grey passage underfoot continues to circle the inner perimeter of the temple sphere.  Two silver sconces frame the arch, their pale yellow light casting shadows that disappear into the valley of mahogany benches below.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: Visible from the edge of this lofty ridge, the High Altar stands proudly upon a raised platform far below, its metallic surface bathed in the soft light that streams down from the watchful Eyes of the Thirteen.  The Iris Rim continues its circular path around the circumference of this massive chamber, both directions leading toward one of the six arches that line this level of the Temple.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: The circular rim underfoot seems to flow toward the graceful cascade of a pale granite stairway, its procession of worked stone streaming down around a steel-like pillar below.  Opposite the stairway, a pale-green chalcedony arch beckons silently toward the shrine that waits within.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: The wide granite walkway of the Iris Rim curves around the interior of the temple sphere, its circular path visible across the vast expanse of the bowl-like chamber.  Six stone archways are spaced evenly along the entire circumference of the ledge, each poised in silent dignity before the shrine that waits within.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: The edge of the walkway marks a perilous drop to the marble of the Grey Promenade that divides the northeast seating areas of Ve Aevan Gaenan.  Toward the center of the chamber below, grey tiles mingle with those of white and black, uniting to form an elegant mosaic around the High Altar.  An alabaster arch beckons in the opposite direction, providing access to one of the six shrines that line the Iris Rim.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: Following the inner circumference of the Temple, the Iris Rim provides an uninterrupted view of both the High Altar below and the vigilant Eyes of the Thirteen above.  From those thirteen iris-shaped panes of glass, thirteen different colors of cool light touch the chamber below, illuminating with a pale grace.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: Far below, marble tiles of grey, black and white stream outwards from the base of the High Altar, their motley arrangement growing monochromatic as they begin to define the entrances to their respective promenades.  The broad granite ridge underfoot continues its circular progress around the lofty circumference of Ve Aevan Gaenan, granting access to shrines that wait in either direction.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: A dark marble arch stands patiently to the northeast, its base melding seamlessly with the granite that comprises this curving passage.  Any who dare skirt the rim's inner edge risk a cliff-like fall through open air, only a slight breeze standing between this ledge and the white marble tiles below.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Hallway]]
description: From the edge of the Rim, myriad mahogany benches begin their graceful procession down into the bowl of Ve Aevan Gaenan, every seating area intent on the High Altar.  Appearing for a moment like the delicate sheen of a silken fabric, lines of pale yellow light trace shifting patterns over the white plaster walls, wavering in time with a slight breeze that tickles over the sconces circling the ledge's perimeter.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Shrine of Destruction]]
description: The walls of this room are formed of smooth black trachyte, the reflective surface carved with images of Gorbesh soldiers ransacking and pillaging the former temple.  Resting in the center of the shrine, a dull iron altar leans awkwardly, its base cracked and broken.  A fierce depiction of the power of destruction, this room is an eerie reminder that nothing is eternal.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Shrine of Healing]]
description: Designed to honor those who devote their lives to the salvation of bodies and souls, this shrine is decorated with a profusion of flowers and medicinal herbs.  Fresh flowers adorn the wall next to the alabaster arch leading into the hallway, and a collage of dried flowers protected by glass looms over the altar in the back of the room.

title: [[The Iris Rim, Shrine of Thought]]
description: To free the mind for journeying along the pathways of thought, this room is bare of ornamentation, the bustle and din of the outside world held at bay by thick marble walls draped in blue-black velvet.  Deep silence reigns here, and soft darkness surrounds all.  Suspended near the apex of the high arched ceiling is a luminous crystalline sphere, its silvery light falling upon a single white lotus blossom centered on a little sandalwood altar.

title: [[Ve Aevan Gaenan, Southwest Stairway]]
description: From this landing poised just beneath the Iris Rim, a sweeping granite stairway climbs onto the annular ledge above, providing access to the six arches that line the equator of this spherical space, and drawing one toward the watchful Eyes of the Thirteen.  The stairs continue downward in a gentle curve toward the metallic altar, their progress as fluid and graceful as water streaming down a rough face of rock.

title: [[The Southwest Stairway]]
description: The stairway seems to stretch on forever as you climb step after granite step.

title: [[Ve Aevan Gaenan, The Pillar]]
description: Rising from deep within the pale granite, a steel-like pillar stands with regal dignity, its surface carefully etched with the horned owl of Firulf and the great wolf of Meraud.  Its composition strikingly similar to the altar below, the formidable column is capped with a halved sphere of an opalescent mineral whose milky interior swirls with a tamed power.  Spacious seating areas rest on either side of this great marker, each perched in silent vigil high above the sacred altar.

title: [[Ve Aevan Gaenan, Southwest Stairway]]
description: Rows of mahogany benches blend into a continuous sea of darkly stained wood, the wedge-shaped seating area bisected by the clean lines of these granite steps.  Further up the stairs, a thick metallic pillar stands firmly, rooted deep into the foundation as if it had been built around rather than added to the structure.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The hallway continues its curved passage leading to each of the Eyes of the Thirteen.  A narrow wooden staircase, recessed into one wall, is visible as it curves gently downward toward the lower portions of the temple.  To the northwest within the curving passage, sprinkles of some kind of shimmering purple dust are visible on the floor, adding a remarkable contrast of color against the white plaster walls.
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Crossing Temple Eyes of the Thirteen
meta:mapshortname:Crossing Temple Eyes of the Thirteen

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Matte black marble rises in a graceful arch leading to the entrance to a shrine.  Steel dagger hilts, their blades buried in the stone, radiate outwards along the curve of the arch, while the keystone is carved with the image of a snarling amber-eyed panther.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Finely carved mahogany borders hug the curves of the archway which serves as entrance to the shrine.  A faint corona of ruddy light flows through the arch, bathing the pale paster with a pale reddish tint.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The pale walls of the hallway curve to each side, reflecting on floors of polished marble tile.  Set into the tiles before the entrance to the Shrine of Mortals is an intricate mosaic crafted from multicolored glass.  Diffused blue light pours through the silver-inlaid mahogany archway, setting the glittering mosaic afire with color.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The scent of incense from somewhere nearby wafts through the air, filling the space with a mild, sweet aroma.  Revealed by a narrow arch within a section of the curving walls, a narrow staircase flows upwards and disappears above as it arcs up toward the uppermost areas of the temple.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The curving white plaster walls are tinted a rich luminous green as light flows beneath a gem-encrusted satinwood archway.  Beyond the archway, a silver platform leads out into the Eye of the Serpent.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The hallway continues its circular path within the white plaster walls of the temple.  Perfect mirror images, two cresting waves have been inlaid into the tile floor before a narrow archway leading toward a blue crystal platform.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The cool white walls of the hallway are broken by two pillars of ivory -- a pair of carved mammoth tusks forming an archway to a shrine bathed in amber light.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The gentle glow of candlelight emanates from beneath a lacquered oaken archway, causing fickle figures to dance across the delicate white plaster walls.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: A faint flickering of color and luminescence cascades along the white plaster walls, drifting from the nearby shrines dedicated to the gods and their aspects.  The path of the play of light is broken momentarily as it crosses a narrow archway curving over a staircase leading upwards, deeper into the temple's structure.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Rosy light flows into the hallway from a carved white crystal archway, casting a gentle pinkish tint over the white plaster walls.  The faint sound of music echoes through the air.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Curving along pristine walls of white plaster, a reflection of light, emanating from a translucent jade archway, creates a striking contrast between subtle shadow and dominant light.  Claws, carved with a remarkably realistic effect, stand at the base of the archway, warding off some unseen attack.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: This portion of the hallway is dominated by a polished ebony archway that leads into the Shrine of the Void.  Nothing is visible beyond the arch, as the only light which streams out on to the platform is the weak ambient light from down the hall.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The lacquered mahogany borders that ornament the hallway arc over a break in the curving walls.  Recessed slightly, a staircase curves and vanishes from vision as it gently slopes downwards, faint beams of light visible as they reflect off the surfaces below.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Warm textured layers of rich dark mahogany frame an archway, beckoning towards a golden-hued marble platform.  The faint glow from within the shrine cascades across the stark white plaster walls, lending its warm glow to this stretch of hallway as it curves its way around the temple.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: The lily-white plaster walls gently curve along the corridor, following the spheriform shape of the temple itself.  Through a bleached ash archway along the inner wall, a pale alabaster platform extends out over the High Altar area.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hallway]]
description: Lacquered mahogany trim streaks across the bottom of the white plaster wall as it meanders its way around the gentle curvature of the hallway.  A set of wolf prints sprinkled with deep purple alexandrite dust is sculpted into the floor, leading the way into the shrine which lies beyond the polished black granite archway.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Damaris' Shrine]]
description: Walls draped entirely in black silk fill the length of this platform with shadows that shift from ebon to deep azure as light falls from the dome of midnight-blue glass above.  Barely silhouetted in the gloom is the lithe form of a life-sized obsidian panther depicted in full stalk, the great cat seeming to lead the way towards the room beyond.  Someone has placed a garland of scarlet nightshade around its neck, the blossoms gone fiery against the dark, glassy stone of the sculpture.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Damaris]]
description: Filtering through crystalline stars circling the apex of the midnight-blue dome, beams silvered like moonlight edge a graceful obsidian altar at the end of the platform.  Countless bas-relief nightingales swirl up its sides, wings flared and heads flung back in eternal nightsong.  Encircling its base is a ring of shrike skulls, each polished to the warm glow of old ivory and gleaming with opulent rows of tiny jet and lapis beads.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Everild]]
description: Streaks of red tint the fine crystal dome, cascading over the surface of the altar and down to the lip of the platform.  A single white beam of light pokes through a tiny fracture in the crystal, reflecting brightly upon a polished silver statue.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Everild's Shrine]]
description: Fiery shades of red blaze within the confines of this stark chamber, the light from the temple shining smoothly through the warmth of the crystal resting over the far end the platform.  A gentle tapping whispers throughout the room as a barbed spear suspended from the ceiling strikes softly against a battered shield that hangs above the archway.  Resting silently at the edge of the platform, a statue set in pure silver gazes outward, its vigil over the temple floor below constant and unending.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Truffenyi]]
description: The granite platform sparkles slightly where touched by the diffused light shed by the silvery blue dome.  Silver feathers inlaid in the crystal dapple the surface of a polished granite altar with tiny shadows that almost blend into the stone's already mottled surface.  Rising from the altar's center is an ornately carved triptych statue crafted so seamlessly as to appear an extension of the same stone of the altar.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Truffenyi's Shrine]]
description: A silvery blue dome erupts from the wall above, creating a hemisphere to enclose the shrine in hues that mimic the summer sky.  Sunlight filtering through the crystal from the chamber beyond fills the room with a steady glow that sparkles where it touches silver specks in the dark granite platform beneath you.  Sitting near the archway, an obsidian stand is tipped slightly beneath the paws of an impish agate weasel, leaving a silver magpie on top to backwing as its perch is pushed out from under it.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Hav'roth]]
description: A faceted green crystal dome encases the end of the smooth silver platform, giving the shrine the appearance of being trapped within the delicate crystalline structure of an emerald.  The green glow casts itself throughout, as if the only color ever known to this place.  At the edge of the platform, just against the dome, a bejeweled silver triptych statue rests upon a low altar.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hav'roth's Shrine]]
description: The silver platform below you gleams as a sea of liquid emerald, the light striking it tinted by a green crystal half-sphere that encases this small shrine.  Tiny people bustle in and out of the seats in the High Altar chamber below, some likely waiting for the next sermon to begin under the Eyes of the Thirteen.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Eluned]]
description: A rose coral statue rises from its altar base as seamlessly as a wave, silhouetted against a large blue crystal dome that juts out toward the center of the temple.  Filling the space with a bluish glow, faint streams of light accent the ridges and valleys along the carving, granting it a sense of motion despite its lifeless structure.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eluned's Shrine]]
description: Glistening like cool water, a blue crystal platform leads toward a coral statue resting deeper within the Shrine of the Ocean Mother.  Fashioned from the same material as the passage underfoot, a great oval dome curves down to cradle the shrine in the deep blue light found within the heart of the sea.  An indigo glaze marks the center of the colored half-sphere above the far statue, as though this were the eye of Eluned herself, gazing down upon the High Altar below.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Glythtide]]
description: A huge ale-brown crystal dome bows out into thin air, providing an amber-tinted view of the chamber below.  Golden light washes over an altar crafted from thick, twisted grapevines sitting at the end of the platform.  A three-part statue rises seamlessly from the top of the altar.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Glythtide's Shrine]]
description: The arch leading to the hallway is flanked by two large murals depicting key moments in divine history.  They are bathed in a warm amber glow coming from the direction of the platform.  The wash of golden light makes the room seem as if one were viewing it through a mug of pale beer.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Tamsine]]
description: The amber platform ends here, both rows of candles curving around to meet each other behind a low yew altar that stands just before the end of the pale golden crystal dome.  The candlelight gleams brightly against the sloping window, creating an illuminating halo about a yew triptych statue that rests upon the altar.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Tamsine's Shrine]]
description: A pale golden crystal dome extends outward from the wall to surround the amber platform which stretches out from beneath the lacquered oaken archway.  Two rows of Halfling-high candles line either side of the platform, casting an inviting glow throughout the entire shrine.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Faenella]]
description: Bathed in a pale rose hue from the light flowing through the moonlight ruby colored dome, the mirror-paneled chamber reflects multiple images of the carved rosewood statue upon the altar at the edge of the platform.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Faenella's Shrine]]
description: Mirrored panels line the reflective glass of the platform, echoing the image of the altar located at the front of the shrine from innumerable different angles.  Light ripples in through the ruby-colored dome that arcs over the shrine, casting everything in the room with a pink hue.  An elaborately carved crystal archway leads into the hallway.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Chadatru]]
description: Formed out of seamless translucent jade-colored crystal, a dome extends out beyond the platform that supports it, drawing in an eerie reflection of light from the exterior of the dome.  Sculpted from jade is a simple altar that extends outward, upon which rests a translucent triptych statue that stands as mute sentry to its surroundings.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Chadatru's Shrine]]
description: Walls of jade edged in mahogany line the shrine, creating the feel of a clouded atmosphere.  Finely carved from mahogany and possessing startling lifelikeness, lions peer out beyond their posts with an eyeless gaze.  Translucent jade forms a platform that extends outward, towards a muted dome, while an archway leads back toward the hallway.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Urrem'tier]]
description: The artificial light brought into this chamber seems feeble and choked, as if struggling for its own life amidst the blackness that saturates this small shrine.  A giant obsidian dome envelops the glossy jet platform, trapping the chamber in eternal darkness.  Resting flush up against the dome on the edge of the platform is a low onyx altar upon which rests a strange statue.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Urrem'tier's Shrine]]
description: A sea of inky shadows is all that is visible deeper within the black glass dome.  The glossy jet platform gleams with what little light filters through the polished ebony archway that leads back into the temple halls.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Kertigen]]
description: Gazing out over the temple floor, a statue atop the altar rests protected by a fine crystalline dome covering the end of the platform.  The light from the temple, shaded to a rich golden yellow, washes over the heavily adorned sculpture.  Its wealth of gems and precious metals splash tiny reflections on every surface, a sea of shining stars across a sunlit sky.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Kertigen's Shrine]]
description: Flecks of platinum and gold embedded in the marble floor shimmer softly in the warm serene glow of light filling the area as it seeps through the sunlight-colored dome.  Resting quietly on the end of the platform, a scintillating statue of glimmering crystals and precious metals stands in reverence to the god of riches.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Hodierna]]
description: The air itself seems to glow here as the light from beyond the dome filters through in a luminous blur.  At the end of the platform, nestled up against the crystal, stands a low white marble altar which rises seamlessly upward into a magnificent triptych statue, basking in the nimbus of pearly light that permeates this place.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Hodierna's Shrine]]
description: The platform is surrounded by a large opaline crystal dome.  Leading out to the hallway of the temple, a bleached ash archway stands as noble sentry, guarding this sacred shrine.  Faint etchings have been made in the pale alabaster floor, leading inward toward the end of the crystal half-sphere.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Eye of Meraud]]
description: The gem-kissed wolf tracks end their journey at an inscription carved before a polished black granite altar veined in deep purple alexandrite.  Sitting on top of the structure is a stunningly detailed statue sculpted from polished granite as dark as the stone from which the altar is made.  Encompassing the platform is a faceted dark crystal dome that refracts the incoming light with the glow coming from the braziers into a dimly hued array of color and shadow.

title: [[Eyes of the Thirteen, Meraud's Shrine]]
description: Carved alexandrite-dusted wolf prints continue their trek over a black onyx platform, making their way towards a polished granite altar set at the darkened far end.  On either side of the dome are black steel braziers that are lit with eerie purple flames, setting a surreal ambience in the room.  The lighting caresses its way across the four intricate carvings lined on either side of the tracks set into the platform.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: The scent of fresh baked bread and a multitude of herbs wafts from a narrow arch as the cramped hallway continues its curved path leading from one section of the monks' quarters to the next.  A niche in one wall leads to a staircase that provides access to the lower sections of the temple.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Dining Room]]
description: A silver plaque, adorned with the stylized rendition of a rearing unicorn, hangs on the wall above a circular oak table that fills most of this room.  Torcheres line the walls and fill the small space with a gentle light and the everpresent mild scent of smoke.  A narrow red rug lines the barely passable space between the fixtures and the chairs that surround the table.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: The plaster walls are accented with red mahogany borders at both the ceiling and floor as the hallway continues its circular path.  A small wooden door carved with a tiny trail of vines along each of its four sides stands welcoming against the southern wall while an ebonwood door blocks further passage in a clockwise direction.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, West Dormitory]]
description: The little room glows with yellow light from a row of candles set upon a narrow wooden ridge along the southern wall, lending warmth to otherwise drab surroundings.  Two narrow bunk beds stand flush against one wall, each draped with neatly folded woolen blankets.  Piled precariously in the corner, a stack of books has been placed upon a makeshift bookshelf formed from three planks of mahogany.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: Small sconces line the walls.  Maintained by the temple's monks, they provide ever-present light within the passages.  A mahogany door stands proudly at the end of the hallway, the gentle glow from the candles making the polished wood glisten with a reddish hue.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Library]]
description: Glass-covered bookcases hug the walls, protecting the various tomes from the rough hands of time and dust.  Small cushioned chairs fill the center of the room and provide a comfortable space for monks, scholars or those simply filled with curiosity to read the treasure of stories, histories and accounts that fill the shelves.  Carefully tended by the monks to guard against fire or smoke damage, candles have been lined along the mahogany molding.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: A bleached pine door, surrounded by a molding carved to depict sirese flowers in full bloom, stands to the east toward the rim of the sphere while a highly polished ebonwood door blocks passage at the southern end of the hallway.  The light scent of amber wafts within the walls from two oil burners mounted into the white plaster, filling this otherwise confining space with a sense of warmth and welcoming.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, East Dormitory]]
description: Warm light drifts from four tall candle holders placed in each corner of the room, casting a gentle glow upon a watercolor painting on the east wall.  A wooden desk is cramped between two small bunk beds, each draped with a red wool blanket.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: A bleached pine door stands silently on the east side of the curved hallway, the scent of amber emanating slightly from the room beyond.  The white plaster ceiling slopes in a gentle curve above the door, bringing attention to a watercolor mural.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Meditation Room]]
description: Ten willow-reed mats circle a single oil lamp which gives off the faint, wafting scent of burning amber.  The aroma induces a feeling of calm and serenity, creating the perfect environment in which to spend hours in prayer and meditation.  A large plaque is centered above a tall fern on the far wall.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: A panel of glass between the white plaster walls blocks the northern end of the passage.  Various plants growing heartily are visible beyond, the heavy scent of dirt managing to waft its way through and filling the hallway with a metallic, earthy scent.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Li Stil rae Kwego ia Kweld]]
description: Fragrant smoke drifts from censers to carry periodic ripples of sound from the rooms beyond, bringing the silvery chime of bells and rhythmic cadence of chant to rise and fall in the air like the heartbeat of the Temple itself.  An ivory rug cloaks the floor, surrounding an altar of translucent obsidian swirled with fiery highlights.  Stained-glass gaethzen orbs circle the altar with a misty nimbus of violet light shading to crimson and then to amber and gold -- the colors of dawn and of life renewed.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Chamber of Rains]]
description: Softly luminous gaethzen orbs hang suspended from polished brass chains.  The delicate-looking globes are draped with gauzy fabric in a myriad of soft blues and greens.  The veined granite of the far wall has been chiseled into a three-dimensional mural resembling lush foliage.  Gentle pattering laughter of a spring shower fills the room as water from a hidden source cascades in wide rivulets down the sculpted flora.  Large tapestry cushions carpet the floor with embroidered verdure.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: Hanging from a golden brazier is a colorful wreath of branches bearing dark green leaves.  Sprinkled amongst the verdant boughs are pea-sized dirdel flowers of fiery red bearing triangular silver foliage.  The wreath adds a bit of color to the hallway of drab white.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hearth Chamber]]
description: Flames crackle merrily in a large circular fireplace set upon an elevated flagstone dais in the center of the room.  A wrought iron hood is attached to a ventilation shaft which rises upward, leading to a grate on the far wall.  Fine mesh screens enclose the blaze, intricate patterns in the links forming the shadowy images of the thirteen avatars.  Richly woven panels of warm russet wool trimmed with heavy gold braid line the stone walls.  Thick black bearskin rugs carpet the floor beneath leather divans.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: The long, slightly turning, white plaster walls are interrupted by a mahogany staircase leading upward.  The granite floor is slightly scuffed here, perhaps by the countless feet that have trodden upon it, or perhaps by some heavy object having been pushed along.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: A golden candelabra, its treasured flame flickering in the passing breeze of each supplicant moving through the temple halls, casts a soft glow about the curving corridor.  The evened floor of cold granite absorbs what little warmth and comfort the tiny blaze gives off.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: Flanked on either side by white plaster barriers, this smooth granite floor displays the image of a painted starburst pattern.  In the center of the bright red ornamentation, a white flower blooms as though newly touched by spring.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: A low relief has been carefully carved into the rough granite overlooking a mostly nondescript arch, and through the wide arch the twisting granite-hewn steps of an ascending staircase can be seen.  The protruding depictions of the relief portray a group of people before what may be the sun.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Triage Hall]]
description: This brightly-lit interior is devoid of decoration, the utilitarian design allowing healers to focus on evaluating the wounded.  Patients are directed toward treatment according to severity and degree of life threat, and straw-filled pallets line the perimeter of the room for the most severe cases.  The walls have been scrubbed clean, their faint citrus smell not quite masking the coppery scent of blood.  Fresh rushes spread across the floor help to absorb the inevitable spills of bodily fluids.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Hallway]]
description: The smooth arcing is just barely noticeable in the oblique hallway extending throughout the lower walls of the temple.  The curving white plaster partitions enclosing the corridor are adorned in spots by brown woolen tapestries depicting scenes ranging from a prostrate monk to a rearing unicorn.

title: [[Resurrection Creche, Dispensary]]
description: A bustle of activity greets each fresh arrival of wounded.  Long rows of narrow cots covered with immaculate white linen are reserved for recovering patients.  Empaths move efficiently through the room, offering words of comfort as they check on the status of their charges.  The smooth granite walls are adorned along the upper border with a brightly painted plaster frieze depicting long garlands of medicinal herbs interspersed with jadice flowers.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Kitchen]]
description: This small kitchen is as warm and full of wonderful scents as a Halfling grandmother's.  A pine sideboard is draped with a cheery red tablecloth, and a large iron stew pot sits atop a simple wood stove.  Sconces cover the walls between narrow cupboards, filling the windowless room with a soft glow and the scent of smoke mixed with herbs and fresh baked bread.  A crowd of pots and pans hangs from the ceiling, making it impossible to pull one object down without sending all the others toppling to the floor.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: A door formed from bleached pine wood and another of frosted glass stand on either side of this short hallway.  Near the uppermost portion of the sphere, this passage is remarkably constricted, every amount of space having been preserved for the monks' living areas.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Garden]]
description: The floor of this room has been structured to extend further toward the center of the sphere.  Panels of glass surround it, allowing sunlight to filter through the skylight on the top of the temple and feed the ever-hungry plants and herbs that grow here.  Rows of shelves fill the semi-circular room, permeating the space with color and the scent of growth.

title: [[Monks' Quarters, Gardener's Room]]
description: This entire room is filled in every nook and cranny with flowers, plants and herbs.  Some have been carefully wrapped with thin cotton cloth as one would a fresh wound.  A tiny cot just fits between two large potted ferns whose leafy tendrils cascade down and drape across the floor.  In one corner, a large wicker basket is filled with dirt-stained garden tools.

title: [[High Priestess' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: Granite benches provide a place to sit for those waiting to hold audience with the High Priestess of the temple.  The door to her office is fashioned from mahogany, carved with the crest of the guild of clerics which is encircled by two palm leaves.  Tendrils of smoke carrying the scent of exotic incense float lazily through the archway, drifting up from the monks' quarters below.

title: [[High Priestess' Quarters, Hallway]]
description: Each step echoing from the cool marble floor of the hallway reverberates against the temple's plaster walls, intruding upon the monastic silence.  A faint breeze, redolent with the sweet fragrance of flowers and the spicy aroma of herbs, drifts down a narrow winding staircase, while the muffled sounds of distant chanting floats up from the temple below.

title: [[High Priestess' Quarters, Private Chambers]]
description: Comfortable furnishings clutter this cramped bedchamber, the need for function competing with the limits of the space.  A flickering pool of light plays over a tiny writing table near the mahogany door, cast by a tallow candle.  In the center of the room, a mahogany bed nestles amidst teetering stacks of books and parchments fallen from a shelf along the wall.

title: [[High Priestess' Quarters, Defense Control]]
description: Two large cambrinth-framed mirrors -- one oval, the other rectangular -- seem out of place as the only attempt at decoration in this chamber.  A rounded marble console emerges fluidly from the wall as though part of the same stone, or sculpted by magic.  Atop the console, a series of unusual gems are arrayed on the surface of a bronze panel.

title: [[High Priestess' Quarters, Office]]
description: A dark wooden desk sits before a small window that looks over the temple below.  Bronze braziers stand to either side of an iron-bound door, their glowing embers providing light and warmth to the office of the key religious leader of the province.  Two wooden chairs provide a place to sit for those who would seek advice or counsel with the High Priestess of the great temple.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: Well-tended rows of herbs and flowers stretch in leafy array over the convex surface, reined in by a sturdy railing that guards against a perilous drop from the steepening curve of the dome.  A gravel path trails between the rows and rises gently toward a spire that juts from the center of the roof.  The fire from the top of the nearby watchtower flares faintly against the warm light of day.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: City sounds rise as a complex melody from the Crossing's teeming streets, drifting aimlessly before fading into the breeze like the smoke that rises from the vents beyond the railing.  The crunch of the gravel path underfoot, the vibrancy of the plants, and the silent spire of the beacon at the center of the roof all contribute to the sense of remoteness from the busy world below.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: Sturdy, thick planks of wood curve around the perimeter of the garden.  A small streamer of ivy has wound around the railing and swings gently with every gust of wind.  The breeze bears with it the reeking scents of the Segoltha River mingled with the sharp tang of smoke from the nearby watchtowers.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: A small rosebush clings to the railing, swooning gracefully against its strong support.  Other, better behaved flowers nestle in the thin soil surrounding the gravel paths and flourish among the herbs.  Their blooms follow the sun on its course through the sky's dome, halting only when the shadows of the watchtowers and beacon spire fall across them.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: Here at the northernmost point of the roof garden, a massive watchtower rises beyond the wooden railing, mostly blocking the view of the city below.  The expanse of smooth slate on the tower is mirrored in the metallic beacon spire opposite it at the center of the garden.  A gravel path leads toward the spire and stretches through the rows of leafy plants.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: The scent of rich loam rises from a mounded heap of dirt from which the monks replenish the garden.  Ivy has gained a foothold in the soil and drapes thickly over the wooden slats, stretching toward the skylights and the curve of the temple below.  One tenacious strand crawls along the gravel path, slowly making its way toward the beacon spire.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: A curious sculpture in the shape of a plant with clear leaves stretches low to the ground, taking up much of this patch of soil and swaying gently near the edge of the gravel path.  Sparkles of sunlight dance along the structure, which radiates in thirteen points from its center stalk.  The leaves chime faintly when they brush against the stones and the railing.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, Gardens]]
description: When the wind shifts, smoke from the watchtower directly southeast drifts through the slats of the railing and across the path.  The flourishing plants appear not to suffer for it, however, and thrive in the rays of the sun.

title: [[High Priestess' Sanctuary, The Beacon]]
description: At the center of the dome's surface is a thick metallic spire that rises into the sky, the conjunction of the paths from the edges of the roof and the focus of the three watchtowers.  It is to here, in times of trouble, that the greatest defenses of the temple -- and the city -- are summoned.  The silvery surface of the beacon is cool to the touch, even on the sunniest of days.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: Diffuse golden light falls from somewhere above, its honeyed beams drifting down the length of the tower.  Matched flagstones of deep grey slate create a broad landing that punctuates the staircase as it continues its gradual climb.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: Cool air sweeps into this space, as though drawn down the flight of neat granite stairs that pierce the shadows above.  Austere white plaster walls circle the stairway, dropping to meet the panels of blue-grey slate that rise along the base of the floor.  A wide band of hammered gold borders the slate, gleaming like the edge of dawn between mountains and sky.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: A circular platform marks the terminus of the stairway, the tower itself soaring upward to culminate in a deeply vaulted ceiling.  Lanterns faced with heavy amber glass are set along the walls, imbuing the very atmosphere with a golden tint.  Blazing overhead are swirls of gold leaf hammered into the plaster to form the image of a sun in full glory circled by countless stars.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: Little breezes eddy up and down the stairway as it continues, its structure angling slightly with the tower walls.  Touches of scrollwork and gilt rendering it ornate, a hammered iron railing clings to the edge of the flight, the whole atmosphere so suddenly aerial that it is almost dizzying.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: The stairway's journey is interrupted by a narrow landing that grants access to a polished acanth door and a graceful ebonwood arch that stands adjacent to it.  Opposite the portals, the tower walls fall away, fading into velvety darkness below and rising into a haze of amber-tinted light above.  Latticed shadows flicker against granite and plaster, cast by the ornate iron railings edging the flight.

title: [[Temple, North Tower]]
description: Flowing into a wide landing of polished granite flagstone, the stairway curves to meet an iron-banded acanth doorway before moving onward again.  Flanked by torches in tall gold cobra sconces, the portal falls directly under the gaze of its elegant guardians.  Hoods flared wide and metallic scales gleaming, the golden serpents stand silent vigil, eternally poised to strike.

title: [[Temple, North Watchtower]]
description: Climbing from the grandiose chamber of sun and stars, a bronzed ladder peeks out onto the summit of the Temple's north tower, the vast expanse of Elanthia stretching out to meet the sky in every direction.  A roaring fire dances within the hold of a giant steel brazier, its appetite fed with devoted regularity by those who stand watch in defense of the temple, and the Crossing as a whole.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northwestern Face]]
description: Dark metal joins fine-grained wood as the bridge flows up to meet the threshold of the North tower's archway.  Overhead, the tower's expanse looms to shadow the bridge, inclining towards the temple and conveying a sense of protectiveness that seems somehow fitting in this place.  To the northeast, barely visible behind the curved side of the tower, a blue-white sparkle reveals the crystal skylight of the Paladins' Guild.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northwestern Face]]
description: Finely-articulated metalwork and neatly placed bolts convey strength and stability - a harmony to the more ethereal sensibility that comes as the inevitable result of hanging suspended in midair.  Little breezes whip up in random directions, then fade as quickly as they appear, carrying momentary hints in scent and sound of the life of the city that sprawls below.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northwestern Face]]
description: Dark as velvet against the far horizon, the edge of the Forest of Night slips up to tease at the outskirts of the settlements and ferry landings scattered along the banks of the Segoltha.  Below, the streets and avenues of Crossing meander in an orderly crosshatch, bounded by the shops, taverns, and guildhalls of this busy thoroughfare.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northwestern Face]]
description: Lifting gracefully to meet the sky, the Southwest tower curves over the domed bulk of the temple itself.  A heavy acanth door that guards access to the tower's interior at this point adjoins the web of wood and metal that forms a narrow walkway stretching upward and to the north.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: Warmer air rises here, suffused with streams of pale emerald light from above that bathes polished granite flagstones in verdant illumination.  Laid end-to-end, the stonework comprises a narrow landing that runs between an iron-banded acanth door and a carved ebonwood arch.  Clinging to the opposite wall, the staircase climbs onward, angling with the superstructure of the tower itself.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: Its dark iron railings gleaming with copper fretwork, the stairway bends to adjoin a heavy acanth door and a polished ebonwood arch.  Fluted brass poles that flank both openings bear ornately sculpted scorpions grasping blazing torches in their claws.  Tails arced gracefully over their backs to display their distinctive curved sting, the metalwork creatures steadfastly face the portals that lead away from this place.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: An interweave of light and shadow plays across the plastered walls and along the stairs, touching surfaces with random patterns that shift with the torchlight filtering through the air.  A mud honeycomb of swallows' nests is tucked high in one corner, though the feathered denizens are currently nowhere in sight.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: Faint sounds from somewhere outdoors undo the silence and tease through the air, though they cannot be fully discerned from within these thickly reinforced walls.  Polished granite floors subtly shaded from grey to dark ivory are swept clean, surrounding the stairway that lofts towards the next level of the tower.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: Darkness steals into the room from the tunnels on either side, creating pools of shadows in the corners.  Ultimately, though, the gloom is held at bay by oil lamps suspended from the banister of an ironwood staircase wending its way upward.  Warm glints along the walls reveal a fine band of hammered copper that borders a heavy door and continues to edge the granite panels that shield the tower's base from the pressure of the surrounding earth.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Tower]]
description: The stairway ends at a rounded platform surrounded by copper lanterns set with vivid emerald glass.  Surging upward past the platform, the tower arches into a massive canopy of mosaic greenery that mantles protectively overhead like the veiled boughs of a forest glade.  Beams of light and the gemstones of the mosaic combine in a lush overlay of textures and hues ranging from dusky jade to the dazzling green of early spring.

title: [[Temple, Southwest Watchtower]]
description: Bright points of fire leap from the northern and southeastern towers, their proud light joining the blaze that roars within the brazier here, fitting the Temple with a triangular crown of flame.  Centered atop the temple orb that rests cradled between these three ironwood talons, a spire of dark metal rises into the sky with an almost liquid grace, casting a shadow that hints at the time of day.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Southern Face]]
description: Brought to life by the dense grain of ironwood, a graceful pattern of dark lines courses over the surface of this tower, flowing naturally around a carved ebonwood arch like water around a midstream boulder.  A narrow landing grants access to the spindly bridge descending eastward, a soft jade light from within the arch beckoning in the opposite direction.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Southern Face]]
description: Poised high above the magnificent approach to the temple's entrance, this narrow walkway looks out upon a glorious panorama of the southern horizon, the canopy of Leth Deriel barely visible in the distance.  On all but the most still of days, a crisp breeze whips over the handrail, insistently tugging at loose clothing and hair with a playful vigor.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Southern Face]]
description: From this lofty vantage point the Forest of Night stretches across the southern horizon like a malevolent shadow, its dark influence held back only by the moving waters of the Segoltha.  The confident strength of the temple is an almost tangible presence behind this spinneret bridge, its massive structure serving as a mighty shield against all who would oppose the Thirteen.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Southern Face]]
description: Stretching across the sky like a strand of nightstalker webbing, a narrow bridge climbs the distance between the curving ironwood monolith just to the east and its counterpoint far to the west, wound cable and metal bolts reflecting the light of day.  A polished acanth door breaks the smooth surface of the proud tower, a wavering blue-green light shimmering from within.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Lower Southern Face]]
description: A faint scratching of metal on metal sounds with every strong gust of wind, the narrow bridge that descends to the east shifting to test its tower-bound supports.  A polished ebonwood arch waits at this dark landing, its graceful curve complementing the sleek lines of the ironwood spire to which it grants access.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Lower Southern Face]]
description: Swaying gently in time with the breezes that rise from the Segoltha and the Oxenwaithe, this spindly bridge proves more sturdy than one might expect, confidently climbing to meet the Temple's southwestern tower.  Tumultuous activity along the waterways seems serene from this distance, ships and workers moving in unison like dancers upon a great stage of sea and wood.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Lower Southern Face]]
description: The composite bridge rises steadily to the west, wound cable and sanded planks spanning the distance between the towers that stand to the east and west.  Several stories below, a majestic walkway climbs its way toward the Temple entrance, charting a proud path from the massive walls that surround this holy ground.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Lower Southern Face]]
description: Broken only by a reinforced acanth door that leads within, the thick ironwood of the southeast tower flows in graceful curve to embrace the tremendous swell of the Temple.  A bridge woven of metal and wood traverses the space between this landing and the tower to the west, angling upwards to meet a distant opening in the southwestern spire.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Watchtower]]
description: The din of daily life fades to a distant memory atop this curved tower of ironwood; the shifting breeze tugging at anything that breaks the platform's smooth surface, the roar of a brazier-held flame filling the air with its constant hunger.  Turning slowly, one can devour every vista Zoluren has to offer, the view broken only by leaping fires atop each of the other two towers.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: Rows of silver lanterns set with blue glass fill this room with a wash of sapphire and send cyan beams down the expanse of the tower.  In their final upward sweep, the curving walls have been cloaked in a celestial mural.  Great wheeling spirals of silver-gilt stars whirl high overhead against a midnight-blue background, as though the vault of heaven itself made its abode here.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: A fall of azure-tinted light bathes this space, shafting downward from some loftier origin and causing patches of verdigris on the iron railing to shade from green to deep blue.  The stairway pauses and broadens toward a polished acanth door and a reinforced ebonwood arch, then climbs to meet the light, angling steadily upward between the encircling walls of the tower.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: The stairway ascends into a pool of shadows above, slight depressions in the heavy wood marking the passage of others who have traveled this way.  A tracery of silver flows up the railing, the simple adornment brilliant against the deep black of the ironwork.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: Faint sparkles mark tiny crystalline inclusions within granite flagstones set along a landing that is just wide enough to allow free passage in and out of a reinforced acanth door and a polished ebonwood arch.  Between them, a pair of silver lion sconces bearing blazing torches sends thin wisps of smoke up the stairway.  Polished to a high sheen, the great cats grip their burden with deeply curved claws, their steady gaze encompassing both the door and the arch.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: Air carrying the light freshness of the outdoors eddies in little zephyrs about the room, making random figures in the dust that has been tracked across the stone floor.  Curving slightly to meet the wall, the staircase smoothly rounds the tower, dappled in angular patterns from the shadows cast by its cast iron railing.

title: [[Temple, Southeast Tower]]
description: Blocks of precisely fitted granite compose the floor, matched by heavy beveled reinforcing slabs that rise halfway up the walls to frame a polished mahogany door.  A wide strip of hammered silver gleams at the intersection where the subdued greys of granite abut the expanse of whitewashed plaster, the whole surrounding an ironwood staircase that rises into shadows above.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northeastern Face]]
description: Rising out of earth that is still scarred from the old temple's destruction, the Southeast tower rises victoriously upward, its very existence a rebuke to defeat.  A reinforced ebonwood arch offers entry to its inner recesses, while from its threshold and coursing to the north leaps a bridge of metal and wood that appears almost delicate in comparison to the heavy portal.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northeastern Face]]
description: No other construct vies for position here.  The only concrete presence is the bridge itself -- dark ironwood against darker metal, the sweep of cable and subtle glint of bolts -- the whole framed by a great arc of sky.  Standing silent and vigilant at its distant endpoints are the towers marking the southeastern and northern aspects of the temple.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northeastern Face]]
description: Staring out over a sweeping cable handrail, the distant east wall of Crossing follows a meandering path along the edge of the city below, its earthen spine struggling to rein in the varied buildings that span a giant arc from the base of the temple.  The dark peaks of the Lesser and Greater Fists spear the horizon far to the north, the ruined tower of Arhat to the northeast a testament to the threat that once called those spires home.

title: [[Tower Bridges, Upper Northeastern Face]]
description: Curving slightly to embrace the massive globe of the temple, an ironwood tower rises from the ground like a dark scimitar, its profile marking the northern vertex of this proud structure.  A composite bridge of metal and wood leads away from the tower's polished acanth door, climbing steadily toward the distant southeastern support.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The tunnel, while oft traveled by foot traffic between the Temple Towers, stubbornly clings to the hallmarks of under-use.  Cobwebs drape from the ceiling like funerary shrouds, and a thin layer of dust settles and resettles across the floor.  Torch sconces reach out from the tunnel walls, as if beseeching any passerby to stop and live for a moment in this lifeless place.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The passage here is cool and dry; a strange, musty scent emanates from the surrounding semi-darkness and fills the still air.  The remains of an intricate mosaic, its tiles broken and scored from the dragging of a heavy object, can be seen on the floor.  A large cobweb holds the dried husk of a small rodent, a reminder that life is still forfeit even on the temple grounds.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: This section of the tunnel has remained unvisited by maintenance workers for many years.  Bronze oil lamps, green with verdigris, are fastened to the walls, their small beacons of light long since extinguished.  In tattered shreds, the remains of an elegant tapestry hang from the wall.  The once-luxurious fabric is fragile and rotted now, useful only as nesting material for vermin.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: Empty torch sconces cling forlornly to the soot-streaked riverstone slabs of the tunnel walls, the light and warmth that once bedecked this dreary hall long since extinguished.  Cast by the merest glimmer of illumination from elsewhere in the corridor, long shadows flick and shudder across the drab stonework like the silent flight of bats at twilight.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: Perhaps, in some time past, the tunnel was breached by nature's wrath, or by foe unknown; this section has seen recent reconstruction.  New mortar stands out in stark contrast to the dull grey of the older stonework, giving a sense of hope and life to this otherwise dreary passageway.  Torches burning brightly in brass sconces bring some semblance of warmth to the chill atmosphere of the tunnel.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: Evidence of new construction -- fragments of chiseled stone and splinters of new wood -- lie scattered about the tunnel floor.  The stone walls have been cleaned and appear to be in the process of being polished.  Perhaps as a jest, some of the stoneworkers have discreetly imprinted their initials in the new mortar.  A worker has left behind a small cloth apron, its hem firmly trapped in the tight joint between two wall slabs.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: This section of the tunnel has seen some recent renovation.  The walls have been scrubbed, and much of the dust and debris collected over the ages has been swept off the floor.  Bright, new mortar gives a hint of recent repairs to the cracked and crumbling mortar of the older stonework.  New sconces have been fastened to the walls, and brightly burning torches bring light and warmth to the cold stone of the passage.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: Vast slabs of riverstone interlock with barely visible seams along the tunnel's walls.  The stones' imposing size lends this passage a silent, brooding air, a sense of majesty requiring reverence.  Some skilled craftsman has laid an intricate mosaic on the tunnel floor, though its image and the story it conveys are now obscured beneath a layer of dust and soot.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The stone walls and floor have been blackened by fire in this area.  Scattered about the floor are the charred remains of what might have been a wagon, and several flame-scarred barrels, recruited as nesting places for vermin, have rolled up against the walls of the tunnel.  Hanging between two small oil lamps, a once-elegant tapestry is now a scorched and tattered rag, the story it told greedily consumed by the fire.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The hands of time have been hard at work in this section of the tunnel; several of the large stones lining the walls have become loose and tumbled to the floor.  Small rodents can be heard scurrying in the darkness, perhaps the only creatures capable of thriving in this underground habitat.  The fallen blocks of riverstone and crumbling mortar serve as a reminder that even the strongest of constructions is no match for the march of time.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The tunnel, clearly constructed by master masons, has withstood the passage of time.  Gigantic slabs of riverstone, laid across the walls, form the ceiling of this corridor.  The sheer size of the individual stones lends a claustrophobic effect to the passage, a sense of impenetrable confinement and closeness.  Small bronze oil lamps, fastened to the walls, dispel the darkness with warmth and light.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: This section of the tunnel has received the careful attention of several skilled workers in the recent past.  Cracks and gouges in the stone walls have been repaired, and loose, broken masonry has been replaced.  The new stone, clean and polished, contrasts dramatically with the older stonework of the walls.  Torch sconces, recently corroding pieces of metal, have been restored to their original brilliance.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: A penetrating chill shrouds this part of the tunnels in a dreary gloom.  Bronze sconces line the corridor walls, and sputtering torches generate a feeble yellowish glow that does little to dispel the cold.  Cobwebs, covered with dust, drape the passage walls and hang listlessly from the ceiling.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: Deep grooves have permanently marred the floor of the tunnel, evidence of the passage of a great weight.  The once brightly polished walls now bear the scars and gouges of a battle with an unknown assailant.  The sturdy riverstone was no match for that which has passed.  An ornate tapestry once covering the western wall now lies in a tumbled heap, torn and shredded, home to countless rodents and vermin.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The dark and cold are so pervasive, one might doubt that light had ever fallen on this chill stone, or warmth filled this icy air.  Hundreds of spiders have woven a tangle of cobwebs over the years, and now dust-laden threads cling tenaciously to all they touch.  A thick layer of dust covers the tunnel floor and almost obliterates a mosaic that, once a glory of color, is now barely discernible through the grime.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: A section of the tunnel wall has collapsed, causing large pieces of riverstone and mortar to scatter about the floor.  A lone torch sconce stands in silent watch over this area, its partner lying crushed beneath the broken tunnel wall.  The desiccated remains of a small animal lie near the tumbled stone, its wizened form clad in a shroud of thick, grey dust.

title: [[Crossing Temple, Tower Tunnels]]
description: The walls of this passage are constructed from large blocks of riverstone.  Spider webs hang like fishermen's nets from the walls and ceiling, ready to catch unwary prey.  Torch sconces, covered with corrosion and clinging precariously to the walls, once gave warmth and light to the tunnel; now they rest in cold silence.  The chill stone of the passage exudes a dull dreariness, creating a sense of loneliness and abandonment.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: The passageway angles upwards, and a faint breeze whispering through carries lighter scents than the dense odors of wet clay and oily smoke found deeper in the tunnel.  The enveloping shadows here begin to shift almost imperceptibly from black to grey, hinting that there is light somewhere above.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: A massive boulder of pale grey granite - probably too difficult for the tunnelers to remove - has been left in the center of the passageway, with just enough space on either side to slip past.  Chopped into the surface of the rock, in bold and hurried strokes, is the stylized image of a wolverine silhouetted against a full moon.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: Rubble piled along the base of one wall gives mute testimony to the constant, eroding forces of time and damp.  A haphazard arrangement of rocks and planks has been used to reinforce the weak area, and judging from the little tangle of rags and twigs under the planks, some creature of the tunnels has made a home here.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: An abandoned bucket, blackened with the tarry remnants of the building process and overturned against one wall, threatens to ambush the hasty passer-by stumbling along the dimly illuminated corridor.  Underfoot, loose rubble and wooden debris uncleared after the tunnel's creation renders passage perilous and sometimes painful.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: The air is thick with oily smoke that drifts from a lantern hanging from a beam thrust across the ceiling.  Its wavering light outlines a strip of blackened ironwood placed along one edge of the floor and stretching from passage to passage, appearing as though it may run along the entire way through.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: Timbers of alder, slathered with tar against the underground moisture, reinforce the crumbling walls.  Light from the passages on either side sparkles against amber resin that gleams like gold beads against the blackened wood, but does little to lift the surrounding darkness.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: The floor levels out and flows into a wide tunnel that would be filled with darkness if not for a guttering torch jammed between rocks lining the walls.  A faint haze of smoke eddies through the air, propelled by a cool breeze from somewhere beyond.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Kuniyo's Egress]]
description: Rough-hewn blocks of sandstone form a tall arch with a stylized metallic eye gleaming at its apex.  The structure curves over a hard-packed path of earth mixed with clay and pine needles that slopes abruptly down and into darkness.  Stray beams of light reveal that this is no dead-end, barely outlining a narrow passage at the foot of the incline.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: Fragrant rushes crackle softly underfoot, the verdant carpet filling the air with a sharp green scent.  Shadows shift from black to grey, yielding to the stronger light that flows into this passageway as it begins to slope upward, and a little breeze carries the faint, melodious sound of a bell chiming in the far distance.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: A crude alcove has been hacked out of the surrounding stone, creating just enough space to shelter a little shaal wood altar.  Sage leaves and a few sticks of incense fill an engraved copper bowl placed at its center.  A single pure white taper casts diffuse light over the modest offering, the flame's soft illumination throwing the ridged granite walls into sharp relief.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: Shadows hold sway here, blocking any effort to discern detail.  Only the faintest illumination from somewhere ahead limns the edges of the next passageway and highlights a narrow strip of blackened ironwood running along the length of the tunnel.  Occasional soft fluttering from the gloomy recesses of the ceiling indicates that at least some beings welcome the darkness.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: Neat coils of rope lie amid stacks of rubble and the splintered remains of a pickaxe destroyed in the pressure of creating these passages.  Brass rings tinged blue-green with verdigris are set in each wall, each holding torches that fill the room with smoky light.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: White mortar worked into cracks stands starkly against the darker stone, but nature has provided mortar of her own -- the walls are honeycombed with countless mud-daub nests constructed by cave swallows.  Though the nests stand empty at the moment, little drifts of feathers swirling around your feet are evidence that these tunnels represent a sanctuary for even Elanthia's smallest citizens.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: The sharp-sweet scent of lavender and juniper rises all around you -- someone has laid a pathway of rushes over the earthen floor to muffle hurried footsteps and relieve the heaviness of the dank underground air.  Long cracks run down the stone walls, yielding silent evidence of the relentless pressure of the surrounding earth.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Truffenyi's Way]]
description: A stylized eye of some metallic substance is set at the apex of a granite arch that guards the entrance to this room.  Against one wall, a plank between two stacks of clay bricks forms a makeshift shelf, supporting a row of tallow candles in brass holders.  Their flickering illumination, combined with pervasive dampness, imbues the atmosphere with a topaz-hued glow.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Smooth white pebbles give way to neatly-chiseled granite steps angling steeply upward, flanked by an ash pole wrapped in strips of leather that has been staked into the loamy walls to provide a crude handrail.  The barest hint of incense moves through the air, though the darkness above yields no hint of the delicate scent's origin.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: The white pathway climbs ever upward, following the rising angle of the tunnel floor.  A straw broom rests against one wall, mute evidence that someone strives to keep the little path clear and safe for those who may need to traverse it in great haste.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Ruddy clay walls, bisected with veins of some chalky material, begin to press in more closely as the westerly end of the passage angles slightly upwards.  A sooty lantern dangling from a wooden spike thrust into the ceiling sends arcs of pale light into the surrounding gloom, throwing sets of handprints left in the clay into shadowed relief.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Illumination from the passage beyond washes the little pathway in a pearlescent gleam and glints along the edge of a polished slab of dove-grey marble that has been settled into the dirt floor.  Centered on it is a wreath of herbs interwoven with jadice flowers, the soft green of the leaves and the creamy white blossoms making a vibrant contrast in this tunnel that is so far removed from sunlight and sky.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Crumbling clay walls have been reinforced with heavy netting filled with coarse gravel and staked up on either side of the white pathway.  A pair of candles alongside the path flings light through the netting to cast odd, webbed shadows against walls and floor.  High in one corner, a silvery glint reveals a true web, though the tiny master weaver is nowhere in sight.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: The only sounds are the faint hiss of flame from a lantern tucked into a niche, and the soft crunch of the white pebbles underfoot.  Though the great city of River Crossing is somewhere overhead, its bustle and noise cannot penetrate the earthen canopy of this underground walkway.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Plump beeswax candles set in brass sconces throw warm yellow light against walls pitted with marks from the tools used to force a way through unyielding rock and soil.  Coursing through the room and the tunnel beyond is a narrow path of smooth white pebbles, edged with a strip of blackened ironwood.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Hodierna's Path]]
description: Dense walls hacked out of earth and stone curve around a massive arch centered with a stylized metal eye that shadows a series of unevenly-chiseled steps wending their way down into darkness.  Gloom obscures the area beyond, but a chilly draft from below hints at an opening of some kind.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: Soot from a little torch propped in an iron rack has feathered the sandstone walls with streaks of black, echoing the shadows that veil the far reaches of the room.  The passageway narrows and lifts here, bringing the beam-reinforced ceiling closer -- so much so that this space would become almost suffocating if not for the fact that a slight breeze from somewhere ahead cools the air.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: Sudden flashes of light come from all directions, brilliant and momentarily blinding.  Finally, though, one can see that these walls are hung with countless shields -- some near-perfect, others almost destroyed.  Brass and gold, silver and copper are all set ablaze with the reflections cast by torches burning at each end of the room.  On one wall, a small space is left almost clear, occupied only by a simple wooden plaque.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: Half-collapsed scaffolding tilts precariously, left behind by tunnelers more intent on finishing their task than on cleanup.  Yellowish sandstone walls scarred with pick and shovel marks arch overhead, the dark shadows pooled at their apex out of reach of the tentative beams cast from an oil lamp set on a wooden shelf.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: The gentle sound of trickling water fills the room, its source a little runnel that has slipped through a crack to flow down the sandstone wall, leaving crystallized streaks in its wake.  At its origin is a tiny clinging garden of mosses, their velvety, vivid green almost glowing against the paler stone.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: The ceiling of this passageway is ridged with rough half-timbers placed to withstand the pressure of the earth above.  Frayed carpets of azure and burgundy line the floors, their edges curled from the dampness of the earth.  From somewhere just beyond, the sound of running water echoes faintly through the air.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: Pale sandstone dances with the shadows thrown by smoke that drifts from torches set in iron rings bolted into the walls.  A flash of rich color underfoot strikes an unexpected contrast in these stark chambers -- someone has thrown worn rugs along the floor, perhaps to quiet the sound of armored footsteps.

title: [[Crossing Escape Tunnels, Chadatru's Vigil]]
description: Dark granite forms a graceful archway crested by a stylized cast metal eye, flanked by blazing torches in iron sconces.  Layered sandstone walls, rubble and timbers heaped at their base, mantle over a narrow pathway inclining downward and leading into darkness.

title: [[The Healerie, Entrance Hall]]
description: Moss and lichen thickly blanket the walls and floor of the damp underground hall.  At one end, long spiraling oaken stairs hug the side of the shaft that leads up to the main room of the distant Empath Guild.  Near the middle, a walnut ramp goes up towards the Hospital Triage while an arch leads into other areas.  Light reflected from aboveground through an intricate mirror system floods the area.

Moss and lichen thickly blanket the walls and floor of the damp underground hall.  At one end, long spiraling oaken stairs hug the side of the shaft that leads up to the main room of the distant Empath Guild.  At the other end, two swinging doors lead into the Healerie proper.  Near the middle, a walnut ramp goes up towards the Hospital Triage while an arch leads into other areas.  Shielded lanterns light the area.

title: [[The Healerie, Dim Corridor]]
description: The dim light coming through the arch at the end of the corridor delineates the long shadows of those moving about considerably more than it does the features of the people themselves.  The small amount of additional light coming through the doorway halfway down the corridor further accentuates and twists the shadows of those present, playing them across the floor, walls, and ceiling of smoothly polished black stone.  Cool moist air flows over the stone leaving it slick to the touch.

The dim light coming through the arch at the end of the corridor delineates the long shadows of those moving about considerably more than it does the features of the people themselves.  The small amount of additional light coming through the doorway halfway down the corridor further accentuates and twists the shadows of those present, playing them across the floor, walls, and ceiling of smoothly polished black stone.  Cool moist air flows over the stone leaving it slick to the touch.

title: [[The Healerie, The Blue Area]]
description: Thick blue moss and lichen covering the floor absorb the water that falls from the ceiling of this enormous chamber as well as the blood from the many wounded who come here.  A vast forest of stone stalactites stretches from the ceiling above, the largest as big as great trees and bearing strange crystal orbs like fruit.  The orbs shed a strong bluish light that provides adequate illumination for healing.  A silver plaque has been set into the floor near the middle of this area.

title: [[The Healerie, The White Area]]
description: Thick white moss and lichen covering the floor absorb the water that falls from the ceiling of this enormous chamber as well as the blood from the many wounded who come here.  A vast forest of stone stalactites stretches from the ceiling above, the largest as big as great trees and bearing strange crystal orbs like fruit.  The orbs shed a strong white light that provides adequate illumination for healing.  Stalagmites block passage beyond the light where the moss and lichen fail.

title: [[The Healerie, The Viewing Area]]
description: Thick white moss and lichen covering the floor absorb the water that falls from the ceiling of this enormous chamber as well as the blood from the many wounded who come here.  A vast forest of stone stalactites stretches from the ceiling above, the largest as big as great trees and bearing strange crystal orbs like fruit.  The orbs shed a strong white light that provides adequate illumination for healing.  Stalagmites block passage beyond the light where the moss and lichen fail.

title: [[The Healerie, The Yellow Area]]
description: Thick yellow moss and lichen covering the floor absorb the water that falls from the ceiling of this enormous chamber as well as the blood from the many wounded who come here.  A vast forest of stone stalactites stretches from the ceiling above, the largest as big as great trees and bearing strange crystal orbs like fruit.  The orbs shed a strong yellow light that provides adequate illumination for healing.  Stalagmites block passage beyond the light where the moss and lichen fail.

title: [[The Healerie, Lecture Hall]]
description: Large crystals in the upper corners of this room shed a soft glow on the tiers of comfortable seats that look down on the ebony lectern below.  A velvet curtain covers the wall behind the lectern.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Wine Cellar]]
description: As your eyes adjust to the sudden darkness, you see several bookshelves that have been converted into criss-crossed wine racks with a corked bottle in each cubby hole.  The air is cool and dry, making this the perfect storage area for the aging liquid.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Courtyard]]
description: Several wooden benches face the center area of this large courtyard.  An older monk is demonstrating the art of the mace to a young acolyte, reminding you of the lesson of diligence from your youth.  At the far end of the courtyard, a sicle tree grove is being tended by a withered old monk with a serene look on his face.  Opposite the grove, a row of large lunat vats lend an unusual scent to the air.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Gathering Hall]]
