description: Fishing poles, nets and signs proclaiming sales on bait are clear clues that this minuscule village's survival depended on the fishing trade.  Only a handful of homes still stand after so much time exposed to the elements without upkeep, and the doors on most swing open in the sea breeze.  A pier, some distance to the south, juts out into the sea, desperately attempting to escape whatever memories it holds of this deserted village.

title: [[Fever Point, Sailor's Ramble]]
description: Sharp bends and angles in the road lend credence to the story Sailor's Ramble was named for the path stumbled by drunken sailors from pub to beach.  Unlike the seedy, derelict town center, this area has been enjoying a revival of care: fresh paint, colorful curtains, and even a few flowerbeds to replace the weeds.

title: [[Fever Point, Sailor's Ramble]]
description: The road winds back upon itself in a hairpin bend, then slowly straightens as it curves downward toward the ocean.  A few cabins, once temporary housing for sailors awaiting their next berth, rest among the scattered weeds and leaves that edge the dusty path.  Splashes of whitewash here and neatly raked lawns there show the buildings have received renewed care.

title: [[Fever Point, Sailor's Ramble]]
description: Careening northwest, the road makes an abrupt jog toward a massive oak standing at the end of the forest, then abruptly veers just short of the tree's roots to run along the forest line.  Two cairns are set side-by-side on the road.

title: [[Fever Point, Forest]]
description: Hooking west, the road makes an abrupt turn into the forest and meanders among the trees.  At one turn, the path splits before a large camphor tree as though no consensus could be made upon the preferred route, then merges on the opposite side.  A prickly ravelthorn hedge intermingled with esturi bushes bounces the road sharply back toward the south.

title: [[Fever Point, Gully]]
description: Gently swinging southeast, the road dips into a gully and narrows to little more than a footpath used as much by animals as by men.  Brush growing from the gully walls reaches out to tickle passersby, and the occasional thorn to sting them.  Gradually, the sloping walls of dirt flatten to a trail that deposits travelers onto a sandy beach.

title: [[Fever Point, Beach]]
description: Jewel-like shells are nestled in the crooked line of seaweed that marks the beach's high tide line.  The beach curves westward, stopping at a meadow of sharp-bladed sawgrass.  Eastward, the Fever Point Pier juts out over the water, and the soft sand gives way to rocks and stones dumped to prevent erosion.

title: [[Fever Point, Village Inn]]
description: From the size of the building, the inn, ironically named "The Lost Sailor's Refuge," was obviously a mainstay of the fishing village.  A large picture window, now but a boarded-up frame, stares out at the street.  Unlike other structures, the inn's front door has been sealed securely with lengths of rusty chain.

title: [[Fever Point, Woods]]
description: The inclined trail rises from the beach and curves northwest toward the village.  Holes have been dug near the roots of many of the trees -- whether by rodents or residents is unclear.  Scrub pine grows among the larger hardwoods, nearly overwhelming the sea's scents with the smell of resin.

title: [[Fever Point, Beach]]
description: Emerging from the gravel and rocks beneath the pier, the beach continues its graceful arc before disappearing into the line of trees above the beach.  Tufts of yellow flowers grow in the shelter of a tumble of boulders close to the trees.  Footprints dotting the beach, as well as other unnatural disturbances in the sand, hint this is a frequently used area.

title: [[Fever Point, Under Pier]]
description: Gravel and colorful chunks of split rock dumped beneath the pier interrupt the sandy beach's east-west course.  The pier above stretches a large ship's length into the ocean, ending where the water is deep enough to dock a vessel larger than an island skiff.  A slippery coating of salt moss clings to the pilings and hangs from cross-braces overhead.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: To the southwest, the road runs through a covered bridge that crosses a deep gully.  The bridge, barely wide enough for a wagon, has been laboriously pieced together from odd-sized planks cut from driftwood -- signs of both the scarcity of wood and the abundance of free labor.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: Torchlight throws black shadows on the looming bulk of the Colony fortress to the north.  A lane leads up the hill to a deep-set gate, cast in shadow by flaring lanterns hung on either side.

To the north, a lane runs uphill to the grey bulk of the Colony's fortress.  The Desert Gate of the fortress is shut, but the slits in the wall and its parapets suggest (if not guarantee) that vigilant guards are at hand.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: A little south of the fortress walls, the road already shows signs of its disuse.  A well-travelled highway is always marked by litter, old campsites, fresh wheel-ruts, and animal droppings, none of which are in evidence here.  To the west, a lane leads uphill to the fortress gate, and to the southeast, the road curves to avoid an inlet.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: The ancient road, once a thoroughfare along M'Riss's north shore, is surrendering to the elements.  Paving stones cracked and heaved up by frost lie half-buried in sand blown by the constant northwest winds, and a grey-green moss covers their leeward side.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: To the east the road disappears abruptly: the tides have washed away its foundation, and a big section of the paving has simply slid into the encroaching sea.  Not that anyone seems to mind -- there's no sign that traffic has headed eastward in a long, long time.

title: [[Penal Colony, Northwest Ring Road]]
description: A few torches burn atop the Colony Fortress's South Wall.  The shadows they cast partly hide the deep-set Desert Gate.  A lane leads from the gate downhill to where the Island Ring Road bypasses the colony, southwest to northeast.  Aside from a large flat rock and a few scrubby patches of sea-oats, the area is barren.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the South Wall]]
description: Just to the west of the Desert Gate lies a small flowerbed outlined with whitewashed stones.  Someone has tried to nurture a bit of color in the shelter of the wall, providing the daily water and weeding needed.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the Bay Bastion]]
description: This shadowed corner where the south and the bay walls meet has become the home of weeds, the seeds brought by passing gulls and sheltered from the desert winds.  The land slopes steeply down from the fortress wall.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the South Wall]]
description: The ground drops off below the south wall, almost as if someone had planned a moat and begun the digging, only to abandon the job.  Now the desert sands have sifted in, leaving only a curiously regular depression like a dry riverbed.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the Desert Bastion]]
description: The high tower of the Desert Bastion faces rank on rank of dunes receding into the distance.  The wind picks up swirls of sand from their tops, shifting the sands in a slow procession.  If not for the hazy mountains to the southeast, one could believe that the desert went on forever.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the East Wall]]
description: A wide cleared area stretches along the wall from the beach to the north to the desert in the south.  Here, some lazy or careless hand has tossed rubbish from the fortress, and it lies piled at the base of the wall, buzzing with flies.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the East Wall]]
description: As the coastline curves to the east, the dunes give way to a barren, rock-strewn headland, dotted with shallow dips and hollows.  Only an occasional stunted tree or low bush has been spared the clearing of the ground outside the fortress walls.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the East Wall]]
description: The wind whistles and swirls around the Lee Bastion to the north, scouring its seaward face, but in the shelter of the eastern wall huddle a few greyish-green creepers.  The vines, none thicker than a little finger, scratch out a meager living among the rocks, shells, and sand.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the Lee Bastion]]
description: The mighty Lee Bastion anchors the northeast corner of the fortress.  Arrow slits pierce its walls high above and the deep shadows in their recesses hint at the thickness and strength of its masonry.

title: [[Penal Colony, Below the North Wall]]
description: Clumps of sea oats rise from dunes as high as a Halfling.  The dunes follow the shoreline to the west, curving gradually around the prominence on which the fortress stands.  Its walls rise to the south, weathered from the steady ocean winds.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: Just a step into the verge of the forest, the trees become taller, stronger, more majestic, and the undergrowth thins.  The ground looks more open to west yet contradictorily seems darker.  Somewhere overhead, a bird warbles, and its song is answered with a like melody from deeper in the woods.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: Giant red oaks and pines stand widely separated, rank on rank.  Their crowns spread high above, almost blocking out the sky and dimming the light that penetrates to the forest floor.  Travel is easy, the path underfoot softened with a thick layer of needles that hushes each footfall.  The path, perhaps a game trail, follows a small stream that extends from the brushier east off to the west.  A grey, furry object lies near the trail.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: Along its way down the gentle slope, the stream widens into quiet pools as if for some sylvan ritual.  It curves to the southwest, gliding through a forest cathedral dappled with beams of light lancing from the forest crown high above.  The scent of balsam sweetens the air, and even the birds seem hushed in quiet reverence.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: From the northeast the stream eases its way down a shallow valley.  Here and there along its banks a willow or a birch overhangs the edge.  What looks like a reddish stone near one tree proves to be a rusty bascinet.  To the southwest the ground levels again, and the trees look smaller and less imposing.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: A shelf of rock rises from the soil, angling the brook sharply northeast and northwest.  In the pond below the shelf, a small turtle catches flies and contemplates whatever turtles ponder.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: A mixed wood covers the hillside -- fragrant hemlocks and an occasional slash pine stand on the higher ground and broader-leafed, moisture-loving trees in the lower areas.  The stream meanders around hillocks, sending an exploring arm bubbling into side channels here and there, descending the slope to the south and west.  The path mostly hugs the firmer ground but sometimes crosses a softer, wetter patch.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Upper Slopes]]
description: The ground slopes and the stream ripples down a gentle decline, twisting and turning with the lay of the land.  Fewer firs and oaks rise from the moist soil, and more willows and river birches droop slender branches along the path.  The tangy scent of evergreen sap, strong on the steeper slopes to the east, is fainter here.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: Appearing and disappearing, the stream splits and breaks into pools and puddles.  Small rivulets run off right and left, half of them seeping into the forest mulch.  The fallen leaves are wet and slippery underfoot.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: A sharp rise in the forest floor allows a good view despite the dense vegetation: to the east the forests rise, and to the west a vast land lies shrouded in blue mist.  In the distance to the north, though it's difficult to make out through the trees, looms a large outcropping of rock, its peak thrust high above the thick forest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: The path is dim beneath the thick cover overhead, and dimmed further by mist drifting from occasional low-lying patches of ground.  Where the path crosses these dips, the moist earth slightly gives way underfoot.  The drone of mosquitoes has replaced the humming of wild honeybees, and the air feels warm and humid.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: Signs of wildlife are everywhere: squirrels scamper in a stunted elm, rabbit warrens hide in its roots, and the trails of small game lead off into the brush around it.  To the west stands a low knoll that offers a way around the bottoms to the southwest and an escape from the clinging mud.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: At the top of a firm, dry knoll, a curious oak with twin trunks rises high into the air.  Its high, dense crown has held down the undergrowth and allows a view to the west of what looks like an upthrust cliff.  The cliff itself is hard to distinguish from the surrounding vegetation because of its own thick covering.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: Over the years, water has soaked a deep depression between the hills, making every step a chore.  In the dark water, a silvery cypress tree stands like a monarch, scores of roots and knees anchoring it, its limbs covered with moss and vines, reaching up toward the trees on the surrounding hillsides.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: A massive cypress grows on a slight rise just above the waterline.  Its upper branches form a second storey high above the forest floor.  Occasionally something stirs in the canopy above, sometimes raining a shower of leaves and twigs, but nothing ever seems to show its face.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: One of the younger cypress trees stands near the bottom of a slight rise of the land, small only by comparison with the giants to the east, yet one of the few that doesn't seem wrapped in vines.  Still, the lower branches are within reach, and it looks climbable.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: The sound of water splashing comes from the northwest.  A stream curves out from around the base of the outcropping of rock, heading south toward the marsh.  Here at its base, where the cliff looms high overhead, the trees are noticeably thinner than the bigger ones to the northeast.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: A good hundred feet up, a small stream of water spills over the edge of the cliff.  It has worn a slippery channel down the slope, but the channel looks far too slick and steep to climb.  The run-off gathers in pools along the path before seeping into the surrounding bog.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: On the border between the forest giants and lesser trees, water trickles along the ground in innumerable ribbons, heading generally south.  The path is nearly mud, and walking is difficult as it winds among the bushes and vines that swarm up the face of the outcrop.  And the mosquitoes are especially hungry.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: A fallen log lies across the path, sunk half-way in the moist ground.  Moss covers its trunk, softening the outlines, and its upper branches are coated with a hard, white fungus.  A puddle has collected on the eastern, upslope side of the trunk.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: A curious mixture of trees and undergrowth lines the trail: where the path rises, the ground is a bit firmer and drier, with oaks predominating.  But in the hollows, the going is slower, the earth damp and yielding, and alder and willow saplings thrive.  To the south and west, the land is lower still.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: To the west looms a great outcropping of rock, tinted green and grey with moss.  Great trees rise in all other directions but southwest.  On that side, the ground slopes down to a wet, marshy bog, out of which comes a din of frogs croaking and insects buzzing.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, Lower Slopes]]
description: The path has become a yielding muck, hampering movement but not greatly slowing it.  Swarms of the tiny black flies that breed in the marsh are more numerous, almost everywhere, and they all seem to be just at eye-level.  Still lower ground lies through a thicket to the southwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A grove of cypress trees of all sizes spreads in all directions, rooted in the soft, wet bog.  Insects hum and buzz, bubbles rise from the ooze and pop with every step, and unfamiliar cries of birds or animals sound on all sides.  A bramble thicket on a slight rise running northeast to west, or possibly an opening in the trees to the southeast, looks like the only chance of dry, firm footing.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: The ground is soft underfoot, making a liquid sucking sound with every step.  A discarded boot, now a permanent resident, is lodged nearby, half submerged in the mire.  The surrounding woods are full of birdsong, and every so often comes a rustling in the brush or something like a muffled footfall.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: The trail winds between the marsh and the rocky slopes of the Forlorn Hope -- the fabled mountain, Galduta Isharon, visible to the northwest through breaks in the tress.  The stench of decay hangs over the murky brown water lapping along the edge of the path.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: On the crest of a slight rise a massive white oak towers into the sky, a stalwart sentinel.  The ground around the base of the tree is littered with empty acorn caps.  A few slender oak saplings find purchase here and stretch to the sky but are hard pressed to find sunlight in the shade of the behemoth above them.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A rocky outcropping like a tilted tabletop stretches far to the north to a jagged peak jutting into the sky.  Through the ravelthorn bushes to the south and west comes the flash of sunbeams on the Altanen River.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A thicket of alder surrounds a big willow tree, then stretches off to the east -- a pleasantly shady resting spot if the biting flies ever left the swamp.  Occasionally, the wind blows fresh air and the smell of life from across the Altanen, momentarily masking the reek of the bog.  A piece of cloth caught in some ravelthorn bushes flutters in the breeze, near a trail following the rising ground north along the river.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: From the west comes the noise of rushing water -- no small stream, by the sound of it.  Here, in the midst of a thicket of alder and willow trees, the water is still and knee-deep in some places, but a path can be traced by stepping carefully across the roots of the trees.  A shaft of sunlight flashes a reflection from something at the base of a willow.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A game trail, a path for something between the size of a badger and a deer, struggles through a patch of dense underbrush.  The path is wide and well-trampled, but to each side, saplings as thick as an arm have been broken off and scored with deep gouges.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A fair-sized clearing allows the light to reach this one small part of the bog.  One of the giant cypresses has fallen, pulling its neighboring trees down with it, and the tangled remains of broken trunks and shattered limbs are slowly sinking into the mire.  Spindly saplings sprout in the gaping hole and struggle to capture the precious sunlight.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: A gnarled cypress, bent into a wooden parody of a giant bowed under a heavy burden, stands in the muddy soil.  The tree even bears something that resembles a wound: a gash has been ripped into the bark along one side.  Beyond it to the west is a large pool of dirty brown water, home to who knows what kind of creatures.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: Scum-covered waters swirl around a moss-shrouded cypress standing in a murky brown pool.  Unknown and unseen inhabitants lurking below the surface stir the water, from which an everpresent fog slowly twists and dances despite the deathly still air.  Rumors say the fog holds the spirits of the fallen, forever trapped in the mist.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Bog Wallows]]
description: The water deepens, making the footing even more uncertain in front of a large cypress tree slowly being strangled by greyish-green vines with big, plate-sized leaves.  The vines drape the tree like a shroud and will eventually pull it down, but for the creature that climbs the tree, they offer a secure handhold, almost as good as a ladder.

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: A few faint tracks of small animals wander, seemingly at random, among the broken fragments of dry mud that form the old watercourse.  Thorn bushes and scrubby trees overhang the banks, futilely seeking moisture in this dry place.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: A dense thicket, full of thorns, rises suddenly in the sun-baked mud of the old streambed.  Perhaps tapping a lost spring, the deep green of the twisted branches is a marked contrast to the drier shrubs along the banks.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: The hard surface of the streambed rises noticeably to the south.  Crumbling chunks of rough-hewn stone along the banks show that someone once managed this watercourse for some long-forgotten purpose.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: Stones and gravel from the sides of the streambed have fallen down into untidy piles.  One massive boulder rises up above the rest like some patriarch among his flock.  Given its rough edges and lack of softening, this huge rock likely fell long after the stream dried up.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: A dry streambed ends in empty air.  The crumbling lip of a long-dead waterfall hangs out over a small pond some distance below.  Broken chunks of shaped rock lie to one side, their purpose unknowable to a casual look.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Wilderness, Dry Streambed]]
description: Several large rocks and small boulders form an untidy pile along the edge of a dry streambed.  Nearby, a huge growth of thorns and brambles arises.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A tangle of thick bushes covered with long thorns creates an interlocking mesh of spikes and vine.  Two narrow paths intersect, beaten through the stubborn shrubs, but even the crushed branches and thorns underfoot are an obstacle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A hill slopes up to the west, and from the curve of the land, you can see the thornberry patch reaches to the western horizon.  A brown rabbit scurries quickly across the path before diving to disappear into the growth.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A high, level plain of knee-high brambles unfolds, without a tall bush or tree nearby.  The relentless sun and fierce storms have destroyed all but the persistent growth of thornberry shrubs, which are able to survive under almost any condition.  They cling to the hard rocky soil and hold this wilderness in place.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Top of Chasm]]
description: Soft siltstone and sandstone washed away by rain through the ages, have created a sheer slope that starts as a large gully and descends rapidly into an impressive arroyo.  Sculpted by the elements, large knobby boulder-like outcrops project upward from the rock forming oddly shaped sentinels to watch over the small canyon.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Old Mill, Broken Bridge]]
description: A shattered bridge once provided a safe pathway from the mill to the southern side of the ravine.  Now, however, the chasm appears uncrossable as thick rotting ropes trail away from termite ridden support posts to disappear over the canyon edge.  Bits of frail wooden planking still litter the steep slope near the supports and the chasm bottom far below.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Old Mill, Near Cliff]]
description: A deep chasm opens almost beneath your feet.  The remains of an old grist-mill sit beneath the faint shade of some scruffy trees nearby.  A broken millstone lies against the side of the mill, complete with an empty bird's nest in the center hole, though no birds appear to have used it in a long time.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Old Mill, Near Cliff]]
description: Small clumps of crabgrass and scraggly shrubs give way to a gritty sandstone promontory, forming a sheer cliff that plummets down to the deep gorge below.  Across the chasm, on the far wall, layer after layer of herring-bone shaped laminations alternate with one another in the rock forming a curious pattern.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A cluster of small slender trees rings a sparser area of the thicket. The shrubs are dwarfed here, but the thorns are even sharper.  Sticking to the paths is the only option.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, High Above Chasm]]
description: The ground has broken away and tumbled far below to a chasm of dry rocky soil.  Some remaining fat plump thornberries cling fiercely to their protective branches, just as the shrubs themselves hold fast to the slowly eroding ground.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: An open area has been cleared from the thicket recently, but the voracious shrubs have begun growing back, their branches trailing into the clearing.  Rubbery shoots of new growth have pierced the bare ground, and biting green thorns already make the tender growth hostile.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: Thick brush surrounds everything, rising taller than the tallest elf.  Narrow passages through the thorns fan out in several directions, but what lies around each bend is hidden from view.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A dense wet smell of rotten fruit permeates the air, as thornberries protected from any beast hang overripe and decaying on the branches.  Swarms of midge-like flies fly in and out of the thorns -- if the thorns don't bite you most likely the flies will.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: Rising out of the thickets of thornberry shrubs is a lone pine.  Blighted by the dry land and poor soil, it still climbs to an impressive height.  Some distance away, past a totally impassible wall of brambles, a few other trees can be seen.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: The shrubs grow thicker and taller here, the way east a solid wall of dagger-thorns.  The path leads into an area hollowed out within the brake, with the shrub branches arching overhead to form a latticed roof.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A wild plum tree struggles upwards from the choking thorns, as the thorny vines reach upward for support.  Though the tree struggles for air and space, the remaining plums are protected from any but the swiftest and most agile birds.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Old Mill, Maple Tree]]
description: A long-abandoned grist mill lies beneath the weak shade of a scruffy maple tree.  A surprisingly stout lock holds the sagging front door closed.  Mouseholes gnawed into the wooden siding give shadowy glimpses into the dark interior.  A rotting pile of empty grain sacks shows obvious use as nesting material for some now-gone animal.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Maple Tree, Trunk]]
description: You cling to the thick and heavy trunk of an ancient maple tree.  Below you, a ruined mill sits in the scattered shade.  To one side, the millwheel waits for the stream that once turned it.  Cliffs rise to the northeast where the thin thread of a waterfall descends to form a small pool.  Perhaps this is where the old mill stream has gone.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Maple Tree, Branch]]
description: The heavy branch you crouch on sways near an upper story window set into the weathered side of the old mill.  To one side, the mill wheel waits endlessly for the water that no longer turns it.  Only dust now fills its rusting scoops.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Maple Tree, High Branch]]
description: A thick and twisted limb sways underfoot uneasily.  A gnarled branch from a creaking pine tree brushes this limb, making footing even more uncertain.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: Grey bushes bristling with hundreds of small, pointed thorns stand like giant sentries at silent attention in this tunnel, ready to strike at the first sign of invasion.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: Ravens tap and pick at the engulfing net of thistle branches weaving across several defoliated oak trees.  They carefully avoid the sharp thorns, but blackened blotches underfoot reveal their occasional lack of past success.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: Thorny brambles engulf everything in sight, forming both rug and canopy.  Through the latticework of grey branches you can dimly make out lights winking their message of cheer and warmth from distant cities.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A horde of dense brambles crowds in upon this area from all sides, and from above.  Gusts of wind send its nettled branches snicking loudly with sinister emphasis.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket]]
description: A small animal thrashes about in the all-encompassing vegetation, trapped, reduced to anonymous pulp by the action of innumerable thorns.  The bushes that hold it seem almost alive, their scraggly branches clinging with single-minded frenzy.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: A small metal cart lies on its side, its wheels broken, its spilled contents a rotted, unidentifiable mass.  Spread over its surface is a heavy layer of brambles speckled with vivid red thornberries.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: Several caves open into the side of a enormous, moss-covered mound.  They were once occupied by intelligent creatures, judging by the rusty tools which lie scattered about their entrances.  However, an impenetrable wall of bramble now prevents any access.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: A dark green moss expands along every curve of the sloping hills of this region.  The moss in turn is completely covered by a patchwork blanket of brush, its thorns glistening with dew.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: The thorn thicket crests like a giant grey wave, engulfing several dead black oaks.  Wisps of nests can still be seen in their higher boughs.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: Tendrils of snakeweed wind endlessly through mounds of dagger-thorn bushes like the work of some sylvan weaver.  The result is a clogged thicket of grey branches striped bright green, shimmering in the air as it stirs with every passing breeze.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: A few variwinkles peek out from the wild tangle of surrounding thorn bushes.  Their small purple flowers nod among the briars, dancing innocently in the fitful play of light.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Thorn Thicket, Deep]]
description: A bristling net of thorns covers the stump of a silverwood sapling.  The remaining bark gleams in all its primal glory, but dried black stains on the thorns testify that travelers have tried to remove a few souvenir splinters from the stump in the past.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Peri'el Prayer Gate]]
description: A grove of white birch trees stands opposite the prayer gate dedicated to the Goddess Peri'el.  Watching over the wild inner slopes to the south, a golden king snake perches atop the gate.  Two guards, taking their duty very seriously, stand to either side of the gate watching those who approach.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Beneath the Prayer Gate]]
description: Patterns of light bloom within the glossy black stone of the prayer gate's walls.  Etched in gold on one side, a wounded S'Kra Mur woman sings to a sleeping dragon, her tail held gently above her ankles.  On the other side, the same woman holds a sleeping S'Kra Mur baby in her arms, her tail undulating in the air.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Old Passageway]]
description: This old passage once connected the main hall with the southern towers of the keep, but has been converted into a sitting room.  Well-padded benches cluster around imported wooden tables to give the bank patrons a place to smooth out any disagreements in their planned financial deals.  A large old painting of a group of S'Kra hangs on the back wall, looking sternly down upon the room.

title: [[Martyr Saedelthorp, Triage]]
description: At first glance it is difficult to tell you are in the renowned healing arts' hospital of Martyr Saedelthorp.  It looks more like a battlefield healer's station.  Blood, gore, sweat and mud streak the tiled floor and the wooden benches.  Groaning adventurers in various states of shock and consciousness await tending by concerned but fatigued healers.  You gingerly step over a patient with a severed limb sprawled out on a canvas stretcher.

title: [[The Crossing, Town Green Pond]]
description: You stand on the bank of a tiny pond in the middle of the square.  Cool water laps against the soft, velvety silt that covers the shore, and in the distance you can hear the bustle of the town.  Sitting in the middle of the pond is a massive gelapod, looking content and not the least bit aggressive.

title: [[Outside Muspar'i, Barge Platform]]
description: This metal platform waits defiantly for the frequent storms that batter the walls of Muspar'i, as it huddles down in the sand.  Thick coils of rope, wrapped around the platform's steel pillars, stand ready to tie off the barges traversing the desert sea to the isolated city, and a wide ramp allows easy access for boarding and disembarking the flatboats.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: A deep shelf is carved into the wall, in which is stored locked chests bound by chains.  Strange symbols are crudely etched into the rock wall above each one, though their relation is unclear.

title: [[Lake Ratamipak]]
description: The water of Lake Ratamipak is dark with a greyish tone, owed to a dense concentration of suspended salt.  Here away from shore, the bottom drops off rapidly, making it difficult to move further out into the lake.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Foreign Exchange]]
description: Unlike the teller windows across the hall, the exchange of coins is handled a bit more openly.  An old stone-topped table has been set out with all the tools of the exchanger to allow the customer to see that everything is as they wish.  The exchange official confers with a teller behind an iron screen from time to time in order to keep the number of coins on the table to a minimum.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Lightwell Balcony]]
description: A strong breeze pulls upward past the well-traveled balcony forming a wide half circle around the perimeter of the lightwell at this level.  Daylight streams down from the skylights above to brighten the area, despite being nearly in the center of the great stone keep.  Off to the side of the balcony is a set of carpeted steps leading up to the top floor.

title: [[Mhasulri the Gem Buyer]]
description: Sandstone floors have been rubbed smooth and lightly polished to a soft, rosy glow, then covered with a luxurious scatter of thick carpets patterned in a white-on-white arabesque motif.  Light glints off the glass fronts of tall rosewood cabinets filled with rows of velvet-lined shelves holding an array of precious and semiprecious gemstones, and a long table that is covered with a length of white linen is scattered with magnifying lenses, forceps, and other tools of the gembuyer's trade.

title: [[Salt Gleaner Road]]
description: The dusty track continues to follow the great wall of the city, pounded out by the generational tread of gleaners that were unwilling to stray out into the merciless desert.  Sloping gently to the northeast for a number of yards, the ground suddenly drops away sharply towards the vertical, a potent natural barrier between the city and the arid plain below.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Courtyard]]
description: A great tower of black stone rises high overhead with a pair of massive double doors leading within.  Its buttresses and outrunning columns cast long shadows across the courtyard, which is occupied primarily by two long tables of black oak set up to either side of the lane, displaying various wares to passersby.  The bright buntings draping down from the tables' canopy create a daring splash of color, offsetting the other rather austere surroundings.

The black stone tower rises upward like the blade of a knife, spearing the night air.  Shadows darken the finely decorated oak tables to either side of the path, but the bazaar is far from quiet, though its colors are muted by the darkness.  Oil lamps filled with fragrant fuel sit atop each table, casting globes of warm light to illuminate the attendants' wares.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Preparation Hall]]
description: Long tapestries sewn in deep, rich colors drape the polished stone walls of the preparation hall.  Stools and straight-backed chairs are scattered about for the use of those entering the arena and those waiting to join the line.  The scent of sandalwood hangs in the air, drifting from incense burners placed in the four corners of the room.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Hall of Masters]]
description: The stone walls are dense and thick, draping the hall in a curtain of heavy, reverent silence.  Every other panel in each wall is carved with images, alternating with clear crystal oil lamps that burn with strange blue flames.  Those buried in the Hall of Masters lie at rest beneath the stone floor, their names engraved atop granite slabs turned dark with age.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Foyer]]
description: The entryway to the guild is sparse and utilitarian, but its seamless stone walls and heavy floor tiles are undoubtedly crafted from the finest of materials.  A pair of massive double doors dominates the south wall, directly opposite the heavily carved archway leading into the Guildmaster's office.  Two towering cobras with glittering emerald eyes watch over the hall from either side of the arch.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Armory]]
description: Three tall arches lead out from the armory, one on each wall opposite and adjacent to the eastern passageway.  While the floorboards here are sanded, they are not polished, offering better traction when the weapons that line the walls are tested.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Library]]
description: Dark mahogany paneling lines the walls but is barely visible, for every scrap of space against the wall is covered with shelving stacked neatly with books.  A special crosshatched wooden shelf stands just to the right of the entryway, full of scrolls.  Heavy curtains, made of a material that makes them seem to shimmer, drape over the three stone arches leading into the gardens, helping to keep dust and debris from outside at bay, preserving the precious stock of the library.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Water Garden]]
description: A heavy humidity hangs in the air in defiance of the garden's desert surroundings.  Shallow pools weave around the round-cobbled paths, sprouting several varieties of fragrant water lily.  Huge blue irises twine around one large stone archway that leads down to the south.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Air Garden]]
description: A cool radiance sparkles in the clear, refreshing atmosphere of the Air Garden.  Twisting, careless paths weave in easy elegance around the area, curving in fanciful spirals and grandiose arcs.  The flowers here vary in size, but all are snowy white and speckled toward the center in pale primrose-blue.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: A smooth stone walkway passes through the tall metal gate that opens here, dust and sand giving way to small green shrubs and blossoming succulents.  Stretching east and west, stone walls serve to protect the area from the harsh Velakan winds.  Faintly carved into the sand-worn surface of the walkway lies the image of a goblet, pointing north further into the oasis.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: Walkways from three directions converge in this area, meeting along the perimeter of a deep spring of saltwater.  Protruding from the center of the splashing water, a large limestone fountain bears inset pieces of carved zenith spinel.  Gnarled cacti rise out of the ground, surrounded by large sand-worn rocks.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: Clusters of desert lilies huddle along the bottom edge of a layered stone wall that shields the surrounding area from the harsh desert winds.  The dusty walkway extends north towards more houses and east further into the oasis.  Barely visible beneath the sand on the path is the carved image of a stylized knife.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: Bursts of green wildflowers litter the walkway, providing stark contrast to the muted color of the stone.  On the east side of the path rests a massive smooth rock chiseled to depict the image of a male S'Kra Mur.  A small opening cut into the sand-worn walls allows visibility of the sweeping dunes on the other side.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: The north and east walls meet here in a sharp corner marking the boundary of the area, naturally lined by piles of sand of various sizes.  Near the north wall stands a large rock carved to depict the image of a male S'Kra Mur.  The unmistakable sound of trickling water drifts through the area, enticing in the unrelenting desert heat.

title: [[Velaka Desert, Path of Three Brothers]]
description: Enough sand has been cleared away to expose an intricately carved female S'Kra Mur along the full height of one wall.  The walkway branches southeast further into the oasis, where tall shadows waver in the desert heat.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Aether Garden]]
description: The light plays sparkling games with the crushed obsidian that lines the weaving pathways here, dancing in faerie-like jocosity across black marble benches.  Tiny wood violets take shelter beneath them, spreading their vivid petals in the comfort of the shade.

title: [[Manor House, Courtyard]]
description: Candlelight twinkles from the many windows of an enormous manor house that is sprawled across the southern end of the village, hugging the shoreline of the Segoltha River.  The low sound of snoring comes from the house, and you notice a large pig laying sound asleep next to the massive hardwood door.

title: [[Manor House, Orchard]]
description: A grove of trees covered with deep green, glossy leaves and laden with plump fuzzy peaches stands just east of a large manor house.  A cobblestone path winds through the trees toward a group of buildings to the south.

title: [[Manor House, Pathway]]
description: A Gor'Tog housemaid emerges from a stone building carrying a huge silver platter of roasted meat.  She hurries it through a side door of the manor house.  Opposite the stone building is a brick structure with neatly-trimmed rosemary and lavender hedges surrounding it.  Several women in servant's garb hang freshly washed garments and linen on the hedges to dry.

title: [[Manor House, Pathway]]
description: A strong, unpleasant odor comes from a stone-block building where bits of bones and brownish stains cover the entryway.  Dozens of flies buzz and crawl over the strong mesh covering the building's window.

title: [[Manor House, Game Larder]]
description: The unmistakable odor of putrefying meat assails you when you enter the larder, lessened only slightly by the breeze flowing through the mesh-covered windows that are arranged all around the building.  A large iron wheel mounted in the ceiling supports several slabs of meat and carcasses of game birds.  Brine barrels and salting tubs are placed alongside a stone chopping block.

title: [[Manor House, Kitchen]]
description: The tantalizing aroma of roasting meat and herbs emanates from a massive brick hearth on the far wall.  An iron spit revolves slowing over the fire, powered by a strange contraption.  Sitting conveniently at the hearthside are a tinderbox and a huge wooden bin.  Shelves on the walls are covered with neatly arranged supplies, and sturdy wooden pegs mounted in the beams of the high vaulted ceiling hold hanging bunches of garlic and onions.  A long deal table occupies the center of the stone floor.

title: [[Manor House, Washhouse]]
description: Enormous coopered tubs fill the room, some filled with clothes soaking in soap-filmed water.  Several washboards and an assortment of wash-sticks hang from the wall.  An earthenware soapdish holds a few greyish lye-balls.

title: [[Manor House, Poultry Yard]]
description: The gentle fluttering of wings and occasional cooing come from the dark huddled shadows of sleeping birds.  A stone dairy and great barn overlook the yard, and some wooden steps lead down toward the Segoltha River's edge.

title: [[Manor House, Waterfront]]
description: The deep waters of the mighty Segoltha River lap against the wooden planks of the Grandmaster's boats that are securely tied at the shore.  Across the river and far off to the south, you can see the treetops of the massive Endrus Forest.

title: [[Manor House, Caravan Barn]]
description: The soft lowing of cattle mingles with the more strident sounds of yaks and mules being unharnessed by strapping Gor'Togs.  A similiar group can be spied through the stable door, swiftly unloading caravans and pack animals.  Tired traders troop towards the manor house and a meal, passing beneath a large painted sign.

title: [[Manor House, Dairy]]
description: The gurgle of trickling water resounds pleasantly in the peaceful tranquility of this ceramic-tiled room.  Slate shelves trimmed with marble edge the walls, providing a cool surface for the flat pans of separating milk.  A Gor'tog dairymaid wielding a pair of grooved wooden batlets deftly shapes a portion of butter, then adds a decorative Tiger imprint with a butter stamp.

title: [[Manor House, Hallway]]
description: This short hallway contains a wooden entryway leading out to the curia on the west side and a servant's door on the east.  A young serving girl comes through the door, carrying a covered platter toward the buttery to the north.

title: [[Manor House, Dry Larder]]
description: The west wall of the larder is covered with an enormous blue cupboard, while the east wall holds an equally large purple cupboard.  Birdcages containing blackbirds, larks, plovers and thrushes hang from the ceiling among muslin bags of drying herbs.

title: [[Manor House, Wet Larder]]
description: This dimly-lit larder is cool and damp.  A light breeze wafts in from mesh-covered windows, easing the strong fishy smell that hangs in the air.  The brick floor slopes downward toward a drainage hole in the center.  Thick slate shelves contain fresh fish, cuts of meat and vegetables covered with muslin and handfuls of wet rushes.

title: [[Manor House, Servant's Passage]]
description: This cramped passageway connects the servant's areas.  Some stone stairs lead down to the manor's ale cellar.

title: [[Manor House, Servant's Passage]]
description: The clanking of iron comes from a wooden door, as a weary-looking Gor'tog maid passes through it, heading up some rickety steps for a much-needed break.

title: [[Manor House, Buttery]]
description: Dishes and cups are arranged in piles and stacks atop wooden shelves that line the walls.  Loaves of fresh baked bread wrapped in clean cloths are lined up on a table, awaiting the morning meal.

title: [[Manor House, Linen Closet]]
description: A large fitted cupboard takes up most of the space in the little linen closet.  A wooden mending table, set off to the side, holds a frayed monogrammed sheet with a threaded needle still stuck in it.

title: [[Manor House, Ale Cellar]]
description: A massive copper dominates the cellar room.  Ale barrels stand in rows on the sawdust-strewn cobbled floor.  A Gor'Tog woman, her head covered by a purple kerchief, uses a wooden paddle to stir some malt into the liquid held in a large mash tun.  A shelf holds casks of yeast and tubs of malt.  By the foot of the stairs, a wincing elderly Gor'Tog man holds a stringy wig between two fingertips as if he were disposing of a dead rat.

title: [[Manor House, Servants' Quarters]]
description: This large attic room holds several curtained bedsteads that are tucked into the eaves of the manor roof.  Short stools and a single table holding a metal wash basin are the only other furnishings here.

title: [[Manor House, Curia]]
description: The clang of iron against iron jars the peaceful night in this open-air courtyard.  Two young men from Ortug's team of guards train with massive metal clubs.  The sweat on their hefty Gor'Tog arms glimmers in the dim light from their candles.  A large archway leads into the main part of the manor.

title: [[Manor House, Dining Hall]]
description: The heavy blue velvet drapes that cover the many windows in the room are trimmed with shiny gold fringe.  A long mahogany dining table is surrounded by highback chairs, with a large throne-like chair occupying the master's place at the head of the table.  A massive sideboard runs the length of one wall, its surface laden with food.

title: [[Manor House, Hallway]]
description: A Gor'Tog dressed in servant's garb drags a leashed goat out of a wood-framed opening in the south wall.  The animal, stubbornly munching on a candlestick, tosses its head in irritation as it follows the man.  Delicious aromas of roasted meat waft through a wooden arch to the west.

title: [[Manor House, Vestibule]]
description: The high-ceilinged vestibule leads from the manor's entry to an ornately carved wooden archway that opens out to the central courtyard.  Tiers of purple velvet with gold fringe top the vestibule and connecting passageway walls, adding a garish touch to the otherwise attractive room.

title: [[Manor House, Corridor]]
description: The walls topped with tiers of purple velvet continue down the east-west stretch of corridor.  A Gor'Tog housemaid, wielding a broom, chases an angrily clucking chicken around a bend to the south.

title: [[Manor House, Corridor]]
description: Several prosperous-looking Halfling traders emerge from an iron door, stepping aside gingerly to avoid a mother pig who has chosen a central spot on the corridor floor to nurse her young.  They chuckle to each other about the hazards of finding good caravan guards these days, as they head north.

title: [[Manor House, Corridor]]
description: The corridor ends at an enormous purple door that fills most of the south wall.  A smaller blue door leads to the west.  This end of the hall seems much quieter, with not a pig or chicken in sight.

title: [[Manor House, Master Bedroom]]
description: The Borthgar master bedroom is a visual disaster!  The purple paisley bed quilt clashes with the red floral rugs and blue checquered draperies.  Resomba, the manor mistress, sits in a massive rocking chair trying to do some embroidery.  She glowers at her work and impatiently yanks out some stitching, ripping the fabric in the process.

title: [[Manor House, Bedroom]]
description: This small bedroom belongs to the family's son, Grob, who is sitting on the floor studying something.  He quickly shoves a piece of paper under the bed, giving you a furtive glance.  Toy war clubs and shields are strewn around the room, and a small version of the Tiger Clan guard uniform hangs from a peg on the wall.

title: [[Manor House, Cloak Room]]
description: Several cloaks and greatcoats belonging to the manor's guests hang on wooden coatracks.  A collection of muddied boots have been tossed in a discarded jumble in a dark corner.

title: [[Manor House, Library]]
description: Impressive acanth wood bookshelves line the walls here.  Several books reside on the shelves, but most are heaped in a pile on the floor.  A young goat stands over them, contentedly munching on some pages.

title: [[Manor House, Drawing Room]]
description: This richly, but rather garishly furnished drawing room contains an ancient central hearth where a hearty fire crackles.  Vivid purple and blue flowers cover the long couches and chairs, and equally bright matching flowers spread across the carpeted floor.  The furniture has a dusty appearance, as if the room has been unused for awhile.

title: [[Manor House, Guardroom]]
description: The Grandmaster Ortug lumbers slowly around a group of Gor'Tog guards, proudly examining their bright purple uniforms.  The guards listen carefully as Ortug instructs them.  He recites, "Some person mess with caravan, you bash them!  Some critter mess with caravan, you bash it!"  Several of the guards nod thoughtfully, while another carefully scratches a reminder note on a crumpled piece of paper.

title: [[Manor House, Ortug's Study]]
description: Chaos rules in this unorganized jumble that Ortug calls a study.  Unsteady piles of papers and books cover the floor and desk, forming the Grandmaster's preferred filing system.  A brown and white feathered chicken makes her way through the maze of stacks, squawking and flapping her wings when a single paper drifts down from the desk, sailing over her head and onto the floor.

title: [[Old Church, Belfry]]
description: The ivory-colored balustrade surrounding the belfry is carved with stylized representations of birds and animals.  The view below is of the church cemetery to the north, and the village green off to the west.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Old Church]]
description: Some rows of wooden pews are set before a simple altar.  A symbol carved in the shape of a dove rests on a dais, and a quiet peace fills the space in tribute to Albreda's blessing.  Candlelight casts a tranquil glow over the walls and pews and gives the space a safe and warm feeling at any hour of the night.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Cemetery]]
description: The final resting places of individuals and entire families are marked with carved stones.  The history of the village is written in the epitaphs.  A tiny mound of freshly turned earth covered with flowers gives testimony to the continuing function of the cemetery in the cycle of life and death.

title: [[Tiger Clan Home, Cemetery]]
description: The headstones here are plainer and newer than the section of the cemetery closest to the church.  A lavender hedge separates the sacred ground from the surrounding countryside, with a Halfling-high stone wall stretching across the northern boundary.

title: [[A Dark Gap]]
description: Cold, clammy, damp dark surrounds everything.  An odor of decay permeates the stale air.

title: [[El'Bain's Stop, Picnic Area]]
description: The quiet surroundings of this picnic area give weary travelers a short break before moving on.
A singing bird, lost in the limbs of a nearby tree, pays respect to the tranquility of this rest area.  Somehow the simplistic chirping soothes tight muscles and suppresses life's worries.

title: [[El'Bain's Stop, Cabin]]
description: The sounds of travelers can be heard from the main road, but the voices are faint and hard to distinguish.  Though touched by civilization's hand, the encroaching trees and chattering critters leave no doubt that nature rules here.  A small log cabin rests on the edge of the path.

title: [[El'Bain's Stop, Cabin]]
description: Cutting through the forest's vegetation this packed path is used fairly often, if the numerous footprints are any indication.  The trail rises slightly to the northeast and levels out to the southwest, connecting two small log cabins.

title: [[El'Bain's Stop, Cabin]]
description: At the end of the path rests a small cabin, cradled gently in the arms of ancient firs.  Though the way is neatly cut-back, it appears that the wilds could take this place at any moment.

title: [[Temple Hill, Neighborhood Entrance]]
description: A pair of stone pillars mark the edge of the neighborhood named Temple Hill.  A freshly graded, crushed-stone street carries traffic south into the heart of the community.  Running along one side of the lane, a low stone wall, cut with a prominent wrought iron gate, borders the grounds of Temple Hill Manor.  Across the street are a row of neat stone cottages.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: The crushed stone of the lane leads between several stone cottages, winding its way deeper into the district.  Young locust trees have been planted along both sides of the road in the hopes that with the passage of time they will shade the way.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: The Mycthengelde Flatlands encroach upon the base of Temple Hill just below this stretch of Hero's March, with the tallest trees almost an extension of the hill.  Stone cottages cluster along the gravel surface of the way, the solid houses and well-maintained street lending a sense of permanence to the area.  Children shout as they sport among the cottages, their noises echoed by the noise of stone falling in a nearby quarry.

The taller vegetation of the Mycthengelde Flatlands grows close against the hill below this stretch of Hero's March.  Darkness and shadows create an illusion that the Mycthengelde treetops are but an extension of Temple Hill.  Stone cottages cluster along the dark gravel of the street, their windows throwing a welcome light on the comforting scene.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: Yellowish-green lawns and shrubs stretch in front of cozy stone cottages, green only where the owners have imported soil or planted raised beds.  In spite of the yellow color, the residents of this area are enthusiastic gardeners as shown by the attention to their landscaping.

Low plantings form lines and odd geometric figures on the lawns that surround the gaily lit stone cottages.  A few raised beds sport taller varieties of vegetation that draw thick shadows around them in the embrace of the night.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: Pristine cottages line each side of the path and enjoy a pleasant view of a tall marble fountain and the surrounding flatlands.  A memorial plaque upon the fountain hails warriors from seasons past.  Thick shrubs and pale flowers grace each home with sweet smells and a touch of elegance.

A broad view of the Mycthengelde Flatlands looms emptily to the west, fading into the dark night.  Pristine cottages face a tall marble fountain whose surface is lit by carefully placed lamps.  Thick shrubs and pale flowers rustle in the breeze and send fragrant scents into the air.

title: [[Temple Hill Lane, Salvage Stoneworks]]
description: Lazy clouds of dust occasionally billow out from a large stoneworking shop dominating the south side of Temple Hill Lane.  Behind the workshop, loose rock and unprocessed rubble tumbles down a large chute from a partially visible quarrying area.

With lights dimmed for the night, somber cottages stand across from a large industrial workshop that dominates the south side of the lane.  Just visible in the weak light behind the large building is a chute leading down from a quarry that lifts strange vertical shadows into the night sky.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: Carefully tended lawns and young trees provide evidence that the residents of this neighborhood are planting and planning for the future.  Stone and brick cottages line the lane, with somber colors predominating -- mostly dark greys, dark browns, and dull reds, although the trimmings and trappings suggest the inhabitants are not nearly as gloomy as their dwellings.
Dark iron lanterns hung from tall poles glow softly against the darkness of night.  A scattering of pots and vases leave shadows against the somber walls of the homes.

title: [[Temple Hill, Memorial Park]]
description: Grass surrounds a small reflecting pool in this wooded park at the top of the hill.  Strategically placed low stone benches surround the pool, allowing peaceful contemplation of life.  Roses twine along a fence that separates the park from the quarry to the east.

title: [[Temple Hill, Memorial Park]]
description: Jagged stone makes a staggered path through this restful park.  Tall trees reach out to the sky and give homes to squirrels, rabbits and a variety of birds.  A lone stone bench, flanked on each side by a pot of fragrant flowers, offers a place for quiet reflection.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: Lawns and gardens stretch out alongside stone cottages that stand in rows along the lane.  Small trees and plantings decorate the well-tended lawns, but none are of any immense size.  Evidently, the temple rubble provides better building material than soil for planting.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: Cozy, sturdy white cottages line the crushed-stone street, with the exception of one cordoned-off lot.  The fence surrounding it is quite sturdy, and has been patched and reinforced to prevent even the most agile of children from wandering into the area.

Brightly lit stone cottages throw light almost everywhere on the darkened street except for one rubble-strewn lot, leaving it in the shadows.  An unusually sturdy fence, immediately noticeable even in the dim light, surrounds the area.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: The street turns to follow the contour of Temple Hill, providing a good view from the high vantage point.  Downhill lies a small court with a statue in the center.  Rising behind it are the earthen ramparts of the Crossing, the roofs of the city peeking over the top of the wall.

Stolid cottages stand in the darkness of the crushed stone street bending around the hill.  A cluster of lighted windows are visible downhill, backed by the shadowy mass of the city wall and the lights of the Crossing twinkling in the inky darkness beyond.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: Cottages surround a simply carved stone pedestal in the center of the lane.  A glass case surmounts the pedestal, with a bronze plaque mounted firmly on the front.  Downhill to the east, a great expanse of rooftops stretches out behind the earthen mass of the Crossing city wall.

Carefully arranged cottages surround a stone pedestal topped by a glass case.  The many lights of the Crossing glisten to the east, while a thoughtfully placed lantern highlights a bronze plaque and the contents of the glass case.

title: [[Temple Hill, Temple Hill Lane]]
description: Scents of fresh bread and baked goods drift upon the air, perhaps from one of the nearby homes.  Sounds of children playing mingle with bird song and form a pleasant melody.  The cozy cottages here have a sweeping view of the Crossing wall below with the city beyond.

Scents of cedar and pine drift upon the air, perhaps from the fires of the nearby homes.  Soft rustlings of night creatures mingle with faint owl hoots and form a serene melody.  To the east, the twinkling lights of Crossing contrast with the closer black bulk of the city wall.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: The low, yellowish vegetation of the lane gives way to deeper greens and larger shrubs, partially masking the gentle slope to the south.  One young lunat tree seems to be thriving, although it still stands only about as tall as a Gor'Tog.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: The stately manors constructed high on Temple Hill enjoy a broad view of the Mycthengelde Flatlands and the roofs of the Crossing.  Rows of colorful flowers and shrubs encircle each manor and give them a distinctive look.  A narrow stone path leads south towards Finch Cottage Path.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: Cottages lining the crushed rubble surface of Hero's March have expansive views of Finch Cottage Path and a tiny glimpse of the Crossing's western wall.  Clusters of homes, visible as roofs and chimneys, poke through the lush vegetation below while birdsong drifts on the air.

Cheery glows emanate from the windows of stone cabins lining Hero's March, echoed by a small glimmer of lights from the Crossing to the east.  A scattering of cabin lights twinkle to the south through the thick undergrowth.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: A heavy cast iron sundial is centered in middle of the crushed stone path, surrounded by a narrow ring of low-growing herbs.  Occasionally a bird swoops down to land on it, as if checking the time.  Between two cottages, a grassy path winds uphill.

A heavy cast iron sundial is centered in the middle of the crushed stone path, a low dark shape in the dimness.  Occasional gleams of light like bright gold shine from cottage windows or doors.  Nearly invisible in the shadows between two cottages, a grassy path winds uphill.

title: [[Temple Hill, Hero's March]]
description: Colorful cottages line the crushed rock street and enjoy a panoramic view of the Mycthengelde Flatlands.  Young trees, freshly planted, lift up their scrawny limbs to the sky.  One such tree enjoys a ragtag doll hanging haphazardly from its highest point.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Path]]
description: Finch Cottage Path represents a drastic change from Temple Hill proper.  The soil is old and deep here, and vegetation flourishes.  Care was taken when building the cottages to leave as many of the original plants as possible.  Numerous songbirds flit and chirp among the abundant shrubs and trees, a living reward for the careful preservation of plants.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Path]]
description: A number of paths converge upon a wide tan circle of crushed stone surrounded by twisting wyndwood trees.  Snug cottages tuck themselves beneath the tangled tree limbs that reach out over the circle.  Birds dart about from tree to bush to shrub, pausing frequently at the cedar platform birdfeeder on a tall pole that stands at the center of the circle.

Soft breezes carry over a wide tan circle of crushed stone and slip into the surrounding wyndwood trees, producing a soothing music of rustling leaves as they pass.  Snug cottages tuck themselves beneath the tangled tree limbs that lean in over the circle.  A platform birdfeeder on a tall pole in the middle of the circle stands lonesome in the night, waiting for birds to arrive with the dawn.

title: [[Temple Hill, Battle Bell Court]]
description: The clamor of commerce from around the West Gate carries from beyond the city wall, but this tranquil court is well screened from view among the trees.  Graceful cottages cluster around a huge iron bell hung from a decorative stone tower.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Path]]
description: Lunat trees line the elegant path meandering between the comfortable-looking cottages snugly situated in thick stands of shrubs.  The tree-lined path continues to the south, while a smaller path branches off to the northwest.  Birds dart between shrubs and trees, while birdsong rings out in a near-constant flow of music.

title: [[Temple Hill, Goldfinch Circle]]
description: The path dead-ends into a cozy circle of homes clustered around a small clearing edged with wildflowers.  Comfortable cottages are nestled among native plants and lush landscaping tended with loving care.  Birds flit about the luxurious vegetation, pausing at a cedar platform birdfeeder on a tall pole.

The path dead-ends into a cozy circle of homes throwing warm light through their windows into a small clearing.  Cottages nearly disappear in thick growths of native plants and the landscaping gathers odd shadows in the dim light.  A cedar platform birdfeeder stands on a tall pole in the middle of the clearing, bereft of winged visitors by night.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Path]]
description: The graceful path winds between stone cottages nestled in comforting thickets of vegetation.  Chirping echoes around the cottages as birds dart in and out amongst the shrubs.  A long sunflower feeder hangs from a sprawling old oak, providing a royal feast for visiting birds.

The graceful path winds among cheerily lit stone cottages nestled in thickets of vegetation.  One notable oak stands paternally near the path, a tall feeder hanging from its branches just visible in the dim light thrown out by the homes.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Path]]
description: Lunat trees line the elegant path that narrows as it continues toward the southwest, slipping between cozy cottages pleasantly located in stands of tended vegetation.  Birds gambol in the air between trees on either side of the path and birdcalls ring out with a merry chatter from the surrounding undergrowth.

Lunat trees cast long shadows over the path that narrows as it continues toward the southwest, slipping between cozy cottages pleasantly located in stands of tended vegetation.  A faint sound from the surrounding undergrowth provides evidence of the noteworthy number of birds found in the neighborhood.

title: [[Temple Hill, Finch Cottage Grounds]]
description: The Finch Cottage grounds are carefully landscaped to attract birds.  Shrubs and berry bushes provide food and sanctuary, and nest boxes hung about the yard provide cozy homes.  Finches abound, attracted to a long hanging feeder in front of the cottage's window.

Tall shrubbery dominates the landscaping around Finch Cottage, appearing denser in the dark.  Occasionally, rustling sounds and the rare sleepy birdcalls can be heard coming from the bushes.  A long feeder hangs in front of one window, waiting for birds to arrive with the dawn.

title: [[Temple Hill, House Finch Circle]]
description: Native plants and bird-friendly vegetation grow in lush profusion around cozy stone cottages.  A large oak birdfeeder on a tall pole creates a focus for the cabins -- evidently bird watching is a common local interest.

Tall shrubs and heavy vegetation grow in lush profusion around cozy stone cottages set in a rough circle.  Light from the cabin windows coalesces upon a large birdfeeder on a tall pole -- evidently the local entertainment.

title: [[Temple Hill, Pine Finch Circle]]
description: The path ends in a grove of trees containing a small circle of cottages centered about a tall cedar platform birdfeeder.  The cottages are nestled beneath the canopies of tall old trees and surrounded by luxuriant stands of low plants.  Birds sprint from place to place in a flurry of wings, pausing from time to time at the birdfeeder.

The path ends in a dim grove of trees with scattered lights originating from a small circle of cottages centered about a tall cedar platform birdfeeder.  The cottages are nestled beneath the canopies of tall old trees and almost disappear into shadows of the trees behind luxuriant stands of low plants.  Soft, irregular sounds disclose the presence of birds hidden for the night in the thick undergrowth.

title: [[Temple Hill, Captain's Court]]
description: Laughter rings loud as children play with boats upon a small pond.  Each cottage in this pleasant court faces the pond and has a different flag hung from its eaves.  To the south grows a more densely wooded area that offers the children more exciting play.

A small pond in the middle of this quiet, restful court sports tiny boats upon its surface.  Outdoor lanterns from the surrounding cottages give a nice, soft glow to the surrounding shrubs and flowers.  Taller trees loom to the south as an occasional sleepy birdcall sounds in the darkness.

title: [[Temple Hill, Salvage Quarry]]
description: Workers sort the salvaged stone of the quarry into piles of similar size and color.  Along the west edge of the pit, stone is pounded and poured through stacked sieves to make various grades of sand and gravel.  Finished materials are stacked along the side of the quarry until needed, when they are slid down a large chute to the stone works.  Every few minutes, warning shouts precede a great tumbling of raw materials from a cliff to the south.

Piles of stone and pieces of machinery stand silently in the darkness.  Along the west edge of the quarry the dust of the day's work has settled upon the machines in a thick layer opposite piles of sorted material.  A cliff stands to the south, forming a tall backdrop to the scene.

title: [[Temple Hill, Salvage Quarry]]
description: Tall faces of variegated stone loom above the observer on three sides of the quarry.  Workers pry mixed stone and rubble from these rock walls, sending it tumbling into piles which are then shoved over a small cliff to the north for sorting.

Tall stone faces loom above three sides of the quarry, standing stark in the night.  Occasionally small stones slide down from the treacherous rock walls, echoing loudly as they reach the bottom and bounce over a low cliff.

title: [[Temple Hill Manor, Grounds]]
description: Framed by a low stone wall pierced with a wrought iron gate, a grand lawn stretches out along three sides of Temple Hill Manor to gracefully encompass the elegant abode.  Small plantings dot the grass, drawing attention toward the young maple trees flanking the door of the manor.  Two bronze statues set on stone pedestals hold places of honor on the great lawn, further enhancing the elegant setting.

title: [[The Black Spire, Gates]]
description: Sheltered under the watchful eye of the mountain, towering walls and craggy parapets rise like a ravenous serpent from the rock that composes this end of the ravine.  Wrought of mikkhalbamar and thick, iron bands, the massive gates of the fortress mark the end of the valley road.  Silent evidence of battle litters the ground; riven siege towers, wrecked onagers and shattered scorpions have been trodden nearly to splinters by time and the footfalls of great beasts.

title: [[The Black Spire, Gatehouse]]
description: Unadorned except for two large torches in plain iron holders, the gatehouse is empty and clear of debris.  Many years of tramping boots have worn a smooth path across the flat stones of the floor.  Thick, iron-banded gates, made of dense mikkhalbamar, provide an exit to the valley.  A stout crossbeam sits nearby, ready to secure them against invasion.  Two openings and a raised portcullis lead further into the fortress.

title: [[Seord Kerwaith, A High Ledge]]
description: From this vantage point, high above the trail below, the view would be spectacular -- if only the constantly wind-whipped snow would clear long enough to allow a good look.  The mountain rises with a sheer slope, curving slightly overhead so that this ledge is somewhat protected, but also preventing any possible climb further.  The ledge itself is wide enough for comfort standing, but not so wide that one is tempted to remain for any length of time.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Gap]]
description: Dim light from the passage filters through the foliage, illuminating an opening in the forest that's barely wide enough for a Gor'Tog to pass through.  The sounds of animals and insects come from the underbrush, along with other, unidentifiable sounds.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
description: Raucous calls of birds ring out overhead from the unseen sky.  Vines and creepers dangle from the soaring canopy which stretches far above the shrubs and saplings of the forest floor.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Glade]]
description: Standing tall and straight in the forest opening, a mighty durmast stretches skyward, its spreading branches reaching like outstretched arms to the surrounding forest.  The opening in the canopy allows for grass to struggle with the ever-present vines and shrubs.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
description: Growing up over a clump of saplings and shrubs, a particularly exuberant creeper has all but obscured one path through the woods here.  Further paths are less overgrown, and show evidence of being used by something, although the tracks are not quite like any animal recorded.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
description: Fallen leaves lie like forgotten children's toys along the forest trail, tattered and strewn about with the passage of animals.  The faint scent of decaying foliage lingers in the air, everpresent beneath the smell of the forest.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
description: Seeping from the ground, a tiny spring burbles within the forest, its waters making the area more humid while providing a source of moisture for delicate plants.  One bank of the pool shows signs that the waters are also used by the forest's denizens as welcome refreshment.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
description: The game trails that wend their way through the heavy undergrowth come together long enough to split apart again.  The rustle of leaves gives evidence of something lurking just beyond sight, but nothing gives any clue as to the unknown creature's identity.

title: [[Shambling Weald, Wildwood]]
