title: [[Mountain Road]]
description: The road jinks around a tight switchback that siege engines and battering rams would find very troublesome.  It also offers an incomparable panoramic view of the valley below Chyolvea Tayeu'a.

title: [[Mountain Road, Dead End]]
description: The road's progress down the mountain is abruptly halted by a yawning chasm.  Ancient war machines, long ago foiled by the avalanche that destroyed the road, lie rusting and forsaken on the other side of the gap.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Duty]]
description: A narrow shaft of sunlight blazes through the narrow opening between a pair of massive almhara doors.  It pierces the gloom of this wide, curving hall, illuminating the closely set polished black stones of the floor.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Duty]]
description: A few flickering torches in their sconces provide plenty of ambience, but barely enough light to see by.  However, they nicely highlight the silver eye-in-triskele insignia inlaid in the unusually wide stone door set in the southwestern wall.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Duty]]
description: Cheery bright light pours into the hall through the open doors of the chapel.  It glints off the polished stones of the floor, set at slight angles so that they cleverly form a subtle mosaic of the face of Meraud.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Duty]]
description: The great hallway widens and rises slightly as it curves gracefully toward the center of the citadel.  The almhara walls are hung with the banners of lesser cities and minor nobility.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Chamber of All]]
description: The heart of the Citadel, the Chamber of All is an immense circular courtyard surrounded by the stone walls of the three Halls.  White gravel and red brick walkways surround an open-air amphitheater, providing a place to relax away from the gloomy black hallways.  A steep stone staircase leads up to a private balcony which is lined with the standards and banners of countless nations, most long fallen to dust.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, southwest, up.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Winding Staircase]]
description: Made from thirty-six slabs of almhara, the staircase forms a tight spiral that leads to a balcony overhead.  Some of the slabs are badly cracked and canted at odd angles.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Power]]
description: Light from the Chamber of All slightly illuminates this portion of the hallway, reflecting off a silver plaque set above the entrance to the Warrior Mage Guildhall.  A small lizard pokes its head out from a crack between two stones, watching what transpires.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Power]]
description: The curving stone hallway is shrouded in muffled darkness, broken only by a faint light to the west.  Torch sconces line the almhara walls, waiting to be lit.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Power]]
description: Light coming through the open infirmary door barely illuminates the hallway, casting the well of the curving stone staircase into deep shadow.  The silver inlay of an almhara plaque above the door catches the light, shining in defiance of the gloom.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Power]]
description: Torchlight plays across an intricate spiderweb near the ceiling.  The web echoes the shape of a series of cracks which radiate out from a central point in the hall floor, as if something heavy had been dropped on it from a great height.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Death]]
description: Guards walk the hallways with hands on the hilts of their weapons, their eyes casting suspicious glances in every direction.  Their gazes occasionally drift to a large eye-in-triskele symbol etched upon the wall opposite a narrow corridor, but never dwell on it.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Guildmaster's Balcony]]
description: The balcony features the graceful winged buttresses and angelic friezes of Celestial Elven architecture, in contrast to the ponderous darkness of the rest of the fortress.  It overlooks the amphitheater, allowing whoever stands here to overhear what is said.  Five of the world's most priceless artifacts and works of art are set about the balcony, each on an individual stone pedestal.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Death]]
description: The black almhara stone hallway curves slightly here, leading off into shrouded darkness. Patches of glowing moss are growing on the northern wall, barely providing enough light to see by.  A black onyx archway, a deeper shadow against the black wall, leads to the fortress's credit union.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Death]]
description: Pale light filters into the gloomy hall from below a narrow door on the eastern wall.  A large black rat sits across from the door, its beady eyes reflecting the light into twin pinpoints of fire.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Hall of Death]]
description: The Hall of Death ends here, the curving almhara hallway stopping abruptly at a blank wall.  A small crack in the ceiling has allowed rainwater to drip through, collecting into a small pool of clear water, which is glowing softly.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Artificer's Workroom]]
description: A single oil lamp burns low in this untidy workroom.  Odd shapes loom in dark corners, and bits of twisted copper and glass are strewn across the scarred oaken countertop.  Zharlest, the aged and dozing S'Kra proprietor, seems to take no notice of the mess nor of his potential customers.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Infirmary]]
description: Every inch of black stone in the infirmary has been covered in pearlescent white tile.  A score of torches blaze brightly from sconces set about the walls, filling the room with a cheery light.  Though busy tending the myriad wounds of the residents of the citadel, Healer Elys takes time to acknowledge your presence with a polite nod.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Barracks]]
description: The barracks hall is filled with row upon row of empty cots, each one with a little chest at the end for storing personal items.  A few mages have set their familiars to guard their belongings.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Office]]
description: Though the main features of the office are a simple and functional ebonwood desk and chair, the beige carpet, light deobar paneling, and numerous lanterns give the room a sense of luxury in contrast to the rest of the fortress.  A small stone fireplace set in the wall opposite the desk keeps the room comfortably warm.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Mess Hall]]
description: Rows of tables and benches are arranged to seat hundreds.  Designed to feed them all with speed and efficiency, the kitchen, run by a stern Halfling, is larger than the public rooms of many inns.  Warm air from the ovens issues from a vent in the wall near the floor, barely adequate to heat the large room.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Security Checkpoint]]
description: A stony-faced sentry stands at attention besides a silvery arch with the word "Setheral" inscribed above it.  Torches blaze brightly from sconces set in the walls.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Credit Union]]
description: The credit union is furnished in expensive silk rugs and imported Elven tapestries.  Smokeless white candles ring the chamber, looking nice but providing very little light.  A S'kra guard dips some throwing darts in poison vials, keeping one eye on his task and one eye on the people in the lobby.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Teller]]
description: A marble counter holds a row of teller windows which are all closed save one.  This window is manned by a frazzled Elothean girl who looks ready to rip the head off of the next person to bother her.  Customers in the long line grumble to each other about the lack of service.

title: [[Chyolvea Tayeu'a, Exchange]]
description: The currency exchange is little more than a blank stone room with a large counter and a steel-barred window.  An Elf with bloodshot eyes minds the counter, yawning occasionally.

title: [[Darkmist Moor]]
description: A strange, meticulously placed line of bones begins here, travelling to the northeast through the tall grass.  Comprised of many sizes and shapes, the bones are devoid of rotted flesh or sinew.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: The dusky scent of nightshade seems to manifest visually as the rolling, dark mists that are omnipresent over the wild moor.  The grasses waver in a lilting motion, enchanted by the intoxicating aroma.
Barren of leaves, wretched trees loom up from the tall grass looking a great deal like upturned claws.  A somber mist perpetually hangs in the air, dampening your lungs with its weight.

Tall grasses sway under the ebb and flow of the dark purple mists, kissing the verdant blades with icy dew.  Patches of colorful nightshade bloom amidst the grasses, a beautiful yet deadly addition to this dark, wild garden.
Barren of leaves, wretched trees loom up from the tall grass looking a great deal like upturned claws.  A somber mist perpetually hangs in the air, dampening your lungs with its weight.
Tendrils of blooming nightshade climb high through the dark mists into the vacant claw-like trees, appearing to give the deceased husks some semblance of life, however perverted.
The dark mists cast a bluish-lavender pall through the air.  The motion of every shadow is magnified, twitching in wait just beyond your field of vision.
Irregular patches of tall grass and squat shrubs lie beneath a sinuous blanket of dark purple mist.  The twisted shadow of an occasional barren tree looms in the foggy distance.
Sharp shadows cut through the landscape, accenting the twisted silhouettes of the grotesquely haggard trees while concealing the hazards that lie hidden within the patches of tall grass.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: Sharp shadows cut through the landscape, accenting the twisted silhouettes of the grotesquely haggard trees while concealing the hazards that lie hidden within the patches of tall grass.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: The soft mist makes everything seem muted and far away, disconnected and tinged with the illusion of a dream world.
Sharp shadows cut through the landscape, accenting the twisted silhouettes of the grotesquely haggard trees while concealing the hazards that lie hidden within the patches of tall grass.
Swaths of dark mist drape the moor in layers of shadow, concealing the source of a malignant rustling that waits in nearby tangles of nightshade.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Scraggly Treetop]]
description: The age-worn tree lofts its branches just above the heavy pall of mist, offering a clear vantage of the surrounding terrain.  A simple whitewashed church nestles in the green countryside to the east, an odd sight amidst so much gloom.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Dirt Road]]
description: The ground slopes along the sides of a simple dirt road meandering northward from the thin mists.  Delightfully earthy smells of dust and wildlife punctuate the crisp fresh air.  A small white building sits quietly at the side of an abandoned road.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Secluded Shrine]]
description: Shrouded in dark purple mist, a tall ebony altar rises from the overgrown grass.  A collection of hideous gargoyles stands sentry in a macabre circle around the shrine, sneering inward at the scarred monolith.
