title: [[Fang Cove, Fate's Fortune Lane]]
description: The bank's dome rises up above the limestone wall, and even from this distance the occasional tinkling of coins being rattled from their jars can be heard as clearly as the chimes hanging from the tall palm tree alongside the lane.  Smells from The Shanty's kitchens, though faint, are ever present.  From time to time, a group of workers approaches the countless pallets of building supplies that are stacked one atop another in search of a specific wood, cut of stone or barrel of paint.  More often than not, the sought treasure is buried at the bottom of such a stack.

title: [[Fang Cove, Fate's Fortune Lane]]
description: The swirling ocean breeze stirs the sand that finds its way onto everything, creating intricate patterns across the surfaces of the cobblestones that form the lane.  Long and low wooden planter boxes are centered in the gap between the lane and the wall on the northern side, an effort to fill the space in the absence of the growing structures across the way.  Some of the gardens are covered to create makeshift tables to serve the workers meals at different times of the day.

title: [[Fang Cove, Fate's Fortune Lane]]
description: The lane diverges into two paths that lead around a wooden frame in the center of the cobblestone pavement.  When completed, the structure would be a rough cube approximately one dozen hands high with the same width and length -- too small to be a place of business, though its purpose is unclear.  An unfinished bench lies half assembled along one side.  Curious onlookers pause from time to time to examine the slow progress being made and to speculate at what it will eventually be.

The lane diverges into two paths that lead around a large community gazebo at the center of the cobbled pavement.  Curious onlookers pause from time to time to admire the structure and to pick the redolent, surrounding blossoms.  A sturdy bench sits to one side beneath a leafy windmill palm, providing a shady rest for visitors to the area.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: This long stretch of beach curves out toward the rocky cliff commonly referred to as Fang's Peak.  Children are not often seen along its dark sandy surface as crabs and various other creatures reside beneath the sand waiting for their chance to sting, poke or bite.  Tiny mounds of rock dot the area, with sprigs of dried grasses caught within them.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: Grains of sticky wet sand attach themselves to everything they come in contact with, including those unlucky souls who happen by.  Gentle sounds of the nearby lapping waves contrast sharply with the ruckus being made by the gulls that inhabit the area.  Cliffs nearby offer homes to various creatures, including some better left alone by those unable to defend themselves.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: More rocks than sand lay upon the foot of the cliffs, mixed with bits of bone and grass.  The cliff walls have been eroded by the elements, leaving cracks and crevices and even a few shallow caves along its surface.  A worn wooden sign perches precariously near one of the crevices.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: Swirls of water gather in the footprints left by those passing by, while tiny crabs dart between mounds of rocks and grass.  The sparse remains of a fish lay embedded in the sand along with other debris that has washed ashore.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: A huge stone stands at the entrance of this cave, with only a slight crack to give evidence of it being there.  Strange noises can be heard within, though whether it's the amplified moaning of the air or some prowling beast is unclear.  Perhaps the stone's purpose is to keep people out, or to keep something in.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: The long stretch of beach ends here, with the jutting rock of Fang's Peak lurking above.  A rough stairway leads up the peak but appears to stop midway, as if something interrupted the construction.  The result is the same -- overland access via the steps to areas beyond is impossible.  A large mound of sea grass lies near the steps, with bits of hair and twine woven in.

title: [[Fang Cove, Cliffside]]
description: The stairway ends here at a carved and raised area midway to the peak.  The area is just large enough to accommodate a worn log and a firepit.  Bits of old twine and bones are woven through a tree root that thrusts its way out of the cliff.  Faint whistling sounds come from the hallowed recesses of the partially gnawed bones.  Though some may call this a perfect camping spot, others might be intimidated by the howls and screeches from the beach below.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Cave]]
description: Tall enough for a Human to stand upright, yet low enough for a Gor'Tog to need to hunch over, the ceiling is covered in cobwebs and the nests of countless insects.  Numerous clawed footprints mar the cave floor, and the piles of fish bones and remains from other unlucky sea creatures suggest the occupants visit often.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: Hardly perceptible, the floor slopes downwards as one travels further into the darkened tunnel.  The rock walls are discolored, showing signs of water damage as well as a struggle for various fungi competing for dominance on the roughened surface.  Running down the center of the ground is a tiny rivulet, only slightly damp.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: The tunnel constricts on all sides as it leads further into the deepening darkness.  Five lines of scratch marks follow along either side of the rivulet that runs down the center of the ground, though there are no other signs of who -- or what -- may have made them.  A stalactite dangling from the ceiling almost completely blocks further passage.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: Strange stalactite-like structures angle downwards from the tunnel's ceiling.  Rather than being large at the source and tapering towards the end, they're the precise opposite -- thin as a strand of thread at the ceiling and the width of an opened palm at the loose end.  A single circular ring is carved into the surface of each structure at varying levels of height.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: Primitive drawings dot an area of the tunnel's wall that has been worked into a relatively smooth surface in comparison to the stone surrounding it.  One of the more common symbols represented is that of a tentacled creature.  The faint remains of a tall blue waterfall reside above the creature.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: The declining slope of the floor as the cave curves around itself becomes much more pronounced.  Faint splashes echo off the stone walls as each step disturbs the stagnant water that has collected here.  Markings on the wall show that the elevation of the water sometimes rises to more than halfway up the tunnel.

title: [[Talas Sagamat, Western Tunnel]]
description: A putrid odor lingers in the stale, musty air trapped within the small chamber.  Muffled crunches echo beneath each footstep as the bones of some creature's past meals are shattered into mere slivers under the water's surface.  Stifled moans echo throughout the curving tunnel, though their source remains a mystery.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beneath Fang's Peak]]
description: Rocks and boulders big and small lie strewn across the floor of the tunnel.  The clatter of falling rock from nearby resounds sharply in the tight passage.  Cracks in the walls and ceiling creak ominously, releasing small puffs of dust and pebbles.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beneath Fang's Peak]]
description: Large roots from above have grown through the ceiling, cracking the surrounding rock.  They trail along the surface before disappearing into one wall that has collapsed below them.  The constant groan of stone grating against stone fills the air.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beneath Fang's Peak]]
description: The threat of collapse disappears through this section of intact tunnel.  A straight, solid passage has been hewn through a vein of hard granite.  The sound of dripping water echoes in the tight space.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beneath Fang's Peak]]
description: Water has eroded a section of wall and drips into a stagnant mineral pool below.  Pale moss grows on the wet surfaces.  Smelling faintly of iron and sulfur, the air is damp and cloying.  The creaking of unstable rock can be heard faintly from above.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beneath Fang's Peak]]
description: An old collapse fills most of the tunnel, and the rubble turns the passage into an obstacle course.  An occasional rumble of shifting rock warns that the tunnel is far from safe.  The sound of dripping water comes from somewhere nearby.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: Grasping creepers climb, drape and clasp everything in their path, hiding who knows what beneath their leafy carpet.  They hinder every step through the jungle and strive with each other for possession of light and space.  Nearyby, thick green shoots weave around a pale, thin tree trunk, and the vine is far healthier than its host.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: Roots protruding from the underbrush are clearly visible in some spots and hidden beneath the mulch in others, waiting to trip the unwary.  Multiple branches of the rampant vegetation block the path and require careful manipulation to avoid being whipped left and right.  A small clearing to the side of the cluttered path is guarded by dense foliage that dissuades the prudent from exploration.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: Industrious ants have created a huge mound smack in the middle of the pathway.  The bare soil is marked with minute trails that disappear into the ground cover.  It is difficult to avoid the sensation of having disturbed the creatures' habitat and to avoid scratching oneself against the brush.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: Something has been digging in the dirt, and as a result, the area is heavily pockmarked.  Depressions of varying widths and depths make for careful stepping to avoid twisting an ankle or worse.  A few of the holes could be tunnels, though their darkness masks how deep they might be.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: Charred ground with a rusting cauldron at its center fills an area bounded by logs laid in a square  A few sticks that might have been tent pegs lie nearby.  Beyond the fire pit, a dilapidated mud and rock wall blocks passage into the jungle.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: A tangle of growth climbs upward, its roots wormed into muddy spaces between the stones of a high, long wall.  The rampant vegetation conceals a good bit of the structure, which in turn blocks the view of anything behind it.  To the southeast is a small clearing from which the scent of burnt wood drifts on the wind.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: The jungle closes in, laying claim to the land, air and water beyond the mud and rock wall.  Impenetrable thickets as far as the eye can see camouflage what lies behind and beneath them.

title: [[Fang's Shadow, Dense Undergrowth]]
description: The ability to see any distance is obscured by thick growth.  What doesn't hang from every available limb climbs up and over anything attached to the ground.  Moisture beads on the greenery, the result of so much life attempting to breathe in such close proximity.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Trail]]
description: Vast, overgrown vegetation lines the worn dirt path and creates a towering canopy stretching overhead.  Entwined branches sprout above as if seeking respite from the tightly clustered bushes.  Small, half-eaten berries litter the ground around a particularly dense bit of foliage.  In the distance, the path forks to encircle a large pool

title: [[Fang's Rise, Western Embankment]]
description: Though steeper than the opposing embankment to the east, the climb is made easier by some jutting pieces of rock that provide steps leading from the deep, blue water below.  Mosses of various hues of green cover the ground and some of the nearby rocks.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Eastern Embankment]]
description: Rocks, dirt and broken branches from the surrounding trees cover this side of the embankment.  A few large boulders, positioned near the edge of a pool, make perfect seats for a weary traveler.  One can rest while dipping their feet into the cool, clear water and taking in the scenery.

timeto.8346: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 300 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Fang's Rise, Pool]]
description: The loud, thunder-like roar of the waterfall blocks out virtually all other noise, exerting its dominance over Fang's Peak.  Waves of white water erupt from the percussion point, rippling across the pool.  A light mist rises from the surface partly concealing a steep embankment.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Pool]]
description: Clear blue water hurtles down from the waterfall, freefalling into the deeper blue of the pool to create a liquid turmoil.  Mist rises from where the two meet, and beneath the surface, a deep fissure is visible.  An opening can just be made out behind the tall wall of water.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Pool]]
description: Away from the turmoil of the nearby waterfall, the pool takes on a calmer, almost serene appearance.  Tall branches covered in large leaves hang protectively over the water like a parasol against the elements.  A nearby embankment offers passage to dry land.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Pool]]
description: The current causes the deep, blue water to swirl gently in lazy, irregular circles, almost concealing the pebbles and rocks beneath its surface.  The air is filled with a heady scent from the nearby trees that shelter sections of the pool with their large, overhanging branches.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Secluded Island]]
description: Low hanging trees, branches and dense vegetation make this little island seem to be like its own secluded world.  The sounds of the nearby waterfall are nearly drowned out by the abundant insects, birds and other creatures hiding within the profuse foliage.  A well-worn tree stump, smooth with age, sits before a large flat rock that appears to have been used as a table.

timeto.8341: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 300 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Fang's Rise, Hidden Cave]]
description: This cave's concave stone walls are heavily carved with sea scenes that run the gamut from the tiniest minnow to several sea monsters.  Some large, rough rocks surround an unusual assortment of boulders.  The air hangs heavily, almost as if pressing downward.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Behind the Waterfall]]
description: Water drips through narrow cracks in the rock, wetting the floor which slopes towards the opening covered by the waterfall.  A short passage leads away from the loud roar of the tumbling water and rises up toward a large open cavern.

title: [[Fang's Peak]]
description: Dense foliage lines either side of the clear blue river as though it were guiding the rushing water to the cliff's edge.  The rest of the river disappears into a treacherously rocky ravine that trails into the jungle's wilds to the southwest, preventing any further travel by land.  The rushing water creates a powerful waterfall as it cascades over the ledge into a pool below.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Peak's Ledge]]
description: Sparse shrubs spring from small patches of dirt adding greenery to the rock face and difficulty to navigating this section of the cliff.  The only respite is a small ledge at the halfway mark that is barely large enough for a large Gor'Tog to sit on.

title: [[Fang's Rise, Peak's Base]]
description: Large, moss-covered boulders provide step-like footholds to traverse the cliff, while protruding rocks also offer some assistance.  They stretch up for about forty feet on either side of the waterfall, the grey stone slick from water hitting parts of the bulging rock face.

title: [[Jungle Area, Pale Tree]]
description: The thin tree sways slightly with the added weight, but seems to be sturdy enough to handle a large Gor'Tog.  Droplets of light penetrate the surrounding canopy, providing welcome relief from the foliage-enforced gloom.

title: [[Jungle Path, Tangled Growth]]
description: The vegetation is so dense with vines, branches and other flora, that visibility is pretty minimal up here.  Still, it is quite sturdy and inviting, giving a brief respite from the pressures of the jungle.

title: [[Fang Cove, Beach]]
description: A strip of pale sand plays home to children, pets and other wayward creatures that make their way up from the lapping waves nearby.  A stone-ringed firepit and a picnic table are surrounded by crushed seashells that make soft crunching sounds when stepped upon.

title: [[Fang Cove, Shoreline]]
description: The coarse sand of the beach gradually gives way to granite boulders and smaller stones.  As the rock formation rises from the ocean floor, it creates a protective bowl that contains a large coral reef to the north.  Barnacles encrust the stone, promising nasty scratches for the unwary.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Reef]]
description: A coral reef hugs the leeward side of a granite outcropping.  Surrounded by schools of colorful fish, pink and white coral grow in bunches, some making skeletal fingers straining toward the surface.  In a small hole, young moray eels peek out from time to time, their eyes flickering warily.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Fang Cove, Seaward]]
description: The granite outcrop, cracked into separate pillars by constant erosion, reaches toward the surface.  A chasm makes a slight break in the stone wall like a thin knife cut.  It is completely dark down the opening, and rushing currents make entrance impossible.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Fang Cove, Seaward]]
description: The granite outcrop, cracked into separate pillars by constant erosion, reaches toward the surface.  Like silent monoliths, they protect the reef from erosive currents and pounding waves.  The coral grows up the side of the rock for a short distance before giving way to barnacles and sea mosses that have taken hold on the craggy surface.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, down.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Waving tendrils of kelp float in the currents, obscuring both the surface and the seafloor from view.  A dim glow from above illuminates the fluttering blades of the vegetation.  Occasionally the brown fronds part enough to allow a glimpse of the broken body of a shipwreck resting on the sand.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Reef]]
description: A coral reef hugs the leeward side of a granite outcropping.  Surrounded by schools of colorful fish, pink and white coral grow in bunches, some making skeletal fingers straining toward the surface.  A large barnacle-encrusted timber, embedded at an angle in the reef, points accusingly towards shore.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Reef]]
description: A forest of coral, reaching toward the surface, creates a small cul-de-sac.  Curious sea horses, clinging to the branches, silently observe everything around them.  Sand has settled in the still current to make an underwater beach.

title: [[Fang Cove, Shoreline]]
description: The coarse sand of the beach gradually gives way to granite boulders and smaller stones.  As rocky formations rise from the ocean floor, they create a protective bowl that contains a large coral reef to the north.  Barnacles cling to the stones, promising nasty scratches for the unwary.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Reef]]
description: A coral reef hugs the leeward side of a granite outcropping.  Surrounded by schools of colorful fish, pink and white coral grow in bunches, some making skeletal fingers straining toward the surface.  Sparse clumps of sea grass sway gently in the tidal current.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Fang Cove, Shoreline]]
description: Progress is impeded by a large bed of dislodged kelp that has washed ashore and now dances with the ebb and flow of the tide.  Even in the shallow, ankle-deep water, colorful fish, mollusks and other small sea creatures use the plant's fronds for both food and temporary shelter.  A glimpse of a coral reef can be seen to the north between the cresting waves.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Reef]]
description: A coral reef hugs the leeward side of a granite outcropping.  Surrounded by schools of colorful fish, pink and white coral grow in bunches, some making skeletal fingers straining toward the surface.  To the east, the coral has grown overhead making a small cave.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Fang Cove, Seaward]]
description: The granite outcrop, cracked into separate pillars by constant erosion, reaches toward the surface.  Like silent monoliths, they protect the reef from erosive currents and pounding waves.  The coral grows up the side of the rock for a short distance before giving way to barnacles and sea mosses that have taken hold on the craggy surface.

title: [[Fang Cove, Coral Cave]]
description: Protected from the ever present current, the water in the cave is still.  The coral walls are covered with phosphorescent algae that give off a meager white light.  Small fish dart about, feeding on loose plankton filtering in from the opening.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: A small sailing ship has sunk here, coming to rest in the midst of the kelp beds.  One porthole has come open, its empty metal frame swaying slowly in the current.  Seaweed twines around the mast, tangling in the rotting rigging.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Rising from the seafloor, the barnacle-covered stern of a ship breaks through the thick kelp beds.  Tilted at an angle, the stern windows have been smashed in.  Brightly colored fish dart in and out of the openings where once the ship's crew looked out.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Shoots of kelp rise up from the seabed, reaching towards the sunlight far above.  Colorful fish dart amongst the fronds, dodging the relentless predators who hunt the deep waters.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Broken masts, decks and tangled rigging from two wrecked ships litter the area, leaving only a narrow tunnel that allows passage between the two rotting hulks.  Limpets and mussels cling to the wooden surfaces, attracted by the water current flowing through the tapered channel.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Thick kelp beds block further transit, ringing the area with brown walls of swaying foliage.  The vegetation meets overhead, blotting out the water's surface from view.  Dark shapes lurk in the shadows, hiding from view.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Part of the bow of one shipwreck fell on another, smaller wreck, creating a hole in the older ship.  Collapsed decks and spilled cargo litter the seafloor.  Wavy shadows from above create ever changing patterns on the sand and debris.

title: [[Fang Cove, Deep Water]]
description: Debris and detritus from a shipwreck litter the seafloor, trailing from the almost complete stern.  Little vegetation has found purchase in the few open spots between the wreckage.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: The breeze coming off the water blows the sand into mounds resembling cresting waves.  Liberally mixed with bits of glass and shell, the sand glistens as if wet.  A large browned frond lies at the base of a tall palm, its spiny stalk ready to trip an unwary passerby.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: Bits of finely ground sea glass, washed up by long ago storms and mixed in with the clearing's sand and broken shells, capture and reflect the day's light in colorful displays depending on the viewing angle.  From one view, the sand appears pale beige, but from another it is alive with light and sparkles.  A lush green carpet of grass encircles a large central palm.

Bits of finely ground sea glass, washed up by long ago storms and mixed in with the clearing's sand and broken shells, capture and dance in the night's dim light depending on the viewing angle.  From one view, the sand appears dull beige, but from another it glistens and sparkles like snow.  A lush green carpet of grass grows about the base of a large central palm.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: Heavy foliage encloses this tropical clearing complete with sand and shell fragments.  Glimpses of deep blue water to the north are revealed as palms sway gently in the breeze, presenting an ever changing view.  To the south, the jungle attempts to exert its dominance, but so far has not managed to encroach too far.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: The soft slap of waves is but a whisper in this spot surrounded by thick clusters of palms.  A bountiful blend of grass and sand forms a visual carpet of beige and green.  A large boulder, vaguely shaped like a frog on its haunches, hampers viewing of this area from the southwest.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: A tangled mixture of queen and cabbage palms, overrun with climbing vines, almost obscures the view of the sea, but the blue of the water peeks through at eye level.  The sound of waves lapping on the sandy beach provides a counterpoint to the whisper of the fronds.  Fine white sand mixes with a darker soil where the beach heads inland.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: This quiet locale is a blend of soil, sand, shell and wood debris as the inland jungle meets and mingles with the beach.  A long dead frond rests its dried tip on the ground as it dangles from a tall full-headed fan palm.  The shade cast from the tree offers relief from the relentless sunlight.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: Several running vines mix with sparse scrub grass in a race for fresh water and sunlight.  Overhead, the canopy of palms provides dappled shade to the other plant life.  Reminiscent of a dancer in a grass skirt, a large queen palm sports its regal fan head above its dried, dying fronds.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: Coral, crushed by the long retreated sea, mixes with the natural sand and more solid soil of the area.  Here and there a few sharp bits remain, ready to slice the unwary who forget the respect it deserves.  Glistening bits resembling silver reflect light depending on the viewing angle but disappoint those seeking anything of value.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: The idyllic view to the north is a stark contrast to that which heads inland off the beach.  Just past this small cleared area is a long growing jungle of vines, fallen fronds and seed pods atop a prickly ground cover.  There's little doubt that the tangled growth provides shelter to countless creatures, only some of which might be benign.

title: [[The Enclave at Fang Cove]]
description: On a ridge just off the beach in a murky pool of water, blades of marsh grass wave in a complex ballet, keeping time with the sea breezes.  They serve as an effective divider between the actual beach and this stretch reaching inland.  Powdery white sand, dotted with shells and low-growing creeper grass, provides an idyllic retreat, complete with the whispering voice of the sea as it responds to the tides.

title: [[Amidst the Fronds]]
description: The sturdy base of a large frond provides a spot to rest and take a moment to enjoy the shade provided.  The scenery up here is a tangle of tropical foliage and a good view of the distant water.

title: [[The Gemmery]]
description: Thin strips of leather knotted with glass fragments and cheap gems hang in bunches at various lengths around the room, reflecting the light in a spray of vibrant colors.  Most give a gentle tinkle as they knock together in a breeze while others are hopelessly tangled together, swaying in clusters.  A driftwood counter, of the same material and condition as the distressed walls, serves as storage for transactions as well as an odd collection of treasured trinkets.

title: [[First Council Banking, Vestibule]]
description: Adobe clings to the latticework of woven bamboo that forms the domed structure overhead.  A set of shallow steps on one side of the room leads downward at an angle that makes it clear that the area at its other end is outside the walls of this abode.  A hatch-covered ladder resides on the other side of the room and leads straight down.

title: [[First Council Banking, Foreign Exchange]]
description: The frazzled Halfling attendant can barely be seen amid the paperwork stacked dangerously high atop her desk.  She seldom looks up as patrons come and go, even those seeking her attention.  Hand signals to the mage beside her keep the flow at a steady pace.

title: [[First Council Banking, Exchanges]]
description: Lengths of wooden planks span short beams and are supported by simple stone columns.  The construction shifts unsteadily as the weight of the beach overhead constantly tries to collapse.  A single table in the center of the room bears three jars with numerous coins of different metals in each.  A sign rests beside the first jar.  A cool breeze circles the room, causing the light-giving candles to flicker and splutter.

title: [[First Council Banking, Vault]]
description: Little more than a deep hole, the below-ground sod structure is reinforced with vine-lashed lengths of weathered wood.  Jar-covered shelves line every bit of space available while a lone set of steps provide the only entrance to and exit from the community's small bank -- a liberal description of the surroundings.  No windows or tellers are present, only guards that stand with their backs to the wall on either side of the steps so they can keep an eye on everything that happens.

title: [[Lakyan's Tailored Goods and Repair, Sales Floor]]
description: An oddity among some of the other local shops, this one contains wooden planks for a floor in lieu of the natural sand.  Hardy wooden beams are evenly spaced around the square room, each joined to the next by a Gnome-high shelf.  A battered trunk has been tucked away in one corner.

title: [[Osmandikar's Crafts and Repair, Showroom]]
description: Shattered stalks of bamboo, semi-dry mud from sand, and large sheafs of tattered tropical leaves form the majority of the crudely crafted hut.  A wide cloth spans the width of the room from the northeastern corner to the southwestern one, though a large hole directly above the counter has formed.  Gazing up through the hole in the cloth, you take note that a similarly sized hole resides in the hut's roof at the same location.

title: [[Yrisa's Hut]]
description: Bits of the hut's leafy canopy dangle down from the vine-bound rafters above.  Small holes in the bamboo fortifications whistle shrilly when even the slightest of sea-scented breezes wafts by the simple structure.  Footprints come and go as the sandy floor shifts under the weight of patrons.  Frequent strong winds from the ocean cause the structure to creak as it shifts under the stress.

title: [[Gorund's Furs]]
description: The driftwood walls sag inward with the weight of pelts drawing them down.  Flies buzz around the fresher skins while preserved ones wait in bundles by the exit, lashed tightly for easy transport.  An occasional breeze wafts through a window cut into a wall, chasing the normally stifling air.

title: [[The Shanty, Kitchen]]
description: The kitchen, though clean, is crammed full of food in various stages of preparation.  Onions, garlic, peppers and bananas hang from brass hooks along one wall, while a large table is lined with bowls and mixing implements.  The kitchen's chef roams the area and keeps an eye on one and all, making sure everything is running smoothly in her domain.

title: [[The Shanty, Alcove]]
description: This area is bereft of much, other than stairs leading to the top floor and a small painting of fruit.  The pale oak walls echo with the sounds coming from the kitchen and lend little respite for those seeking refuge from the noise.

title: [[The Shanty, Living Area]]
description: Though somewhat muffled, the indistinct sounds of patrons coming and going and the work being done in the kitchen are still prevalent in the small living space used by the facility's maintainers.  The room is decorated in soft shades of yellow and blue, and a couch of matching striped fabric sits before a carved oval window that looks out to the sea beyond the dock.

title: [[Fang Cove, Under the Dock]]
description: A protected area free from most of the effects of the surf exists under the dock.  Massive pilings made from the trunks of huge trees hold everything firmly in place.  A seaweed-covered ladder leads upwards.

title: [[Fang Cove, Under the Dock]]
description: Seaweed collects around the pilings making swimming more interesting amid the strands.  An outcrop of granite sticks through the water, providing a nesting place for a pair of gulls.  They eye everything suspiciously and croak loudly if disturbed.

title: [[Fang Cove, Under the Dock]]
description: Deep under the pier, the filtered light makes the water seem luminescent.  The sound of foot traffic overhead can be heard through the creaking of boards.  A close inspection of the underside shows pieces of rusted chains and brackets still attached to the scavenged wood used to construct the town dock.

The creaking of the wooden dock as the waves steadily assault its moorings resounds loudly into the night.  Long shadows are cast from the lanterns' light above onto the rusted chains and brackets still attached to the scavenged wood, adding to the menacing ambiance.

title: [[Fang Cove, Under the Dock]]
description: At the head of the dock, the pull of the tide becomes more apparent.  Between two large supports, the open ocean runs to the distant, stark horizon.  Seabirds swoop and flutter, waiting for any tidbits that may be discarded from local fisherman.

title: [[Fang Cove, Under the Dock]]
description: The pull of the current is less intense on the leeward side of the dock.  Past a seaweed covered piling, the beach can be seen being caressed by gentle waves in the distance.  The surf seems to be tamed by some natural formation out in the bay.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Village Square]]
description: A lone tree stands forlornly here, its once luxurient foliage now covered with creeping vines.  Underneath the shady boughs, rotten planks mark where a small bench once sat, its outline barely discernable still.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Village Square]]
description: Tumbled stones mark where a wall once stood sentinel around the village's well.  Now all that remains are the crudely cut rocks precariously perched around the lip of the shaft.  Off to one side, a wooden bucket lies silently in the dust, a frayed rope extending from its handle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Down the Well]]
description: Condensation causes the stone-lined walls to drip moisture continuously and making the climb up or down the crudely hacked out handholds treacherous.  A small ledge running around the wall provides a precarious stopping point just above the water's surface.  Set into the stone walls above the ledge, a niche holds a tiny carved statue.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Village Square]]
description: Grudgingly giving way to open ground, the jungle has retreated from the trampled clay plaza surrounded by crude huts.  Brave shoots of grass spring up from the bare dirt, beginning nature's process of reclaiming the abandoned village.  Broken bits of pottery, smashed into tiny pieces, are strewn about the square and mingle with other rubbish and debris in the dust.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Trail]]
description: Twisting between the towering trees, a dirt track wends its way towards a clearing in the jungle.  Lianas and other vines drape from the overhanging branches down onto the ground.  The smell of rotting vegetation wafts through the air, mingling with the musty odor of damp earth.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Village Square]]
description: Two huts have collapsed here, strewing debris into the abandoned plaza.  A blooming rose bush, long since gone wild, flourishes near what once was a door.  The scent of the abundant blooms fills the air, drowning out the normal rotting smells of the nearby jungle.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Collapsed Hut]]
description: Mud and wattle walls end abruptly barely two feet off the pounded clay floor, sheared off.  Nothing remains of the roof or upper walls, nor are there any signs of furnishings within the ruined walls.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Collapsed Hut]]
description: Nothing remains of the hut that once stood here but the bare earth of the foundation and a few posts sticking up from the ground.  Vine tendrils inch across the earth, forerunners of the encroaching jungle lurking just beyond the ruined hut.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Collapsed Hut]]
description: Timbers have buckled inward, creating a small cave-like structure.  Thatch from the roof covers the ground in heaps, obscuring and obliterating any interior furnishings that might have survived the collapse of the building.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Hut]]
description: Glimmers of light enter through the doorway, only partially blocked by the sagging door.  Crude shelves hang on the mud-covered walls, their surfaces covered with a thick layer of dust and grime.  Nothing else remains in the hut but a blackened hearth in the middle of the floor.

title: [[Abandoned Village, Hut]]
description: A simple stool sits on its side in the corner, surrounded by cobwebs and dust bunnies.  Mud flaking from the walls has exposed the wattle structure underneath and left piles of debris at the base of the walls.  A faint odor of decay lingers in the air, mingling with the humid stench of the jungle.

title: [[A Sunken Ship, Cargo Hold]]
description: Jagged timbers line the hole torn in the hull of the ship, although the cause of the breach is unknown.  Sand has drifted in through the opening and fills the hatchway leading to the lower decks.  A few forlorn barrels lie jumbled in the corner with the remnants of many more that once filled the cargo hold.

title: [[A Sunken Ship, Cabin]]
description: Thick gloom covers the cramped cabin, the only illumination coming from the open porthole leading out.  Debris blocks the passageway that once led to the deck.  Silt covers most of the furnishings, making their original purpose hard to discern.

title: [[A Sunken Ship, Cargo Hold]]
description: A narrow opening allows escape from the confined spaces of the cargo hold.  Thick bolts of decaying fabrics fill the room, and rotting fibers hang in the still waters.  A solid door is set in one bulkhead, its hardware covered with a thin coating of rust.

title: [[Lady Atladene's Salon, Parlor]]
description: Paintings of famous heroes hang upon the walls of the salon's expansive parlor.  Young Elven men and women move silently amongst the patrons, replenishing glasses and taking orders.  Crystal and gold lamps filled with azure oil offer illumination, and a wide hearth provides warmth in the bitterest of weather.  Music floats in from behind a rosewood screen in the northeast corner, and a private booth off to one side allows for more intimate discussion.

title: [[Lady Atladene's Garden, Roses]]
description: The scents of the roses of the daytime have been replaced by that of the night-blooming jasmine and midnight glories.  A faint trace of dew sparkles in the grass like a Fae's strewn diamonds, the delicately crafted jewels dissolving at the merest touch of mortal hands.  A small path meanders off to a flowery glade, and a stone-inlaid walkway leads to the Salon's pool.  A beveled glass door allows entry back into the house.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Grasslands]]
description: Tall, head-high grass mixes with short, broad-bladed grass emerging from the detritus at the base of the slope.  Some of the blades are crushed and broken, but most simply spring back when disturbed.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Ridge]]
description: The winds whip through the branches of the short, stunted trees up here on the ridge line.  It's uncomfortably cold, and eyes watering from the wind can't even properly appreciate the view.  Footing is good, since the wind has blown away loose stones and soil, leaving only what is well-anchored.

title: [[Dismal Grove, Paper Mill]]
description: Surrounded by boulders and jagged rocks, a small wooden paper mill sits in the center of the circle of dead poplars, appearing to be relatively newly built.  Several younger trees near the building struggle valiantly against the harsh environment, providing patches of green that sharply contrast the barren landscape.

title: [[Paper Mill, Entrance]]
description: The paper mill's high walls are crafted from planks of untreated wood, held together with bare nails in even rows.  Wooden beams hold up the high ceiling, and sawdust is scattered over the dirt floor.  The building has an unfinished air about it, as if aesthetics were sacrificed solely for function.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Hollow]]
description: This small hollow in the stone of the outcrop is surprisingly pleasant.  Dry rivulets in the ground suggest that rainwater carries loose dirt from higher on the mound and deposits it here, creating an oasis of both soil and water.  A variety of plants grow in this place -- little yellow bell-shaped flowers, puffy white ones, and tiny purple ones that grow scattered amongst all the others.  A vine with shiny leaves climbs up the walls, softening the otherwise harsh contours of the stone.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Chasm]]
description: Although cramped, this chasm connects two hollows and allows rainwater to flow away from the tiny oasis to the north.  Tiny pools of water dot the sandy floor.  Numerous large footprints almost obscure the dry runnels linking the puddles.

title: [[Rocky Outcrop, Hollow]]
description: Lush vines climb the sheer walls, growing up out of the deep pool that collects much of the runoff from the rocks above.  No exits exist but the one entrance, with the sheer rockface allowing no escape.  A litter of dried leaves and other debris lies scattered on the sandy ground.

title: [[Paper Mill, Narrow Hallway]]
description: The smell of sawdust hangs heavily in the air, and a fine wooden powder covers everything.  Light from an old gaethzen orb flickers above a boarded-up window, the aged sphere constantly threatening to go out.  The sound of crickets occasionally breaks the silence, and occasionally a rustle of paper echoes through the mill.

title: [[Paper Mill, Drying Chambers]]
description: Enormous sheets of white paper hang from wooden dowels over narrow troughs of water, arranged in diagonals to make the most of the mill's space.  The ceiling rises high, occasional lines of light from outside shining through cracks in the untreated wood.  A faint chemical smell hangs in the air, mixing with the constant scent of sawdust.

title: [[Paper Mill, Drying Chambers]]
description: A constant drip, drip, drip sound comes from a slanted tin panel hanging over a trough of water.  Apparently set up as an attempt to remove moisture from the drying area, the mechanism is attached to a fist-wide drainage pipe that leads outside.  In the southern portion of the expansive room, freshly made sheets of paper hang from wooden dowels, waiting to be moved.

title: [[Paper Mill, Chemical Baths]]
description: Steel troughs filled with steaming water line rows of thick shelves, each long basin delivering an acrid smell into the air.  Softening wood chips line the bottom of each one, preparing them to be turned into pulp for paper.  Shallow puddles mar the floor next to the troughs, slowly sinking into the dirt floor, while small piles of sawdust lie discarded in the corners.

title: [[Paper Mill, Chemical Baths]]
description: An enormous pile of wood chips dominates the eastern side of the room, underneath a large chute fixed in the ceiling.  Stuck halfway into the mound is a rusty shovel, apparently made for shoveling the wood chips into nearby troughs filled with water and chemicals.  The scent of sawdust hangs heavy in the air, and the occasional hooting of an owl can be heard from nearby outside.

title: [[Paper Mill, Working Stations]]
description: Towering stacks of square wooden frames filled with thin layers of wood pulp take up most of the floor space in this warehouse.  Set out to begin the curing process, each of the frames is large enough to make a full yard of paper.  The plain floor is simply hardened dirt, packed tight and scattered with a fine layer of sawdust.

title: [[Paper Mill, Working Stations]]
description: The center of the room is dominated by a pair of rollers, apparently used to squeeze chemical-laced water from freshly made paper.  Nearby a wide, shallow vat filled with water holds several large sheets of paper, sitting ready to be put through the wringer.  The walls and equipment show some signs of neglect: spots of rust appearing on the metallic parts of the equipment.

title: [[Paper Mill, Sawdust Heap]]
description: An enormous pile of sawdust mixed with bits of bark, metals and discarded paper makes a huge heap in this corner of the scrap yard, apparently unsuited for creating paper.  The mixture spreads over the entire yard, choking what little grass there is and mixing with the dirt underfoot.  A few barrels have been shoved next to the building, giving off a somewhat chemical smell.

title: [[Paper Mill, Scrap Yard]]
description: Sheared scraps of discarded bark, broken and rusty equipment, crumpled paper and other waste line the edges of the yard.  A relatively clear path leads east, where an enormous sawdust pile can be seen.  A compost bin has been shoved into the corner of the room, the rotting greens casting off an earthy smell.

title: [[Paper Mill, Upper Chutes]]
description: Cut blocks of wood, trimmed of all their bark, are piled in neat stacks all around this area.  A large saw lies suspended over a nearby cutting table, looking heavy enough to require four people to use.  Several discarded pieces of half-folded origami lie next to a wooden bench, as if their creator became disinterested halfway through the project.

title: [[Paper Mill, Upper Chutes]]
description: The center of this room is dominated by a large metallic grinder, apparently used to turn logs of wood into chips for papermaking.  A large half-covered hole near the grinder shows an enormous pile of cut wood chips in the room below.  Near the southern wall, a second chute lies open, apparently made for dumping discarded bark and other waste into the scrap yard.

title: [[Paper Mill, Rooftop]]
description: The slightly slanted rooftop of the paper mill is covered with piles of sawdust, creating little piles of powder that resemble dirty snow.  Jet black tiling peeks through the heavy layer of dust occasionally, in vague shapes that sometimes resemble footprints.  A sizable storm drain edges the roof, likely used to collect runoff water to be used for other purposes.

title: [[Paper Mill, Rooftop]]
description: This small area of the rooftop is relatively bare except for an empty bird's nest tucked into one corner of the storm drains.  A few bits of eggshell still remain inside the random-looking bundle of twigs and bark.  The roof is fairly flat in this area, only a slight angle directing rainwater into the trough lining its edge.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Golden grain gently sways beneath a faint breeze sending wave-like ripples across the field to the north.  A rail fence runs along the southern end of the field, separating it from the farmyard to the south.  A weathered wooden stile spans the fence, its broken risers allowing wayfarers to scramble across, while preventing stray animals from easily accessing the field.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A flimsy nest has been built in the base of a shallow hole beneath a wooden fence which runs across the southern end of the field.  Three speckled eggs lie unattended in their bed of straw and feathers, awaiting their mother's return, half hidden amidst the wheat and barley which ripen in the field.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A delicate silver spiderweb glistens in the moonlight, tiny dewdrops sparkling like diamonds adorning an intricate filigree net.  With each gust of wind, the fragile fabric stretches.  Eventually, it will tear, to waft away upon the wind while the spider patiently builds another -- a thing of beauty, fleeting, yet ever renewed.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A maple tree leans at an awkward angle over the banks of a drainage ditch to the east.  Blackened and scarred by a lightening strike, one branch has broken off to lie carelessly across the muddy bank of the ditch.  A twisted tangle of rope and a cracked wooden board are all that is left of a child's swing, now broken beyond repair.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Wheat and barley lie in carefully tended rows along the field, slowly ripening as the seasons change.  Eventually, the grain will dry, and workers armed with razor sharp scythes will be sent to cut and thresh it before turning the golden kernels into the ales and beers for which Baearholt's farmstead is famous.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: In the distance, a meadowlark sings amidst the slowly waving stalks of barley which run the length of the field.  Though carefully hidden from predators, the bird's song rings out in a joyous melody.  Nearby, water flows slowly along the floor of a drainage ditch.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A rocky spring bubbles to the surface, the excess water flowing northward through the barley.  The thin stalks are heavy with ripening barleycorns, swaying gently beneath each breath of wind.  A drainage ditch runs along the eastern end of the field, the water gently murmuring as it flows toward a pond in the distance.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Claw marks mar the soft soil of the field where the mottled brown feathers of a ring-necked pheasant lie scattered about.  Off to one side, a fist-sized paw print is clearly preserved in the hardened mud from a recent rain.  It seems the peaceful field is not without its dangers.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Vibrant orange-red poppies mingle with the pale green-gold wheat slowly ripening in the field.  To the north, the normally straight furrows detour at an irregular angle around a granite boulder which juts out of the soil.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A narrow rivulet, runoff from a nearby spring, flows sluggishly over the gnarled root of a long-dead tree stump before tumbling over the muddy bank into a drainage ditch.  Shelf lichen grows upon the tree stump, pale and white in the moonlight.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Grain stalks rustle stealthily as an unseen bird or other animal passes nearby.  Darkness and strange noises combine to make what is, by daylight, a pleasant field seem mysterious and otherworldly.  A hoarse cry echoes through the air, sending an atavistic shiver down your spine.

The smell of freshly tilled soil and growing things combine to bring a warm feeling of security to the area.  Sharpened senses detect the dry rustle of grain stalks, an oddly friendly and comforting noise, as some unseen fox or pheasant moves through the field.  In the distance, a farmhand weeds the tender growing shoots of wheat and barley, a stolid example of industry and other traditional country virtues.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Water pools in a shallow hollow beneath the shadow of the granite boulder to the west, making the field muddy underfoot.  A quail, followed by her four chicks, can be glimpsed scurrying quickly amidst the tender stalks of the fall crop of theronuligh athael wheat, a soft grain favored by local brewers.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A massive granite boulder juts up from the western edge of the field.  From the weathered pockmarks on its surface, someone has tried to use a pickaxe to reduce the rock to rubble, yet still it stands, asserting the dominance of nature over mans will.  The furrows of the field merely swerve about the outcropping, pale green wheat softening its outline.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Broken stalks and scattered barleycorns lie trampled in the mud beside the bank of a drainage ditch.  A smooth stone sports a dried bloodstain, while nearby, a frayed strip of canvas lies discarded on the ground.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A caterpillar writhes slowly on a blade of grass, preoccupied with spinning its cocoon.  Driven by instinct, soon it will undergo the changes to transform it from a slow, ponderous creeper into a delicate winged beauty.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A drainage ditch runs alongside the eastern edge of the field, filled with waist-deep silted water.  As the land slopes down to the north, the water tumbles over piles of glistening smooth rocks before falling into the placid pond to the north.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: Hops vines twine about a high wooden fence on the northern end of the field, clinging to it for support as gravity tugs ceaselessly downward.  Cone-shaped fruit pods bob on the vines, slowly ripening.  When the pods dry to the point where they rustle like paper, they will be gathered to produce the beer for which the Baearholt family is famous.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A rabbit peers furtively out from beneath a cluster of hops vines which trail along the ground, its pink nose twitching nervously.  To the south, pale green stalks of wheat rise about knee-high on the soft loamy soil of the field.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Northeast Field]]
description: A tangle of hops vines climbs the fence which borders the northern side of the field, the green seedpods bobbing with each gust of wind.  The field stretches out to the south and west, row after row of golden wheat and barley gently swaying in rippling waves.

title: [[Mill Pond]]
description: Water sparkles as it tumbles over smoothly polished rocks where a ditch drains into the mill pond behind the brewery.  Cattails sway in the still water near the shore, their delicate brown and green stalks reflecting in the mirror-like surface of the silted brown water.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: The water tumbles down an incline to splash into the still waters of a mill pond which lies beside a low brick building.  To the west, a mud-slick bank leads to a field of grain slowly ripening, the golden stalks nearly ready for harvest.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: Years of erosion have eaten away at the bank of the ditch, forming a dreary, muddy and generally unprepossessing little cave beneath the overhanging bank.  Vines trail over the edge of the field, further concealing the tiny cavern from view.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: Water swirls around smooth limestone rocks at the bottom of the ditch forming rippling patterns on the surface.  The nearby field runs along the edge of the shallow bank, explaining the barleycorns which float downstream with the current.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: A narrow rivulet tumbles over the muddy bank from the field to the west, adding to the water flowing through the ditch.  The current drags at your legs and pulls you inexorably northward.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: A shallow spot along the bank allows a slippery scramble across the muddy sides to the field to the west.  Smooth green vines dangle over the bank, making the climb easier.  A narrow irrigation streamlet enters the ditch to the north, the extra water speeding the sullen flow of the current and causing treacherous eddies to swirl about.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: Water flows slowly northward along the drainage ditch, the gentle current swirling unprotestingly about obstacles in its path.  The muddy bank is slick, but it's probably possible to scramble over to the nearby field.

title: [[Drainage Ditch]]
description: Maple leaves swirl atop the muddy brown water which flows through the drainage ditch.  Though only knee-deep, the silt clouds the water obscuring the floor of the ditch, and making travel difficult.  A fallen branch provides a place to scramble up the bank to the nearby field.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Farmyard]]
description: Ruddy-tailed chickens wander about the yard, snuffling in the dirt as you make your way along the path connecting Baearholt's Tavern to the north, and the brewery to the south.  Beside the brewery is a covered well, its rough grey stonework softened by climbing ivy which clings to its surface.  A wooden fence, bridged by a stile, separates the farmyard from the grain fields.  Off to the side, orchard trees stand in neatly pruned rows, their branches heavy with fruit.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: The sinuous apple tree trunks complement the strong green tones of what appears to be newly scythed grassy undergrowth.  Ripe red apples dangle overhead from branches ready to be harvested.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: Overripe apples litter the ground beneath the apple trees.  Black ants swarm over the spoiled fruit, gathering bits of juicy pulp, then return to their nest.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: The paw prints of a very large animal mar the soft undergrowth beneath a particularly large tree.  The trunk is savagely clawed and bits of bark lie scattered at its base.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: Baskets of freshly harvested cherries are stacked beneath the trees and left to rot! A tall ladder lies twisted and broken on the ground.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: Wild black cherry trees with their rough, scaly black trunk and smoother, reddish brown branches occupy this part of the orchard.  Clusters of dark red cherries hang from their limbs.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: A wheelbarrow full of apples lies on its side, its contents spilled to the ground. In the distance, heavily laden pear trees stand in neatly pruned rows.  Crushed, tiny mustard plant blooms lay lifeless underfoot.  A tall ladder leans against the heavy trunk of a nearby tree.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: Cracked and splintered branches litter the ground beneath the trees.  In the distance, heavily laden pear trees stand in neatly pruned rows.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: Leathery leaved pear trees stand majestically in rows.  Soft yellow pears glisten with dew in the light.  A large honey bee streaks past.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: A swarming bee hive hangs from a nearby branch of a pear tree.  Rivulets of honey drip from elaborate combs in the nest.  A bee smoker lies on the ground smoke still listlessly coming out of its snout.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Orchard]]
description: A red shouldered hawk works a slow spiral over the orchard looking for its supper.  A tiny chipmunk twitters and cautiously peeks out from beneath a log at a fallen pear in hunger.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Apple Tree]]
description: This large sturdy limb is hidden in the lush branches of the apple tree.  It is an ideal spot for a lovers' tryst.  Roughly scratched in the trunk is a heart with faded initials.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Taproom]]
description: Dark oak beams criss-cross the low whitewashed ceiling in the taproom of Baearholt's Farmhold.  In the corner, a bard sits on a tall stool playing a rapid melody on her gittern as patrons join in a hearty drinking song and sample the quality meads and ales for which Baearholt's is known.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold]]
description: Just off the Northern Trade Route stands an ivy-covered small brick building which houses Baearholt's Tavern.  Part of the family farmhold, it is renowned for its meads and ale, all of which are brewed on the premises under Ivor Baearholt's exacting supervision.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Brewery]]
description: Steam rises from an iron cauldron which hangs above an open firepit.  Stacks of wood lie piled nearby, ready to be warped into shape for the waist-high barrels used to age the mead and ale produced at the brewery each year.  Off in a corner, finished barrels have been piled one atop the other from floor to ceiling.  A trap door in the floor leads down to the underground aging rooms.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Brewery]]
description: Wooden crates line the whitewashed walls, stacked about shoulder-high for a human.  Several are missing slats, while a hammer and wood are lying atop one crate -- evidently being mended before the harvest season.  In the corner, a fruit press stands ready for the first crop of fruit from the multitude of trees in the family orchards.  The juice will be turned into honey-sweetened mead, while the pulp flavors the ales produced at the brewery.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Brewery]]
description: Sprouted grain lies spread across a rough granite tabletop, covered with a thin layer of cheesecloth.  A heavy-set woman, her linen sleeves rolled up to her elbows, wields a thick wooden roller over the table, crushing the malted grain before transferring it to water-filled copper pots.  Across the room, a Halfling lad scrubs the interior of one of the pots before turning it over to dry.

title: [[Baearholt's Farmhold, Brewery]]
description: Tarnished copper pots hang from the whitewashed wall above a wooden table in the brightly-lit kitchen of Baearholt's brewery.  On the table, roughly crushed grain soaks in a wooden vat, barely covered with luke-warm water.  The ovens built into the walls keep the room warm and filled with the aroma of baking bread.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Chains descend through a trap door in the earthen ceiling, their iron links creaking noisily as barrels of mead or ale are chosen to be moved upstairs.  In the fluttering shadows, half-seen rodents skitter about.  Wooden barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the passages extend.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Chittering noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen rodents skitter about the aging rooms.  Wooden bins filled with barrels line the tunnel walls.  One of the bins has collapsed, leaving the barrels piled haphazardly in a corner.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Chittering noises echo along the passage as half-seen rodents skitter about.  Wooden barrels line both sides of the tunnel walls for as far as you can see.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the passages extend.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Cork sheets litter the table which stands at the end of the tunnel.  Cutting knives soak in a sink beneath a sullen trickle of water which echoes about the tunnels.  A reed torch flickers half-heartedly in its sconce, the darkness favoring the rodents skittering about.  Wooden barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the passages extend.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Ruby eyes gaze out from shadows beneath a broken chair.  Chittering noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen rodents skitter about the aging rooms.  Wooden bins filled with barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: A wooden mallet lies abandoned upon the muddy floor, surrounded by a pool of mead dripping from a gnawed wooden barrel.  Chittering noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen rodents skitter about the aging rooms.  Wooden bins filled with barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Chittering noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen rodents skitter about the muddy floor.  Wooden slats have been driven into place to hold the barrels which line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Children once might have played down here, their forgotten voices singing in the shadows.  Now, isolated footsteps echo as half-seen spiderwebs float in the dusty silence, and dust kittens skitter about.  Wooden barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the passages extend.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Chittering insects scrabble along the hall, their ruby eyes glinting from the shadows.  Their noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen forms seem to dance in the shadows which skitter about the tunnel.  Wooden barrels lie piled neatly along the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: A sweet scent of fermenting mead, or perhaps of decaying flesh, wafts through the air to send an atavistic chill down the spine.  Chittering noises echo along earthen walls as half-seen rodents skitter about the tunnel.  Wooden barrels lie tumbled into piles which might kindly be described as a line along the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the network of underground passages extends beneath the farm.

title: [[Baearholt's Brewery, Aging Rooms]]
description: Glass bottles lie in sawdust-filled wooden crates which block the end of the passage.  Chittering noises echo from the shadows, as half-felt drafts send shivers down your spine.  Off in a corner, dusty implements used to cork the bottles lie upon a table, scattered about.  Wooden barrels line the tunnel walls.  Given the uncertain lighting, there's little way of telling just how far the passages extend.

title: [[Tanis Belta Gaizen, Stream]]
description: Willows drape their sweep of emerald veiling over the stream, while underneath the shadow of the trees comes the sweet sound of moving water.  In little side pools are bright green mats of algae, occasionally ruffled by swarms of water beetles or hungry tadpoles.

title: [[Tanis Belta Gaizen, Stream]]
description: The stream widens and flows over a ledge to form a clear, deep pool.  Splashing water sparkles on the surrounding tree trunks, sending soft echoes between the canyon walls.

title: [[Tanis Belta Gaizen, Canyon]]
description: Closing in above the stream as though sheltering it from the world beyond, the cliffs loom close, blocking the sky and creating a pervasive chill.  An incessant wind whines between the narrows, whipping around spires of stone and kicking up gusts of sand.

title: [[Tanis Belta Gaizen, Canyon]]
description: A narrow embankment lifts away from the stream to press up against a wind-sculpted divide in the canyon walls.  Little light can reach this place; it is a world of shadows and stone.  Ferns luxuriate in damp clefts in the rocks, and the only sound is the quiet chatter of the nearby water.

title: [[Tanis Belta Gaizen, Canyon]]
description: Unexpected colors gleam against the pale sand where some clay pots lie broken and scattered.  A burial mound appears to have been desecrated, its carefully stacked rocks ripped away and any valuable contents meant to accompany the occupant on his or her final journey now gone.  Bones have been pulled into the open and appear to be crushed, and in a final violation, the skull is missing.

title: [[Therenborough, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive conical building rises from the cobbles at the square's center, its snowy alabaster surfaces gleaming brilliantly.  A bejeweled mosaic set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Therenborough, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Therenborough, Carousel Desk]]
description: A white marble desk spans the width of the western wall.  Highly polished brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in sparkling white tile.

title: [[Ice Cave, Forgotten Chambers]]
description: A bitter cold that chills the bones grips all who enter this smaller cavern.  The walls are slick with ice which covers and obscures ancient markings to the point of making them non-decipherable, and the floor is smooth and free of debris.  A path of scrape marks mar the floor, leading to a large block of stone at the far end of the chamber.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Lifeless Ascent]]
description: The occasional fissure in the sheer ice wall offers a precarious purchase for those who wish to brave the upward climb, while scant juts of obsidian offer just enough footing for a careful retreat from the icy ascent.

title: [[Order of the Dragon Shield, Grounds]]
description: Sprawling trees dot the vast, well-manicured grounds.  Along the white gravel path that winds its way to the Order house's grand double doors, beds of seasonal blooms encircle a stately central fountain.  In the distance, a picket fence borders off a small garden, while the opposing lawn bears a hedged area large enough to host a variety of functions.

Sprawling trees dot the vast, well-manicured grounds, lit only by the soft candlelight from the nearby windows.  Along the white gravel path that winds its way through the darkness to the Order house's grand double doors, a hulking mass is poised amid a stately central fountain, encircled by a bedding of seasonal blooms that sway and taunt from their shadowy cover.  In the distance, a fence borders off a small garden, while the opposing lawn bears a hedged area large enough to host a variety of functions.

title: [[Order of the Dragon Shield, Lobby]]
description: Rich tapestries hung upon the off-white walls offset the dark marbled floors of the spacious lobby.  Dominating the room overhead is a stained-glass dome which complements the broad, arched windows that overlook the grounds.  Ornate candelabras cast a soft glow over the glass display case resting against a far wall and the elegant sofas provided for relaxation.  Tucked into a corner near a sweeping staircase, a comfortable chair sits near a small oaken table, cordoned off from the rest of the area.

title: [[Order of the Dragon Shield, Grand Banquet Hall]]
description: Golden chandeliers hang from ornate medallions at measured intervals along the grand vaulted ceiling, bathing the room in a soft candlelit glow.  Satin brocade drapes swept back with clusters of fresh flowers, cascade elegantly down the beamed dragonwood walls along the edges of the polished hardwood dance floor.  Comfortable couches, each accompanied by a small oval table, dot the corners of the large room while soft music drifts from behind a silk screen.

title: [[Order of the Dragon Shield, The Tankard]]
description: Thick oak beams frame the rough, white plastered walls which display a variety of weapons and mounted beast heads, while a gleaming suit of armor stands sentinel beside a nearby archway.  Wooden trestle tables, surrounded by banded barrel chairs, overlook the grounds through a grand arched window and provide ample seating for those visiting the inviting pub to enjoy a refreshing drink and hearty meal.  Redolent scents from the long bar mingle with the faint smell of fire-roasted fare that wafts through the air from the grand river rock fireplace.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Deer Trail]]
description: The narrow trail, forged by generations of wandering wildlife, wends its way to the south through thick, chest-high brush.  It is quieter here than to the north, where the unmistakable and unrelenting cries of ravens fill the air.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Deer Trail]]
description: Bushes rustle at your passing, driving birds and lizards into panic-stricken flight.  Every movement produces an incredible amount of noise that would drive away every sensible deer for miles.  However, it may attract more predatory creatures.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Deer Trail]]
description: The meandering trail takes the path of least resistance through the thick brush rather than proceeding in a straight line from origin to destination.  The soil, not especially rich, is carpeted by fallen, decomposing fronds.  A loud buzz heralds the departure of a fat bumblebee.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Deer Trail]]
description: The narrow trail is barely discernible as it twists through the dense scrub.  Every bend and crook has some purpose known only to the instincts of the animals that forged the path.  Nearby bladebrush fronds bristle menacingly, keeping animals and adventurers at bay.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Deer Trail]]
description: The trail bends sharply here to avoid an intimidating cluster of bladebrush.  In the corner of your eye you catch the bright glimmer of sunlight reflecting off water to the southeast.

title: [[Zaulfung, Standing Stones]]
description: This curiously circular clearing looks as if all its vegetation was blasted away centuries ago in an arcane duel.  A pair of imposing standing stones, one grey and smooth, the other blackened and charred, face each other across the clearing.  To the east and southeast are narrow gaps leading through the otherwise impenetrable scrub, while the path to the southwest is a broken tangle of exposed roots.

This circular clearing is dominated by the presence of two imposing standing stones, silent sentinels of an ancient power.  A shadow deeper than the night reaches across the clearing from the south, while at the north end the stark grey stone looms pale and ghostlike.

title: [[Zaulfung, Boar Trail]]
description: The bare dirt of the trail is extremely uneven thanks to the digging of boars and the crisscrossing of thick, tough bladebrush roots.  Extra care must be taken to avoid spraining an ankle.

title: [[Zaulfung, Boar Trail]]
description: The path is wide enough here for a full-sized carriage, though it would undoubtedly break an axle on the rough and broken ground.  A column of ants marches purposefully across the trail.

wayto.8515: ;e fput('north'); pause; unless checkstanding then fput('stand');  move('north'); end
wayto.8517: ;e fput('southeast'); pause; unless checkstanding then fput('stand');  move('southeast'); end

title: [[Zaulfung, Boar Trail]]
description: The path is made treacherous by roots as big around as a barbarian's bicep.  If it is supposed to be leading somewhere in particular, it's taking neither the most direct nor the easiest route.  It opens up into a marshy clearing to the south and meanders northwest to drier ground.  A large spider pauses its work to regard you dispassionately from its web in a nearby scrub pine.

title: [[Zaulfung, Clearing]]
description: Four logs have been arranged in a square around a large fire pit to provide seating for a dozen or more.  An iron cauldron rests beside the pit, now filled with rainwater and serving as a breeding ground for mosquitos, as if the expanse of swamp weren't large enough for the omnipresent pests.

title: [[Zaulfung, Clearing]]
description: A shallow trench directs rainwater to the southeast rather than letting it flow downhill into the fire pit.  A pair of tulvora trees, intertwined as if locked in either loving embrace or deadly combat, occupy this corner of the clearing.  Their fragrant leaves not only serve to repel damaging insects, but nearly cover the stench of the swamp.

title: [[Zaulfung, Clearing]]
description: The damp ground bears the tracks of hundreds of hooves as well as the lighter marks of a boobrie's passing.  The dried-out husk of a boar lies half-buried in the mud, its corpse trampled by its brethren.  A scattering of bloodstained grey feathers indicates that the boar did not die peacefully.

title: [[Zaulfung, Clearing]]
description: A mighty stench, the bouquet of the Zaulfung, wafts in over the waist-deep brush to the south.  The swamp itself, like a black stain on Elanthia's green robes, is visible beyond the scrub.  A natural clearing opens up to the northeast, while a wide manmade path strikes eastward.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Path]]
description: The path follows the southern shore of a small stagnant pond completely overgrown with an unwholesome yellow scum.  A stand of gnarled trees has been felled and their roots and branches stripped, leaving a stack of logs to one side.  It looks as if some large animal has been digging by the woodpile recently.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Path]]
description: Tough, hardy bushes with thick leaves and nasty thorns scrabble toward the pathway, but fall short by several handlengths.  The fresh markings of a well-applied machete or axe have cut a ruthless path through the brush, much to the woe of the plants that would cling to the flesh of passersby foolish enough to push through too quickly.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Path]]
description: A gnarled tree has been uprooted and dragged to one side of the path.  A few eager weeds, or possibly just ugly flowers, are already emerging from the dirt-filled place where the tree so recently stood.

title: [[Northeast Wilds, Path]]
description: This east-west path cuts directly through the dense brush, too straight and regular to be the work of animals.  A wooden stake with a red ribbon tied around it serves to mark the junction of the path and the twisting deer trail.

title: [[Zaulfung, Clearing]]
description: Thick bushes with barbed finger-length thorns serve as a boundary for this clearing.  A few have been cleared away, allowing access to a lunat pierwalk leading south to a chickee out over the swamp.
