description: The broken branch of a tremendous oak slopes down out of the pitch-blackness above and touches the ground.  Blood ivy and sathmoor moss crawl up the branch's sharp incline toward the forest canopy.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The burden of the forest's darkness settles down upon the shoulders of those who travel below, as if the trees wished to pass on the weighty gloom they've carried for too long.  From above comes the sound of sinister whisperings that rustle through the leafy canopy from tree to tree.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The great age of the forest is spoken from each bent limb, gnarled knothole and twisted root of the massive hardwood trees towering overhead.  Even the newer growth of young pines that feed on the rotting remains of their forbearers seems wizened in this forest.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: As dark as the forest is, there are shadows even darker that dance through the trees like living things.  Mist rises from the damp ground like wisps of smoke and gives everything a ghostly, bleached-out look.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The feeble-looking saplings dotting the understory have obviously been growing slowly in the dimness for many years judging by the thickness of their bark.  They patiently wait for a larger tree or branch to fall and open a spot in the dense canopy.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The splintered bottom half of an ironwood juts from the ground like an enormous pointed fang from a blackened jaw.  Apparently the victim of a lightening strike, the tree's top half and branches have been shattered and lay in a wide circumference on the ground.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: A gathering of torch rhododendrons clusters beneath a small break in the forest canopy where thin shafts of sunlight spill to the ground.  The bright red-streaked orange flowers are a celebration of life amid the dismal gloom of the understory.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Moss-clad stones and splintery, rotting sticks interrupt the otherwise soft ground.  The sound of dripping water seems to come from everywhere yet nowhere in particular.  Most of the time, the drips sound flat as if they have landed on leaves or other porous matter, but occasionally they ring with a higher pitch as they land in water.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Blood ivy cloaks the dark ironwoods with crimson filigree that shivers with the movements of tiny insects and tree frogs that live within.  The bright red leaves enable the vine to absorb more of the dim light available in the understory than their verdant counterparts.  Ironically, because it has become so adapted to the darkness, the blood ivy dies when it reaches the bright sunlit top layer of the forest canopy.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Buzzing black flies hover over what appears to be a moldy blue sack slouched against the broad base of a black oak tree.  The cloth sags limply over oddly protruding lumps and a rotted leather boot peeks out one end.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Pale fungus growing in small shelves spirals around the thick trunk of a locust tree like a tiny stairway leading upwards into shadow.  Local legends say they are made by the woodfae that protect the trees of the forest and that harm will surely come to anyone who interferes with their work.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Shadows hang from the bony limbs of the forest canopy in great dusky swaths that meet the rising mist and conceal the understory from the eyes of the outside world.  Sounds echo through the wood, reverberating and becoming so distorted that their sources are unidentifiable as anything of this plane.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The trees crowd close, their thick rope-like roots making the ground uneven and breaking through the leaf litter in spots.  Here and there, the roots frame murky holes leading down into the earth that look like open maws waiting to gobble an ill-placed foot.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The foul smell of dung rises from a rather large pile near the base of a towering hawthorn tree.  A conference of black flies begins to assemble for the occasion.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Spindly shoots adorned with only a pale leaf or two spring up from a low mound in the mulch.  Whatever lay composting beneath the leaf-strewn mound is nourishing the next generation of the forest that will compete for a space in the canopy when an elder falls.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The silence of the somber forest envelops you like the gulfs of night embrace a dying star.  Time here doesn't have the same quality as it does elsewhere, as everything seems either unmoving or at least very slow.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The muddy ground squishes sickeningly underfoot and makes traveling through the area very slow going.  Sodden earth and rotting vegetation form a sticky, spongy mat that is unwilling to easily release its hold.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The matted layer of composting materials littering the forest floor is disturbed here, as though thrown into the air during a scuffle.  Like a flag of surrender raised above the battlefield, a small scrap of dirty white cloth clings to a broken stick.  A spattering of crimson visible against the pale, freshly broken wood seems to indicate the fight did not end peacefully.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The dense forest seems thinner to the south, where color and the golden warmth of sunlight seem to live without the deadening pall of eternal darkness that envelops the Paasvadh.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Deepening shadows created by the thick leafy canopy soaring overhead foster a sense of forboding where the seeds of fear may be found.  Broad-leafed plants nourished on decaying vegetation creep along the forest floor seeking whatever dim light might reach them.  The acrid smell of rot and fetid earth hangs heavily in the air.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The ground here is sodden and squishes with each step, leaving small foot-shaped ponds of murky water.  Pale lichen-patched stones rise like islands from a dark sea of wet leaves.  A shallow pool of water to the south and east glistens faintly through the gloom.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Feather-leafed ferns cluster near a muddy frog pool.  Some broad cypress trees grow along the dirty edge of the water, their fluted bases connected to their reflections, but few other trees do.  The sparseness of trees in the pond creates a break in the canopy that allows thin shafts of sunlight to filter down into this otherwise shaded place.

Feather-leafed ferns cluster along the muddy edge of a shallow frog pool.  Some broad cypress trees grow near the water, but few other trees do.  The sparseness of trees in the pond creates a break in the canopy that allows a few stars to peek into view.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Footprints captured in the muck from a recent passer-by slowly fill with muddy brown water and disappear.  They are quite large and appear almost humanoid but have a finger-like toe extending from the heel.  The tracks don't have a wide stride, but seem to belong to a heavy creature with a loping gait.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Book Store]]
description: Freshly chiseled granite walls surround an area where forgers can quickly resupply.  A passageway covered by a leather flap pierces the wall to the south, and from the passage resound the clangs of an anvil chorus.  A simple wooden door leads back outside.

Freshly chiseled granite walls surround an area where forgers can quickly resupply.  A passageway covered by a leather flap pierces the wall to the south, and from the passage resound the clangs of an anvil chorus.  A simple wooden door leads back outside.

Freshly chiseled granite walls surround an area where forgers can quickly resupply.  A passageway covered by a leather flap pierces the wall to the south, and from the passage resound the clangs of an anvil chorus.  A simple wooden door leads back outside.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Lobby and Maker's Mark Ordering]]
description: A chamber with stone walls and a lofty, vaulted ceiling links the rooms of the forge.  Its high arches help to subdue the clangor, letting it rise and echo in the space overhead.  Waves of heat and flickering reddish light from the foundries to the west strive with the scream of the grindstones to the east and the pounding din of metal on metal from the smithies to the south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Waves of heat, blasting with an almost tangible force, roll from the flames of a brick-lined firepit.  Over the firepit, a blackened granite crucible hangs by stout chains from an oak beam high overhead.  Near the crucible's spout stand stone molds of different shapes, with a pile of fuel within easy reach.  Similar crucibles hang to the north and south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Windows high in the vaulted ceiling ventilate the south corner of the foundry, reducing its oven-like temperature to something endurable.  The forms of a granite crucible and a pile of fuel shimmer in the heat waves rising from the orange bricks of the firepits.  Two similar crucibles hang to the north.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Supplies]]
description: A chamber with stone walls and a lofty, vaulted ceiling links the rooms of the forge.  Its high arches help to subdue the clangor, letting it rise and echo in the space overhead.  Waves of heat and flickering reddish light from the foundries to the west strive with the scream of the grindstones to the east and the pounding din of metal on metal from the smithies to the south.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Tool Store]]
description: Masters and journeyman of the forging craft find a home in this room purchasing tools and ingredients.  Loud thumps and groaning accompany the loading and unloading of goods from storage.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Forge]]
description: The south end of the grindstone room has a few more of the big stone wheels, all in good condition.  Apprentices of Yalda inspect them daily, treating them with oil and checking for chips on the grinding face.  Other grindstones stand to the north.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Several large grindstones on wooden frames stand in the middle of the workroom.  From time to time, a Dwarven apprentice scatters sand over the floor, both for more secure footing and as a safeguard against fire from the sparks cascading off the grindstones.  A high-pitched keening and the smell of hot metal rise from those in use and from others to the south.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: This area is the one most favored by the knowledgeable smiths in the guild.  Tall, narrow windows in the northern wall admit whatever breaths of air are stirring, occasionally fanning the flames beneath a granite crucible.  Like the two foundries to the south, this one has all needed implements close at hand.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Book Store]]
description: Well-fitted granite brick encloses this space.  Thick oak doors exit onto the street, and a thick tarp leads deeper into the forging chambers.  To the side a burly guard limits entry through a narrow arch.  A rhythmic pounding echoes from inside the building.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Deed Vendor]]
description: Thick steel bars block access to a depot storing a multitude of resources and crafted goods.  Workers hoist larger pieces atop massive shelving using an intricate network of ropes and pulleys.

title: [[Forging Society, Maker's Mark Shop]]
description: A selection of organized patterns, templates and designs for maker's marks line the walls.  A handful of prestigious crafters browse the possibilities and discuss selections with nearby attendants.  An arch leads back into the main lobby.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Hallway]]
description: The ardent sound of anvil work carries from doors on either side of the hallway and echoes off the well-fitted granite floor.  A pair of masterwork weapons lines the wall as testament to the skilled work accomplished within.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Crafting Shop]]
description: A storefront backed up by boxes and cabinetry offers tools for sale.  Attendants rush back and forth helping customers and shout above the din of forging hammers smacking metal.  A stockpile of coal sits off to one side.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Supply Shop]]
description: Bins of recently mined metal await sale next to eager attendants happily serving crafters' needs.  Several nearby crates contain additional materials for sale, including already smelted ingots.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Office]]
description: A massive iron table decorated with pewter miniatures dominates this small office.  A soot-stained bookshelf and an oak chest with an ornate haralun lock sit nearby.  Three charts detailing the techniques for weaponsmithing, armorsmithing and blacksmithing hang from the wall.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: Soot-stained stone walls rise up to a peaked roof where smoke and ash escape through several air vents.  To one side of the room a granite crucible hangs suspended over a glowing fire.  A pile of fuel lay scattered across the room from it and black footprints cover the stony ground.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Even the walls have accumulated moisture from the incredible heat rising from the forge fires.  A short distance away sits a hefty anvil with an extra long horn, a slack tub filled with water and a messy pile of fuel.  The clang of metal on metal assaults your ears as nearby forgers ply the trade.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Dents and chips line the walls as though someone once became careless with a forging hammer.  Placed diagonal to the wall is an iron anvil and a slack tub filled with water.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: A large granite crucible hanging over a glowing fire rests in the center of the room.  The fire pit beneath the crucible forms a star pattern from the way in which its stones arrange.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Barely any soot remains on the walls or floor here, despite constant use.  A nice leather tarp holds a mountain of fuel, and nearby is a large anvil and forge fire that crackles and pops in the low light.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: The freshly scrubbed walls of this smelting spot indicate it is the preferred place for upper class patrons.  An organized pile of fuel sits nearby, and a large granite crucible hangs from decorated leather straps above a glowing fire.

title: [[Langenfirth, The Langenfirth Tree]]
description: A rickety platform in the top of this huge, tall, ancient tree provides a good look-out point with a view which is unbroken for many miles.  It has given the towns folk, as they peer in many directions, fair warning of anything coming their way from the distant hills and early sightings of the barge arriving from Riverhaven.  The town below is hidden beneath the tops of shorter firs, but the view far out into Gwenalion Lake is clear for miles.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Stooping Cypress]]
description: The ironwood platform has withstood the test of time.  Despite some loose and uneven planks, neither rot nor moss mars its surface.  Several scorched spots blacken the northern edges, and bent and broken arrows litter the surface.  A sinuous creeper snakes across from an adjacent cypress.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Stooping Cypress]]
description: The bark on the limb is well worn, as if it has been traversed frequently.  The mosses and vines are dense here, hampering sight, though an overgrown platform is visible further down the limb.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Stooping Cypress]]
description: The sad state of the cypress is even more apparent up close.  The northern side of the trunk is marred by deep burns that have not yet healed.  The once well-proportioned tree is crouched over, as if protecting its remaining, life-giving limb.  Vines and mosses have slowly begun to cover the wounded cypress, taking advantage of its weakened state.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Undogoz Square]]
description: Cobblestones line this small square, which is dominated by the large, stone building housing the Mer'Kresh Crafting Society.  A parade of sturdy wagons going in and out of the nearby alley is a common sight as artisans haul their hand-made goods off for sale at the local markets.  Wooden benches line the edge of the canal, offering a scenic spot for workers to rest and enjoy some fresh air.

title: [[Sazu's Cottage, Byre]]
description: A mule brays in surprise as you enter his domain, and several chickens flap their wings, annoyed at the intrusion.  Mounds of hay and nesting shelves provide sleeping places for the occupants.  A deep ditch separates the byre from the living area to the south, and a narrow wooden ramp provides access.

title: [[Sazu's Cottage, Dyeing Chamber]]
description: Sazu, the Gor'Tog dyer, works industriously at a table, pounding dried flowers into a fine powder.  She tosses the colorful powder into a black iron kettle, and stirs the liquid within.  Dozens of wicker baskets hang from the ceiling, along with bunches of the drying flowers.  The cottage windows are shuttered tightly against the night air.  A dye menu chart is nailed next to a ladder which appears to lead to a room overhead.

title: [[Sazu's Cottage, Sleeping Loft]]
description: A simple straw pallet is the only furnishing here, but the loft has been festively decorated with bunches of lavender heather in earthenware pots and colorfully dyed garments hanging from wall pegs.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Performance Hall]]
description: Plush seats lined up in rows face a hardwood stage raised four feet from the ground.  Red velvet curtains draped from the high vaulted ceiling cover the walls.  The acoustics create a warm echo which lends an air of nobility to the place.  A podium in the corner hints that the hall must be used for formal meetings as well as performances.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Slopes]]
description: Though straight and sturdy, the trees lean with the sharp downward pitch of the land, each limb on their northern sides farther from the ground than those on their southern sides.  From those heights, a shower of needles, leaves and limbs falls, set into a whirling plunge of motion with every buffet of wind.  The debris races down the hillside, lost from sight as its descent takes it beneath the interposing branches of the valley below.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Slopes]]
description: Covering the angled banks of the sloped ground, a lush beard of grass thickens the humps of the trail.  As real whiskers might hide an unsavory profile, so does the hefty growth in this wood disguise the rough, rocky surface of the land.  The trees have little problem with the stone-ridden ground, growing tall and strong, surely making for a different scale of metaphorical beard to viewers on the other hills and mountains.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Slopes]]
description: Riddled with plant life as the trail may be, a hazy grey peak in the Undogoz mountains manages to rise into view and out of the trees' concealment.  Though distant, the glimpses of sheer cliffs and bare stone humble any comparison of the slanting footpath winding in these hills.  Folly it would be to travel upon those dangerous crags, and the thought makes the steep, northern descent of this land quite manageable in contrast.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Path]]
description: A wide selection of vegetation clusters at the base of every tree in the forest, ranging from ferns and flowers to ivy and vines.  The ash enriched soil at the foot of the Undogoz chain is most likely responsible for the rampant growth, yet the view of the nearest slope through the trees reveals a relatively barren surface.  Sheltered from the high cliff's strong winds, the wooded path has become a botanist's dream.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Slopes]]
description: Surrounded by a cul-de-sac of living greenery, thick grass blades wave in unison under the brisk mountain zephyrs.  Several types of brightly colored wildflower nestle in the grass, seen only when an appropriate breeze shoves the interposing blades out of the way.  The gentle rustling is constant, but rises and falls in tempo with nature, its conductor.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Crafting Society, Vestibule]]
description: The building is constructed of stone, mined locally, to withstand years of abuse from the salty air that blows in off the ocean.  Tall, fluted columns stand near each corner of the room, helping to support the raised dome ceiling decoratively covered in silver leaf.  Tiny lights hidden within the roof's architecture reflect off the metallic surface to highlight an intricate, mosaic map of M'Riss inlaid into the tile floor.  A pair of crossed hammers adorns the top of an archway leading to the Forging Society.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Entry Hall]]
description: Across the room from an archway leading to the main edifice are a pair of wooden benches, which are the only furniture provided for the customer's comfort.  Periodically, custodians hired to keep the area tidy wander through, occasionally muttering as they sweep the stone floor clean of all the grime people drag in with them when they leave the foundry.  On one wall, an artist has painted a portrait of the Undogoz Forge as a memorial to the now closed building where many Rissans learned their craft.  Insulating the space from the searing heat of the smithy is a heavy oak door, covered on each side with a sheet of steel for added protection.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Bookstore]]
description: A long, cypress counter serves as a partition between the bookstore and a much smaller office area, making it easy for Master Smith Kapric, who runs the facility, to keep an eye on customers when they enter and offer assistance when necessary.  Tall racks are filled with sample books for the shopper who prefers to peruse the merchandise.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Tool Shop]]
description: Despite the building's thick, rock walls, the faint sound of metal hitting metal can sometimes be heard, its repetitive pattern becoming almost lyrical.  Clerks keep busy checking to make sure the displays of tools and supplies for sale are filled, often rushing to the backroom to load up on any stock that is missing.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Supply Shop]]
description: Crude, wooden pallets stacked with recently mined ore create cramped aisles throughout the room, giving customers a chance to inspect the selection before making their purchase.  Off in the corner, several crates contain additional materials for sale, including already smelted ingots.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Maker's Mark Shop]]
description: White paint coating the stone block walls serves as a neutral canvas for the sketches of sample designs aimed at helping potential customers decide on what aspects they desire in their maker's marks.  Tools, templates and patterns hang above a small work area where artisans construct the purchased orders promptly as they come in.  Heat emanates from cracks around a leather curtain leading to the foundry.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Once servicing the Undogoz Forge, select pieces of equipment, which still remain in good working condition, have found a new home here as part of the city's attempts to keep costs down.  In the room's center, a constant fire burns in the circular firepit with a small pile of fuel by its side, waiting to be added to increase the flames to a blazing inferno.  The clang of metal against metal drifts over from the smithy to the west and a heavy, oak door leads to the entry hall of the society.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: Constant waves of scalding heat flow through the smithy, set into motion by the sizzling fires and red-hot metals being worked.  Even sounds seem warped and muffled, but somehow the echo of clanging tools and crackling of fiery sparks manage to cut through the thick air.  Nothing is spared the attentions of the temperature and dust, and both stone and metal tools wear the scars that the environment has delivered.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: A combination of sweat and molten steel intertwine to permeate the air with a slightly acrid, sour smell that varies in intensity depending on the time of day.  Suspended by heavy chains secured to a blackened wooden beam is a huge granite crucible.  Piled high in the corner of the room is a large pile of crushed coal, waiting for the next forger to feed it to the fire.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: The floor bears the burns and scars from regular sprays of stray sparks.  Should only the stone surface be an ocean, the equipment scattered about would make a parody of an armada of ships, possibly in mockery of the failed attempts of the Dragon Priest Empire to subdue Mer'Kresh.  In reality, though, the only subduing going on is that of iron and steel beneath a determined worker's tools.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Emanating from the fire, patchy clouds of soot cover the ceiling and form streaks down the walls like black rain during a tropical storm.  Ashy dust fills the air, spiraling up in the heat as it blows off a pile of fuel.  A rhythmic hammering sound drifts over from the smithy to the west, followed by an occasional curse indicating things probably didn't go the way the forger desired.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: An oversized, glowing forge dominates the center of the stone floor, banishing all other equipment to the outlying corners of the room.  Nicknamed -- The Beast -- it's constantly consuming the red-hot coals in its belly and demanding more fuel from the pile, much like a ravenous animal.  From the smell of burning flesh lingering in the room, many craftsmen have felt its fiery bite.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Already dark by its nature, the stone walls of the forge are blackened further by soot, ash and dust kicked up by the constant stream of workmen the forge serves on a daily basis.  Custodians hired by the city wander in and out checking the large waste bucket, making sure the discarded pieces of metal are cleaned up off the floor and keeping the foundry as clean of trash as possible.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: Despite being swept on a regular basis by diligent custodians, metal shavings and bits of broken steel litter the floor, creating a sparkling effect when lit by the flames of the forge's roaring fire.  The smell of burning coal and heated metal fight for dominance here, indicating the amount of work this room normally sees.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Along the top of one wall, a row of exhaust vents siphon off some of the oppressive heat generated by the fire in an attempt to make the room's temperature more comfortable for forgers busy at their craft.  An ingot cutter salvaged from the Undogoz Forge sits near a large pile of fuel and a leather curtain leads to the Maker's Mark shop.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: The back wall of the smithy area is covered with a grimy grey and red dust from the constant attention of the grindstone.  Several small windows along the top of the wall vent some of the choking dust and heat from the forge, but solid steel grates prevent anything larger than a gauntlet from passing through and into the canal beyond.

title: [[Lish'telga, Wooded Path]]
description: The heady scent of soil and plant life fills the air, only to be whisked temporarily away with each swirling breeze.  As the wind blows, ferns nod and branches sway, as if to shoo the thick smells of earth.  Losing leaves and needles with the motion, the waving of the plants reaches a crescendo before stillness descends on the area, and the scenario repeats.

title: [[Trintah's Herbal Remedies, Front Salesroom]]
description: Twinkling sounds from a cowrie shell door chime hung above the entrance welcome visitors to this bustling shop.  Display shelves lining a large window are packed with an assortment of curious bottles, jars, and boxes containing healing remedies collected from several provinces that have been arranged between a collection of potted plants.  Small bundles of exotic herbs hang from the ceiling, thickening the air with their earthy perfume while partially concealing a set of stairs leading to the attic.

title: [[Trintah's Herbal Remedies, Side Salesroom]]
description: Faded whitewashed walls, painted with images of healing regents, serve as advertising for some of the items sold here.  An earthy, herbal scent wafts through the air, growing stronger near an iron cauldron hung above a copper brazier, which slowly simmers with one of Trintah's latest experiments.  Flashes of color dash around the room like elusive pixies as light from bronze lanterns bounces off strings of colored sea glass, collected from local beaches and hung to create a decorative beaded curtain.

title: [[Trintah's Herbal Remedies, Salon]]
description: Offered by the owner, this cozy salon may be a ploy to keep people spending coins in her shop.  The smell of freshly baked bread mingled with medicinal liquors wafts from a sideboard against the wall, masking the odd scent permeating the building while encouraging customers to linger and socialize.  Groupings of small tables, covered in colorful linens and surrounded by comfortable chairs, are strategically placed about the room to draw attention to a dolphin triskele mosaic set into the tiled floor.

title: [[Ship Circle, Scupper's Furrier]]
description: Neat as a pin, Scupper's Furrier Shop still bears the disquieting scent of uncured hides and pelts.  An attempt has been made to mask it, not quite successfully, with large bowls of potpourri placed here and there.  Scupper busies himself about the place, moving stock from one pile to another.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Lobby]]
description: The bank lobby has been roofed over and is open to customers, although the walls still show some scorching where the painters have not yet finished.  Scaffolding and building supplies lie here and there.  The staircase to the second floor, uncarpeted as yet, has been repaired and the polished wooden handrail replaced.

title: [[Lish'telga Misekar, Lowlands]]
description: Quite out of place considering the environment, a broken stone arch rises from the weeds in the center of the path.  Missing a Gor'Tog sized chunk from its keystone down, the arch looks liable to fall over under the slightest provocation.  This may prove deceptive, however, as the steady winds and heavy growth of vines across its surface are seemingly unable to affect its position.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Main Hallway]]
description: Stately guardians, two potted fiddlehead ferns of enormous size flank the staircase leading to the lobby below.  Obviously, some extraordinary measures were taken to promote the growth of these two decorations, be it magic or alchemical, perhaps for the purpose of drawing attention from the doors beyond.  An ash door peeks out from the behind the fern to the north and down the hall towards its ornate looking opposite.  The hall itself opens to a domed courtyard filled with a multitude of plants.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Courtyard]]
description: The timid beige hues of the walls peek out from behind the brilliant splash of the red and green foliage of the potted plants.  Pushed against one of the polished stone walls is a wooden bench padded with red velvet.  The indentations in the seat confirm that many a trader and bank employee have rested here, stopping to gaze upwards at the soft glow of daylight from the domed ceiling above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, up.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Moneychanger]]
description: Appearing to be little more than an afterthought in the construction of the bank, the coin exchanger's room is manned by a stooped, elderly Human.  He constantly kneads something at his chest as he sits behind the safety of the steel bars that seperate him from his customers.  The black metal and ironwood craftwork of the booth is in direct opposition to the softer hues and flowing architecture of the beige stonework elsewhere in the bank.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Courtyard]]
description: A dazzling array of multicolored plants with large, floppy leaves decorates every niche and recess of the walls.  Most of the plants have been set into heavy looking ceramic pots and all show signs of good maintenance.  A deep red carpet stretches across the floor, marking pathways through the flora and along the gently inclined stairs leading upwards.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, up.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Teller's Window]]
description: A pretty Elf sits behind the teller's window, dabbing occasionally at the rose petal makeup daintly applied to her cheeks.  Every so often she looks towards the exit and past the velvet ropes that file customers to her booth and sighs.  A soft light flows in from the courtyard outside, as well as from the skylight above, keeping the area cheerfully lit for the benefit of easy transactions.

A tired-looking Halfling sits behind the teller's window, grumbling as he occasionally drops a handful of coins.  Every so often he begins to nod off in front of a customer, snapping awake only after a few seconds elapse.  The dark sky stares down through the skylight above, lending no helpful light to the fumbling teller.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Courtyard]]
description: There is a definitive lack of the larger indoor plants that make up the decor in other parts of the bank's courtyard.  Where they might have been, large statues of crouching gargoyles sit.  Despite the tell-tale worn spots in the center of the red carpet, little business takes place here beneath the eyes of the grotesque stone forms.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Conference Room 'X']]
description: Unadorned tapestries hang from a handful of thick bronze wall mounts encircling the room, doing little but adding to the already present gloom.  The tapestries have been arranged in such a way that they emphasize the solid oak table set centrally.  Without a skylight or window to shed any illumination upon the table, items upon it take on a similar murky quality.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: Soft mud underfoot, not to mention the occasional ankle-deep pool, shows that the river is lower than usual.  But from the sound of flowing water, the Altanen is still wide and powerful.

The water level in the Altanen has dropped, exposing a nearly flat strip of muddy bank.  To the west, a long streak of green is visible in the middle of the river, and there seems to be movement on it.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: A strip of muddy bank lies between the river and the face of the cliff to the east.  A narrow crevice splits the rock face at a steep angle, carrying a trickle of water down the mountainside.
A strip of muddy bank lies between the river and the face of the cliff to the east.  A narrow crevice splits the rock face at a steep angle, carrying a trickle of water down the mountainside.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: The water in the Altanen ripples in the current and laps at the bank underfoot.  Frogs thrum a deep bass accompaniment to the chuckle of the river.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: A shoulder of the cliff looms up to the north as the mudbank comes to an end.  The sound of the river flowing past echoes from the near-vertical wall close at hand.

The mudbank ends, closed off by a shoulder of the cliff.  The view across the arm of the river shows that the island, although low, is fairly long, extending a good half-league downstream.  Low vegetation covers it, some kind of grey-green scrub or grass.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: Insects drone in the dark, prey to the bat or night-flying bird whose passage is revealed by the beat of a wing.  The soft splashes in the river to the east suggest that the fish are feeding too.

The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  An occasional waving of the grass in a purposeful direction hints that something else inhabits the island.  Across the channel to east, the tops of trees rise above the mist from the river.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: Spray from the obstructed river casts a damp smell over the island.  The churning rapids to the west drown out all sound of movement through the high grasses that have sprung up to cover the island's muddy surface.

A long, low island stretches to the south, dividing the river in two.  The eastern channel must be deeper, for its water is relatively smooth and unruffled, but in the western arm the lowering of the river has uncovered jagged rocks, and the water foams and races between them with a loud roar.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: The roar of the rapids and the wall of mist above it lend a strange boundary to the west.  The buzz of a mosquito or the croak of a frog punctuates the background noise.

To the north, the island narrows to a point, but to the south it broadens until it almost looks like a meadow covered with waving grasses.  The grass is beaten down in a few places, possibly animal trails.  The rapids to the west cloud the air with spray, making it hard to see what lies beyond them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: It's hard to see much more than the clumps of grass, like huddled figures in the darkness.  The splash of the rapids to the west masks all sounds.

The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  Taller patches here and there confuse the view as they wave in the wind and the drifting, blurring spray from the rapids to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: It's hard to see much more than the clumps of grass, like huddled figures in the darkness.  The splash of the rapids to the west masks all sounds.

The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  Taller patches here and there confuse the view as they wave in the wind and the drifting, blurring spray from the rapids to the west.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: A faint smell of decaying vegetation -- or perhaps a fish stranded when the waters dropped -- touches the air.  Swarms of insects have found a home on the island, although what they feed on is a puzzle, unless it's each other, or maybe whatever makes that snuffling sound heard now and then.

Grass extends in all directions.  From here, it's easy to forget that this is an island in the middle of a great river.  It looks like one could walk across this wild meadow to the trees distant in the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

To the north, the island expands into a field of waving grasses, but to the south it shrinks to a narrow spit of land, barely above the surface of the water.  A bowshot to east or west would reach the river, but the roaring rapids to the west show there's no escape in that direction.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]

To the north, the island expands into a field of waving grasses, but to the south it shrinks to a narrow spit of land, barely above the surface of the water.  A bowshot to east or west would reach the river, but the roaring rapids to the west show there's no escape in that direction.

A narrow neck of the island curves north to southwest, covered with high grass.  The rapids must be close, judging by their noise, but the quieter channel to the east shows through breaks in the grass, with places where it would be possible to get into the river.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: Spray from the obstructed river casts a damp smell over the island.  The churning rapids to the west drown out all sound of movement through the high grasses that have sprung up to cover the island's muddy surface.

To the south from this spit of land, the Altanen has a strange appearance: a band of muddy water along the western shore, a clearer blue one along the eastern side, slowly blending as the river winds into parts unknown.  Its two arms join here, holding the low, grassy island that stretches to the north.  From here it could almost be a meadow or a pasture.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Main Hall]]
description: The bustling main hallway of the large building provides a place for people to gather and discuss new ideas with one another.  Stone benches topped with soft cushions offer moderately comfortable seating for those who wish to rest their weary bones.  On either side of the benches stand intricate pedestals which bear carved marble vases filled with floral bouquets.

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Paarupensteen's Office]]
description: An elaborate gold birdcage rests on a large stand, placed next to a makeshift desk in the center of the room.  Along the far wall, a workbench bearing a variety of gadgets and tools display what Paarupensteen treasures most in life.  Upon the wall above the workbench hangs a picture of a plump Halfling woman next to an equally so Halfling man.

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Hallway and Bookstore]]
[[Engineering Society, Hallway and Bookstore]]
description: Marbled flooring surrounded by white walls, which are accented with brass lanterns, span the length of the hall.  Not as many crafters walk through this end of the building, though echoes of pounding hammers permeate the hallway.  A carved sign bearing workshop rules hangs from the wall before three doors.

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Repair Shop]]
description: Bustling back and forth from the shop's backroom, harried workers carry goods that are either in need of repair or have been completed.  Behind a long counter, which spans nearly the width of the room, stands the shop's repairwoman.  Upon the wall behind her are rows of shelves which hold repaired goods waiting for their owner to retrieve them.

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Crafting Supplies]]
description: Like most of the Society Hall, the shop is neat and clean.  Attendants bustle around with brooms and rags cleaning the marbled floors and smooth stone walls.  Behind the counter are crates of supplies to restock the tables and countertops so that any crafter in need of a specific tool does not go without.  Sheer black curtains upon a small oval window shield the shop from prying eyes outside.

title: [[Riverhaven Engineering Society, Resource Depot]]
description: Solid white stone walls encompass the marbled flooring of the shop.  A large double door guarded by two Gor'Togs allows workers to travel between the store and the outside of the building where they bring in new shipments or prepare to be transferred to one of the workshops.  Several raised platforms upon the floor bear heavy blocks of stone which are waiting to be crafted into furniture or unique decorations for the home.

Solid white stone walls encompass the marbled flooring of the shop.  A large double door guarded by two Gor'Togs allows workers to travel between the store and the outside of the building where they bring in new shipments or prepare to be transferred to one of the workshops.  Several raised platforms upon the floor bear thick logs and heavy blocks of stone which are waiting to be crafted into furniture or unique decorations for the home.

title: [[Crossing Alchemy Society, Entrance]]
description: Ill-fitted boulders jut at odd angles from the damp granite walls.  Even the ceiling looks a bit ramshackle here, as though the entry-way were built with speed more than safety in mind.  A slight draft blows from deep inside the building and carries a mixture of odd smells with it.

title: [[Crossing Alchemy Society, Tool Shop]]
description: Tall oak supply crates flank an extended counter displaying various alchemical tools for sale.  A pair of robed individuals rush about helping customers restock.  You notice the overwhelming combination of smells is somewhat reduced here.

title: [[Crossing Alchemy Society, Bookstore]]
description: A haze of dust permeates the air and casts a glow about the wall torches.  A large bookshelf rests against the back wall and a robed figure scurries up and down a ladder to sell tomes and recipes to interested patrons.

title: [[Crossing Alchemy Society, Supplies]]
description: A pungent odor combines with the powder-filled air to make breathing here more difficult.  Racks of spices, herbs, plants and other materials line the walls as attendants scurry about helping customers.  Pewter trays in each corner hold burning incense sticks.  Despite the size and large amount of smoke wafting from each stick, it is nearly impossible to detect even a hint of their scent.

title: [[Crossing Alchemy Society, Office]]
description: Cut into the granite of the far wall is a shelf containing an elaborate collection of alchemical equipment.  The assortment overshadows the Society Master's desk, a simple piece of oak furniture pushed unceremoniously against the wall.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, Depot]]
description: Grey marble walls give way to alabaster columns framing an open supply depot.  The northern hallway bears a sign indicating it leads to workshops, and a well-used road meanders out to the east.  Crisscrossing wagon ruts in the dirt remain from trips to supply the guild with stone and wood supplies.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, Crafting Supplies]]
description: Expertly fitted grey marble slabs frame the lower half of the shop's alabaster walls.  A sliver of light shines through a pair of squat windows bordered by well-polished oak molding and fitted with iron bars styled to resemble vines of ivy.  This area sells a variety of supplies to eager crafters and offers some shelter from the loud noises of productivity emanating from the east.

title: [[Engineering Society, Rangu's Repair Shop]]
description: A small forge in the corner of this room basks everything in its warmth.  Adjacent to it, a long counter sits cluttered with numerous tools and devices for repairing things.  Bundles of repaired goods rest against the far wall waiting for pickup.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, Hallway]]
description: A long hallway cut from smoky alabaster echoes with all sorts of clinks and clanks.  Doors leading to solitary workshops line the walls, manned by attendants waiting to deliver on deed orders.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, Talia's Office]]
description: Mechanical components of all shapes and sizes lay scattered about the polished marble floor.  A large workbench littered with diagrams sits under a pair of shelves cluttered with widgets and gears.  The office's rear contains a row of overflowing bookcases lacking any semblance of organization.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Mossy Cypress]]
description: Within the folds of the mossy shrouds the air is deathly still.  Sheets of moss compete with tangled vines for purchase on the steady limbs of the cypress.  Despite the clinging companions, the great tree seems unhindered in its growth.  It stands straight and proud, keeping endless vigil over the things that dwell in the bog.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Mossy Cypress]]
description: A dark grey moss hangs from the branches above, making footing treacherous and soaking the traveler who pushes through its clinging, soggy curtains.  Water drips down with a recurring 'plop' that adds to the cacophony of sounds.  A warm glow from the east hints at a drier perch.  A weather-worn rope, nearly overgrown by the mosses, hangs from a branch higher up.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Mossy Cypress]]
description: Above, the sun shines brightly though a hole in the canopy, and the moss is dry and almost brittle.  A dry branch snaps underfoot, and silence fills the air.  For a few moments not even the wind dares stir.  Slowly the chatter and whistles of birds return.  A thin vine dangles here, reaching over from a stooping, worn-out cypress.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: Midway up the tree, big vines wind about the mighty cypress like ropes around a mast.  Two large limbs branch out like strong arms spread in welcome to the forest before them.  The marsh below is hidden by a sea of green leaves and fronds waving and glistening in the sunlight.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: The branch threads its way through a nightmare of green strands, almost like soft, searching tentacles.  While they offer no real resistance to movement, their leaves block the view of the way ahead.  They wave in every breeze, threatening to distract and fray nerves already burdened with constant watchfulness.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: Many of the creepers that hamper the view and confound the step trail down to the ground or are so caught in branches that they might almost be a web for a monstrous spider.  But something so menacing could hardly be possible.  One vine looks almost designed for swinging to a nearby willow.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: The wide limb is all but invisible, completely wrapped in layer upon layer of twisting creepers.  Young green tendrils wreath around it, groping for a hold on the limb.  Strong vines cascade from above, reaching from tree to tree.  One of the larger vines nearby disappears into a big oak tree to the north.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: Peat and muck cake the limb, and the smell of decaying vegetation is thick.  A small clump of bog grass has taken root in the crook of the branch, a dwarfed flowering weed growing in its midst.  A single yellow blossom leans toward the few beams of sunlight that make their way through the upper canopy.  It rocks back and forth in a gentle dance with the breeze.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Vine-covered Cypress]]
description: Sunlight filters down through the canopy above, dappling with light and shadow a wide limb littered with twigs and leaves.  A small nest of sticks and moss nestles deep in a nearby crook.  Vines hang from above, draping from branch to branch in graceful, snakelike curves, some reaching to a neighboring cypress.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Hospital, Entrance Room]]
description: This room, located just off the main cavern, serves as a junction for the different locations within the hospital.  In addition to serving as the workplace for the resident healer Shalvarn, whose office is located through a small door to the west, the infirmary allows other healers to stop by and help with the demand for healing.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Hospital, Sitting Room]]
description: Located just off the entrance hall, this room allows members of the community a quiet space to sit and relax while waiting to be seen by Shalvarn.  Several chairs lie scattered about the room in small groups, enabling friends to have a quiet chat.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Hospital, Volunteer Room]]
description: Small alcoves set into each of the four walls hold short canvas cots to raise the patients off the cold stone.  The center of the room is mostly empty save for several large pillows piled there.  A white cabinet rests against the north wall between two of the bays.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Hospital, Shalvard's Room]]
description: This small alcove off the main room is the work area of the resident healer of Hibarnhvidar.  Although many adventurers utilize the services of the primary Empaths' guild, Shalvard set up this small hospital to service those who do not desire to seek help from the guild.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Bank Foyer]]
description: The ornate entrance arch gives way to a long hall, filled with accountants and bookkeepers.  Opposing the arch, two tunnels lead deeper into the bank to the foreign exchange and teller windows.  Several Dwarven employees wander about, conversing with colleagues seated at the desks.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Teller Windows]]
description: Two Dwarven guards stand at the entrance to the tunnel leading back to the bank foyer, insuring the safety and security of deposited funds.  Several alcoves are available in the cavern walls to allow for privacy as one converses with the tellers on the other side of the stone counters.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Foreign Exchange Office]]
description: A small opening sits embedded in the wall opposite the tunnel to the bank foyer.  This part of the cavern claims only a narrow garbage trough and the exchange window as adornment.  A short Dwarven banker sits behind the metal grille, waiting to exchange patron's money into other currencies.

title: [[Vandorf's House of Hides]]
description: The smell of curing hides clings to the air, cloying the nostrils with a heavy unpleasant smell of decayed animal flesh.  A thick cord draped with various furs extends from one end of the room to the other, acting as a makeshift curtain that leads to the back room.  The shop owner Vandorf tends to his furs, stopping every so often to acknowledge customers that walk in to do business.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Bookstore]]
description: A glaes arch divides the public forge from the main cavern.  Owned by Juln, a master smith of Hibarnhvidar, the area resounds with the dull roar of the furnaces, the screech of metal against grindstones and the hiss of hot metal being quenched beyond the hatch in the south wall.  At the entry, tables and counters groan beneath the weight of books for both casual and master smiths.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Inner Corridor]]
description: Granite walls and arches support and decorate this hallowed hall of metalworking.  The crackle of fire from the forges and smithies and the sharp hiss of grinding metal echo around the area in a symphony for the senses.  A small hatch lined with soot leads back towards the main cavern and storeroom, and racks containing tools for sale line the walls.  The other tunnels lead to destinations most suited to a smith.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: More suited to fine detail work than mass production, this room does not contain all the amenities the larger foundries possess.  However, it is much quieter, enabling smiths to concentrate on the projects at hand.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: The fire in the small forge, primarily used to reheat weapons or to prepare smaller items, burns merrily in the south wall.  A large anvil stands ready for smiths to pick up the hammer and set to work.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: The workbench, forge and anvil take up the entire west wall of this room, though there is plenty of room to walk around.  Smells of burning coal and warm metal vie for supremacy here, indicating the amount of work this room normally sees.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: Two large counters bracket the forge and anvil located in the southeastern corner of this room.  An irregular layer of soot films the walls and counters near the forge and the smell of burning flesh lingers in the room.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Tool Shop]]
description: A small alcove to one side of the room contains tables displaying tools for sale.  Several vents in the ceiling gently pull warm air from the foundries nearby.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Maker's Mark Hall]]
description: Maker's mark attendants wait in a small alcove above which hangs a variety of tools.  Prestigious crafters mill about and eagerly discuss trade skills with each other.  An old grindstone sits off to one side.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Supply Depot]]
description: Fashioned similarly to the rest of the forge, this room offers additional space for the storage and sale of crafting supplies.  Large wooden pallets display materials that can be ordered at any time.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: The forging area feels warmer than most places in Hibarnhvidar due to a large fire kept constantly burning in the basement of the forge.  Heat from the blaze below bleeds up into a smaller standby fire in the room, enabling a well-trained smith to work with even the most difficult of metals.  A small pile of fuel sits by, waiting to be added to the fire.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: A vent high in the ceiling helps to alleviate some of the heat circulating in this room.  A hearth has been set up against one wall, its fire fed from the blazes below, allowing work to proceed at all hours of the day.  A pile of fuel has been shoveled against the wall, allowing a smith to easily stoke the fire up to a raging inferno.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Various forging accoutrements line the walls, encircling the fire located in the center of the room.  Blasts of heat from below constantly surge through the room.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: The forge fire takes up the entire northwest wall -- the roar of the blaze drowns out all but the strongest of noises.  A small access port in the center of the wall allows a smith to use the heat within for his own purposes.  On the opposite side of the room a pile of fuel waits to be used.

title: [[Gemsmith, Rasiya's Appraisal]]
description: Sized like an after thought, this room has just enough space for the gemsmith to conduct her business.  Whether to give this area the illusion of space, or to provide something for Rasiya to rest her eyes on, the stone walls have been sculpted with flowers representative of the province.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Western Stair Landing]]
description: The stairway pauses more than midway up the wall at a small landing before continuing up to the battlements.  Each step has a smooth valley worn from ages of boot traffic and since there is no railing that accompanies the stairway, the valleys are positioned closer to the safety of the wall.  Smoke twists from the chimney of a small lean-to below.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Forward Battlements]]
description: Each merlon and crenel of the parapet is the width of two men, offering ample protection to archers.  The crenellations cast alternating pools of colored light and shadow across the wall walk as the moons perform their celestial dance.  A torch flickers nearby.

title: [[Coin of the Realm]]
description: A brass chandelier and matching wall sconces illuminate walls of white plaster and pale oak wainscot in this small, handsome shop.  A note and a brace of candles rest on a simple table next to some chairs for customers.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Forward Battlements]]
description: Stretching the length of the great wall, the battlements allow many men to stand along the top to keep the watch and defend when needed.  Here, the granite wall meets the sheer rock face of the canyon wall with cuts so precise there is neither need for mortar nor room enough for a scrap of paper to be slid in the seam.  A torch flickers nearby.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Eastern Stair Landing]]
description: The stairway pauses more than midway up the wall at a small landing before continuing up to the battlements.  Each step has a smooth valley worn into the top from ages of boot traffic.  Since there is no railing that accompanies the stairway, the valleys are positioned closer to the safety of the wall.  At the foot of the stair is a pale muslin tent.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Forward Battlements]]
description: The porous stone is worn by the ages, yet dark brown stains mar the parapets and wall walk.  They stubbornly defy the weather and remain as silent monuments to the fallen who refuse to be forgotten.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Forward Battlements]]
description: The battlements have resisted the ages, their defiance against crumbling to the elements as strong as the will of men to defend them against the foe.  Torches flicker on the wall nearby.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Forward Battlements]]
description: A large section of the parapet has been rebuilt with coarse uncut fieldstone and pebbly mortar.  Though a much more recent addition to the wall, the materials used in the repair have weathered worse than the original granite beneath it and patches of moss have found purchase in the disintegrating fill.

title: [[Quentin's Healerium]]
description: Loose boards of white-washed wood and a collection of dingy tapestries that reek of dust and mold compose this small, windowless hovel.  Oddly, there is little detectable tell-tale scent of blood, although the walls are splashed liberally with bright red splotches.  A single oil lamp hangs overhead, and the only other light source is the open door leading out.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: This eastern chamber of the smithy is equipped like the others, with a forge and anvil for heating and tempering the castings from the foundry.  From time to time, the din of hammers pounding on the heated blanks rings out from the anvils in the other rooms.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Smithy]]
description: An iron anvil is mounted on a thick oaken stump in the center of the chamber.  Against the wall behind it is the forge, stoked by Yalda's apprentices, where the sword- or shield-to-be is brought to a red-hot glow before being hammered into shape.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Forge]]
description: These small rooms at the back of Yalda's establishment are the shrines of the smiths, housing the furnaces where the glowing metal is heated, tempered, and beaten into shape.  Just a step away from the forge is an iron anvil, bolted to a charred but solid wooden support.

title: [[Traders' Guild, South Hallway]]
description: The faint outline of your image is blurred on the sheen of the highly polished mahogany walls.  Short red carpeting, maintained in pristine condition, cushions the hardwood floors.  Hand-carved cherrywood cuts horizontally across the paneling halfway from the ceiling in a decorative trim.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Reception]]
description: The reception desk is stacked with letters, invoices, purchase requests, and a general stream of bizarre visitors, yet still maintains a sense of orderliness, due mainly to the young Prydaen man behind it.  He seems the sort who can keep control of even the most stressful of situations without blinking.

title: [[Traders' Guild, West Hallway]]
description: The faint outline of your image is blurred on the sheen of the highly polished mahogany walls.  Short red carpeting, maintained in pristine condition, cushions the hardwood floors.  Hand-carved cherrywood cuts horizontally across the paneling halfway from the ceiling in a decorative trim.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Hall of Records]]
description: This is the nerve center of the Traders' Guild, a long narrow hall plunged into a state of utter chaos.  While harried clerks run to and fro collecting paperwork to assist the guild's members, others are busily calculating the ever-fluctuating exchange rates of nearby towns.  As your senses assimilate the free-flying information, you begin to notice a kind of method to this room's insatiable madness.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Shipment Center]]
description: A sense of chaos mingled with urgency pervades the scene before you.  Harried stock clerks rush about, gathering orders and directing sweating laborers in assembling the contents of endless caravans.  The cavernous room echoes with grunts and banging and voices all shouting conflicting commands, each trying to drown the other out to be heard first.  Impatient traders try to catch the fleeting attention of the clerks and give vent to a varied array of oaths in many tongues when ignored.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, out.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Gathering Room]]
description: This room serves as a social hub for the cherished members of the guild to gather and share their adventures and exploits with one another.  Highly polished mahogany walls open up to a large bay window overlooking the River Oxenwaithe.  The guild staff keeps fresh treats available on the serving cart.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Office of the Guildleader]]
description: Long imported silk drapes extend from ceiling to floor and are gathered on either side of a large area window that spans several paces in length.  From this vantage point the bank, gates and various guilds and merchants can be seen throughout Crossing.  An exceptional hand-spun silk carpet nearly covers the entire floor.  Positioned directly opposite the guildleader's desk is a large map of the province mounted high up on the wall.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Stables]]
description: The local traders guild runs its supply out of this dingy excuse for a stable.  Moldy hay is piled in the corners, while the pitiful sounds of cramped animals calls up from the stalls.  Perched on the latest shipment of flour is a greasy-looking boy who can only be the clerk.

title: [[Deep Forest, Monastery Wall]]
description: Stopping the trees abruptly, a tall stone wall rises above the forest canopy.  Set into the wall's outward face is a small iron gate, and the courtyard of a monastery can be seen through it.  Far too small to be a main entrance, it appears to be a back way into the grounds and is a little rusted from years of weathering.

title: [[Deep Forest, Winding Path]]
description: The path here splits in two different directions, each one branching off sharply.  Set at the center of the junction is a large sana'ati tree, much taller than any of the others in the forest.  Small white mushrooms dot the dirt around the tree's roots, although the area is otherwise quite clear of debris or undergrowth.

title: [[Deep Forest, Winding Path]]
description: The forest path sharply ends here at a fallen tree trunk, although the trail looks like it once continued further.  Shining clubmoss covers the ground and some of the trees, and the area feels somewhat damp.  Tangles of vine, shrubs and other undergrowth cover the felled trunk and the space around it, making passage completely impossible.

title: [[Deep Forest, Winding Path]]
description: A crumbled piece of white marble is set in a wide spot between two half-dead trees, the chunk of stone looking to be the broken remnants of a monument or statue.  No longer recognizable at all, the marble's surface is covered in the forest's climbing vines, making it their home.  Overhead, the branches are quite thick, the apple trees flourishing in this area.

title: [[Deep Forest, Winding Path]]
description: Apple trees grow tall in this part of the forest, spread out between the maple and occasionally a willow tree.  Large knotholes in several of them appear to house nests for forest creatures, although many seem to have gone unused for quite some time.  Barely visible through the thick trees to the east is a small pond.

title: [[Deep Forest, Winding Path]]
description: Large huckleberry shrubs somewhat obscure the beginning of this small trail, which winds its way between several tall maple and poplar trees.  Their branches tangle together overhead, forming a dense canopy.  In contrast, the forest floor is sparsely covered, with only a few small wildflowers poking through the cover of decaying leaves.

title: [[North Road, Oasis]]
description: Within the crevice is a green oasis, hidden below the barren plains above you.  Water trickles from a spring in the gully's face, collecting in a series of crystal pools in the rock.  Reeds and a few small trees grow up around the water's edge and rustle in the cool moist breeze.  An old firepit built in the shade of the overhanging granite walls shows that you are not the first to seek shelter in this small paradise.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Greenhouse Entrance]]
description: The narrow cobblestone path continues east and west, looking as if its surface was washed recently.  Visible through a wrought iron fence is a large covered greenhouse, rows of ripening grapes and other plants visible within.  A small wooden gate leads into the carefully crafted structure, and next to it sits a large washtub full of monk's clothes.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Abandoned Tower]]
description: A tall tower stands at the end of the cobblestone path, made from the same stone as the other buildings dotting the grounds of the complex.  With a sturdy iron door that looks solidly locked, the structure's function seems to be a mystery, though the occasional window is visible a few stories up.  Lush vineyards can be seen through the wrought iron fence to the north, growing in neat rows on white trellises.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Gate]]
description: A well-kept cobblestone path runs through the center of a large green lawn, which appears to be very freshly cut.  Although a tall iron fence runs parallel to the pathway and cuts off passage, it's still easy to see several buildings through it, each of them made of mortared stone.  Standing next to the walkway is a single lamppost, also made of cast iron.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Courtyard Path]]
description: The expansive lawn is meticulously kept free of any weeds, creating a completely uniform sea of green on either side of the cobblestone path.  The view through a wrought iron fence shows several buildings, and each one appears to be set aside for a specific purpose.  Directly to the north is a modestly sized chapel, its stained glass windows and wooden doors a bit marred by the accumulation of dust and dirt.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Side Entrance]]
description: The cobblestone pathway passes between two buildings, turning the space briefly into an alleyway.  Each structure is several stories tall, although it's hard to judge exactly because of the flat roofing.  Though the southern building has a small window facing the alley, the interior is fully obscured by heavy grey curtains.  A small wooden door leads into the northern building, apparently a side entrance.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Iron Gate]]
description: The cobblestone pathway stops at a tall stone fence, which seems to be more for appearance than to keep out intruders.  A sign hangs above the entrance, marking it as the monastery's private cemetery.  Growing near the entrance is a small poplar tree, looking like it's not much older than a sapling.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Passage]]
description: The stone walls contrast somewhat with the polished white marble floor, which has a narrow strip of dark red carpeting running down the center.  Although careful work has gone into detailing and carving the architecture, the walls are completely bare and seem almost sterile.  Set into the eastern wall is a steepled window featuring plain glass in an iron frame, which looks out into a small graveyard.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Passage]]
description: Large portions of the hallway's walls are very smooth, divided by columns that break up the pattern of the flagstone.  Though these sections are almost completely bare, flecks of paint at the very edges imply that images once decorated the walls but have long since been scrubbed away.  Gaethzen orbs hang from the ceiling high above, illuminating the narrow hall in a somewhat dim light.

title: [[Monastery, Winding Passage]]
description: The hallway here bends slightly, a single raised step in the center of the floor.  Though the walls are made of bare mortar stone, elaborate borderwork near the ceiling and floor give it just a touch of elegance.  Placed upon a white stone pedestal at the slight corner is a small sword of polished silver, resting atop a dark red pillow.

title: [[Monastery, Winding Passage]]
description: A single raised step in the center of the hallway marks a slight bend in the passage.  Gold leaf adorns the top and bottom borders of the rough stone walls, which are spaced every so often with carved marble columns.  Securely bolted to the northern wall is a large lead sheet, which looks somewhat scuffed in various places.

title: [[Monastery, Winding Passage]]
description: Torches are set at periodic intervals on each wall of this wide passageway, flickering and sending tongues of orange light to play over the grey stone.  Crafted from polished steel, a small medallion hangs around the base of one of dark iron sconces.  The hallway ends to the east at an elegantly arched door, its surface covered with ornate carvings.

title: [[Monastery, Side Passage]]
description: Very narrow and rather claustrophobic, the interior of this hallway is quite plain and unadorned, the walls crafted from mortared stones.  Thick red carpeting covers the entire floor, perhaps placed to mute the sound of footsteps.  The only light in the area is somewhat dim torchlight, filtering in from the passage to the north.

title: [[Monastery, Stairwell]]
description: The cramped, curving hallway is difficult to see down, its southern end washed out by torchlight.  A narrow strip of red carpeting runs down the center of the stone floor, both kept very clean.  Twin torches burn on the walls, their red and orange light flickering and playing off the mortared stone.

title: [[Monastery, Shaded Balcony]]
description: Though the rest of the hallway is almost sterile in appearance, the northern wall opens completely out into a balcony, providing a view just over the treetops.  The nighttime sky is clearly visible, extending over the forest like a dark blanket.  Dim torches line the railing, burning with an orange glow.

title: [[Monastery, Shaded Balcony]]
description: Brightly burning torches set on the southern wall nearly obscure the view from a balcony to the north.  The sky appears pitch black, and the trees below look like little more than the vague outline of shadows.  A waist-high stone railing blocks off the balcony, preventing any serious falls.

The northern wall of this narrow hallway fans out into a covered balcony, providing a sharp view of the forest below.  Endless trees form a rough canopy that hides anything below them, extending to the mountains to the distant north.  Occasionally a small bird passes in front of the stone railing, fluttering its wings and keeping a fair distance away.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Passage]]
description: Both walls are very smooth and completely bare, contrasting sharply with the arching ceiling overhead and its elaborate design.  A deep red carpet runs down the center of the marble floor, muting footsteps and adding just a hint of warmth to the room.  Blazing torches frame both sides of an ornately carved wooden door set in the northern wall.

title: [[Monastery, Alcove]]
description: Standing in the circular end of the hallway is an elegant statue crafted from white marble which depicts a woman in a long robe.  Coated in elegant gold leaf, the alcove's interior is designed to reflect a shower of light onto the figure, giving it a surreal feeling.  A small window on the southern wall looks out onto the monastery grounds.

title: [[Book's Private Study]]
description: Row upon row of volumes and tomes line several darkly stained cedar shelves, taking up the entire eastern wall of the room.  A dark mahogany desk stands in the center of the room, a large and comfortable-looking chair behind it.  Two narrow strips of deep red carpeting run along each side of the desk, simply accenting the black marble floor.

title: [[Journalai Route, Foothills]]
description: A set of rolling green hills rise up to the west, gradually flattening out into grasslands to the east.  A barricade blocks off further passage toward the east along the Journalai Route.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: The old, abandoned Journalai Route runs through the rolling hills outside of the village of Kaerna like a winding brownish-green ribbon someone dropped and forgot.  A few stones that might have been road markers still remain, cracked and weathered and lying, forsaken, to one side of the road.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: The Route continues to the east and west, while to the north you notice a dirt path that looks to have been tread by the passage of feet, not the passage of wagons.  A trickling stream passes over the road, leaving mud and muck in its wake as it vanishes into the grasses of the surrounding hillside.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: The silence here would be peaceful, if it weren't so intrusive.  No birdsong, no movement of wildlife, just an empty, all-encompassing stillness, as if the green, wild hills that rise about you were holding their breath.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: From here, the top of one of the tallest hills, you can see the lay of the land, rising and falling before and behind you.  The Route winds onward to the east, and dwindles slowly toward the west.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: Slender, willowy trees grow along the side of the road on this part of the Route, their boughs intertwining to form a wild, beautiful arch of leaf and branch.  From somewhere in the trees you hear the soft twitter of a single bird, the first you have heard in your entire time here.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rolling Hills]]
description: Large stones crop out from the sides of the hills, bones jutting from the round flesh of the earth.  Wild roses climb over the hillsides, their bushes tangling into one another, and their fresh scent encircling you.  It is not enough, however, to dispel the faint tinge of rot that seems to hang in the air.

title: [[Journalai Route, Rocky Hills]]
description: The ground is extremely stony here, and the sides of the hills are dotted with the broken remains of boulders.  To the west you see mountain peaks, broken-edged etchings against the sky.
