description: The posts of its banister now nothing but stubs, a partially collapsed staircase descends to the floor below, groaning softly as it shifts.  In worse condition is the rotted carpet, split and torn to expose the gaps in the floorboards.  Along the ceiling, the brown stains from water damage create billowing clouds, floating above the dilapidation of a place in disrepair.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Bedroom]]
description: A shattered window allows a draft to whisk through the room, swirling the dust bunnies and lighter clutter into a graceful dance to the music of a shuddering breeze.  Spinning pirouettes and half-turns upon the vacant floor before a crumbling fireplace, the twisting refuse performs with the air's every motion.  Running from beneath the window to points all along the room are scratches and gouges, as if several somethings were shoved forcefully toward the open window.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Second Floor Hall]]
description: It takes little keeness of perception to note the sad state of the floor, as vacancies in the boards are commonplace and in some places allow glimpses of the level below.  Equally obvious is the cracking and waterstained plaster along the walls, devoid of paintings or ornamentation unless one counts the occasional protrustion of a rusty nail.  Not as apparent is the state of the ceiling, as shadows and murky stains disguise its stability.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Windowless Bedroom]]
description: Each of the windowless walls has been painted in garishly bright colors with macabre depictions of tall flames and screaming souls, twisted skeletons dancing in fire, and all manner of people drowning in burning lakes.  Otherwise, the bedroom is featureless, stripped of all furniture, most likely to make room for the wide circle of black wax that loops around the room.  In the center of this waxen design is a skull, affixed securely to the floor by a cage of oversized nails.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Second Floor Hall]]
description: Smashed in various places, the walls yield tiny avalanches of plaster powder upon the blackened floor each time the manor settles or a heavy footstep shakes a loose board.  Thousands of dead and living insects litter the insides of these pockmarked walls, sometimes pouring through the fissures in a singular flow of legs, wings and carapaces.  Though mostly shattered, the walls have been reinforced around a wooden door, most likely to sturdily support the metal bands and bolts that once kept it sealed.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: A haunting chill in the air is stirred by the gentle disturbance of a slight draft, carrying with it the scent of something bitter.  Possible as the source of this heady smell are the beads of moisture that cling to the walls, milky white in consistency and color.  Growths of thick vines braid themselves around one another, snaking up the stairway in a seemingly intelligent course, determined lovers to the steps' framework.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: Twisted tendrils wrap themselves around supports, their growth slowly suffocating the wood as they make their way up from a jagged-edged crack in the wall toward the summit of the stairs.  Interlacing themselves in tight braids, the vines threaten to replace the ascending steps with a plant life simulacrum.  Sturdy it may be, but the slow transformation appears strange and alien.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: A bitter moistness slickens the skin as an ever-present draft spirals downward, occasionally whistling softly as it strikes the slats along the stairs.  The wood suffers from the damp air, and vacancies where steps once were beckon a tumble to the solid stone floor far below.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: Dark cracks stand out against even the oppressive blackness of shadows that conceal the walls.  Each slat of the stair groans and creaks, as if pushed upward from some unseen force below, or as if the entire wooden structure of the stairway were shifting with every minute settling of the building.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Grand Hallway]]
description: A pyramidal mass hangs from the ceiling by a rusting length of chain, swaying gently.  Strands of webbing drape from the masked form, dangling directly above the center of an odd circular pattern in the marble floor.  The stonework is limited to this immediate entryway, and is usurped by a wooden floor to either side of the hall -- not that this transition is easy to see, due to the large amounts of dust and refuse that cover the floor.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Library]]
description: Partly cowled by a massive maroon tapestry, a solitary window provides a limited and distorted view of the world outside.  Boards crisscross the window, further minimizing its usefulness and blocking up the larger of the vacant panes the way a vagabond might wear an eyepatch.  Rows of dilapidated shelving cover most of the other walls, the soggy remains of paper a sign that many books have been lost forever.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Grand Hallway]]
description: Covered in a yellowed webbing that obscures their features, a pair of marble statues dutifully guard either side of a veiled mahogany archway.  Thickening near the ceiling, the webbing shifts in the errant drafts of the hallway, forming oddly familiar faces momentarily before reforming into more esoteric guises.  Ironically, the ceiling's shade of dark blue has not yet faded to the point that the semblance to a cloud-filled sky is lost.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Grand Hallway]]
description: The planking along the hall is exposed and warped, curling inward on the passageway as though it were in the crushing grip of massive skeletal hands.  Unstable at best, the floor creaks with any applied pressure, and occasionally without any apparent stimulus at all.  Adding in its own sounds of settling to the ambient groaning of shifting wood is a partially collapsed staircase.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Den]]
description: Lumps of what appear to be hardened sap hang from the crown moulding, occasionally dripping greasy muck down the bricks of a broken fireplace.  Their lofty perches are surrounded by brownish water stains and yellowing webbing, unreachable from the cluttered floor.  No large pieces of furniture remain in the room -- only bits of unrecognizable debris and rotting wood.

timeto.2335: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 260 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Second Floor Hall]]
description: Resting in a concave depression of curved boards and splintered supports is a mostly intact chandelier, having apparently fallen from the dangling chain in the ceiling directly above the mess.  While easy to get around, the light fixture is permanently wedged into the floor and several gaps even allow glimpses through the weakened wood.  Ominously, the entire mass creaks as if everything will collapse any time now.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Second Floor Hall]]
description: Still retaining some semblance of a pale ivory color in spite of being heavily stained by smoke and brownish smudges and fingerprints, a decorative arch splits the hallway into two distinct sections.  Yellowed webbing stretches from the ceiling to one wall, mimicking the arch in basic shape, but its sticky confines entrap a group of skeletal rodents.  One bone in the mass is far too large to be a rat, however.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Second Floor Hall]]
description: Atop the filth of the derelict floor are piles of shattered glass and shiny ceramic fragments, scattered in blossomed patterns where the force that devastated vases and cups left their remains.  The wall supports a theory that someone flew into an insane rage and slung the items to purposefully break them, and bears hundreds of jagged shards embedded in its plaster surface like tiny daggers jammed in the flesh of a beast that refused to fall.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Bedroom]]
description: Yellowed webbing covers the ceiling, masking sight of the wooden supports to the point that it can't be determined if they even exist.  Strands of the sticky webs dangle down from that hanging mass, shifting over the fragmented floorboards from unseen drafts, though a sizable clump sticks to one wall and therefore barely moves.  At the bottom of this net-like tendril is a desk, devoid of all drawers and glued in place by the affectionate webs as they wrap around this lone piece of furniture.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: Everywhere around, lining the wall stones and the thick vines that clutch the stairs, are what can only be tricks of light in the form of a thousand gasping faces.  The macabre truth screams out after but a moment's stare, shattering the mocking illusion that this could be playful light and revealing the army of desiccated bat faces that are tacked haphazardly across every available surface.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: A bell of unprecedented quality, considering the level of ruin the manor is in, hangs from the rafters above, neatly centered.  Knotted lengths of rope dangle from beneath but are out of reach, their condition not echoing the sorry state reflected in the stairs.  If not for the lengths of vines that entwine themselves in and out of the steps, it's easily conceivable that they would collapse beneath their own weight.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: Spreading out like an elegant oak reaching for the purity of sunlight, a series of tangled vines creeps its way up the wall and through a small break in the roof.  The shifting of the staircase that the plants have so powerfully entwined sets off a quiet ripping noise from the clinging growth with each motion.  Even if the stairs collapse, the ornate bell hanging above would most likely remain.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Circular Stairwell]]
description: Massive, a large ornate bell hangs almost directly across from a wooden door, the landing before the door extending nearly to the edge of the bell itself.  Knotted but only slightly stained, a pair of ropes hangs from the opposite side of the mammoth bell.  Shadow blankets the ceiling and the area around the bell, so opaque that it resembles the way a gem seller might present a fine stone.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Attic]]
description: An army of soldiers would have taken quite some time to stack the discarded and now forgotten items that fill every available niche.  Over the years, surely only a handful of servants and family members were responsible, gradually building up the collection here in storage.  Torch boxes, toys, bottles, bridles, dresses and dolls lay all about, shuffled in among odd bits of metal and covered with dust and webs.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Attic]]
description: The muffled echo of something dripping sounds out, speaking cautiously from its hideaway the way a lost child might meekly call.  A vision in porcelain and glass, the mockery of a real baby lies headfirst in a dusty bin, the tiny doll's dress in tatters.  Perhaps abandoned as the owner came closer to adulthood and discarded the flights of youth, it rests -- an attendee of playful tea parties no more.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Attic]]
description: As if winter's first dirty snow had fallen, everything is layered with a light coating of white.  The illusion of this being an icy covering is temporary, as the nostrils quickly scream that this is the haven for what must be a huge flock of pigeons.  Though no birds are in sight, soft cooing comes from nearby, weakly sporadic like the muttered pleas of a dying man.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Attic]]
description: Soggy and stained from exposure to the elements via the lack of a ceiling, haphazard stacks of crates and barrels fill the spaces between the support beams, hiding the walls from view.  A statue of an Elf sits amid the clutter, a grotesque caricature of clashing colors vandalizing his face.  Resting at a disturbed angle, he gazes into the sky as if longing for escape, but the reality is that he is nothing but shaped granite pointed skyward.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Attic]]
description: A stone S'Kra rests in a small alcove, gazing down the length of the attic with the impassive serenity of lifeless sculpture.  Behind and all around, shadows and webbing lurk, obscuring what's really present with ambiguity, and readying the mind to fill that mysterious space with an ideal.  In love, such a void might be filled with perfection that doesn't exist, but here in the darkness, the only perfection is the perfect fear of the unknown.

title: [[The Great Tower, Narrow Hall]]
description: Floors of dark walnut gleam in the light cast by a row of standing lamps.  The plastered walls, painted a bright scarlet, are decorated by tightly spiraled white patterns that maze across their curved surfaces.  The violet furnishings of the antechamber are visible through a curtained arch, while across from it stands a pair of large teak doors.

title: [[The Great Tower, Narrow Hall]]
description: A miniature potted cherry tree flourishes here despite the lack of natural light, coating the walnut floor surrounding it with a snowfall of delicate pink blossoms.  Across from it opens an ash archway, its surface carved with a flowered vine motif to match the standing lamps that curve out of sight with the rest of the hall.

title: [[The Great Tower, Narrow Hall]]
description: The brilliant patterned scarlet of the walls is broken here by a stretch of black silk curtains that veil the outline of an open archway.  Beside them, a bright copperwood stand houses a large book which is laid open to reveal a pair of blank pages.  Long paintings span the hallway, done in stark greys and blacks on creamy white paper.

title: [[The Great Tower, Narrow Hall]]
description: Off to one side stands a spidery table, its cloth dyed in a rainbow of colors.  A long mural painted on creamy ricepaper stretches above, the black shapes splashed upon it looking alien and vaguely menacing in the muted lamplight.  Closer inspection, however, reveals them to be nothing more intimidating than a highly stylized landscape of the Dragon's Spine.

title: [[The Great Tower, Hall of Feasts]]
description: High, curving walls arch upward in the muted light, meeting to form the domed ceiling of this great chamber.  At the apex stretches a chandelier so skillfully spun from gaethzen and glass that it resembles a spider's web, dew-coated and cradling the stars.  Thin marble pillars, also studded with gaethzen, form a wide circle, and between them rest long tables rimmed by benches.

title: [[The Great Tower, Hall of Dances]]
description: A semicircle of tall daylily-shaped lamps wraps around the perimeter of the dance floor, the flickering light lending an almost cozy atmosphere to the area.  Large screens painted with fantastic beasts and impossible landscapes line all but the southernmost wall, which is broken by a large archway leading back to the dining hall's more formal setting.

title: [[The Great Tower, Hall of Dances]]
description: Given a warm orange cast by the natural lamplight, the ebonwood floor gleams underfoot, with a polished surface unblemished by careless bootmarks.  Beyond a sweeping archway cut into the north wall, the great chandelier of the Hall of Feasts can be seen, its glittering expanse partially dimmed by a thin veil of curtains.

title: [[Chambers of the Ferdahl, Antechamber]]
description: Pale marble walls carved with a stylized pattern of curled vines and flowers enclose this quiet waiting room.  About the perimeter, cushioned silverwillow benches fashioned in a graceful bentwood style have been placed for the comfort of those arriving early for a private audience.  Underfoot, scattered rugs in muted tones of blue and green soften the bleached limestone floor, and in the western wall, arched windows allow daylight to spill in, dimming the gaethzen lamps that occupy the corners.

title: [[Chambers of the Ferdahl, Wash Room]]
description: Bright blue tiles cover the floor of this small room, ending at the foot of a large bowl-shaped white porcelain basin.  A complicated arrangement of twisted copper pipes snakes beneath it, winding up and around to end in a pair of gleaming taps.  Above, an oval mirror hangs on a wall decorated by stylized cresting waves.  The opposite wall is dominated by an arched window, bordered by light white curtains.

title: [[The Great Tower, Antechamber]]
description: Large cushions of plush, deep purple pile in the corners of this small room, ready to provide seating should the wait for admittance to the Ferdahl's inner chambers be a long one.  Twin gaethzen orbs frame both entrances, the pale, steady light lending a feeling of warmth to the red-violet walls that enclose the chamber.  A small indigo rug sits to the side of the door, hosting an array of soft slippers.

title: [[Bank of Raven's Point, Lobby]]
description: Incredibly thick slabs of stone form this bank, the sheer impenetrability giving the impression that the building was carved from an outcropping of stone at the center of the town.  There is no decoration here, just low bronze braziers which illuminate the room and stain the walls with their soot.  The doorway of the bank itself is open, though a massive stone cleverly designed to roll into place rests beside it.  Several ornery-looking guards armed with enormous battle axes stand at the ready.

title: [[Bank of Raven's Point, Depository]]
description: Chiseled into the cold stone walls of the bank is a tiny opening which leaves just enough room for the teller behind it to squint through and pass coins.  The flat grey of the room is unbroken, save for a few pale scuffs and a streak of old blood on the thick wall nearest the lobby.

title: [[Bank of Raven's Point, Exchange]]
description: A small square hole is cut into the stone wall, leaving just enough room to speak to the clerk behind it and to slide coins back and forth -- security is no joke at this bank.  The only break in the monotony of the grey stone walls is a plain exchange rate board and a small calendar set into the wall.

title: [[Smoky Bandit's, Shop]]
description: Pungent to extraordinarily sweet, the heavy aroma of tobacco of all kinds assails the senses in this small, cramped room.  Shelves lined with dusty glass jars of varying translucency vie for space with hooks hung with pouches, and tiered tables display handmade pipes.  Centered on the back wall is a large portrait of an extremely aged Dwarven man with a long pipe dangling from his mouth.

title: [[Smoky Bandit's, Lounge]]
description: Rocking chairs and couches with rock-hard cushions are arranged in a semicircle around a large fireplace, above which is a detailed mosaic landscape done in a variety of rough native stone.  A snowbeast pelt rug is spread in the center of the space, a squat stone table atop it holding refreshments for customers to enjoy while puffing on their pipes.  The stale scent of tobacco clings to every surface despite the cloudy glass window kept open a small crack for ventilation.

title: [[Commerce Center, Entryway]]
description: Matted and worn from the stomp of heavy boots, a large rug of unidentifiable brown fur covers the floor of the foyer.  Braziers billow heat from the corners of the room, set to warm the three main sections of the commerce hub of Raven's Point: the furrier to the west, the general store to the north, and the gembuyer to the east.

title: [[Gimsta's Gimstaan]]
description: Glass baubles in rich jewel tones hang before a glistening window that faces the street, the faux gems catching and refracting the sunlight into a rainbow of colors.  A thick white fur rug lies in front of a polished stone counter behind which is a cushioned stool and a golden loupe hung on a small hook.  Brocade tapestries of Forfedhdarian landscapes cover the walls, their brilliant hues and refined appearance a rarity in this cold mountain village.

title: [[Stedh's Furs]]
description: Dominated by a long stone counter, this small room is filled with the heavy scent of the partially preserved pelts and hides that hang on every surface of the walls.  A dirty window overlooks the town square of the tiny village.  The shop's burly owner, Stedh, keeps the store in a barely controlled state of disarray -- though only between flirting with every lass who walks through his door.

title: [[General Store]]
description: Hardly more than a handful of miscellaneous supplies, the general store of Raven's Point is a hub of activity for visiting hunters, warriors, and miners.  A pitted bronze weapon rack takes up most of the display wall, the gleaming armaments hung above a long stone table.

title: [[Seastar Curios, Foyer]]
description: Freshly dried bamboo stalks are tightly tethered together with braided hemp to form the small building, while an array of seashells and various finds hung upon the walls provides a bit of decoration.  A multitude of blue-green gaethzen seastars hang overhead, casting a soft ocean-colored hue over the pedestals, counters, and various surfaces below.

title: [[Seastar Curios, Back Room]]
description: An array of makeshift racks surround the bamboo walls, each displaying a variety of wares, lit by a trio of lanterns overhead.  A large threadbare rug covers the rough hewn plank flooring, while a faded tapestry decorates a far will with image of battling warriors.

title: [[Seastar Curios, Vault]]
description: Faded sea nets drape the ceiling and walls of the small room, each entangled with bits of driftwood, seashells, and dried sea kelp.  Casting a soft golden hue upon the trio of tables below, a marbled gaethzen orb encased in pewter vining dangles overhead.

title: [[Seastar Curios, Apparel]]
description: Sheer blue and green silks drape the tethered bamboo walls, creating a small parlor-like atmosphere with a trio of brass lanterns that hang overhead highlighting the wares below.  A pair of weathered rattan chairs surround a small cart in a far corner.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Winding Path]]
description: Well hidden among the thickets and thistles of the island, the nearly invisible trail is a barely traveled place between the heavy trees and foliage.  Walls made from trees and dense vines rise up on either side of the narrow cleared area.  The path has the feel of a shortcut, and appears to have been forged recently, with fresh cuts of sharp instruments still visible in the local flora.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Palisade Gates]]
description: The orange light of the guttering torches casts a sooty, wavering light up the smooth barricade of the immense double doors of the entrance gates set centrally in the thick band of the log palisade spearing imposingly into the sky.

Thick slabs of roughly hewn wood securely fastened by stout diagonal battens of a darker wood make up the double massive entry gates.  Centered in the line of logs spearing imposingly into the sky, the gates resemble a dark squared gem set in the thick band of the defensive palisade circle.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Palisade Path]]
description: Spearing imposingly into the night, the thick logs of the palisade forbid any intrusion into the compound.  The faint trail patrols the length of the wall, apparently beaten into the lush grasses by the inhabitants' feet as they scrutinize any possible breach in the security of the logs.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Palisade Path]]

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Clearing]]
description: The thick jungle vegetation suddenly gives way to a small clearing.  Someone has swept the ground clean of even the smallest pebble, and placed several fist-sized stones to form a path to a primitive hut made from branches, sticks, and fronds, and topped with a roof of broad, waxy leaves of the indigenous plants.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Hermit's Home]]
description: Only the bare essentials are present in the hut.  A sleeping mat, a simple table, and a small cooking pot are the only major furnishings in the one-room dwelling.  A light breeze passes through the gaps in the make-shift walls and an occasional gust curls the corner of a woven grass sleeping mat.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Jungle Overgrowth]]
description: The jungle, once teeming with activity and overflowing with a cacophony of sound, is still and silent.  The moist, dank air wraps itself around everything like a smothering blanket, and muffles the sounds of creaking leather and clanking metal.  Only one direction of travel offers a convenient path and the strikingly similar foliage only serves to confuse and hinder judgement.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Town Hall, Second Floor Landing]]
description: A large but scraggly palm tree in a pot sits at the top of the stairs in an effort to liven the dull civic atmosphere.  This floor contains the Mayor's Office and meeting rooms.

title: [[Town Hall, Council Chamber]]
description: This spacious chamber, elegantly decorated, is where the Town Council meets in formal session.  One of the most notable features here is the domed ceiling painted to resemble the night sky spangled with stars and moons.  A very realistic and lovely work of art, this is a surprising find in this stuffy bureaucratic environment.  A large horseshoe-shaped table for the members is the main furniture.

title: [[Town Hall, Mayor's Office]]
description: A large office, reasonably well-appointed with comfortable furnishings.  Portraits of past mayors line the walls and you notice they all smile in the same way, a bit too wide and a bit too sincerely to make you trust them.  An old but well-kept desk dominates the center of the room and a leather couch for guests sits along one wall.  A window looks out over the town.

title: [[Town Hall, Short Hallway]]
description: This short hallway leads from the second floor landing to the public Meeting Hall.  Cream-colored walls are hung with portraits of various famous citizens and a series of engravings, copies actually, of the famed Elothean artist Hoa Kiu-Sawa's series called "7 River Views".

title: [[Town Hall, Short Hallway]]
description: Austere and formal, this section of the hallway is bare of plants and clutter.  An archway framed by ivy-carved molding opens in the south wall, its size and shape implying that a door should be housed within the arch's confines.  An unsigned portrait of a woman hangs directly across from the archway.

title: [[Town Hall, Records Storage]]
description: This cramped, dusty office displays all the standard appointments that mark it as serving an extremely important role in the bureaucracy of the town government.  Dilapidated, make-shift shelves are crammed full of books and papers that bear no evidence of being organized in any useful manner.  Everything is covered with a thick layer of dust, and the walls and ceiling are stained with black from the smoke that rises from the single, small lamp that rests on a high desk in the center of the room.

title: [[Town Hall, Public Meeting Room]]
description: The largest room in the Town Hall, this is used for public meetings.  Both official meetings and ones held at the behest of townsfolk will be had here.  Sometimes visiting scholars will lecture for the edification of the populace as well.  Dark oak panelled walls and polished floor are surprisingly clean and in good repair.  Padded benches for the public's use are arrayed about a small stage and podium.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Path]]
description: The narrow trail curves to the west towards a long row of earthen mounds.  Interlaced in a web of worm-eaten wood, the bare branches of the whistling wood hang low over the beaten path.  Curiously devoid of the sounds of animal life present in most woods, the silence beneath the trees weighs heavily on the air.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Path]]
description: Like the footprint of a giant bird, the trail branches in three directions.  One branch curves toward the northwest, where a large hill of dirt and rock rises from the earth.  Another leads deeper into the dead silence of the wood, its end lost in the dark shadows beneath the trees.  The third branch leads east towards the derelict road.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Darkened Path]]
description: Shadows hungrily swallow the light, cloaking the path in their darkness.  A faint rustle of sound can be heard thrumming through the trees.  It is impossible to tell whether the sound is caused by something moving in the shadows, or the whisper of wind through the gnarled branches.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Darkened Path]]
description: A trace of frost laces the air as the tunnel of darkness curves to the west.  The trunks of the trees now press so closely it would be impossible to see into the depths of the forest, even if there were light to do so.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Darkened Path]]
description: The mass of shadows weighs heavily upon the ground, muffling all sound and movement.  Standing like stern sentinels, the riddled trees line a trail so twisted and choked it is impossible to take two steps without having to turn.  A sibilant hissing echoes from the branches above.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Darkened Path]]
description: Faint patches of light can be seen to the south, scattering the shadows enough that the dim forms of trees stand out in stark relief beside the path.  The bark and branches of the trees are rimed in bluish-grey frost.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Clearing]]
description: The worm-riddled ranks of the whispering woods open onto a great clearing filled with light from the sky above.  A streambed cuts through the ground, running from the mouth of a large cave and towards the east.

title: [[Ice Caves, Cave Mouth]]
description: Like the maw of some great beast, the stalagmite and stalactite-filled cave's stone teeth are as sharp as time and nature can make them.  Beyond the cavern's gaping entrance, a forest of stone rises.  Yet, the pillars are coated in black ice, reminders of the spell that once kept this area frozen -- the area and its inhabitants, feared even by their creators.

title: [[Ice Caves, Stone Forest]]
description: Among the great teeth of stone a narrow stream weaves its way down out of the darkness.  Revealed by its path is an archway that opens to the west, offering a sloping passage beneath faded markings that have become illegible over time.

title: [[Ice Caves, Sloping Passageway]]
description: Following the steep incline of the passage, the stream flows downhill seeking escape from the dark chill of the caverns.  Scratches mar the rocks that make up the tunnel's walls, showing signs of frantic digging by some sort of clawed beasts.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Pool]]
description: Stalagmites, straining to reach the ceiling, surround a pool of water that rests in the center of the chamber.  The stream cuts through the pool, vanishing under its ice-coated surface, before re-emerging from the pool's far side.

title: [[Ice Caves, Narrow Tunnel]]
description: Floodwater escaping from the shallow stream cutting through the tunnel floor fills the area with mud and grime.  What little ground there is to walk on is a mire that is both slow and treacherous.

title: [[Ice Caves, Underground Lake]]
description: Years of erosion have cut a shallow stream into the hard rock floor of the tunnel as the lake's waters seek a faster means of escape from the dark confines of the massive cavern.  A bridge of stone rises out from the passageway and offers the only means of crossing the freezing waters.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A mound of earth looks curiously out of place beneath the twisted and warped branches of the dead trees.  Barren of all but the hardiest of grasses, the mound has several small holes in its side.

title: [[Orem's Bathhouse, Main Bathing Hall]]
description: This large room is comfortably warm.  Men and women mingle here sociably, most differences in class shed with their clothes.  Bathing pools of different temperatures lead off in several directions and a married couple are undergoing a vigorous massage therapy session from a winsome but apparently strong pair of twin Elven lasses.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: One large tree has collapsed, partially blocking the pathway.  The bark of the tree is riddled with hundreds of tiny holes that must have weakened it and caused its fall.  A skull, yellowed with age, hangs by a frayed rope from one of the tree's branches.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Dark lichen and moss cover the ground beneath the barren trees.  Riddled with holes from some age-old catastrophe, several trees have collapsed from their own weight.  Away from the trail, a few small plants have begun sprouting in the small patches of light that penetrate the closely interlaced branches.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A dark mound of earth rises beside the trail.  Faint patches of moss grow around several holes dug into the sides.  The stench of rot and decay fills the air.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Several stumps line the pathway, evidence that many trees have been cut down.  Who would want the rotting wood found here is a great mystery.  Faint gouges mark the trail, leading away from the stumps.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A waiting silence fills the shadows beneath the ancient trees.  Faint patches of sky can be seen through the branches above, covering the earth with patterns of light.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The packed earth of the trail is covered in a mass of blood and shreds of bone.  A rotting leather coat lies pinned beneath a sapling, its young wood out of place in the ancient forest.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Faint pockets of light gleam from beneath the trees, piercing the gloomy shadows.  The trail continues its winding course through the trees.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The ghostly forms of the rotting trees fall away from the trail, allowing faint patches of the sky to be seen.  Recently dug graves line the sides of the trail, their crudely constructed grave markers rising from the earth like the stalks left after a strange harvest.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Faint shadings of frost line the bark of the trees in this area.  Dark lumps hang from the branches of the trees, looking like miniature cocoons.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Fire-blackened trees line the dark pathway, their forms twisted and shattered by intense heat.  A few rusted arrowheads lie scattered beneath the trees, evidence of intense combat sometime in the past.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The trail curves sharply around a tightly packed group of trees.  Their tangled branches allow a very faint light to filter though, just enough for travelers to avoid the rocks and roots littering the path.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A dark mound of earth rises beside the trail, its surface covered in recently dug holes.  Faint sounds can be heard coming from them, though they are too dark to see what lies within.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Gleaming darkly in the subdued light, a large pool of water lies nestled beneath the roots of a dead tree.  The bark of the tree glimmers with light reflected from the pool.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The beaten pathway wanders sinuously beneath the trees, dappled with patterns of shadow and light.  A large branch partially blocks the trail, its surface riddled with small holes.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The ground here is softer than in other parts of the trail.  Several footprints have set into the earth, both those of animals and of Elanthia's many races.  Puddles of water lie in the depths of the prints.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Strong gusts of wind have knocked several trees over, leaving their dead forms strewn about the path.  The rotten corpse of an animal lies on the trail, impaled by a branch.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The narrow path twists out of sight beneath the looming forms of the great trees.  Writhing tendrils of shadow vie with patches of light for room beneath the interlaced branches of the trees.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: An aged tree has collapsed over a packed mound of earth.  The hole where the tree's roots once buried into the earth now reeks of decay.  Several openings have been dug in the side of the mound, some large enough to squeeze through.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The ancient trees line the pathway like soldiers, their close-knit ranks preventing anyone from leaving the trail.  A tattered bird's nest rests in the forked branch of one tree.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The barren path continues its frantic twisting through the woods.  Dark markings line the trunk of one dead tree, either burn marks from a long-past war or a guidepost of some kind.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Several large holes have been dug in the side of a large earthen mound that lies beside the trail.  The spacing of the holes appears deliberate, as though it were more than the work of curious animals.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A large grey tree is split cleanly in two, its center burned a dark black by a lightning strike.  Chips of bark lie scattered about the ground beneath the tree, shattered from the tree by their brief contact with the powerful manifestation of nature's force.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The narrow trail lies dappled with light and shadow in constant struggle for dominance.  A patch of earth beside the trail has been recently dug up, as though someone were searching for something beneath the ground.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The branches above are linked by a great spider's web, beautiful in its deadly symmetry.  Beneath the web, the trail is covered with the remains of countless dried cocoons.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The trail rises abruptly to the north, rent by deep gouges and jagged outcroppings of rock.  A mound of earth has fallen in on itself, and within the hollow, rusted pieces of swords and armor pierce the dirt.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The trail slants sharply downward to the south, its flattened surface marred by jagged stones and ancient roots.  Deep gouges in the earth show that not all travelers made it to the bottom of the hill unscathed.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The narrow pathway curves sharply to the south for a few paces, leading through territory uncluttered by stray tree roots or rocks.  Sagging branches hang low over the trail, creating a nasty trap for the unwary traveler.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A small pool of stagnant water lies sheltered by the rotting roots of a large tree.  Small tracks lead from the pool to a pile of bones deeper in the woods.  The air smells faintly rotten.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The branches of the trees fall away, allowing an unobstructed view of the heavens above.  Light from the burning sun chases away the dappled shadows that line the rest of the pathway.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: A small stone spire has fallen across the path, its once gleaming surface marred by weather and burn marks from wild spells.  Several skeins of rope lie beneath the spire, evidence that someone once tried to move it.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Deep furrows cut sharply across the trail, as though something heavy had been dragged through here recently.  Curiously, the furrows begin and end at the edges of the path.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Barren branches hang low over the path, brushing the top of an earthen mound.  A few stones lie scattered about the ground, breaking the monotony of dead earth.  The stench of death and decay fills the air, coming from several holes in the earthen mound.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The speckled form of a large grey boulder juts from the ground, forcing the path to turn sharply around it.  A pile of bones, gnawed clean by scavengers, lies at its base.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Narrow Path]]
description: The path skirts a gigantic grey boulder that looms off to the east.  From this distance, the side of the boulder looks as smooth as if it had been planed.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Narrow Path]]
description: A dark canopy of leaves hangs over this narrow path through the Whistling Wood.  To the south, a large boulder forces the path to detour around it.  Raw stumps and piles of stones show that the bypass has been recently constructed.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Fissure]]
description: Among the worm-riddled trees that crowd this forest clearing, a great fissure has rent the ground, opening a passageway into the depths.  To the south, a weed-choked path offers the only way out of the clearing.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Gnarled roots break the surface of the path as it curves to the northwest.  A hardy strain of moss grows on the dead wood, slowly eating away the tree's foundation.  Several fallen trunks provide visible proof of the moss's efficiency.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Pale white trees press close about the jagged pathway, their forms riddled with hundreds of tiny holes.  A large cocoon hangs from one branch, dried and withered with the passing of the centuries.  Whatever creature might have emerged from that haven is long since dead.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Gleaming white bones line the pathway, long since picked clean by scavengers.  The eyeless sockets of a jackal's skull stare reproachfully at the lattice-work branches above.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Rising abruptly from the sheltering shadows of the forest, a mound of earth is riddled with holes and evidence of recent digging.  The scent of rotting bodies mixing with the earth wafts upon the wind from the burial site.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: The light of the sun filters weakly through the heavily interlaced branches of the wood.  Barren of all plant life, the earth is dappled with shadows that avoid death at the sun's touch.  Wounded long ago, the trunk of one old tree bears a rusted iron arrowhead.

The light of the moons and stars barely pierces the heavily interlaced branches of the wood.  Cloaked by silent shadow, the path is treacherous to the unwary adventurer.  A rusted iron arrowhead seems to shine from where it is sheathed in the bark of an old tree.

title: [[Whistling Wood, Barrows]]
description: Haphazardly spread throughout the surrounding forest, several dark mounds rise from ground thick and treacherous with twisted tree roots.  A small trail wanders by each of them, its length as tangled as the skeins of Huldah's plotting.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Bulen Ond Alcas]]
description: Ribbons of green surround a clear mountain lake to provide food and shelter for various fauna.  Nearby, the rugged mountain peaks carve out a majestic skyline against a pristine backdrop.  Footprints lead the way along the slender trail encircling the water.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Bulen Ond Alcas]]
description: Up ahead lies a lush garden of evening primroses, their golden yellow blooms fluttering softly with the slightest breeze off the lakefront.  Fragile moths glide from petal to petal imbibing themselves with the heavenly nectar.

Up ahead lies a lush garden of evening primroses, their tiny heads bowed in protection against the rays of the sun.  Bumblebees flit lightly from stem to stem in their vain attempt to reach the heavenly nectar inside the closed blooms.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Bulen Ond Alcas]]
description: By the edge of the narrow footpath, a mountain ash tree stands tall, keeping close watch over the creatures that inhabit the lakeside.  Painstakingly carved into its bark is the outline of a heart with an arrow through its middle.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Bulen Ond Alcas]]
description: Peering up from the edge of the trail, twin saplings lean gracefully into each other as if attempting to gain added strength as a single unit.  Bright pink and white water lilies glide leisurely across the faintly rippling surface of the lake, forming a perfect mirror reflection of themselves against the clear pool, some floating close enough to the shoreline to be captured by an admiring traveler.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Bulen Ond Alcas]]
description: Massive willow trees droop low to dip their feathery tendrils into the cool water beneath their feet.  Cattails and other various reeds line the banks of the lake and harbor a multitude of tiny insect larvae awaiting maturity.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: The craggy incline abruptly becomes steeper and begins to take its toll on the calves of the hiker.  Perched overhead on a low-hanging branch, a tiny brown squirrel sits in death-like stillness, its cheeks nearly overflowing with the most recently acquired of provisions.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Clusters of silverwood and spruce trees thicken to form a deeply shaded canopy and lengthen even further the encroaching shadows.  A rather ominous stillness settles over the ground, as if the creatures that normally inhabit the region are hidden in their burrows cowering in fear.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Rows of roughly hewn fir planks are lashed haphazardly together to form an obviously man-made ramp of sorts across a shallow creek.  Peering wide-eyed up from beneath the floorboards rests a pair of warty bullfrogs, mouths agape in an otherwise silent croak.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Any traveler desiring to avoid an ice-water bath in the chilly waters of the creek bed below must step very carefully over the decaying ramp's rotting planks.  Tall mountain ash trees cast long, dark shadows dimming the vision even further and making it quite difficult to distinguish the moldering logs from the intact ones.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Slippery green moss stealthily weaves its way in and out amongst the granite stepping-stones that lead further up the steep incline.  A single errant step may be all that is necessary to send one careening backwards head over heel towards the base of the cliff.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Clusters of chicory crop up sporadically along the sides of the trail, their pale blue flowers bringing just a hint of a welcome glimmer of brightness to an otherwise shadowy landscape.  Off to the north, clumps of stems lie broken, recently trampled, and oozing their milky sap onto the ground.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Towering silverwood trees sway silently with the slightest breeze, shadow-boxing with each other for dominance of their individual territories.  Competing in vain for space, tiny white-capped mushrooms spring up randomly at the base of each tall trunk.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The trees here are subtly twisted, their gnarled trunks hung with ivy and lichen.  High above, their branches seem to twine together like grasping, skeletal hands, bearing only a scattering of blackened leaves.  Snarls of tangled and matted vegetation are an obstacle for any who pass this way, creating hummocks and lumps resembling scattered corpses in varying states of decay.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The undergrowth is thinner here, burnt by some calamity to a spiky, blackened stubble.  The boles of the surviving trees are scaled and charred along one side, though enough are unscathed to ensure little light penetrates the dense tangle of branches above.  A few blackened stumps are a lingering testament of those who did not survive, their ashy remains lending the whole area a suffocating odor of scorched pine.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The skeletal remains of some fox-sized creature are suspended in a snarl of coiling vines, its body wrenched and splayed in a way no living animal could hope to survive.  The trees are slightly blackened along one side, but the undergrowth is thriving ferociously, forming an impenetrable wall blocking passage to the east and south.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: Skeins of vines tangle with the branches of trees and the area's dense undergrowth to form a living web that seems to suffocate this place.  The air here is still and torpid, redolent of rotting vegetation and the cloying odor of decay.  Even the trees seem choked and smothered, the clinging vines and mosses overwhelming smaller individuals in the arboreal battle for light and life.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The area around a massive, lightning-struck deobar tree is burned down to the ground, creating a clearing that is nearly perfectly round.  A large hole in the tree's bole seems to peer at all that passes here like a gigantic, lidless eye.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: A massive boulder dominates this spot, its stony bulk reaching nearly as high as a tall Gor'Tog.  Its grey flanks are crusted with lichen and snarled with vines, though thus far it has not been completed subsumed by the ravening plant life.  A small deobar tree appears to be growing from the boulder's summit, the added height provided by the hulking rock providing the tiny sapling a meager edge in the war for survival.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The metronomic sound of dripping water pervades the area here, though the noise's source is not apparent.  A fungal reek lingers in the air, mixing noxiously with the smell of mouldering leaves and an unmistakable whiff of rotting flesh.  The vines here are so profuse that a few small trees have succumbed, their skeletons now serving only as support for the parasitic plants that killed them.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: A humanoid skeleton reclines into the grasping embrace of the pervasive vines, its bony limbs sprawling in a morbid parody of decadent relaxation.  A few tatters of silk cling to the remains, bleached by wind and weather to a gaudy red-orange.  Below the corpse, the hilt of a rusted sword rises from the sea of foliage.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Sushu Rahat]]
description: The vegetation here is thickly studded with thorns, burrs, spines and prickles of every description.  Despite the plants' warlike defenses, the area here is somewhat clear and open, as though daring those who pass this way to move with careless inattention.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: With its roots splayed for all to see, a humongous dead tree prohibits movement in an eastward direction.  Insects scurry along the base to scavenge for morsels of detritus or to consume the tender bark.  Mold and mushrooms proliferate along the surface, presumably because of the large gaps in the hedgerow that allow outside light to filter in.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Weathered fragments of bone litter one spot in this section of the field.  The shards surround a large humanoid skull, likely that of a fallen combatant.  Grass grows through the eye sockets and nose holes as fiercely as it flourishes elsewhere in the field.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Dull paint flakes off the immense benches blocking passage to the east, and vines creep around the wooden legs to ensnare them for all eternity.  Dotting the unshapely hedgerows along the southern edge are numerous practice togballs.  The dented leather globes protrude from the branches and leaves only a fraction and must have been thrown into the shrubbery with astounding force.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Tattered and shriveled, what's left of a jersey clings to the pointy branches of the hedgerow.  A large ditch plowed into the ground disrupts the field's natural flow, preventing easy travel west.  The edges of the long, deep furrow are smooth with slimy moss, indicating the hole is not a recent occurrence.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Great ruts and gouges in the ground allude to the many midfield battles that took place here in the past.  Grass collects in the depressions along with weeds and twigs, though the terrain still threatens to twist the ankles of unobservant wanderers.  The formerly pristine landscape now lies in ruins, devoid of its former glory.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Most of the coarse underbrush gives way to less impenetrable grass at this conjunction of sorts.  Haphazardly cut, a ragged gash in the hedgerow facilitates access to a gravel path circumnavigating the field.  Bits of cloth stick to the rough twigs along the gap's edges, fluttering like confetti against the green backdrop.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Bumpy logs from a variety of native trees spread across the ground in no particular order.  The long, thick chunks of wood rise from the depths of the untamed grass like the backs of alligators in a murky creek.  Thankfully, these arboreal additions lack the vicious teeth of the reptiles, though they do manage to trip unwary adventurers and stub quite a few toes.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Birds have overrun the towering hedgerow initially set up as the northern barrier.  Tawny nests peek out from the foliage, and broken eggshells produce a bright mosaic in the mud below.  Wooden posts in various states of destruction rest solemnly upon the tall grass like fallen soldiers on a silent battlefield.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: A broad tree slices through the hedgerow border, likely having crashed onto the field after a lighting strike or other natural calamity.  The moldy bark bears deep scratches all along the side, as if some creature was trying to rend the giant trunk in two.  Messy patches of earth have been dug up from the ground as well, leaving unsightly bare spots in the grass.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: A collection of sculpted oak creatures sits in a circle around a huge grey boulder.  The arrangement is somewhat peculiar considering the environment.  Wavy stalks of grass caress the carvings, the growth not impeded by the wooden residents.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Flying insects swarm above a ditch separating this end of the grounds from midfield.  Copious amounts of soggy leaves and smashed twigs obscure the formerly green and manicured lawn underneath.  No matter the weather, an eerie chill and a stench of death infect the desolate field.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Slumped on the ground like bloated corpses, some leather dummies rest amidst the grass and leaves.  The practice equipment rots and decays just like everything else exposed to the elements for years on end.  A family of enterprising rodents claims sanctuary in one of the torsos, and every now and then, beady eyes glint from the holes riddled through the fabric.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Splintered oak planks and bent metal rods compose the ruins of a modest structure.  A sign hangs from a single nail near the relatively small doorframe.  The only inhabitants now are the same weeds and grasses overwhelming the rest of the field.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Forgotten along with the rest of the clutter, a rusty rake lies adjacent to a tarnished pair of branch cutters.  From here, the view of the field through the goal posts reveals how nature is stealing the grounds slowly but surely.  Only the few gardening tools, relics of a past time, linger on the field as if to lie in wait for the elements to claim them, too.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: An upended wheelbarrow in the corner explains the excessive amount of dingy white chalk dust encrusted on the hedgerow and grass.  Too persistent to be washed away by rain or snow, the mixture must include some type of mortar or cement, likely the brainchild of a lazy landscaper who hated redrawing the lines on the field.  Unfortunately, a squirrel met his untimely demise while scampering through the stuff, as he now accents the area as a perfect plaster-cast statue.

title: [[Boar Clan, Derelict Togball Field]]
description: Curiously out of place amongst the lanky weeds, a large metal bathtub is situated directly in front of the green team's goalposts.  A film of matte-brown algae thrives upon the surface of the rainwater collected within.  The grass does not seem to care, however, as it just keeps growing skyward around the bizarrely placed basin.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Fog's Edge]]
description: The scent of reggus bushes wafts through the air, a few plants surviving on this side of the tree.  Ferns nearby grow hesitantly, reaching for a sky blocked by the thickly woven forest canopy.  Trickling water pools at the edges of hearing somewhere in the murk beyond.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: Black tree trunks stand in the perpetual gloom, individual branches lost in the tangle overhead.  Pine needles underfoot deaden sound.  The air tastes of decay with an overlay of dust, as though nothing living had walked the ground in a long time.  Facing away from the path is a haycart, its wheels broken and the sodden, rotted mass inside it barely recognizable as hay.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: The lower branches of the pine trees jut stiffly from the trunks, bristling with needles that look black in the thin light.  A tattered kerchief lies half-buried on a small mound by the roots of one tree, all that's left of some lost Gypsy.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: A fickle breeze churns the fog, sending clammy droplets like a cloak around the pine trees.  Black trunks stretch in all directions, vanishing into the mist.  Moving through the thick air, kinterbugs hover close to the ground, ready to feed on vulnerable skin.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: Shapes move slowly through the trees at the edge of your vision.  Almost blending into the mist and the black tree trunks, the figures toil at some labor, never pausing, constant as the winds on the mountains.  Through the pine-needled ground comes the vibration of wood pounding on earth.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: The black pine trees thin out, but a wall of brambles -- thick and unyielding and sharp-thorned -- prevents further passage to the north and west.  The ground underfoot squelches as you step on the blanket of pine needles.  The mist seethes angrily, seeping into the brambles.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: Brambles have been hacked back around the trees to form the path here, which is thickly carpeted with pine needles that absorb footfalls.  The brambles are blackened with decay, and the trees they surround are covered in a slimy brown moss.  More of this moss hangs from the trees' branches, brushing a wet trail across whoever passes by.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: The mountains can be sensed, a looming presence beyond the treetops.  Branches stretch and intertwine far above, impeding a clear view of anything beyond the forest.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: A glint of gold within the striated bark of an oak among the pines catches the light.  Half-covered by the tree's bark, the glint reveals itself as a gold bracelet whose delicate carvings are worn with age and exposure.  The bracelet grows out of the trunk just a few hands from the ground, but no wound in the tree shows how the bracelet came to be imbedded there.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: Still and black and silent, the forest presses in along the path.  Although nothing rustles in the bramble bushes that skirt the trees, and there is hardly a breeze to be felt, there is a presence in these woods with you.  The tree trunks are limned with moss that makes them stand in sharper contrast with each other while at the same time blurring the edges between the ranks.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: The path ends abruptly, a wall of brambles entwined with the tree trunks closing in on the pine-needled trail.  To the north the trees seem to thin, but there must be another route around, as the forest here will not give way.  The top supports of a ladder peek from a slight depression in the ground, but the bottom of the ladder is invisible in the darkness below.

title: [[Ker'Leor, Seordav Telga]]
description: The path ends abruptly, a wall of brambles entwined with the tree trunks closing in on the pine-needled trail.  To the north the trees seem to thin, but there must be another route around, as the forest here will not give way.  The everpresent mist roils about the brambles, shifting and disorienting, tickling around the ground then drifting away.

title: [[Marcipur's Stitchery, Fitting Room]]
description: Spools of thread, tangles of ribbons and laces, and baskets overflowing with fabric remnants are strewn about in a jumble of texture and color befitting a true artisan.  In the center of the room, crates of varying sizes surround a sturdy pedestal, probably allowing the proprietress easier access to some of her less vertically challenged clientele.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Vestibule]]
description: True to the tavern's name, a noose of thick knotted rope dangles from a wooden beam just above the doorway.  Drunken patrons stagger out the door and into the street, sounds of merriment and music drifting from the common room to the north.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Common Room]]
description: Crackling torches light this musty room, the air filled with the smells of smoke, roasted meat and strong ale.  Tables have been pushed away from the center of the floor to form a makeshift stage for a small band, playing raucous and bawdy shanties on battered instruments.  A long bar lines one wall to the west, and a broad table is pushed against the opposite corner.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Private Table]]
description: Big enough to seat ten or more, this wide round table offers a view of the tavern and its rowdy patrons.  Antique instruments of torture have been mounted on the walls in this corner, part of the owner's grisly collection.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Main Bar]]
description: Crossed headsman's axes hang on the fieldstone wall behind the bar, the blades inlaid with carnelian to resemble spatters of blood.  To the south, burly patrons cluster about a private table, while the noise from the east makes it easy to identify the location of the common room.  A stairway leads up to the second floor.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Private Table]]
description: Most of the patrons hesitate to approach this shadowy table, its surface pitted and scarred with axe marks.  Rough-looking warriors jostle and laugh with one another here, the crude local argot as thick as the steel weapons that flash at a moment's provocation.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Second Floor Landing]]
description: A staircase leads down to the bar, music and laughter drifting up from below.  This small landing opens up onto two rooms to the east and west, the doors long since removed from their hinges.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Storage Room]]
description: Piled high with crates and kegs, this room must be the main storage area for the bar below.  It seems a wonder that none of the more drunken patrons have wandered up here to help themselves, but the huge Gor'Tog bouncer who occasionally wanders the upstairs landing may serve as an explanation.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Sparring Room]]
description: The rough wooden floor is streaked with dirt and blood in this windowless room, apparently used for sparring and weapons practice by some of the tavern's regulars.  A weapons rack hangs empty on one wall -- apparently the locals like to bring their own.

title: [[Hangman's Noose, Backroom]]
description: Several sweating laborers haul a seemingly endless quantity of casks across the floor from a loading dock.  They curse and strain as they hoist each one up onto one of many shelves already filled with dozens of casks, each painted a dull black.  A massive Gor'Tog overseer flicks a short-handled whip to remind shirkers of their job.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Tool Store]]
description: Tools hang from corkboard decorating this long, rectangular room.  A thick sent of oil clings to the air and the scraping sound of stone sharpening metal drones on in the background.  Some nearby salespeople wait to help customers.
tags: meta:mapname:Ilithi - Shard Outfitting, Engineering, and Enchanting Societies
meta:mapshortname:Shard Outfitting, Engineering, and Enchanting Societies

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Bookstore]]
description: Cluttered stacks of books completely fill a recessed pit in the corner.  Book sellers for the Society shrug to confused patrons, seemingly unapologetic regarding the mess.  One neat and organized table of books stands out from the rest.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Walkway]]
description: A suspended wooden walkway connects both halves of the Engineering Society.  Below, a statue garden demonstrates the very best works of art from local crafters.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Workroom]]
description: At one end of the room stands a work bench covered with tools.  Deep grooves and scratches cover the bench's oak surface.  Wood shavings and stone bits dot the rough granite floor below.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Workroom]]
description: At one end of the room stands a work bench covered with tools.  Deep grooves and scratches cover the bench's oak surface.  Wood shavings and stone bits dot the rough granite floor below.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Workroom]]
description: At one end of the room stands a work bench covered with tools.  Deep grooves and scratches cover the bench's oak surface.  Wood shavings and stone bits dot the rough granite floor below.

title: [[Shard Engineering Society, Workroom]]
description: At one end of the room stands a work bench covered with tools.  Deep grooves and scratches cover the bench's oak surface.  Wood shavings and stone bits dot the rough granite floor below.

title: [[Crin's Herbal Shop, Salesroom]]
description: The smell of green, living things fill your nostrils as you stare around Crin's humble shop.  Plants and herbs grow in splendid array along the walls and even along the sides of the counter.  Moss hangs from the ceiling and Elephant's Ear plants grow from large clay pots located by the door.  Crin, a young human, busily spends most of his time pruning and watering the greenery.

title: [[Shard, North Battlements]]
description: High above the North Gate, embrasures pierce the stone battlements between the merlons that give cover to the defenders of the walls.  The perch commands the main entrance to the city with a field of fire that covers the North Bridge.

timeto.2807: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 255 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Shard, North Battlements]]
description: Paved in stone, the walkway extends a short distance to the west, giving a good view of the North Gates below.  Though the battlement's construction feels somewhat hasty, several reinforcements make it able to hold up to strong attacks.  The Great Tower lies directly to the south, the sturdy walls coming to just above the city's rooftops.

A stone-paved walkway extends a short distance to the west above the North Gate.  The new stone, the fresh mortar, and the smell of new wood give evidence of the battlement's recent (and somewhat hurried) construction.

title: [[Crystal Shore, Sparkling Sands]]
description: Close to the path stands a lifesculpted statue of Ferdahl Kukalakai haloed by a ring of gaethzen orbs hovering from copperleaf tree branches.  She watches eternally over the tranquil waters of her city, a force for peace in death as she was in life.  The surrounding villas nestle in the iridescent sand along the lake as if taking comfort in her serene presence.

Radiant gaethzen orbs halo a statue of Ferdahl Kukalakai, positioned in the center of a cluster of lakeside villas so she can continue her eternal vigil over all of Ilithi.  The light casts a shadowed silhouette that stretches over the trees and lake, as if she was reaching for her lost home.

title: [[Crystal Shore, Sparkling Sands]]
description: A grass-covered rise on the shore supports a large willow tree that leans out over the waters.  Many years of erosion have taken their toll on the roots, but the drooping branches still manage to extend over the path as it cuts by the lake shore.  Small gaethzen orbs dangle between the rustling leaves like will-o'-the-wisps caught in a spider's web.

The path cuts particularly close to the water as it traverses a grassy rise.  A large willow tree growing from the hill leans out over the lake.  The faint lighting from the gaethzen orbs causes the tree's slender branches to form tendrils of shadows that ooze across the lake's mirrored surface.

title: [[Crystal Shore, Sparkling Sands]]
description: The wide gravel path curves along the shore to end at a white crystalline pier that extends over the waters.  Smooth gaethzen orbs encircle a small clearing centered around a silverwood telescope mounted on a marble pedestal.  Nearby, the villas and their residents enjoy a grand view of the beach, lake and cityscape beyond.

Bright gaethzen orbs light the shore path, though the illumination ends before reaching a shadow-cloaked pier extending over the waters.  Carefully shielded by the surrounding foliage, a dim clearing contains a silverwood telescope mounted on a marble pedestal.  Nearby, the villas and their residents enjoy a grand view of the nightscape beyond the lake.

title: [[Crystal Shore, Sparkling Sands]]
description: Crystalline grains glitter in the daylight, a prismatic display of colors stretching from the gravel path to the shore.  Calm, blue waters fill the lake, with tiny ripples lapping softly at the sandy edge.  A pair of marble benches underneath some dangling gaethzen orbs rests alongside the gravel path in a position to look out over the lake.

Gaethzen orbs illuminate the gravel path, their light glittering off the nearby sand.  Dim reflections of each orb float over the dark, calm waters.  A pair of marble benches rests along the gravel path in a position to look out over the lake.

title: [[Crystal Shore, Sparkling Sands]]
description: The quiet lakeside retreat is sheltered from the bustle of the trade road by a small grove of copperleaf trees.  Crystal-white sands extend from the placid lake to the edge of the wide gravel path, their radiance barely outdone by the distant walls of Shard towering over the heart of the lake.  Softly glowing gaethzen orbs dangle from the nearby branches, reflected like miniature suns in the rippling waters.

The quiet lakeside retreat is sheltered from the trade road by a small grove of copperleaf trees.  Softly glowing gaethzen orbs edge the wide gravel path, reflected as ghostly apparitions in the gloomy waters.  The city of Shard blazes on the southern horizon, bursting with activity throughout the night.

title: [[Tokens of Affection]]
description: Set high in the walls are roundels of colored glass that shed patches of light in rose, light blue, ochre, and apple-green over the counters.  As the sun moves, the rainbow of circles shifts, casting new shades and highlights on the wares displayed on crystal, platinum, gold, and silver trays.

title: [[Blazons and Banners]]
description: The shop is crowded with bales of fabric in every color, cutting tables, tailor's dummies, and all the tools for fine needlework.  Cases hold tabards and flags in abundance, and near the street door, the seamstress Zezinka sits behind a wooden counter with a catalog listing the shop's stock in trade.

title: [[The Heraldry Shop]]
description: A palette of smells greets patrons of the Heraldry Shop as mineral spirits, turpentine, and linseed oil compete for olfactory attention.  But Bonime, the artist, allows no visual clutter: rows of paints and solvents, pots of brushes, and sketches on scraps of paper all occupy orderly places on walls and workbenches.  A leather-bound catalog rests on a plain plank counter at the front of the shop.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Bright orange and crimson red paintbrush climbs stealthily in and out of the cracks in the rocks.  Guarding its abode, a large brown lizard blinks sleepily from its perch on a rocky ledge above.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Eroded by time and the elements into the seemingly impenetrable rock, a narrow rift provides a possible venue to further the perilous climb.  Mountain laurel lines the breach in the cliff face with just a hint of purple color.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: The climb grows ever steeper, dizzyingly high above the deep confines of the chasm below.  Chilly breezes caress your face, bringing a silent shiver as they brush lightly across your brow.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: The peak of the mountain comes into view above, though the shortage of suitable footholds along the way belittles all hope of attaining that goal at times.  Looming just ahead stands a huge boulder, heavily splattered with a dark red stain.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: A pair of mockingbirds perches leisurely along a slanted ledge.  Their soulless black eyes peer about, uncaring as to whether or not anyone joins them there.  Each new step up the face of the cliff tosses down a shower of rock fragments, leaving one to ponder even further just how advisable this journey may be.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: The forces of nature are constantly at work, slowly breaking down even the largest boulders only to deposit them elsewhere and build new ones.  Occasional lone branches of fir trees stick their arms out of the hard rock at random, possibly giving the climber an opportunity to progress further up the mountainside.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Water trickles slowly in patches down the face of the cliff, making it even more perilous to obtain a firm grasp for the climb.  Polypody ferns grow thick and dangle leisurely from between any available crack in the stone wall, but quickly prove to be too frail to aid in the ascent whatsoever.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Sweet alyssum pokes its tiny white-flowered blooms out in rounded domes from among the hard stone.  Skittering quickly back and forth along the rocks, a brown newt with red eyelids frantically searches for a suitable hiding place with the rustle of any footstep.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Clusters of moss peek out in patches across the mountainside, vying with adventurers for a safe place to cling to the hard stone.  Nestled cozily on a slanted ledge, a large yellow-brown bull snake dozes, midline still bulging with evidence of its most recent meal.  An occasional contented hiss echoes softly across the summit.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Firm handholds are hard to come by as clumps of what at first appear to be solid rock often crumble to the touch, leaving one to hang by mere fingertips alone.  From her well-appointed nursery in the small niche overhead, a mother chickadee warily surveys the area while guarding her cherished family.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Clay and limestone form distinctive layers in the strata and harden to take the shape of a steep cliff face on the side of the mountain.  Off to the south stands a small grove of spruce trees, their massive trunks standing guard over the earth.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Deep, narrow crevasses form a somewhat regular crisscross pattern across the sides of the chasm.  Quickly moving back and forth between a gap in the rocks here and a pocket in the cliff face overhead, a large grey vulture carries bits of food to her hatchlings tucked away in the small opening.

title: [[Undergondola, Cliff Face]]
description: Pocketing the face of the cliffs are several eroded pits, ranging from the size of marbles to others large enough to hold two grown men.  Vegetation clings tenaciously to life, sending roots into mere cracks in the rocks.

title: [[Skeletal Claw]]
description: A massive claw of bleached bone discolored with swamp sludge cradles you in its palm, jutting up from the marshy ground beneath it. It's a wonder what beast this remnant once belonged to, or if it is in fact the remains of a natural creature at all. The bony fingers are creeping slowly inward, and are close to trapping you inside.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: A small chimney high above in the ceiling is unable to remove all the smoke from a large fire burning under a granite crucible here.  The brown haze swirls about as air currents shift, and adds a bitter taste to the air.  A nearby pile of fuel resembles a shadowy beast in the dim torchlight.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Thick grooves in the dolomite floor lead over to a steel anvil and sandstone grindstone that must have seen many dragging trips into and out of the room.  A nearby slack tub of discolored water mists into a cloudy haze that further obscures the already smoky air.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: Billows of smoke rise up from a large fire and are sucked through a brick chimney situated high above the work area.  A granite crucible towers over the glowing coals, its smooth sides marred by driblets of solidified metal.  A wooden slat stacked with a pile of fuel is nearby.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Sparkles from long-dried metal reflect up from the dolomite floor, illuminated by an octagonal forge in the room's center.  Nearby, a steel anvil and a granite grindstone wait for use with metalwork.  Tendrils of steam rise from the damp floor beneath a briny slack tub used for cooling finished goods.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Crucible]]
