description: Crinkled patches of metal stain the dolomite floor.  The splattering becomes more numerous and expands to form concentric circles near the room's center, where a large granite crucible hangs over a large fire.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Forge]]
description: An octagonal forge situated in the room's center emits a ruddy glow illuminating the basalt blocks framing it.  In the corner, a large grindstone casts a gigantic shadow upon the wall, and wisps of steam rise up from the recently used slack tub and anvil.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Crucible]]
description: A central cavity splits the ceiling and metal tubing funnels smoke away from the glowing fire.  A granite crucible scarred with use rests atop a forked beam next to the fire.  Black scrapes along the ground lead over to a circular pile of fuel in the corner.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Blocks of carved basalt form an octagonal forge surrounding shallow pits containing piles of fuel.  A steel anvil butts up against, and peeks over the heavily chipped blocks.  An assortment of metal molds and attachments for the anvil hang from the wall.

title: [[Catherine's Court, Exterior]]
description: A two-story stone mansion rests here in a plot of well-trimmed hedges and perfectly shorn grass.  Green vines draped with blood-red iera flowers climb the trellises and wind about granite gargoyles standing sentinel from their second-story perches, tickling the beasts' stony chins in a vain attempt to awaken them from their slumber.

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Path]]
description: Stone steps provide entrance and exit for an icy paradise.  A faint pathway follows a ledge, snaking by caverns on one side and a steep drop-off on the other, with everything sparkling from a pristine coating of snow.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Grove]]
description: The path ends here, among tall, stark pine trees covered with ice and snow.  Drifts of delicate cold crystals form a ghostly landscape against the trunks of the outer trees, while only a few paces in, the ground is barely covered at all.  In the snow that exists, faint footprints lead off in different directions.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Grove]]
description: A break in the trees reveals a cave entrance nearly covered in ice.  Someone has taken the time to break the ice, enabling even a Gor'Tog to enter.  The chips of ice surrounding the cave have become quite slippery, as several outlines in the snow show.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Natty's Cave]]
description: As your eyes adjust to the dim light within this cave, a wave of warmth rolls over you.  It emanates from a fire pit encircled by large, rough stones.  A few Gnomes, trappers judging by their garments of snowbeast hides, huddle around the fire, their cheeks reddened from standing so close to the flames.  Various skins and pelts are piled by type along the walls, almost covering a large keg that has seen better days.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[A Warmly Lit Alcove, Skin Art By Mothaki]]
description: The small alcove's roughly carved walls glint like diamonds as the illuminating candlelight reflects from the light layer of frost covering the stone.  Shallow holes in the walls above work tables and near a pair of chairs hold larger torches to ensure proper lighting for those working in the cramped space.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Grove]]
description: Towering pine trees block most of the light, casting a greenish-blue tinge over everything below them.  Claw marks mar their trunks, and some have gashes so deep, it almost appears that the frozen sap is all that holds the tree upright.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Grove]]
description: The trees thin out slightly here, giving opportunity for shafts of light to fall between them and turn the snow into a patchwork of cool blue-green expanses broken by glittering patches that refract to every color of the rainbow.  The shadows that remain seem darker and more ominous by comparison.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Grove]]
description: Abruptly, the grove ends with one tree standing precariously on the edge of the cliff.  Some of its roots have become exposed as time erodes away the cliff face, leaving it dangerously close to becoming the next victim of gravity.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Path]]
description: Fallen branches and other debris from above litter the path as it widens into a small grove of ice-covered pine trees.  Their needles shiver in the wind, causing an odd rattling sound like bones clicking together.  Occasionally, a branch will creak and ice will fall to the ground below, echoing in the frosty air like lunatic fae laughter.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Path]]
description: The ledge is wide enough that the snow-covered path curves around a fallen tree, its branches encrusted with ice crystals.  Snow and ice crunch underfoot, but the mountain wind quickly erases almost every trace that anything or anyone has been through here.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Frostweaver's Den]]
description: Blood has pooled and quickly freezes at your feet as wicked ladies dance among the snow and ice.  Eerie laughter fills the air and echoes along the cavern - a curious mingling of hysterical giggles and shrill screams.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Frostweaver's Den]]
description: Snow-filled beds of carved rock make comfortable sleeping areas for the icy inhabitants.  Slabs of ice form decorative mirrors, with swirls of snowflakes along their edges.  Wind blows through the crevices and entrances to this wide open home of the Frostweavers.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Frostweaver's Den]]
description: Ice-covered bones are piled in a corner where even mice fear to tread.  Snow dances in circles across the cold ground, blown by the whistling wind, while hunters shiver as they make their way through the caverns.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Frostweaver's Den]]
description: This tiny alcove, barely lit by small phosphorescent stones, is covered from ceiling to floor in faint images of maiden warriors.  Each of the blue-painted warriors holds a sword in her hand, plunged deeply into her opponent's chest.
location: Southern Trade Route South of the Gondola

title: [[Biabo's Bug Collection, Front Parlor]]
description: An aged wooden floor is tessellated unevenly while the walls are boarded in dilapidated oak.  Large glass display cases sit atop unfired brick stands giving way to an elongated counter.  The attendant, Biabo, a middle-aged Gnome, peers over his thick spectacles inspecting a small cricket in the palm of his hand.

title: [[Biabo's Bug Collection, Basement]]
description: Dim candlelight illuminates the roots breaking through the crumbling basement walls.  Boxes and barrels are thrown about in disarray making it nearly impossible to navigate through the room.  A few more glass cases stand in the corner awaiting the arrival of Biabo's next shipment of insects.

title: [[Shrine to the Dragon, A Dank Passage]]
description: Streams of light trickle over some uneven jade stairs to the north.  A passage westward leads towards the rest of the shrine.

title: [[Shrine to the Dragon, A Dank Passage]]
description: The murals that were once here have long since faded from the walls, leaving behind broken plaster and crumbling stone as their remain.  The only apparent exit lies east.

title: [[Marachek's Oak, Trader Caravan Stables]]
description: In this large, pleasantly airy room, industrious Halflings muck out straw-lined stables, fill water troughs and towel down sturdy pack animals around the clock.  Their overseer glances in occasionally to make certain everything is going along nicely, then pops out for his nonstop cardgame of tableen down at Marachek's Oak.

In this large, pleasantly airy room, industrious Halflings muck out straw-lined stables, fill water troughs and towel down sturdy pack animals around the clock.  Their overseer glances in occasionally to make certain everything is going along nicely, then pops out for his nonstop cardgame of tableen down at Marachek's Oak.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Granzer's Repairs]]
description: The forge of Mastersmith Granzer Wothhome is a model of efficiency and industry.  Assistants scurry about, keeping the fires stoked and at peak temperature, while the smith himself, a whipcord Elven man with a commanding presence, shapes the steel that comes hot from the forge.

title: [[Struan's Weapons and Armor, Salesroom]]
description: The Dwarven weaponsmith Struan Arguye keeps careful watch over the shop that sells his creations.  The inside of the shop is filled with cheery candlelight that reflects from the walls and the white bearskins covering the floor.  A large circle, clear of all obstructions, is set up to allow patrons to practice with an unsharpened version of the weapon they are interested in before buying.

title: [[Struan's Weapons and Armor, Closet]]
description: Small and rather dark, this room appears to store Struan's work samples.  Neatly stacked hilts, blunted swords, roughly carved shapes and experimental shields provide an intriguing treasure trove of weaponry.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Winding through farmland, the ruts show the rich brown dirt under the strands of green grass.  Growing between the golden grain fields and the road are alyssum bushes, their dense branches bearing clusters of white flowers.  An ornate wrought iron gate is set into a break in the bushes.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Azalea bushes flourish along the sides of the road as the grain fields give way to rows of Ilithic apple tree saplings.  Their branches are spindly and many of them are no higher than a Gor'Tog is tall.  Positioned on one side of the road is a fancy wrought iron gate.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Saplings give way to older apple trees, some of their branches gnarled and entwined with those of the tree next to them.  The grass is sparser but still holding onto a rich green hue as it follows the track through the orchard.  A faint pathway leads away from an elaborately carved wooden gate.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Mature Ilithic apple trees form stately lines along each side of the road, their branches thick with age.  Making their home near the base of one tree is a patch of forest violets showing off their bright hues.  Lavishly carved, a wooden gate stands at the end of a path.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Ancient and twisted, the trees along this part of the road all seem to have different personalities due to their varied shapes.  One hunches over to the side, while another sends branches to sweep the ground almost blocking the lane.  Placed between two of these monoliths is a delicately carved wooden gate.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: The lines of Ilithic apple trees thin out and are smaller than their towering neighbors to the east allowing patches of monkshood to grow among the grasses.  They bloom in a multitude of colors, one patch showing white, another purple and a third yellow.  Set to one side of the roadway is a gracefully carved wooden gate.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Giving way to fields again, the orchard's edge is planted with wood roses that display petals a shade of pink that is tipped with lavender.  Dense grasses threaten to hide the road itself, their shades of green richly hued.  A gate of artfully wrought iron stands between two of the bushes.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Grassy Road]]
description: Nestled under the shade of a lone Ilithic apple tree is an arrangement of beehives, their denizens roly-poly bumblebees.  A constant parade of buzzing creatures travel seemingly aimless paths to and from their artificial homes.  Located nearby is a finely wrought iron gate.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: Bamboo torches edge the walls, providing such bright light as to blur any details within the stone with their dancing flames.  Cool air from the west brings with it a distinctly floral scent, pricking at the senses.  Moving toward the aroma, the passage widens, opening up into a cavern.

title: [[Underground Passage, Hidden Garden]]
description: Slender pathways delineated by spiraling bamboo torches lead between the plantings, casting flickering shadows that dance between the leaves and petals of the fantastically lush flora in this cavern.  Though nearly eclipsed by an abundance of irises of remarkable size and a wide array of colors, decorative grasses and hostas splay outward in artful angles that speak to the careful planning and tending involved in their growth.

Six evenly placed skylights, each covered with clear quartz, are cut into the rough stone of this cavern's ceiling, their angled design funneling sunlight down upon carefully tended flora.  Unexpectedly lush, the decorative grasses and hostas are nevertheless overshadowed by a wide variety of irises in a dizzying array of colors.  Even more remarkable, many of the flowers bear blooms of quite unusual size, some nearly dwarfing a dinner plate.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: Slender wavy lines have been carved into the ceiling in a meandering pattern, encircling golden disks from which hang a series of red paper lanterns.  The carvings become more complex as they radiate outward, incorporating alchemical symbols and jagged geometric glyphs.  Set into one of the walls, a curving osage door looms, its frame nearly as tall as the passage itself.

title: [[Below Wyvern Mountain, Main Laboratory]]
description: Spacious and bathed in warm, golden light from a hanging gaethzen sun, the room sports an impressive array of accoutrements for both research and reflection.  Placed around a sunken central drainage collection tub, gleaming bronze stands have been situated next to each of five granite slabs, holding tools both arcane and surgical.  Plush leather lounges flank a burl wood table, set off from the active research area by matching bookcases.

title: [[Below Wyvern Mountain, Flensing Room]]
description: Body-sized steel boxes sit atop pedestals near the shelf-lined walls that enclose this adjunct laboratory.  Though set up primarily for stripping flesh from bone, the space retains most of the amenities of the main lab to the west, albeit on a smaller scale.  Twin granite slabs sit between tool carts and cabinets, forming narrow aisles that lead to a long, double basin sink at the back of the room.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: Pale paper lanterns reveal a swarm of beetles scrambling across the craggy stone of the ceiling and walls, their shiny, jewel-toned bodies acting as a constantly shifting, living tapestry.  Their versicolored chitin catches in the lantern light as the skittering rainbow horde mills about in an oddly restive fashion, avoiding the floor entirely and appearing to have no interest in leaving their little patch of stone.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: The fossilized skeleton of a large, winged beast is embedded into one of the rocky walls in this long, mostly unadorned tunnel.  Though its left wing is missing entirely, the sheer size of the bones tells of the creature's former glory.  A cluster of footprints overlap one another in the sooty dust beneath the single lantern that hangs from the ceiling, a visible indicator of the high traffic this area must see.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: The surfaces here have been polished to a smooth sheen in striking counterpoint to the rough-hewn stone to the southwest.  Quartz inclusions glitter brightly in the dim illumination, a scintillating play of light working across walls, floor, and ceiling alike.  Sounds of bustling activity come from the east, where glimpses of robed figures milling about can be seen.

title: [[Underground Cavern]]
description: The passage opens dramatically here, terminating in a gargantuan natural cavern.  Carved into the rough stone of the floor, alchemical symbols radiate outward from the towering white marble obelisk that stands in the center, stopping to encircle each of six onyx slabs along the curving walls.  Streams of Elotheans and Humans, all clad from head to toe in saffron silk, move in and out of the chamber, attending to various ritual tasks.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Guildleader's Study]]
description: The warm scent of sandalwood peppered with sweet clove and anise infuses this room, generated by the foot-tall sticks of incense within an urn upon a low, curved table.  Vibrant reds and blues mingle with the dominant gold of the color scheme, their eye-catching tones found in the brightly enameled wall decorations as well as the floor's lapis and carnelian inlay.  Caught and intensified by quartz sheets layered over the skylight channel carved into the stone above, the pallid glow of the stars illuminates this chamber, giving it an unearthly appearance.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Narrow Hallway]]
description: The elevated height of this passage alleviates any impressions of tightness engendered by its narrow width.  Tranquil wave patterns wrought in alternating silver and gold stream through the ivory of the walls, the hammered metals catching light from the hanging lanterns to scintillating effect.  Carried in on a soft breeze from some unknown source, the delicate scent of lotus blossoms lingers in the air.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Narrow Hallway]]
description: The ceiling here descends, tapering down to a much more humble scale that stands in striking counterpoint to the grandiosity of its etched silver embellishments.  Set into the ivory walls, hammered golden troughs hold resplendent lotuses floating within crystal clear waters, their pale, unblemished petals illuminated from above.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Meditation Chamber]]
description: The majority of this chamber consists of large, silver-lined pools filled with shimmering koi.  Slender pathways curve between them, swelling at uneven intervals to accommodate movement around those seated in meditation without causing disruption.  Water cascades down the rippled golden walls, catching in ivory basins before trickling across multitudes of crystalline bells on its way to the ponds below.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Side Room]]
description: The heady aroma of dried lotus blossoms mingles with that of the sweet almond oil in the decanters situated upon the low, golden table in this small room's center.  Wooden benches, heavily gilded and lacquered to a flawless sheen, line the elaborately carved walls, providing a place to sit in respite before or after enjoying the adjacent cleansing spring.  A silver serving cart sits near the entry, holding a large golden pitcher.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Cleansing Spring]]
description: The smooth ivory flooring of the room above gives way to a solid gold coating that lines the natural depression created by the spring.  An eye has been carved into the gold along the bottom, its inset amber iris split by the crevice through which the water rises up from within the mountain itself.  Warm enough to melt away tension, the mineral laden water holds a slightly earthy smell that lingers within the resultant steam.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Sanctuary]]
description: This portion of the chamber is arrayed entirely in shades of gold, from the gilded carving that covers all of the hard surfaces to the intense glow of the illuminated honey-hued rice paper of the interior wall.  The incense is very strong here, suffusing the very air with its thick, nearly intoxicating perfume.  Musical chanting comes clearly from the east, a call and response of wordless tones that evoke the sounds of a gently burbling stream.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Sanctuary]]
description: Placid blue streaks across the bottom of the rice paper, as the scene upon it expands to include a multitude of robed figures seated around the banks of a lake, their raised arms meeting golden rays of sunlight.  Carved into the ivory of the opposite wall, a series of fantastically embellished niches holds opened scrolls bearing silver gilt text.  The scent of heavily spiced incense wafts in from the north, bringing with it the soft murmur of footsteps and song.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Sanctuary]]
description: Rendered in burnished gold, the elaborate carvings of the temple's exterior seem to only expand once within its walls, covering the entire ceiling here.  Patterned rice paper set within golden framing serves as interior walls, the warm glow of lanterns on the other side casting distorted silhouettes upon it.  Set into the floor is a lidless, vertically-slitted eye crafted from amber and onyx, its edges limned in inscribed silver.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Podium]]
description: The walls here, two paper and two stone, are nearly obscured by the many floor-to-ceiling lanterns that line them, washing the eerily-still temple attendants in a saffron light that matches their silken robes.  Mostly Elotheans and Humans, they stand upon the raised platform in the room's center, eyes closed and faces tilted skyward as they chant.  Perfumed smoke filters down from the cloud-carved ivory censers set into the golden sun-patterned ceiling, tickling the senses with rich, spicy notes that play atop an earthy musk base.

title: [[Temple of Serenity, Garden Entrance]]
description: Lacy foliage wends around numerous pallid statuary that blaze with inner light, illuminating the temple that rests at this garden's center.  A sweeping ivory edifice rendered even more luminous by the surrounding shadows, the temple is itself of elegant construction, from its niche-carved walls to its elaborately tiered roofs, each staggered to overlap the last as they climb upward to embrace the building's integration into the mountainous terrain.

Detailed stone statuary intertwines with the lacy foliage of this garden, mirroring the pale hue of the temple that rests at its center.  The building's simple, elegant construction is overwhelmed by the intricate carving adorning its facade, from its niche-carved walls to its elaborately tiered roofs, each staggered to overlap the last as they climb upward to embrace the temple's integration into the mountainous terrain.  Luminous in the daylight, the ivory edifice rises to peek above the surrounding tree tops.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Temple of Serenity]]
description: A building can be seen past a garden to the north, its elaborately tiered roofs staggered to overlap each other and follow the mountainside.  Lush bamboo grows on either side of the twisting path, the intertwined and gently swaying tops making an ever-present rustling sound.  Green grass grows sheltered by the shoots of bamboo, and the dirt path transitions to tightly interlocked stone.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Temple Path]]
description: Numerous shoots of bamboo frame the small path, blocking most of the view of the surrounding rock and forming a lush green canopy overhead.  Blue paper lanterns hang on poles that follow both sides of the narrow path, casting a serene glow that tinges the area in gentle cerulean hues.  Well-tended herbs grow in stone-lined garden beds, protected from the harsh mountain wind by the hardy bamboo plants.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Temple Path]]
description: A small and well-maintained garden has been built on either side of the pathway, flourishing in the shady space between the tall mountain boulders.  Bright blue violets, scorpion blossoms, and snowdrops grow in abundance, filling the air with a heady scent.  Twin fountains flow on either side of the path, made from natural rocks that spill crystal clear water into perfectly circular ponds.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Above the Treeline]]
description: Jutting out almost directly overhead, a wide dolomite ledge shades the pathway somewhat.  Numerous hardy plants cling to the side of the mountain, sheltering in the protection of the ledge above.  Tufts of tall grass grow around a tall fence crafted of green bamboo that ends the mountain pathway, sturdy and very well kept.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Above the Treeline]]
description: The cutoff of trees is abrupt, very few growing above the cliff as the air at the top of the mountain grows thin.  Evergreen trees occasionally grow their tops just above this narrow ledge, their tops shrouded in the constant mist that comes from Wyvern Falls.  Darkness shrouds the mountain, its massive ice-capped peak blotting out much of the night sky.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Above the Treeline]]
description: An ancient bristlecone pine stands alone atop a slab of pale dolomite rock, the tree twisted and contorted by many years of harsh mountain winds.  Though it appears mostly dead, the tree grows away from the ledge, separated from the younger trees by the high altitude.  The air is quite thin and crisp, unable to support much moisture.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Golden Field]]
description: Tall grasses hold a golden tone as they sway and rustle with any breeze.  Tiny red and purple hollyhocks dare to poke their heads between the stalks, their bright colors a striking contrast to the otherwise monochrome field.  A heavy gate stands between the field and the nearby road.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Golden Field]]
description: Meadow thistles attempt to gain a hold against the tall stalks of grass, their stems and leaves covered in tiny but sharp thorns.  Topping the prickling plants are the fuzzy purple heads of the flowers.  A trail winds through the field, branching off toward a stream in one direction and a grove of trees in another.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Quiet Stream]]
description: The soft sounds of the stream disturb the quiet of the field, its banks giving a home to thick, soft moss sprinkled with drops of water and tiny blue sweet pea flowers.  Large stones are set in an almost even row across the water, their surfaces shiny and damp.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Briar Bramble]]
description: The grass gives way to the tangled briar bramble that grows unchecked along the line of Ilithic apple trees.  Buds of pale pink and fully bloomed roses spot the deep green with their delicate hues.  An occasional rustle or the sound of birdsong comes from within the bushes where many an animal probably makes its home.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: The shoreline is dark with the coming of night, painted a shade of coffee brown and chilly to the touch.  Darker water hisses against the shoreline, trying to erode the sand away.

Rich brown silt lies like a blanket of silk over the shoreline, with the proper consistency and water to sand ratio that makes it perfect for wriggling one's toes in.  The water laps gently against the shoreline, a crystal blue color.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline Under the Bridge]]
description: The south bridge spans above, casting a deeper shadow over the shoreline and rendering to dismal black the night-greyed.  The faint scent of offal rises through the air from the north.  The haunted creak of the loose boards of the bridge does nothing to ease the nerves.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: To the west, the shore of the Lake of Tears curves into shadows, marked here and there by water weeds that have washed to shore to die a cold death on unfamiliar terrain.  The south bridge arches to the east, the scent of corruption traveling with it.  The muttering of water sucking at the sand ripples through the air.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: Footprints -- both humanoid and animal -- pad side-by-side along the sand, their presence gradually eroded away by the water.  The profound lesson of the water on the sand is a centuries-old one.  The shoreline, while giving the appearance of eternally being the same, is in fact eternally changing.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: Decaying blades of water weed lie in squiggly shapes on the shoreline, chilled by the touch of night.  The walls of Shard to the northeast glow softly despite the curtain of darkness, perhaps the reason a Bard from long ago named it the "Evershine City".

Long blades of water weed lie stranded on the shoreline, the sunlight gradually sucking out their life just as surely as the sand is sucked away by the greedy water.  The walls of Shard -- glittering and bright -- rise up to the northeast, and the faint sounds of the city wash over the lake from its teeming streets.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: Bits of black rock stick out from underneath the rich brown silt of the shoreline, deposited here by the lapping waves of the lake.  Thick black boulders can be seen to the west, signaling an end to the accessible section of the strand.

title: [[Shard, Shoreline]]
description: Huge black boulders block off the rest of the shoreline, their placement too suspiciously perfect to have been nature-made.  The loud splash of the water throwing itself at the rocks ripples over the shoreline, a lesson in futility.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Water]]
description: Despite being a freshwater lake, there is still the tang of salt to the water, perhaps lending credence to the origin of its name.  Chilly in all seasons and deadly in some, the current pulls like a small child at you, seeking to drag you along.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Water]]
description: Neck-deep to a Human, the water in this part of the Lake of Tears is icy cold in the winter and fall and littered with sewage that grows rank in the sunlight during spring and summer.  The movement of the water gives the illusion that the walls of Shard are bobbing up and down.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Deep Current]]
description: The current tugs like a force of Fate, drawing flotsam and jetsam into its chilly embrace.  Planks of wood and bits of garbage float on the surface, aimlessly twisting about in the small, choppy waves of the lake.

title: [[Morikai's, The Back Office]]
description: Nothing more than a small portion of the main hut blocked off with hide walls, this is where Morikai does his business of buying the skins and hides he sells on the main salesroom floor.  Plunked down behind a make-shift desk crowded with papers and dirty dishes, Morikai smiles up at you with a snaggle-toothed grin as he waits to see what you have to offer.

title: [[Arthianna's Clinic, Healing Tent]]
description: Arthianna, the famed Elven empath, appears young but carries herself around the treatment tent with a grace and self-assurance that could only come from many years of experience, wisdom and practice in the healing arts.  Under the barkcloth canopy, she methodically and compassionately moves from cot to cot, tending to the most seriously injured first, revitalizing patients with her touch.

title: [[Sewer]]
description: The overwhelming stench of raw sewage and rotting vegetable matter creates a miasma that causes the air to shimmer and waver.  Water rushes by thickly to the south, vanishing into pitch darkness.

title: [[Sewer]]
description: The water rushes by to the south, carrying with it the stench and substance of Shard's refuse.

title: [[Sewer]]
description: Eddies of brown-red currents swirl over the surface of the water, muddling it to a dingy color reminiscent to dried blood.  Specks of foam and other unnameable substances dot the surface, disturbed by dripping condensation and the frantic flailings of adventurers foolish enough to dare the murky waters.

wayto.9696: ;e move 'go sewer grate'; waitfor 'you surface to see....'

title: [[Lake of Tears, Underwater]]
description: The murky water closes around you, cold and chilly.
paths: Obvious exits: obscured by the murky water

title: [[Lake of Tears, Broken Grate]]
description: Flush against the rock foundations of Shard is an iron grate through which travels the refuse of the city.  One bar of the grate has been sawed through, revealing a gap just big enough to fit an agile -- and iron-stomached -- humanoid.  You shudder to think of the consequences of swimming directly into the flow of the sewage outlet of Ilithi's capital.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Sewage]]
description: The stench of refuse is strongest to the northwest, where the sewer at Ruby Street releases the unwanted quantities of the city into the Lake of Tears.  Also in that direction lies the rocky foundations of Shard, sticking up out of the water in a jumbled thirty foot rise of bedrock that looks too slick and dangerous to climb.  The cold and the reek are almost overpowering.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Deep Current]]
description: Ripples break the surface of the water, creating circles within circles.  The rocky surface of the foundations that uphold the city of Shard looms to the north, impossibly tall from this angle.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Sewage]]
description: The raw sewage released from the nearby city turns the water a disgusting shade of green.  Despite the rank stench, this does appear to be the perfect place for such a dump since there appears to be an unseen current sucking down the fouled water, sending it to the gods only know where.

title: [[Lake of Tears, Water]]
description: Green weeds wave in the water, wrapping loosely about ankles and wrists.  The smell of offal and rotting remains rises thickly off the water, a miasmic stench that makes it hard to breathe, much less struggle through the neck-deep lake.

title: [[Ice Caves, Fissure]]
description: Disturbed graves poke from the walls of the fissure as the steep stone tilts to meet the surface.  A partially uncovered coffin juts out of the walls providing a place to rest between climbs, its surface pitted and scarred from whatever ripped it from the ground.

title: [[Ice Caves, Fissure]]
description: A narrow niche in the wall, once the home of a large boulder, allows adventurers to rest between climbs through the steep fissure.  Walls of grey granite rise high all around, crumbling in places as cracks weaken the entire area.

title: [[Ice Caves, Fissure]]
description: Boulders litter the ground of the chamber, having been knocked from the walls by whatever caused the fissure to open.  Decaying remains of various Adan'f cover the floor, their bones crushed in places by falling rocks.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: Walls of loose black soil surround the passage as it leads through the cold earth.  Towards the east a fissure through the very bedrock has opened up a path to the surface, offering a way to escape from the dark confines of the caves.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: Water from the west has weakened the walls, allowing the loose soil to slip free to clog the ground.  Moss covering the ceiling acts as a net to keep the earth above from joining the mess of mud that slows travel through the passage.

title: [[Ice Caves, Flooded Tunnel]]
description: Swirling whirlpools sweep through the area sending sediment throughout the water, choking off all visibility.  A break in one of the crumbling walls is the cause of the flooded chamber, the current pushing southwest.

Lazy whirlpools float through the area toward the southwest, spreading clouds of sediment in the water that completely obstruct visibility.  A break in one of the crumbling walls is the source of the flood.

title: [[Ice Caves, Flooded Tunnel]]
description: Water rushes through the room as currents pull it this way and that through the dark confine.  Near the floor a pitch black hole is barely visible against the lesser grey of the surrounding water, and it is this opening that is causing the currents as it sucks the water down.
A slight current moves the water this way and that, but always toward a dark hole, barely visible near the floor.  The water is draining through the hole, creating the slow surge.

title: [[Ice Caves, Flooded Tunnel]]
description: Freezing water, clouded with sediment from the loose soil that comprises the walls, fills the tunnel from top to bottom.  Currents within the water make movement difficult as they try to pull you south.
Freezing water clouded with soil from the walls fills the tunnel from floor to ceiling.  A sluggish current does little to hinder movement.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: The ground slopes down to the east where it meets and disappears beneath the freezing cold water that has risen to flood the tunnel.  What is left of the remaining dry ground is concentrated in the moldy ceiling, clinging tenaciously above the water as if afraid to drown.
The passageway slopes down to the east and disappears beneath the bone-chilling water that floods the tunnel.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: Water seeps from the ground here, making it wet and soggy, clinging to anything it touches.  Along the passageway, puddles gather in old footprints like miniature lakes.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: Chunks of rocks jut forth from the loose soil that makes up the walls of the passage.  Here and there ice-coated stones have fallen from the ceiling, making movement through the area difficult at best.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crumbling Passageway]]
description: Walls of crumbling black dirt packed loosely together make up the sides of this passage.  To the west, a small hole offers the only way to get through a wall of granite that blocks the rest of the tunnel, while to the east the passageway continues further into the darkness.

title: [[Ice Caves, Dead End]]
description: Body parts from all the races litter the bottom of this chasm.  For most of them it appears that this was where they died after a long fall and a terrible meeting with the hard stone floor.  Old blood stains the ground, and the sickening stench of decaying flesh fills the air, challenging even the strongest stomach.  The only way out is through a crumbling passage leading off to the east, or by climbing the towering chasm walls.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Book Store]]
description: Shelves of books line the walls of this otherwise simple room.  Set off to one side is a long oak counter with a long silk tablecloth dangling just slightly over the edges where patrons wait patiently to purchase their work books.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Hallway]]
description: Clear glass cases span the length of the hallway, displaying fanciful quilts of all different shapes, colors and patterns.  Upon a table set across from the displays is a simple bouquet of silk flowers within an ornate glass vase.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Supply Depot]]
description: Grand marble tables and shelves fill the room with fashionable product for sale.  Upon the surfaces is a wide variety of stylish fabrics in a broad spectrum of color.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Tool Store]]
description: Devoid of decoration, rows of shelving line the walls and hold various tools for sale in the shop.  Filling them are fine spools of thread, flat irons, straight pins and needles -- the absolute essentials for creating the perfect garment.  Tiny cobwebs hang in the corners of the ceiling, strands dangling down to the surfaces below.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Hallway]]
description: Painted upon the center of a brown wall are women and men dressed in a variety of stylish clothing.  From either side of the grandiose painting hang dark green curtains made of thick cloth which frame the work of art.  A soft chaise lounge rests on the other side of the hall next to a series of workroom doors.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Hallway]]
description: Painted upon brown walls are soft green leaves that appear to be floating down from the branches of an unseen tree.  Near the base, chipmunks and squirrels play with each other.  Soft cloth mats rest before several workroom doors.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Office]]
description: Sheer green material dangles from the ceiling and flows down to the floor in billowing cascades surrounding a neat desk and chair.  Hanging on the walls are framed sketches of various clothing designs, each drawn with an obviously skilled hand.  Situated to one side of the room is a green velvet sofa before a masterfully carved oak table.

title: [[Riverhaven Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Brilliant orange silk flowers carefully affixed to the dark green walls create a gentle elegance to the room.  Beneath a large spinning wheel is a padded silk rug trimmed with braided cord.  A large workbench and chair pressed against the back wall provide a convenient place to relax.

title: [[Xathvier's Curios and Oddities, Backroom]]
description: Despite being equally as large as the store proper, the backroom is far more cluttered.  Stacks of dusty boxes and satchels of unknown content are piled in precarious placements, and an overabundance of shelving is covered with a two- and three-layer high menagerie of trinkets.  Everything from quills, scrolls and tomes lie next to disorganized heaps of cloth, metal and leather.  In the midst of this chaotic mix is an ornate marble desk.

title: [[Baravor's Wagon]]
description: Resembling more of a traveling disaster area than a workroom, a myriad of pouches, canisters, tools and various items in need of repair lie strewn about what can only be considered a work bench.  Spools of gold, silver and platinum chain sit precariously atop a long wooden shelf, and a mahogany display stand leans unevenly against the back wall.  Ashen smudges and faded burn marks of all shapes and sizes dot the walls and floor, the products of a less than fastidious mage.

title: [[Prairie, Wylder Spring]]
description: Someone built a small platform halfway up the tree.  From this vantage, the distant walls of Shard can be seen to the west, surrounded by a seemingly endless sea of undulating green and gold.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Western Corridor]]
description: The narrow interior of the wall bears none of the battle scars that the exterior does.  Though occupied for years by the Emerald Knights, the wall's inner corridor still displays the graceful architecture of its Elothean builders.  A tightly winding newel stair leads down to the lower level.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Western Corridor]]
description: A range of arches composes the hall, each arch gracefully supported by fluted columns rising to stylized diadem capitals.  The grime of the ages has settled into the recesses in the stone, giving the carved images greater contrast in the dim light.  Opposite a carved door is a colorful tapestry edged in tarnished metallic threads.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Eastern Corridor]]
description: Dank and musty from ages of dampness, the limestone of the wall's interior makes the air seem closer.  Hollows in the great wall were carefully positioned so it could offer safe haven in times of siege without weakening its defensive strength.  An archway to the north leads to a small chantry washed in lamplight.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Eastern Corridor]]
description: This passageway is barely wide enough for two men to walk side by side.  In the thin lamplight, the series of concentric arches down the length of the corridor look like the ribs of a great worm seen from its belly.  A tightly winding newel stair leads down to the lower level.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Chantry]]
description: Tall brass candlesticks flank two altars draped in emerald silk that occupy a deep alcove.  One is carved of deep crimson bloodwood and the other of fine-grained ironwood.  Though no sunlight enters the windowless chantry, a bowl of oil burning behind a stained glass panel sends bright colors chasing shadows into the far corners.  Before the altars are worn velvet-clad kneelers embroidered with a laurel encircling a lion's claw.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Upper Hold]]
description: Neat and efficiently ordered, narrow paths between stacks of crates full of supplies are the only open spaces available in the storage hold.  Navigation is made more difficult by the muddy amber patches of light given off by a small oil lamp hanging in the center of the low ceiling.  From behind the dark stacks of supplies occasionally come scratching sounds that could either be infiltrating rats or the cats employed to defend against them.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Lower Hold]]
description: The darkly patched stone of this tiny hold is stained with ages of mold and seems to radiate dampness.  Whatever had been kept here is gone, either chased or rotted away by the pervasive moisture.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Armory]]
description: Weapons hang from the stone walls, arranged in fans and rows that create patterns of darkly glistening steel.  The thick scent of oil and sawdust hangs in the air making the small space feel closer still.  Wooden weapon racks line up back to back through the center of the room and unopened crates line the perimeter.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Rear Battlements]]
description: Viewed from the battlements' height, the landscape appears to fall away and atop the wall it seems as though you are standing amid the net of stars in the night sky.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Watchtower]]
description: The small wooden platform is sheltered by a thatched roof and stands nearly a story and a half above the battlements, offering an unequaled view of the canyon to either side.  On one side, a pale river of stone wends north to the dusky fringes of the Darkling Wood.  To the south, mist and shadow recreate the forsaken landscape leading up to the soullessly black edge of the Dark Hand.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Rear Battlements]]
description: The wind funnels through the twisting canyon and saws across the teeth of the wall's parapets.  Sounds carried in on the wind are distorted by echoes and it's impossible to tell from where they originated.  Sometimes, they sound like laughter, other times, like death cries, but in the reality of life under siege it could be either.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Rear Battlements]]
description: Overlooking the canyon entrance, the battlements seem so high up until one's eyes follow the sheer canyon walls from the ground to the peaks of the Stormfells that soar overhead.  Their icy summits seem made of starlight and rival Shard's own crystal spires.

title: [[Shard Meeting Tower, Rooftop Balcony]]
description: Open to the air, the perfectly round balcony is surrounded by a three-foot wall that has an alternating brick pattern at the top.  Low benches are set in even intervals along the rooftop, giving a place to sit.  Wyvern Mountain is visible past the walls of the city to the west, and the entirety of the Crystal Tower rises to the east.

title: [[Shard Meeting Tower, Third Landing]]
description: Thin sheets of dark shale line the lower half of the pale walls, creating a mosaic effect that vaguely resembles the skyline of Shard.  Gold veins pierce the white marble that covers the floor, forming a shimmering spiderweb effect.  A ramp slopes downward, leading back to the second landing.

title: [[Shard Meeting Tower, Second Landing]]
description: Small windows on each end of the hallway look out just above the rooftops of the city, and the Crystal Tower is visible from the eastern window.  Tall pillars stand at even intervals through the short hallway.  A narrow red carpet runs the length of the hall, leading to ramps that lead up or down respectively, each one hugging the edge of the outer wall.

title: [[Shard Meeting Tower, Entrance]]
description: Though relatively small compared to the other towers in Shard, the meeting tower is quite sturdily built and perfectly circular.  The rather low ceiling of the landing level is made from polished cedar wood, and its floor is a lustrous white marble.  The long hallway bisects the tower past stone walls, a narrow ramp leading upward to the other levels.

title: [[Crystal Plaza, Office]]
description: Gleaming brass stanchions with velvet-lined ropes stretch across the carpeted room inside the doorway.  Traders and vendors wait quietly in line to be called to the long counter with four clerks waiting behind it.  Occasionally, an awaiting party is directed behind to one of the desks where they sit to discuss more intensive business.

title: [[Shard, Trader's Mercantile]]
description: Wall-length mirrors form an open, triangular trade hall, creating the illusion that the area is twice the size that it actually is.  Light from the heavy brass chandelier hanging in the center of the painted ceiling illuminates a collection of fabric-covered tables provided for traders to display their wares.  An ornate doorway leads back out to Moonstone Street, open regardless of the time of day.

title: [[Shard, Trader's Mercantile]]
description: Wall-length mirrors form an open, triangular trade hall, creating the illusion that the area is twice the size that it actually is.  Light from the heavy brass chandelier hanging in the center of the painted ceiling illuminates a collection of fabric-covered tables provided for traders to display their wares.

title: [[Shard, Trader's Mercantile]]
description: Wall-length mirrors form an open, triangular trade hall, creating the illusion that the area is twice the size that it actually is.  Light from the heavy brass chandelier hanging in the center of the painted ceiling illuminates a collection of fabric-covered tables provided for traders to display their wares.

title: [[Seats of Plenty]]
description: Petriciu's shop is an odd affair.  The walls, floor and ceiling are fashioned from thick slabs of opaque rock crystal which glow with a faint luminosity, reflecting brisk darts of light off the various enormous chairs he offers for sale.  He seems to work almost exclusively in precious materials, and his handiwork is arranged around the room almost as museum pieces, such is the pride he takes in his craft.

title: [[A Grand Entrance]]
description: Samples of beautifully-constructed doors in the most fashionable and costly styles stand in neat rows around the walls of this smart shop, each flawless piece a worthy tribute to its maker's skill.  A haughty salesman wanders around the store, pausing occasionally to run a manicured hand over the gleaming entrances on display.

title: [[Zerek's General Store]]
description: Freshly varnished wooden walls and impeccably swept floors attest to a measure of careful observance to the custom of tidiness by Zerek and his staff.  Shelves on the walls hold various sundries necessary for the survival of travellers and city-dwellers alike, and the open windows supply plenty of light to see by.

title: [[Mirrors by Noelle]]
description: White drapes balloon from the roof, giving this store the feeling of a tent established by some temporary merchant.  Occasionally brushing back the colored drop beads that dangle from her veil, Noelle d'Lorchesse smiles quietly as she displays her mirrored wares to discerning customers.  Her visitors are a varied lot, from all across Elanthia, testifying to the Elven glazier's talent and notoriety even at her young age.

title: [[Scholars' Museum, Rotunda]]
description: The museum entrance is strangely hushed and peaceful after the day's echoing bustle has ended.  The massive fossilized skeleton of a war mammoth looms ominously on a low marble pedestal in the center of the room.  Shadows cluster in the recesses, while the pale marble of the interior gleams softly in the variable light filtering through the curved crystal panes of the high domed ceiling.

title: [[Scholars' Museum, Salon]]
description: Opulent red velvet curtains, which can be drawn to preserve the warmth on cold winter nights, reveal through the tall windows an inspiring view of the Great Tower glittering in the reflected light of the stars and moons.  Lit tapers in branched candlesticks and a crackling fire in the carved stone fireplace lend a cheering warmth and glow to the salon, as well as the pleasant scent of burning apple wood.  Some of the museum's rare and exotic finds are displayed on pedestals around the room.

title: [[Scholars' Museum, Gallery]]
description: The glow of gaethzen lamps blocks all view of the night outside, giving the gallery the air of a well-lit stage awaiting the opening curtain.  High arched windows reflect the interior like black mirrors, creating a double image which reinforces the sense of unreality.  In the soft light, images in the tapestries and paintings lining the walls flicker, and dim shadows cluster about the display cases and pedestals.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Front Desk]]
description: Shadows drift in lazy patterns over the gleaming dark wood that compose the floor and walls, digging into the carvings of roses that gracefully climb in vines over the satiny planks.  A black desk serviced by a young man curves out of the east wall.  Stairs lead up, a pattern of black roses woven into the blue carpeting that covers them.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Tavern]]
description: Roomy and rectangular, the tavern for Milene's Rose is always busy, but strangely never so full that it becomes unbearably crowded.  A booth in the corner allows for privacy, and a bar offers service for the thirsty and the hungry.  There is little sign of disarray anywhere.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Back Hallway]]
description: Miniature roses grow in ceramic pots within a shallow bay window at the end of the hallway.  The tiny blooms come in all colors, from pale ivories and pinks to deep corals and crimsons.  A window bench makes this a cozy corner for friends to sit and chat while enjoying the flowers and relaxing after the rigors of the day.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Back Hallway]]
description: The hallway is redolent of lemons and beeswax, rubbed in and buffed to bring out a soft golden sheen in the rosewood paneling.  A large brass pot hangs beneath a half-open skylight, cradling within its confines a s'vraela vine imported from the island of M'Riss.  Beads of dew form on the metal surface of the pot, causing it to shimmer slightly with each movement.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Back Hallway]]
description: Quieter than the front hall or rest of the inn, the rooms in this part of the wide corridor are occupied by permanent guests who choose to reside at the Rose.  Polished marble-topped mahogany tables hold crystal vases filled with fragrant flowers, and a deep blue carpet runs the length of the hall.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Entrance]]
description: This large hallway is slightly curved and has a rather high ceiling, well lit with pale blue oil lanterns mounted on the wall.  A dark red carpet runs down the center of the hallway, covering a rich black marble floor shot through with gold veins.  A small plant in a vase the same color as the carpet has been tucked into the corner, opposite the door leading back to the streets of Shard.

title: [[Balint's Tiles]]
description: Behind a faded and unassuming storefront, the tile business of Balint Firkusny appears to be booming.  Every inch of wall space is covered with tiles in a variety of colors, sizes and textures.  The Elven merchant himself scurries about, pointing to one area, highlighting the details of another under a small oil lamp, and in general making a nuisance of himself to his quiet, dedicated staff.

title: [[Aelik's Pawn]]
description: The deceiving appearance of this shop's broken down and dreary outside is nothing compared to the clean and carefully organized inside.  While a fine layer of dust does seem to coat some of the older items, there is a feeling of constant change here as things are shuffled about, sold, or moved off to other locations.

title: [[Aelik's Pawn, Backroom]]
description: Shelves line the walls, side-by-side with cabinets that hold various oddities and objects that will not fit in the front room being shoved in here instead.  Clutter covers nearly every inch of bare space, piling up to the ceiling.

title: [[Shard, Ruined Building]]
description: Crumbling stone walls sunken into the earth are all that remain to mark this area as the basement of some long abandoned structure.  A skeletal framework rises into the sky above, framing the outline of what used to be the first floor.  The few surviving beams are blackened and charred.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Introspection]]
description: A surface of cyan light ripples gently a few hand spans below your feet, creating the illusion of a luminescent ocean.  Brief-lived waves crash against a pillar of white light that rises from the depths, sending beams of sparkling light flying through the air.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Convergence]]
description: The main surface of a disc-shaped plane of seething silvery-white energy stretches in every direction from here.  Odd colors and disturbances in the surface of the disc appear as it curves downward toward eight pillars in the distance, each jutting out horizontally like the spokes of a wheel.  A stunted silvery-white pillar, standing only about ten feet high, is set in the center of the disc.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Nightmares]]
description: Countless streams of steel-grey light writhe and hiss like snakes mere hand spans below you.  Every few moments, one of the energy streams explodes outward from the mass with incredible speed and twists wildly through the air before dissipating.  A jagged purple and black pillar rises from the serpentine mass and climbs up into the distant, flickering sky.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Secretia's Secret, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A steel table and a granite table sit on the bare floor.  A black oak rack hangs on the oaken walls, with a steel cabinet along the edges of the room.

title: [[Forest of Night, Tangled Bosk]]
description: Winding through the shade of the forest, the trail disappears into the gloom betwixt the spindly and abnormal willow and bloodwood trees here.  Intermittent shadows dart through the forest, just out of immediate view.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast.

title: [[Forest of Night, Tangled Bosk]]
description: Warped and twisted bloodwood trees rise out of the darkness of the forest, sprawling their draping limbs overhead and blotting out the sky.  A tangled snarl of bushes cut off several directions, leaving only a few paths available.

title: [[Forest of Night, Willow Valley]]
description: Breaking through the murky air, the occasional branch of a nearby willow tree crosses the path.  Echoes of dripping water and something scuttling in the brush nearby only seems to highlight the lack of any indigenous creatures.

title: [[Forest of Night, Willow Valley]]
description: Permeated by a dense miasma and greenish fog, the forest here is left dim and much of the area is obscured by large weeping bloodwood and willow trees.  Rising to a small hill, the path parts beneath a split tree.

title: [[Forest of Night, Willow Valley]]
description: Opening up slightly into a haze-filled meadow, the area here is largely arranged around a broken altar.  Large chunks of moss crawl across the surface of the altar, obscuring lumps on its surface.  Small, recently planted khor'vela trees encircle the altar.

title: [[Forest of Night, Willow Valley]]
description: Appearing suddenly out of the gloom, a boggy, marsh-like stream cuts across the path, flooding over a partially submerged bridge.  Deep ruts appear along the trail, as if something heavy had been brought this way.

title: [[Forest of Night, Tangled Bosk]]
description: Irregular and unsettling sounds verberate through the bosk, a clear sign to travelers that they are not alone.  Thick redwood trees intermingle with bloodwoods, their expansive canopies blanketing the forest in darkness.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Forest of Night, Tangled Bosk]]
description: Allowed to grow beyond measure, redwood trees of enormous proportions sprawl through the forest, draping the woods in deep shadows filled with chaotic underbrush that threatens to trip the feet of unwary travelers.

title: [[Forest of Night, Tangled Bosk]]
description: Rising up to the north, a dense grove of ancient redwood trees appears.  Along the treeline, a dark platform hangs just out of immediate view.  Thick shrubbery brings a halt to the trail here.

title: [[Shard, East Battlements]]
description: Paved in stone, the walkway extends a short distance to the north, giving a good view of the East Gates below.  Though the battlement's construction feels somewhat hasty, several reinforcements make it able to hold up to strong attacks.  The Great Tower lies directly to the west, the sturdy walls coming to just above the city's rooftops.

A stone-paved walkway extends a short distance to the north above the East Gate.  The new stone, the fresh mortar, and the smell of new wood give evidence of the battlement's recent (and somewhat hurried) construction.

title: [[Shard, East Battlements]]
description: High above the East Gate, embrasures pierce the stone battlements between the merlons that give cover to the defenders of the walls.  The perch commands the main entrance to the city with a field of fire that covers the East Bridge.

timeto.2780: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 255 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Whistling Wood, Boulder]]
description: From the top of this boulder a great stretch of the Whistling Wood is revealed.  Trees of all sizes expand across the horizon, but even at a distance the decay is obvious as darkness clings to the forest.  To the north, a path leads off into the trees, while to the south a path winds its way through the barrows.

title: [[Duskruin, Central Parade]]
description: The large central parade seems to have all the accoutrements of a fortified location, but instead of soldiers marching in formation, the courtyard is a blur of revelry.  Small carts laden with food and drink line the battlement wall to the south, and more can be seen along upward sloped walkways to the east and west.  High on the north side of the public walk, a plateau has been cut out of the mountainside, while directly below, a sweeping archway reveals a broad ramp attended by the only guard in sight.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Walk]]
description: Stone walls rise on both sides of the western walkway, which spans a massive width large enough to accomodate large crowds -- or perhaps an army.  Blazing torches burn in iron sconces that are placed at even intervals, lighting up the wide walkway and the people traveling it.  Noise from the central parade carries upward to the walkway, filling the air with a cacophany of sound.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Walk]]
description: Sloping rather gently to follow the exterior curve of the massive fortress, the western walkway follows the natural slope of the mountainside.  Bustling people move back and forth, moving along the wide walkway in a constant stream.  Arranged against the southwestern wall are several stockpiles of neatly stacked crates, each one stamped and labeled.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Walk]]
description: The massive sloping ramp curves gradually around the exterior of the Duskruin fortress, its walls incredibly thick and some of them crafted from the same stone that makes up the mountainside.  Small platforms are built into the defensive wall along the outer portion of the ramparts, allowing for extra defenses to be added if needed.  Sconces line both sides of the western walk, each one blazing brightly with torchlight.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Walk]]
description: Silhouettes of pennants dance across the stone of the broad western walk, their source mounted on flagpoles planted around the inner edge of the walkway that faces the arena.  Each flag flutters occasionally in the mountain breeze, though it is difficult to see them in the darkness.  The walls of the walkway rise high on either side, shepherding the sparse nighttime crowds between them.

Brightly colored pennants fly on flagpoles planted around the inner edge of the walkway that faces the arena.  Each flag flutters occasionally in the mountain breeze, revealing crests and symbols embroidered on them.  The walls of the walkway rise high on either side, shepherding the busy crowds between them.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Walk]]
description: The wide walkway melds into the side of the mountain, with the last section coarsely cut into the dark granite.  The walls rise high on either side, enclosing the sparse nighttime crowds between them.  Ornate sconces line the area, each one blazing brightly with torchlight between green plants and a small potted tree.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: Heavily fortified walls rise up on both sides of the eastern walkway, the exterior adorned with arrow slits and gaps designed to allow for siege equipment.  Torches rest in tall iron sconces, burning brightly and illuminating the area as the night traffic flows slowly through the area.  A faint din of noise constantly echoes from the central parade to the west, and additional sounds drift from the arenas high overhead to the north.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: Illuminated by gently flickering torchlight from nearby sconces, suits of polished steel armor line the interior side of the walkway, standing at attention and each grasping a sword in their hands with its point resting lightly on the ground at their feet.  The walkway slopes upward at a gradual incline, wrapping around the mountainside with its exterior wall providing a solid defense.  Occasionally, people make their way back and forth through the area, passing quickly through the dimly lit area.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: Highlighted by the flickering torchlight of the nearby sconces, green plants and small trees in neat pots ine the rampart, which curves upward slowly to wrap the fortress in its protective walls.  The foliage adds a bit of color to the otherwise grey area, while sparse traffic passes back and forth in the night.  Dominating a portion of the walkway is a rather large apple tree heavy with fruit, though most of the lower branches are bare from passersby picking them.

A few green plants and a small potted tree line the rampart, which curves upward slowly to wrap the fortress in its protective walls.  The foliage adds a bit of color to the otherwise grey area, while steady traffic passes back and forth.  Dominating a portion of the walkway is a rather large apple tree heavy with fruit, though most of the lower branches are bare from frequent passersby picking them.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: A line of flagpoles runs the length of the tall stone wall, each bearing a vague pennant at its top that flutters occasionally in the evening breeze.  Handkerchiefs of similar colors decorate the poles near their bases, neatly tied to them by those that visit the area.  In the torchlight of the nearby sconces, elongated shadows appear to shuffle along with the occasional passing of visitors in the evening anlasaen.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: The wide granite walk melds into the side of the mountain, a series of deadly spikes along the outer wall preventing any attempt by invaders to scale the imposing fortress.  The occasional evening visitors move throughout the area, lit by the flickering torchlight from the nearby sconces.  The fiery red light washes over the granite walkway in heat-fueled waves, blanketing the stones underfoot with a deep crimson sheen.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage]]
description: Shelves, racks and all manner of surfaces are neatly placed into rows throughout the tent's interior.  Wide pathways maneuver between them, allowing ample room for browsing and discussions.  A giant banner hanging from the tent's supports proclaims, "All sales final!  No refunds!  SHOP carefully!"

Shelves, racks and all manner of surfaces are neatly placed into rows throughout the tent's interior.  Wide pathways maneuver between them, allowing ample room for browsing and discussions.  A giant banner hanging from the tent's supports proclaims, "All sales final!  No refunds!  SHOP carefully!"

title: [[Duskruin, Darkened Tunnel]]
description: Smoothed and polished, dark granite walls enclose the dimly lit tunnel as it descends sharply into the heart of the mountain, while a stone archway provides a way back to the Duskruin central parade.  Baroque reliefs adorn the walls with scenes of epic battles, their exquisite details barely discernible in the dwindling flames of the pitch covered torches that hang nearby.

title: [[Duskruin, Darkened Tunnel]]
description: Skewed racks of gleaming halberds stand at the ready, secured by heavy chains along the sharply angled walls that provide passage to and from the heart of the vast granite fortress.  Smoldering torches hung nearby do little to accentuate the roughly chiseled crest along a portion of the granite walk underfoot.

title: [[Duskruin, Stone Stairwell]]
description: Flickering light from a nearby torch illuminates the smooth steps of the winding stairwell and artistic frescos that line the walls, each depicting brave warriors engaged in battle.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Observation Tower]]
description: Simple and understated, the observation room holds the faint scents of clove and cedar.  Framed by potted miniature cedar trees, a polished and thickly lacquered bar provides several refreshments to those who frequent the area.  Several tufted leather benches are carefully arranged around a blackened steel firepit that creates a glowing ambience to the area, while a spacious window along the far wall overlooks the arenas beyond.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Observation Seating]]
description: Miniature potted cedar trees are set into the corners of the room, filling the air with their redolent scent.  Tucked into a nearby corner, a lacquered bar offers a host of refreshments, while tiers of overstuffed, tufted leather benches face a large window along the western wall, offering an ample view of the arenas below.

title: [[Duskruin, Antechamber]]
description: Long marble benches line the walls of the perfectly round room, placed between ornately carved pillars that rise to a domed ceiling.  A large crystal chandelier dangles from the center of the ceiling, throwing rays of light in all directions.  Cedar panels grace the walls, each carved with a detailed scene of a fierce battle with the minions of Sorrow's Reach.

title: [[Duskruin, Victor Lounge]]
description: Brightly colored banners hang on all the walls, each one emblazoned with a proudly displayed guild crest.  Comfortable leather couches line the walls, flanked on either side by potted ferns.  A long marble banquet table is set up with food and refreshments along the back wall, curved lightly to fit the circular shape of the room.

title: [[Duskruin, Recovery Area]]
description: Dozens of neatly made beds line the walls of the long and narrow room, which is quite a lot larger than most triage sites.  Large porcelain pots filled with fresh flowers stand in between each bed, and ornate decorations on the walls give the room a very formal atmosphere.  Several marble benches provide a place to wait, just in front of a large mahogany desk.

title: [[Duskruin, Central Observation Tower]]
description: Draped in sumptuous silks and velvets, the richly-colored fabrics on the walls bring a warmth to the lavishly appointed area that is not found in the arenas below.  A pair of plush, silk-covered benches are arranged in an arc around a central firepit, while a nearby table plays host to an array of refreshments.  A large glass viewing window opens across the northern wall and partially across each side, affording a view to the arenas below.

title: [[Duskruin, Central Observation Seating]]
description: Liberal use of silks and velvets adorn nearly every surface in the room along with touches of masterfully sculpted gold accents and a generous amount of seating options.  Each arranged to provide the viewer with an unparalleled view of the arenas below, plush benches with tufted backrests are carefully arranged to facilitate conversation among patrons as well.  A central table rests within reach of each of the seats, awash with a bounty of refreshments.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Observation Tower]]
description: Making up a portion of the vast stone fortress, the elegantly decorated observation room is shaped into a perfectly curved half moon.  Large purple satin curtains cover the walls in gracefully draping folds, somewhat muting both the sound and the light that comes from the areas outside.  Rows of plush, velvet benches with tufted backrests are carefully arranged around a blackened steel firepit, all facing a large window that makes up most of the eastern wall, overlooking the arenas below.

title: [[Duskruin, Western Observation Seating]]
description: The western half of the circular tower has a slightly staggered floor, with tiers of tufted velvet benches that slope down toward the arenas.  Dark purple curtains made from flowing satin surround the walls, drawing attention to the large glass windows that face the arena.  A large portrait hangs on the tower's dividing wall, showcasing a scene of fierce battle.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of the Heavens]]
description: Burning white lights twist and flicker high above your head, creating the illusion of a brilliant night sky.  The same energy as the lights overhead flows smoothly along a wide congruent plane a few hand spans below your feet.  A slender pillar of blazing light joins the plane below to the heavens above and randomly discharges violent streams of energy.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of the Shrew]]
description: An almost blinding pillar of purple-tinged white light, resembling a lightning bolt frozen in mid-strike, emerges from the depths of a violently billowing cloud of shadows a few hand spans below you.  Bolts of light shoot out from the pillar and ground themselves into the black cloud.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Unity]]
description: Vortices of brightly colored energy, each a different hue, rapidly twirl a few hand spans beneath your feet.  Sprays of burning light are constantly ejected from the spinning energy, sending prismatic arcs flying through the sky.  A pillar of swirling light rises up into the flickering sky from the center of the vortices.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Secrets]]
description: Heat rises from a still, black mass a few hand spans beneath your feet.  A constant crackling sound issues from the surface, often accompanied by rapidly expanding blooms of burning shadows.  A dull grey pillar emerges from the inky surface and blends into the dim, flickering sky a few dozen feet up.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Tradition]]
description: Bright silvery-white light burns like the surface of a star a few hand spans beneath your feet.  Narrowly focused beams of light rise from the surface and gently sway in response to some unfelt wind.  A pillar of light, by all appearances simply an overly large beam, ascends into the flickering sky.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Pillar of Fortune]]
description: A large source of golden light pulsates like the rhythm of a heart-beat a few hand spans below your feet.  Thin threads of energy rise from within the golden light and arrange themselves into seemingly random patterns in the sky.  The patterns eventually meet in a single spot, where they weave into a spun pillar that rises into the flickering sky.
paths: Obvious exits: east, west, up, down.

title: [[Astral Plane, Broken Pillar]]
description: A jungle of energy streams converge in the area, complicating both navigation and sight.  The landscape among the prolific energy streams feels almost insubstantial:  a deep chill fills the air and the eight pillars in the distance are vague, grey silhouettes.  A slowly twisting mass of streams creates the outline of a pillar in the center of the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Astral Plane, Rolagi Conduit]]
description: Thousands upon thousands of stars hang in darkness above, around and even below: the heavens unfurl completely around you, without any hint of ground or a horizon.  An invisible plane of force seems to extend through the area, providing a sense of substance in place of solid earth.  An intricate web of burning energy slowly swirls all around you and seems to touch the distant stars.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Cliff]]
description: A completely sheer wall of limestone rock rises to the north, gradually narrowing into a high and inaccessible peak.  The stone is somewhat chalky, the powdery limestone mixing with the air's heavy moisture and piling in clumps at the edge of the rocky walls.  Small bunches of pink clover grow from the makeshift dirt, tenaciously clinging to life in the harsh environment.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Cliff]]
description: The narrow ledge forms a very shallow cavern in the side of the cliff face, offering some limited shelter for travelers.  A makeshift firepit is dug into the ground just before the shelter, with a small supply of wood set out in a bin.  Flat, wide boulders circle the firepit, providing a place to sit and rest.

title: [[Barder Town, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Craftsmen]]
description: Variegated sandstone tiles pave the broad street which is lined with colorful clay pots that overflow with vibrant desert lotus blossoms, their sweet scents wafting through the area.  Several benches rest beneath the leafy fronds of the swaying palms, creating a comfortable spot to enjoy the shade in the desert heat.  Craftsmen bustle to and from the ornate mosaic archway that leads to the north while several hawk their wares in the soft glow of the nearby torches.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Hemlock Forest]]
description: A shallow ditch cuts across the path and runs along beside the trail a short distance until it plunges out of sight into the forest growth to the west.  This gully, dug by rainfall and melting snows, channels its way to the lake below, and puddles remain on the saturated ground even in dry weather.

title: [[Malik the True Bard, Instruments and Picks]]
description: Less a shop and more an extension of Malik's living room, several tasteful couches and lounges have been arranged in aesthetically pleasing positions about the room, the better to allow the true musicians who visit this shop to test the owner's handiwork.
