description: A trio of sandstone dragons carved in bas-relief circle the domed ceiling, looking down from their lofty perches upon all who seek to peruse the facility's texts.  The wings of each dragon are chisled craftily to appear as if they were blending into the wing of the next, forming as a whole an intricate textured pattern.  The focus of the creatures' stony stares are the rows and rows of shelving, all filled with hundreds of crimson and rawhide tomes.

title: [[Imperial Stargazer's Medical Pavilion, Healing Chamber]]
description: Pristine white walls adorned with frosted crystal sconces enclose the chamber, surrounding a floor composed of blue and green tiles.  Nestled under an oak-framed painting is a large, whitewashed cabinet, smelling of freshly harvested herbs.  Tinted skylights overhead lend an airy feeling to the room, bathing the area with muted illumination.

title: [[Imperial Stargazer's Medical Pavilion, Treatment Chamber]]
description: Pale azure panels line the walls of the chamber, edged with ornately carved midnight-blue molding.  Frosted crystal sconces cast pools of gently flickering light, making the faint silvery lines embellishing the darkly-stained floor appear to float above the glossy finish of the wood.

title: [[Imperial Stargazer's Medical Pavilion, Treatment Chamber]]
description: Pale red panels line the walls of the chamber, edged with ornately carved dark crimson molding.  Frosted crystal sconces cast pools of gently flickering light, making the faint golden lines embellishing the darkly-stained floor appear to float above the glossy finish of the wood.

title: [[Imperial Stargazer's Medical Pavilion, Treatment Chamber]]
description: Silvery panels line the walls of the chamber, edged with ornately carved charcoal-grey molding.  Frosted crystal sconces cast pools of gently flickering light, making the faint coppery lines embellishing the darkly-stained floor appear to float above the glossy finish of the wood.

title: [[Seven Star Exchange and Pawn]]
description: The walls are white marble, though this is difficult to tell since there is such an abundance of what most people would term junk.  Most of the items have a nautical theme, if one could give randomness such a unifying concept, but it is just as likely it was all simply salvaged from a ship wreck.  Buried among the rubble of the assorted goods is a large iron safe.

title: [[Seven Star Exchange and Pawn, Storage Room]]
description: Long rows of shelves, oddly empty for the backroom of a pawnshop, cover three of the four marble walls.  Only a handful of small boxes and barrels are kept here, though the upper shelves are filled with dust and cobwebs.  Interestingly, none of the lower and more accessible rows show signs of similar disuse.  The wall devoid of shelving has a door-sized panel with obvious hinges.

title: [[The Celestial Forum, Atrium]]
description: A compass rose is set in the floor, its deep blue ceramic tile contrasting the white marble of this sprawling atrium.  At the points of the cardinal directions, wide pillars stretch into flying buttresses from which drape streams of flowing silk.  Sparkling crystal stars connected by silver thread trace constellations across each of the deep-blue silken banners.  Further up, where the walls meet the ceiling, the text of the Lunar Accord is carved into slabs of marble encircling the chamber.

title: [[The Celestial Forum, Amphitheater]]
description: Two marble columns rise from the center of the room, reaching up to the vaulted ceiling far above.  Rows of padded benches are arranged in a semi circle around an elevated dais between the columns.  A wide balcony overlooks the amphitheater, providing more seating for onlookers and the rare petitioner awaiting his or her turn to speak to the assembled crowd.  The back of the room is marked by a tall stained glass window depicting Jares Braun signing the Lunar Accord.

title: [[The Celestial Forum, Assembly of Yavash]]
description: A mahogany banister guards the edge of the balcony, overlooking the amphitheater below.  Descending rows of padded benches, upholstered in crimson leather, provide seating for the gallery.  Small gaethzen orbs held aloft by black marble shadowlings with spinel eyes cast a dim red light from above.  In the corner of the room, a small buffet is attended to by a quiet steward.

title: [[The Celestial Forum, Assembly of Katamba]]
description: A mahogany banister guards the edge of the balcony, overlooking the amphitheater below.  Settees of ebony with sable cushions provide seating for the gallery.  Small gaethzen orbs held aloft by black marble shadowlings with onyx eyes cast a dim light from above.  In the corner of the room, a low counter is attended to by a quiet steward.

title: [[The Celestial Forum, Assembly of Xibar]]
description: A mahogany banister guards the edge of the balcony, overlooking the amphitheater below.  A row of high-backed chairs, cushioned in light blue velvet, provide seating for the gallery.  Small gaethzen orbs held aloft by black marble shadowlings with eyes of blue-white diamonds cast a dim azure light from above.  In the corner of the room, a wide sideboard is attended to by a quiet steward.

title: [[Maginius Kaentao Maous, Spell Library]]
description: Tall, elegant columns carved like intermingled two-headed serpents rise to the ceiling, which itself is a dizzying distance above.  Circular shelves contain thousands upon thousands of books, most of which are off-limits to the casual browser.  Scribes constantly scurry here and there, cataloging and arranging the contents.  Near the entrance is a red velvet partition, where those visitors interested in viewing books up close have to register.

title: [[Vermadian's Exotic Pelts]]
description: Thick stitching binds the canvas walls of the stall securely, but not enough that the sounds of street traffic or the tugging of random breezes is even partially blocked.  Crates of animal products and salts are stacked in the corners, most of which are sealed and labeled with unusual and faraway locations.  The floor is nothing more than the dirty road surface, giving Throne City's only furrier a sense of being merely temporary.

title: [[Dahl Aeliy Provisions and Wares]]
description: Well insulated from both the stifling heat of summer and the chill touch of winter, this tent has multiple linings of canvas between its interior and exterior.  Less attention has been paid to the dynamics of aestheticism, and the ceiling, propped up on the corners by reed shoots, droops sloppily down in the center.  Splitting the tent is a low mahogany table with a bound set of bark sheaves resting atop it.

title: [[Garden Rooftop, Medical Pavilion]]
description: Branching vines of ivy creep outward from their tenacious hold on an ornamental trellis jutting up into view from below and wind through the elegantly beveled banisters of a low railing that borders the edge of the rooftop.  Small clay pots nestle against the tendrils of green ivy, harboring carefully tended herbs that perfume the air with a faintly medicinal scent.  Watching over the garden are three odd little statues, their ivory, jade and amber bodies mingling with the surrounding colors.

title: [[Garden Rooftop, Medical Pavilion]]
description: Occupying the center of the garden is a clear crystal dome enclosing a swirling mass of greenish mist.  As though observing from on high, a lone figure carved from snow-white marble stands on its translucent perch, the long flowing tresses cascading towards the ground in sculptured smooth curves from an upward-tilted head, lost in contemplation.  Bordering the edge of the roof is a low railing supported by elegantly beveled banisters, framing the tops of the high pillars lining the street below.

title: [[Garden Rooftop, Medical Pavilion]]
description: Sheltering a bed of roses the colors of the moons is a low railing resting atop elegantly beveled banisters.  Tiles of green marble alternate with patches of springy heather and gildleaf shrubs, creating a verdant frame that compliments the blue and green of the serpents rising from within a marble fountain carved in bas-relief.  Gazing toward a cobalt blue telescope from its perch in the water is a wooden duck, its wings partially extended as though for balance.

title: [[Sanyrsen Hall, Goldcap Application Office]]
description: Designed for purpose and function over aesthetics, the furniture in this office is arranged with calculated precision.  A large set of shelves fills one wall while an immense map of the known world covers another.  Despite the utilitarian placement of the larger fixtures, tattered papers and thick tomes are scattered over every available flat surface.  Muffled sounds of people shuffling about come from behind an oaken door set into a granite archway.

title: [[Shard, Carousel Desk]]
description: A long wooden desk spans the width of the western wall.  Brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in spotless red tile.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Wooded Area]]
description: Something has bedded down here lately.  A crude lean-to of branches stripped of their leaves sits in this tiny clearing.  A torn and ruined backpack lies in front of the lean-to and several trees bear scorch marks as if they had been hit by a mage's fire spells.  There is a faint scent of dried blood in the air and hundreds of large flies buzz about in morbid curiosity.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Wooded Area]]
description: The trees grow thick here and the air is heavy and still.  Dried twigs and branches underfoot cause you to move carefully lest a snap give warning to things best left undisturbed.  A partially-gnawed corpse of a small inkhorne deer hangs impaled upon a sharp upthrust branch.  The stench of its corruption thickens the air with a sweetish, vile miasma.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Wooded Path]]
description: The ground here is slightly damp and marshy underfoot.  Several snails laboriously work their way across a large rock, leaving glistening trails of slime.  An odd form of clinging vine has snaked around the trees here and there.  Many heavy loops of it threaten to garrotte you as they dangle along your path among the dense greenery.

title: [[Demiciil's Armory]]
description: A showcase of wood and glass runs the length of this room around the east, west, and north walls.  Gleaming helms and pieces of armor hang from the wall, rest behind the glass of the showcase, or off of hangers that are arranged all about the store.  The powerful figure of Demiciil, the shop's owner, dominates the back where he stands with arms folded across his chest, watching everyone carefully.

title: [[Forest of Night, Shallow Ford]]
description: The waters swirl about you, high enough to reach a Human's ankles and a Halfling's kneecaps.  A fine layer of black silt covers the river's bed, beneath which lies thick, gooey mud.  Delicate growths of reeds raise their heads out of the watery swirl, while up on the muddy banks to the west and east graceful willows bend in silent mourning.  A sheltered cove off to the side provides protection from the onslaught of the currents.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: Hollow plops, the crash of stream on stone, and the swirl of obsidian waters compose the deafening roar of the river.  The multitude of sounds fill your ears and dull all ability to hear past it.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: The river bank thins to nothing here, becoming too treacherous to continue along.  The river eventually vanishes around a bend, its waters becoming more turbulent as it winds southward.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: Patches of mud dot the river bank, making it even more treacherous than it already was.  A set of footprints lead away from one part of the bank and vanish into the river.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: The river bank narrows to a nearly perilous path, the brambles to one side pushing you toward the drop off that leads to only one thing: swift, deadly waters.  Oddly, the river does not throw back your reflection, and, indeed, the water seems to swallow not only images, but light...what little there is.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: Fine droplets of water dash up against you from time to time as the river gushes along its way.  Overhead, the trees yet rise, casting long shadows and dropping the occasional stray leaf into the rapid waters.

title: [[Forest of Night, The River Bank]]
description: The black waters of the river surge forward, heedlessly crashing over stones and watery reeds.  The river bank is relatively dry, and a dirt path leads up from it, heading back to the main road.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: Overgrown and underused, the path winds heedlessly through the wood, one way leading to the heart of a grove of black-leaved trees, the other up a steep embankment.

title: [[Forest of Night, Raevelthorn Patch]]
description: The low-lying raevelthorn outgrows the ironwood tree in this part of the forest.  Small, questing trailers covered in black thorns crawl over the path you tread, perhaps seeking out a quick snack from an unprotected foot.

title: [[Forest of Night, Blackfruit Tree]]
description: The grass of the path ends abruptly as a large swatch of circular bare dirt interrupts the path.  At the center of the clearing, a large blackfruit tree grows and before it rests a small altar.  A smoking censer releases a heavy perfume into the thick and heavy night air, attracting insects who announce their presence with dischordant buzzing and pricking bites.

A wide, round swath of bare, dark grey earth interrupts the path.  Directly in the center of the unnaturally perfect cleared circle grows a tall blackfruit tree.  A small altar rests in front of the tree, and a smoking censer releases a heavy perfume into the air.  The silence here is unnatural and contributes to a heavy air quality not unlike a summer afternoon right before a storm.

title: [[Forest of Night, Raevelthorn Patch]]
description: The trees are sparser here as if to make more room for the abundant raevelthorn that sprawls through the area.  The bushes, with their wicked thorns, seem to intentionally seek out flesh or scale, using the cover of night to better ambush those that dare tread here and draw out the fluid that pumps through the victims' veins.

The trees move aside here to allow the raevelthorn to grow.  The bushes, with their wicked thorns, seem to almost willingly seek out flesh or scale, reaching for the fluid that pumps within the veins that the flesh sheathes.  You also see a raevelthorn bush.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: Southward, the wood appears to thin and grows ever more thickly to the north.  The path seems a bit wider here as if this is a well-traveled stretch of grass, but between the darkness of night and the foliage cover above it is difficult to make out any clear tracks.
The trees thin out to the south, but grow all the more thicker to the north.  The grass looks freshly trodden with tracks made by something other than deer or rabbit.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: Silent silvery-white mist wraps its coils about ankles and knees, moving up from where it wraps around the trees, like a snake waiting to strike.
The delicate trill of a songbird fills the air, its song at once beautiful and sad.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: A clinging white mist on the forest floor seems to tug at the feet, and the heaviness of the night air seeks to aid the strange miasma in its task.

Originating from somewhere vaguely southward, the distant trill of a songbird echoes through the wood and cuts the squawks of the roosting ravens like a knife.  The air feels thick and heavy, as if the trees shirk the burden of air and darkness and lay it instead upon the shoulders of intruders.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: Black steel-sheened leaves brush the sky and equally black roots occasionally poke up from the forest floor.  Thick, massive trunks create a living fence that bars deviating from the narrow trail that the ironwoods have deigned to allow.

title: [[Forest of Night, Dying Oak]]
description: Pitiful amongst the living foliage of night, a small, sickly oak grows beside the ironwoods, enduring a pitiful existence as it is slowly suffocated by the taller, greedier trees of the forest.

A single, sickly oak grows here, enduring a pitiful existence as it is slowly suffocated by the taller, greedier ironwoods.  Their black boughs reach for the light they so crave, as if, were they to grow high enough, they could drain all the sunlight from the land and leave it as dark as the forest within which they dwell.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Wood]]
description: The trees grow thick here, shouldering up against each other and blending so perfectly that it is hard to discern them from the cloak of the night sky.  A thick white mist coils at the base of the trees, its light, silvery tendrils caressing the tree trunks with a pale, watered light.
The trees grow thick here, shouldering up against one another as if they had something to fear.  Metallic-sheened leaves glitter, reflecting light that never seems to reach the forest floor.

title: [[Forest of Night, Outer Woods]]
description: The heavy darkness of night obscures the path which winds through the forest.  Barely visible, a narrow deer trail jumps from the path and up a steep embankment.

A barely visible path winds through the forest, dodging between the trees and leaping around bushes and low-lying shrubbery.  A narrow deer trail jumps from the path and up a steep embankment, eventually vanishing between two slender ironwood trunks.

title: [[Zoluren Royal Mews, Brokerage Offices]]
description: This quiet, sparse office holds a simple desk and a couple of cushioned chairs.  Book-lined shelves cover one wall completely, with titles ranging from horse care to adventure stories relating to them.  A single window is covered by long emerald drapes embroidered with brown thread.

title: [[The Gash, North Face]]
description: The sun's relief brings its own price as the frozen ground thaws into slick mud which sticks to everything it touches.  Small rivulets of melted snow race downward to a small gully towards the south.  Small creatures, basking on sun-warmed rocks, quickly dart away instinctively as you walk by.

title: [[Aberro Cliffs, Above a Pool]]
description: Trees cling precariously to the cliff face, their leaves rustling in the blessedly fresh breeze.  The small stream below glistens in its ravine, sparkling and clear until its end at the putrid pool.

title: [[Aberro Cliffs, Cliff Face]]
description: The trees here are more scraggly than those lower on the cliff face.  A dead sapling hangs unsteadily from a single remaining root.  Though unsuited to trees, the rocks do offer enough cracks and protrusions for climbing.

title: [[Tysoeti's Hospital, Reception]]
description: A rack on the eastern side of this building contains numerous canisters of herbs of all shapes, strange looking liquids, insects, dirt and what appear to be the organs of unidentified animals.  Opposite that bizarre display is a larger rack of finished potions born from the unpleasant mass of ingredients.  An alchemist tends to the massive black iron cauldron resting at the center of the building and surrounded by a collection of misery-stricken sick and wounded.

title: [[Tysoeti's Hospital, Gaktrhn's Triage]]
description: Smoke hangs listlessly in the air all about the dimly lit triage hall.  Amorphous halos hover around the flickering flames of oil lamps that sway gently over cushioned benches in recessed alcoves.  In the center of the room rests an oak-framed settee draped with Musparan silk, upon which the healer awaits the arrival of new patients.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Narrow cracks in the ravine wall offer an escape from the shadows of the canyon, though to judge by the amount of rubble littering the rocky floor, "treacherous" is probably the kindest way to describe the climb.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: A boulder juts up from the ravine floor to the south, blocking travel in that direction.  The walls of the ravine are shrouded in shadows, but there seems no easy way out from here.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Water ripples as wind skitters across a sink pit along the south wall, sending flickers of light dancing around the ravine.  High overhead, a pair of ropes span the top of the canyon, occasionally traversed by travelers, but more often providing a precarious perch for hawks hunting small rodents in the gorge.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Water glistens in a deep sink pit along the south side of the ravine.  The canyon floor is shadowed by the high walls that allow the light to shine down only when the sun is at its zenith.

Reflected moonlight shimmers against the water in a deep sink pit along the south side of the ravine.  Steep rock walls overhang the canyon floor, making it difficult to distinguish details of the surrounding area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Deep cracks in the canyon floor widen to the west, making further travel impossible.  Though the bottom is not visible, the sound of rushing water echoes up from the depths of the crevice.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Broken rocks, fallen from the ravine walls, litter the ground with splintered shards.  Years of erosion have cut away at the south wall, leaving it to rise at a steep inward-leaning angle that even the most intrepid mountain goat could not navigate.  High overhead, two ropes cross the top of the ravine, far out of reach.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Shallow grooves worn by years of running water undulate across the floor of the ravine.  The depressions form catch-basins for rubble fallen from the rock walls, filling with gravel and other debris to make for hazardous footing.  Overhead, the south wall of the ravine leans in at an acute angle, making it impossible to climb.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: A sink pit near the south wall is filled with ice-cold water that spills over the side of the ravine.  The trail skirts the obstacle, winding in a smooth arc through the rubble-strewn canyon.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Wind rushes through the canyon, ruffling the surface of the water in a nearby sink pit and catching at hair and clothing of travelers making their way through the gorge.  The high walls funnel the force to send it whipping remorselessly against any exposed skin.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: The ravine wall takes a sharp turn, forming a sheltered hollow less exposed to the wind.  Some previous traveler has evidently taken advantage of this, given the remains of a fire pit surrounded by a few comfortably curved stones.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: High along the ravine's southern wall, a bird has built a large nest.  There's no way to get to it from here, however, and no sign of the occupant.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Shards of sharp-edged shale litter the floor of the ravine, a hazard to anyone foolish enough to go barefoot in the dim light.  From time to time, a few rocks bounce along the rocky surface as something moves in the shadows.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Dark boulders topped with a stone slab form a crude altar in the shadow of the ravine walls.  A hollow in the slab holds a bit of stagnant water, and a dried snake skin and a desiccated cardinal's wing with a few bedraggled feathers still clinging to it lie nearby.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: A rockfall blocks the ravine to the east, leaving behind shifting piles of shale too precarious to climb.  Green with mold and decay, a few bones are visible amidst the sharp-edged rubble.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, In a Ravine]]
description: Worn by years of falling water, the ravine wall exhibits gentle folds running from floor to rim.  The north wall rises nearly straight up, unlike the inward tilt of the southern wall.  While it doesn't seem possible to climb out at this point, perhaps it will be further down the ravine.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Empath Home]]
description: The cottage has an air of peacefulness, though sounds of weeping and the occasional scream conquer other sounds.  Cushions and rugs cover the floor offering much appreciated comfort to the patients.  Bloody bandages piled in a corner show how many people depend on this empath's services.  Blood-spattered walls mount paintings of empaths on battlefields healing the wounded.  A young woman glides across the room examining each patient in silence, occasionally touching one lightly and moving on.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Baluster Boulevard]]
description: Perfectly uniform regiments of mature copperleaf trees border the expanse of warm sandstone and form a whispering canopy above the boulevard as it parades between mansions and sprawling villas.  Most of the residences on this stretch of the boulevard boast a magnificent portico resplendent with the marble pillars which give the thoroughfare both its name and the imposing dignity of its appearance.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Almhara Arch]]
description: Curiously quiet despite its metropolitan location, Fayl'Shar Court occupies a prime plot in the city's most affluent quarter.  A broad tree-lined boulevard of imposing estates sweeps southwest toward a quadrangle of grand residences, offering a vista of outstanding architectural beauty.  Fronted by flawless lawns and exquisite specimens of rare Elanthian flora, the boulevard provides a pleasant promenade for residents and a living monument to the skills of the master gardeners they employ.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Baluster Boulevard]]
description: Several of the homes on Baluster Boulevard possess grand gates and driveways wide enough to accommodate an entire collection of opulent carriages, and even properties on the smaller lots are served by lengthy stretches of immaculate gravel or goldstone.  Those residents who prefer privacy surround their homes with seamless banks of thick privet and poplar, while others offer a clear view of their magnificent abodes through smart black iron railings.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Baluster Boulevard]]
description: Baluster Boulevard closes sedately in an elegant crescent, the gentle curve of the pavement punctuated by carved marble stepping stones placed to allow visitors a dignified descent from their carriages.  A group of elegant white-painted ironwork benches sits around the base of a large oak tree, providing a pleasant place to sit beneath the spreading boughs and watch the world go by in all its finery.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: The splendid architecture of Goldstone Square may be viewed in a pleasurable stroll along the broad walkway which leads around the edge of the quadrangle.  Each home here is a magnificent example of prime Elanthian architecture, using only the finest materials and ornaments transported across the lands by discerning merchants.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: The homes on the east side of the Square present dramatic facades, each frontage carefully designed to demonstrate both the wealth and the good taste of its owner.  Every front door is polished to a deep gleam, each doorknob handled only by white-gloved servants.  Tradesmen never see this side of the homes they serve, since functional entrances and kitchen gardens have their own place out of sight behind the buildings.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: Glossy black railings run along the side of the promenade between the elegant residences and the goldstone pavement, supporting elegant glass streetlamps on ornate poles at regular intervals.  Well-scrubbed steps lead from the walkway up to the front door of each home, where a liveried butler can be expected to greet visitors to the monied families who occupy the Square.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: Perched atop the ornate iron railings outside a magnificent villa, two carved obsidian ravens stand sentry over the activity in the Square.  Each has glittering sapphire stones for eyes, and the deep sheen of their midnight plumage is carved with an expert hand, such that the symbols are a fitting tribute to the god they represent.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: Two large homes overlook the Southeast Lawn of the Arboretum, the broad balconies under their upper windows suggesting they were designed with a view of the park and passers-by in mind.  A pair of mature ban-minahle trees provides a slender arched entrance to the Arboretum, their branches forming a silvery canopy overhead.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: One particularly impressive mansion dominates the southernmost end of the Square, its extensive frontage commanding an unparalleled view of the Arboretum.  The palatial residence is set back from the promenade, putting a dignified distance between itself and the public in the Square.  Its vast plot of land is surrounded by tall poplars which bend gracefully in the scented breeze.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: Two spreading tulvora trees form a living arch leading onto the southwest lawn of the Arboretum.  The sweet and spicy fragrance of their palm-sized leaves fills the air with a heady perfume that drifts gently around this corner of the Square, mingling with the fresh scent of a bank of mimosa climbing elegantly around the porch of a large residence in the corner of the quadrangle.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: Most of Goldstone Square's lofty edifices boast luxurious leaded windows paned with high quality glass, the better to admire the Arboretum and neighboring buildings.  Those windows overlooking the Square are polished to a radiant shine, causing them to glint warmly in sunshine or lamplight.  From a distance, the sparkling windows might be rich gems embedded into every facade.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: A bronze statue of two elegant men dressed in lavish robes stands at the side of the promenade, the foot of one of the figures polished to a bright sheen as if frequently rubbed for luck.  Two splendid fir trees flank the statue, the piquant fragrance of their evergreen foliage filling the air with a lush, cool scent reminiscent of trade routes leading through distant forests.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: The homes on this side of the Square are set back from the promenade, their own private gardens offered as frontage to the quadrangle.  Each lawn is a perfectly uniform deep, lush green, surrounded by elegant trees and eye-catching beds of unusual blooming shrubbery.  Private pathways lead away from the Square toward each front door, curving gently through the gardens.

title: [[Fayl'Shar Court, Goldstone Square]]
description: A smooth walkway of lustrous goldstone encloses the edge of the Square, passing by the elegant facades of the rich homes that occupy this desireable address.  Stunning arrays of seasonal flowers and shrubs in polished acanth tubs decorate the promenade, contributing a colorful and leafy display to the park-like atmosphere of the Square.

title: [[Goldstone Arboretum, Southwest Lawn]]
description: The elegant Water Garden takes pride of place on the Southwest Lawn.  Elegant white wooden bridges traverse tiny brooks which flow gently from some unseen water source into a sparkling pond.  Fat, colorful fish swim lazily in the clear waters, their spectacular hues flaming dramatically with every flash of light on their scales.

title: [[Goldstone Arboretum, Northwest Lawn]]
description: The Northwest Lawn of the Arboretum demonstrates formal gardening at its best.  Impressive examples of cunning topiary surround the uniform green of the lawn, each perfect privet fashioned into a lifelike representation of animal or bird.  A pair of polished oak benches sits beside the lawn, allowing visitors to inspect the horticultural artworks at leisure.

title: [[Goldstone Arboretum, Northeast Lawn]]
description: Inside the Peregan Arch, the Northeast Lawn of the Arboretum is surrounded by groves of trees arranged in such a way as to give the impression they grow wild, untouched by human hands.  Large nuts falling from the peregans have been allowed to take root around their parents, and banks of carefree wildflowers grow with elegant abandon in this unconstrained corner of the park.

title: [[Goldstone Arboretum, Crystal Fountain]]
description: A circular area paved with glittering goldstone surrounds the Crystal Fountain, its countless spouts providing a fascinating display of dancing waters.  Elegant wrought iron benches surround the fountain, allowing visitors to the park a place to sit and relax while observing the aquatic spectacle.  Carefully-tended willows surround the area, hushing all but the restful splash of water on crystal and the occasional snippet of quiet conversation.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Goldstone Arboretum, Southeast Lawn]]
description: An impressive collection of boulders from every corner of Elanthia forms the rock garden, each crack and crevice providing an unlikely new terrain for a selection of flowers and shrubs drawn from remote, mountainous regions.  The air remains cool here at all times of year, as if the Gardeners have employed some clever means to duplicate the freshness of the mountain air.

title: [[Medratha's Designs in Marble]]
description: The air is cool and still within Medratha's salesroom, where samples of flawless marble are on display around the walls like masterpieces in an upmarket art gallery.  The artisan himself moves among his customers, silent and catlike, his footsteps soundless on the expanse of snowy-white marble beneath his feet.

title: [[Ice Caves, Stone Bridge]]
description: This is a holding room for people "on" the bridge.  The room script should prevent them from seeing this text.  If you are a player, and are reading this, please BUG how you got here, and then REPORT to get moved.

title: [[Ice Caves, Underground Lake]]
description: Descending out of the darkness, the bridge comes to rest on a narrow ledge that juts from the cavern walls.  Once there was nothing but a void within this hollow mountain, but now melting ice has formed a great lake that spreads out beyond the light's reach.

wayto.9470: ;e fput 'go bridge'; waitfor 'you step back onto solid ground'

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Dim Tunnel]]
description: Light from the main cavern only barely challenges the darkness that shrouds the tunnel as it turns to dig deeper into the ice coated walls.  Underneath the bloodstained ice that covers the ground, deep scratches mar the dark stone leading further into the black passageway.

title: [[Ice Caves, Dim Tunnel]]
description: Set into the frozen walls is a large iron door covered in scrollwork that blocks further passage into the tunnel.  Odd symbols are crafted into the framework supporting the door, but aside from vague dragon-like shapes, their meanings are lost.

title: [[Ice Caves, Larder]]
description: Cold air circulates about this small chamber creating a frosty environment that chills the blood.  In times past the tunnel obviously continued further into the dark stone walls, but because of a cave-in, that option is no longer available.  It has since been transformed into a larder for the Adan'f and bodies are stacked haphazardly about the area, kept fresh by the cold air coming from behind the cave-in.

title: [[Ice Caves, Dim Tunnel]]
description: Dark stone coated with black ice reflects the light from the main cavern, absorbing it and hiding it away.  The result is a dim passageway that leads further into the frozen caves.

title: [[Ice Caves, Recessed Alcove]]
description: Light rarely finds its way back to this cold dark corner.  Long ago the passage continued further into the black walls, but due to a cave-in in the past the way is completely blocked off.  Gouges in the walls around the cave-in show evidence of digging, but none actually make it through the hard stone.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.  Several skulls have been piled in a corner, an eerie trophy of some sort.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Dim Tunnel]]
description: Darkness shrouds this tunnel as it burrows away into the ice coated stone.  From time to time firelight from the main cavern reflects off veins of rock crystal that have been revealed by past digging, their soft glimmering accounting for what little light there is.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crevice]]
description: Narrowing abruptly, the walls close in tight making passage through the crevice slow going.  The veins of rock crystal in the dark stone grow more evident and seem to be increasing in size as the tunnel gets further from the main chambers.

title: [[Ice Caves, Crystal Cavern]]
description: Cut from the very heart of a massive vein of crystal, the passage ends here in a pocket of precious stone.  Smooth sheets of crystal make up the walls, their multicolored hues of blues and reds and greens sending off bursts of color as light from the main cavern bounces back through the dark stone tunnels to reach this small confine.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Ice Caves, Cavern's Heart]]
description: Torches are set up in a circle around a gaping chasm that opens in the hard frozen stone of the cavern's floor.  At the north edge of the void, an iron altar stained with dried blood stands flanked by two large silver braziers.  Light from the fires fill the surrounding cavern and flicker in a light breeze that constantly rises from the chasm.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Warehouse Of The Ruby Skull, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Chasm Floor]]
description: Huge patches of phosphorescent moss cling to the slick sides of the creviced wall, lending a ghostly glow to the surrounds.  The ground is smooth and dusty, littered with tiny bits of gravel that have fallen from above.  An occasional drip plops into a body of water nearby and the sound echoes eerily before the deep hush settles once more.

title: [[Underground Lake, Shoreline]]
description: The ground gradually slopes down, dipping below the surface of a murky lake.  Thick, phosphorescent fungus sprouts out of crevices in the cave wall, grasping out for moisture dripping down the stone.  Small ripples in the lake refract the pale light, causing an effect similar to moonlight dancing off the water.  Something can be heard dripping into the lake from further into darkness to the east.

title: [[Underground Lake, Shallows]]
description: The chilly water in the shallows of this subterranean lake is crystal clear, showing the silted bottom.  It looks only knee deep.  Drops of condensation occasionally plummet from somewhere unseen, far up above.  A large rock rises up out of the water to the east, making straight travel impossible.  The lake stretches out to the southeast, around the rock while the gravelly floor rises up to the west.

title: [[Underground Lake]]
description: The water here laps carefully against the massive boulder to the north.  Spotted, glowing fungus has taken up resident on the edge of the rock, casting a sickly pallor across the water.  The ethereal light dances on top of the lake, but makes it impossible to see what lies below the surface.  Water drips steadily into the water from walls which are slick with condensation.  The cool water continues its path northeast and northwest around the rock.

title: [[Underground Lake]]
description: The lake casually winds north alongside the protruding rock to the west.  Another boulder rises up from the inky depths to the east, not quite breaking the surface of the water.  Slick layers of moss have coated both rocks, swaying slowly in the lake's gentle current.  The water is so deep here that what lies below cannot be seen through the murk.  Trickling water can be heard coming from beyond the eastern boulder.

title: [[Underground Lake]]
description: The lake dead ends here in a stagnant pool pushed up against a solid wall of huge stalactites and fallen boulders to the north.  The water is warm due to the lack of circulation, but the amount of moss and algae on the walls have increased greatly.  Chunks of finger-like fungus have drifted to the surface of the water here and the air is rich with the stench of rotting plant matter.  Cooler water can be felt drifting in from the south, but it has little effect on the overall temperature.

title: [[Underground Lake, Rocky Shore]]
description: This false shore is formed by a low rock shelf, the floor not quite rising above the surface of the lake.  As the water laps up against the shelf wall, it trickles into a large chute which has been naturally formed to the east.  A few deep gouges mar the rock walls, many of which have been turned into shelters for a spongy type of fungus.  The ground drops away to the west into the gloomy lake.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnel, Sludge Pit]]
description: The smell of stagnant mud is heavy in the air here and the ground has the consistency of old porridge.  Standing water mixed with fine dirt rests atop a treacherous bottom of thick mud, making movement in this area difficult.  Water occasionally drips into the mixture from the hole that rests high on the western wall.  Some shoring begins to the northwest and the ground appears to gain some semblance of structure.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Dead End]]
description: The soil is almost too soft to support a body's weight.  Apparently, those who excavated this tunnel realized the futility and stopped a little southeast of here.  Far to the west is the remnant of a last attempt at shoring the walls, and in all other directions, the floor gently slopes upwards.  While the slope seems innocuous, a brief test would reveal that the soil is only slightly more firm than mud.  The deceptive slope mocks any attempts to climb up and jealously guards the secret of what lies beyond.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Eastern Corridor]]
description: The walls gradually widen until there is no need to brace them for comfortable walking.  Heavy moisture in the air has penetrated the soil, causing it to be soft and formless.  Some failed remains of an attempt to hold the saturated walls back is barely discernable, most of the structure having rotted away.  Three metal bands and a pile of decaying wood appear to be all that is left of some sort of barrel, whose original contents one might only guess at.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Eastern Corridor]]
description: As the corridor continues, the damp smell is unavoidable and much stronger.  The wooden wall braces steadily become more frequent presumably to defend against the lack of consistency in the soil, which appears to have sloughed off after years of neglect.  Partly obscured by decades of accumulated dust, the imprints of boots are still faintly visible on the floor.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Eastern Corridor]]
description: The faint smell of lingering mold and a heaviness in the air both betray the presence of moisture in this roughly-hewn corridor.  The rotting remains of wooden braces line the walls, occasionally bearing a blackened hole ideal for holding a torch or lantern hook.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Crevice]]
description: The floor of this crevice would dead end to the west at the foot of a towering rock shelf if not for the beginnings of a tunnel carved into its base.  Wooden supports and miscellaneous debris can be seen further west in the tunnel, while the crevice path continues to the east.  The walls of this chasm fade into nothingness above you as a vast expanse of shadow ceilings the cavern, the faint but consistent sound of dripping the only answer to your gaze.  To the north is a low opening.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: All sounds become short and claustrophobic, losing the familiar echo as the walls close in.  Heavy, but aging wooden structural supports line walls of this section of the tunnel, holding back the immense pressure of the rock shelf surrounding it.  Various mining tools, now worthless, lay scattered haphazardly about the area, a hint at the flurry of activity this tunnel may once have seen.  To the east, a seemingly roofless chasm opens up, as the cramped mining tunnel plunges on to the west.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: Pebbles skitter down the tunnel dislodged by the slightest movement of air.  Rocks jut out of the sides of the tunnel, scraps of rotting cloth caught from some unwary passerby.  Many of the sturdy supports are soot stained, marking the locations of torches long since expired.  To the southwest, the tunnel continues downward, while higher ground is to the east.  At the side of the corridor, a patch of burlap is half-buried by a small cave-in.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: A large crack runs perpendicularly through this part of the tunnel.  The strong timbers are heavily reinforced in order to compensate for the structural weaknesses that the crack implies.  While narrow at the floor, the crack's width at the ceiling looks almost large enough to fit a gnome.  The gap in the floor is filled with rocks and dirt to make a smooth passage across, but the filling seems to be blotchily discolored.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: The tunnel continues west with its uniform look of sturdy support beams and messy mining leftovers strewn about in a hasty fashion.  Every noise seems to fall short, causing the tunnel to feel unnaturally cramped.  The darkness that closes in on the tunnel from east and west makes it seem possible that it continues on forever into the rock.  Slightly off the middle of the walkway lies a half-buried bird cage.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: The passageway stretches on to the east and west with no end in sight.  The vastness makes time feel dilated, presumably affected by the absence of significant differences in the surrounding environment.  Even the rocks sent tumbling by any footstep seem to skitter to an abrupt halt, providing no alleviation to the seemingly endless repetition of the deserted tunnels.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Western Branch]]
description: A brilliant quartz vein surfaces in the wall here, glowing from some unknown phosphorescence.  Deep within the vein, there are dark spots presumably indicating the presence of a denser mineral.  Someone in search of the hoped-for gold or perhaps trying to get to the dark spots within has gouged out a large chunk of the quartz, damaging the natural splendor of the vein and littering the floor with the off cuts.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Ledge]]
description: The tunnel comes to an abrupt westward end, as a rockslide has collapsed a good portion of the floor.  The only way to continue on the path west is down a steep cliff of fallen rocks mixed with the splintered remains of some support beams.  Attached to a sturdy rock at the edge of the ledge is a steel cable, which hangs stiffly down the side of the low cliff.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Rockslide]]
description: Snaking its way amongst the litter of the rockslide is the steel cable that hangs from the ledge above.  Small rocks and skittering pebbles make getting a foothold difficult and the way uncertain.  To the southeast, resting on some rocks is a massive split girder arrested in its downward descent.  There perched rather forlornly is an old decaying boot lying on its side, either discarded by some unfortunate or perhaps ripped off their foot.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Rockslide]]
description: The precariously lodged girder cuts off here, its savagely splintered end hanging in mid air.  That might have been the end of the journey, were it not for two solid metal pins driven into a boulder.  Suspended from this surprising discovery is a rope ladder that hangs down the slope.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Old Camp]]
description: Rubble surrounds a long-expired fire pit.  Ever-higher piles of rocks to the west block the way forward.  Short of excavation, there is no way to go further.  To the east is a high rock wall that looks very difficult to climb except for the rope ladder that provides a way out.  Years of non-use have worn down what may have once been a makeshift camp.  A few discarded ration wrappers lie decaying between and under two large stones.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Staging Area]]
description: A low opening expands into this broad cave.  While hardly a home away from home, it looks like this was used as a meeting room for a team that came some time before the tunnel's construction began.  A few aging wooden chairs surround a fallen table, all resting atop a tattered hemp rug.  A rusted iron lantern depends above the sitting area, providing awkward lighting at best.  Scraps of cloth, torn-out pages, and frayed rope-ends show that many preparations were executed here.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Storage Area]]
description: Long abandoned and stripped of anything useful, this room still retains the notable odor of steel and weapon oil.  On the western wall leans a warped cabinet, its door hanging from one rusty hinge.  On the eastern wall hang various iron racks, suited for holding weapons and armor while keeping them readily available for use.  Dark oil stains pattern the floor.  Large barrels and boxes lie discarded; some even smashed, in a corner of the room, obvious remnants of depleted food stores.

title: [[In The Cabinet, A Prayer Niche]]
description: Amidst the decay, a broken panel guards this small prayer niche like a drunken sentinel.  Even so, there is a hush here reminiscent of a holy place.  Two iron sconces hold dusty candles that have long ago burned down, leaving beaded streams of milky wax to sink to the floor in lacy strands.  Further back in this peaceful nook sits a tumbledown altar, covered in similarly exhausted candles, and there at its feet, between two candle stubs rests a worn, leather-bound journal.

title: [[Abandoned Tunnels, Way out]]
description: It is obvious that this was an initial excavation site some time ago.  Mining tools that have been worn down to the nub lie scattered about this wide tunnel, while sturdy wooden shoring lines the rough stone walls.  Oddly, a substantial-looking axe handle with a rope tied to it has been wedged in between two rocks near a rocky ledge.  The northern wall has been dug away to reveal a large hole, causing a brisk mountain wind to whistle through the hallway.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Orchard Edge]]
description: Ancient Ilithic apple trees stretch their heavy, twisting branches toward the sky.  The thick trunks stand in straight lines, showing that this was once an orchard, likely long abandoned.  Leaves and sticks create a carpet of noise, which threatens to crunch with any movement across them.  A faint trail winds through a briar patch to the nearby field.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Fallen Tree]]
description: One of the Ilithic apple trees has succumbed to nature and fallen to the ground, half of its branches broken and lost under its bulk.  Smaller plants have started to take root upon the decaying tree, a living display of new growth taking the place of old.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Fallen Tree]]
description: Many smaller plants have taken advantage of the fallen apple tree and its nourishing decay to grow upon the trunk.  Standing out with their bright, fiery hues is a grouping of Ilithic irises.  A small nest can be made out in one of the higher branches that hasn't broken off.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Ancient Tree]]
description: Larger than its nearby brethren, a huge twisting Ilithic apple tree towers over its neighbors.  Sprouting from the trunk are branches that droop to the ground due to their great weight, blocking the way past.  High in the branches, mostly hidden from below, a structure can just be made out.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Treehouse]]
description: The platform circles the trunk, giving views in all directions across the orchard and the golden fields beyond.  A slanted roof offers scarce shelter in the case of rain, but the open sides offer no protection from harsh winds.  Affixed next to the opening leading back down is a sturdy shelf.  A rope dangles through a hole in the roof.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Hammock]]
description: Strung in the fork created by two large branches is a large net made from thick ropes, almost like a giant's hammock.  In the distance, the crystal tower of Shard can be seen above the great city's walls.  Hanging from one side of the net is a rope.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, Below the Spinneret]]
description: Tomiek chains with links as large as a Gor'Tog descend from the spinneret to connect to the thick, chitin-like ramp below your feet.  People are milling about the entrance hawking their wares while small children run to and fro playing games and singing.  An air of frivolity and joy surrounds everyone present at the occasion.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, Entrance]]
description: Tomiek chains with links as large as a Gor'Tog descend from the spinneret to connect to the thick, chitin-like ramp below.  People of all ages and races mill about, some gaping skyward at the massive abdomen of the fantastic beast while others talk excitedly about the wares they might find for sale.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  Painted in bold red across the wall is a large lit cigar with an even larger 'X' covering it.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  A large metal blade spider has been suspended from the ceiling by a thick steel cable that seems to grow directly out of the flesh itself.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  Some of the tubes are translucent, allowing you to see a greenish substance being pumped through them with rhythmic pulses.

title: [[The Great Sea Battle, Ticket Booth]]
description: Cool, humid air fills the area and droplets drape over everything in the area, living and inanimate.  Water pools in sunken areas showing all the places the ground is not exactly level.  A Merelew female stands in a booth to one side, her unblinking gaze sweeping the crowd for potential riders.  A brightly painted sign hangs above her head proclaiming, "Tickets for sale!"  People of all ages are gathered near another sign that contains further information on the ride.

title: [[The Mind of Sdai]]
description: Brightly painted lengths of silk have been haphazardly hung on the walls in an attempt to cover the dull metal and rust spots.  A large sea glass urn has been placed in the center with small stools and cushions arranged in a semi-circle around it.  Clearly not present by design, a florid pink paint stain on the floor mars the pleasant nature of the room.

title: [[Your Inner Animal, Warm Fuzzies]]
description: The rich oak and pine paneling of the walls bears a broad spread of well-preserved animal parts.  On the western side of the room, a giant boar's head is mounted above the door.  A large stuffed hawk perches on a stand in the corner, glaring menacingly at the various tables, shelves and clothing racks that dominate the far wall.

title: [[Your Inner Animal, Cold Hearted]]
description: Darkly stained planks cover the walls as much as possible, the dull and rusted metal peeking through in places due to the inevitable warp of the wood.  Pinned to the wall with dark nails, large four-legged skeletons appear to be crawling atop the shelves that line the far wall, heading towards a rough wooden door.  An array of preserved lizard heads encircles the room, each staring inward at some invisible focal point.

title: [[Creepy Costumes, Vestibule]]
description: Stark natural-colored canvas-coverd walls unrelieved by any ornamentation surround the room's austere furnishings.  A plain oak table stands in the middle of an expanse of crimson carpet, a solitary notice the only accessory.  A flame-red painted door stands between two plain ladder-back chairs.

title: [[Diamond Deities, Showroom]]
description: Velvet cloths in rich, dark tones of crimson, scarlet and maroon are draped over the pedestals that hold the merchant's wares.  Light from candles with brass shields keeps the shop softly lit.

title: [[Funny Bones, On The Run]]
description: Lurid red velvet panels cannot entirely hide the rusting metal walls behind them.  Sumptuous furnishings resting upon a riveted bronze floor display the merchant's wares.  An attendant, notable for her blonde hair and skimpy attire, is unable to answer the simplest question about the items for sale -- but she is suitably decorative.

Lurid red canvas walls are held up by black-painted tent poles.  Sumptuous furnishings resting upon a carpet-covered floor display the merchant's wares.  Clerks bustle about as they attempt to both answer questions and restock the merchandise.

title: [[Creepy Costumes, The Art of War]]
description: Murals, painted with battle scenes, cover the canvas-covered walls of the room.  Rugs depicting stylized weapons and armor cover the floor, underneath the three stands bearing costumes in the center of the chamber.  Sconces made from worn sword-blades hang on the walls, allowing plenty of light for shopping.

title: [[Creepy Costumes, Survival Instincts]]
description: Thick brown carpets patterned with leaves conceal the floor, running from wall to wall.  Three stands bearing costumes are arrayed in a triangle arrangement in the center of the room, directly underneath a chandelier made of antlers.  Simple benches, painted dark brown, stand along the forest green canvas-covered walls.

title: [[Creepy Costumes, The Finer Things in Life]]
description: Deep plush rugs carpet the floor, stretching from wall to wall.  Arrayed around the room are three stands bearing clothing, each carved in intricate designs.  Hanging from the center of the ceiling is a crystal chandelier, fitted with hundreds of tiny prisms.  Maroon leather armchairs sit in each corner, allowing the clientele to rest at need.

title: [[Accents for the Arachnophile, Jewels and Accessories]]
description: At first glance, this room appears to be nothing more than the den of a giant, demented spider.  The wan light of a single gaethzen lantern dangling from a chain in the ceiling illuminates somber metal walls festooned with a drapery of webbing.  Thick curtains of the silky white strands droop low from the ceiling, making it difficult to navigate without becoming entangled.  Fortunately, the webs are only slightly sticky and refuse to cling excessively to those brave enough to enter.

title: [[Elahkti's Metal Arts, Foyer]]
description: Velvet draperies of grey and silver brocade cloak the walls, the patterns of the brocade sparkling in the light of lanterns suspended from the ceiling.  Fresh-cut rushes crackle softly underfoot, their green scent blending with the mellow fragrance of oils and polishes used to keep Elahkti's creations in top form.

title: [[Shrine to the Dragon, Central Chamber]]
description: This chamber is carved directly into the stone of the caverns.  The walls are a dark green jade, encircling a stained altar that rests in the very center.  Statues, shattered and smashed by time and angry mortal hands alike, stand forever frozen in broken dances.  Elegant brass sconces still flicker with mystic lights, dim but bright enough to illuminate the area.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, Jubby's Tattoos]]
description: Heavy steel plates have been riveted together to form the walls of this cramped room.  A thick iron door on rusting hinges stands open to allow the carefree wandering in and out of passing shoppers.  A few large chairs are placed in the center of the room, and each has a table nearby with tools used to create artful designs.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  A heavy bronze hatch provides passage into the thorax beyond.

title: [[Sable's, Odd Treasures]]
description: A cool breeze enters from the metal archway leading out, causing sheets of canvas draped from the walls and ribbons on racks to flutter.  A layer of dust covers the plain floor, and pale streams of light radiate from whimsical gaethzen globes set at even intervals around the room, giving everything a cheery glow.

Occasional breezes cause the sheets of canvas forming the walls and ribbons on racks to flutter.  A layer of sawdust covers the ground, and pale streams of light radiate from whimsical gaethzen globes set at even intervals around the room, giving everything a cheery glow.

title: [[Asketi's Stop, Front Room]]
description: The flickering flame of a carved pumpkin hanging from the ceiling provides the only source of illumination in this ominously quiet tent.  An errant breeze emanates from further within, causing the flame to cast eerie shadows across the walls.  Hanging limply from one wall, a tattered out-of-place banner proclaims "Happy Jeolandu!" in a bold, broad script.  Despite outward appearances, the merchandise is neatly organized on cloth-covered tables, racks and chests.

title: [[Yarrel's Varmint Vittles, Display Room]]
description: The overwhelming smell of all sorts of cooked meats dominates the air of the small room.  A glass display case shows off the shop's selection of fine hams.  Yarrel, the shop's owner, stands proudly behind the counter, making sure there is always enough stock out for perusal at all times.  A colorful sign is hung prominently from the rafters.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  A pair of young Dwarven children stand off to one side, pointing and giggling at the passing shoppers while simultaneously daring each other to touch the strange, fleshy parts of the surroundings.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes has been cauterized, leaving a lumpy, blackened scar at the end.  Small droplets of green fluid occasionally form upon the scar tissue, adding a slickness to its surface.

title: [[Sable's, Masquerade]]
description: Fabric walls in subdued shades serve as the backdrop for displays of colorful masks in many varieties.  Bright feathers, gems, and cord adorn the masks that liberally cover the table and hang from the three racks on the walls.

title: [[Glythtide's Gifts and Gags]]
description: A merry atmosphere fills this rickety wagon.  Excited children dart to and fro, examining the wares on assorted shelves and tables.  Sounds of pops, bangs, and giggles echo off the walls as some customers try out their latest purchases.

title: [[Lavender and Lace, Salesroom]]
description: Fabric swatches in varied hues of purple blanket the walls, completely covering the metal.  More fabric hangs from gaily painted poles, which are surrounded with white and purple crates and trunks.  White and purple painted racks and tables fill the rest of the room.

title: [[Forever Faithful, Primary Gods Area]]
description: Selling on consignment for a small profit to assist in their monastery's upkeep, monks from every province trust this merchant to display their handcrafted items.  Little has been done to decorate the space, allowing the wares to take center stage.  Merchandise is grouped throughout the inside of the wagon, forming simple but distinct areas.

title: [[Forever Faithful, Negative Gods Area]]
description: Shades of grey, so dark they almost resemble black, have been used to define this area, from the watered paint on the walls to the simple cotton rugs on the floor.  The absence of color draws attention to the collection of merchandise instead of distracting shoppers with frivolous decorations.

title: [[Forever Faithful, Positive Gods Area]]
description: Layers of white have been used to define this area, from the milk paint on the walls to the simple rag rugs on the floor.  The absence of color draws attention to the collection of merchandise instead of distracting shoppers with frivolous decorations.

title: [[Forever Faithful, Neutral Gods Area]]
description: Varying degrees of beige have been used to define this area, from the powdered paint on the walls to the simple braided rugs on the floor.  The absence of color draws attention to the collection of merchandise instead of distracting shoppers with frivolous decorations.

title: [[Forever Faithful, Holy Armory]]
description: Varying degrees of grey have been used to define this area, from the pale stain on the walls to the rugs on the floor that smell faintly of weapon oil.  The absence of color draws attention to the collection of armaments instead of distracting shoppers with frivolous decorations.

title: [[Stuff It, Fine Leather Goods]]
description: The interior of this small room is sparsely decorated.  A scattering of fabrics drapes various boxes that bear items for sale.  A faint smell of cured leather blends in with the fresh scent of roses coming from a large vase filled with the fragrant blossoms.

title: [[Scabbards 'n' Sheaths]]
description: The pungent smell of warm leather fills the small room, enriched by a hint of fragrant oils.  The wares are displayed on a rack and three tables lining the room.

title: [[Simply Essential, Sales Room]]
description: Yellow silk fabric casts a golden glow over everything in the room.  Painted canvas covers the floor, held down at each corner by intricately crafted and brightly polished brass lamps.  A painted paper screen stands in one corner, hiding it from view.

title: [[Simply Essential, Side Room]]
description: Plum-hued silks drape the area in an attempt to disguise the drab metal walls.  A large bear hide covers the floor beneath the brass lanterns that hang overhead.  Several large pillows are gathered at the center of the room, providing a comfortable spot to rest during the day's shopping.

title: [[Misenseor Goods, Entrance]]
description: This small ingress is confined by dark-colored drapery, concealing the rest of the shop from view.  Two openings admit into larger rooms where the wares of the monks are displayed.  A sheaf of sirese flowers lies forlornly nearby on the floor.

title: [[Misenseor Goods, Zealous Destruction]]
description: The pinewood walls enclosing this side of the shop are equipped with implements of battle for the use of warrior monks.  Large twin bowls, filled with red liquid, flank a stylized thirteen-pointed star burnt into the wall between the room's two egresses.

title: [[Misenseor Goods, Dark Light]]
description: A chandelier with black crystal prisms is mounted on the ceiling, casting the room in an eerie midnight ambience as though beneath a cloud-covered Xibar.  Large twin bowls, filled with ash, flank a stylized thirteen-pointed star burnt into the wall between the room's two egresses.

title: [[Misenseor Goods, Shrouding Darkness]]
description: Heavy curtains in a multitude of black and grey hues hang all around the room, only allowing passage through three narrow slits.  Several bolts of fabric are propped upright to lean against a wall.  A faint scent of incense comes from the middle opening in the curtains.

title: [[Misenseor Goods, Abbot's Blessings]]
description: Olibanum incense cones smolder within a faience censer at the far corner of the shop's heart.  Their smoky tendrils whorl upward, deepening the already dark tones of a somber portrait just above.  Unlike the other rooms, the floor here is neatly carpeted and furnished with velvet cushions.

title: [[The Smaller Side of Life]]
description: Fanciful murals create an oversized forest across the walls serving to highlight the surfaces used to display the many wares.  A low branch wrapped in honeysuckle arches over a carved ruby mushroom with large opal spots.  Sitting next to a vine-wrapped archway is a silversteel tree strung with tiny firefly filled jars, while across the room is a small silver door flanked by a tiny white spiritwood cupboard and a tidy curly birch shoe rack.  A silk curtain embroidered with leaves hangs between two painted trees.

title: [[The Smaller Side of Life, Eastern Wing]]
description: Painted black with shimmering silver and gold stars, the walls create a backdrop to the two large cubby-holes decorated to look like a grassy mound and a flowering mound respectively.  A silk curtain embroidered with leaves hangs between them, fluttering with any movement in the room.  Sitting in the center of the room is an ornate icesteel pedestal flanked by a dark dragonwood chest on one side and a frosted glass table top on the other.  Along the back wall is a very short Ilithic applewood counter.

title: [[Nectar of the Wisp, Main Room]]
description: An abundance of plants and small trees have been placed against all the walls, which are painted like the night sky.  Small glowing orbs, in a multitude of colors, have been hung by black strings and appear to float above the merchandise on display.

title: [[Odiferous Ornaments, Entry]]
description: Black-and-green splotches and powdery white spores create unusual patterns across the metal walls of the room.  Added to the dampness is an intense stench coming from the merchandise on display.

title: [[Odiferous Ornaments, Women's Fashions]]
description: Along one wall, black and green splotches and powdery white spores create the image of a well-dressed woman holding a dainty parasol.  An almost overwhelming stench emanates from the merchandise on display.

title: [[Odiferous Ornaments, Men's Fashions]]
description: Along one wall, black and green splotches and powdery white spores create the image of a well-dressed man sporting a top hat and a cane.  An almost overwhelming stench emanates from the merchandise on display.

title: [[Slings and Things]]
description: The walls of this small room are lined with deep burgundy velvet and embroidered in gold-colored thread.  Each piece of embroidery shows scenes of people using various slings and staff slings.  The entire area is well lit with a large spherical lantern hanging down from the center of the ceiling, with a light coating of sawdust covering the floor.

title: [[Limited Treasures, Lounge]]
description: Plush white carpet covers the floor from wall to wall, contrasting with the dark polished metal that creates them.  A pair of overstuffed black chairs sit to either side of a long charcoal-hued couch covered in throw pillows.  More pillows of various colors are scattered upon the floor giving customers a choice for seating.  A silversteel door stands across the room from a curtained archway of the same metal.

title: [[Damsel In This Dress, Top It Off]]
description: Normally dull metal walls have been painted with scenes from the countryside, showing rolling hills of varying shades of green and colorful flowers.  Painted blue sky stretches across the ceiling, adorned with a few fluffy clouds that look soft enough to touch.  Carefully placed to enhance the space are copper and bronze trees stretching out their branches to create shelves along the realistic background.  Stumps crafted from the same two metals create tables and stands, scattered about almost randomly.

title: [[Damsel In This Dress, Fine And Fancy]]
description: Vivid colors depict a light-speckled forest across the metal walls, the leaves stretching to cover most of the ceiling, allowing only bits of the sky-blue pigment to show through.  Mossy-green plush carpet has been spread across the floor, highlighted with sunshine yellow and tiny specks of purple.  Tables of bronze and copper are crafted to resemble tree stumps, each sitting next to matching racks that climb the walls, blending into the trees around them.

title: [[Damsel In This Dress, Glitter And Shine]]
description: Snow-covered fields cloak the walls in white and grey hues of paint, leading upward into a monochromatic sky.  Sparkling snowflakes hang from the ceiling on varying lengths of wire allowing them to swing and sway as if threatening to finish their fall.  Silk carpeting of pure white covers the floors, parting like snow to allow the growth of copper and bronze stumps and trees that turn their branches into long shelves.

title: [[Damsel In This Dress, Dress Up]]
description: An elegant rose garden has been created with hundreds of shades of paint and the artful use of fabric, each bloom detailed down to the smallest petal and thorn.  Brambles grow into climbing vines, covered in sprouting flowers, flowing across the ceiling to dangle silken creepers.  Underfoot a carpet of silk petals hides the ugly metal floor, giving the bronze and copper tables that are shaped to appear like dense bushes a place to grow.  Petite stands seem to sprout from the floor, crafted into the shapes of twisting maples.

title: [[The Cookie Emporium]]
description: Curved slats of dark wood cover the walls, the planks appearing to be repurposed from oak wine barrels.  Thick honey-colored carpet covers the floor.  A long sofa lines the eastern wall, crafted from deep golden-colored fabric and overstuffed to the point of bursting.

title: [[The Cookie Emporium, Kitchen]]
description: A long island counter stands prominently in the center of the kitchen, piled high with baked goods fresh from the oven.  Two ovens sit next to each other among the various stovetops and worktables, filling the room with the smell of baking cookies.  A small table in one corner is surrounded by chairs, offering a place to sit while eating.

title: [[The Glass Bubble, Finned Friends]]
description: Tiny gaethzen spheres float midair just under the bright blue canvas tarpaulin, the near-invisible fishing line used to string them together doing a marvelous job of not breaking the illusion.  Water travels in beads along the oilcloth mats in the aisles, making the ground a mess of puddles.  The merchandise rests on the shelves of several tall racks, and each display is situated an adequate distance from the next so customers have plenty of opportunity to see the selection.

title: [[The Glass Bubble, Splendorous Swimmers]]
description: Further under the awning, the light source switches from the tiny spheres to larger orbs on iron pedestals flanking each rack.  The effect is slightly eerie as the harsh white light reflects off the glass bowls on the shelves and scatters about.  A dusty mop and bucket sit in a cluttered corner, apparently not used often enough judging from the excess of water on the mats lining the ground.

title: [[The Glass Bubble, Aquatic Adventurers]]
description: The oilcloth mats on the ground narrow and the tarpaulin's sides fall inward here, the designated end of the makeshift enclosure.  Rods of glowing gaethzen attached to the top of each rack transform the darkness into a background of dark blue, reminiscent of deep ocean depths.  It's an appropriate setting for the inhabitants of the glass bowls upon the shelves, perhaps making them feel acclimated to their otherwise unnatural accommodations.
