title: [[Blanve's Bounty, Den of Decadence]]
description: Diaphanous gossamer scarves of crimson and gold veil the gaethzen orbs dangling from the ceiling.  The spheres glow softly with alluring, jewel-toned light to subtly illuminate the shadowy space.  Positioned in twos and threes, plump damask pillows claim the floor along the edges of the dusky, silk-draped walls.  In the room's middle, wisps of scented smoke float lazily upward from a tall bronze censer, its sophisticated ornamentation a perfect match for the plush indigo rug's elaborate maze pattern.

title: [[Blanve's Bounty, Oasis of Opulence]]
description: Extensive murals illustrate an exotic desert horizon at twilight.  The black-painted ceiling dilutes to shades of rich purples and pinks, eventually culminating in a white-orange band as it meets the sand decorating the lower half of the walls.  Miniature gaethzen orbs dot the sky to emulate twinkling stars, illuminating the tranquil scene with a subtle glow.  Tall potted palms in large golden urns frame the pebbled beige carpet, and a majestic rock fountain stands prominently in the center.

title: [[Blanve's Bounty, Sanctuary of Splendor]]
description: White marble columns adorned with climbing jasmine vines border the area at even intervals like a temple, strategically revealing glimpses of the shimmering midnight blue silk draped smoothly underneath.  Brilliant gaethzen orbs glow overhead like will-o'-the-wisps caught in perpetual luminescence, bathing the displays in pools of starry light.  A shadowy expanse of luxurious black carpet draws attention to the sparkling quartz sculpture stationed conspicuously in the room's center.

title: [[Blanve's Bounty, Garden of Grandeur]]
description: Lustrous deep green silk covers the walls and ceiling, enveloping the area in luscious color on par with the lavish earth-brown carpet underfoot.  Sculpted terra-cotta pots filled with blooming flowers border the display area, and tiny gaethzen orbs suspended from above hover effortlessly over the wares like curious fireflies on a midsummer's eve.  The musical rhythm of chirping crickets lingers in the air, emanating from somewhere close yet out of sight.

title: [[The Naked Sheep, Woolly Wears]]
description: Fluffy and soft, swaths of thick cream-colored fleece coat every side of the cozy tent.  The theme continues along the floor in the form of a puffy black carpet that stretches underneath several trunks and chests full of goods for sale.  Warm but not stifling, the air holds a faint musty scent from all the fabric, which the merchant has apparently tried to smother with dozens of freshly potted flowers placed in the room's corners.

title: [[The Naked Sheep, Fuzzy Fluff]]
description: Puffy as a cloud, the fleece along the walls retains its natural beige hue, arranged in swaths that drape casually along the slanting sides of the homely nook.  The woolly black carpet extends into this section of the tent as well, lining the floor beneath a collection of opened boxes.  Stationed in one corner is a brass sheep sculpture with a look of embarrassment on its face, the surface of its skin cleanly smooth to mimic its strikingly shorn real life counterparts.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Entrance]]
description: A wide red carpet welcomes you to Krobble's Karavan.  Krobble himself stands behind a wide crystalline counter, haggling with shrewd traders of all races.  Embossed doorways lead in several directions, through which you can see various sales surfaces and upgrades.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Elegant Fineries]]
description: Complex gold engravings line the white walls of this delicately prepared room.  A silk tapestry hangs on the western wall above a table bearing a decanter of wine.  Several other surfaces, clearly for sale, have been elegantly placed throughout the room.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Overstock]]
description: A selection of surfaces with no discernable theme litters the floor of this room.  Some are covered in canvas dust cloths, and others are stacked atop one another.  The dim light coming from the lobby to the south causes the shapes to seem discarded and forgotten.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Images of Hibarnhvidar]]
description: The hewn stone walls of this expansive sales floor are deeply engraved with pictures of Dwarven heroes.  Several shop surfaces have been tastefully placed around the room, accented by the nearby sculptures.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Bright and Shining]]
description: A large glowing gaethzen orb hangs from the ceiling, casting the room in a glaring light.  Metal surfaces have been placed about the room, carefully arranged to reflect the light away from the customer.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Colors of Night]]
description: The ceiling of this room has been carved into a dome, pinpointed with hundreds of tiny holes.  Each hole glows brightly, as if embedded with some luminescent material.  All three moons are visible in this false sky -- Katamba to the north, Xibar to the west and Yavash to the east.

title: [[Krobble's Karavan, Forest]]
description: Thick columns have been carved into the walls, twisted and knotted like the trunks of stone trees.  Evergreen branches, coarsely textured, are carved on either side of the pillars.  The faint smell of pine needles lingers in the air.

title: [[Fall's Harvest]]
description: An oilcloth tarp covers this small area, the long oak poles holding it up bearing hooks of apple-themed merchandise.  Brightly painted apples in shades of red, green and gold hang from the sides of the cloth overhead.

title: [[Delicate Creations]]
description: Pale blooms of fragrant flowers are interspersed throughout this small shop.  The oak-paneled walls are softened by crystal sconces and ivory tapestries.  Simply clad clerks appear ready to help customers with fine clothing hung on silverwillow racks.

title: [[Turialo's Haven]]
description: This narrow hallway is painted from top to bottom with colorful scenes, none of them seeming to have anything to do with each other.  The thick wooden walls and lush carpeting both serve to muffle sound, making this short hallway very peaceful.  A small table in the corner of the room holds a few refreshments.

title: [[Turialo's Haven]]
description: Off-white carpeting lines the floor of this colorful hallway, muffling steps and doing a decent job of hiding the metallic floor underneath.  Detailed scenes of all four seasons line the walls, each of them painted in exacting detail.  A large silver-framed mirror hangs on the end of this narrow corridor.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Autumn Colors]]
description: Trees in brilliant colors of red, purple and brown have been painted on the walls of this heavily-decorated hallway.  The carpeting is carefully dyed into a loose mosaic that vaguely resembles freshly fallen leaves.  Painted between the trees is a small red barn, both its doors standing open to reveal heaping piles of hay.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Autumn Promise]]
description: Several potted saplings, each one turning brilliant shades of yellow and red, have been tucked into the corners of this end of the narrow hall.  The mural on the wall continues, changing from autumn forest into rolling hills speckled with fallen leaves, set below bare trees prepared for the winter.  The area holds a faint scent of dry leaves.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Autumn Harvest]]
description: A large mural of rolling wheat fields makes up the walls of this end of the hallway.  Subtle swirls in the long golden stalks make the harvest-ready wheat appear to be blowing in the wind.  Near the horizon of the mural, thin trees stand tall, their leaves shed in preparation for the coming winter.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Winter Jewelry]]
description: The walls of this small room resemble the interior of a jeolzindu, with white ice bricks painted onto wooden boards.  A small circular window has been frosted over and painted with a scene of children throwing snowballs.  A small cast iron stove crackles cheerfully near the window, a fresh pot of tea resting atop the burner.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Winter Wear]]
description: Cheerful blue paint covers the walls and ceiling of this whimsically decorated hallway, a mural of a winter landscape making it seem much larger than it is.  The fresh white carpet is sprinkled with a blue glitter, giving it the appearance of newly fallen snow.  Large origami snowflakes hang from the ceiling, completing the look.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Winter Accessories]]
description: The beginnings of an evergreen forest decorate this small room, painted on the walls in a serene bas-relief style.  Hidden between the trees, the silhouette of a deer is just barely visible, its head raise and alert.  Several pine branches heavy with false snow extend slightly from the walls, and the air holds the faint scent of melting ice.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Spring Sunshine]]
description: Soft green carpeting resembling newly grown grass rests over most of the wooden floor of this small hallway, and rolling hills cover the walls.  A vast sky extends onto the ceiling, artfully painted above the landscape, and storm clouds complete with yellow streaks of lightning hang darkly in the eastern part of the room.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Spring Showers]]
description: This area of the hallway is decorated to resemble a full thunderstorm, with pouring rain streaming down onto soaked hills in the background painted on the wall and tall trees bent in the wind.  The green floor is punctuated with shimmering pools of glass that resemble puddles.  Small clear streamers hang from the ceiling, each strung with tiny teardrop-shaped crystals to mimic falling rain.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Spring Flowers]]
description: Flowing silk drapes the walls of this corner in bright colors, a pole in the center making it resemble the interior of an open tent.  Shining gaethzen set behind the elegant fabric imitates cheerful sunlight, illuminating the interior with a muted glow.  Outside the canopy, a small table has been set up with an array of fresh fruit.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Summer Day]]
description: Dark green rolling hills have been painted on the walls of this small hallway, an expansive blue sky spread out above them.  Shining brightly, the noontime sun has been painted in the middle of the ceiling, a few fluffy clouds surrounding it.  In the center of the room is a low picnic table set with a checkered tablecloth.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Summer Dusk]]
description: Painted artfully across the wooden walls, pictures of grassy hills continue from the east.  Beginning on the floor and continuing onto the bottom of the west wall, a sparkling beach decorates the furthest reaches of the small caravan.  Just above the sand, the setting sun has half-vanished behind still ocean waters, and the skyscape above it is filled with hues of purple and red.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Summer Dawn]]
description: A large mural carefully hung over the eastern wall gives the small room a sweeping backdrop of the sun just rising over purple mountaintops.  Expansive forests are painted onto the other walls, with shimmers of the dawn sun reflected on the leaves of the trees.  Carefully contained in a low brazier and disguised with rocks, a small campfire has been set up in the center of the room, surrounded by small benches.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Harvest Eve]]
description: This portion of the hallway is decorated to resemble a lonely maple forest, with all the leaves down for the winter.  Fallen leaves are painted across the wood-covered floors, and a pile of real leaves is heaped in an untidy bundle.  A carved pumpkin sits on a small stool, a small candle burning inside it and sending flickers of light across the walls.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Harvest Night]]
description: An expansive mural of stars is painted on the north and western walls, the late fall constellations all clearly visible.  Silhouettes of buildings are barely visible on a stylized horizon, and a small brazier gives off a gentle, serene light.  Bales of hay are pushed into the corners, spread over the top with sturdy burlap.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Harvest Sky]]
description: Decorated to resemble the inside of a barn, the walls of this small room are crafted from rough wood, and exposed beams crisscross overhead.  Fresh hay is scattered across the floor, giving the area a grassy smell.  The doors to the south and west stand open, leading to the other portions of the shop.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Night Shadows]]
description: Back-lit black velvet adorns the walls and ceiling, small pinholes representing stars and allowing light to peek through to form a representation of a cloudless autumn sky filled with constellations.  Small mechanical fireflies buzz about on wires, making light and shadow seem to chase each other.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Night Fog]]
description: Varying hues of blue and purple paint adorn the walls, and exquisite night-blooming flowers are stenciled crawling up them.  Each bloom has a small crystal set in the center, each one casting a bit of light.  A low mist clings close to the floor, mostly obscuring it and making the room feel rather hazy.

title: [[Turialo's Haven, Night Creatures]]
description: Sets of glowing yellow eyes peer out from irregular intervals on the pitch-black walls, some slitted and others more round.  Although they vary in size, they all seem to be watching every movement within the enveloping walls.  Wares are set out at each wall, dimly lit from above by small lanterns.

title: [[The Perfect Rose, Entrance]]
description: Fine rugs of braided silk cover the floors of this opulent tent, while the faint scent of vanilla spice wafts from candles burning on low tables.  Clerks dressed in linen robes confer with their customers, murmuring in low tones.  The smiles on the customers' faces bespeak their satisfaction with the service they receive.

title: [[The Perfect Rose, Apparel]]
description: Dark polished wooden wardrobes spaced sedately about the room brim with a selection of richly designed garments.  Plush fur rugs spread in abundance offer protection from the cold hard floor.  Mirrors have been strategically placed to admire the many flattering views of an outfit, while delicate paper screens offer the more modest customers a place to dress.

title: [[The Perfect Rose, Accessories]]
description: Shoes, slippers and boots, gathered from across Elanthia, wait to grace the feet of lovely maidens.  Ivory stands and crystal shelves hold elegant additions to any wardrobe.  Small cushioned stools are set out to offer comfort while finding that perfect fit.

title: [[The Perfect Rose, Jewelry]]
description: This room is a showcase of beauty with its sparkling jewelry placed in velvet and silk lined cases.  Crystal oval mirrors have been hung from the walls along with elaborate drawings.  A fountain carved in the shape of a rose is placed in the middle of the room, its petals in full bloom.

title: [[The Perfect Rose, Reflections]]
description: Thick carpets of patterned cloth hide the floor between cushioned couches that are covered in embroidered pillows.  A steaming teapot waits on an ironwood sideboard next to some shortbread cookies, and a young bard sits in a corner, softly playing a flute to entertain those who wait for the tailor's attentions.

title: [[The Eye of Power]]
description: Stark white canvas walls painted with crude eye images surround an area bare of anything but the displays of wares.  Though swept neatly, even the floor is absent any decoration, leaving patrons to trod the hard packed earth.

title: [[Fishy's Pants Mart, Pants Department of Pants]]
description: Scorch marks festoon the inside walls of this tent as if someone had run amok with a torch, or perhaps there were several small explosions.  A mild sulfurous odor hangs in the air with an underlying hint of old fish.  All this combined with the bright colors of the displays, however, might lead one to suspect that the proprietor is not a reserved or, indeed, stable individual.

title: [[Fishy's Pants Mart, Pants Department of Not-Pants]]
description: This side room is a bit shabby and unadorned, as if it were an afterthought.  The tent walls show less obvious damage than those in the main section, although the general aroma is similar.  Stray fragments of fabric litter the floor here and there.

title: [[Whimsies]]
description: As customers enter this brightly lit shop a parrot screeches out a loud, "Welcome!", startling many nearby at the same time.  Along its fine oak walls are fanciful mannequins dressed in brilliant costumes and other ornate clothing.

title: [[The Terrific Turnip]]
description: An assortment of mismatched lanterns spreads a warm glow over this small room, while the scent of fresh earth and greens permeate the air with an outdoorsy appeal.  Makeshift shelves and pine cabinets dot the wall behind the long counter that divides the space neatly in half.  A weary Gor'Tog woman dozes in an over-stuffed chair near the fireplace.  A pair of tripod tables stands to either side of the entrance.

title: [[The Terrific Turnip, Taproot Territory]]
description: Clutter covers every surface of this cramped room, which appears to serve as both a sales floor and a storage closet.  The overflowing boxes, chests and barrels that litter the floor give the room a mazelike quality.  Hanging from the haphazardly hung hooks along the far the wall is a motley assortment of weapons, interspersed with strings of dried turnips.  A rusty iron armor stand leans dispiritedly against a rotting pine chest near the inviting doorway.

title: [[The Terrific Turnip, Emanda's Nook]]
description: Sparse of furnishing, this tidy room seems out of place.  Trophy fish line the walls, iridescent scales gleaming with care.  A long table rests along the far wall, an assortment of food and drinks neatly placed upon it.  Oversized orange chairs that have been embroidered with turnips fill the rest of the space, giving customers a place to think.

title: [[In The Hollow]]
description: A cold draft wafts through the room at regular intervals, its source undetermined.  Each passing breeze causes the hooks hanging from the rafters to sway, making the ribbons and papers decorating the pinatas they hold flutter with eerie sounds.  A small table set to one side contains additional beribboned items.

title: [[Signs of the Times]]
description: Constructed of rough, paint-splattered wood, the hastily assembled stall with its leaning walls and crooked floor seems to be fairly sturdy, and might even hold up to a light breeze.  A grumpy-faced Gnome stands behind the durable worktable located towards the back of the room, glancing up occasionally from his reading to glare balefully at the customers.  Several barrels and a wide trough line the walls, displaying the wares in haphazard fashion.

title: [[Everything in Moderation, Main Room]]
description: Billowing slightly outward from the rusty metal walls, sheets of ivory gauze drape from the ceiling in an attempt to give a light, airy feel to an otherwise small room.  A mobile of hammered gears and gaethzen orbs suspends from brass wires of varying lengths and turns aimlessly in the current of air.  Against the far wall, a mirror rests between an armoire and a wardrobe, while an ottoman placed near a shoe rack provides a place to rest or try on shoes.

title: [[The Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Dim light filters up through the somewhat translucent floor, providing just enough illumination to navigate this tunnel-like hallway.  Preternatural oozes steadily stream beneath the surfaces of the membranous walls, letting off some sort of gasses as they pass by.  The dank air and overpowering stench make loitering in this bizarre passageway an unappetizing prospect.

title: [[Musical Chairs of Doom, Lobby]]
description: Large steel plates riveted to metal beams make up the walls, sending a rattle through the large room from time to time.  Exposed piping runs through the ceiling, much of it rusted and giving off a slightly musty odor.  A large wooden desk sits on a square of red carpeting, looking a bit out of place.

title: [[Musical Chairs of Doom, Viewing Room]]
description: The metallic ceiling is quite low here, with several lanterns hanging from it to make it rather well lit.  Rows of benches set in squarish patterns against the dull iron walls all face large windows looking into the arena below, giving spectators a place to sit.  Occasionally a breeze wafts through, bringing with it the distinct tang of fresh blood.

title: [[Musical Chairs of Doom, Triage]]
description: Stark metallic walls enclose this semi-circular room, set out with some bamboo mats to be used for the sick or injured.  Dried blood stains clot the floor, and an acrid smell lingers in the air, mixed with the scent of bandages.  Someone has left a few rose-filled flowerpots in the corners, apparently in a desperate attempt to mask the fouller odors.

title: [[Fangs For The Memory, Sales Floor]]
description: Streaks of rust run down the metal walls where iron rivets join the sheets of bronze and steel in the arachnid's body.  The smell of grease and metal is almost overwhelming, and a low thrum of machinery rumbles the floor beneath your feet.  A careless jumble of goods is displayed in this out of the way nook.

title: [[A Game of Chicken, Lobby]]
description: Every inch of this cube-shaped room is made from cold metal secured in place with rivets.  Several exposed pipes work their way through the ceiling, their seams and joints covered with rust.  The only piece of furniture is a large metallic desk, which is clean and polished to a mirror shine.

title: [[A Game of Chicken, Room of Judgement]]
description: Neat rows of hard metallic benches are lined up next to a large glass window in the western wall of the room.  From here, spectators can watch any mayhem happening down below in complete safety.  Only dim lighting provided by gaethzen orbs shines, most of it coming from the arena to allow for a better view.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: The low ceiling curves directly into the walls, making it difficult to discern where one ends and the other begins.  A deeply pitted and tarnished bronze slot machine is fused into the outer wall.

title: [[Outrageous Fortune, Salesroom]]
description: Two weapon racks, one of brass and the other of bronze, stand proudly in the middle of the smooth metal floor.  Nothing else impedes passageway through the stark room, as there are no other furnishings or decorations.

title: [[Bobbin' For Bolts]]
description: An assortment of quivers and bolt cases are nailed, lashed, or otherwise affixed to the walls and rafters of this cramped and excessively humid building.  Poor ventilation results in the combination of customers and "sales associates" smelling like a mixture of cucumbers, skunk, and old feet that have been wrapped in an unwashed loincloth, dipped in sour milk, and allowed to dry in the sun.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Nave]]
description: Whether by optical illusion or by some magical means, the unexpectedly high walls vault upward with columns of darkly stained maplewood that crisscross in elaborate patterns and showcase the surprisingly lofty and blindingly white ceilings.  Arching stained glass windows on either side appear to let in muted light of many colors.  A strip of dark red carpet runs down the center of several wooden pews, leading toward the cathedral's transept and wings.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Crossing]]
description: The ceiling here seems to be higher than the exterior would indicate or allow and is comprised of green-tinged, stained-glass panels arranged in offset rows.  A strategically but subtly lit, moderately sized altar stands in the middle of the crossing's aisle, flanked by rows of simple oak pews on the left and right.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Choir]]
description: The front rows of pews are curved to provide their occupants an optimal viewing angle from end to end.  Placed strategically in the open area in front of the large dais, a short rack for scrolls or hymnals has been placed for those latecomers unfortunate enough to not find an open seat.

title: [[Tending the Fold, East Wing]]
description: The floor of the east wing is sloped upward and the silverwood pews here are arranged amphitheatre style, with each row being slightly higher than the row in front of it.  A moderately sized altar is placed in the center of the wall behind the last row of pews and is surrounded by a set of gaethzen spheres that bathes each row in a warm glowing light.

title: [[Tending the Fold, West Wing]]
description: The floor of the west wing is sloped upward and three rows of ironwood pews here are arranged amphitheatre style, with each row being slightly higher than the row in front of it.  Placed in the center of the wall and looming over the last row of pews, a moderately sized altar is illuminated by several dimly burning torches.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Sanctuary]]
description: Two large banners flank either side of the pulpit, one depicting a large sword with an open, four-taloned claw pommel, the other decorated with a cascade of jagged, yellowish shards.  Several urns are arranged around the outside of the dais, filled to overflowing with arrangements of Queen-of-the-night lilies, Elven Tears, and Shar'nath flowers.  An ornate chest is located on a small decorative table placed a few steps behind the podium.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Presbytery]]
description: Located down the dais stairs behind the sanctuary, the presbytery provides access to quiet areas for private devotions of a more specific nature.  Banners, paintings, and small tapestries, all of which are decorated with a myriad of esoteric symbology, hang on the walls over slightly darkened archways.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Alcove]]
description: Walls inside the alcove are covered in tiny mosaic tiles that create an effective, albeit crude, illusion of being outdoors.  A mobile hangs from the ceiling and spins languidly, allowing several dangling clouds and birds to orbit overhead.  The floor is covered with woven grass mats and several small pots, filled with grasses and wildflowers, are arranged around the perimeter of the room.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Alcove]]
description: Situated on the back wall above the altar, an arched stained glass window depicts a lush green field and a sky of iridescent blue with a column of smoke in the distance.  Incised into the stonewalls on either side are butterflies, badgers and crows in scenes from Odcoru, their forms slightly hazy as if time has blurred memory.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Alcove]]
description: Stark, spartan walls enclose this alcove and reflect light from a gaethzen sphere mounted at the ceiling.  The floor is covered with harsh grey flagstones which have several signs and symbols scratched into them.

title: [[Tending the Fold, Alcove]]
description: Carved wood panels depicting a tranquil forest landscape cover the walls of the alcove, bordered with scrollwork of interlocked gears.  On one wall a beaver is shown dragging off fallen timber, while on the opposite wall a hare sits upright, watching from a cluster of low foliage.  A stained glass window shaped like a majestic oak against a sky of blue fills the center wall.  Closer examination reveals tiny grinning gremlins slipped into the imagery, peeking out from their hiding places.

title: [[The Thorax, Central Chamber]]
description: Sweltering heat permeates this room. Membranous bulges and conduits snake along the arcing walls, entering and exiting the room seemingly at random.  Visible within them is a faint bluish fluid that seems to surge by at a very high speed.  An overturned oil drum occupies the center of the floor surrounded by an assortment of rotting wooden crates in various stages of decay.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: Strange gases hiss from fleshy valves that dapple the arched ceiling, adding unwelcome heat to the already noxious air.  A dilapidated slot machine slumps against one wall, its precious silver trim now tarnished nearly black.

title: [[Jewelry in Phases]]
description: Crystal representations of Elanthia's moons hang from the dark velvet ceiling of the room, illuminated from within by burning oil lamps.  Silvery globes representing stars join them in celestial harmony, reflecting the multihued light over the glittering wares below.

title: [[Made for Walking]]
description: The smell of leather and polish permeates this large stall, creating a thick texture to the air.  Tables, shelves and racks crowd together, displaying wares.  In the center of the area, a glass display case holds a rather non-descript pair of boots.  A small note is tacked to the case's wooden base.

title: [[The Cutting Edge, By Ventidius]]
description: Inside a spacious room, clean rushes have been spread over the metal floor.  The merchandise for sale rests on three trestle tables -- one painted red, one blue and one green.  Aside from the plank tables and a ticket counter shoved in the corner, the room holds neither furniture nor decoration.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: Erratically shaped holes pockmark the chitinous floor, making navigation of this passageway difficult.  An acidic tang seems to belie the source of the damage.

title: [[Gearanimals, Main Room]]
description: Scattered across the floor is a light layer of metallic dust in a variety of shades.  Trails of cleaner ground snake through the debris, forming intricate patterns in the dust.  Nothing else decorates the bare iron walls or floor.

title: [[Beastly Behavior]]
description: Tree branches and underbrush, some beginning to wilt, have been set up along the metal walls to give an impression of the wild as a backdrop for the shop's wares.  An iron rack and an oak rack hold a variety of furs that have been tanned but otherwise retain much of the appearance of life -- complete with teeth and claws!

title: [[Heikea, Food Display]]
description: Nestled in among the various furniture displays visible in the background, this corner of the shop offers refreshments prepared by the resident chef.  Tables and chairs provide a place to relax and enjoy one's meal before resuming the shopping excursion.

title: [[The Thorax, Corridor]]
description: The walls here have been dangerously eroded by putrid gases that rises into the air from valves near the floor.  A decrepit silver-trimmed slot machine sits within a naturally occurring niche along the interior wall.

title: [[Behind the Mask, Foyer]]
description: Jewel-toned silks drape this area of the shop, creating a foyer in which the artisan has chosen to display numerous individual masks available for purchase.  Two sets of cushioned hooks line the side walls, and a table draped in velvet rests directly opposite the door.  A single lantern hanging from the ceiling provides light for shoppers.

title: [[Behind the Mask, For the Gentlemen]]
description: Midnight blue silks drape this portion of the shop, creating a separate showroom for the attire displayed on the mannequins here.  No other decor is present to distract the eye from the merchandise available for purchase, save for a single lantern hanging from the ceiling.

title: [[Behind the Mask, For the Ladies]]
description: Soft ivory silks drape this portion of the shop, creating a separate showroom for the attire displayed on the mannequins here.  No other decor is present to distract the eye from the merchandise available for purchase, save for a single lantern hanging from the ceiling.

title: [[Behind the Mask, Treasures]]
description: Black silks drape this area of the shop.  The light from the lantern overhead shines on the masks featured in the cases, and is scattered in a sparkling display of color by the inlaid gemstones in the artisan's creations.

title: [[Entrail Toss Arena, Entrance]]
description: A series of bulky tarpaulins conceals the Entrail Toss Arena.  The thick sheets of canvas are painted with a large blood-spattered skeleton wielding a formidable scimitar in a variety of garish scenes and morbid encounters.  Covering the ground in a messy layer, dusty straw clumps together in an attempt to soak up any excess bodily fluids tracked from inside.

title: [[Entrail Toss Arena, Fling Ring]]
description: Heavy canvas tarpaulins stained with sticky sanguine smears envelop the oblong area.  The floor is covered with masses of damp straw, thick with globs of gore and bile from the dripping entrails chucked about the room.  At the far end of the arena, a rickety wooden stand exhibits a skeleton of ambiguous origin.  A line of stacked hay bales separates the contestants from the target, and the bucket o' guts sits conspicuously in front of the barrier.

title: [[Entrail Toss Arena, Grub Hub]]
description: In a chaotic attempt at decoration, several smooth, furred, and scaled skins hang slapdash along the canvas interior.  A mess of dingy straw covers the floor, dank and rotting like the rest of the miserable decor.  Filled with not-so-exotic delicacies, a stained bloodwood counter is stationed opposite a small souvenir table so that patrons may pick and choose between the two at their leisure.

title: [[Natural Selections, On Your Guard]]
description: Skulls of strange creatures and beasts hang overhead from pieces of sinew, each one free of any remnants of their previous owners.  Various furs are splayed along the floor, cushioning the footfalls of visitors into the room.  Painted upon the walls are depictions of conquests and adventures within the wilds of the lands.

title: [[Natural Selections, Fang and Claw]]
description: Furs are littered about the floor, hiding only portions of the metal floor.  Overhead, an oil lantern brightens the area and provides light for a tapestry that covers the wall.  Adjacent to the tapestry is a small, well cared for tree planted in a ceramic pot.

title: [[Natural Selections, Below the Belt]]
description: Figurines depicting various scenes of violence sit on a small end table beside the metal wall.  Attached to a metal bolt is a lantern that puts the products for sale under bright light.  Several skins have been placed on the ground, cushioning customers' feet from the bare metal flooring.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: The curved walls here are entirely smooth, transitioning from chitin to metal and back again with seemingly organic flow.  A platinum-trimmed slot machine has been neatly set flush against the interior wall.

title: [[Masquer Aid, The Costume Cupboard]]
description: A long and broad table is lit by torches on the walls of the room.  For those who feel uncomfortable in enclosed spaces, a big landscape of Dirge is hung on one wall, counterfeiting a window.

title: [[Mordiv's Fun House, Peculiar Parlor]]
description: Bold stripes decorate the entire room, their alternating colors vibrant and glossy thanks to several oil lamps.  A scarlet-draped counter is positioned with a matching bookcase along one wall, while a table sits beneath the painting hung upon another.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: Dark and gleaming, the smooth flesh of the walls looks nearly as tough as the tomiek floor itself.  A battered, silver-trimmed slot machine leans against one wall, its metal partially fused to the living matter behind it.

title: [[The Thorax, Leg Junction]]
description: A luminous green fluid seeps from a crack near the ceiling, sliding down the wall in a sickly rivulet before disappearing into the darkness that lies beyond the grated floor.

title: [[Mob Mentality, Dilapidated Showroom]]
description: Rusting walls drip water in the corners, with spiders lurking where they can find a dry niche.  Several broken barrels and crates compete for floor space in front of poorly constructed wooden furniture.  The wares on display appear to belong in a farmer's toolshed, and given the scraggly appearance of the shifty-eyed sales clerks, they may once have been found there.

title: [[Mob Mentality, Effigies of Power]]
description: Patchwork silks conceal the walls of this portion of the shop, giving it a more refined feel -- until one notices the blackened metal through some of the more poorly-stitched seams.  A crate draped in scarves displays some wares available for sale, while others are set out upon shelves.

title: [[Wicked Windows]]
description: Thirteen stained-glass windows are displayed in frames around the dim room, with lamps set behind them to show their sullen colors to best advantage.  The subjects of the windows lend an air of apprehension -- almost of foreboding -- to the shop.  A prominent sign hangs on one wall.

title: [[Objective Oriels]]
description: Thirteen stained-glass windows are carefully placed around the room, artistically arranged with lamps behind them to show their brilliant colors to best advantage.  The subjects of the windows lend an air of solemnity -- almost of reverence -- to the shop.  A prominent sign hangs on one wall.

title: [[Saintly Skylights]]
description: Thirteen stained-glass windows are carefully placed around the room, artistically arranged with lamps behind them to show their brilliant colors to best advantage.  The subjects of the windows lend an air of solemnity -- almost of reverence -- to the shop.  A prominent sign hangs on one wall.

title: [[Farther Heavens]]
description: Nine stained-glass windows are carefully placed around the room, artistically arranged with lamps behind them to show their brilliant colors to their best advantage.  The subjects of the windows lend an air of solemnity -- almost of reverence -- to the shop.  A prominent sign hangs on one wall.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Softer, near-translucent flesh throbs overhead, the muscles contracting to transport some sort of fluid to other areas of this logic-defying beast.  On one glistening, dark wall, a patch of bronze is visibly melded into the surrounding living matter, its presence a clear reminder of the creature's strange nature.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Overwhelming the tight corridor is a convoluted network of membranous bulges and conduits that converges in a nexus along the northern wall.  Every so often, a spasm of muscular movement ripples through them, causing the walls to vibrate.

title: [[Ratchet Shack, Front Room]]
description: Nothing has been hung to disguise the metallic walls or soften the sharp edges of the enclosed space.  A sturdy counter crafted from flattened gears and sprockets stands to one side, while austure wooden racks display the merchandise.

title: [[Ratchet Shack, Back Room]]
description: Tucked into a space under part of the engine room, this small area is set aside for storage.  Boxes and crates spill out over the floor, jumbled together indsicrimately.

title: [[Jade Cavern, Vestibule]]
description: Elaborate stone carvings arch overhead, twisting into fascinating shapes.  Tall columns crafted from translucent jade flank the walls that lead further west into the heart of the caverns.

title: [[Holey Warez, Salesfloor]]
description: Unidentified stains mar the polished metal walls and floor, mixed amongst gouges and scratches.  A grime-covered counter stands to one side of the room, serving the sales force as the center of operations.  Rickety racks and stands are scattered about the rest of the shop, displaying the merchandise.

title: [[Nest o' Snakes]]
description: The walls are covered with stripes of scaly patterned skins, giving the impression that one is surrounded by huge snakes.  Overall the effect is rather dizzying and tends to draw the eye toward the displays in the center of room, if only for relief.

title: [[Silken Seams, Showroom]]
description: Stained oak panels line the walls, giving the shop a distinctly warmer feel than the metallic corridors beyond the door.  Polished brass sconces lend a soft glow to the room overall, while gaethzen lanterns add focused light for the displays.  An elegant clavichord with a matching bench stands in the center of the floor, awaiting play by a bard employed for that purpose.

title: [[Silken Garden, Entry]]
description: Red curtains painted with a brick pattern hang from ceiling to floor, creating a small half-circle entryway.  A white arbor draped with curling tendrils of silken honeysuckle is nestled to one side, leading further into the shop.  Angled opposite that, a dark arch choked with twining green cotton poison ivy leads to a separate section.

title: [[Silken Garden, Flower Patch]]
description: Cushioned green fabric carpets the floor, dotted with white satin daisies.  A short white fence lines the blue painted metal walls, silken vines spiraling up the wooden pickets.  Suspended from the ceiling are puffy cotton clouds surrounding a large golden lantern in the center of the room.

title: [[Silken Garden, Poison Patch]]
description: Dead branches hang from the ceiling, their twigs reaching toward the rusted metal floor like skeletal fingers.  Old, rusty lanterns are suspended from some of the limbs, their flickering light casting eerie shadows through the boughs.  The walls are covered with silken vines of poison ivy along with bunches of nightshade, monkshood and other flowering plants sewn from various weaves of cloth.

title: [[Ang'hhsmus]]
description: From floor to ceiling, each wall of this room is swathed in rich golden brocade accented with a vivid crimson rococo leaf motif.  An elaborate golden chandelier hangs from the center of the ceiling, each arm dangling dozens of shining fire opals that dapple the room with splashes of brilliant color.  A plush carpet muffles the floor, its colorful pile dense and luxurious underfoot.  In each corner, a small stand holds a tray of smoldering incense, the spicy citrus scent filling the room.

title: [[The Stylish Stallion, Salesroom]]
description: Weathered barn boards have been nailed together to form a paneling that totally covers the metal walls and ceiling.  One side of the room has been painted with a row of horse stalls, complimenting the other images painted around the room to recreate the appearance of a public stable.  A layer of straw carpets the floor, releasing its grassy scent into the air when stepped on by shoppers perusing the merchandise displayed for sale.

title: [[The Archivist, Showroom]]
description: Large canvas paintings depicting oak shelving have been stretched across the walls of this room.  Thousands of books, scrolls and parchments fill the shelves, giving the impression of an enormous library.  A detailed mural on the ceiling depicts a group of scholars in lively debate over some topic of interest.  Numerous attendants carrying armloads of scrolls deposit them on a large wooden crate before returning to the back room to retrieve more merchandise.

title: [[Cute as a Button]]
description: Flowing curtains of various textures and colors of scrap cloth hang around the walls, dotted with hundreds of assorted buttons.  A spiraling lantern with strings of translucent multihued buttons is suspended from the center of the ceiling, shedding colorful light over the goods on the table below.

title: [[The Head, Access Hatch]]
description: The curved walls here are entirely smooth, transitioning from chitin to metal and back again with seemingly organic flow.  The steel access hatch stands open to allow easy passage to and fro, its squashed ovoid shape reminiscent of a chicken's egg.  A pair of short hallways lead to the left and the right, their translucent floors giving glimpses into the creature's inner workings.

title: [[The Head, Right Chamber]]
description: The curved walls here are entirely smooth, transitioning from chitin to metal and back again with seemingly organic flow.  Underfoot, the translucent nature of the floor gives visibility to all manner of pulsating organs awash in bluish fluid.

title: [[The Head, Left Chamber]]
description: The curved walls here are entirely smooth, transitioning from chitin to metal and back again with seemingly organic flow.  Underfoot, the translucent nature of the floor gives visibility to all manner of pulsating organs awash in bluish fluid.

title: [[The Arachnid's Head, Harawep's Messengers]]
description: The curved walls here are entirely smooth, transitioning from chitin to metal and back again with seemingly organic flow.  The composite materials gleam all around you, their brilliant shine offsetting a centralized control panel.  In front of the brushed steel controls is a pair of large bowl-shaped seats.

title: [[The Upper Abdomen, Hatch]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  A scraggly potted plum tree stands next to a polished metal bench and directly across from a heavy iron hatch that allows passage from the abdomen to the thorax.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Several groups of guests gather around the entrance of the raffle center, each eagerly waiting for the next event to begin.  A bronze plaque is fused into the wall near the large iron arch.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, Raffle Center]]
description: The gleaming chitinous walls of the room easily reflect the light of the hanging lanterns.  A wide granite counter sits on this side of a canvas curtain dividing the interior space into two rooms, preventing the casual peruser from seeing the cache of prizes beyond.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Circling the corridor is a large spiraling tomiek ramp that leads to the lower level of the abdomen, the dark metal fusing seamlessly to the surrounding living matter.  A large sign has been placed at the entrance of the ramp.

title: [[The Upper Abdomen, Lounge]]
description: Dominating the center of this round room is a large circular pillar of flesh that runs from floor to ceiling.  Sunk into the pillar on opposite sides are a pair of food and beverage stands.  Disgruntled-looking Dwarves stomp back and forth behind the counters, serving their wares to the guests in line.  Surrounding the eatery are several steel tables with matching chairs, each a vibrant shade of tangerine.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Eagle Eye, Main Room]]
description: Feathers dangle from strings attached to the ceiling, twirling in the slightest breeze.  Green carpets cover the floor and hide the metallic deck while wooden racks and stands display the merchandise.

title: [[Creature Comforts, Central Sales Floor]]
description: The spacious sales floor offers a display of this year's finest set up to entice shoppers.  The theme of the set is instantly apparent, as various types of furniture are represented, all crafted from skillfully preserved and stuffed bears.  A flighty and waxen-faced attendant makes her way around the display, occasionally stopping to pet one of the ex-creatures.

title: [[Creature Comforts, West Wing]]
description: Thin rugs cover the wooden floor, and perched upon them are a dozen tables and beds, arranged for optimal viewing.  A gaunt attendant stares dazedly at nothing, taking a passive approach to selling.  A cloying odor of wood polish and preserving chemicals chokes the air.

title: [[Creature Comforts, East Wing]]
description: Though this room is smaller than the central sales floor, it is nonetheless packed with chairs and benches.  Stuffed and mounted creatures crowd above the display furniture.

title: [[Birds of a Feather, Showroom]]
description: Feather fuzz covers every inch of the dark wooden floor, and each step one takes kicks some of the stuff into the air to float lazily before finding a new surface to cling to.  A stout wooden table bearing folded clothing for sale sits imposingly in the middle of the sales floor, though at a slight off-center angle.  Along one end of the room, wooden poles and jewelry trees lean precariously against one another and the walls.  A cloak rack and a wooden mannequin with a cardinal's head stand together on the other side of the shop, partially obscuring a recessed alcove.

title: [[The Toy Box, Showroom]]
description: This tiny shop stocks a variety of toys, knickknacks and festival items from Gnomish merchants.  It also offers a selection of some of their most popular reading matter.

title: [[Acaph's Acquisitions, Foyer]]
description: This simple metal room is bare of any decorations save a large sign that dominates the center of the room and forces customers to squeeze around to continue into the shop.  Due to the narrow walking space and those customers stopping to read the sign, there is much congestion and a waiting line to get inside.

title: [[Acaph's Acquisitions, Wilderness Glade]]
description: The surrounding walls have been painted with an encompassing mural of a forested glade.  Birds, squirrels, raccoons and other wildlife can be seen watching you from the various foilage.

title: [[Acaph's Acquisitions, Hall of Valor]]
description: The walls of this narrow hallway have been painted to resemble stones and large faded tapestries hang on each side.  Five armor racks shaped like humanoids display the wares available for purchase, with each rack displaying a message upon its base.

title: [[Bobbing for Leeches]]
description: Light from the flap barely penetrates the gloom.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  A trio of thin jets of steam spews forth from one of the tubes, as if venting internal gases no longer needed.

title: [[All Wound Up, Sales Floor]]
description: Immaculately clean, the grey metal walls and bare floor shine in the light of the hanging lantern above.  The spacious area is underutilized, as only a tall table and dented pine chest sit on the floor.  Attached to the wall is a toy shelf, displaying all kinds of whimsical mechanical creations.

title: [[Eye Spy]]
description: Little more than a closet, this tiny room is lit by what can only charitably called a chandelier -- a simple chain hanging from the ceiling supporting a dirty and chipped lantern.  A crooked bookshelf huddles in one of the sharp corners, the top shelf and middle shelf displaying spectacles for sale.  A squat table holds several wooden heads that are wearing armored goggles, though several of the other display mannequins must sit on the dusty floor beneath the table for lack of room.

title: [[Slay It With Music]]
description: The shop is obviously having a plumbing problem.  Duckboards are laid out in the room so that patrons don't have to step in the inch of water sloshing across the floor and gurgling down a drain.  Pipes run across the ceiling and along the walls, their joints spitting small clouds of steam from time to time.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: The crowds bottleneck at a thick steel door that is fused into the now spiked and ridged chitin of the walls.  A pair of surly Gor'Tog guards flank the entrance of the First Arachnid Bank, eyeing everyone that passes with a suspicious leer.

title: [[The Upper Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  Several shoppers gather excitedly at the archway nearby, hoping to catch the next merchant in time for some custom work.

title: [[First Arachnid Bank, Lobby]]
description: Clerks bustle about the tiny room, carrying bags of coins to and from the vault under the eye of a guard.  A teller stands behind a counter at one side of the room.  At the other end, the exchange room stands open for those with other transactions.

title: [[First Arachnid Bank, Currency Exchange]]
description: This small room holds the official money-changing office for the Miracle of Harawep.  The clerk works behind a thickly barred window and operates a small drawer that is used to pass money back and forth.  A strange, chitin-covered mass rises up from the floor near one wall, its slightly indented form providing seating for those waiting on the busy clerks.

title: [[First Arachnid Bank, Foreign Exchange]]
description: For the convenience of guests, the First Arachnid Bank employs mages who, under the careful scrutiny of the guards, maintain moongates between the various banks, running the length and breadth of realms.  These gates allow customers to effortlessly transfer money from other banks, saving their customers time as well as protecting their purses from the hazards of the road.

title: [[The Upper Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of vein-like tubes runs from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of flesh fused with dark metal.  The churning noises from the tubes overhead cause cautious shoppers to glance warily upwards as they pass.

title: [[The Upper Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick chitinous walls bear what looks like bristly fur in some spots of this spacious hallway.  Melded perfectly into the surrounding living matter, a steel-banded bronze door is flanked by a pair of potted grapevines.  Hanging next to the door is a polished brass plaque.

title: [[Vatari's Ritual Addiction, Permanent Fixes]]
description: Smooth leather walls of overlaid straps with silver studs rise up around a dark haon floor.  Dim sconces cast irregular shadows across the room, revealing a collection of haphazardly arranged tables.  A curtain of dangling chains hangs along the backwall.

title: [[Something's Fishy]]
description: Large salt-stained nets are draped around the metal walls, dotted with carefully preserved specimens from the sea.  A large chandelier crafted from a ship's wheel hangs from the center of the ceiling, shedding light on the goods below.

title: [[Magical Minions, Creatures from Afar]]
description: A vibrant backdrop circles the front room of the wagon, creating faux environments around a lush tree with silken leaves and a miniature sand barge.  Centered along the eastern side of the room in front of a fanciful backdrop, a painted stool sits next to a deep mahogany table just below an ebonwood shelf.

title: [[Magical Minions, Tiny Toys]]
description: Fantastical drawings of curling towers and flower filled forests cover the walls.  Depicted frolicking between the trees or flying through the clouds around the castles are all sorts of fuzzy, winged and scaled creatures.  Dangling at different lengths from the ceiling are colorful baskets.

title: [[Magical Minions, In the Waves]]
description: A vibrant backdrop circles the room, creating faux environments around a lush kelp forest with silken fronds and a miniature coral reef.  Centered along the eastern side of the room, an enormous open oyster shell sits next to a driftwood plank.

title: [[Magical Minions, Circus Toys]]
description: Swathes of alternating red and gold silk drape from the center of the ceiling, creating a cheerful tent-like atmosphere, while circus murals decorate the walls with bright splashes of color.  A gaily painted grandstand faces a square stage and a round platform for prime viewing.

title: [[The Faithful Defender, Gallery]]
description: Lavish, gold-threaded brocades drape the gallery in elegant splendor while thick, cerulean carpets blanket the area for the many shoppers, casually perusing the various consignments.  A multi-tiered chandelier, set with amber-colored gaethzen orbs, casts a soft golden hue over several ornately carved racks that line the perimeter and gleaming weapons that decorate the walls.

title: [[Famous Last Words]]
description: The walls and ceiling are of brushed metal oiled to a gleam, and the floor is covered in narrow maple planking.  The center of the room is dominated by a circle of varnished oak easels with gear-shaped bronze fittings, suggesting an art gallery rather than a shop.

title: [[Focus on the Past, Relic Room]]
description: Several soil-stained packing crates stacked along the back encroach towards the interior at random intervals, detracting from the otherwise orderly desk where recent finds are cataloged.  Various shelves and bookcases occupy much of the remaining space, holding artifacts marked and tagged from previous expeditions.  A slight mustiness lingers in the air, infusing the room with the dampness imagined held within the tomb or temple where these artifacts originated.

title: [[Looty Booty, Salesfloor]]
description: Glass-fronted wooden cabinets line the walls, their black velvet-covered shelves displaying the exquisite wares to a well-heeled clientele.  The pale woods of the paneling and floor provide a sharp contrast to the plush ebony-hued shelving.  Genteel salespeople unobtrusively wait to help the patrons with their selections.

title: [[Merchant Lounge, Lobby]]
description: Brightly dyed lengths of silk hang haphazardly on the walls, allowing sections of gleaming chitin to peek through in places.  Spanning the far wall of this makeshift lobby are four metal doors painted bright red, yellow, blue and green. Chintz cushions placed around the area facilitate a more comfortable wait for patrons.

title: [[The Spidersilk Bridge]]
description: Spanning the width between the massive arachnid and the smaller metallic arachnid to the east, the bridge is mostly a tube of spidersilk with thin wooden slats reinforcing its floor, and it reaches a dizzying height in the air.  Far below, the green foliage is dwarfed by the enormous size of the two creations.
tags: meta:mapname:Event - Hollow Eve Festival Baby Spider

title: [[The Spidersilk Bridge]]
description: Spanning the width between the massive arachnid and the smaller metallic arachnid to the east, the bridge is mostly a tube of spidersilk with thin wooden slats reinforcing its floor, and it reaches a dizzying height in the air.  Far below, the green foliage is dwarfed by the enormous size of the two creations.

title: [[The Spidersilk Bridge]]
description: Spanning the width between the massive arachnid and the smaller metallic arachnid to the east, the bridge is mostly a tube of spidersilk with thin wooden slats reinforcing its floor, and it reaches a dizzying height in the air.  Far below, the green foliage is dwarfed by the enormous size of the two creations.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the west, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  A makeshift radiator vents heat from the eastern wall, water dripping into a pan underneath.

title: [[Jade Cavern, Dark Passage]]
description: The walls are gouged and scratched, chunks of rock ripped from the once-polished and painted murals.  Fragments of tile lie shattered on the floor, crunching at the lightest touch.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the west, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  The blades of a fan turn lazily in the western wall, venting heat away from the corridor.

title: [[The Fashionable Panda, Panda One]]
description: The room is enclosed with rice screen panels depicting a frolicking panda cub throwing delicately hued cherry blossoms into the air.  Painted pink petals seem to float in lazy drifts and swirls in the air above an arrangement of low tables.  Woven bamboo mats cover the floor.

title: [[The Fashionable Panda, Panda Too]]
description: Thin ricepaper screens stand in front of the walls, lending the room an exotic air.  A trio of pandas tumble through a bamboo forest in several of the panels, but appear to be taking a well-deserved nap in the final panel as they curl together to form a black-and-white mound.  Curved to create a circle, tables are set in the middle of the mat covered floor.

title: [[The Fashionable Panda, Panda For You]]
description: Several delicate ricepaper wall screens depict nighttime scenes of panda cubs sleeping in seemingly boneless, uncomfortable-looking huddles.  A final panel depicts the moons shining down on a lone panda cub in pursuit of a bamboo stalk tied to a string as a second baby panda pulls it away.  Centered in the room are long tables of varying woods.

title: [[The Fashionable Panda, Panda Tree]]
description: Draping silk forms colorful scallops above ricepaper screens set along the walls.  Most of the panels depict a calm scene of plum trees, but one is painted with a panda cub wearing a mask as she chases three others as they roll and tumble away.  Placed at angles to each other, smoothly polished tables rest upon the bamboo mats used to cover the dull steel floor.

title: [[Tildi's Blooms, The Hollow]]
description: Curling silversteel vines wind upward from the floor to spread out across the walls and ceiling of this dome-shaped room.  Gem flowers of topaz, alexandrite and ruby partly hide among the many leaves that sprout from the thorn covered tendrils.  Backlighted blue glass gives the impression of a boundless sky behind the creepers.  On one side the vines twine together to create an open archway, while in other spots giant-sized leaves are crafted into shelves.  A rug the color of new grass completely covers the floor.

title: [[Tildi's Blooms, Annex]]
description: Smoky glass is used to cover the metal walls and ceiling mimicking a cloudy night's sky.  Tiny lights inserted behind the glass help to give the impression of distant stars peeking through the cloud cover.  Draping from a center point on the ceiling is a square-seated swing with green ropes the hue of new leaves.  A low ground cover of blackberry vines made from silversteel twist together to create unique stands and tables made from brambles and leaves.

title: [[Tildi's Blooms, Bugs and Flowers]]
description: In soft oranges, yellows and golds, variegated glass creates the appearance of a sunrise up the walls and onto the ceiling.  Lights are placed along the bottom edge of the walls to further the illusion, leaving the glass up high darker as the true sky would be with the first touches of the morning light.  An oversized rose, daisy, lotus and poppy stand in each corner of the room.  Made from different metals, they spread their fake petals wide to form the sales surfaces.

title: [[Tildi's Blooms, Picnic in the Garden]]
description: Lush grass has somehow been grown inside this room with walls painted to resemble a verdant garden.  Dangling from a ceiling designed to have the look of a gathering storm are puffy clouds that way back and forth with any movement of the air.  A sturdy mistwood picnic table covered in a checkered cloth resides in the center of the area with a cluster of colorfully painted garden gremlins gathered near one end.  A squat pineapple yellow bench sits against one wall bordered on either side by a fluted marble birdbath and a bumbershoot stand splattered with lime green paint.  Up against another wall is a rustic whitewashed cutlery cabinet that appears to be leaning to one side.  A spun glitter quilt is spread out in one of the open spaces upon the soft grasses.

title: [[This Little Piggy, Stayed Home]]
description: Bright green paint creates lush hills of soft-looking grasses upon the walls.  A few trees dapple the rolling fields giving shade for the many hogs that are depicted frolicking, napping or nibbling from silver platters.  A pack of proud peccary appear to have taken control over one of the hills and a slightly larger brown swine is perched at the peak while wearing a shiny silver crown.  Set in the middle of the room are brightly polished wooden tables.  A doorway carved with yet more pigs leads out of the shop.

title: [[This Little Piggy, Went To Market]]
description: A mural takes over all four walls, its pictures showing a bustling marketplace full of colorfully painted stalls draped with ribbons.  Instead of the usual customers, the streets are full of pigs in all sizes and hues with their backs supporting shopping baskets and bags.  On either side of the room, an actual stall is built.  One is bright blue with tiny flowers decorating it, while the other is grapefruit-pink and designed to look like a dresser of drawers, each one a different metal.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Back Abdomen]]
description: The floor slopes southward in a noticeable manner, following the unsupported back of the clockwork Arachnid's abdomen.  Interlocking plates above form a thin shell of a ceiling, entirely devoid of pipes and gears.  A few throw rugs are laid out on the metal plating, making the sloping floor a bit less treacherous.

title: [[The Other Siegery Shop]]
description: Elaborate tapestries hang from the four walls in colorful banners.  Each is decorated with an army marching over fields and meadows, ready to clash with an opposing army on the opposite banner.  Incandescent lights hang from the ceiling, illuminating numerous tables filled with miniature figures and a lone shelf with sets for sale.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the east, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  A large framed blueprint hangs on the wall between the pillars, marked up with complicated formulas and diagrams of the machinery.

title: [[Jade Cavern, Small Opening]]
description: Luminescent walls of rough green jade curve around you, the cupped, smooth hands of the earth.  A path chisled into the stone floor leads east.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the east, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  A steel plate on the western wall has a number of odd switches, and is protected by a clear glass case surrounding it.

title: [[Hair Apparent, Sales Floor]]
description: Lush velvet panels cover the walls and ceiling of the room, while thick carpets cover the floors, dampening the sound of any footsteps.  Simple lanterns illuminate the wares, the scented oil within them permeating the area with heady spice notes.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the east, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  Triangular ceramic tiles interlock with each other to form the floor, alternating between blue and white colors.

title: [[By the Book, Sales Floor]]
description: The scent of a well-stocked library fills the area, with wood paneling painted to resemble full bookcases lining the walls.  Overhead, lanterns are interspersed among open books, hung to appear as if they are flying.  A large area rug covers the floor, embellished with unreadable script.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Forward Abdomen]]
description: Numerous metal rings are partially encased in rubber, forming the bulk of the northeastern wall and giving structure to the abdomen.  Glass plates in the floor enclose interlocking gears that turn with a steady pace.  A small steam engine merrily whirrs away in the corner, making the passageway feel quite humid.

title: [[Which Craft, Sitting Room]]
description: A crooked brick fireplace stands against a stone-textured wall, cold and bare except for an empty cauldron inside.  The area in front of the fireplace is dominated by a large, dusty floral-patterned sofa and an area rug, covered in ruddy stains.  Light flickers from a twisted iron chandelier above, hanging precariously from a nearly broken chain.  Everything is draped with a fine veil of cobwebs, with the exception of the goods for sale.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Item Registrar]]
description: A large metal arch domes at the end of this small hallway, and several mismatched throw rugs are thrown hastily onto the floor.  Evenly spaced rivets go up and down the walls to hold the paneling together, which is made from several different kinds of scrap metal.  Harsh white lamps light up the walls from each corner, illuminating the area well.

title: [[Item Registration]]
description: Filing cabinets and slanted metal shelves line the walls from end to end, stuffed full of papers and badly organized notes.   A large desk dominates the center of the room, with a clockwork contraption seated behind it.  Several papers are strewn about on the floor, most of them crushed into the metal grating that houses the machinery in the bowels of the spider.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the domed ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping short of the concave dome high above.  Three sturdy bars cover a heavily reinforced porthole of glass in one wall, and little can be seen past it except the occasional splash of water hitting its interior.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping short of the concave dome high above.  A large spherical window juts out from the southern wall, enclosing a piece of machinery that occasionally fogs up the glass interior with steam.

title: [[ScallyWags]]
description: A heavy canine odor hangs in the air of this wood-paneled room, its walls covered with ropes, nets, and various nautical devices.  Centered on the back wall is a large black flag emblazoned with a skull and crossbones, lit by a chandelier crafted from a ship's wheel hanging overhead.

title: [[Crypticats, Front Room]]
description: Furniture of ebony and deeply colored fabrics is scattered haphazardly around the room, covered in cat hair and dust as if left unused for a significant time.  A cobweb-covered chandelier hangs over head, casting dim, flickering light across the purple and green stripes covering the walls, which are so dark they almost look black.  Shredded curtains frame a painted window on one wall, an overly large full moon behind its false, glossy pane.  From behind a door in the back wall, a blood-curdling yowl emanates every few moments, alternating with long, slow scratches down the wood.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the domed ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping short of the concave dome high above.  One of the metal sheets high above looks quite a lot newer than the others, its shiny surface standing out among the duller plates surrounding it.

title: [[Women at Arms Annex, Sales floor]]
description: Someone has painted the metal walls a cheery yellow shade, attempting to transform the bare room into an oasis of warmth and color.  Floor-length mirrors provide ways for the patrons to see the merchandise while being worn.  Scattered across the floor are thick wool carpets that support a number of mannequins displaying the shop's wares.

title: [[Chizelli's Charms, Showroom]]
description: This shop's metal walls are gaily painted with vines and flowers, while luxuriously woven carpets cushion the polished wood floor.  Finely crafted built-in cabinets line the walls, their sliding wood doors thrown open to display racks of velvet-lined cases filled with charms of every description.  A cat perches atop one of the cabinets, its slitted green eyes gazing intently at a set of delicate crystal chimes suspended from the ceiling.

title: [[Aerial Artistry, Paint It On]]
description: A rainbow of colors appears to be splashed across the walls, each section displaying drip marks and bits of splatter from the bordering sections.  Four platforms in red, yellow, green and blue are evenly spaced around the room, holding small jars, vials and boxes.  Taking up most of the space in the middle of the area is a black mat with a set of ocean-hued silks suspended above it.

title: [[Aerial Artistry, Featureless]]
description: Masks of all shapes and sizes cover the walls, appearing to show no order to their placement.  They create a riot of colors and expressions around the area.  Set in the center of the room is a red mat that has a set of orange aerial straps hanging over it, their ends just inches above the surface.  Placed carefully to create plenty of space around the set up are painted stands.

title: [[Aerial Artistry, Trapeze Yourself]]
description: Alternating black and white silks are draped down the walls, while a single huge mirror covers the ceiling to reflect back the whole of the room to whomever looks up.  Sturdy and spacious tables are neatly arranged to show off their wares, each table holding a different style of trapeze for the home.

title: [[Aerial Artistry, Aerial At Home]]
description: In all different hues, panels of silk are draped from a single point on the ceiling to give the impression of being inside of a circus tent.  Lights are placed behind them to give the area a soft, colorful glow.  Large tables are set up around the room, their surfaces covered with varying aerial apparatuses, leaving no room for anything else.
In all different hues, panels of silk are draped from a single point on the ceiling, while lights are placed behind them to give the area a soft, colorful glow.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Forward Abdomen]]
description: The maze of corridors centers on a crossroads, with a large pipe leading northward into the sternum, while the east, west, and south branches of the halls venture into the Arachnid's abdomen.  Cobwebs drape from the low ceiling and clog the corners, making use of the numerous nooks and crannies that dot the spider's metal interior.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[All in Good Tome, Good Reads]]
description: The room, a cheery tribute to the color spectrum, smells of rich leather, fine linen, and dry parchment.  Paper mache flooring mixed in with rainbow glitter covers the ground and continues halfway up the walls where they connect with ivory walls.  The ceiling boasts four gaethzen hemispheres, one in each corner, that provide a warm, even light.

title: [[All in Good Tome, Unpublished]]
description: The room, a blank canvas in stark white, smells of new parchment and vellum.  Woven papyrus reeds cover the floor and continue halfway up the walls where they connect with unpigmented plaster.  The ceiling boasts four gaethzen hemispheres, one in each corner, that provide a warm, even light.

title: [[All in Good Tome, Reference]]
description: The room, a monochromatic tribute to the shade of grey, smells of rich leather, fine linen, and dry paper.  Roughened limestone tiles cover the floor and continue halfway up the walls where they connect with the slightly lighter painted walls.  The ceiling boasts four gaethzen hemispheres, one in each corner, that provide a warm, even light.

title: [[All in Good Tome, Reading Nook]]
description: The room, a peaceful neutral zone, smells of rich leather, fine linen, and dry parchment.  Plush carpeting and insulated walls do their best to create a quiet environment that is ideal for reading.  The ceiling boasts four gaethzen hemispheres, one in each corner, that provide a warm, even light.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Sternum]]
description: The ceiling is quite low and flat in this area of the spider, and slightly convex to shield whatever machinery drives the internal trappings of the massive construct.  Large metal columns rise here and there in the open area, riveted together with bolts at even intervals.  The corridor narrows to the south, leading into the arachnid's abdomen.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Forward Abdomen]]
description: Numerous metal rings are partially encased in rubber, forming the bulk of the northwestern wall and giving structure to the abdomen.  Glass plates in the floor enclose interlocking gears that turn with a steady pace.  A long groove holds ball bearings inside the wall, allowing a portion of the metal plating to turn easily and support whatever mechanism lies behind it.

title: [[Tea For Tamsine, Entrance]]
description: The entrance to this well-lit shop is framed in soft curtains of petalette, the shimmery rose-hued fabric complements the ivory and gold floral pattern that covers the walls.  A small table rests next to the small hearth burning brightly in the center of the room, while a gilded drink cart sits in the corner.

title: [[Storms of Silk, Front Showroom]]
description: Lavish banners of storm-grey and silver silks enfold the elegantly appointed foyer of this upscale storefront.  High-collared Elothean salesmen glide tirelessly among the mannequins on the showroom floor, preaching the 'finest fashions from Katamba's Crescent to Moonstone Street' with dutiful and unflagging conviction.  A stately notice has been posted near the passage leading north.

title: [[Storms of Silk, Passageway]]
description: A short hallway of lustrous copperwood paneling connects the shop's two main showrooms.  With quiet dignity, a row of wooden mannequins display their more modest wares here for patrons of the well-to-do working class.

title: [[Storms of Silk, Back Showroom]]
description: Strings of gaethzen fireflies suspended among swaths of fiery orange silk create a cozy effect of artificial sunset here in the shop's rear showroom.  Along the northern wall, a row of armored mannequins solemnly proffer their wares in the dusky light.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the domed ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping short of the concave dome high above.  A large metal barrel is built into the floor, capped securely with a slightly domed lid and stained black in patches.

title: [[The Laughing Nomlas, Showroom]]
description: Rough wooden planks cover the walls and frame the door to conceal the underlying metal.
