Sheltering tree boughs stretch from the ceiling as if to greet entering visitors with open arms and wish them luck on their way out.  An expansive mural provides the backdrop for the community picnic table situated at the rear of the shop.  The carpet of cedar needles upon the floor fills the air with an earthy fragrance, completing the illusion of a secluded forest hideaway.

Rough wooden planks cover the walls and frame the fish-shaped door.  Sheltering tree boughs stretch from the ceiling as if to greet entering visitors with open arms and wish them luck on their way out.  An expansive mural provides the backdrop for the community picnic table situated in the middle of the shop.  The carpet of cedar needles upon the floor fills the air with an earthy fragrance, completing the illusion of a secluded forest hideaway.  Along the side walls you see a carved driftwood case, a smooth driftwood rack, and a small driftwood shelf.  You can also see a smooth driftwood table, and a carved brinewood stand in the back of the room while a large forest green curtained arch leads to another room.

title: [[Comfortable Rakash, Form is Function]]
description: The open floor plan of this shop provides customers with freedom to move around without fear of knocking anything over or damaging the goods for sale.  A series of odaj-clad mannequins stands in the center of the room, interspersed with racks holding various pieces of traditional Rakash clothing.

title: [[Comfortable Rakash, Function is Form]]
description: A pair of racks stand at either side of the room, holding a practical selection of Rakash-style robes and cloaks.  Near the back wall resides a life-sized statue of a Rakash in moonskin, its pose and proximity to a Katamba-embroidered curtain reminiscent of a guard.

title: [[The Humanist, Mivamaen]]
description: A simple white display rests in the center of the shop, just beneath a large oaken sign that is suspended from the ceiling by iron chains.  Pale furs are sewn together into a rug that covers the majority of the floor, lending a touch of warmth and softness to the otherwise sparse decor.

title: [[The Humanist, Side Room]]
description: Dark walls enclose this small space, matching the ceiling and floor in shadowy simplicity.  A single table dominates the area, resting in the center.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Abdomen]]
description: Pipes cover the wall to the west, which slopes sharply to form the ceiling and follow the curve of the Arachnid's abdomen.  Lacquered cedar wood beams are bolted into the wall at even intervals, providing additional support to the metallic interior.  Two parallel pipes hang from chains, running horizontally along the ceiling and occasionally dripping a dark-colored liquid.

title: [[Griniel's Cottage, Garden]]
description: Bursting with sultry perfumes and vibrant color, well-maintained gardens surround a cozy whitewashed cottage.  Sparkling colors glitter from the matching stained glass windows that peek through the climbing roses garnishing either side of the arched entry.

title: [[Orphanage, Flower Garden]]
description: A lush garden, full of seasonal flowers, borders the cobblestone walk to a large, stone building and fills the air with a sweet fragrance.  Fat bumblebees buzz lazily about the garden, landing occasionally to partake of a drink of nectar.  Ironwood double doors, under the careful watch of two guards, lead into the orphanage.

title: [[Skyward Crafting, Billowing Tailoring]]
description: All around the room whips a steady breeze.  The wind grows in intensity as it whirls up alongside the tent walls towards the roof where an elaborate mobile of the Immortals spins about.  Ignoring the scene above, several attendants adorned with streaming ribbons dance about, helping shoppers.

title: [[Skyward Crafting, Radiant Engineering]]
description: Angled mirrors raised high against the roof direct beams of torchlight about the shop floor.  Carefully positioned metal, stone and bone artwork gleams under the warm glow, and helps to illuminate the wares in this section of the tent.

title: [[Skyward Crafting, Stormy Forge]]
description: Large sooty stormclouds float overhead near the roof, while the thunderous peal of hammers on metal crash about from some unseen location.  Soot-stained attendants stand at the ready to help customers choose their forging wares.

title: [[Skyward Crafting, Torrential Alchemy]]
description: An assortment of pungent odors and sweet smells dance about this area of the shop.  Above, a dense canopy of fog blocks view of the roof and all around echoes the drip-drop sound of rain falling down.  The fog lessens into a steamy mist coiling down the shop's walls and hovering just above the floor.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Sternum]]
description: The ceiling is quite low and flat in this area of the spider, and slightly convex to shield whatever machinery drives the internal trappings of the massive construct.  Large metal columns rise here and there in the open area, riveted together with bolts at even intervals.  An enormous machine on the western portion of the wall grinds away at some unknown task.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Entryway]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floor, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  The bare metal walls reflect the sounds of shoppers within as well as those wandering the corridors outside.  Hallways branch off in opposite directions leading away from the entrance.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Entrances]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floors, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  Strips of matching material line the walls at regular intervals to mute some of the echoing sounds, and gaethzen lanterns occupy every other gap to light the corridor.  Leaned in the remaining open spaces are replicas of a number of doorways, arches and other entrances of various styles.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Wall Panels]]
description: The floor and ceiling of the circular chamber are bare, causing lingering echoes when someone enters or leaves.  A single gaethzen lantern hangs from the exposed steam pipes overhead.  Curiously, the metal walls are covered in a hodgepodge of panels depicting segments of otherwise typical walls consisting of wood, colored papers and more.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Backroom Access]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floors, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  Strips of matching material line the walls at regular intervals to mute some of the echoing sounds, and gaethzen lanterns occupy every other gap to light the small chamber.  Leaned in the remaining open spaces are replicas of a number of doorways, arches and other entrances of various styles.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Surfaces Aplenty]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floors, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  Pale light from a back corner illuminates the space, though it's rather weak in the corners opposite from it.  A number of tables, counters, pedestals and other flat surfaces fill the large chamber's floorspace while racks, shelves and hooks hang from the walls.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Flooring]]
description: The floor and walls are uncovered in this chamber.  A single gaethzen lantern hangs from the exposed steam pipes overhead, illuminating a number of upright panels that would look better laid flat as flooring.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Additional Surfaces]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floor, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  Sheets of gleaming metal conceal most of the spider's construction, though the steam pipes overhead remain exposed.  The items scattered around would ordinarily seem to belong to a storage room, but most have price tags attached indicating inventory waiting to be sold.

title: [[The Clerks' Collections, Miscellany]]
description: A deep blue carpet lines the floor, though ripples in the material show it was hastily thrown down and not properly secured.  Sheets of gleaming metal conceal most of the spider's construction, though the steam pipes overhead remain exposed.  The items scattered around would ordinarily seem to belong to a storage room, but most have price tags attached indicating inventory waiting to be sold.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Hind Leg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  Odd symmetry follows the north and southern walls, the rivets placed in a mechanical and repeating manner.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Hind Leg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole.  The walls form a nearly perfect vertical from the metal floor, which is bolted to a platform above a tangle of machinery.  Tangled wires of thin metal zigzag across the ceiling, out of reach and rusted in spots.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Sternum]]
description: The ceiling is quite low and flat in this area of the spider, and slightly convex to shield whatever machinery drives the internal trappings of the massive construct.  Large metal columns rise here and there in the open area, riveted together with bolts at even intervals.  Several loose cogs are visible underneath a glass plate in the floor, apparently dropped and just left scattered haphazardly underneath the tile.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, west.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Cephalothorax]]
description: Thin steel plates are bolted together to form the floor and ceiling, arcing in a tangle of wires and gears high overhead.  Steaming pipes run along the walls, fitted with cogs and whirring clockwork parts that drive the machinery.  The wide corridor runs along the outer edge of the spider's front half.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Entrance To The Pit]]
description: Lavish tapestries depicting battles between warriors and giant beasts adorn the smooth metal walls.  Brightly colored banners hang from the broad ceiling beams and flutter tauntingly with any whisper of a breeze.  Two curving stairways, displaying red and blue runners, trail up the eastern and western walls to lead toward the stands which overlook the arena floor.  A massive gate leads back outside.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Entrance To The Pit]]
description: Hordes of people fill the hall as hopeful combatants mingle amongst the spectators, awaiting their chance at the pit.  A smooth silversteel desk piled with stacks of parchment, scrolls, and ink bottles rests before the gated entrance to the pit.  Behind the desk, a small army of heavily armored guards flanks the gated entrance to the fighting pit, keeping watch for any vicious beasts attempting to escape the arena.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Hall of Champions]]
description: Crystal cases line the walls of the passage, their icesteel shelves loaded with the equipment of the long lost champions of the past.  Several large steel-wrought lanterns dangle from the thick beams that reinforce the ceiling, casting a shifting yellow candle light across the surface of the plush blue carpet that lines the hallway.  Gentle curls of silver smoke waft from several incense burners hidden amongst the foliage arranged about the area, filling the air with the strong smell of lilac.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Souvenir Shop]]
description: Rich blue and red silk is draped from the beams to create a faux ceiling and walls to enclose the shop.  Made from smooth steel, two tables sit at the far end of the area while racks and hooks hold wares just within the reach of any eager shoppers.  Scantily clad Elven men dressed in black silk sweep gracefully from place to place, assisting the customers with any questions they might have.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Mid-Back Leg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  One wall panel lies open, displaying the vestiges of some long-forgotten mechanism.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Mid-Back Leg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole.  The walls form a nearly perfect vertical from the metal floor, which is bolted to a platform above a tangle of machinery.  Trapped inside a network of cogs is a lone pair of discarded goggles, scratched and torn by the relentless driving of the machinery.

title: [[Ode to Glythtide, Taproom]]
description: Dark oak beams stretch across the whitewashed ceiling of the taproom with leafy grapevines wrapped around them.  An attentive Halfling clerk waits behind the wrap-around bar, ready to help any customer in need.  A line of sturdy oak cask stands are placed underneath some shelves on the wall facing the bar.

title: [[Ode to Glythtide, Halfling Corner]]
description: The homey corner is gaily decorated with a colorful assortment of paper mache tarts dangling from the rafters, while a mural depicting everyday Arthe Dale life covers the creamy plaster walls.  An attentive Halfling clerk stands discreetly behind a wide yew counter.

title: [[Ode to Glythtide, Bard Corner]]
description: The cozy corner is gaily decorated with a colorful assortment of tankards dangling from the rafters, while a mural depicting a troupe of Bards performing on the Yulugri Wala stage covers the creamy plaster walls.  An attentive Halfling clerk stands discreetly next to a tall rosewood rack and a sturdy rosewood table.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Mid-Front Leg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  Whirring noises can be heard from several gears that are bolted into the wall.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Left Mid-Front Leg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole.  The walls form a nearly perfect vertical from the metal floor, which is bolted to a platform above a tangle of machinery.  A coil of honey-colored tubes runs from the floor into a bulbous mechanism, with a lever jutting from it and locked in place.

Steaming pipes run along the walls, fitted with cogs and whirring clockwork parts that drive the machinery.  A small viewport looks in on an engine, its internal workings incomprehensible.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, northwest.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Eyes]]
description: With a ceiling arching sharply upward in a dome, the small room's walls are covered with confusing controls.  Several wide viewports open out to show the forest outside the spider, four large round windows mimicking an arachnid's eyes.  The larger figure of the massive metal aracnid looms to the west, swaying and moving slightly as if almost alive.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Cephalothorax]]
description: Thin steel plates are bolted together to form the floor and ceiling, arcing in a tangle of wires and gears high overhead.  Steaming pipes run along the walls, fitted with cogs and whirring clockwork parts that drive the machinery.  A fine mesh grate offers a dizzying view of the ground far below.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Cephalothorax]]
description: Thin steel plates are bolted together to form the floor and ceiling, arcing in a tangle of wires and gears high overhead.  Steaming pipes run along the walls, fitted with cogs and whirring clockwork parts that drive the machinery.  Small dials on one wall monitor the unknown functions of some strange container, reading at half full.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Foreleg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  The hands of a clock are bolted into one wall, ticking away rhythmically with little visible purpose.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right ForeLeg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole.  The walls form a nearly perfect vertical from the metal floor, which is bolted to a platform above a tangle of machinery.  A grip-handled wheel sticks out from a pipe, kept from turning by a thick chain and padlock.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Eyes]]
description: With a ceiling arching sharply upward in a dome, the small room's walls are covered with confusing controls.  Several wide viewports open out to show the forest outside the spider, four large round windows mimicking an arachnid's eyes.  The forests of Forfedhdar stretch out to the distance, ending at the mountains.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Cephalothorax]]

Several electrical burn marks mar a set of steel plates, warped slightly by whatever accident caused them.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest, west.

Ruined scraps of cloth hang from the ceiling, the remains of a washcloth defeated by an oily spill.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Mid-Back Leg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  One wall holds a tiny porthole, giving a view of the inaccessible parts of the massive clockwork creature's legs.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Mid-Back Leg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole. Coin-sized circular holes are cut out of a plate in one wall, revealing a mass of turning gears behind it.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Hind Leg]]
description: Massive levers and pistons drive the workings of the baby arachnid's leg, which is hollow and full of strange mechanisms.  The curving hallway continues down the spider's femur, just wide enough to be navigable.  A single U-shaped pipe juts out dangerously from one wall, its surface covered in condensation.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Right Hind Leg]]
description: Beveled gears run to the huge joint in the spider's leg, the corridor dead-ending at a sealed manhole.  The walls form a nearly perfect vertical from the metal floor, which is bolted to a platform above a tangle of machinery.  A series of three glass pipes cuts through the middle of the room like a column, containing some amber-colored fluid that drops out of sight below.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, A Strange Passage]]
description: This narrow tunnel is formed by the gaps between a complex jumble of almost vein-like tubes and what appears to be organ sacks.  A dark, oily gas pours into the area from some unknown source, the noxious fumes more than enough encouragement to keep moving.

title: [[The Massive Arachnid, A Strange Passage]]
description: This narrow tunnel is formed by the gaps between a complex jumble of almost vein-like tubes and what appears to be organ sacks.  A dark, oily gas pours into the area from some unknown source, the noxious fumes more than enough encouragement to keep moving.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Half Pint, Upstairs Hall]]
description: The hall here is hung with paintings of various knights, maidens and wildlife in idealized, pastoral scenes.  The signatures scrawled in the corners of the artwork cover an impressive variety of notable artisans from around the realms.

title: [[Half Pint, Nightshade Suite]]
description: The wallpaper in this chamber is midnight blue.  Heavy velvet curtains with satin lining drape the windows, so that what little light can filter in seems tinged with the blush of eternal night.  An oil lamp burns with a bluish cast, illuminating a recessed pit in the floor which is filled with black silk pillows and dark blue comforters.

title: [[Half Pint, Moonlight Suite]]
description: A crescent-shaped, billowing bed dominates the center of this room.  The ceiling is painted midnight blue, with glowing gems twinkling in rhythmic sequence like some perfect night sky.  On the deep blue walls are depictions of the eleven planets and scenes of the Immortals who govern them engaged in feasting and merriment.

title: [[Riding The Range, Sales Room]]
description: Fresh straw is covered by rustic mats to cushion the cold, metal floor.  Colorful woven blankets, used pieces of harness and tack decorate the room, drawing attention away from pipes as well as any other odd fittings that are normally visible.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Leisure Lounge]]
description: Panels of rich mahogany cover the walls, their deep cherry grain lustrous under the light of ornate metal sconces affixed at even intervals around the room.  With head and teeth still intact, a massive frostweyr bearskin rug cushions every footfall along the floor.  An ebony libations table is centrally located amidst oiled leather couches, allowing patrons a place to relax and converse while taking a break from perusing the wares further inside the shop.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Amiable Arrangements]]
description: Walls of dark burgundy feature a leafy vine trim painted in forest green both along the ceiling and baseboards.  A round island built from mahogany serves as a focal point, centered in the middle of the room and surrounded by several thick black ape rugs upon the hardwood floor.  Hanging overhead, a wrought iron chandelier supporting a collection of glowing candles illuminates everything on display.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Dapper Dandy]]
description: In shades a bit more cheerful than the rest of the shop, the walls feature a silky covering of pastel blue swirled with sumptuous peach.  Spread across the hardwood floor, a plush clouded arzumos rug enhances the eccentric elegance of the room's decor.  Soft light flickers onto the various displays from freestanding candelabras placed strategically around the area.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Refined Rustic]]
description: Painted a soil brown and dappled with rich earth tones, the canvas-covered walls match perfectly with the dark hardwood floor.  Wooden baseboards and ceiling trim of sandy beige complement the furry red leucro rug that decorates the room.  Housed in frosted glass, candles in brass-edged holders shed light around the area for the goods on display.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Formal Fellow]]
description: Black satin walls envelop the area in sobering shades, and a sleek golden gryphon rug accentuates the hardwood floor underfoot.  Flickering candlelight scatters about the room from the crystal chandelier, refracted through multifaceted teardrops dangling above.  The pinpoints of light more than adequately illuminate the collection of men's finery for sale.

title: [[The Male Persuasion, Genial Gentleman]]
description: Like a dense coat of mist, layers of glossy grey velvet cover the bright room's walls.  Contrasting attractively with the dark hardwood flooring, a luxurious spotted jaguar rug is positioned between several sets of item displays.  Filigreed silver sconces provide ample lighting for shopping patrons to view the wares for sale.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Sketchy By Design, Gallery]]
description: Polished red oak sheathes the walls and floor of this spacious room.  Several paintings and sketches adorn the walls, their steady line broken only by a full-length mirror and the painted black door leading into the artist's workshop.

title: [[Sketchy By Design, Supplies]]
description: Polished red oak sheathes the walls and floor of this spacious room.  Various jars and trays sit on a table along the back wall, each filled to overflowing with writing utensils.

title: [[Bare Necessities, Salesfloor]]
description: Little effort has been made to spruce up the bare metal walls or floor.  A few ratty cougar pelts have been thrown down on the decking but they do nothing to relieve the barren feeling.  Haphazard piles of pelts, hides and skins rest on various tables scattered about the room, while a small rack displays some wooden planks.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Packrat's Piece of Paradise]]
description: Containers literally surround you in this shop, as old and battered ones have been used to partially cover the scuffed metal walls.  Several lanterns of different makes hang on drawstrings from various bags on the ceiling.  The warm light from the lanterns reveals shabby decor around the room and mostly secondhand fixtures.  The items for sale resting on the furniture, however, are far from second rate.

title: [[On the Mend, Main Room]]
description: String-tied bundles of dried healing herbs are suspended overhead, perfuming the air with a sweet and musky aroma.  A wide variety of alchemist's tools litters the surface of the battered pine worktable that stands alone in the center of this sparsely decorated room.

title: [[On the Mend, Sales Floor]]
description: Flickering candles send shimmering waves of light across the yards of gleaming jewel-toned silk that crisscrosses the walls and ceiling.  A patterned wool carpet softens the cold grey of the metal floor and brings a touch of warmth to the area.  An elderly Gnome is kept busy tidying the wares on an oak table and dusting the shelves of the teak and pine curio cabinets that occupy the far corners.

title: [[Spikan's Sporrans]]
description: A great amount of effort and time was obviously spent polishing the metal walls until they were pristine.  Shiny new lanterns hang from polished brass hooks on the ceiling.  Cool bright light is cast upon the finely crafted tables holding the items for sale.

title: [[Below Deck, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Fabric Fantasies, Salesroom]]
description: Lengths of assorted colorful and luxurious fabrics cover the room's dingy walls, allowing customers closer inspection of the exquisite goods sold at this location.  Large gaethzen spheres dangle from the ceiling, washing the area in bright light, which causes metallic threads and gem flecks in certain displayed textiles to sparkle like crystals on a summer's day.  Pale beige carpeting covers the floor, hiding the building's metal partitions from hurried shoppers.

title: [[Excess Baggage, Salesroom]]
description: Panels of ethereal white fabric are draped across the ceiling and allowed to fall in waves to the floor, creating a bright, neutral backdrop for the displayed merchandise.  Woven rugs hide the last bit of metal from the existing space as well as muffle the hurried footsteps of busy shoppers.

title: [[Town and Country, Autumn Room]]
description: Potted ferns and plush moss-green rugs are scattered across the floor, and leaf-batiked bronze and gold fabrics drape the walls to soften and disguise the metal beneath.  Wrought-iron lanterns hang over displays variously shaped like a house, a tree, a door and a knoll, illuminating the wares and spreading warmth throughout the room.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Central Intestinal Chamber]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Corridors lead off in every direction from this circular area.  At its center stands a massive boiler tub, the nearby bin overflowing with charcoal for the fire.

title: [[Shimmers of Silver]]
description: Despite the rather small confines of this long, narrow hall, careful attention has been given to the expensive-looking decorations.  The white walls prominently showcase several small glass windows that look into elegant sculptures of colored glass, and bright lighting in the ceiling of their small cabinets shines onto the the works of art.

title: [[Snookie's Divine Spoons]]
description: Prosaic canvas walls define this small booth; their only apparent purpose is to hold the inventory and, of course, to blot out the monotonous steel and grey.  However, Snookie's inventory is as colorful as ever, with the boutique-style wares shown off to their best advantage.  A spoon display bears the latest imports from Reshalia, and the wall boasts a cluster of small spoon racks fresh from the master artisans of Leth Deriel.

title: [[Amylia's Attic, Accessories]]
description: Stacks of crates, barrels, and all kinds of junk fill this shop, making it seem smaller than it is.  Dead stuffed birds hang from the ceiling while dirty, torn parchments litter the floor.

title: [[Amylia's Attic, Furniture]]
description: Chairs and trunks are stacked precariously upon beds and other furniture, offering a labyrinth of household purchasing options.  A nervous-looking clerk continually shoots furtive glances towards the teetering mountains of furnishings that threaten to crash down at any moment.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Disenchantments]]
description: Drapes of matte black silk covering the walls give this small shop a somber, reflective feel.  A large tub of viscous gloop is pushed up against one wall with a bold plaque above it.  On the opposite wall hangs a battered board set with what seems to have once been a drawing, now slashed to pieces with several pointy implements protruding from it.  A small red sign is propped up by the implements, further obscuring the picture's former content.

title: [[Nigeyi's, Purveyor of Fine Footwear]]
description: Various displays, each catering to the different tastes of Nigeyi's customers, line the room.  Suspended from the ceiling are wagon wheels upon which lit candles brighten the room and cast dancing shadows whenever the door opens.  A worn stool and cobbler's form sit in the corner beneath a rack holding a neat assortment of tools.

title: [[Nigeyi's, Selections]]
description: Several candles on the small circumference wagon wheels have sputtered their last, leaving this room with dusky shadows that dance with any movement.  A cobweb dangles from one wheel, seeming to float as it spins in the meager light.

title: [[Nigeyi's Resale]]
description: Deliberately darker than the other rooms, items consigned to this space have been rehabilitated, but no one has appeared to pay for the service.  Long abandoned by their owners, they accumulate dust as Nigeyi attempts to recoup his labor and expenses.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Once Possessed, Accessories]]
description: Piles of used items are stacked around the room covered in translucent black material making them appear to be dark rolling hills.  Papier-mache tombstones stick up on the piles with skeletal hands planted before each, reaching upward like possessed beings rising from their graves.  Various branches hang from the metal ceiling, covered in mosses, dim lanterns, and stuffed ravens with deep red marble eyes.

title: [[Once Possessed, Furniture]]
description: Old broken furniture rests around the room, mingling with pieces that still look functional.  Partially blocked by the furnishings, an odd mural is painted around the top half of the metal walls depicting skeletons and zombies sitting in chairs and lounging in beds.

title: [[Crafty Cloaks]]
description: Cloaks are hung on the walls, spread out to their fullest extent, almost completely covering the pitted metal plates.  An elaborately carved armoire is pushed up against the rear wall, its surface covered with images of hooded figures mingling with an odd assortment of characters, from skeletons to giant bunnies.  Above, a large orb hangs from the ceiling, casting a dim glow around the room with a hue similar to moonlight.

title: [[Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Tobacco Showroom]]
description: Small bundles of assorted tobacco leaves decorate the iron walls, softening their stark appearance and providing an assortment of aromas throughout the area.  Merchandise has been creatively placed around the room, attempting to draw a shopper's gaze away from the bare floor.  A duo of drainpipes stands partially hidden in a darkened corner, announcing their presence by rattling periodically.

title: [[Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Cigarillo Showroom]]
description: Thickly-padded mahogany panels cover each iron wall, attempting to keep the temperature cool and the air moist.  Stock boys dart in and out from the back room checking various bins, showing the great care this merchant takes to keep his tobacco products fresh.

title: [[Cloudwalker's Smoke Shop, Cigar Showroom]]
description: Copper sconces hung on the mahogany-paneled walls brightly light the room's merchandise.  A cloudy, lavender haze lingers above a pair of padded benches, evidence left from shoppers stopping to relax and sample one of the tobacco products sold here.

title: [[Jhiskar's Provisions]]
description: The light from a hanging lantern dances over woven reed mats that cover the metal walls and floor.  Strips of bell-laden leather crisscross the ceiling overhead, the tiny brass bells tinkling melodically with the breeze caused by any passing customer.

title: [[Jhiskar's Provisions]]
description: Bundles of wood and piles of pelts are stacked wherever space will allow, covering the inherently metallic scent of the room with musty and sweet aromas.  A cluster of beeswax candles and a slowly smoldering bundle of sage burden a small table set well away from the leather-encased walls.

title: [[The Gear Shop, The Inventive Gentleman]]
description: Painted across the walls with an inexpert hand are scenes of young male Gnomes exploring a bright green and tangled jungle.  One stands proudly atop a fallen log, his right hand shielding his eyes as his left hand stretches toward some distant spectacle.  A plush rug of dirt-brown speckled with grass-green shades covers the floor from edge to edge.  Low shelves poke out from the walls, presenting a danger of banged knees to the taller races.

title: [[The Gear Shop, The Intrepid Adventuress]]
description: Brightly hued paints depict a young female Gnome standing alone on a stretching savanna, small blobs of trees and animals only guessable by their colors.  She stands tall, for a Gnome, with high heeled boots and an umbrella perched jauntily over her shoulder while her long hair curls to the side as if caught by a wind.  Sandy hued, a rug covers the floor and allows the many short tables a place to rest.

title: [[The Gear Shop, The Undaunted Lady]]
description: Blue paint splashes across the ceiling and halfway down the walls, mimicking the color of a cloudless sky on a sunny day.  Small humanoid shapes seem to be flying through the air, long skirts hinting at the gender of these daring adventurers.  One wall shows a Gnome girl climbing into a huge catapult, her skirts caught up in her hands and an umbrella clenched between her teeth.  Poking out low enough on the walls so as to not block the pictures are an array of shelves.

title: [[The Gear Shop, Crowning Achievements]]
description: Depicted upon the walls of this room are groups of Gnomes, male and female, standing around with huge smiles as if regaling each other with stories of their triumphs.  All sorts of treasures, mostly colorful blobs, rest around their diminutive figures.  A portly fellow in fine clothing stands out from the crowd, holding what could be a huge diamond.  Integrated into the scenes are squat tables holding the wares above a wooden floor.
