title: [[Monastery, Blueberry Bushes]]
description: Dark green moss dapples the high stone wall skirting one side of the path, and fronds from the bushes overhang the narrow trail in places.  A crow struts among the dried leaves and berries littering the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Monastery, Blueberry Bushes]]
description: Rows and rows of blueberry bushes grow within the stone fence enclosure.  The narrow path following the stone wall bends from the north to the southwest, other less well marked paths disappear into the stands of shrubs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Main Hall]]
description: Whitewashed walls surround the hall, a series of nautical items hung at various points around the room.  Wide wooden planks underfoot creak under the weight of large stone slabs that stand nearby, each awaiting inspection, while smaller carts of bone and wood are pushed under tarps to protect them from the salty air.  A stern overseer keeps a close eye on things, barking at his associate when a new delivery arrives or needs moving.  A wide stairway leads downward, further into the society, while a large waste bucket rests nearby.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Repair and Storage]]
description: A heavy rope net drapes from the ceiling overhead, while a sweeping potted palm stands in a nearby corner of the brightly painted shop.  The discarded hull of a dingy has been shaped into a counter for the Dwarven attendant, where he busies himself with the task of repairing tools and tending to the stored goods on the shelves behind him.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Office]]
description: At the far end of the small office is a stately desk piled with parchments and several ledgers, a built-in bookcase beyond overflowing with rows of books and personal trinkets.  Hung beneath a pair of crossed, sun bleached oars, a large chalkboard details several of the society's stone shipments, while a trio of decorative pilings stands in a nearby corner.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Hallway]]
description: The long hallway echoes with a variety of clinks and clanks in the distance, while attendants bustle back and forth with deed orders.  Brass lanterns hung overhead provide a minimal amount light, enough to indicate entrances to the east and west, along with the stairs that lead up to the main floor of the society.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, up.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Crafting Supplies]]
description: An ornate stone pedestal at the center of the room displays a brass astrolabe and mistwood telescope, highlighted by a large brass lantern overhead.  Workers periodically wander in and out, restocking the items held by the many baskets and shelves along the surrounding walls, while a nearby attendant sees to the craftsmen who stop by in need of supplies.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Depot]]
description: Several heavy blocks of marble and alabaster rest at various points along the painted brick walls, while additional shelves and tables hold a wide selection of bone and stone.  Several stout workmen grunt under the weight of the rough-hewn crates they heft through the busy shop to the backroom.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Hallway]]
description: Artisans and attendants bustle throughout the area, the varied sounds of craftsmen echoing along the long hallway.  Brass lanterns overhead highlight the compass pattern in the brick floor underfoot, while a trio of doors lead into several workshops where many perfect their craft.

title: [[Ratha Engineering Society, Workshop]]
description: A vibrant mural detailing crashing waves upon a rocky shoreline surrounds the workshop, the brass lanterns overhead providing additional lighting during the evening hours.  Unfinished stone furniture, statues and more are spread across the surfaces of the dozens of reinforced tables that form neat rows along the length of the room.  Several artisans pour over their creations, while attendants haul away other pieces too large to carry with an overhead system of pulleys and chains, storing them for later retrieval.

title: [[Onsuwayo's Clinic, Treatment Room One]]
description: Several cots and pallets await the sick and wounded.  Cold white tile and chill stone floors make the environment clean but lacking in warmth.  Even the cots are a bleached white.  The only trace of color in the room is a thick spray of blood on the wall, each drop sparkling in the glaring light like a ruby.  The sight is less than reassuring.

title: [[Krrikt'k's Forge, Salesroom]]
description: Deep red silk hangings fall in graceful folds along the walls, softening the stark lines of the tiny shop.  Mounted along the walls are samples of Mastersmith Krrikt'k's work, the polished steel reflecting the deep red glow of the fabric.  A dark oak counter stands at the center of the lamp-lit display room, bearing a brass-trimmed leather catalog with a list of the items available for sale.

title: [[Krrikt'k's Forge]]
description: No wood lines the walls of the forge, just massive stone blocks to reduce the risk of fire.  In the center, coals glow within a beehive-shaped furnace, the flames fanned by a leather bellows.  Apprentices work at their craft -- a tall dark-scaled youth hammers out a dent in greaves, a younger lass works on steel rings for chainmail, yet another smoothes nicks in the edge of a broadsword.  Overseeing them all, the Mastersmith works at his own anvil.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Reception]]
description: Creamy marble with a mirror-like finish spreads across the floor underfoot, while a variety of animal hides and shields are displayed at various points upon the surrounding walls.  A pair of brocade settees sit opposite each other at the center of the room, separated by a short oval table which is highlighted under the soft glow of the chandelier overhead.  A S'Kra Mur clerk stands behind a nearby counter, making notes in a small ledger.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Book Store]]
description: Jeweled brass lanterns overhead highlight a mural of a magnificent palace that decorates one wall of the small book store.  Flanked by broad potted palms, several shelves display a variety of books where patrons browse before making their purchases at the counter nestled in a nearby corner.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Supply Depot]]
description: A variety of animal hides decorate the walls of the small depot, a brass lantern overhead casting a soft glow over the area.  Long tables line the room, each piled high with padding supplies and various leather hides, while nearby baskets overflow with an assortment of fibers.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Framed sketches dot the walls of the corridor beneath ornately jeweled sconces, each displaying a uniquely designed image.  Several artisans bustle back and forth through the area, each laden with sacks filled with a variety of goods.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Framed sketches dot the walls of the corridor beneath ornately jeweled sconces, each displaying a uniquely designed image.  An ornately carved wooden bench rests against one wall, a quilted throw draped along the backrest, while a thick burgundy rug lies before archways of oak, maple, and walnut.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Tool Shop]]
description: A trio of gaethzen orbs hangs overhead, casting a soft glow over the area and a small counter along one wall.  The store's perimeter is lined with colorful wicker bins, each piled high with various waxes, tools and notions essential to the local craftsmen.  In a nearby corner, a large clay planter overflows with sweet-smelling, golden melilots, the redolent blossoms adding a pleasant touch to the otherwise utilitarian room.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Office]]
description: Swathes of opulent silk sweep to each corner of the small office from a central point overhead, contrasting against the dark mahogany walls.  A broad desk and tufted leather chair rest along a far wall, facing an arched window that overlooks the bustling street beyond, while a wide corridor leads further north.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Framed sketches dot the walls of the corridor beneath ornately jeweled sconces, each displaying a uniquely designed image.  An ornately carved wooden bench rests against one wall, a quilted throw draped along the backrest, while a thick burgundy rug lies before archways of oak, maple, and walnut.

title: [[The Raven's Mask and Leatherworks, Workroom]]
description: Fragrant piles of cured leather lie stacked about the tiny workroom, the aroma mingling with the scent of melted beeswax used to stiffen the leather for armor.  An almost half-finished leather mask sits upon the workbench, and several pieces of armor in various states of repair are heaped upon a table.  In the center of the room, a young Halfling woman perches upon a wooden stool, her nimble fingers flying as she puts the finishing touches on her current project.

title: [[Furrier's Shop]]
description: Untanned skins lie piled atop each other on the floor, while cured leather stretches in wooden frames hung upon the walls.  Surly Gor'Tog laborers toil away, using large paddles to turn the skins soaking in the vats.  The proprieter of the tannery looks on from his spot behind the counter.

title: [[Forging Society, Bookstore]]
description: The shop is filled with the smell of raw metals, a smell so sharp that it clings to the teeth.  A large iron door stands at the back of the room, acting as a barricade between the forge and the front shop.  Sitting at a ticket counter is an elderly Elothean sales clerk, keeping the supply of books nice and orderly, while a series of three charts hangs on a nearby wall.

title: [[Forging Society, Tool Shop and Entryway]]
description: This passage acts as an entryway in and out of the forge.  Stifling heat marches up from a large hall to the south, nearly destroying a subtle cross-breeze heading east and west.  Sweat-soaked merchants offer assistance to crafters needing to resupply tools and materials.  To the north, a thick iron door protects the outside office from the smothering heat.

title: [[Forging Society, Maker's Mark Hall]]
description: Soot-stained red brick makes up the walls and floor of this large hall.  Attendants offer maker's mark design services to eligible crafters here.  The sound of bubbling metal echoes through passageways further south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: The floor slopes toward a circular firepit fed by a large pile of crushed coal.  A huge granite crucible hangs over the fire, suspended by heavy chains from a thick wooden beam.  The only exit is a blackened passageway to the north.

title: [[Forging Society, Western Passage and Supply Depot]]
description: This expanded passage offers some protection from the heat and contains pallets of materials for crafters to order.  Passages continue to the west, one streaked with oily handprints and two that have been haphazardly scrubbed down.  From the west you can hear the pounding of hammers upon metal.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Forging Society, Forge]]
description: The ceiling of this forge has been cut away, leaving half the room under open sky.  The forge sits close to the inner wall under the shelter of the covered half while a rusty anvil lies further out, with limited protection.  Although this is a bit cramped compared to the other two forges, the constant airflow adds a great deal of relief from the heat.

title: [[Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Blackened stone walls enclose this simple forge.  A great shaft lies in the slanted ceiling, breathing out fumes and smoke, yet not seeming to give any relief to the heat.  An old anvil scratched with time and neglect stands ready for use near the tempered forge, its hot coals giving an odd glow to the room.

title: [[Forging Society, East Passage]]
description: A gentle breeze stirs in this passage, adding a bit of relief to the blistering heat.  To the south is a break room, and to the east are various grinding rooms.  Even from here, the metal's wail can be heard.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Forging Society, Grinding Room]]
description: The warm air is filled with the smell of heated metal.  Far from the sound of the hammers, the grindstones have been placed to allow for freedom of movement as journeyman smiths work to perfect their prized blades.  Curious apprentices hover about, hoping to learn a trick or two studying those that take a turn at the wheel.

title: [[Forging Society, Grinding Room]]
description: This is a small grinding room set apart from the others.  Conveniently located by the break room, it also tends to be the most used.  Young Gor'Tog lads, looking to earn a spare coin for their families, work to sweep up shavings and oil the stones.

title: [[Forging Society, Grinding Room]]
description: A large grated window set high on the east side of this room provides a steady stream of air from the outside world.  Set back from the rest of the forge, only the whining of grinding metals can be heard.  A large grindstone is here, accompanied by a moderately clean bucket of cool water.

title: [[Forging Society, Break Room]]
description: This is a small, simple room set up to act as a break room for people working in the forge.  Above, a small slitted window lets in some fresh air, helping to take a bite out of the heat.  A rickety table made from salt-stained planks lies in the center of the room, offering simple snacks.  Nearby on the floor is an open barrel with a tin ladle chained to it.  Several crates line the floor as well, acting as chairs.

title: [[Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Eerie shadows dance on the walls across the smudged passageway that leads out of the foundry to the northwest.  A huge granite crucible hangs over the fire, suspended by heavy chains from a thick wooden beam.  Black dust fills the air, spiraling up in the heat as it blows off a pile of fuel.

title: [[Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: A huge granite crucible sways from a blackened beam in the center of the foundry.  A large fire burns near the end of the crucible and an immense fuel pile is placed in convenient reach.  A sooty passage to the northeast leads back to the hall.

title: [[Ice Caves, Chasm]]
description: Black ice coats the walls and floor of the chasm, making climbing in either direction a perilous adventure.

title: [[Ice Caves, Chasm]]
description: Darkness fills this empty void as it sinks down into the frozen stone of the surrounding caves.  The chasm walls rise upwards around the small ledge that offers a brief respite from the harsh climb above and below.

title: [[Ice Caves, Chasm]]
description: A ring of firelight breaks the darkness as the steep frozen walls open up above into a large cavern filled with torches.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A small, unidentifiable drowned animal floats face down in the putrid sludge.  It slaps up against the cavern wall with a sickly smacking sound as the slightest movement causes small waves in the thick muck.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Relatively clean of the wet sludge covering the cavern floor, basalt boulders give evidence of a recent cave-in.  Overhead the din from a cluster of noisy bats echoes dully against the cavern walls.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Dark basalt walls covered in black slime reach upwards to a high vaulted ceiling.  Thick alluvium covers the slippery cavern floor, splashing stagnant gunk on the legs of any who dare to trudge through the fetid sludge.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Small mud banks encroach on the cavern sides where the slippery floor is raised slightly.  The flow of water echoes dully as it laps upon the small muddy shore.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A long ledge covered with moldy bat droppings mars the smooth cavern wall.  Traveling the length of this passage, the basalt stone is notched with deep gouges, as if it had been struck by a heavy, blunt instrument.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Strange lichen covers one of the dark basalt walls of this underground cave.  The peculiar-looking fungus seems to be thriving in the fetid atmosphere and scant light.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Small, scattered stalagmites jut above the waterline in the darkness, making travel treacherous.  Dark veins of greenish black basalt are embedded deeply in the cavern walls.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Strange lichen covers one of the dark basalt walls of this underground cave.  The peculiar-looking fungus seems to be thriving in the fetid atmosphere and scant light.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A huge cavern, its ceiling obscured by a foul mist, opens ominously before you.  Droplets of cloudy liquid trickle down the dark basalt walls into the putrid muck that covers the slippery floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Swirling eddies of brackish water, laden with unidentifiable refuse, appear haphazardly on the filthy sludge covering the cavern floor.  Occasionally a loose rock will fall from above, spattering black slime on the dark basalt walls.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Oozing matter seeps from the dark basalt walls and dribbles down to the murky sludge covering the cavern floor.  Walking has become treacherous -- a single misstep will be cause for a slimy bath.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: The walls are jagged and sharp.  Several pointed outcrops, discolored with a reddish hue, have remnants of what appears to be clumps of matted hair.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Movement through the thick sludge raises the waterline that marks the sides of the cave walls.  Small pieces of debris slap against the hard stone and echo dully throughout the cavern.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Several deep scratches mar one of the cavern walls, as if someone or something had attempted to dig minerals out of the hard rock.  Rivulets of moisture from above trickle down and fill the indentations like a thick pus.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Two huge slime-covered boulders partially block the passage, leaving only a small opening to squeeze through.  The basalt-veined walls are covered with a thin deposit of black silt.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A thin layer of silt covers heavy stalactites hanging from the vaulted ceiling.  A steady plopping sound can be heard as moisture drips down from the long icicle-shaped forms and hits the putrid sludge covering the cavern floor.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A long ledge covered with moldy bat droppings mars the smooth cavern wall.  Traveling the length of this passage, the basalt stone is notched with deep gouges, as if it had been struck by a heavy, blunt instrument.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: About halfway along the dark passage are boulders wedged in a rift near the waterline.  Dark brown moss completely covers the protruding stone, giving the semblance of a deformed badger peeking from its den.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Dark basalt walls covered in black slime reach upwards to a high vaulted ceiling.  Thick alluvium covers the slippery cavern floor, splashing stagnant gunk on the legs of any who dare to trudge through the fetid sludge.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Small mud banks encroach on the cavern sides where the slippery floor is raised slightly.  The flow of water echoes dully as it laps upon the small muddy shore.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Dark basalt walls flecked with unidentifiable minerals glisten in the damp atmosphere.  Sharp rocks underfoot are slick with slimy lichen, slowing travel through this treacherous area.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Ominously shaped stalagmites protruding haphazardly from the cavern floor hinder movement and cast eerie shadows.  Navigating through these natural obstacles slows the vigilant traveler.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Dull echoes reverberate throughout the vast cavern as overhead the faint fluttering of unseen bats breaks the silence of the cave.  Layers of fetid droppings cover the walls and floor like splatters from a malformed brush on a painter's canvas.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Crumbled stone litters the dry floor and the basalt walls are scorched and pitted, as if a constant heat or fire has been applied.  Random scratches and gouges are deeply imbedded in one wall, the indentations filled with blackened soot.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: A recent cave-in partially obstructs travel here, and one must slow the pace to traverse the fallen boulders and crushed rock.  Rare minerals extended in chaotic lines on the surface of the walls resemble the weavings of a deranged spider.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The passage opens up to a three-way intersection as if to befuddle the unwary traveler.  Jagged outcroppings dusted with shiny specks of rich minerals glisten like minute diamonds, almost begging for a pickaxe to mar the studded surface.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: A huge rock, besmeared with fetid animal droppings and remnants of scorched bone and scraps of tattered cloth, partially obstructs the passageway.  At the base are deep scratches and irregular notches filled with packed dirt.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The passageway widens slightly and is large enough for three Gor'Togs to walk abreast.  The cold walls are jagged, with razor sharp outcroppings that glisten with minerals.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Unidentifiable minerals snake randomly on the surface of the stone walls, leaving sinuous trails in the hard rock.  A pile of scorched rubble lies abandoned in one corner, a remnant from a past battle.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Several icicle-shaped stalactites hang from the cavern ceiling.  Their damaged tips are blackened and scorched, making them look like the rotting fangs of some huge carnivore.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The cavern opens into a room with a high vaulted ceiling and several passageways, with no clues in which direction to traverse.  Occasionally a stray rock falls to the floor with a dull thud, but otherwise a traveler is met with only an ominous silence.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Denticulated walls with tiny formations of serrated rock provide an unusual nesting place for mysterious fungi, whose foul, pungent odor permeates the stale air.  Unidentifiable mushrooms are strewed along the cavern floor, smashed into a slippery pulp by previous visitors.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Deep claw marks are slashed irregularly along the craggy walls and floor, as if something had attacked the rock with great anger or frustration.  The porous floor is saturated with varying degrees of rust-colored stains, having soaked up and absorbed all manner of unidentifiable secretions.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The stone riddled floor slopes slightly and the passageway narrows.  The dark walls seem to bulge outwards, creating an almost claustrophobic feeling in this area.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Three darkly ominous passageways greet the unsuspecting traveler in this cavernous chamber.  Blackened and scorched walls guard a floor littered with animal droppings and crushed rocks.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: A large crack has caused a jagged rift in one of the basalt walls, exposing a variety of minerals embedded deep within the hard stone.  The cavern's floor is uneven and treacherous to walk on, with serrated rocks emerging helter-skelter along the rough surface.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Craggy basalt walls stretch upwards toward a natural domed ceiling.  The hard floor is tamped down and smooth, almost as if an invisible broom has swept miscellaneous debris into one of the three passageways that open into this area.

title: [[Charred Caverns, Chasm's Edge]]
description: The passageway ends abruptly at the edge of a wide chasm.  The surrounding walls are blackened with fiery marks seared deeply into the hard rock.  The floor is littered with the charred remains of small animals that were trapped, perhaps as they waged a final battle.  A rope bridge, frayed but otherwise unmarked, spans the deep abyss before you.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Craggy walls pitted and filled with grime and soot line the passageway.  Irregularly notched indentations hold the remains of tiny bits of debris that are blackened and charred beyond recognition.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Oddly shaped rocks, singed black from an unexplained flame, protrude erratically from the walls and ceiling of this narrow passageway.  To the north the passage leads deeper into the recesses of the earth, the floor pitching slightly, impeding travel with its treacherous surface.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The rugged passage leads into a larger chamber filled with jagged rocks and small scabrous boulders haphazardly scattered.  The whisper of a draft whistles ominously and echoes hollowly through three open entryways.

title: [[Charred Caverns, Chasm's Edge]]
description: The stony ground ends in a jagged ledge to the west overlooking a great chasm.  An enormous flat boulder nearby anchors a fraying rope bridge.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: Skulls and other indistinct skeletal remnants lie strewn in a disorderly pile near the path's edge.  The acrid odor of charred human flesh obtrusively invades the palate.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: The cavern snakes onward, the walls uneven and jagged.  Whatever force, natural or otherwise, gave birth to these tunnels clearly valued haste over beauty or safety.

title: [[Charred Caverns, Maelshyve's Threshold]]
description: A stout obsidian obelisk stands prominently in the center of the circular chamber.  Its four faces are pristine and unmarred by etching or carving.  An ornate black crystal archway molded from the rock leads north into an eerily lit shrine.

title: [[Maelshyve's Threshold, Antechamber]]
description: Contorted skulls affixed to thick iron spikes flank a black crystal archway that leads to the southern caverns.  The orifices of the morbid effigies burn with intense flame, casting a flickering glow upon three great statues carved into the northern walls of the shrine.

title: [[Maelshyve's Threshold, Antechamber]]
description: A small pile of coarse bone meal lies in tribute at the foot of a grotesque statue carved into the face of the northeastern wall.  Shadows hang in the corner, obscuring the rightmost half of the stillborn creature.

title: [[Maelshyve's Threshold, Antechamber]]
description: A pile of rubble is strewn upon the ground beneath a large hole that has crumbled in the northern wall of the chamber.  A cold stillness hangs in the air, a foreboding harbinger of what may lie beyond this chamber.

A sickly, fluttering glow from the south illuminates a carving in the northern wall depicting a contorted reptilian woman.  A cold stillness hangs in the air, a foreboding harbinger of what may lie beyond this chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Maelshyve's Threshold, Antechamber]]
description: Carved into the face of the northwestern wall is a hideous statue bearing vaguely reptilian yet humanoid features.  Its grand musculature and cruel, claw-tipped appendages unmistakably shatter any remote resemblance to a S'Kra Mur.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Grand Hall]]
description: The stone walls of the preceding caverns end abruptly, giving way to a crystalline hall of inky purple-black obsidian.  Murky shadows gestate within the cool glassy sea, shifting languidly in the dim, unstable light.  Two hallways fork off from the entryway, slithering deeper into the depths of the foul temple.  The southern stone wall has crumbled, leaving a pile of rubble on the ground.  A jagged hole allows passage into a large chamber beyond.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Terror]]
description: Sleek obsidian walls extend into darkness to the north.  The ceiling vaults high above, thick shadows concealing what may perch overhead.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Terror]]
description: Masses of insects flood the floor of the narrow, dank hallway, producing moist crackling noises as carapaces are crushed with every step.  The choking stench of decomposing flesh invades the room and the nostrils.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Terror]]
description: The incessant hissing resounding through the close quarters reveals the shadow-shrouded presence of what must be thousands of cockroaches crawling along the slimy ground.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Terror]]
description: Rusty iron cages are affixed to the highly polished obsidian walls, their surfaces covered in an ever-flowing wave of insects.  Several of the restraints appear particularly brutal, bearing spikes to spear into flesh and bone at the slightest protest of a captive's predicament.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Terror]]
description: Luminous red lichen on the low ceiling casts a bloody sheen over the smooth, glassy northern wall.  Illuminated just under the obsidian's surface is the twisted skeleton of a hulking reptilian creature.  A head above the average Gor'Tog, the fanged skull protrudes from the solid rock.  Just below it, the skeletal tail is also exposed to the open air.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Anguish]]
description: The ceiling of the dark obsidian hall hangs low, lending an element of confinement to the stale musty air often found in enclosed spaces.  A dark pool of viscous liquid lies near the eastern wall.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Anguish]]
description: The overwhelming stench of bile rises from the ground, bringing with it a bitter taste.  The ceiling seems to slope lower further to the north.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Anguish]]
description: Rusty iron implements protrude awkwardly from the icy obsidian walls, stained with a thick crust of dried blood.  Nearby, the wall is notched with crude hashmarks, likely a calendar kept to catalog prolonged suffering.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Anguish]]
description: Corroded shackles anchored deep into the walls imprison weathered skeletons of victims long deceased.  Discolored bone fragments litter the floor as the restrained corpses give way to the siege of time, crumbling ever so slowly into the dust of which they were conceived.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Anguish]]
description: The low obsidian hallway meets an abrupt end at a small alcove.  A morbid effigy lies in the northern wall, a full skeleton mostly submerged within the dusky obsidian.  Protruding from the glassy prison is a Human skull and a single skeletal arm.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Grand Hall]]
description: The stone walls of the preceding caverns end abruptly, giving way to a crystalline hall of inky purple-black obsidian.  Murky shadows gestate  within the cool glassy sea, shifting languidly in the dim, unstable light.  Three  hallways fork off from the entryway, slithering deeper into the depths of the foul temple.  The southern stone wall has crumbled, leaving a pile of rubble on the ground.  A jagged hole allows passage into a large chamber beyond.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: Deep blue velvet tapestries drape down from the vaulted ceiling, framing the wide obsidian hall that extends northward.  To the south, the hallway ends in a grand antechamber.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: The obsidian walls here are highly polished to a mirrored sheen, duskily reflecting whatever passes.  The hallway is broad, but the hanging velvet tapestries swallow the space within their shadowed folds, narrowing the passage to a sliver.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: Veins of a red crystalline stone course through the obsidian ceiling, slathering a bloodshot sheen across the polished walls.  The velvet drapes cast long clawlike shadows across the smooth ebon floor.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: Twin statues carved of a rich midnight blue crystal flank either side of the hallway.  Each bears the likeness of a Human woman disfigured with reptilian features -- claws, wings, and fangs.  Both faces are alluring, a siren's call beckoning the unwary.  The figure to the west stands proudly, her arm raised and her fanged lips curled into a battle roar.  The eastern figure is solemn, her claws clasped demurely before her, both shoulders slumped under the weight of two enormous outstretched wings.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: The sleek walls crumble to the north, giving way to an open cavern that booms with the sound of rushing water.  Glistening in the darkness, an underground river flows to the east, threatening to sweep any who descend the jagged bank deep into the bowels of the cavern.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: Water crashes strongly against you, threatening to drag you with it on its eastward journey into unknown depths.  A jagged bank of rocky earth littered with crumbling obsidian shards ascends to the south, leading into a narrow hallway.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: The violent current crashes through the twisting caverns, snaking downward to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: Water crashes strongly against you, threatening to drag you with it on its eastward journey into unknown depths.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: Water crashes strongly against you, threatening to drag you with it on its eastward journey into unknown depths.  A jagged bank of rocky earth littered with crumbling obsidian shards ascends to the north, leading into a narrow hallway.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: The violent current crashes through the twisting caverns, snaking downward to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: Water crashes strongly against you, threatening to drag you with it on its eastward journey into unknown depths.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: The violent current crashes through the twisting caverns, snaking downward to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Cavern, Underground River]]
description: The violent current crashes through the twisting caverns, snaking downward to the east.  A steep drop-off appears just up ahead, the waters cascading brutally into the roaring darkness below.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: The sleek walls crumble to the south, giving way to an open cavern that booms with the sound of rushing water.  Glistening in the darkness, an underground river flows to the east, threatening to sweep any who descend the jagged bank deep into the bowels of the cavern.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: Claw-shaped sconces protruding seamlessly from the obsidian walls grasp feeble flames that faintly illuminate the hall.  A large circle has been outlined in the glassy floor, its borders etched in indecipherable runes.

title: [[Maelshyve's Fortress, Hall of Malice]]
description: Tapestries bearing the prominent image of a skyward-turned claw in blood red adorn the walls to either side, embroidered upon dark blue velvet.  Etched into the floor is a curiously placed circle of intricate runes.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Tendrils of brackish mist sweep errantly through the area, carried upon wretched zephyrs tainted by the noxious fumes drifting up from the swamp.  It's a wonder that any life can exist here, and that which does seems fouled beyond all hope of salvation.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A single violet flower blooms from a creeper vine draped between the wretched, clawlike trees above, a faint semblance of unperverted life amidst a garden of death and gloom.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Brackish water rises roughly knee-high on a Human throughout this swamp, making it quite laborious to trudge through the slime.  It is unknown what lurks beneath its depths due to the sickly greenish-brown color the mud has taken on.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A disgusting slurping noise constantly plagues your ears as bubbles rise to the surface of the swamp only to burst and release their noxious fumes into the air.  The looming foliage seems to draw in closer, the canopy above growing more confining as the gasses begin to take their toll.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A large, clawed footprint has been preserved in a raised portion of the mud here, a foreboding sign to travelers who dare disturb the eerie sense of peace that pervades this sickly wilderness.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A nearby tree lies half sunken into the marsh, severed from a trunk that has been splintered beyond recognition by some unknown act of nature -- or perhaps the unnatural forces that laid waste to this region.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A dense shawl of thorny brush all but completely covers a stone wall that looms to the east.  The brush grows even thicker to the north, diverting the path westward.  Underfoot, the squishy slurp of the swamp is ever-present, unyielding despite the thickness of the foliage here.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Creeping foliage has laid claim to the bizarre structure that skirts the eastern side of this murky path, draping it in a shroud of thorny brambles and withered vines.  Further to the south, a large stone paw stretches out, curving southeast toward the front of the structure.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Tendrils of brackish mist sweep errantly through the area, carried upon wretched zephyrs tainted by the noxious fumes drifting up from the swamp.  It's a wonder that any life can exist here, and that which does seems fouled beyond all hope of salvation.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]

The looming foliage seems to draw in closer, the canopy above growing more confining as the gasses begin to take their toll.

title: [[Zaulfung, Aldauth's Maw]]
description: A massive structure looms out of the mists at the north edge of the clearing, the only semblance of civilization amidst this wasteland of gaseous swamp.  Stylized and almost primitive, it appears to be a statue consisting of portions of three different animals that concoct a chimaera of great age and mystery.  Directly above, a giant stone vulture's head protrudes from a body much resembling a jackal's, with paws outstretched to either side.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: To the northeast, a massive stone structure rises from the murky depths of the Zaulfung.  Even to the untrained eye it is more than apparent that this was a primitive temple of sorts, a gathering place of those who lived in this region before it was wracked with whatever blight corrupted it so.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Thick, tangled vines with a dusky green tint clutch and strangle a lone berry bush, as if trying to slowly wring the life from it and draw it under the swamp to add to the collective decay of this region.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Withered and sickly-looking creeper vines dangle from the canopy of claw-like branches above, resembling lifeless snakes that have met the somber touch of Eylhaar, asphyxiated by the noxious fumes burbling from the murky waters below.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The squawk of a vulture echoes above the canopy of tainted trees, a sign of Aldauth's eternal grip on the tilted balance of life in this swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The faint scent of fresh air teases you, stirring from a gap in the thick canopy above the swamp.  The respite offered by the pale breeze is quite welcome, its worth to your lungs like a single diamond chip amidst a pile of coal.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The air is stagnant, laden with the brackish vapor seeping from the festering greenish-black waters of the Zaulfung.  It is unlikely that even a fresh coastal breeze buoyed upon Lemicus' wings could rid the swamp of the stench, the war of time already lost in saving this befouled wetland.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A single branch has splintered off a nearby tree, now slowly sinking into the murky quagmire below.  It reaches up like a wretched claw, grasping for what futile semblance of life it had attained in this foul garden.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A choking pall of putrid vapor drifts through the swamp, held prisoner by the canopy of tormented foliage above.  The gas weaves a monstrous miasma of death and destruction, one that no living creature should be subjected to.  It is a ghastly wonder what morbid fate could have created a place as horrid as this.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Thick reeds jut upward from the murky waters, forming a small burrow for the harmless creatures of the region.  The omnipresent canopy surrounding most of the swamp breaks here, allowing the fumes to drift upward into the sky, escaping the festering quagmire.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The miasma grows thicker, the noxious stench becoming almost too much to bear.  Each step is laborious and fatiguing, the knee-high muddy water making movement much slower than on dry land.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Putrid fumes rising from the swamp coalesce into a heavy blanket of black fog that flows all through the surrounding air, held in by the ceiling of twisted branches and vines above.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A looming blanket of black fog drifts lazily through the air, obscuring the sky and incubating the swamp's noxious gasses in the cramped space beneath the canopy of twisted trees above.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A raised portion of muddy soil to the east forks the path here.  Beyond the squishy mound, a wall of solid stone is visible, rising up into a primitive, almost animalistic form.  Thick tangles of shrubbery cling to its side, leaving very little to discern about its origin from this vantage.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Clouds of gnats flitter about with erratic purpose, inadvertently ending up in hair, nostrils, and open mouths.  Decaying foliage stagnates, half submerged in the stinking mire underfoot, and the likely attraction for the unwelcome swarm of pests.  It is all one can think of to get away from this place, or end up with a meal's worth of gnats rumbling about in their belly.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A narrow passage exists here, sandwiched between a great stone wall to the east and a tangled mass of thorny brambles to the west.  Working through the strange tunnel is difficult, the vapors rising from the muddy waters below threatening to overcome even the most hardy of Dwarven noses.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The structure to the east tapers, its surface curving smoothly to the northeast.  The stylized form of a hind leg is visible directly north, chiseled into the wall with some manner of primitive instruments that is far surpassed by more modern architectural feats.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Chisel marks cover the stone wall to the east, somewhat obscured by draping vines and clingy brambles.  The etchings are quite crude, but it is apparent that this is the hindquarters of some sort of beast -- perhaps a hound or even a jackal.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The subtle, constant slurp of the mire is shattered by the distant throaty cry of a buzzard.  Scanning the trees above, nothing resembling a semblance of life is visible, yet the sound remains imprinted into your mind.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A sickly-looking tree bends in despair beneath an unseen burden, its withered leaves dipping down into the thick, swampy path.  The canopy of trees above seems healthier, but the leaves have taken on a brackish green color that doesn't bode well for their destiny.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The brush grows denser here, thick tangles of foliage rising right out of the muddy waters, flourishing despite the deathly fumes that coil and swath every semblance of the living, threatening to wring the life from every last pore.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Thick tangles of thorny brambles cover what little land is elevated enough not to be drowned by the brackish mud, blocking the path on the easiest of routes and making it necessary to trudge through the muck and mire.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Dense thorny foliage obscures most of the structure that stretches out directly to the south, sculpted into the vague form of a jackal's hindquarters, sinking beneath the swamp's rancid surface.  A rigid stone tail rises from amidst the dense vegetation, decidedly not of mammal inspiration to those who created the strange monument.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A strange stone monument rises to the east, stretching far to the south.  From this vantage, it appears to be the hindquarters of what has been chiseled to resemble a jackal-like beast.  A strange obelisk of stone juts up where its tail would be, breaking the form of what would otherwise appear to be a quite realistic rendition of the animal.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A dense cloak of sickly vegetation lurks over the surface of a stone structure, rendering it impossible to climb without gaining a host of nasty (and possibly poisonous) laceration wounds.  A tall, shadowy spire is visible a short distance to the west, jutting out of the back of the mammalian stone figure.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The unforgiving mire grapples with every moving thing, ever-vigilant in its quest to devour all within its reach.  An eerie sense of purpose looms over the swamp, as if its very presence on Elanthia is not just simply a foul die cast upon Berengaria's golden plains.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A deep gash mars the side of the monument half-sunken into the marsh, a reminder of the horrors that must have befallen this area to send it so far down the spiral, shattered from the equilibrium of nature's cyclical balance.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A large skeleton of unknown origin lies half-sunken into marsh, tangled within the wicked clutches of the thorny brambles.  Its stature lends to the belief that it may have once been a Gor'Tog, but time and decomposition have mangled it so badly that it may simply be the remnants of one of the foul sluagh.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The sludge underfoot yawns open from time to time, releasing bubbles of noxious fumes into the air.  The pall of decay lingers heavily throughout the swamp, permeating everything with the sights, smells, and eerie silence of death.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A massive stone structure stretches to the north and south here, half-sunken into the swamp itself.  Irregular patterns of brambles twist and grapple over its surface, looking a great deal like thousands of scraggly clawed hands attempting to drag the grotto beneath the muddy sludge to devour it whole.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The eastern wall of brambles curves sharply to the south, widening the swampy path to make it passable around the front leg of the stone structure that blocks the direct southern route.  The carving is detailed even on this back side of the leg, its elbow jabbed deep down into the murky waters.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The massive arm of the stone jackal monument rises from the northern mire, stretching far out to the southwest.  Following the line of sight with the paw, a massive bird-like head is visible, looming above the brackish mist like some sort of twisted guardian.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A dense layer of brackish green fog is buoyed upon the air, constantly stagnating at eye-level.  The noxious stench emanating from the gasses is nearly too much to bear, and pockets of fresh air are slim and infrequent.  Stretching from the northeast to the southwest, a large stone structure serves as a landmark to this uncharted path, beckoning loiterers onward.

description: A giant paw sculpture of carved stone lies half-sunken into the marsh, still standing the height of two Gnomes.  Carefully-detailed claws clutch the muddy earth, as if afraid to let loose their grip and allow the entire structure to be devoured by the swamp.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A Gor'Tog-sized bubble of brownish-green expands and contracts in the middle of the swamp here, breathing with a life of its own.  Vicious claws loom from the trees overhead, shielding the enigmatic bubble from the elements and incubating the foul stew.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The bleak surroundings grow even more dismal, viewing the expanse of murky swamp laid out in all directions.  Twisted marsh-dwelling trees reach up like primitive claws, vying for respite in the clean air that exists far above the noxious gasses burbling up from the watery slime underfoot.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Murky slime burbles below, seeming to grow deeper and thicker the more one stands still.  Wild foliage climbs in every direction, the wicked and unintended children of the Zaulfung's inadvertent nourishment.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Thick, tangled brush flourishes over this murky swamp, obscured by a lazy black mist that constantly rolls up from the sludge underfoot.  The sickly gas tendrils writhe through the air, incorporating themselves with the sky above like a thick shawl of shadow.
