title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Main Office]]
description: Two clerks sit behind the counter taking orders and sorting through the day's various requisitions.  A pile of invoices and work orders are stacked high on the Society Master's desk in the rear of the office next to a tall book shelf.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Hallway]]
description: Pine paneled walls are nearly covered by racks of raw cloth and leather that flank either side of the narrow hallway.  In one corner sits a mannequin completely destitute of any type of clothing.  Tailors of all kinds rush back and forth, busy with their wares, dropping a random pin on the floor adding to the collection of scrap.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Book Store]]
description: The scent of tanning lotions lingers in the air from the hides covering the walls.  An overworked Elven fellow sits behind a small table scraping away at some leather that he pulls from the large pile on the table.  Several tall racks against a wall hold a plentiful supply of crafting books.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Tool Shop]]
description: The supply shop projects an air of quiet efficiency at all times with clerks refilling the various empty slots with new tools for sale.  Bottles, fabrics, and canvases stand neatly arranged on shelves that line the wall behind a polished white granite counter.  Several workrooms nearby provide enough static noise to block out the clerks idle conversations.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Material Depot]]
description: Three finely crafted rocking chairs sit around a round table in the center of the room where denizens will often sit and play a quick dice game while working away.  Shelves line the room where someone can set aside their work for a moment of rest, although those come few and far between.  A counter stocked with many types of fabrics and furs dominates one side of the room to make crafting materials readily accessible.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Hallway]]
description: The hallway comes to an abrupt end where it branches off into to three rooms separated by granite arches.  Scrap cloth and leather along with empty bottles litter the otherwise empty tile floor.  Busy tailors shuffle in and out of the rooms, avoiding the garbage on the floor, hurrying to get more supplies.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Weaving Room]]
description: Smoke from several sconces lining the room swirl out of the dim skylights overhead, and create a smoky fog along the ceiling.  Stained glass windows line the wall, reflecting the warm glow off the colored panes back into the room.  A long, thin rug decorated with embroidered sunbursts stretches in front of a hefty loom, a threadbare trail evidently marking where most weavers stand to perform their craft.  An azure granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Weaving Room]]
description: Open prairies and grasslands are painted in a panoramic mural that cover the stone walls from floor to ceiling.  Planted pots of junegrass and lilies are set up in a horseshoe around a hefty loom.  A beige granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Weaving Room]]
description: Darkness pours through the expansive windows as small candles on the sill illuminate the area.  Beneath a hefty loom is a lumpy burlap rug showing signs of wear atop a large lump, which props up the rug, from the shoes of many a weaver propping his feet up as he worked.  A grey granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Large panes of thick, frosted glass make up the ceiling of this room, reflecting flickering torchlight across the walls.  A large spinning wheel sits below the darkened skylight atop an intricate grass rug woven in a zig-zag pattern.  The workbench lining the back wall generally serves as a place to take a quick respite or work on a project that requires more attention to detail.  A puce granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Hundreds of stained glass panels make up the ceiling of this room, allowing the occasional glimpse of the skies above.  A painted spinning wheel sits below the skylight atop a rug dyed in vibrant greens and blues.  The workbench lining the back wall is splattered with various colored paints to add to the visual effect.  A white granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Alternating panels of ironwood and cedar surround the walls to form stripes of dark and light.  Torchlight reflects off the highly polished walls to showcase the large spinning wheel sitting atop a plush cotton rug near the center of the room.  Beneath it, the alternating woods come together in a point.  The only other piece of furniture to grace the room is a long workbench against the back wall.  A green granite arch leads back out into the building.

title: [[Dirge, Volcano Ledge]]
description: A narrow ledge has been hacked out of the side of one of the volcanoes that dominate Dirge.  Whether carved by nature or mortal hand none can tell.  The mountain falls away steeply below, and any attempt to traverse that slope would lead to a painful and lonely death on the jagged spires far below.  The route upward is as hopeless, so you remain like some spirit of air, poised between heaven and earth.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A precipitous ledge leads down into inky depths.  Cool air, tinged with a flinty dryness, drifts bits of dust and feather fluff about your feet.  The remains of numerous bird's nests lie scattered about on the ground and in every nook and crevice.  A wide crack in the rock leads to a painfully bright daylit exterior.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A faint breeze stirs the air, it appears to come from the direction of a twisting crack in the basalt wall.  Grit and dust covers the stony ground and a few dried leaves caught in a corner indicate a possible route to the outer world.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: You are wedged into a narrow crack in the rocks.  Jagged edges chafe at every bit of exposed flesh.  Crablike sideways movement is all that is possible.  The floor below pitches at a steep angle and one would surely fall if not held in a stony embrace.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A vast echoing space swallows your senses into utter darkness.  Unseen air currents brush by with cold, clammy hands.  Faint gleams of bone amongst piles of rubble mark the narrow edge of a seemingly bottomless crevasse.  A huge mound of bones to the east rises up to a darker spot in the darkness.  Far overhead, a few specks of light shine like stars against the dark rock.  Apparently when the roof collapsed, rifts opened to the outer air.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Balancing on a knife-edge of rock, darkness hangs over you like a heavy cloak.  Mounds of bones and gravel-sized rock slope steeply downward to the east and west.  Straining to pierce the Stygian blackness, there is the faintest glimmer of light from the west.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: The dark walls show signs of once having been smooth, but some upheaval of the earth has turned the arched dome into a jagged mass of splintered rock and shattered stone.  Mounds of bone lie heaped along the ruins of the walls, where their burial niches once held them.  There is little rest, even for the dead, in this world.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Broken and cracked rocks encumber your feet and the roof is a crazed mass of rotten stone that appears ready to crash down with no warning.  Splintered bits of bone poke out from among the piles of rock.  There is no way to tell if they are the remains of the ancient dead, or someone of more recent vintage who got very unlucky.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: This is a large cavern, almost circular in shape, with a domed roof of worked stone arching high overhead.  A low altar rises in the center of the cave.  Hundreds of bone-filled niches tower on all sides, climbing up the curving walls.  One great stalactite descends from the shrouded heights of the dome like the accusing finger of an angry god.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Sometime in the distant past, this passageway was wider.  A huge slab of rock has forced its way up from beneath like a stony wedge, narrowing the path almost to uselessness.  Occasional bits of bone litter the cracked and fissured ground.  The air is curiously damp, enough so that the walls are covered with a thick fur of moss or mold that gives off a musty stench like rotting leather mixed with rancid butter.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Dozens of niches carved deeply into the wall contain an overflowing abundance of bones.  Skulls and femurs, finger-bones and kneecaps litter the stony ground and roll everywhere.  Centuries of burial have crammed every crack and corner of the cave with the grim relics of the departed.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A cramped and twisted passage leads from one cavern to another.  Bone fragments litter the ground and larger remnants lie heaped against the walls. Chill breezes, scented with a tinge of rot, stir the air.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Cavern]]
description: This cavern is circular, with walls and floor polished smooth by time and human effort.  The air is thick with mingled odors and an odd white dust covers the floor.  The walls are crammed with hundreds of carved niches, rising far overhead on all sides.  Those nearest you are piled high with bones and skulls of all sizes and conditions.  A strong smell of decay and rot wafts up from a large pit in the center of the room.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A narrow, twisty passage wends among unclimbable mounds of broken rock.  Here and there, a skull rests upright by some chance upon a ledge or flat surface.  Each one seems to leer with silent mirth as you stumble and lurch on the uneven pathway.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A funnel-shaped area narrows to the northeast and widens out into a huge spherical chamber to the southwest.  The rock walls are featureless black stone, all texture melted and smoothed into a dull, glassy surface.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A narrow passageway opens out into a roughly spherical cave.  The walls are a curiously porous stone, resembling a petrified sponge.  The overall effect is that of being inside a bubble formed by some strange quirk of nature when the rock was soft and pliable.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A trio of spherical caves, like ebony pearls in a row, form a line one after another.  Shaped perhaps in the time of the volcano by hot gases surging outward, the inner surface of the rock is a mass of frozen froth.  In places it shows ripples and waves and flow marks, resembling custard stirred and left to harden.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A bubble-shaped cavern rises on all sides, nearly perfect in its symmetry.  The walls are a curiously porous rock, laced with millions of lesser bubbles.  The edges are brittle and sharp for all the seeming softness of the stone, caught in mid-flow and solidified.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: What was once a large cavern, roughly spherical in shape, has collapsed into formless heaps of rubble.  Unlike its brethren to the north, there is nothing of graceful arcs and curves here.  Only hard and brittle boulders of dull grey and black rock, jagged and misshapen lie within view.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: This large grey lump of ancient stone lies against the curve of the cave wall.  Above, on the wall itself, a dark pocket with jagged edges shows from whence it came.  Time has worn the boulder's surface into a series of pits and fissures.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: The inside of this boulder is cracked and fissured, so much so, one can find a limited amount of room to move about.  Jagged slabs of broken rock form rude walls, blocking vision and hampering movement.  Gravel rolls beneath your feet, making the footing uncertain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, down.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Stone walls curve in close above your head and jagged flakes of rock form shaky walls inside this oddly hollow boulder.  Something has made a nest here, tufts of rank hair and a few scattered bones attest to meals once consumed and dried droppings attest to their aftermath.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: Chunks of crumbling rock litter the cramped floor in this narrow hollow inside a huge boulder.  The rough ceiling presses down on heavily and the air is thick with dust.  A rising sense of claustrophobia grips at your mind.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: A few largish rocks and scattered pebbles litter the otherwise smooth floor. The cramped confines hem all movement and obscures vision.  The air is dead and still.  No wind has stirred here for ages and the air tastes of ashes and rock dust.  Dry and sere, it seems to lack any vitality.  It can be breathed, but it does not encourage one to linger.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: There is scant space to turn or move, broken slabs of rock nearly pin you against a cold wall of stone.  Flinty dust rises in a dry choking fog all about.  Silence hangs thick like a musty blanket.  The closeness is oppressive, daylight and fresh air are all but forgotten.

title: [[Dirge, Ossuary Caverns]]
description: This cramped space resembles a niche, someplace to place an idol or statue on display.  The entire weight of the massive, hollow boulder feels as if it might come crashing down at any moment.  Tiny flakes of rock drift everywhere in a constant rain, like dessicated snow.  They grate underfoot and coat every surface with a grey dust.

title: [[Dirge, Narrow Cave]]
description: This narrow cave resembles a hallway of sorts.  A cool breeze filters up from the darkness but it bears a hint of foulness and corruption.  The walls and floor are smooth and dry, though cold enough to seem clammy.

title: [[Dirge, Charnel Pit]]
description: The bottom of this pit is filled with a dark, thick liquid.  Viscous and foul-smelling, it fills a deeper pit almost to the rim.  Small waves travel across its surface though there is no wind to cause them.  Dozens of corroded bronze cages hang from the walls attached to long chains.  For centuries, the dead of Dirge have been brought here to have their flesh eaten away by the liquid in the pit and their polished bones laid in niches of remembrance in the room above.

title: [[Wilderness, Overgrown Path]]
description: A sharp movement in a low thicket sends stalks of stinging nettles sailing, slapping the air like angry insects.  A moment later, everything is silent.

title: [[Wilderness, Overgrown Path]]
description: An ambitious thicket of weeping hemlock reaches for the sky, casting odd dancing shadows on the ground.  A few twigs nearer the ground are broken, as if something had passed this way not long ago.

title: [[Wilderness, Overgrown Path]]
description: Tufts of goldenseal struggle amidst the tangled thicket of dry, scrubby boar-bristle bushes.  A faint trail of broken thorns leads off to the northeast.

title: [[Wilderness]]
description: Daylight clings like a fitful child to the thick forest and undergrowth.  Though it is possible to venture in most directions, it promises to be a frustrating, difficult and painful battle against the stubborn resistance of the woods.  Discerning the cardinal directions is a matter of guesswork and only close observation reveals anything of worth.

title: [[Wilderness]]
description: This area is virtually barren.  Only a few low, sickly bushes survive here on the rocky soil, their branches devoid of leaves.

title: [[Wilderness]]
description: A huge dead oak overhangs the road.  One enormous crabbed branch extends directly overhead, its smaller branches splayed like a giant, outstretched claw.

title: [[Pine Tree, Trunk]]
description: You rest a moment in the crotch of a dead branch that sticks out at an acute angle midway up the gnarled and twisted tree trunk.  Nearby, other trees break through the heavy thornbrake far below.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Urrem'tier's Temple, Interior]]
description: One single candle lights the way in the interior room of the temple.  The light flickers as an unnerving cool breeze that seems to come from nowhere chills the air.  Reflections can be seen on the walls made of black glasslike material that is polished to a high shine.  Unfamiliar scraping and hissing noises leave the hair at the nape of the neck standing on end.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Cambrigweld]]
description: Sheer-sided and sandy, this massive crater is utterly bereft of life.  A sharp smell, like heated metal, permeates the area.  A faint track picks its way up the southern slope of the crater back toward the main road and a narrow lava tube on the northwestern face leads into darkness.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Lava Tube]]
description: An uncomfortable heat radiates from the smooth, round walls.  The tube ends here with the southern maw opening into a massive crater.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Lava Tube]]
description: An uncomfortable heat radiates from the smooth, round walls.  The tube slowly curves here concealing either end of the tunnel.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Lava Tube]]
description: An uncomfortable heat radiates from the smooth, round walls.  The tube slowly slopes upwards towards the eastern maw.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Lava Flow]]
description: Undulating sheets of long hardened lava flow forth from an old lava tube.  A few stray cobblestones have survived both the lava the more recent explosion from which the massive crater to the south resulted.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Old Imperial Road]]
description: A crooked fissure brings the road to an abrupt end, glowing sullenly and casting forth an acrid sulfuric reek.  A collapsed black marble column serves as a makeshift bridge, allowing relatively safe passage to the northeast.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Old Imperial Road]]
description: A crooked fissure blocks passage to the southwest, a fallen black marble column serving as a makeshift bridge.  The road continues to the southeast, though it has been almost completely obliterated by drifting ash.  A rocky trail leads northwards to the collapsed ruins of a stone building.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: The ground here is blanketed in ankle-deep ash; the rocks and masonry hidden beneath making for treacherous footing.  A plinth from a massive black marble column lies shattered in two pieces; the scattered remains of the pillar stretching southward like an out-flung arm.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Old Imperial Road]]
description: The road ends abruptly here, a treacherous jumble of massive rocks making passage onward all but impossible.  The volcano looms to the northwest, rumbling and muttering like a sleeping giant.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: A precipitous escarpment rises directly off the canyon floor and up into the night sky.  A collection of dirt and rubble lies at the bottom of the cliff.
A precipitous escarpment rises directly off the canyon floor and up into the sky, tapering into a crooked spire high above.  A collection of dirt and rubble lies at the bottom of the cliff.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Dead End]]
description: Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  The path bends sharply around a corner and reaches a dead end.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Mesa]]
description: The top of this mesa is broad and flat, offering spectacular views of the varied rock formations and surrounding savannah.  With overhanging cliffs around most of the plateau, the only way down is an unstable, crumbling cliff on the south side.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  Upon closer scrutiny, a deeper gloom near the base of the cliff proves to be simply a large boulder.  A steep crumbling cliff rises to the east.

A large misshapen boulder lies near the canyon wall, its shadow a cool resting spot for the lizards that can occasionally be spotted bobbing their heads up and down.  Near the rock, a small group of cacti thrive in the dry canyon bed.  A steep crumbling cliff rises to the east.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, On the Cliff]]
description: The crumbling rock on the face of this steep cliff is extremely unstable.  Clinging precariously in the dark, your slightest movement causes small avalanches of rocks and soil to go careening down the bluff.

title: [[Sleeping Dragon Corn Maze, Rest Area]]
description: Set up as a small celebration area, the festival area for the corn maze is surrounded by a wooden fence.  Any grass in the area is thoroughly trampled by the heavy foot traffic, and the smell of ale hangs heavily in the air.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: A lone dogwood tree grows here, its white and red petals unexpectedly bright against the muted background of sand and silt at the bottom of the canyon.  A light, flowery scent wafts from the wizened tree.  Animal tracks mark the ground near the tree, evidence that these canyons are not as uninhabited as they appear.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  A light, flowery scent wafts from the vague outline of a wizened tree.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Dead End]]
description: Convoluted limbs shaped like skeletal arms extend into the narrowing canyon, grasping at passersby.  The path twists and turns until it reaches a dead end.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: A long precarious ledge angles sharply down the northern wall of the canyon, dwindling as it descends.  Small holes chipped in the unforgiving granite above the ledge are worn smooth from use.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  The dark line of a ledge leads up the north wall of the canyon.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, On the Ledge]]
description: A narrow ledge ascending steeply from the canyon floor culminates at a dark vertical crevice that splits the thick granite wall, its depth indeterminable without closer inspection.  Small smooth holes are carved into the face of the cliff above the ledge.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Cavern]]
description: A musty smell permeates this dark cavern.  Discarded rags lie along one wall, riddled with holes and infested with bugs.  Daylight is visible through a large vertical crevice in the granite.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Gnarled trees line the path in a row here, the handiwork of a passing traveler or nature's plan unknown.  Five-pointed leaves are scattered amongst the rubble of fallen rocks, their fading color dusted with the blue silt of an eroding stratum on the cliff above.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  A row of stunted trees is the likely source of the leaves that crunch underfoot.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: The chasm twists and narrows unexpectedly, the high cliffs closing in on the canyon floor.  Only a small patch of sky is visible beyond the steep walls.

Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  The chasm narrows unexpectedly, with the high cliffs closing in on the canyon floor.  Only a small patch of the night sky is visible beyond the steep walls.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Wind moans through the stark canyons and stone columns, the sound lonely and desolate.  Seemingly familiar sights, smells and sounds in this maze of canyons confound the senses with their disorganized patterns and could easily lead an inattentive wanderer astray.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Obstinately clinging to life, a cluster of gnarled cottonwood trees line the bed of an all but vanished stream.  A passing breeze rustles their leaves, exposing their silvery undersides to gleam in the light.  Dozens of small mounds near the roots of the trees swarm with red ants, moving quickly and purposefully about the canyon walls and floor.

Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  Near a stand of cottonwood trees the ground is alive with the movements of hundreds of red ants, tireless in their busy work.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: A colony of prairie dogs inhabits this broad valley between low bluffs.  With quick darting movements, they take turns poking their golden brown heads out of their burrows and looking about with bright eyes.  Their chittering and barking oscillates in an intermittent rhythm.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Several desert ironwood trees with smooth grey bark and glossy green leaves huddle around a small natural spring.  A rich, spicy fragrance emanates from white blossoms growing singly on elongated stems while some fallen flowers float serenely in the placid water of the spring.

Grey-barked desert ironwood trees shine with a faint silvery gleam in the starlight, clear white blossoms picking up and reflecting the milky hues until they glow like stained glass images.  Faint splashes disturb the mirror-like smoothness of the spring, sending light sparkling across the surface of the water.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: The ravine widens here and paths lead in three directions.  From this angle the surrounding geological formations look curiously like heads and faces engaged in an animated conversation.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: The canyon twists unexpectedly through the bluffs in this stretch of the path, widening slightly here as it snakes its way through the maze of weather-sculpted stone.  Off to one side a cairn of carefully stacked rocks and pebbles has been constructed.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Fantastic arches and pillars of ruddy sandstone, formed over centuries by the slow work of wind and water, loom silently on either side of the narrow track.  The passing wind sings eerily through the stone.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: Canyons twist and turn through the colorful bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  The cliffs taper off to the east, and the savannah can be glimpsed beyond the badlands.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Mosaic Bluffs]]
description: Spectacular rock formations dominate the eroded bluffs looming to the west.  Vividly colored in stratified shades of tan, black, red, blue, and green, the steep cliffs and arches soar over the canyons like rainbows in the distance.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: The crumbling canyon walls are bolstered in places by twisted and dwarfed trees that cling tenaciously to the nearly vertical surfaces.  Tiny birds flutter in and out of a small hole near one tree, the avian family choosing to make their home in solid rock rather than in the tortured vegetation.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Mosaic Bluffs]]
description: Named for their vividly colored layers of soil and minerals, the heavily eroded Mosaic Bluffs loom to the north.  From the muted hues of dun sandstone and dark charcoal to brighter strata of red, blue, and green,  the steep cliffs form a harmonious chiaroscuro of light and dark.  Scattered patches of rock nettle and purple star thistle quiver with each breezy gust of wind.
Huge dark shadows loom ominously to the north, blocking out part of the nighttime sky.  Nearby, small patches of rock nettle and purple star thistle rustle in the breeze.

title: [[Siegery Shop, Set Sets]]
description: Detailed maps of Ilithi's different roads and towns are painted on the walls.  The largest map depicts the city of Shard and the deep blue of the lake around it.  Two long tables of polished wood fill the floor space, while a thick black rug spreads from corner to corner.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Ferry Dock]]
description: Hard packed ground is littered with barrels, boxes and various conveyances awaiting the ferries' return to dock.  Smooth rock benches are scattered around the large area, for those travelers wishing to wait off their feet.  The dock itself is crafted from dark wood and braced by huge rocks and beams, while iron lanterns blaze from poles hung along each side.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, River Road]]
description: The south fork of the Segoltha River surges steadily eastward.  Compared to the aspects of the river on the other three sides of Ain Ghazal, the flow is deep and calm.  The lantern-lit South Dock, perpetually busy with ferry traffic, extends south from River Road.  The road itself curves northeast and northwest, and a steep slope leads upward.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, River Road]]
description: The well-built and durable East Pier connects to River Road at this spot.  Skiffs take the public to and from River Clan, loading and unloading people, animals and commodities on the wide, dimly lit pier.  This road arcs to the northwest and southwest, and a steep slope leads upward.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, River Road]]
description: The Segoltha water that crashes deafeningly against Ain Ghazal rock renders the surface of the road damp and fills the air with a fine mist.  A moist cliff leads uphill.

A fine mist of water floats above the Segoltha as the river crashes into a cluster of towering boulders and cleaves to flow in two branches around the island.  The surface of the road is damp and the air reverberates with the constant thunder of the battle between Segoltha water and Ain Ghazal rock.  A low wall borders the outside edge of the River Road and the Spiral Road branches upward to the southeast, heading toward the chateau at its apex.  A moist cliff also leads uphill.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, River Road]]
description: The roar of the river is inescapable as it echoes between the soaring heights of the Journalai Range to the north and the mass of Ain Ghazal to the south.  The River Road, bordered by a low wall, curves southwest and southeast, and a sheer cliff lies directly above.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, East Pier]]
description: Subtle light gleams from bronze lanterns hung from a couple of tall poles, leaving shadows along a wood pier that juts off from the hard packed ground.  The pier provides a sturdy transition from road to river conveyance, with its beams wide enough for large beasts to go safely aboard.  The river's brisk waters beat against the rocks below with a wild rhythm, while a sign nearby warns of their danger.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The Spiral Road curves downhill to the northwest and up to the northeast.  A steep slope leads straight down to the river and the South Dock, where ferries carrying passengers, caravans, and cargo hustle back and forth.  Overhead is a sheer cliff.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: A steep slope leads down to the River Road at its intersection with the East Pier.  The steady activity of passengers, skiffs, small boats, crates, barrels, and packages continues through the night.  A sheer cliff leads upward.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The sound of rushing water resonates against the mountain cliffs to the north.  Overhead is a perpendicular escarpment that appears difficult to climb, and a sheer cliff below would lead adventurous climbers down to the River Road.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The roar of the river is reminiscent of a powerful waterfall.  The road, which leads up to the southeast and down to the northeast, may be a longer journey between the docks and the chateau, but it appears to be much safer than attempting to climb the perpendicular escarpment above or the sheer cliff below.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: With lights reflecting in sparkles on the surface of the water, ferries move busily between the South Dock of Ain Ghazal and the Haalikshaal Highway Dock on the southern shore of the river.  The perpendicular escarpment above looks like a very difficult climb, and the sheer cliff below does not seem much easier.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: Visible from this location are the lights of the East Pier and the lit skiffs moving downstream and upstream, to and from River Clan.  The perpendicular escarpment above might be suitable for expert climbers, and a sheer cliff leads down to the segment of the road directly below.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: A dim precipice overhangs the road, and an escarpment leads downward.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The crash of the river against the foot of the island thunders through the air.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: Dimly illuminated ferries move quickly back and forth between the South Dock of Ain Ghazal and the dock at the terminus of the Haalikshaal Highway.  A precipice looms above the road, and on the other side of the road an escarpment may be a difficult shortcut to the section of road just below.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The distant lights of the East Pier and the skiffs it services are visible from this vantage.  A precipice juts out overhead, and a perpendicular escarpment lies between this section of the road and the section immediately below.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: Directly below this section of the Spiral Road is an overhanging precipice that makes it difficult to see the lower curves of the road.  Off to one side of the road is a good-sized sinkhole.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The road curves down to the northwest and up to some iron gates in the northeast.  Directly below, an overhanging precipice blocks the view of the rest of the island.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Spiral Road]]
description: The towering Journalai Range thrusts out from the earth just across the river from Ain Ghazal, obstructing the view of all areas farther north.  Directly below this section of the Spiral Road is an overhanging precipice that makes it difficult to see the lower curves of the road as it winds around the island.  Off to one side of the road is a sinkhole about twelve feet across.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Sinkhole]]
description: A jagged hole high above shows the sky, making this cavern appear to be some sort of sinkhole.  Boulders of all sizes litter the area, perhaps flung there by some long-past cave-in.  Soft green moss spreads across the floor like a living carpet, growing thickest directly under the wide opening.  Many bones poke through the greenery, the remains of some poor, doomed animals that fell to their deaths.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Amphitheater]]
description: A shallow stream runs along the bottom of a boulder-strewn passage for a short distance before disappearing into a narrow fissure running across the floor.  One wall of the passage is sheer rock, but the other is formed of tumbled boulders atop one another almost like tiered amphitheater seating.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Drogor's Gullet]]
description: Dark rock walls press close, forming a cramped tunnel.  The ceiling is festooned with rows of razor-sharp, blood-red stalactites that curve ever so slightly.  Fang-like stalagmites jutting up from the floor do little to dispel the impression of traveling down some monster's throat.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Red Pillars]]
description: Boulders littering the floor have lain undisturbed for ages, as proved by the white flowstone formation that drapes across the top and down one side of a massive pile.  Out of the pile extends a pair of red pillars connecting it to the ceiling.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Sewing Room]]
description: This narrow passage inclines steeply, making footing precarious.  A thick layer of loose rock and mud covering the floor compounds the problem, but with care and balance it is possible to move onwards.  Needle-like sprays of white crystal radiate from the walls and ceiling, adding a further impediment to travel.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Flowstone Cavern]]
description: Moisture percolating through the porous rocks above forms thin rivulets of water trickling across an immense and intricate white flowstone formation banded with shades of blue, grey and green.  The sound of water splashing as it drips into the puddles that litter the floor echoes incessantly in the large cavern.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Plunge]]
description: Narrow and treacherous, the way becomes less like a path than a ledge on the face of a steep rock wall.  Over the rim of the ledge, the crevasse plunges almost straight down, without any cracks or crevices to provide a solid grip for climbing.  The far wall of the cavern is hidden in the darkness, and only the echoes hint at its existence.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Shattered remains of a rock wall that once divided two smaller caverns cover the floor.  The stone lies splintered, destroyed by some angry force.  Scarred flowstone remnants cling to the ceiling and walls, their broken edges curiously clean, as if cut with surgical precision.  A distant rumble shivers the rock underfoot, perceptibly stronger to the north.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, By The Waterfall]]
description: A narrow shelf runs along the edge of a sheer precipice as it passes beneath a roaring cataract.  Bursting forth from a fissure high in the wall, the cascade of water falls in a thundering torrent into a churning black pool far below.  Mist wafts up from the depths of the gorge, slicking the rocks with condensation.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Sewing Room]]
description: This narrow passage inclines steeply, making footing precarious.  A thick layer of loose rock and mud covering the floor compounds the problem, but with care and balance it is possible to move onwards.  Needle-like sprays of white crystal radiate from the walls and ceiling, adding a further impediment to travel.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Underfoot lie patches of thick mud and golden-brown sand, but the walls are slick and clean.  Overhead the flat expanse of the ceiling is marred only by a few tiny cracks which extend a few feet then disappear into the smooth stone.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Twisting and turning, the narrow tunnel weaves a circuitous and disorienting path between craggy rock walls.  The ground underfoot is a slippery layer of mud and stone that shifts with every step.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Muddy Pit]]
description: Moisture seeps from the walls in slow trickles, pooling on a slick floor of dark clay mixed with sand.  Anyone wading through the cavern is in danger of being mired by the molasses-like consistency of the knee-deep sludge.  Jutting out of the muck is a low flowstone formation which is relatively smooth and flat in places, making it possible to sit upon.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Muddy Passage]]
description: Every exposed surface -- the floor, walls and even the ceiling -- is coated with thick mud.  Sloping downward, the ankle-deep muck gives way to a still pool of dark water filling one end of the cavern.  One can only surmise that the mud was deposited by receding floodwaters which filled the cave recently.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Mosaic Passage]]
description: A river once flowed freely through this tunnel, depositing a muddy clay residue which hardened over time.  Studded with chunks of white rock, the dark red clay covers the floor and rises halfway up the wall, looking much like a tile mosaic.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Cathedral Cavern]]
description: A broad open area lies between crowded ranks of stalagmites and massive, green-streaked columns.  With no rubble barring the way, it resembles nothing so much as a wide aisle in some great cathedral.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Copper Grotto]]
description: A thick vein of copper flows down one wall and runs across the floor.  The glittering metallic line has many spidery offshoots, each spreading for a short distance then tapering off into ever-thinner veins before disappearing altogether.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Odd bumps and protrusions cover the walls of the passage.  Some are smaller than a pea while others are larger than a boobrie egg.  The unusual formation gives the rock appearance of popcorn.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Rock Fall]]
description: The passage flares high and wide into a cavernous chamber where heaps of rubble litter the broad floor.  The debris spills from an enormous rock fall in the center of the room.  Multi-colored layers of stone are exposed on the ceiling where the chunks of rock have recently broken off, adding to the pile fallen in past upheavals.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Squeeze]]
description: Stone walls press inward, constricting the passage to its claustrophobic narrowest.  Red-swirled flowstone curtains flecked with sparkling mica nearly seal the tunnel at one point, leaving a narrow opening to squeeze through.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Shallow River Bed]]
description: Carved from the rock by an underground river, the tunnel walls are smooth rather than rough, and the ceiling and floor are barren of rocky growths.  Reduced now to a shallow stream, the clear waters cover a bed of fine sand with leaf fragments and water-polished quartz pebbles.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Shallow River Bed]]
description: Shallow water laps gently at the edges of a tumble of boulders in the middle of the cavern.  The water-worn rocks, too heavy to be pushed any further by the river that carved these tunnels ages ago, are riddled with dark scars where erosion has eaten away the outer stone.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Drains]]
description: Walls of water-cut limestone are covered with jagged edges, ready to slice whatever might fall down upon them.  Hundreds of trickling streams of water pour from the holes in the ceiling high overhead.  The water gathers in shallow rivulets before spilling down the sloping passage.  An uneven fault splits the floor, forking into many more.  The fissures split and split again, covering most of the floor with a web of flaws.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Smooth stone walls are covered with beads of water dripping down with inexorable slowness.  Puddles and tiny pools cover the floor, some spilling over to merge with the stream that winds between green- and blue-marbled stalagmites before disappearing into a pile of rocks.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: An extensive maze of cracks runs across the limestone walls and ceiling.  Dense clusters of calcite deposited by the mineral-rich water fill the intersecting fractures.  The resulting veins of white crystal stand out starkly against dark grey rock, as intricate as ornamental fretwork.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: A tier of white stalactites festoons the ceiling like elegant chandeliers.  Jagged stone stalagmites mark a staggered path through the cavern.  The way is treacherous, littered with loosely piled mounds of pebbles and slabs that shift underfoot.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Muddy Passage]]
description: Soaring up from the mud, strangely shaped columns stretch into the dark recesses of the stalactite-studded ceiling.  Yielding to the pull of gravity, heavy droplets of water saturated with dissolved minerals slide down the needle-like rock formations, dropping from above and forming miniature craters in the mud on impact.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: The rock walls and floor of this steeply sloping corridor are riddled with occasional splits and fissures.  Most can be stepped over with ease, but some would have to be jumped across by anyone shorter than an Olvi.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Draping from the ceiling to the edge of a blue-green pool is an expansive curtain of a creamy translucent mineral, dominating the small grotto.  Thin rivulets of water stream from cracks in the ceiling and flow down the curtain and into the pool with unusual quiet.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Crystal Grotto]]
description: Outcrops of crystal spar interspersed among the formations that cover the walls and ceiling make the grotto sparkle.  Only the smooth stone floor remains free of decoration and is coated with a fine grit of pulverized rock.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Blue-grey stone glitters with mineral deposits, flecks of gold glimmer in veins of quartz in the walls, and still more quartz forms rosettes adorned with many large, lustrous, dark red needles.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Glass Bower]]
description: Transparent stalactites grow from the ceiling, resembling glass more than stone.  Glittering like a glassblower's display, every surface is covered with curling streamers of crystalline minerals clustered together to form "cave flowers".

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Sparkling Grotto]]
description: The passage widens abruptly to reveal a grotto whose ceiling is lost in shadow high overhead.  Creamy flowstone curtains whorled with blue and green drape the walls.  Flecks of pure white calcite crystals are woven into the flowstone, sparkling with reflected light.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Drawing Deep]]
description: Although the bulk of it has long since crumbled into the gorge, a natural stone bridge once spanned the stream rushing through a channel carved deep into the rock.  The swift-moving water cuts across the cavern before disappearing into a narrow fissure.  From the black depths of the fissure comes a disquieting sucking sound.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: The walls slope sharply inward, narrowing and lowering the passage.  At the narrowest point the ceiling is low enough that members of the taller races would need to hunch over to keep from hitting their heads.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Stalagmites and rocky scree litter the floor and hinder the explorer in this long tunnel.  A pair of collapsed columns lean against one another for support.  Wedged tightly between one wall and a broken stalagmite, a slab of fallen stone rests at a near level angle, forming a natural table.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Fragments of the ceiling have collapsed here and there along the length of the tunnel.  The dark fissures exposed by the fall are jeweled with minerals that contrast starkly with the surrounding dull grey rock.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: The walls curve gently upward and inward to form a natural hemisphere of dark grey, mica-flecked stone.  Crystal spar decorates the ceiling and walls, tracing some of the cracks in a glittering display.  Sand lies deep on the floor, save for a few small piles of crystalline debris, apparently the remnant of something once attached to the ceiling that now lies in shattered ruin.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Great Hall]]
description: Widening abruptly, the tunnel affords a view of stately stone formations.  Untold years of dripping water depositing layers of colorful minerals have resulted in stalactites and stalagmites streaked with shades of blue and green.  Some meet in the middle to form columns, demonstrating the great age of this hall.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Widening slightly into a long channel of high-walled stone, the ceiling is lost in shadow high overhead.  A dun crystalline crust covers the walls, powdering and flaking with the lightest pressure.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Whistling Passage]]
description: A narrowing of the passage forces air to flow past with increased velocity, producing a faint whistling sound.  Thick, twisted stone columns run the length of the tunnel, like a marble colonnade supporting the vaulted ceiling of a grand ballroom.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Reflection Pools]]
description: A large flowstone formation banded in grey and white forms one wall in this gigantic cavern.  Numerous rimstone pools hug the bottom edge of the stone curtain, spilling downwards in terraced sections.  The unusually clear waters reflect the stalactites hanging from the ceiling overhead, creating the illusion of ruined towers drowned deep within the pools.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Choked Passage]]
description: Although this cavern must have once been fairly open, passage is now made difficult by rock formations jutting up from the floor and rubble where great stalactites have fallen in ages past.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: Seams in the ceiling are lined with long, needle-like clusters of stalactites, commonly referred to as "cave straw".  At intervals, mineral-rich water gathers from above to drip down onto the point of one of the many stalagmites.  Fragments of broken crystal needles litter the floor, resembling splinters of glass.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, White Grotto]]
description: Slanted walls and narrow passageways leave little room to maneuver without brushing against the delicate crystalline formations covering the rock.  Resembling fluttering ribbons frozen in a moment of time, twisting streamers of snowy calcite lend the grotto the appearance of a wedding pavilion.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Twisting Tunnel]]
description: The rock itself grows darker here, indicating a change in the nature of the stone as the passage winds its way onward.  Flecks of crystal glitter in the walls and ceiling.  The floor is uneven and covered with pebbles poking up through a layer of powdery sand.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Hot Springs]]
description: Rock walls soar upwards, coming together gradually to form a natural dome enclosing a cavern cratered with hot springs.  The stone floor is wildly uneven, creating ridges and half-walls of buckled stone that pose a threat to anyone walking through.  Brown and red streaked columns rise like twisting trees to support the vaulted ceiling high above.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Bubbling Spring]]
description: A hot spring roils and steams in the upper end of the gallery, rimmed by crowded stalagmites and flowstone streaked lemon-yellow.  The drab rock walls are smooth and damp, intermittently veined with yellow and red.  A faint, sulphuric scent rises from the pool.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, The Sauna]]
description: A soft mist spills out over the ground, issuing forth from a number of tiny fissures along one wall.  The air here feels warmer than in the rest of the cave, and it smells slightly of rotten eggs.  Deep crevices in the walls are lined with sparkling white crystals studded with lemon-yellow mineral deposits.

title: [[Kradhren Caverns, Steamy Grotto]]
description: Welling up from a crevice in the wall, a steamy trickle of water flows down a rock outcropping and into a shallow pool.  A creeping vapor clings to the surface of the water, filling the area with the stench of rotten eggs.

title: [[Sylvan Glade, Creek Inlet]]
description: Water from a deep creek rushes into a small inland pond. Fresh from its passage over cleansing rocks and sand, the water is crystal clear and the shadowed forms of fish can be seen gliding through the darkened depths of the pond.

title: [[Ushikhh's Tannery, Barter Tent]]
description: Piles of stacked skins, finished and unfinished, crowd the broad tent of calico patchwork hides and make it seem far smaller than it would appear from outside.  The overpowering fetid odor of the tanner's craft pervades the space within the tent, clutching at the throat and clinging to all who pass through.  Amid it all stands the tanner himself, apparently immune to the miasma from long exposure.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Spinning Parlor]]
description: A vast tapestry of nine golden stars sprinkled on a midnight blue background hangs upon one of the painted turquoise walls, while a soft woolen rug blankets the floor underfoot.  A large spinning wheel stands at the back of the parlor, while a large workbench and padded chair rest nearby, providing a place to relax or work on a project that requires more attention to detail.

title: [[Ratha Outfitting Society, Weaving Hall]]
description: Set in the back of the large workroom is a hefty loom.  Hooks and shelves line the painted turquoise walls, holding various tools and spools of thread that are currently not in use.  Next to the archway is a simple workbench and chair, a place to take a load off and enjoy a cool drink, and enjoy the fruits of one's labor.

title: [[Forging Society, Forge]]
description: A sturdy anvil dominates the center of this small forging area.  Heat pours out from the glowing forge and permeates the room as a small ceiling shaft tries futilely to draw it outside.  A slack tub stands guard below the forge, waiting to cool off the anvil's bounty, be they broken pieces or masterpieces.

title: [[Urrem'tier's Temple, Room of Death]]
description: Two acolytes stand guard over a cold black marble altar, while others drag the deceased and pull them on top in offering to Urrem'tier.  The darkness is broken by the lone torch that stands next to the altar, casting a glow on the black glass walls.

title: [[Urrem'tier's Temple, Dark Alcove]]
description: Snickering noises echo in the alcove, or maybe it is the unknown breeze that chills the air even colder here than in the outer room.  Shadows dance on the walls yet there is no light source visible to cause them.  A larger than life onyx scorpion statue stands menacingly in the middle of the room.

title: [[Urrem'tier's Temple, Under the Interior]]
description: The scraping noises are louder now and seem to come from all around.  An arched doorway is cut into the black rock that leads off into an endless tunnel.  Torches are placed over the doorway to help light the way through the darkness.

title: [[Under the Temple, Urrem'tier's Tunnel]]
description: Darkness permeates the cave with the only light coming from some source to the north of the tunnel.  Trickling noises seem to come from behind the walls as well as an unfamiliar hissing sound coming from somewhere within.

title: [[Aldauth's Lair, Cavern of Glass]]
description: Shadows flicker on every wall possibly coming from the torches reflecting off of the black crystal walls.  Tunnels branch off in many directions and show no signs of ending.  An unfamiliar sound, possibly hissing, is enough to make hair stand on end.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Aldauth's Lair, Cavern of Glass]]

title: [[Cavern of Glass, Eylhaar's Grotto]]
description: Formations of marbled white and black glass make up the interior of the grotto.  Less eerie here, light seems to filter in from cracks in the ceiling, giving an indication the exit is near.  The tunnel narrows down to an entrance leading north back towards safety.

title: [[Cavern of Glass, Eylhaar's Grotto]]
description: An almost eerie quiet fills this part of the cavern.  No sounds seem to filter through except for the occasional echo of a footstep nearby.  Carved images in the cavern walls depict scenes of death in a more natural state.

title: [[Cavern of Glass, Eylhaar's Grotto]]
description: An almost eerie quiet fills this part of the cavern.  No sounds seem to filter through except for the occasional echo of a footstep nearby.  Carved images in the cavern walls depict scenes of death in a more natural state.

description: An almost eerie quiet fills this part of the cavern.  No sounds seem to filter through except for the occasional echo of a footstep nearby.  Carved images in the cavern walls depict scenes of death in a more natural state.

title: [[Cavern of Glass, Shrine to Eylhaar]]
description: The obvious end of the tunnel is a shrine to the goddess Eylhaar.  A featureless statue, somewhat feminine in nature but with a hint of masculinity, stands next to a gnarled doorway.  The feeling of death hangs in the air, but is one of a more peaceful, natural death.  The walls themselves are etched with memorials of those who have died and may be buried here.

title: [[The Seerah, Foredeck]]
description: Rusted chains, frayed rope, and fragments of wood litter the foredeck, the debris scattered across the slanting ship.  With its weight crushing the sea-torn starboard rails, the giant foremast provides a bridge between the ship and the shallows, its upper portion now partly wedged in the rocks like a toothpick between the teeth.  Occasionally a fierce wave crashes against the creaking vessel, spraying it with water but doing little to move the ship from its impaled position.

title: [[The Seerah, Prow]]
description: Heavily pitched mahogany rails along the foredeck of the ship converge on the pulpit just above the headless figurehead.  Rusted chains and debris litter the area, most piled upon the lower eastern end of the prow.  Occasional spray slickens the deck, making it slightly hazardous.  Nestled between the rails is a small shrine, constructed from sea stones and hardened sand.

title: [[The Seerah, Main Deck]]
description: Securely nailed, a row of small tables lines the port side main deck, slanting in unison with the angle of the ship as if their battered surfaces were bowing to the cliff-lined coast.  Large sections of greying planks show through chipped white paint, and disturbingly large cracks cross the wood from the stress of the crash.  In the center, the remains of the main mast stick out like a jagged spike.

title: [[The Seerah, Quarterdeck]]
description: Splitting through the deck like a giant tree stump are the remains of the mizzenmast.  Its once proud sails have long since disappeared, leaving only rusted rings, wood splinters, and rope fragments to remember them by.  A narrow, steep stairs matches the deck's angle, making them a little trickier to navigate.

title: [[Ferashi'ini's Forge]]
description: Smoke fills the air as Ferashi'ini toils over his anvil in front of a massive brick forge, creating weapons with precision and skill.  His apprentice works by his side, keeping his master stocked with the supplies he needs and stoking the bellows to keep the fire raging.  Underneath a soot covered sign, several finished weapons have been mounted upon a display wall, their blades gleaming in the light of the fire.

title: [[The Sun Forge]]
description: The blended scents of oil, leather, and metal create the characteristic atmosphere of those rooms where the art of weapon repair holds sway.  Rough sandstone floors are kept swept clean, though occasional stray glints in the corners betray metallic shavings that have escaped from the workroom somewhere in the rear of the building that Fekoeti uses to ply his trade.

title: [[Cleric Shop, Showroom]]
description: A pair of tiny windows in the vaulted ceiling far overhead capture every errant breeze, transforming the hollow of the building into the bell of a great stone whistle.  Low thrumming notes resonate through the chamber and out onto the cobblestone street, carried on the back of swooping gusts that cause the wares on a pair of heavy wrought-iron tables to quiver.

title: [[Undergondola, Deep Pit]]
description: An unusually rancid aroma rises to meet the nostrils.  Lying farther back in a dark corner are the remains of some poor beast, once covered with a white downy coat but now disemboweled as fodder for scavengers.  Small rocks are arranged in a rather crude circle near the carcass, but no ashes are to be found within its perimeter.

title: [[Muspar'i, Urban Oasis]]
description: Shaded almost completely by the heavy cover of lofty palm trees, this small manmade pool brims with crystal blue refreshment.  Daylight peeks through the verdant green leaves to stripe both the water and the bordering sandstone bricks.  The pool's gentle undulations artistically distort the elaborate mosaic of vibrant tiles lining the bottom.

Lofty palm trees obscure the night sky almost completely, ensuring complete seclusion for visitors to the shadowy pool.  Occasionally, moonlight seeps through the dark leaves to stripe both the water and its border of sandstone bricks.  The pool's gentle undulations draw attention to a barely visible mosaic lining the bottom.

title: [[Hidden Clearing]]
description: A wild garden grows here with hawthorn and blackberry bushes that are plaited together by twisting vines of rambler roses.  Pale pink rose petals are strewn across the well-tended grass.  A stone urn filled with flowers sits on a pedestal in front of a wooden garden pavilion.

title: [[Secret Grotto]]
description: Faint moonlight streams through the translucent veil of rushing water that seals off this small cave, but does not provide enough illumination to reveal the surroundings.
Faint moonlight streams through the translucent veil of rushing water that seals off this small cave, but does not provide enough illumination to reveal the surroundings.

Sunlight sparkles through the translucent veil of rushing water that seals off this small cave.  The walls and ceiling have been painted with a lifelike mural depicting Lemicus, her head thrown back in laughter.  Handsome mermen attend her, brushing out her long golden tresses.  Through the babbling of the waterfall, one can almost hear her sweet laughter.

title: [[Shore Walk, Rocky Path]]
description: Giant boulders are scattered haphazardly about the ocean near the beach.  Curiously, smaller stones have been collected to form a rocky path atop the water -- wide enough for a pair of horses and long enough for at least ten.  The ocean's floor drops away to invisible depths at the pathway's midpoint, leaving little doubt that the end is quite deep indeed.  Tufts of soggy, seaweed-matted fur cling to the stones.

title: [[S'hhtrkith's Instruments]]
description: Meticulously placed with care upon the cushioned shelves circling the walls of this small sandstone shop are a variety of musical instruments.  The tenaciousness of S'hhtrkith's gentle and tender hand in the care of his goods shows that he is a true believer in the bardic spirit.

title: [[Melodies of the Earth]]
description: Light from the desert sky pierces through an elaborate, imported stained glass window, spraying streams of rainbow luminance upon shelves of instruments.  A wide counter spanning the length of the store separates the shopping area from the work and residence portions -- a stairway in the shadowy recesses of the shop stretches up to what presumably is a bedroom.

title: [[Muspar'i, Songs of the Sands]]
description: This small shop is cluttered with stands and racks bearing all manner of scrolls made of dozens of type of parchments -- some leathery, perhaps from certain desert beasts, while others appear to be of the highest quality paper.  From somewhere, whether within the shop or one of the nearby buildings or from the street itself, can be heard a faint singing.

title: [[Eretesk's Jugs]]
description: It is hard to walk through this medium-sized shop without tripping over the clay jugs splayed across the floor.  Eretesk's prized goods create something of a narrow, maze-like trail through the room as one navigates the stacks and piles of pottery products.

title: [[Uurlath's Clayware]]
description: Despite its small size, or perhaps because of it, Uurlath's tiny shop is extremely well kept.  The tiled floor is swept clean of dust, and the clay walls show signs of recent washing.  Narrow shelves line the walls, displaying the potter's wares.

title: [[Fragile Finds]]
description: Small and sparsely decorated, the sandstone shop offers a welcoming atmosphere all the same.  A bright blue rug with golden tassels rests just inside the door, directly across from a liberally padded counter and a small painting on the rear wall.  A pillow-topped pedestal stands tall and proud just in front of hexagonal window overlooking the busy street outside.

title: [[Porcelain Perfection]]
description: Smoothly woven white cloth hangs in folds from the cool sandstone ceiling to the matching floor in this sparsely decorated room.  A single shelf draped with thick black velvet provides a sharp contrast not only to the light cloth around it, but also to the creamy white porcelain dolls sitting patiently on it, waiting for a home.

title: [[A Dim Shop]]
description: Wobbling uncertainly just above a crooked shelf is a lantern hanging from the ceiling, making the shadows dance oddly across the walls and giving the room a more claustrophobic feeling than it already has.

title: [[Vhorsit's Unguents]]
description: Unbelievably cluttered, the tiny shop has clearly seen better days.  The slant to the walls, visible from outside, is also clear from within, and they lean precariously inward.  Bits of dried plants and preserved animal parts are tacked to the walls at random intervals.  At least partially cleared, a stained countertop displays a small collection of identical pots.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Hemlock Forest]]
description: In the shadow of the steep cliff rising to the north, the hemlocks grow close together, their branches entwined and woven in a matted mass of snarls.  The sky is barely visible overhead and only a wan light penetrates to the needle-covered forest floor.  The distant sound of tumbling rocks ricochets dully off the cliff face high overhead where something climbs, or falls.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Hemlock Forest]]
description: The narrow trail plunges on into the dense trees, weaving amongst the scented, drooping branches.  The smaller trees show scars where the bark was stripped away, either by a gnawing animal, or cut and harvested for medicinal uses.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Bottom of Cliff]]
description: A cliff rises overhead as the northeastern slope of the island sweeps upwards at an impossible angle.  The initial climb up is a mixture of earth and protruding rocks, but not far overhead is a broken face of red-veined dark stone.  Hemlock trees crowd right to the base of the cliff, a few smaller specimens even encroaching up the lower reaches of the ascent.

title: [[Muspar'i, Shadow of the Great Gate]]
description: This chunk of land hides in the overwhelming darkness, both from the structural behemoth and the presence of night.  Though it is hard to tell precisely due to limited visibility, the lot appears free of unnecessary objects and even the coating of sand upon the ground.  Everything about the area exudes separation and discretion.

This chunk of land hides in the absence of light produced by the structural behemoth.  No unnecessary objects mar the lot, which appears to receive regular cleaning in an effort to avoid any unwanted attention from the city maintenance workers.  Even the ground feels recently swept of its coating of sand, likely to eliminate the crunching of grit from hastened and frequent footsteps.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: Chiefly used as a storage facility, the rooftop houses dozens of crates brimming with shadows.  Gentle tings reminiscent of distant cathedral bells dance around the rooftop, seeming to come from the improbable musical stylings of the boxes themselves.  The enchanting scent of jasmine oil pervades the night air like a persistent perfume salesman.

Chiefly used as a storage facility, the rooftop houses dozens of crates brimming with small vials and other vessels.  A few of the opened boxes submit their contents to the constant contingent of sand in the breeze, and the grit tings upon contact with the material like the ringing of a thousand tiny golden bells.  The enchanting scent of jasmine oil pervades the warm air, escaping into the open from slim vents on the side of the building.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: The end of the sun's daily crusade slows the journeys of so many of the city's inhabitants.  A faint sulfuric aroma lingers within the hushed atmosphere, the odor a remnant of the secretive production processes carried on during the business day.  The night's cooler breezes dissipate the pungency, only to be faced with the same problem the following evening.

As the sun travels across the sky, so do the dedicated patrons through the city's shops, each person appearing stunted in stature from this heightened perspective.  A curious sulfuric aroma lingers with the tiny tornados of sand here, the odor betraying the secret production processes of various chemicals beneath the roof.  The day's warmth exaggerates the problem as the sun releases torrents of heat upon the roof.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: The singular melody plucked from a string instrument strains to eke out an existence amidst the quietude above the streets.  Several dark banners stationed in even intervals inflate with each gust of wind, adding a percussive beat to the periodic movement in the city.  The fabric also buffers rooftop loiterers from the all-too-observant eyes of law enforcement prowling through the shadows.

Discordant notes of practicing musicians clash together, failing to harmonize and instead composing a riot of noise below.  Several colorful banners stationed in even intervals around the rooftop billow in the blowing wind and lure customers into the shop underneath with eye-catching intrigue.  The fabric also buffers rooftop loiterers from the near constant attack from sweltering heat and shifting sands.

title: [[Muspar'i, Atop Heketha Theater]]
description: Pushed astray by sporadic desert winds, broken bottles and empty cartons roll across the rooftop in rhythmic fashion.  Squat ledges bordering the area as well as imperfect wooden lattices stand out, blacker than the deep blue of the night sky.  The sound of people is never far away, especially during the mad dashes in and out of the theater before and after each performance.

Broken bottles and empty cartons on the rooftop suggest the multiple uses of the building's topmost floor.  Squat ledges border the area, and in certain places, wooden planks form an imperfect lattice for increased security along the edges.  The sound of people is never far away despite the heat's attempts to suck the life out of everything that moves.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: The rooftop's surface shifts underfoot, with its layer of confetti and sand grinding against the tiles with each movement from intruders.  Though quieter now due to the late anlas, music from the streets serenades the space high above the enduring crowds, the noise bouncing off the walls to fill each crevice with sound.  The festivities distract potential onlookers from gazing at the rooftop for very long, rather entrancing them with magic and song to keep them occupied with their immediate surroundings.

An accumulation of faded confetti mixes with the desert sand to form an unusual carpet upon the rooftop.  Music and laughter from the performances in the streets sound just as lively here as if one were participating face to face, the noise bouncing off the city walls and bombarding everything in sight.  Thankfully, the festivities distract any potential onlookers from gazing at the rooftop for very long, ensuring some semblance of isolation amidst the chaos.

title: [[Muspar'i, Up a Palm Tree]]
description: Hidden amidst the shadows harbored by the branches and fronds, a circular platform extends inconspicuously around the trunk, high above the street.  The location provides a bird's-eye view of all activity below, though the volume of travelers is lessened by the onset of night.  A string of glowing lanterns stretches across the road to connect the tree to the rooftop of an adjacent building.

Hidden amidst the branches and fronds, a circular platform extends inconspicuously around the trunk, high above the street.  The location provides a bird's-eye view of all activity below, making the spot an ideal sniper's perch.  A string of vibrant lanterns stretches across the road to connect the tree to the rooftop of an adjacent building.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rear Lot]]
description: Sturdy wooden posts frame the small box of land, the fencing intended to provide as much asylum as possible, keeping the area's activity away from the prying eyes of local authorities.  A low canvas spreads across one corner to create a section completely overtaken by shadows.  Improvised seating in the form of discarded crates delivers a modicum of utilitarian hospitality.

Sturdy wooden posts frame the small box of land, the fencing intended to provide as much privacy as possible, keeping the area's activity away from the prying eyes of the public.  A low canvas spreads across one corner to create a section of shaded ground, an unpretentious respite from the scorching heat.  Improvised seating in the form of discarded fruit crates delivers a modicum of utilitarian hospitality.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: Situated in nearly the direct center of the city, the space here thrums with the pulse of urban nightlife.  A grand landscape of black and blue predominates, the regular desert hues painted over with shadow and darkness with a few twinkles of white from lit windows.  The silhouette of the Golden Heights towers over the rest of the streets, imposing an almost perceptible presence amidst the other structural inhabitants.

Situated in nearly the direct center of the city, the space here thrums with the bustle of daily life.  A grand landscape of yellow and tan predominates, though the colorful banners outside some vendors' stalls offer variety.  The angles of the Golden Heights tower over the rest of the streets, imposing an almost perceptible presence amidst the other structural inhabitants.

title: [[Muspar'i, Above the Marketplace]]
description: Despite the darkness, the distinctive buzz of the renowned bazaar below is still present, albeit more subdued.  Stacked wooden pallets produce a shadowy maze due to their inadvertent partitioning of the broad space.  When moonlight passes through the gaps in the planks, the illumination cast upon the ground mimics checkered tiles in a fancy salon.

Jingling coins, excited voices and braying pack animals characterize the distinctive buzz of the renowned bazaar below.  Wooden pallets bleached by the sun litter the area, placed here in stacks of five and ten and inadvertently producing partitions that divide the space, giving it a mazelike appearance.  When sunlight passes through the gaps in the planks, the shadows cast upon the ground mimic checkered tiles in a fancy salon.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: Though the spiky clusters in the corners of the confined space are no more than shadowy in the night's dim, they radiate warmth likely retained from bathing in the heat during the day.  A few cylindrical pipes sprout from the sandstone like motionless statues in an outdoor gallery.  The desert breeze blows over the openings, transforming them into crude instruments that color the silence with low, windy tones.

Scraps of metal cluster neatly in the corners of the confined space, promising blisters and pain to anyone foolish enough to tamper with them after immersion in the desert heat.  Sprouting from the sandstone, a few cylindrical pipes emit vapors from the forge below, gifting clouds to the almost always clear and sunny sky.  Dull clangs from singing hammers add a musical element to the atmosphere.

title: [[Muspar'i, Rooftop]]
description: Laid bare to face the glory of the night sky, the square of flat sandstone still retains the warmth from the desert sun.  The streets below lack their usual conversations of expensive treasures and rare finds, leaving the rooftop in marked silence.  Sand upon the ground manages to refract some of the available light, sparkling subtly like so many of the city's fantastic jewels exchanging hands.

Laid bare to face the full brunt of the desert sun, the square of flat sandstone releases heat in palpable waves that distort the air.  Conversations from below, mainly discussion of expensive treasures and rare finds, filter upward and illustrate the shoppers' and merchants' activity on the street.  In keeping with the theme, the sand sparkles brilliantly upon the ground like so many of the city's fantastic jewels exchanging hands.

title: [[Muspar'i, Behind the Justice Office]]
description: Overflow from the dump floods the shadowy crescent of space between a tall wall and the back of the building.  Dimly lit by the city's nighttime haze, simplistic texturing upon the stone reveals several imperfect attempts at defying the judicial authorities inside.

Overflow from the dump floods the crescent of space between a tall wall and the back of the building.  In apparent defiance of the judicial authorities inside, graffiti litters the stone, etched with several imperfect hands.

title: [[Uramih's Perfumerie]]
description: The overpowering smells in this shop, some sickeningly sweet while others are of a more tingling scent, serve as a testament of alchemists' fortitude that would make even the finest tanner, with all the rotting, tarry smells of their work, proud.  As a stark contrast to the deluging nasal distinction, the shop is visually nondescript -- unappealing sandstone walls, unpainted wooden door, unremarkable wooden table.

title: [[Adashjkah's Perfumes]]
description: Even the dullest and most congested nose would be overwhelmed by the staggering assailment of conflicting smells sealed within this bastion of olfactory strength.  Individually sampling the various perfumes within the shop's confines would serve as a virtual impossibility.

title: [[Tobriash's Workshop]]
description: A haze of pungent oily smoke belches from a tangled mass of copper piping, stinging your lungs and leaving a sticky film over the glass vials and jars that line the shelves along the wall.  The counters are littered with dried herbs, spilled ink and bits of paper as the alchemist, Tobriash Merrybay, works at his craft.

title: [[The Green Lady's Glasshouse]]
description: Water trickles over carefully placed rocks in a fountain that overflows to irrigate the plants of the greenhouse.  Small trees are planted in the lush brown soil, surrounded by low shrubs and vines.  A border of jadice flowers surrounds the gravel walk that winds its way among the plants as novices of the Order of the Green Lady continue their struggle to raise the healing herbs in the desert city of Muspar'i.

title: [[Sevitei's Strange Smells]]
description: This small shop is piled high with bizarre objects, stacked on shelves and racks encircling the sandstone room.  The odd ingredients and vials of unpleasant-smelling liquids are perhaps why Sevitei has a reputation for being the least successful alchemist and perfumer in Muspar'i.

title: [[Shasuro's Dyes]]
