description: Vibrant silk drapes obscure the rough sandstone of this shop's walls, while lively banners parade about the upper echelons, interrupted by a curtained archway leading to the back room.  Along the walls stand several large vats of dark, almost bubbling liquids and shelves of innumerable and quite unidentifiable alchemic concoctions and ingredients.  The materials, all of dazzling colors of a wide assortment, animate what might otherwise be dull in appearance.

title: [[Muspar'i, Street of Cloth Weavers]]
description: Here at the edge of the Street of Cloth Weavers, those not so accomplished in the trade ply their wares from trays and an occasional stall.  The poorer denizens of Muspar'i, rarely bothering to penetrate further down the row, flock here in hopes of snatching up the inexpensive castoffs of the more opulent districts catered to by the shops further to the southwest.

Darkness muffles this normally bustling avenue in a cloak of subdued neutrality.  While the occasional hopeful crier still plies his wares by torchlight, most have retreated to their pallets, wherever those meager dwellings might be.

title: [[Yhhsakri's Floor Tapestries]]
description: Thick, heavily dyed area rugs give Yhhsakri's shop the sharp, pungent scent of cloth dye.  Her wares adorn each of the four walls, leaving very little space between them.  The slate floor and clay ceiling are the only surfaces providing any respite from the colorful assault on the eyes, resting carefully unadorned in a quiet counterpoint to the intricately detailed rugs.

title: [[Danih's Pouches]]
description: A low-set table crouched down upon the rock floor glares across the small expanse of the shop toward a watery blue door.  Plopped onto and tossed about the table, numerous small pouches leave not a trace of wood uncovered.

title: [[Imogen's Accessories]]
description: A thick cloud of sandalwood incense engulfs your senses, hanging just below the low ceiling in a thin fog of blue smoke.  The shop is heavily decorated, trinkets of brass and drapings of colorful silk littering every available surface.  Imogen, though not present, makes her touch known through every nuance of her shop's vibrant display of undeniable -- style.

title: [[Shonu Ger, Sanji Osrel]]
description: Small tassels edge a cream-colored rattan rug that contrasts with the dark, sparse furnishings.  A large chandelier holds dozens of small candles whose bright flames are reflected by the crystal pieces displayed around the room.  An open black walnut bookcase displays three crystal sculptures, each on its own shelf.

title: [[Szilri's Formal Clothier]]
description: A wide table containing several sacks presents the weaver's craft to the browsers and shoppers while samples of her work hang from one wall.  Szilri, her work focusing on non-S'Kra formal clothing, runs a tidy shop with nary a speck of dust within her business.

title: [[Clothes by Ethanhhz]]
description: Enclosed within these rough and coarse sandstone walls is a surprisingly formal and showy stock of clothing, woven with an appeal to the discerning eye of wealth.  The products for sale adorn a stone countertop in the center of the cramped room.  A narrow brown door leads to the streets outside.

title: [[Almalne's Festive Wear]]
description: Sunlight streams through the small shop's windows, casting a warm glow over the work area.  Low stools provide a place for customers to stand for a fitting, and a comfortable rattan chair near the window offers the seamstress a place to sit while she sews.  A colorful braid of embroidery threads bears dozens of tiny silver bells that chime with each breath of wind.

title: [[Mhoishu's Clothes]]
description: A cyclical row of mannequins vainly model a few decorative articles of clothing, pleading with passing purchasers to exchange their lirums for the proffered pieces.  The clothing, most likely stitched by the old S'Kra shopkeeper that resides up the sealed-off stairwell, is all done in the traditional racial style.

title: [[Kohiti's Instrument Cloths]]
description: Bolts of many-colored cloth decorate this tiny interior, the silks and chamois and wool hanging from racks and poles.  As a stark contrast to the works-in-progress, a relatively long table displays the finished products.  The sedate and pacific Street of Cloth Weavers can be seen through a white door.

title: [[Neidle's Pattern Shop]]
description: Intricately embroidered patterns are displayed on the walls on cloth strips framed in teak wood.  Threads of different colors have been laid out onto a low counter and covered with glass, showcasing the different types that can be bought.  Neidle, the shop's proprietor, stands behind the counter, smiling at all who enter.

title: [[Lataanan's Clothing]]
description: A row of wooden mannequins displays fine sets of elegant green formal wear, the handiwork of the shop's proprietress, while a long table facing the shop's cream-painted door contains sets of the exquisite clothing bundled in knapsacks and backpacks.  Through the open doorway, the sounds of the city destroy any attempt at quiet in the shop.

title: [[Tuul Shho'i'yvvh-ur, Showroom]]
description: The floor of this small shop is laid with an exquisitely woven carpet showing the three moons in all their phases against a field of night blue silk.  Several oil lamps are suspended from the ceiling on fine silver chains, their flickering light illuminating a polished teak case along the back wall.  Centered upon the carpet is a low mahogany table covered with an ornate damask cloth.

title: [[Calabria's Daggers]]
description: A catalog rests on the rough wooden counter that divides the front sales area from the work area in the back of the shop.  Knives, daggers and short swords in various stages of completion are heaped in baskets along the back wall.  A sullen orange glow outlines the ill-fitting door that leads to the back room, evidently the forge to judge by the waves of heat that seep around the edges.

title: [[Silver Simplicity, Shop Interior]]
description: Bright sunlight from the open door shines where it touches the silver wares inside this shop.  Silver plaques crowd one another as they perch on mottled grey stone shelves lining the walls, each silently vying for attention as they stand among fellows of myriad shapes and sizes.  A counter of the same stone divides the room near the far wall, preventing the casual peruser from reaching the more delicate wares beyond.

title: [[Shoipak's Weaponry]]
description: Wooden and metal racks littering the floor and hanging from the shop's sandstone walls display an array of well-crafted weaponry.  A banner reclining along the far wall carries several sinuous marks.

title: [[Khidu's Shop]]
description: Unlike the owners of most shops in Muspar'i's many mercantile districts, this shopkeeper goes to great lengths to decorate his store.  The sandstone walls, normally a sedately tepid and uninspired color, have been painted in vibrant hues distinguishable, even from the street, through the store's two windows.  Several tapestries hanging above and beside a jewelry case serve to further set the establishment apart.

title: [[Golden Nusse]]
description: Shadows would drown the tiny room, were it not for the open doorway.  Various ragged rugs have been spread haphazardly atop each other on the floor, and brightly dyed gauzy fabric drapes from the ceiling to soften the stone walls.  Several rock pedestals are arranged in a semicircle on the carpets, each holding a silken scarf as backdrop for a piece of merchandise.  In the darkest corner, the attendant unobtrusively sips tea between customers.

title: [[Desert Jewels, Showroom]]
description: Muted shafts of colored light dapple the interior of the shop, cascading down from the abstract pattern of jewel-toned glass insets carefully placed in the vaulted ceiling.  Dangling down from the room's peak is a twisted confection of silver and brass chains, from which hangs a caliginous tzgaa orb.  Arranged on a shimmering sandstone counter are a marble tray, slightly tilted to better display the contents, and an obsidian rack.

title: [[Rataraduum's Fine Jewelry]]
description: Bejeweled metal ornaments ostentatiously line the plush interior of a glass case, the display curving in a crescentic way across an otherwise drab and unadorned shop.  Fastidious care is obviously paid the jewelry case, its imported velvet pillows fluffed, its fine glass unsmudged.

title: [[Naarti'hhs'naartin, Foyer]]
description: Frosted glass lanterns fill the foyer with soft light, complementing the warm wood paneling and thick, dark rugs.  A polished oak table laden with champagne sits in one corner, its lamp shaded with blue glass that casts a sapphirine glow on the wood behind it.  There are no windows, the better to close out the street sounds outside, but the ceilings are vaulted, creating an illusion of immense space.

title: [[Naarti'hhs'naartin, Hallway]]
description: Two elegantly garbed mannequins dominate the center of the hallway, set to either side of a simple wooden door made of rare desert pine.  The wall paneling becomes more elaborate here, carved at floor and ceiling with tiny flowers.  The pattern seems to extend the full length of the long hallway without repeating.

title: [[Naarti'hhs'naartin, Women's Wear]]
description: Tiny wooden panels no larger than a Halfling's thumb cover the floor below from wall to wall, forming an intricate pattern of swirling waves.  A large cabinet carved in the same pattern presides over the room, set between two bright oil lanterns.  Before it sits a low table, and on the far end of the room a tall rack shares a corner with an array of wooden mannequins.

title: [[Naarti'hhs'naartin, Men's Wear]]
description: Paneled in dark, fragrant sandalwood, the room is tasteful and bordering on austere.  Its only decoration is a delicate herringbone pattern carved into the wood just below the ceiling, encircling the room.  Small brass censers emit thin strands of blue smoke, filling the air with the scent of tiger lily incense.

title: [[Hekipe's Locksmithery, Private Quarters]]
description: Wavering light from a wrought iron candelabrum fights the abundant shadows residing in this small corner, hidden away from the main showroom.  Wax drips from the metal branches onto the surface of a circular table, the congealing liquid forming splatter patterns around several items for purchase, obviously selected for an exclusive clientele.  Placed under a small wooden shelf, a comfortable-looking, albeit drab, leather sofa fills the entire wall opposite the door.

title: [[Stairwell, Second Floor Landing]]
description: The dark stone staircase briefly halts its upward journey here at a small landing.  A brilliantly-colored green and gold patterned rug covers the stone floor of the landing, its surface slightly marred by the muddy tracks of a large cat.  A large tapestry hangs upon the wall, its surface depicting the aspects of Meraud.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Hall of Knowledge]]
description: Shaped like a hexagon, the Warrior Mage Guild's library is devoted to instructing members on the history of the Guild, as well as the arcane uses of their power.  Each of the six walls is covered in a mural inspired by one of the elements.  A stand of dark ebonwood holds many volumes of written lore, a treasure for all Mages.

title: [[Stairwell, Third Floor Landing]]
description: The third floor landing is devoted to the Warrior Mage's eternal companion:  his familiar.  Statues and tapestries depict the countless varieties of familiars, from lizard to dolphin and beyond.  An arch to the east leads to the familiar infirmary, where Mages can tend their companions if they become wounded in battle.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Infirmary]]
description: Since most familiars are too sensible to allow their Mage to perform major surgery on them, the small room set off the third floor landing only contains the bare necessities to prevent bleeding.  Cabinets filled with medical bandages and flat wooden boards for splints line the walls.  A large stone table, its surface lightly stained with blood, rests in the center of the room for those familiars small enough to fit upon it.

title: [[Stairwell, Fourth Floor Landing]]
description: The portion of the winding staircase that led up to the rooftop has been shattered beyond repair.  All that remains are a few fragments of stone that lie scattered about the landing.  A large glass window which once filled the room with light, is now obscured by a fog or mist outside the tower.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Barracks]]
description: The Guild barracks is dimly lit, the only source of light being what can filter through a large casement window on the western wall, and the mist beyond.  Rows of thinly padded cots and small chests fill the room, provided for the use of junior members of the Guild, or those too poor or avoidable to have a place of their own to stay.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Cloudwalk West]]
description: A portion of the cloud which surrounds Stormwill has solidified into a narrow walkway that circles the tower.  The mist looks as fragile as the rest of the cloud, yet seems sturdy enough to support a Gor'Tog in full plate armor.  Leading back into the tower is a small casement window, the only way to access the cloudwalk.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Cloudwalk North]]
description: The narrow ledge of mist continues wrapping around the tower, barely wide enough to sidle along.  A small gap in the mist provides a bird's-eye view of the city far, far below.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Cloudwalk East]]
description: The mist ledge broadens dramatically at the eastern side of the tower.  A small flight of stairs, each step made of the same mist as the ledge, leads up to the top of the tower.  The stormcloud rumbles and crackles threateningly above.

title: [[Stormwill Tower, Cloudwalk South]]
description: Where the other areas of the cloudwalk are sturdy as the ground itself, portions here have begun to weaken and dissipate.  The rest of the cloud is thicker than ever, its dark mass churning and rumbling as air currents sweep through it.

title: [[Eye of the Storm]]
description: The top of Stormwill Tower, as well as its highest floor, is completely enshrouded in a massive stormcloud which never dissipates or moves from its position.  Created years ago by a half-mad mage drunk with power, the storm is now a permanent fixture of the Tower.  Each Guildmaster devotes every waking moment to keeping the storm in check, preventing it from growing large enough to destroy the city.  A small flight of stairs, shaped from the very substance of the storm, leads down to the cloudwalk.

title: [[Riverhaven Hospital, Garden]]
description: The smell of herbs is strong in this small but well-kept garden.  Numerous herbal flower beds are laid out in rows holding Balm, Chickweed, Fenugreek, Basil and more.  An empath helps an elderly female dwarf slowly around the garden, all the while chanting softly to help ease the senior dwarf's old age ills.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: The weather outside suddenly seems beneficent.  Once the frigid wind enters this cavern, whether howling through the cave mouth or swooping in a hole in the mountainside, it gets trapped and gains power as it spirals between gaps in the cavern floors, walls and ceilings.  Each gust spreads a damp, brittle cold that chills even through the thickest armor while appearing to caress a variety of ice formations.  Depth perception is erratic as ice walls almost act like mirrors, reflecting what may not be there.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern ]]
description: A slight slope to the ice floor results in a slipping hazard that has been somewhat alleviated by battles fought in the area.  Constant melting and refreezing has mercifully ruined the smoothness of the cave floor, barely visible in some spots under clouded ice protrusions.  Gouges and ruts in the ice allow for last minute balance corrections, saving many a sore behind.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: Slippery tunnels, narrowed by ice, seem to twist and turn in no ordered direction.  A huge stalagmite forming here hampers progress even further.  Slick deposits of lime and frost coat the floor so thickly that in places only the most agile can safely pass between it and the ceiling.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: Frigid air stiffens anything warm-blooded and makes navigating the slippery cave more treacherous.  The thick ice encasing an extremely narrow passageway to the northeast seems pearlized, as if it was exposed to outside light.  Close inspection of some dark spots in the floor reveals rusted items trapped in the ice.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: Claustrophobia easily affects those susceptible, as perspective in here is skewed: the floor slopes slightly upward while the ceiling seems to plunge suddenly, looming just above a Gor'Tog's head.  Protrusions of thicker ice along the tunnel-like walls narrow the passageway further.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: Shards of ice litter the floor and crunch into tiny crystals under foot.  A few strands of matted hair are half frozen into the floor.  Puddles of water covered in a frigid glaze mask what lies beneath, increasing the challenge of choosing safe footing.  The slick walls act like mirrors, reflecting what may not be there.

title: [[Himineldar Shel, Ice Cavern]]
description: Thick frozen spires jut up from the slick floor, never quite meeting those that hang down from the roof of the cavern but coming close enough to force a change of direction.  Gaping holes in the cave floor plunge into inky depths below the frost line causing passage through the area to be slow and careful.  In some spots, newly formed ice tentatively creeps over old holes, but counting on its ability to hold weight is for the foolhardy.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Ladar's Shop]]
description: The sounds of industry are mysteriously quiet in this small alcove of the mountain.  Since many of his potential customers can perform their own repairs, the proprietor of this small shop, Ladar, has much of his time to himself.  He sits on a stool at the side of the room, moving only to take care of the rare customer who wanders in.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Heavy boulders leap out from the middle of the trail and hinder passage through the chasm.  Some stand proudly, reaching toward the sky, while others topple over to lean one against the other like a pair of drunks reeling home after a night at the tavern.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Off to one side of the faint trail through the chasm, a towering silverwood tree stands out amongst the otherwise barren and rocky landscape.  At its base is a stone marker etched with faintly visible lettering.  A lone chicory branch, withered and brown, lies next to the simple landmark.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Silence settles across the chasm, broken only by the occasional soft shower of pebbles down the cliff face.  Retreat continues to remain a viable option against whatever unseen foe might await in the blackness ahead.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Old bones lie in haphazard piles along the cavern floor.  In one far corner, a weathered and eyeless skull peers out from beneath the hood of a tattered grey cloak, its bony mouth agape in silent laughter at your courage.  Cold drafts creep along the floor, seeking out every gap in clothing or armor with a bone-chilling touch.

title: [[Muspar'i, Justice Office]]
description: The only decoration in this bland chamber is a raised dais, on which sits a single chair.  Used by the king's appointees to dole out justice, when they deign to make the trip to this room, the dais almost has the appearance of a throne.  On the far side of the office, a ring of bars surrounds the area where the prisoners are kept, and a heavy iron-bound door leads to the front of the building.

title: [[Muspar'i, Justice Office]]
description: One side of this small stone building is occupied by a large pile of sacks.  Periodically, guards in the red and black uniform of Muspar'i carelessly and haphazardly toss additional sacks, containing some hapless prisoner's belongings, onto the pile.  Near a narrow door, painted to match the justice officials' uniforms, sits a lone wooden desk.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Graveyard]]
description: Neat rows of headstones fill three quarters of this small cemetery, which looks to be kept clean and regularly maintained.  Set into the stone at the front of each grave marker is a simple medallion bearing the names of the monks entombed in the area.  Small poplar trees planted in each corner of the cemetery give a bit of shade.

title: [[Pinemast Field, Top of the Boulder]]
description: Moss, lichen and bare stone compose the surface of this broad rock, providing a pinnacle from which to view an extensive amount of surrounding land.  Pine to the east contrasts with the large wall to the west and the river beyond, separated only by the rock-strewn earth between.  Below, gouges in the soil are more discernible from this vantage point, seeming to concentrate around the base of the boulder.

title: [[Monastery Commons Room, Southwest Corner]]
description: The ceiling rises upward and toward the northeast to form a dramatic arched dome, a large marble obelisk centered exactly underneath it.  Puffy white clouds are painted onto the dome, giving it a very open feeling.  Several granite benches line the southern wall, providing a convenient place for a brief respite.

title: [[Monastery Commons Room, Northwest Corner]]
description: Overshadowing everything else in the room is a massive set of double doors in the northern wall, marking the main entrance to the building.  Although it appears to have been carved with many deities, all of the work is very abstract, making it impossible to recognize any individual one.  The rest of this corner of the commons room is quite bare, with no furnishings at all except a tall marble obelisk standing in the center of the room.

title: [[Monastery Commons Room, Northeast Corner]]
description: A dramatic arched dome rises in the center of the common room, a large marble obelisk positioned underneath it and standing quite tall.  Muted wisps of cloud are painted onto the dome, mimicking the noontime sky.  Several prayer mats are lined against the north and eastern walls, providing a convenient place for worship.

title: [[Monastery Commons Room, Southeast Corner]]
description: A curious arrangement graces the southern wall of the common room.  Three arched windows rise high in the stonework, two of them filled with clear, textured glass.  The third is crafted from elaborate stained glass, seeming a little out of place next to the others.  To the east is a small entryway, and a large marble obelisk stands in the center of the common room.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Entryway]]
description: Apparently a side entrance leading into the building, the door is rather plain, although it apparently sees frequent use.  Twin torches frame the entryway, set into metallic sconces bolted to rising columns in the corners of this short hallway.  A large common area opens up to the west, with a white obelisk standing in the center of it.

title: [[Monastery, Marble Hallway]]
description: The long stretch of corridor bears windows on the right side and a set of doors on the left, and is sparkling clean as if washed and dusted very recently.  Sloping stone ceilings arch upward, supported by marble pillars that stand at even intervals.  The dark marble floor is covered with a rich mahogany carpet that runs the center of the room where the most traffic tends to tread.

title: [[Monastery, Marble Hallway]]
description: The long stretch of corridor bears windows on the right side and a set of doors on the left, and is sparkling clean as if washed and dusted very recently.  Sloping stone ceilings arch upward, supported by marble pillars that stand at even intervals.  The dark marble floor is covered with a rich mahogany carpet that runs the center of the room where the most traffic tends to tread.

title: [[Monastery, Marble Hallway]]
description: The long stretch of corridor bears windows on the right side and a set of doors on the left, and is sparkling clean as if washed and dusted very recently.  Sloping stone ceilings arch upward, supported by marble pillars that stand at even intervals.  The dark marble floor is covered with a rich mahogany carpet that runs the center of the room where the most traffic tends to tread.

title: [[Monastery, Small Lounge]]
description: With an unusually low ceiling for the monastery, the wide room appears to be a converted wine cellar.  Long couches and tables line the walls of the room, and a few free standing clusters make ideal areas for small meetings.  Numerous silver and red banners drape the walls of the room, covered with abstract patterns that defy a clear meaning.

title: [[Monastery, Cloister]]
description: Two shade-filled arcades flanked by an array of plaster columns meet at the corner of this plain cloister, which ends to the south and west at grey stone walls.  The curving tops of the columns give way to stylized ogee arches that look out into a secret garden.  A small window is set in the northern wall, offering a glimpse into the monastery grounds.

title: [[Monastery, Cloister]]
description: The bright colors of the gardens beyond the massive arched opening are a vibrant contrast to the dull grey of the stone walls surrounding the meditation area.  A trio of thick reed mats lines the floor, each arranged in a circle surrounding a small fountain.  From outside, the peaceful cloister garden contributes its own natural perfume to the combination of fragrances wafting from the stalks of burning incense.

title: [[Monastery, Cloister]]
description: A light breeze drifts in from the open ogee arches to the south, bringing with it the scent of fresh flowers.  In sharp contrast to the color in the garden, the greyish stone walls are rather plain and completely unadorned.  Set in the eastern wall is a solid door made from cast iron, its top slightly arched.

title: [[Monastery, Quiet Library]]
description: Plain white marble walls surround the rather large room, which is quite clean and free of dust.  Large bookcases stand in neatly spaced rows, while a ring of shelves line the walls, neatly packed with books from top to bottom.  Several wooden benches provide a place to read, and a simple return desk stands at the front of the library.

title: [[Monastery, Side Yard]]
description: This small yard is rather enclosed but is maintained very well.  Covering the entire lawn is a bed of healthy-looking green grass, and a narrow fence connects to a small wooden building nearby, surrounding the peaceful area.  The walls of the structure look very freshly painted in a plain grey color.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, New Growth]]
description: Newer trees have started growing here near the edge of the grove, their size, while still large, is smaller than their neighbors to the east.  A single sapling grows out of line, its height not even that to rival a Gor'Tog, and its branches remain thin as they strive to grow to match the other trees.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Under the Branches]]
description: Once in a while a bird calls out to break the silence of the grove, unseen from some perch among the branches of the stately Ilithic apple trees.  Game trails wind through the debris on the ground, showing where animals make their way through the orchard.

title: [[Forest, Amongst the Trees]]
description: Periodic sounds of rustling branches and snapping twigs issue forth from deep within the trees, far out of sight in the darkness that pervades this area.  The air holds itself thickly still, a bated breath that never seems to be exhaled.

Old growth trees, mostly acantha and elmod with a smattering of birch, abound on every side, while enormous ferns vie for space with the various grasses and hostas that comprise most of the underbrush in this area.  Slightly flattened patches of plant-life wend about in a northerly fashion, bearing the signs of some large creature's recent egress.

title: [[Forest, Amongst the Trees]]
description: The surrounding darkness is nigh impenetrable as the overhanging branches all but blot out the sky above.  Gusts of somehow still stagnant-seeming wind rustle the surrounding foliage, causing it to whip about wildly.

The air seems nearly suffocatingly dense and the foliage whips about, propelled by gusts of wind that eddy within the crushed sections of underbrush, following in the footsteps of the unknown creature that disturbed this once-pristine forest.  Whatever it was, it managed to knock over several smaller trees, their shattered trunks testament to the strength of that which rent them.

title: [[Forest, Break in the Trees]]
description: The surrounding woods cast deep shadows over the sparse smattering of acanth and elmod tress that dot this small clearing.  Dark shapes move between the wildly overgrown plants that have taken up residence within the gaps, some obviously woodland creatures going about their nocturnal routines, while others seem so distorted that identification is all but impossible in the brief moments of their visibility.

The woods here thin out considerably, a sparse smattering of acanth and elmod trees all that remain within this small clearing.  Perhaps in response to this absence of competition for space and nutrients, the underbrush has grown especially wild and intermittent rustling sounds issue from within the dense foliage.

title: [[Cabin, Entrance]]
description: Worn to a smooth finish, plain ash flooring mirrors the planks used in both the walls and the ceiling.  Little embellishment is present in this small entryway, but the open floor plan allows for glimpses of a sitting area to the north, and the kitchen to the west.

title: [[Cabin, Kitchen]]
description: Sparse and utilitarian, this small kitchen might seem cozy if it had been decorated at all.  Instead, the granite countertop and simple pine chair seem almost unused, giving the room a clinical appearance that is only slightly marred by sooty smudges on the wood burning stove.

title: [[Cabin, Sitting Room]]
description: Though smelling faintly of must, this room is nonetheless rather inviting.  The floor here is mostly covered by a large earth-toned rug, while the walls have been hung with thick tapestries depicting woodland scenes.  Positioned around a circular table, a plush leather sofa is flanked by deep-green upholstered chairs.

title: [[Cabin, Vegetable Garden]]
description: This small garden appears remarkably still and quiet in the torchlight, with not even the usual sounds of the woods just beyond the fence-line audible from within its confines.  Various raised planting beds dot the area, casting long, deep shadows.  A slender slender white marble obelisk stands in the middle of the plantings, its slightly-rounded sides etched with precise patterns.

title: [[Cabin, Cellar]]
description: Carved into the earth itself, this simple root cellar is but tightly-packed dirt on its walls and floor, while the ceiling is comprised of the floorboards from the room above.  The heady scent of soil fills the air, though creeping moisture lends it a slightly moldering tinge.

title: [[Cabin, Upstairs Hall]]
description: Goldenrod and ochre tones saturate the carpet lining this narrow space, and a subtle scent of aged parchment fills the air.

title: [[Cabin, Library]]
description: More a storage space than a comfortable place to read, this room bears no furniture whatsoever outside of the heavy oaken shelves that line its walls.  Crates are arranged in neat rows along the floor, while a stack of stone tablets sits in one corner.  Much stronger than in the hallway to the east, the scent of aging parchment pervades the area, now mingled with more obscure, earthy undertones.

title: [[Xerasyth's Office]]
description: With a rough-hewn stone hearth and unadorned wooden walls, this office seems more functional than homey.  The simple cherrywood desk is bare save for a mug of tea, and the low side table next to it holds only a single book.  Darkness seems to seep into the room from the large picture window behind the desk, vying with the flickering light from bronze lanterns hanging above it.

title: [[Muspar'i, Garbage Dump]]
description: A collection of the entire city's disposed unpleasantness, the multiple levels of rotting refuse serve to destabilize one's footing and balance.  The sounds of opportunistic rodents moving through the rubbish sporadically fill the air, squeaking and crunching their way through the night in their own private tunnels.  Fortunately, the stifling heat of day is abated by the night's breezes, causing the reeking odor to relax its affront, at least until dawn.

Stained from years of exposure to all of the city's disposed unpleasantness, the ground bears a resemblance to distressed leather in both color and texture.  Opportunistic rodents scurry through the rubbish, only sporadically visible but always heard.  As if demanding attention simply by existing, the reeking odor emanating from the waste takes advantage of the heat, soaking the area in an almost tangible coating of taint.

title: [[Muspar'i, Back Alley]]
description: Stinking piles line the narrow passage, obviously not intended for public use, let alone at night.  Not subdued by the lack of the sun's heat, the stench forces passersby to squeeze up against the towering wall, presumably on the northwestern side of the city due to its height.  Sand sprinkles down from unseen locations above the cliff opposite the wall, likely kicked up by the howling desert wind.

Piles of stinking refuse line the narrow passage, obviously not intended for public use.  The garbage forces passersby to squeeze up against the towering wall that separates the northwestern side of the city from the desolate desert.  Sand sprinkles down like snow, kicked up in passing breezes from unseen locations atop the cliff opposite the wall.

title: [[Base of the Cliffs, Triangular Tunnel]]
description: Almost imperceptible against the predominant blackness, a sliver of light alludes to passage beyond the enormous cavern.  The corridor widens from the hint of illumination in a 'V' shape, though nothing beyond a massive sandstone column is evident.  Pinpricks of sound punctuate the quiet, quite possibly the noise of rock tumbling in the distance or the plight of a creature trapped and blinded by the dark.

title: [[Muspar'i, Crafter's Square]]
description: Beneath the torchlight of the broad square, a few artisans move through the area, their sacks laden with tools of their trade.  Small shops with clay tiled roofs are tucked amid the uuryvhh trees along the perimeter, the most predominent being the large whitewashed building of Muspar'i's Alchemy Society.  A wide cobbled path encircles a towering central statue, a trickling fountain at its base.

The broad square bustles with activity as several artisans move through the area, their sacks laden with tools of their trade while some carry wares to be delivered.  Small shops with clay tiled roofs are tucked amid the uuryvhh trees along the perimeter, the most predominent being the large whitewashed building of Muspar'i's Alchemy Society.  A wide cobbled path encircles a towering central statue, a trickling fountain at its base.

title: [[Muspar'i, Crafter's Square]]
description: Tucked amid the swaying uuryvhh trees, several small workshops surround the perimeter overlooking the towering central statue encircled by a trickling fountain at its base.  Seasoned artisans make their way along the darkened path, stopping occasionally to discuss business near the doors of Muspar'i's grand Outfitting Society.

Tucked amid the swaying uuryvhh trees, several small workshops surround the perimeter overlooking the towering central statue encircled by a trickling fountain at its base.  Seasoned artisans make their way along the cobbled path, stopping occasionally to discuss business near the doors of Muspar'i's grand Outfitting Society.

title: [[Muspar'i, Crafter's Square]]
description: A steady ribbon of smoke flutters across the evening sky from the stacks along the tiled roof of Muspar'i's Forging Society, its vast whitewashed walls dominating this portion of the broad square.  In the light of the surrounding torches, towering uuryvhh trees hunker over the polished sandstone benches that overlook the grand fountain, a statue of a S'Kra Mur man at its center.

A steady ribbon of smoke flutters from the stacks along the tiled roof of Muspar'i's Forging Society, its vast whitewashed walls dominating this portion of the broad square.  Towering uuryvhh trees hunker over the cobbled path, providing a rare bit of shade for the polished sandstone benches that overlook the grand fountain, a statue of a S'Kra Mur man at its center.

title: [[Muspar'i, Crafter's Square]]
description: A few artisans make their way along the cobbled path that encircles the area, some slipping through the doors of Muspar'i's Engineering Society, while others work their way to other buildings along the broad square.  A brief breeze rustles through the fronds of the towering uuryvhh trees, creating a slight mist from the central fountain that glistens in the surrounding torchlight.

Several bustling artisans make their way along the cobbled path that encircles the area, some slipping through the doors of Muspar'i's Engineering Society, while others work their way to other buildings along the broad square.  A brief breeze rustles through the fronds of the towering uuryvhh trees, creating a slight mist from the central fountain, a welcome repreive from the heat of the surrounding desert.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Reception Hall]]
description: Varicolored striations within the surrounding sandstone walls are incorporated into the decor of the reception hall, creating a harmonious ambience to the area.  Placed around the perimeter are rich goldenoak-framed sofas accented with pierced carvings, each cushioned with pillows of Musparan silk in dusky hues of azure, rose and amber.  Flowering potted vines hang overhead, complementing the palms and cacti that dot each corner below.  Muted conversations can be heard down the eastern corridor, while several artisans bustle through the area, their arms laden with their crafts.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Book Store]]
description: Jeweled brass lanterns overhead highlight a mural of sand-hued dunes with a stylized oasis that decorates one wall of the small book store.  At the far end of the room are several bamboo shelves flanked by broad potted palms where patrons browse before making their purchases at the nearby counter.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Slender brass planters mounted near the ceiling overflow with a variety of ivy plants, a few of their long tendrils clinging to the dusky-hued sandstone walls.  Framed sketches dot the length of the corridor beneath ornately jeweled sconces, each displaying a uniquely designed image.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Supply Outlet]]
description: Long swaths of vibrant silk crisscross the small outlet overhead, each sweeping to a central point of the ceiling near a hanging lantern, then out to various points along the walls to drape gracefully to the woven mat that covers the floor.  A series of rattan shelves and tables display a vast array of fabrics, leather and supplies as artisans bustle in and out of the area making their purchases.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Tool Store]]
description: A trio of tzgaa orbs hangs overhead, casting a soft glow over the area and a small counter along one wall.  The store's perimeter is lined with colorful wicker bins, each piled high with various waxes, tools and notions essential to the local craftsmen.  In a nearby corner, a large clay planter overflows with fragrant, flame-red dragon primroses, the redolent blossoms adding a pleasant touch to the otherwise utilitarian room.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Jeweled sconces shaped like clusters of palm fronds create plenty of soft lighting, while the supple ivies continue to cascade from their slender planters mounted high on the sandstone walls as the corridor branches in either direction.  Clay pots rest nearby, bursting with hearty and colorful purple sage shrubs that fill the area with a light herbal scent.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Dusky hues of azure, rose and amber are evident within the striations of the corridor's sandstone walls, a multitude of small flecks within the stone glinting in the soft light of the nearby sconces.  Sweeping potted palms rest in nearby corners, while an elaborate mosaic underfoot details the crest of the society.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Corridor]]
description: Dusky hues of azure, rose and amber are evident within the striations of the corridor's sandstone walls, a multitude of small flecks within the stone glinting in the soft light of the nearby sconces.  Sweeping potted palms rest in nearby corners, while an elaborate mosaic underfoot details the crest of the society.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Weaving Hall]]
description: Sweeping potted palms dot the corners of the brightly painted hall, a hefty loom resting along the far wall.  A series of shelves and hooks provide a place for storing supplies when not in use, while a simple workbench and chair nearby invite a leisurely rest and place to enjoy a cool drink.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Spinning Parlor]]
description: Clusters of lush sand verbena cascade from a broad planter hanging overhead, while a vibrant woven rug blankets the parlor's floor.  The sound of trickling water from an ornate niche within a nearby wall creates a soothing environment for artisans to practice their craft.  A large spinning wheel stands at the back of the parlor, while a large workbench and padded chair rest nearby, providing a place to relax or work on a project that requires more attention to detail.

title: [[Muspar'i Outfitting Society, Office]]
description: Hanging baskets of supple green ivy cascade from each corner of the small office, a few of their slender vines spidering their way across the varicolored sandstone walls.  The occasional ray of moonlight streams in from a large window, highlighting the carved goldenoak desk and rattan, peacock chair tucked behind it.  A wicker dress form stands nearby, draped with an opulent Musparan silk gown, accented with brilliant Heke'mhhg lazuli gems along the bodice.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Book Store]]
description: A colorful mosaic adorns the surrounding walls with a complex geometric pattern, the brass lantern overhead casting a soft glow upon the bookshelves nearby.  Over the vague sounds of hammering coming from beyond the curtained archway, a S'Kra Mur attendant watches over the area as he rests upon one of the plump tasseled pillows at the center of the room.  A gilded tray sits nearby, providing refreshments for those who frequent the area.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Hallway]]
description: The muted sounds of anvil work carry through the narrow hallway, the smell of smoke and sweet beeswax filling the air.  A pair of crossed damascended steel longswords are mounted upon the wall, a testament to the craftsmanship carried on within the walls of the vast society.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Deed Vendor]]
description: Colorful mosaic tiles decorate the walls of the area, while thick steel bars block access to a depot storing a multitude of resources and crafted goods.  Using an intricate network of ropes and pulleys, workers hoist the larger pieces atop the rows of massive shelving.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Tool Store]]
description: Several workmen shuffle in and out of the busy shop, hefting heavy oaken crates into stacks that stand along the surrounding walls.  A young S'Kra Mur woman tirelessly unpacks the many forging tools, arranging them upon broad tables that rest at the center of the room.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Supplies]]
description: Vibrant pigments adorn the walls, creating a colorful mural that depicts the several stages of the forging process.  A S'Kra Mur attendant bustles about the area as he maintains the vast array of stock available on the nearby tables.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Hallway]]
description: The muted sounds of anvil work carry through the narrow hallway, the smell of smoke and sweet beeswax filling the air.  Several suits of armor line the hallway, a testament to the craftsmanship carried on within the walls of the vast society.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Maker's Mark Shop]]
description: Tzgaa orbs hanging overhead cast vibrant hues over the many workbenches laden with tools and supplies beyond the broad counter.  Away from the clamor of the busy lobby and main forging area, future master smiths plot their technique choices as they study the many charts detailing their career options.  Several craftsmen huddle nearby as they deliberate over the designs of their soon-to-be-made crafter's mark.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Repair Shop and Storage]]
description: A heavy rope net drapes from the ceiling overhead, while a sweeping potted palm stands in a nearby corner of the brightly painted shop.  A long counter stands at the far end of the room, behind which a S'Kra Mur man busies himself with the task of repairing tools and tending to the stored goods on the shelves behind him.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Main Hall]]
description: Ornate mosaics surround the main hall with palette of vibrant colors, the imagery depicting several artisans developing their craft amid decorative arches of sweeping palms and blossoms.  A series of tzgaa orbs encircle the room overhead, highlighting the area and several benches that invite a leisurely rest as those bustling through the busy society stop and share their ideas.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Repair Shop]]
description: Clusters of hanging plants dot the corners of the brightly painted azure walls.  Bustling back and forth from the shop's backroom, several S'Kra Mur workers carry goods that are either in need of repair or have been completed.  Standing near several shelves laden with items waiting to be returned to their owners, the shop's repairman makes notes to a leather-bound ledger as he carefully inventories each piece.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Davattak's Office]]
description: Musky sweet scents waft through the small office from a brass incense burner resting upon a small table in a nearby corner.  Vibrant jeweled veins embed the polished stone walls with rich striations, offset by the soft woven mat that blankets the floor.  A large potted palm rests at the side of a stately desk with a series of parchments and ledgers stacked on its surface.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Corridor]]
description: Tiny glazed tiles mosaic the floor in a complex geometric design in vibrant hues of rich purple, offsetting the simple whitewashed sandstone walls along the length of the corridor.  Large tzgaa orbs dangle overhead from short chains, each highlighting the shop entrances to the north and south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Stone Outlet]]
description: Several stout workmen grunt under the weight of the rough-hewn crates they heft through the busy shop to the backroom.  Heavy blocks of marble and alabaster rest at various points along the sandstone floor, creating a narrow maze amid the additional shelves and tables holding a wide selection of stone and bone.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Workshop]]
description: Brightly painted walls surround the workshop with a vibrant mural of stately palms, the brass lanterns overhead providing additional lighting during the evening hours.  Unfinished stone furniture, statues and more are spread across the surfaces of the dozens of reinforced tables that form neat rows along the length of the room.  Several artisans pour over their creations, while attendants haul away other pieces too large to carry with an overhead system of pulleys and chains, storing them for later retrieval.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Workshop]]
description: Brightly painted walls surround the workshop with vibrant color, the brass lanterns overhead providing additional lighting during the evening hours.  Unfinished stone furniture, statues and more are spread across the surfaces of the dozens of reinforced tables that form neat rows along the length of the room.  Several artisans pour over their creations, while attendants haul away other pieces too large to carry with an overhead system of pulleys and chains, storing them for later retrieval.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Workshop]]
description: A complex geometric mosaic accents the floor of the spacious workshop, while several artisans tend to their craft at the many tables that line the room.  Society attendants bustle in and out of the area, some discussing techniques while others assist in the storage of the larger pieces using a system of pulleys and chains mounted overhead.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Crafting Supplies]]
description: Tzgaa orbs mounted in ornate holders along the vibrant azure walls light the shop's many wicker baskets and rattan shelves.  Several workers wander in and out restocking the wares while a S'Kra Mur attendant sees to the many crafters who stop by in need of supplies.

title: [[Misenseor Abbey, Narrow Stairway]]
description: A narrow, winding staircase has been chiseled into the bedrock foundation of the temple.  Twisting around a corner, the spiral passageway disappears into the unknown.  Stale air wafting up from the subterranean passages below carries with it a hint of rot and decay.  Moss and algae grow thickly on the stone steps, making for a dangerously slippery descent.

title: [[Misenseor Abbey, Narrow Stairway]]
description: If not for the dim light seeping in from above this narrow stairway would be cast in total darkness.  Stone stairs slick with moss and algae present a deadly consequence for the unwary.  The cramped confine of the stone passageway is magnified by the fetid air rising from deep below.

title: [[Misenseor Abbey, Narrow Stairway]]
description: This narrow, winding staircase has been chiseled in the bedrock foundation of the temple.  Far above, the spiral passageway disappears as it twists around a corner.  The faintest of light cuts the gloom as the stairway opens into the darkness of a chamber below.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: The air is cool and damp, laced with a strong malodorous scent coming from the passages beyond.  Small bits of shattered bone, torn clothing, shreds of leather and other debris litter the floor.  Near the gate, the walls are deeply scored and scratched as if something had tried to claw its way through to the other side.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A myriad of decayed cadavers lie in hastily constructed alcoves along both sides of the passage.  Twisting and turning, these halls of the dead quickly disorient and confuse.  Small pools of water, putrid with rot, fill the depressions in the uneven floor, and the odor of decay is overpowering.  An occasional alcove sits empty, giving one cause to wonder where the previous occupant now lies.

title: [[Watchtower, Command Center]]
description: The broken ends of termite eaten beams protrude from the walls above you, the floors they once supported having long ago collapsed, leaving only the towers ceiling far overhead still intact.  The shattered remains of furniture lie buried in a pile of rubble among chunks of wood and cracked bits of stone which have fallen from the upper stories.  A stone staircase along the inside wall looks mostly intact, and should offer access to the roof.

Thick wooden beams line the room, supporting large, smooth stones that make up the walls and ceiling.  Arranged in a semi-circle are some basic oaken chairs that face a massive table covered with maps of the local area and a pot of roasted coffee.  A well-worn footlocker is pushed against one wall, the surface stained from years serving as a makeshift table.  A wide stone staircase affixed to the wall offers access to the roof.

title: [[Ruined Watchtower, Roof]]
description: The tower offers a commanding view of the surrounding countryside.  Through the crenelations in the wall, you can look out for miles in any direction.  A strange apparatus in the center of the roof appears to be some sort of signalling device.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A myriad of decayed cadavers lie in hastily constructed alcoves along both sides of the passage.  Twisting and turning, these halls of the dead quickly disorient and confuse.  Small pools of water, putrid with rot, fill the depressions in the uneven floor, and the odor of decay is overpowering.  An occasional alcove sits empty, giving one cause to wonder where the previous occupant now lies.

title: [[Misenseor Abbey, Catacombs]]
description: Solid rock has been hewn away to form a crude antechamber.  The stone walls and ceiling seem to press in as if trying to stifle all light, sound, and life that would dare to enter.  A skeleton leans in final rest against a large iron gate that separates the antechamber from the catacombs beyond.  Peculiar growths have sprouted from the cracks in the floor, fed by the stagnant pools of water and perpetual darkness.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: Rubble and debris fill this burial chamber, a result of the partial collapse of the ceiling.  Many of the deceased once housed here have been crushed under the weight of the fallen stone.  Water flows freely down the western wall forming a stagnant pool.  A large iron gate once allowing egress into another region of the catacombs lies twisted and broken.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A myriad of decayed cadavers lie in hastily constructed alcoves along both sides of the passage.  Twisting and turning, these halls of the dead quickly disorient and confuse.  Small pools of water, putrid with rot, fill the depressions in the uneven floor, and the odor of decay is overpowering.  An occasional alcove sits empty, giving one cause to wonder where the previous occupant now lies.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A seemingly endless line of corpses runs down the length of this burial hallway.  Propped up against the rough stone walls they stand as silent sentinels to the ages.  The large empty eye sockets of almost countless skulls stare vacuously into the deep gloom.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Entrance]]
description: Piles of snow are scattered along a wide cobblestone path that runs between two low hills, the area blanketed in an eternal winter.  Ice is compacted into the spaces between the stones, the area's foot traffic only barely keeps up with the accumulation of fresh snow.  Evergreen trees mark the beginning of a small forest, their branches blanketed in mounds of powdery white snow with the smoothness of sugar-white frosting.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Icy Snowdrifts]]
description: Fields of freshly fallen snow blanket the somewhat hilly ground, ending to the north at a large frozen lake.  Wooden picket fences line the cobblestone pathway in even intervals, the boards heavy with numerous icicles.  Evergreen bushes dot the landscape, providing hints of green peeking through the powdery white snow.

title: [[Persida's Home, Garden Secrets]]
description: Flickering bronze lanterns hang from the branches of the surrounding magnolia trees, dappling the garden with enough softly golden light to allow for continued work well into the darkest hours.  Several freshly tilled flowerbeds dot the area, their dark mounds forming ominous shadows amongst the resplendent night-blooming flowers.  Additional lanterns hanging from wrought iron poles illuminate some steep flagstone steps that lead up to a thatch-roofed cottage resting upon the sloping hillside.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Icy Snowdrifts]]
description: An abandoned mitten hangs on a nearby fencepost, tattered and half unraveled by the winter wind to stream colorful trails of yarn into the drifting snow.  A few loose strands of the tangled cotton drift on the empty air, as if waving in celebration of the wintery season.  The rest of the landscape is a stark white, giving a background to the small splash of color.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Bridge]]
description: A narrow bridge crosses a small creek, runoff from the lake to the northwest.  The serene sound of trickling water comes from below, the landscape too dark to see much further.  Bushes line the winter stream, the red winter berries on their branches standing out against the darkness.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Evergreen Forest]]
description: Fresh snow blankets the ground in mounds, piling up between the trees and leaving the areas of the branches as havens mostly free from the snow.  Iron lamp posts mark both sides of the trail, the path underneath long hidden by the wind-frozen ice.  Each lantern casts a steady glow of yellow light in a circle around it, illuminating the snow and the pathway in even intervals.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Deep Forest]]
description: The branches of the evergreen trees nearly touch overhead, though the path winding through them has enough space to walk comfortably.  Though snow heavily lines the trees, the path is nearly clear of it, with only a few piles of powder here and there where they managed to filter through the trees.  Small pinecones are piled around the bases of the trees along the path, each one dusted with a bit of sparkling snow.

title: [[Javac's Place, Office]]
description: Cool night air streams in through the open east wall.  This room exits into an open-air courtyard.  In the middle of the room sits an etched steel desk.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Deep Forest]]
description: Old pine trees line either side of the path winding through the forest, their lower branches mostly clear and their upper branches heavy with fallen snow.  Small snowdrifts are piled up on both sides of the thoroughfare, the tops of them crusted over with thin layers of ice.  A pair of small lamp posts mark the pathway, both of them glowing brightly with a steady yellow light.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Deep Forest]]
description: Numerous evergreen trees fill the forest, all quite tall with thick trunks, and the path widens in the area.  Several boulders block off further exploration to the south and west, forcing the path to bend sharply to the north and east.  Snowdrifts blanket the ground, drifting into frozen waves away from the trodden path.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Deep Forest]]
description: The branches of evergreen trees sag heavily with the weight of the snow that covers them, and a slow but steady shower drips from them as the snow slowly slides off the branches in tiny chunks.  Patches of snow cover many of the tree trunks as well, most of it appearing to have been there for a very long time.  The path along the ground is clear, however, lined with narrow cobblestones that lead to a merry glade to the southeast.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Merry Glade]]
description: Opening up into a relatively clear area within the deep forest, the glade is brightly aglow with thousands of points of light that hang from the trees in colorful streams.  Holly and mistletoe hang from several of the trees, providing splashes of color in the white backdrop.  A large number of snowmen occupy the center of the clearing, each one dressed in a different winter outfit.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Merry Glade]]
description: Several benches line this section of the glade, making a ring around a cheery campfire.  Nearby, a large table is spread out with frozen winter treats along with a large carafe of steaming hot chocolate.  In contrast to the rest of the area, the ground is relatively free of snow, having melted from the fire's heat.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Merry Glade]]
description: A large red sleigh is parked at the northern end of the glade, decorated with large glass snowflakes and wrapped around the railings with tinsel.  In the driver's seat is a large snowman, with several snowman passengers riding behind him.  Hooked up to the front of the sleigh are several horses sculpted from ice, each crafted to look like it's about to start running.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Merry Glade]]
description: Numerous bootprints in the compacted snow on the ground indicate heavy traffic through the area.  Bright metallic streamers decorate the trees and the lamp posts that pepper the clearing, giving an air of lively cheer to the forest.  A large snowman stands at the eastern edge of the glade, tipping a black top hat in its stick hand.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain's Base]]
description: Twin lamp posts line the beginning of the steep mountain path, which climbs steadily to snake upward along the mountainside.  Several thin streamers decorate the posts of the lanterns, which are unlit during the daylight hours.  Tiny rabbit tracks are visible in the snow, indicating that the area is often frequented by them.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain Path]]
description: The mountainous path slopes sharply upward as it continues eastward, piercing the tops of the trees and continuing to a winding mountain path.  Toward the west, a merry glade can be seen past the tops of the trees, a band of snowmen in the center of it and colorful streamers decorating it throughout.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain Path]]
description: Elaborate ice crystal patterns cover the rock surfaces of the mountain, creating strange designs crafted purely by the forces of nature.  Snow-frosted evergreen trees are clearly visible far below, appearing to be in minature because of the distance.  Streams of snow blow around in tiny flurries, picked up by the lazy wind.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain Path]]
description: Fine, powdery snow piles in sparkling drifts that hug the mountain path, creating giant pillows for the thick white blanket that envelops the mountainside.  Thousands of points of brightly colored light glimmer softly through the thick ice, making the white snow crystals beneath shine in the thin mountain air.  Snowflakes carried on the wind constantly tumble down the mountain, adding to the thick piles already present.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain Path]]
description: Dark boulders lay broken on either side of the narrow mountain path, their granite faces rimed with a sparkling cloak of frost.  Thick blankets of ice-covered snow cover each side of the narrow trail.  The sheets of ice are perfectly smooth and have a pale blue tinge to them, resembling frozen waves vainly trying to climb to the peak.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Mountain Peak]]
description: The peak of the mountain looks down over the snowy landscape, unfolding like a giant map in all directions.  The merry Chris' Mass area is visible far below to the west, the pathways and skating lake blanketed with snow but still giving off a cheerful vibe.  Snow and mountainous regions spread out to the west, while the evergreen forest blankets the rest of the landscape.

The peak of the mountain looks down over the snowy landscape, unfolding like a giant map to the west.  The merry Chris' Mass area is visible far below to the west, the pathways and skating lake brightly lit with torches and lamp posts to give off a cheerful vibe.  Darkness spreads itself like a cloak in the other areas, only the Chris' Mass area brightly illuminated in the pale wintery night.

title: [[Iocanthe's Sanctuary, The Leafless Tree Room]]
description: Pale grey walls contain wide windows overlooking a misty field scattered with leafless trees.  No furniture distracts the mind from its contemplations of grey.

title: [[Iocanthe's Sanctuary, A Bland Void]]
description: Plenty of floor space offers seating.  Each wall is as bland and boring as the next.  There's nothing in here to look at except an unusually solid cloud that floats from one corner to the next in ceaseless flight.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Merry Glade]]
description: Numerous streamers cover the trees and zigzag across the sky to attach to lamp posts that line the pathway, coloring the landscape with bright reds, silvers, yellows, and blues.  Glass spheres hang on the nearby trees in elaborate arrangements, livening up the area.  The snowmen in the center of the glade are lined up to resemble a marching band, most holding silver instruments.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Evergreen Forest]]
description: Clumps of mistletoe hang from the branches of a nearby evergreen tree, growing wild and displaying bright red berries.  Numerous footprints in the snow show the plant as quite popular, and there are numerous bare spots on the branches where sprigs have been taken.  Still, the plant seems strong and hardy, the frequent pruning likely spurring it to an even more rapid growth.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Evergreen Forest]]
description: Large banks on either side of the pathway mark where some adventurous person tried in vain to shovel the snow away down to the path.  Long since covered up again by fresh snowfall, the mounded drifts have been molded into walkways, with tunnels dug out here and there.  Pine trees covered in snow stand tall just beyond the snowdrifts, framing the makeshift sculptures.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Evergreen Forest]]
description: Numerous deer tracks are scattered in the white snow, crossing the pathway and marking deer trails zigzagging through the forest.  The tracks seem to crowd around several of the barer trees, the bark stripped away and eaten to reveal the sapwood underneath.  The cloying smell of pinewood hangs in the cold air.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Foot of the Hill]]
description: Thick snow blankets a large hill at the edge of the forest, the large mound sloping at a steep angle.  Numerous tracks mark a path upward, following the edge of a long area of snow packed tightly by the passing of numerous sleds.  Sheets of ice dot the ground in several places, making the hillside even more treacherous -- or more fun, depending on the point of view.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Forest Clearing]]
description: Evergreen trees surround the large clearing, which is remarkably smooth and flat, the snow packed to be almost icy.  Large blocks of ice are cut clean and arranged in neat piles in various sizes.  Tall iron lamp posts line the edge of the clearing near the trees, dimmed by the daylight.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snow Covered Hill]]
description: The snow is packed firm on the eastern side of the hill, numerous sled marks dug into the ground.  Numerous footprints mar the western side of the hill, although most of them are half filled again with fresh snowfall.  Motes of light sparkle from the numerous drifts, while small dimples in the snow's surface show where the ground beneath is uneven.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snow Covered Hill]]
description: Wooden slats laid onto the ground form crude stairs, helping passersby on their way up the large hillside.  Bare tree trunks dot the side of the hill, their trunks standing out nearly black against the stark whiteness of the snow.  Halfway up, a small bench offers a bit of respite from the climb.  A single iron lantern stands post behind the bench, hung from an evergreen tree branch.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snowy Path]]
description: A plain wooden fence lines the edge of an evergreen forest nearby, mounded with powdery snow on its posts and numerous icicles hanging underneath.  Covered in snow, a large hill rises to the west, with several steps aiding the steep climb.  The air is crisp and cold, and the road is lined with iron lamp posts that stand sentinel in the snowy land.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Shop]]
description: Pools of melted snow mar the floor in places, and a heavily used mop rests in a corner of the room.  Sleds for sale hang on the walls, while tables spread out hold other winter wares for sale.  Large frost-coated windows look out on the evergreen forest outside.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snowy Path]]
description: Festive red and gold streamers decorate a row of bushes that lines the pathway, the colorful tinsel contrasting the snow in a celebration of the winter season.  Hints of a large frozen lake can be seen through the bushes, its surface smooth and glassy.  Long strands of green holly wrap around a series of lamp posts that follow the pathway.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Cabin]]
description: The winding path passes by a small cabin, its cheery windows hung with forest green curtains and coated with intricate patterns of frost.  Made almost entirely from thick logs, the exterior is rather rustic, although brightly decorated for the season with tinsel and bunches of holly.  A few wooden benches line the front porch, their tops dusted with fine powdery snow.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snowy Path]]
description: Nearly buried under the drifting snow, several bushes line the edge of a large lake to the south, with the stark whiteness broken only by hints of festive color decorating the evergreen branches.  Ripples in the snow form waves across the white drifts, contrasting the lake's perfectly smooth surface.  Small bells hang from iron lamp posts on either side of the pathway, and several are wrapped with red and green ribbons.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Log Cabin]]
description: Dark green couches line the interior of the cabin, the walls made of honey-colored wood slats and decorated at the edges with festive holly patterns.  A large poinsettia plant rests on a stand in the corner of the room, lending the warm room a bit of bright red color.  Several curtained windows show the snowy landscape outside.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Cabin Side Room]]
description: Built partially into the side of a hill, the spacious room's lower half is reinforced with loamy brick walls, separating at a slight angle and rising into warm wooden paneling.  Honey-colored benches line the walls, giving plenty of room for seating while a wide rug covers the center.  Light comes in from high windows, the snow piled up high to cover most of them.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Cabin Dance Floor]]
description: Wooden honey-colored slats create an elegant dance floor that takes up this corner of the rustic cabin, polished to a bright gleam and well trodden by numerous feet.  Quiet music wafts from by a small box on a silver stand, sending out out tinny but festive notes throughout the room.  Small benches edge the dance floor, offering a spot for the weary to rest.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Winter Banquet]]
description: A large banquet table lines the northern side of the room, covered in a snow-white cloth that holds a large spread of food.  Nearby, an elegantly carved bar holds numerous bottles of fine liqueurs and other drinks.  Paper cutouts of snowflakes are fastened to the cabin's honey-colored walls, varying from childish renditions to delicate works of art.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Cozy Den]]
description: Numerous overstuffed couches of dark red corduroy surround a low coffee table, and thick carpeting keeps the room warm and cozy.  Standing tall in one corner of the room is a high evergreen tree, decorated with motes of light from miniature gaethzen orbs and numerous glass spheres peeking out among ribbons and tinsel.  Large curtains are half drawn back from the frost-covered windows.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snowy Path]]
description: A sharp bend in the path is decorated with a large statue of a swan, formed entirely of ice.  Crystal clear and shining to resemble glass, the bird's wings are spread upward as if swimming, taking on a serene appearance.  Piles of snow litter the ground all around the swan, which seems curiously untouched by the winter weather.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Snowy Path]]
description: A dark wooden fence lines the edge of the nearby lake, powdery snow forming lumps on its posts and icicles filling in the spaces between its slats.  Cold and crisp, the air occasionally sparkles with snow stirred up from the ground that showers back to the ground in motes of light.  Iron lamp posts stand tall along the edges of the snowy path, dimmed by the daylight.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Lake's Edge]]
description: A large sled is parked on the side of the wide pathway, with narrow golden runners holding up its sleek red carriage.  Large leather straps attach to a harness and are heavy with silver bells, although the vehicle's horse is currently missing.  A wide lake is clearly visible to the east, spreading out in a glassy surface marred only by the occasional tracks of skates.

title: [[Chris' Mass, Lake's Edge]]
description: A large trellis arcs overhead and on either side of the wide path, decorated in festive colors and laced with purple snow crocuses, the hardy plants easily withstanding the harsh cold.  Wooden slats line the steep banks that lead down to the frozen lake, a small railing along the side set up to aid those wearing skates.  Strands of bright ribbon decorate the fences lining the path, each one edged in silver or gold.

title: [[Kaarina's Garden, Garden Clearing]]
description: A half circle of geometrically arranged stones leads to a pergola, away from the small clearing.  Thick moss and soft grass create a luxurious carpet of green life.  Tiny purple flowers have found their way into the garden, growing together in heavy patches near the rim of a metal lined pool.  The splashing sound of a waterfall beckons from nearby.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Riverside]]
description: The river burbles playfully along the base of the steep, muddy bank with a song that is steady and meditative, like a Cleric's chant.  Bright-winged moths flutter by, shimmering in borrowed light from the heavens.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: The frigid water gambols along the steep and muddy river's edge, so clear it catches whatever light fills the sky and twinkles like liquid silver.  The tree branches hanging over the river are heavy with birds searching the water for fish to eat.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: As the river bends, the shoreline seems to pull away its frilly vine-clad bank and the soft mud gives way to a stony incline littered with brown pine needles and sticks.  The shushing sound of the burbling water is overwhelming and soothing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: In all but the snowiest months of the year, lacy ferns grow in the rocky soil of the shore.  Their delicacy is in sharp contrast with the hardy woody plants that dominate the forest steppe, and their bright green color is a welcome addition to the cold greys, browns and blacks of the river's edge.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: Small streams of meltwater run down the steep riverbank, carving veins in the soil and carrying pine needles, cones and leaves down into the river where the currents carry it further south.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: Spreading the broad and graceful limbs of its ample crown over the river's edge, a quaking aspen's leaves shiver in the wind.  Though patches of ice and snow enjoy the deep shade along the riverbank during the majority of the year, they yield in warmest months to bright green clusters of skunk cabbage.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: Cedar trees shade the shoreline and scent the cool mist-filled air above the river with a clean, astringent fragrance.  Small eddies swirl in small coves along the soft, muddy bank, but the steady flow of the current prevents them from staying long enough to stagnate.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: The peaty edge of the land dips down into the cold, swiftly flowing water.  Clusters of hosta huddled along the edge and mimic the piles of rounded rock that dominate the shoreline to the south.  In the summer, they send up shoots of white flowers that bob in the breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: The cold currents steal whatever warmth they touch, flowing strong and clear as crystal.  Fish can be seen swimming far below the surface against the backdrop of the riverbed's pebbly grey-brown texture.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: The cold currents steal whatever warmth they touch, flowing strong and clear as crystal.  In the darkness, the river seems endless.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Hunter's Glade, Liirewsag River]]
description: The cold currents steal whatever warmth they touch, flowing strong and clear as crystal.  Fish can be seen swimming far below the surface against the backdrop of the riverbed's pebbly grey-brown texture.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Cabin, Vegetable Garden]]
description: Half-covered by a canvas awning and bordered by both a high fence and a screen of tall, densely-packed trees behind it, this garden is very well protected from outside elements.  Various raised planting beds dot the area, taking advantage of the small space with their tiered design.  A slender white marble obelisk stands in the middle of the plantings, its slightly-rounded sides etched with precise patterns.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar]]
description: This twisting path has been created over the years by the migration of animals.  Foliage deep green in coloration outlines the rough roadway, dwarfed by the massive trees that tower high above.  The faint smell of lilac and pine drifts causally though the air, filling the wood with the gentle aroma.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Barrier]]
description: The faint scent of pine is carried upon the air ever so slightly.  Small squirrels scamper along the edge of the path, searching for any stray bits of food accidentally left behind.  A large wooden barrier, painted with bold red lettering, reaches across the road to block passage northward.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Barrier]]
description: The large trees blossom in abundance, hugging the edges of the pathway through its twists and turns.  Small lilies and tulips grow sporadically amongst the underbrush adding a splash of color to the drab greens and brown of the wilderness.  A large barricade crafted of a dark wood rests across the pathway, settled deep into the earth.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The large trees lining this rugged pathway rise aloft to a massive canopy, extending to overlap protectively above the trail.  High overhead the dark greens shift in the breeze, causing breaks and gaps revealing brief glimpses of the sky beyond.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
