description: The light tan of the rugged pathway stands out in contrast to the deep greens of the lush foliage.  A thick carpet of leaf litter, muddy brown in coloration, shifts with the movement of the wind sweeping through the surrounding forest.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Small bits of bone are scattered about the trail in a slapdash fashion, and many of the surrounding trees have been marred by deep slashes and gouges.  Within the bowels of the dense wilderness, the sharp sounds of cracking branches reverberate through the air.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Weeping Willow]]
description: The pathway widens to a small clearing where a massive weeping willow has been planted, dead center.  Brownish grey branches reach outward from a thick trunk flawed by deep carvings.  At its foot, a thick patch of white roses flourish under the safety of the mighty tree.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The tan trail narrows out gradually as the surrounding wilderness presses in close.  The trail east slants downward into a small, narrow gully.  From this vantage point, a large mountain can be made out through the swaying leaves of the trees, its snow capped summit reaching high above.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Trench]]
description: Dark earthen walls tower high above, worn smooth over time by the unforgiving elements.  Large patches of a brownish green moss flourish all around, tightly clinging to any available surface.  To the west, a large slope rises out of the cool water, also coated in a dense layer of moss.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Trench]]
description: Gently, the murky water laps against a steep slope leading upward and away from the brackish filth held within the trench.  A few lily pads float upon the surface, blooming with large yellow flowers and shifting with the slightest movement of the water.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Trench]]
description: Gnats and other flying pests swarm about, moving in as if working with a single mind.  An antediluvian ironwood tree lays collapsed across the opening above, partly blocking the view.  Thick creepers and other hanging plant life sway to and fro suspended from the fallen tree, partially concealing a dark crevice in the wall.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Cavern]]
description: Rough walls, dark in coloration, form a dome that peaks high above where a section of the ceiling has collapsed, yet there is no trace of rubble anywhere.  Now in disarray, the remnants of a rough campsite remain, ready for another resident.  Four thick logs are arranged around a large fire pit.  Close by, a fetid pile of hay with a tattered cloak draped across it forms a makeshift bed.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Trench]]
description: Brackish water coats the area above the waterline with a thick black film as it sloshes against the worn rock walls that outline this narrow gully.  To the east, its steep surface covered in a tangle of withered roots, an earthen slope rises from beneath the stagnant water.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The twisting trail expands drastically as the dense wilderness of the west begins to thin here.  Visible through gaps in the trees, a large mountain dominates most of the view of the northern sky.  Leading down into a deep, murky trench is a steep slope that is covered with patches of withered roots.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The trail slants slightly from north to south, following the curve of a large mountain's foot.  Elder trees and small saplings dot a gentle slope, climbing slowly up the rocky face to its snowcapped peaks.  A few wood violets grow in random patches alongside the track, filling the air with their fragrance.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: A large granite boulder has settled on the footway, hindering passage northeastward.  From here, a large trench has been cut along side the mountain, showing the destructive path this oversized rock took to reach its final destination.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Small bits of rubble lay strewn about, not much more than random pieces tossed away from a mammoth boulder before it came to rest on the trail.  A light growth of trees surrounds the path, green foliage swaying gently with any movement of the wind.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Tightly hugging the rocky landscape, the animal trail flows with each bend and turn nature bestowed upon this colossal mountain.  Along one side of the path, a great earth wall reaches skyward and on the other, a thick forest flourishes allowing no deviance from the asperous trail.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: A legion of animal tracks marks the trail, traveling in virtually every direction without rhyme or reason.  From the forested side of the footway, a faint, rattling hiss can be heard from deep within the tangled scrub brush.  The gentle shudder of leaves fill the verdant wood as the canopy sways in the slightest breeze.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Obscure limbs form the canopy aloft, sweeping from side to side to reveal the sky above.  A few dead leaves precariously cling to withered branches, their burnt yellow surfaces standing on stark contrast against the sea of green.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Copious amounts of rubble have fallen upon the pathway against the mountain's side, rising high above the original animal trail.  A tangle of snake-like creepers and vines wind along the craggy surface, their pale green skin covered in a tangle of wickedly sharp yellow thorns.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Rock Slide]]
description: Hundreds upon hundreds of rocks are piled on top of each other to form this natural walkway.  With each step, the rubble shifts and settles, making quick passage nearly impossible.  Crooked treetops reach up from the valley below, gently swaying back and fourth in the sporadic breeze.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Rock Slide]]
description: The rock wall to the west rises high into the sky, making climbing extremely difficult.  Small grey lizards scamper across the stone with unknown intent, easily traveling across its surface worn smooth by the elements.  Occasionally, a brisk breeze sweeps across the slide's face, sending small bits of rubble tumbling over the edge.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Rock Slide]]
description: Large liana vines sprout between stones in the massive rubble pile, crawling up the smooth rock face.  Pristine white flowers adorn the thick vines, bending in odd directions as they attempt to utilize any light in the most efficient way possible.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The smooth rock wall bends at a sharp angle as it comes to a corner.  To the south is a large earthen bridge spanning a narrow chasm, created from debris that has fallen from higher up the mountain.  Far below, an animal trail is visible following the forest's contours.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The dark rock walls hug the interior of the animal trail, arching downward to nothing more then a small slope.  A large earthen bridge spans across a deep chasm, created by rocks and boulders falling from high atop the gigantic mountain.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Vibrant flowers grow in abundance along the animal trail, adding a prominent splash of color to the drab earth tones of the forest.  Fragrant floral aromas saturate the air with a wide array of overwhelming scents.  Small animal tracks cross the beaten path, its muddy surface riddled in a tangle of old and fresh markings.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Gigantic foliage grows in an abundance of dark leaves, shuddering softly with the slightest breeze.  Creepers spiral up the thick trunks of surrounding trees, tightly grasping the bark and cutting into the soft wood beneath.  The canopy is filled with the high-pitched calls of numerous hidden birds, sporadically drowned out by sounds of fluttering wings as they dart between the heavy vegetation.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Light brush at the roadside periodically shudders and shakes, followed closely by sounds of scurrying claws accompanied by low-pitched grunts.  A fallen ironwood tree is strewn across the animal trail, its gnarled roots spiraling in random directions.  Skeletal remains fan out along the ground, a reminder of dangers lurking in the area.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Loud screeches followed by thunderous flapping echo though the dense woods.  A large ironwood tree is strewn across the animal trail, its gnarled roots spiraling in random directions.  Pieces of long, thick femurs lie in a precise pattern along the ground leading out from the fallen trunk.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Several large, dark rocks rest at the animal trail's edge, pushed safely away to prevent any accidents.  Small bits of scattered rubble remain tossed about by some unknown force.  A few black frogs with bright red markings hop in and out of sight as they travel along the tan soil.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Just a few paces off the animal trail, swarms of flies buzz around a thorn bush, creating the illusion of a darkened cloud that permeates the air with a stench of death.  Occasionally a low, thunderous growl echoes in the distance, causing a few birds to quickly fly past overhead.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: Large brambles line the outer edges of the trail, their pale grey limbs covered in red-hued thorns with sharpened points.  A few brave rats scurry within the maze of branches, searching for any stray morsel they can feed upon.

title: [[Hrendh Skogar, Animal Trail]]
description: The canopy is thinner here, allowing moonlight to cast pale shadows on the forest floor though a variety of small openings.  In several spots, something appears to have dug up the trail, giving it the appearance of an excavation site.  Several large bones protrude from the bottom of shallow basins carved into the tightly compacted soil.

title: [[Temple of Light, Alcove of Eylhaar]]
description: Dark grey walls enclose a somber chamber dominated by an ebony dais in the center of the room.  Censers in the four corners fill the air with the aroma of sandalwood.  Worshippers repeat hushed prayers of peace for departed friends and relatives as others sit in silence, remembering the dead.  Ebony pews with kneeler boards are set before the altar.

title: [[Beach, Hara'jaal]]
description: The black sand beach stretches to either side of a makeshift stone quay.  Piles of wood stand off to one side of a jerry-rigged hut.  A short distance from the shanty, a large dug out pit, encircled by black stones, is lined with the remains of many fires.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Beach]]
description: Thick bushes, sun-scorched a dark brown, edge a steep cliff hiding the foot of the stone barrier.  The surf beats hard against the obsidian grit beach.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Beach]]
description: The black sands of the beach stretch around thirty feet from the surf to a tall cliff.  Shrubs edge the steepness, blocking the view of the cliff's base.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Beach]]
description: The beach ends abruptly at a tall escarpment.  Thorny brush grows around the base of the steep rock wall.  Brown vines climb the wall along with a number of creepers that grip the steepness precariously.

title: [[A Steep Cliff]]
description: A narrow ledge offers a brief respite from the climb.  A fall from this height, unlikely to be fatal, would definitely be detrimental to a person's health and well-being.

title: [[A Steep Cliff]]
description: Sparse handholds provide a moment to catch a quick breath.  It is a sheer drop to the ground from here.  Small trees have a precarious hold on the rock face but still seem to squeak out a meager life.

title: [[A Steep Cliff]]
description: This slight perch is a dizzying height from the beach at the foot of the rocky precipice.  A spider web of vines covers the sheer surface of the overhang.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The beach and ocean are visible below at the foot of this tall cliff.  A slight slope leads down into a deep wooded thicket.  In the distance is the island's mother, an ancient mist-covered volcano, rising high above the forest's canopy.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: A faint path opens up into this clearing on the edge of a tangled thicket.  The ground slopes to the northwest in a steady but gradual incline.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Thick-growing brush closes around the barely visible path, throwing all into deep shadows.  Black branches, like cadaverous fingers, block the skies above.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The pitch-black dirt of the ground is covered in dark green moss.  Thorny bushes along the faint trail give off a powerful stench of rot and mold.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Brush closes in on every side of the trail like stout walls.  Large roots break through the black soil, causing the trail to fade in and out.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Darkness shrouds the already faint trail as the surrounding trees' leafy boughs block the sky overhead.  Thorny vines, covering everything nearby, give off an acrid scent.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The trail opens up into a grassy glade.  A giant oak tree growing in the center of the clearing rises high above the forest canopy.  Black vines hang down from the foliage like dark curtains.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Thick walls of vegetation surround the faint trail on every side.  The trees grow straight and tall, their dense foliage blocking out the sky.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Dense detritus covers the rough path, leaving only the protruding tree roots visible.  A number of sharp-thorned bushes line the barely visible trail.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The thicket becomes impassable to the south, while clearing further to the east.  A dry wind blows through the dark foliage, carrying with it a sweet scent.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The brush is thin through this area, making the trail much easier to navigate.  To the west, the forest phases into dense thickets filled with murky shadows.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Large fingers of igneous rock, worn down by many years of erosion, border the trail as it makes it way eastward.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Scrubby grasses grow in the cracks of the rocky trail.  A great mountain rises to the south, blocking out the sky with its impressive height.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The rough terrain makes the trail harder to navigate as it draws close to the foot of the island's volcanic mother.  Scrawny trees cover the mountain's craggy heights.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The trail is blocked to the south by the mountain's steep walls, forcing it to skirt the ancient volcano.  Massive protrusions and wafer-thin ledges of obsidian extend from the volcano's surface, overhanging the path like branches from a tree of smoked glass.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: A wide grassland is the only thing visible to the south and west from here.  The trail continues to circle around the mountain that takes up the whole of the eastern horizon.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Black ridges of stone cross the trail, making it difficult to continue onward in places.  Sharp-leafed weeds grow up out of the cracks in the path.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The air smells vaguely of sulfur gasses through this area.  Withered trees seem to scavenge a meager existence on the slopes of the mountain, though how the scrawny things hold purchase on the craggy rocks is difficult to see.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Following along the foot of the mountain to the north, the trail turns to the southeast here, away from the volcano.  A vast grassland can be seen further to the west and south, though there seems to be no clear way to reach it as of yet.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: Though still stunted, the vegetation seems to be finding greater purchase along the trail as it moves southeast.  The north is full of the majestic glory of the volcano that gave birth to the black sands of the island.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The trail turns east here, beginning a descent into a grass-filled valley.  To the north, the steep walls of the island's volcanic mother cause the path to turn westerly, skirting the mountain as it continues onward.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Amo Potha Telga]]
description: The trail pauses for a moment on top of this low hill.  To the north, one can still see the massive expanse of the volcano that gave rise to this island.  The south holds nothing but a vast grassland.  Close by, the thunder of a waterfall can barely be heard, echoing from some unseen valley.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Glaren Kweld]]
description: A slope leads down into a plain of tall blue-black grasses.  The grassland stretches far into the distance like a living sea, waving with the tiniest breeze.  To the north are the slopes of the island's mother, an ancient volcano.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Glaren Kweld]]
description: Ropy grass presses in on every side, hiding all but the vaguest impression of pathways.  The ground is covered with a dense loam which cushions footfalls.  Rotting detritus fills the air with a heavy scent.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Fal Daelfa]]
description: Running water can be heard through the thick foliage to the east, though no clear trail leads in that direction.  The trees are thin and tall, competing for every bit of sunlight.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Fal Daelfa]]
description: The land slopes gently to the southwest, leading into a small valley.  Marshy patches of ground make the trail a bit difficult to negotiate at points.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Fal Daelfa]]
description: Small pools of stagnant water pervade this grass-covered depression.  Gnats swarm around the puddles of black sludge.  Squat, leafy trees encircle the dell, throwing the area into deep shadows.

title: [[Hara'jaal, Glaren Kweld]]
description: A grassland stretches far into the north while a vast river plain is visible to the south.  Sparse shrubbery lines a barely recognizable trail that leads towards the river.  To the north, the summit of the island's volcano is still visible.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Spreading outward to all sides is a grassy plateau mottled with dusky blue-violet heaths and low-growing white blooms.  Soft soughs of wind arrive with a mosaic of sounds that swirl with echoes of laughing children, running water and barking dogs.  A rough stone step leads to a lower precipice.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Across the canyon's divide, the spires of the Stormfells' western ridge appear through the mists like the sails of great ships at sea.  The delighted burbling of a mountain spring calls from the bottom of a steep footpath etched through the thin soil.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: The open meadow in the center of the plateau is sprinkled evenly with clusters of white starflowers and patches of snow.  The frost of winter and spring's warmth exist in balance here and neither life nor death holds greater influence.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Fragrant sage and dwarf pine are scattered through the quilt of grasses and heaths that cover the rocky ground.  A stone cottage with a half-timbered second story rises from a feathery purple line of heather.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Nearly two stories up the sheer granite crags edging the meadow is the dark circle of a cave opening.  Thin streams of smoke curl from a small vent a few hands above it and a wooden bucket of short swords sits on the ledge outside.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: As gusts of air bend the grasses and heaths in supplication, rigid stones are revealed by their defiance.  A low structure of stacked granite is finished on one side with hinged wooden doors.  Birds alight on the roof to find what seeds may remain in the thatching, but are quickly frightened off by the barking dogs within.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: The neat pathway travels along the plateau's rim as it narrows and falls away into a series of sedge-covered shelves before dropping vertically into the dark canyon.  Yellow buttercups march alongside, bobbing in time to the wind's cadence.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Two upright stones stand like sentinels guarding the path down to a small shrub garden below.  The slope becomes lusher as it tumbles down to the glen, accumulating deep green tendrils of ivy and bluish juniper bushes along the way.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Pyre Garden]]
description: Evergreen shrubs and alpine wildflowers enclose the stony plateau within a low wall of color.  Broad slate paths lead to the four sides of a dark granite plinth in the center, but smaller pathways paved with hewn stones in geometric shapes snake in and around the formal quadrants.  Birds sing within blueberry bushes that stand at the end of this path leading to the north side of the plinth.  On the ground is a small stone bowl.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Pyre Garden]]
description: Banked curves of paving stones and soil define discreet circular spaces screened with flame-red heath and stunted cedar.  Unable to receive the dead, the thin and stony soil supports barely enough vegetation to burn with the fallen.  A shallow pit incised into the ground contains wood and bundles of dried grass tied with string.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Pyre Garden]]
description: Twining and looping pathways of hewn stone surround low-growing wild rhododendrons.  A mountain spring burbles through an aperture in the rock and pools in a shallow impression before running over the edge of the wall.  When in bloom, the breezes shake pink buds from the rhododendron that fall into the thread of water and begin a journey down to a stone basin.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Plinth]]
description: This hewn plinth of black granite is a perfectly symmetrical ashlar symbolizing the rectitude of a pure soul.  The top is charred and blackened with fire, but kept free of ashes by the swift winds.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Pyre Garden]]
description: The glen opens on this end of the garden into an outcrop overhanging the canyon.  Bright-winged butterflies frolic in the swirling updrafts, attracted by tall flower-sprinkled grasses growing from the ash-laden soil.  A flat rock provides a focal point to sit and feel the converging winds.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Stone Basin]]
description: The silver thread of a mountain spring slicks the face of a rock wall as it flows from its source high above.  The spring splashes rhythmically from the end of the vertical rock to the clear surface of the pool, where it chases waves of ripples to the outside edge.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: A modest black gravel road weaves around the clearing, cutting through the stunted grass as if the earth itself was scorched.  The small rock shards bleed into the green borders to dull and blur the field's color.  Situated atop a wooden pole, a weathered sign bears a simple greeting.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: Patches of grass remain untrimmed farther away from the road despite the relative uniformity closer to the gravel.  The unkempt areas resemble spots on a dog's coat against the dominant fur.  Tufts of wildflowers add to the eclectic mix with their hodgepodge of muted pastel hues.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: Mountains loom upon the horizon, sending the clearing into stark contrast and making the sizable houses appear insignificant in comparison.  The gravel path continues around the neighborhood and encircles a broad field in the middle.  Though some garden variety flowers stake their claim along the outer edges, the majority of space is reserved for children's games or other communal activities.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: Unobtrusive winds swim through the dusty grass, tenderly lifting stray wildflower petals upward in praise to the clouds.  Whiskers of weeds sprout from random openings along the gravel road and manage to find purchase despite the obvious obstacles.  A pile of slate sits adjacent to the field from an unfinished landscaping project.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: Colorful shrubbery in one unpretentious garden thrums with swift-moving dragonflies, their wings as luminous and iridescent as oyster shells.  The cheerful shades contrast with the matte blackness of the gravel road as well as the ring of towering mountain peaks visible from all sides.  Set a distance away from the main path, the houses mimic neither the darkness nor the light, but rather they blend comfortably with the scenery.

title: [[Shadow's Reach, Settlement]]
description: Spindly weeds with slender leaves bob to and fro in the gentle breezes as if waving hello to passersby.  Nesting somewhere beyond the confines of the neighborhood, a few blackbirds peck at the ground in the middle of a grassy field enveloped by the gravel road.  Atop the plateau, the vantage point is unparalleled, and one can easily see for miles on a clear day.

title: [[Stormfells, Shadow's Reach]]
description: Warm air wafts in heavy waves from the cave opening, pausing briefly on the rocky ledge before catching a cool breeze to ride down the stony slopes.  From inside the mountain echoes the metallic ringing of weapons being born from fire and force.

title: [[Pin Oak, Lower Branches]]
description: The lowest branches in the tree are thick and strong, tilting down toward the ground in an invitation to greater feats of climbing.  In the side of the trunk itself, some young lover has carved his beloved's initials, framed by a crude heart.

title: [[Pin Oak, Midway]]
description: Midway up the trunk, branches stretch out almost perfectly parallel to the ground.  Their bases are largely free of leaves and offshoots, and a spot where several burly branches have grown in close proximity makes for a rather comfortable seat.  Farther out on the limbs, leaves grow thick and vibrant, making this spot the center of a secure cocoon of greenery.

Midway up the trunk, the branches stretch out almost perfectly parallel to the ground.  The bases of the branches are largely free of leaves and offshoots, such that a spot where several burly branches have grown in close proximity makes for a secure perch, even in the darkness.  Farther out on the limbs, leaves grow thickly enough to block out any stars that might otherwise have been visible, closing around in such a way as to give the impression of being sealed in a cocoon.

title: [[Pin Oak, Treetop]]
description: The branches here grow thinner and more impatient for light.  They strain upward, intent on gathering every stray bit of precious energy that the sun sees fit to bestow, leaving little more than a pool of shadow for the grasses growing far below.

At the very top of the tree, the branches grow more ambitious and stretch out toward the sky.  From this height the ground is almost impossible to see, though the lights of a city are just barely discernable to the south.

title: [[Eastern Fields, Roadway]]
description: Open fields of golden grains stretch out into the distance on either side of the narrow road.  Seldom are the hearty stalks stationary, as even the slightest of breezes causes them to ripple in vast waves.  Vibrant, contrasting colors dot the fields as wildflowers and other colorful foliage stake their claim to the now-untended fields.  The smell and feel of moisture is heavy in the air.

title: [[Eastern Fields, Roadway]]
description: A low, soft mist slowly crawls across the ground, reducing visibility to only a few paces in any direction.  The sound of swiftly moving water disrupts the unearthly calm, though the resounding echoes make it impossible to determine its source.  Faint silhouettes of tall giants with menacingly long arms, hands and claws play at the edges of the fog before resolving into the benign forms of gnarled trees.

title: [[Eastern Fields, Roadway]]
description: The blackened lower branches of the few remaining trees along the fence are evidence of a fire that swept across much of this stretch of the winding road in the recent past.  Where old life once dominated, new life in the form of smaller shrubs and tall grasses has already taken root and started to conceal the farmlands' wounds.

title: [[Eastern Fields, Roadway]]
description: A great vista of fog-shrouded, abandoned and charred fields stretches out in all directions from this elevated rise in the road.  A single oak, tall and majestic, crowns the summit and remains unmarred by the devastation of the lower areas.  Though the whole region is in ruins, the fields to the west are the most damaged.  Though untouched by the fire, deep marks are clawed into the bark of the tree.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Thick, heavy fog obscures much of the damage from the fire that raged across the farmlands.  Numerous charred wooden stakes rise up out of the ground at even intervals and would appear to be the remains of a young orchard that was blackened into ruins in its infancy.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Thick, heavy fog obscures much of the damage from the fire that raged across the farmlands.  The remains of a blackened fence that once protected the young orchard from wildlife emerge from the shrouding mists in the form of charred posts every few paces.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Thick, heavy fog obscures much of the damage from the fire that raged across the farmlands.  The lingering scent of charred wood mingles with the thick, water-saturated air.  Even with the surroundings fallen into a ruined, lifeless mess, the fresh tracks of wild animals prowling the orchard are clearly visible in the mist-soaked ground.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Badly leaning, the remains of a wooden tool shed emerge from the shifting fogs that obscure the view.  The door of the structure burned away from its hinges, fell into it and would appear to be the source of the building's slowly toppling stance.  Metal heads from shovels, plows and other farmland tools are scattered across the interior, their wooden handles having been entirely consumed in the fiery devastation.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Though not as elevated as the hill at the farm's center, these fields are artificially raised above other areas to allow for better drainage during the rainy seasons.  Countless cracks snake their way across the scorched grounds, a sign of just how hot the fires were burning when they swept through.  The heavy mists, while prevalent elsewhere in the distance, fail to crest the upraised cropland.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Clinging to the gulley between fields, errant tendrils of mist stretch to reach the raised field.  Though none visibly succeed in making the climb, the air is heavy with the fog's moisture, causing the topsoil to be soggy.  Tiny patches of green can be seen as new grasses try to make their living in the wounded earth.  A series of hoof prints near one such clumping mark the curiosity of a small animal -- a deer or goat, perhaps.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: A narrow crevice runs at a tangent to the base of the raised field and is fed by a series of smaller grooves sloping down from the end of each row.  Deep gouges in the soil, however, show that little rainfall has a chance to make it to the drainage ditch before being soaked up by the parched ground.  A stone's throw away, the line of charred trees gives way to living foliage once more.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Narrowly spaced rows run from east to west, sloping downward in either direction from their peak in the center.  Blackened pieces of thin but strong wire encircle charred wooden poles and are all that remain of the supports used to keep overburdened vines and stalks from snapping under their own weight.  A nearby line of trees marks one boundary to the fiery devastation, though the underbrush is noticeably absent.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: The ground rises sharply to the southwest, and a tall oak tree is visible above the thick fogs that hug the ground of the hill's base.  The mount is barren at its base, a sign that new life has yet to take root after the damage of the fires.  The roar of rushing water can clearly be heard to the northeast.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Clinging to the ground, a light mist nearly obscures the makeshift bridge leading to the unburned farmhouse to the north.  The smell of charred wood lingers, though little evidence of the tall trees of the farm's elder orchard remains.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: A natural bridge of large steppingstones links one bank to the other across a wide, swiftly moving creek to the east.  Though the ground is devoid of life on this side, the stream was enough to halt the advance of the fire.  All that remain of the efforts to save the farm are rusted metal pails, abandoned as the inferno forced those fighting the blaze to surrender their hold on this side of the stream.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmlands, Burned Fields]]
description: Stacks of metal buckets line the bank of the creek, many of them heavily rusted from being exposed to the harsh elements for an extended period.  A wooden sign has been staked into the ground near an abandoned farmhouse.  Vandals have broken the windows of the structure and knocked the door from its hinges.  A natural bridge of steppingstones reaches across the swiftly moving water to the blackened banks of the western side, and a rickety temporary bridge crosses to the south.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Rough Tunnel]]
description: Someone or something has crudely hacked out an extension of the passage, roughly working the walls just enough to allow travel deeper into the caverns and subterranean areas that surround Hibarnhvidar.  The unfinished feel of the excavation extends to the flooring, which is uneven and treacherous underfoot.

title: [[Cavern, Visceral Laboratory]]
description: This laboratory seems as though it has never been cleaned, every surface bearing bloodstains both fresh and old.  Stone slabs illuminated by sputtering oil lamps provide experimentation surfaces, while buckets hold an assortment of tools from the mundane to the bizarre.  Burlap sacks streaked with gore sit piled in one corner, awaiting disposal.

title: [[Cavern, Clinical Laboratory]]
description: Scrubbed and polished, the stone walls and floor of this room are extremely clean, as are its furnishings.  A gleaming steel operating table sits centered beneath several brightly glowing gaethzen orbs, while instrument racks line the north wall, providing easy access to the surgical tools held within.  Two sturdily reinforced cages, one large and one small, sit against the wall opposite the door.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: The walls in this part of the passage are very smooth, as if some powerful force scoured them clean.  Several small area rugs are thrown onto the floor to cover it, some of them soggy but most of them dry.  A single gaethzen orb provides a harsh white light, making the relative darkness of the passages to the east and west seem like an endless blackness.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: A constant 'drip, drip, drip' noise echoes through the air in the narrow passage, and the air smells heavily of damp moss.  Naturally occurring ruby growths protrude from the walls surrounding the door, their sharpness dulled somewhat by polishing.  Caught by the torchlight, the rubies cast a sanguine glow upon wood, stone, and occupants alike.

title: [[Underground Passage]]
description: The underground passage is narrow and the air feels bloated with water, almost suffocatingly clingy and thick.  Carved niches hold torches that crackle and threaten to falter entirely in the dampness.  Ruddy discoloration speckles the ground, a dark echo of the glinting mineral veins that wend through the pallid stone walls.

title: [[Guildmaster's Office]]
description: With its riot of colors and textures, this room demands attention.  Swathes of vibrant batiked fabrics cover the walls and a wide river reed mat spreads across the floor, muffling the sound of footsteps upon the stone beneath.  Exotic cave-dwelling plants grow in the brightly enameled pots that rest upon nearly every available surface, except for the coral-edged driftwood desk that sits catty-corner to the door.  The desk itself is piled so high with scrolls as to nearly eclipse the numerous trinkets that vie with them for space.

title: [[Cavern, Shady Merchant]]
description: Wooden boards are set up to hide the cavern walls, giving the interior of this small room a feel similar to the interior of a ship.  Sailcloth curtains hang in long drapes from each of the walls, each one weathered from long use.  A large stuffed swordfish hangs on the western wall, its scales glinting in the dim candlelight.

title: [[Underground Passage, Storage]]
description: Vibrant orange lichen grows out of the bluish algae that covers most of the stone encompassing this overstuffed storage room.  Crates and barrels abound, their contents safely nailed shut within, while rust-covered steel racks line the walls, holding a variety of jarred items.  The room holds a heavily spiced scent that nearly obscures the ever-present dank odor of the passage.

title: [[Hidden Den]]
description: In striking counterpoint to the passage outside, the walls of this chamber are smooth and lined with plush fabrics that show no signs of mildew despite the dampness that pervades even in here.  Tall wrought iron poles, reaching nearly to the ceiling, bear both lanterns for illumination and sachets of aromatics to sweeten the air.  Several chairs, opulent though mismatched, are situated around a low stone serving-table filled with food and drink.

title: [[Underground Passage, Dead End]]
description: Roughly hewn from the surrounding stone, this chamber remains largely unadorned save for a trine of incarnadine gems set into the curving walls at even intervals.  Brownish-red stains streak the floor, punctuated by larger, similarly colored splotches.  A low, steady hum fills the air from an unknown source, the acoustics of the space causing distorting reverberations.

title: [[Wilderness, Aberro Valley]]
description: Disappearing among the thick bushes and underbrush in the south, the trail north winds through the forest.  Pressed leaves and snapped twigs litter the ground, evidence of heavy use.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Trampled Path]]
description: Twisting and turning through the trees, the meandering turns of the beaten track hinder visibility in all directions.  The sound of a nearby river filters through the dense trees.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Trampled Path]]
description: Skimming through the area on the west, a narrow river draws the local wildlife to it.  The chirrups of birds and various other animal noises can be discerned accompanying the flash of movement along the river's bank.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Trampled Path]]
description: Darkened beneath the dense trees, the forest sprawls across slowly sloping hills.  A fallen tree or two lean against those that still stand, as if unwilling to give up.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Trampled Path]]
description: Beginning to harden, the trail here grades into something more akin to gravel toward the south.  Several paths lead off into the darkened bosk, zigzagging through the woods.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rocky Trail]]
description: Laden with gravel, the trail becomes a climbing path, circling upwards and downwards on a hill within the large valley.  Trees and underbrush cling to life in the rocky ground, their sparse limbs stretching upwards.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rocky Trail]]
description: Upon the apex of a smaller hill, the trail here sketches itself deeper into the valley below on one side and rises steeply into a rocky track to the east.  Short grasses grow along the sides of the path, opening up into brief, truncated areas where a traveler may take a cautious rest.

title: [[Riverhaven, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive conical building rises from the square's center, its snowy alabaster surfaces gleaming brilliantly against the drab backdrop of the surrounding stone and wood.  A bejeweled mosaic set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Riverhaven, Carousel]]
description: Paneled in a rich dark wood of exotic origin, the walls of this circular room support a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: Blades of grass stretch to eye level on a Gor'Tog and are intermingled with shorter grasses and sedges.  The patter of small feet is barely audible over the rustling of the plants as rodents slip easily along the ground.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: The tough shrubs littering the side of the ridge give way to wildflowers and lush grass that thrive on the moist soil of the valley floor.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: Sinuous shapes occasionally flicker through the tall, thick grass as bright-eyed ferrets scour the area for food.  A half-cropped tuft of buffalo grass shades a hole in the ground that leads to the creatures' burrow.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: The tall grasses are thicker to the east and west, but a faint path is worn northward where large animals have made for the stream.  The air is redolent of lush greenery, and one can almost hear the roots unfurling within the earth as the plants grow.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Stream]]
description: A morass of rocks and dead trees filters the water that flows to the ridge from to the valley floor, creating a natural dam that widens the stream.  Although the stream is murky, the water at the surface is clean and untainted.  Cedar trees shade the stream and keep it cool, and toads croak along the bank in a cacaphony of noise.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Stream]]
description: The wide stream runs through the small valley, bordered on each side by jutting feldspar stones constantly dampened by the fresh spray.  Tiny minnows dart here and there under the surface, constantly playing in an underwater dance in the clear water and sometimes darting downward and out of sight.  Occasionally leaves and twigs float downstream, carried by the rushing current.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Stream]]
description: Flowing water eddies against the side of the ridge that walls the small valley, slowly eroding the rock.  Dark blue water below hints that the stream is quite deep, the murky depths disappearing before the bottom is visible.  Small reeds line each side of the bank, small insects jumping back and forth between them.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: Overhead, the sky seems bluer than on the grasslands, the high valley walls bringing the span into focus.  An exaltation of larks sometimes sings by, looking for a greener bit of grassland on the plains above.

title: [[Eastern Fields, Roadway]]
description: A curious and unsettling silence hangs heavily over the fog-shrouded countryside.  What little light there is succeeds only in creating eerie phantoms that dance wildly in the lingering mists.  A single oak, tall and majestic, crowns the summit and remains unmarred by the fiery devastation afflicting surrounding areas.  A series of deep marks are clawed into the bark of the tree.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: The sky to the northwest is aswirl with burning, shifting colors, reflections of the fire blazing at the heart of the Greater Fist.  Fine ash and drifting embers eddy and swirl with each gust and breeze, moving through the air like swarms of fireflies.  The ground is littered with cracked masonry and bits of shattered mosaic, their colors dull and flat beneath a heavy coating of soot and grime.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: The parts from a shattered humanoid statue are scattered here, interspersed with jagged blocks of pumice and tile fragments from ruined murals.  A slender, long-fingered marble hand juts upward from a mound of debris, seeming to wave cheerfully at those who pass this way.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: Some rubble-choked steps dominate this area, the massive, black marble blocks that comprise them scattered about like a child's abandoned toys.  The scent of brimstone is more pungent here, the fickle breezes that play through the area stirring the ash that blankets the ground.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: A small, bright-red flow of lava oozes across the edge of the courtyard, stretching forth like a questing finger.  Varicolored tiles are scattered everywhere, their bright hues dampened by the ubiquitous ash and soot.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: The floor here is almost totally obscured by a long-cooled lava flow, rucked and wrinkled like the skin of an elderly human.  Only one part of the mosaic is visible and unblemished -- a cracked, unblinking eye staring blankly skyward.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Courtyard]]
description: A massive black marble plinth dominates this area, largely intact, if empty.  The bits of floor visible despite the ash and dust are deeply scarred and gouged, the mosaic here almost completely destroyed.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Shard, Tunnels]]
description: Overhead is the loose cover on an abandoned well on the surface, to judge by the muffled footsteps and hoofbeats coming from above.  Directly below the opening, a wooden ladder descends into a shaft in the earth.  A tunnel leads north just under the surface, and another tunnel in the western wall slopes sharply down out of sight.

title: [[Shard, Tunnels]]
description: The tunnel walls are noticeably damper here  -- possibly because the passage lies beneath one of Shard's many waterways.  The steady dripping of moisture calls up frightening visions of the tons of water overhead.

title: [[Shard Tunnels]]
description: The tunnels widen into a broad oval area where three tunnels converge.  It looks like someone has made their home here at some time in the past.  Debris is scattered throughout the room, and a long unused firepit sits in the north corner.  A pile of mouldering crates near the firepit looks like it might have served as a bed frame.  Perhaps some thief on the run sought shelter here from the forces of law and order.

title: [[Shard Tunnels]]
description: Brick arches support the foundation of the street overhead, where a barred sewer grate provides easy access to the surface.  Reeking piles of rancid produce have been dumped here by the bazaar vendors above, and the stench discourages any curious surface dwellers from paying this area too close attention.  The sewer tunnel slopes steeply downwards to the southeast.

title: [[Shard Tunnels]]
description: A stream of refuse flows through a rough channel cut into the floor, reeking of sewage and things better left unexplored.  A rough-hewn shaft in the ceiling rises toward the surface, spotted with slippery but useable stone handholds.  The tunnel continues into the distance to the northwest and slopes upwards slightly to the south.

title: [[Shard, Abandoned Building]]
description: Once inside, it is obvious that this abandoned carriage barn is not as abandoned as other buildings in the neighborhood.  Although unpainted, the walls are shored up with sound wooden planking, and the flagstone floor is swept clean.  A ladder pokes from an opening in the floor.

title: [[Undershard, Tunnels]]
description: The tunnel changes from bare rock to brickwork along a smoothly paved corridor.  The skilled masonry contrasts with the rough, unfinished stone passageways to the west and southwest.  Overhead, an open well climbs far into the shadows, lit by torches attached to the wall every few feet.

title: [[Undershard, Tunnels]]
description: The fissure widens slightly into a narrow passage, one that has obviously been worked, but not by skilled hands.  The walls are rough and badly chipped, and the floor is covered with fragments of stone that make the footing treacherous.

title: [[Undershard, The Grey Market]]
description: This corner of the market runs up along one of the cavern's walls, the black stone inscribed with old Imperial records but the glyphs long since obscured by crude graffitti and chiseled obscenities.  A large stall stands nearby, its billowing sheets woven of purple thread instead of grey like all the others, and the locals give it a wide berth.

title: [[Undershard, The Grey Market]]
description: Every sort of intelligent being and every walk of life can be seen in the aisles of the Grey Market, from urchins and cutpurses, to adventurers and lesser nobles, the crowds churning in an elaborate dance that only the locals seem to understand.  The best an outsider can do is try to move with them, and cut your own path without starting a brawl.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Undershard, Grey Market Outskirts]]
description: The few merchants in this area feature items of a different nature and the tempo is much more subdued.  Workmen move large crates, their contents carefully concealed behind closely spaced wooden slats, over the edge of a dark causeway.  Loosely tied bales surround a rag merchant who sits propped against the wall, his hat covering his face as his assumed pose cries easy mark.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Every footstep, man-made or otherwise, reverberates through the cavern.  Hanging from the ceiling, flocks of bats rustle their wings as they slumber quietly.  Glistening webs, some still fresh and damp to the touch, fall in graceful swags against the walls, as if some lunatic decorator has tried to brighten the dark surroundings.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Undergondola, Chamber]]
description: Half-domed, a large underground chamber opens out, formed from eons of erosion through an ancient earthquake fault.  Water bubbles gently from an effervescent pool at the bottom of a towering cascade, accounting for the cool dampness of the grotto.  Diminutive cave fish, devoid of eyes, intermittently thrust sensitive whiskers into the air from the surface of the frothy waters.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Cool, dank air flows through the caverns, dampening fur and hair, and weighing heavily against skin and scale alike.  Shadows pool in the corners, making it hard to see, but an occasional wink of red eyes or the glint of a discarded longsword makes it hard to pretend you're all alone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: For centuries, feeble trickles of mineral-laden water have run down the walls of the cavern, leaving behind them voluminous calcite "draperies".  Folding and curling back and forth along themselves, the shimmering curtains are carefully arranged by the hand of nature.  Even the most talented of artisans could not likely have painted such a display upon a mere canvas landscape.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Tiny rivulets of ice-cold water drop from the ceiling to fall uncaring against the cool stone floor and exposed skin alike.  The dampness of the grotto seeps into your bones to make the cavern seem several degrees colder than it actually is.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Darkness envelops all who venture into the dimmest recesses of the grotto.  A loud shriek, full of agony, echoes from deeper within the cavern.  The sound is distorted by distance, making it impossible to clearly distinguish whether it is produced by man or by some beast about to expire at a hunter's blade.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Rivulets of water trickle down the walls, causing a soft drip to echo throughout the cavern as the tiny droplets splash against the solid rock floor.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Disorientation begins to take a firm hold as the passages twist and turn in all directions.  Shimmering webs of silver lace dangle from the walls and ceiling, gently but firmly tangling the limbs of any who attempt to make their way through the caverns.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Masses of carrot-shaped stalactites descend from the ceiling, forcing one to weave precariously in and out to avoid a sharp welt on the head.  Columns make navigation even more difficult where the low-hanging stalactites flow into stalagmites rising up from the ground.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Darkness envelops all who venture into the dimmest recesses of the grotto.  A loud shriek, full of agony, echoes from deeper within the cavern.  The sound is distorted by distance, making it impossible to clearly distinguish whether it is produced by man or by some beast about to expire at a hunter's blade.

title: [[Undergondola, Twisting Grotto]]
description: Every footstep, man-made or otherwise, reverberates through the cavern.  Hanging from the ceiling, flocks of bats rustle their wings as they slumber quietly.  Glistening webs, some still fresh and damp to the touch, fall in graceful swags against the walls, as if some lunatic decorator has tried to brighten the dark surroundings.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: An unnatural silence settles across the chasm, broken only by the occasional soft shower of pebbles down the cliff face.  Retreat continues to remain quite the viable option against whatever unseen foe might await in the blackness ahead.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Standing guard against heedless entry by less cautious explorers, heavy boulders loom large before a series of dark caverns ahead.  Distinct, sinuous markings that cross over themselves in the dirt floor of the chasm reveal the recent passing of those creatures that crawl along on their smooth underbellies alone.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Now drab and browned by the sun, clusters of once-bright orange paintbrush ramble across the landscape.  Rolling and tumbling in the breeze, like dice in a chance game of hazard, the now tangled vines scratch mercilessly at any bare patch of flesh they may encounter as they flit swiftly past.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: From its leisurely perch atop a rock-strewn crag, a small brown lizard lightly tastes the air with its tongue and then quickly scurries across the chasm floor with any encroaching footstep.

title: [[Undergondola, Chasm]]
description: Boulders of all shapes and sizes litter the landscape, forcing one to have to weave and climb in and around the chasm.  Dust springs up in heavy swirls without warning, bringing tears to the eyes and evoking more than one fit of coughing.

title: [[Undergondola, Narrow Path]]
description: From somewhere off in the distance comes the mournful hoot of an owl, awakened uneasily from its peaceful slumber.  The intermittent shadows overhead appear to have confused the otherwise nocturnal creature as to whether or not nightfall has, at long last, arrived.

From somewhere off in the distance comes the mournful hoot of an owl in search of prey.  Dark shadows appear overhead at regular intervals, at times obscuring even a hint of the moonlight by which this nocturnal creature prefers to hunt.

title: [[Undergondola, Narrow Path]]
description: The occasional call of a lone eagle in flight through the abandoned canyon remains the only sound to break the solitude.  Steep slopes covered in loose rubble known as scree are too treacherous to climb, leaving only this twisting path for travelers to make their way through the canyon.

title: [[Undergondola, Narrow Path]]
description: The breeze echoes with a faint creaking sound as large, black shadows wheel and turn overhead.  Heavy boulders grow denser and crowd out the few sprigs of dry, brown grass that so valiantly attempt to rise from between them.

title: [[Alongside the River, Narrow Path]]
description: Parched grasses line the winding path and leave one to wonder how far away the river must be for these simple plants to unable to sustain any nourishment.  Rows of large boulders loom menacingly along the horizon.  Perched atop one of the heavy stones sits a scowling grey vulture, furtively scanning the area in search of the next tasty morsel to scavenge.

title: [[Alongside the River, Narrow Path]]
description: Settled unobtrusively beneath a lone spruce tree is a narrow bench of sorts.  Formed of two small boulders with a rough log placed across them, the rigid seating silently offers a welcome pause in an increasingly arduous journey.

title: [[Alongside the River, Narrow Path]]
description: Tiny brown saplings peer up from amongst patches of withered grass, fruitlessly attempting to gain some lease on life.  Clusters of rocks spring up across the path, rudely interrupting any view of greenery along the trail.

title: [[Alongside the River, Narrow Path]]
description: Thick taffelberry bushes reach out along the sides of the trail, inviting further exploration deeper into the chasm.  Sparrows chirp noisily to their mates as they flit from bush to bush in their search for any of the dark, juicy berries to take home to their hatchlings.

Thick taffelberry bushes reach out along the sides of the trail, their branches shrouding your view of anything beyond the path.  Crisp leaves rustle in the darkness as deer or some other unseen creature forages for the sweet, dark berries.

title: [[Alongside the River, Narrow Path]]
description: Towering stands of silverwood and fir trees line the riverbank, their massive trunks dominating the earth and providing a welcome nest amidst their roots for the weary adventurer.  Peeking out from his burrow with beady black eyes, a furry mole cautiously plans an escape route to the water's edge.

title: [[Frozen River, The Shallows]]
description: Currents begin to abate and footing is once more attainable as the waters shallow and the icy film floats away in ever-widening parcels.  A much-welcome rush of fresh air fills the nostrils and inflates the chest with sweet relief upon stepping up out of the deeper waters.  Tall clusters of cattails and fronds of eelgrass line the riverbank.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: A quick glance upwards reveals a noticeable thinning of the heavy ice sheet across the water.  Light filters through in patches to reveal a school of tiny minnows attempting to conceal themselves among the hairgrass and coontails lining the silt floor.

A quick glance upwards reveals an obvious thinning of the heavy ice sheet across the water as moonlight filters through in random patches.  Tiny minnows attempt to conceal themselves from the incandescence amongst the tall grasses lining the silt floor.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: While the frigid water remains crystal clear, nearly impenetrable beds of bristly muskgrass and stonewart rise up from the river bottom.  Stealthily entwining their slender branches around arms and legs, they quickly become a nuisance making movement through the brisk currents even more perilous.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: Dark shadows overhead take the form of an ice hut bored into place, quite likely the favorite hunting ground for some nearby fisherman.  Barely discernible beneath the shadow is a small, though perfectly formed circular opening, expertly carved into the ice sheeting above.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: Maneuvering effortlessly along on the swift current, a bevy of large multi-colored trout dart in and out amongst each other.  Vision dims even further as the unrelenting frosting across the surface of the water thickens.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: The icy river takes on a mind of its own as the merciless waters become increasingly difficult to navigate.  Great care is required to suppress the instinctual urge to replenish the lungs with air.  Shivers crawl up and down the limbs of the weary traveler.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: Fingers and toes are numbed by the bone-chilling cold of the waters.  A large hatch of tiny, newborn salmon floats by, carried along by the ever-strengthening current.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: Chilling currents grow ever stronger with further navigation along the river bottom.  Overhead, a solid sheet of ice covers the water, trapping you underneath.  One can only hope for the appearance of an occasional pocket of air near the surface.

title: [[Frozen River, Beneath the Ice]]
description: Icy fingers crawl up your spine upon entering the frigid waters.  The overwhelming desire to hold one's breath overtakes all other coherent thought.  A small hole in the thick blanket of ice overhead drifts just barely within reach.

title: [[Lady Atladene's Garden, Healer's Glade]]
description: Ringed by succulent bushes dotted with flowers kept blooming by the gentle ministrations of skilled lifesculptors, the personal glade of Lady Atladene is canopied by twining ivy and interwoven leaves of the tall birch and willow trees that grow here.  The Lady herself sits at the center of the glade, waiting for the wounded with tireless patience.

title: [[Lady Atladene's Salon, Entryway]]
description: Thick blue carpet covers the floor of the entryway, a strip of rich purple down the center to accent it.  Painted murals cover the walls, alive with vibrant hues that pull at the eyes.  The faint sound of talking and laughter echoes down the corridor that leads into the parlor, where the upper class of Shard gather to chat and dine.

title: [[Therenborough, Church Courtyard]]
description: A simple church of crumbling brick and dark, aged pine stands here surrounded by walls of rough-hewn stone.  The bare earth leading to its entrance has been pressed flat by the passing of countless generations of worshipers, leaving not even a hardy weed to break the brown vista underfoot.  Despite the poverty of the building, a warm, inviting glow beckons through its open doors.

title: [[Therenborough Chapel, Interior]]
description: The city's tiny chapel is a simple square room furnished with polished oak pews facing a raised altar.  The small stained-glass window over the entry door casts a subdued light upon the altar, causing the embroidery on the altar cloth to sparkle with a silky bluish glow.  A single brass candlestick rests in the middle of the cloth.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: The sandy soil shifts easily underfoot, sending small landslides down the uneven slope.  Straw-like tufts of grass grow from cracks in rocks and on any vaguely horizontal surface.  Above, a thin trail winds inland through the grass.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: Protruding stones provide more solid footholds than the loose and sandy soil.  Further down the slope, the soft loam gives way entirely to large slabs of broken rock.  The soothing sounds of surf washes up from below, pierced now and again by the cry of a sea bird.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: Gulls reel and swoop through the sky, crying out soulfully to each other.  Occasionally, one dives and plunges into the sea and emerges triumphantly with a struggling fish in its beak.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: In the distance, great masted ships look like splinters of brown and white slipping over the horizon and out of sight while others emerge and gradually draw closer.  Long before the bluffs greeted the ships of mortals, it is rumored they were home to the island's fae.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: The wind ebbs and flows like the waves below, but with a rhythm all its own.  Sometimes the soft breezes sound like a ballad quietly whispered between the land and sea, while at other times the wind sings shrilly across the crags like a bitter song of mourning.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: The sheer bluffs soften to a sharply sloping talus of rock slabs either broken off of or dislodged from the cliff above.  Water seeps up between the large stones, creating calm tide pools where small schools of tiny silver fish dart about in search of food.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: Mist-laden air sprays and swirls around the stony bluffs, slicking the already slippery rock.  Pearly little crustaceans about the size of walnuts cling to the safety of a slim crevice in the rock face.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: Light and shadow play against the surf.  Sunlight catches waves as they grow from the sea and rides the crest above little pools of darkness that bob in and out of view.  As the waves crash against the stony shore, both are lost in a jubilant spray of white foam.

title: [[Egress Bluffs]]
description: An algae-stained precipice littered with broken rock and shells reaches out from the bluff in a broad arm that seems to hover just above the waterline.

title: [[Egress Bluffs, Fissure]]
description: Briny water left by the receding tides fills the slim aperture in the stone.  Slimy strands of seaweed cling to the rock just above the waterline.

title: [[Egress Bluffs, Fissure]]
description: The deep grey, mica-flecked stone walls have been worn smooth by ages of tides flowing through the narrow fissure.

title: [[Egress Bluffs, Fissure]]
description: The uneven walls grow close, making the passageway more difficult to navigate.

title: [[Egress Bluffs, Fissure]]
description: Thin light glows vaguely above and diffuses shadows lurking within the fissure.

title: [[Plaza, Central Area]]
description: Most of the encroaching sand has been cleared away, leaving the once-smooth paving stones exposed anew.  The air is heavy with dust and the acrid smell of hot rock and sand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Plaza, Western Area]]
description: Jumbled stones lie heaped in disordered piles where buildings once stood.  A few withered weeds sprout from cracks, struggling to survive in the blasted environment.

title: [[Plaza, Eastern Area]]
description: Piles of broken rock and sand snake across the otherwise barren stones of the plaza, the forerunners of the blasted surroundings ready to rebury the ruins under debris and dunes.

title: [[Plaza, Northern Area]]
description: Partially cleared spaces vie with the aggressive sand that keeps trying to return the reclaimed concourse to dunes.  Paths lead to various stone buildings reclaimed from the desert.

title: [[Stone House, Interior]]
description: A single lantern casts a fitful light over the musty chamber.  Sand drifts in small rills on the stone floor, piling up in the corners.

title: [[Plaza, Southern Area]]
description: Piles of sand and rocks show where efforts at beating back the badlands have borne fruit.  The cleared areas include a couple of stone buildings which have been reclaimed for habitation from the wasteland.

title: [[Stone Hut, Interior]]
description: Broken boards and other debris are swept against the walls, clearing a space in the middle of the room.  A hastily assembled shelf holds a flickering lamp which sheds an irregular light throughout the building.

title: [[Stone Home, Interior]]
description: Makeshift sconces line the walls, holding flickering candles that barely beat back the gloom.  Although the room has been cleared of most obstructions and debris, some still fill the corners.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Tumbled stones litter the platform, refugees from higher on the structure.  A trail has been hacked out of the surrounding vegetation, allowing access further around the edifice.  The middle and upper platforms, covered with tangles of foliage, loom over the crude pathway.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: A few blocks have fallen from the heights, providing obstacles for the path hewn from the jungle.  The upper platforms tower over this, the lowest terrace.

title: [[Plaza, Southern Area]]
description: Most of the encroaching sand has been cleared away, leaving the once-smooth paving stones exposed anew.  The air is heavy with dust and the acrid smell of hot rock and sand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Hewn from the surrounding flora, a crude pathway zigzags between jumbled rocks that cover the platform.  The upper platforms tower over this, the lowest terrace.  Some of the stones have been cleared off in the beginnings of attempts at archaeological work.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The upper levels soar in vertical stone walls above the lower level.  A few blocks have fallen from the heights, providing obstacles for the path hewn from the jungle.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The two upper platforms, covered with tangles of vines, loom over the crude trail zigzagging between fallen stones.  Some of the stones have been cleared off to the side in the beginnings of attempts at archaeological work.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Hacked from the surrounding undergrowth, a narrow trace zigzags between fallen rocks that cover the platform.  Some of the stones have been cleared away to begin the process of excavation.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The middle and upper platforms, covered with vines and trees, loom over the trail hacked out of the surrounding vegetation.  The constant calls of insects and birds fill the air.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Fallen stones litter the platform, refugees from higher on the edifice.  The middle and upper platforms, covered with trees and vines, loom over the twisty pathway.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The ever-present jungle growth crowds in on the narrow path, threatening to once more reclaim it.  Puddles from prior rains stretch across the footpath, settling into the depressions in the stones of the pyramid.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow Trail]]
description: Buffered by forest to the north, this meandering trail is shaded by towering deobar trees high overhead.  Sparsely laid out, the trees provide an attractive shelter to the homes nestled amidst the foliage, while a large meadow opens up away from the forest.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow Trail]]
description: The occasional clanging monastery bell sounds in the distance, summoning monks from their various tasks for service.  A crowing chicken waddles along the narrow path trying to assert its dominance over the mellifluous bell.  Wildflowers stretch in every direction giving each house that lines the path a vibrantly colorful lawn.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow Trail]]
description: Wooden pallets form an uneven trail through the thicker woods.  Massive blueberry bushes dot the area creating a dense canopy for small skittering woodland animals.  Tucked into the overgrowth, thatched cottages melt into their surroundings, creating harmony between habitation and the natural world.

title: [[North Turnpike, Meadow Trail]]
description: The soft babbling sounds of a nearby brook mingle with the occasional scuffling of small creatures and the ever present chirrups of local birds.  A pair of benches line the cobbled brick pathway that encircles a massive pagoda tree surrounded by tall grasses bent to either side from the traffic of local residents.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tunnel]]
description: Solid rock walls curve gently toward each other and come together somewhere above but the peak has been lost in the shadows.  Torches line the walls at regular intervals, their illumination nearly drowned out by a more intense light coming through an ogee arch.  The other end of the tunnel fades into a murky darkness to the north, only visible because of the torches lining the walls.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tunnel]]
description: A pinprick of light to the south is the only indication that this tunnel has any end.  The darkness is held at bay by a number of flickering torches bolted to the wall.  Carved into the rock wall, small arrows next to the crest of the Warrior Mage guild point north.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tunnel]]
description: A narrow staircase plunges at a sharp, but passable, angle downward into darkness.  Torches bracketed to either side illuminate both the tunnel leading southward, and the rough stone of the first few steps down.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Narrow Stairs]]
description: A set of narrow stairs leads up at a sharp angle towards a doorway in the distance.  The climb is steep in comparison to a set of broader steps which lead gently downward.  The air is damp and algae has grown in the cracks between squared stone blocks which form the staircase walls.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Narrow Stairs]]
description: A long hall separates two sets of steps, the algae-covered walls flanked by plain stone pillars.  Broad stone steps gently slope upwards towards the south while to the north narrow stairs ascend steeply to an archway high above.  The air is rank with a musty scent caused by stagnant puddles formed in low spots in the floor.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tunnel]]
description: Two large, fire-filled bronze bowls sit on either side of a small archway, working to light up the large tunnel.  The flames are bright enough that they illuminate the smooth stone walls which slope upwards into a tapered point as well as a set of narrow stairs which lead down on the other side of the arch.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Cavern Lake]]
description: Two torches are bracketed to the unnaturally smooth stone walls of an arched tunnel, dimly lighting a crag which juts out above a body of water.  The feeble light does little and shadows press in oppresively as the walls fade away into oblivion, giving off a sense of vastness.

title: [[Cavern Island, Sandy Beach]]
description: A stone bridge rises out of the lake and traverses the gap between an arch in the southern wall and the shore, leading up to a gateway.  Tall wicker torches line the small beach, illuminating the stone fortress' walls and giving it a menacing look.  Two silver banners hang down from the crenellations and flank the gateway, each bearing the crest of the Warrior Mage Guild.

title: [[Cavern Island, Sandy Beach]]
description: Torches line the beach, flickering and sputtering in the damp cavern air and illuminating the fortress walls.  The dominant sound is that of water lapping against the sandy shore, but occasionally there is the drip of falling water elsewhere in the cavern.

title: [[Cavern Island, Sandy Beach]]
description: Torches line the beach, flickering and sputtering in the damp cavern air and illuminating the fortress walls.  The dominant sound is that of water lapping against the sandy shore, but occasionally there is the drip of falling water elsewhere in the cavern.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Courtyard]]
description: Large stone blocks stack atop one another to create a dull grey wall that surrounds the courtyard.  A steel portcullis is raised, allowing access to and from the courtyard through an arched gateway.  Large slabs of green slate pave the ground, covering nearly every square inch.  Care has been put into maintaining the area as none of the slabs contain cracks or even pitting.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Courtyard]]
description: A variety of mushrooms, ranging in size from pebbles to large Gnomes, fill this section of the courtyard.  A drainage ditch reveals a thick layer of soft loamy soil that spreads across the stone plateau, giving the mushrooms ample fertilizer.  Tightly fitted stones form what looks to be a low wall, ending almost a foot above the courtyard floor.  A sign is placed at the edge of the garden bearing large, white letters.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Courtyard]]
description: A catapult sits broken in this corner of the courtyard.  The wood shows signs of rot and the throwing arm is completely smashed beyond any repair.  A ladder has been set up next to the catapult, leading up the south wall.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Courtyard]]
description: A flight of white marble steps leads from the courtyard to a limestone hall.  Two large brass braziers sit outside the door of the hall, casting off light and a generous amount of smoke.  The limestone walls are highly polished, gleaming even in the light cast off by the braziers.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Courtyard]]
description: A covered stone well sits next to a tall wall, which surrounds the courtyard.  The well looks to be no longer in use as a large board covers up the mouth and the bucket is missing.  A sign bearing large, white letters sits next to the well.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Battlement]]
description: Iron sconces, bracketed to the walls outside the fortress just below crenellations in its fortifications, dimly illuminate the battlement and the lake below.  Small pinpricks of light illuminate a bridge that leads to an arching entrance in a rock wall across the water from the keep.  The top of a ladder can be seen peeking above the inside of the wall, leading down to the green slate floor of the courtyard.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Battlement]]
description: Iron sconces have been bracketed to the walls on the outside of the keep and provide a dim illumination.  The battlements stretch from east to west, overlooking a stone bridge that leads to the southern wall of the cavern.  The entrance of the Warrior Mage Guild is visible here, the crenellations angled so that a casual glance down would allow one to see anyone entering or leaving the guild.  Two silver banners are visible through the crenellations, each bearing the crest of the Warrior Mage Guild.
