title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Tranquil Tundra]]
description: Flakes of snow and ice crystals casually float by in abject defiance of both gravity and the still air as any trace of warmth is quickly extinguished.  Irregular flickers of light dance from the darkened entrance of a cave to the east.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Unfathomable Grotto]]
description: The obsidian walls of the cave are absolutely smooth, and form a mathematically perfect arc above.  Tiny flecks of ice float in from the mouth of the cave, gracefully swirling about in an otherworldly dance.

title: [[MAMAS Company, Main Office]]
description: The Assay Office looks like a contractor's storeroom: scaffolding, loose timbers, planks, and tools lie everywhere, as carpenters and plasterers work away.  Behind a tin-topped counter stands the assay clerk, who is adjusting the beam of the smallest of three graduated scales.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tabernacle]]
description: Logs form concentric half-circles in front of a large peregan tree altar that dominates the far end of the tent.  Sweet bearberry candles line the perimeter of the humble tabernacle, flickering softly and chasing the musty smell of dampness from the air.  A leather pennant branded with the image of a rampant boar hangs from above.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Foyer]]
description: This tasteful entry hall is paneled with a variety of exotic woods.  The parquet floor is patterned in alternately light and dark diamond shapes, surrounding the Estate Holder crest in the center of the room.  Lining the walls are several plush couches for the comfort of those awaiting appointments.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Office Hallway]]
description: This wide hallway is somewhat less opulent than the entry foyer and the rooms dedicated to council meetings, reflecting the fact that this is where the day-to-day business takes place.  Several offices open off from here, with frequent visitors coming and going.  The walls display portraits of prominent estate holders, past and present.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Housing Office]]
description: This is a large office with a well-worn counter, several windows each with a "Use Next Window, Please" sign and apparently one clerk actually working.  Every town in the land seems cursed with lines and waiting and fees.  This office is for the obtaining of permits, licenses and similar matters.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Home Exchange Office]]
description: Tiny, stuffed with old, dusty furniture, and smelling like yesterday's laundry, this office is anything but a testimony to bureaucratic efficiency.  Large piles of yellowing papers spill from cracked file cabinets and lie scattered upon the floor, fallen from large, ungainly stacks on what little desk space is not taken up by piles of mouldering food.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Office of Acquisitions]]
description: Maps cover practically every inch of available wall space, with overview maps covering all of Kermoria ranging down to ones detailing individual neighborhoods.  Trays labeled "IN" and "OUT" are filled to overflowing, although the "IN" box is piled deeper by far.  Government officials, landowners and couriers seem to form a parade of traffic through the office.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Office of Expansions]]
description: This office is like a cousin to the Acquisitions Office without all the hubbub.  There are a handful of maps on the wall, with pushpins marking areas for development.  A few office workers are engaged in conversation with merchants and artisans, discussing potential development opportunities.

title: [[Journalai Route, Dim Passage]]
description: The dim passage is a good deal larger than it looks from a distance.  From the texture of the walls and the chips of granite covering the floor, it's apparent the tunnel is not a natural formation.  Someone carved a trail between the cul-de-sac and whatever lies beyond the wall.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Dim Tunnel]]
description: The path underfoot is treacherous and strewn with gravel chips painstakingly carved from the rock wall.  This end of the tunnel opens through a granite arch onto a limestone valley.  The scent of burning charcoal is much stronger here.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Granite Arch]]
description: A granite arch opens into the base of an unusual stone wall.  Nearly thirty feet tall, the granite wall is encrusted with shimmering quartz crystals.  Although the crystals have been removed as high as can be readily reached, the remaining strip extends along the southern wall of the valley in brilliant display.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Crystal Wall]]
description: The crystals end abrubtly at the eastern wall of the valley, refracting pinpoints of light against a limestone backdrop.  The slight inward tilt of the limestone cliffs precludes any possibility of scaling them.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Eastern Wall]]
description: The greyish-white wall leans in over the tar pit where the path narrows to a few feet across.  A fine rain of chalky powder continually drifts down from above, dislodged by stray breezes.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Northern Wall]]
description: Thin striations of pure pink marble can be seen embedded in the limestone.  The veins are scarce, but time will create a rich harvest for future miners.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Marble Gate]]
description: A tall arch is carved into the wall and set with a solid marble gate.  Although there's no apparent locking mechanism, the gate is solidly closed.  Fresh air drifts through the narrow crack around the slab carrying a hint of pine.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Northern Wall]]
description: The skeleton of a mid-size feline lies here in disarray and several large chunks of limestone are shattered beneath the remains.  It appears the edge of the cliff gave way while the luckless animal investigated the valley from above.  A far quicker death than the slowly suffocating fumes of the pit.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Western Wall]]
description: The path here is thick with spatters from the pit, making each step a challenge.  An extremely large bubble of tar hisses and burbles, slowly releasing a steady stream of gas and black ooze.

title: [[Limestone Valley, Marble Vein]]
description: Between the crystal-encrusted granite and the chalky lime runs a thick vein of pure ivory marble.  An ambitious Halfling miner was unsuccessful in attempts to reap some of nature's bounty before being overcome by the fumes.  Nothing but a skeleton and a few tattered scraps of clothing are left.

title: [[Journalai Cavern, Narrow Fissure]]
description: Squeezing through the small gap is hard going as the rough walls seem to grasp for exposed skin at every chance.  The fissure extends back a good distance into the northern cliff, then vanishes around a corner.

title: [[Journalai Cavern, Abandoned Camp]]
description: Someone has used this small hidden cavern as a refuge in the past.  There's a circle of stones containing the remains of a campfire and a narrow vent in the ceiling provides ample ventilation for escaping smoke.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]]
description: The tree-lined trail winds an erratic route along the riverbank, eternally muddy and smelling of fish.  The bank drops off steeply into the river below, a deadly climb for anyone foolish enough to try.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]]
description: The vegetation grows thickly here, fertilized by the steady stream of birds and wildlife attracted to the nearby river.  To the west, the riverbank subsides into a more gradual slope, easing entrance into the water for animals and fishermen alike.  Here however, the man-made bank drops off treacherously, its slippery slope inviting the sounds of the river to permeate the area.

title: [[An Enclosed Courtyard]]
description: Surrounded by lush ferns, an expansive flagstone patio supports several smokewood benches and a small table of refreshments.  Vibrant crimson blossoms spangle the clematis vines that cover the trunks of a pair of dwarf maple trees standing guard at the courtyard's archway.  Glowing gaethzen orbs are tucked neatly within the fragrant lavender bushes that line the surrounding fence.

title: [[Luthier's, Private Showroom]]
description: Tiny gaethzen globes light the room, adding a soft gleam to the silks draping the displays and tables that feature some of the luthier's more intricate work, available for his most discriminating clients.  A settee provides seating, and a small tray offers beverages and snacks to entice those shopping into staying longer -- and buying more.  A heavy lined curtain leads back out to the main shop.

title: [[Emmiline's Cottage, Pantry]]
description: A shelving unit gleams from regular polishing, their shelves laden with supplies and wares both available for sale and those yet to be unpacked.  In the center of the room, a short table sits before a glass display case, both of which hold sparkling treasures.

title: [[Phoebe's Fashions, Sales Room]]
description: Racks and shelves are filled with a kaleidoscopic display of small clothing for men and women.  Phoebe Woodcock, talented village seamstress, is standing in front of a rack methodically arranging shirts according to color.  She pauses to give a flirtatious smile to an attractive male Halfling customer.

title: [[Odds 'n Ends, Sales Room]]
description: A gilded birdcage containing a wind-up parrot is suspended near the doorway.  Glass cases line the walls, displaying practical items alongside rare oddities.  A stuffed leucro head, which has been mounted on the wall, stares down at you with its sharp teeth exposed.  The owner of the shop, Rufus Tanglefoot, looks up from combing his foothair and smiles at you expectantly.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Shore Road]]
description: Huddled amongst the gulls that scream noisily atop the wooden pilings of a nearby pier, a local wag has placed an articulated wooden pelican.  Its deep bowl-shaped beak bobs up and down, spilling dribbles of rainwater as it does, to reveal a golden fish swimming within, while its wings are poised to spin in the breeze.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Shore Road]]
description: An occasional metallic clang echoes beneath the boardwalk, drawing attention to a rope tied to the harbor-side railing.  At the other end of the rope, flies congregate, thick and black, around a bucket of chopped fish half-submerged in the water below.  The rope holds the bucket in place, keeping the fish cool until it is needed for bait later in the day.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: The backsides of stalls and wagons press in against the road, forcing it to narrow slightly in passing.  Bright and festive banners flutter madly in the breeze while colorful signs beckon passerby with promises of exotic wares at affordable prices.  The cry of an auctioneer echoes out from somewhere down one of the alleys that cut between the wagon carts.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: An over-scaled wooden hammer nods in the wind from atop an oddly-angled building nearby.  Displayed in the windows of the shop are a wide assortment of tools and construction goods, and the painted image of fat crowned face gleefully peers out into the street.  Tacked above the door, a sign proclaims "King's Hardware and Fine Goods" in bright, flowing colors.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Thick strands of honeysuckle dangle teasingly over the top of an iron fence, blocking all but scant glimpses of a stone building on the other side.  A bell tower rises proudly from the building, dwarfing the fence and the surrounding structures.  Attached firmly to one of the brick supports for the fence is a brass-plated plaque.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Squeezed snugly in an alley between two apartment buildings is a descending series of stone steps.  Makeshift handrails flank the steps and a banner flaps from above the alley's entrance.  Someone has kept the narrow side street swept clean of most debris, but the nostril-flaring scent of rubbish still wafts through the air.  On the other end of the alley, the tops of gondolas can be seen bobbing on the canal waters.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Several seagulls strut and flit along the ground, snatching scraps of garbage and discarded food before hopping off to devour their meals.  The gulls are considerably braver here than elsewhere in Mer'Kresh, though this may owe as much to the abundance of loose trash as it does to any courage the birds can muster.  The flaking paint and broken windows of some of the buildings here echo the street's condition.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Shore Road]]
description: A broken board has been mended with a support brace, carefully secured with bent-over nails.  The new wood is lighter in color than the surrounding slats, not yet greyed by exposure to the elements.  Sailors and merchants brush past on their way to and from the ships swaying beside the nearby pier.

title: [[Oceanhome Apartments, Mer'Kresh]]
description: Most of the floor has been swept free of debris, revealing a mosaic of faded pastel tiles.  Black dirt, spared by the broom, still clings in the corners of the room.  Hung crookedly on one wall, a message board wears an assortment of smudged papers proclaiming long-past resident meetings.

title: [[Oceanhome Apartments, First Floor]]
description: A set of rickety stairs ascends to the next floor as the giant-sized face of a smiling Rissan beams down the hall.  Originally painted in extreme colors, the face is now partly veiled by a thin layer of soot and dust.  Tightly clutching to a foaming mug with one hand, the happy Rissan indicates his prized drink with a pointing finger.

title: [[Deeper's Tavern, The Common Room]]
description: A few steps lead down to a hot, brightly lit room packed with sailors in every state of consciousness from keen-eyed alertness to drunken collapse.  Somewhere in the crowd, a reedy concertina accompanies one or another of several songs being sung in cheery disregard for each other.  Behind the mahogany bar, the owner Deeper presides over the tumult, disappearing into the throng from time to time with an armload of mugs.  Above the bar hangs a hand-written menu.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out.

title: [[Deeper's Tavern, The Mainmast]]
description: A yard-thick, floor-to-ceiling wooden pillar dominates this corner of the tavern.  The mast, as the regular patrons call it, rises like a tree trunk through the center of a circular table.  Here the boastful and the optimistic gather to test their strength of arm.

title: [[Deeper's Tavern, Behind the Bar]]
description: Kegs empty and full, mugs for the filling, and the tools of the trade (including a solid-looking bungstarter) line this long, narrow space between the bar and a rear wall hung with trophies of the sea.  At the end farthest from the entrance is an open trapdoor.

title: [[Deeper's Tavern, Rancois' Table]]
description: This secluded corner of the tavern contains the favorite table of Rancois Sendaque, the most famous part-time poet in Mer'Kresh.  Many of the song scrolls he sells are his original work, and well known among the discriminating (and the stingy).

title: [[Deeper's Tavern, The Cellar]]
description: The dim lantern-light reveals a room filled from the floor to the low ceiling with the supplies and furnishings of the tavern.  Here stand broken tables and benches awaiting repair, boxes of crockery mugs, framed paintings that appear to have been used as weapons, and even a stuffed marlin that has seen better days.  Stacked kegs of rum hide one wall completely, and a large wine rack filled with bottles stands a little ways out from another wall.  Stairs lead up to the tavern's main room.

title: [[Starcanth Forge And Mercantile, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A ironwood rack and some steel shelves hang on the oaken walls, with a black oak armoir along the edges of the room.  A granite table sits on the granite floor, with a lunat trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

title: [[Suit Yourself, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the stained oak floor, while the granite walls are unadorned.

A crescent-shaped sales counter lined with burgundy velvet sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits on the highly polished fruitwood floor, with an oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options, and the granite walls are unadorned.

title: [[Town Hall, Citizenship Registration Office]]
description: Several oval paintings line the off-white walls of this office, and a faint scent of old paper fills the air.  A bored clerk sits behind a semi-polished desk occasionally glancing at a book entitled, "Rules and Regulations."  A couple of plush wine velvet couches provide seating for those waiting, while a colorful fringed rug entertains a kitten that seems to have found its way through the doors.

title: [[Trintah's Herbal Remedies, Attic]]
description: Ventilation grates provide a slight breeze that assists in drying bundled herbs hung from the rafters but do nothing to relieve the oppressive heat.  The air is thick with a strange odor, not floral and not spice but definitely unpleasant.  Large storage barrels stacked alongside wooden crates provide seating for the weary.  Light from a lantern outside a small window falls on one of these containers, marked with a skull and crossbones, fueling rumors that not all of Trintah's concoctions are for healing.

title: [[Crystal Monolith, Belvedere]]
description: Perched at the apex of the gardens' central spire, this carved crystal platform commands an all-encompassing view of the adjacent grounds.  Floating terraces encircle the monolith below, surrounded themselves by a larger ring of airborne islands.  Further out, a wall of constantly shifting light enfolds the lofty gardens in a massive sphere, obscuring everything beyond its boundaries.

title: [[Crystal Monolith, Stairway]]
description: Glittering stairs wind along the inner wall of the crystal tower, spiraling about an elaborate gyroscopic device curiously suspended in midair over the rotunda below.

title: [[Crystal Monolith, Rotunda]]
description: Rays of prismatic light filter through thick quartz walls, bathing the grand circular gallery in an ethereal glow.  The chamber interior is sparse and utilitarian, unfurnished aside from an aetheric distillery centered on the floor, the gurgle of the strange apparatus echoing softly throughout the rotunda.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Pearl Circle]]
description: The cobbled road widens as it curves past a gondola landing.  Tall blue and purple striped poles topped with golden streamers and set with large metal rings are moored near the slips.  The frayed remains of rope used to tie off the gondolas hang off one ring.  The only barriers to Shell Circle and Gull Circle are the salty stretches of water and the massive terracotta planters marking the entrance steps to each gondola slip.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Pearl Circle]]
description: Staggered gaps between the colorful buildings give plenty of room to gaze at the canals and the slow moving barges hauling cargo.  The area boasts few shops -- residences surrounded by patches of lawn dominate.  Above, ropes strung between the upper stories flap with laundry and birds.

title: [[Origami Shop]]
description: Burlap bags filled with old rags cast a sharp scent throughout the shop.  Several fine mesh screens lean against a large square tub filled with thick, grey liquid.  Colorfully glazed jars, brushes, and sheets of raw paper are neatly arranged on the work table in the center of the room.  Above, finished paper is hanging to dry on rough cord strung from wall to wall.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Santazel's Lean-To]]
description: Splits of leather, replacement hilts and blades, rivets and metal scraps are jumbled together in crates.  A box of broken shields, armor and weapons sits in one relatively clean corner.  Two barrels with a plank of wood across them serve as a makeshift counter.  In the back of the small lean-to, a scruffy-looking Elf with tobacco-stained teeth and fingers works at his trade.

title: [[Caress-of-the-Moons Manor, Upper Hall]]
description: Dark wood paneling runs the length of the upper hall, split by contrasting trim nearly halfway up the wall.  A carved sandalwood door breaks the monotony of the paneling along the southern wall.  Tacked to the center of the door is a curled note, pierced through the middle by a bent nail.  At the far end of the hall, a spiral staircase rises through a covered opening in the roof, while opposite, a set of wide steps descends to the lower floor.

title: [[Caress-of-the-Moons Manor, Rooftop Garden]]
description: Stone troughs along the edges of the rooftop serve a dual purpose as homes for flowering plants and as guard rails to keep sky-watching mages from stumbling off into the gardens two stories below.  Spider vines arc over the ledges and flow downward, unafraid of the height.  To the west, the roof of the commodities building stares into the sky in poor imitation of the scholars that use this manor.

title: [[Caress-of-the-Moons Manor, Rooftop Garden]]
description: Heavy growths of plants and vines drape down the side of the building, wrapping themselves lovingly around the stone gargoyle statues protruding from the ledges.  A blank spot some distance below hints that one of the gargoyles may have lost its mortared hold on the wall and plummeted into the canal.  Poking out over the edge of the rooftop, and uncaring of the canal's rushing waters, is a polished blackwood telescope set neatly onto a raised pedestal at the southern end of the roof.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Foyer]]
description: Heavy double doors open onto a large, rectangular foyer.  Two stories high, the entryway to the Cleric's Guild is well lit through tall, narrow windows high on the walls.  Two thick, fluted pedestals guard each side of the chapel's double door to the east.  Low padded benches line each wall between the pedestals and the doorway to the guildmaster's office on the north wall, and the meeting room on the south wall.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Guildmaster's Office]]
description: Neat bookshelves behind a large desk hold Eydtha's private library.  The office is brightly lit through two tall windows on the east and west walls.  A thick, dark blue carpet covers the stone floor, and two padded, straight-backed chairs sit in the corners nearest the door.  The large desk holds neatly stacked papers and a small statue of a dolphin.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Meeting Room]]
description: The windowless meeting room holds a long, narrow table surrounded by chairs, as well as several smaller tables.  Several people sit at a corner table discussing a private matter.  Benches line the walls underneath three large tapestries depicting various gods.

title: [[Clerics' Guild, Chapel]]
description: Tall windows high on the north and south walls allow plenty of light into the chapel.  A plainly carved altar sits under two beautiful stained-glass windows in the east wall.  Thick red carpets hug the walls, leaving the center of the stone floor bare.  Each corner holds two floor-standing braziers for the ritual burning of sacred writings.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Courthouse Entryway]]
description: Low steps, each the entire width of the room, climb at evenly spaced intervals to the large door at the far end.  A long, narrow, black carpet lines the center of the room from one door to the other, hugging the steps closely.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Courthouse Guardroom]]
description: Several long-suffering guards stand on the other side of a large table, arms crossed, frowning and nodding at the supplicants across from them.  Occasionally a guard will turn around and pick up an item of some sort and hand it to the person across from him, but more often than not, the people leave empty-handed.  The unwilling are forcefully escorted out of the room.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Court of Law and Justice]]
description: High arches in the eight cardinal directions meet in the center to support a large, circular skylight.  Behind a curved desk on the far side of the round room sit the judges, stern-looking men and women with a reputation for rapidly deciding the fate of the accused.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Town Hall, Grand Foyer]]
description: The high arch of the Grand Foyer is pierced by huge stained glass windows illustrating the aspects and heroics of the thirteen.  White marble columns anchor the majestic arch to the grey marble floor.  Great oaken doors along the north wall lead to various city offices and the formal Council Arch on the south wall leads to the Grand Hall of the Council.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Grand Hall of the Council]]
description: The Grand Hall of the Council is extremely formal.  If the Rissan oak beams and white marble walls could speak, they would tell tales about the founding of Rissan tradition.  A huge oak council table dominates the hall.  Council chairs surround the table at precise locations.  The council president's chair looms like a throne above one end of the council table, adding to the sense of awe the room inspires.

title: [[Housing Arcade, New Homes Office]]
description: At the far end of a spacious room with a polished oak floor sits a large, ornately carved desk and a high-backed oak chair with a velvet cushion.  On either side behind the desk are floor-to-ceiling stained glass windows.  A brightly colored rug is draped over the desk.

title: [[Housing Arcade, Transfer Office]]
description: This little room, barely bigger than a closet, is crowded even more by crates, boxes, racks, and bookcases overflowing with scrolls and papers.  In front of a tiny window is a folding desk and stool.

title: [[Perobler's Orlogs, The Vestibule]]
description: A small vestibule lit by ornate bronze lamps occupies the space between an ascending flight of stairs and the street door.  All the furnishings, from the polished lamps to the soft carpet underfoot, set a tone of quiet (and expensive) good taste.

title: [[Perobler's Orlogs, The Lobby]]
description: At a large landing at the top of the stairs, several gleaming oak chairs face each other across a dark blue carpet with deep pile.  In the far wall, paneled double doors stand open, in limed oak matching the chairs.  To the right of the doors is a window with a dark blue drape, and to the left is a smaller door that says "Repairs."

title: [[Perobler's Orlogs, The Showroom]]
description: The light gleams off polished glass in the showroom of Bergen Perobler, Elanthia's foremost chronometrician, where the wares of this inventive and artistic genius are displayed.  The buzzes, hums, chirps, cuckoos, chimes, and ticks of his astonishing creations are a background to every conversation.  A competent-looking guard by the exit doors keeps a wary eye on the customers and merchandise alike.

title: [[Perobler's Orlogs, The Repair Closet]]
description: This tiny, almost bare room -- the workroom of Knobby Snaggle, Perobler's repairdwarf -- has only a small counter with a high stool behind it.  What light there is comes from a small window in the rear wall, on which hang a handsome sign and a framed certificate.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Conference Room 'B']]
description: More cramped than cozy, this conference room has seen a fair amount of use.  The carpet has lost its color in an arching trail from the ash door to the chair at the head of the glossy black table, and the walls are brown from years of cigar-smoking inhabitants.

title: [[Lish'telga Misekar, Lowlands]]
description: Thick woods gradually thin to light forest and, finally, to occasional close growing clumps of trees in the northern wilds.  The ground begins to rise rapidly and steeply to the north.  Vanishing up in the hills, a faint path winds its way through the tall grasses.

title: [[Carillon Park, Footbridge]]
description: Rising gently, the footbridge's arched shape is barely noticeable as it spans the narrow brook.  Spilling from the bridge's railing, roses and honeysuckle trail into the water and are tugged by the current.  Within the brook, glints of golden fish flash among the plants and sparkling coins thrown from the bridge by wishers and seekers.  The path away from the carillon parts the tufts of grass and cattails vying for space on the stream bank.

title: [[Carillon Park, Stone Lions]]
description: Sheltered beneath a camphor tree, a proud basalt lion watches over his stone pride as they lounge in the flower-speckled clearing.  One lioness rolls on her back, one sniffs at a clump of lilies, while yet another sculptured lioness licks her cub.  Several stone cubs gather around a bronze paladin seated upon a basalt slab.  At the north end of the clearing, a grass and bamboo gate closes the path from further exploration.

title: [[Carillon, Entrance]]
description: Towering above the city, the Carillon tolls the sailor's watch and serves as a look-out for those who wait for a mariner's return.  Centered on the innermost disk, this slender obelisk is home to those who seek comfort and counsel.  Flecks of quartz in the sandy granite exterior sparkle in the light, and stained glass windows, like a jeweled belt, encircle the building midway to the top.  Atop, bells hang in the open arches supporting the roof.

title: [[Lish'telga Misekar, Lowlands]]
description: Higher in the hills, the forest sounds die away as the thick southern woods thin to sparsely wooded highland.  The scattered growths cling tenuously to the earth, their wind-twisted trunks and branches betraying misery in the face of the surrounding greenery.

title: [[Oweede's Place]]
description: The air is thick with motes of dust dancing in the dim light and the scent of lemon polish nearly masks the smell of musk.  Heavy oak shelves lining the walls from floor to ceiling bow under the weight of countless items of undeterminable value.  A stack of crates holding hundreds of used cards and wedding invitations rests against the end of a scarred counter.  In one corner, a canvas sack full of dull jelly beans lies against a box overflowing with used shapers.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Carousel Desk]]
description: A long wooden desk spans the width of the western wall.  Brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in spotless red tile.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: A temporary pier of scaffolding mounts the walls and tapering dikes to provide workers with sure footing.  Hanging from one of the support beams, a bucket sways in the wind, its contents clattering as it moves.  Just beneath the planking of the makeshift walkway, the explosive sound of the ocean washing over the jumbled stones shakes the wood, and sends the bucket into yet another shifting motion.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Most of the pilings and posts that support the wooden walkway lean askew, pushed off kilter by the movement of the heavy and keen-edged boulders underneath.  The boards, glossy and green from the constant dampness, shudder under the slightest weight or the most gentle push of the wind.  Whenever a particularly potent wave slams into the barrier, some unseen part of the walkway growls angrily as it shakes and repositions itself.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Abruptly stopping over a mound of pointed basalt, the walkway lacks any safety features such as guardrails or warning signs.  One heavy black stone in particular is a favorite spot for the waves to dash, if only because its great size presents such a good target.  Just poking from the surface of the waves, another series of black basalt curves in mimicry, shielding this one from the worst of the ocean's assault.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: Only slightly more stable than its twin to the west, this heap of rock and rubble is at least saved from the most dramatic of swells flooding over both.  All manner of rough stonework is half-buried in the mounds, from cracked sculptures and friezes to the remnants of support columns and paving stones.  Some are glaringly apparent, the white of pitted marble contrasting sharply with the dark basalt.  Others are more subtle, like the mostly-covered face of the statue gazing from the shattered rocks.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Gull Circle]]
description: The wet, black stones underfoot shift menacingly in the tide, every so often uttering a muffled plop as one of their number slides into the sea.  Thick pilings struggle to keep the pile of stones from vanishing completely under the onslaught of the ocean's power, but their barnacle-encrusted forms betray the weakened state that their time in the water has brought.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Southern Canal Gate]]
description: Solidly mortared and built from heavy blocks of basalt, the base for the planned canal gate is closer to completion than the surrounding ring, and stands out from the surrounding pile of rough and loose rock.  Ebbing waves slicken the stones on top of the base with spray and foam.  Caught only by the most violent splashes, a brilliant red banner flutters from atop a wooden pole.

title: [[Iden Araba, Southwest]]
description: Light from the city's buildings reflects off the rippling water, but doesn't cast enough illumination to navigate.  Only the current, tugging toward the southeast, hints at where you are.

title: [[Iden Araba, South]]
description: Light from the city's buildings reflects off the rippling water, but doesn't cast enough illumination to navigate.  Only the current, tugging toward the southeast, hints at where you are.

title: [[Iden Araba, South]]
description: Light from the city's buildings reflects off the rippling water, but doesn't cast enough illumination to navigate.  Only the current, tugging eastward, hints at where you are.

title: [[Iden Araba, South]]
description: Light from the city's buildings reflects off the rippling water, but doesn't cast enough illumination to navigate.  Only the current, tugging eastward, hints at where you are.

title: [[Iden Araba, Southeast]]
description: Light from the city's buildings reflects off the rippling water, but doesn't cast enough illumination to navigate.  Only the current, tugging toward the northeast, hints at where you are.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, A Big Willow Tree]]
description: The willow, not nearly as tall as some of the giants around it, has some of its branches tangled in a mass of vines hanging from a nearby cypress.  One in particular looks like a way to get to the larger tree.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: A barren, rocky clearing slopes slightly up to the north.  On lower ground to the south, a heavy thicket of ravelthorns blocks the way, broken only by a few faint game trails.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: On the high side of a steep ditch, the ground rises almost to the tops of the trees in the bog below.  Cypress branches and tangled vines conceal the view to the south, but to the west, the way seems clearer.  Already the air feels drier and cooler.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: The view to the north shows a rising field of broken rock, a jumble of odd shapes and strange conjunctions.  In one place, the path skirts boulders that look for all the world like trolls.  In another, it avoids the smaller rubble scattered at toe-stubbing, ankle-twisting, and shin-barking heights.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: The trail swings through a half-turn as it threads its way among the sharp, loose stones.  A few ravelthorn bushes spring up in the soil collected on the high side of the larger stones, but for the most part, the slope is barren of plant life, left to the wind and the rain.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: The trail stands at the last switch-back in its steady mounting of the hillside.  Red and brown stones from the size of pebbles to cottages cover the ground, and the trail cuts back and forth between the largest of them like the path of a bouncing ball.  Each Spring rain must change the path as the smaller stones wash southward to the bog.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: The rock, sloping gently to the south, suddenly rises high above the treetops.  A massive ridge looms against the northern sky, its front like the prow of a gigantic ship cresting the green billows of the forest.  A side-trail leads off to the northeast, passing along the foot of the ridge.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: The path ends at a sheer face of rock with a small pool at its base.  Water from a chimney in the rock face has worn a shallow basin in the ledge, and it spills over the side, trickling down a mossy channel that drops to the ground far below.  The chimney looks like it leads to higher ground above, but might be a tough climb.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Young Cypress]]
description: High above the knees of the cypress, a wide limb offers firm footing to the creatures who spend most of their lives among its leaves.  They are born, hunt, mate, and die in this green world above the forest floor.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Young Cypress]]
description: The wide limb spreads its branches to either side, moss cascading in grey-green strands to left and right.  A world of birds and beetles, caracals, squirrels and snakes -- a whole aerial menagerie -- whistles, growls, chitters, and hisses a welcome.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Young Cypress]]
description: The limb of the cypress tapers, and with each step it flexes underfoot.  This aerial path is clearly at an end, but a cluster of vines from nearby trees entangles the end of the bough like a weaver's nightmare.  One sturdy vine in particular drapes over from a massive cypress.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, A Massive Cypress]]
description: Pink flowers with a cloud of feathery petals dot the end of the branch, a startling sight on a cypress.  A closer look shows that the flowers only appear to be sprouting from the limb: they are blossoming on a dark green vine swooping down to a smaller, younger cypress.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, A Massive Cypress]]
description: This perch on a wide limb of the cypress stands well above the leafy canopy, and commands a panoramic view.  The thick forest rolls upslope to the higher ground to the east and descends steeply to a swamp in the south.  In the west, a steep spur of rock hides the river from view.  A supple vine close at hand trails over to a silvery cypress.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Silvery Cypress]]
description: Through some odd effect of the tangle of vines or the lay of the land, the whisper of the wind is louder here, and every sparrow's chirp and mosquito's buzz is ten times magnified.  Through the maze of creepers and moss, the outline of a huge cypress can be seen to the west, and some of the vines close at hand disappear into its upper branches.

title: [[A Massive Cypress, A Leafy Hut]]
description: Someone has built a shelter from the elements against the trunk of the cypress.  Leafy branches have been skillfully woven into the limbs of the tree to make walls and a roof, as snug a room as one might wish.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, A Massive Cypress]]
description: The cypress stands regally among its fellows, its girth and height showing its victories in the slow, unceasing forest battles with weather and rivals.  Here a storm has broken a branch, there a vine has strangled a limb, but the cypress has overcome them all, and stretches its crown above the knoll it rules.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Silvery Cypress]]
description: Broad branches in many directions make a firm floor underfoot.  Light filtering down through the leaves lends a color of enchantment, annihilating all that's made into a green thought in a green shade.  Sheets of silvery moss billow and ripple, like tent walls pierced with windows of curious shapes.  A dwarf seems to be peering through one of those windows to the northeast.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Silvery Cypress]]
description: Nature's mischievous hand has left its mark at the joint of two big branches: the wrinkles in the bark bear a striking resemblance to a Dwarven face.  No sculptor could have bettered the swellings that form the beetling brows and the bulbous nose, complete with wart.  A fold supplies a broad smile, and the greenish moss provides a luxuriant beard.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Twin Oak]]
description: The two trunks of the oak are so close together that from a distance they appear to be one.  Their branches are flourishing, and several of the larger limbs seem almost trunk-like themselves.  They fork into something very close to a natural lair for the small -- and the larger -- predators of the forest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Twin Oak]]
description: The tree has been lavish with its seed, and acorns and acorn caps litter the boughs.  Its resident red squirrels are especially sleek and sassy, springing from branch to branch in a world where food is abundant, shelter is free, and life is easy.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Twin Oak]]
description: This limb of the oak hangs high above a little stream that winds its way down the hillside.  The splash of the water is pleasant, and a dip might be refreshing, but the stream is obviously shallow, and no convenient vines allow an easy or safe descent.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Twin Oak]]
description: Here and there on the bark of the limb are little tufts of grey fur, the kind that a cat might leave behind if it was lying on its back scratching an itch.  The main difference is that the hairs are twice as long as any cat's, and the tufts cover a wide surface.  The trunk also shows deep scores, as if it had been used as a scratching post by impressive claws.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Stunted Elm]]
description: Not many elms populate the forest.  This one must have been a volunteer sprung from a seed carried by a far-flying bird.  It hasn't thrived in its setting, short on water and sunlight, and the vines trailing from the taller trees add yet another obstacle.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: A ledge hardly the width of a loaded camel ascends the west side of the rock outcropping.  The fall to the river is abrupt, down a steep cliff with exposed strata of red and brown rock.  On the other side of the ledge, the shoulder of the rock rises high overhead, hiding the view to the north, but to the south a marshy swamp lies in the mists.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: The narrow ledge, barely wide enough for two people to stand side-by-side, works its way along the cliff side.  Steps cut from the rock help the traveller surmount the steeper parts of the trail.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: The trail runs through a narrow valley cut in the outcrop like a gash in its rocky skin.  A grudging concession by the rugged outcropping, the trail winds its narrow route deep-set among boulders that limit sight to a few feet.  A passage branches off to the northeast.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: Over the millennia, the outcropping has bowed to its only master, nature: the wind has filled cracks in the rock with bits of silt and mulch from the bogs.  The result is a mottled harmony of bare granite and scrub brush determined to seize life on the barren rocks.  The only flaw in this example of nature's irrestible will is a patch of rusty soil at the base of one boulder, as if over the ages the elements, angry at the affront, had ground something metal under vengeful feet.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The Outcropping]]
description: Water trickles down the face of the rocky slope from above, a soothing balm on the dry outcrop.  A small lip of rock leans out over the lower elevation to the east, allowing a sheltered view of the lower outcropping and bogs below.  Bits of rotting leather and pockmarked stones half-buried in the thin soil show that others have done a fair amount of watching here as well.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The East Face]]
description: Midway up the face of the outcropping, a cleft in the stone provides shelter from the wind howling unchecked across the face of the mountain.  Water from a small spring bubbles into a pool at the back of the cleft and trickles down the slope.  Next to the pool is a crude firepit whose ashes suggest recent use.  Charred bones lie strewn about the outer edge of the cleft, away from some flattened indentations in the rough ground circling the firepit.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The East Face]]
description: The trail levels out slightly, as if gathering energy before rising toward the pinnacle of the outcropping to the northwest.  Empty roosts are scattered among the crags, many of them with broken eggshells.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, A Narrow Ledge]]
description: The main outcropping divides spectacularly as the land rises to a peak like a huge spike driven into the earth between the rugged outcrop to the southeast and the cliff edge to the southwest.  A small ledge to the north seems almost an afterthought compared to this rocky finger pointing defiantly at the heavens.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, A Narrow Ledge]]
description: A small ledge clings desperately to the main outcropping, overlooking a dangerously entrancing vista hundreds of feet below.  A step onto the ledge dislodges bits of scree that skid across and down to fall in silence into the roiling waters of the river -- the ledge is fighting a losing battle against weather and time.  Beyond the churning waters lies the far side of the river: a vast, barren expanse empty of signs of habitation.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: The narrow path skirts the edge of the rocky outcropping, ending in a sharp peak to the northeast.  The trail blends into the face of the rock like a scar from a long forgotten wound.  Along the western edge of the trail, a patchwork of lichens and stubborn mosses drinks in the moisture rising from the river far below.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: The broader expanse of rock to the southwest tilts and sharpens to the north, as if the outcropping itself resisted further efforts to scale its imposing face.  It must have taken persevering labor to forge the narrow path that struggles the north and south route.  A roughly carved niche in the eastern face of the rocky wall offers more evidence that the path was the work of hands, not nature.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: Part of the edge of the path has fallen away, and a broken slope leads down to the west.  On what remains of the ledge, massive boulders define a trail that rises to the north and east.  Far to the north is the summit of the outcropping, a sharp peak dominating the rugged landscape.

title: [[The West Face, A Broken Slope]]
description: The slope ends sharply, jutting out at a dizzying height above the river.  The debris from the rockslide clutters the area except where it has fallen down a narrow channel, carved into the face of the rock, that allows a switchbacked route toward the river below.

title: [[Galduta Isharon, The West Face]]
description: The view north looks like nature's chaotic side was inspired to rend the bedrock itself, heaving the land up, gradually at first but culminating in a towering height hundreds of feet in the air.  Like a serpent attacking the feet of a giant, the river to the west rages over rapids, pounding against the rock in an angry competition between the two elements.  Along the rapids, shadows collect in hollows that mark the river's slow victory in the struggle between water and earth.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The White Oak]]
description: Halfway up the ancient oak, its enormous limbs form highways in the sky for the creatures of the canopy.  The weathered walkways cast dark shadows over the marsh below.  A leaf drifts down, taking a long time to fall, slowed in its descent by the rising bog gasses that clog and taint the air.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The White Oak]]
description: Deep claw marks, signs of nature red in tooth and claw, scar the wide branch near a broken arrow lodged in the wood.  The archer must have missed his target, because bloodstains streak the limb and the leaves below.  A large vine twists down from a vine-covered cypress to the south.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The White Oak]]
description: The limb groans under the unaccustomed weight of visitors.  Something has stripped the branch of its bark, maybe the insect larvae of a wood-boring beetle that now infest the creaking limb, making every step both distasteful and dangerous.  A plump, white grub inches its way to a richer feeding spot, and disappears into the limb.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The White Oak]]
description: Sunlight breaks through the canopy above, painting the branch with patches of light and shadow.  Only the rising stench from the bog below spoils the temptation to lie back and enjoy the sight.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The White Oak]]
description: The top of the oak provides a wide view of the surrounding lands.  To the north Forlorn Hope springs from the rocky ridge into the sky.  To the far south a shining line on the horizon may be the ocean, Altanen's destination, glistening in the sunlight.  The splash of Altanen's rapids rises over the sounds of the bog.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Silvery Cypress]]
description: The branch takes a sharp, sudden bend, possibly in a direction set when the tree was young, and the limb grew toward a patch of sunlight.  The obscuring moss partly masks the turn, and an unwary traveller risks a dangerous fall.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Silvery Cypress]]
description: The pleasant scent of living cypress wood is overlaid by a heavier, spicy aroma, possibly the silver-shaded moss that covers this tree alone of those that stand on the slope.  Vines weave in and out of the moss, connecting the branches of neighboring trees in a complicated network.  Judging from scuff marks on the boughs, some of the vines are routes as well marked as the paths on the ground below.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: The water level in the Altanen has dropped, exposing a nearly flat strip of muddy bank.  To the west, a long streak of green is visible in the middle of the river, and there seems to be movement on it.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The River Bank]]
description: The mudbank ends, closed off by a shoulder of the cliff.  The view across the arm of the river shows that the island, although low, is fairly long, extending a good half-league downstream.  Low vegetation covers it, some kind of grey-green scrub or grass.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: Toward the south across this arm of the river, a low scrub-covered island rises, dividing the river's flow.  The swift current sends up feathers of spray where it hits the island, but the water in this back-channel is slower and smoother.  To the east, a muddy strip of land lies at the foot of Galduta Isharon.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: To the east looms the cliff of Galduta Isharon, a narrow river bank at its base.  An island lies further west, an easy swim through the flowing water.  To the southeast, the trees of the Bog Wallows rise above the edge of the swamp.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: To the north looms the cliff of Galduta Isharon; to the east beyond the river bank, treetops rise above the mist.  A low island lies further west across the channel, an easy swim through the flowing water.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water in the back channel flows southeast here, lapping at the shore of the low island, but smoother to the east toward the cliffs of Galduta Isharon.  Except for a covering of waist-high grasses, the island looks barren.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: Swirling leaves and muddy streaks in the water show that a strong current pushes away from the swamp, apparently the outflow from the streams that feed it.  Easier water lies to the west toward the island.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The shore of the island to the west lies close by, its bank receding to the southwest.  Its appearance is much like that of the swamp across the river to the east, except for an absence of trees.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The shore of the island to the west lies close by, its bank receding to the northwest.  Exposed by the falling river level, it's covered with grass that looks to be waist-high on a Gor'Tog.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water in the back channel flows southeast here, lapping at the shore of the low island, but smoother to the east toward the cliffs of Galduta Isharon.  Except for a covering of waist-high grasses, the island looks barren.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  An occasional waving of the grass in a purposeful direction hints that something else inhabits the island.  Across the channel to east, the tops of trees rise above the mist from the river.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  An occasional waving of the grass in a purposeful direction hints that something else inhabits the island.  Across the channel to east, the tops of trees rise above the mist from the river.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: A long, low island stretches to the south, dividing the river in two.  The eastern channel must be deeper, for its water is relatively smooth and unruffled, but in the western arm the lowering of the river has uncovered jagged rocks, and the water foams and races between them with a loud roar.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: To the north, the island narrows to a point, but to the south it broadens until it almost looks like a meadow covered with waving grasses.  The grass is beaten down in a few places, possibly animal trails.  The rapids to the west cloud the air with spray, making it hard to see what lies beyond them.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  Taller patches here and there confuse the view as they wave in the wind and the drifting, blurring spray from the rapids to the west.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Ashala'taman, Dawn Terrace]]
description: Suffused in muted pink light, a vibrant undersea mosaic spans the inner wall of the terrace and provides a colorful backdrop for a small meditating statue of Eluned.  The white coral goddess is seated in contemplative repose, gazing past a vine-draped sandstone colonnade and into the world beyond.  A spring warmth fills the air.

title: [[The Island, A Hunter's Shelter]]
description: Some thoughtful soul has dragged driftwood into a crude shelter and stuffed the larger holes with weeds.  How well it keeps out the rain is anyone's guess, but it offers more protection than anywhere else on the island.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: Grass extends in all directions.  From here, it's easy to forget that this is an island in the middle of a great river.  It looks like one could walk across this wild meadow to the trees distant in the east.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: A narrow neck of the island curves north to southwest, covered with high grass.  The rapids must be close, judging by their noise, but the quieter channel to the east shows through breaks in the grass, with places where it would be possible to get into the river.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: To the south from this spit of land, the Altanen has a strange appearance: a band of muddy water along the western shore, a clearer blue one along the eastern side, slowly blending as the river winds into parts unknown.  Its two arms join here, holding the low, grassy island that stretches to the north.  From here it could almost be a meadow or a pasture.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: To the north, the island expands into a field of waving grasses, but to the south it shrinks to a narrow spit of land, barely above the surface of the water.  A bowshot to east or west would reach the river, but the roaring rapids to the west show there's no escape in that direction.

title: [[The Altanen River, The Island]]
description: The animal runs in the grass, if that's what they are, cross and mingle with a bewildering complexity.  An occasional waving of the grass in a purposeful direction hints that something else inhabits the island.  Across the channel to east, the tops of trees rise above the mist from the river.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The shore of the island to the west lies close by, its low bank presenting no obstacle.  A bird circles overhead now and then, too high up to identify, but it might be a vulture.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The shore of the island to the west lies close by, but its bank looks undercut and higher than it is to the north.  The view to the east is obscured, with only the tops of the taller trees rising above the mist.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The shore of the island to the west lies close by, but its steep, high bank makes reaching it impossible.  The view to the east is obscured, with only the tops of the taller trees rising above the mist.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The two arms of the river join where it broadens at the south end of the island.  To the northwest, the turbulent rapids spill their water into the confluence, slowing dramatically in a cloud of spray.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water surges first in one direction then in another, bouncing around, between, and sometimes over the rocks that were once below the surface of the river.  The current races along, sweeping past the banks on either side.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water surges first in one direction then in another, bouncing around, between, and sometimes over the rocks that were once below the surface of the river.  The current races along, sweeping past the banks on either side.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: As the flow of the broad river parts around the island, this western arm forces its way between and over clusters of rocks, barely above the surface.  The water races through the narrow channels, its speed and power increasing at every constriction.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water surges first in one direction then in another, bouncing around, between, and sometimes over the rocks that were once below the surface of the river.  The current races along, sweeping past the banks on either side.

title: [[Fala Inisharon, The Altanen River]]
description: The water surges first in one direction then in another, bouncing around, between, and sometimes over the rocks that were once below the surface of the river.  The current races along, sweeping past the banks on either side.

title: [[Fever Point, Zhendil's Emporium]]
description: A portable sorting table with compartments full of sparkling gems seems out of place in this musty room, with its walls and ceiling that look held together by cobwebs and wasp nests.  Oiled paper tacked over one window frame creates a makeshift covering that blocks not only the elements, but also most of the light.  Two barrels offer seating near the counter where the gem dealer does business, and a ceiling lantern casts a glow whereby he is able to judge the character of his customers.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Town Hall, Debts and Fees]]
description: A massive oak counter topped with a fence of steel bars dominates the Mer'Kresh Office of Debts and Fees.  A smiling clerk behind the counter does his cheerful best to help Rissans who have problems with debts or with the city bureaucracy.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Town Hall, Registry Records Office]]
description: Wooden filing cabinets line the cypress planked walls of this tiny office, giving it a rustic scent.  Piles of neatly stacked papers cover the top of a driftwood desk that has been positioned to immediately catch the attention of anyone entering the room.  A velvet rope divides the small waiting area in an attempt to direct Rissans, impatient to get back to the hunt, into forming a line to wait their turn.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Path]]
description: The path gradually rises to the northeast, sloping upward as it winds around a flat-topped hill.  Smooth waves of hardened lava lash out amongst shadowy remains, the basalt shining glassily against the backdrop of night.

title: [[Skeleton's Crook, Blasted Hilltop]]
description: A desolate scape of scorched shadows and piles of wreckage rolls out around you.  Flattened by forces at present unseen, everything is lit by an eerie, demonic red light the color of blood.  Remains of houses lie in restless piles amongst pools of frozen lava, skeletons of the former village of Crook.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Verandah]]
description: A wide verandah with a canopy of honeysuckle and grape vines runs the full length of the building.  Colorful mosaics celebrating the healing arts cover the walls.  Above the doorway leading into the building, the greeting "Welcome to the Empath Guild of Ratha" is formed in blue and gold-colored tiles.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Central Corridor]]
description: The long corridor serves as little more than a passageway to get from room to room and front to back of the guild hall.  Except for occasional scuff and gouge marks from careless visitors, the plaster walls are undecorated.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Store Room]]
description: Rows of mostly barren wooden shelves fill the room, the few that are full contain empty jars and glass bottles.  Rounds of hard cheese, several braids of onions, and a string of sausages hang from ceiling hooks.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Main Patio]]
description: The crest of the Empaths' Guild has been skillfully recreated in broken tiles to pave the patio at the back of the Guild.  Carved limestone benches interspersed with young potted palms line the rim of the circular patio.  Behind them, crimson and orange daylilies dance happily in the breeze.  To the west beyond a wrought iron gate lies the Guild Leader's herb garden.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Guild Office]]
description: Sketches and drawings of herbs, flowers, and arcane alchemical equipment cover the walls of the guild office.  Bundles of jadice, rosemary, and lavender hang from overhead drying racks.  Pots of yelith and miniature roses sit on a bench in front of a window overlooking the garden.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Grassy Clearing]]
description: At first glance the clearing appears to be covered with short grass, but each footstep releases citrus and pineapple scents.  Lemon thyme and low-growing chamomile have been planted along with the grass to form a slightly springy herbal carpet.  Their small yellow and white flowers are strewn among the deep green grass like stars across the sky.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Covered Patio]]
description: Although the framework is complete, only part of the slats for the patio cover have been installed.  At the far end of the patio, workmen have carelessly left bundles of the slats and several stacks of tiles uncovered.  A young grapevine has been staked and tied to climb one of the outer support posts.  In a few years, it may cover the patio and provide shade and shelter, but for now it looks abandoned in a forgotten corner of the guild.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Herb Garden]]
description: Small paths trace through the naturalized herb garden giving limited access to all the plants.  The sweet, heady perfume of moonflowers fills the air.  Practically invisible during the day, at night they bloom a pale silvery-white on the vine-covered wrought iron fence that surrounds the garden.  In the glow from the patio and the guild house windows, only the vague shapes of the other plants can be seen.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, West Verandah]]
description: Lush vines laden with grapes block the sights and sounds of the street outside the guild.  Padded benches, tucked into the corners at this end of the verandah, provide comfortable seating for guild visitors.  A candle-lit chandelier illuminates the room.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, East Verandah]]
description: The sweet scent of flowers fills the eastern end of the verandah.  A candle-lit brass chandelier casts a warm glow illuminating the mosaic on the inner wall.  Mounds of colorful canvas cushions have been set out as seating.

title: [[Menevia the Seeress, Seance Parlor]]
description: In a velvet robe punctuated with beetle-wing spangles, Menevia the Blind Seeress holds forth, seated at a round table.  She does not rise to greet you.  Querents huddle around her, awaiting answers on what the future holds.  Several cowled figures stand by a trelium display case, pointing at talismans, orbs and other trinkets, debating their virtues and price.

title: [[Menevia the Seeress, Rooftop Gazebo]]
description: This pleasant gazebo is a surprising annex to Menevia's stuffy chambers below.  Light from the astral bodies envelops you through enchanted glass, a kind that permits the full spectrum to penetrate.  Stained glass lightcatchers of unicorns, chimeras and griffins cast tiny rainbows on everything in the room, including you.  Menevia seems totally aware of the state of the heavens, sensing rather than seeing.

title: [[Prison, Eating Area]]
description: The smell of rotting food swirls around the various-sized tables that fill the room.  Dented plates litter the ground amid broken chairs.  Long bars of steel run parallel to either side of each table and are anchored at both ends.
