title: [[Prison, Lower Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: This side of the prison was reserved for those that misbehaved.  Damp air carries a biological odor that is not mitigated by the aromas of rotting food that emanate from the south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Lower Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Everything, from the walls to the doors is dark grey, shrouding the area in the dreary appearance of a rainy day.  Shreds of cloth litter the ground, although what they once were is unclear.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Solitary Cell]]
description: The dim light from the passages above casts a faint glow into the area.  This dark cell has been filled about halfway up the walls with an unusual black goo that smells worse than a paladin who hasn't washed his armor in many years.  Skulls, internal organs and half eaten animals float upon the surface.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Lower Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: A small, reinforced portcullis dangles from the ceiling, its operating chain broken in pieces on the floor.  Lanterns hang on the walls, providing light through the grime that coats them.  Dirtier still, the floor is caked with dirt and mud.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, northwest.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Middle Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by gaping openings that were once barred by doors.  Flickering shadows from torches filter upward from the stairs that lead below.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Middle Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by gaping holes where doors once stood.  The heavy material muffles sounds coming from inside the cells so that only the sound of footsteps against the ground are audible.  A musty odor envelops the entire area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Prisoner Cell]]
description: Dark stone walls enclose a large dirty cell used for holding prisoners.  A small pile of rotting hay covers the corner of the floor, the only form of bed in the cell.  Cracks in the walls and brickwork show how little care the guards had for the prisoners well-being.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Work Yard South]]
description: Trapped between the foreboding stone walls to the west and the spiked fence to the east, the work yard stretches out to the north.  Countless years of mining the marble of the quarry have left the area sunken well below the ring road to the east, adding to the oppressive sense of confinement.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Work Yard North]]
description: The ground here is uneven, rising and falling with no seeming pattern.  Gaping pits where blocks of marble have been cut free lie hidden behind high ground, unintentional traps for the unwary.  A spiked fence separates the work yard from the surrounding ring road above.  Near the compound wall is a deep pit covered with rough timbers, a staircase leading down into the darkness.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, The Pit]]
description: The flickering light of torches sends shadows scurrying across this expansive underground chamber.  A series of long ironwood worktables with accompanying benches dominates the center of the room.  Along one wall is a series of racks containing all the tools needed to work in the quarry above as well as prepare the garnets here in the Pit.  Stacks of unworked marble blocks glistening with crude garnets line another wall.  A staircase leads to the work yard above.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, The Pit]]
description: Flickering torches cast eerie shadows within the room, creating a foreboding dance of light within the dank pit.  Worktables and benches are pushed against the wall, each holding an assortment of tools for use.  Worked marble blocks stacked upon wooden slats within the center of the room await further preparations.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, The Pit]]
description: Dim light flickers upon a large sign fastened to the wall, baring a loud proclamation of moral intent.  Neatly piled upon wooden slats are roughly shaped marble blocks, each awaiting further work.  Workbenches line the center of the room, each holding the necessary tools to further the process of the material.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, The Pit]]
description: Well placed torches upon the wall create ample lighting over the workbenches.  Shaped marble blocks rest upon wooden slats, awaiting final shaping before moving onto the last of their processing.  Thick layers of debris line the floor, though a broom stands at the ready in a corner next to a waste bin.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, The Pit]]
description: Crates of garnets and slats of marble blocks rest to one side of the room.  Directly across, well lit workbenches loaded with supplies stand at the ready.  A sign carved with a stern warning is fastened upon the wall above the workspace as a deterrent to those with thieving fingers.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Processing Area]]
description: A massive desk dominates the western wall, flanked on either side by large racks spilling parchments and scrolls onto the ground.  Overhead, a gaethzen orb glows steadily in the gloom, chasing away the encroaching shadows.  Cabinets fill the remaining wall space, their open drawers gaping and empty.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Cramped Office]]
description: Grey tendrils of light creep from a dingy lantern hung from the ceiling, barely illuminating even such a tiny space.  Nothing remains of the furnishings but splinters and mattress stuffing strewn about.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Receiving Area]]
description: Flickering torchlight reveals deep gouges and scratches on the walls, mostly obscuring older images on the walls.  A shallow pool of water stands in one corner where guards used to scrub the newly arrived prisoners but now the water is fouled with refuse and debris.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Clearing]]
description: Trees have been hacked down and dragged leaving nothing to hide behind, making escape through the front gate nearly impossible.  Anyone on the tower has a clear view of the entire area, able to shoot both inside and outside the compound.  Lizards lie sunning themselves on a rock that was too large to be moved.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Crossroads]]
description: Three roads meet in the center of this clearing.  Two branches lead into the jungle, and the last towards the compound.  All of them are level, creating a smooth path for animals to travel over.  Grass and other little green shrubs litter the area around the road, leaving the road looking empty but colorful.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road South]]
description: The largest of the towers that surround the prison stands here on a small knoll, like a lighthouse overlooking its rocky shore.  Looking down over the southwest you can see the tiny boathouse that brings guards and prisoners alike to the island and the sheer cliff that keeps the prisoners from escaping.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road South]]
description: Part of the road has been eroded by heavy rains, creating deep groves as the water runs down to find equilibrium.  Green areca palms have started to grow here and get thicker to the west, creating a tropical jungle.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road South]]
description: Skirting the road that winds between the tropical trees and the walls of the prison is a single pendas plant.  Its broad red leaves stand out among the brown, sandy dirt of the path.  The hard walls of the prison have crumbled a bit.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road South]]
description: Surrounding fishtail palms and bamboo threaten to overgrow the road, which gets narrower here.  Some of the cane has been cut short from past attempts to keep them from reaching the road.  To the east is a ladder leading up to a guard tower.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Guard Tower]]
description: The upkeep on this guard tower is long overdue and much needed.  The floor has started to come apart, causing cracks and large gaps to appear in the surface of the bamboo.  Discarded knives and rusting shackles have been scattered about the decaying floor.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road East]]
description: Deep within a dense planting of bamboo, a spiked iron fence struggles to remain upright.  The road cuts wide around the stand, moving perilously close to the dark tree trunks of the ever-present jungle.  High-voiced monkey calls echo through the foliage.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road East]]
description: The road bends slightly around an enormous tree that rises up out of sight among the canopy.  Its shade has crowded out most of the normal undergrowth, leaving a clearer area for the road to pass through.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road East]]
description: Wataba trees line the road, crowding close and blocking almost all sight of the spiked fence.  Looped over the limb of a bush close to the road is a green vine snake, its long tongue flicking in and out as it watches the rare traveler.  A thin path leads to the east, almost overgrown in the thick stand of foliage.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road East]]
description: Philodendrons bloom in lush profusion along the spiked fence to the west.  A low rock outcrop helps keep the trees away from the road, which winds along between the fence and the rocks.  Maidenhair ferns cluster close to the roadbed, taking advantage of the increased sunlight.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road East]]
description: Cattleya orchids give way to thick clumps of unidentifiable vines and bushes, dense and impenetrable.  Foliage swarms over the spiked fence enclosing the work yard, obscuring all views of the interior.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road North]]
description: Purple cattleya has grown in thick patches to complement the rainbow-colored birds that can be seen flapping from tree to tree and squawking at one another.  To the east is a ladder leading up to the guard tower that oversees the prison work yard.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Guard Tower]]
description: The view from the tower offers contrasting worlds to see.  Northeastward, the lush greens of the forest set within the deep blues of the surrounding ocean look surreal, as if painted by the gods.  However, in the opposite direction, the shabby work yard with its canvas of browns and greys looms behind the dangerously sharp fences below.

title: [[Prison, Ring Road North]]
description: Bright pinks and reds of the vireya plants that have amassed here give varied color to the otherwise dark green.  A fortress of winding vines and other plants make any travel except along the road impossible.  The jungle canopy high in the air shakes from time to time.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road North]]
description: Royal palms rise in shapely curves and turns, beside other large tropical trees, sometimes providing cool shade along the road.  The wind, rustling the palm leaves, grabs clothing as if in attempts to hold or push people around.  The start of the prison fence that encloses the work yard can be seen here.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road North]]
description: Sand and shells give way to rich tropical foliage.  Sago palm and green bihai lend a rich emerald color to the vegetation against a background of bamboo and lush verdant grasses.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road North]]
description: Gravel fills the roadside, lined with wispy grasses and weeds.  Guard towers rise above the white-painted prison wall which stretches endlessly beside the pathway.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road West]]
description: Little flanks the road except sand and a field of creeping crabgrass.  The crashing sounds of waves echoes from beyond the headland.  A stone guard tower looms high above, a ladder leading inside its cold walls.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Guard Tower]]
description: Though remaining sturdily in place against the wind, the old, lashed-together bamboo still creaks and groans with each step taken upon it.  A driftwood rail surrounds the edges of the platform, giving little to no protection against a plummet off the edge.  Above, palm leaves have been secured to the bamboo frame, creating a small bungalow to relax under.

title: [[Prison, Ring Road West]]
description: Below the road, nestled in the curve of the cliff is a small beach.  Seabirds mill in the air, looking for washed up food or soaring aimlessly.  The sea breeze is strong here, wafting up from the distant ocean.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road West]]
description: Running close to the drop of the cliff, the road is bare and easily manageable, comprised of layers of seashells intermixed with sand.  A few large rocks break up the flatness of the island, although it still gives the appearance of a flat-topped seamount rising above sea level.  A small shrine hugs the cliffside, clinging to the narrow space between the track and the sheer drop to the waters below.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Ring Road West]]
description: One of the guard towers stands here overlooking the entrance to the prison, with walkways for the guards to observe.  The road is worn from many years of prison guards walking along the perimeter while patrolling or on the way to their posts.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Guard Tower]]
description: Crafted of sturdy bamboo lashed together with rough vine, the guard tower seems sturdy enough to support a good amount of weight.  The view from this perch is perfect to assess the surrounding landscape.  A makeshift ladder leads back down to the ground.

title: [[Prison, Cliff Top]]
description: At the top of the ladder, thick jungle surrounds a rocky, dirt road.  Far below, the crushed and broken skeletons of unfortunate souls who failed to find their freedom litter the jagged rocks, left there by the guards as a warning to others who might entertain thoughts of escape.  The road twists and turns through the jungle as far as the eye can see.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Summit]]
description: A narrow, rocky trail weaves back and forth up the mountain from the boathouse, hugging the sheer cliff.  The only way to continue from there is a very tall ladder.  The ladder stretches over three hundred feet straight up and is six feet wide, leaving plenty of room for even the largest prisoner or guard.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Storage Vault]]
description: Darkness pervades this room, pierced only by a single bright light focused on a table and a soft glow emanating from an archway to the north.

title: [[Riverhaven, Halfling Quarter]]
description: Covered with tiny footprints, this small alley runs behind Noot's Teahouse.  Unused and hidden from the main street, this site is a perfect locale for a youth's first smoke or to sleep off a drunk.

timeto.51522: ;e unless UserVars.riverhaven_password then nil else 3 end

title: [[Traders' Guild, Banquet Room]]
description: A large seven-tiered crystal chandelier is poised high above and casts warm light throughout the room.  The dining tables are draped with pure white tablecloths and adorned with centerpieces of freshly cut flowers.  Carved mahogany chairs are pulled to the tables, an elegant place setting before each one.  Plush gold-flecked deep green carpeting borders the inlaid wood floor that bears the image of a gilded yak and looks well-suited to dancing.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Conference Room]]
description: An air of formality can be felt throughout this stately room where conclaves are welcome to gather and collaborate on various guild matters.  The Crossing Traders' Guild crest is proudly displayed on the rear wall and next to it, in the corner, is a superbly stitched flag bearing the emblem of the Traders' Guild.  A large oval mahogany conference table dominates the room and is surrounded on all sides by finely crafted leather wingback chairs.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Gold Key Club]]
description: The smoke in this room is thicker and more cloying than any encountered at Catrox's Forge, but its source is entirely different.  The finest cigars, the most expensive pipeweed, and imported maugwort weed are being puffed on by the prosperous merchants gathered in this inner sanctum of commerce.  Rotund Halflings in fancy vests, grey-bearded Humans in elegant, fur-trimmed jerkins, Elves in shimmering raiment, all are among the land's elite traders who form the heart of the Guild.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Gallery]]
description: Immaculate partitions with carefully hung works of art are interspersed throughout the stark gallery.  Crushed velvet roping imposes several feet of distance from these treasured pieces.  Hand-carved sconces are discreetly positioned to cast soft ambient light to accentuate each masterpiece.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Hall of Awards]]
description: The sheen of polished mahogany floors vanishes into dimness at the far end of the long hall.  As your eyes follow the length of the flooring, you notice a series of niches set into the walls.  Nearby, a delicate rope of fine silk stretches across the hallway.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Guest Suite]]
description: The suite is reserved for the elite of the Traders' Guild governing hierarchy, particularly those outlanders visiting the Guild headquarters on business.  The walls are paneled with rich, dark huljik wood, oiled to a fine sheen.  A mahogany writing table, decked with a silver inkwell and eagle quill stands before a tall bay window which affords a panoramic view of the town's commercial district.  A high, carved sleigh bed faces the window, flanked by nightstands holding books on trade and travel.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Wholesale Outlet]]
description: Plain fittings display luxury goods from the farthest corners of the realms, but this wholesaler makes no attempt to puff up the goods or cajole the buyers.  This is a place where professionals do business with other professionals, all of whom know and disdain the weaseling tricks commonly played on customers.  Displays are sturdy and pleasant, but not fancy, and everything is brightly lit.  Rugs are a plain brown, walls are an unpanelled beige, and the atmosphere is one of business.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Narrow Corridor]]
description: This seldom used corridor has become a favorite temporary storage room for excessive stock.  Stacks of various wares make quick passage through here difficult.  You notice a thick, steel door just peeking out from behind some wooden pallets.  A Gor'Tog guard leans against it, nonchalant and vigilant at the same time.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Narrow Corridor]]
description: This seldom used corridor has become a favorite temporary storage room for excessive stock.  Stacks of various wares make quick passage through here difficult.  You notice a thick, steel door just peeking out from behind some wooden pallets.  A Gor'Tog guard leans against it, nonchalant and vigilant at the same time.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Auction Hall]]
description: This room is in the process of being finished.  The polished mahogany walls and ceiling are angled in such a way that would project the Auctioneer's voice clearly to the rear of the hall as well as to those listening in the front.  In the emptiness of the room one can imagine the many items and Kronars that will one day exchange hands here.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Vault]]
description: The vault walls are clad in thick steel plates, one of which has been engraved "commissioned from Catrox the Smith".  Locked chests of various sizes, with members' names on them, are neatly stacked in metal racks.  You are being watched by the Gor'Tog guard through a narrow, almost imperceptible gap between two of the plates.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Foreign Trade Office]]
description: This cramped office, a former broom closet, is a close definition of chaos.  An old desk, cluttered with orders awaiting delivery to other provinces, occupies most of this room.  A mottled carpet covers the floor except in the few spots it is burned through from carelessly dropped cigars butts.  What wall space is available is covered with hastily drawn charts tracking the movement of goods between provinces.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Pure's Feed Emporium]]
description: The scent of grains and cut grass permeates the room.  A broad straw broom and long-handled dustpan are propped against sacks of grain that have been neatly arranged along the back wall.  The worn mahogany floors show signs of frequent use.  A faint chirping emanates from somewhere inside the grass bin.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Cellars]]
description: Giant bins, huge wooden barrels and piles of overstuffed hogsheads all await distribution to their final retail destination or to warehouses and shippers around town for export to far corners of Elanthia.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Auction Foyer]]
description: This newly constructed room is devoid of any furnishing.  The breadth of the room is easily large enough to accommodate many potential buyers, while allowing them to converse freely without disrupting any auctions that may be underway.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Moot Foyer]]
description: The lavishly furnished guild continues its traditions with rich oak furnishings and dark, oil-stained mahogany walls.  The foyer provides a place for visitors to listen in on events held in the Moot Room, without disturbing the participants.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Moot Room]]
description: Here the Guild holds meetings and lectures for the townsfolk and interested guests.  There is always some informative, cultural or public relations event scheduled to transpire in this chamber.  Often, high-profile ceremonies where merchants contribute to the community fund, the Mayor's Charity Ball and other worthy causes are conducted here as well.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Sunken Vestibule]]
description: Leaning walls inlaid with panes of polished black onyx enclose this sunken, icy vestibule that is lit by sparkles of dark gold winking fleetingly like teasing ghosts.  Odd sounds echo back and forth, reminiscent of a choir bustling through rehearsal.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Dark grey stone walls and cold basalt floors stretch far beyond sight through the dimly lit corridors that branch from this central nexus.  Two dilapidated pine doors flank the southern passage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Prison Hallway]]
description: The dark stone floor is uncluttered and swept clean of dust and debris, leaving the impression that something has been here recently.  In spite of the lack of rubble, the air smells dank, with a hint of decay.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Prison Hallway]]
description: The four hallways converge here, centered around a massive grid of wrought iron that stretches out over a shadow-draped pit sunk deep into the ground.  A thick noxious order of decay curls up from the depths of this repugnant cage.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Prison Hallway]]
description: The uneven dark stone walls bear strange, ancient etchings that depict gruesome scenes of war.  Dark colors outlining some of the carvings have permanently leached into the porous stone.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Vaulting high to the ceiling, a black crystalline archway opens a narrow corridor to the north.  A discordant choral chant echoes against the dark stone enclosure, carrying from far away.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Entry Hall]]
description: The exquisite white marble floors are veined with swirls of verdant green forming the shape of a triple-tined claw pointing northward to the worship halls.  A great black crystal archway leads south, back to the clergy's quarters.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Entry Hall]]
description: This great hall features vaulted walls of dark crystal and an inlaid floor of green-veined marble.  A faint, spiritual chanting converges from every which direction, buoyed by frigid air.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: High onyx walls line a featureless passageway along whose mirror-like surfaces a shock of light occasionally crackles to show travelers the way.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: A rusted iron lamp swings precariously from the vaulted onyx ceiling, disturbed by a strong breeze.  The erratic flicker cast from above draws ever-shifting apparitions of shadow on the smooth onyx walls, leaving one to wonder what is real and what is illusion.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: The smooth onyx of the walls is disrupted here, with each wall carved in its own intricate, raised pattern.  The shallow illumination flowing from the southeast casts soft shadows from the raised features.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Flesh]]
description: Diffused light from the northwest casts a dull glow against the smooth surface of the onyx walls.  The walls feel cold to the touch and no seams mar their perfect symmetry.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Altar of the Flesh]]
description: The smooth onyx floor has been shattered by thick, muscular roots pushing upward.  The roots intertwine into a contorted mass in the center of the hall.  The stench of burning flesh rises from the strange altar, yet no fire is visible.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Flesh]]
description: Muted light from the southwest casts dark wavering images on the unblemished onyx wall and bounces to the neighboring wall.  Further shadows shimmer eerily on the polished floor, resembling writhing bodies caught in the throes of a painful death.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: A wavering torch secured in a solid stone funnel is solidly fused into the glossy onyx wall near the high ceiling.  Occasional wafts of air cause the flame to twist slowly, an imitation of an ominous dance of the macabre.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: The smooth, glossy finish of the onyx walls is unbroken.  The passage seems brighter to the southwest, where filtered light seeps into the room, reflecting eerie shadows on the polished surface.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Onyx Corridor]]
description: Surrounded on all sides by smooth lustrous onyx walls, the enclosed environment lends the impression of being entombed in a box of solid rock.  Occasionally a glimmer of light will reflect dully across the unblemished surfaces, causing a brief moment of vertigo.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Soul]]
description: Sinister frescoes adorn the northern wall of this cavernous hall, where the dichotomy of the silver and onyx hallways merges into one.  The ceiling is a sweeping arch of black crystal, supported by pillars of darkly veined jade.  A twisting hallway with verdant malachite walls winds to the south.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Soul]]
description: Irregular formations of malachite create a treacherous cavern that winds in an erratic serpentine pattern to the south.  The air is crisp, cold, and fresh, with no hint of the musty pall draped over the rest of the ancient temple.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Soul]]
description: The icy air carries the faint tinkling of off-key wind chimes that echoes eerily through the dark malachite tunnel.  As one travels southerly down the hall, the temperature seems to drop rapidly.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Soul]]
description: A thin layer of frost coats the malachite formations, while slender icicles jab downward into the hall.  Vapor crystallizes with every breath, each a wraith of former life captured forever by the cruel clutches of the temple's heart.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Altar of the Soul]]
description: The ice-laden floor suddenly gives way to an enormous chasm to the south.  Tendrils of intricate silver writhe out from the dusky malachite walls, intertwining to form a strange altar just before the lip of the gaping chasm.  Far in the distance to the south, a glimmering crystalline dais hovers inexplicably over the great pit.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: Smooth and deathly cold to the touch, the silver walls are free of any markings.  A pale luminance from the northwest seems to beckon the unwary traveler.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: Silver walls, their smooth surface polished to a glossy finish, refract the dim light invading menacingly from the southeast.  Odd reflections bounce between the polished surfaces, causing a moment of dizziness that quickly passes.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: An old lantern, its finish blackened from years of use, hangs from a silver hook embedded in the passageway's ceiling.  Nefarious shadows, resembling malformed beings, flitter gruesomely on the silver walls as subtle air currents cause the lantern to sway ominously.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Mind]]
description: Dim light filtering eerily from the southeast allows enough luminance to see that the passage continues.  The silvery walls are slick and cold to the touch.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Altar of the Mind]]
description: The silver walls take on a brilliant emerald hue, painted by the light emanating from a makeshift altar formed from a massive block of green crystal set upon two egg-shaped stones.  The faint murmuring of foreign prayers echoes on the edge of aural perception, yet nags incessantly at your mind.  The alcove is barren of embellishments, accentuating the austerity of its reflective walls.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Hall of the Mind]]
description: Faint light from the northeast casts grim shadows on the glossy silver walls, illuminating the dark passage slightly.  The polished mirror-like surface of each wall reflects distorted impressions of the moving images it captures.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: Silver walls, shrouded with lines of faint luminance from the southwest, stretch upwards to a smooth metallic ceiling.  This refracted light seems to move of its own volition, converging into long, silvery tendrils that creep deeply into the darker recesses of the wide corridor.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: A sputtering torch is nested securely in a conical silver bracket attached to a corner near the ceiling.  The reflected image of the torch is mirrored upon two of the glossy silver walls and ceiling, its wavering likeness shimmering unendingly against the polished surface.

title: [[Abyssal Descent, Silver Corridor]]
description: Smooth silver walls, with an identical ceiling and floor, form a glossy passageway to greet the unwary traveler.  Random echoes of light glaze the shiny surfaces like skeletal hands scraping long bony fingers across a polished mirror.

title: [[Sinjian's Bardic Requisites, Sales Room]]
description: Inside the basswood tree grows a green patch of grass, lending it the ambience of a courtyard.  Full of goldfish, a stone fount is an unexpected centerpiece to the eccentric atelier of Sinjian the bard, the charismatic but mercurial musical instrument maker and teacher.  Examples of his work, from harps, lyres, psalteries, and lutes to recorders, flutes and pennywhistles, line the shop walls.

title: [[Sinjian's Bardic Requisites, Practice Room]]
description: This modest sized chamber has curved walls and an arched ceiling to enhance the acoustics of any practice or performance.  Bardic verses, with their strict metrical patterns and themes of battle, glory and heroism, may be recited at the top of one's lungs, or that shaky fiddle tune practiced until it is impossible to resist its call to the dance.  It is in this room that Sinjian's select students receive their lessons as well.

title: [[Sinjian's Bardic Requisites, Workshop]]
description: Soundboards, strings, reeds, frets and various unidentifiable pieces cover a broad work table here, forgotten remnants of projects from earlier in the day.  Casting odd-shaped shadows that dance in the flickering lamplight, they seem more like a macabre jigsaw puzzle come to life rather than the exquisite instruments they will be turned into by the skillful hands of Sinjian and his apprentices.

title: [[Sinjian's Bardic Requisites, Workshop]]
description: Silver moonlight spilling in from a large bay window to the north casts deep shadows in the lee of the shelves and cabinets to either side.  Only the illumination of a single glass lantern sitting on a long table lightens the enveloping darkness.  Sitting there in the pool of golden radiance are several piles of unsewn cloth, awaiting a tailor's touch in the morning.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Entrance]]
description: Choked with stony debris and rubble, the pitch-dark stone of this corridor crowds oppressively.  High above, tiny growths of phosphorescent lichen glow like strange, cheerless stars, providing just enough light to make out the worst of the hazards.  An awful reek permeates the area, its acrid pungency so pronounced that it is tasted more than smelled.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: A massive infestation of phosphorescent lichen flourishes on the dark stone, its pallid green glow contrasting sharply with the unrelieved gloom in the rest of the cavern.  The uneven, rocky floor is nearly clear of debris here, though the slick stone is treacherous footing.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: The pervasive reek takes on a strong note here, the acrid odor of guano mingling unpleasantly with the smell of decay and rotting meat.  Detritus from a long-ago rock fall is scattered all around, mixed with more organic refuse.  High above, sickly green cave lichen glows sullenly, a scaly infestation on the face of the dark stone.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: A dainty teacup rests on its side amid heaps of mounded guano, its delicate rosebud design nearly obscured beneath a layer of grime.  The phosphorescent lichen glowing high above gives off barely enough sickly green light for navigation.  An awful reek permeates the area, its acrid pungency so pronounced that it is tasted more than smelled.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: Mounded stones and debris form treacherous obstacles as the floor slopes downward.  Dark brown stains mar the dark rock forming the back wall of the cavern, the splotches forming no discernible pattern.  The air here is strangely chill, the cold driving away some of the pervasive reek afflicting this place.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: The rocky cave floor is littered with a multitude of tiny white bones, pointed obstacles for all who pass this way.  High above, phosphorescent lichen casts forth a sickly green light, the tiny pinpoint growths clustered in groups like strange constellations.  An awful reek permeates the area, its acrid pungency so pronounced that it is tasted more than smelled.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Dunien rae Orek]]
description: A massive pile of shattered porcelain dominates this spot, the multitude of pieces in myriad patterns and colors.  Nearby, a smaller pile of humanoid bones is stacked with uncanny neatness, their bleached white color painted a sickly green in the illumination of the glowing cave lichen high above.

title: [[Seord Kerwaith, Mountain Road]]
description: The air is filled with the overwhelming stench of sulfur, and sickly yellow smoke billows from a narrow crack in black stone floor.  Shallow pools of brackish water fill gentle dips and niches carved into the stone lining the roadway, their surfaces covered with a papyrus-thin layer of ice.

title: [[Trabe Plateau, Yurt]]
description: Thick furs line the walls and almost the entire floor, except for where a blazing fire pit in the center of the yurt mingles the musky animal odors with its smoke.  A wide circular hole sits in the roof above the fire, allowing a billowing column to escape.

title: [[Trabe Plateau, Steps of Arishalan]]
description: Steps have been roughly hewn into the southern wall of the plateau, following a switchback route a third of the way down its face.  The steps descend through the poorly lit night, ending at a small ledge on which a few long tufts of grass grow.

title: [[Riverhaven, Cleric Shop]]
description: Although only a small window exists in this shop, it does not suffer from a lack of lighting.  Just about everywhere a lit candle could safely sit, you see one.  Thick fabrics line the walls behind the shelves of goods, quieting the room and protecting the ears from the sounds outside.  Behind a small simple table sits the owner, Friar Othorp.

title: [[Cleric Shop, Storage Room and Supplies]]
description: A small opening in the thick fabric leads out to the main room of the cleric shop.  Tucked neatly on shelves are boxes filled with various clerical supplies.  Tables are layered with wares for sale, imported by Friar Othorp from the finest merchants around.  A robed attendant tends to the merchandise, stocking the tables as needed.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Heart]]
description: The center of the cavern is dominated by a large pool filled with inky black water.  Its surface is smooth like a single pane of glass, and not a ripple disturbs the serene shrine.  A cylindrical obsidian altar flanks the entrance to the pool, a sign of reverence to the holy waters within.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Belly]]
description: A jagged crevice has been rended open high up in the northern wall.  The climb looks treacherous, but several carved hand and foot holds make it less foreboding.  The stone is smooth and shines with a freshly-polished luster, so care must still be taken to keep from slipping.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Belly]]
description: A small niche yawns open in the eastern wall, its surface carved into the shape of a gaping jackal's maw.  Great attention to detail has been paid to the stone carving.  Despite its ancient appearance, it has been polished and taken care of with stringent devotion.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Belly]]
description: The grotto opens into a quaint, yet cold living space to the north.  The stone floor is smooth and polished, with not a speck of dust apparent to the naked eye.  It seems strange, given the state of the swamp, that this cavern would be so well looked after.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Belly]]
description: The smooth stone of the cavern floor curves gently upward to create the western wall.  A deep niche in the wall has been hollowed out and filled with fertile soil, creating a flourishing garden filled with various herbs and small plants.  Off to the north, a dimly-lit tunnel winds into the floor, curving down into the depths of the grotto.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Vulture's Gullet]]
description: This strange circular crawlspace offers little room to maneuver around.  The gullet yawns open into a larger cavern to the north, while carved steps in the stone floor to the west curve upward, further into the throat of this giant beast.  A rough black basalt slab is leaned up against the wall flanking the steps, covered in strange glyphs of a forgotten language.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Vulture's Gullet]]
description: The dark stone walls have been carved with strange ridges, evoking the image of vertebrae and other bones protruding into the vulture's gullet.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Vulture's Maw]]
description: Grotesque depictions of horrific beasts are etched over the dark stone walls like cobwebs, each unique and intricate in its own right.  The entrance to this dark grotto gapes open, carved by the hands of the ancients to pay homage to Aldauth's vulture.  Beyond the edge of the massive beak structure you perch upon, the rancid swamp stretches out below.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Scorpion's Tail]]
description: A massive stone tail arcs upward, towering over the wretched marsh.  The canopy of the swamp stretches out infinitely below, a withered green carpet that holds the foulness below its deathly shroud.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Scorpion's Tail]]
description: Smooth stone steps have been carved into the segmented tail, arcing upward into the sky.  One wrong move could prove devastating, sending you hurtling down through the blighted canopy into the waters below.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Scorpion's Stinger]]
description: The precarious steps come to an end at last, at the end of the scorpion's tail.  The swamp stretches out far below, the city of Riverhaven nestled beyond its wretched grasp far to the west.

title: [[Zaulfung, Urrem'tier's Spire]]
description: A long shadow falls beneath a giant, segmented obsidian tail that arcs out of the foliage behind the southern structure, curving upward to a tall spire far up in the sky.  The tail appears remarkably similar to a creature that is more insect in nature, rather than the mammalian jackal depicted in the rest of the ancient stone.

title: [[Kweld Gelvdael, Jackal's Spirit]]
description: A sense of serenity saturates the aquatic shrine, as if guarded by an otherworldly presence.  The glassy black water is so frigid that it numbs your flesh immediately upon first contact, beckoning you to lie back and drift down into the deathly grasp of the jackal's spirit.

title: [[The Shelter, Children's Wing]]
description: Stopped at the entrance to the wing by a wall of debris from the cave-in of the ceiling, there is no way to proceed further into this wing.  Even with careful listening, no cries or other sounds can be heard from within.  A stuffed animal with a pale, motionless arm wrapped around it is barely visible but out of reach deep within the rubble.

title: [[The Shelter, Recovery Room]]
description: Where once divided into separate alcoves by curtained walls, the whole area is now a single room, the curtains in tatters.  The beds lie upturned.  Several have their batting ripped out and another is stained with blood.  A colorful patchwork quilt, hanging from an overhead beam, strangely remains untouched amidst the rest of the damage.

title: [[The Shelter, Dayroom]]
description: Gloomy silence fills this place where patients would wait for healing from the empath Timothy.  Decorative blue glazed globes lay in shattered heaps, their contents of willows branches and daylilies trampled and wilted.  A potbelly stove lies prone with large rents in its sides as though something held inside had forceably escaped.  Several needlework hangings covering the rough wooden walls remain in place but are now marred by singeing, their designs obscured.

title: [[The Shelter, Consultation Area]]
description: A gaping hole in the ceiling, the result of a heavy, wooden beam falling, lets in a stream of dust which blankets the room.  A cushioned bench lies snapped in two after taking the brunt of the fallen ceiling rafter, while several others lay scattered about by the impact.  Glass cases, formerly attached to the wooden walls, rest in shattered heaps.

title: [[The Shelter, Supply Nook]]
description: This small storage closet seems to have survived the disaster better than the rest of the building.  Except for a few jars broken on the ground, the remaining jars of herbal remedies and boxes of bandages are still somewhat in order on narrow wooden shelves.  Lard candles and sprigs of dried coneflowers remain hanging from a peg rail.  Fresh globs of wax upon the floor prove someone was here recently and perhaps even took shelter in this room.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Low Rise]]
description: Dust clouds the air and casts ominous shadows against the distant horizon.  The ash-filled terrain continues, but nearby, a heavy wooden beam stands out in the otherwise monotonous, gray landscape.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Low Rise]]
description: Each footstep falls silently and sinks into the layers of dust and ash that have settled in this area.  On the western horizon, smoke-shrouded mountains, the twin volcanos called the Fists of Heaven, dominate the landscape.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Low Rise]]
description: The grade of the rise levels out, but walking does not get easier as your feet sink into the thick layer of volcanic dust.  Small whirlwinds dart about and trace sweeping arcs in the loose ash, giving the bleak landscape an eery artistic quality.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Low Rise]]
description: As you wander around, the loose ash crunches as it engulfs footprints, leaving almost no visible traces of your passing.  A dry, hot breeze picks up bits of ash and dances with them in small, dusty whirlwinds.  From this vantage point, other mounds can be seen on the other side of the smoky plume of the fumarole to the east.

title: [[Sicle Grove, West from Fumarole]]
description: Thick layers of ash paint the surrounding landscape in a palette of shades of gray.  Each footstep sends a cloud of dust into the air and obscures the already limited view of the lifeless terrain.  From the east, waves of intense heat radiate from the smoking vent as it belches forth black, noxious gases.  Towards the north and northeast, rectangular earthen mounds stand out on the otherwise featureless plain.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Atop Gateway]]
description: From atop this arched portal, a dry field of ash and smoke, where verdant lands once lay, is all that is visible.  Except for signs in the dusty ground that someone has climbed down the gateway recently, a search for traces of life yields nothing.  Nearby, a pillar of thick, ash-filled smoke from a fumarole climbs into the air.  Waves of intense heat radiate from the active vent.

title: [[Sicle Grove, North of Fumarole]]
description: A slight breeze from the south carries the black exhaust of the fumarole through this area, making the air hot and heavily tainted with sulphurous fumes.  This stifling mixture makes breathing difficult and all but eliminates visibility.  Ash from the vent's plume settles to the ground in deep layers and forces one to take careful steps to keep from falling in the loose material.

title: [[Sicle Grove, Northeast of Fumarole]]
description: While the air is warm by its proximity to the smoking fumarole, it is made warmer still by the the heat coming from a glowing fissure that cuts through the area.  The ground gives slightly as you explore, but is otherwise stable.  A low mound with a small shack standing on it lies towards the east.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Great Hall]]
description: Several sets of broad antlers adorn the surrounding black walnut walls that continue upward towards the hammer-beamed ceiling.  Cast-iron chandeliers dangle from heavy chains above, bathing the elongated central table in a soft golden hue.  A stately standard hangs overhead while padded wood benches rest upon the rich burgundy carpet, adding a decorative accent throughout the room.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Corridor]]
description: A wide runner covers the dusty floors of the long corridor in threadbare patterns of burgundy and gold.  A thin layer of ashen residue dusts portions of the sandstone walls, the dark hardwood trim and mounted sconces dangling long, wispy cobwebs.  Several drab tapestries line the hall, overlooking the armchairs and small table that are tucked against the rich, walnut wainscoting.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Magistrate's Office]]
description: A series of framed maps line the white sandstone walls that over look an elaborately carved desk, piled high with various documents.  To one side, a trio of tall bookcases store volumes of records while set within the opposing wall is a large marble fireplace.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Library of History]]
description: Towering shelves that line the enclosing walls store hundreds of colorful, various-sized volumes laden with dust, save for a what appears to be a few frequented areas.  Several tables and chairs line the central area, some of which bear stacks of books, while others reveal handprints and smudges found in the thin layer of ashen residue that covers them.  Dark beams traverse the room overhead, beneath the vaulted ceiling, each dangling an iron lantern that bathes the room in a soft light.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Grand Foyer]]
description: Polished white sandstone surrounds the expansive room, with side walls imbedded with a series of creamy marbled columns that form blind arcades.  Several suits of armor and a variety of weapons are displayed within the dark, arched recesses.  Along the far wall, a grand fieldstone fireplace towers to the rafters, its wide mantel supported by spiraling, stone pillars that flank the open fire pit.  A large chandelier hangs from a central beam, casting a muted glow over the chamber's matching walnut framed settees and artful decor.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Reception Hall]]
description: Restored to its original grandeur, the polished brick walls support the surrounding mahogany pillars that extend upward across the rib-vaulted ceiling.  A heavy, tasseled rug blankets the marble flooring, while displays of vibrant tapestries and crested shields decorate the room.  Majestic marble statues of robed wizards stand adjacent to the ornate stone archway that leads further into the tower, each holding a tall staff topped with a gaethzen orb that casts a soft glow over the entryway.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, West Corridor]]
description: Ornate candleholders are mounted between the framed portraits that line the white sandstone walls of long the corridor.  An elaborate, rosewood etegere rests against the deep, walnut wainscoting while several potted plants dot the opposing wall.  Protecting the polished wood floors is a wide, tasseled runner, woven in an intricate floral pattern.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Kitchen]]
description: Sandstone walls enclose the area, supporting the wide brick hearth set into the far wall and several nearby cabinets.  Several brass pots and utensils hang above a heavy wooden table, its surface cluttered with flour and herbs.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Pantry]]
description: The low-beamed ceiling of the small room dangles with clusters of various herbs and cured meats, the aromas melding into a mouth-watering essence that fills the area.  A collection of knives and utensils are mounted along the far wall above a marble-topped counter, designed for butchering and other preparations.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Basement]]
description: Aged brick walls surround the area, the mortar crumbled and deteriorated.  Heavily laden with dust, several cobwebs dangle languidly at various corners of the ceiling and from the gaethzen orb that hangs overhead.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Basement]]
description: Secured by a vast network of cobwebs, a patinaed chandelier dangles at an awkward angle from a rafter overhead.  While a number of cracked globes remain attached, most have fallen and shattered on the floor below.  A long wooden table stands on its end and leans against the wall, partially concealing a recess that currently serves as the home for a rather large rat's nest.  A musty scent hangs in the air and comes from a stack of rotting clothing at the table's base.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Basement Shrine]]
description: Unlike the other bedraggled and ruinous conditions within view, this corner of the basement is remarkably well kept.  A long, cloth-covered table sits centered along one wall beneath a tapestry depicting Kerenhappuch's shrew looming before a smaller representation of Meraud's wolf.  An open tome rests upon the table, though its pages are blank, and a plaque sits beside it.  Padded benches, also in remarkably good condition, form rows before the makeshift altar-like setup.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Basement]]
description: Dust from years of abandonment competes for dominance with layers of cobwebs that hang thickly from the walls.  Battered and water-damaged chests are stacked in one corner, while a trickle of water seeps down the opposite wall into a reeking pool of stagnant water contained within a dip in the earthen floor.  Rolled carpets rise up out of large barrels, their tops lost in the webs above.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Basement]]
description: Set within the crumbling brick walls that surround the area are dark recessed shelves, which hold dust-covered scrolls and various bottled potions.  Rows of ebonwood drawers cover two of the decayed facades, most with missing or broken hardware.  Casting a dusty haze over the room, a small lantern hangs overhead, revealing the ramp leading out of the area.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Alchemy Lab]]
description: What appears to have been an active workshop at one time now lies in chaotic disaster.  Dark ashen burns stain the surrounding walls, with sections of flocked wallpaper peeled away and dangling their singed edges.  Broken flasks and jars are scattered amid the ashes across the large rug that lies partially burnt away along the floor.  A scorched sofa rests against the far wall, near a collapsed table.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Cloak Room]]
description: Oak panels, almost blackened from age and the accumulated soot that drifted in from the Gathering Room next door, comprise this space's walls.  Knobby hooks are evenly spaced along a running board affixed to the wall high enough to allow a voluminous garment to avoid dragging the floor when hung.  An abandoned, moth-eaten cloak still hangs precariously from one peg.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Gathering Room]]
description: Once this room was where residents repaired to relax after feasting.  Now, dust now covers the sofas and an upturned chair leans crookedly against the wall beneath a faded tapestry.  Industrious mice have chewed holes in the once vibrantly colored carpet that still emits the faint scent of smoke.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Balcony]]
description: The doors to this balcony lie shattered against the balustrade, as if thrown open in haste.  Splinters cover the stone floor alongside a board covered with dark stains.  The muted sounds of Inner Hibarnhivar's daily life drift upward.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Passageway]]
description: Narrow and dark, this hall connects the ladies' drawing room with the gentleman's gathering spot.  A rumpled runner appears pulled up as if grasped desperately and then suddenly released.  The wall and floor at that spot has dark stains in a splash pattern.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Foyer]]
description: This rather small space served as a transition area from the feasting room to the gathering, more social areas of this floor within the tower.  Dust stalactites attached to the flocking now obliterate wallpaper that was once velvet etched in a whimsical design.  A long narrow bench runs along one wall.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Drawing Room]]
description: Settees and tea tables litter this room, once used by the ladies as the gentlemen repaired to the gathering room across the passageway.  Several paintings hang on the walls, some landscapes and some stuffy portraits.  A huge floral arrangement, now dried and flaking, droops from a vase atop a central round table covered in dust.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Balcony]]
description: Barely clinging to the smashed doorframe, tattered lace curtains flutter.  Below, neat rows of sand and rock separate a well-tended garden, oblivious to the destruction above.  The muted bubbling of the fountain lends an air of innocence to the destruction inside.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Aerial Garden]]
description: Supported by stone gargoyle corbels, the outer balcony is surrounded by a tall parapet bearing ornate quatrefoil piercings that overlook the surrounding community.  A plethora of potted trees and plants encompasses the area, creating the garden-like atmosphere.  A pair of stone benches rests beside a weathered marble statue of a graceful maiden, her cupped hands revealing a bright flame.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Bar Room]]
description: Dust covers the splinters of glass and pottery that cover the shelves and floor, making it difficult to see in the semi-gloom of this room.  The faint scent of spirits permeates the air, wafting upward from the many stains on the floor.  An overturned table once used to prepare orders now leans precariously against one wall.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Corridor]]
description: Blackened areas mar the sandstone walls of the long corridor, evidence of something gone horribly awry.  Charred debris and broken glass litter the ash-laden floors, the lingering footprints an obvious indication that others still roam the area.  A pile of splintered planks is pushed against one wall opposite the burnt remains of a large armchair.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Chamber of Divinity]]
description: Marbled gaethzen orbs mounted along the polished sandstone walls cast a muted glow over the surrounding thirteen arched, blind arcades, each set with an intricately carved statue depicting one of the Immortals.  Ornately carved benches surround a central, black amber altar that pays tribute to Meraud, its facade meticulously detailed with a aspectual scene.  Swept into a corner is a pile of charred debris, a witchclaw broom leaning nearby.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Corridor]]
description: Blackened streaks travel up the sandstone walls from the charred baseboards that run the length of the long corridor.  Doors that once secured the surrounding rooms now lie scorched and fragmented amid broken glass and a thick layer of soot.  A blistered painting hangs precariously from its place upon the wall, while a suit of ash-covered armor slumps nearby, no longer the gleaming image it once was.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Chamber of Moons]]
description: Richly grained wood of deep walnut supports the built-in bookcases that tower along the side walls, each set of the shelves framed in elaborately-carved flamewood trim and scrolling fretwork spandrels.  Beyond rows of wooden benches, an expansive mural at the far end of the hall displays a complex star chart which details the many constellations.  Ornate architecture overhead surrounds the recessed, domed ceiling which is painted a deep blue with tiny stars that emulate the night skies.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, Chamber of Elements]]
description: Massive potted trees with overflowing roots line the spacious chamber, creating a vast network of twisting, gnarled branches with their heavy foliage nearly overgrowing the bas-reliefs upon the surrounding walls and the ceiling overhead.  An elaborate central fountain supports an immense, brass fire bowl that burns with a scintillating flame.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, East Dormitory]]
description: Simple cots line both sides of the peach-colored room, each of the neatly-made beds covered with colorful quilts, with a small nightstand nearby.  Long curtains divide the areas, providing a modest amount of privacy for those taking up residence within the tower.  Next to a copperwood dry sink, an ornately carved cabinet stands against the far wall, providing storage for additional linens.

title: [[Akigwe Tower, West Dormitory]]
description: Simple cots line both sides of the pale blue room, each of the neatly-made beds covered with colorful quilts, with a wooden footlocker nearby.  Long curtains divide the areas, providing a modest amount of privacy for those taking up residence within the tower.  Next to a copperwood dry sink, an ornately carved cabinet stands against the far wall, providing storage for additional linens.

title: [[Dirge, Iron Mountain Weapons]]
description: This place is even shabbier and dirtier than the rest of the town.  Bits of broken armor and scraps of half-done weapons are scattered everywhere.  The owner, a disgraced dwarf exiled from his tribe, presides over the dim smoke-filled shop with a heavy hand.  Infamous for his lethally vicious weapons, Othien deals with a tight fist and few are known to walk out with a bargain.  Most customers seem to go out of their way to avoid glancing at each other as they sidle into the store.

title: [[Dirge, Ahnglor's General Store]]
description: A small store packed to the rafters with a little bit of everything.  Ahnglor, the proprietor, has a reputation as a packrat and you can easily see why.  Piles of clothing long out of fashion teeter next to odd bits and pieces of armor of half a dozen types.  A low wooden counter holds sacks and packs and a multitude of unguessable items.  There is barely enough space to conduct business.

title: [[Dirge, Gateway Road North]]
description: Leading away from the gate and into the center of town, this stretch of road passes between a shop and one side of the Town Hall.  The bleak stone walls reflect the sound of your footsteps making you feel as if you were being followed with every move you make.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Dirge, Garn the Grocer]]
description: This shabby little shop, tucked across from Town Hall, represents the only source of groceries and foodstuffs for the entire town.  A few bins hold dispirited greens that are wilting.  A few joints of unpleasant looking meat hang from the rafters.  A dirty counter offers a selection of moldy cheeses and less identifiable comestibles.  The proprietor, a fat and greasy looking Elf of uncertain ancestry, glowers at you as if you were more a disturbance than a source of profit.

title: [[Emmiline's Cottage, Sales Floor]]
description: Warmly toned, the large room invites browsing.  A rack stands in one corner, displaying fabrics in many hues, while in the center of the room, a large display holds an array of items.  Before one window sit a green striped sofa and chair, and a round table stands between them.  A maple and linen screen partially obscures an archway.  Two steps lead to an area hidden behind a curtain.

Warmly toned, the large room invites browsing.  A rack stands in one corner, displaying fabrics in many hues, while in the center of the room, a large display holds an array of items.  Before one window sit a green striped sofa and chair, and a round table stands between them.  A maple and linen screen partially obscures an archway.  Two steps lead to an area hidden behind a curtain.

Shelves of wares gleam from the warm glow of lanterns lit in corners and on surfaces.  The sales floor seems hushed in the night, though the clerks still busy themselves with cleaning the racks and displays, and with helping customers.  A curtain has been pulled, partially obscuring a set of steps, and a small lantern illuminates the archway that leads to the other sales area.

title: [[Emmiline's Cottage, Parlor]]
description: Sized and painted like a standard home's parlor, the room is bare of the typical seating arrangement one might expect.  In place of furniture, a large white basket is located near the window.  In one corner stands a book rack with assorted papers tucked into it and the mantle shelf above the fireplace holds additional items.

Sized and painted like a standard home's parlor, the room is bare of the typical seating arrangement one might expect.  In place of furniture, a large white basket is located near the window.  In one corner stands a book rack with assorted papers tucked into it and the mantle shelf above the fireplace holds additional items.

Quiet murmurs accompany the rustle of paper as clerks and customers alike rifle through the wares offered in the parlor.  A white marble fireplace, clean and unused, displays a number of items on its mantle while a book rack in the corner supports assorted papers and bindings.  Near the window, a white basket glistens in the minimal light available.

title: [[A Wagon]]
description: The dark cedar paneled walls commingle their essence with the scents of strong ink and old parchment that permeate this wagon.  Suspended just beneath the ceiling, locked iron-strapped cabinets hang far above the few thin cushions that are the room's only concession to comfort.

title: [[Barsabe's Grocery, Salesroom]]
description: Every shelf, every counter, every table, every square inch of this spacious shop is crammed with visions and fragrances of culinary delight.  Long ropes of spicy-sweet sausages, huge wheels of aromatic cheeses, and loaves of fresh bread create a tantalizing focal point in the center of the room.  Amid the hustle and bustle of a steady flow of customers, the diminutive (if slightly rotund) proprietor himself takes a moment to smile at you as he puts the finishing touches on some new, delicious creation.

title: [[Barsabe's Grocery, Kitchen]]
description: The clatter of pots, punctuated by the delighted laughter of the kitchen help as they go about their business greets you here.  Drying meats of all shapes and sizes swing merrily from the low-beamed ceiling, as if dancing on the warm breezes created by the regiment of cast iron stoves that ring the room.

title: [[Barsabe's Grocery, Deliveries]]
description: Walls, apparently formed of an endless supply of oaken barrels, tower impressively over your head, testament to the popularity of the town's favorite grocer.  As youths from the kitchen race out to request more of one item or another, the burly workmen grumble somewhat, but nearly stumble over themselves to help the prettier maidens who work at the bakery next door.

title: [[Cargil's Engraving, Showroom]]
description: Shields displaying examples of the fine work done by the proprietor line the walls of this neat, compact shop.  On a low marble counter sits a gold-embossed menu board, which enumerates the options offered.  Cargil, the engraver, sits atop a squat stool in front of a heavy curtain leading to his workroom.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Granite Block]]
description: This granite block provides a stable if somewhat slick perch in the middle of the inlet's flowing waters.  Several paces wide, it doesn't even slightly tilt nor tremble with the passage of rushing water.  The size and resilience indicates it may have been from a particularly massive structure.  An equally large granite rock lies in the calmer water to the east, although it looks extremely slippery and wet.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Slick Granite Rock]]
description: Though the inlet waters are not particularly rough here, foamy white splashes soak the surface of this large rock every few seconds.  Years of this action have worn the granite smooth, and slippery green slime maximizes its slickness, providing a possible but hazardous crossing to the eastern bank.  Perhaps once this rock was part of a larger structure, but the vanquished features are long since gone.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet]]
description: Though the water is quite deep and the current rather strong like a small pony, masses of aquatic vegetation manage to thrive.  For the most part, the long tendrils of algae-coated grasses cling to the sheltering sides of two massive blocks in the course of the inlet, but a few manage to survive just fine along the sticky sludge on the bottom.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet]]
description: Slowing somewhat as it approaches the shore, the inlet takes on a distinctive, lazy-river feel, though the undercurrent remains a continual risk.  The water is murky, churned mud along the bottom rising nearly to the surface.  What hungry things might lurk in this cloudy flow can only be guessed, but there are plenty of hiding spaces for who knows what.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Shallows]]
description: Clusters of brown cattails clog the water, leaving scant few spaces available for wading explorers to trudge.  The current beneath the surface is routed and rerouted, forced between the shoots of these water-dwelling reeds, but nonetheless black and thick with swirling mud.  Strong, deadly, and deep water lies further to the west, beckoning but cordoned off by rows of hardy plants.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Eastern Shore]]
description: Patches of elephant grass and clumps of dagger-like reeds part just enough to reveal easy access to the inlet shallows, though what may lurk in those dark waters could be worse than anything hiding in the vegetation.  Through this vacancy can be seen swifter waters to the north and in the middle of the inlet, but close to the shore it slogs along slowly, churning up mud and leeches.  The nearest ground is waterlogged, blurring the line between land and liquid.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Eastern Shore]]
description: Amidst the rough-barked trees, clusters of thin, wiry vines dangle from the upper limbs and wrap around the trunks.  Some tinged with red along the leaves, others merely rough and cordlike, the vines belie the increasingly feral nature of this shore.  Further south, the woodland becomes so choked with hearty plant life that only subtle signs indicate the presence of humanity.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Eastern Shore]]
description: Oak and willow trees spread their greenery overhead in a heavy umbrella of tangled branches and drooping limbs.  In this shade, the shoreline is covered with layers of hairy moss, thriving in the dank dirt and drinking in the occasional spray of mist.  Though this moss may provide a soft bed for tired beasts, the sharp reeds lining the inlet are a hazard for thirsty snouts.

title: [[Faldesu Inlet, Eastern Bank]]
description: Thick water oaks cluster a short distance from the shore, growing with abandon in this rich, moist soil.  Despite the packed reeds, grasses, and undergrowth, several criss-crossing paths divide and conjoin, generally heading southward.  Someone or something regularly beats the vegetation into submission while passing.

title: [[Bosque Deriel, A Path]]
description: A path is barely discernable over the golden-tipped mosses that cover the ground off to the east.  The golden-leafed trees thin here and intermix with small, newly-planted fruit trees.

title: [[Bosque Deriel, A Path]]
description: The path is lined with small Halfling-high fruit trees that are covered with both fruit and flowers.  The slightly sour smell of overly ripe fruit fills the night air.

title: [[Bosque Deriel, A Path]]
description: The path leads to a clearing and gardens off to the northeast.  The forest of trees protects the site, a wild tangle of growth just ever-so-slightly tamed.

title: [[Shrine, A Clearing]]
description: Low-mown sweet grass, chamomile and yarrow carpet this small clearing, centered around a stump of a once-great tree.  A nearby plank holds a smoothly polished ram's horn as well as fresh offerings of tarts and ale.

title: [[Shrine, A Vine-Covered Gazebo]]
description: A twisting vine twines about the roof and ceiling joists of this open-air shelter.  Heavy blossoms dangle from the vine, swaying gently in the perfume-scented breeze.  The wooden planks of the gazebo floor have worn smooth by footsteps, weather and years of polishing with beeswax and care.

title: [[Shrine, A Hidden Place]]
description: A cheerful-looking, rotund Halfling perches atop a low stool, gazing intently at you.  His face is illuminated by the dim light which filters through some cracks in the wooden ceiling.  Most of the room is in shadows, but there is just enough light to allow you to make out the earthen walls and floor, a potting counter, and some flower pots and tools pushed up against one corner of the room.

title: [[Shrine, A Rose Garden]]
description: The garden is a tumult of tangled blooms, all sweetly scented with rare colors and petal formations.  The thorns are very long and sharp, however, protecting the precious blossoms from ravage.

title: [[Shrine, Herb Garden]]
description: A cobblestone walkway surrounds a circular garden, a mass of useful plants divided down the middle with a winding pathway.  One section of the garden contains herbs used for medicinal and decorative purposes, the other side full of specimens for poison and known for their bitter properties.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Alcove]]
description: This tiny alcove is dominated by a rough-hewn granite statue of a proud wolverine standing guard over a simple cedar altar.  The floor is strewn with fresh evergreen boughs, their dense, verdant needles hushing the area and lending the air a sharp, crisp scent.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Spectator's Perch]]
description: Numerous lacquered cedar benches are arranged in tiers, affording a fine view of the arena below.  A mesh screen has been placed in front of the benches to protect the spectators, while scarred stone walls protect this spot from the elements.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Red Corner]]
description: Several blood splatters down the wall are framed on either side by a series of bloody hand prints.  Drag marks line the sand, and irregular dark droplets follow the trail back towards the triage area.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Blue Corner]]
description: Impaled in the wall is the massive blade of a sword, snapped off like the tooth of a large predator.  Several scorch marks line the wall leading to a massive mark still bearing the silhouette of the victim of an attack where his body protected the wall from damage.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Green Corner]]
description: An iron portcullis blocks a dark tunnel leading deep within the walls.  Howls and screeches drift across the sands from the doorway, mingling with the sounds of the spectators.  Swarms of gnats fly thick in the air like angry black clouds, occasionally darting to the walls to feast on the blood of the recently dead.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Yellow Corner]]
description: Niches carved in the chilled stone walls provide storage for those no longer with the living.  The arena attendants place the bodies in the niches out of way of further harm until they can be dragged out.  Tiny dried trickles of unidentifiable fluids trail down from recess, the only remnant of the departed.

title: [[Wyvern Arena, Centerfield]]
description: Light from evenly placed wall torches illuminates the the dirty white sand of the stadium floor, which is packed rather hard in places.  The cloying smells of blood and sweat mingle in the air, hanging thick and making the arena smell rather musty.  Clouds of sand roll across the arena like a low fog, added to frequently by the fierce battles.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[The Black Spire, Connecting Hallway]]
description: Only a single gaethzen sphere and the occasional seam among the great stone slabs decorate the otherwise featureless, dimly lit hallway.  At its sharp, perpendicular turn rests an ebony door.

title: [[The Black Spire, Cupola]]
description: The wide, domed ceiling of this area stands in stark contrast to the smaller, utilitarian halls extending outwards from it.  Four white pillars rise at the cardinal points in the cupola, topped by majestic black dragon statues.

title: [[The Black Spire, Prime Intercessor's Office]]
description: A wide ebony desk dominates one corner of this stark office.  Kept neat and tidy with no papers or documents, the presence of multiple writing implements and a well-worn chair still suggests its frequent use.  On the other side, a plain white training mat bears the impression of many footsteps.

title: [[The Black Spire, Planning Room]]
description: Functional and circular, a square table covered with maps and tomes is surrounded by dozens of chairs of different sizes.  Softly flickering gaethzen spheres dot the grey stone wall, shining a continual interplay of white light chasing darkened shadows.

title: [[The Black Spire, Connecting Hallway]]
description: Only a single gaethzen sphere and the occasional seam among the great stone slabs decorate the otherwise featureless, dimly lit hallway.  Additional light streams in through an open archway to the east.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Chambers]]
description: A long hallway dotted with dozens of small doors leading to small living chambers, each door has beside it a small nameplate in S'Kra Mur script.  No dust lurks in the area despite worn rugs giving evidence of heavy travel, its denizens obviously maintaining the area with utmost care.  A break in the western row of doors instead contains an archway leading out to a darker hallway.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Chambers]]
description: The smaller chambers to the south give way to larger domiciles in this end of the hallway, the doors spaced further apart and of high quality ebony.  The area is spotless, reflecting the orderly nature of its denizens.  The wall to the north is smooth grey stone, lacking any additional chambers or furnishings.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Chambers]]
description: A long hallway dotted with dozens of small doors leading to small living chambers, each door has beside it a small nameplate in S'Kra Mur script.  No dust lurks in the area despite worn rugs giving evidence of heavy travel, its denizens obviously maintaining the area with utmost care.  The wall to the south is smooth grey stone, lacking any additional chambers or furnishings, while a narrow passageway extends eastwards.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Chambers]]
description: A long hallway dotted with dozens of small doors leading to small living chambers, each door has beside it a small nameplate in S'Kra Mur script.  No dust lurks in the area despite worn rugs giving evidence of heavy travel, its denizens obviously maintaining the area with utmost care.  The wall to the south is smooth grey stone, lacking any additional chambers or furnishings, while a narrow passageway extends eastwards.

title: [[The Black Spire, Equipment Storage]]
description: Boxes of provisions are stacked in orderly rows interspersed between shelves of clothing and racks of weaponry.  The barest hints of dust hint at the futility of attempting to keep the area truly pristine as things are packed, unpacked, stowed, and retrieved, though no dust or mar rests upon any of the equipment itself.

title: [[Dwarven Stomp Studio]]
