description: This large rectangular chamber is bare of furniture.  Several rows are marked off by chalked lines drawn along the floor.  Carefully arranged against one wall are dozens of pairs of steel-toed boots from which a few people are making their selections.  Above the boots is a carefully lettered sign.

title: [[Justice Office, Chief Constable's Office]]
description: A large, blocky desk spans nearly the entire breadth of this room.  Behind it sits a white-bearded Dwarf, peering over the top of a pair of square-rimmed spectacles.  The walls are lined with several framed portraits of Dwarves in constable uniforms.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Bramble Snarl]]
description: Mikkhalbamar trees tower majestically overhead, the lowest branches twice the height of a Gor'Tog from the ground.  A thick growth of thorny brush not only blocks the view, but also makes navigation nearly impossible.  Bodies, in various states of decay, have been impaled on some of the thorns, whether in punishment or some macabre ritual, it is impossible to tell.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Broken Bridge]]
description: The smooth, grey stones of the bridge end abruptly in a blackened chaos of splintered rock.  Luckily, the foundations remain strong enough to support the remaining span of ten paces above the hubbub of rushing water.  The faint scent of sulfur still rises whenever the air stills.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Mushroom Grove]]
description: The bulk of the fungal infestation appears to have clustered upon and around a desolate sana'ati sapling in the center of the area, as if feasting on its essence.  A narrow, circular walkway provides arduous navigation about this eerie garden, while a foul stench emanates from the area to the northeast.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Fresh Diggings]]
description: This end of the cavern is dominated by the comparatively wholesome smell of freshly turned earth.  The beginnings of a new tunnel are evident to the west, though as yet it is nothing but a shallow dead end.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Living Area]]
description: The walls of this area are sturdy, undressed stone.  Braided root mats adorn the smooth, hard-packed dirt of the floor and twisted, root ropes hang like garlands from the generously high ceiling.  Pale leather pallets are arranged in groups along the walls.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Deep Cathedral]]
description: The walls, ceiling and floor of this cavern are elaborately carved with repeating patterns of shrikes, moths and eyes.  The north end of the hall is dominated by an unfinished humanoid statue, its crude limbs arranged with incongruous grace.  A low, half-finished altar rests below the stony figure.  Echoing through the hall is a low susurration formed from whispered snatches of Common and Gamgweth mingled into a bewildering, nigh-unintelligible tangle.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Gathering Hall]]
description: Several concentric circles of crude stones are arranged in the middle of this cavernous hall, the outer rings slightly larger than those within, giving the whole an appearance similar to a shallow amphitheater.  The height of the ceiling adds to the effect, shrouding the top of the hall in utter darkness reminiscent of a vast, starless sky.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Akul'tiz Tunnels, Treacherous Entry]]
description: The cloying smell of rot and mildew enfolds you like a clammy cloak, the moist air feeling strangely warm.  A jumble of dirt, rubble and scree makes passage nearly impossible and provides sharp obstacles for any who pass this way.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Feed Yard]]
description: Piles of succulent roots stacked like bales of hay occupy the northern end of this spot.  A massive, makeshift trough sits to the south with a crude ladder propped against each end.  In between, the floor is churned to mud, the reek of urine and feces indicating that the muck is not just earth and water.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Spawn Corral]]
description: Stones of many disparate shapes and sizes are stacked haphazardly, creating an improvised corral.  A pungent animal smell reminiscent of urine and sweaty, unwashed bodies assaults the senses, mingling unpleasantly with the pervasive, dank reek of mold and mildew.  Piles of dung fester within the corral.

title: [[Akul'tiz Gardens, Mushroom Grove]]
description: A multitude of massive mushrooms chokes the area, many of the fungi aglow with violescent traceries.  Their dim reflection of light does little to illuminate this spot, however, instead dazzling the eye and making navigation more difficult.  A circuitous narrow track that is nearly clogged with fungus provides passage to the west.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: The air here is strangely dry and chill, with a flat, stale odor.  The dark stone floor of the cavern is swept clear of rocks and debris, its uneven surface shining wetly.  High above, phosphorescent lichen casts forth a ruddy red-brown glow, arcing in rough spirals across a ceiling otherwise lost in darkness.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: A stalagmite bursts from the dark stone of the floor, its multi-pronged bulk clutching the chill air like a massive, mangled hand.  High above, phosphorescent lichen casts forth a ruddy red-brown glow, arcing in jagged spirals across a ceiling otherwise lost in darkness.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: The cavern ceiling grows oppressively low here -- barely high enough to accommodate a Gor'Tog.  Above, spiraling growths of phosphorescent lichen seem to pulse and undulate unwholesomely, the dim light lending a sullen sanguine hue to everything it touches.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: The cavern here is preternaturally still and silent, as if the stale air disdains to transmit sounds.  Crude, reddish-brown designs mar the sloping cavern wall, barely illuminated by the sullen red light of the arcing spirals of lichen high above.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: A trickle of dark liquid seeps down the face of the cavern wall, marking the stone with vivid crimson streaks.  Despite this moist ooze, the air here is dry and chill, with a flat, stale odor.  High above, phosphorescent lichen casts forth a ruddy red-brown glow, arcing in rough spirals across a ceiling otherwise lost in darkness.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: A massive force has wracked the ceiling, scraping great swathes from the phosphorescent lichen high above.  Bits of fallen fungus litter the dark stone of the cavern floor, their ruddy glow extinguished.  The air here is strangely dry and chill, with a peculiar odor reminiscent of heated metal.

title: [[Li Surmi Gelv, Abule rae Seord]]
description: This spot is free of the phosphorescent lichen infesting the rest of the cavern, the area directly overhead a pitch-black void that seems to stretch upward forever.  The lichen elsewhere in the cavern creates an ambient glow that is barely enough to navigate by, the slick, dark stone of the floor almost as lost to sight as the ceiling high above.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Urglub's Squishing Emporium, Showroom]]
description: Racks bristling with weapons line the log walls of this rustic shop.  As one would expect in a shop catering to Gor'Togs, everything in here is big -- the furnishings, the merchandise, and the owner.  Urglub, the muscular weaponsmith, stands behind a scarred counter made of thick oaken planks.

title: [[Gudthar's Tannery, Furrier]]
description: The pungent aromas of lamp oil, tannins and musky animal hides thicken the air in the longhouse, making it nearly unbreathable.  Bundles of pelts and skins awaiting the tanner's art pile in the corner.  On the rear wall, boar tusk sconces illuminate a large plank sign.

title: [[Gudthar's Repairs]]
description: A scarred wooden counter that doubles as a worktable runs between two of the longhouse support posts.  Pegs in the beams and posts hold a wide array of tools for working with leather and wood: chisels, mallets, hide cutters, and spools of sinew thread in various weights and colors.  Tacked beneath the large hide that dominates the rear wall is a small painting.

title: [[Gudthar's Tannery, Supplies]]
description: Serving as a heavy counter, a split tree trunk spans the room, cutting it in half.  Behind the counter and against the far wall several towers of rickety crates, stacked atop each other, serve as merchandise bins.  Strong scents of acid, glue and other substances best left unexplored war in your nostrils and stab at your brain.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Canyon Floor]]
description: To the northeast, thick reddish dust floats down from a crumbling cliff, covering everything from the muted vegetation to the sloping mass of rock debris on the canyon floor.  A small hole choked with the ochre dirt is barely visible in the ground, the abandoned den of some small animal.
Canyons twist and turn through the shadowy bluffs and peaks, creating a disorienting sense of deja vu.  To the northeast rises a steep crumbling cliff.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Deadfall]]
description: In years past, two mikkhalbamar trees fell, their branches enmeshed as if grabbing onto each other in an attempt to remain upright, creating this sheltered locale.  A sense of safety fills the area, as the larger and less nimble beasts of the woods are unable to penetrate the tangled deadfall.  Though not completely weatherproof, the still-living branches do give some protection from the sometimes violent storms that pass through the ravine.  A storm-split branch provides access to the trees above.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Mikkhalbamar Canopy]]
description: Massive branches, wide enough to accommodate two large Gor'Togs walking abreast with room to spare, make traversing the trees easy.  The only thing that helps indicate direction is the muted sound of the river to the north.  The roar of a waterfall can be heard to the northeast.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Rocky Shore]]
description: The roar of the nearby waterfall nearly drowns out all other sound as it comes crashing down.  Mist from the cascade gives the feel of perpetual rain as it drenches everything in the area.  A twisting path leads away from the shore to disappear in the thick growth of trees.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Waterfall]]
description: The roar of the nearby waterfall nearly drowns out all other sound as it comes crashing down.  Strong currents tug at those foolish enough to enter these waters, threatening to take the unwary with them as they rush back towards the pool and river beyond.  Mist from the cascade gives the feel of perpetual rain as it drenches everything in the area.  Nearby, a rocky shore can barely be seen through the mist.

title: [[Cragstone Vale, Mikkhalbamar Canopy]]
description: The multitude of branches twisting and turning in every direction possible has a dizzying effect on travelers not used to this forest.  To those traversing this route, getting lost is more of a concern than falling.  A large, turbulent pool caused by the nearby waterfall lies far below.  The constant mist makes the branches slippery and treacherous to navigate.

title: [[MAMAS Hibarnhvidar, Main Office]]
description: Several small work stations ring the large cavern of the Merchant Adventurers' Mapping, Assay, and Survey Company's primary office in Forfedhdar.  Tools and survey instruments lie stacked at the various stations, soon to be available for purchase by adventurers needing the latest in mining equipment.  At the end of the cavern, a lone clerk stands by a counter with a set of small scales used to weigh individual items and stones of valuable minerals.

title: [[Tower East, Air Floor]]
description: A dark grey carpet decorated with a pattern of crossing black lightning bolts covers the floor, matching the decoration on the grey-painted walls.  A constant, low thrum hangs just inside the range of hearing, its source nearby but not readily apparent.  Doors spaced in an even circle around the perimeter lead to initiates' private cells.

title: [[Western Gate Tier, Guard House]]
description: This customs post is the roughest and least desirable station in the entire Militia, and looking at the guards here, you have no doubt of it.  Recruits from the town's most formidable dungeons, a stint in the Militia their ticket to freedom.  Weary traders and travelers argue with them about tariffs, and a badly beaten thief and an unconscious black marketeer both dangle from iron manacles against the far wall.  You quickly turn and leave, hoping not to catch the eye of a surly guard.

title: [[Outer Hibarnhvidar, Fortuneteller's Tent]]
description: Beneath a colorful sign draped along the length of the tent's roof is a small round table covered in a loud paisley-patterned cloth.  A thick scent of incense permeates the air, and the room is dimly illuminated by a single lantern shielded with red glass.  Seated in the back is an elderly Gor'Tog woman wearing dangly earrings and a folded kerchief on her head.

title: [[Province of Ilithi, Citizenship Office]]
description: Marble flooring, dark wood paneling, silk drapery and leather chairs give the office a veneer of elegance.  A cut-crystal chandelier protruding from the center of the ceiling shimmers with dangling faceted drops.  Beneath it, there is an ornately carved desk which is home to the sole visible personal item: a handsome wooden frame.

title: [[Willow Walk, Up a Linden Tree]]
description: The entire northeast corner of the city can be seen from this vantage point high above the rooftops, lights twinkling through the darkness.  To the north is dimly visible the gleaming white block of the Paladin's Guild, tucked up against the city walls marking the edge of the forests to the northeast.  The pulsating glow of Gaethrend's Court lights the sky to the east, and the bustle of the Infirmary and the Empath's Guild lying to the south can be only dimly heard.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]]
description: Moonlight reflects off the five towers which dominate the city of Shard, providing a beacon for travelers in the night.  The rhythmic lapping of waves against the lake shore mixes with the squelching sound of boots struggling to free themselves from the mud of the trail with each footstep.  The trail stretches onward to the west, away from the main road which leads toward Shard.

To the east, sunlight glints off the surface of the lake which surrounds the city of Shard.  This near the shore, the narrow footpath is muddy, clinging tenaciously to the boots of those who travel it.  A squishing sound fills the air with each footstep along the path.  The path stretches out to the west, away from the main road leading to Shard.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]]
description: The trail is firm beneath the feet of the traveler as it winds its way through the farmlands which support the city of Shard.  The rich brown soil is perfect for growing grains and fruit, as well as other delicacies to tempt the jaded palate of the city dwellers.

The trail is firm beneath the feet of the traveler as it winds its way through the farmlands which support the city of Shard.  The rich brown soil is perfect for growing grains and fruit, as well as other delicacies to tempt the jaded palate of the city dwellers.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]]
description: Fields lie fallow and overgrown by weeds, the farms abandoned to time and the wind.  With each step, a small cloud of dust rises into the air to hang there for a moment before dispersing.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]]
description: Tangled scrub brush gives way to taller trees as the trail continues through a forest.  Gnarled branches clutch at the clothing of those who journey, traveling ever onward toward their final destination.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Path]]
description: The trail is rugged here as it climbs over the rocky terrain near Wyvern Mountain.  Dense brush surrounds the trail on all sides as travelers walk warily, lest a wrenched ankle turn the long journey into an agonizing one.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Clearing]]
description: Tangled brush surrounds this small clearing on all sides, save for a narrow trail which leads east.  Next to the trail lie the twisted remains of a once mighty oak tree, phosphorescent lichen glowing faintly from its blackened trunk.  A faint smell of charred woodsmoke hangs on the still air to tickle the senses.  Footprints criss-cross the clearing between the trail and a particularly rough patch of brush.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rocky Trail]]
description: Sparse vegetation dots the area here, leaving a precariously sloping path of gravel that winds its way through the valley.  In the distance, the calls of various creatures can be heard.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rolling Hills]]
description: The parched landscape gives way to a rolling piedmont of hills that rise slowly upward toward a distant cliff face.  Low brush and sparse vegetation grows along the trail.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rock Slide]]
description: Despite the forests and greenery in the distance, in this elevated area of the valley, the air is arid and dusty.  Rock and gravel, stirred by passersby and animals, rise into the air, clogging it and giving it a gritty taste.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rock Slide]]
description: Large, jagged boulders jut upward from the ground like misaligned teeth, creating a macabre illusion of a lower jawbone across the hillside.  Patches of lichen and moss have wedged themselves betwixt the stones.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rolling Hills]]
description: Growing in lushness, the underbrush here houses the occasional small creature that fills the air with sporadic sounds of movement.  Perhaps felled by a particularly strong storm, a large tree trunk lies adjacent to the path.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Barren Hillside]]
description: Cloistered near the cliff, a large dark hill rises in the distance, while the path towards the west slopes downward.  A small, stone well has been constructed here accompanied by the putrid smell of something long dead wafting from its depths.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Rolling Hills]]
description: Verdant abundance coats the hillside with a profusion of plants and small saplings.  Farther to the west, a sheer cliff wall rises upwards, marring the horizon with a dark, looming presence, as if something evil waited there.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Barren Hillside]]
description: Growing slippery, the once sturdy and grassy ground falls away to a consistently muddy surface in this area.  Looming against the horizon, the hulking mass of a dark cliff face rises upward.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Narrow Stream]]
description: Lush grass carpets the ground on the rocky slope.  Water seeps from the hillside, joining together into a small stream that flows to the west.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Narrow Stream]]
description: The small stream cascades down the slope, channeling a valley to the west.  Despite the nearby water, the surrounding brush is sparsely distributed across the hillside.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Ravine]]
description: The banks of the stream continue to grow steeper and rockier.  Though the flow of water is still a mere trickle, over time this stream has made an impressive mark on the landscape.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Fetid Pool]]
description: As the stream takes a turn southward, the source of the stench becomes apparent.  The flow of water is blocked here by massive amounts of rotting refuse, causing the water to pool.  Bones, flesh, and rotting plants mingle with things less identifiable but more vile in a noxious soup.  To the north, a sheer cliff face rises upward.

title: [[Aberro Valley, Narrow Stream]]
description: A deadfall dams part of the stream's path as it flows down the valley, creating a small pond.  Next to the pool, the remains of a campfire suggest that some traveler once used this space as a shelter.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, Den]]
description: Plush velvet armchairs and pillow-laden sofas dot the meticulously appointed room.  A mahogany cart occupies a corner beneath a leaded glass window, its polished surface bearing refreshments.  Elaborately wrought sconces of hammered iron hold white beeswax candles that light the room with their glow.  Along the perimeter of the lush silk rug set in the center of the obsidian-tiled room are dark grey basalt pedestals bearing alabaster busts.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, Master's Den]]
description: Sumptuous curtains of heavy Musparan silk drape from the walls, obscuring them in the hues of eventide.  Crushed velvet divans, dyed a deep plum hue, boast cloth-of-gold pillows.  Underfoot, the granite floors glitter with flecks of precious metals.  A low goldbark table sits in the center of the room.

title: [[Langenfirth, Kamze's Repairs]]
description: Several windows in the cabin's walls allow the breeze to enter and fill the room with the scent of the forest.  Kamze stands behind a tall wooden counter littered with leather armor in various stages of repair.  An ebonwood longbow hangs on the wall beside a sign made from a tanned Inkhorne pelt.

title: [[Ranger's Guild, Practice Yard]]
description: Utter darkness under the trees prevents identification of the source of sounds in the underbrush by sight.  The occasional whisper of a branch brushing against something could be anything from the passing of a large animal, a person or simply a stray breeze.

title: [[The Rangers' Guild, Practice Yard]]
description: Utter darkness under the trees prevents identification of the source of sounds in the underbrush by sight.  The occasional whisper of a branch brushing against something could be anything from the passing of a large animal, a person or simply a stray breeze.

title: [[Calliana Leather Goods, Salesroom]]
description: The smell of freshly tanned leather is overwhelming.  Leather clothing, footwear and armors of many designs hang about the walls.  Calliana is young for an elf but spent many years as a Ranger until the loss of one eye forced her to retire to safer pastimes.  Her leatherworking skill is unsurpassed whether it is a new item or just the patching of an old piece.

title: [[Bowyer Shop, Showroom]]
description: The Bowyer, Jarrod, can supply the eager hunter with just about any finely crafted ranged weapon desired.  On display along the walls of the shop are fine bows and well-balanced arrows.  Jarrod is a wiry elf who has lived most his life in the northern hills.  His skill at his craft tends to make his items more expensive, but he is willing to dicker and loves a fair trade, as can be seen by the satisfied customers leaving happily with a purchase, and return buyers eagerly lining up to make a new selection.

title: [[Shalan's Peltry, Showroom]]
description: From the most casual of sportsman to the life-long hunt enthusiast, Shalan's Peltry offers a cozy, friendly place at which to conduct business after the hunt is over.  A jovial, well-respected native of Langenfirth, Mato Shalan is known for his fair appraisals and honest opinions.  Business is conducted informally around a circular table that dominates the center of the room.  A smaller table with several comfortable chairs provides a nice environment for casual discussion.

title: [[Shalan's Peltry, Tannery]]
description: Crates of tanning supplies are stacked in tall columns against the walls of this small back room.  A sharp, acrid smell can be detected despite the overlying sweetness of the scented candles burning about the room.  Among the crates stands a small oak table strewn with various tools and bits of leather.  A sturdy wooden plank serves as a counter for those wishing to make purchases.

title: [[Small Cabin, Room]]
description: The warm glow of the lantern fills the room with a soft yellow light.  The lantern sits on a small wooden table in the center of the tidy cabin.  On one wall is a narrow bunk with a thin mattress, covered with a thin gray blanket.  A small wooden door leads out to the street.

title: [[Smithy, Front Yard]]
description: A large oak tree looms tall here in the yard of one of the town's smithies, providing shade for a small work area built into one corner.  A simple brick forge is built up against the low-lying stone wall, and nearby stands a sturdy anvil and a heavy oak worktable.

title: [[Smithy, Storage Shed]]
description: This long, narrow building appears to be a storage area for the Blacksmith's tools and finished projects.  Wide metal shelves running along two opposite walls of the shed frame a narrow aisle down the center of the room.  Several larger implements have been hung from hooks nailed to the rafters above.  To the south lies a door.

title: [[Therenborough, Gizgo's Engraving]]
description: A short pine counter divides Gizgo's work area from the rest of his shop. Bleached animal hides, upon which are drawn carefully crafted engraving patterns, are nailed along the back wall of the shop.  Near the front is a menu board listing all the patterns that Gizgo currently offers to potential customers.

title: [[Bank of Therenborough, Lobby]]
description: The lobby seems dead compared to the constant crowd of the day.  A chandelier hanging from the center of the vaulted ceiling provides a great deal of light.  Shadows dancing with the flicker of the flame seem to make the few customers nervous, all glancing around and holding their coin purses tightly.  The daytime guard has been replaced by a pair of guards who look more nervous than any of the customers.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, out.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Bank Teller]]
description: Clerks bustle about the tiny room, carrying bags of coins to and from the vault under the eye of a guard.  Visible through a small window, a teller stands behind a counter at one side of the room.  At the other end, the vault door stands open for those who must transact business via the moongates to other banks in the realms.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Foreign Exchange]]
description: The Communal Center prides itself on the special services it provides.  For the convenience of guests, the Center employs mages who, under the careful scrutiny of the guards, maintain moongates between the various banks, running the length and breadth of realms.  These gates allow customers to effortlessly transfer money from other banks, as well as to efficiently exchange currencies, saving their customers time as well as protecting their purses from the hazards of the road.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gemsmith's Alcove]]
description: Gently glowing pillars stand to either side of the shallow alcove, their steady light illuminating the counter where the young gemsmith, Jasmine ap'Wyrr, does business.  Her nimble fingers and sharp eye expertly evaluate each gem offered her, while her ready smile and soft voice soften the disappointment when she refuses to purchase an item.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: A kitten purrs contentedly as she drowses atop a small table at the end of the hallway, sleeping off a meal of scraps filched from guests.  One of several which inhabit the center, her usual mischievious demeanor is subdued now by slumber.  To the east, an airy white hallway runs the length of the building, while dark oak stairs lead down to the first floor.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Practice Room]]
description: White walls are unadorned, providing little to no distractions for students who wish to practice their craft.  The sole furnishings of this spartan room are a worn table and a few wooden chairs, suitable for scholarly pursuits.  Yet despite the stark nature of the room, a window looks out onto the land around the center, and the young people playing outside.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: A light breeze flows from the windows of a room to the south, gently turning a small pink and white mobile which hangs from the ceiling.  Made of twigs and seashells gathered from the nearby beach, it clicks softly as it moves, a charming memento of some child's visit to the center.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gathering Room]]
description: Flames crackle in the hearth of a stone fireplace.  They glow with a flickering light, casting shadows which dance about the dimly lit room.  The wooden shutters which cover the windows allow air to circulate, but block the light of both sun and moon.  Leather chairs surround the fireplace, with a low tray in easy reach holding a tempting array of snacks.  At the far end of the room stands an odd half-round table surrounded by five wooden stools.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: The white stucco walls of the Communal Center are cheerful and bright, reflecting light from sun and candle alike.  A heavy oak door, carved with images of dolphins and merfolk playing in the waves, leads north.  To the east and west, the hallway spans the length of the building.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Library]]
description: Comfortable chairs with overstuffed cushions are scattered about the room, pleasant places to relax with a book from the oaken shelf.  On the western end of the room, a cozy nook provides a private place for friends to talk without bothering those who are trying to read.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: Strains of music fill the air, echoing about the hallway.  The music room to the south has long been used by bards and others who seek to improve their skills, the pleasant room carefully designed to enhance the performance of artists.  In a shallow niche, a candle burns beneath a driftwood sculpture of wrens perched upon a gnarled branch.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: The hallway continues past a large room to the north.  Like most rooms along the hallway, there is no door barring the entrance, allowing air to circulate between the rooms in the hot summer months, and heat to spread evenly in winter.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Lounge]]
description: Off in a corner, palm trees silently wave in the draft from a nearby window, their leafy green fronds moving gracefully about.  In front of them, carefully placed to catch that same breeze, are some wicker chairs, a low table, and a pile of cushions, such as children use to sprawl upon the floor.  With snacks upon a low table, and the company of friends, this is a charming room in which to relax.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Bar]]
description: As in other places of the center, the white stucco walls contrast sharply with the dark oak used to build a small bar.  Atop the bar, a small but ever-changing assortment of drinks have been set out, allowing guests to help themselves.  Stools provide a place to sit, or people may take their drinks over to the lounge to the east.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: Roses fill a crystal vase atop a polished cherry table at the eastern end of the hallway.  To the north, a tattered sign hangs on a louvered door, while to the south is an open room filled with sunlight, plants and the scent of green and growing things.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Alchemists' Workshop]]
description: Shelves and counters line the walls, their surfaces scratched and marred, and the built-in stove is crusted with unidentifiable debris.  Broken bottles sit haphazardly upon the shelves, and a utilitarian unlonchai bucket has been fastened to the floor.  In a tiny skylight, a Wayerd pyramid has been installed for drying herbs and other supplies.  No attempt has been made to add decoration to the room, yet the workaday tools of the practicing alchemist have a certain charm.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Solarium]]
description: Windows surround the room on the east and south, flooding the solarium with sunshine during the day, and moonlight at night.  Taking advantage of this, the designers of the center have set out several small chaises upon which guests can lie back and relax while they bask in the light.  Against the north wall, a glass tank houses a brightly colored siren fish which lazily swims about.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Conservatory]]
description: Plants from all parts of the realm fill the room, from delicate palms to graceful lepradria orchids twining about the trunk of a fragrant lemon tree.  The spicy scent of a lily blends with the almost overwhelming sweetness of a freesia, the combination forming an altogether delightful aroma.  A glass door to the south leads to a small balcony.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Balcony]]
description: Palm fronds have been woven into an umbrella to shade a small table and chairs upon the balcony.  To the south, ships ply their trade on the river.  From a distance, the brightly-colored boats look more like children's toys than working vessels, as though a small boy had carefully set them adrift on a stream.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Lozraet bushes grow close to the building, their berries harvested daily to create delectable desserts for Estate Holders.  Vines bearing brilliant white blossoms climb the railings of an ornate set of spiraling ironwork stairs leading to and from a small balcony above.

Large bushes huddle close to the building as if afraid of the dark.  They block off much of the light from the windows, leaving very little to illuminate the stairs and the blossomed vines climbing their railings.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Lush green grass grows close to a simple fountain consisting of three ground-level pools.  Water arcs at varying heights between the basins, filling the area with the soothing sound of running water.  The air thrums with their nose-tickling spray, which adjusts with each change of the wind's direction.

Crickets and peepers serenade each other over the constant murmur of running water.  Faint floral aromas mingle with the misty spray from the fountains jetting between three pools artfully inlaid amongst the lush grass.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: The low drone of bees at work is constant, even when they are not visible.  Roses of crimson and pale pink cover a bower which arcs over a stone bench, their sweet scent tantalizing the noses of passers-by as much as it does the bees.

In the faint light coming from a window of the Community Center, roses droop sleepily atop a bower arcing over a stone bench.  Their faint odor floats on the air, mingled with the scent of dew on the grass and the nearby sea.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Ethereal tenra blossoms bob their heads gaily from side to side on their cushy bush abodes.  Their delicately sweet odor is offset by the saltiness of the ocean breezes carried in on the wings of gulls and other water fowl.  The birds' waning cries interrupt the mellow atmosphere in the gardens only occasionally.

Ethereal tenra blossoms quiver slightly within their cushy bush abodes, each petal glistening with collected condensation from the cool air.  The flowers' delicately sweet odor combines with the saltiness of the ocean breezes, both scents heightened by the serene night atmosphere.  Hooting from nocturnal owls hidden nearby interrupts the mellow atmosphere in the gardens only occasionally.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Shrill chirps of rage interspersed with the gentle songs of more satisfied birds emanate from a low-lying scrub willow tree.  Gathered around the trunk, a smattering of yellow Zoluren enshaen grows together as if congregating for a party.  Only the uniformity of their hues gives away the master gardener's plan.

Restful coos of contentment and the occasional fluttering sound of wings come from a nearby tree.  As the sea breeze blows through the branches, the leaves rustle continuously.  The smattering of enshaen near the trunk glows a deep goldenrod hue underfoot, the dim illumination from the Center's windows failing to highlight the vibrancy of the blossoms' true colors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Bima vines climb a broad arbor affixed to the Center's side wall.  The tendrils attempt a daring escape up the textured stone, but the careful hand of the gardeners keeps them in check.  A stone bench rests underneath, its surface carved with many a whimsical rendering.  Tiny violets poke their heads above the manicured grass and bob merrily in any passing breeze.
Diamonds of light from the windows of the nearby building dapple a broad arbor as it curves around a nearby bench.  The air is scented with a mixture of floral tones and the salty ocean breeze.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Gardens]]
description: Varying shades of green greet the eye.  Vines heavy with selmor roses twine themselves around the white wrought iron fence, the colorful blossoms adding their perfume to the fresh sea air.  A variegated stone path originates at the ornate gate and leads further into the confines of the lush gardens.

Though the evidence of lush foliage is present, mostly shadows greet the eye.  Vines heavy with roses twine themselves around the bordering fence, the blossoms adding their perfume to the fresh night air.  A path originates at the gate and drowns in the gardens' darkness.

title: [[The Strand, Dune Path]]
description: The hard-packed earth and stone of the hill beyond give way to fine, silvery sand.  Smooth driftwood boards run between dunes scantily covered in a hardy sea grass, and it appears most travelers know to stay on the path to protect the dunes from erosion.  Buzzing around the sparse foliage, tiny insects scavenge for daily treasure in the form of food and shade.

The texture of the ground underfoot shifts from more bulky and solid to yielding and soft.  Like blocks of solid shadow, several boards run between the dunes, and it appears most travelers know to stay on the path so as to not get lost in the darkness.  Faint buzzing from the sparse foliage reveals a clutch of tiny insects still full of activity despite the presence of night.

title: [[The Strand, Private Beach]]
description: Covered in shimmering, silvery sand, the beach extends from the cove and follows the Segoltha toward the docks in the distance.  The riverbank, ridged with rocks, holds in and protects the sand from erosion.  Smooth patches upon the ground allude to the spots where various blankets and towels have been placed throughout the day.

Though lacking its luster due to night's embrace, the pale sand coats the beach extending from the cove and down the riverbank.  The sound of the waves' gentle rocking glides in on every roundabout breeze, replacing the noise of people and excitement normally heard during the day.  Barefoot couples sometimes walk hand-in-hand across the sandy expanse for a pleasant stroll under the dark sky.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[The Strand, Picnic Area]]
description: The dunes level off here, creating an area that is slightly raised from the rest of the beach.  Sparse sea grass covers the sand around several picnic tables complete with matching benches.  Nearby, beachgoers often stop by the driftwood shack huddled on the edge of the communal gathering spot.  Enticing aromas emanate from the open-sided structure, indicating the strong likelihood of delicious snacks and thirst-quenching beverages inside.

title: [[The Strand, Beach Snack Shop]]
description: Although made from scrap driftwood, the interior frame of the meager shack appears to be extremely sturdy.  The hut is small, with only enough space for a counter and the cooking implements in the back corner.  Only daylight from outside fills the makeshift shop, leaving no need for any manmade illumination.

title: [[The Strand, Private Beach]]
description: Overlooking a small cove cut into the bank, the beach curves inland.  The sand is damp from the swells of the two rivers.  Visitors flock to the vacation spot, and adults are often seen teaching children to swim in the calm waters closest to shore.  Farther into the cove, swimmers that are more adventurous skim across the waves.  A tall wooden chair is settled in the sand as if to observe the goings on.

title: [[Dzirta Nars, Library]]
description: Wide floor planks of polished oak run the length of this room and beyond while the walls are rounded fresh-wood blonde logs chinked with mud and straw.  A large painting hangs above a small bookshelf on the far wall.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Music Room]]
description: Soft yellow paint covers the stucco walls, reflecting the light with a soft amber glow.  Actors and musicians perform atop a low stage at one end of the music room, while the audience watches from rows of pale blue sofas and chairs.  Open windows line the southern wall, providing a view of the Crystalline Beach.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Stage]]
description: Rich plum velvet curtains pulled back on each side of the small stage accent polished bare wood floors.  Small glass sconces line the stage and are lit at all times, keeping the dark at bay.

title: [[Music Room, Row]]
description: Pale yellow paint covers the stucco walls, reflecting the light with a soft amber glow.  Actors and musicians perform atop a low stage at one end of the music room, while the audience watches from the comfort of a pale blue sofa.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Herb Garden]]
description: An abundance of herbs gathered from across the realms grow around a meandering cobblestone path.  Splitting and rejoining numerous times, the fitted stones wend their way almost haphazardly through the greenery.  The result is an intriguing way to effectively divide the various herbs from one another.

Lifted into the sky by gentle zephyrs, the faint aroma of herbs peppers the air from the growth around a shadowy path.  Buzzing insects enliven the still night atmosphere along with glimmering lights from the neighboring building.

title: [[Strand Communal Center, Quiet Garden]]
description: Merely a square of verdant grass, the modest patch of land overlooks the rest of the property behind the Communal Center.  The natural green carpet has been landscaped with a professional checkerboard pattern and remains free of intrusive weeds and dandelions.  Concave stone seats embedded in pairs in the ground allow visitors to relax in close proximity to the earth.

Merely a square of silky grass, the modest patch of land overlooks the rest of the property behind the Communal Center.  The natural carpet resembles an unfurling layer of black velvet.  Concave stone seats embedded in pairs in the ground allow nighttime visitors to relax under the stars.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Red Showroom]]
description: Stacks of various-sized wooden crates surround the canvas-walled room, lit by a small lantern overhead.  People meander through the narrow path that works its way around several central displays, each of them pouring over the wares available for purchase.  A giant banner hanging from the tent's supports proclaims, "All sales final!  No refunds!  SHOP carefully!"

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Green Showroom]]
description: Stacks upon stacks of wooden crates line the area, some of them partially opened and spilling their sawdust packing along the floor.  Several people wander amid the various displays, pouring over the unique treasures.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Yellow Showroom]]
description: Decorative brass incense burners dangle at each corner of the room, creating a heady floral scent that wafts throughout the area.  A trio of marbled gaethzen orbs captured within ornate holders hangs overhead, each casting a yellowed hue over the wares below.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Blue Showroom]]
description: Swathes of rich blue silk drape from a central point overhead to each corner of the canvas-walled room.  An elongated brass lantern overhead casts a soft hue upon the many patrons browsing the various displays below.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Back Room]]
description: Lit by a small lantern overhead, stacks of shipping crates are piled high along various points of the canvas walls.  Amid the haphazard arrangement are a wide assortment of containers displaying select treasures for purchase.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Crafting Annex]]
description: Haphazard stacks of large wood crates surround a small area at the center of room.  Beneath the dim light of the lantern overhead, varying displays glint with a selection of unique treasures for purchase.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Back Corner]]
description: Much like the main expanse of the tent, surfaces here are neatly arranged.  The quality of wares here is higher, and a banner hanging from the back wall of the tent proclaims, "Items here are limited or otherwise special in some way.  Purchase before someone beats you to it!"

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage, Alcove]]
description: Additional surfaces are gathered throughout the area, each displaying higher quality wares.  A broad banner sways slowly overhead, the brightly painted words exclaiming, "Items here are limited or otherwise special in some way.  Purchase before someone beats you to it!"

title: [[Furs and Furnishings, Sales Room]]
description: The scrubbed pine walls and floor of D'ianrey Peral's tiny cabin are cluttered with animal skins and simple wooden furnishings, each item perfectly preserved and as rich in color as the day it was culled.  D'ianrey's tanned Elven features glow with quiet pride as she allows customers to browse amongst her inventory of rustic crafts, each bed and hammock and rug from her hand imbued with the spirit of the wilds which she embodies.

title: [[Hayseed and Hatchet]]
description: Piles of fragrant pine sticks and sweet-smelling hay lend a pleasant, woodsy fragrance to this tiny shop.  An underlying aroma of damp earth wafts around the room, drifting off a pile of crudely-shaped mud and straw bricks stacked against the back wall.  Xlaie, a stoop-shouldered Human woman of indeterminate age, leans casually against a splintered pine counter in the center of the room.

title: [[Hayseed and Hatchet, Door Stack]]
description: Stacks of doors lie haphazardly on top of each other, cluttering the narrow entrance to this ragged lean-to.  Leaning against the weathered plank walls, more doors threaten to topple like dominoes if disturbed by an inquisitive hand or a brief gust of breeze from the open back of the building.  Work benches and tools crowd the dirt floor, and a faint smell of damp wood fills the air.

title: [[Smells Like a Rat]]
description: Mangy pelts of all shapes, sizes and scents cover the floor, though exactly which animal is represented by what pile of fur is anyone's guess.  It's all the same to the shop owner, since his price never varies no matter what rag a foolhardy soul deigns to carry away.

title: [[Abotenik's Pawnshop, Frontroom]]
description: An amazing assortment of goods is strewn about the shop.  Items covered with dust as old as the glaciers, are tucked in every nook and cranny and nearly-new items from Riverhaven and Crossing shops fill one wall.  Used and outdated fishing and trapping gear are stacked in piles everywhere.  Bynari Abotenik, the eldest son, is spreading the piles to air out the more pungent odors.  He works his way back to the stone counter glancing at you occasionally to see if you have your wares ready.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Supply Stand]]
description: Trampled grass and a pair of lingering mud puddles mar the once lush lawn surrounding the amphitheater.  Pickaxes and shovels lean against tables full of supplies, behind which sits a surly-looking Dwarf.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Excavation Site]]
description: This section of the site has had the top layer of soil removed.  Several shallow trenches have been roped off to preserve the integrity of the dig.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Excavation Site]]
description: This section of the site has had the top layer of soil removed.  Several shallow trenches have been roped off to preserve the integrity of the dig.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Excavation Site]]
description: This section of the site has had the top layer of soil removed.  Several shallow trenches have been roped off to preserve the integrity of the dig.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Excavation Site]]
description: This section of the site has had the top layer of soil removed.  Several shallow trenches have been roped off to preserve the integrity of the dig.

title: [[Behind the Amphitheater, Center of the Dig]]
description: This section of the site has had the top layer of soil removed.  Several shallow trenches have been roped off to preserve the integrity of the dig.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Quiet Stream]]
description: The tinkling of the water past the stones in the stream creates a musical counterpoint to the soft rustling of the grasses.  A golden raspberry bush grows beside the water, its branches untrimmed as it stretches from side to side threatening the faint path that leads north.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Quiet Stream]]
description: A tangled golden raspberry bush makes its home here, almost completely blocking access to the stream that runs past to the west.  Poking through the stems of the wild plant are a few pale pink trilliums.  The grass is shorter here, threatening to tangled the ankles of anyone who passes through carelessly.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Orchard Edge]]
description: Blocked from getting a day's worth of sunlight by the stately row of Ilithic apple trees, the grass at the edge of the field grows low to the ground.  A path winds back southward, showing brown through the green and gold of the grass.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, In the Trees]]
description: A strange silence seems to rule for a moment under the branches of these ancient Ilithic apple trees, only to be broken by the high pitched call of one squirrel to another.  Untrimmed for uncountable years, the tree limbs have tangled together into what appears to be an impenetrable maze.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Behind the Branches]]
description: Tangled into what appears to be an impenetrable maze, the branches of the giant Ilithic apple trees seem to block the way west.  A layer of twigs and dead leaves are scattered upon the ground, save for where an animal of some sort must have been digging, leaving a small hole near the roots of one tree.

title: [[Almalne Alolan, Forest Violets]]
description: Towering in the distance to the west is a single massive Ilithic apple tree, just barely visible between the branches of its smaller brethren.  The ground is clear enough here to allow for small clusters of forest violets to poke their heads up, adding highlights of color to the drab orchard floor.

title: [[Ratha, Hidden Dock]]
description: Tucked behind one of the run-down warehouses, the dock seems to be mostly in disuse.  However, a few newer looking ropes and boxes stacked up at the end of the pier indicate that it's not entirely abandoned.  Sea waves lap against the wooden posts at the end of the dock in a constant back and forth.

title: [[Cavern in the Cliffs, Crescentic Corner]]
description: Echoes meander inward from the main room, bringing tones of voices and activity to the secluded alcove.  Set up as a modest office, the area features a desk, chair and cabinet all in matching ironwood.  The lack of additional furniture, however, indicates extraneous distractions from guests are likely not welcome unless invited.

title: [[Cavern in the Cliffs, Domed Hall]]
description: Shadows undulate across the low ceiling, as flames from the torches near the steps regulate the ebb and flow of light.  The round room's smooth walls and shallow alcoves give the impression that this makeshift shelter was merely the result of some natural imperfection in the solid mass of rock rather than something hollowed out by hand.  Though the decor is mostly spartan, the floor houses dozens of pillows strewn in no discernable order, while several throw rugs create a path toward a stone ramp.

title: [[Cavern in the Cliffs, Rest Area]]
description: Partitioned off from the hall by a translucent curtain, the space provides a smidge of privacy while still allowing the sights and sounds from outside to filter in.  The wall curves deeper into the rock, creating a small, dark recess where many worn pillows accumulate like giant mushrooms in the hollow of a log.  Exotic spiced smoke wafts from tiny burning cones of incense deposited inside small crevices carved into the rock.

title: [[Cavern in the Cliffs, Drop-off]]
description: The ramp slopes severely downward from the hall, ending in a constricted semicircle of a ledge.  An unstable wooden railing separates the tangible from the apparent nothingness past all visible surroundings.  Unfortunately, the light from the central sanctuary fails to penetrate the darkness beyond the edge, revealing none of its secrets, much to the displeasure of the inquisitive and the delight of the thrill-seeking.

title: [[Depths of the Cliffs, Vertical Expanse]]
description: Malformations in the steep side provide crude hand and footholds for ascending and descending.  As the rock face plunges further into the darkness, the temperature cools noticeably, yet the air remains stagnant from eons spent in the gargantuan cave.  The occasional clattering of falling rock breaks the monotony, both obliterating the silence and impressing upon travelers the inherent danger of scaling the wall.

title: [[Depths of the Cliffs, Platform]]
description: Somehow, a miracle of engineering allows a short wooden landing to extend outward horizontally from the stone goliath.  Lack of railing reinforces precise, calculated and deliberate movement, lest one should meet an untimely demise at the hands of the groping darkness.  The origins of a manmade rope bridge begin at the platform's edge opposite the rock face.

title: [[Depths of the Cliffs, Rope Bridge]]
description: The darkness along the walkway is almost welcoming, dulling the reality of the perilous journey across the groaning slats.  Creaks from the rope and wood shuttle around the cliff interior, colliding against the walls and ceiling in the far distance and returning as mere shadows of their original selves.  Traveling across the bridge with nothing but two lengths of rope to fence one in creates the sensation of walking blindly through the Void itself.

title: [[Depths of the Cliffs, Sandstone Column]]
description: The navigable area here is circular and slanted to a slight degree, with all sides exposed to the great abundance of empty space all around.  Two pikes fused into the ground on one side initiate an unstable-looking bridge comprised of little more than rope, wood and knots.  Thick notches extend down the side of the precipitous column, chiseled from the solid stone with substantial depth to aid climbing efforts.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Cliffs of Ruin]]
description: The harsh sound of the ocean waves breaking on bare rock echoes through the chasm, and the towering basalt makes strange geometric shapes that look ready to give way at any moment.  Huge basalt boulders are scattered here and there, indicating that a few chunks have already fallen.  A few stubborn scrubby bushes cling to either side of the cavern walls, their thin branches parched and bleached by the salty sea air.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Stone Dock]]
description: The roar of the ocean waves constantly fills the air, and the foamy saltwater coats everything with a tangible dampness.  Evenly spaced stone pillars offer a crude place to tie a boat, their metal hooks badly rusted from the salt-filled air.  Sheer cliffs made from thousands of basalt columns rise tall at the water's edge, their outlines shrouded by the darkness of the night.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Cliffs of Ruin]]
description: Towering basalt pillars interlock tightly with each other, forming huge cliffs that rise tall on either side of the narrow gap in columns of dark grey and black.  Broken bits of rubble line the bottom of the chasm, the scattered pieces forming geometrical patterns in the sharply angled ravine.  Nothing grows here, the desolated environment not even affording purchase for plants or insects.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Steep Approach]]
description: Enormous basalt columns hang toothlike at this incline, worn away at the bottom by erosion and leaving the bottoms of the geometrical pillars exposed and jagged.  Small clumps of moss and grass cling to the sides and underside of the basalt columns, somewhat sheltered here from the harsh wind and salty air.  The cracked path is quite steep, wending its way between the jagged cliffs.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Steep Approach]]
description: Darkness makes the wide hexagonal columns rather treacherous to traverse, the natural stairway offering little purchase or protection against a fall.  The dim silhouettes of pine trees crown the top of the basalt cliffs, standing silent sentinel over the crack between the pillars.  The night wind constantly blows through the chasm, howling its mournful dirge to the ruined island.

Wide hexagonal columns of basalt form a natural stairway, steeply inclining from the direction of the sea and following the crack in the basalt pillars.  Tall pine trees crown the top of the chasm's cliffs, most severely withered but still surviving in the harsh environment.  Wind constantly blows through the chasm, making strange sounds that sound unnatural and otherworldly.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Harrowed Chasm]]
description: Basalt columns bend and fold at odd angles, molded at a diagonal by some enormous geological pressure so that the top-most layer has become nearly horizontal.  Bits of rough crab grass grow here and there between the harsh grey stones, tiny oases in between the dry and lifeless desolation.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Harrowed Chasm]]
description: The chasm forms a dead end, surrounded on most sides by the rough tablerock basalt.  Rough wind blows through the chasm, whispering a thousand secrets in a language understood by none.  Huge holes in the basalt cliffs above are marred with dry rusty streaks, indicating the odd stream of water once managed to trickle through and wet the stone before draining away.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Salt Deposits]]
description: This portion of the island has sloped into a vague bowl-like shape, framed with spiked points to the east while huge basalt columns rise tall to the west.  Harsh white deposits of salt cover the area almost completely, contrasting the dark grey rocks with large rectangular crystals.  Jagged points rise here and there among the scattered stones, though the majority have broken free and cover the ground in a relatively even layer of rubble.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Salt Deposits]]
description: The island's huge basalt cliffs shelter the salt-crusted basin, trapping the sea's deposits in large crystal formation and trapping eddies of brown and red in among the pale grey stone.  Jagged rocks make passage here treacherous, jutting from the bedrock and worn into sharp shapes by the harsh wind from the east.  Loose, broken rubble lies underfoot, underscoring the desolation and hostility of the island.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Salt Deposits]]
description: A break in the jagged rocks offers a clear view of the ocean, though further passage is impossible due to a sheer cliff dropping a hundred feet down to the ocean waves washing through a thousand points of jutting rock.  Salty wind constantly whips in from the ocean, amplified by the shape of the strange rock formations.  Reef formations can be seen far in the distance out over the ocean, offering glimpses of a shipwreck trapped by the treacherous rocks.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Needle Passage]]
description: Runnels of salty water have formed shallow pools, fresh water mingling with the salt deposits and becoming trapped between the jagged rocks.  A few plants and beds of moss tenuously make their home in the patches of soil, speckling the ground here and there.  Several of the grey needle-like pillars have been forcefully toppled and shattered, forming a makeshift way through the treacherous terrain.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Needle Passage]]
description: A single huge, toppled pillar of basalt lies on its side in among shattered grey stone, providing safe passage through an otherwise treacherous terrain.  The ground underneath the pillar is thoroughly soaked, the occasional waves from the island's edge finding their way through and dampening the broken stones.  Dark red moss speckles the underside of the column, thriving on the salt-saturated water.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Needle Passage]]
description: The ocean meets the edge of the island here, dark pillars continuing out further into the water but gradually disappearing into the murky black waters.  Piled rock forms a safe walkway across the hazardous terrain, made from loose rubble.  The dim silhouette of a reef can be seen edging the island, barely visible pieces of wood marking a splintered shipwreck in the darkness.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Field of Rubble]]
description: Crumbled stones worn somewhat smooth lie in scattered piles, indicating the vague outlines of what used to be stone buildings.  A few are stripped bare down to their foundations, revealing shallow basements and storm cellars.  A small number of hardy trees edge the field, and the occasional bit of foliage pokes up through the grey stones.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Field of Rubble]]
description: A lone, roofless stone hut stands defiant against the continual assault of the inclement weather, sturdy and nearly intact despite its age.  Other ruins line the otherwise flat field, most of their stones blackened and reduced to their ruined foundations.  Scraggly trees poke through the edges of the field, though seems to grow here, only a few hardy plants continuing to valiantly make the attempt.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Field of Rubble]]
description: Ruined foundations surround what was once a town square, its paved cobblestone haphazardly shattered and broken.  A once-noble statue stands in the center of a fountain, completely missing its upper half and its historical plaque thoroughly defaced.  The fountain is long since dry and desiccated, though small marble benches next to it are largely intact.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Field of Rubble]]
description: Dead, skeletal trees jut here and there with their fingerlike branches intertwined in a nightmare embrace, indicating that the area was once a flourishing park.  However, all life has been violently scoured clean from the area, only a thick dusting of dark ash remaining of anything once living.  Small rocks cover the landscape almost completely, sown there with a determined maliciousness and preventing new life from taking root.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Entrance]]
description: The still of night blankets the quiet fishing village, and the fishy scent of smoke from burning oil lanterns drifts through the air.  Most of the wooden buildings stand completely dark and abandoned, although a few are lit from the interior with the muted sound of conversation coming from within.  Racks of half-preserved fish stand drying on hooks, the cloying odor mingling with the smell from the lanterns.

The muddy path into the town is seldom used, as if few ever leave this small fishing village.  Wooden buildings line the streets, haphazardly nailed together without much care or concern, and over half of them looking quite abandoned.  Racks of half-preserved fish stand drying on hooks, the cloying odor ever pervasive in the air.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Communion Circle]]
description: A dark hole in the ground serves as the town well, fed by a small stream that is one of the few places on the island to get fresh water.  The dirt road wends its way through the spaces between the wooden buildings, narrowing in an almost claustrophobic manner.  Every building seems dry and weather-worn, the old planks thoroughly cured by the salty wind.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Communion Circle]]
description: The dirt road abruptly ends at a long wooden dock, built out over the ocean in a sturdy manner uncharacteristic to the rest of the village.  Long fishing lines drag out into the sea from poles anchored to the dock, left mostly unattended and uncared for.  The vast ocean stretches out to the horizon, broken only by the occasional rock jutting from the island's reef.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Communion Circle]]
description: The dirt road stops at a long wooden dock, very well kept in comparison to the rest of the run-down town.  A small boat is tied to this end of it, though it looks cracked and worn with age, barely seaworthy and staying afloat.  Quiet pervades the mood of the village here, the loudest ambient sound coming from the lapping of the ocean waves underneath the dock.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Gem Shop]]
description: Made entirely from the flat grey stone that gives the island its name, this small hut appears much older and sturdier than the rest of the town.  A small glass window in the western wall looks out toward the sea, and a long stone counter takes up most of the northern half of the room.  Built into the back wall is a tiny safe, clearly inadequate for the task of storing precious gems.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Communion Circle]]
description: Open barrels half filled with dried and salted fish sit between the makeshift buildings, each one left incomplete and exposed to the dry salty air.  Huge stacks of shipping crates line both sides of the dirt road here, although some have been repurposed and broken down as building material.  An unguarded gap between huts leads directly to a small ledge over the ocean, serving as the village's dumping ground.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Repair]]
description: Standing in the center of this small wooden hut is a stone ironworking furnace, with a tapered chimney leading up through a hole in the roof.  Nearby a wooden table and stone counter lie ready, while several mostly repaired goods hang from pegs on the walls.  The tools spread out in the small shop are repurposed or crude, though together they are sufficient enough for the task.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, General Store]]
description: Several round makeshift tables are set out on the plain dirt floor of this modestly-sized building, selling both basic goods and slightly fancier items.  Hooks hanging from the walls display both simple and somewhat more elaborate clothing, both appearing imported.  Small windows let in light from outside, and a lantern of fish oil hanging from a rafter provides some extra illumination.

title: [[General Store, Back Room]]
description: Hard rations and a large number of fishing supplies are set up in this small room, bait filling up several barrels while fishing poles hang on hooks.  Lines are spread out on a long table made from wooden planks.  A wooden bench offers a place to sit, appearing to be often used by fishermen tying bait to their lines.  Tiny mice occasionally scurry among the bottom of the barrels, protected from persecution by the strong hand of ennui that blankets this town.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Communion Circle]]
description: Barely functional and long past their prime, several haphazard shanties crowd each side of the street.  Simple burlap clothes hang out to slowly dry on fishing lines strung between several of the shanties, clearly repurposed for the task.  The smell of cooking fish fills the air, wafting on the salty ocean breeze.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Carousel]]
description: The interior of this oddly round hut is cut neatly in half with a large wooden wall, dividing the Carousel's booths from the main entrance.  Gears, pulleys, and weights hang from the ceiling, forming the mechanism that drives the carousel.  An air of tension lingers in the air, as if no one in the building actually wants to be there.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Bank]]
description: Made mostly from squarish rocks spackled together and covered with a slanted wooden roof, the interior of this building is a bit larger than most of the others in the village.  Several iron boxes are set out on a wooden table along with several hand-written lists, indicating who has deposited or withdrawn what.  The building's interior exudes the faint smell of fish, coming from some unknown source.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Exchange]]
description: Tucked into this corner of the bank is the Exchange, consisting of three separate iron boxes laid out on a table for making change.  No light penetrates the roof of this windowless building, most of the illumiation coming from greasy oil lanterns hanging on the walls.  A small painting hangs on the eastern wall, depicting an enormous otherworldly monstrosity in the middle of devouring a ship.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Stairway of Bone]]
description: Natural basalt columns form the strange hexagonal staircase, which curves up steeply toward the lonely cliff at the northwestern end of the island.  Fastened to the outer edge of the stairway is a grim railing, crafted almost entirely from the bleached bones of creatures both large and small.  Small hollows in the basalt cliff hold skulls, each one mounted on a miniature pedestal carved into the rock to ensure its permanent residence.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Stairway of Bone]]
description: The basalt staircase closely follows the curve of the cliff, the bone railing made from femurs far too large to be from any of the mortal races.  Small skulls and teeth lie scattered along the side of the stairway, grinning with a macabre and fleshless intensity.  Ocean spray flies into the air from far below, tinging the air with salt.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Stairway of Bone]]
description: Darkness shrouds the space between the vertical cliff walls, the macabre fleshless faces of skeletons grinning out from the darkness.  Pitch blackness otherwise pervades either side of the basalt stairway, dead-ending at a massive wrought iron gate that stands slightly open and is lit with deep red burning torches.  Clearly visible in the torchlight is the stylized symbol of a slashed double hex enclosed with a circle, the crest of the lich Jeihrem.

Vertical cliff walls on either side are lined with whole skeletons, standing grimly at attention and staring forward with blind, fleshless grins.  The path on either side of the basalt stairway is somewhat narrow, dead-ending at a massive wrought iron gate that stands slightly open and shows a tall castle-like manor behind it.  Decorating the gate is a stylized symbol of a slashed double hex enclosed with a circle, the crest of the lich Jeihrem.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Entrance]]
description: Wrought iron fences close off meticulously kept lawns on either side of the walkway leading to the huge manor, keeping visitors confined to a narrow path.  Large buttresses on its ramparts hold macabre statues of otherworldly creatures, reveling in the celebration of the profane.  A coppery tinge clings to the salty air, lending a sickening aspect to the confinement that is abated only the the open sky above.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Blood]]
description: The grand hall of the manor spares no expense in opulence, with each wall elegantly covered with paneling depicting images born from harrowing dreams.  Dark grey marble shot through with veins of red makes up the floor, softened somewhat by a blood-red rug that runs the length of the hallway.  A muted crimson glow comes from in the ceiling above, illuminating the sinister art.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Flesh]]
description: Enormous leathern tapestries hang over the marble walls, reaching nearly to where the arched ceiling begins high overhead.  Each canvas is mostly blank, the paintings started but soon abandoned before much was completed.  An elaborate carpeted stairwell leads sharply downward, but is blocked by an impenetrable mass of seething darkness.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Flesh]]
description: Huge leathern tapestries hang on the walls of this arched-ceiling hallway, painted in vivid and unsparing detail.  Each one depicts a macabre scene, from a hoard of ravaging undead to a tall man tearing open a hole in reality itself.  Stairs leading upward are blocked off with a thick pane of glass marked with a crimson rune, denying passage to the upper parts of the manor.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Blood]]
description: Elaborate silver decorations on each wall depict a highly abstract form of artwork, forming vague patterns that play with the imagination.  The metallic decor is tinged a slight reddish color, stained with rusty markings from fluid that has dripped through holes in the ceiling.  A few of the dried droplets have reached the bare marble floor, which is streaked with veins of crimson that reach like branches through the expansive hall.

title: [[Jeihrem's Throne]]
description: Rising at the end of this long arched hallway is a dais, set with a throne made from pure obsidian and carved at sharp angles.  A huge circular window stained in murky tinges of purple and black rises behind the dais, allowing filtered daylight light to stream in from outside and shroud the throne in strange and eerie patterns.  Black iron-clad figures armed with halberds stand at attention on each side of the hall, silently guarding their master with the unmoving stillness that death brings.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Life]]
description: Dozens of silver channels set in the grey marble walls and floors are capped with strips of clear glass, revealing a black, foul-looking ichor that occasionally pulsates as if vaguely alive.  The viscous solution flows from somewhere above and appears to be slowly oozing toward the east, disappearing into unknown channels deeper in the floor and walls.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Hall of Life]]
description: Potted plants and small trays of soil line the marble floor in a neat and orderly fashion, all of them blossoming with flowers or vines.  Small intendations in the walls hold clinging vinses that support other plants between them, forming an artistic tapestry of living greenery.  Many of the specimens exhibit an unnatural and unhealthy amount of growth, extra vines and branches extending through holes in the ceiling to the unseen room above.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Chapel of Bone]]
description: Hundreds of bleached white skulls strung into intricate designs rise up from each corner in fleshless grins.  Strands of skulls follow the vaulted arches of this small chapel and culminate at an enormous bone chandelier hanging from the ceiling.  The arrangement is lit with twelve skulls topped with a burning candles, illuminating the rows of understated pews below.  Carefully aligned arm bones on the front of a dark altar form an enormous and nearly solid crest, the mawlike double hex of the necromancer Jeihrem.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Serene Garden]]
description: Pallid night blooming flowers seem to almost glow in juxtaposition with the darkened foliage, their ghostly shapes visible in the dim light.  Crystalline panes form the ceiling overhead, letting in dim light from the night sky.  Lush and low groudcover carpets the floor, while the muted smell of flowers comes from raised beds of smooth rock.

Entirely obscured by climbing vines, the walls here have become a living tapestry of clematis and honeysuckle.  Crystalline panes form the ceiling above, held fast within wrought iron frames.  Lush and low growing groundcover carpets the floor, leaving visible only a circular path of marble shot through with intersecting stony lines.  Raised beds carved from smooth, virid rock allow for a tiered series of plantings with exquisitely large blossoms overhanging their edges to form a cascade of color.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, West Laboratory]]
description: Brightly lit with mulitple gaethzen orbs set in each corner of the room, the laboratory is fully stocked with several metallic tables and counters.  Numerous tools are set out neatly and ready for use, while a glass cabinet is filled with powders, liquids, washcloths and other supplies.  A small stove rests against the northern wall, set up with glassware and ready to use for mixing chemicals.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, Secluded Library]]
description: Very little light enters the dusty library, the only source a dim lantern that sits on a narrow return desk.  Silhouettes of bookcases are visible in the darkness, each one lined with dark leather books.  It's quite apparent that the library is mostly neglected, although a few chairs and tables in the center of the room seem like they get at least some use.

title: [[Jeihrem's Manor, East Laboratory]]
description: Harshly lit with mulitple gaethzen orbs set in each corner of the room, the laboratory is fully stocked with several metallic tables and counters.  Numerous tools are set out neatly and ready for use, while a glass cabinet is filled with powders, liquids, washcloths and other supplies.  A small stove rests against the northern wall, set up with glassware and ready to use for mixing chemicals.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Cobblestone Way]]
description: Cobblestone made from flat pieces of hexagonal basalt lines the modest path, giving this part of town a slightly more upscale look than the dirt path of the main village.  Mostly bare trees line both sides of the path, vying for what sunlight they can get, and wide patches of crag grass dot the landscape.  A wooden post driven into the ground marks the crossroads, indicating the path as Cobblestone Way.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Cobblestone Way]]
description: A wide wooden fence made mostly from repurposed fishing barrels surrounds each small house.  Each home has its own small yard, although the cobblestone road still seems somewhat crowded in.  The foliage is somewhat thicker here, allowed to flourish from frequent and careful watering.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Cobblestone Way]]
description: The small cobblestone path abruptly ends at a strange statue carved from a single block of obsidian.  Dark and somewhat macabre, the figure is rather abstract, though its eyes are piercing and have a drawing, otherworldly quality toward them.  Small wicker baskets of dried fish line the base of the statue, apparently left there as offerings.

title: [[Jeihrem's Barrow, Furrier]]
description: The long stone walls and floor appear to all be carved from a single piece of flat grey rock, making the building quite sturdy and able to withstand the ravages of time.  Several round porthole windows look out onto both the village and the sea.  In the center of the room is a large stone counter, piled up high with furs and leathers of varying quality.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Salt Deposits]]
