description: Crusty layers of salt thoroughly coat the walls and floor of this partially sheltered side of the basin, save for a single chunk of raw obsidian lying on its side.  The black rock is a stark contrast, its surface worn almost mirror smooth by the last eddies of ocean wind.  Deposits of white crust the boulder's base, as if threatening to swallow this last holdout and make the landscape uniform.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: The sandy floor of the cavern falls away from the surrounding wall and the cool waters beckon you to follow.  Crystalline pool spar lining the bottom glistens through the water like a mythic treasure trove.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, northwest, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Diffused light washes the misty air a ghostly blue.  Gentle currents of air nudge aside the saline mist to expose pools of light that dance over the water and make small ripples gleam like polished platinum.  Darkness peeks from a narrow crevice in the limestone wall.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: The cool water is shallow enough at the base of the wall to gaze at your footprints in the silt-dusted floor.  Soft light penetrating the limpid pool reveals an enormous cavern to the southeast looming beneath its diaphanous surface.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Softly fluorescing algae barely illuminates the capacious room leached from the island's foundation.  Twisted dripstone pillars seem to support a great canopy of stalactites hanging overhead like a frozen forest of weeping willows.  A thick stalagmite climbs out of the water and terminates near a ledge capping the limestone wall that skirts the cavern interior.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: Patiently formed through eons of dripping water depositing layers of colorful minerals, flowstone blankets the walls with rainbow-hued folds and drapes.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: A rippling curtain of blue and green flowstone seems to dance along the edge of a granite mantle about ten hands overhead.  Shifting light reflected from the pool's surface casts pinks and yellows on the curtain, mixing new colors that fade and blend into others.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: The sulfur-laden limestone walls of the large grotto glow a pale green in the ghostly blue light of the cavern.  The light pools in the wet sand and gravel deposited in ripples along the stone floor.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: In static waves, a red-swirled flowstone formation rolls down the ledge and into the water more than eighty hands below.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Two massive columns of red-swirled dripstone rise from the water and meet overhead in a gently curving arch that soars above the ledge.  Heavy droplets of water carrying dissolved minerals and flecks of mica glitter gaily as they roll slowly down the graceful curves.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Gypsum crystals coating the rear of the cave sparkle like the first frost of winter and refract the light into millions of tiny rainbows that shower the wall with color.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Narrow Crevice]]
description: The slimy stone walls are close and the air is thick with the scent of briny seawater that fills the bottom of the crevice.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Narrow Crevice]]
description: The slimy stone walls are close and the air is thick with the heavy scent of the briny seawater below.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: The surreal seascape of rainbow-hued dripstone formations is enrobed in soft light and the melodic burbling of running water.  Near the center of the cavern, the waters swirl with small whirlpools that dance across the glassy surface like frolicking sprites.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: The smell of brine makes the air feel heavy and dank in this dim corner of the cavern.  The granite wall to the east is oddly free of crystal or dripstone growth, but a series of shallow impressions in the stone weave a route up to the ledge above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Like sharpened teeth dripping with spittle, stalactites pierce the shadows above and drip milky water into the water near the wall.  In places, stalagmites rise from the pool to meet them, making the cavern seem like the inside of some great creature's maw.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southwest, west, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Long tendrils of sea vines hang from the ledge high above the water.  The milky drip of mineral-laden water frosts their deep green leaves, making them glitter in the shifting light.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Shells speckling the cavern floor at the base of the wall paint the water with pinks and blues that swirl with colored minerals to form an amazing variety of hues.  Drafts of cool air descend from above and move through the area, pushing whorls of mist over the water's surface.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Shapes move in the darkness below, making themselves felt among the shadows by causing shifts in the water's steady current.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest, west, down.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Upstairs Hall]]
description: A painting of Magda Tarr, the wife of Captain Josiah Tarr, hangs above a narrow table at the southern end of the hallway.  A sour-faced Halfling woman, the painter has captured her expression perfectly, frozen in a perpetual glare at her husband's picture to the north.  Rumor has it that one of the incentives behind Captain Jack's many sea voyages was the lengthy time it gave him away from his wife.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Common Room]]
description: Waitresses carrying trays laden with food and drink make their way through the closely packed tables which fill the darkened common room.  The floor is sticky from spills, and the candles' illumination is fitful at best, yet none of that seems to affect the patrons' enjoyment.  A group of rowdies give catcalls and whistles of appreciation as a bard performs a slightly bawdy song in the corner.

title: [[Old Fields Road, Springhouse]]
description: A constant drip, drip, drip echoes through the dank confines of the old springhouse.  A moss-covered stone slab lies halfway off of a small clear pool.  The overflow from the pool trickles across the floor and over the sagging doorstep.  Deep in one of corners, a lone cricket chirps and is answered from another corner.  An abandoned bucket hangs forlornly on the damp walls.

title: [[Old Fields Road, A Deep Crack]]
description: Thin light filters into the darkness of the deep wound in the island's foundation.  The narrow space is made more crowded by thick growths of sea vines flourishing in the warm, moist air rising from the shadows far, far below.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: Long tendrils of green vines hang from an aperture high above the shell-speckled cavern floor.  The milky drip of mineral-laden water frosts their dark leaves, making them glisten with crystalline brilliance.

title: [[Arthelun Flats, Amidst the Boulders]]
description: Surrounded on all sides by a jumble of boulders, this nook is sheltered somewhat from the incessant ash fall.  A peculiar glyph has been carved along the edge of one of the massive rocks, though the inscription is weathered as if it was placed there long ago.

title: [[Fornsted, Pavilion Center]]
description: Weathered hides have been expertly stitched together and stretched between strong wooden poles to form the walls of the pavilion.  Various provisions and supplies are stowed here in wooden crates neatly arranged along the rear wall.  Workers dressed in finely cured leathers busily load and unload new shipments.

title: [[Forest Path, Ancient Oak]]
description: Surrounded by limbs, from those that are thin and sleek like a young lad to some scaly and gnarled like bent old men, the variety of branches begets the question of why trees are usually referred to as being feminine.  Neither the odor of the fens nor that of the forest floor reach high enough up to dispel the pure woody scent emanating from a woodpecker's latest work.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Darkened Corner]]
description: A wooden booth dominates this corner of the common room, its surface scarred by hundreds of brawls and warped by spilled ale.  A seedy Halfling sits at the booth, clutching a mug of some dark liquid in his hand.

title: [[Riverhaven, Ranger's Guild]]
description: Ferns, small trees and plants have been used to build a living wall around this area set aside just for Rangers and their guests.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Foyer]]
description: Vibrant silks drape the polished granite walls amid the many potted plants that decorate the broad foyer.  Marbled gaethzen orbs hang overhead, highlighting a pair of thickly-padded benches that surround a low table at the center of the room.  A busy clerk tends to the many artisans that visit the society from behind a sturdy counter with a small placard on it.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Supply Shop]]
description: A vast array of colorful baskets and earthenware surround the shop, their essences mingling into a variety of sweet, musky scents.  Brass oil lamps dangling overhead cast a soft glow over the wide counter below as several society workers tend to restocking and taking care of the needs of crafters.

title: [[Shore Walk, Beach]]
description: The Port Walk's fractured cobblestone paving gives way to a broad sand path strewn with broken shells, strands of seaweed, and driftwood drying in the breeze.  A small trail heads north toward the cliffs that hem the narrow band between true earth and salt sea.  The ocean's voice, ranging from soft whisper to beast's roar, sounds across the beach.

title: [[Ratha, Kor'adu Avenue]]
description: The darkened facade of a large building casts a shadow on the street below.  A wall of wooden crates blocks passage along the walkway, forcing pedestrians into the street and the path of trotting hoofbeats.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Tool Depot]]
description: Several decorative bamboo shelves line the polished granite walls of the small shop, each displaying a variety of alchemical tools.  Standing behind a broad counter, a young Elven lass greets the many crafters who stop to make their purchases.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Gathering Hall]]
description: Brass oil lamps overhead illuminate the surrounding polished granite, the walls spidered with clinging ivy that spills from planters cut into the dense stone near the ceiling.  Colorful woven mats decorate the floor amid the rattan chairs, providing a place where many of the crafters rest and share their ideas.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Office]]
description: Polished granite walls hung with clusters of dried herbs surround the small office, lit by a single brass lantern overhead.  A large desk and chair stand in one corner, overlooking a pair of perpendicular workbenches covered with various tools of the trade.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Hallway]]
description: Slender brass planters mounted near the ceiling overflow with a variety of ivy plants, a few of their long tendrils clinging to the brightly painted granite walls.  Framed specimens of pressed herbs dot the length of the corridor beneath ornately jeweled sconces, each displayed in an artful arrangement.  An alabaster statue stands in a nearby corner, the maiden's urn spilling over with rich purple shalyria blossoms that scent the long corridor.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Hallway]]
description: Slender brass planters mounted near the ceiling overflow with a variety of ivy plants, a few of their long tendrils clinging to the brightly painted granite walls.  A pair of ornately carved benches rest against the walls between the archways, their seats thinly padded and tossed with decorative pillows.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Workroom]]
description: Carved out of dense granite, the laboratory holds a set of alchemical equipment scattered at various points about the room.  The high ceilings are dotted with small holes that provide a way for deadly gasses to be released out of the area, while an archway out affords anyone in the room the chance to escape from a dangerous conflagration of chemicals.

title: [[Ratha Alchemy Society, Book Store]]
description: A small shelf advertising available alchemical books sits below a chart on alchemical techniques on one side of the small enclosure, while the other side an exhausted clerk notes work order completions on a board.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Meadow Park]]
description: Hidden from the traffic of the road and the trail, this spot is a favorite for just enjoying the sun and the quiet of the meadow.  A little brook works its way through grass and stone.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Meadow Park]]
description: Birdsong and sweets smells highlight the lovely trail into the urban meadow.  Amidst the turmoil and chaos of the city, this meadow affords the average citizen a chance to enjoy the beauty and peacefulness of the outdoors without the long journey to the outskirts of town.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Meadow Park]]
description: The trail winds haphazardly here, through the gentle dale and along a low driftwood fence.  Sounds of splashing and laughter echo from just beyond a gentle hummock to the west.  A large, draping Sana'ati tree blocks the path as if awaiting a visit from a much loved companion.

title: [[Odalva Reach, Meadow Park]]
description: In the shadow of the great Sana'ati, the meadow here is cool and fragrant.  The sounds of playful activity at the pond and the babbling of a little brook nearby infuse the area with an atmosphere of carefree innocence.

title: [[Meadow Park, Shallow Pond]]
description: Surrounded by tall grasses, and a sandy embankment, this pond is barely visible from the trail.  Opening out toward the west, the shallow watering hole is perfectly oval and tended to by a motherly weeping willow.  The pond is protected from the wind of the bluff, making a perfect reflection possible on a calm day.

title: [[Shallow Pond, In the Water]]
description: Quiet and reflective or wild and splashing, the pond serves many purposes for the inhabitants of the neighborhood.  Clear and surprisingly warm, the water is silky to the touch and about waist high for a human and surrounded by a sandy embankment.  At the eastern end of the pond is a clear, deep pool perfect for diving.

title: [[Sana'ati Tree, Low Hanging Branch]]
description: The large branch here is broad and flat, well worn by many hours of comfortable repose.  Enveloping the branch, a canopy of leaves forms the walls of a large room.  Overhead, a sturdy limb leads out toward equally intriguing cubby holes.

title: [[Sana'ati Tree, Upper Limb]]
description: Refreshing breezes blow through the upper limbs of the great tree.  A well worn crook tells of many happy hours sitting and enjoying the arboreal hideaway.  Just above, a frayed rope descends from some upper reach of the tree, disappearing through a gap in the foliage.

title: [[Sana'ati Tree, Bird's Nest Lookout]]
description: A panoramic view from this spot takes the breath away.  The meadow, lush and rolling appears as a soft blanket, the pond just beyond the tree shimmers with reflected light.  The most dramatic, however, is the view of the sparkling crystal ocean, as far as the eye can see.  Through the curtain of leaves and branches a deep pool sparkles an invitation, a giant rope swing can be seen just below, hanging from an outstretched branch.

title: [[Ratha, Eastern Promenade]]
description: The Oracle Veraclese's Cleric shop stands at this, the eastern end of Promenade Way.  More shops and guilds are found to the north on Three Fold Path along with an Inn which eagerly awaits the visit of folks in need of sustenance and sleep.  Journeying westward, the route borders the banking district and the Palace, and finally leads to the temple district.

title: [[Ratha, Theater Roof]]
description: The view from here is breathtaking.  Both the city below and the lifts that lead above can be seen.  Ships of all sorts fill the harbor, their masts pointing at the sky like a giant finger.  The streets look almost alive with the flickering of lights and the movement of Ratha's citizens.

title: [[Meadow Park, Babbling Brook]]
description: Gurgling happily past, the delightful little brook cuts a path through the rolling meadow.  A small stone bench at the eastern edge of the brook offers the weary a chance to sit and dip their feet in the whirling water.

title: [[Oak Tree]]
description: Rough bark covers the huge branches of this venerable old tree.  From up here you can see clear to Ratha in the south, and the misty upper curve of Slo'Tami Bay to the north.  A few bees buzz around, busily bumbling back and forth between the fields nearby and their hive just overhead.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: The children of a farmer have set up a little stand in the bend of the road.  Both farm folk and travellers gather here to have a cup of ale or a piece of bread and while away as much time as they can take from their labors, making this stretch of the track rather congested.

title: [[Meadow Park, Babbling Brook]]
description: Cool and refreshing, the water here runs clear.  Looking closely, small fish can be seen swimming along upstream toward the quiet pools of the pond beyond.

title: [[Reshalia, Boulder]]
description: The dark grey boulder is bare of any dirt or vegetation, and the sharp edges on the pits and pockmarks covering it discourage more movement than absolutely necessary.

title: [[Reshalia, Coastal Road]]
description: A good-sized bay cuts into the coast, and the road curves around the cliffs lining it.  Across the stretch of water to the south, a pale line cutting across the hillside marks its path as it heads toward the city gates of Ratha.

title: [[Ratha, Mastik Mews]]
description: As the throng of citizens heads north from the lifts, this delightful little road heads west over the ridge toward some of the most beautiful scenery Ratha has to offer.  Weeping bloodwood trees form a graceful arch over the roadway, while neat white pickets surround a cluster of tidy homes.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Light shines throughout the cavern from a crack in the ceiling.  It falls upon a tapestry of a young maiden walking next to a pure white unicorn, which hangs against the rocky walls.  Heaped high before the tapestry are sheaves of wheat and ripe fruit, while healing herbs fill wicker baskets on the floor.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Wooden shelves, cracking in the dampness from the cave, line the walls of the room.  Books have been piled on every available surface, from grimoires filled with cryptic spells, to a rather sappy epic penned by a young bard.  In the center of the room stands a statue of an aloof Elothean male, a black ironwood wolf at his side.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Knives and daggers are mounted on the walls of this cavern, surrounding a mural of an Elven man with ebon skin and long black hair flecked with strands of silver.  A night-black panther stalks by his side.  Beneath the mural is a small statue of a sleeping child, a peaceful smile on his marble lips.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Swords and armor lie piled haphazardly on racks in this room, surrounding a statue of a wild-haired warrior attended by several youths and maidens.  A feral smile lights the statue's face as it seems to gaze at those who pass through the cavern.  A stone boar snuffles at the feet of the warrior, the carved bristles and fangs sharply detailed.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: A mural on the wall is bordered by statues of a human and Halfling child.  The mural depicts a human man in the prime of life, full of health and vigor, watching over a green field in which children play.  Though an indulgent amusement lights his eyes, something about the set of his jaw indicates that his indulgence is tempered with steel.  An ox stands by his side, calmly chewing the grass of the field.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Veins of gold and precious gems glitter from the walls of the cave, reflecting what little light exists here.  In the center of the cave, a statue of a S'kra Mur male has been sculpted from the stalagmites which litter the floor of the cavern, scorning any foreign marble or granite.  A stone cobra rears up before him, hood spread wide and fangs bared in a sibilant hiss of wind.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Water splashes in an underground pool, reflecting dancing rays of light off the cavern's walls and ceilings.  Some acoustical trick makes the splashing of water sound like a chittering sea mammal, lending realism to an exquisitely carved grey marble dolphin which swims beside the statue of an Elothean maiden within the clear water of the pool.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: A tubby little man perches atop a worn wooden table in a fresco on the wall of the cave, a mug of ale in hand.  His eyes are filled with merriment as he surveys a band of dancing Halflings frolicking about the room, while older Halflings play on various instruments.  A ram reaches out from behind a keg to snarfle a tart from the piles of pastries, sandwiches and ale heaped high upon the table.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: A tabby cat lies purring before an open hearth in a charming painting of a young housewife resting in a rocker.  A half-finished tapestry of consummate craftsmanship is shown threaded on an upright loom beside her, while a spinning wheel, churn and various other domestic implements are neatly stored in her tiny cottage.  In the cavern, wooden tables are piled high with homely gifts of ale and butter, bolts of cloth and spools of thread, humble offerings to a gentle goddess.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Embroidered silk panels flutter from the ceiling with every passing breeze, each depicting a slender green-eyed Elven woman with glowing brown hair.  One shows her dancing, another depicts her playing a harp, while still another shows her apparently talking to a wren perched upon her outstretched finger.  Mischievous sprites and other creatures of Faerie flutter about her, faint images in the panels' backgrounds.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: A painted triptych hangs on the wall of the cavern.  The center panel depicts a golden-haired man wielding a gleaming greatsword, his only shield, an olive laurel.  Fine linen covers his eyes, yet lack of sight seems no impediment as he battles his unseen foe.  On his right is a painting of a group of kings, judges and wise men, while on his left hand, a tawny lion seems ready to step out of the panel and shake his shaggy mane.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: Light passes through cracks in the roof of the cavern to reflect silently off the piles of gems and jewelry which lie heaped before a finely-crafted statue of a Dwarven man.  Golden leprechauns scamper over the piles of treasure, the natural guardians of such a booty.  An onyx raven seems to watch the leprechaun's antics with an expression of detached amusement.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Dragon Shrine]]
description: Six carved columns of pale marble support an enormous vaulted ceiling.  Silvery sand covers the floor, while an enormous dragon, carved of smoky black quartz, lies in the center of the room.  The unknown artist who carved the creature depicted it asleep, curled about a jasper globe.  Next to it sits a white marble statue of a S'kra Mur woman of twisted body yet serene expression.  An open flame burns on an altar on a raised dais near the globe.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Raised Dais]]
description: The view atop the raised dais is impressive, gazing into the dragon's yawning maw.  The artist faceted each individual dragon scale on the smokey black quartz beast, causing them to glitter as they reflect the light.  Flames flicker above a white marble altar, though neither wick nor candle may be seen.  The overall impression is one of awe, and perhaps... fear.

title: [[Muspar'i Engineering Society, Corridor]]
description: Tiny glazed tiles mosaic the floor in a complex geometric design in vibrant hues of rich purple, offsetting the simple whitewashed sandstone walls along the length of the corridor.  Large tzgaa orbs dangle overhead from short chains, each highlighting the various entrances to the society's workshops.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Traders' Guild Outpost, Foyer]]
description: Metal bars cover the tall, narrow windows, allowing little light to filter through.  Candles chase away the shadows of the foyer, bringing warmth to the cold hall.

title: [[Traders' Guild Outpost, Gem Shop]]
description: Thick tapers hang in a wrought iron chandelier, shedding their light over the plush grey carpet and pale walls.  An assortment of tools lie on a velvet-topped lapidary's bench, padded to prevent damage to the precious gems.  Working with scales and loupe, the goldsmith examines each stone for flaws and determines its value before bagging it and storing it away in a strongbox.

title: [[Traders' Guild Outpost, Depository]]
description: Footsteps are muffled by the plush brown carpet and paneled walls of the depository.  No mere ostentation, the soft, dark surfaces allow clerks to easily spot any spilled coins, and keep them from rolling away.  Young traders work under the careful supervision of their masters, always alert for any possible pilfering.

title: [[Traders' Guild Outpost, Exchange]]
description: Neatly labeled coffers hold coins of various demonimations and currencies, all arranged on shelves lining the paneled walls.  As in the outer room, plush brown carpet cushions the floor, preventing any dropped coin from rolling away.  Apprentices labor beneath the watchful eyes of Master Traders, counting coins and making change for visitors to the booth.

title: [[Carleen's Emporium]]
description: Stuffed with knick-knacks and kitsch treasures, this little shop is the perfect place to stop for a travel break.  Wooden shelves hold a variety of items suitable for mementos or gifts, and the back wall is devoted to a counter holding refreshments.  A note with a platinum kronar encased inside its glass frame hangs on the wall behind the attendant.

title: [[Prison, Boathouse]]
description: The same kind of wood used for the planking of the dock was used in the construction of the walls and floor for the boathouse.  There is no wall opposite the door to the dock, and the floor opens into the water of the bay.  A large hoist with dangling rusty chains has been mounted onto the floor near the edge.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Boathouse]]
description: The corner of the boathouse has been extended and made into a cell complete with long, iron bars that go from ceiling to floor.  A sturdy door is the only entrance and exit to the open, yet secure, room and a small table and chair rest not far from it.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Dock]]
description: Thick, sturdy pylons, constructed from the wood of the local trees, have been driven into the churning waters of the bay and lined with planking to form the dock.  Attached to one side of the dock is a wooden structure, a sturdy door leading inside.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Dock]]
description: Weathered and beaten by years of exposure to the pounding surf, the wooden dock creaks and groans ominously.  The sheer cliffs of the narrow gorge loom on either side like grim sentinels, silently standing watch over the doomed souls that dare venture into their stony embrace.  The only egress from the dock is a series of iron rungs ascending the glistening gneiss cliff, unless someone is foolish enough to dare the shark-infested waters of the channel.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Receiving Platform]]
description: Perched precariously over the churning waters below, an expansive stone platform has been carved from the dark metamorphic stone of the gorge.  A huge derrick dominates the center of the platform, a rusted iron cage resting on the ground beside it.  A rickety wooden walkway hugs the cliff wall as it crosses to the boathouse, while a series of iron rungs set in the wall descend to the dock below.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Walkway]]
description: The relentless advance and retreat of the sea, amplified by the narrowness of the gorge, is clearly visible through the warped and weathered planks, creating the unsettling sensation that the walkway itself is swaying to and fro.  To the west lies the receiving platform, where a large hoist waits to raise cargo from the docks below.  A boathouse constructed of native stone skulks in the eternal shadows of the cliffs to the east, a reinforced door leading into the interior of the oppressive building.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, West Entry]]
description: Dim light flickers in from an iron grate in the ceiling above, a grim reminder that guards can watch, and unleash a rain of bolts, from the rooftop.  A reinforced door guards the way out to the west, while a portcullis to the east can be raised or lowered to hold new arrivals until it is time for them to be escorted to their final destinations.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Interior Passage]]
description: The cold stone walls of this hall offer little comfort to the doomed souls that make the journey from the west entrance to the east entrance -- from their old lives to their new.  Guards on the roof above watch the passage through a pair of iron grates, controlling the massive portcullis that can be lowered to seal the hall from the entrances.  A reinforced oak door and a pair of large ironwood doors are set into the south wall.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, East Entry]]
description: Dim light flickers in from an iron grate in the ceiling above, a grim reminder that guards can watch, and unleash a rain of bolts, from the rooftop above.  A reinforced door guards the way out to the east, while a portcullis to the west can be raised or lowered to hold new arrivals here until it is time for them to be escorted to their final destinations.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Landing]]
description: The sound of waves crashing against the cliffs below echoes through the confines of this narrow stone landing.  A towering wall of twisted gneiss looms to the north, while a tall stone wall prevents escape by diving into the sea to the south.  To the west lies the stone boathouse, a reinforced door the only visible means of entering the building.  A broad gate to the east guards the ascent to the compound far above.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Worn Road]]
description: The boathouse lurks in the shadows to the west, separated from the road to the compound by a stout gate.  The gate stands tall and proud, guarding the boathouse from wild animals.  A small worn trail begins at the gate and passes through a patch of jungle as it leads closer to the cliff.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Tangled Path]]
description: Clematis vines cling to the trunks of densely growing deciduous trees.  Water has collected in pools along the trail here, turning the air into a mass of flying bugs.  A crooked path, crowded on either side by the flora that grows so vibrantly, runs through a depression between two low rock outcrops.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Clearing]]
description: Opening suddenly, this small clearing forms around the fallen trunk of one of the jungle's former giants.  The decaying trunk lies in the center of the clearing, overgrown with moss and creeping vines.  Though the path is interrupted, it is easy to pick out where it begins again on the other side of the tree.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Clearing Path]]
description: A thick and tangled canopy overhead blocks most light, making passage slightly more hazardous than it otherwise might be.  Meandering through moss covered trunks, this faint path links two jungle clearings.  Jewel-colored dragonflies flit amongst the trees, lighting briefly on leaves and vines before resuming their colorful flights.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Clearing]]
description: A rock outcrop rises out of the jungle floor, its granite surface resisting all efforts of the foliage to gain purchase.  The trees grow close to the rocks, and their roots reach out, trying to try to find a solid grip in the cracks and crevices.  The croaking of a solitary frog echoes through the air.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Clearing]]
description: Thick brush encloses this large clearing.  Granite boulders crowd closely together in a heap, many of which have been partially split into blocks.  Amongst chips and slivers of detritus, discarded chisels and mallets litter the ground.  Off to one side, near the edge of the clearing, a small, fenced-in area holds worn markers that serve as the island's cemetery.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Prisoner Cell]]
description: Four walls of a rough marble make this room appear to be more of a tomb than a cell.  The floor is extremely slippery, coated in some vile brownish substance that sloshes around with any movement.  A bed of hay has been piled in a corner, but with the screaming that echoes in the darkness, a full night's sleep seems almost impossible.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Solitary Cell]]
description: Loud screams mingled with the scent of burned flesh assault the senses.  Darkness shrouds what little there is of this room.  Lengthy chains hang from the ceiling, much like a spider's web awaiting prey.  Strips of skin dangle from bloodstained hooks, which are affixed to the walls.  The rough-hewn walls form an indestructible barrier, leaving nothing but a barred and narrow hole as an only exit.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Kitchen]]
description: A rotten stench permeates the area, coming from the cauldron sitting on the stove.  The tables and counters display a deep layer of dust, showing their disuse.  Empty pots and pans litter the kitchen in an organized chaos, and knives and other assorted utensils to line the walls.  A mahogany door leads to the serving area while a black ironwood door opens into the eating area.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Serving Area]]
description: Pots rest on several low tables, covered with dust.  An oak door stands stoutly between this room and the eating area, while a mahogany door provides access to the kitchen.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Prisoner Cell]]
description: Carvings of names, dates, and slashes accompany the words of wisdom written on the otherwise clean walls.  A small basin lies overturned underneath a broken bamboo bed.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Solitary Cell]]
description: Every sound reverberates within the small room, echoing within the heavy stone walls.  Frayed rope dangles from an iron grating in the ceiling, its end forming a makeshift noose.  Upon the dirty wall are rows of etched lines, marking the days a prisoner was confined in this space.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Middle Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by gaping holes where doors once stood.  The heavy material muffles sounds coming from inside the cells so that only the sound of footsteps against the ground are audible.  Moist, dirt-caked stairs -- apparently the source of the ever-present earthy odor -- spiral upward.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Solitary Cell]]
description: Upon the walls are carvings of various people and creatures, the work of a prisoner's artistic ambition.  A small bowl lies discarded in the corner.  Stuffed sacks line along one side of the room, an attempt to create a softer bed for the resident within.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Prisoner Cell]]
description: Thick grime and dirt cover the cracked walls and floors of the cell, while the air is penetrated by the stench of rotting sewage.  The remains of a hay bed are scattered across the floor, mingling with the filth in the small, cramped quarters.  Barely audible sobbing echoes within the room, though its point of origin is undeterminable.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Upper Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by dark holes where doors used to be.  The heavy material muffles sounds coming from inside the cells so that only the sound of footsteps against the ground are audible.  A musty odor envelops the entire area, and seems the most concentrated near the stairs that spiral downward.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Upper Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by narrow gaps where doors used to be.  The heavy material muffles sounds coming from inside the cells so that only the sound of footsteps against the ground are audible.  A musty odor envelops the entire area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Upper Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by only by black openings.  The heavy material muffles sounds coming from inside the cells so that only the sound of footsteps against the ground are audible.  A musty odor envelops the entire area.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Middle Prisoner Cell Block]]
description: Black and grey stone forms the floor and walls of the prison hallway, punctuated by gaping openings that were once barred by doors.  Flickering shadows from torches filter upward from the stairs that lead below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Prison, Guard Room]]
description: A few simple bunks line the walls of this small room, a footlocker bolted to the ground at the base of each.  Battered and worn, a single table stands in the center, four scuffed chairs in disarray around it.  In the southeast corner, a ladder ascends to a hatch in the roof.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Prison, Rooftop]]
description: Low battlements surround the rooftop, providing a sound defense to the guards that watch over the boathouse.  From this lofty perch, sentries can cover the docks to the west as well as keep a close eye on the road to the east as it snakes its way up to the compound above.  A series of iron grates overlook the interior passage, winches on either end raising or lowering a portcullis as a secondary protection against escape.
image: Quest, Raven Prison, Quelling the Riot.gif

title: [[Latanaara's Musical Wonders]]
description: Foamy white curtaining adds a scant touch of decadence to a droll sandstone interior, the decorative cloth overflowing from a table placed carefully in the shop's center.  Upon the serene surface, numerous exotic instruments are offered up like gold and berries on an altar.

title: [[Dhralduum's Instruments]]
description: At almost all hours of the day, a haunting melody floats through the stifling air that is confined within the sandstone walls.  Dhralduum's apprentices are tasked with ensuring the continuation of the music, that his masterful pieces should be experienced in harmony by all would-be customers.

title: [[Ishamik's Instruments]]
description: This shop would likely pass as the city's version of somber surroundings, with the only remarkable additions to the drab sandstone setting being the black-painted door and an equally dark ebonwood table.  Like corpses laid out for their mourning viewers, the shop's instrumental goods rest morosely upon the dark table.

title: [[Laskaf's Alchemy Supplies]]
description: An orange door, somewhat reminiscent of the blowing sands, is flanked by two tables, each placed in an opposing corner.  A smaller stand, set against the far wall, contains stone pieces of all sizes, as well as the scattered tools of a stoneworker's trade.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: This ledge is just high enough to see over the hemlock forest below and beyond to the far side of the lake.  Gusts of wind sweep across the tops of the trees, appearing for all the world like a sea of silvery green waves shifting and swelling.  A thin ledge overhead is accessible by the protruding roots in the soil and cracks in the projecting rocks that may serve as handholds.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: This long thin ledge provides little room for movement.  A flat rock juts out overhead and another ledge appears within reach below -- either option seems safer than lingering here.  A scuttering sound scratches over the rocks as some unseen creature darts safely out of sight.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: A huge dark rock juts out from the cliff face and offers a comfortable resting point before continuing to climb.  A clump of burr-weeds grows from a crevice and thrashes against the hard surface of the rock with a raspy whisper as the wind whips across the cliff.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: At the juncture of the rock and the cliff, long cracks mar the vertical face.  Some of these cracks are almost wide enough to squeeze into, but the weather has created enough chinks to assist a climb up to another rocky perch above.  A constant "drip, drip" comes from somewhere within the cracks.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, A High Perch]]
description: Deep vertical cracks, like gashed wounds, continue up and down the cliff face.  This perch offers little protection from the wind and weather that can pound against the cliff wall.  Bits of rock crumble and fall with each movement -- at this height, the climb is not one for the inexperienced.  A rock shelf is visible even higher above.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: Barely a third of the way up the cliff, this shelf cut from the rock is wide enough to comfortably pause upon.  Scraggly bushes, leafless with wooly stems, cling to every crack deep enough to hold a spoonful of sandy soil.  A long horizontal crevice slices through the rock overhead, and appears to be deep enough to crawl inside.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: The crevice slants back deeply into the face of the cliff and cradles you safely within.  Towards the back, an arched tunnel bores through the rock to the west.  A few animal droppings and a tuft of fur caught on a burr-bush reveal other creatures have sought shelter here as well.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: The western side of the deep crevice ends abruptly.  Any misstep and it's a long, long fall.  A crumbling ledge above is the only way up -- otherwise, an arched tunnel leads back to the eastern side of the crevice and the alternative route down.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: Chunks of rock fall with every movement -- this ledge does not appear to be stable at all.  Small spider webs glint within the fracturing stone, creating the illusion of silver threads tying the dark, disintegrating chunks of rock together.  Above, a shallow crevice is an even darker stain upon the black rock.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: This shallow crevice offers minimal protection from the wind, and a view, with a hefty dose of vertigo, of the terrain below.  Within the crevice, dark red veins streak the black rock, and gusts of wind blow gritty sand in little swirls.  Above, you can see a round hole in the cliff face.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: This large hole is just one climb away from the top of the cliff.  However, very few cracks in the rock are in the right places for holding on, and the wind is especially brisk and strong here.  Some dirty straw tucked within one corner of the hole resembles an untidy nest.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Top of Cliff]]
description: At the top of the cliff, very little vegetation thrives.  A few scraggly tree-like bushes, with short thick needles, rock in the strong wind gusts, and some grey blotches of lichen stain the dark red rocks.  Jagged basalt boulders litter the top and rise further north in a second cliff, more perilous than the climb below.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff Trail]]
description: A trail snakes between the barren rocks -- here is a cold and lifeless terrain.  The hiss of wind is constant, the stone hard underfoot.  Grit and sand swirls over the landscape, scratching a forlorn plea in the lonely quiet.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff Trail]]
description: A lime-green creeping plant is startling in the barren soil and sand.  Its tiny leaves stand out brightly against the dark ground.  Except for this one patch of green, all else is dark and bare.  The wind thrums along, a constant companion, day and night.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff Trail]]
description: Columnar basalt formations, octagonal in shape and in varying heights, rise off to the west.  Arranged like giant steps, the phenomena has a comical appearance, but otherwise it is more rock in a place of rocks.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, High Cliffs]]
description: A pile of old bones lies at the base of the high cliffs.  Clearly some animal has scavenged and picked them clean of any identifying features.  A slanting ledge scales up the bluff, although the ascent looks treacherous.  Care and skill are required to prevent the same fatal outcome as the poor creature whose remains are as cold and bare as this land.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, High Cliffs]]
description: The ledge slants steeply down to the west.  Between the slope and the wind, merely staying in one place is difficult.  A cantilevered ledge overhead, if reachable, appears to be a more practical spot to make decisions about the next stage of the journey.

title: [[Sea Caves, Tunnel]]
description: The surging of the sea registers as a slight throbbing in the earth and a faint tickle of salt in the air.  The sparkling passage leads smoothly and directly away from the trail and ocean into the hard rock of the seaside cliffs.

title: [[Sea Caves, Tunnel]]
description: A slender path winds its way through the chamber, the floor to either side rising gradually until it meets the shallowly arched roof.  Short stalactites crowd the ceiling, dripping lonely drops of water.  The floor, aside from the worn path, is pocked with puddles and tiny pools.  As water drips into the higher pools they overflow their small banks and send a miniature stream running down to the next pool where the event is repeated until the overflow has dribbled out onto the path.

title: [[Crystal Cave]]
description: An outcrop of clear crystals bursts from a red and gold rock formation like the morning sun rising over a forest of stalagmites growing thickly on the cavern floor.  Several long stalactites glisten from where they hang on the ceiling, letting fall an occasional drop of water.

title: [[Sea Caves]]
description: Water cascades down the glistening walls of the large cavern and drips rapidly from many long stalactites.  Rivulets of water meander across the uneven floor pooling in a depression near the center of the room.  Flecks of mica glimmer like thousands of tiny stars through the thin sheets of water.  Numerous stalagmites jab upwards, dribbled spires and towers of some god's languorous dream.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, south, northwest, down.

title: [[Sea Caves]]
description: No water glistens here.  The small room's floor is uneven and covered with rocky dust.  Multi-colored layers of rock are exposed in the ceiling where chunks have recently broken off and fallen.  Gouges and long scrapes mar one wall where something frantically scratched it some time ago.

title: [[Sea Caves, Cavern]]
description: A small waterfall pours from the low ceiling into a long shallow pool running along one wall of the elongated chamber.  Rocks and stalagmites crowd its banks almost like a dam.  Several stalactites reach their long points down nearly to the surface of the pool.  Where free from hanging rock formations, the ceiling is covered with a blue-green fungus tinged with yellow.  The basalt wall opposite the pool is streaked with yellow, red, and green veins like wisps of colored smoke against a midnight sky.

title: [[Sea Caves, Cavern]]
description: A ledge skirts its way about this huge chamber.  Between the ledge and the wall rises an enormous pile of rubble which has fallen from the ceiling above.  The caved in portion of the roof is as flat and round as a plate, and the coloring of the exposed rock forms an image which resembles a large shark.  On the other side of the ledge, the floor tilts steeply down among large bits of rock debris, broken stalagmites and shattered stalactites before reaching the far side of the cavern.

title: [[Shrine of Drogor]]
description: The top of the pile of rubble is just out of reach of the ceiling of the chamber, where the image of a ferocious shark is clear on a barren circle of stone.  Small bones litter the top of the rubble pile, and offerings lie scattered about the loose stone.

title: [[Sea Caves, Passageway]]
description: Warm light glows from a thick vein of clear crystal intersecting the tunnel.  The vein must break through the surface somewhere above and reflect the sunlight down.  Green metallic tendrils cobweb the walls, forked lightning forms frozen forever in the rock.  A small garden of mushrooms has taken up residence on a shelf in the basalt walls which has managed to accumulate enough soil to support the little forest.

title: [[Sea Caves, Large Cavern]]
description: A damp rock curtain glitters like a grey-green waterfall tumbling down the southern wall of the cavern to spill out across the floor in an uneven carpet of stone.  A tall column reaches up into the dark recesses of the stalactite studded ceiling.  The sound of water splattering as it hits the floor or a receiving stalagmite echoes weirdly in the chamber.

title: [[Above the Curtain]]
description: A wide ledge spreads out across the top of the rock curtain.  The air feels warm and moist, and it smells slightly of rotten eggs.  A few stalactites hang near the edge of the ledge above the curtain, but otherwise the ceiling and floor are barren of rocky growths.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The air is warm and humid.  Beads of water cover the walls and roof, dripping down with inexorable slowness.  The rock is patterned with holes and vents of all sizes, and no stalactites or stalagmites grow.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Wisps of steam rise from the holes and pits in the walls.  The air is hot, muggy, and foul smelling, making breathing difficult.  A roiling cloud of steam churns against the high roof of the wide chamber.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cove]]
description: A crescent of warm black sand nestles at the base of the trail, softening the harsh lines of the towering escarpments.  The sea sends forth restless tendrils of aquamarine to wash at the sands, leaving behind foam-flecked reminders of its relentless energy.  Far overhead, a lone cypress clings stubbornly to the rock casting its cool shadow over a tangle of driftwood and debris.

title: [[Waters of the Cove]]
description: The onslaught of the sea is lessened within the protective borders of the small cove.  Black sand embraces the water's edge in sun baked warmth, its heat quenched in the cool caress of the ocean as it glides its foamy, green fingers softly over the shore.  Each wave thrusting lightly over the beach steals a precious cargo of sand, yet deposits its own seeds of marine life upon the warm, receptive land.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Glassy basalt glitters darkly on the walls, ceiling, and floor.  All surfaces have a peculiar scalloped appearance, the small depressions varying between smooth and glassy or rough and pitted.  The small ridges are sharp and jagged.  A fall or misstep would likely rend flesh from the unlucky fumbler.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The uneven floor and bulging walls of the moderately sized chamber are pocked with eerie dark mouths, vents, wells, and holes.  Some of the orifices emit tendrils of hot steam, other release nauseous fumes, a very few intermittently burp out scalding water.  The smells and sounds are sickeningly remniscent of a sour stomach.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: A large puddle of muddy water burbles slowly in the lower portion of the small chamber.  A couple of stalactites drip sadly into the puddle, looking as if they are about to melt away.  The floor has a treacherous, slimy feel to it and the walls and ceiling glisten damply.  In the wall behind the pool of muck is a small hole.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Thick clouds of steam make for terrible visibility in the narrow passageway.  Hot air blows through the cramped confines, tugging at loose articles of clothing and nearly blistering the skin.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Small fissures split the floor and walls, allowing blasts of hot air and steam to shoot up from somewhere below.  The air is heavy with the stench of rotting eggs and has a sharp quality which makes eyes water and heads pound.  Beads of water drip down the slick green walls.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The large cavern is honeycombed with vents and fissures of all sizes.  One would need to step carefully to avoid turning an ankle on the uneven and pit-strewn floor.  A loud hissing noise fills the room.  Steam billows from several sunken orifices about the chamber, and the walls sweat heavily.  A glassy-black basalt outcropping gleams in the center of the room.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Odd holes and vents riddle the walls of the passage.  Some are too small to poke in a finger, others are larger than a Gor Tog's head.  The unusual construction gives the rock a soft, spongy look, but it is quite firm and warm to the touch.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The walls of the small chamber are oddly shaped with bulges and strange eruptions in the rock.  The ceiling bows down in the center as if tired of holding up the tons of rock overhead.  Tiny holes riddle the undulated floor of the chamber.  The air is thick and hot with a halo of steam floating around the edges of the ceiling.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The jagged entrance opens into a smooth black-glass oval.  The surface is nearly unmarred, only minor blemishes interrupt the dark reflective walls.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The tunnel comes to an end in a small chamber, the floor sinking down to a narrow shaft in the floor.  Gurgling sounds echo up the shaft, and geysers of steam blast intermittently from the hole.  Above the pit, the ceiling is blasted smooth.  Water condensation runs down the pock-marked walls from the ceiling.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Steam gushes into the small chamber from several flues in the walls and floor.  Some of the dense clouds escape through small shafts in the ceiling, leaving a light mist blanketing the room.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: Sharp crystals sprout all about the chamber.  Black, clear, crimson, and azure spikes thrust up to snag the unwary.  Rather than sparkling beautifully, the crystals radiate a dim, unhealthy green glow.  Steam swirls sluggishly around the room of the cavern, shrouding some crystals in a thin veil.

title: [[Steam Vents]]
description: The walls have the oozy appearance of mud, piling in soft-looking folds towards the floor.  Several fist-sized holes line the top of the walls around the chamber, shooting gouts of steam and spitting out hot mud.  Wisps of steam linger about the walls and floor in smoky tendrils.

title: [[A Nook]]
description: A large lip of rock forms a pocket in the ceiling within easy reach of the thick stone column.  The nook is amazingly dry and feels a bit cooler than the chamber below.  A bed of fresh rushes lies invitingly in the rear of the cavity.

title: [[Sea Caves, Passageway]]
description: The passage narrows enough that a Gor'Tog would have to squeeze to get its shoulders through, but the ceiling is lost from sight as a crevice extends far above into the darkness.  The walls are smooth and straight rather than uneven and rough, as is the case elsewhere in the caverns.

title: [[Sea Caves, Crevice]]
description: The top of the crevice ends at a slender opening in the wall.  A faint breath of warm air caresses the flesh on its way up the natural chimney.  The walls and ceiling are much drier and the air less humid than down below.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A huge flat slab of rock serves as a floor in this shaft, ending at a dark slot-like opening splitting the north wall horizontally.  The low ceiling and walls are likewise even and flat, although the texture is rough to the touch.  A fine grit of pulverized rock is scattered across the peculiar chamber.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The small dome-shaped chamber is unremarkable except for the smoothness of its surfaces.  The floor is even and level with only a light coating of rock dust.  The walls slope gently inward and upward to the apex of the hemisphere of black stone.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: Passages lead out of the large chamber like spokes from the hub of a wagon wheel.  Dust and rubble cover the floor in cluttered disarray.  The ceiling is lost behind many layers of webbing, old and new, as if to hold back the falling stone of the roof.  A small cairn stands in the center of the room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Sea Caves, Cavern]]
description: A host of slender stone columns join the ceiling and floor, giving the glimmering cavern the look of a palace ballroom.  The ropey veined basalt, glistening with dampness, is a polished marble dance floor.  The long stalactites are glittering chandeliers.  The elegant stalagmites, clustered in tight knots, are indolent courtiers.  A low shelf skirts the northeast side of the chamber, wide and smooth.

title: [[Sea Caves, Passageway]]
description: The long passageway is cramped and close.  Damp walls press in from the sides and great care must be exercised to avoid smashing one's head against the ubiquitous stalactites or barking one's shins on the solid stalagmites which seem to move to get in the way.  The glittering speckles imbedded in the rock do very little to banish the stark shadows which grow blackly behind the hanging rock and across the obstacle-studded floor.

title: [[Sea Caves, Hot Spring]]
description: A small pool burbles and steams in the lower end of the small cavern, a wide ledge running about its edge.  The walls are smooth and damp, intermittently adorned with a fragile blue and green fungus.  A sweet, floral scent wafts from the pool.

title: [[Hot Spring]]
description: The water is almost too hot to endure but is strangely relaxing.  The sweet scent of the steam eases the mind, soothing away worries as the rejuvenating water loosens stiff muscles.  Each inhalation clears the head with a startling sharpness while inducing a wistful sleepiness.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A thick black ichor creeps down the southern wall of the chamber from a thin crack where the smooth wall slab meets the rough rock of the ceiling.  The excretion has built up at the base of the wall and solidified into a scabrous crust.  Remarkably, the room is free of the ubiquitous dust and rubble encountered elsewhere.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: Sloping steeply down to the northeast, the floor is pocked with numerous pits and festooned with fallen rock.  The extreme southwest end of the room is flat and even for a couple of paces before the ground begins its descent.  A couple of out-of-place boulders are worn down and polished on their tops.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A deep crevice splits the cavern in the east.  A narrow bridge of stone arches over the abyss to a small landing.  The sound of running water echoes loudly through the chamber, reverberating off the high ceiling.  Heaps of rubble litter the expansive floor.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The upper reaches of the chamber are cloaked in deep shadows.  Strewn among the unusually large stones and rubble are a litter of cracked bones and other less savory detritus of death.  One wall is cloven with an ominous crack running from the floor up into the darkness above.  Many smaller spidery lines fork off from the main split.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A large clump of webbing obscures and fills a man-sized nook in one wall.  Crisscrossing the high ceiling is a multitude of webs.  Clouds of fine dust sift down occasionally through the thick strands with a dry rasping rustle.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The intersecting tunnels form a small chamber only a few paces across.  The foot of one of the corner walls forms a low shelf worn smooth by use.  The rubble and loose stones in the area are swept aside forming a low ring of debris which passes in front of the passage openings -- a formidable barrier to marauding mice, but naught else.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: Thick gouges evidence an effort to widen the narrow passage here.  Knobs of rock protrude from the irregular walls and thrust into the room to crowd the small space.  Dust and flakes of rock litter the ground, crunching sharply when trod upon.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A disturbingly large pair of disembodied chelicerae lies haphazardly against a wall.  Poking out from beneath a large rock fall are several long slivers of chitinous plate.  Trailers of aged webbing dangle in silver-grey patches from the walls and ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A dark cut slices through one wall of the chamber running from a gaping hole in the ceiling down through a narrow slot in the floor.  A thin stream of water runs along the channel, falling through the hole from somewhere above only to disappear into the rocky earth.  The gurgling sound of running water is a pleasant diversion from the unnatural silence of these dry caverns.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A thin coat of ashen dust covers everything in the wide cavern.  Strange scuffling marks are etched in the dust as if someone tried sweeping the room with the wrong end of a broom.  Thick webs shroud the roof of the chamber from view, glinting the same silvery-greyness as the fine layer of grit below.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The misshapen ceiling hangs down in several banded layers.  Parts of the great rock plates have fallen, leaving black gaps like missing teeth grinning down from above.  Piles of rubble lie in chaotic disarray beneath the gaping holes.  At infrequent intervals, fountains of dust rain down from the pits and scatter on the rocks below.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The floor lies like a rumpled blanket in untidy folds of rock and makes for precarious footing.  Loose stones, pebbles, and dust do not help the matter.  A long slab of stone leans tiredly against the wall, forming a small niche beneath.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A long tube has been cut into the rock with great force.  The rounded walls are rough and uneven, but the shaft runs in a nearly perfect straight line, a testament to the power of the earth.  Shards of mica sparkle in the dark surfaces of the stone.  Looking down the tunnel is like gazing into a well of stars.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: The small chamber is little more than a widening of the connecting passages.  A web of cracks spreads across the otherwise flat and featureless floor.  The ceiling is also afflicted with cracks, and wide slates of rock appear on the verge of releasing their tenuous grip and dashing to pieces below.

title: [[Ocean, Near the Cove]]
description: Among sheer towering cliffs is nestled a small sandy cove, a picture of bliss next to the fury of waves breaking on the massive wall of stone.  The water, here at the mouth of the cove, bobs gently with the incoming waves, lifting swimmers on its rolling crest.  The wide, sweet sea spreads out to the north and west, its swells rising and falling with its own secret rhythms.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Willowbee's Pelts and Spinners]]
description: Crates of furs and piles of tightly wrapped spinnerets are stacked in the room, many of them tagged with the names of far away places -- the destinations where the furs are bound.  A spindly male elf, Willowbee himself, is often seen bustling around the shop and preparing orders while keeping an eye on the door for hunters, trappers, and traders to bring him business.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Sheds and Shacks]]
description: The small building is crammed with a variety of new and used building materials, but most of it looks scavenged at best.  There is hardly room to turn around, much less closely examine anything, but the merchant is delighted to see any potential customer and eagerly awaits an order.

title: [[Denison's Pub, Common Room]]
description: A long bar curves around the eastern end of the room, the imposing figure of Denison guarding the casks along the back wall.  Several wooden tables surrounded by rickety chairs in various states of repair crowd the small room in front of the door.  Along the north wall are a couple of slightly more private, and less clean, booths.  The dingy interior is lit by the sunlight streaming in the broken windows on either side of the entryway.

title: [[Builder's Warehouse, Interior]]
description: An entry area to the warehouse lies just inside the door.  As the space stretches away from the docks, rice paper screens partition it into private sections that shopkeepers rent to display their wares.  Fluttering overhead, a paper mobile hangs out of reach and dances wildly in the breeze each time the door opens and closes.

title: [[Builder's Warehouse, Sectioned Corridor]]
description: The screens form a passageway to move deeper into the warehouse.  A sisal runner covering the wood planked floor and the scent of burning sandalwood lends warmth and comfort to the practical space.  The muted shouts of workers on the dock drift into the interior through partly-open windows high overhead.

title: [[Builder's Warehouse, Sectioned Corridor]]
description: Several open screens lead into various sections providing wares for the homeowner or builder.  From somewhere in the farthest reaches comes the soft cry of an infant and his mother's singing coos to calm him as she works.

title: [[Smoque's Screens]]
description: Translucent ricepaper screens in neutral and pastel colors are on display along the walls of the shop.  A sliding arrangement near the door allows the purchaser to judge the colors in the light when selecting furnishings for their home.

title: [[Where There's Smoque, There's Fyere!]]
description: Fires burn in small braziers and stoves, each carefully screened to protect the ricepaper screens which form the walls of the shop.  Designed to sit upon the floor, the low braziers provide a surprising amount of warmth for their size.

title: [[Thymes' Tables]]
description: The fragrance of freshly carved sandalwood doesn't quite mask the sharper smells of the lacquer used to provide the glossy finish so popular on the island.  An assortment of tables and desks are on display, providing the homeowner with a good selection of both traditional and modern styles.  From the abstract shesegri design of the meditation table to the more representative floral images on the rose and lotus tables, the shop bespeaks fine craftsmanship and careful attention to detail.

title: [[Fenwycke's Floormats]]
description: Samples of the local floormats -- woven reed or grass floor matting which conceal the floor of a home -- are on display along the walls of the shop.  The shopkeeper, Fenwycke, plies his trade as he works, waiting for customers to make their decisions.

title: [[The Lap of Luxury]]
description: Pale gold ricepaper screens enclose the small shop.  Within, piles of cushions in various fabrics and colors are scattered upon the floor.  Traditionally, local homes use these cushions in place of the mainlander's chairs to offer a comfortable place for guests to sit or recline while eating dinner at low tables.

title: [[Tredwynne's Bedding]]
description: Translucent ricepaper screens line the walls of the shop, the austerity complementing the black stone columns as well as the neutral color of the woven reed floormat.  Against the understated neutrality of the background decor, the sleeping mats on display around the shop provide bright splashes of color.

title: [[A Room With A View]]
description: Thin metal chains hang from the ceiling, supporting metal-framed frosted and stained glass windows.  The windows are more decorative than functional, keeping insects out and allowing light to filter through the cut glass surfaces.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Kregkeirel Stable]]
description: Whitewashed wooden stalls line the room, customized to suit the needs of the native creatures of Surlaenis.  Long-eared and camel-faced, the kregkeirels peek over their pens with bored interest, using their long necks to get a good view of the hay-filled surroundings.  Along one wall is a row of panniers, large woven baskets shaped to fit comfortably on the back of the beasts.  Stablehands come and go as they see to their work, sometimes stopping to offer the beasts an affectionate pat.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Mausoleum Grand Foyer]]
description: Polished floors made from black marble reflect the light emanating from several candles placed in tall brass candelabras.  Two divans rest against the far wall underneath a large painting of the inner lake.  An arched doorway made of carved oak leads into the gela oleni, or the main burial chambers.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Gela Oleni]]
description: Walls of black marble shine with such a high gloss, reflections are seen with almost crystal clarity.  Images of flowers are etched into portions of the marble, and grooves are cut at evenly spaced intervals, outlining each individual resting place.  Each grave is a large two foot square, just enough room to hold the urn of a resident.  A door, made from the same marble as the walls, stands slightly ajar.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a Mausoleum, Behind the Door]]
description: The only thing visible in the dark is a staircase that leads down to the cellar of the mausoleum.  Faint sounds echo below, disturbing the silence with restless tones and thumps.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a Mausoleum, Crematorium]]
description: The room is dark and windowless.  The only means of light is one lone candle that flickers in the far corner.  A large steel oven, its doors slightly ajar, takes up almost all of the floor space.  A faint smell of something indistinguishable fills the air, unpleasant to the nose.  An occasional bumping sound appears to come from the general direction of the far wall.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Necropolis Tunnels]]
description: The tunnels branch off into several directions, leading deeper into the unknown.  Ancient S'Kra symbols are carved into the marble wall that leads back out towards the cellar.  Indistinguishable sounds echo throughout the darkness, coming from all directions.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast.

description: Ancient S'Kra symbols are carved into the tunnel walls in a continuous line, their meaning indecipherable to the common eye.  The darkness of the tunnel is broken by a single lantern that casts just enough light to make traveling through the tunnels easier.
