title: [[Observatory, Library]]
description: Softly glowing sconces line the walls of this long library, where wooden shelves are polished to a dark luster and lined with dusty and arcane manuscripts.  A rounded archway leads out to the observatory walk.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Ruined Flat]]
description: Thin cracks spiderweb through the walls and ceiling, apparently defying several previous attempts at repair judging by the crusty globs of dried putty all over the sandstone.  The floor is bare save for shards of glass previously owned by the window frame.  A large rock nestles in a pile of the glinting wreckage.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Washroom]]
description: Initially used by the tenants as a communal lavatory, the facilities now supply a different utility.  The bathing tubs, wash basins and even the chamber pots emit the pungent aroma of grain alcohol -- the new liquid alternative since the well ran dry.  A single tiny window near the ceiling hinders ventilation, and the fumes contribute to feelings of dizziness rather quickly.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: A small grove of young pine trees sprout in a tight bunch, marking the edge of the evergreen forest.  Their needles hued a deep emerald green, the small trees flourish in the rich soil of the mountain.  Shadows cast from larger trees overhead dwarf the little grove, spreading out like fingers in the murky twilight.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: A narrow deer trail winds its way through the thick evergreens, bending sharply to follow the densely packed trees that line the mountainside.  The soil underfoot is rich with loam, permeating the air with a hearty, earthy smell.  Occasional tree roots and fallen logs jut from the ground, hugging the edge of the cliffs running along the steep mountainside.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: Most of the lower branches of the trees in this area are completely gone, apparently eaten by the local wildlife.  Evergreen branches high enough to escape being eaten create a sheltering canopy that casts the forest in an eternal twilight.  The ground underfoot is covered with a thick blanket of dead pine needles, which are much more prominent near the trunk of each aging tree.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: The cliff's edge hugs the side of the treacherous mountain path that wends its way around the edge of the lonely woods.  An oddly-shaped pine tree clings to the side of a nearby ledge, its trunk growing at a sharp bend and its roots forming a spiral to grasp the viable soil.  Smaller saplings have taken root at the very edge of the cliff, tenaciously clinging to life in the harsh environment.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: An animal trail winds down the side of Wyvern Mountain, thick on either side with bushes and undergrowth speckled with lilac.  Several boulders and smaller trees cluster near the edge of the path, showing only darkness beyond.  Mineral-rich mist clings heavily to the ground at the base of the trees, giving the air a strong earthy scent and stirring up ghostlike wisps with every breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, west.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: Widely spaced at even intervals, a set of four nearly identical cedar trees creates a natural crossroads in the forest's deer trails.  Overhead the branches tangle with each other, blocking out the dim twilight almost completely and making the crossroads very dark.  The night is alive with sound, crickets chirping and the occasional hoot of an owl echoing across the lonely mountainside.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Forest]]
description: A small patch of vivid blue flowers grows in a rich streak of soil in a gap between two trees, hugging the edge of a steep cliff.  Wide spaces between the tall trees allow them to grow oversized feather-shaped branches, fanning out over the shady path.  Long strips of bark hang from several of the evergreens, marred at the edges with bite marks that expose the pale white sapwood underneath.

title: [[Hidisharon Desert, Sandy Trail]]
description: Small tan rocks stand out from the swirling shades of dark sand, randomly settled into their positions by the elements, but striking a noticeable similiarity to a night sky.  The stars are untouchable, yet the pebbles and stones are within an arm's reach away from being rearranged, playthings of some traveling mortal who fancies himself a god dabbling with constellations, or shifted by the vagaries of wind and nature.

title: [[Hidisharon Desert, Sandy Trail]]
description: Ripples of sand, curled not unlike discarded snake skins, fill the horizon to the south, sight beyond blurred by the shimmering air rising from the desert, night or day.  Somewhere beyond the dunes are the peaks of the Undogoz mountain chain, their presence masked by distance and the waves of dancing heat so perfectly that one might wonder if the mountains are there at all.

title: [[Hidisharon Desert, Dune's Edge]]
description: Arched as though bitten by some giant mouth, a crescent-shaped depression dips into the dunes below, swallowing stones, rocks, and anything else too close to the flowing sand along its edge.  When the wind blows, the wash of debris down its gullet actively hisses as it slides, falling silent again as the breezes cease.  A weathered sign leans near the edge of the pit, only the thickness of its post keeping it stable.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: The damp, fog-shrouded path wends its way through the ancient cypress and tupelo, gaining height as it approaches the great limestone cliffs to the west.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: An imposing limestone bluff delineates the western edge of the swamplands here.  Years of muddy runoff have accumulated along a softer incline of the rock face, forming a mucky slope that ascends out of the bayou.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: Somber shadows grip the forested swampland.  Like an army of slender ghosts advancing on the path, dark tree trunks shrouded in moss drift in and out of visibility in the heavily shifting fog.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: Aided by persistent black fog and the dense canopy of moss-knit cypress, a willful gloom strangles the bayou through day and night alike.  Adding to the oppression, a stale odor permeates the moist air.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: The trunk of an uprooted water elm rests against a craggy overhang here, creating a naturally secluded alcove along the glen path that's further concealed by a thick screen of dangling vines.  Occasionally, the wet slap of droplets hitting muddy ground punctuates the chorus of frogs and insects that drifts in through the bordering swamp reeds.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: Stacked stone blocks scattered amidst the soggy vegetation suggest the remnants of ancient buildings here.  The hewn basalt, likely mined from the nearby Dragonspine Mountains in long-forgotten times, has admirably resisted erosion, while any other construction elements have long since decomposed into the swamp.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: A collapsed stone arch lies half-buried and overgrown with wiregrass beneath a low groundsel tree.  Similar bits of crumbling wall and other basalt rubble are visible deeper in the undergrowth.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: Gaps between the dense cypress and their spinous knees define the narrow path cutting through the swamp.  Scraggly grey moss dangles from the branches above, threatening to ensnare unwary passerby.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: The solitary remains of an archaic stone hearth poke above the wiregrass and reeds here.  In contrast to its air of bygone abandonment, the silhouettes of man-made construction and the flickering of torchlight can just barely be made out through the swamp timbers to the north.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: The woods abate as the earth becomes quaggy in its approach to the bayou.  Emerging through the thinning trees, the path skirts the shoreline and affords a clear view of a stilted encampment with flickering lights situated out on the open water to the north.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou, Sheltered Bank]]
description: A welcome aid to footing, cattails and maidencane crowd the steep embankment that slopes down to the water's edge, where wood piles begin to rise from the mud to support the raised encampment overhead.  Enjoying this stagnant corner of bayou, patches of duckweed float lazily amongst the cypress poles.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou, Beneath the Encampment]]
description: A maze of wood piling rises from the inky waters to support the crude encampment overhead.  Many piles are crooked and poorly hewn, an indication that prompt completion was prioritized over construction quality.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou]]
description: The oppressively dark and dense forest presses in from all directions, challenging progress through the swamp.  As further hindrance, woody cypress knees project from the ground like spears defending the unwrought path.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou, Nirefrei Falls]]
description: Blocking southern passage but providing a magnificent waterfall vista, the Nirefrei River tumbles down timeworn channels in the limestone cliff face and flows into the swamp's black embrace as a vast wall of broken rivulets.  A mossy path leads down off the ridge and towards the dark bayou below.

title: [[Boleausun Bayou, Muddy Slope]]
description: Slick, sludgy runoff coats the limestone incline, with precious little available to grasp for support.  Below, the dark bayou stretches ominously eastward.

title: [[Jademist Shore]]
description: A high embankment conspires with the prevalent mist to isolate a dark stretch of shoreline here along the Jademist River.  Gnarled roots from ancient trees growing further up the bank are tangled into a natural retaining wall that camouflages an unobtrusive cave set into the earthen slope.

title: [[Shadowy Safehouse]]
description: Fresh cedar buttressing, plush fur rugs, and decorative oil lamps make a serviceable hideout from what would otherwise be a dank and ordinary cave.  Pushed up against the fictile walls, shelves laden with fastidiously organized sundries and armaments are illuminated by the flickering lamplight.

title: [[Riverbank Trail]]
description: The sounds of the city fade slightly into the background, muffled by the steep slope of the riverbank that lines the trail.  The path follows the river, edging along the slippery slope that is littered with old bottles, broken wood and dead fish.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Abandoned Lot]]
description: An accumulation in one corner indicates the city's rubbish disposal depot resides on the other side of the lot's wall.  Layers of grease, sludge and similarly unpleasant liquids decorate the sandstone's surface like an artist's splatter painting.  The stagnant stink invades every nook and cranny while loitering in the air like a putrid fog.

title: [[Chedik Bridge, Engineer's Tower]]
description: This cluttered chamber at the bottom of the tower looks more like a classroom than a base of operations for maintenance of a massive stone structure.  There are several benches facing a desk behind which a large dusty slate is bolted to the wall.  A prominent sign is posted to one side of the slate.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: Tall iron standards mark the entrance to the Bazaar, the slightly tattered penants flapping in the occasional breeze.  Traffic is heavy here as carts pull up to load provisions and unload wares.  Shoppers find themselves milling about the entrance, pondering their purchases.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: Bedraggled peddlers make their way to this spot daily, as bargain hunters from every corner of Elanthia converge here at the entrance to the great Bazaar.  Deeply recessed into the cliff face, a large dark opening looms to the east.  A smoky haze swirls playfully, eluding the wisp of a breeze threatening to blow it away.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southwest, northwest.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Abandoned Lot]]
description: Muspar'i's north wall looms over the crowded patch of land, making the lot's barricades appear like matchboxes in comparison.  Occasional gusts of wind brush sand off the nearby rooftops, causing it to rain audibly onto the piles of trash all around.  Hardly any wind reaches this desolate space, resulting in a gut-wrenching odor that soaks into clothes and bodies alike.

title: [[World's End Apartments, Abandoned Lot]]
description: Adjacent buildings huddle around the lot as if to peer inside and watch for any spark of activity.  The crowd of stone spectators faces disappointment on a regular basis due to the utterly despondent environs.  Most of the movement in the area emanates from scavenging rodents disturbing the mounds of trash collecting on the ground.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Foyer]]
description: Vibrant silks drape the polished sandstone walls amid the many potted plants that decorate the broad foyer.  Marbled tzgaa orbs hang overhead, highlighting a pair of thickly-padded benches that surround a low table at the center of the room.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Supply Shop]]
description: A vast array of colorful baskets and earthenware surround the shop, their essences mingling into a variety of sweet, musky scents.  Brass oil lamps dangling overhead cast a soft glow over the wide counter below as several S'Kra Mur workers tend to restocking and taking care of the needs of crafters.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Gathering Hall]]
description: Colorful murals are painted along the sandstone walls between the vibrant mosaic arches that lead into the various workrooms of the society.  Thick beams sweep to the vaulted ceiling overhead, the rich teak wood carved to resemble towering palm trees and adding to the inviting decor of the circular gathering hall.  Lit by the hanging brass oil lamps, woven mats decorate the floor while piles of plump pillows scattered about the room provide a place where many of the crafters rest and share their ideas.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Tool Depot]]
description: Several decorative bamboo shelves line the polished sandstone walls of the small shop, each displaying a variety of alchemical tools.  Standing behind a broad counter, a young Elven lass greets the many crafters who stop to make their purchases.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Book Store]]
description: Striations imbed the surrounding sandstone walls with a variety of vibrant hues, the rich minerals glinting in the light.  A small shelf advertising available alchemical books sits below a chart on alchemical techniques on one side of the small enclosure, while the other side an exhausted clerk notes work order completions on a board.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Workroom]]
description: Tiny glazed tiles mosaic the surrounding walls with a colorful array of soaring birds, helping to create a relaxing environment for the visiting crafters who frequent the society.  Several potted plants and shelves line the room's perimeter, the tall ceilings and rounded chimneys overhead providing adequate ventilation for any experiments with unexpected results.

title: [[Bay Cliffs, Trail]]
description: This narrow trail through the woods is barely wide enough to walk sideways if you're bigger than a Dwarf.  Leaves obscure the line of sight in all directions, and branches and twigs poke from all sides.  Flying, crawling and hopping bugs are much closer than is comfortable, and there's no way to avoid them short of just leaving.  The foliage is denser to the south, but there are voices coming from that direction.

title: [[Bay Cliffs, Monument]]
description: The trees and bushes have been cleared away from the rim of the cliff.  Halfway between the edge of the woods and the edge of the precipice stands a bronze monument, tall and shining.  A couple of young men are lounging on the grass and chatting.

title: [[Pokekehekepi olpo'staho]]
description: Gleaming golden sand stretches out, seemingly endless under the glaring light of the daytime sun.
Glistening with a silver sheen, the sands stretch out into the darkness beyond the range of vision.

title: [[Pokekehekepi ghedo]]
