Dry, almost dusty dirt lies bare in neat, even spaces between the ripening rows, which have changed from a green to a nearly golden color.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Amphitheater]]
description: Rows of padded seats slant upwards along the curved walls, giving ample room to house any number of spectators.  Banners in bright shades of red and blue hang from the polished metal beams that arch overhead.  A few darkly clad figures weave amongst the crowd, taking side bets on the combatants' chances in the pit, careful to stay inconspicuous under the watchful eye of the patrolling guards.  A stairway stretches downward along the eastern wall.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Refreshment Stand]]
description: This three-sided stand is crafted from polished steel walls and etched with the figures of hulking monsters.  The open side faces the pit, allowing the patrons to watch the battles below while making their pick of food from the long counter or pouring themselves a drink from the keg rack above it.  Several beautiful maidens stand behind the counter, ready to pass overflowing glasses to the spectators.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Amphitheater]]
description: Rows of padded seats slant upwards along the curved walls, giving ample room to house any number of spectators.  Banners in every shade of red hang from the polished metal beams that arch overhead.  Several guards stand watch over the railing that separates the fighting pit from the crowd, occasionally using their elaborate halberds to coax a blood-thirsty beast away from the inner wall.

title: [[Kasine's Gauntlet, Amphitheater]]
description: Rows of padded seats slant upwards along the curved walls, giving ample room to house any number of spectators.  Banners in every shade of blue hang from the polished metal beams that arch overhead.  Brightly dressed vendors wander amongst the crowd, loudly hawking their wares to anyone who will listen.  A stairway stretches downward along the western wall.

title: [[Witchery, The Tunnel]]
description: Dark grey tarps, fastened to the walls and ceiling, stretch downward, creating a twisting tunnel that shoppers must navigate.  A structure, hidden beneath the tarps, rises upwards in the center of the passage, creating shelves and niches that further slows traffic.  Small windows have been cut into the sides, providing glimpses of other customers moving through the snake-like passage.

title: [[Private Home Interior]]
description: Walls of polished oak and a polished riverstone floor covered by a plush moss-green rug dappled with blues and purples enclose this small room.  In one corner lies a carved rich brown sana'ati four-poster bed with sheer curtains, and near the bed sits a gilded oak heartwood table on which rests a lockpick ring.  An arched white marble fireplace inlaid with matching jasper and emerald willows burns along the far wall with some silvery stars hanging above it.  The room holds a lingering scent of rose petals.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Vertical Cliff Face]]
description: A soft phosphorescent glow emanates from huge patches of fungus that coat the rocky outcrops jutting from the walls of this sheer cliff face.  Even so, the surroundings are difficult to make out in the low light.  All that is readily visible are shallow handholds in the immediate vicinity that appear like daubs of shadow pocking the luminous fungi.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Vertical Cliff Face]]
description: The darkness is only slightly ameliorated by the soft phosphorescent glow emanating from huge patches of fungus that coat the rock walls of this narrow crevice, making it difficult to fully discern the surroundings.

title: [[Eye of Urrem'tier, Warding Chamber]]
description: Concave walls of pitch black obsidian carve out a small spherical chamber.  Etched into the walls are strange sigils and warding runes that glimmer every so often with a white radiance.  The chamber is bare save for a simple black ironwood stand in the center and an ebony rack on one wall.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Mesa]]
description: From this lofty summit, the maze of canyons and striated cliffs to the north and west spreads out in a colorful panorama.  The overhanging cliffs effectively prevent descent from this side of the mesa, which slopes slightly downward to the west.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: Avian loiterers tease each other with twitters and tweets in the fluttering canopy overhead.  The dense thicket boasts both new and old growth, with several dwellings built to entirely encompass whole tree trunks.  Residents have broadened an old deer trail into a navigable path for people and horses traveling into the coppice.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: The improved deer trail winds through the trees like the gracefully arcing neck of a swan, with several wooden structures built into the crook.  Bowed ferns submit to the dominance of the thicker trees and greedily clench any sunlight managing to pierce the leafy branches.  Both the daytime anlas and the abundance of plant life soften the atmosphere, promoting lightheartedness and relaxation for all.

The faint trail winds through the trees like a crescent moon, with several structures built in the crook.  Bowed ferns and thick trees alike submit to the dominance of night, silently keeping to their stations lest aroused by wandering creatures.  Both the darkness and the abundance of plant life soften the atmosphere, promoting quiet contemplation and reflection under the heavens.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: Ridged tree trunks stand as columns to hold up the verdant green ceiling sheltering the home site.  Tiny winged insects move in clumps from bush to bush, performing feats of exploration of a distinctly primal nature.  A few wild mushrooms sprout near a rotting stump next to the grassy path.

Towering tree trunks stand as great columns to hold up the velvety black ceiling sheltering the home site from the forces of night.  Tiny glowing insects move in clumps from object to object, giving hazy snapshots of the dark thicket to observers along the grassy path.  A few wild mushrooms sprout near a stump, though the blackness makes it hard to tell if they are friends or foes.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: Moss and lichen upon the trees resemble a greenish patina on aging bronze.  Swathes of buttercups and violets streak the underbrush like bejeweled inlays more in color than fire, though the occasional dewdrop combined with generous daylight lends a hint of brilliance to the petals.  The branches and ferns lurch forward across the path as if to protect their bounty.

Moss and lichen upon the trees resemble dark linen banners draped down castle walls.  Swathes of buttercups and violets lie concealed amongst the rest of the monotonous undergrowth.  The branches and ferns lurch forward across the path as if to protect their kin.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: Particle-filled shafts of daylight slip through the tree cover, spilling their brightness upon the clover-strewn path.  Antelope and other passive mammals can be seen nibbling the foliage in between the sturdy constructions of thatch and timber.  Clinging to a nearby trunk, a handful of sky-blue feathers twirls on the breeze.

Darkness seeps into the quiet copse, slipping through the trees and shrouding the path's subtle curves.  Animals occasionally move between the houses to seek protection from the foliage, some to hide from predators, others to elude prey.  Clinging to a nearby trunk, some feathers hang limply, undisturbed in the solitude of night.

title: [[Prairie Grove, Brushwood Trail]]
description: The ground's scent of rich loam coupled with the ferns' herbal fragrance transforms the plain grassland into a pristine natural paradise.  Puffs of white flowers edge the deer trail, which ends in a cul-de-sac amongst the homes and trees.  A circle of weathered stones rests in the middle of the small clearing, perfect for midday gatherings.

The scents of wild creatures and thriving plants in the wilderness transform the grassland into a nocturnal paradise full of thrills and wonderment.  Puffs of flowers, their white hue muted by the night, edge the deer trail, which ends in a cul-de-sac amongst the homes and trees.  A circle of stones rests in the middle of the dark clearing, perfect for midnight gatherings.

title: [[Sand Spit Tavern, Barroom]]
description: Apparently made from a section of salvaged ship's hull the main bar area is constructed of ancient and scavenged nautical ware.  The decor is of the same vintage, an old hatch cover for a door, worn and broken capstans for tables with a hodge-podge of chairs of all sorts.  A long bar that has seen much better days is the main focus of the room.  The lighting is dim and there are many dark corners.  The clientele seems to prefer it that way to judge from the heavily curtained porthole windows.

title: [[Sand Spit Tavern, Round table]]
description: Here in a very dark corner of the bar, sits a large table.  A rough wooden bench and some chairs are drawn up about it and a shaded oil-lamp sitting on it throws a narrow cone of light on the surroundings.  An ideal place to sit and drink or talk for those who'd prefer not to be disturbed.

title: [[The Finer Things, Front Room]]
description: The room is lavishly floored with durian buffed to a brilliant sheen while a perfume bottle chandelier hangs from above illuminating the opulent coral walls with a warm glow.  A shelf of brushed platinum faces an intricately carved chest, each carefully placed to subtly catch the light upon their showcased wares.  Taking the central focal point of the room is a glass counter wrapped in strands of seashells and adorned with purposely placed jars of brightly glowing gaethzen.

Taking the central focal point of the room is a glass counter wrapped in strands of seashells and adorned with purposely placed jars of brightly glowing gaethzen.

title: [[The Finer Things, Back Room]]
description: The opulence of the shop is carried into this room, but with a more casual setting.  Sun bleached coral walls are draped in pastel-tinted whisperlayne interwoven with soft glowing lights that help to highlight the salt-stained durian floors.  Reclaimed wood and expensive fabrics combine to create the chests and whitewashed shelves used to display the wares in the cozy area.

title: [[Half Pint Inn, Balcony]]
description: This intimate balcony looks out of the top story of the inn, over the river and the town, facing south.  From here, stunning views of the dawns, sunsets and the night's sky over the water greet you.

title: [[The Mercurial Mage]]
description: Ivory gossamer is hung from the ceiling in broad, capricious swoops, enveloping the small chamber in translucent fabric.  Suspended in multicolored glass jars between the gauzy layers, gaethzen shards cast shifting rainbow light over the whimsical shop, illuminating marble mannequins, hat stands, and a shoe rack arranged at the center of the room.  Near the back, a velvet-lined eyewear display rests beneath a bevelled marble shelf laden with additional wares.

title: [[The Musiceum, Orchestral Manoeuvres]]
description: Dark sable velvet drapery has been hung from ceiling to wall, swathing the room in near blackness.  The darkness is staved off completely by several gaethzen globes hung by near invisible wire that have been carefully positioned over the display cases to allow the wares for sale to be seen clearly.  Nestled between the swathes of cloth, cases and instrument tools have been hung on pegboards to show them off to their best advantage.

title: [[The Musiceum, Amber Room]]
description: Set up in an octagonal shape, this room has been fitted with amber panels throughout.  Behind each panel, light has been set up to allow the amber to glow like a warm fire as well as highlighting the tiny bubbles and animals trapped within.  Ornate gold hardware secures each panel to the next, blending almost seamlessly with the tawny-hue of the paneling.  Three gaethzen globes suspend above the empty room, while a large hanging sign has been strung up to rest immediately below the middle globe.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Back Room]]
description: Neatly kept, this tiny room serves as both living quarters and an additional storeroom.  A small cot and a cooking stove designate one corner as the home, while the rest of the room is stacked to the ceiling with boxes and crates placed here in storage.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Small Storeroom]]
description: The contents of stacked boxes and opened crates surround a young sales clerk who is busily categorizing the items in a large parchment binder before placing them on sturdy storage shelves.  A polished brass lantern hangs from the ceiling, affording ample light to display the wares that are available for sale.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Garden]]
description: Several troughs filled with colorful herbs and flowering plants growing from rich soil are aligned in orderly rows.  A weather-worn wooden bucket filled with well water rests on the cobblestone walkway next to one of the troughs.  A sturdy oak door marred by the elements leads to the back room of the shop.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Garden]]
description: A whitewashed wooden fence encases the small back yard, with muffled sounds from the surrounding buildings and homes of the city drifting in over the painted enclosure.  The herbs growing in the troughs in this area have thick stems with sharp thorns.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Garden]]
description: Wicker baskets bearing rare and precious herbs hang from a tall oak tree shading the cobbled path.  Encircling the large trunk are several racks filled with tiny glass bottles of pastes, powders, and dried herbs.

title: [[Sister Nongwen's Garden]]
description: Off to the side of the cobblestone walkway stands a low brick wall protecting the jewel of Sister Nongwen's garden, a plot of dirt containing several different varieties of sirese flowers.  Wooden poles around the wall support a cloth roof that protects the fragile buds from damage due to inclement weather.

title: [[Taernen's Alchemical and Herbal Supplies]]
description: Glass bottles sit in haphazard rows on dark shelves along the back wall of the shop.  In the far corner, an iron cauldron bubbles over a bronze brazier set into the brick floor.  Bundles of herbs hang from hooks on the rafters.

title: [[Elver Rummeltum's Home and Garden Supplies]]
description: Baskets and plants fill the shelves of the general store, with even more sitting on a workbench off to one side.  The aroma of roasting meats and fresh-baked bread wafts through the open doorway of the catering shop, mingling with the fragrance of flowers grown by the pudgy Halfling shopkeeper who stands behind the counter.

title: [[Fiona's Fine Swords and Shields, Front Room]]
description: The sharp smell of burning pine and a touch of heat on the skin marks the presence of the forge in the back of this mostly stone-crafted building.  Swords hanging from the seamlessly fitted granite walls glow in the light, gleaming with the polish and care that has been lavished on them.  Fiona Lightwielder, the owner of the shop, watches her inventory and clientele from where she sits before a table of knife pieces, fitting them together methodically.

title: [[Drangvold's Sundries, Sales Floor]]
description: Stacked stone chinked with straw and plaster form the base for an unusual lichen painting on the back wall of the shop.  Subtle shades of blues and greens mingle with grey and brown in a seascape, far from the sight or smell of the ocean.  The other walls are hidden by rows of shelves creaking beneath the weight of the goods offered for sale in the town's general store.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Entry Platform]]
description: Situated high in the grove, brief flickers of light and movement reveal that this particular platform is only a small part of the hidden Hub.  Opening expansively around a central hut, the platform is populated by wandering Prydaen.  A nearby Prydaen woman helps others to ascend or descend from the platform.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Sleeping Hut]]
description: Thick wooden walls are lined with pelts, keeping the hut warm while deadening the interior from sounds outside.  A small wash basin and pitcher sit atop a low table that rests near a stack of pallets.  Several other pallets filled with slumbering occupants appear throughout the quiet area.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Private Quarters]]
description: Built solidly around a tree, a large wooden building with a thatched bloodwood roof has been neatly partitioned into psuedo-apartments that share a communal porch that circles around the broad trunk.  Along the covered porch, several chimes constructed of bones, shells, and feathers flutter in the wind, bringing the occasional sound to the otherwise quiet area.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Private Quarters]]
description: Leading around a large tree, more doorways to living quarters appear along the covered platform here.  A sturdy bloodwood bench dominates the end of the walkway, providing seating for any that wish to pause to enjoy the weather or the sounds of the forest beyond the Hub.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Crafting Hut]]
description: The rich smell of redwood permeates the area, bringing a sense of calm to the busy hut that is built around an expansive tree.  Baskets of supplies are stacked near the walls and tanning hides are stretched taunt on racks.  Several stations are set up in the area, where gathered Prydaen work on projects.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Lookout]]
description: Covered only by a truncated roof, the platform here is open to the elements, allowing the Prydaen to scout the forest for potential food or danger.  The platform extends out slightly underneath an overhanging branch, providing a way to access a wooden-seated swing that someone has installed.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Warriors Treehouse]]
description: Half walls surround the treehouse itself, providing a safe walkway and a route for patrolling warriors.  Set up in several nearby branches are cunning snares, some wriggling with unlucky squirrels.  Prydaen warriors chat with each other, work on their weapons, and idly lounge across the area.

title: [[Silverclaw Hub, Central Treehouse]]
description: Built into the sprawling canopy of a shorter tree, the central platform features a large firepit.  Several young Prydaen run through the area, squealing and making various babyish mewling sounds at each other while a handful of Elders watch over them with a tolerant expression.  Nearby warriors feign negligence, but fiercely approach any that get too close to the playing kits.

title: [[Forest of Night, Murky Woods]]
description: Black matte trunks grow aimlessly about you, their branches creating a curtain of thick leaves and shadows.  The light is just enough to make you wish for more, and dim enough to make every tree look like the next.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[The Finer Things, Corner]]
description: The lush, ocean-blue carpeting of the small room serves the dual purposes of muffling the sounds of heavy foot traffic and providing a more cushioned place to sit or stand.  Lavish piles of sea-shell patterned pillows are stacked with an eye to detail and the customers' comfort in mind.  Potted palm trees strung with softly glowing sungold lanterns stand in each corner of the room, giving off just enough light to create a relaxed ambience.

title: [[Beech Glade, Forest Green Hammock]]
description: The branches hang low to almost completely conceal this spot, nestled among the restful rustling of the trees.

title: [[Orphanage, Foyer]]
description: The warm glow of oil lamps lights the foyer of the orphanage, giving the dark-stained wood floor a soft luster.  Small, cushioned benches outside the oak door to the office provide a place for visitors to enjoy a brief rest while they wait to be seen.  On either end of the hall, carved archways open onto the two lower wings of the complex, and a large staircase leads to the upper level.  Directly across from the main entrance, a walnut door set with a large window overlooks a courtyard.

title: [[Orphanage, Vegetable Garden]]
description: The sweet, rich smell of fertile earth is prevalent here.  Gardeners are busy tending to the vegetable plots, which border the way leading to the playground.  Nearby, several children gather and wash the harvested crops, gazing longingly at the playground to the north.

title: [[Orphanage, Administrative Office]]
description: A huge mahogany desk sits before two cushioned chairs.  Light cascades across its surface, which is practically covered with stacks of ledgers and neat piles of parchment.  A large window with burgundy curtains overlooks the flower garden.  Outside, the chirping of songbirds and laughter of children can be heard, providing a relaxing background to the otherwise stressful task of overseeing the daily running of the orphanage.

title: [[Main Hallway, North]]
description: Cream-colored tiles cover the floor of the rectangular hallway that leads from the large staircase towards some doors, which are spaced along its length.  A large glass skylight illuminates the area, creating shadows on the pale yellow walls.  A large gold-framed picture is placed in a perfect vantage point on the wall above the stairs.

title: [[Bedroom, Nursery Staff]]
description: A large rug covers the wooden floor of the room.  A small window opposite the neatly made bed, looks out on to the courtyard and is framed by heavy, pale green velvet curtains which fall behind an overstuffed armchair.  A small dresser rests against the wall by the door.

title: [[Orphanage Nursery]]
description: Pale lemon-yellow paint covers most of the walls.  The wall with a door has a mural of a woodland scene that extends onto a sky-blue ceiling.  Cribs are placed in an orderly fashion around the room with rocking chairs between them.  Snowy white curtains dress the windows and just reach the varnished wooden floor.

title: [[Nursery, Bathing Room]]
description: A small sink with steel taps is situated under a small window.  Beside it is a long table covered in folded cotton towels of various colors.  Pale grey slate tiles cover the floor while all the walls are vividly painted with the image of a seascape.

title: [[Main Hallway, East]]
description: Polished brass railings aid the younger children to keep from falling while on the walkway overlooking the ground floor.  Covered torches are mounted high on the wall to provide additional light when necessary.  A pale blue door leads off the main hallway into a large room.

title: [[Orphanage, Staff Bedroom]]
description: Two beds dominate the room and flank the pine door to the hallway.  Matching trunks have been placed at the foot of each.  A large window, dressed with cream lace curtains, lets in light and overlooks the courtyard below.  Tucked into the corner is a wardrobe beside a small table.

title: [[Boys' Dormitory]]
description: From the pale walls to the much darker carpet, the dormitory is filled with various hues of blue.  The beds are lined up with almost military precision against the two longest walls and have small trunks at their feet.  Three large windows sit above one of these rows, while tucked away in the corner is a large open crate filled with toys.

title: [[Boys' Bathroom]]
description: A large bath dominates the room and is encircled by sinks, each with a small cupboard over it.  Beside a narrow arch that leads back into the main dormitory is a table filled with blue towels.  Light is provided from small torches high on the wall.

title: [[Main Hallway, South]]
description: The cream tiles of the floor are marred with tiny scratches.  Most of them are near a painted white door with a neatly nailed sign that leads to the clinic.  The hallway stretches an equal distance to the right and left.

title: [[Main Hallway, West]]
description: A cream-colored door with a small rose-shaped plaque stands across the hallway from a plain birch door.  The faint sound of music drifts up from the ground floor, while the air is tinged with the slight scent of roses.

title: [[Clinic Staff, Bedroom]]
description: Pushed tightly against the wall, a bed sits under the room's only window.  A pale lilac rug covers the wooden floor, almost matching the color of the walls.  Sitting next to a mahogany door is a small writing desk with a straight-backed chair.  A light grey door that is slightly ajar leads to the infirmary.

title: [[Orphanage, Clinic]]
description: Stark white with pale grey tiling, the room is void of any variation in color.  Metal beds have been lined up against the walls, and there is a regimented feel to the room.  The scent of pine hangs heavily in the air.  A light grey door leads to a small room, and nearby is a desk with a plain chair behind it.

title: [[Girls' Dormitory]]
description: Pale pink walls complement the rose-colored runner between the two rows of beds in the room.  A small set of drawers is to the right of each bed. A bathing area can be seen through a tall arch, while a door leads back to the hallway.

title: [[Bathing Area, Girls']]
description: Ceramic tiles cover the floor and surround the large bath.  The cream ceiling complements the pale white walls painted with delicate pink roses.  A large rose-colored rug rests on the floor between the bath and a large sideboard piled high with towels.  Next to it sits a small pedestal filled with soap.

title: [[Staff Bedroom, West]]
description: Various shades of cream are scattered around the room, from the painted walls to curtains draped from the window.  A large, fluffy rug has been haphazardly flung over the floor near a bed covered in a cream woolen blanket.  A large trunk has been placed at the foot of the bed.

title: [[Orphanage, Playground]]
description: A large climbing structure juts out of an enormous sandbox that provides a relatively soft landing for any who make a misstep.  A teeter-totter balances precariously and a wide expanse of soft grass makes for the perfect place for a spirited game of tag.

title: [[Orphanage, East Wing]]
description: The muted sounds of children echo through the long corridor.  Scarecrows can be seen through the many large windows, watching over their crops.  At the end of the hall stands a stout oak door.  Light shines across a pine door, a guide to the fun which lies beyond it.

title: [[Orphanage, Library]]
description: A comical painting of a large, green dragon wearing reading spectacles adorns the wall opposite a row of sturdy bookshelves.  A scattering of oversized pillows surround a leather chair, ready for reading lessons and storytelling sessions.  Oil lamps cast their glow down upon several books that litter the dense, blue-green carpet.

title: [[Orphanage, Playroom]]
description: Plush, purple carpeting covers the floor of this expansive playroom, providing a soft and comfortable surface for the children.  A toy box has been tipped on its side, scattering its contents into one of the corners.  Large, bean-filled, stuffed animals double as toys and furniture.  One looks to have been slain by a particularly energetic orphan, causing it to spill its beans.

title: [[Orphanage, West Wing]]
description: The smell of baking bread and the faint sounds of clanking pots and pans fill the hallway.  Several windows looking out onto the courtyard line the long hall, at one end of which stands a sturdy walnut door.  Dust specks seem to dance in the light that shines across the hall, bathing a pine door and an oak door in warm brilliance.

The smell of baking bread lingers in the hallway.  Several windows looking out onto the courtyard, line the long hall, at one end of which stands a sturdy walnut door.  A pine door and an oak door can also be made out in the dim light.

title: [[Orphanage, Craft Room]]
description: The sharp smell of paint and wheat paste lingers in the air, while the walls of the room have nearly been covered by the drying artwork of children.  The original color of the tile floor is nearly indiscernible, with a mosaic-like pattern created by the various spills and stains.  On the worktables, several paint-smeared palettes rest waiting to be cleaned, while others soak in a basin filled with soapy water.

title: [[Orphanage, Dining Room]]
description: Several rows of dining tables with bench seating rest opposite the serving counter.  A large, colorful mural of an overflowing horn of plenty covers one of the walls.  The opposite wall is filled entirely with windows, which look out onto a beautiful flower garden.  A service door rocks slightly back and forth, sending the wonderful aromas from the kitchen spilling out into the room.

title: [[Orphanage, Kitchen]]
description: Busy cooks are diligently preparing ingredients on the central granite countertop.  Several open windows fight a futile battle in an attempt to cool the massive, furnace-like kitchen.  The aroma of wood smoke and baking breads permeate the room amid the sounds of bubbling stews and chopping knives.  A bank of brick ovens and cast-iron stoves line the wall opposite the swinging door that leads to the dining area.

title: [[Private Home Interior]]
description: Walls of polished ironwood and a polished flamewood floor covered by a thick rug of iridescent black silk dyed with a crosshatching of silver enclose this room.  In one corner lies an overstuffed dark sana'ati trundle bed with down pillows, and near the bed sits a low khor'vela wood table with a haralun bastard sword with a tempered blade and an orange globe of Jack-o-Lantern gin painted with smeary black glittered eyes on it.  A black marble fireplace with a gilded mantle burns along the far wall with a crinkled poster with a stick figure of a cat above the words "Lost!  Reward!" hanging above it.  The room holds a lingering scent of cloves.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Office of Citizenry]]
description: Silk cushions in colors of rose and foam-green line the pale screened walls of this office.  A long dark carved table stands in the middle of the room with a young clerk waiting there patiently for the next new citizen of Surlaenis.  Collages of seashells and sponges hang from the dark beamed ceiling and often chime with any sudden breeze.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Courtyard]]
description: Soaring white quartz columns line the courtyard, supporting the overhanging roof and creating a two-story cloister lit by dozens of brass and glass lamps.  Pale blue marble and white quartz tiles covering the floor have been interlocked in a subtle pattern that creates a sense of the open ocean, with a round raised garden in the center.  The sounds of the street filter in only faintly through the polished bronze bars of the front gate, and matching bronze stairways climb up to either side.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Council Chamber]]
description: Built into the living rock of the slope up from the central lake, the council chamber's back wall is raw basalt.  Midway across it, a stream flows down the jagged rock, dancing off projections to fall quietly into a narrow pool at the base.  In front of the pool, twelve unadorned chairs are arranged at a long table.  The rest of the room is filled with simple polished wooden armchairs for spectators.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Home Permits Office]]
description: The office for obtaining permits and licenses is pleasantly lit by a shell-shaped lantern that hangs from the rafters overhead.  A soft-spoken clerk sits behind a counter of carved pale wood, her head bent as she studies the records before her.  A row of large silk cushions stands along one side of a low table topped with a vase of fresh flowers.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Home Exchange Office]]
description: The straw mats that form the floor create a zig-zag pattern in pale colors of wheat and cream.  A clerk sits behind a high counter with papers stacked neatly in piles for review or filing.  A breeze from an open screen brushes across them, fluttering the corners of the paper softly.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Western Cloister]]
description: The balcony runs to the north, with doors leading into various offices along the western side.  A polished brass railing runs between gleaming white quartz columns, providing security and a perfect view of the courtyard below.  From this angle, you can see that in the middle of the central garden is a tiny pool, surrounded by screening bushes that hide it from view at ground level.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Northern Cloister]]
description: The wide balcony stretches the width of the courtyard's northern edge, with the overhanging roof creating a sheltered and shady retreat.  Between the closed doors leading into the building are low planters, each holding a miniature tree, aged-looking, gnarled, and bent.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Northern Cloister]]
description: A small set of silvery wind chimes hangs from the eaves of the roof, creating a musical counterpoint to conversation at the slightest breath of wind.  Overhead, rubbed copperwood planks have been laid in swirling patterns that gleam even in the shady retreat of the cloister.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Shipping Office]]
description: The room is divided by a low copperwood railing running from one side to the other.  Behind it are several battered desks, and the walls are covered with large charts showing lists of cargos, ships, and prices.  Occasionally a harried-looking clerk scurries in and scribbles a new listing.  The front area of the room is furnished with several plush, comfortable-looking armchairs set around an intricately patterned jewel-toned carpet.

title: [[Tribunal Building, Eastern Cloister]]
description: White paper walls interspersed with occasional copperwood doors form the eastern wall.  Opposite them, a polished brass railing runs between the gleaming white quartz pillars spanning the full two-story height of the building.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Courtyard]]
description: A sculpture fashioned from driftwood rests at the center of the bright courtyard.  Light reflects off the pale stone and paper screen walls, while the overhanging roof softens any glare.  Kelpbells grow throughout the space in curving flowerbeds that create a visual dance of shape and texture.  The slightest breeze bends the plants gracefully, further enlivening the rhythmic play for the eyes.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Main Hall]]
description: The tiled floor of the main entry hall recalls a flowing stream of water rushing over a grid of stones.  A tall willow tree, planted in a massive wooden crate, spreads its limbs above, the tendrils of fluttering leaves drooping in graceful arcs.  Overhead, stone columns support a two-story rise to the ceiling above.  Several white quartz arches on the floor above, and to the north and south lead into study rooms of the library.  A carved wooden staircase to the west ascends to the second floor.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Language Study Room]]
description: Comfortably cushioned chairs are grouped beneath overhead oil lamps.  Faded rugs soften footsteps and preserve the hushed atmosphere.  A bank of bookshelves on the east and one on the west divide the space into two smaller sections.  At the end of the room, a glass case houses an illuminated manuscript, carefully protecting it from any idle touch.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Study Room]]
description: This section of the library is devoted to scientific studies, ranging from natural history to alchemy.  Beakers on the top of the book shelves demonstrate various chemical processes and dried, pressed specimens of plants and preserved insects are displayed beneath glass cases.  Chairs and a single large table are positioned near the paper screen walls to allow for good reading light.  A low bookcase circles the room and is filled with all manner of books upon such scientific subjects.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Shoan Sulihean]]
description: In a small alcove beneath the stairs, an Elothean scribe sits behind a large wooden table, staring at a piece of parchment and muttering to himself.  Puzzles of all types lie on the table, as well as several books of riddles.  A large sign hangs on the wall behind him.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Upper Hall]]
description: The upper hall functions as a balcony and looks down on the main entrance below.  The splendid tile floor fashioned as a rushing stream of blues and pale green colors is best viewed from this angle.  White quartz archways lead into three additional study rooms, and lanterns shaped in fantastical shell shapes emit a softly glowing light.  Carpet runners soften footsteps along the pale wooden floor.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Spiritual Studies Room]]
description: This study room is a splendid pattern of dark and light, the wooden screen walls framed with ebonwood slats and pure white oiled-paper panels.  The floor is an inlaid design of dark and light woods in a spiraling formation, and the structure of the bookcases echoes the proportions of the screen walls.  Primitive stone carvings of the thirteen immortals rest in shell-shaped niches at regular intervals.  A table and chairs stand in the center of the room.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Magical Studies Room]]
description: Pale screen walls glow softly with the filtered light from outside, filling the room with a soothing light.  Rows of bookcases hold glass or crystalline shelves laden with books upon the subjects of magic.  Low tables, each with a glowing gaethzen sphere, are surrounded by worn cushions on which students may sit.  A polished sandalwood telescope points toward an observation window set into the ceiling.

title: [[Misrel Lemicus'a, Poetry and Music Room]]
description: Pale images of musical instruments -- a flute, a harp, a drum -- decorate the paper screen walls of the study.  Books of music and poetry are piled carelessly upon low bookshelves.  An old carpet covers the floor, the once bright colors stained with dark ink splotches.  Despite the jumble, the overstuffed chairs and water-stained round wooden table give the room a comfortable, inviting air, making it a quiet place for friends to gather, instead of just a sterile place of study.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Inn Stables]]
description: A green swath of grass, neatly clipped, forms a small lawn in front of a compact but clean and well-kept stable tucked beside the Inn.  The path back to the street is hard-packed dirt sprinkled with clean straw, and lined along each edge with a row of grey cobblestones.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Inn Stables]]
description: Huge skylights cut in the tiled roof allow daylight to stream in, illuminating the rows of wooden stalls.  Stable boys scurry here and there, bringing food and water for the animals, and their conversations mingle with the soft sounds of horses stamping the straw-covered earthen floor.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Courtyard]]
description: Carved driftwood benches cluster around the huge bole of an ancient tree, its thick overhead branches and broad leaves deflecting rain and weather.  A crushed-shell pathway encircles the trunk and leads up to a grand doorway at the far end of the courtyard, sheltered by a generously overhanging blue-tiled roof.  The substantial exterior beams supporting the roof are carved with mingled Elothean and Elven script so that the effect is more of pattern and shape than discernible words.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Entry Hall]]
description: The ceiling soars high overhead, a puzzle of crossing and joined beams, brightly illuminated by windows filling the top half of the front and rear walls.  The floor is crystalline-etched in swirling patterns that give the impression of sea foam.  Low planters divide small conversation nooks filled with couches and soft padded chairs.  A glass door to the rear leads to a garden area.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Partaking Garden]]
description: A broad patio of grey flagstones spans almost the entire rear of the inn, covered by a glazed lattice that admits the sunlight and helps maintain a comfortable temperature.  Glass-topped tables are scattered among young silver plum trees, a few in private corners, and are separated from the lawn beyond by low planters heaped with blooming plants.  In the distance, Lake Chawalkas sparkles beyond the white quartz menhir of the First Stone of the Cloud.

A broad patio of grey flagstones spans almost the entire rear of the inn, covered by a glazed lattice that allows a view of the night sky.  Glass-topped tables are scattered among young silver plum trees sparkling with tiny lights, a few in private corners, and the scent of blooming flowers from the lawn beyond scents the air.  In the distance, bright streaks on the water reveal where night boaters on Lake Chawalkas pursue their business, or their romances.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Serenity Garden]]
description: A high, plain wooden fence surrounds the area, cutting off sounds and distractions and leaving only a sense of peace.  At its base, low evergreen shrubs have been trimmed into a uniform hedge.  A crushed white shell pathway encircles the garden, with four benches placed at spaced intervals.  In the center is a large, wind-cut boulder, covered in green lichen on its north side, and surrounded by raked sand.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Garden of the Senses]]
description: Water trickles down a large stack of randomly fallen boulders, creating tiny and large waterfalls and a constant peaceful background for quiet conversation.  Crystal goblets have been placed nearby, allowing visitors to enjoy the icy cold water.  Fragrant k'dira bushes, blooming roses, and lyrandia vines planted in clumps perfume the air and delight the eyes.  Copperwood benches have been carved and polished into intricate shapes that invite fingers to explore.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Dance Floor]]
description: The flagstones have been polished and waxed to a mirror finish, providing a smooth surface underfoot for dancing.  The fragrance of the garden flowers and the soft strains of music from somewhere nearby create an intimate atmosphere for a romantic tete-a-tete.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Hallway]]
description: Mats of woven fresh tules besparkled with tiny shells along the outer edges lead down a broad hallway.  An abstract etching of a soaring albatross done in pale pastels hangs on the wall.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Hallway]]
description: Mats of woven fresh tules besparkled with tiny shells along the outer edges lead down a broad hallway.  An abstract etching of a crab done in pale pastels hangs on the wall.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Hallway]]
description: Mats of woven fresh tules besparkled with tiny shells along the outer edges lead down a broad hallway.  An abstract etching of a sea turtle done in pale pastels hangs on the wall.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Hallway]]
description: Mats of woven fresh tules besparkled with tiny shells along the outer edges lead down a broad hallway.  An abstract etching of a nautilus shell done in pale pastels hangs on the wall.

title: [[Inn of the Crystal Wave, Guestroom]]
description: The wall screens depict crashing waves with flecks of sparkling foam under pale blue sunshine-filled skies.  Silken coverlets and pillows in silvery blue embroidered with milky thread are piled upon the sleeping mat.  Plump cushions provide comfortable seating for intimate conversations.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Courtyard]]
description: An elegantly raked gravel walkway meanders toward the house, diverting around a burbling marble fountain on its way.  Delicate paper lanterns stand ready for the coming of night, protected from the elements by cunning metal caps.  A narrow garden surrounds the fountain, containing lovingly tended orchids and birds of paradise.  The east and west wings of the house shelter the courtyard from the winds.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Courtyard]]
description: Bordered by delicate paper lanterns, the walkway ends at the foot of a large teak door bound in iron.  A plush garden carpets the ground before the front walls of the house.  Startlingly lush and exotic blooms appear here and there throughout the garden as the dense growth sways in the gentle courtyard breezes.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Foyer]]
description: Polished cedar flooring reflects back the faint glow of the oil lamps that light the area.  Walls of thin, bone-white rice paper stretch between sturdy wooden supports, while intricate Elothean knot patterns decorate the high ceiling between the trusses.  The east wing is dedicated to worship and study, while the west wing leads to the private chambers of those who help to maintain this household.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Hallway]]
description: Small oil lamps line the delicate rice paper walls, their warm glow casting soft shadows throughout the hallway that leads deeper into this once grand mansion turned monastery.  A large archway provides access to the chapel area, a place for quiet meditation and worship by the inhabitants and caretakers.  A bamboo runner softens the floor, continuing eastward toward the offices and library.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Hallway]]
description: A stream of water endlessly trickles down a seemingly random pile of polished rocks placed in the center of the room, falling into a low pool filled with tiny blue and yellow striped fish.  Light streams through broad windows forming the southern wall, highlighting gleams of copper in the polished cedar floor planks.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, East Wing]]
description: Large ebony-framed windows admit the daylight to reflect from the rice paper walls, warming the area and chasing darkness from even the deepest of corners.  Outside, the courtyard garden blooms in an exuberant display of artistically-arranged color, and the faint scent of the blossoms drifts through the hall.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, East Wing]]
description: Paintings adorn the walls at intervals, set against a simple backdrop of rice paper panels.  Though some of the artwork has faded over time, most show recent restoration work.  Beneath them, a low planter holds a miniature tree sweeping its branches toward the ground in an elegant arch.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Chapel]]
description: Rows of brightly polished pews bisected by a plush red carpet lead toward the altar where religious services are held for the residents.  Covering the walls are rich tapestries, each of which depict one of the races of the Empire of the Seven-Starred Crown.  On the far wall is a large stained glass window in colors of tawny gold and brown, so subtly interwoven that it only gradually reveals itself to be the image of a regal lion.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, East Wing]]
description: A large window unobstructed by hangings allows a sweeping view of the courtyard garden through leaded glass panes.  Now unlit, small oil lamps stand ready for the coming of night.  An open sliding door leads into the library, a haven for scholars in search of knowledge.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, Isinrel]]
description: Scores of books fill the plain shelves lining the walls of the room, many written by Ilerthan herself.  A low table, surrounded by scholars of all races, rests in the center of the room.  A priest of Lemicus dusts the books and shelves.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, West Wing]]
description: Set into the west wall is a large window made up of small panes of frosted glass held in place by a wrought-iron framework.  The color of the glass shades from purest white to the blue of the sky over the ocean on a cloudless spring day.  The daylight streaming through it creates the illusion that the room is suspended somewhere in the heavens, illuminating the master artistry of the subtle pattern and the interplay of the colors.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, West Wing]]
description: A row of doors is set into the western wall, and opposite them across a stretch of polished cedar floor is a low black-lacquered table.  Placed to one side on the table is a translucent carved jade vase, holding a tumble of fresh geshiloira flowers accented by a single upright twig.

title: [[Ger Ilerthan, West Wing]]
description: Thick, translucent paper, sheltered from the elements by the overhanging roof outside, forms the eastern wall.  At the end of the hallway, an anlas candle burns steadily, wafting the faint smell of incense into the air.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Spectator Hallway]]
description: A short hallway leads from the front of the building to the viewing room, where members can watch council meetings.  A slender royal blue runner carpets footfalls, preventing heavy steppers from disturbing those in attendance.  The walls display portraits of prominent estate holders, past and present.

title: [[Estate Holders' Headquarters, Spectator Gallery]]
description: This auditorium provides a place from which the council chambers can be viewed when a meeting is in session.  Comfortable benches, padded in port wine-colored velvet, are arrayed in rows facing a glass window which affords a clear look at the proceedings.  The walls are a finely lacquered teak.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Private Seats]]
description: Several rows of leather-clad seats offer plenty of room to sit and cheer on a favored combatant.  Plush damask draperies cover the back and side walls of this exclusive viewing box, while a polished teak railing separates the spectators from the gladiators below.  Opposite the exit flap, a small buffet offers a few choice tidbits for the parched or hungry pit fanatic.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Antechamber]]
description: Granite benches divide the room into a central square surrounded by a wide onyx-floored walkway.  Within the square, a pillar of twisting flames roar up from a wrought-iron brazier with the commanding vigor of a berserker's rage.  Banners and tapestries depicting fierce battle scenes line the antechamber's walls.

title: [[Cha'walkas, Beside the Pier]]
description: At the shore beside the salt-encrusting pilings of the dock, several sailors cluster about a stained wooden sign, arguing over who has seen the worst storm.  A small two-man boat is tied to the pier, a set of oars inside.

title: [[Shh'yris's Forge, Public Rentals]]
description: The small back room is barren of furnishings except for a large oak table set up against the stone wall.  Soft light filters down a short flight of stone steps leading out through the west wall.  Leading eastward, back to Shh'yris's workspace, is an arched passage.

title: [[Joirin's Puzzles]]
description: Colorful baskets painted in every shade of the rainbow hang from the rafters, holding wood and other supplies for the puzzle maker.  The wicker and rattan containers provide a sharp contrast to the stark white paper walls of the shop itself.  A gilt-edged black leather catalog rests atop a fringed red silk shawl which has been draped over the counter.

title: [[Joirin's Puzzle Shop, Back Room]]
description: Several halfling children, each seated at a small table, labor industriously to build the puzzles their father sells in his shop.  An older woman walks among the children, helping them with the more difficult parts.  A large sign hangs on the wall opposite the wooden door leading out.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Willow Park]]
description: The sound of crickets and frogs engaging in their nightly chorus echoes across the still waters of the pond.  A narrow white gravel path is bathed by the moonlight, like a pearl necklace surrounding the velvety dark waters.  The children who enliven the park by day have long since found their beds, leaving the night to young lovers who sit on wrought iron benches, exchanging kisses as they talk.

The air is filled with the sound of children's laughter as they race along the shore of the pond, diving off the dock or flying down a slick rock slide to land with a splash in the dark waters. Nearby, local residents of all ages strive to perform a graceful series of stylized combat movements under the guidance of an elderly Elothean man.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Chui'mysanda Shyrel'nor Fundisoli]]
description: Lush rose bushes fill the air with a heady fragrance in the garden at the center of the school's courtyard.  Young men and women of good families stroll the soft mulched pathways, accompanied by stern duennas to chaperone their behaviour.  A mischievous young man gives you a wink from his perch atop the garden wall.

title: [[Isendry's Weapons Training, Harti]]
description: Thick paper walls surround the courtyard, painted with images of crashing waves.  Dark blue flowers grow opposite the steel gate leading back to the street.  The delicate chiming of steel upon steel echoes through a paper screen door in the western wall.

title: [[Isendry's Weapons Training, Entrance]]
description: Bright light streams through the paper screen door leading to the courtyard.  Through a white birch archway, figures engage each other in a dance of blades, their weapons flashing in the light.  A large sign hangs upon the northern wall.

title: [[Isendry's Weapons Training, Salle]]
description: A circle of dark rosewood is polished smooth from the hundreds of men and women who have danced the blades on its surface.  The paper walls are painted with images describing the various positions of the siressa nijare'a.  Isendry's office lies to the west.

title: [[Isendry's Weapons Training, Office]]
description: Blademistress Isendry sits behind a desk piled high with applications for entry into her school.  A shelf set against the northern wall is filled with various trophies won by the Elven lady.  Opposite the shelf is a rack where two curved swords, nisrotan of the siressa nijare'a, are on display.

title: [[Atop the Ledge]]
description: The dark basalt ledge looks southward over the lake, and gusts of wind brush dust and grit scuttering over the stone's surface.  A small clump of gorse clings to a crevice of soil and whispers and clicks as it scratches against the rock.

title: [[DiSilveron, Front Gate]]
description: Grand alabaster lions flank a regal wrought-iron gate that is accented in heavy silver leaf.  To either side of these gargantuan works of art are high hedges of jasmine intertwined with woodrose, which continue on for several yards before banking out of sight.  A silver-tinged, multi-gabled roof is visible just above the hedges.

Several torches flicker from beyond a wrought-iron gate that makes its sudden appearance in a high, jasmine-scented hedge.  Two ominous statues, silhouetted against the lighter night sky, sparkle with faint traces of silver which glisten in the scant light.  Their eyes glow with an inner fire.

title: [[Town Hall Lobby]]
description: The entrance to the town's civil nerve center is simple and businesslike.  Pale grey stone floor and white-washed walls allow little in the way of decor, but are functional.  Opposite the main entrance is the Licensing and Debt Office where citizens handle matters of taxation, fines and public debts owed.  A sweeping staircase leads to the upper floor.

title: [[Town Hall, Debt Office]]
description: Depressingly like any office anywhere in all the realms you have travelled, this one is obviously where people come to part with money that someone else thinks they can spend more wisely.  A bored clerk behind a worn counter patiently answers questions and takes payments from all comers.  The floor, once a soft grey, has been scuffed and rubbed into a dingy mud color that no scrubbing will ever alleviate.

title: [[Town Hall, Upper Landing]]
description: The decor here is somewhat more elaborate than the utilitarian mode of the ground floor.  The office of the Mayor and the Hall of Public Assembly bring the great and powerful to gather.  The walls, washed a soft cream, are hung with paintings of past mayors, each wearing a suitably aloof expression.  A glass case to one side holds a large ship's model.

title: [[Town Hall, Mayor's Office]]
description: This office defines luxury.  The walls are covered in tooled leather and burled flamewood.  A huge desk of tiger-striped oak dominates the room.  High-backed chairs of soft-cushioned leather await the lordlings of the city.

title: [[Town Hall, Hall of Public Assembly]]
description: This hall is designed to hold the major portion of the town's gentry for important meetings.  Padded benches form long curved rows facing a raised speaker's platform.  The decor is subdued but elegant, with figured walnut and dark burgundy velvet hangings as the major features.  Only one odd note mars the sober and reserved scene, a painting on one wall seems oddly out of place.

title: [[Langenfirth, Up an Oak Tree]]
description: Crisp clean air flows through the treetop.  From this height, one can easily spy the light stream of smoke billowing from a small cabin nestled among the trees to the north and the commercial hub of the outpost holding off the encroachment of the wilderness to the east.

title: [[Langenfirth, Up a Tall Pine Tree]]
description: Amongst the blue needles and pine cones of this large tree an offering of solitude for the occasional tree-sitter is provided.  Off to the west the outlines of cabins pollute the horizon of this once wild land.

title: [[Langenfirth, Up a Swaying Fir Tree]]
description: Trying to perch at the tree's top is difficult, for the thin branches offer only a tenuous hold.  The fir provides little shelter from the frequent stiff wind that blows through the area, but from up here it is a simple matter to track the progress of the frequent visitor heading into the swamps to the south.

title: [[Langenfirth, Perched in a Birch Tree]]
description: The narrow birch branch trembles with the weight of unwelcome visitors.  Wisps of wind carry the sound of water faintly lapping against the outpost's dock.  Far below, one can see the faint trace of an animal trail leading to the swamps.

title: [[Small Cabin, Room]]
description: The bare logs of the walls have not even been stripped of bark.  A narrow bunk, with a thin mattress and a ragged gray wool blanket, is attached to one wall across the room from the door.  A wood table sits in the center of the small room with a lantern placed on it.  While small and sparsely furnished, the room is very tidy.

title: [[Town Hall, Main Room]]
description: There is not much government in Langenfirth and that is reflected in the Town Hall.  All that is ever handled here is the simple payment of taxes and debts.  The hall has a homey feel to it, furnished to resemble someone's home.  Several chairs sit near a fireplace, and there is a well worn rug on the floor.  A ledger sits on a shelf covered with a thick layer of dust.

title: [[Town Hall, Office]]
description: The room is less office than personal living quarters.  A desk and a cot fill part of the room, while ledgers and stacks of trading records fill up most of the empty floor space.  Dust coats everything and motes fly about with every draft through the open door.  It does not appear that even the Mayor uses this place very often.  A clerk reads through various ledgers trying to determine who still owes debts and who has paid.

title: [[The Fur Exchange, Trading Office]]
description: The Exchange is one of the busiest places in Langenfirth.  Hunters and trappers arrive constantly with new piles of hides and pelts from the northern hills.  Traders regularly arrive delivering goods from the south or looking for some select furs to buy on speculation.

title: [[The Fur Exchange, Trading Floor]]
description: Traders roam this room, inspecting the piles of hides and furs, looking for the best bargain.  The shouts of dickering parties can get very loud at times and occasionally end up in a shoving match.  The commodity boards are reflected on the glass top of the counter, though difficult to read.

title: [[Langenfirth, A Simple Lean-To]]
description: Several flat pieces of wood lay precariously upon some makeshift sawhorses, creating shelves for the wares sold in this quickly constructed shop.  Sawdust thrown on the ground makes for cushioned stepping and defines the area well.  Several clerks stand about talking to each other, barely noticing any customers who enter.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Hall]]
description: This large rustic hall is lined with many wooden benches guarded by trophy heads mounted high on the walls among an exquisite collection of bows, crossbows, arrows and bolts.  A raised platform against the far wall bears flickering torches and a large awards case that proudly displays honors achieved by guild members.

title: [[Cabin, Front Room]]
description: The main room of this cabin is furnished with a table and a rocking chair.  A stone fireplace with a wood mantelpiece has a warm fire glowing in it.  A bearskin rug lies across the hearth making the room very homey and comfortable.  Log steps nailed to the wall provide a way to reach an upper loft area.  The door is closed firmly but the window is unshuttered with a nice view of the street.

title: [[Cabin, Loft]]
description: Most of the loft is filled with a straw mattress covered in muslin.  The peaked roof gives plenty of headroom in the center, but descends to the floor along the walls.  This is a cozy sleeping area, separate from the living area downstairs, and warmed by the heat of the fireplace rising upward.

title: [[Tinker's End, Repair Shop]]
description: A surly, grouchy dwarf sits near a pile of broken armor and cooking utensils banging away at dents.  Down on his luck he had, years ago, opened this shop to make a few coins.  Since then he has re-edged, banged out dents, grumbled, and complained but never quite made enough money, or so he says, to get back to his mining.  In a large bin are a number of odd things for sale, apparently items brought in for repair but never picked up.

title: [[Langenfirth, Stock Pens]]
description: Several pigs, a goat and some sheep mill about a small wooden pen.  While the towns tradesmen expect hard coin from travelers and traders, with the locals they will often barter stock for services or products.  The floor of the pen is covered with wet, mucky straw and the pen smells of both fresh and well-aged manure.  Over the years this small holding pen was built simply to keep the locals' "currency" from wandering about and bothering visitors.

title: [[Langenfirth, Caravan Reed Barn]]
description: This barn was made for wealthy travelers wishing to stable their animals while in Langenfirth.  With its woven reed walls and raised slat flooring, animals are kept relatively warm and dry.  Several stable lads make sure that the animals in their charge are well-fed and watered and that the stalls are mucked out regularly.

title: [[Bowyer Shop, Jarrod's Quarters]]
description: The backroom serves as both home and workshop for Jarrod.  A master tracker and hunter, he is used to living in the woods without amenities, and that shows in the sparse quarters.  On a low table is a work in progress, either a special order or a newly designed bow.

title: [[Net and Bait, Fish Market]]
description: The market reeks of fish although it sells a variety of goods.  Once nothing more than a shop for bait, it now buys the local catch and sells many sundries along with the fish to travelers and locals alike.  A large barrel marked "Today's Special" sits in a corner near the door.  Shelves of sundries line the wall and there is a selection of tackle along another.  The sound of fish being slapped hard on wood, and the rending sound of a knife through scales is heard from the back.

title: [[Gwenalion Marina, Seord Dock]]
description: Neatly coiled ropes lie next to highly polished anchors on this well tended dock.  Sailors hurry about their daily business, lugging cargo and moving briskly from ship to shore.  Shouting is heard from the ships as they make their passage safely to shore.

Lanterns flicker in the night with their flames dancing against the waters below.  Sailors lounge about at their leisure, done with their daily chores of lugging cargo and swabbing decks.  Singing is heard from the ships as they make their way back after a few drinks at the nearby taverns.

title: [[Gwenalion Marina, Zelka Dock]]
description: Heavy waves lap against the docks, often splashing water on its new wooden structure.  Families stroll around the area, gazing at the different ships, looking for fresh fish to buy, and stopping to feed the little birds nearby that call the sea their home.

Dark seas stir, lapping against the dock with a slight lulling tune.  Lanterns bring soft lighting, their flames flickering against the water below.  Seagulls rest among piles of rope and gear till the next day's dawning.

title: [[Gwenalion Marina, Fulmi Dock]]
description: Barrels of fish are neatly stacked by boxes of cargo that are ready to be delivered to market.  Seabirds squawk as they argue with one another over a piece of dropped fish or a favored stoop to land on.

title: [[Calliana Leather Goods, Work Room]]
description: The workroom of the shop is awash with scraps. Bits and pieces of leftover hides are strewn about the tables and floor.  On a long worktable are several leather items in various states of repair, and on a nearby rack are the beginnings of several new projects.  Well cared for tools and sharp needles are arranged on a high shelf.

title: [[Tower of Honor, Training Room]]
description: Racks of weaponry line all four walls, an impressive array gleaming from the shelves.  Everything from wooden practice staves to polished steel broadswords are available for use.  Padded mats on the floor help to prevent injury if students become over-eager.

title: [[Tower of Honor, Chapel]]
description: An exquisitely carved ivory statue is the centerpiece of this small chapel.  Representing Chadatru, the traditionally honored god of Paladins, the statue dominates the area with its presence.  Brilliantly colored stained glass windows cast multihued shadows over the wooden pews radiating outward from Chadatru's icon.

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Shore]]
description: The dull brown water of Lake Gwenalion is shallow at the shore.  Rippling waves lap the dark loamy earth giving the water its odd hue.  The gentle swells toss small sticks and dead leaves against the beach and carry them away again.  Up and down the lake various geese and ducks paddle back and forth in the tepid shallows, while further out over the lake herons circle lazily watching the surface for a glint of scales.

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Edge]]
description: The wind blows steadily off the lake tossing white caps across the center of the lake.  In the shelter of the cove the breeze barely ripples the surface of the knee-deep water.  The shallows serve as a safe haven for fry, young fish and a family of mallard ducklings.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: Columns of stone sprout from the floor and tower up into the web-veiled reaches of the high ceiling.  Nine of the mammoth shafts connect floor and ceiling like living fibers stretching between rent flesh.  The cavern is easily fifty paces across at its widest point and at least half as high.  Ropes of webbing connect the upper reaches of the pillars in intricate patterns which shift and glimmer with each vibration.

title: [[Lofty Perch]]
description: A small ledge juts from the side of the column near the ceiling, just wide enough to stand on comfortably.  Instead of walls, the ledge is ringed by the complex webs built all about the upper portion of the cavern.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the wide column.  Thick strands of silk, anchored to the sturdy stone, create difficult obstacles.  Several planes of webbing stretch across the upper reaches of the high cavern, providing easy access to all areas by whatever creature fashioned them.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Lobby]]
description: Leading down from the circular door, a small set of hardwood steps guides patrons to the welcoming entrance area of the bakery.  Thick, woven rugs cover the dirt floor, enhancing the rustic feel set in place by the handcrafted furniture.  Various aromas drift through the room from the bounty of tasty treats available for purchase in the depths of the shop.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Enchanting Exotics]]
description: Hung from the ceiling, decorative vines dangle sparkling gem-dusted leaves and brightly colored feathers.  Indigo gingham cloths cover the counter and tables set up around the room, each surface piled high with pastries to tempt the palate.  Despite the dirt floor, the area retains an aura of cleanliness and refinement.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Charmingly Chocolate]]
description: Hung from the ceiling, decorative vines dangle diminutive spotted cows and real cocoa beans.  Brown gingham cloths cover the counter and tables set up around the room, each surface piled high with pastries to tempt the palate.  Despite the dirt floor, the area retains an aura of cleanliness and refinement.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Meatlicious Meatiness]]
description: Hung from the ceiling, decorative vines dangle miniature leather steaks and thin strips of paper bacon.  Red gingham cloths cover the counter and tables set up around the room, each surface piled high with pastries to tempt the palate.  Despite the dirt floor, the area retains an aura of cleanliness and refinement.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Fabulously Fruity]]
description: Hung from the ceiling, decorative vines dangle painted wooden strawberries and tiny silk blossoms.  Orange gingham cloths cover the counter and tables set up around the room, each surface piled high with pastries to tempt the palate.  Despite the dirt floor, the area retains an aura of cleanliness and refinement.

title: [[Thipbeet's Tart Boutique, Liquored Loveliness]]
description: Hung from the ceiling, decorative vines dangle stained glass bottles and small brass goblets.  White gingham cloths cover the counter and tables set up around the room, each surface piled high with pastries to tempt the palate.  Despite the dirt floor, the area retains an aura of cleanliness and refinement.

title: [[Exterior Motives]]
description: This poky shop houses a motley assortment of building supplies.  The quality of the materials stacked against the walls is questionable -- the wood is pocked and scarred with large knots and mildew, and the clay bricks have a crude, uneven appearance.  The presence of Mebblec Gumsroe behind the battered deobar counter indicates him to be the salesman, although his utter lack of interest in the customers seems a concerted effort to appear otherwise.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, Wild Rose Thicket]]
description: Pale pink roses blossom against thorny green leaves, growing in profusion in the dense thicket.  The trail twists and turns, following the hoofprints of countless generations of deer.  An intense fragrance perfumes the air, but all the roses in the world can't conceal the sickly-sweet stench of rotting meat that underlies it.

title: [[Korhege Apartments, First Floor]]
description: The surface of this hallway is an aquamarine sandstone, buffed to a dull, marbled sheen.  The firmly encased, calcified remains of small marine creatures lay scattered about the top of the floor, one a large, golden starfish and the other an opalescent sea conch.

title: [[Korhege Apartments, First Floor]]
description: A large, decorative walnut chest adorns the end of this corridor.  Above it, wall-mounted iron supports in the shape of wave-lapped seahorses uphold a pair of cylindrical glowstones.  A stairwell leads to the second floor.

title: [[Korhege Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: The sand in the corridor's surfaces, frozen in rolling, shaded blue patterns, imitates the flow of waves.  One wall reveals the skeleton of a boulder-sized sponge.  Another swarms with fragments of fish scales, sea-changed into mother-of-pearl.  A stairwell leads to the first floor.

title: [[Korhege Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: A set of tiles have been inlaid along the blue sandstone walls of this hallway.  Their ivory backgrounds are covered with geometric patterns featuring artemisia, purple variwinkle blossoms and k'dira leaves.  A stairwell leads to the third floor.

title: [[Lyneya's Hideaway, By the River]]
description: Large tangerine trees stand along the river's edge, their boughs providing a sheltered place to rest by the water.  Yellow and green flowers grow around the base of the trees.  In the distance, a fountain sits near a stone bridge that spans the river.  A small cottage with a wide wooden door is situated just past the bridge, surrounded by some flowers that have grown incredibly high.

title: [[Lyneya's Hideaway, A Small Cottage]]
description: A well-worn desk piled high with notes and folders is set in front of glass windows that provide a breathtaking view of the river.  Two wooden chairs, offering a place to sit for a discussion, face a small square table.  Some shelves decorate the wall, displaying various mementos and souvenirs.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Hierophant's Chamber]]
description: An intricate mosaic of gleaming gemstone tiles graces the otherwise gloomy stone wall above an ancient silverwillow bed.  Stained linens, shredded and tattered in some past struggle, hang off the bed and onto the cold stone floor.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: A stale, coppery stench fills the dark stone corridor.  Rust-colored stains, looking suspiciously like blood, mar the pale ash door in the southern wall.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Shadows drape the northeastern corner like lingering specters, unwavering in the feeble glare of makeshift torches affixed to rusty iron sconces in the walls.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: A flickering torch in the eastern wall casts a feeble glow down the dark stone corridor, barely forcing the shadows to abate.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Shards of clear crystal cover the dark stone ground, possibly relics fashioned by the absent inhabitants of the temple many years before.  Movement through the hallway has caused some of these shards to clump oddly against a black granite pedestal, as if protecting it.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Prison Hallway]]
description: An empty sconce hangs askew from one wall, the area around it scorched black.  Clumps of cobwebs, heavy with dust, enshroud the tarnished brass.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Ripped grey cotton tapestries drape the dark stone of the southern wall, once offering reverence to some now-unrecognizable deity.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: The stone corridor curves haphazardly, with jagged shards of dark grey stone jutting out of the southeastern corner.  An empty doorway with shattered remnants of wood hanging off it gapes open in the northwestern wall.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: The overwhelming stench of decay fills the dank corridor, emanating from a rotting alder door in the north wall.  Thin patches of unidentifiable mold mark random trails on the cold damp walls, almost like sinister handprints left by an unearthly child.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Across from a cracked ash door, an empty rusted iron sconce juts out of the northern wall.  The shadows here drape heavily, choking what feeble light flickers from down the hallway.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: A rusted iron rack hangs in the northwestern corner, bearing several implements of war.  An omnipresent, distant chanting rises and falls in your ears, carrying eerily through the corridor.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Shattered chips of mahogany lie scattered over the cold stone floor before an empty doorway in the eastern wall.  A remnant of ripped cloth hangs from the door's smashed iron hinge.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: The chill air is dank and sour, carrying the stenches of decay, dried blood, and stale dust.  The corridor branches to the east, wending further into the forgotten temple.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: Barely attached to its rusted iron hinges, a battered pine door hangs crookedly from the northern wall.  Scraps of rotting cloth lie strewn about the floor, perhaps serving as nightly shelter for the errant rat or two, as evidenced by trails of dried droppings.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: The curving corridor seems crude and haphazard, shards of jagged stone sticking out from the walls.  This temple was obviously constructed in haste, with an eye toward functionality rather than beauty.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Dark Hallway]]
description: A scarred alder door in the eastern wall bears several heavy gashes, perhaps the result of some past conflict.  Empty cobwebs hang forlornly from the narrow corners of the stone ceiling.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Prison Hallway]]
description: Deep gouge marks mar the rough stone floor, as if something with very large claws was dragged in an unwilling manner through the passage.  Moisture has collected in some of the indentations, causing the floor to be slick in spots.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Hierophant's Chamber]]
description: An ancient silverwillow bed swathed in shredded silk linens sets against the southern wall.  A rich mahogany armoire inlaid with silver filigree stands nearby, flanked by an ornate blued-steel cloak rack.

title: [[Dilapidated Cabin, Tunnel]]
description: The rough rock forms a jagged arch overhead that curves to the south and northeast along the tunnel.  Piles of stones line the sides of the path, each scarred by chisel marks.

title: [[Mother Marilla's Clerical Supplies]]
description: Moonlight filters through the window's shutters, lending a soft glow to the white paper walls.  A crystal bowl filled with dried rosepetals sits on the windowsill, perfuming the cool night air with a faint sweet fragrance.  In the middle of the room, a young Halfling lass rubs her eyes as she perches atop a stool behind the counter, studying a scroll.  A catalog near her elbow lies open to display its table of contents.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Hemlock Forest]]
description: Young saplings crowd the undergrowth of the forest and create a dense mesh of vegetation impenetrable except where the trail forces its way through.  No animal, or even insect life, stirs about.  The only sound is the lulling whisper of hemlock needles as the branches sway in gentle winds high overhead.

title: [[Evike's Office, Foyer]]
description: In the middle of the domed ceiling, a large cut glass chandelier descends to illuminate the inlaid wooden floor in the center of the room.  Various stained glass skylights dot the ceiling in an artfully haphazard fashion, almost too dim to make out with only the chandelier's radiance for light.  Along the western wall, a long cloth-covered table has been covered with various objets d'art.  Against the opposite wall, a plush velvet settee rests on the pale green marbled flooring that runs the edge of the room, offsetting the large carved double door at the northern end of the room.

title: [[Evike's Office, Library]]
description: Sconces and tall candle stands dot intervals of floor space in this wooden paneled room as very little light enters in naturally from the one window connected to a garden to the east.
