title: [[North Tower, Aether Floor]]
description: Carpeting the color of a death shroud covers the floor, devouring the light as hungrily as Aldauth consumes souls.  The walls are devoid of decoration, instead painted a uniform black to match the floor.  Only the doors leading to initiates' cells betray any hint of color in this otherwise cold, bleak room.

title: [[Small Cottage, Living Area]]
description: Spotlessly clean, the small room contains only a table and four rickety chairs, a long cabinet with a washbasin perched on it, and a small fireplace built of rough-edged rock.  The walls have been carefully patched in several places, and covered with a fresh coat of whitewash.  Roughly sewn but bright and cheerful curtains hang at the window, and a teapot whistles softly from its hook in the hearth.

title: [[Small Cottage, Master Bedroom]]
description: A simple bed is pushed into the corner, covered with a faded but freshly washed comforter.  A large window on the northern wall gives a view of the church steeple rising from behind a ridge of tumbled rock not far off.  From this distance, the devastation of the village is invisible, and one could believe it was still filled with friends and neighbors.

title: [[Small Cottage, Children's Bedroom]]
description: Painted in a now faded light blue, the walls provide a sense of serenity, accentuated by the mural of Hodierna and Damaris on the eastern wall.  A small bed with a sleek panther carved on the deobar headboard sits beneath the window.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Work Area]]
description: Like a shell-laden beach, the ground here is laden with a myriad of items from bones, broken beads, twine, and metal shavings.  A large anvil rests next to a large forge that appears to double as a kiln.  Several Prydaen nearby appear to be stripping carcasses or working away at various crafts.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Inside A Hide Tent]]
description: Built upon sturdy sets of stilts, several hammocks with thick pallets are suspended, waiting to hold the weary.  A simple dirt floor is covered by thin hides, with a small rock encircled firepit set into the center of the room.  A hide flap provides both entrance and exit to the room.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Sitting Room]]
description: Soft robin's egg blue paper covers the walls of this large room, patterned with delicate arabesques in an even lighter shade of powder blue.  Several gaily-colored painted landscapes complement the rich hue of the paper, their heavy gilt frames resembling windows into perfect summer days.  The vibrant golden oak of the floor is muffled by a sumptuous woolen ivory rug with a deep, luxurious pile.  Several cheerful golden sconces provide bright -- but not harsh -- light, the oil they burn perfuming the air with a fresh citrus scent.

title: [[Lower Kaerna, Village Pond]]
description: A group of wooden benches sits at the edge of the pond beneath a swaying willow that dabbles its long fingers in the shallow waters.  Broad lilypads cover the surface of the pond, their white and purple flowers smiling up at the sky.  Fat fish swim lazily among the trailing mass of roots and reeds under a rickety jetty, taunting local anglers with the intermittent flash of light on silver scales.

title: [[Village Pond, The Old Jetty]]
description: Jutting out from a marshy section of the pond shore, an elderly jetty hovers over the water.  The wobbly, uneven surface of the walkway, and the occasional gap where one plank has fallen away completely, conspire to make an unplanned trip into the dark waters a distinct likelihood.  Bits of old bait and scraps of fishing line have attached themselves determinedly to splinters in the ancient wood.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Entry Hall]]
description: A front desk manned by a young Elven woman is all that composes this corridor-like room.  She smiles gently up at you from where she is working on embroidering a linen tunic with simple but bright flowers.  A sign behind her states the inn's fees for lodging, and stairs to her right lead up to the inn's bedrooms.

A front desk manned by a small Elven boy is all that composes this corridor-like room.  The boy nods at you as you enter, his elbows on an open ledger book and a bored look on his impish face.  A sign behind him states the inn's fees for lodging, and stairs to his right lead up to the inn's bedrooms.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Tavern]]
description: Spacious and open, the tavern allows for plenty of breathing room.  Axes, swords, and shields decorate the walls, all scratched with the wear of battle and all safely nailed in place that a patron might not grab one in a fit of drunken rage.  Situated behind the bar is a tall, muscular Elven woman with long red braids.  Judging from her demeanor and the way she handles the people who work and eat here, this can only be the owner, Savrin Kaerna.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Secluded Booth]]
description: This booth has been set aside from the rest of the tavern for those who wish more intimate conversation.  There is a clean table with a vase here, and padded seats for the weary.  Someone has gone to the trouble to make sure that there are real candles to light the otherwise darkened corner, and every now and then a server comes over to check the wicks and replenish the ones that are beginning to gutter.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Private Room]]
description: Small but comfortable, a cheery fireside takes up a good part of the eastern wall.  The floor is covered with fur throws and a few overstuffed chairs complement the feeling of security and warmth.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Quarters]]
description: This room is so tidy it is militant.  A small iron stove provides warmth, and a few cots in a corner are set up for sleeping purposes.  Someone has carelessly left a doll lying on the floor.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, Top of the Stairs]]
description: Plain instead of fancy, this corridor of rooms is spotless, the wood solid and slightly gray from the wear and tear of time.  You can just make out the sounds of the tavern proper below you, the noise creeping through the scuffed floorboards and faded red carpeting.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Tree House]]
description: This wooden house has been constructed in the upper branches of the old oak tree as a play area for any of the village children daring enough to venture up to this height.  A colorful rug braided from strips of yellow, blue and green cloth covers the floor, and several plump pillows are scattered around it.  One wall opens out to a narrow ramp that extends along a heavy branch.

title: [[Tree House, Ramp]]
description: The narrow wooden ramp extends out from the tree along one of its branches.  Oak leaves rustle softly around you, and through them the lights from Arthe Dale's homes twinkle like bright fireflies.  From somewhere off in the distance, the sweet melody of a lone flute hovers in the air.  Suspended high above the swimming hole, the branch is a good place for making an impressive dive into the water directly below.  An open doorway behind you leads back into the treehouse.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Caravan Stable]]
description: The fresh smell of hay and the sounds of snorts and whinnies fill the immaculately-tended stable.  The ponies belonging to the guests and the Burdock family are diligently looked after here by young Nubbin Burdock.  The young Halfling boy pauses in his grooming chores to pull a sicle fruit from his pocket and feed it to one of the ponies.

title: [[Farmer's Market, Refreshment Stand]]
description: The mouth-watering aroma of baking dough and cinnamon makes your stomach rumble as you examine the tempting treats displayed in the glass case.  A Halfling lass adds a tray of freshly baked crullers to the tantalizing array.

title: [[Small Dwelling, Main Room]]
description: The walls of this one-room cottage are painted a dappled pale blue and white.  Woven blue-green fabric shot with pale peach covers the bed and adjacent loveseat.  The white curtains on the window rise and fall gently with the breeze.  A carved walking stick rests on a workbench surrounded by tiny curls of wood.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Front Yard]]
description: Bright shapes of circles, crosses, crescents and stars glow mysteriously, floating in the darkness in front of you like a row of jack-o-lanterns.  You notice the dim silhouette of an oddly shaped building behind them, and you realize that the glowing shapes are brightly lit windows.  A sign has been mounted on the door of the house.

This long, low building is a strange and fascinating sight to behold.  Enlarged over the years by various creative builders, it contains several add-on sections, each constructed from completely different materials and each displaying its own oddly-shaped windows in the forms of circles, crosses, crescents and stars.  The many clashing parts manage to merge together into a whimsically enchanting whole.  A painted sign is mounted on the carved wooden door.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Living Room]]
description: The glow from the burning fireplace fills the room with a warm light.  An incredible collection of souvenirs, knickknacks, toys and various odds and ends fills every nook and cranny of the room, casting peculiarly-shaped shadows on the walls.

This cheerful room might once have been considered pleasantly decorated.  The lustrous sheen of the dark wood paneling and the artfully carved trim can still be seen in places, but much of the pleasant decor has been obscured by the incredible collection of souvenirs, knick-knacks, and various odds and ends that fill every nook and cranny.  As a result, the room has the same comfortable, thrown-together appeal as the outside of the house.  Several chairs are gathered cozily in front of a stone fireplace.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Woolly's Room]]
description: This austere room belongs to the head of the Tanglefoot family.  A narrow bed covered with a brown flannel blanket and a plain wooden table and chair are the only furnishings here.  An old worn duffel bag sits in the corner, unused for years, but never forgotten.  A small sword is mounted on the wall above a wooden rack holding several hand-carved pipes.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Nursery]]
description: This is the room that houses the youngest of the Tanglefoot clan.  There are several short beds here, each neatly covered with a colorful quilt, and each quilt covering the form of a small sleeping child.  A large wooden cupboard takes up most of one wall.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Dining Room]]
description: A huge oaken table dominates this large room.  This is the gathering place for the entire Tanglefoot clan.  A large assortment of straight-backed wooden chairs surround the long table, and a white runner edged with embroidered yellow butterflies and blue morning glories spans the length.  White ceramic candle sconces with the same butterflies and flowers are spaced regularly around the walls at a convenient height.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Kitchen]]
description: The kitchen is quiet and dark at this time of the night, but there are signs of someone's late snack left next to an old ice box.  The windows are open, and an evening breeze ruffles the curtains.  Ingredients for tomorrow morning's bread have been neatly arranged on the trestle table.

This cheery room is kept immaculately clean.  Round windows, curtained in bright yellow gingham, open out to the garden.  A reed basket, overflowing with crisp lettuce and bright red radishes, has been placed on a trestle table in front of the windows.  A brilliant blue pitcher filled with yellow tulips sits next to the basket.  The delicious aroma of baking bread wafts from a large oven.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Kitchen Garden]]
description: The bright moonlight reveals row after row of leafy plants in this orderly little garden.  A large snail leaves a wet iridescent trail across the back door stoop.  In the corner of the yard you can see the vague outline of a squat shed.

A small kitchen garden is set conveniently close to the back door of the house.  Neat rows of lettuce and spinach fill the plot with alternating stripes of pale and deep greens.  Off in the corner, you can see old Woolly Tanglefoot's personal crop of pipeweed.  A stone path curves from the door around to a small wooden shed.

title: [[Tanglefoot House, Shed]]
description: Neatly arranged hoes, rakes, spades and other garden tools line the walls.  Woven gathering baskets, some empty, some filled with bags of seeds, occupy one corner of the shed.  A wooden wheelbarrow has been left next to the door.  Bunches of drying herbs and flowers hang from the low ceiling.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Backstage]]
description: The men's and women's dressing rooms to the southeast and southwest and the prop storage room directly south are all accessed from this central hub of behind-the-scenes activity, resulting in a hectic atmosphere during rehearsals or performances.  All traffic seems to flow to the northeast, where the stage wing awaits performers, musicians, and on occasion, nervous financiers.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Women's Dressing Room]]
description: Shelves are available for costumes used in the current production, or for storing actors' own clothes during performances.  Padded benches and plush carpets provide comfort for those changing, and mirrors above a long shared vanity allow performers to apply stage makeup or check their appearance before going to the wings.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Prop Storage]]
description: Shelves and racks line every available portion of wall space, providing ample storage for props and costumes when not in use for the current show.  Gaethzen globes brightly light the room, so that needed items can be quickly located.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Men's Dressing Room]]
description: Shelves are available for costumes used in the current production, or for storing actors' own clothes during performances.  Padded benches and plush carpets provide comfort for those changing, and mirrors above a long narrow table allow performers to apply stage makeup or check their appearance before going to the wings.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Stage Wing]]
description: In contrast to the main backstage area, which is alive with activity when the theater is in use, this stage wing is quiet.  Performers and stage hands wait here for their cues to pass through the curtain and onto the stage.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Musicians' Pit]]
description: Stools and music stands wait in rows for use during performances.  Facing the stage, the conductor's stand is strategically located to allow for the direction of musicians and vocalists alike.  Off to the side, a box holds a bizarre collection of objects to be used for sound effects for productions.

title: [[Fillop's Knollshop]]
description: The dark earth walls of this round chamber are lined with fine green mosses and delicate white starflowers.  Her black eyes sparkling above rosy apple cheeks, a bustling Halfling woman beams brightly at her customers as she combines the latest gossip with an expert patter about the quality knoll landscapes she purveys.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Oak Tree]]
description: Thick branches stretch outward from the trunk of the tree, the crazy quilt of colorful grass and flowers below barely visible between the leaves.  The wide, knobby trunk provides an easy climb down to the safety of the ground.

title: [[Berry Knolls, Open Field]]
description: At the top of the mound, a large open field emerges.  Speckled with occasional gooseberry, thimbleberry, and mintberry bushes, it provides a perfect area for picnics or fairs.  Pink clover and sweet woodruff cover the ground profusely, marred only by several tamped down patches indicating where tents and wagons have previously rested.

title: [[Willow Walk, Water Lily Pool]]
description: Water trickling down from the fountain provides a constant musical backdrop.  Tiny fish swim among the floating water lilies, darting up to the surface occasionally to search for their next meal.  The water, coming from wells far below the surface, remains cool to the touch in every season.

title: [[Old Warehouse]]
description: The reek of dead fish permeates your nostrils making you feel ill.  Besides the stench, you notice piles and piles of old crates almost entirely filling this rotting deobar-paneled warehouse.  One of the crates in the corner has been smashed open, straw and broken glass spilling across the floor from it.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chamber]]
description: You find yourself on a slimy cobblestone floor in a dark, dank and smelly chamber.  Noxious trickles of effluent seep through tiny cracks in the tortured walls, which appear to be on the verge of collapse.  The hole in the rotted timber high above is hardly convenient for escape, and you realize with a chill that you must find another way out.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: The walls of this narrow corridor are closer than is comfortable.  Bits and pieces of once-glorious tapestries still cling to their surfaces, caked with crud and sagging from the weight of the water they have absorbed.  Certain stones in the wall threaten to fall at any moment, and the floor is smattered with debris.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Broken stones litter this part of the corridor.  The cobblestone floor is suddenly uneven, buckled by some ancient cataclysm.  A great boulder has punched its way through one wall, almost completely obstructing any northward progression.  Fine stress fractures trace the western wall, ending in a narrow crevice high above your head.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Tattered pieces of cloth are hung from rusted bars along each wall of this corridor.  While most of the fabric has disintegrated over time, a few remain somewhat complete, though dark splotches of mildew make it difficult to discern their patterns.  By the regularity of their placement, you gather that these are the remains of a series of heraldic banners.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Here you find a nearly intact raised mosaic floor.  Tiny tiles of many colors form patterns unlike any you've ever seen, its beauty still apparent despite the wreckage strewn about.  Touching one of the tiles, you are surprised to find it soft and pliable like cork, which might explain why this part of the corridor has endured the upheaval.  At the southern end, a great boulder has nearly blocked all passage in that direction.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Cubiculum]]
description: Scant light filters in from a narrow section of grating in the ceiling far above.  Looking about, you find yourself hemmed in by walls on three sides.  On the floor, you see a series of battered and broken tiles, remnants of some ancient artisan's work.  After careful study, you believe they depict a wizened old mage holding forth a pulsating crystal.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Passageway]]
description: Cascading nitre hangs thick along the walls of this passageway, which wends into utter darkness.  The fetid remains of a dead rat invite a host of vermin to keep you sorry company.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Passageway]]
description: A collapsed hallway twists and turns in the darkness, filled with great piles of stone and rotted timber.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Rotting deobar planks clotted with reeking sewage comprise the floor of this narrow corridor.  Thin streamers of decayed silk hang from rusting iron sconces, while soggy, mottled tapestries of indeterminate design lie clumped along the baseboards.  Nitre is thick and cloying, and a steamy heat envelopes you.  What is left of the floor slopes like a ramp, leading into darkness.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Stone walls and floors echo each footstep as you cautiously make your way along the slippery incline.  A soft scuffling and distant chitter cut through the darkness, assaulting your imagination.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Cobblestone strewn with sludge and debris stretches out in this cavernous hold, set with a large iron gate at one end.  Rubble from the broken foundations of the Close lies in piles in each corner.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Putrid water filters through cracks in the stone walls and cuts moist paths through the clinging nitre.  A large desk lies on its side, swollen and rotting from the surrounding puddles of muck.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Fetid puddles combined with the absence of fresh air give rise to a suffocating humidity.  Your mind's eye envisions all manner of vermin scaling the moist stone walls or crunching beneath your feet.  There is a scraping sound which echoes from either side of this corridor.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: The constant drip of water seeping through the walls becomes immediately irritating as you make your way through this large, dark room.  In some areas, the mire is ankle deep, threatening to slip you into its embrace.  A strong smell of decaying flesh permeates the dank air, but without adequate light, its source remains unknown.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: The walls of this corridor are agonizingly close.  Nitre and foul-smelling slime streak your clothing and skin as you move slowly on the pitted stone floor.  A massive pile of rubble at the southern end makes it impossible to continue in that direction.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: The walls of this corridor are agonizingly close.  Nitre and foul-smelling slime streak your clothing and skin as you move slowly on the pitted stone floor.  A massive pile of rubble at the southern end makes it impossible to continue in that direction.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: In odd contrast to the sparsity of its surrounding rooms, this chamber houses the rotting remnants of someone's sleeping quarters.  A soggy bed snuggles up against one wall, flanked by a broken chair and a sloping nightstand.  A reed torch lies in a puddle of sludge, and a cracked mirror hangs on a slimy wall.  Though its current state is less than inviting, it would appear it was never outfitted for comfort.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Passing through this corridor, you are greeted by the overwhelming stench of the mushy, decaying rug beneath your feet.  Bedraggled and torn asunder, only the intricate thick binding along its edges is more or less intact.  A stark-white lizard appears out of a crack in the oozing walls and scurries for the other end of the corridor.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Iron brackets in the walls suggest that weapons once hung here, but nothing else remains in this spartan hallway.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: A mass of crumbled wall and jagged rock fill the northern end of this corridor, making any further progress impossible.  Mixed in the rubble are shards of broken pottery and the bent remains of an iron torch ring.  Frozen in mid-crawl within a pool of mire, the mottled torso of a skeleton seems to be clawing its way from the ruins.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: You find yourself in a narrow passageway where the stone walls have been overlain with wood slats.  Whatever purpose this room may have served at one time, it is now nothing more than a reeking mess of rotting boards and pooling ooze.  Every sloshing footfall stirs up a horrid odor as you make your way through.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: A collapsing wall spans the width of the eastern end of this corridor.  Crumbling bricks lie strewn across the cobblestones, and a thin layer of mortar dust coats tiny puddles of effluent.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Something about this room causes you to give pause.  The air seems charged with some fantastic energy, and eventually you realize there is no destruction here.  Not a single stone is out of place, nothing putrid festers or fouls.  Though the hall bears no visible sign of an egress, something stirs you to press forward with extreme caution.  You give hefty consideration to the pristine floor, which is made of twelve massive tiles deeply etched with the icons of various items.

wayto.14181: ;e fput 'go Dirdel'; fput 'go Elvish'; fput 'go Almagarus'; fput 'go Tamarind'; move 'go Horeb'

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Crystal Chamber]]
description: To your utter astonishment, you find yourself engulfed in a breathtaking array of vivid, sparkling colors.  Constantly shifting in their prismic dance, they seem to make up the very air in the room, for as you move the hues and tones retreat and reconverge like liquid.  You feel as though you are standing at the very source of rainbows.  A pleasant, resonant hum reaches your ears.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Deobar Sentinel]]
description: A fork in the burned tree's trunk provides precarious footing for those who venture here.  Slender, nearly-straight branches reach upward from the blackened wrack of the tree, like a multitude of fingers yearning toward the sky.  The higher canopy of the forest all around looms in every direction like walls of a living castle.

title: [[Forest of Night, Sheltered Cove]]
description: The murky waters of the river eddy here, making it a pleasant place to simply sit and relax.  A large piece of driftwood found its way here in some distant time, and is now covered nearly halfway with silt and mud, leaving it stuck firmly in place.  Along with a few tangled roots that jut out of the river bank, they provide relatively dry resting spots.  The long branches of willows bend toward the water, giving you the distinct impression of widows weeping for a lost love.

title: [[Garden Pavilion]]
description: A breathtaking view of the tiered waterfall splashing over white rocky ledges can be seen from this garden pavilion.  A large, plump chaise lounge placed next to a wrought iron table spread with rich delicacies make it appear that this spot is ideal for a secret lovers' tryst.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Woodpile]]
description: On top of this unsteady perch you have a view of the surrounding area.  Most directions are blocked by the heavy growth of trees, but the ruined chimneys of the manor poke above the treeline like broken teeth in a decaying mouth.  Not too far away, you catch a glimpse of the river that flows by the preserve.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: A minor clearing sits here, surrounded by thick-set willows in a strangely circular clearing.  The stump of a long-dead and decayed tree rises high in the center of the clearing.  A grandfather of willow trees to judge from the thickness of the stump that remains.  A strange mold covers the ground here and every step sends small puffs of spores into the air.  Only the damp air keeps them from swirling high enough to be a threat to eyes or nose.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Willow trees grow thick on all sides of you.  Long green fronds trail to the ground, still and lifeless in the heavy air.  Massive, gnarled tree trunks covered with dangling beards of moss look like old men hunched together in ragged cloaks.  To the south, the trees grow even taller, their heavy foliage casting a deep gloom over the fern-shrouded, damp ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Thick fungi grow at odd angles from the gnarled brown trunks of the numerous willows growing all about.  A damp musty smell catches at your throat and stings your eyes.  A curious object, shaped like a dog-sized insect, lies tangled in thick fibrous strands of fungal material at the base of one tree.  A trail of large black ants troops up to the corpse in an unending line as nature quietly reclaims its dead.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Great clumps of horsetail ferns sprout among the willows here.  The trees are thinner and more widely spaced, though they still grow close enough and thick enough to block your view after only a few feet.  Somewhere nearby, frogs croak in an irregular chorus.  Among the ferns, a lone bird calls, the sound echoing dully in the wet air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Heavy mud grabs at your feet and every movement results in loud squelching noises.  To the north, a thick line of willows stands a silent watch over this seeping marshland.  Clumps of ferns grow on small outcrops of drier land.  The rest is a sea of heavy mud and thick swamp-grass.  Southward, the land rises a bit and willows return to overgrow the marshes.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: A large patch of relatively dry ground sticks out from a grove of willows to the north.  Here and there, shallow pools of water glisten darkly through a heavy covering of marshflowers that cover their surface.  Hordes of bloodsucking insects throng around you, climbing into your eyes and nose and flying about your ears, their thin, high whining sound grating on your nerves.  To the south, the land continues its slow decline into the marshy bottomlands.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Scattered willow trees cover this rise in the damp landscape.  Marshland flows both north and south like a heavy sea around a low island and even here, the earth is damp enough to squish as you move.  Frogs in all directions sing a raucous chorus in a curious harmony of high and low voices and somewhere a bird calls out in a long, lonely cry.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: A giant among willows has collapsed here, its foundation undermined by the seeping marsh as it spreads across the once-dry land.  Roots pulled free as the tree toppled now stand naked in the air as the dead giant slowly melts into the mud and decay.  A thick lacing of moss and less identifiable growths have sprung up along the trunk and branches where half a hundred spider webs gleam with collected dew among the still-green leaves.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: Stagnant water splashes about your feet as you tread carefully on the slippery mud.  A rough path wanders along a marshy strand between a line of willows and the sluggish river that blocks any progress southward.  Slime-worms ooze their gelid way through the thick ooze at your feet as something with a shiny carapace and numerous legs springs out of the ooze to grab one of them and drag it, struggling weakly, back beneath the thin film of water on the mud.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: A thin margin of fen runs down to a muddy riverbank.  South of that, a small river flows sluggishly, the current checked by tremendous growths of a drab-green water-weed that has formed thick mats across the stream.  An occasional fish breaks the soupy water to snatch at the unending clouds of midges and water-dancers that swarm above the stream.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: A thin clump of willows grows on a relatively dry patch of higher ground surrounded by marshland.  Heavy clumps of rushes grow around the edge of the dry land and somewhere among them something is moving carefully.  A wading bird perhaps, in search of the numerous frogs who continually sound their varied notes on all sides.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: The land rises to the north where a line of massive willows sweeps the ground with their deep green fronds.  As the land drops to the south, it becomes damp and marshy.  Thick hummocks of drier ground hold clumps of tiny wild-flowers, giving a curiously lovely splash of color to the drab grey and brown of the scum-covered pools between them.  A sea of mud to the south fades indistinctly into a sluggish brown river.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Upper Library]]
description: Rows of leather-bound books and pigeonholed racks of scrolls indicate the private library of the manor.  Time has been kind here and the place is surprisingly intact.  Whatever horror occured here long-ago, those involved could not bring themselves to burn or harm these ranked volumes.  Your eye is caught by something bizarre in this almost normal scene: in one large chair, a shrivelled corpse grins out at you eerily.  A blood-stained book still clutched in its gnarled hands.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Master Bedroom]]
description: A huge canopied bed dominates this large room.  Obviously the sleeping chambers for the Lord of this place, the decor reflects the hunting themes so common throughout the building.  To one side, a massive desk made of polished bones surfaced with ivory holds a jumble of papers.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Master Suite]]
description: This was a sitting room once.  Outfitted in an antique and elaborate style, the walls are hung with intricate tapestries and decorative moldings that still retain their heavy gilding.  Little furniture remains now and the fireplace shows where much of it ended up, to judge from the bits of gilded brass that were once handles and knobs and such among the ashes.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Upper Hall East]]
description: This would appear to lead to the master suite of the lord of this house.  A huge door, solid and well made, still stands in silent guard over this ruined domain.  An elaborate coat of arms has been woven into the carpeting here and the colors remain fairly bright and unsullied.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Upper Hall]]
description: Near a set of grand stairs, the hallway seems in good shape.  Several doors remain in place, closing off unknown upper rooms.  The preserved head of a huge wild boar has broken loose from its wall hanging and dangles over the railing like an over-indulgent party-goer being ill.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Bedroom]]
description: This room is fitted out as a guest bedroom for overnight visitors.  The bedding has long since rotted away leaving only the iron frame and some leather scraps that once formed the supports for the mattress.  Scraps of cloth and bits of discolored ribbon show that perhaps a lady once dwelt here.  A patch of blood-stained plaster on one wall shows you she did not enjoy her stay.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Upper Hall]]
description: A wide balustraded corridor runs around three sides of the upper hall.  Faded carpet still depicts a scene of dozens of fantastic animals being hunted in various ways.  Widely spaced doors hint at the luxurious size of the rooms on this level.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Upper Hall]]
description: The hallway here is still relatively intact.  The walls retain a hint of the once-bright colors with which they were decorated.  A leak in the roof overhead has created numerous water-spots in the carpeting and allowed a unique collection of molds to spring up.  One or two of them look almost worthy of attention by the hunters depicted in the undamaged portions of the carpet.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Upper Hall West]]
description: This end of the hallway is a ruin of collapsed plaster and stonework.  Anything left here has been buried under piles of rubble and dust that have been turned into a form of cement by rain and frost.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Bedroom]]
description: One of a number of rooms set aside for guests, this one has been thoroughly ransacked and looted.  A cracked stone basin and part of the iron bedstead are all that remain in here.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Linen Closet]]
description: A small storage area and workroom, this once held the supplies of linen such as sheets, blankets, towels and so on needed to keep people clean and rested.  A hole in the roof has let in years of rain and snow and dirt.  What is left of once crisp white sheets and warm woolen blankets is now an unspeakable mass of corruption and rot.  There seems something in the very air of this place that causes decay far beyond what one might normally expect.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Lodge Entry]]
description: Dark polished wood gleams dully in the subdued light of the entry hall of the manor.  Black and white tiles form a diamond pattern on the floor, reflecting the elegant taste of a bygone time.  Giant racks of antlers and mounted heads of snarling beasts line both walls.  A moth-eaten and ruined rug that was once the skin of some massive beast is crumpled up in one corner.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Lodge Library]]
description: This was once the library of the house.  Long ago stripped of any valuables either by the owner or by later thieves, the room is bare and cold.  The tall windows are smashed and broken and choked with crawling vines that have snaked their way in along the frames.  The wooden shelves have been used for firewood as evidenced by the ash on the floor and the soot on the ceiling.  The desiccated corpse of some forest dweller is sprawled across a blood-stained and burnt rug in the middle of the room.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Den]]
description: This small and intimate room was reserved for the lord of the manor and his close friends.  Rotting leather furniture and cobwebbed souvenirs of the hunt line the walls and focus on a large fireplace with a carved stone mantel.  Faded tapestries depicting people riding to hounds and pursuing stags and other scenes of blood-sport hang on the blotched and mildewed plaster walls.  Something once made a nest out of the stuffing in one of the couches and bits of fluff drift all over the room.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Billiard Room]]
description: The remains of a large billiard table are scattered about this spacious chamber.  Tatters of green felt litter the floor and several cue sticks lie splintered here and there.  One wall still holds a dart board though the darts imbedded have become rusty and useless.  A silver and crystal chandelier that once hung above the table seems to have survived the disaster, looking almost incongruous now in its dusty splendor.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Grand Hall]]
description: This huge room was the banqueting and festive hall for the manor in happier days.  Long trestle tables, now ruined and wrecked, once lined the great hall facing a raised dais for the lord and his noble guests at the far end.  Broken windows have let in rain and wind and the room is fetid with mold and rotfungus.  Once elegant wallpaper now dangles in forlorn tatters from the high walls.  A curious mound squats in one dark corner and from it there seems a trail worn in the muck on the floor.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Trophy Room]]
description: This room once boasted a fine collection of mementoes of the hunt.  A few mounted heads yet remain on the walls.  Fierce creatures, some of which you have never beheld or even heard of, can still be seen here.  A massive cabinet that once held many curious and unusual weapons is now broken and empty.  One item still stands out, a small table, topped with a single gigantic scale.  You have no idea what it once adorned, but your respect for whoever hunted it rises.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Armory]]
description: This room was once used for weapon storage and maintenance.  Partly a museum and partly a workshop, racks and hooks for swords and spears line the walls and a small forge and anvil command the room's middle.  A broken boar-spear still lies in one corner, with dried blood on the blade.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Kitchen]]
description: Here is where feasts were prepared and the trophies of the hunt were cleaned and dressed for cooking.  Marble-topped tables still stand but most of the wooden fittings are gone leaving only bits and splinters.  A huge fireplace takes up the far end of the room.  Hung alongside it are a few corroded pots, skewers and less-identifiable artifacts.  To the north is the pantry and buttery.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Pantry]]
description: This room has been almost completely gutted.  Only some brass fittings and hinges that once adorned the wooden cupboards remain.  Bits of wood, half-chewed and splintered, litter the floor.  Several stone tables and benches yet remain as well as some deep sinks used for food preparation.  Dried trails of slime criss-cross the floor and some even climb the walls.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Cellar Stairs]]
description: A narrow landing sits at the top of a rotted wooden staircase.  Above you is a trapdoor and below you is only darkness and musty smells.  You can make out a row of massive objects below but little else.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House Wine Cellar]]
description: Dark and shadowed, the room extends a good ways under this part of the building.  Huge casks stand in a row along the brick wall.  One or two evidence some attack as they seem to have been gnawed on.  But by and large, the casks seem intact.  Thick cobwebs stretch between them and all along the walls.  Dust and mold are heavy in the air as is the stink of rotting wine dregs.  A shadowy arch leads deeper into the gloom.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Manor House, Cold Cellar]]
description: This room has a surprising chill to it.  Used once for cold storage, it lies abandoned to rot and waste.  You nearly trip over a moldering mess that was once a carcass of meat.  Iron hooks hang from the roof and threaten to impale you if you are not careful.  Once used to hang meat, they are rusty and many are coated with dried blood.  Rotting sacks of root vegetables and grain lie about, apparently left behind and forgotten.  They are ruined by the damp and time.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: The space here is somewhat larger than a tunnel but only by a fraction.  To the northwest, deeper blackness shows a path.  Overhead, the roof seems to be startlingly regular and not made of the congealed slime and mud that can be faintly seen upon the walls.  Several large, square stones have fallen to the floor from overhead leaving a gaping dark hole.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: From far to the northwest, a faint and ominous clicking sound can be heard.  The walls here are slimy and sticky, making them unpleasant to touch.  Tiny lumps of glowing toadstools along the floor keep you from totally losing your sense of perspective and direction.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: The tunnel walls are covered with a sticky, drying, mass of slime.  Small, scabrous-looking mushrooms encrust the rocks here and there and gleam with a faint light.  You can barely make out the deeper blackness ahead and behind you.  The air stings your throat with a smell composed of rotting matter and refuse that makes the worst of the slums you have walked seem like gardens of roses in your memory.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: Curving tunnel walls here are thick with a mucous-like substance that sticks to your hands and feet and equipment.  Heavy odors of rot and corruption invade your nostrils and make you gag.  Loud rustling sounds fill your ears.  Among the stinks and foulness, a tiny hint of fresher air drifts from the southeast.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: This wedge-shaped chamber narrows down to a tunnel that passes to the southeast.  The air here is heavy with a foul stench of rotting matter and heavy ropes of thick mucous-like slime cover every surface.  An enormous toadstool, thick and tall as a Dwarf, glimmers with an evil yellow glow casting strange shadows all about.
