title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: The room is thick with danger.  You feel dozens of cold, unblinking eyes watching your every move.  Heavy strands of viscous slime trail from the roof and walls, making your footing uncertain and causing you to shy away from their clinging touch.  An enormous toadstool, thick and tall as a Dwarf, glimmers with an evil yellow glow casting strange shadows all about.  With an increasing sense of fear, you realize the shadows are moving towards you.

wayto.14225: ;e fput 'rub enormous toadstool'; fput 'get spore'; fput 'throw my spore at slime'; move 'go slime'

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: This huge, hemispherical chamber is a nightmare of wriggling movement and unclean shapes.  Rows of rough cylinders, apparently made of festering matter laced with the ever-present slime, pulsate from within in a grotesque manner.  Mud-colored insectile shapes crawl around and over them, apparently tending them and keeping them moist.  At the far end of the chamber, a latticework of dried slime and mud hides something enormous and foul from full sight.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: The floor is of loose rock and mud, mixed with the endless slime that drools in long strands from every surface.  Your footing is treacherous and uncertain.  The thought of falling into the unwholesome muck that is the floor makes you retch sour vomit.  Dark shapes scuttle about, moving in and out among the stones and rubble but never quite there when you look directly at them.  The air is thick and a loud clicking fills your ears.  Something cold and wet drips stickily down the back of your neck.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnels]]
description: In the faint glow of huge fungi on the befouled walls, you can see that here a tunnel widens out into a wedge-shaped room.  The walls glisten with a thick layer of slime and trails of it cross the floor like half-jelled mud.  Your eyes seem to think they catch movement in the corners of your vision, but when you look directly, you see only rock and dirt and muck.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: The walls here grow thick with putrid-smelling fungi that gleam with a foul internal light.  For what the light reveals, you'd rather they not be here at all.  From a rounded roof hang dozens of bloated monsters.  Looking like enormous, pulsating sacks of flesh, they have vaguely insect-like heads with massive jaws that dig deep into the roof to hold them in place.  Enormous, distended guts pulsate slowly and through the thin chitin, you can make out faint shapes moving in some thick ooze.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Underground Chamber]]
description: The air here is so heavy with the stench of rotting matter that you gasp for breath in the foul miasma.  The floor is hip-deep in decaying refuse and here and there, a gleaming bone pokes up out of the pulsating mass.  Dark insectile shapes scuttle about, on and in thick porridge of rot, seemingly oblivious to your presence.  You watch one for a moment, to your regret, as it voids half a gill or more of noisome semi-liquid from its maw into the mess and scuttles off.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: Clicking and rustling noises loom large in your ears as your eyes grasp vainly in the uncertain fungal glow for the source of the noise.  Mucous-like goo drips in an almost continual rain from overhead and fouls the walls and floor with its viscous mess.  Something dark and very fast scuttles by, its hard carapace brushing against you in the gloom.  The clicking dies away a moment and then returns, now with a sinister overtone of urgency to it.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: A tiny flicker of pale green light here and there from loathsome misshapen fungi on the walls gives you barely enough light to see your hands in front of you.  The walls and low roof overhead drip with a thick and sticky secretion that clings to you coldly.  Something pale and bulbous crunches under a careless step, and a fine white mist squirts into the air from the ruined thing.  The stench of rotting flesh is overpowering.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: Darkness all about you hinders your senses and confuses your notions of direction.  Something thick and glutinous turns under your foot with a disgusting squelch and you taste bile in the back of your throat.  A clicking noise as of dry sticks hitting each other overlays a subdued rustling sound.  The air is thick with the sweet, sickly smell of festering meat.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: To the northwest, there is a faint breath of fresh air.  Southeast, deeper into the darkness, faint clicking noises and a barely heard whirring sound like the rustle of dry leaves can be made out.  The walls are smooth and slightly slimy to the touch.  Your breath catches in your throat from the odd musty smell mingled with the stink of rotting organic matter.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Tunnel]]
description: Daylight, achingly bright here in the darkness of this tunnel, fails to penetrate very far down into the cool, slimy depths.  Hard-packed dirt walls form a steep funnel sloping down from a ruined farm wagon overhead into the unknown.  The whole place reminds you disturbingly of the traps some insects dig in the sand to ensnare other insects passing by.  From far down the tunnel, a faint clicking sound emanates.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Grasslands]]
description: You stand surrounded on all sides by high grass that blocks the view after more than a few feet.  The tall stalks rustle softly, stirred by unfelt breezes, or worse.  Your shoulders twitch as if momentarily expecting to feel the hot breath of some unseen predator upon them.  There seems no clear choice of direction out of this grassy trap.

title: [[Farmland, Ruined Barn]]
description: Bare boards, riven with dry rot, barely hold up a roof that is missing more shingles than it retains.  Bits of straw and chaff litter the ground all about.  A few doves nest in the rafters, and your arrival has bestirred them to gentle cooing.  The pleasant sound is offset by a rain of dung, as they do what birds normally do when disturbed.  A rickety ladder leads to a small hayloft.

title: [[Ruined Barn, Hayloft]]
description: The planks that make up the hayloft are warped and rotted, making the footing more than a trifle unsteady.  Years of use by doves has also added to the challenge of keeping your footing.  Bits of open sky peek in through numerous gaps in the roof overhead but there are a few spots still intact enough to keep things dry and almost snug.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Lodge Porch]]
description: An elegant stairway sweeps up from a circular carriage drive to this large porch in the front of the ruined manor house.  The ancient stone of the building's facade is echoed in the stone work of the porch.  Ivy straggles across the flagstone paving that is now broken and irregular.  The massive entry doors stand solid and unbroken, defying time and the elements.

title: [[Tower West, Air Floor]]
description: A dark grey carpet decorated with a pattern of crossing black lightning bolts covers the floor, matching the decoration on the grey-painted walls.  A constant, low thrum hangs just inside the range of hearing, its source nearby but not readily apparent.  Doors spaced in an even circle around the perimeter lead to initiates' private cells.

title: [[Tower West, Earth Floor]]
description: Bare, dark soil forms the floor underfoot.  The stony walls surrounding this circular room are similarly devoid of decoration, keeping instead the plain, natural look preferred by those mages who favor the element of Earth.  Doors leading to the initiates' private cells line the walls.

title: [[Tower West, Water Floor]]
description: Deep blue carpeting covers the floor, its surface cut in a manner that suggests the rippling of waves upon the surface of a lake.  Bright blue spirals, representing the element of water, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is moist and cool upon the skin.

title: [[Tower West, Fire Floor]]
description: Lush, red carpeting covers the floor, muffling any ambient noise into oblivion.  Images of bloated red suns, representing the element of fire, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is significantly warmer than on the tower's other floors, although the reason is not readily apparent.

title: [[Tower West, Aether Floor]]
description: Carpeting the color of a death shroud covers the floor, devouring the light as hungrily as Aldauth consumes souls.  The walls are devoid of decoration, instead painted a uniform black to match the floor.  Only the doors leading to initiates' cells betray any hint of color in this otherwise cold, bleak room.

title: [[Xala'Shar Camp, Firepit]]
description: Extinguished, the firepit houses burnt bones, meat, and gristle.  Suspended by a massive bone spit, an abomination waits for the cooks to finish roasting it.  The odor of the partially cooked meat smells rather like a latrine.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Wine Cellar]]
description: Strong support beams crisscross the ceiling above, converging towards wide brick columns that stoically maintain the foundation of the guild.  Shallow grooves worn into the floor attest to the memory of several absent storage racks.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Old Library]]
description: Time has not been kind to the cornerstone room of the old Bards' Guild, as is evident by the vein-like cracks and discolorations to the aged brick foundation.  Several long black streaks scar the floor at the west wall where a door might have stood -- a visible reminder and striking mystery as to the demise of the missing portal.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Conservatory]]
description: Several smokeless candles flicker from behind cut-glass sconces, bathing the room in a soft and even light that refracts off the countertop of the wraparound bar.  The centerpiece of the conservatory is a beautiful ebonwood clavichord, framed by the top of a staircase and a sliding glass door.

title: [[The Baron's Table, Dining Room]]
description: The dark polished wood of the paneling and tables provides a warm glow to the elegantly furnished dining room.  Throne-like chairs with pale yellow silk damask seats are arranged around each table.  Glazed windows look out over the town walls, the milky rippled glass turning the surrounding hills and groves into waves of rainbow images.  The susurration of quiet conversations rises and falls as diners linger over their meals.

title: [[Gretchen's Hats, Workshop]]
description: An array of silk flowers, satin and grosgrain ribbons, wooden berries and chiffon scarves spread across the polished granite slab that covers a row of maple cupboards.  The hatmaker Gretchen Abernathy sits at the workspace, a fanciful hat adorned with bright wooden strawberries and green silk leaves in her hand.  Boldly patterned rugs crisscross the floor below her, and handpainted flowerpots cluster in the corners.

title: [[Wycliffe's Harvest Market]]
description: The shop's decor reflects the vibrant personalities of its owners Barnaby and Liccy Wycliffe.  Bold splashes of color bring a feeling of warmth and light to the room in the green and yellow tiled walls and the yellow fringed cloth that covers the trestle table.  The heady fragrance of cloves, cinnamon and pepper fills the air, coming from the crates of spices nestled among barrels piled high with salt pork and iron planters filled with basil and tomato plants.

title: [[Sweet Delights, Front Room]]
description: A comfortable, homey clutter fills this pleasant shop giving it a relaxed, lived-in atmosphere.  Mismatched pitchers and jugs cover the shelf-lined walls, and rows of tapered candles hang from the top of the window frames.  The pale blue of a magnificent wisteria growing outside the back window is reflected in the sky blue walls of the shop.  Several regular patrons sit over endless cups of coffee discussing other people's love lives.

title: [[Fit for a Baron, Display]]
description: Hanging high from the opaque ceiling are bright lights that glint off the armor displays.  Tapestries and heavy curtains cover the ironwood walls while plush snowbeast fur rugs line the marble floor.  Stands line the walls and mannequins fill the corners of the room.

title: [[The Cupcake Cafe, Front Porch]]
description: Multi-hued flagstone covers the floor, adding a splash of color to the glassed-in room.  Bistro tables and chairs are spaced apart, just far enough so customers can sit and sample their purchases while still enjoying a private conversation.  At the end of the porch, a white wicker swing hangs from the ceiling complete with extra cushions for those in need of a comfortable rest.

title: [[The Cupcake Cafe, Salesroom]]
description: Whitewashed walls are decorated with whimsical paintings of dancing cupcakes, candies and herbs to amuse shoppers as they wait in line for their purchases.  Bakers in white coats and tall, puffy hats rush out from the kitchen with trays of freshly decorated baked goods trying to keep up with the day's orders.  The aroma of freshly brewed coffee and tea emanates from a small cast iron stove in the corner that keeps the complimentary pots hot for customers to enjoy.

title: [[The Cupcake Cafe, Specialty Sales]]
description: Mixed in with the aroma of baking cake, the scent of assorted liquors helps to perfume the air, indicating that the confections displayed here were created with the adult customer in mind.  The bakers working this area seem particularly happy with their jobs, although not very steady on their feet.  Despite looking as if they've been sampling some of the special ingredients for quality control, they keep the counter constantly stocked.

title: [[Elanthian Travel Tours, Gift Shop]]
description: Poles hold up a brightly covered canvas awning that can be lowered when the shop is closed.  An oversized tower shield with a small plaque is in a roped area in the corner.  Hooks loaded with wares hang near a counter that blocks customers from rifling through the unopened boxes and crates piled in the shadows.

title: [[Silver Coin Inn, Common Room]]
description: The well-worn tread on the sturdy pine floorboards indicates the number of patrons whose tired feet have sought out the rest and comfort of this plain traveler's inn.  A large stone hearth crackles at the far side of the room, adding cheerful warmth to the appetizing scents drifting from the kitchen.  Tucked away into one corner, an unobtrusive staircase leads up to the guest rooms provided for those who cannot afford finer lodgings within the city.

title: [[Silver Coin Inn, Gaming Room]]
description: Thick, choking clouds of smoke swirl about your head from the smelly cigars favored by the regular occupants of this tiny gaming room.  A collection of wooden card tables and flimsy chairs are scattered about the cramped space, hastily pushed together or shoved aside as the gamblers change games and fortunes with each card drawn.  An occasional curse rings through the air to drown out the whirr of cards and the clink of coins changing hands.

title: [[Silver Coin Inn, Bar]]
description: A long polished bar stretches across the eastern side of the small tavern, flanked by a row of cushioned stools.  Several large shelves built into the back wall behind the bar contain liquid-filled bottles and flasks of myriad sizes, shapes and colors -- testament to the widespread fame of the Silver Coin's taproom in providing beverages from across Elanthia.

title: [[Silver Coin Inn, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: Off-white walls and dark deobar wood paneling add little to the atmosphere of this plain yet hospitable hallway, providing a sense of dullness and familiarity that is both welcoming and a little unsettling in contrast with the predominately S'Kra culture of Muspar'i.  A small table graces the end of the hall beneath a dusty oval mirror, a porcelain bowl filled with friendly white daisies set in its center.

title: [[Silver Coin Inn, Guest Room]]
description: A worn but freshly pressed yellow and blue quilt lies folded neatly upon the small double bed in the center of the room, its once-bright diamond pattern repeated in a threadbare throw rug.  Freshly picked flowers nestled in a painted stone urn fill the air with a pleasant scent, adding to the room's determined impression of cheer despite the sparse furnishings.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Upper Lightwell Balcony]]
description: Just out of reach above the balcony, an amazing and intricate set of mirrors hangs beneath the skylights at the top of the great shaft.  No matter where the sun travels in the sky, the mirrors catch the rays of light, and redirect them down into the lightwell.  At the same time, the heated mirrors draw air up the shaft to be released out the skylights with cleverly arranged openings.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Sitting Room]]
description: A line of several comfortable looking armchairs, broken only by the occasional wooden table bearing refreshments, has been left under the eaves at the edge of the great keep's roof.  The provided luxuries coupled with the breezes that pass in and out of the building from under the roof's edge transform the room into a cool retreat to wile away the hours safe from the scorching heat found outside.

title: [[Old Lata'arna Keep, Exchange Vault]]
description: For security reasons, steel grates have been added in the gaps between the eaves and stone walls to compartment the exchange vault from the rest of the floor.  A pair of burly guards lurks in the corners of the vault, keeping an eye on all that enter.  In the center of the room, an Olvi Moon Mage reclines upon a couch, his only job to maintain the moongate shimmering in the arch on the back wall.

title: [[Silver Simplicity, Loft]]
description: High, arched ceilings and wide casement windows fill this room with light during the warm hours of day.  Pale blue and green carpets woven with ivory geometric designs cover the cool tiled floors, providing the room's only color to combat the harsh whiteness of the plaster walls and furnishings.  Costly birch cabinets line the free walls, their doors lined with fine mesh screens that shine softly when touched by light.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: A road of pale red crushed coral stretches up a slight incline towards the bright edifice of the palace to the north, its minarets and great blue dome shining in the distance.  Carefully tended and cultivated greenery has been laid out on either side of the road, sustaining a wealth of life in spite of the harsh climate.  Flanked by guardsmen in gleaming armor, a broad gate pierces the wall around the palace grounds, leading back to the city proper.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: Passing between low, thick greenery and beds ablaze with colorful flowers, the crushed coral road follows a great curve between the gate and the palace, both visible in the distance.  Delicate scents drift across the quiet way from the purple, red and white blooms amid the plantings.  A grove of trees planted before the grand palace offers a shady counterpoint to the harsh desert air that slips in over the walls of the palace grounds.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: Broadening into a small lot as it reaches the palace, the crushed coral road curves away from the doors in two directions.  The tall entry facade belonging to Shorka's Palace stretches between a pair of slender, carved stone minarets faced with spiraling bands of polychrome tile.  Tall double doors lead into the great building, set back within a niche in the grand facade.  Opposite the doors is a grove of trees placed to cast shade over the road.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: The first of the tall minarets bordering the palace's main entry stand not far to the east, resting almost directly on top of the road of crushed red coral.  The palace continues to the west briefly before being halted by the outer wall that surrounds the regal structure and the city of Muspar'i alike.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: Blending seamlessly with the the wall's white limestone blocks, the west wing of Shorka's Palace stands proudly.  High above are tall windows from which the structure's residents can see the land over which they preside.  The edge of the great central dome, visible from many places in the Velaka Desert, peeks out over the wall.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: Exotic desert flora grows along the side of the crushed coral road in well-kept flower beds, accenting the usual drab brown sand with splashes of bright orange and vibrant pink.  The blossoms sway in the light breeze that sweeps over the wall and down the path.  Beyond a few tangled bushes to the northeasts rests the corner of Shorka's Palace, a subtle reminder to observers of where they stand.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: Wedged between the wall and a grove of shady trees, the crushed coral road is secluded from the world in this narrow pass.  The only available glimpse of Shorka's Palace reveals the tip of its recognizable dome, obscured occasionally by the swaying green fronds.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: This crook in the Palace Road brushes up against the wall, closely hugging the curve of the white limestone blocks without ever quite touching.  The royal stables are clearly visible along the path's other branch and Shorka's Palace itself stands beyond a grove of trees to the north.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Gates]]
description: The grand wall around Shorka's Palace is divided here by tall iron-banded gates, watched day and night by stoic guards in highly polished armor.  A road of crushed red coral curves away from the wall to the north and northwest.  Each pale chunk seems perfectly placed, forming a well-groomed path deserving of its role as the Palace Road.

title: [[Muspar'i, Palace Road]]
description: The curving road of pale red crushed coral skirts around the royal stables, kept out of direct sight from the palace by a grove of shady trees.  Liveried grooms lead magnificent horses and snorting dakohirdu through their daily paces, exercising their charges with devoted attention and care.

title: [[Muspar'i, Royal Stables]]
description: Contradicting the stereotypical image of a stable, this modest room is kept remarkably clean.  The freshly swept floors could be mistaken for those in any respectable shop, utterly free of sand and dust.  Even the bales of hay stacked between the stable's two stalls are neat and orderly, held in place by a sturdy spidersilk net.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Fire Garden]]
description: The heat in this garden is persistently palpable, creating a lushly tropical environment teeming with exotic life.  All of the flowers are some variant of red in shade, from vermilion to deep burgundy, and all are tended assiduously by dedicated fire elementals.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Earth Garden]]
description: The rich scent of saffron gilds the air of the Earth Garden.  Other herbs rest in scattered patches around massive sandstone boulders, adding a grassy texture to that scent but not overpowering it.  Trellises formed of thousands of tiny stacked stones add a delicate touch, as do the carefully trained vines of honeysuckle that wrap around them.

title: [[Sho'hhs Migendaniis, Electricity Garden]]
description: Pathways of gleaming black stone snake around the garden, forking abruptly before large marble pots of strange herbs.  A faint, tingling energy hangs continuously in the air, filling it with a sense of unrelieved anticipation.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Caravan Stable]]
description: The wide south end of the wing has been opened up to create a sheltered area for incoming caravans to deliver their goods.  Along the western wall, a collection of stalls and a storage area provide Traders with a place to store their tack as they rest or explore the city.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Market Plaza]]
description: Broken colored tiles arranged in a circular pattern brighten the sides of the plaza set between the walls of the Traders' Guild.  Sturdy masoned tables are scattered about the area, in hopes of attracting the odd customer that wanders in from the dusty streets.  Stone dragons expertly carved crest the tall wide arch leading out to the street, their wings and tails stretching to meet the limestone walls of the guild.  On the opposite side stand the double deobar doors that lead into the main hall.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Prospect Hall]]
description: Gilded candlesticks sit in bronzed sconces with elaborately coiled ironwork design.  Platinum-flecked dark marble tiles, polished to a fine sheen, have been set in a diamond pattern on the floors, passing below a crystalline railed spiral staircase that leads into the North Wing above.  To the east and west, one can hear the raised voices of traders as they barter and bargain in the safety of the guild hall.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Desert Exchange]]
description: Wealthy traders and merchants dominate the busy exchange, always trying to keep one step ahead of the ever-changing prices of liquid assets.  Clerks file into the room on a regular basis, updating the clientele about the current demands of the city.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Kertigen Hall]]
description: Dark marble tiles have been set in a mosaic of a large broken chain, running down the length of the hall.  In the center of the east wall, an exquisitely carved white marble statue of Kertigen gazes down onto any who pass.  Ironwork sconces line the walls with reddish flickering candles, creating pools of darkness on the limestone walls and floor like waning torches in an underground cavern.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Guildleader's Office]]
description: Polished granite covers the walls of the office, perfectly smooth and amazingly seamless.  Bits of quartz have been exposed in the granite, sparkling radiantly under the light of the masterfully crafted iron chandelier.  A low hand-carved walnut desk stands in the center of the room, its surface completely etched with a repeating star design.  The rest of the furniture in the room is of high quality but austere, giving the office a rather stark and solemn ambiance.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Minister's Office]]
description: Deobar desks line the stone walls, piled with delivery orders and accounts received.  Clerks bustle through on their way to shipping or east towards the exchange, keeping business rolling like a well-oiled caravan.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, Freight Office]]
description: Crates, woven baskets and bundles pile about the freight office, neatly tagged with slips of paper, the color indicating whether the shipment is incoming or outgoing.  Clerks scribble in their ledgers as they take inventory, glancing up every now and then to nod to arriving Traders.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, North Wing]]
description: High open windows line the long northern wall, allowing breezes to filter through the wing.  Vases and flower boxes sit on the broad stone window ledges, adding a finished touch to an otherwise bare corridor.  To the east, a white pine door leads into the Trader Shop, while an open hall to the west allows passage into the recreation wing.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, West Wing Recreation Room]]
description: Comfortable furniture, a private bar and games of chance occupy the long and spacious upper west wing.  Traders from abroad sit and chat about their travels while tired clerks on all-too-short breaks rub their temples and sip cool drinks near the bar.

title: [[Muspar'i Traders' Guild, East Wing Trader Shop]]
description: Flourishing trades of goods extend through the entire east wing as tables, racks, barrels, and crates display only the latest and most exclusive items at lower than value prices.  Young merchants show off their items to the shop's dealer, hoping to impress them with their craftsmanship for a chance to display their wares and begin their path to fame and fortune.

title: [[Izma Ru'ef University, Lecture Hall]]
description: Above the arched roof of the entry is a vast, domed lecture hall.  The wood is carved in step-like terraces, to seat large crowds of knowledge-thirsty students.  The dome and walls are shaped in such a way as to naturally amplify the sound from the speaker's platform.  This hall is also the site of concerts, bardic recitals, dramas and pageants that make up the cycles of life in Leth Deriel.

title: [[Izma Ru'ef University, Library Branch]]
description: The curved walls of the old redwood are carved with deep, high shelves crammed with books, scrolls, all irreplaceable and priceless.  One fortunate characteristic of the aromatic wood is that it serves as a natural repellent to bugs, mildew and all the other enemies of paper and parchment.  Rough hewn benches and tables topped with flickering oil lamps are occupied by students and professors absorbed in the wonders of the words before their eyes.

title: [[Izma Ru'ef University, Study Branch]]
description: A circular skylight carved into the wooden wall here affords a clear view of the sky above the forest stronghold of Leth Deriel.  A small brass telescope on a raised platform points towards the opening.  Devices of brass and iron, mechanical models of some sort, sit on some worktables.

title: [[Izma Ru'ef University, Dormitory Branch]]
description: Small wooden doors line the walls, evenly spaced around the circumference of the trunk.  These are the student quarters and here live mostly non-Elven exchange students of outstanding ability who have passed the rigorous entrance examinations and interviews required to gain admission into Izma Ru'ef.  All Elves, by birthright, are automatically entitled to attend University classes.

title: [[Gymnasium, Entrance]]
description: A statue of Everild stands in the center of the room, with its arms raised to the sky like wings ready for flight.  From behind it rolls loud chiming punctuated by staccato drumming.  The musky scent of sweat mixed with incense hangs in the air.  An archway beyond the sculpture leads deeper into the building.

title: [[Gymnasium, Dance Pit]]
description: Countless bare feet have stomped a hard-packed circle into the dark earthen floor.  The air is hazy from burning incense and damp from perspiring bodies.  Swan-emblazoned shields hang from one wall, on another rough charcoal drawings depict stick figures in various positions.  A pair of ancient Elven barbarians sit in a corner of the sultry room, one thumping a huge kettle drum, the other striking a row of metal chimes with a mallet.

title: [[Gymnasium, Poolside]]
description: Murky water masks the depth of the swimming pool, but a diving board at one end and a Gor'Tog with water to her chin hint that it's safe to jump.  A dirty skylight centered over the pool casts a dim glow throughout the room.  Some damp towels are thrown haphazardly on the wooden benches lining the walls and a pair of moldy shower shoes lay abandoned in a corner.

title: [[Gymnasium, Meditation Room]]
description: Woven straw mats are scattered around the dimly lit room for those who wish to nourish their inner self.  What little light there is filters in through chinks in the walls, illuminating floating motes of dust settling to the floor.  A cluttered pile of armor and weapons abruptly snores, proclaiming a person somewhere within.

title: [[Kilth Aldiyaus, Atrium]]
description: You are within the main temple of Leth Deriel, devoted to all the gods and goddesses of Elanthia, for each to worship in his or her own way.  This atrium is in the heart of an old banyan tree that constantly sends out new shoots.  It is hollow all the way to the top, allowing the air and light to filter down through green leaves, more radiant than any stained-glass cathedral window could ever be.

title: [[Kilth Aldiyaus, Prayer Branch]]
description: Vaulted beams are carved into the grain of the wooden walls. Echoes of mumbled prayers and heartfelt supplications are amplified by the room's curvature.  In the reverberating din, the names of all the deities mingle, then merge as one.  A polished Sana'ati wood altar is surrounded by hooded figures kneeling on the bare floor.

title: [[Kilth Aldiyaus, Meditation Branch]]
description: Low benches, slanted to be knelt upon, are arranged in rows along the floor of the room.  Devotees and layfolk of all races and professions sit side by side, silently immersed in meditative exercises.  Along the walls are mats, and racks bearing wooden staves and swords, as well as ceremonial longbows.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Public Library]]
description: Skillfully cut into the stone of the mountain, this chamber houses many books that the people of Hibarnhvidar find important.  Several citizens mill about, browsing the books on the shelves, speaking softly to one another and discussing their opinions on various subjects.  The Dwarven librarian welcomes patrons into the library, gesturing to an engraved silver sign.

title: [[Brickwell Tower, Provincial Broker]]
description: A no-nonsense businesswoman, the Provincial Broker's office is severely plain, its walls unadorned and its stone floor uncovered.  In fact, the only item in the room, other than the broker herself, is a large white ironwood desk.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Entry Hall]]
description: Numerous landscape paintings cover the walls of this short hallway, giving the room an illusion of windows that open on widely varying vistas.  The faint noise of a commotion can be heard, seeming to emanate from a pair of gilt doors opposite the arch to the cavern.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Meeting Hall]]
description: The expansive room resembles a boisterous tavern more than it does a guildhall.  Tankards and glasses on the room's four tables indicate that the revelry has been going on for quite some time, and shows no sign of slowing down.  Weapon and armor racks standing near training dummies against the walls, however, hint at a time when the mood was far less celebratory.  An entryway to the south seems a bit quieter.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Guildleader's Office]]
description: Although small, this office feels larger due to what appear to be windows.  A second glance, however, reveals that they are actually landscapes, similar to those in the entry hall of the guild.  A worktable holds some scrolls, but any guild records seem almost to be an afterthought, as the majority of the surface is covered in various containers of paintbrushes and paints.  An easel in the corner displays another picture, of which the artist is either proud, or lacks wall space for display.

title: [[Rummeltum's Catering]]
description: Baskets filled with fresh-baked bread and rolls are piled high beside the counter, and the aroma of roasting meats and pastries fills the air.  The shop bustles with young Halflings carrying food from the stone bakehouse behind the store, or returning empty baskets and platters to be refilled.  A leather-bound menu lies atop the counter, listing the goods offered for sale.

title: [[Martrem's Forge and Armory]]
description: The air is filled with the raucous din of apprentices' hammers striking the anvils about the forge.  Near the fire, a soot-streaked urchin labors over the leather bellows to fan the flames.  Supervising the confusion is a burly Gor'Tog smith who paces tirelessly about the room.

title: [[Field of Shields]]
description: Shields of all shapes and sizes line the walls.  Some are nicked and scarred from years of use -- trophies of war.  Others are bright and clean -- trophies of art.  Daylight streams through the wide open windows, brightly illuminating the shop.  A sleepy S'Kra Mur clerk smiles politely as he directs entering customers toward the various displays.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Ishh's Used Goods]]
description: White birch shelves, piled high with used weapons and armor, line the walls.  Ishh stands behind a counter of mottled marble stone.  An obsidian plaque shaped like a flying raven hangs over the door leading out.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Silver Room]]
description: Roses are traced in black over the thin silver leaf paper that has been applied to the walls of this spacious room.  Windows framed by long curtains of white gauze allow for all the kinds of light to slip through -- softly.  A four-poster bed made from a frame of lovingly polished beech wood lies pushed up against the wall, its covers turned down.  A hearth framed by grey bricks allows for coziness in the wintertime.  Through the silverwillow door in the south wall lies the distant world left behind.

title: [[Milene's Rose, Private Booth]]
description: Circular and featuring just the right compliment of shadows to light, comfortable seats, padded with blue velvet upholstery that features the signature black rose motif of Milene's, await those who enter here.  The soft perfume of flowers drifts through the air, and a crisp midnight blue cloth of thick linen covers the tabletop.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Foyer]]
description: Dark red carpeting runs down the center of the long hallway, covering a polished black marble floor.  Occupying much of the northern half of the room is a large mahogany desk, its clean surface following the wall.  Next to the desk is an arched walnut door leading further into the House.  A small sitting room is visible through a small arch at the northwest end of this hall.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Sitting Room]]
description: Overstuffed suede couches frame a low table set with a small tray of tea and other refreshments.  Dark purple curtains line each corner of the room, though the off-white walls have no windows at all.  Lit with two small oil lanterns hanging from the low ceiling, the room has a serene feeling, and holds the scent of brewed tea and tobacco.

title: [[House of the Silver Star, Beneath the Willow Tree]]
description: Long branches trail nearly to the ground around a majestic weeping willow tree, some dipping the tips of their leaves into the clear pond nearby.  The willow's broad trunk disappears above into a dense tangle of fragrant leaves that rustle softly in even the slightest breeze.

title: [[House of the Silver Star, Atop the Willow Tree]]
description: High in the willow's branches is a smooth wooden platform with an unobstructed view of the nighttime sky.  Towards the northwest, the massive black marble building which is home to the House of the Silver Star stands proudly, little visible through its drawn curtains.  A downward glance reveals the city of Shard, illuminated with thousands of lights cut through by the pools of darkness where the rivers lie.

High in the willow's branches is a smooth wooden platform with an unobstructed view of the daytime sky.  A downward glance reveals the bustling city of Shard, the din a faint buzz from here.  Towards the northwest, the massive black marble building which is home to the House of the Silver Star stands proudly, its facade as impenetrable as the secrets within.

title: [[Foot of Wyvern Mountain, Cavern]]
description: A hissing wind blows through the small opening into the cave, echoing eerily throughout the fairly large cavern.  A crude brazier sits in the corner, a collection of pine limbs stacked neatly beside it.  Along one wall, an assortment of odd-shaped boulders piled upon each other like a crude ladder lead up to a thick ledge jutting from the sleek cavern wall.

title: [[Foot of Wyvern Mountain, Thick Ledge]]
description: The large boulders from below give way to small stones and rocks scattered haphazardly onto a thick ledge that opens into a hollowed-out area.  Large enough for even the tallest Gor'Tog to stand upright, it appears the deep scratches and jagged gouges in the surrounding walls were hewn by mortal hand.  A flickering wall torch casts a feeble light over a pine altar sitting flush against the back wall.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Cafe]]
description: The mosaic pathway threads its way lazily through a lush grass courtyard.  Surrounding numerous billowy satin cushions, a series of crystal globes outline the center of the courtyard.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Herb Garden]]
description: Composed of low hedges and filled with ground-hugging herbs, a geometric knot garden prominently occupies most of the area, leaving room around the outskirts for a mosaic pathway.  A heady aroma, intensifying at the slightest breeze, wafts through the air as if it were a living thing waiting to greet all who pass.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Flower Gardens]]
description: Flower beds, contained within stacked stone borders, give rise to a riotous explosion of color and scent.  Several benches have been placed along the mosaic pathway that winds between the enclosures, affording a place to relax.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Water Gardens]]
description: Diverting briefly around a small fish pond, the mosaic pathway continues its journey through plants that range in a barely tamed mass of ground-concealing greens and blues.  A brass heron stands on thin legs, poised as if to drink or perhaps capture one of the tiny fish swimming serenely under its gaze.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Topiary Gardens]]
description: Dense hedges clipped into animal shapes nearly hide a small vine-covered structure at the center of the garden, in turn surrounded by meticulously-shaped miniature trees.  A mosaic pathway skirts the edge of the observatory roof, affording an excellent view of the Segoltha in the distance.

title: [[Observatory, Celestial Garden Shop]]
description: The air in this elegant garden shop is perfumed with the lingering scent of lilacs and roses.  Items of interest to members of the Celestial Compact are stocked here, the fragrant scent meant to appeal to customers.  A low herbal bench, a wicker clothing rack and a long ivory table are lit by small crystal globes while clerks stand by to attend to both the casual and wealthy shoppers.  An open archway leads out to the Observatory Gardens.

title: [[House of Bardic Blues, Wayfarer's Den]]
description: Sweeping folds of deep blue broadcloth drape every wall from ceiling to floor, making the shop appear more like a tent than a building in the middle of town.  Candles of all shapes and sizes are arranged throughout the room, adding to the nomadic feel while providing some meager light.  Exotic odors linger to tantalize the senses, while the faint sounds of castanets clap rhythmically in the background.  Plump pillows in various shades of blue lie sprawled about if one feels the need to relax.

title: [[House of Bardic Blues, Baubles and Bits]]
description: Candlelight dances off of trinkets and spangles that are on casual display about the small room.  Jewelry pieces rest on silk pillows and silk-covered stands with seemingly cavalier disregard for their safekeeping.  More broadcloth hangs from the ceiling and walls in a shade of blue that's a bit lighter than the cloth in the Den.  Sparkling jewels, sewn into the heavy fabric, create a spectacular kaleidoscope of reflecting shades of blue as the candlelight caresses them.

title: [[House of Bardic Blues, Secluded Courtyard]]
description: This partially covered courtyard is pungent with the smells of savory spices and incense.  Exotic plants and flowers thrive here, creating an oasis away from the city's bustle and noise.  Filmy blue fabric falls from the latticework overhead, cloaking the courtyard from outside view and creating a cozy, shrouded ambiance.  Tall ironwork tables stand close to one another, providing stable and attractive places to enjoy a light repast.  A roped-off stairway leads up to the next level of the building.

title: [[Cecelia's Blossoms, Showroom]]
description: The fragrances of sweet roses and spicy lavender intermingle, creating a heady perfume that fills this small shop.  Twisted vines, potted plants and brilliant floral arrangements completely hide the walls, creating a tropical jungle-like atmosphere.  The air feels heavy with humidity from the multitude of moisture-laden plants.  Cecelia, a willowy Elven woman, smiles at you from her side of an elaborately carved acanth wood counter.

title: [[Seli's Armory, Sales Room]]
description: A masked figure, clad head to toe in black leather, stands alongside a scaled curtain dividing the front room from the workshop in back.  Only a little light filters into the room through the drawn window shades, lending the whole room a spooky, otherworldly feel.  Shadowy outlines along the walls reveal themselves on closer examination as pieces of leather armor hung for display.

title: [[Zanthron's Artificer Shop, Salesroom]]
description: You flinch as you feel slight shocks of static running up your arm while standing in Zanthron's shop.  A purple and black tapestry hangs in the back of the shop while glass display cases of miniature animals sit on shelves arranged haphazardly on another wall.  Zanthron herself sits on a stool behind the counter scowling at a runestone and muttering arcane phrases as if looking for an opening in the stone.

title: [[Smaragdaus' Joy, Front Room]]
description: This shop is filled with perfume scents and the underlying aroma of chocolate.  Despite the humble surroundings, this business offers quality gifts for the romantic.  A square "box" sits above the large hole cut into the ceiling, obviously an attempt to reach a taller market.

title: [[Smaragdaus' Joy, Scrivener's]]
description: Fragrant bundles of drying tobacco in white cheesecloth bags hang from the rafters, perfuming the dusty air.  Assorted overturned boxes surround a rickety table topped by cards and a stack of painted wooden chips, evidently the site of a regular game.  In the far corner, beneath a window, sits a slant-topped desk holding an array of pens and paper.

title: [[Fine Leaf's End, Sales Room]]
description: A rush of pungent tobacco fumes greets patrons upon entering the Fine Leaf.  This enormous amount of smoke is created by the numerous half-pint customers trying out new blends, but the most proficient creator of the dense haze is the proprietor, Beeanna Donee, who is never without her long walnut pipe.

title: [[Mirglyn Sisters, Goldsmiths]]
description: Brightly burning lamps hang above the low felt-topped tables used by the Mirglyn sisters in their work.  Small glass-front drawers holding assorted metal clasps and other findings used in the jewelers' creations line the back of each bench.

title: [[Riverhaven, Ioun's Pawn]]
description: Nothing in your lifetime has prepared you for the clutter you encounter in this shop.  Not a single hint of organization meets the eye.  Looking behind the counter you see an assortment of items that span the gamut from antique to brand new.  Dust is so thick on some of the older items that it is difficult to make out any color.  You kick yourself a path to the counter and are startled by Ioun, the shop owner, who was hidden by a stack of items on the counter.

title: [[Inside Tent]]
description: The room is almost bare except for a table resting atop a red rug in the center of the tent.  Salt deposits have streaked the lower quarter of the tent walls white, and the tide has left a scattering of seaweed and driftwood twigs on the sandy floor.

title: [[Eluned's Temple, Pool]]
description: The water is cold and salty, and deep.  The waterfall gently froths the water and lulls with a rhythmic splashing sound.

title: [[Eluned's Temple, Pool]]
description: Some light filters down from above, but beneath the water looks dark and deep.  What may lurk there is anyone's guess.

title: [[Shallow Pond, Deep Pool]]
description: The pool here is very deep, surrounded by large boulders and tall grass along a steep bank.  Warmed by an underground hot spring, the water is soothing and delightful.  Hanging just out of reach, a large rope swing is suspended from the upper branches of the large sana'ati tree in the meadow just beyond the pond.

title: [[Deep Pool, Sandy Shore]]
description: Pebbles and smooth sand line the shoreline.  Several old logs have been placed strategically along the edge of the water.  Swimmers stop to rest and watch the divers plummet into the water from the giant tree above or lurch out into the deep pool on the incredible rope swing.

title: [[Amorand the Tailor]]
description: Clothing in the traditional colors of Ratha's ruling families is displayed on mannequins atop the counters scattered about the shop.  An open door in the base of one cabinet reveals bolts of fabric stacked in neat rows beneath the counters.

title: [[Eluned's Temple, Pool]]
description: A rock protrudes, but it does not appear to be the bottom of the pool.  The cold water swirls in a strong current here.

title: [[Muspar'i Alchemy Society, Office]]
description: Several bookcases line the richly grained teak wood walls, a thick woven rug padding the polished sandstone floor underfoot.  Resting against the far wall of the dimly lit office is a large desk, a tall chair tucked neatly beneath it.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Corridor]]
description: An intricate mosaic creates a detailed mural of sweeping palm trees that runs the length of the corridor.  Brass lanterns overhead add to the temperature of the hall, which is considerably warmer than the outer areas.  The colorful archways to the east and west lead into the various work areas, the sounds of hammering and grinding metal reverberating throughout the area.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Forge]]
description: A massive iron anvil mounted on a granite pedestal stands in the center of the tiled floor.  Against the wall, a iron forge awaits things to heat, casting a reddish glow over the room.  Small windows high in the wall and open stacks overhead draw some of the heat outside to mingle with the dusty air.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Windows high up in the stone walls provide just a hint of fresh air over the stench of burning coal and molten metal.  Supported by chains from a wooden beam, a heavy ceramic crucible swings over the fire or over to the molds lined against the wall.  Shovels protrude from a pile of fuel nearby, the blackened coal waiting to be added to the fire.

title: [[Thieves' Highway]]
description: Flickering lights, cast from goat's horn sconces, reveal a circular tunnel with a cleared walkway.  Winding swiftly underneath the city overhead, the tunnel is punctuated at one end by a single, darkened doorway cast in shifting shadows.

title: [[Thieves' Highway]]
description: Smooth stone walls wrap around the tunnel, giving it a circular shape that is just large enough for the tallest Gor'Tog to pass.  Cleared from rubble and trash, the walkway here is uninterrupted in either direction and dimly flickering lights within goat's horn sconces light the passage towards the southeast.  A dark, rubble-filled gloom flickers its shadows across the western path.

title: [[Underground Passageway]]
description: Massive boulders from above press deeply into this rubble-strewn area.  Jagged corners of granite lurk everywhere, grinding harshly against each other, and against inhabitants' heads when they don't dodge swiftly enough.

title: [[Underground Passageway]]
description: This lengthy passageway is clogged with knife-sized bits of sharp debris.  Overhead several massive boulders block out most of the light, and the din of town traffic is reduced to a surflike roar.  No one stops to glance down between the chinks of rubble, leaving your travels unnoticed and undisturbed.

title: [[Underground Passageway]]
description: Jagged piles of debris line the center of this passageway, chips and shards of large rocks lodged deep in the low ceiling above.  A fine grey dust blankets everything else, sifting into clouds at knee-level from the passage of thieves.

title: [[The Raven's Court, Secret Passage]]
description: Though the cool stone walls are bare, a long maroon runner with pale golden fringe spreads across the length of the floor.  The tunnel's interior is visible only by the overflow of light from the basement beyond.  Despite being underground, a fresh breeze fills the space from an opening overhead cleverly concealed with leafy hedges above.

title: [[The Raven's Court, Basement]]
description: Crowding every inch of wall space, several shelves store everything from empty wine barrels to shiny gardening tools.  Piled into one corner, a collection of overturned boxes are arranged into layered seating like rows in an amphitheatre.  A long vegetable crate has been propped on its side for use as a podium in this makeshift meeting room.

title: [[Tunnel of Roses]]
description: Shuffling noises from the basement occasionally echo through the dark underground passage, lit by a few small glowstones inlaid in the ceiling.  No scent of dankness or mold lingers here, making the air refreshingly clean albeit a bit humid.  A painted mural of blossoming roses decorates the curved walls, and glimpses further east reveal the extent of the artist's work.

title: [[Tunnel of Roses]]
description: The sound of rushing water from above fills this curve of the passage, mostly dark save for the dim light from few small glowstones in the ceiling.  Soft and quiet as a whisper, a gentle breeze flows through the tunnel and cleanses the humid air, leaving no unpleasant scent of dankness or mold.  An extensive mural of multicolored roses curves along the length of the walls and into the shadows in both directions.

title: [[Tunnel of Roses]]
description: The muffled sounds of city life echo through this turn of the underground passage, originating from past the sloping ground where the tunnel approaches an opening.  Though the humid air is devoid of dank aromas, the tinge of soured ale occasionally drifts by on a soft breeze.  Daylight seeping in from the northeast illuminates the painted mural stretching along the curved walls, the subtle pinks and reds blending into the shadows toward the west.

title: [[Behind the Half Pint Inn]]
description: Heavy wooden ale kegs line the small back alley on all sides to form high barriers, save for the area to the southwest that slopes into a dark underground tunnel.  Dimpled glass windows along the building wall prevent the tavern's patrons from noticing any suspicious activity in the cramped lot.  A tangle of blue violet wolfsbane spills over the edges of a faded red flower box toward the cobble below as if attempting a daring escape from its wooden prison.

title: [[Sand Spit Tavern, Backroom]]
description: Behind the bar you find the storage area with barrels and casks of assorted brew.  A pot boy washing up some glasses in a pail of indifferently clean water looks up at you with dull surprise and continues his work.  There is a litter of broken glass here and you wonder if and when the place was last swept out.

title: [[Sand Spit Tavern, Cellar Room]]
description: This dank and cheerless place is the tavern's cellar.  Once a wine vault, the moisture and brackish water seeping in from the estuary ruined the wine.  Old barrels, mostly rotted and splintered still stand in a row.  Now largely unused, you have heard lurid tales of smugglers hiding down here to buy and sell and conduct other, less savoury dealings.

title: [[A Damp Cavern]]
description: This dark, muddly corridor looks like an intestinal tract lined with roughage.  It smells like one, too.  Perhaps it's all the decaying vegetation or just the rats that seem to come here solely to die, but the fumes alone could crack leather armor.

title: [[A Damp Cavern]]
description: The fetid air in this portion of the dark cavern is heavy with a green mist of fungi spores.  They sting and itch wherever they touch unprotected skin, and leave a burning sensation in mouth and throat.

title: [[Shard, Basement]]
description: This large cellar looks like a storeroom: stacks of crates, some bearing the Traders' Guild emblem, wrapped canvas bundles, and barrels of liquor are arranged in neat piles against the walls.  A dark doorway in the southern wall leads into a narrow tunnel.

title: [[Undershard, Tunnels]]
description: A small bubble in the rock has been enlarged and shaped to provide just enough room to stand in.  Inside the rounded walls, the incessant cries of the grey market merchants are reduced to mere whispers.  A fire outside the entrance lights a long cramped corridor cut through the rock to the northeast.

title: [[Svra'an's Fine Jewelry]]
description: A glass display case lined with deep blue velvet runs the length of the room.  Carefully arranged on the velvet are precious gems and metals fashioned by the skill of the gemsmith into delicate circlets, sparkling rings and polished ru'at bracelets.  On top of the case, a tooled leather catalog embossed in gold lists the various items offered for sale.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Corridor]]
description: An intricate mosaic creates a detailed mural of sweeping palm trees that runs the length of the corridor.  Brass lanterns overhead add to the temperature of the hall, which is considerably warmer than the outer areas.  The colorful archways to the east and west lead into the various work areas, the sounds of hammering and grinding metal reverberating throughout the area.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Corridor]]
description: An intricate mosaic creates a detailed mural of sweeping palm trees that runs the length of the corridor.  Brass lanterns overhead add to the temperature of the hall, which is considerably warmer than the outer areas.  The colorful archways to the east and west lead into the various work areas, the sounds of hammering and grinding metal reverberating throughout the area.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Grand Foyer]]
description: Richly veneered cherrywood beams climb the polished marble walls, peaking to form the arch of the high vaulted glass ceiling.  Evening light casts a dim glow upon the stone floors, lengthening the shadows beneath a wide deobar staircase that leads to an open hallway above.  The sounds of thrifty commerce seem enhanced in the echo -- every footstep, every jingle of coin and every barter from the nearby Exchange fill the air with promises of exciting ventures and profitable returns.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Private Dock]]
description: Crates and barrels line the docks, all properly tied and marked as they wait for shipment abroad.  Dockhands and guild clerks mill about on the dock as they unload, sort and load -- their heavy boots making a rhythmic plodding sound on the wooden surface.  Wheeled carts are filled with goods and readied for the short trek up the ramp and into the Traders' Guild.

title: [[The Trader's Guild, Lower Deck]]
description: Shadowed by the decks above and hanging over the deep, rolling ocean, the lower deck provides a delightful view of the sea.  Every now and then the tumbling waves crash against the dock and spray the deck with water, leaving it constantly damp and glistening.  Deck chairs have been lined up between the doors on the south side of the guildhall, keeping them fairly dry for those wishing to relax and enjoy the salty air.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Hallway]]
description: Separated from the lower foyer by an open wooden rail, the narrow hallway provides an excellent view of the room below -- as well as an acoustical ear into any conversations carelessly spoken under the wide, vaulted ceiling.  Open glass doors to the west lead out onto an elevated wooden deck, while a large, finely carved door leads into the only room on the second floor, the guild leader's office.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Seranda's Office]]
description: Memoirs gathered from countless journeys on the high seas are decoratively placed around the room, some clustered on small tables and some hanging along the walls.  A low cherrywood desk stands in front of an open window that faces the guild's private dock, providing a view of the activity.  Placed beside it is a high-backed wicker chair of local craftsmanship, filled with watersilk cushions and pillows, custom-made to suit the Guild Leader's taste and comfort.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Mariners' Deck]]
description: Taking full advantage of the panoramic view of the docks, this finished wooden deck has been constructed upon the lower roof of the Guild Hall, looking out towards the sea.  Tables and chairs have been placed about the area, somewhat protected from the elements by a large wooden awning that overhangs the deck.  Elderly mariners and traders gather in groups around the tables, boasting of good deals or telling tales of dangers on the high seas as they puff on pipes and gaze down on the lights of the harbor.

title: [[The Traders' Guild, Kitchen]]
description: Arranged in a fashion much like the galley of a ship, this private kitchen serves not only the private needs of the Guildleader and her staff but also provides the food and menus for the restaurant and rope-service.  Crates of goods line the back wall along with dangling dried meats and seasonal fruits, filling the kitchen with a constant, spicy aroma.  A chipped cat dish has been placed below the heavy wooden prep table in the center of the room.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Public Hall]]
description: A large, bulging lower branch of the mighty Sana'ati Dyaus has been hollowed out to form the public auditorium here.  The arching ceiling and concave walls make the acoustics perfect for speeches, bardic recitals, music and plays.  Thick, sturdy grass mats form the spacious seating area, and spectators can spread out and enjoy the programs.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Grand Hollow]]
description: You stand within the Grand Hollow of Sana'ati Dyaus.  Great vertical ribs of wood have been lovingly shaped over generations into upward-sweeping vaults and buttresses that support the vast interior space.  Light filters in from an unseen source on high.  As in all multistoried structures in Leth Deriel, inconspicuous wooden stairs sculpted into the sides of the chamber lead to the higher levels and upper branches of the trunk.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Mayoral Branch]]
description: It is difficult to tell from this office who it actually belongs to, save for some faceless, nameless town official.  Since the mundane day-to-day tasks of running a municipality have never appealed to the most talented and bright of Leth Deriel's citizens, having a politician in one's family line is more often a source of embarrassment than not.  There are not even portraits of former town officials on the walls here.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Fees Branch]]
description: A rather bored Elven lass presides over the office here, where debts, taxes, fees and other fines incurred within the jurisdiction of Leth Deriel are paid.  The spare furnishings consist of a table with a few cast-off chairs.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Registry Branch]]
description: Here is where legal and official things are recorded, including births, deaths, marriages and such, wills, inheritance, property deeds, and items.  The dusty folders on a decrepit desk in the center of the room attest to the regard that most Elvenfolk have for bureaucracy.  Behind the desk sits an even more decrepit looking Head Registrar, appearing emaciated even for one of his race.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Top Platform]]
description: You stand at the highest point of the famed sylvan stronghold of Leth Deriel.  This platform is nestled in a fork of the topmost branches of the venerable Sana'ati tree which forms the focus of the town.  Groves and footpaths radiate out from this massive arbor in a series of concentric rings, much as the growth of a tree trunk is marked.  As you gaze down to observe the scurrying of townsfolk far below, you instinctively clutch for a secure branch.

title: [[Froissart's Tannery, The Supply Room]]
description: The supply room projects an air of quiet efficiency when Froissart is away and hectic activity when he's present.  Bottles, paper patterns, and tools stand neatly arranged on shelves that line the room behind a polished wooden counter.  Placed squarely in the center of the counter is a vellum catalog.

title: [[Survivalist Supplies, Front Room]]
description: Fragrant pine boughs hang to the ground, sheltering this quiet space from the elements.  Flickering light from a fire crackling in a stone-lined pit sends dancing reflections against the forest-green curtain that divides the trunk into a cozy semicircle.  Comfortable but businesslike, every spare corner of the room is jumbled with equipment suspended from hooks and pegs on the walls or stacked neatly on chests and cabinets crafted from sturdy oak and knotted pine.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Stable]]
description: Thick walls of mortared fieldstone dance with wavering light from tin-backed lanterns perched at intervals along the walls.  A thick bed of fresh straw insulates the cool stone of the floor and muffles the footfalls of both rider and beast.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Stable]]
description: Rough wood-sided stalls stand side by side like attentive soldiers, their edges chewed to uneven scallops by previous boarders.  Assorted pieces of worn or broken tack hang on hooks about the walls awaiting the skilled hand of the leather worker to give them new life.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Training Yard]]
description: Shrouded in shadow, the training yard looms with unseen obstacles.  Faint detail appears if one looks closely.

Paved with broad flat-topped cobbles, its boundaries marked by thick walls easily the height of the average mounted Gor'Tog, the training yard bears little resemblance to the wide grassy plains most of its current inhabitants once occupied.  A stout pole corral stands against the far wall, and nearby, brightly painted sawhorses await the next jumping practice.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Granary]]
description: Bins of weathered grey wood line the walls, their contents protected by solid lids fastened with stout iron locks.  Trickles of grain trail from worn and chewed corners, betraying the persistent assault upon their contents by resident mice and rats.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Quintan's Leather]]
description: The smell of buffed leather hangs thick in the air, mingling with the mixed aromas of the stable.  Tools of all shapes and sizes hang on nails and hooks on the walls in this makeshift workspace, while bits of leather and rope cover the floor.  The mess builds up around a horse-shaped armor stand that sits against one wall, bearing the weight of several scarred pieces.

title: [[Blackthorn Canyon, Sutler's Wagon]]
description: A riot of color and pattern assaults the eyes and disorients the senses.  Every conceivable surface in the small wagon is cluttered with wares.  Items on the shelves and racks lining the windowless interior are neatly arrayed while scattered crates and boxes gather a wide assortment of goods.

title: [[Blackthorn Canyon, Sutler's Wagon]]
description: Brindle Roundtoe perches atop a small stool behind a low counter in the rear of the wagon.  The corners of the sutler's bright eyes crinkle with interest as they furtively assess the goods on the shelves and cases around the interior.  On the wall next to him, a mail vest and dented cookpot helm hang close at hand.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Foyer]]
description: The crescent-shaped room soars upward the full height of the theater, to an intricately painted ceiling depicting a clear, starry night sky.  Silver gilt molding frames the depiction, matching the columns down the walls and the balusters along the grand staircase.  Raw silk panels in a rich ivory hue line the space between the columns.  On one side of the staircase, two shorter columns flank an archway leading to the floor seating area, while on the opposite side, a matching pair highlights a recessed doorway.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Memories]]
description: Ivory-hued lacquered panels line the walls of the shop, and a glass counter stretches along the length of the room.  Silver-gilt racks and silk-lined shelves display collectibles and necessities.  Gaethzen globes draped with strings of crystal beading create a softly flickering light to attractively highlight the merchandise.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Lounge]]
description: Midnight blue lacquered panels line the walls of the lounge, a polished silverwood bar curving across one corner.  Behind the bar, matching silverwood shelves display several bottles of featured wines, served from a silver tray resting on the bar.  Bright silver sconces hold crystal shades that reflect their light in a rippling underwater effect.  Tables and tall bentwood-backed chairs allow patrons to sit and enjoy their selections before or after performances.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Backstage]]
description: The working heart of the theater, this area is alive with activity during performances as actors and staff rush between the men's and women's dressing rooms to the northwest and southwest and the wing to the southeast.  Though sparsely decorated in comparison to the public areas, a few luxuries are available.  A small silk-draped niche in one wall bears a statue, and a cart nearby holds tea and light refreshments.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Stage Wing]]
description: A strange calm hangs over the stage wings even during performances, in stark contrast to the activity just a few paces away backstage.  Performers and stage hands wait here in silence for cues to enter the stage or change scenes.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Orchestra Pit]]
description: Simple chairs, their legs muffled with thick felt, provide seating for musicians.  From here, a conductor can direct both the orchestra and any singers on stage.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Women's Dressing Room]]
description: Rich blue silk hangings line the walls, a luxury that serves to dampen noise and provide an atmosphere of calm for those preparing here.  Shelves and wardrobes bear costumes for the current production.  Mirrors along one wall allow actors to check their appearance before going to the wings.  A sign in bold but elegant script hangs on the wall.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Men's Dressing Room]]
description: Dark silk hangings line the walls, a luxury that serves to dampen noise and provide an atmosphere of calm for those preparing here.  Shelves and wardrobes bear costumes for the current production.  Mirrors along one wall allow actors to check their appearance before going to the wings.  A sign in bold but elegant script hangs on the wall.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Mezzanine Landing]]
description: The staircase broadens here to allow theatergoers to pass through the archway to the mezzanine seating without disrupting the flow of those continuing upward to the balcony.  Highly polished railings protect against falls while allowing a view of the foyer below, and intricately patterned carpets soften the sounds of footsteps.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Patron's Lounge]]
description: Silver-veined white marble tiles cover the floor, and silk tapestries depicting cloudscapes hang on the walls.  A bar faced with white quartz extends along one side of the room, with padded high-backed chairs pulled up to it or clustered around one of several small silver-gilt tables with marble tops.  Matching booths line the opposite wall, providing opportunity for private conversation between the artists and potential or current patrons.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Balcony Landing]]
description: The staircase broadens here at the top to allow easy passage through the archway to the balcony and box seating.  Highly polished railings protect against falls while allowing a view of the foyer far below, and intricately patterned carpets soften the sounds of footsteps.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Mezzanine Seating]]
description: Plush velvet upholstery covers the seats, the top edge of each gilt in silver.  At this height, the stage is easily viewable, as is the chandelier hanging from the ceiling over the orchestra section.  Overhead, the partial ceiling provided by the balcony section is painted a deep ebon hue, and tiny inset crystal stars display constellations.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Orchestra Seating]]
description: Plush velvet upholstery covers the seats, the top edge of each gilt in silver.  The stage is easily viewable from this gently sloping section, allowing a view over any taller theatergoers in front.  An elaborate chandelier hangs from the ebon-hued ceiling, in which inset crystal stars display constellations in an intricate depiction of the night sky.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Upper Landing]]
description: Sturdy railings provide safety for those passing from the staircase through the door to the theater roof and the outdoor performance area.  One newel post has been carved in a depiction of a tower.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Outdoor Stage]]
description: The simple stage consists of a raised platform of wood planks.  Lanterns provide light for nighttime performances.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Understage]]
description: Here in the underbelly of the theater, items are all but abandoned -- damaged or worn beyond easy repair, awaiting eventual disposal or perhaps salvage and rebirth as pieces for new props or costumes.  A trapdoor leads up to the stage floor for actors entering or exiting through some abyss or Eylhaar's embrace.  A noticeable draft passes between the steps and a large brass grate.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Stage]]
description: A row of lights illuminates the boards and those who take their place upon them.  Dark curtains block sight of the wings.

title: [[Shoan a Sidelkuloa, Outdoor Seating Rows]]
description: Rows of polished wooden boards are shaped to provide comfort to theater attendees even in this simple setting.

title: [[Fernwyk's Fish]]
description: Wooden stands line the walls, supporting water-filled glass tanks.  Some contain schools of silvery fish that wheel and dart in unison, others contain a single jewel-toned specimen against a backdrop of swaying water grass.

title: [[Pischic's Pearls]]
description: Polished wooden apothecary cabinets hold row after row of tiny drawers along the far side of the shop.  Between the cabinets is a shallow workbench padded with soft velvet.  Soldering irons bristle amidst the coals of a brazier, kept hot until required for use.  Tendrils of smoke rising from the fire give the air of pleasant fragrance.  At the front of the store, an assortment of jewelry is displayed atop a dark case.

title: [[Anyaila's Fine Clothing, Sales Floor]]
description: Shelves line the walls, filled with lengths of fabric in a wide range of colors and materials.  The wooden floor is littered with scraps of material and discarded bits of thread around the low stool where the seamstress works.  Above it all, a round shoemaker's lamp casts a steady light over the area.

title: [[Krimand's House of Stuff]]
description: Layer upon layer of woven reed mats cushions the floor, doing little to disguise the tilting boards beneath.  Stacks of oilskin rain gear occupy a crate in the lowest corner of the store, while packs, panniers and other carriers hang from the center pole.  Assorted mirrors hang upon the far wall, swaying slightly with the movement of the water beneath the hut and sending rainbows of reflected light over the shop's flaking paint.

title: [[Salt Yard, Barge Dock]]
description: A row of water-stained benches occupies the deck of the Imperial Glory, where wealthy passengers can sit at ease and view the beautiful landscape, rolling forests and a few sandy beaches, of southern Therengia.  Ropes used to tie off the barge when in harbor neatly hang from metal hooks.  A tall railing along the side of the barge helps prevent the careless traveler from falling overboard into the murky waters, and a door leads within a cabin.

title: [[Salt Yard, Barge Dock]]
description: The ship's captain directs the crew as the Riverhawk plies the waters of the Faldesu.  A long and thick wooden board, used as a gangplank when the barge is at dock, rests beside a railing the height of a Human's chest, and heavy coils of rope are placed at haphazard intervals.  Passengers huddle closely together upon the cargo barge's one bench.

title: [[Stone Docks, Covered Shore]]
description: A row of water-stained benches occupies the deck of the Imperial Glory, where wealthy passengers can sit at ease and view the beautiful landscape, rolling forests and a few sandy beaches, of southern Therengia.
