title: [[Stone Docks, Covered Shore]]
description: The cabin is sparsely decorated, if pleasantly, and with an air of affluence -- a painting of a flower-filled meadow hangs from one wall, and a wooden sidebar provides drink for the passengers.  A cherrywood table and the chairs surrounding it are nailed to the deck of the barge, providing relative stability as the moderate-sized craft moves through the rolling waters.

title: [[Salt Yard, Barge Dock]]
description: The cabin is sparsely decorated, if pleasantly, and with an air of affluence -- a painting of a flower-filled meadow hangs from one wall, and a wooden sidebar provides drink for the passengers.  A cherrywood table and the chairs surrounding it are nailed to the deck of the barge, providing relative stability as the moderate-sized craft moves through the rolling waters.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, Caged]]
description: The walls, floor and ceiling of this cramped space resemble driftwood, lacking the clean lines typically found on cut timber.  Seeping through gaps between the unevenly spaced planks, the sand of Velaka has worked its way inside, as if asserting that no structure is as timeless as the dunes.  Spread out along the floor are several small cages wrapped in wire mesh, containing the beasts for sale in the establishment.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, The Canopy]]
description: A forest of heavy, burlap cloth hangs in thin strips from ceiling to sand floor, dyed the color of tree bark.  Between the cross-woven supports overhead, many more folds of dark green fabric serve to resemble foliage, though not very convincingly.  Amidst the artificial trees dwell several mannequins displaying the wares for sale, most of which stand out starkly from the distinctly non-native landscape.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, Ilerenz's Supplies]]
description: Surprisingly sturdy walls of heavy burlap cloth hang from carved wooden beams down to the scuffed oak floor, making what would otherwise be a modest desert lean-to resemble a formal structure found in most any town.  Within the confines of the room stand several tables and racks, proudly displaying the mottled assortment of goods available for purchase.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, Oil and Leather]]
description: The fabric of the walls and ceiling, stretched flat and fluttering slightly from the currents of air beyond, stands in contrast to the simple sand floor, making the room an uncharacteristic clash between establishment and nature.  Settled into the soft ground near the back of the tent, an arrangement of benches and tables serve as the tanner's shop, his completed wares on display in the middle of the room.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, The Spade and Stave]]
description: Serving as a cross between the hamlet's weapon shop and watering hole, the interior of the tent is a peculiar sight to behold.  A stone-topped bar in the center of the room is attended by a clerk, who also casually keeps an eye on the weapons lined up along the walls.

title: [[Haizen Cugis, Fletcher]]
description: Dark cloth serving as the roof and walls of the tent blocks any outside light, enshrouding the space in a murky darkness.  Piercing the tenebrous veil, a single oil lamp with a flickering flame illuminates the wares of the bowyer who set his shop here, though the craftsman is nowhere to be seen.

title: [[Imble's Ironworks, Receiving Docks]]
description: Stepping through the large doorway, you enter a cavernous building.  Rife with smoke and heat, the thought occurs to turn and seek the freshness of the air outside the door.  Three crumbling stone steps lead into a room, illuminated brightly by the blazing foundry.  Enormous carts filled with rocks and dirt are queued, waiting to be transported along the tracks toward the inferno beyond.

title: [[Imble's Ironworks, Foundry]]
description: Burning every moment of every day, the great fires of the foundry generate enormous heat.  Giant bellows and cooling fans, operated by the teams of burly slaves, assist the smiths in creating the famous anchors.  Though master craftsman abound in this shop, Imble himself is always willing to give the interested visitor a sound lesson in taming the molten iron ore.

title: [[Ratha, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive conical building rises from the cobbles at the square's center, its snowy alabaster surfaces gleaming brilliantly.  A sparkling mosaic of coral and turquoise set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Ratha, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Fornsted, Pavilion Tannery]]
description: Preserved hides of large creatures, complete with long claws and pointed teeth, have been nailed to boards and hung about as trophies or perhaps as a testament of the tanner's skill.  The scent of fresh hides being cured by strong chemicals permeates the room.  A large high-backed leather chair sits before a dark-stained worktable littered with various tools of the trade.  A rack of sharp tools stands next to a grindstone in the far corner.

title: [[Fornsted, Pavilion Outpost]]
description: A large wooden desk looks strangely out of place on the cobbled floor.  Small tufts of grass struggle to sprout between the stones in the less trafficked corners.  A Dwarven clerk stands at the desk, busily recording inventory and shipments in several ledgers stacked about him.  The commerce minister is stationed within eyeshot of both the clerks and workers.

title: [[Fornsted, Chapel]]
description: The chapel is built of fine-grained deobar wood.  The predominant feature is an altar of polished alabaster, a bronze lion depicted on the front in tile mosaic.  Poised above the altar is a luminous gold and jade cobra with emerald eyes, its silver tongue forking between sharp fangs.  A few candelabra are scattered about the room, illuminating the cherrywood benches facing the front of the chapel.

title: [[Fornsted, Wall]]
description: On the stone walls surrounding Fornsted village and the keep, the surrounding areas are clearly visible.  A looking glass is mounted upon a pedestal, pointed to the east.  Rough slits are carved in the surface of the wall, allowing crossbows to be aimed below.

title: [[Fornsted, Wall]]
description: A massive iron cauldron rests on the walkway, a dangerous weapon in times of battle when filled with boiling oil or water.  A pedestal facing southwest contains a metal scope allowing the soldiers of the keep to survey the landscape.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Outskirts, An Abandoned Field]]
description: Untidy sheaves of wheat, out of reach of the meager protection offered by the stone wall, lean against one another while weeds spring up around their bases.  A narrow strip of packed earth runs between the tangle of thorny vines and the wall.  Thready runners stretch across the bare ground, greedily reaching for the untouched greenery.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Outskirts, An Abandoned Field]]
description: Curling away from the scorched strip of land to the south, the thorny vines form a tangled mat overwhelming the scattered clumps of withered wheat pushing up through the invasive vegetation.  Crops already engulfed slowly rot into mulch, fertilizing the vines and adding their aroma to the ashy scent hanging over the field.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Outskirts, An Abandoned Field]]
description: Curling away from the scorched strip of land to the south, the thorny vines form a tangled mat overwhelming the scattered clumps of withered wheat pushing up through the invasive vegetation.  Crops already engulfed slowly rot into mulch, fertilizing the vines and adding their aroma to the ashy scent hanging over the field.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Outskirts, An Abandoned Field]]
description: Withered amethyst bloom vines hang limply against the stone wall, nearly engulfed by the rapacious thorny green vines.  Stretching toward the sky, a few hardy weeds stubbornly struggle to survive the engulfing tangle of vines.  Over the wall, a dense forest stretches northwards, blanketing part of the slope of Asketi's Mount.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Outskirts, An Abandoned Field]]
description: Stunted and withered stalks of wheat are strangled by thick greenish-brown vines armed with cruel thorns.  Running parallel to the weathered stone wall at the edge of the field, a broad swathe of bare, scorched earth cuts across the untended rows.  The scent of smoke lingers unpleasantly, and only a few tracks of small animals give evidence that there are still regular visitors to the area.

title: [[Observatory, Reception Lounge]]
description: Candles flickering in wall sconces of ornate bronzework light this wide chamber, the ebony hardwood floor reflecting a bright sheen from the passage of countless slippered feet.  A light smell of incense hangs in the air, tickling the nostrils of passersby as it wafts through a gilded archway to the west.

title: [[Observatory, Seers' Passage]]
description: This short hallway runs from west to east, opening into a larger area through a golden arch at the west end.  Curtains of various colors cover open doorways lining both sides of the hall, the closest a gold one on the north wall, and a silver to the south.

title: [[Observatory, Gold Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of gold, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Silver Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of silver, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Seers' Passage]]
description: A pair of alcoves stand opposite each other in this section of the corridor, each covered by a metal-colored curtain.  The opening to the north sports an iron-colored drapery, and the one to the south is graced by a cloth of copper.

title: [[Observatory, Iron Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of iron-grey, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Copper Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of copper, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Seers' Passage]]
description: The end of this corridor can be seen, not far to the east.  A bronze curtain hangs across an alcove on the north wall, and a deep crimson one to the south.

title: [[Observatory, Bronze Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of bronze, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Crimson Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of crimson, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Seers' Passage]]
description: The corridor ends here at a cold mahogany wall, the passage stretching far to the west.  An ivory curtain hangs over the northern opening, while one of midnight black conceals its southern counterpart.

title: [[Observatory, White Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of ivory, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Observatory, Ebony Room]]
description: This small, round parlor is bounded by a series of doors, each the entry to a guild member's residence.  Furnished with a low table and chairs, callers may wait for friends who may be entertaining or working.  Everything is trimmed in shades of ebony, matching the curtain hanging over the exit.

title: [[Blackthorn Canyon, Dwarf's Tent]]
description: Cool darkness and a thick musty scent fill the dank and confining space inside the tent.  A bright circle of light hovers just above a polished stone table arrayed with little heaps of gems on swaths of velvet.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Silver Suite]]
description: The room is surprisingly elegant for the surroundings.  The walls are panelled with burlwood and silverwood.  Thick carpets woven in complex patterns cover the floor completely.  A huge four-poster bed dominates the room and its function possibly explains the elegant decor.  Curtained windows set with frosted glass provide privacy while filtering the light into something soft and warm.

title: [[Taelbert's Inn, Linen Closet]]
description: Shelves stacked neatly with fresh linens line the walls from floor to ceiling.  In one corner, a pile of fluffy comforters looks oddly out of place in the otherwise well-ordered room.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Dining Hall]]
description: Partially filling the void of the massive room is the bulk of a dining table, its dark wood matching the wall trim in type, color and poor present condition.  Empty plates still wait on the table, seemingly random in their positioning and nowhere near the single chair that sits nearby nor its long deceased occupant.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Kitchen]]
description: Cabinets left open and barren, countertops stained and covered in fungal growth, and the overall unwholesome state indicate that this kitchen has not been used in a long time.  The yellowed webbing so prevalent elsewhere in the manor is present here as well, at least to a lesser extent, seemingly sewing together ceiling and wall, floor and counter.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Kitchen]]
description: A lifetime flickers past, and the spoils of wealthy living decay and fall away, leaving only memories of a finer time.  Food rots and turns to dust, wood crumbles with moisture, and portraits fade.  This kitchen displays these truths in all their harshness, webs draping from the ceiling like burial shrouds for the long forgotten meals prepared here.

title: [[Oshu'ehhrsk Manor, Pantry]]
description: Dust is all that remains of the foodstuffs collected here, once so carefully labeled and placed upon the shelves in convenient containers.  Absence may make the heart grow fonder, but an absence of kitchen workers and hungry diners has left only flasks filled with murkiness, boxes marked with such frail delicacies as "cookies" and "bread," and wine racks lined with cracked bottles.

title: [[Genevive's Sweet Tooth]]
description: The heavenly scent of baking sweets floats through the air on a gentle breeze coming from the oven in the store's backroom.  Metal trays stacked on shelves along the walls hold a wide assortment of finished edibles waiting to be purchased.  Genevive, the woman who single-handedly runs the bakery, runs back and forth from the kitchen to the front room, bringing forth the latest delight.

title: [[MAMAS Company, Shard Branch]]
description: Shard's assay shop is filled with the smell of new wood and plaster.  Builders move in and out, hurrying to get the place finished, while the assay clerk stands behind a counter in the midst of the clutter and confusion, quietly working away.

title: [[Lowest Depths, Corridor]]
description: Masses of membranous bulges and conduits run in a seemingly endless array across the walls and ceiling, pulsating and constricting in uneven intervals.  Each section of corridor looks like the last, the different doors your only confirmation of progress.

title: [[Beech Glade, Low Hammock]]
description: Just above the ground, the hammock sways gently with each movement.  The quiet spot is pleasantly shaded.

title: [[Sewer]]
description: The packed dirt tunnel leads east and west through soggy piles of refuse.

title: [[Ice Caves, Narrow Bridge]]
description: Water surges directly below a narrow stretch of stone that connects the cavern walls with a slender pillar of rock that rises up out of the glacial lake.  Although the bridge is made of the same dark stone that makes up the walls, none of the reassuring strength is apparent, and each step across it is a test of willpower.

title: [[Ice Caves, Rock Pillar]]
description: Rising from the depths of the lake, this pillar overlooks much of the hollow mountain.  Waves slap against the slender base and spray from their crests makes the chill even more apparent.  A massive glacier is barely visible to the northeast as it slowly slips beneath the water's surface, and to the southwest, the vague outline of a bridge rises into the darkness.

title: [[Undershard, Sewage Tunnel]]
description: Raw sewage clogs this claustrophobic tunnel, the air choked with nauseating fumes.  Tiny creatures wriggle through the muck, their wormlike bodies writhing just beneath the surface.  The tunnel slopes downward to the north, into utter darkness.

title: [[Undershard, Sewage Tunnel]]
description: The brick ceiling arches downward as the river of sewage rises, and only a small pocket of rancid air allows survival.  A slow current moves the sludge northward, odd strands of phosphorus goo casting the narrow tunnel in a sickly green glow.

title: [[Undershard, Sewage Tunnel]]
description: A lazy current pushes a river of waste northward.  This cramped tunnel angles sharply downward and makes it near-impossible to wade against the filth.  Further north, the tunnel opens up into a large area, some sort of underground grotto.

title: [[Undershard, Sewage Grotto]]
description: An archway to the east opens onto a rounded plateau overlooking a steady stream of raw sewage, pouring from a drainage tunnel to the south.  The air is thick with the rancid, oppressive stench of humanoid waste as it slides northward into a second tunnel, this one blocked off with a rusted iron grate.  A sign has been hung over the canal, coated with sloppy red paint on a tattered board.

title: [[Undershard, The Gallery]]
description: This broad gallery is a boulevard of sorts, stretching from the northern to the southern ends of Undershard.  The stone walls have crumbled and fallen in spots, revealing packed earth and glimpses of natural caverns just beyond, while archways open up onto vaults once used for storing supplies.

title: [[Undershard, The Gallery]]
description: Grooves are worn into the flagstone floor of this vast gallery hall, where wagons were used to haul siege supplies from one end of the Undershard to the other.  The gallery runs north and south, beyond the limits of vision.

title: [[Undershard, The Gallery]]
description: The main gallery of the Undershard splits off here, with another broad corridor running east down a slight incline.  Most of the wagon tracks seem to roll in that direction, towards what might have once been the main storage vaults.  This great hall continues to the north and south.

title: [[Undershard, Low Gallery]]
description: The ceiling of this broad gallery dips low as it intersects with a great boulevard to the west, rotting timbers propping up the dangerously weakened stone walls on either side. The gallery runs eastward, the ground underfoot furrowed with old wagon tracks.

title: [[Undershard, Low Gallery]]
description: Ensconced torches light the way down this long gallery as it runs from east to west, the tunnel serving as a makeshift street for citizens of the Undershard.  Many of the small vaults leading off to the north and south have been converted to black market shops or squatters' homes, a crude parody of the city streets just overhead.

title: [[Undershard, Derleth's Teahouse]]
description: Brick walls painted a glistening black, this sedate teahouse seems oddly at home in the warrens of the Undershard.  The patrons, a mixed lot, share a common bond of silence:  there seems to be an unwritten law against speaking over a whisper in the sparse, dimly-lit chamber.

title: [[Undershard, Teahouse Corridor]]
description: This small corridor has almost completely caved in, forcing you to squeeze around fallen timbers and debris.  None of the patrons seem to venture down this corridor, to the darkened room on the eastern end.

title: [[Undershard, Teahouse Storage]]
description: This cramped room is piled high with wooden boxes and crates, storage supplies for the teahouse.  Judging from the official Shard government seals on most of the boxes, it doesn't seem as though the teahouse is supplied by a very reputable source.  A small corridor leads west, back to the main room.

title: [[Undershard, Caved-In Junction]]
description: Numerous wagon tracks turn to the north, rolling up a vast corridor that intersects with this one.  However, a cave-in has destroyed the junction, the northern way blocked off by a wall of solid rock.  Whatever was once there is forever lost, and the locals pay the rubble no attention.

title: [[Undershard, Low Gallery]]
description: The low gallery ends here at a sheer stone wall, once ceiling.  Their import has been lost, buried beneath countless defacements and lines of obscene graffitti.  The gallery runs westward, past archways leading to smaller side vaults.

title: [[Undershard, Temple Foyer]]
description: This short corridor has been converted into the foyer of a temple, the air scented with incense and the walls painted with images of Hodierna.  Not a speck of graffitti mars the spotless adornments.  Southward, this corridor opens onto a large vaulted chamber.

title: [[Undershard, Temple of Hodierna]]
description: This abandoned storage chamber has been refurnished as a temple, the rough stone walls painstakingly painted with beautiful, elaborate murals.  An altar of rosewood stands at the center of the room, lit with beeswax candles and surrounded by small piles of crude offerings from passers-by.

title: [[Undershard, Priest's Bedroom]]
description: This humble chamber, furnished only with a threadbare cot, is the bedroom of this temple's resident cleric.  A single candle of pure white wax lights the room, casting a warm glow over the dusty brick walls and keeping back the shadows.

title: [[Undershard, The Wayfarer]]
description: The Wayfarer looks like a bawdy-house in a Dwarven mine, sashes of garish red velvet put up to mask crumbling brick walls.  The local clientele is from Undershard's rougher side -- scavengers, mercenaries and thieves -- and they ignore the squalor of their surroundings with help from the local brew.  A narrow hallway runs off to the north, and a wide table commands a good view of the room.

title: [[Undershard, Wayfarer Hallway]]
description: The Wayfarer offers a small number of private rooms for entertaining, a black lacquered door and a yellow door flanking either side of this narrow hallway.  To the south, the hallway opens up onto the back of the tavern, and ends a short distance to the north.

title: [[Undershard, The Yellow Room]]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, this destitute nook has been made up as a makeshift bedroom with a filthy, flea-infested mattress.  The walls are festooned with putrid yellow paint, splotched with mildew and decay.  A yellow door leads out to the hallway.

title: [[Undershard, The Black Room]]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, this destitute nook has been made up as a makeshift bedroom with a filthy, flea-infested mattress.  The walls are festooned with putrid black paint, splotched with mildew and decay.  A black door leads out to the hallway.

title: [[Undershard, Wayfarer Hallway]]
description: The short hallway comes to a dead end here, flanked on the east and the west by a green door and a red door.  The paint is peeling from the walls in chunks, and the rancid stench of unwashed flesh fills the air.

title: [[Undershard, The Red Room]]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, this destitute nook has been made up as a makeshift bedroom with a filthy, flea-infested mattress.  The walls are festooned with putrid red paint, splotched with mildew and decay.  A red door leads out to the hallway.

title: [[Undershard, The Green Room]]
description: Barely bigger than a closet, this destitute nook has been made up as a makeshift bedroom with a filthy, flea-infested mattress.  The walls are festooned with putrid green paint, splotched with mildew and decay.  A green door leads out to the hallway.

title: [[Undershard, The Gallery]]
description: Arched timbers support the vaulted ceiling some fifteen feet above, where moisture leaks from the crumbling roof and drips into muddy puddles on the dank stone floor.  This great gallery continues to the south, and to the north it opens onto a large room, not far up the passage from here.

title: [[Undershard, South of Well]]
description: A great well dominates the center of this vast natural cavern, the rough stone walls reinforced with brick and wooden beams.  A passage leads south, to a warren of smaller vaults, and the rubble-strewn ground winds around the well on either side.  Further to the north, across the chamber, sounds of shouting can be heard.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, East of Well]]
description: A plank runs from east to west across the yawning maw of a wide, open well.  Occasionally, a pair of locals will meet on the plank itself and engage in a ritual combat of sorts, leaping about and performing feats of acrobatics until one falls over the edge and into the pit below.  Most of the time, the loser manages to crawl back out again.  The cavern wall curves around here, running southwest to northwest.

title: [[Undershard, On the Plank]]
description: Only a thin plank of green, worm-eaten wood lies between you and the abyss of the great well, its stone shaft plunging into darkness far below.  A faint rustling sound echoes up from the pit, like leathery wings preparing to take flight, but nothing moves in the shadows.  The plank runs from west to east, touching on either rim of the well.

title: [[Undershard, West of Well]]
description: Pitons hold a rotting rope ladder in place, its rungs dangling down into the gaping maw of a dry well.  Beside it, a narrow wooden plank has been laid across the well to touch the eastern rim.  The cavern curves around here, from southeast to northeast, and a side corridor runs off to the northwest.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, Well Bottom]]
description: Faint light shines down from the mouth of the well some twenty feet above, casting deep shadows across the crumbling stone walls of this ancient shaft.  Slimy mud burbles up from the earth, giving off clouds of putrid odor.  A rope ladder, its rungs frayed and treacherous, dangles down from above.

title: [[Undershard, Causeway]]
description: Rough brownstone walls are silent sentinels as the causeway passes over a dark ditch used for flushing refuse out of the area.  The loudest shouts from the Grey Market are a tinny echo as they pierce the solitary gloom and bounce off the cobbled floor.

title: [[Undershard, Tunnel Passage]]
description: Relegated into a corner by passing feet, a smear of matted fur is squabbled over by a swarm of minute insects hovering like a cloud of dust motes.  Nearby, the scratching sound of claw on cobble hints at a speedier companion than the corpse.

title: [[Undershard, Tunnel Passage]]
description: Like a thief slipping unseen past guards, a small chink overhead admits a narrow shaft of light that slithers to the floor, creating a small puddle on the filthy cobbles.  The feeble efforts of what should serve as a ray of brightness fail miserably and serve only to further darken the surroundings.

title: [[Undershard, Tile Tunnel]]
description: Seepage from the ceiling runs down the walls in dark rivulets, leaving behind ridged lime deposits that glisten in the half-light.  Green moss draperies spread fuzzy tendrils that further conceal the mosaic tile walls hidden under the grime.

title: [[Undershard, Tile Tunnel]]
description: Changes in the moisture level cause the air here to range between the damp musty scent of the lower tunnels and a dry dust that leaves an itch in the back of the throat.  Glinting in the gloom, tile squares reveal a variety of mosaic eyes in shades from corn yellow to mud brown, erratically spaced high along the sides of the tunnel.  These mosaic eyes seem able to follow movement and occasionally appear to blink in the twilight.

title: [[Undershard, Tile Tunnel]]
description: Cold white tile, almost antiseptic in its starkness, is broken by mosaics, one set high above its diametrically opposing colleague, as the eye motif develops.  The dark center of one wide-open eye stares down and across the expanse at its half-lidded mate, whose mirrored pupil appears to focus on something in the next room.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Three columns -- purple, white and grey -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Three columns -- black, white and purple -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Four columns -- black, teal, bronze, and white -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Two columns -- teal and black -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Three columns -- teal, pink, and bronze -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Three columns -- grey, red, and blue -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Two columns -- brown and orange -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Columns]]
description: Thick columns diagonally shadowed by each other make the perception of depth elusive, and the immediate view of this room shrinks to hide far more than it reveals.  Three columns -- green, orange, and silver -- almost obscure the rest of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, Collapsed Tunnel]]
description: Opening onto a large vault to the southeast, this brick tunnel dies out in an abrupt pile of rubble and debris.  The same collapse that blocked the northwestern vaults, however, also opened a natural passageway to the north.  The northern tunnel slopes downward, and looks utterly deserted from here.

title: [[Undershard, Edge of the Warrens]]
description: A thin ray of pale light streams from a corridor to the south, sloping upward to a tall jumble of rocks.  All around, the shattered remains of brick walls mingle with natural rock to create a maze of passages and warrens, the aftermath of a great tremor that destroyed this quarter of Undershard.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Insane, hysterical laughter echoes faintly in the distance, ringing off the moldy bricks that barely support the low earthen roof.  Gouges in the walls open onto several passages, all of them shrouded in darkness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Gallery]]
description: Shadowy denizens of the Undershard dart from archway to archway, making their way up and down this long gallery hall.  The corridor has become a boulevard of sorts, the main artery of this city-beneath-a-city, and you see merchants and thieves alike travelling the twilit road.

title: [[Undershard, Gallery Fall]]
description: The gallery ends here, at a catastrophic cave-in where a wall of giant boulders and hard-packed earth has closed off the southern vaults forever.  A few humanoids dart in and out of a tiny archway to the east, but beyond that, this end of the warrens is unusually quiet.

title: [[Undershard, Squatters' Hovel]]
description: This rounded chamber, low-ceilinged and dank, has been converted into a crude home for several families of destitute squatters.  All around you are the faces of the poor and hungry, who have found no shelter on Shard's golden streets.  The walls are oddly disjointed in places, the sheets of solid rock irregularly placed.

title: [[Undershard, Secret Nook]]
description: This cramped nook forms the base of a narrow shaft leading straight up, with a rickety wooden ladder stretching up to a trapdoor far above.  The nook itself looks to be a dead end, the ladder balanced against a curving wall of sheet rock.

title: [[Undershard, Canal Junction]]
description: A long, thin stone tunnel winds from the northeast to the south here, dominated by a deep drainage canal filled with icy water.  The canal has overflowed the narrow stone walkways on either side by about half an inch, the footing slippery and treacherous.  An open archway branches off to the southeast, where it connects to a featureless and near pitch-black corridor.

title: [[Undershard, Drainage Culvert]]
description: A narrow walkway surrounds the lip of a great pit, where water from the northwestern canal pours endlessly through a rusted metal grate and down into darkness.  The circular chamber offers no exit but back up the tunnel, and the vast corroded gratework looks like it might cave in at any moment.

title: [[Undershard, Canal Tunnel]]
description: Curving northwest to southwest, this dark tunnel is silent save for the sloshing of water in a narrow drainage canal. Stone walkways flank the canal, providing passage for maintenance workers.

title: [[Undershard, Canal Inlet]]
description: A dark brick tunnel slopes down beneath the city here, narrow stone walkway running alongside a deep canal.  The tunnel mouth leads out, back to the city streets, while the stone tube quietly winds to the southeast.

title: [[Shard, Channel Bank]]
description: A narrow opening in the bedrock leads into darkness here, the faint scent of sewage rising from it.  Legend has it that during the Dragon Wars and the occupation of Shard, the priests dug underneath the city, creating warrens and passages deep below.  The bubble and splash of the water channel that rushes by to the south tries hard, but cannot drown out the loud creaks and clangs that reverberate out of the opening.

title: [[Shard, Channel Bank]]
description: The angry sound of the madly rushing inner-city channels fills the air as the chilly waters sweep east to west on their way out of Shard.  A steep bank nearly thirty feet high pushes its way up to the north, the shadows from the Bridge of Sparrows changing the soil and bedrock that forms the wall of earth from russet brown to umbra.

title: [[Shard, Channel Bank]]
description: Rich brown soil dotted with patches of emerald green grass forms this bank.  Gradually changing from soft dirt to the hard bedrock of the city's foundations, the slope rolls down to a bank that allows one to skirt the edge of the rushing water channel over which the Bridge of Sparrows, rising to the west approximately fifteen feet away, allows passage.

title: [[Undershard, Stone Ramp]]
description: The endless warrens open onto a great cavern here, the core of the labyrinth.  A vast amphitheatre-like pit lies just to the south, reachable by a long stone ramp that slides down to the arena floor.  Torches flanking the ramp crackle and spit, acrid clouds of black smoke obscuring your vision.

title: [[Undershard, Arena of Trothfang]]
description: The arena floor is a theater of horrors, with the stone washed brown in a river of dried and caked blood.  The stench of charred flesh rises from a roasting pit in the center of the floor, before a crude shrine to Trothfang built with scraps of brick and severed bone.  A metal spike juts up from the center of the pit, the blackened remains of a human skeleton impaled halfway down its length.  Empty wine flasks and gnawed bones litter the floor, the remains of some insane cult's revels.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: The ruined street of a once-beautiful city curves away to the east and west.  Looming imposingly over the shattered windows and walls of houses, the slate gray walls of the Arena of Trothfang are split by a large crack to the north.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: A cold silence fills the air, along with the miasma of bodies long dead and rotting.  Trinkets and scraps of cloth litter the ground, along with the gnawed bones that are the only remains of the underground city's inhabitants.  Many of the trinkets are those commonly found at festivals throughout Ilithi, as though the citizens were in the midst of some celebration when the caverns collapsed about them.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: A small mountain of stone debris blocks all passage to the south.  Once part of the cavern's roof, the avalanche of stone fell unexpectedly upon the innocent people living below, shattering their homes and their lives.  As though in defiant denial of the ancient destruction, thick green moss coats the stones in testimony to life's triumph over destruction.

title: [[Undershard, Path of Kertigen's Gift]]
description: A great chasm lies to the west, blocking all travel in that direction.  In the dim light of the caverns, a faint gleam of light can be seen reflecting from the inside of a house split in twain by the chasm.  A small skeleton, that of a child or a Halfling, holds onto a mirror even in death.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: The houses and storefronts lining this stretch of the city street are curiously untouched by the destruction seen elsewhere, almost as if some fickle god had protected them, while leaving their neighbors to die.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: The bones of a small child hang from an upstairs window like a puppet with its strings cut.  Too high for the scavengers to reach, the skeleton remains in perfect condition, save for the chunk of stone imbedded in its skull.

title: [[Undershard, Path of Kertigen's Gift]]
description: A charnel house reek emanates from the crumpled remains of a tavern on the northern side of the street.  Layer upon layer of bodies lie pinned beneath rubble covering the porch, an indication of the mass panic to exit the pub before the end came.  Hanging from a rotting cord, a decrepit sign sways from the remains of the tavern porch.

title: [[Undershard, Path of Kertigen's Gift]]
description: Towards the east, a great chasm slices through the street with knife-edge precision.  One house, split in twain by the chasm, perches precariously upon the edge.  Half-rotted furniture and gnawed bones can be seen in the abandoned rooms.  A tall spire of stone rises to the south, looming imposingly over the shattered cavern.

title: [[Undershard, The Spire]]
description: Like a giant spear of stone, the Spire rises in overwhelming majesty from the cavern floor.  Faded rags hang from a large sign nailed to the base of a small stand beside the Spire.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Undershard, Cavern of Voices]]
description: The huge cavern is filled with the echoes of long-dead voices.  Shouts of laughter and joy vie with screams of pain and terror in the overwhelming cacophony of sound.

title: [[Undershard, Minstrel's Nook]]
description: The small side cavern is filled with the sounds of a small stream of water trickling down one wall.  A ledge towards the back is piled high with moldy cushions, the place where Bards once entertained the people of Undershard.  On one wall, a small painting provides a clue why this cavern was untouched by the catastrophe.

title: [[Undershard, Path of the Shadow's Brother]]
description: The houses lining the street, decrepit even before the cave-in, are now so fragile that the slightest breeze would turn them to dust.  The miasma of long-rotted bodies is, if anything, more pronounced in the area once known as the slum of Undershard.

title: [[Undershard, Path of the Shadow's Brother]]
description: Several houses have collapsed, their rotting wooden frames destroyed from within by various pests.  Two houses lean together, forming a narrow alley to the southwest.

title: [[Undershard, Blind Alley]]
description: The walls of the alley press close together.  The two collapsed buildings which form this passage rumble and groan as though about to collapse at any second.  A faint skittering sound in the shadows fills the room with a sense of danger.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: A great pile of stone to the north blocks all travel in that direction.  The once-lavish city street curves around to the southwest, lined by broken-down houses and a few signs that the houses are once again occupied.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: A wall to the southwest has completely collapsed, shattering many decrepit houses with it.  The destruction has revealed several small caverns not seen in centuries, if ever.  The few remaining houses lining the street are a mix of wood and stone that look ready to fall apart at any second.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: The cavern's collapse shattered the wall to the south, opening pathways to several new caverns.  Curving to the north, the shattered remains of the street continue their silent journey.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: Chips of wood and glass, and large boulders are all that remain of the houses lining this portion of the street.  Under one large boulder, a shattered skeleton still tries vainly to protect another from the sky's falling.

title: [[Undershard, Circle of the New Moon Rising]]
description: The gates of a great manor lie warped and twisted shut between the crumbled remains of walls once patrolled by vigilant guards.  In the manor's yard, the bones of a small dog can be seen, a steel chain still around its neck leading to a spike in the ground.

title: [[Undershard, Path of the Shadow's Brother]]
description: In an uneasy juxtaposition, the remains of the slums lean against the crumbled wall of a once-prosperous Merchant's house.  Once filled with the noise and laughter of parties and family, the mansion is now pierced by a great column of stone.

title: [[Undershard, Caverns]]
description: A giant stalactite hangs precariously from the cracked ceiling above.  The soft whistling of wind through the cavern fills the air with a sense of suppressed danger.

title: [[Undershard, Caverns]]
description: Phosphorescent moss grows on the floor, filling the cavern with a queasy green light that does little to illuminate the pathways leading south.  A few insects have made their homes beneath the moss, their shells covered in phosphorescent spores.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: This tunnel bends sharply around, opening up into several more passageways.  The mazelike warrens never end, looping and twisted like a barrel of snakes.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: This tunnel junction is marked by a splash of sticky brown wetness across one wall -- it is blood, fairly fresh by the looks of it, and whoever shed it was apparently trying to escape this hellish maze.  A number of corridors intersect here.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The shadows that fill this corridor shift and move as if they were alive.  Twisting passageways, barely visible as maws of darkness against the crumbling stone walls, lead out of this ruined chamber, looping sinuously back upon themselves.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Half of the tunnel to the northwest has been cut off by a recent, massive cave-in.  The crumbling stonework walls seem frail compared to this evidence of stone's power.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Like filaments of an intricate spiderweb, crumbling stone passages lead from the room.  Darkness fills each passageway a few feet from the room, making it impossible to tell whether they are dead ends or more of the infuriating looping tunnels that have driven so many mad.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The skittering of rat claws upon stone fills this nexus of the twisting stone passageways that wind through the warrens of Undershard.  Darkness so thick it seems no light can penetrate it fills this room, making it nearly impossible to peer down the tunnels to see which lead to freedom, and which to continuing madness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: One of the walls to the east has collapsed, leading into a huge natural cavern.  Whatever tremor collapsed the one wall also closed off several of the passageways leading from this room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Phosphorescent moss grows on the floor, filling the room with a queasy green light that does nothing to illuminate the pathways leading out.  A few insects have made their homes beneath the moss, their shells covered in phosphorescent spores.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The shadows of the room seem to solidify and move as dark-furred rats crawl in and out of the holes upon the wall.  A slight breeze wafts out of one of the myriad tunnels, filling the room with the stench of rotting eggs.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The stench of rotten eggs fills the room, coming from a bubbling pool in the northeastern corner.  Wafting upon a gentle breeze, the smell is drawn down the myriad tunnels that fill the warrens.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A high-pitched giggle fills the room and echoes through the warrens.  Every few seconds, the wraith-like image of a small Elothean girl flickers into existence, her eyes filled with madness and her lips curled back against her teeth in a perpetual howl of loneliness.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A yawning chasm splits this great stone cavern in two, just barely narrow enough to leap over.  Noxious fumes billow out of the chasm, filling the room with a miasma of death.  A slight updraft prevents the fumes from leaking into the rest of the warrens.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A stone bedframe, lying in pieces upon the floor, is all that remains of what was once a child's bedchamber.  When the cave-in that shattered this portion of Undershard struck, most had enough warning to get out.  Although, judging by the gnawed remains of a finger-bone sticking out from under the rubble, not all did.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A small crack in the ceiling has allowed water to leak through and form a stagnant puddle on the packed-earth floor.  The plink of drops of water hitting the pool sends echoes racing through the warrens to confuse the lost and drive the mad even more insane.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A coppery, carrion stench fills the tunnel, but its source is nowhere to be seen.  Natural tunnels intersect and loop through this tiny cave, with no rhyme or reason.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Tunnels zig-zag every which way around you, without concern for logic or order.  Some double back to this very spot, while others run into one another or end in cave-ins and brick walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: This cramped nook is a junction point for several natural tunnels, twisting and winding in all directions.  Heavy bootsteps mar the soft dirt, the remnants of travellers who came before.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Portions of the haphazardly constructed walls in this section of the warrens have fallen down, cluttering the ground and revealing glimpses of great natural caverns beyond.  A pile of bones lies upon the rubble, vaguely resembling a humanoid shape.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: A small line of moss grows upon the northern wall, next to one of the many twisting stone passageways that lead through the warrens.  Lush and healthy at the top, nearly dead at the bottom, the moss follows the path of a small trickle of water leaking through a crack in the ceiling.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The ceiling of this chamber is lined with stress fractures and is braced by a rotting wooden beam.  A sturdy wooden frame has been erected around each of the myriad twisting paths leading out, to prevent the roof from collapsing.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Strange echoes fill the room, echoing off the crumbling walls and down the many switchback tunnels that lead through the warrens.  Many scratches cover the walls, first in orderly rows then haphazardly, as if in desperation.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Wisps of smoke hover in this cramped tunnel, the apparent remains of a campfire, but only a few shards of burnt kindling litter the earthen floor.  Tunnels branch out in several directions, twisting out of sight.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The mazelike warrens of Undershard continue to twist and turn, baffling the greatest of trackers.  Ratholes line the walls, filling the dark room with the fetid stench of diseased flesh and rotting bodies.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Deep gouges have been cut into the rock, carving a strange geometric symbol that might have served as a marker for earlier travelers.  Its meaning, however, has been lost to time, and provides no clue on which way to turn next.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: This huge cavern is filled with hundreds of stalactites and stalagmites, each as unique as a snowflake.  A breeze winds among them, creating a haunting whistling noise that echoes past the remains of a stonework wall to the west, leading into the tunnels of the warren.  One large stalagmite, its sides filled with crevices, leads up to a large opening in the ceiling of the cavern.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The soft glow of light fills this room, coming from a small vein of rose quartz that peeks its way out of the stone ceiling.  Stretching all the way to the surface, somehow light refracts down the length of the vein to fill the room with the same glow seen at sunset on a clear day.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The chunks of rock that fill this room bear the reddish patterns common to rock near a vein of iron ore.  It is doubtful the vein is still intact, considering the massive destruction wrought by the cave-in, yet many a prospective miner has begun searching for this instant source of wealth.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: Filled with jagged rocks and debris, the only way through the large room is a narrow pathway cleared by some unknown traveller long ago.  From the drops of dried blood spattered upon the rocks and floor, whoever cleared the path did so while trying to run from some unnamed terror.

title: [[Undershard, The Warrens]]
description: The brick walls of an old storage chamber still stand here, pushing back the weight of a cave-in on three sides.  Jagged holes in the stone open onto natural tunnels all around.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Old Oak Tree, Amongst the Branches]]
description: Thick and twisted, one heavily gnarled limb reaches out like a claw, softened only slightly by the tangled vines of deep green ivy curling leisurely along it.  Perched uneasily in a slight groove between two branches lie the withered remnants of a tiny nest, long abandoned by its owner.

title: [[Old Oak Tree, The Treetop]]
description: Balancing precariously on two gnarled branches that sway underfoot allows for a spectacular view of the surrounding wilderness from the thick crown leaves.  Carved into the rough, black bark of the swiftly aging oak are a series of carefully chiseled letters.

title: [[Old Oak Tree, Amongst the Branches]]
description: A thick latticework of leaves forms a dense, canopied bough overhead, just within arm's reach.  Rough black bark scrubs mercilessly at the hands, in stark contrast to the soft foliage it gives birth to.  Several limbs gently divide off to form cozy forks in which to sit and relax from the labors of the hunt or while planning the next adventure.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, First Floor]]
description: This semicircular corridor is dry and slightly cool.  Its floor of packed earth is covered with an intricately woven, red and gold rug.  Lamps of glowstone line the room and a nearby staircase, bringing to the area a subdued but warm light.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, First Floor]]
description: The jackdaw sounds of everyday business in the Crossing have faded completely from this section of semicircular corridor.  Underneath a glowstone, a small wooden icon of Peri'el rests upon a sandstone lip.  An archway outlined in fluted columns leads south.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: This interior stone corridor is bare save for a green and gold rug and a single, brightly shining glowstone.  Translucent paints have been delicately applied to the latter, creating a splay of soft, geometric shadows upon the far wall.  A staircase leads down to the first floor.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: A dwarf plovik tree sits quietly in an earthenware pot in one corner of this sandstone corridor.  Its lustrous, splayed leaves draw nourishment from the soft but warm light of numerous glowstones.  A staircase leads up to a third floor.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, Third Floor]]
description: This spartan corridor has been rendered more lively by a flat-woven, floor-length kelim in deep magenta, black and gold, its fringes laced with tiny, round, brass bells.  Pearlescent glowstones shine softly next to each room.  A staircase leads down to the second floor.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, Third Floor]]
description: The kelim continues here, its pebble-sized bells jangling with any movement that ruffles its surface.  Above it, recessed in a small alcove of one sandstone wall, a small statue of Hav'roth reclines upon a square-cut throne.

title: [[The Gear Shop, Accessories for the Bold]]
description: Painted with more color than talent upon the walls are scenes with pairs of Gnomes on various explorations.  One wall displays two dapper young men in what appears to be a gloomy and dank cave while another shows two well-dressed young women in stylish gowns and boots climbing a rocky hillside.  The final wall depicts a young lass defending the male of the pair with only a valise and an umbrella against what might be a large house cat.  Set just above the carpeted floor but below the pictures are metal shelves.

title: [[The Gear Shop, Adventurer Essentials]]
description: Honey-hued wood covers the ceiling and walls and is left strangely unadorned save for a single shelf sticking out at the back of the room.  A highly polished floor of black oak holds two costume trunks placed side by side in the center of the area.

title: [[The Gear Shop, Venturesome Locomotion]]
description: One wall is adorned with a brightly hued painting of a Gnome girl wearing ornate wings and perched at the edge of a cliff as if just about to jump off.  Opposite the painting is a mural depicting two young lads finding their way through a dark forest, the one on the left using an observational gadget that he holds to his eye while the other appears to be studying a compass and pointing the way.  Stubby-legged tables are arranged upon a plush black rug.

title: [[Tezler's Shop, Sales Floor]]
description: A silver-veined black marble sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A black oak stand and a black oak table sit on the silver-veined black marble floor, with a black oak case placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A black oak rack hangs on the white-veined pink marble walls.  A strong sit odor wafts about.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: Wagons clatter over reddish granite cobblestones as traders go about their business.  A low stone well stands in a grassy circle at the center of the intersection, surrounded by wooden homes with brightly painted shutters.  A shy young maid peers down from a nearby balcony, but ducks quickly back out of sight with a flutter of skirts.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: Shady deobar trees line the road, spreading their limbs like a canopy over travelers.  A tantalizing aroma of onions baking slowly with a joint of beef wafts from a nearby home.  Outside another home, a child's wooden practice sword clamped in a vise awaits the finishing touches from the woodworker.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: Fragrant roses twine along a white lattice arch over the entrance to a nearby home, the deep red blossoms contrasting with the dark green paint on the door and shutters.  A rain barrel sits beside the door, arranged to catch the water which rolls off the home's roof tiles.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: A low stone wall runs beside the road, the stark outline softened by scattered clumps of moss which cling to the mortar.  A gutter runs beneath it, allowing rainwater to drain away instead of forming pools in the street.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: The wind catches at a loose shutter, sending it banging against the house.  The once-vivid red paint has faded to a soft rose over the years, a distinct contrast to the well-kept appearance of the surrounding homes.  A splash of the original scarlet paint is revealed where the knocker has been removed from the door.  Evidently that particular house has been vacant for some time.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: Vivid yellow shalyria blossoms twine along a brick chimney, the fragrant flowers filling the air with a sweet scent to delight the senses.  A housewife has planted an herb garden beside her door, surrounded by a lattice fence to keep away the local dogs.  Lavender, fennel, thyme, marjoram... these are but a few of the culinary herbs which grow in the neatly tended beds.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: The sandy square is empty now, occupied only by the lobsided wooden pells used to teach children their beginning lessons in swordwork.  During the day, the yard bustles with activity, but at night all is quiet and serene.

Children practice sword work, swinging at wooden pells in a sandy square under the watchful eye of a retired mercenary.  The woman's missing leg makes her unable to sustain an offensive rush, yet her graceful movements and quick reflexes combined with her patient explanations make her a perfect teacher of the young.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: A pear tree stands within a nearby brick-walled garden, the branches reaching out toward the street.  Wooden crates lie beneath the tree, half-filled with the year's bounty.  These crates will soon find their way to the root cellar to become pies or preserves under the skilled hands of the housewife.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Jegu Kai'avren]]
description: A child's doll lies discarded in a gutter by the side of the road, the rag-stuffed body soaked with water, and one button eye broken in half.  A trickle of water flows through the ditch, swirling around one sodden leg before running off into the distance.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the thick stone column.  Enormous webs cast their strong silken strands across the upper reaches of the cavern, connecting pillar to wall to stalactite in a dazzling pattern of intersecting and concentric silver lines.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the rock column.  Long, thick silk strands sweep across the upper reaches of the chamber, shimmering silver rays as the threads stir in the dim reaches of the cave.  Above, the ceiling is visible through a few more layers of webbing.

title: [[Upper Caverns, Top of the Column]]
description: The narrow ledge ends near the rough ceiling of the huge cavern.  A single horizontal plane of webbing stretches across the area below the roof at the level of the ledge.  The many layers filling the nether region create the impression of clouds or fog floating below.  Nearly out of reach, where the thick column joins the vaulted ceiling, is a faintly illuminated, rough hole.

title: [[Small Cavern]]
description: The walls and floor of the chamber are smooth with barely a chisel mark to betray the skilled hand of whatever worked the stone.  Overhead, however, the walls curve to the domed ceiling in the usual rough way of caverns.  A smooth-walled alcove, slightly larger than a burly dwarf, cuts into the wall.

title: [[Small Cavern]]
description: The walls and floor of the chamber are smooth with barely a chisel mark to betray the skilled hand of whatever worked the stone.  Overhead, however, the walls curve to the domed ceiling in the usual rough way of caverns.  A wide ledge of stone, cluttered with shards of pottery and ceramics, juts from the wall.

title: [[Small Cavern]]
description: The walls and floor of the chamber are smooth with barely a chisel mark to betray the skilled hand of whatever worked the stone.  Overhead, however, the walls curve to the domed ceiling in the usual rough way of caverns.  A narrow hole, chimney-like bores its way out through the roof.

title: [[Small Cavern]]
description: The walls and floor of the chamber are smooth with barely a chisel mark to betray the skilled hand of whatever worked the stone.  Overhead, however, the walls curve to the domed ceiling in the usual rough way of caverns.  Slicing out of the east wall is a small passageway.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Narrow Passage]]
description: The entire passage is finely cut through the black rock, though it is a bit narrow for 'Togs.  It is impossible to tell where chisel may have touched stone in its creation.

title: [[The Rift]]
description: A narrow passage ends at a tall crevice which runs north and south through the cavern.  A ledge, wide enough for safety, protrudes into the rift and overhangs the deep gash.  The sound of rushing water reverberates through the space.

title: [[Quill's Convincing Forgeries, Sales Floor]]
description: A blocky wooden sales counter with a row of flattened orichalcum coins hammered around its edges sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A black oak table and an ornate smokewood chest sit on the burgundy-tiled floor with fanciful scrollwork, with a multi-tiered rack with staggered shelves edged in leather and a lunat trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A black oak cabinet stands against the tapestry-covered pearwood walls.

title: [[Waerdmor House, The Courtyard]]
description: An open courtyard fronts the oak-framed house that draws creative minds from around the world.  Candles flicker in a few rooms where someone is working late, casting dim light on the large statue of a dragon before the house.

A courtyard dappled with light and shadow lies beneath a latticework canopy hung with climbing roses.  Along the walkways of the court bustles a flurry of workers, passing in and out of the modest oak-framed house that draws creative minds from around the world.  In front of the house, a marble statue of a dragon raises its head.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Trader Outpost Furrier]]
description: Dominating the wall opposite the entrance, the stuffed head of a massive storm bull nearly distracts from the stench of decay and harsh chemicals.  Arches cut into the other walls lead to different parts of the outpost, elaborate carvings decorating their edges.  Oblivious to the commotion of business being conducted throughout the large space as well as the smell, the tanner works at the stained and warped wooden counter piled high with animal skins in various stages of curing.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, out.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Trader Outpost Gem Buyer]]
description: A multitude of boxes stack upon the shelves lining the walls on the far end of this chamber, each a different size and type.  Decorated with a colorful mosaic, a polished counter dominates the room, giving space for record keeping.  Standing in the back corner, a guard keeps a watchful eye on all who pass through.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Traders' Guild Outpost]]
description: Despite the large board hung on the back wall and the built-in seating arranged around the room, this chamber appears to be used for no more than storage at the moment.  Shipping crates fill the area, a number of them open and their contents rummaged through.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Trader Outpost Bank]]
description: Bright decorations offset the dim interior created by the dark paneling in this part of the outpost.  Shelves lined with vibrant textiles display an eclectic collection of multihued shells in varying sizes while an old fisher's net, mended with colorful threads, adorns the wall behind the counter.  A bored clerk stands idly nearby, waiting for business.

title: [[Empath's Guild, Courtyard]]
description: The green courtyard is planted with low-growing herbs -- yarrow, thyme, and pennyroyal make a carpet of fragrant softness.  A carved urn filled with cool, clear water reflects the sunlight and any breeze sends ripples over the surface.  Several benches, some in the sun, and one shaded beneath a butterfly bush, invite one to rest and contemplate the peace here.

title: [[Empath's Guild, Welcome Room]]
description: Soft straw mats cover the floor and large pillows with flower patterns arranged in a welcoming cresent make this visiting area a nice place to relax.  The northern screen walls stand open to allow a view of the courtyard.  A crystal windchime tinkles softly whenever the wind stirs it, but the overhanging roof and construction of the building keeps any harsh weather from disturbing the visitor.  A low brazier burns to keep the chill from the air during the cool season.

title: [[Empath's Guild, Guildleader's Study]]
description: A large work table stands in the center of the room, scarred from years of use and bearing multiple pale rings where wet containers have apparently rested.  Translucent white paper walls allow ample light for working or reading.  Low tables surrounded by soft teal green pillows hold piles of notes, sketches, and charts.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive conical building rises from the cobbles at the square's center, its snowy alabaster surfaces gleaming brilliantly.  A sparkling mosaic of coral and turquoise set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Lairocott Brach, Forkbeard's Brodger]]
description: This hall is distinguished by a large table and two stone benches that run the length of the tavern.  At the far end of the hall is a large roaring fire, the smoke slowly curling up towards the hole in the ceiling.  Along the walls are hung various furs, skins and mining implements.  Hakon Forkbeard is standing behind the imposing marble-topped bar, working and whispering intently to several of his customers.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Tunneling through walls of ice, this passageway slopes downwards to the southwest.  The colorless, hard surrounding surfaces show no sign of mortal passage, and no sign of thaw.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A vertical tunnel of ice penetrates into the dark below.  What appears to be a plant, slicked with ice, protrudes from a small ledge on one side, the leaves coated and preserved with a sheeting of glassy frost.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Cave Mouth]]
description: From a light source nearby, long shadows dance across the sandy floor.  Along the eastern wall, something catches the reflection of a flame.  The crisp and pleasant night air of the cave carries with it a scent of a warm meal not too far off.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Tunnel]]
description: Halfway through the torch-lined tunnel, the ceiling begins to bloat downward, forcing all but the smallest of races to stoop over.  Above a small, unattended fire pit, the contents of an iron pot slowly simmer.  Gradually the smell of onions, garlic, and some sort of fowl become recognizable, masking the otherwise dank, musty smell of the cave.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Main Area]]
description: The low tunnel opens into a magnificent cathedral of stalagmites and stalactites veiled in a thin mist of moisture.  Amplified by the acoustics of the cavern, water droplets and their echoes perform a natural symphony.  To the north, a natural formation of rocks bridges the chasm.

title: [[Dirge, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive building dominates the square, rising in an impenatrably black cone to its pinnacle far above.  Scarred by wind-driven pebbles and sand, the structure stands as a monument to the imminent power of nature and time.  A weatherbeaten wooden sign set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Dirge, The Carousel]]
description: A thin scattering of grit spreads across the drab floor, collecting in packed deposits at the base of the curved wall ringing the building's center.  A flat circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's distant pinnacle.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Dirge, Carousel Desk]]
description: A long wooden desk spans the width of the western wall.  Brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in spotless red tile.

title: [[Trader Outpost, Stable]]
description: Drying hay lends sweetness to the thick scents of leather and cattle in the stable.  The limed plaster and oak beam walls are studded with brightly polished brass hooks from which hang harnesses, saddles, and bridles of many shapes and sizes.  An iron-strapped oak door leads into the office.

title: [[Darkling Wood, Trader Outpost]]
description: Pewter oil lamps hang from the thick oaken beams below the thatching, casting a warm glow on the cool efficiency of the outpost.  The slim Elven commerce minister strides from table to table with quill and ledger, handling each transaction with a quick nod.  Leaning against the center beam with arms crossed, a Human knight watches the room carefully.  An iron-strapped oak door leads out to the stable.

title: [[Haldofurd's Barn, Caravan Stable]]
description: Light filters through the open double doors illuminating the clean, whitewashed expanse of the barn's walls and dozens of spacious stalls line the interior, each thickly carpeted with fresh straw.  Stable boys bustle about filling water troughs and currying road dust from newly-arrived pack animals under the watchful supervision of equally dusty caravan drivers.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Exchange Building]]
description: A dazzling tile mosaic of the sun stretches out across the center of the exchange floor to the white marble walls encircling it.  The design glitters like scattered gems as it is bathed from light filtering through a gold-tinted skylight above the room.  An oak door to the north has been deeply chiseled and painted with the image of a bag of gold, while to the south lies a grand stone arch supported by a pair of rearing pony statues.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Caravan Stables]]
description: Despite the white marble walls, the stable area at first glance seems quite ordinary except for the fact that it is strikingly clean.  Square tiles of cobbled stone are set with great accuracy across the floor, and the stable doors all look freshly whitewashed.  Large windows that look out onto a small exercise yard are constantly open to let in fresh air, while mild lavender incense drifts through the room mixed with the smell of fresh hay.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Private Depository]]
description: Were it not for the bag of coins painted upon the carved door, it might be difficult to recognize this large marble room as a bank at all, despite the vault and pristine white counter at the far side of the room.  Comfortable couches sit across from each other on either side of polished counting tables, providing a place for the island's residents to rest during their errands and chat with their fellow sisters.  A tall decanter of blue liquid sits on a mirrored tray on one of the tables.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Foreign Exchange Vault]]
description: An old counting table with a carefully repaired leg has been positioned in the front part of the vault, sectioned off with hide partitions as if the office were an afterthought.  A small sign has been tacked to the partition behind the table.

title: [[Raven's Point, Trader's Outpost]]
description: Unfinished pine boards packed with a smoothed mixture of clay and straw in the cracks keep the room free of drafts.  Built from boulders dotted with glistening flecks of mica from the nearby pass, a fireplace fills one wall.  Traders stopping to rest between hauls lounge in chairs, each been carved from a single piece of wood.  Piles of furs and pelts are heaped in a corner near empty crates, awaiting the busy clerk.

title: [[Raven's Point, Outpost Storage Room]]
description: Through the dim haze of the smoke from the other room, the shapes of crates and boxes piled to the ceiling can be seen.  Crunching underfoot are the contents of a grain sack that has been torn open in one corner.  A lopsided bench is pushed against the wall and has become the repository for a stack of caravan axles.

title: [[Drathrok's Assemblage]]
description: Hanging gaethzen globes cast an even glow along the tent walls.  Prizes fill a series of differently-shaped displays, attractively laid out to tempt passers-by into becoming buyers.  A large banner reads, "READ each surface to be sure you understand the nature of the item you're purchasing before you GET it.  No refunds!"

title: [[Duskruin, Darkened Antechamber]]
description: Rich veins of emerald and amethyst spider throughout the dark granite walls of the rounded antichamber, their deep hues occasionally reflected by the light of the surrounding torches.  Several upholstered benches line the area, overlooking a central statue of a valiant warrior.  A stoic Dwarven soldier stands before a blackened steel portcullis, guarding the entrance to the dark labyrinth of catacombs beyond.

title: [[Duskruin, Eastern Walk]]
description: The wide granite walk bends to the east, leading to the Bank of Duskruin.
