A series of deadly spikes along the outer wall prevent any attempt by invaders to scale the imposing fortress, while crowds steadily move back and forth through the area, creating a near constant din of noise that blankets the area.  Despite the throngs of visitors, the area is meticulously maintained and well kept.

title: [[Duskruin, Outside the Bank]]
description: Thick iron bars fortify the tall windows of the bank building, its towering stone walls blending seamlessly into the adjacent mountainside.  Closing off a narrow entryway are two vigilant guards dressed in yellow and black uniforms with their tasseled pikes resolute.  A nearby ramp leads down a side street and away from the bustle surrounding the guarded structure.

title: [[Duskruin, Dark Alley]]
description: The dark alley works its way between the towering walls of the bank and a row of shuttered buildings, ending ubruptly at the outer wall of the fortress.  Barely visible amid trash bins and stacks of weathered crates is a darkened tunnel entrance, the surrounding area littered with chunks of granite and gravel.

In the darkness, the dark alley works its way between the towering walls of the bank and a row of shuttered buildings, ending ubruptly at the outer wall of the fortress.  Barely visible amid trash bins and stacks of weathered crates is a shadowed tunnel entrance, the surrounding area littered with chunks of granite and gravel.

title: [[Duskruin, Side Street]]
description: The narrow street traverses between the towering walls of the bank and a row of homes along the opposing side.  Rounded stone archways stretch between the two-story homes, shading the cobblestone pavement and disguising lines of drying laundry that crisscross overhead.  A discarded bucket and hearth broom lean against the steps leading to one of the numerous unmarked doorways, while a ramp at one end of the street rises up to the commotion surrounding the bank above.

title: [[Hvaral Trading Post, Caravan Stable]]
description: Fresh straw has been laid over the cold stone floors as stable hands perform their daily duties to keep the stable clean and the animals properly rubbed down and fed.  Yaks, ponies and mules can be heard over the wooden stall doors, as if they were catching up on all the gossip of life on the trade roads.

title: [[Hvaral Trading Post, South Side]]
description: Desks and chairs line the southern side of the exchange floor as stock clerks and guild officials shuffle paperwork and calculate their ledgers, working to keep track of the merchandise coming on and off the exchange floor.  From beyond a marble archway carved to fit the contours of the circular room, the calls from beasts of burden and the scent of fresh straw and sweated animals announce the presence of the trading post's stable.

title: [[Hvaral Trading Post, The Granite Exchange]]
description: Precisely cut granite bricks comprise the walls of the circular domed structure.  Its unique design provides for a large, spacious trading floor where folk from across the desert can come to haggle their goods in hopes of discovering the road to prosperity.  Golden light streams down from a glowing orb hung in silver netting from the center of the dome, shining on a sandstone pedestal placed below it.  A detailed crystal sculpture has been placed upon the pedestal, sparkling like diamonds.

title: [[Hvaral Trading Post, North Side]]
description: Crates are piled along the curve of the northern wall of the exchange floor, some of them partially opened as if in hopes of attracting a business eye for a quick sale.  Peddlers and merchants gather with their unsold wares, negotiating for trades of coin or cargo.

title: [[Windows to the Universe]]
description: Paneless windows of various shapes and sizes line the walls, near them stacked large piles of multi-colored sands and small tubs of dyes.  Several sheets of finished glass sit near the exit, awaiting insertion into frames.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, First Floor]]
description: The spare sandstone corridor is cool and quiet, its walls unsanded and rugged.  Running diagonally through one wall from ceiling to floor is a broad, glittering vein of golden feldspar.  Several lines of poetry, written in the Common tongue but using the flowing, elusive S'Kra script, have been incised across it.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, First Floor]]
description: The bare, rocky hallway of white stone looks almost bleached in the light of several glowstone globes.  Four lines of poetry have been carved in a continuous, single wave along walls of the area.  A plain stairway leads up to the second floor.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: An arm has been sculpted out of one white, rugged corridor wall, from shoulder to outstretched palm.  Beneath it are several lines of poetry in S'Kra script.  A plain stairway leads down to the first floor.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: A circular brass plate as large as a tower shield is firmly mounted upon a wall of this hallway.  Several lines of poetry are carved upon the wall, encircling the plate and the image of an exotic city engraved upon its surface.  A plain stairway leads to the third floor.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, Third Floor]]
description: A ship's mast was affixed to the wall here sometime in the past, though its fabric has long since eroded away to leave a barren stump.  A few crudely-etched words are carved in the rock which serves as its base.  A plain stairway leads down to the second floor.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, Third Floor]]
description: A giant geometric rose has been sculpted out of the end of this corridor.  Underneath it run several lines of poetry, lit by glowstones emitting softly pearling light.

title: [[Tower South, Air Floor]]
description: A dark grey carpet decorated with a pattern of crossing black lightning bolts covers the floor, matching the decoration on the grey-painted walls.  A constant, low thrum hangs just inside the range of hearing, its source nearby but not readily apparent.  Doors spaced in an even circle around the perimeter lead to initiates' private cells.

title: [[Tower South, Earth Floor]]
description: Bare, dark soil forms the floor underfoot.  The stony walls surrounding this circular room are similarly devoid of decoration, keeping instead the plain, natural look preferred by those mages who favor the element of Earth.  Doors leading to the initiates' private cells line the walls.

title: [[Tower South, Water Floor]]
description: Deep blue carpeting covers the floor, its surface cut in a manner that suggests the rippling of waves upon the surface of a lake.  Bright blue spirals, representing the element of water, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is moist and cool upon the skin.

title: [[Tower South, Fire Floor]]
description: Lush, red carpeting covers the floor, muffling any ambient noise into oblivion.  Images of bloated red suns, representing the element of fire, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is significantly warmer than on the tower's other floors, although the reason is not readily apparent.

title: [[Tower South, Aether Floor]]
description: Carpeting the color of a death shroud covers the floor, devouring the light as hungrily as Aldauth consumes souls.  The walls are devoid of decoration, instead painted a uniform black to match the floor.  Only the doors leading to initiates' cells betray any hint of color in this otherwise cold, bleak room.

title: [[Tower East, Earth Floor]]
description: Bare, dark soil forms the floor underfoot.  The stony walls surrounding this circular room are similarly devoid of decoration, keeping instead the plain, natural look preferred by those mages who favor the element of Earth.  Doors leading to the initiates' private cells line the walls.

title: [[Tower East, Water Floor]]
description: Deep blue carpeting covers the floor, its surface cut in a manner that suggests the rippling of waves upon the surface of a lake.  Bright blue spirals, representing the element of water, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is moist and cool upon the skin.

title: [[Tower East, Fire Floor]]
description: Lush, red carpeting covers the floor, muffling any ambient noise into oblivion.  Images of bloated red suns, representing the element of fire, fill the walls between a series of doors leading to initiates' private cells.  The air here is significantly warmer than on the tower's other floors, although the reason is not readily apparent.

title: [[Tower East, Aether Floor]]
description: Carpeting the color of a death shroud covers the floor, devouring the light as hungrily as Aldauth consumes souls.  The walls are devoid of decoration, instead painted a uniform black to match the floor.  Only the doors leading to initiates' cells betray any hint of color in this otherwise cold, bleak room.

title: [[Crossing, Item Registration Office]]
description: Red tile continues its way through the open doorway and stops abruptly at a long wood counter with polished brass bars positioned to form a cage around the clerks.  A soft glow comes from a single lantern placed atop a long row of filing cabinets.  Papers are strewn about the tops of the cabinets and have spilled over onto the floor.

title: [[Riverhaven, Carousel Desk]]
description: A long wooden desk spans the width of the western wall.  Brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in spotless red tile.

title: [[Riverhaven, Item Registration Office]]
description: Rows of tall filing cabinets, covered in dust, nearly fill the small office.  Shelves full of haphazardly stacked papers cover the majority of the walls.  Two oil lamps burn brightly atop the cabinets, illuminating the room, revealing a polished black stone desk which occupies the remaining space.

title: [[Shard, Item Registration Office]]
description: Different paintings depicting the Great Tower in different styles adorn almost every inch of open wall space.  Rows of large metal cabinets line the wall behind a high counter that separates the clerks from the general public.  The spotless red tile floor shines as if it had been polished just moments ago.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Item Registration Office]]
description: A few gaethzen spheres on the ceiling provide a dim light to the underground office.  Damp walls surround the office which has a few cabinets and a low counter with a content looking Dwarven clerk behind it.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Item Regstration Office]]
description: Green and white marble tiles cover the floor in a crisscrossing pattern.   Two brass lanterns hang on the wall behind a low counter.  Stacks of papers cover the tops of a row of cabinets, waiting to be filed away.

title: [[Taelbert's Inn, Stables]]
description: White plaster walls hung with drifting cobwebs enclose this dank space.  Identical narrow stalls, each blanketed with a thick carpet of fresh straw, line the walls allowing just enough room for a pathway west to a smaller work area.  Tools and grain barrels rest between each stall, at the ready for any stablehand to use to care for their charges.

title: [[Taelbert's Inn, Tack Storage]]
description: Barely more than a closet, this tiny space is practically filled with dozens of trunks, boxes, and baskets.  Each is filled to overflowing with goods that often find their way here to be repaired and resold -- one person's loss is another's profit.  Standing in a narrow corner is Stablehand Ilinear, occasionally rummaging through containers apparently looking for a particular piece.

title: [[Forest, A Small Clearing]]
description: The trees thin out slightly, forming a small clearing.  Daylight filters through the leaves overhead, illuminating a small, crumbling cottage built of lichened stone.  The thatching on the roof bears signs of recent patches, and smoke rises from a chimney that seems to be a few bricks short.

title: [[Bruwster's Home]]
description: Lit by a cheerful fire crackling in the stone fireplace, makeshift bookcases built from stacks of bricks interspersed with boards cover virtually all of the available wall space.  They are loaded with piles of scrolls, books, and papers of all sizes and descriptions.  A large table fills most of the rest of the room, and the quiet burbling of several glass beakers suspended over small flames provides a counterpoint to conversation.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Secret Laboratory]]
description: Softly glowing gaethzen orbs provide diffuse light for a work table holding a collection of vials, herb pouches, parchments, and crusted mugs.  A few scratched runestones lie cheek-by-jowl with dirty dishes stacked in precarious small piles.  Two dusty boxes are half-filled with a selection of wine bottles, most of them empty.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Dark Stairwell]]
description: Dim light filters in from below, doing nothing to illuminate the narrow tunnel but providing at least a sense of direction.  The strong smell of damp earth permeates the stairwell, and the soft dirt crumbles underfoot, threatening to send you sprawling down the stairs at any moment.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Dark Stairwell]]
description: Rough earthen stairs descend steeply into darkness, framed by wooden walls down to ground level, and then by raw dirt.  The low ceiling, only a few feet high, fades imperceptibly into the walls.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Bedroom]]
description: At first glance, it appears that this room has been ransacked and pillaged, but a closer look reveals a chaotic organization of sorts.  Three bookshelves stuffed with scrolls form a barricade of paper before each wall, filling the room with a dusty smell.  An apparently unused small bed is pushed into one corner, almost totally covered with a collection of cat hair, papers, and herb pouches.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Living Area]]
description: With walls as beige as freshly woven linen, the room is set up for two distinct functions.  Three couches are grouped to create a miniature parlor, and in the opposite corner six chairs surround an oval dining table like children stalking someone for a last scoop of ice cream.  A small window above the cooking area is open, admitting the rich herbal scents of the garden outside.

title: [[Knoll, Garden]]
description: Hugging the building and hillside is a clump of wormwood, its lacy silver-grey foliage giving it the appearance of a shaggy dog sleeping in its favorite spot.  Heart-shaped balm leaves and pink star-shaped pimpernel flowers blanket the rest of the knoll with a lemony fragrance.  A cream-colored door leads into the house.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Entryway]]
description: A small painting hung in a prominent place on the wall depicts a Halfling family, perhaps the previous owners of this abode.  Daylight pours through large windows to either side of the door, tinted slightly green from the encroaching vegetation that threatens to cover them.  A preserved jadice flower wreath marks the corridor to the west.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Infirmary]]
description: Pristine white cabinets to one side and cots to the other form a pathway from the entry to a small rickety desk.  While a blanket of papers covers most of its top, a tiny yellowed piece of parchment lies on the one part of the desk not totally submerged in notes.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Children's Bedroom]]
description: Two beds are positioned foot-to-foot to the rear of the room, headboards wedged against both of the adjacent walls.  Crocheted throw rugs on the ground brush the quilt bedcovers.  A large hope chest sits on the other side of the room, covered with a folded crocheted coverlet.

title: [[House on a Knoll, Master Bedroom]]
description: The ceiling is lower in this room than in the entryway, and the room's dimensions and furniture are all sized for Halflings.  A double bed is centered between two windows on the far wall, and cheerful rag rugs cover the polished copperwood floor.

title: [[Taelbert's Inn, Alcove]]
description: Little more than a niche off of the main banquet room, this dark alcove is at least quiet, if not sumptuous.  A faded sofa takes up much of the floorspace, and though not elegant by any means, it certainly appears inviting.

title: [[Taelbert's Inn, Banquet Room]]
description: Candles placed at regular intervals along several wide banquet tables light the room with a warm golden glow.  A single table placed at right angles to the rest sits atop a low platform near the northern wall.  Garlands of wildflowers drape in gentle spirals around stone pillars, filling the air with their delicate, sweet scent.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, Alchemy Kitchen]]
description: Below a centrally located skylight sits a Wayerd pyramid.  A thick column of leaded glass obscures the view to the outside world without blocking sunlight to the pyramid during the day.  A wide iron stove sits beside a fountain fed by a steady stream of water pouring from the wall.  Nestled within it is a water clock.

title: [[Crossing, Carousel Chamber]]
description: A sturdy vault, set in the back wall, stands ready for your use.  The floor is covered by a soft thick carpet of deep red, and the walls are paneled in polished gold pine.  Looking at the back wall, you notice a tiny gap between it and the rest of the room.

title: [[Crossing, Carousel Booth]]
description: A polished steel lever protrudes from the eastern wall of the small, ebony-panelled room, flanking an iron door to the north.

title: [[Crossing, Carousel Booth]]
description: A polished steel lever protrudes from the eastern wall of the small, ebony-panelled room, flanking a steel door to the north.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Entry]]
description: Massive palm fronds have been tightly woven together to form the thatched roof.  Bundled groupings of tall bamboo climb from the wooden floor up to the ceiling to provide sturdy supports.  Numerous framed arches open up and split off from the entryway, each leading to a different area of the bungalow.  A wicker chest and a glass display table occupy opposite corners of the spacious room.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, northwest, out.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Fountain]]
description: Majestic and massive, a multi-tiered marble fountain towers up to the raised thatch roof above.  Small motes of light gleam and flit around the fountain's pool; a sense of powerful magics lingers in the air.  The soothing sounds of the many streams of flowing water mesh harmoniously with the music of the bards who find their inspiration here.  Stone benches are set on the outer areas of the greenery that encircles the fountain.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Gift Floor]]
description: A dark ironwood table with a bamboo chime hanging above it rests against one silk-covered wall.  Scents of musk and lavender are emitted from a pair of lighted candles lying in a shallow stone bowl, and sounds of moving water echo from the south.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Crafter Thazzuc]]
description: This section of the bungalow features a potted palm tree adorned with beads in various colors.  A scroll-covered oaken counter provides a cramped workspace for the crafter to perform his duties.  Two cushions near the workspace are the only other furnishings.  A corridor opens up to the east.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Eastern Wing]]
description: Wicker trunks and counters line the northern and southern walls of this protrusion.  A series of short shelves encircles the massive window that dominates the eastern wall.  Humming in the sea breeze, a multitude of exotic wind chimes dangles from the bamboo rafters above the opening.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Gift Floor]]
description: An opening in the wall allows a gentle sea breeze to circulate a current of fresh air throughout the bungalow.  Nestled closely to the walls are elegant bamboo tables and counters that proudly display both common and not-so-common treasures from across the realms.  The faint splashing of water can be heard nearby.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[A Squat Bungalow, Western Wing]]
description: Hanging from the ceiling in each corner are ornate golden birdcages, their color reflected in the rich carpetry that adorns the floor here.  Avian calls and chirps fill the air with a constant natural music that perfectly complements the soft, tropical floral scent wafting in from some unseen source.

title: [[Cabana, Waiting Room]]
description: Reed mats line the floor of this small cabana, and wooden lounge chairs are placed around the room.  Pots of exotic flowers line the palm leaf walls, while a small table in the corner holds refreshments for those waiting on a visiting merchant.  A wooden plaque hangs by the beaded curtain that leads further into the cabana.

title: [[Seasoned Dressings, Foyer]]
description: Piles of tasseled cushions sewn of sumptuous brocades are gathered around a low ebony table, creating an atmosphere of informal elegance in this waiting room.  A silverwillow arch leads to the back of the caravan.  An ebony screen separates this room from the sewing room nearby.

title: [[An Oak Hut, Interior]]
description: Below the smoke-discolored tapestries adorning the uneven walls, a worn hand-hooked rug partially conceals the warped floorboards.  Surrounded by four chairs that list awkwardly to the side, a rough oak table dominates the room.

title: [[The Shanty, Storage Cellar]]
description: Rust-colored clay beneath the sandy shoreline overhead forms the perimeter of the cellar.  Only a handful of square beams provide reinforcement to the dense earth.  The southern wall is stacked with large oak barrels recovered from the shipwreck, while wooden steps leading upward are bolted onto the northern wall.

title: [[The Shanty, Storage Cellar]]
description: A disturbed pile of dust sits in the corner of section of the cellar next to a stumpy broom, while lanterns, candles, torches and casks of oil are kept on shelves higher than most children could reach.

title: [[The Shanty, Storage Cellar]]
description: Stacks of chairs line the northern and southern walls of the storage cellar, while the western wall is home to a series of warped cabinets.  Smells from the Shanty's ever-active kitchen above drift down a narrow pipe whose purpose is unclear.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Tree Top]]
description: Faint light streams down through the tree's upper limbs, painting the branches in an eerie, pale hue.  Now and then the surrounding foliage rustles with movement, though whatever is causing it cannot be seen.  Occasionally something glints in the depth of the shadows -- could it be watchful eyes?  But they appear and are gone again so quickly that perhaps they were only a trick of the imagination.

title: [[Tree Route, Canopy]]
description: Lofting at least one hundred feet above the ground, a single misstep on this treetop highway could very well be the last.  Stray breezes lash twigs and branches against your body, their buffeting moving you through the treetops yet increasing the chance of a slip and lethal fall.

title: [[The Crossing Meeting Hall, Entrance]]
description: Kept very clean and tidy, the walls of the Meeting Hall entrance are covered in stained wood.  Several glass windows are enshrouded in dark crimson curtains, and twin potted plants stand tall on opposite sides of the exit.  A long carpet runs the length of the long hallway, decorated with a loose mosaic pattern that mimics cobblestone.

title: [[The Crossing Meeting Hall, Lounge]]
description: Candles adorn the many surfaces within the room, casting their fickle, flickering light across the area.  Rough-hewn wooden walls, dressed up by several elaborate paintings, encircle a floor that's covered in carpet.  Long couches are arranged in the middle of the room, set up for quiet talking.

title: [[The Crossing Meeting Hall, Corridor]]
description: Gaethzen lights illuminate the hallway in wide strips set into the edges of the ceiling.  Darkly stained mahogany paneling covers the walls, and several pictures of the city hang on the walls.  A long carpet runs the length of the hallway, a cobblestone motif making it appear like a well-used road.

title: [[The Crossing Meeting Hall, Corridor]]
description: Two small lanterns stand on long poles in each corner of the hallway, which ends at a large portrait of the old Ulf'Hara Keep.  Small twin shelves line the walls, with candles giving off a bit of soft light.  Vertical boards of polished and darkly stained mahogany wood cover the walls, giving it a homey feel.

title: [[Viper's Nest, Courtyard]]
description: Cracked flagstones pave the grim courtyard of the Viper's Nest Inn, making you stumble as you feel your way along.  A scabrous-looking, dense deobar tree blocks off any light.  Trails of mud, dust, sweat and blood streak the pavement, as if heavy burdens of all ilk had been dragged through here.  In a corner of the patio is a broken clay urn filled with water, the only place where guests and carousers can wash, or dunk themselves to shake off the haze of their intoxicants of choice.

title: [[Viper's Nest, The Pit]]
description: The Viper's Nest is known throughout the land for catering to the dregs of society.  The premises are often frequented by spies, conspirators, thieves, smugglers, rogue adventurers and crooked traders.  Folks congregate around long, rough-hewn tables, hunched forward listening, gesturing or speaking in harsh, sibilant whispers.  The ale is warm, the viands are inedible, nonetheless the Pit is jammed.  You notice a large proportion of S'Kra Mur and Gor'Togs in the mix.

title: [[Viper's Nest, Storm Cellar]]
description: A battered storm cellar door leads down into the room via a few rickety, decrepit wooden steps.  The musty odor and clammy air are intensified by the darkness.  A constant dripping sound and the scurrying of creatures unseen about your feet makes you utter a quick prayer that there are no impending squalls out over Segoltha Bay.  Leaking casks of sour ale, maggot-ridden hogsheads of flour, and dark-stained, shapeless burlap bundles can barely be discerned in the half-murk.

title: [[Viper's Nest, Attic]]
description: The inn is not set up for overnight guests, but this cramped garret is often pressed into service for that purpose.  A filthy mattress with discolored ticking is thrown haphazardly in a corner.  Your feet adhere to the planks and, wondering why, you glance down to see reddish-brown spots that trail out the door.  A lone oil lamp provides dim light.  The harsh chatter of the crowd downstairs, and the scuffles from the courtyard insure that sleep here will be fitful at best.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, Training Room]]
description: Limestone floors, buffed but completely bare, indicate this room is more function than form.  Brightly lit oil lamps hang in abundance, the glare a definite change from the more subdued ambiance of the rest of the guild.  In the center of the room is an iron table surrounded by sturdy chairs.  A polished silver bucket sits to one side.

title: [[Anzu ia Bima, Reservations]]
description: Framed chalk sketches and paintings line the walls of the small office, displaying party rooms filled with guests in some, and others displaying food and drink presentations.  Comfortable chairs sit in front of a fine birch desk, where guests may sit to discuss their plans with the reservation clerk.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Upper Hallway]]
description: Polished brass sconces with lit white candles line the wide hallway.  Colorfully patterned rugs line the polished mahogany floors, practically laid not only to add dimension to the room, but also to mute the sound of scores of feet that enter the busy corridor.  A hand-carved mahogany entrance stands open to welcome guests into the auction hall foyer, while on the opposite end a large brass-hinged door marks the way to the banquet hall.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Upper Hallway]]
description: This hallway leads to the Guild library and to a small lounge overlooking the Trading Pit.  Walls painted a soft blue harmonize with pale gold carpeting.  The frenzied atmosphere below is much reduced here.  A few apprentices lounge about talking quietly among themselves or reading scrolls from the library.

title: [[Traders' Guild, Trading Pit]]
description: The Pit is a crowded and noisy place full of rushing messengers and shouting Traders.  Deals are being made and unmade all about you as rows of numbers are scrawled and erased on chalkboards almost faster than you can read them.  Here and there, Traders shout out offers or counter-offers to one another as their scribes make hasty notes on wax tablets.  Goods and materials for half the province pass through the many hands at work all about you.

title: [[Finer Things By Zincir, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A black oak mantle hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a glass armoir and a black oak bar along the edges of the room.  A lunat stand sits on the stained oak floor, with a deobar chest placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

title: [[JAK'S Treasures, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A granite table and an oaken table sit on the bare floor.  A granite cabinet stands against the oaken walls.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Landing]]
description: The second floor landing is paneled in softly-colored woods that start at a pleasant gold at the north and south, and shade gently to a pale pink at the east and west.  A large goldenwood door to the north blends perfectly with the paneling, and is flanked by two archways of pale pink marble to the east and west.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Library]]
description: Pale pink marble walls and ceiling, a luxurious white carpet, and an abundance of comfortable but unadorned furniture are the only features of this pleasantly warm room.  A large rosewood shelf lined with tomes of history and lore matches the pale pink marble of the archway to the east.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Hall of History]]
description: Thickly woven tapestries adorn the dull granite walls, each depicting something different.  Iron sconces shaped like human hands, each holding a brightly lit gaethzen sphere, are affixed to the walls at regular intervals around the hall.  A few mages read quietly in plush, high-backed chairs sitting atop the thick, bright red carpet.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Reflection]]
description: From the peaked ceiling hangs an enormous gaethzen sphere which casts a bright, white light onto the room.  Polished marble walls intensify the light, creating an aura effect around everything.  In the center of the floor sits a fountain where a tall marble statue of a robed Elven male sends water arching into the pool below from cupped hands.  Large, fluffy cushions circle the fountain, creating a comfortable spot to rest.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Target Range]]
description: Blackened marks mar the surface of the grey stones which form this room.  The charred remains of a tapestry hang on one wall, now only a narrow border of blue surrounding a black-edged hole.  From time to time, young apprentices sidle in to practice their magic upon one of the constructs, only to hurry off to classes.  They leave behind new pits in the stone walls, though perhaps not much damage to the construct they had aimed at.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Archery Range]]
description: A wide marble archway opens up into a spacious room.  Grey stones form the vaulted ceiling and smooth walls, giving this space a somewhat austere feel.  Affixed to the front of a bale of hay is a small target.  The target has been sloppily painted on a square of canvas, streaks of paint running down onto the hay.  Some paint has been splattered liberally on a tree branch from which the canvas hangs.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Storage]]
description: A small space has been set aside in the guild for the storage of goods.  Numerous crates are stacked up against the walls leaving an open area in the center of the room.  The room is dimly lit by a small lantern which sits atop a wooden box near the wall opposite an iron door.  Behind the box sits an apprentice, his eyes focused intently on a ledger before him.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Landing]]
description: The slate grey walls of the tower end, and large panes of glass taper to a point above, creating a massive skylight and window to the heavens above.  Five archways ring the room, each one etched with a curious symbol at its apex.  Dangling from the skylight, a wooden ladder hangs almost directly over a spiraling staircase that leads into the floor.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Air]]
description: Dominated by the translucent panes of the massive skylight, the roof of the tower provides an unparalleled view of the lands around the Crossing, including the shattered remains of Arhat's Tower to the south.  Fickle breezes and gusty gales swirl about the stone, causing the tower to resonate in a never-ending song of change glorifying the dance of the winds.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Earth]]
description: This small cavern, held secret within the depths of the earth, seems to pulse with the very heartbeat of Elanthia.  Phospherein lines the ceiling, emitting a steady, pearlescent green glow.  Roots of various plants, some ancient as the Gods themselves, entwine together to form a small couch upon the ground.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Water]]
description: Perpetually frozen, a great stalactite of ice hangs from the ceiling, reaching almost to the floor.  As the end slowly melts, drops of water fall into a pool below and flow along cracks in the stone to form an intricate lattice-work beneath.  Fog slowly rolls off of the ice, cooling the air and settling into a dream-like haze upon the blue marble.
paths: Obvious exits: obscured by a thick fog

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Fire]]
description: Walls of obsidian blackness reflect the light from a fire-pit in the center of this room.  Smoking braziers of flame-kissed gold line the walls, filling the room with pleasant heat.  Spiderweb traces of rhodonite line the ceiling, glowing in the firelight with the stylized image of a flame.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Electricity]]
description: An anticipatory hum resonates through the air, as though everything in this room were filled with the power of a lightning strike.  Columns of pure ilmenite line the walls, glowing from within with pent-up force.  All traces of metal are conspicuously absent from the room's furnishings.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Aether]]
description: Silvery-blue wall hangings cover the base stone walls of the room, matching the cushions scattered about the floor.  Floating in the center of the room is a sphere of white-gold which glows with an inner fire.  Undefined patterns of light and color swirl about the wall hangings, as though this room were not entirely within the Plane of Abiding.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Chamber of Steel]]
description: This plain white room is unadorned, save for a large map of the realms upon the northern wall, and a small weapons rack.  Several rows of benches cluster about the map, obviously used for strategy sessions, and war games.

title: [[Noot's Teahouse, Main Room]]
description: Patrons of the teahouse enjoy peaceful conversation while sipping and munching on the establishment's splendid edibles.  A wavering stream of cinnamon smoke wanders carelessly through the room.  Carmellia Noot can be found either helping customers or talking to two young elven gentlemen who are sitting at the counter.

title: [[The Marsh, Stone Road]]
description: Some reeds have been hacked away close to the road, undoubtedly destined to become someone's new basket.  The removal has left an opening in the reeds allowing you to peer into the marsh on the other side which seemingly waits for its next victim.  A water beetle that is traveling through the mud stops and waves its feelers at you in what seems to be a challenge before continuing on its way.

title: [[The Marsh, Stone Road]]
description: The lack of direct sunlight here is daunting.  You can't seem to suppress the notion this is the perfect place for highway bandits to ply their trade.  Squinting at the deeper shadows, you search the area for possible ambush locations and poke at the reeds just to make sure.  A quick glance north and south confirms you are in the middle of the grove.

title: [[Julge Dolen Zaldeni, Valley]]
description: Overhead, the stars seem brighter than on the grasslands, the high valley walls bringing the expanse into focus.  A parliament of owls sometimes wings by, looking for richer lark-hunting on the plains above.

title: [[Northwall Trail, Tree Top]]
description: Natural light filters down through the tree's mighty limbs.  The bark of the trunk is well worn with use, as if something or someone has been using this as a way of getting around.  Often, the leaves overhead flicker with movement as squirrels leap playfully through the canopy.  The tree has several crude carvings on it, apparently done by someone who had nothing better to do.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Entrance]]
description: A dim and flickering torch provides barely-adequate illumination of the Society's entryway.  The hall immediately forks before a shimmering sign indicating directions down each hall.  Distorted echoes from numerous chanting voices rebound down the hallway and combine to form a somber melody in this acoustically well-placed room.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Bookstore]]
description: Aisle after aisle of books stand side by side in this place.  The walls of the hall curve back and forth in a visually confusing fashion, but somehow the bookshelves and cobblestone floor are still aligned perfectly.  Robed attendants stand ready to take book orders.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Supplies]]
description: Flickering torches are set in bronze sconces that line the walls of the square hall.  A series of shelves with open cubbyholes line the back of the room in tidy rows.  Standing behind a sturdy oak counter, robed attendants stand ready to take supply orders.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
description: Pairs of torches are set at each corner of the triangular room, causing strange shadows to shift and undulate against the rough stone walls.  Open shelving stacked neatly with supplies line the furthest corner of the room.  A trio of robed attendants stands ready to take orders for enchanting tools.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Rotunda]]
description: Hooded figures stand within recessed balconies that surround the perfectly circular room.  Their low-pitched chanting echoes through the area with a deep thrumming sound.  Four doors are placed at equal intervals along the curved wall of the rotunda.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Society Master's Office]]
description: A large domed ceiling is magnificently painted into a faithful recreation of the night sky, complete with constellations and moons.  A plump tasseled cushion is placed on the cobblestone floor at the center of the room.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Air Workroom]]
description: Azure velvet padding lining the walls and plush carpet covering the cobblestone floor prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with cyclone-shaped legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Earth Workroom]]
description: Sienna velvet padding lining the walls and plush carpet covering the cobblestone floor prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with mountain-shaped legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Fire Workroom]]
description: Crimson velvet padding lining the walls and plush carpet covering the cobblestone floor prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with flame-shaped legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Crossing Enchanting Society, Water Workroom]]
description: Cobalt velvet padding lining the walls and plush carpet covering the cobblestone floor prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with raindrop-shaped legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Entrance]]
description: Arched windows on either side of the doorway illuminate the busy entrance of the Enchanter's Society, the dark marble floor shot through with veins of silver and muted somewhat with dark grey carpet runners.  High above, the ceiling rises in a pointed dome, the spaces between the rafters painted with numerous stormy clouds.  Potted plants add a hint of green to the otherwise monochrome decor.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Amethyst Hall]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Amethyst Hall]]
description: Delicate purple hues cover the entirety of the walls, enhanced somewhat by a large chandelier hanging from the high ceiling.  Teardrop-cut amethysts hang from the chandelier's multifaceted arms, scattering about flecks of light that range from deep violet to an almost transparent blue.  The colors painted on the walls vary in subtle shaded tones, giving the appearance of flowing and untamed aether.

title: [[Society Master's Office of Enchanting]]
[[Riverhaven Society Master's Office of Enchanting]]
description: A single arched picture window lets copious amounts of daylight into the room, and the high domed ceiling makes it feel larger than it really is.  Near the window is a large mahogany desk with an overstuffed chair behind it, while two much smaller chairs are placed in front of it as almost a careless afterthought.  Shelves line the walls, their contents kept meticulously neat and tidy.

A single arched picture window gives a good view of the nighttime sky outside, and the high domed ceiling makes it feel larger than it really is.  Near the window is a large mahogany desk with an overstuffed chair behind it, while two much smaller chairs are placed in front of it as almost a careless afterthought.  Bookshelves line the walls, their contents kept meticulously neat and tidy.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Book Store]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Book Store]]
description: Numerous wooden shelves line the stone walls, each shelf crafted from a rich mahogany that is polished until glistening.  Tomes and manuscripts fill them, most displayed for sale but a few on the top shelf being labeled as 'do not touch'.  Only a few muted lanterns light the room, the low illumination protecting the more fragile of the aging parchments.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Emerald Hall]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Emerald Hall]]
description: Numerous plants in ornate pots line the hallway, the deep green marble floor running from east to west.  Most are in various states of bloom, and a few adventurous vines creep up the marble pillars that line either side of the hall.  More plants are painted onto the walls, and the hallway is lit with several gaethzen orbs behind triangular panes of green glass.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Cerulean Hall]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Cerulean Hall]]
description: Light blue hues cover the eastern wall and ceiling, varying in vibrant shades that mimic a cloudless noon sky.  Deeper blue paneling comes halfway up the walls, peaked at points to resemble ocean waves.  To the west, the colors fade from blue into green, meeting to form a teal color in the center of the long corridor.

title: [[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Silver Workroom]]
description: Metal tables provide ample working space, yet are easily moved out of the way for larger incantations.  The plain marble floor gives the rest of the building some protection against errant spells, while small windows in the ceiling allow for the fast removal of smoke and other fumes.  Acoustically dampened walls dissolve away the echoes of most sounds, making for few distractions in the room.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Citrine Hall]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Citrine Hall]]
description: Carefully set crystals and panes of reddish orange glass give the appearance of fire crackling over the walls, the effect heavily stylized and abstract.  Light plays across the walls in fiery tones, reflecting off gemstones placed in flame mosaics.  Several large torches burn on their pillars on either side of the long hallway, which is completed with dark red carpeting flecked with occasional streaks of golden thread.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Supply Store]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Supply Store]]
description: Large volumes of deep red fabric hang from the walls in heavily draping sheets, enclosing the room and giving it a soft feel.  Wares for sale are laid out on cloth-covered tables, lit by candles that hang from the ceiling in enclosed lanterns.  A vase of firewheel flowers adorns a corner table, their broad petals red at the base and tipped with yellow.

title: [[Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
[[Riverhaven Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
description: Light from gaethzen orbs shines down from each cardinal point of the room, illuminating the numerous wares for sale.  Framed pictures hang on the stone walls, each depicting a complex formula or theory of artificing.  Embroidered into the carpet is an enormous compass, oriented so its northern needle points in the correct direction.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Atrium]]
description: Built in circular splendor, the Enchanting Hall is designed to make the narrow building seem much larger on the inside than it appears from the outside.  Opposite of a crystalline archway, a spiral ramp winds its way up the tower, breaking only to allow access to each level.  A stream of water falls from the magnificent domed glass ceiling, filling a shallow pool in the center of the room that gives sanctuary to a multitude of brightly colored fish.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Tool Store]]
description: Uneven and sporadically spaced floorboards give a glimpse of the lower level as it wraps around the tower to form a charmingly quirky balcony.  Dozens of gaethzen fireflies are placed just out of reach, illuminating the space while adding to the whimsical oddness of the tower.  Attendants bustle around the shop as they pull down tools, restock, and wait upon customers.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Supply Store]]
description: Numerous planters line the walls of the translucent-floored tier, many of them blossoming with flowers.  Daisies and daffodils lend a splash of yellow, while dozens of tulips dazzle in shades of deep red and pink.  Clerks mill about behind a curvy counter, tidying up and restocking supplies.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Book Store]]
description: Swirls of copper, silver, and gold shimmer within the thick glass floor, distorting the view of the lower level.  Filled with an assortment of books and scrolls, glass shelves line the circular walls of the room.  Clerks bustle about as they attend to the needs of the waiting customers.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Ascendant Tier]]
description: Encircling a mosaic medallion embedded into the thick glass floor are thirteen bronze triptychs, each of them turned to reveal their neutral aspect.  The eyes of the neutral gods stare blankly at mosaic in the center of the room.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Transcendent Tier]]
description: Set into a thick glass floor are a plethora of esoteric gold and silver sigils, each elaborate in their simplicity, yet too complex to define.  Several pewter pedestals holding mirrored bowls are placed about the area in a seemingly haphazard manner.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Copper Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments.  Several gaethzen orbs in the ceiling allow enough light to work by, aided by crystal lanterns that hang near each corner.  The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Bronze Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments.  Several gaethzen orbs in the ceiling allow enough light to work by, aided by crystal lanterns that hang near each corner.  The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Pewter Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments.  Several gaethzen orbs in the ceiling allow enough light to work by, aided by crystal lanterns that hang near each corner.  The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Silver Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments.  Several gaethzen orbs in the ceiling allow enough light to work by, aided by crystal lanterns that hang near each corner.  The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Gold Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments. The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Tower of Enchantment, Platinum Workroom]]
description: Fairly spacious, the workroom is set up in an ideal fashion for working with enchantments.  Several gaethzen orbs in the ceiling allow enough light to work by, aided by crystal lanterns that hang near each corner.  The room is relatively quiet, tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the rest of the tower.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Society Master's Office]]
description: Pale blue walls encircle the plush ivory carpet upon which sits a rich mahogany wood desk.  Expansive and covered with odd scorch marks, the desk rests in the center of the room with only one chair behind it.  A large matching hutch rests to the side of the room, packed full of scrolls, various tools, and crumpled letters.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Supply Store]]
description: Enormous birch cabinets stand against the back wall, filled with the various scrolls and totems necessary for enchanting.  A neatly-dressed attendant waits behind a white crescent-shaped counter, ready to answer questions and complete supply orders.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
description: Various tools for enchanting are neatly stored in the many labeled crates that fill the open birch shelving along the back wall.  A cluster of attendants wait behind a long white counter, ready to answer questions and complete orders.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Bookstore]]
description: Pale birch bookshelves are lined up in straight rows at the back of the room.  A cheerful attendant waits behind a simple white counter, ready to answer questions and fetch book orders.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Hallway]]
description: Plush carpeting continues down the hallway in a straight ivory white path.  Similar plush fabric covers the walls, continuing the sound muffling effect by dampening ambient noise.  A diamond-inlaid door and an emerald-inlaid door are the only notes of color to the pale corridor.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Hallway]]
description: The marble flooring of the lobby transitions suddenly into plush carpeting of the same ivory white shade.  Similar plush fabric covers the walls, creating an oddly muffled effect that dampens ambient noise.  A ruby-inlaid door and a sapphire-inlaid door are the only notes of color to the pale corridor.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Diamond Workroom]]
description: Sparkling white velvet walls and plush ivory carpet prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with curved legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Emerald Workroom]]
description: Emerald velvet walls and plush ivory carpet prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with curved legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Ruby Workroom]]
description: Ruby velvet walls and plush ivory carpet prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with curved legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Fang Cove Enchanting Society, Sapphire Workroom]]
description: Sapphire velvet walls and plush ivory carpet prevent outside sounds from disturbing the peaceful sanctity of the workroom.  A large marble table with curved legs provides ample working space.

title: [[Fang Cove Forging Society, Tool Shop]]
description: Boxes and crates of goods stacked high behind the storefront counter are packed with goods for sale.  Attendants scurry about the hustle and bustle of the small shop, attempting in vain to assist customers and tend to deliveries at the same time.  A beaded curtain leads back to the hallway.

title: [[Horse's Haven, Stables]]
description: Freshly cut wooden beams hold up a roof made of braided vines and thick ironwood branches.  Each stall is spaciously built with plenty of room for grooming and feeding of the spectacular horseflesh that makes its home here.
image: Therengia, El Bains Estate Holder Club.png

title: [[Horse's Haven, Trading and Training]]
description: A grassy track leads to and from this training area, which also houses the trader's brokering office.  Horses are led about by young and old alike as their teacher sternly instructs them on the proper care of their charges.
image: Therengia, El Bains Estate Holder Club.png

title: [[Stablemaster's Office]]
description: Charts, shelves of books and pictures cover the walls of this office, all featuring horses as their main theme.  A small desk holds papers belonging to the Stablemaster whose job it is to make sure riders treat their horses with care.  A couple of plain chairs offer a place to sit while waiting for her instructions.
image: Therengia, El Bains Estate Holder Club.png

title: [[Horse Brokerage, Office]]
description: The walls of this room rise chest-height on a human, allowing a gentle breeze to blow under the vine and branch braided roof.  Benches surround a huge table carved from a single block of ironwood that dominates the otherwise sparse area.  Designs of wild horses prance across the surface of the table, as scattered parchments block their way.
image: Therengia, El Bains Estate Holder Club.png

title: [[The Telgar Inn, Upstairs Hallway]]
description: At the top of the stairs is the entrance to a large dormitory.  Down the hallway is a door to a more private room.  The hallway is unfurnished except for a lantern hanging from the ceiling and a ladder leading up to a loft area.  The wood floor is old and worn, warped and sagging from years of feet passing back and forth.

title: [[The Telgar Inn, The Dormitory]]
description: Most of the second floor is taken up by this huge communal dormitory for traders and trappers passing through the town.  The soft glow of a lantern lights the room enough so late arrivals do not stub a toe, but it is not bright enough to bother the sleepers.  Large bunks run along the other walls of the room, many of which are already occupied by tired travellers.

title: [[The Telgar Inn, Private Suite]]
description: This is the best suite the Inn has to offer and is reserved for the town's most important guests or those with the most money.  A large window, one of the few in the town with glass panes, is closed against the night's chill.  A large canopied bed with a down mattress fills a good part of the room.  A long white candle in a bronze candlestick flickers on a small writing table near the window.

title: [[Gwenalion Marina, Seord Dock]]
description: Lanterns flicker in the night with their flames dancing against the waters below.  Sailors lounge about at their leisure, done with their daily chores of lugging cargo and swabbing decks.  Singing is heard from the ships as they make their way back after a few drinks at the nearby taverns.

title: [[Gwenalion Marina, Zelka Dock]]
description: Dark seas stir, lapping against the dock with a slight lulling tune.  Lanterns bring soft lighting, their flames flickering against the water below.  Seagulls rest among piles of rope and gear till the next day's dawning.

title: [[Uz Zinat]]
description: This cramped tent bears obvious signs of repair with lighter patches interrupting the heavy soot stains that cover its interior.  A braided carpet provides flooring while, on the table, a sputtering, half-burnt candle in a dull brass candlestick emits both light and a sulfurous scent.

title: [[Cefrit of Odcoru, Showroom]]
description: Rolled and tied skins that provide insulation are secured to the ceiling, allowing light to sift through the tiny cracks in the joints of the wide sideboards of the wagon.  A curtain across the back wall divides the small showroom from the private areas, while a dark green rug muffles the occasional creak from the floorboards.  Hooks, tables and shelves all display a variety of wares in the cramped area.

title: [[Kifa Awrocis, Showroom]]
description: Thick poles in an ingenious formation line the ceiling and provide plenty of angles from which to suspend the merchandise on display.  Carved into one of the wider supports is a small sign.

title: [[Permutations of Siksraja]]
description: This small shop is brightened by gaethzen stars set into the top of its central support pole.  A plush rug covers the floor and swathes of colorful fabrics are tacked to the tent walls, their hues matching those of a stack of pillows arranged near the back.  Giving the tent a cluttered feel, wares are displayed upon every available surface, though many of the browsing Rakash customers seem to navigate the space without issue.

title: [[Siksraja, Saralt Kaste]]
description: Cinnamon and fresh bread scent the air so heavily that some customers seem to have difficulty remembering what they came to purchase.  Tilted racks line the surrounding walls, displaying the current items for sale.  Only the freshest goods will do for Siksraja and the baker can be heard through swinging half-doors, giving orders in the kitchen to his staff.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Second Floor Foyer]]
description: The ceiling stands high above, giving the sense that this entryway to the second floor is a lot larger than it actually is.  A shattered vase lies crumbled atop an oaken table, some of its pieces scattered on the floor.  A frayed rug lies on the floor -- once a beautiful showpiece, now covered in dirt and tattered and torn in many places.

title: [[Siksraja, Shaded Porch]]
description: Thick posts rise from the ground, supporting the floor and roof of this porch.  Split log railings guard against falls into the trough or hitching post below and enclose everything but the steps.  A rocking chair in the crook of the porch creaks with each passing breeze.  A bell hangs from the support above the hitching post.

title: [[Visfarej Cehs]]
description: Merchandise hangs from every available beam and stocked shelves run along the perimeter of the room.  An empty stool sits next to a high counter as a clerk busily sorts through some items on a table.

title: [[Garidznawk Cehs]]
description: Pushed against one wall is a white table decorated with the emblems of various gods rendered in a rainbow of colors.  A braided rug set beneath a small table and two plain wood chairs completes a cozy corner for contemplation or conversation.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Guest Bedroom]]
description: Once an elegant guest bedroom, the remains are nothing more than a jumbled mess of tattered cloth and broken furniture.  A featherbed sits on a large oaken frame, its contents spilling through several slashes in the fabric.  A lone window opposite the doorway is boarded up, allowing no view from the outside world.  A framed picture hangs on the wall over the bed, the canvas torn to shreds, rendering indecipherable the portrait that the gold frame once held.

title: [[Cietums, Dim Entrance]]
description: Built with sturdy walls of smooth river stones, this simple building serves as a jail for this small village.  Near the center of the room is a simple silverwood desk, the only furniture in this sparse office.  A single window looks out into the street, its frame secured with heavy iron bars built straight into the wall.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Child's Bedroom]]
description: A small child-sized bed sits in the middle of the room, its frame shattered as if something large stomped on it.  The bed coverings are tattered ruins, tossed all about the room as if someone were in a fit of rage.  An oak dresser leans up against one wall with all drawers open, the contents covered in years of dust and grime, but nevertheless still folded neatly.  Curtains made of light green linen hang over the boarded up window, the material frayed at the hem.

title: [[Child's Bedroom, Playroom]]
description: The playroom, though very dusty from lack of cleaning, is in less disarray than most of the other bedrooms in the castle.  A wooden toy box lies in one corner, its contents strewn about the room.  One lone stuffed teddy bear, still intact, sits atop the cover of the box as though someone had placed it there intentionally and neatly.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Master Bedroom]]
description: The largest of all the bedrooms, the master bedroom is dominated by a polished ebonwood four-poster bed.  A tattered and frayed lace canopy drapes over it, once a symbol of style and elegance, now looking more like a pauper's rag.  An extremely large snowbeast rug covers the floor, its once-pristine white color smeared with dirt and mold.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: A small dock slants down over the rock-strewn shore into the water, providing a safe way out of the lake.  Here water crashes against a submerged rocky outcrop and its return digs holes in the bottom large enough to disrupt the lake's normal currents.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: Farther from shore and rescue, the gentle lake begins to exhibit its darker nature.  Beneath the deceptively smooth surface, the water suddenly begins to move swiftly, pulling and pushing in turn.  Care needs to be exercised to keep from being swept off a chosen course.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: Close to the center of the lake, only accomplished swimmers should venture this far offshore.  Water stretches in all directions making it easy to become confused and lose one's bearings.  No sounds from the shore carry this far out, insuring the silence of the water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: The once distant mountains loom much larger in this part of the lake.  A school of small fish swims just beneath the surface, zigzagging with amazing oneness and agility considering they are moving against the current.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: Blue water ripples gently past, carrying bits of forest debris on its way to the shore.  The village's cultivated garden shows as orderly rows but what type of crops might be growing is not discernible from this distance.  Littered with debris and large rocks, the closest bank is quite a distance above the lake's water level.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: The northerly view from this part of the lake is of the village's main street that runs toward the forest.  To the south, the lake stretches into the distance, appearing to lap at the feet of the looming mountains.  A small whirlpool to the southeast serves to caution swimmers about becoming complacent in the water.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: The bottom of the lake begins to disappear as the water becomes deeper.  Fed by an underground spring and precipice runoff, the lake's temperature is noticeably cooler than expected, which is probably the result of snowmelt from the peaks.  Across the lake, the mountain range rises majestically, casting shadows on the water.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: Small plants mixed with several grass species grow in the lake and some of their tops stretch into the night air above the surface.  Dark leaflets project their shadows upon the surface as some vegetation floats past.

title: [[Dzive Ezer]]
description: Weathered piles support the farthest reaches of the dock above and provide a visible boundary for the shallow water.  The combination of piles and a large boulder upon which the dock rests form gently swirling water that never stops moving.  Protected from the weather by the dock, this spot is a favorite for passing time in knee deep water activities.

title: [[Master Bedroom, Drawing Room]]
description: Once an elegant sitting room for the lady of the house, the drawing room now is in a state of disarray and shambles.  Various spools of thread sit in a sewing basket on a table over in the far corner next to a rocking chair.  The shutters over the window are nailed shut, not allowing any views of the outside world.  A large closet looms opposite the doorway, its doors falling from the hinges.

title: [[Siksraja, Zivis Cehs]]
description: The faint scent of fish tickles your nose in this neat as a pin shack.  A long wood counter, with a rack above it, lines the back wall.  Diagonally suspended between two corners is a hammock fashioned from used fish nets.  A huge glass bowl, filled with dirt and alive with worms, props the door open.

title: [[Drawing Room, Closet Interior]]
description: Crates filled with old clothing, all neatly folded and covered in a pile of dust, take up the majority of the floor space inside the closet.  Broken shelving lies scattered about, leaving the contents piled in a heap against the wall.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, First Floor Foyer]]
description: Twin crossed swords hang above the entryway into the reception area, several spider webs hanging from the blades like thin silk veils.  The arched doorway leading into the main rooms of the first floor is made of an intricately carved oak that is marred and gashed in many places.  An elegant tapestry rug covers the entire floor, its gorgeous material stained with a dark brown substance.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Reception Room]]
description: Lavish furnishings draped in white covers are the main centerpieces of the reception area.  Once used to entertain guests before dinner, the room is now covered in dirt and grime.  The painted ceiling is embellished with a row of continuous scrolls and seashells flanked by winged gryphons, the images seemingly unfaded after years of neglect.  A harpsichord sits by the fireplace, its beautiful walnut case marred and broken as if someone took a hammer to it.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, The Gallery]]
description: Three rows of portraits line the far wall of this narrow and long room that serves as an entryway between the reception room and the dining room.  A long woven rug runs the length of the room, its intricate patterns interrupted with large dark spots of grime or something else.  All portraits have been slashed, their canvases hanging in shreds from their golden frames.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Dining Room]]
description: A long table designed to seat ten guests comfortably is centered in the middle of the room.  Three mahogany sideboards along one wall hold several place settings of bone china, many of which lie shattered on the floor.  A couple of recessed niches flank each side of the large fireplace, each one decorated with a coat of arms most likely belonging to the former residents of the castle.  Several of the dining chairs are smashed and broken, leaving large shards of wood strewn about the room.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Library]]
description: A long bookcase occupies the entire length of one wall.  Several of the books are missing, many of them thrown about the room in an apparent whirlwind fit of rage.  The once elegant room is now in complete disarray, pages torn from several books crumpled in heaps throughout the room.  The lone reading table is missing two of its legs, causing it to rest at an angle to the floor.  A large fireplace opposite the bookcase is filled with the charred remains of several books.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, The Weapons Room]]
description: Several racks along one wall apparently held the many weapons of varying sizes and types which lay scattered about the floor.  A large battle-axe protrudes from the wall, thrown with such force that the blade is more than halfway buried in it.  A tattered map hangs from the wall, supported by nothing but a dagger of which only the hilt is visible.  Several splintered and smashed chairs, as well as the remains of a table, have been thrown about the room.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, The Oratory]]
description: This small room of prayer is one of the only rooms that appear to have escaped destruction.  Two rows of padded oaken chairs remain untouched, though the padding is covered in years of dust.  A stained glass window remains intact, a colorful rendition of the Goddess Eluned watching over a sea of dolphins.  At the front of the room is a raised altar made of white alabaster, its surface covered in grime.  Behind the altar in an alcove is a marble statue covered in veils of spider webs and dust.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, The Chapel]]
description: The chapel walls are whitewashed limestone adorned with a large mural of the Immortals along one side of the room.  A white carpet runs between two rows of pews, the once-pristine fibers now covered in a mixture of a dark substance and dirt.  Several of the pews are overturned and broken, large chunks scattered about.  A carved oaken arched trellis stands before an alabaster altar, its frame covered in a veil of spider webs and dried ivy.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Dungeon]]
description: Water drips implacably from the ceiling of a twisting maze of tunnels running beneath the stout-walled fortress.  Footsteps echo along the passage, adding to the disorientation felt within the caverns.  A torch flickers from a rope sconce on the wall, creating a dim sphere of illumination that only serves to emphasize the darkness of the surrounding area.
