title: [[Dadzi's Skrawt Stal, Kwar Stof]]
description: Soft lights, recessed in the stone ceiling, bathe this space with a faint blue glow and create the impression of the night sky.  A small settee covered in silver bear pelts sits on a midnight blue carpet sheared in a latticework pattern.  Four displays, topped with silver velvet, resemble the moons of Elanthia and encircle the settee.

title: [[The Fashion Firmament]]
description: The room is as dark as night, and in fact seems designed to give that illusion: through some art or science, scores of little lights twinkle on the ceiling like stars in the sky.  In the darkness, the only furnishing clearly visible is a counter with a large menu beside it.

title: [[Hvairn's Showldh Stal]]
description: A polished bell hung from a spring on the door tinkles merrily each time someone enters the room.  Redolent of pungent oak and acrid metal polish, the rough timber floorboards and walls are bare of superfluous ornament save for the wares on sale.  Shields of every hue and color, shape and design fill the glass case and the wide shelf, their sumptuous elegance counterfeiting glamour where in fact there is none.

title: [[Hvairn's Heraldry Room]]
description: Pervading every nook and cranny is the prevalent stink of paint thinners and the acrid smell of burnt metal.  A counter divides the room neatly into two, behind which stands a desk whose surface is edged in miniature compartments, each holding items of the trade -- ink pots, brushes, and stylus.  Lyewend, who oversees the ordered chaos, stands framed by myriad small square drawers, each wooden front dotted with a small copper knob.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Behind the Forge]]
description: Blasts of heat rise from a radiant vent in the floor, far too hot for any mortal to survive.  Several smaller crevices exhibit the same molten glow.  Curiously, a tempered steel grate covers the vent, and guards stand duty just outside the door.  Other, cooler cracks lead downward, though only one is wide enough to allow you to squeeze through.

title: [[Stawk's Brothers Mineral and Supply]]
description: The entire room has been roughly chipped out of the surrounding stone.  Crates and boxes are haphazardly strewn about with merchandise, while a single chunk of stone with a slightly flattened surface sits in the middle of the room, chained to the floor.  An old corner table stands in the back of the cavern, covered with a thick layer of dust and carrying a lone item which apparently receives little attention from the local customers.  Across from the exit into the upper cavern is a bolted iron door.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Entry]]
description: Gleaming like a bright star in a night sky, an uthamar arch separates the Enchanting Society from the main cavern.  Small gaethzen tetrahedrons are strategically placed to provide just enough light to see by, but not so much as to inhibit the dim, soothing ambience of the room.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Hall]]
description: Embedded within the stone walls, bits and pieces of mica sparkle underneath the gaethzen string lights that are strung across the cavern's high ceiling.  Four arches of orichalcum, loimic, mistglass, and animite are positioned at each corner of the square hall and placed equidistant to each other.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Bookstore]]
description: The cavern narrows into a long, skinny chamber where one side is completely covered in bookshelves formed of marble slabs.  Dwarven attendants dressed in sturdy canvas coveralls stand ready to take book orders.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
description: The cavern expands outwards into a shape similar to that of a trapezoid.  Carved into the back wall, open shelves are neatly stacked with various tools of the trade.  Dwarven attendants dressed in sturdy canvas coveralls stand ready to take tool orders.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Supply Store]]
description: The cavern opens up into a large rhombus-shaped room with squat metal cabinets lined up against the walls.  Dwarven attendants dressed in sturdy canvas coveralls stand ready to take supply orders.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Society Master's Office]]
description: The cavern terminates into a large round chamber that is softly lit with gaethzen stars.  Ranging from simple to complex, sigils of all sorts are carved into the curved stone walls.  A wide uthamar desk and matching chair are set at the center of the room.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Orichalcum Workroom]]
description: Deeply recessed from the hallway, the small cavern's dense stone walls protect the workroom's inhabitants from being unduly disturbed by outside noise.  A sturdy granite table placed to the side of the room provides ample working space.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Loimic Workroom]]
description: Deeply recessed from the hallway, the small cavern's dense stone walls protect the workroom's inhabitants from being unduly disturbed by outside noise.  A sturdy granite table placed to the side of the room provides ample working space.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Mistglass Workroom]]
description: Deeply recessed from the hallway, the small cavern's dense stone walls protect the workroom's inhabitants from being unduly disturbed by outside noise.  A sturdy granite table placed to the side of the room provides ample working space.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Enchanting Society, Animite Workroom]]
description: Deeply recessed from the hallway, the small cavern's dense stone walls protect the workroom's inhabitants from being unduly disturbed by outside noise.  A sturdy granite table placed to the side of the room provides ample working space.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Hall]]
description: An intersection is formed of two hallways, one running north and south and the other east and west.  In any direction the smell of smoke is thick, but breathable, made possible by the curved slope of the domed roof which leads the smoke to a large chimney directly above.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Foundry]]
description: A pile of coal sits near the southern wall, waiting to be fed to a fire in the large pit occupying the center of the room.  A crucible hangs from a wooden beam between the fire and several molds to facilitate the process of creating various ingots, plates and wires.  Large bellows sit next to the crucible, ready to be used to fan the flames when necessary.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Foundry]]
description: A pile of coal sits near the southern wall, waiting to be fed to a fire in the large pit occupying the center of the room.  A crucible hangs from a wooden beam between the fire and several molds to facilitate the process of creating various ingots, plates and wires.  Large bellows sit next to the crucible, ready to be used to fan the flames when necessary.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Honing Room]]
description: An occasional shriek of metal being pressed against a grindstone echoes throughout the corridor like a victim being tortured.  A light smoky scent fills the air, filtering in from elsewhere in the forge.  A casual glance upwards reveals most of the smoke being directed through a chimney in the center of the ceiling.  Every so often someone wanders by, carrying an assortment of weapons and looking extremely pleased.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Honing Room]]
description: An occasional shriek of metal being pressed against a grindstone echoes throughout the corridor like a victim being tortured.  A light smoky scent fills the air, filtering in from elsewhere in the forge.  A casual glance upwards reveals most of the smoke being directed through a chimney in the center of the ceiling.  Every so often someone wanders by, carrying an assortment of weapons and looking extremely pleased.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Hall]]
description: A bench gently curves along with the northern wall, serving as a resting place for those waiting to use various parts of the forge.  Every so often someone wanders in and out of the different arches, most likely impatient smiths waiting for their turn.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild Forge, Smithy]]
description: The room is filled with a reddish glow cast by the forge taking up most of the room.  The sounds of hammer against anvil and metal grinding against stone fills the air, along with the occasional hiss of hot metal meeting water.  A smoky scent fills the air every so often for a brief moment, only to be carried up the chimney in the forge's dome or one of the smaller ventilation shafts.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: A pair of Dwarven guards stands on either side of the massive gem-studded door that seals this cavern off from other areas of Hibarnhvidar's interior.  A curving pathway has been coaxed out of the stone and winds lazily around the large terraced cavern.  Though the path is easily wide enough to accommodate the occasional supply-laden caravan, a steel fence placed near the terrace's edge prevents any mishaps from excited visitors.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: A small clumping of Dwarven dwellings is recessed along the cavern's wall.  Decorative silk banners and ribbons are woven into the protective fence in an effort to add color to the neighborhood and draw attention away from the drab housing and tenants.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: Always guarded by a small contingent of armored guards, a large structure -- carved from the stone around it -- protrudes from the wall.  As the Dwarves come and go, they stop by the racks of Dwarven axes, spears, and swords that line the sides of the armory, carefully inspecting the weaponry and replacing those that have been damaged during their sparring exercises.  In the event of threat from the outside, there can be little doubt that the Dwarves will defend the homes that line the cavern.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: Plain and dark, the cave doors here are crafted from iron.  Of the more prominent in view, one features a carving of badgers while another displays a pair of crossed hammers.  Between them sits a dark red clay pot with long pale feathers resting within it.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: The pathway widens considerably here, jutting out into the open cavern as a pier would in water.  Visitors and natives alike venture out onto the fenced area and gaze down to the expansive terraces below.  A massive stone tower climbs from the ground level to just above the cavern's second terrace and emits brilliant flashes of light that provide the illumination for the inhabitants.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: Wooden stalls line the pathway as it continues to circle the cavern's upper region.  Affixed to the front of each is an iron shelf bearing a line of clay pots and jugs that descend in size from left to right.  Occasionally a string of Dwarven children will run through, sometimes pausing in front of one stall or another to blow across the mouths of the jugs in some manner of a game -- often the one making the loudest noise taking up the lead position as they run onwards through the cavern.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: Set back into the corner, a pair of hammocks has been strung up on either side of a table.  A tattered deck of cards and a set of stained ivory dice are scattered across the table, each covered in dust from long periods of disuse.  Though almost always enveloped in a thick blanket of shadows, the recessed area sometimes takes on the vibrant hues of reds and blues and greens as the illuminating tower flares.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: Nestled firmly against the fence on the terrace's edge is a lone home, its facade worn greatly with the ravages of time.  Though certainly not much to look at, the home does stand out from every other one in the expansive area.  A quick observation of the multi-tiered den reveals that, unlike the others, this is the only structure to stand on the edge of any terrace rather than being set against the cavern's wall.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: A pair of ruts runs several feet down the length of the winding pathway.  Buckets of crumbled rock rest beside the deepening holes along with a stack of abandoned parchments.  Supplies and more parchments lie near the fence-protected ledge, all left unattended and gathering dust.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Harst Haalm]]
description: A lone wooden structure stands beside the stairway that leads down to the middle terrace.  An elderly Dwarven woman frequently sits at the window, casually watching the traffic come and go from the three terraces.  Several of the visitors stop to inquire for directions to the various visitation spots.  Flashing a youthful smile to each, she points and gestures in numerous directions as she describes the different routes.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: A large covered wagon rests beside the stairway that leads up to the third terrace.  The full aromas of freshly baked goods and meats waft out from one of the many openings.  As the guard shifts change, many stop by the wheelless structure to share a meal with friends while others pass it by only to return later with their families.  Laughter echoes from within at all hours of the day and night.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: Several Dwarven statues have been erected around a small green, all in poses of great heroics.  Jesters put on shows in the middle of the square while spectators laugh at them and with each other.  The occasional passerby will stop and admire one of the statues before moving on.  The mouth-watering scent of meat and cheese wafts through the air, coming from somewhere nearby.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: The road here becomes a small path as it winds between two halves of a garden.  The hearty smells of wild flowers and herbs mix in the air, creating an invigorating yet unobtrusive aroma.  Attendants wander about the area, tending to the vegetation and adjusting the artificial lighting from gaethzen globes to simulate the conditions of the surface.  Troughs of water sit at either end of the cultivated ground.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: Several stone benches about the area provide ample seating around a large granite fountain.  Travelers occasionally stop and rub the base of the fountain for good luck before continuing on their relaxing strolls.  Laughter echoes into the room from other parts of the city, adding to the calming atmosphere.  Lavish embellishments on the barrier wall obscure most the view of Akigwe Tower.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: Carved from the stone of the middle terrace is a pair of stairways that lead to the base of the tower below.  From atop the descent, a fine view of Akigwe Tower's front side is visible, its beautiful architecture and grandiose lanterns complimenting one another perfectly.  Small crowds of well-dressed visitors stand near the brick wall that guards the edge.  The occasional painter stops by such groups and offers to capture the view for them...for a price.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tower Base]]
description: A pair of stairways, carved directly from the stone of the cavern's walls, leads to the terrace above.  Short, fence-like barriers of rounded dark rocks separate the private gardens of the Dwarves that have made their homes here.  A walkway of perfectly cut and laid stone leads around the base of the massive tower.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tower Base]]
description: A well tended garden with neat rows of sand and multicolored rock decorating its surface occupies much of the otherwise stone ground.  Centered within the garden is a tall green marble fountain that has been expertly carved into the image of a young Dwarven maiden wielding a huge hammer.  A wide stone bench and a pot full of preserved daisies are placed near the fountain.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tower Base]]
description: Lanterns of brass hang on either side of a wide door of iron and oak that sits recessed within the granite tower.  Twisting and turning over the door is a thick vein of black gold-flecked marble with graceful geometric designs.  The faint sound of flowing water emanates from a nearby rock garden.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Tower Base]]
description: Perpetual light bathes the tower's base and the surrounding cavern from an unseen source atop the tower.  Though the cavern is constantly illuminated, the light flutters as if it were a flame caught in a breeze.  Oranges and reds fade to cool blues and greens before flaring back to life once again.  A stone bench rests outside of a nearby home, often occupied with the city's visitors who are unaccustomed to the fiery display.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: An artistic barrier formed by stacked and colored bricks carved to resemble Dwarven faces separates the homes facing this terrace and the ledge that drops to the base level below.  Some of the bricks have signatures carved beneath the face.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: Grey spots discolor the pathway in numerous places, most only a hand's width.  Some, however, are large enough for a well-fed Gor'Tog to lie comfortably across and still have room left for stretching!  A trio of wooden barrels rests against a wall with a crisp parchment tacked to the side of one of them.

title: [[Inner Hibarnhvidar, Midhik Haalm]]
description: A grand view of the rear of Akigwe Tower dominates the vista and obscures the view of the northern most areas of the second terrace.  Though the tower falls short of the third level of the cavern, it soars well above the second.  Flashes of vibrant lights fill the cavern periodically, illuminating the grand houses down below and drawing shouts of amazement from visitors above.

title: [[Orfna's Oddlies]]
description: The shop is large, sectioned into separate climates and decors to accommodate a variety of animals.  A small portion of the area is shrouded in shadow for the benefit of the more nocturnal beasts, while the rest is clean and brightly lit.

title: [[Empaths' Guild, Infirmary]]
description: Granite walls enclose a spacious room, painted a warm sand color and draped with yellow muslin to help mute the noise.  A small waiting area comprised of comfortable chairs and benches sits nearest the arch.  Deeper into the room, low beds of muslin-covered cushions are scattered, some occupied while others await the next patient.  Healers drift between the beds, checking the patients, diagnosing wounds, and healing when ready.  Against the far wall stands a large white cabinet with multiple shelves.

title: [[Merchant Apartments, Plaza]]
description: Grape vines delicately entwine across grey trellises and eroded stone benches in this rounded, open area between the first floor corridors.  A faintly smiling water nymph carved from granite pours from a never-emptying pitcher into a small fountain.  A patch of the Crossing's sky functions for the plaza's dome, but no sound of the Crossing permeates this space.  An archway leads north.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Table of Winds]]
description: A carved horn decorates the end of the pine table, which provides a place to prop one's feet and put down an ale glass while practicing or conversing.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Table of the Voice]]
description: A carved Dwarf, mouth open in song, decorates the end of the mahogany table, which provides a place to prop one's feet and put down an ale glass while practicing or conversing.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Table of Drums]]
description: A carved drum decorates the end of the cherry table, which provides a place to prop one's feet and put down an ale glass while practicing or conversing.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Table of Strings]]
description: A carved lute decorates the end of the oak table, which provides a place to prop one's feet and put down an ale glass while practicing or conversing.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Encampment]]
description: Wagons of various sizes and shapes are spread throughout the area, with some connected by covered walkways for larger families.  Bright pink bee balm flowers grow with abundance here, attracting hummingbirds -- a favorite bird of the elders who come to watch them during the day.  Steps lead towards the main building.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Wooded Trail]]
description: Familial wagons create small huddled circles here, the flickering light from the communal hearth warming the space.  Windowsill planters and large earthen pots filled with flowers and medicinal herbs add color and beauty to the surroundings.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Wooded Trail]]
description: Growing more abundantly as the trail heads northward, the trees are thick on the ground.  Very few wagons are found here, giving a sense of solitude to the area.  Several pots of bright red geraniums are placed side by side with herbs, adding both beauty and function to the portable landscaping.  The path continues toward the sound of water while a ramp heads to a forest bower.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Wooded Trail]]
description: Quiet prevails around the area save for the occasional sound of a bird singing or the rustle of the tall trees in the wind.  Long troughs of fragrant, shade-loving herbs grow abundantly in the darkness of the forest.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Wooded Trail]]
description: Spread thinly here, the distant wagons add to the sense of solitude in the area.  Lavender scents the air, growing in large pots alongside other herbs.  A nearby wagon is painted a bright blue and stenciled with a colorful butterfly.  The path continues towards the sound of water.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Hall]]
description: Spacious windows allow gentle woodland breezes to carry the scents of exotic flowers and decaying leaves throughout this workroom.  The center of the hall is dominated by rows of tables that provide workspace for all manner of industry.  Silk looms and graceful easels are turned to take the greatest advantage of the light.  To the rear of the room, willow stand lamps flank a rounded alcove leading to the dormitory wing.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Flower Field]]
description: Quiet encompasses the field, and the only sound is the babble of the nearby brook.  Every imaginable type of native flower blankets the ground, filling the air with an almost tangible scent.  Multitudes of butterflies are found here, flying or resting on nearby blossoms.  A massive oak tree, twisted with age, rises up in the center of the clearing, providing ample shade on sunny days.  A winding trail crosses the brook then leads to an encampment.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Burial Chamber]]
description: Deep underground and circular in shape, the chamber is protected by beams supporting arches that curve overhead, joining in the center of the ceiling where a gaethzen acorn hangs.  Niches containing small shrine-like collections of candles and trinkets line the walls.  A large altar, used in the House's burial ceremonies, sits in the center of the chamber.  Gnarled roots from the oak above form the stairs leading up.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Forest Bower]]
description: Encircling giant ferns offer privacy to this peaceful glade while the boughs of towering trees and a simple awning offer shelter from the elements.  The gentle murmur of a nearby stream promises a restful slumber in the open air.  For that purpose, a collection of hammocks clusters around a stone firepit.  Some thoughtful soul has left jugs of spring water and a basket of freshly-baked bread near the forest-green door leading into the building.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Dyeing Wagon]]
description: Workers bustle from one vat to another, checking on the silk thread being dyed.  The strong smell of the solvents used in the process permeates the wagon explaining why it is located far from the others.  The windows are open, even on the coldest days, to dissipate the fumes.  A covered archway leads back into the drying room.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, House Garden]]
description: Straight and angular, the walkways evenly divide each type of plant from other varieties.  Herbs, vegetables and dwarf fruit trees abound providing more than enough food for every member of the House and any guests that may visit.  Gardeners work fastidiously at tending their charges.  A wooded path leads directly to a large building, allowing the cooks and their assistants easy access.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Back Porch]]
description: Open on three sides, this simple, covered porch offers both a back entrance to the kitchen and a welcomed respite from the heat of the stove.  The boughs of wild cherry and plum trees cascade over the slatted handrails beside which two rustic benches rest.  A rough-hewn walkway leads past the meeting forum to another building in the distance while a meandering woodland path offers access to the vegetable and herb gardens.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, White Chamber]]
description: The whitewashed, lattice walls of this charming room are interwoven with silver silk and accented with several lace wall hangings depicting healing herbs.  A modest featherbed is covered with matching silk linens, and a grass-green folding chair sits beside a window.  An arrangement of chrysanthemums and wild ginger blossoms graces a small table next to the chair.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Golden Repose]]
description: Tiger maple paneling and a glazed glass window make this room one of the rare fully enclosed spaces in the complex.  Though the cozy chamber is modest in size, no expense has been spared to make guests feel comfortable.  A lacquered dresser, bearing an alabaster wash basin, sits opposite an overstuffed featherbed.  Beneath the small window rests a mahogany rocking chair.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Kitchen]]
description: Cooks work busily at the three tables standing in the center of the room.  With its simmering pots and whistling kettles, a round stove nestles in the corner opposite a massive whitewashed pantry.  Along the far wall, a large window and the brass lanterns flanking it offer ample light for cooking and cleaning alike.  In an attempt to vent the heat of the room, a simple curtain is pulled aside to reveal the back porch.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Dining Hall]]
description: Saffron-yellow tablecloths, cerulean cushions and delicate floral arrangements disguise the simple, low tables and benches at which meals are served in this busy common room.  Braziers have been placed along the rear wall to offer diners light and warmth as they enjoy the gentle, woodland breezes that waft in through an oversized window.  An aggressive wisteria vine winds its way through the silk-draped lattice walls, scenting the area with its heady aroma.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Foyer]]
description: Jaunty watercolor paintings and panels of billowing silk adorn the simple, latticed walls that enclose this winsome chamber.  Tiles of tightly-woven sisal, dyed various shades of sepia and brown, have been arranged to form a mosaic carpet that covers the slatted floor of the platform.  The room's focal point is a large, lacquered secretary that stands opposite the opening leading into a graceful pergola.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Remembrance Hall]]
description: To either side of a teak walkway, elaborate trelliswork rises from the woodland floor, creating a vast pergola under the tree canopy.  Small shrines are sheltered among the hostas, painted ferns, and bluebells that quilt the ground while a profusion of vines reaches upward along the carved beams of the enclosure.  The sound of birdcalls and the steady rhythm of a water clock are all that mar the reverent silence of the hall.  Gaps in the pergola reveal an arbored footpath.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Forum]]
description: Little more than a large, round clearing under the canopy of several towering trees, the forum boasts two concentric rings of benches centering on the speaker's mound.  Rows of torches and embroidered pennants surround the seating area.

title: [[Derbycrop's Farmhouse, Living Area]]
description: Abandoned trinkets and other family relics still sit upon their shelves, untouched by the chaos outside except for the thick coating of dust and smoke stains.  Children's toys and clothes hanging in a closet can be seen in a nearby, doorless room, and the kitchen's furnishings lie in another room on the opposite side of the living area.  A bedroll rests in one corner and shows signs of recent use while a spinning wheel sits in front of a heavy oak mantelpiece in another.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Lower Branches]]
description: Sunlight filters past the thickly leafed, multi-layered branches of the oak in dancing motes that play upon the dark trunk of the tree like fireflies flitting through a midnight sky.  A large twisted limb branches out from the tree to the northeast while two smaller limbs extend to the north and to the southeast.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, White Birch Tree Limb]]
description: The narrow branch trembles with the weight of visitors seeking a peaceful spot to rest in the tree.  White bark covering the trunk peels easily and is marked by narrow horizontal stripes, which camouflage the marks left by travelers on their climb.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Green Ash Tree Limb]]
description: Long green leaves surrounding the branch each have several pairs of leaflets, which are darker at the base and grow paler near the tips.  The bark on the tree's trunk is brown to dark grey and covered in interlacing furrows that add traction for visitors needing to climb down from here.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Red Birch Tree Limb]]
description: The narrow branch trembles with the weight of visitors seeking a peaceful spot to rest in the tree.  Salmon-colored bark covering the trunk peels and turns to dark red-brown plates as it ages, making the climb back down a challenge.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Blue Ash Tree Limb]]
description: Fern-like fronds covered in long, pointed leaves drape down from the surrounding branches, resembling graceful fans awaiting the next passing breeze.  Tiny ridges cover the bluish tinged bark, adding a little traction for visitors needing to climb down from here.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Elm Tree Limb]]
description: Leaves drooping off branches overhead blanket each side of the limb in foliage, muffling any sounds from the meadow.  The smooth bark of the tree's trunk is marred with scars and slashes left from visitors clumsily climbing down to resume their travels.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Oak Tree Limb]]
description: Chunks of bark missing along the branch look as if something or someone has pulled it off to expose the raw wood.  Scarring the tree's trunk, stumps left from broken limbs form makeshift footholds for anyone needing to climb down from here.

title: [['Neer's Hummock, Elm Tree Limb]]
description: From this height, visitors can easily see across the meadow to a path that leads through a break in the surrounding wall of trees.  Scratches on the smooth bark of the trunk show that more than travelers have used it to climb on.

title: [[Langenfirth, Up a Towering Deobar Tree]]
description: Nestled amongst the newer cabins of the small town, the deobar tree is a natural escape from the urbanization of Langenfirth.  The sounds of soft rolling water drift from somewhere beyond the housing area.

title: [[Antechamber Entrance]]
description: A smattering of lanterns hang from the vaulted ceiling of the crushingly tight corridor, giving precious little light to these dismal passageways.  Offering, no extra light, just a passage to the plaza , a charred hole is blasted in the back wall.  Wafts of dank and musty air come from a place beyond here, beckoning all who brave this place to keep moving in hopes of more space and cleaner air.  Along one wall recessed chambers are carved into the stone, forming a couple of shelves that each hold different oddities and artifacts.

title: [[Corridor]]
description: A hand's width wider here than to the west, the ceiling is strung with numerous lanterns.  Black mold and slime fills the corners with moist and gooey muck.  Cracks rise along the stone walls.  Between a pair of doors, a portrait hangs on the cracked stone wall, nearly obscured by cobwebs.  Faint air currents cause the sticky mess of dusty spidersilk to flutter, though an occasional stronger gust causes the door's hinges to creak and moan.

title: [[Library]]
description: Quite roomy in comparison to the the cramped corridor, the smell of melting wax and musty paper encompasses the private area.  A massive two-tiered chandelier hangs from the domed ceiling, lighting the room with a soft flickering glow that casts distorted shadows over random surfaces.  Walls of bespoke shelving wrap around the circular room; each is covered with rows of time-worn books, all neatly ordered and labeled despite being moldy and slightly warped.  Situated near the door, two cracked leather highback chairs face each other separated by a toppled table of marble.

title: [[Antechamber]]
description: Devoid of decoration, the door, walls, and even the ceiling and floors are a uniform, dingy white marble.  Four massive columns support the room in its center, making them the main focal point in the vast space.  Cleverly tucked in a corner behind a pillar, a silver and white damask curtain hangs in shreds, revealing rather than hiding a tiny alcove.  The east wall is nearly gone, deliberately knocked down in an unfinished attempt to expand the space.

title: [[Antechamber East]]
description: Unlike its western half, this room is lavishly decorated.  Gilded columns reach to the ceiling, framing roundels of the Thirteen.  Each deity's eyes are seemingly focused on a frieze depicting the various constellations that runs along the cornice surrounding the room.  Now dusty and threadbare, once plush chairs and sofas face a pair of buffet tables that stretch from one corner to the next.  Framed in intricately carved wood, a wide marble stairwell is blocked by an undulating purple ward.

title: [[Alcove]]
description: A pair of enormous ceramic flower pots rest beside the remains of the curtain, displaying only layers of dust along their rims.  The only other feature is a bench that follows along the back wall.  Surrounded by piles of tattered fabric and matted down, the pitted surface offers precious little comfort.  A series of silver medallions are embedded deeply into the stone.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: Made up of dirt and rocks, the surrounding landscape is completely barren and free of life, as if all vegetation had been scoured away by an overwhelming force.  The ground is parched and dry, with spiderweb cracks running through the ground.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: The ground in the area is unnaturally flat and barren, though there is little indication of what caused the unnatural ground.  To the west, large boulders block the way, tall enough that it's impossible to see past the formations.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: Loose rubble peppers the ground in scattered piles, cleared away in small paths that have little purpose.  Nothing grows in the area, and the normal signs of life are completely absent, with no animal tracks or insects in the dirt.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: Buried halfway in the ground lies a lone skeleton, its spine and legs completely sunken into the hardened dirt and its ribs half sticking out of the ground.  Only its head is exposed, and its posture mimics the pose of a drowning man.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: The flat, dry ground holds little moisture, and it appears that any rain that falls simply runs off it without penetrating the surface.  Large boulders block most of the way north, though a trail wends through them, leading through the tangle of massive stones.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: Compact and barren ground makes up the landscape in the area, and the path continues between several massive boulders that are sunk partly into the ground.  The narrow path has a feeling of intense sterility, and an almost astringent taste lingers in the stale air.

title: [[Edge of the Pit]]
description: The desolate landscape suddenly drops off into a massive spiral-shaped pit, with extremely steep sides and forming a bowl-shaped basin.  At the bottom of the pit, numerous bleached white skeletons are visible, surrounding a massive obelisk that rises up in the center of the pit.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: The lifeless ground is covered in a massive tangle of skeletons, bleached white and stripped of flesh after long exposure to the elements.  Many of the skeletons are splintered and cracked in numerous places, indicating massive trauma before the victims' deaths.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: A thin layer of dust saturates the stale air about one to two inches above the ground, making tiny whorls and spirals whenever disturbed.  The ground itself is completely bare and lifeless, dry as a long forgotten bone and comprised of compacted brown dirt.

title: [[Desolate Field, Barren Path]]
description: The ground in the area is a very deep brown that borders on black, as if the remnants of a blazing fire had sputtered out and then crumbled over the landscape during the eons of neglect.  The occasional small rock can be seen sunken into the dirt, but otherwise the area is flat and featureless.

title: [[Edge of the Pit]]
description: The ground drops off to the east as a massive pit cuts through the desolate landscape like a hole into the world.  At the bottom, a mass graveyard is clearly visible, full of long forgotten skeletons that surround a massive white obelisk that stands tall in the center of the pit.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: The bottom of the ramp is partly covered in bleached white skeletons, scattered here and there in macabre poses.  Several of the bodies still have bits of dried out flesh clinging to them, mummified over eons in the dry air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: The narrow path sweeps south from the crumbling gate and lies within a shallow ravine, with all the signs of once having held a riverbed or wash.  Numerous brown pebbles line the now barren path, and it's clear that any water that falls is quickly funneled away by the sloping path.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: The walls of the ravine widen in this area to accommodate a large brown rock formation in the center of the depression.  Dry trails mark where runnels of water used to flow in the area, punctuated by small pebbles worn smooth and round.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: The shallow ravine narrows to the east, while it widens to the west to accommodate a large rock formation in the center of the path.  Rising tall from the ground, the formation appears to have once been merely a part of the landscape, ancient water having carved the paths around it.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: The shallow ravine cuts through the sullen landscape like a meandering crack through brown rock, and its floor resembles an area where the dull landscape simply caved into it.  Tiny trails in the ground indicate where water flows when it rains, carving dry spiderwebs through the bare dirt.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: Powdery dirt and loose pebbles litter the ravine floor, making it obvious that moisture never stays around for long in this dry and desolate place.  Both the northern and southern walls are cracked and jagged, though erosion has blunted the sharpest of the edges.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: A massive collection of rocks and boulders completely block off any continuation of the shallow ravine to the east, easily filling the path past the top of the gorge.  A path to the north appears man-made, with numerous shovel marks still visible in the hard and compact dirt.

title: [[Edge of the Pit]]
description: The edge of a massive pit is clearly visible to the north, the sides of it straight vertical and the bottom of it filled with a massive number of bleached skeletons.  In the center of the pit, an enormous obelisk rises up high, standing starkly white against its darker surroundings.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Hundreds of skeletonized corpses are piled up in careless and haphazard arrangements, a testament to the brutal efficiency of whoever presided over their deaths.  Mixed into the collection of bones are many animal bones, giving hints that the killing was quite indiscriminate.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Desolate Field, Lifeless Trail]]
description: The path cuts directly into the ravine wall, creating a narrow depression in the stone that marks the beginning of a cave.  However, it appears that whatever water flowed through this area was long gone before the formation could be finished, and the overhang is not enough to protect from the elements.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Scraps of dark cloth still cling to several of the mummified corpses that litter the bottom of the pit, the numerous bodies dried out into empty, dry husks that give little indication to what races they were.  Though immobile and very long dead, the corpses still appear to stare forward blankly.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Piles of bones stack up against the sheer edges of the pit, creating tangles that make it impossible to tell which bones belonged to what skeleton.  Clear and crisp paths between the piles of bone are the only indication that the area is not wholly abandoned.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Relatively few skeletons lie at rest in this area compared to the rest of the pit, though the absence makes the few that remain all the more eerie, speaking of unfinished work in filling the pit.  Several of the skeletons are also not wholly bleached, indicating that they are at least somewhat newer than the rest of the pit.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Obelisk]]
description: Rising high from the center of the sunken pit, the pure white obelisk stands starkly against the sky, made from some strange material that defies any weathering or vandalism.  Each of its four corners points exactly in a cardinal direction.  The southwestern face is visible here and is covered mostly in a cursive script of compact writing, though a little under a third of it is still blank.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Obelisk]]
description: Rising high from the center of the sunken pit, the pure white obelisk stands starkly against the sky, made from some strange material that defies any weathering or vandalism.  Each of its four corners points exactly in a cardinal direction.  The northwestern face is visible here, and numerous runes are carved onto its surface, filled in with a dark material that makes the lettering stand out.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Numerous bare skeletons litter the ground in the area, both decay and rigor mortis having twisted them into macabre shapes.  Stray bones and skulls poke up from the compacted hard dirt, indicating that the pit has seen multiple uses over long periods of time.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Sunken Pit, Mass Graveyard]]
description: Discarded skeletons litter the bottom of the massive pit, most of them partly sunken into the thick dirt that makes up the ground in this desolate area.  Huddled into the stone wall are two corpses holding hands, indicating that not everyone may have been dead before they were thrown into the pit.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The middle and upper platforms, covered with foliage, rise over the trail cleared out of the surrounding vegetation.  The loud calls of insects and birds fill the area.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Hewn from the surrounding undergrowth, a narrow footpath twists between fallen boulders that cover the platform.  The middle and upper platforms, covered with jungle vegetation, loom over the crude pathway.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Some of the fallen stones have been cleared off to the side in the beginnings of attempts at archaeological work.  The two upper platforms, covered with tangles of vines, loom over the crude footpath winding between the boulders.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: Hewn from the surrounding flora, a crude pathway zigzags between jumbled rocks that cover the platform.  Some of the stones have been cleared off in the beginnings of attempts at archaeological work.

title: [[Ziggurat, Lower Level]]
description: The middle and upper platforms, covered with tangles of foliage, loom over the crude pathway.  Tumbled stones litter the platform, refugees from higher on the structure.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: Puddles from previous downpours spread across the trail, settling into the depressions in the stones of the ziggurat.  Most of the area is choked with undergrowth, leaving a track between the steps and staircase as well as pathways leading further around the edifice.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Although the steps and stairs are cleared, little other progress has been made in stripping the vegetation from the ziggurat.  A narrow game trail twists into the jungle, allowing access to the rest of the upper level.

title: [[Ziggurat, Peak]]
description: Winds sweep across the stone platform at the top of the ziggurat, scouring it clean of dirt and debris.  The vista is of mostly unbroken jungle, only occasionally broken by the summits of other ziggurats rising above their own cloaks of jungle vegetation.  Some of the stones have begun to crumble under the onslaught of water and weather, but it remains safe enough for now.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: A small pool of rainwater has formed in the depression between some of the stones of the floor.  Spreading out from the encircling trails, a large clearing fills the space between the steps and stairs moving between the levels.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Broken and crushed vegetation extends around the staircase and steps, providing a bit of a break in the lush tangle of foliage.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: Most of the area is choked with undergrowth, leaving a clearing between the stairway and stairs as well as trails leading further around the ziggurat.  Pools from previous rains spread across the trail, settling into the depressions in the stones of the edifice.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Although the stairway and staircase are cleared, little other progress has been made in stripping the foliage from the pyramid.  A twisty pathway snakes into the jungle, allowing access to the rest of the upper level.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: Spreading out from the encircling trails, a large clearing fills the space between the steps and stairs moving between the levels.  A small pool of rainwater has formed in the depression between some of the stones of the floor.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Flattened foliage extends around the stairway and stairs, providing a bit of a break in the overgrown tangle of undergrowth.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: A few rocks have dislodged from the platform, forcing the path to veer around the openings in the terrace floor.  Vines trail from the surrounding trees, further impeding progress around the pyramid.

title: [[Ziggurat, Middle Level]]
description: A narrow trail has been hacked out of the surrounding jungle, allowing access further around the edifice.  The air is filled with the sounds of avians calling and flitting amongst the trees.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: A lone sapling struggles to rise above the shrubs and vines congesting the platform's surface.  The narrow footpath diverts around the tree, its surface mostly trampled grass.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Shrubs and vines almost completely choke out the narrow game trail.  The calls of birds echo from the lower platforms.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: A gaping hole reveals where a stone block has tumbled to a lower level.  A twisty game path winds among the shrubs, providing a way around the platform.

title: [[Ziggurat, Top Level]]
description: Little marks out the trail but trampled and broken shrubs.  Stone blocks stick up from the undergrowth at irregular intervals.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Dirt and other sludge rises to the surface with each step taken in the waters.  Broken branches and weeds floating along the surface are disturbed by the wake caused by each movement.  A rotted limb sticking out from the hardened dirt of the moat wall provides a somewhat unsteady grip.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Something darts underneath the surface, rubbing against your legs as it swims by.  Water lilies floating on the surface provide a resting spot for a frog that appears to be eyeing a dragonfly for dinner.  Several broken limbs jut out from the hardened dirt banks, though they provide no safe climb back to the grassy clearing.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Dark silt from the floor of the moat rises in swirls, disturbed from the depths by each footstep taken.  Cattails thirty hands high rise above the surface near the banks, blocking the view of the clearing.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Broken tendrils of weeds float on the surface, moving with the ripples that are the result of each step through the murky water.  A tree overhangs the moat, one of its large branches forming a natural arch over the murky waters, lending a touch of mystery as to what lies beyond.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Cattails conceal a broken tree root that leads up towards a small patch of dry land at the edge of the castle.  From this vantage point the wall towers overhead, casting a dark shadow on the water.  Lying at the edge of the dry land are some skeletal remains, a possible casualty of a fall to the ground from the wall.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: The murkiness of the water lends to the deception that the moat is deep, but once within the waters it is no more than waist-high.  The water itself is unnaturally cold.  Bits of algae and other pond plants float to the surface, moving in the ripples.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: The waist-high water ripples as you wade through it.  Something passes underneath its dark murky surface and an occasional splashing sound is heard as one of its inhabitants leaps above the water, and then submerges below the surface once again.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: Tendrils of pondweeds grasp for the surface and reach higher than the actual water levels in the moat.  Cattails grow near the banks, some of them taller than the height of a Gor'Tog.  The water ripples frequently, causing the weeds to sway back and forth in a rhythmic motion.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, In the Moat]]
description: White and yellow water lilies inundate the water, floating atop the surface and concealing the depths below.  Other pond plants and algae survive, despite the unnatural coldness of the water.  A flock of birds sits on the banks, occasionally plunging their beaks into the water attempting to find some fish for their meals.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Edge of the Castle]]
description: This small patch of dry land appears to be the only clear access into the castle.  The wall has several makeshift footholds and handholds leading up to the roof, though most are covered by dried ivy vines that hug the entire length of the outer castle walls.  A broken tree root provides access back to the moat waters below.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Roof]]
description: The stone walls surrounding the perimeter of the castle were designed to prevent any intruders from reaching the roof.  Years of exposure to the elements, as well as neglect, have taken their toll, as the once imposing structure is crumbling in many spots.  A portion of the wall looks as though it has been chipped into, allowing for a somewhat unsteady foothold back down to the ground below.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Roof]]
description: A broken catapult stands in one corner, its mangled pieces a reminder that it once protected the castle from invasion.  The buildings of Riverhaven are barely visible in the distance, as the trees block most of the view.  Cracks in the limestone provide a home for some overgrown weeds.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Roof]]
description: An old catapult stands in one corner, in relatively good condition.  Neatly stacked against the wall are several boulders that were used as ammunition.  Ivy vines creep along the walls and floor, concealing a spiderweb of cracks along the limestone.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Roof]]
description: Crumbled pieces of limestone are scattered along the roof, the remnants of a constant battle the castle has endured over many years of exposure to the elements.  Dried ivy vines practically conceal a very narrow doorway hidden within a tower, revealing a staircase leading down into the interior of the castle.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Upper Landing]]
description: The stairs leading down into the castle are narrow, intentionally designed that way to make it harder for intruders to invade.  Cobwebs dangle from the ceiling and doorway like a veil of dirty silk.  The stairs are severely cracked, causing an unsteady foothold in several places.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Staircase]]
description: The stairway is narrow and dank.  Mold clings to the wall, creating a thin film of slime that looks repulsively slick.  The second floor landing is visible as the stairway winds down toward it.  A small portion of the doorway on the upper landing can be seen from here.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Second Floor Landing]]
description: A window, no larger than the size of a human head, gives a very limited view of the forest surrounding the castle.  A high arch leads into the second floor foyer, allowing a glimpse of the entryway to the bedrooms beyond.  The stairway winds down towards the first floor, a small portion of the landing visible below.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Staircase]]
description: Huge chunks are missing from some of the stairs, making it a dangerous climb.  Mold clings in several spots, adding to the danger by making the already slick stone even more slippery.  The climb down leads to the first floor landing, visible as the stairs wind down towards it.  A portion of the second floor landing can be seen above.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, First Floor Landing]]
description: The stairway is extremely narrow and cramped.  The air is filled with a dank mildewy smell mingled with another odor that is not quite identifiable.  The grand foyer is visible through the high arch that serves as the entryway from the landing.  Above the arch, a pair of cross-hilted swords is mounted, the once highly polished steel now rusted.  Spider webs hang in large clumped strands down from the blades, a sign that the castle has been abandoned for quite some time.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, On the Staircase]]
description: The narrow passageway is filled with an extremely acrid odor that is both unidentifiable and unpleasant to the nose.  The stairway leads down into the dungeons, the apparent source of the odors that are drifting upwards through these cramped quarters.  Roaches crawl in and out of cracks in the walls, appearing as if they are headed down toward nests in the darkness below.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Dungeon Entrance]]
description: Cockroaches crawl in the damp, decaying straw piled in a heap in the corner, scurrying quickly into the shadows and out of sight.  A massive oak door guards the entrance to the dungeon, and a stairway leads up to the first floor of the castle.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Dungeon]]
description: Water drips implacably from the ceiling of a twisting maze of tunnels running beneath the stout-walled fortress.  Footsteps echo along the passage as unseen guards make their rounds, adding to the disorientation felt within the caverns.  A torch flickers from a rope sconce on the wall, creating a dim sphere of illumination that only serves to emphasize the darkness of the surrounding area.

title: [[Shard, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Jungle Outpost, Encampment]]
description: Efforts have been taken to provide comforts for those who maintain a protective watch over the area's water source and nearby shrine amid the small encampment.  Towering durian trees overrun with clinging strangler figs form the soaring emergent layer of the tropical area, while lianas vines drape the many palms that afford a pleasant covering over crudely carved benches.  Bamboo, ferns and a vast array of herbs mingle with the many indigenous plants that crowd the narrow footpath that heads further east.

title: [[Jungle Outpost, Encampment]]
description: Scents of wild orchids waft through the area from the many vibrant blooms that vine through the underbrush and along the trunks of the surrounding trees.  Colorful birds flit overhead in the upper jungle canopy, their melodious song filling the air.  Making its home on a nearby branch, a brilliant scarlet macaw observes the area with curiosity, often appearing to heckle those that pass amid the many homes.

title: [[Jungle Outpost, Encampment]]
description: Subtle breezes dance amid the gently swaying palms that overhang the many homes, where children giggle and dart about, engaged in a game of tag.  A group of weathered chairs is gathered among the trunks of several surrounding fruit trees, while crude, bamboo wind chimes clatter softly from their branches, a modest deterrent to the local wildlife.

title: [[Jungle Outpost, Encampment]]
description: A multitude of creatures travel the vast network of lianas vines and climbing purple passion flowers that drape through the area, one particular vine hangs loosely against a wide tree that towers amid the homes.  Several of the surrounding trees hold a variety of ripened fruit, when in season, making them a familiar visit for many.  Some ship's netting is strung between two of the larger trunks, making for a comfortable hammock in the overlying shade.

title: [[Jungle Outpost, Encampment]]
description: Make-shift benches surround a large bamboo table, where several residents occasionally gather to share a meal roasted over the stone firepit and tell tales of their day's adventure.  Amid the many palms and durians that shade the area, a nearby banyan tree is strung with heavy braided vines that hold a driftwood swing.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Back Chamber]]
description: Time and the collapse of the main building have obscured the purpose of this area.  Now it is filled with a jumble of stones and debris, which fills the corners and divides the area into smaller open spaces.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Back Chamber]]
description: Little remains but a pile of rotting shelves to indicate the original function of the room.  A few slabs from the ceiling have fallen onto the floor, their cracked and broken surfaces mute testimony to the forces that destoyed this building.

title: [[Arthelun Ruins, Back Chamber]]
description: A damp, musty smell wafts through the area, combining with the everpresent dust to create a haze in the air.  Mold has crept up the walls from a tiny trickle of water that flows along the junction between the floor and the walls.  The water disappears into a tiny crevice with a musical gurgle.

title: [[Tavayon, Lake Bed]]
description: Hardened by hundreds of years under the intense heat of the sun, the vast expanse of silt is marred by an endless network of salt-encrusted cracks that form a kaleidoscope of geometric shapes.  Jagged cliffs ring the dry lake bed, broken only by a faint trail leading northward and a towering plateau looming to the south.

title: [[Tavayon, Lake Bed]]
description: Hardened by hundreds of years under the intense heat of the sun, the vast expanse of silt is marred by an endless network of salt-encrusted cracks that form a kaleidoscope of geometric shapes.  Jagged cliffs ring the dry lake bed and a deep crater lies to the south, which is surrounded by numerous spires of obsidian that jut high into the air.

paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Tavayon, Plateau]]
description: Towering over the lake bed below, the ground here is mostly free of salt and speckled with sagebrush.  The edge of the rock cuts in here somewhat, offering a possible descent down the face of the plateau.

title: [[Tavayon, Plateau]]
description: Towering over the lake bed below, the ground here is mostly free of salt and speckled with sagebrush.  Visible to the east is a deep crater in the lake bed ringed by obsidian spires.

title: [[Tavayon, Plateau]]
description: Towering over the lake bed below, the ground here is mostly free of salt and speckled with sagebrush.  The edge of the rock cuts in here somewhat, offering a possible descent down the face of the plateau.

title: [[Tavayon, Plateau]]
description: Towering over the lake bed below, the ground here is mostly free of salt and speckled with sagebrush.  A lone tree leans over the edge of the plateau, its withered roots exposed through crumbling dirt.

title: [[Tavayon, Water's Edge]]
description: Numerous spires of obsidian jut around the rim of the crater and smaller fragments speckle the terrain, ranging from mere pebbles to colossal boulders taller than a Gor'Tog.  Meager plant life struggles to eke out an existence in this bleak landscape, growing marginally more abundant as it approaches a brackish oasis to the south.
