title: [[Tavayon, Oasis]]
description: Shallow, brackish water offers life to the wretched plants that sprout around the shore.  Several salt-encrusted chunks of obsidian spike up through the surface of the water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Crossing Outfitting Society, Workroom]]
description: Hooks and shelves line the deep red walls, holding various tools and spools of thread that are currently not in use.  Next to the carved cedar door is a simple table and chair, a place to take a load off and enjoy a cool drink.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Mountain Pass]]
description: The trail becomes indistinct as the vegetation that forms its borders thins.  Exposed to the merciless elements, scant foliage grows at this altitude.  Patches of colorful lichen adhere to unstable rocks and fallen trees, surrounded by knobby bushes strewn about the barren landscape.  Hanging from a skeletal hemlock tree like a grotesque party favor, a silken pupa writhes whenever the biting wind catches it.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Mountain Pass]]
description: Clumps of brush grass do little to hinder the fierce wind.  Clinging to a small rock cluster is a gnarled formation of twisted branches stripped of foliage.  Interspersed with the vegetation, resinous husks lie cracked and ruptured from emerging imago moths.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Overlook]]
description: Near the ridgeline, the trees have been utterly vanquished, though dwarf shrubs and tufts of grass cling defiantly to life.  Hardy mosses, liverworts, and lichens grow on the lee sides of rocky outcroppings, lending a bit of color to the rugged granite.

Near the ridgeline, the lack of trees offers an unobstructed view of the auroras that arc across the night sky.  Below, dwarf shrubs and tufts of grass cling defiantly to life.  Hardy mosses, liverworts, and lichens grow on the lee sides of rocky outcroppings, softening the rugged granite.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Mire]]
description: Carved out by retreating glaciers, rainwater collects in this hollow, forming a bog dotted with a few shallow pools.  Evergreen trees mark the edges of the mire, growing taller and fuller than their counterparts in more exposed locations.  Many large cocoons burden the undersides of the branches.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Mountain Pass]]
description: A gnarled juniper tree bows before the biting wind.  Nearby, a denuded alpine larch lays atop the frozen soil, roots exposed.  Intertwined in the tangle, a translucent chrysalis husks flap erratically in the strong wind, diffracting the sunlight into prismatic colors.

A gnarled juniper tree bows beneath the night sky.  Nearby, a denuded alpine larch lays atop frozen soil, roots exposed.  Intertwined in the tangle, a cluster of ghostly chrysalis husks flap erratically in the strong wind, contributing a low hiss to the wind when they touch.

title: [[Hraagkaal, Mountain Pass]]
description: Prostrate junipers huddle against the craggy terrain as if seeking protection from the icy winds that whistle down from the mountains and chill the ground underfoot.  A defiant spruce has been sculpted into a banner tree, its windward branches killed by the relentless assault of the wind.

title: [[Kharlan's Tanning Supplies, Salesroom]]
description: Displayed in the front window, mannequins dressed in finished pieces of armor advertise what can be made from the products sold here to potential shoppers strolling by the store during the evening.  A variety of animal hides, in various stages of the tanning process, cover the walls, their scent intermingling with the distinct aroma of leather that permeates the room.  Behind a rough-hewn, log counter hangs a large sign listing the items currently available to order.

title: [[Kharlan's Tanning Supplies, Salesroom]]
description: Plain, wood paneled walls and ceiling look as if no other effort was made to make the space more appealing to customers.  Shipping containers, filled with an assortment of leather armor patterns, are stacked haphazardly around the room barely leaving enough room for shoppers to maneuver in.

title: [[Kharlan's Tanning Supplies, Salesroom]]
description: Plain, wood paneled walls and ceiling look as if no other effort was made to make the space more appealing to customers.  Shipping containers, filled with an assortment of miscellaneous leather patterns, are stacked haphazardly around the room barely leaving enough room for shoppers to maneuver in.

title: [[Mer'Kresh, Item Registration Office]]
description: The walls are covered by shelves which are filled with carved toy ships of varying size and type.  A large, expertly designed ship with four masts is positioned for viewing from every angle atop a low table.  A non-descript counter cluttered with paperwork is pushed up against the back wall.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Common Room]]
description: Saja's Common Room is near-continual chaos.  A harried clerk at the back checks travelers in and out while throwing drinks across the counter that serves as both bar and desk.  A harried waitress rushes in and out of the kitchen, delivering food to patrons at trestle tables in the main room.  A second waitress delivers food through an arch, then delivers drinks to a battered oak booth.  Steep twisting stairs at the back lead to the balcony above.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Dining Room]]
description: The stone wall separating this room from the common room keeps the noise down to a dull roar, making it a preferred location for intimate or discrete conversation over dinner.  The oak benches here are smoother than their counterparts in the common room, and the trestle table has a tablecloth.  Even so, the real attraction is being at Saja's but out of the common room.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Battered Booth]]
description: This battered oak booth is a favorite haunt of bards and students and home to near continuous discussion.  The topics tend toward wine, women and song, but even when they're intellectual, they're never less than heated.  Be it coffee by day or ale by night, the semi-permanent residents of this booth drink too much.  The trestle tables and oaken benches are battered beyond belief, but the history is such Saja would never dare replace them.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Common Room Balcony]]
description: Steep, narrow stairs connect the common room to this open landing.  Doors to the various rooms in the inn open off the balcony while a sturdy railing prevents inebriated patrons from falling to the common room below.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Pine Room]]
description: A heavy oak-framed bed takes up most of this tiny room.  A nightstand is the remaining decor of significance.  The door latches, though, and the room is dry. The walls are solid and the sheets are clean.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Oak Room]]
description: A large feather bed in a battered oak frame dominates a room so small one must almost sit on the bed to close the door.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, Deobar Room]]
description: Two bunk beds are squeezed into this tiny room, creating space for four students to sleep.  A rough chest provides the only storage for clothing.  The lack of space compels the residents to spend most of their waking hours in the booth downstairs and only use this room for sleeping.

title: [[Saja's Boarding House, East Hall]]
description: The one relatively quiet place in Saja's, this hallway provides access to the private rooms of Saja's long-term tenants and some of the better funded students.  Stout stone walls and smooth oaken floorboards along this hall exhibit little of the spontaneous carving so typical of the more public areas of the inn.

title: [[The Sweet Life Candy Shoppe, Salesroom]]
description: White paint covers the room from floor to ceiling, providing a blank canvas for the decorative exhibits of candy placed throughout the shop.  Strategically placed near the front window, a glass case filled with colorful, novelty candies attempts to lure in customers as they pass by on their evening stroll.  A long counter displaying an abundance of gourmet chocolates fills the space along one brightly-lit wall and across from it a spotlight shines above a table holding containers for sale so shoppers can make their own gifts for friends.

title: [[The Sweet Life Candy Shoppe, Salesroom]]
description: Recessed into the ceiling, a collection of gaethzen orbs bounce light off the whitewashed walls to help keep this interior space bright during business hours.  Placed against one wall, a long counter displays an array of colorful confections created with the shop's adult clientele in mind.  Across the room, a strong scent of liquor wafts into the air from the neatly stacked chocolates waiting to be purchased on the glass case.  Tucked into the corner is a table filled with containers shoppers can buy so they can pack up their sweets to take home for family and friends.

title: [[Perpetual Blossoms of Mer'Kresh, Salesroom]]
description: Perpetual Blossoms is endless spring in Mer'Kresh.  Bright gaethzen orbs in the ceiling make it perpetual day as well.  Flowers bloom all about the room, and gablefruit vine climbs across the walls, flourishing in the continuous illumination.  Large displays, including those in the front window, hold freshly cut blossoms and bouquets that fill the air with intoxicating scents.  Floral clerks discretely watch over the domain, gently tending flowers and customers alike with gracious smiles.

title: [[Mer'Kresh City Hall, Office of Citizens]]
description: Several candles cast a warm glow on the polished rosewood counter spanning the back third of the room.  An elderly clerk stands behind the counter, ready to serve people seeking citizenship.  Plainly framed documents interspersed with banners and flags hang from the walls, and historical mementos are housed in a case near the entrance.  A large bronze plaque is affixed to the wall near the case.  Amid the mishmash of artifacts, and perhaps an artifact himself, sits an old man whittling.

title: [[Harti Clemois Bank, Conference Room 'A']]
description: Neatly swept floors gleam under a long table carefully aligned along the length of one wall.  A focal point of tidiness in the room, the table is surrounded by meticulously arranged oaken chairs.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Front Desk]]
description: A long desk enhanced with pieces of shell and driftwood rests in front of a series of shelves lined along the back wall.  Timidly, envelopes and scrolls poke out from their current homes upon the shelves, awaiting delivery to some employee or resting traveler.  A small bell dangles above the desk, patient for a tap from the next person to check into the inn, while a hutch fastened with a bronze padlock waits calmly to dole out room keys.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Lobby]]
description: Two twin windows, shuttered on the outside, stare inwards towards a brightly upholstered couch and a small wooden end-table.  Across from the end-table, the wall is set with a brass sign made in the shape of a dancing herb leaf.  The mutterings of conversation and clinking of dinnerware spill out from the sign's neighbor, an artistically carved arch.

title: [[The Herb Play Restaurant, Host's Station]]
description: A brilliantly colored wooden partition angles from the host's stand towards the opposite wall, blocking the majority of the restaurant beyond from view, and the host's station from the view of seated patrons.  Likewise, any diners glancing towards the exit are spared the sight of the host turning away unsavory types, and are only met by the gazes of the myriad of colored masks affixed to the decorative screen.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Hallway]]
description: The smooth painted walls leading to the lobby stop at the chair rail, giving way to a textured surface of plaster.  Small bits of shell and coral stuck in the plaster turn the upper walls into a mosaic of pink and beige spirals ascending a set of carpeted stairs.  Other than a couple of brass candelabras to light the hall, there are no adornments to distract any of the inn's tired customers from a direct course upwards and to a comfortable bedroom.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Upper Floor]]
description: An out-of-place tapestry barely covers several gaps where time and vandalistic wayfarers have removed bits of attractive coral from their resting places set in the walls.  A richly colored carpet runs through the hallway and down the stairs to the lobby below.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Canal Room]]
description: Curtains, the color of a blue and green streaked river, almost hide a picture window with a view of the outdoor dining area of the Herb Play.  A driftwood bedstand sits quietly by the bed, pushed snugly against the chair rail that splits the walls.  The lower half of the walls are painted in pastel shades of green, while the upper is a soft creme not unlike the color of a frothy stream churning up sand.  Only a small rug covers any of the hardwood floor, nestled at the foot of the bed.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Upper Floor]]
description: Small bits of coral and seashell peek out from the plaster of the walls, mixed in during the construction of the inn.  Lightweight tapestries have been arranged intermittently down the hall, showing various scenes of a musical performance.  A narrow vase rests in its own bed, a small linen-covered table pushed tightly against the wall and out of the way of yawning wanderers stumbling towards their rooms.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Volcano Room]]
description: A plush red carpet covers the entire floor, thick and wooly but for one triangular shaped spot near the red-painted door worn thin from the door's use.  A matching set of fiery curtains hangs about the window, brushing just against the obsidian-topped bedstand.  A bright orange bedspread lays on the bed, continuing the theme of fiery color.  Even the tropical plant in the corner shares the theme, if in design rather than color, as it rests in a stone pot filled with ashy dirt.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Upper Floor]]
description: A portrait framed in dark wood and lit by a small piece of gaethzen hangs on the rough plaster wall.  The shells and coral that poke from the plaster along the other sections of the inn are not absent here, and form intricate spiral patterns around the edges of the portrait.  A small brass plaque is embedded below.

title: [[Lanternside Inn, Island Room]]
description: A large bed carved realistically in the shape of a giant seashell dominates the center of the room.  Its wood has been painted in shades of pearlescent pink and white, and a pale blue bedspread drapes over the edge of the bed.  A deep blue curtain hangs around the window, and a nightstand decorated with bits of coral squeezes itself between it and the bed.

title: [[The Herb Play Restaurant, Dining Room]]
description: Gaethzen spheres hang behind green shades, lending a soft glow that still reflects in the highly buffed and polished hardwood floors.  The only tables are those small enough to be carried by waiters, and remain in place only long enough for food to be transferred to an awaiting booth.  Screens of wood and paper create private dining areas for those artists too smug to allow others a watchful eye of their affairs.

title: [[The Singer's Booth, Herb Play Restaurant]]
description: A horseshoe shaped seat curves around the dining table, obviously packed full of fluffy down given the odd feather that pokes out.  Along the sides of the seat, musical instruments of all types have been carved into the wood and rubbed with oil to a high sheen.  Someone has painted a cryptic signature with gold-colored paint on a small black shield etched with concentric circles that hangs overlooking the tabletop.

title: [[The Actor's Booth, Herb Play Restaurant]]
description: Several miniature portraits line the walls and screens around the booth.  Representing theater performers of some by-gone era, it's likely that most of the faces portrayed have found a stage on the Starry Path by now.  In contrast to the faded color of the portraits, bright purples and yellows streak the walls, and even the seat of the booth itself has been dyed in vivid shades.

title: [[The Herb Play Restaurant, Dining Room]]
description: A set of etched-glass doors allows outside light to flow gently over the booths and diners.  During the day, the gaethzen orbs swaying from the ceiling remain dark, their presence unneeded yet still decorative.  Pale smoke drifts lazily from the kitchen, floating between the timber rafters and wafting against the ceiling planks.

title: [[The Dreamer's Booth, Herb Play Restaurant]]
description: A bold deobar carving of Hodierna perches over the booth, arms outstretched and a sly smile spread across her face.  White alfar statuettes descend from her embrace, pierced by metal rods that hold them in place in the vignette.  To enhance the drama, the depiction of a clear night sky slowly dissolving into a sunrise has been painted in grand colors.  A few wavy letters mark the signature of the artist right near the side of the table.

title: [[The Herb Play Restaurant, Outdoor Dining]]
description: A giant blue and red mask of a half-smiling, half-frowning face leers down on diners, with the words "Eat and Drink, Dance and Sing" painted in glaring colors along its surface.  Only slightly less decorative than the tables seen through the etched-glass doors leading within the restaurant, the ones under the mask have been worn by the elements over time.  The deck itself juts out over the canal from the backside of the Lanternside Inn, supported on huge timbers driven deep into the waters.

title: [[The Herb Play Restaurant, Canal Overlook]]
description: Below the wooden planks weathered grey from time, the sloshing of canal water flows past, adding a constant background song of liquid noises to the clacking and clinking of silverware on plates.  Unlit braziers and torches line the solid railing that borders the deck, stout guardians now sleeping during the day.  Alternating between the unused light sources, dull carvings of dancers and performers lean casually against the rail.

title: [[Oceanhome Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: Holes pockmark the walls, some the size of a fist, while others are no larger than a finger.  Bits of plaster and wood lie on the floor, roughly corresponding to the locations of the gaps.  On the ceiling, brown-edged water stains mock celestial bodies, their origins not nearly as mysterious or impressive.

title: [[Oceanhome Apartments, Second Floor]]
description: A lonely red door sits at the end of the hall, the floorboards just before it swept clean by some industrious soul.  Nearby, an open window reveals a sight of Gull Circle, though not by design -- the window is missing several of its glass panes.

title: [[Globe Arena, Roaring Room]]
description: Deep swaths of quilted white fabric covering the ceiling and walls give the impression of huge pillows stuck to the interior surfaces.  Underfoot, a thick brown carpet muffles the sound of movement.  Even the window is made of several layers of glass set into the frame.  Amidst this stark decor, a lone table huddles near the door.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Dormitory]]
description: The uppermost stair on a short flight of stone steps has been worn down so far over the years that it forms a semi-circular well reaching halfway across the corridor.  Along one wall, mismatched doors lead into the private rooms of the Guild's local members, each small cell no larger than a walk-in closet.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Dormitory]]
description: The ceiling sags precariously overhead, bulging downward as if bowed by a great weight of water, although the air is dry and dusty.  A warm draft swells inexplicably from beneath the splintered floorboards, which creak and groan in protest at the lack of care shown them by generations of inattentive residents.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Dormitory]]
description: The corridor ends abruptly beneath a grimy skylight, which contributes little either to the illumination or the view in this stuffy attic.  A breath of hot, dry air buoys particles of choking dust around the dead end, as the strident grind of industry clanks from somewhere below.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Dormitory]]
description: A few torches strung unevenly along one wall of the narrow corridor cast little more than a glum flicker of light across the patchy plasterwork and loose floorboards.  Muffled scratches and squeaks issue forth from a deep cavity beneath the greyed oak planks.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Pit Gallery]]
description: Descending some fifteen feet into semi-darkness, a circular pit rimmed by low iron railings commands much of the room's floorspace  --  little more than a narrow ledge of standing room remains around the edge of the sunken arena.  Scrawled in faded chalk across the chipped plaster on the far wall, a crude sign declares the Pit Rules.

title: [[Barbarian Guild, Death Slab]]
description: A single slab of chiseled black granite forms a low dais spanning the breadth of this forlorn anteroom.  Glistening treacherously underfoot, the blood of the vanquished coagulates in blackish pools across the stone's cragged expanse, while the rhythmic drip of chilly water echoes forlornly in the gloom.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Stream]]
description: Churning waters rages past, sending a foamy spray into the air!  Darkness hides the low cavern ceiling that enhances the water's deep rumbling.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Stream]]
description: Racing jets of water crash down upon this rock-strewn stream bed.  Deeper into the mine the rumbling sounds even louder.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Waterfall]]
description: The low cavern ceiling opens up into an inky blackness from which a towering wall of water crashes down.  The frothy mix of water and rubble quickly flow down along a path carved into the rock.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths]]
description: A cacophonous rumbling echos all around from the rapid movement of water somewhere above.  The tunnel narrows deeper into the mine.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths]]
description: Cracking tendrils perforate the ceiling's smooth surface.  The ground is littered with fractured rock slabs covered in a fine coat of dust.  Several smaller passageways branch off this area, the fragile entrances holding the promises of riches below.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: A gigantic slab of rock hangs precariously perched on two pumice pedestals worn smooth by the constant drip of water.  A faint rushing noise echoes down the walls from rushing water in the distance.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Stalagmites bubble up from the smooth ground and form marvelous designs in these cold depths.  The drip-drop of water and occasional chitter of an insect carries across the rocky depths.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Treacherous clusters of speleothems zig and zag deeper into the mine until the passage becomes too narrow for further travel.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Trickling down the rocky cavern walls, small streams of water flow through deep crevices set into the rough stone.  Chunks of rock that have fallen from the ceiling scatter across the floor making passage through a bit treacherous but still manageable.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Nearly caved in, passage through this wing of the cavern is tight but possible.  Echoes of voices are muffled by the sounds of hammers pounding against stone.  A single lit torch fastened to the wall provides barely enough light to see one's way through the halls.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Piles of rock upon the ground line the chipped stone walls.  Discarded tools and burnt out lanterns scatter the ground in disarray.  Small slivers of light from nearby create shadows through the cavern hall, though nothing visible to the eye seems to match the figures they shape.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Hole]]
description: An expansive cavern opens above and a pinprick of light shines through a hole in the distance.  Cables and ropes hang down and allow attendants to hoist materials out of this section of the mine for easy transport.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Pass]]
description: Cracked boulders cast long shadows over the narrow path that carefully picks its way through the rocky outcrops and mossy slopes of the rolling hillside.  Loose scree covers the ground, marking the trail's track and lending a subtle treachery to it at the same time.

Cracked boulders cast ugly, malformed shadows over the narrow path that carefully picks its way through the rocky outcrops and mossy slopes of the rolling hillside.  The trail is all but lost in the night, the glint of minerals in the scree that is scattered over the overgrown track the only indicator that you are not lost in a world of darkness.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Pass]]
description: The shoulders of the hillside shove up close to each other, the steep slopes lending no purchase and instilling a sense of claustrophobia.  Tender shoots of grass poke up between the cracks in the fractured stones that are crammed into the looming hills, their greyed and weathered surface resembling the rotting teeth of a grinning giant.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Pass]]
description: Densely packed scrub and the rise of a few hardy and wind-twisted trees skirt the narrow pass.  The shadow of the jealous hillside swallows all that lies in its grip, leaving little purchase for sunlight.  Scattered bird calls echo between the tiny valleys created by the insurmountable slopes, belying the emptiness that fills in the gaps the pass has created.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Pass]]
description: The hillside fans outward to the west and narrows into a cramped pass to the east.  The gentle slope of a valley sweeps up to meet the pass, the green grass short and spikey and surprisingly lush.

title: [[Aldauth's Lair, Cavern of Glass]]
description: Shadows flicker on every wall possibly coming from the torches reflecting off of the black crystal walls.  Tunnels branch off in many directions and show no signs of ending.  An unfamiliar sound, possibly hissing, is enough to make hair stand on end.

title: [[Church, Entrance]]
description: Brilliant shafts of light lance down from gaps in the ancient ceiling, motes of dust perpetually highlighted as they drift.  Thick wooden beams criss-cross overhead, echoing with the sound of nesting birds cooing or flapping their wings.  The acoustics of the church rebound strangely, an eerie, albeit non-threatening, delayed echo.  To the north, the rows of curved pews encircle a stone dais bearing a strange and complex statue.

title: [[Church, Apse]]
description: Ringed by curved pews, the dais stands in the center of the church.  The massive steeple of spiraled wood extends far above, and rotting ropes hang from the rafters.  Dust coats the statue and everything around it, though none of its intrigue or majesty appear diminished for being in a state of neglect.  Whispers echo around the pews, and the area is blanketed in a palpable sense of scrutiny.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Church, Path of Balance]]
description: Broad stone pews curve around the dais to the south, carved with simple icons and symbols -- trees, birds, hearths, anvils, open books, rainbows, crescent moons and broken swords all flow in a seemingly random hodgepodge.  Offering baskets are scattered around the area, filled with cured fish and hard, dry bread.  The dusty scent of ground stone wafts gently along the cool air, while an altar dominates the church's northern wall.

title: [[Church, Terminal of Balance]]
description: The path ends here with a large stone altar, the complex relief worn down by the weight of time.  A few stacks of cut stone blocks are piled against the far wall and are covered in a layer of dust.  A gentle whisper faintly echoes around the area.

title: [[Church, Path of Light]]
description: Richly carved and polished wooden pews curve around the dais to the east, covered in thick but fading cushions with elegantly embroidered scenes of the divine.  The north and south walls are almost entirely composed of brilliantly illuminated stained glass windows which bathe the area in a mosaic of colors -- blood-reds, emerald greens, and midnight purples.  Slowly shifting under the day's moving sun, the riot of light is both inviting and disorienting.

title: [[Church, Terminal of Light]]
description: The branch ends here, the curved wall bare save empty sconces and broken tiles.  Winding ivy has worked its way through cracks in the floor and wall and blanketed the stone, creating an alcove of green within the sheltered space.  A small stone firepit bears a thick layer of caked ash, and the faint smell of burnt wood permeates the area.  A comforting whisper echoes warmly around the area.

title: [[Church, Path of Darkness]]
description: Solid steel pews curve around the dais to the west, covered in flaking rust, brutally angled and unwelcoming.  The rough stone walls absorb the light, and a dripping can be heard echoing in the distance.  Occasional dark streaks are smeared across the ground staining the floor, the area filled with the scent of copper and burnt meat.  To the east there is nothing but dark gloom.

title: [[Church, Terminal of Darkness]]
description: The branch ends here with a massive steel slab made of harsh angles and framed by four sharp hooks.  What light trickles in from the west feels muted, absorbed by the rough stone walls and almost repulsed by the slab.  An angry whispering faintly echoes harshly around the area.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Streambed]]
description: A sudden break in the thick pine forest provides a breathtaking view from the bottom of the valley.  Sharp crags on either side of the valley are lined with steppe scrub -- wildflower and hardy grass thinning as the elevation and incline rises.  Fed from snowmelt in the distance, a clear stream winds down, burbling around smooth stones.  A path leads further up the valley.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Streambed]]
description: Curving around a gentle bend, the water cuts an arc along the bank, depositing sand and dried chaparral from upstream.  A length of fallen tree, stripped of branches, emerges from the sand, inviting the weary traveler to sit and reflect.  To the north, a small clearing looks somehow out of place, the foliage orderly and the rocks lining the riverbank forming a clear dividing line between the steppe and the waters.  The clearing slightly flickers, as though you blinked a moment.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Small Clearing]]
description: While no sign of civilization is evident, the natural setting is strangely ordered. The clearing stretches outward in an oddly flat and lush, almost landscaped field, the stream demarking the eastern border and an almost exact line separating uneven and rough terrain to the south. Pristine wildflowers grow here, explosions of color gently waving in the persistent breeze, cutting the cool air with a subtle sweetness. The stream flows smoothly, so utterly without turbulence it appears motionless.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Small Clearing]]
description: The beginnings of a gravel path start here and dissipate into a few scattered pebbles to the north after a few feet, the clearing surrendering to the steppe and broken, uneven ground and scattered scrub.  The scent of sage and lavender wafts from the southwest, a vague shimmer in the direction of the cairn.  To the east, the brook widens to a nearly circular pool, deep and smooth, lined with broad flat, bench-like boulders.  Large red and yellow carp patrol the pool, and a single gap in the embankment allows drainage downstream.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Small Clearing]]
description: Neatly ordered, a series of tilled rectangular plots expose rich loamy soil cut from the green brush and wildflowers.  A few old posts stand in the corners of some of the plots, and discarded fence boards lay scattered, splintering against time and the elements.  Though the plots fill the area with a richly aromatic scent of damp earth, no weed or vine grows within their borders.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Small Clearing]]
description: Wound in ivy and moss, a short, wide cairn marks the corner of the clearing, the grass hugging the lower stones.  The scent of sage and lavender wafts around you, and thirteen spent candles are placed randomly around the surface of the rockpile, melted wax hardened between the cracks of the stone, burnt wicks cold and black.  A pall of disquiet grips the area, and despite the breeze, everything is strangely silent.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Strange Clearing]]
description: Almost buried completely in ivy and moss, a short, wide cairn marks the corner of the clearing, the grass providing wide berth around the lower stones.  Smoke wafts from within the cairn, carrying the scent of sage and lavender, and thirteen unflickering lit candles, placed randomly around the surface of the rockpile, remain unconsumed as they burn.  Gentle whispers can be heard along the winds, though you cannot identify their source.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Strange Clearing]]
description: Seated on a broad foundation of rough, flat, stone, a thick timbered, modest farmhouse with wide windows sits at the end of a short gravel path, while the scent of sage and lavender comes from the southwest, a vague shimmer in the direction of the cairn.  A stone chimney rises from the western wall, thin plumes of smoke gently wafting in the breeze.  Drying herbs hang under the covered porch, and near the door, a waterskin hangs from a nail next to a simple bench.  The scent of fresh baked bread fills the air, and to the east, the brook widens to a circular pool, deep and smooth, lined with broad bench-like boulders, softly steaming with the heat of underground hotsprings.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Strange Clearing]]
description: While no sign of civilization is evident, the natural setting is extremely ordered.  The clearing stretches outward in an oddly flat and lush, perfectly square, landscaped field.  The stream demarks the eastern border, and an almost exact line separates uneven and rough terrain to the south.  Pristine wildflowers grow here, explosions of color gently waving in the persistent breeze, cutting the cool air with a subtle sweetness.  The stream flows smoothly, periodically stopping entirely as droplets briefly hang a few feet above the surface before gently raining back down like a brief spring shower.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Strange Clearing]]
description: Neatly ordered, a series of tilled rectangular plots expose rich loamy soil arranged into perfect rows bearing lush rosettes sprouting at regularly spaced intervals.  A low wooden fence separates the plots from the wildlands, too low to serve any purpose other than adornment.  A pair of watering cans lean against one of the fenceposts, and the breeze bears the scent of damp soil and root vegetables.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Farmstead]]
description: The tight joinery of the farm's walls has been tastefully covered by hanging tapestries bearing simple geometric patterns and celestial symbols, pressings of leaves and preserved insects, and just a few too many carefully nurtured potted plants.  A wide hearth crackles merrily, warming the space against the chill of the steppe, and gaethzen lamps illuminate the corners and rafters.  Broad open windows provide a full view of the mountains and surroundings, and a few simple rocking chairs face different windows, a brass telescope next to the northern window, and a stack of fresh paper and charcoal sticks resting on a writing desk next to the southern window.  At the center of the room on a thick wooden table rests a basket of thick bread.  Books are scattered throughout the cabin, although there is no bookshelf.

title: [[Sheltered Valley, Farmstead]]
description: The eastern wall of the farm is largely open, affording an expansive view of the steppe and hot springs.  A simple workbench and counter stands next to a modest ice chest and wide basin, sheltered by a wide awning providing shade.  Atop the workbench, bars of soap on wax paper sit next to a basin of clean water and an open box of organized surgical tools.  A weatherproofed cabinet displays alchemical tools gathering dust in the other corner, holding a small collection of clear and brown jars sealed with soft lead.

title: [[Forest of Night, Darkened Bosk]]
description: Off from the main path, the forest darkens substantially as the trees crowd ever closer into a dense grove.  The occasional echo of odd-sounding giggles can be heard from the shadows.

title: [[Forest of Night, Darkened Bosk]]
description: Gloomy and somber, the trees here are strung with small painted flags and lines of prayer beads.  The heavy scent of rich earth and mud impregnates the air, leaving it feeling somehow both stifling and refreshing.

title: [[Forest of Night, Darkened Bosk]]
description: Widening out, the path here is littered with deep furrows and ditches filled with swampy waters.  Bits of cattail shoot up around the particularly deep spots, their long fronds swaying as something disturbs them.

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Sturdy Limb]]
description: The laurel's thick canopy provides a lush home for treehopper toads.  Despite the constant croaking noise coming from all directions, this area seems subdued compared to the ground below.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif
tags: meta:mapname:Zoluren - Grove of the White Laurel

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Thick Branch]]
description: This long branch stretches east, pushing back the brush and trees and demanding its full share of sunlight.  It is fairly low to the ground, making it easy to jump down from here.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Knotted Bough]]
description: Vines filled with tiny flowers drape across the tertiary branches of the knotted bough, forming a cradle of snowy white petals that drape down towards the ground below.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Thin Bough]]
description: This precarious perch offers a good view of the top of the White Laurel and the impressive forest which it inhabits.  To the north is Leth Deriel, and the great Sana'ati reminds one of a great umbrella stretching out over the crowns of the other trees.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Twisted Branch]]
description: Jutting out of the main trunk at a curious angle, this twisted branch seems to right itself as it ascends out of the mesh of other limbs and boughs until it pushes out southwest over thick brush.  Daylight streams down on a small patch of ground, unhindered because of the curious change in direction.  The drop from here would be precarious at best, but with a little work one might still be able to get down by scaling the trunk of the laurel.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif

title: [[In the White Laurel, A Gnarled Limb]]
description: Deep hills and valleys permeate the wood, making it easy to imagine shapes within the textured bark.  A pair of knots in the main trunk looks out at the scenery like unblinking eyes.  The gnarled limb slopes downward to the northwest, making it easy to get down from here.
image: Zoluren, 61c, Grove of the White Laurel.gif

title: [[Reena's Rainbow, Salesroom]]
description: Reena the Dyer dashes around the showroom, as flamboyant as the colors she produces.  Despite appearances, she is a painstaking and methodical perfectionist, since her calling requires her to be part artist, part alchemist.  All her dyes are prepared from the leaves, twigs, roots, berries, and flowers of indigenous plants or from local animal substances.  Swatches of dyed sample cloths are strewn across a faux marble counter next to a menu board listing all available color choices.

title: [[Reena's Rainbow, Dyeing Vats]]
description: Skeins of wool, spools of thread and bolts of fabric rest on wooden decks surrounding bubbling dye vats.  Reena's secret mixtures of natural substances and mordents produce noxious fumes but long-lasting, intense colors.  Apprentice dyers of various races and regions, hoping to learn the trade and start their own shops back home, tend to the actual operations.

title: [[Abandoned Castle, Dungeon Chambers]]
description: A heap of bones lies on the floor, particles of clothing still wrapped around what was once a body.  Another skeleton stretches across the wall, the remains held in standing position by the manacles that tether them.  A steady dripping of water comes from the ceiling, leaving a trail of mildew down the length of the wall.

title: [[Brambles]]
description: Dense brambles press in on all sides, giving this place a claustrophobic feel.  The few narrow gaps in the bushes are barely navigable, and from each branch and twig long, sharp spines threaten scratches and punctures.

title: [[Thrifty Doors]]
description: Large rectangular wooden tables clutter this small room, each one bowed under the weight of a stack of doors.  Unfinished and second-hand doors lean against the walls and lurch in heaps on the floor, and several of the better specimens hang on chains from the rafters.  A grumpy-looking Dwarf leans against a battered oak counter, squinting suspiciously at customers and sucking noisily on a clay pipe which belches thick brown smoke into the air.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Brown Attack Zone South]]
description: Thick, lush grass provides soft footing for the competitors who stomp through here.  An ebony carving of a hedgehog sitting atop a tall pole identifies this portion of the field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

description: Thick, lush grass provides soft footing for the competitors who stomp through here.  An ebony carving of a stag sitting atop a tall pole identifies this portion of the field.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Behind the Goal Line]]
description: A high, dense hedgerow closes off the eastern and southern edges of this area.  The verdant field remains largely pristine in this remote corner; the action rarely comes back here unless a particularly spry togball gets loose and attempts a dash for freedom.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Behind the Goal Line]]
description: A high, dense hedgerow closes off the western and southern edges of this area.  The verdant field remains largely pristine in this remote corner; the action rarely comes back here unless a particularly spry togball gets loose and attempts a dash for freedom.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Behind the Goal]]
description: A high, dense hedgerow closes off the western edge of this area.  To the east are two stout green posts embedded upright in the ground, forming the goal.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Behind the Goal Line]]
description: A high, dense hedgerow closes off the western and northern edges of this area.  The verdant field remains largely pristine in this remote corner; the action rarely comes back here unless a particularly spry togball gets loose and attempts a dash for freedom.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Green Blood Zone]]
description: The grass has been beaten nearly flat here, a testament to the rugged play that typically ensues when the ball is close to the goal.  Two stout green posts are embedded upright in the ground to the west, forming the goal.  A redwood carving of a squirrel sitting atop a tall pole identifies this section of the field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Green Half-Forward Center]]
description: A wide, shallow furrow runs east-west through the otherwise thick grass, where over the years numerous competitors have stormed through, dragging the ball behind them.  A redwood carving of an owl sitting atop a tall poll identifies this section of the field.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Boar Clan Togball Field, Midfield]]
description: Although mostly grown over with the thick local grass, the ruts and depressions still give this spot the appearance of the site of a minor explosion.  Hotly contested face-offs have resulted in innumerable large bodies skidding off in all directions.  A redwood carving of a bear signifies that this is Midfield.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Cha'walkas, Water]]
description: To the east, Tethloren island, barely large enough to contain a white-spired temple, rises from the misty water.  The thick cloud hugs the surface of the salty water, making it difficult to distinguish where mist ends and water begins.

title: [[Cha'walkas, Water]]

paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, northwest.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: Black craggy rock juts upwards, the crevices and hollowed basins filled with glittery black sand.  Urchins and tiny gold and black mottled fish dart amongst the bowls and hollows that hold water, even at the lowest tide.  Waves churn rhythmically, the salty spew of foam clinging to the dark, wet rocks.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, west.
