title: [[Cha'walkas, Water]]
description: To the south, Tethloren island, barely large enough to contain a white-spired temple, rises from the misty water.  The thick cloud hugs the surface of the salty water, making it difficult to distinguish where mist ends and water begins.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: Black craggy rock juts upwards, the crevices and hollowed basins filled with glittery black sand.  A large orange starfish hides in a deep crevice that holds water, even at the lowest tide.  Waves churn rhythmically, the salty spew of foam clinging to the dark, wet rocks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: A large boulder rises to the southeast, breaking the waves that slosh against it.  Bits of smaller cracked and battered rock form the solid surface underfoot, some larger pieces jutting upwards.  The many crevices and hollows hold water, even at the lowest tide.  Waves churn rhythmically over the rocky tidepools, bringing new fish and treasures to populate the sheltered pools.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: A single large boulder a short distance southeast of Tethloren breaks and softens the waves that slosh against it.  Within the sharp surfaces of the basalt that lines the lake floor, salt water fishes and creatures hide in the hollows and crevices of the many tidepools.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: Black craggy rock juts upwards, the crevices and hollowed basins filled with glittery black sand.  Bits of broken shell lie wedged in the cracks and mottled fish dart amongst the bowls and hollows that hold water, even at the lowest tide.  Waves churn rhythmically, the salty spew of foam clinging to the dark, wet rocks.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, southwest.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: Black craggy rock juts upwards to form low barriers to break the waves and hollows to collect pools of water that remain even at low tide.  The clean salty water sparkles against the dark wet basalt flecked with foam.  Rhythmic waves create the whispering shush long associated with Peri'el's song of sleep to still the beast of the World Dragon itself.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Tethloren, Tidepool]]
description: A drop in the level of rock underfoot keeps this section of Tethloren's bordering shore underwater in a deep pool.  The waves swell here in a rocking rising and falling motion and lap gently at the base of Halasa Temple just to the north.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Halasa Temple, West Porch]]
description: The dark basalt that forms the bedrock of Tethloren is leveled, smoothed, and polished to form the floor of the temple.  Without walls, the sacred spot is open to the elements and its high arching ceiling provides little shelter from a howling storm.  Everything here is solid and indestructable, however, and the interlocking obsidian and white quartz stones that form the columns supporting the roof show no sign of mortal construct.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, down.

title: [[Halasa Temple, North Porch]]
description: The floor of the temple's northern wing is inlaid with a magnificent albatross -- shells, pebbles and smooth pieces of glass form the shape, feathers and details of Lemicus in her symbolic form.  As the open sea air gusts through the temple and fingers of mist twine about the columns, one can imagine flying aloft with the great bird among the clouds.

title: [[Halasa Temple, East Porch]]
description: The floor of the eastern porch is inlaid with the image of a huge shark, pearly grey shale forming its body and fins.  Real sharks' teeth, thousands of them, some as large as a Halfling's head, line its open mouth.  The toothy section stretches three paces along the floor, the razor sharp triangles angled upwards to catch at unwary feet.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Inner Chamber]]
description: Torches high overhead light the white quartz columns that spring upwards like trees to the incised arches of the ceiling two stories overhead.  Cut into the perfectly smooth dark floor is a large jagged hole that sloshes with water and spouts a trickling stream of white cloudy mist.  The trails of mist drift upwards and out, circling in slow spirals until they find Cha'walkas, and drift on out over the lake.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Halasa Temple, South Porch]]
description: The black polished floor reflects the image of a large, azurite carving of a dolphin as it emerges upwards from the surface of the stone.  Tendrils and wisps of cloudy mist cling to the columns and swirl through the temple and finally drift southwards out over the waves to blanket the surface of the lake.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Pools]]
description: Beneath the floor of the temple is a dim cavernous area where several pools of sea water dot the darkness among the craggy rocks.  A constant mist fills the air along with a sweet memorable scent unique to this place.

title: [[Halasa Temple, A Shell-lined Pool]]
description: The salty water soothes and calms the spirit as well as the body.  A variety of pale-colored smooth shells decorate the bottom and sides of the pool and reflect the dim light shimmering through the water.

title: [[Halasa Temple, A Pool of Black Water]]
description: The water appears black, as no light penetrates it, nor are the bottom or sides of the pool visible.  The cold briny water sloshes gently among the rocks, the scent invigorating and refreshing.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Misty Pool]]
description: The water is shockingly warm, and a softly-scented cloudy mist rises thickly from the surface.  Gentle eddies swirl through the water to relax and sooth the tired and injured bodies that seek contemplation and quiet.

title: [[Halasa Temple]]
description: This enclosed chamber is a safe harbor, sturdily protected from the wind and weather, unlike the lower levels of the temple.  A small arching window to the south looks out over Cha'walkas, its shape a miniature replica of the pointed arches of the walls and ceiling.  An altar placed in the center of the room is unadorned but for a low dish of incense that burns with a faint pleasant scent.

title: [[Halasa Temple]]
description: A small circular window reveals the view to the west.  The stone walls and floor are covered with tapestries that soften sound, and comfortable cushions for visitors and worshipers to rest upon, or even sleep upon.  Not all pilgrims choose to make the return journey across Cha'walkas the same day.  The cadence of the lake waves splashing on the rocks below is constant and lulling, a backdrop of sound that soothes and reassures.

title: [[Halasa Temple]]
description: This enclosed chamber is a safe harbor, sturdily protected from the wind and weather, unlike the lower levels of the temple.  A small arching window to the north looks out over Cha'walkas, its shape a miniature replica of the pointed arches of the walls and ceiling.  A large silver bowl rests in the center of the room -- otherwise the room is bare.

title: [[Halasa Temple]]
description: This large square chamber contains nothing but four milky-white quartz benches arranged at the cardinal direction points.  A blackened brass lantern hangs from the ceiling high overhead and burns with forty blood-red candles to light the windowless room.

title: [[Halasa Temple]]
description: This very small room with a low slanting roof serves as an antechamber.  Without ornament or color, a single candle casts small shadows against the smooth walls and floor.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Beneath the Spire]]
description: This octagonal room provides a panoramic view of the lake and island from the exact center of Surlaenis.  The floor is a single piece of anloral stone, or at least fitted so seamlessly that its joinings are invisible.  Overhead an octagonal, hollow spire rises many stories above.  A staircase spirals up the interior of the tower, winding to an impossible height.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Spire Interior]]
description: This point is halfway up the tower.  Below, the octagonal floor of the temple shimmers with the bluish light associated with anloral.  The pearls that line the surface of the spire thin, and are embedded like raindrops that sift down from above.  The smooth quartz of the spire's construction is visible, allowing the light to softly penetrate the crystalline structure.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Spire Interior]]
description: A platform suspended below the top of the spire supports a silvered ladder that rises to the very peak above.  Despite the sturdy construction, the wooden slats sway with each step.  The watery sounds of the lake drift upwards and echo gently all around -- the slush of wave against rock is clear and close.

title: [[Halasa Temple, Spire Interior]]
description: The peak of the spire houses a flame that burns with a penetrating light, but is without heat or apparent source.  A basket woven of seaweed holds this heatless fire that radiates as a beacon atop the temple, the light so intense that a direct gaze at it is impossible to maintain.  A silver bell hangs by a silken rope and seems to hum a gentle tone as the light strikes its polished curves.

title: [[Mooring Rock, Tethloren Island in Cha'walkas]]
description: Halasa Temple is a short swim due east from the mooring rock.  Waves splash and curl over the dark rocks, and the spray drenches the area with dampness.  The mist swirls thickest near the temple.

title: [[Traveler's Shrine, Vestibule]]
description: Ranging through all the fiery shades of yellow, orange and red, the natural variance in color of the stone walls resembles dancing flames.  An unusual piping song whispers through the area, occasionally falling quiet at irregular intervals.  The source of the haunting music is a series of hollowed sticks fashioned into flutes and cleverly secured by the arched entry to catch any gusts of air.

title: [[Traveler's Shrine, Refectory]]
description: Sturdy trestle tables and low stone benches offer a place to eat, drink and rest.  Brass lanterns hang from the walls between pine shelves, filling the windowless room with a soft glow and the scent of lamp oil mingled with fresh baked bread and coffee.  Braided rag rugs cover the stone floor between the tables and the kitchen area, where a large iron stove and a battered pine sideboard offer a variety of foods.

title: [[Traveler's Shrine, Dormitory]]
description: Amber-shaded lamps illuminate the area with warm light.  Spartanly furnished, the dormitory is lined with iron cots piled with wool blankets and stone bins to keep clutter to a minimum.  Thick curtains divide the room into smaller areas, to give some modicum of privacy as well as to keep out chilling drafts.

title: [[Traveler's Shrine, Altar Alcove]]
description: Soaring upwards to form a dome overhead, the white walls are decorated predominantly with paint and stone mosaics that will not interfere with the exemplary acoustics of the chapel.  Phoenixes shimmering with traces of copper gilt are depicted emerging from gold-streaked crimson marble flames.  Each bird's attention is focused upon a portrait of a slender Elven woman with red hair.

title: [[Ain Ghazal, Green Glade]]
description: The glow from dozens of fireflies plays off the tall, swaying grass and lights up a dense bed of daisies in the center of the glade.  A faint trail slopes up to the north.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Entry Hall]]
description: Carved inside a huge mica streak with the entrance in a corner, the shrine walls confer the impression of being inside a diamond.  Stone balustrades create a diagonal pathway leading further into the shrine while life-size doves carved from pure white quartz hover over alcoves on either side.  Slight variations in height and color give the blue tile floor a resemblance to waves in an ocean.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Peace Alcove]]
description: A stone bench faces the semi-circular wall of the alcove providing seating for those who would contemplate the bas-relief artwork.  The carved collage depicts moments in Elanthian history that range from a quiet gathering to a signing ceremony between fierce warriors.  Inset into the ocean-blue mosaic floor is a beautiful white dove.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Offering Room]]
description: The roughly chiseled walls and dirt floor contrast sharply with the artistic bent in the other areas of the shrine.  A lone covered table stands in the center of the floor with a paltry selection of offerings for sale.  Some cooing sounds escape from beneath the tablecloth.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Hall of Reflections]]
description: The long, narrow mirrors that line the walls of this area are hung so as to infinitely reproduce each other and the altar.  This design results in constant reflection, which deliberately encourages occupants to look deep within to find reality.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Family Alcove]]
description: Situated within individual niches in the cavern wall are miniature figures of families doing things together.  Tableaus depict families at work, at play, at a wedding, doing daily chores, celebrating a birth and mourning the loss of a loved one.  Stone stools in several heights are arranged before the niches.

title: [[Albreda's Shrine, Healer's Haven]]
description: Blue and green tiles set in an alternating diamond pattern give an expansive feeling to the floor.  Divans sit along the walls beneath frescos of herbs and gardens that soar to the vaulted ceiling where a huge wagon wheel full of lit candles brightens the area.

title: [[Fang Cove, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Fever Point, Pier]]
description: The weathered planks scream beneath any weight applied, imitating the screech of the sea gulls that glide about the pulsing waves.  Even the hungriest of those birds do not venture too far into town, animal senses wary of something unseen.  Indifferent to the cautious sea birds, the ocean spreads out on almost all sides from the tip of this peninsula, stretching to the horizon.

title: [[Wooded Hills, East Slope]]
description: The smooth surface of the slope curves gently in a wave of glass green foliage.  A mist demurely hides the valley floor from prying eyes, offering only teasing glimpses of the tops of jagged marble structures and obelisks that happen to escape its swirling grey clutches.  Overhead, the sky is obscured by the rise of stoney hills as the footrail travels restlessly up and down the hillside.

The smooth surface of the slope curves gently in a wave of smooth, blood dark grass.  Due to a thick mist, the valley floor is inscrutable save for the flash of odd architectural protrusions that claw upwards in a futile attempt to escape the darkness.

title: [[Vale, Journalai Outskirts]]
description: A massive white marble marker lies in two whole pieces, its rune-covered surface rendered illegible from years of work by eolian forces.  Despite the presence of ivy and lichen on the other marble architecture in the area, the marker remains remarkably clear of encroaching foliage.  The hillside that cups the valley flows gently down to the foot of the toppled stone giant, treating it with more deference than the city's conquerers and subsequent plunderers did.

title: [[Wooded Hills, East Slope]]
description: Springy aspens, shimmering maples, and rampant wild rose vines nervously huddle along the sides of the slope, hedging in the vale floor with a barrier that is at times impenetrable and at other times suspiciously thin.  The hoots of gloom-loving owls and the cackle of corbies haunt the treetops, weaving in and out of the all-blanketing mist like lost souls.

title: [[Wooded Hills, Top of Hill]]
description: Trees and other vegetation clear out at the top of the hilltop, creating a bare space whipped by the wind and weather.  Bare rocks fight with lichens and other hardy species to cling to the slope.  The clearing allows a more expansive view across the valley and the further reaches, showing glimpses of abandoned ruins in the distance.

title: [[Wooded Hills, East Slope]]
description: Heavy, black-leafed bushes cluster around the trees that form the overgrown barrier of the Journalai Vale.  The air is bone-numbingly chill here, cutting through the thickest clothing to bite at the very soul.  Down the slope, the lonely and broken remains of the city just barely push up through the mist.

title: [[Vale, Journalai Outskirts]]
description: The vale meets up with the steep curve of the hills that protect it here.  Though the occluding mist limits vision, the faint outlines of dark trees can be detected bordering the top of the hill, creating a tangible boundary between the ruins and the hinterland that surrounds it.  Hazy figures move like ghostly shadows through the wilderness, a hint of something sinister amidst the cemetary-like stillness of the dead city.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, south, northwest, up.

title: [[Vale, Journalai Ruins]]
description: A cracked and perilous-looking pylon marks the gateway into the city, its lintel carved with the defaced visage of an unknown goddess who yet beckons all to pass beneath her with outspread arms.  Moss, ivy, and lichen have crept steadily into the cracks in the gateway, slowly nibbling away at what must have once been a proud testimony to some artisan's genius.  The collapsed rubble that was once the outer curtain of the city's walls yet serves as a barrier.

title: [[Riverbank Trail]]
description: The fading sounds of the city to the north are overpowered by the constant rushing and reverberation of the river below.  The stench of dead fish is intense along the refuse-littered slope.

title: [[Riverbank Trail]]
description: To the west, piles of debris and junk block any possible passage.  The riverbank to the north is too steep to climb, as evidenced by the bits of torn cloth and slide marks that mar the muddy surface.  Below is the Selgotha river, its murky depths slightly calmer in this spot as the westward rushing currents slow to navigate the city-built embankment.

title: [[Segoltha River, North Bank]]
description: Swiftly rushing water cascades over a rocky riverbed, channeling towards treacherous rapids that block further progress downstream.  A small defile in the river bank allows a quick scramble up to safety.

title: [[Segoltha River, North Bank]]
description: Hugging the river bank, the swirling waters surge against the slick banks.  Undercurrents seethe beneath the surface, seeking to drag the unwary down into the river's heart.

title: [[Segoltha River, North Bank]]
description: Surging currents batter against the mud banks, undercutting them and adding their silt to the muddy waters that comprise the Segoltha.  Whirling eddies mark the surface, hiding the treacherous undertow.

timeto.19373: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') > 500 && Script.exists?('bescort') then nil else 20.0 end

title: [[Amusement Pier, Entrance]]
description: Throngs of children mill around, licking lollipops and poking at one another.  Salty air drifts upon the wind, causing bits of old paper to dance around freshly painted garbage bins.  Various buildings and attractions are visible further down the wide wooden and metal pier.

Salty air drifts upon the wind causing bits of old paper to dance around half-full garbage bins, while sweepers go by cleaning up the day's refuse.  Various buildings and attractions are visible in the torchlight further down the wide wooden and metal pier.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: Gentle waves lap against the huge poles that bear the weight of this busy pier.  Sturdy rails are placed along the edges, keeping stray children from tumbling off into the cold waters below.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: The breeze carries with it a tangy citrus scent from a small wooden stand whose base is carved with painted lemons.  A few stools offer seating for those wishing to enjoy the fruity lemonade sold by a Gnome maid who wears a pointed hat dusted with glitter.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: Gentle waves lap against the huge poles that bear the weight of this busy pier.  Sturdy rails are placed along the edges, keeping stray children from tumbling off into the cold waters below.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: A bright red shop roofed with dark brown shingles stands here, with its wide-paned windows painted with apples.  Barrels filled with various kinds of apples stand against the shop, a small Gnome guarding them with a pointy broom.  The scent of fresh apples permeates the air, inviting all to enter and partake.

title: [[Gnoshy and Sons, Orchard's Bounty Ordering Room]]
description: A long wide counter dominates the small, but functional, lobby of Gnoshy's hastily constructed retail outpost.  A small, hand-lettered sign has been tacked to the back wall, next to a more elaborate menu.  Through large chinks and gaps in the wall, smells of cinnamon, honey, and chocolate drift pleasingly.

title: [[Gnoshy and Sons, Orchard's Bounty Store]]
description: Empty bins, buckets, barrels, and crates lie in organized piles in the corners of the room, out of the way of the patrons and the occasional workers, who scurry to and fro amidst the browsing clientele.  Two long, low tables are situated near the back wall of this well-lit room.  A strong, cidery smell tinged with sweet and sugary undertones pervades the air.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: Miniature boats dart between cast-pewter figures of birds in flight that adorn a nearby fountain, cheered on by the calls of children.  The fountain also provides a haven for real birds who splash with gleeful abandon in the water, sending up waves that nearly swamp the tiny vessels.

Miniature boats drift lazily between cast-pewter figures of birds in flight that adorn a nearby fountain.  Late night romance blooms as a young Bard plays softly on a flute, his thoughts his own in the night's dim light.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: Along the edge of the pier, rows of benches are set in a half-circle, all facing a big wooden theater.  Clothed in darkness, the images on its painted doors are barely visible in the flickering torchlight.  Sea birds often land upon the roof, squawking as though performing for a crowd.

Placed along the edge of the pier an area is set up with rows of benches all facing a big wooden theater.  Clothed in darkness it sits, the images on its painted doors barely seen by the flickering torches placed near it.  Sea birds often land upon it, squawking as if performing for a crowd.

title: [[Nightingale's Rest Theater, Seating]]
description: Carved benches are strategically placed to face the theater, each with a perfect view of the entertainers that often perform.  The stage is decorated in bright colors with sconces laid along the base for nighttime viewing.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: A dark establishment stands starkly in contrast with the gaiety surrounding it.  Wind gently swings the sign that names this place, "Zackes."  An arched door stands open with a hint of ale drifting out upon the sea air.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: Big brawny lads and giggling maidens gather round to see who is the strongest in the lands.  A few Halfling children gawk at the huge Gor'Tog that blocks their view of the next contestant.

Torches flicker as big brawny lads and giggling maidens gather round to see who is the strongest in the lands.  A couple of huge Gor'Togs snicker amongst themselves as a Gnome attempts the tower of strength.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Mighty Warriors, Strength Test Game]]
description: Off to one side, a metal pole towers high above the crowds.  A sturdy wooden lever squats on the ground at its base, while a bronze bell tops the tall structure.  A roustabout leans on a heavy sledgehammer, hawking his game to passers-by.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: Crowds gather round to enter a man-made cave that slopes down into the water and off the edge of the pier.  A huge sign above it is decorated with the image of a dragon, a mighty warrior within its claws.  A couple of maidens dressed in gossamer and silk direct people into the cave in a disorderly fashion.

title: [[Zackes' Place, Bar]]
description: Many a seaman calls this rough and tumble place home.  Its tall stools and carved oak bar are perfect for carousing the night away with friends.  On either side of the bar are different areas for letting off steam.

title: [[Zackes' Place, The Pit]]
description: The pit, as it is fondly called by the finest of warriors, is where the bravest grapple amongst taunts and cheers.  Water is often thrown over the encircling benches, clearing off excess mud.  Those daring enough to watch are often pulled in, to the amusement of all concerned.

title: [[Zackes' Place, Baths]]
description: Warmth emanates from steaming hot tubs, giving off scents of musk and pine.  Small candles flicker against the dark wood walls from sconces placed in the corners.  Here is a quiet place that offers relaxation for those weary from the day's journey.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: Gentle waves can be heard lapping against the huge poles that bear the weight of this pier.  Sturdy rails have been placed along the edges, keeping stray children from tumbling off into the cold waters below.

title: [[Prickle Tattoo Shop]]
description: Pale oak walls are covered with various examples of the designs in skin art, ranging from the simple to extreme in detail.  The smell of fresh ink permeates the room, wafting from the shelves that line the far wall.  A couch lies in one corner, covered in dark tapestries with a footstool placed nearby, while some tables are evenly spaced about the shop.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Carousel]]
description: Bright ribbons dance upon the air as the huge carousel goes round and round.  Fun-loving passengers scamper through a black iron gate to reach the various carved animals supported by beribboned poles.  A young Elven lass has a bright smile for all as she stands ready to take their coin in exchange for a ride.

title: [[Prize Stall]]
description: Rough wooden beams hold up this small prize stall.  Painted brown bears dance upon colorful balls along the walls, interspersed with prancing horses.  Each shelf is draped in decorative lace that holds assorted prizes, just out of the reach of small children.  A colorful sign has been nailed upon one wall, giving information about the different prizes.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: "Nifty Gifts!" proclaims the sign that hangs from above a picture of daisies and ribbons.  Brightly painted, this shop is crowded with young and old alike as they chatter about the goodies inside.  The scent of fresh-baked cookies drifts from the half-open door.

title: [[Nifty Gifts, Front Room]]
description: Like many other shops in the province, an array of wares is displayed for shoppers on shelves and racks.  A pot of tea is brewing in the corner, where the owner also keeps a crossbow loaded, prepped and ready for any would-be thieves.  Scents of homemade candy emanate from the beaded curtain that leads into the back room.

title: [[Nifty Gifts, Back Room]]
description: A cloth-covered counter bears today's offerings to soothe a customer's sweet tooth.  Behind the counter a young Halfling works to keep up with the demand for sugar-coated jellies and frosting-covered cookies.  A small sign crookedly hung above the door reads, "Tasty treats by the handful, enjoy!"

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: Gentle waves lap against the pilings that support the weight of this busy pier.  Construction appears to be going on as boards are stacked up and barrels of various tools and nails are piled along the pier's railings.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: Ribbon spirals up poles bearing colorful paper lanterns that line the walkway leading to the doors of a gaily-decorated shop.  A gigantic catapult stands toward the end of the pier, giving patrons cause to look carefully around when exiting the shop to make sure there is no one flying in their direction.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: A simple wooden booth stands here with faded colors reflecting the passage of time.  Laughter dances upon the air drifting from inside the gaming booth that offers a place to enjoy a bit of leisure time.

title: [[Simply Souvenirs, Lobby]]
description: The lobby is wide open and welcoming without any clutter, with carpeted runners leading off to the different parts of the store.  Prisms of all shapes and sizes hang from the ceiling, catching the light filtering in from the hexagonal window, causing tiny rainbows to dance across the walls.

title: [[Simply Souvenirs, Amazing Accessories]]
description: Knick-knacks and trinkets are placed all over the room, giving it a closed-in, cluttered feel.  A wide rack hangs on one wall, elegantly displaying a number of finely crafted fans that are for sale.  Next to the rack stands a tall fanciful tree made from glass, holding various accessories.

title: [[Simply Souvenirs, Random Rarities]]
description: Far from the sounds of the busy pier, this room is cozy and comfortably furnished.  A playfully carved archway, depicting cartwheeling clowns is set in the south wall, with a thick felt curtain covering its contents.  Along the opposite wall stands a line of chairs, mismatched but all focused on the same point, a tall cushioned pedestal in the center of the room.

title: [[Simply Souvenirs, Plush Presents]]
description: A huge comical plush tree stands in the middle of the room, with a big goofy face painted on its front.  Its branches completely cover the ceiling, with long strips of green cloth hanging down like weeping leaves.  A round wooden counter painted to resemble a short stone wall encircles the soft tree.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Wilde Lane]]
description: Wave after gentle wave slowly laps against the pilings that support the weight of the busy pier.  Sturdy railings along the edges keep stray children from tumbling into the cold waters below.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: Piles of hay lie scattered on the ground, providing a soft landing place for those flung from the catapult.  Giggles of children playing hide and seek mingle with the cheers of catapult spectators as they watch a particularly rough landing.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Este Lane]]
description: A decrepit shop, its doors stiff from rusted hinges, stands silent vigil over the street.  Coated windows stare blindly out, covered with some dark smelly substance -- though what it is exactly is anyone's guess.  At times the door quickly opens and shuts with a horrific squeal, allowing a person to rush away from the facade, their bowed head echoing the protective clasp on the bundles they carry off greedily.

title: [[Shop of Horrors, Outer Chamber]]
description: Rotted boards forming the walls are roughly thrown together, leaving splits large enough to reach into in some places.  Shadows obscure a shelf along the back wall, while on the side wall something heavy dangles from a hook.  A smoky lantern hangs from a pole in the center of the room, the only source of illumination.

title: [[Shop of Horrors, Inner Sanctum]]
description: A thick cobweb covers the one small window, tiny trapped bodies in neatly wrapped packages here and there in its strands.  A shadowed figure lurks in the corner, larger than the rest, its eyes reflecting in the lantern-light.  An assortment of dark silhouettes rests on a rickety shelf, a crumbling display case squatting under it.  Remnants of carpeting lump under a lopsided table in one corner, the goods on it tilting sideways as if trying to hang onto the surface.

title: [[Shop of Horrors, Drowned Cellar]]
description: The sound of lapping water reverberates against the distorted walls that seem to melt into the water around your legs, but on second glance it's only the noxious slime dripping down its surface and into the fetid liquid.  Mold covers everything else, including the hole-riddled ladder missing several rungs in one corner.

title: [[Bouncer's, Catapult]]
description: Dominating this area of the pier is a massive catapult, its poles decorated with yellow and blue streamers.  Children watch amazed as daring adventurers take their turn in the catapult's wicker basket.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Amusement Pier, Centre Lane]]
description: A small inn sits at the end of this long pier, its wide doors painted with multi-colored flowers.  A porch made of dark blue and misty-green tile makes a semi-circle beneath the door.  A soft tinkling sound emits from the porch when visitors step on it, informing the owners that potential guests are near.

title: [[Fisherman's Corner, Wilde Lane]]
description: Cantankerous old Humans come here, vying with one another for the best fishing spot.  Occasionally cheers are raised as one particularly large fish is reeled in.  The view off the pier is spectacular as ships sail by, friendly sailors waving from their decks.

Soft, flickering flames dance from torches placed along the end of the pier, providing romantic lighting to nighttime strollers.  A slight breeze causes some to snuggle close to one another, while a scattering of Bards can be heard playing various instruments.

title: [[Fisherman's Corner, Este Lane]]
description: The music of the sea is heard in the soft lulling sound of the waves lapping against the base of the pier and in the echoing calls of seagulls to one another.  A lone bench rests near the railing with fishing equipment casually leaning against it.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Ridgeline Valley]]
description: A sudden drop in the path's elevation parallels a large depression in the ridgeline of Wyvern Mountain.  Verdant moss blankets the sloping path, every step upon its surface releasing a wet, squishy sound.  Drops of water can be seen trailing down amongst the muck and moss as gravity urges them downward.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Ridgeline Valley]]
description: The pungent odor of decay permeates the area, seemingly intensified by the humid environment.  Wyvern tracks mark the fetid goo caked at the base of the skeleton of a pack mule.  Tattered remnants of the yoke and tack once used to hitch the creature to a wagon are tangled amongst its frayed bones.
The pungent odor of decay permeates the area, intensified by the dark, stagnant air.  Fetid goo cakes the base of a skeleton whose bones are tangled with tattered straps of leather.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, southwest, west.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Ridgeline Valley]]
description: Deep calls reverberate through the area as adolescent wyverns stake their claims amongst the mountain's bluffs.  The short brush along the trail shows evidence of being plundered for nest building materials, and holes dot the landscape where plants have been uprooted and carried off entirely.  Despite the ransacking of the developed vegetation, new sprouts persistently emerge from the soil.

Shrill calls pierce the darkness as adolescent wyverns circle menacingly above.  Concealed by a low fog that snakes its way along the trail, holes dot the landscape, threatening to turn the unwary traveler into easy prey for the wyverns that claim this as their territory.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Ridgeline Valley]]
description: The dolomite boulders flanking the wide path have taken on an unusually glossy texture, their surfaces polished smooth where the maturing wyverns have rubbed against them.  Translucent swathes of scaly skin festoon the brambles lining the trail.
Rugged boulders form hulking silhouettes against the night sky.  Occasionally, the breeze creates a rasping noise as it briefly reanimates swathes of scaly skin caught on nearby brambles.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Ridgeline Valley]]
description: Isolated from its neighbors, a weathered boulder looms forebodingly over the path like an ancient tombstone.  Two adolescent wyvern skeletons rest at its base, frozen in the throes of combat.  Though their bones appear to have been here for some time, their brutal claws and teeth remain lodged in the scaly hides of one another.

Isolated from its neighbors, a boulder looms forebodingly over the path like an ancient tombstone.  Two reptilian skeletons guard its base, their indistinct forms appearing to coalesce into that of a hydra in the darkness.

title: [[Bath, Hot Porcelain Tub]]
description: Hot water caresses the senses and brings relief to aches and pains.  Inhaling the soapy scents can cause you to drift into a nap, while the extremely hot water can give even the hardiest Dwarf a nice pink tinge.

title: [[Bath, Hot Wooden Tub]]
description: Hot water caresses the senses and brings relief to aches and pains.  Inhaling the soapy scents can cause you to drift into a nap, while the extremely hot water can give even the hardiest Dwarf a nice pink tinge.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Front Room]]
description: All who enter this small establishment are greeted by the smiling face of Rosealea or one of her many daughters.  Off to one side a spiral staircase leads to the rooms upstairs, while beyond a brightly polished wood arch is seen the main dining room.  Several seascapes line the walls, and its huge front window is outlined with rows of various seashells.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Hallway]]
description: Whitewashed walls are covered with paintings of children and small sea mementos.  A corner shelf holds odd fragments of crystallized rocks, seemingly out of place in this otherwise sea-oriented room.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Bard's Rest]]
description: Midnight silk covers the full-sized bed in this room while the fragrance of roses drifts from a vase full of the colorful blooms.  In the corner stands a gilded stool with a thickly cushioned seat.  A stand has been placed before the stool, offering a place to practice for any visiting bards.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Family Room]]
description: Neat and tidy, this room is made to accommodate those with children.  The huge bed in the middle of the room is covered with many colorful pillows and knitted blankets.  A sofa along one wall is big enough sleep a couple of children, and makes a nice setting for lace pillows and a cross-eyed teddy bear.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Honeymoon Suite]]
description: A four-poster cherrywood bed towers over the other furnishings, framed by dark plum silk draperies.  The scent of jasmine creates a romantic ambiance for the newly bonded.  From its elegant settee to the champagne chilling on the bedside table, no expense has been spared to offer the visiting couple their perfect holiday.  Lace draperies flutter in the window that looks out over the water, while a fragrant fire crackles in the fireplace.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Main Room]]
description: This room buzzes with activity, from harried servers bringing out steaming dishes to customers talking animatedly among themselves.  Red-checkered tablecloths atop wide oak tables have vases placed on them full of fragrant flowers.  Though crowded, the room fits everyone comfortably and offers a magnificent view of the river.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Dance Hall]]
description: Dark crystal sconces hold candles whose soft light seems to flicker in time with music being played by local bards congregating in the corner.  Several low couches surround the dark wood dance floor, offering a place to chat and relax.

title: [[Rosealea's Inn, Rendezvous Room]]
description: Aptly named the Rendezvous Room, a smiling Human man stands behind a dark mahogany bar, ready to take orders for drinks or to offer advice to any would-be listener.  The windows, which are normally thrown wide open, are drawn closed and covered in dark plum silk.

title: [[Ring Toss Game]]
description: Tiers of tinted glass bottles are stacked atop cloth-draped boxes in the shape of a pyramid.  A pudgy Halfling barker stands to one side of the display, easily juggling wooden rings with his free hand.  He calls out to a passerby, enticing them to try their skill at the ring-toss game.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Across the Brook]]
description: Gurgling sounds come from the water flowing past the embankment as it wends its way through the trees towards the distant lake.  The constant humidity fosters the growth of luxuriant moss on the trunks, giving them a fuzzy appearance much like that of an animal's pelt.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Thicket]]
description: Trunks of towering trees close in near the game trail, blocking most light and making the route twist and bend in order to make any progress.  The air hangs heavy and humid, helping the growth of the underbrush pack what little space remains beneath the canopy.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Glade]]
description: Something long ago brought down one of the forest giants, allowing a break in the canopy.  The rotting remains of the fallen titan lie on the forest floor, half-covered in rotting leaves and burgeoning vegetation.  The distant sounds of nightbirds ring through the open space, welcome in the silence of the forest.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Forrest Floor]]
description: Colossal trunks rise from the leaf-covered ground, rising seemingly effortlessly to the distant sky with outstretched limbs and branches.  Little of the sky is visible, most of it blocked by the thick foliage above.  Dangling from the distant branches are wispy strands of moss that help obscure the vault of the heavens.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Dense Woods]]
description: Clusters of trees clump together, as if each parent tree is surrounded by a horde of offspring that are seeking to protect their elder from harm.  Between the clusters of trunks, the ground is covered with low shrubs and other underbrush.  The rustle of leaves and twigs testify to the passage of numerous small animals as they scurry in search of food.

title: [[Langenfirth Woods, Brookside]]
description: Trees thin as the forest approaches a stream flowing within steep embankments.  The sounds of rushing water fill the area, a deep musical splash and bubble sound underlaid with a deep occasional rumble.  The noise of the brook covers all other sounds of the woods, obscuring the passage of both humanoids and beasts.

title: [[Monastery, Monks' Quarters]]
description: Plain white walls interspersed with pillars rise to meet a low ceiling.  Each plaster wall is lined with burning oil lamps set on small shelves in even intervals.  Light streams in through a single stained glass window set high above the entrance, creating a perfect circle of blue-tinged light on the cold marble floor.

title: [[Monastery, Monks' Quarters]]
description: White marble columns flecked with veins of silver and jade stand at regular intervals of this wide hallway, with doors to individual sleeping areas spaced between them.  The cool marble floor is bare, although polished and very clean.  Standing in one corner is a small vase that holds a delicate fern, the small plant thriving in the cool indoors.

title: [[Monastery, Monks' Quarters]]
description: Light streams unhindered through an arched window on the eastern wall, illuminating small motes drifting through the hall.  Doors on either side of the hall lead to the monks' living quarters.  A lone wooden bench pushed against the wall gives a place for brief respite for the weary.

title: [[Monastery, Monks' Quarters]]
description: A single small painting hangs on the northern wall of this wide hallway, placed on one of the columns between the doors to the individual monks' quarters.  A bright spot of color in an otherwise monotone area, the artwork depicts an elaborate forest scene that contrasts sharply with the sterile hall.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Hallway]]
description: Barely wide enough for two people to walk side by side, this cramped hallway has been left undecorated, designed more for function than show.  The ceiling slopes sharply and shows the underside of the roof overhead, while the plain wooden floor is softened somewhat by a runner of deep red carpet.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Hallway]]
description: Bare ends of nails are still visible in the wooden walls, making this hallway seem almost like an afterthought.  Although the beginnings of paint and plaster are visible, the project appears to have been abandoned halfway through.  Only the deep red carpeting is fully in place.  The cramped hall is very poorly lit, with deep shadows lurking in every corner.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Hallway]]
description: The wooden walls in this portion of the monks' quarters are left unpainted, the area seeming unfinished.  Deep red carpeting softens the floor, although the fabric is marred with a little dust.  A lone oil lamp burns on a table in the corner of the windowless hall, carefully isolated from the walls.

title: [[Monastery, Narrow Hallway]]
description: The ceiling rises sharply to disappear into darkness in a point, marking this location as just underneath the building's watchtower.  Suspended by support beams high overhead is a platform made of wood, the walls rising past it in all directions.

title: [[Monastery, Watch Tower]]
description: Built on support beams in the center of the tower and ringed by a waist-high railing, the platform is surrounded on all sides by open-air windows, offering a panoramic view of the monastery below.  Grapevines to the northwest spread out next to the common area, while several still-ruined portions litter the southeastern grounds.

title: [[Monastery Grounds, Greenhouse]]
description: Rows upon rows of flourishing plants grow inside this greenhouse, protected no matter the weather or season.  Clusters of fat grapes hang on carefully spaced vines, clearly labeled to show when they will ripen.  Other fresh fruits and vegetables are planted in rows near the back, providing fresh food for the winter months.

title: [[Monastery, Dining Hall]]
description: A large, ornate table covered with a white cloth shows that this expansive room may have once served as a dining hall.  However, the furniture stands disused and has been pushed far to one side to make way for a large obelisk in the center of the room.  Several arches thinly edged in silver cross high overhead in a sunburst pattern, displaying masterfully carved architecture.

title: [[Monastery, Dining Hall]]
description: Light streams in through towering glass windows on the western wall rising in elaborate arches, hints of colored glass marring their edges slightly.  The rays illuminate a tall obelisk standing in the center of the expansive room.  An ornate cloth-covered dining table fills the area just under the windows, shoved aside to leave most of the room bare.

title: [[Monastery, Dining Hall]]
description: A series of towering glass windows rises to the west, letting light filter in from outside.  Standing in the center of the expansive room is a tall marble obelisk, made of chiseled marble but quite plain.  Pushed up against the northern wall is a plain-looking bench, lightly padded across the top with a light red cushion.

title: [[Monastery, Dining Hall]]
description: Hanging on the eastern wall is a tapestry painting with a nearly blank canvas, the few splashes of paint vaguely resembling the dawn sun rising over a calm blue ocean.  It gives a bit of color to the otherwise large, spartan dining hall, which is dominated by a tall obelisk in the center of the room.

title: [[Rarefish Rando, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A glass table sits on the stained oak floor, with a glass chest and a glass trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A glass rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a glass cabinet along the edges of the room.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, Central Walkway]]
description: At the center of the busy shopping walkway, a beautiful ocean mosaic is pieced together with bits of shell and seaglass.  Festive gaethzen globes are hung from tall poles that are placed at even intervals along the macawood boardwalk.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, Northern Conch Walkway]]
description: Criss-crossed above a macawood boardwalk, festive banners flutter against a gentle sea breeze.  Shoppers stroll down the walkway, gazing about at the different sights.

title: [[The Morada, Gangway]]
description: Bridging the gap over a deep blue sea, a polished ilomba ramp gently slopes upwards from the sandy shore to the Morada.  Opulent diamondwood railings with silver-gilt palm tree balusters protect passengers from unexpected routes of departure.

title: [[The Morada, Lounge]]
description: Opulent diamondwood railings transition into raised half-walls that serve to protect relaxing guests from potential wind gusts.  Providing ample seating, plush cerulean couches are scattered about the area and paired with silver-gilt side tables.

title: [[The Morada, Bar]]
description: Placed in the center as a magnificent focal point, a large curving diamondwood bar is fully stocked with tiers of strong and exotic liqueurs.  Plush cerulean sofas are placed in cozy nooks that are discreetly attended to by sharply dressed waiters.

title: [[The Morada, Promenade]]
description: Opulent diamondwood railings decorated with miniature silver-gilt palm trees line the expansive deck.  Draped elegantly overhead, a crisp white awning provides shade for guests to stroll comfortably underneath.
paths: Ship paths: forward, starboard, port, up.

title: [[The Morada, Buffet]]
description: Flanking an ornate chef's carving station, two large diamondwood sideboards are heavily laden with platters of beautifully displayed food.  A crisp white awning protects any guests seated at the scattered silver-gilt tables from possible inclement weather.

title: [[The Morada, Quarterdeck]]
description: An enormous main-mast towers above the polished ilomba decking at its forward edge.  Crafted into the shape of miniature palm trees, gaethzen lights are gaily strung about the raised deck.

title: [[The Morada, Foredeck]]
description: Separating the polished ilomba deck from the sea, opulent diamondwood railings are decorated with miniature silver-gilt palm trees.  A tall mast rises up from the deck, standing with bast sails neatly furled.

title: [[The Morada, Morgue]]
description: Cold air circles the room and a thin layer of frost covers the steel cabinets that are lined up against the walls.  Placed in the upper corners of the room, large gaethzen lanterns emit a bright and steady light for optimal visibility.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Pathway]]
description: A simple walkway skirts around sturdy stalks of bamboo that have been lashed together into walls, built to protect a seaside village.  To the east, the meandering path leads towards the beach, while shadowy trees lie to the west.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Beach]]
description: A stone launching ramp disrupts the wide sweep of silvery sand edging the crystal lagoon.  A village sprawls over the graceful slopes of the hills to the west, nestled against a backdrop of dense jungle.  The boards of its buildings are bleached and weathered from the constant battering of the sea winds.

title: [[Once Fine Cutlery, Front Room]]
description: Surrounded by walls covered with gouges and nicks, the dusty sales floor stretches across the room and is littered with broken cutlery and shattered flatware.  A few cabinets that likely once displayed the wares stand bare and empty, their doors either broken or left ajar.

title: [[Once Fine Cutlery, Storage]]
description: A minefield of glass and ceramic litters the floor as far as the eye can see.  A thin layer of dust rests atop the majority of the broken furniture, as though nothing has been disturbed for some time.  The faint smell of sulfur fills the room, drawing the eye towards several large scorch marks along the walls.

title: [[The Painted Barn, Tools and Trade]]
description: Pervaded with atrophy, the burned walls barely form any real barrier to keep out the elements.  As a result, mold has begun to grow along edges of the room, and a noxious odor wafts through the air.  Bits of metal and wood litter the floor, waiting to be claimed by the growing mold.

title: [[The Painted Barn, Tack and Gear]]
description: Mold spreads along the charred walls, giving the blackened wood a rotten, white and green hue in several spots.  Clearly once meant for the displaying of tools, empty and rusted hooks line the walls and overlook the littered floor.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Seord Telga]]
description: Cleared of most of the debris that litters the rest of the area, the forest floor is devoid of rubble.  Mosses, herbs and fungi grow in random patches upon the ground.  Large bromeliads and creepers spiral up the massive tree trunks, hugging the bark of the tightly on their way up into the canopy above.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Seord Telga]]
description: Immense trees of various shapes give way to a small clearing.  Bits of paving stones are strewn about the ground, more thickly around the large obsidian pillar leaning dangerously towards collapse.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Seord Telga]]
description: The smell of damp earth hangs heavy upon the air in this ancient forest.  Massive trees tower high above, seemingly standing guard over the flora and fauna that consider this rainforest home.  The dense foliage of the immense trees that flourish in this wilderness creates a massive canopy high above.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Seord Telga]]
description: Dense foliage crowds close around a narrow opening, concealing it under lush greens.  The area is very difficult to navigate with rubble neatly hidden under the epiphytes and massive indigenous ferns obscuring the ground, causing a potential hazard to anyone passing through.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Seord Telga]]
description: Brambles and lianas entwine about an enormous, collapsed tree.  The surface of this once proud giant has become a home for an abundance of mosses and lichens that coat its surface.  Sporadic hoots and calls echo from high above in the canopy.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gam Telga]]
description: The trees crowd closely here, blocking passage to the north and east.  A narrow gap -- nearly obstructed by roots and bracken -- leads northeast, its destination lost in the dim and damp.  The ferns here grow nearly as tall as a Gor'Tog, sheltering dark pools of standing water.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gam Telga]]
description: The collapsed remains of a once glorious pillar lie in ruins, knocked over by some unknown force.  Fruit-bearing plants have flourished here amongst the rubble, growing from within any crack or crevice upon the surface of the weatherworn stone.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gam Telga]]
description: The collapsing ruins of a massive stone wall mars the forest here, blocking passage to the west and south.  Vines and creepers besiege the once-proud edifice, their roots and tendrils slowly bringing the structure to the ground.  The trees beyond the wall are darker and denser than those here, their branches splayed high above like skeletal fingers.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gam Telga]]
description: Numerous inexplicable sounds trickle through this area of the woods.  A tangle of dreary trees marks the end of the dense forest, constructing a natural barrier barring any further passage southward.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gam Telga]]
description: Set into the forest floor is an enormous circular slab of stone.  Four large pillars, each carved of different gemstone, have been placed in the cardinal directions.  Towering high above, they seem to push the canopy asunder, allowing for a break in the dense foliage.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Palisade End]]
description: The patrolling path beaten into the lush grasses by vigilant guards turns in a tight curve back into itself.  The thick logs of the palisade meet the sheer fall of the mountain, the end log melded by some arcane means into the substance of the mountain, forming an impervious joint.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Interior Gates]]
description: Just within the gates a broad expanse of hard-beaten earth runs in either direction along the stockade wall.  The faint chatter of village life drifts sporadically from the north.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Central Ward]]
description: Hard-packed ground barren of any vegetation forms a protective necklace separating the sprawl of vulnerable huts and gardens from the defensive stockade.  Below, the massive gates mark the main entrance into this haven from the wilderness.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, West Ward]]
description: The barren ground continues to the bend of the stockade before curving in on itself, bearing evidence of the vigilant guards who have worn the ground down to bare earth.  Beyond the barren ground a cluster of grass huts can be seen to the north.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, East Ward]]
description: The barren ground continues to the bend of the stockade before curving in on itself, bearing evidence of vigilant guards who have worn the ground down to bare earth.  Beyond the barren ground, a cluster of grass huts can be seen to the north.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ruins of the Heggarangi]]
description: Screened by the towering blackthorn bush, the smoldering ruins of a log lodge lie in the clearing, and the only thing left standing is a forbidding totem carved from an oiled black wood.  The broken remains of a beaded doorway tied with feathers lie scattered underneath the splayed logs, which block all passage eastward.  Hasty fires started inside the destroyed lodge have hidden the secrets of the place forever, reduced to mere ashes.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Sweet Bay Commons]]
description: Sharp shards of broken crockery lie in an untidy pile behind the stout conical hut surrounded by heaped piles of colored dirt.  Dappled shade washes over all from the broad branches the bay tree spreads in a protective parasol from the hub of the clearing, bringing the illusion of relief from the oppressive heat.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest.

title: [[Villager's Hut]]
description: Half this hut is filled with piles of pelts, baskets of beads, fluttering feathers and assorted clay pottery cordoned off behind a thick vine net.  A rumpled plaited palm sleeping pad disturbs the neat pattern left in the dirt by a besom of sweetbay leaves leaning against the netting.  Far against the back wall, a hastily covered bowl reveals a silvery glint.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Sweet Bay Commons]]
description: A pile of neatly trimmed branches is stacked by the curved wall of a well-tended conical hut.  The sweet scent of bay wafting from the thick gnarled tree commanding the center of the commons competes with the astringent odor of rendering dye slowly simmering over the cooking fire.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Sweet Bay Commons]]
description: The conical grass hut claiming this corner of the clearing broods with a smug odiousness, holding its secrets to itself.  The barren ground surrounding the hut is in sharp contrast to the rich spicy scent wafting from the shady branches of the bay tree.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Sweet Bay Commons]]
description: Halved logs have been set as a base to hold a complicated arrangement of woven reeds and branches being used as a drying rack.  Rows of halved coconut shells, each neatly hollowed out, are inverted on the rack to cure.  Following a rough arc, a wide fire blazes busily under a pot of furiously boiling water by a narrow conical hut.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Sweetbay Drums]]
description: Spread under the shady branches, several large bamboo segments are in varying stages of being hollowed out.  A few wood-handled implements that appear to be used for scooping the pulp from the bamboo lie on the ground in front of an oval hut.  As quiet as the area is now, the entire jungle will know when these drums are finished.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ring Commons]]
description: Lush myrtle surrounds the central plaza in a broad collar, offering a natural cushion for the comfort of any observer of the rituals performed at the hub.  The feet of vibrant dancers have tramped a trio of paths around the ring, forming a strangely pleasing braided pattern of brown embossed among the glossy green leaves.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ring Commons]]
description: Lush myrtle surrounds the central plaza in a broad collar, offering a natural cushion for the comfort of any observer of the rituals performed at the hub.  The feet of spirited dancers have tramped a trio of paths around the ring, forming a strangely pleasing braided pattern of brown embossed among the glossy green leaves.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Cloud Ascent]]
description: An imposing broad stair rises into the scanty mist, the arch of each sun-bleached basalt step shaped to the contour of the steep mountain.  Crouched to one side of the base of the steps, a sturdy stone lodge tucks neatly into the mountain, appearing more a natural fall of the native rock than a planned structure.

title: [[Chieftain's House]]
description: The sensual aroma of smoky incense lingers in this spacious area, notable for its lack of furnishings.  The bold motif of the beaded curtain that covers the exit continues, spanning the walls in a continuous mural formed from the skillful placement and manipulation of the thousands of teeth of sacrificial creatures.  At the rear of the room, a locked and barred door blocks off entrance to the rest of the house.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ring Commons]]
description: Lush myrtle surrounds the central plaza in a broad collar, offering a natural cushion for the comfort of any observer of the rituals performed at the hub.  The feet of joyful dancers have tramped a trio of paths around the ring, forming a strangely pleasing braided pattern of brown embossed among the glossy green leaves.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ring Commons]]
description: Lush myrtle surrounds the central plaza in a broad collar, offering a natural cushion for the comfort of any observer of the rituals performed at the hub.  The feet of ecstatic dancers have tramped a trio of paths around the ring, forming a strangely pleasing braided pattern of brown embossed among the glossy green leaves.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Feasting Hub]]
description: Hexagonal pieces of slate have been selected and tiled over the ground at the hub to form a radiating mantra of color that draws the eye inexorably from the pale beige slate of the rim to the deep ebony of the center.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Ring Commons]]
description: Lush myrtle surrounds the central plaza in a broad collar, offering a natural cushion for the comfort of any observer of the rituals performed at the hub.  The feet of energetic dancers have tramped a trio of paths around the ring, forming a strangely pleasing braided pattern of brown embossed among the glossy green leaves.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Abandoned Hut]]
description: The relentless humidity and heat have taken their toll on the dilapidated hut sagging dispiritedly in the overgrown clearing at the end of the path.  Shunned by its neighbors, the structure is prevented from total collapse only by the sturdy trunks of the palisade against which it now leans.

title: [[Abandoned Hut]]
description: Dark and nearly empty, the hut has patches of both old and new wood, as if it has gone through extensive repairs in the recent past.  Thick boards are lashed to the back wall, closing what must have been a gaping hole in the back wall.  The reed walls are reinforced with braided vines and planks of wood, covering up any gaps and peepholes that may have once existed.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Swamp Bay Commons]]
description: The plump rotund grass hut squats in cheerful squalor surrounded by a neglected rock garden, the scent of the minute purple and white violets peeking up from the vine-twined rocks competing with the sharp spiciness of the swamp bay holding court from the center of the clearing.  Welcome shade flutters from the broad leaves moving restlessly in the slightest breeze from the gnarled branches tangling overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Swamp Bay Commons]]
description: A spartan grass hut boldly claims this corner of the commons.  The ground is fastidiously cleared of every weed, the remaining vegetation militarily neat under the spreading boughs of the swamp bay.  The clean spice scent of the tree anoints the air as the welcome shade flutters from the broad leaves moving restlessly in the slightest breeze from the gnarled branches tangling overhead.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Swamp Bay Commons]]
description: An ill-tended grass hut slouches in the far corner of a scruffy clearing, scatters of wood chips and carving curls littering the area before the entrance.  The shaggy reddish bark of the swamp bay in the center of the clearing scents the air with a sharp spice aroma as welcome shade flutters under the broad leaves moving restlessly in the slightest breeze from the gnarled branches tangling overhead.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Swamp Bay Commons]]
description: Centered at an angle across this corner of the commons, a long grass hut lounges amid the almost painful neatness of the area.  Crossing diagonal traces in the swept dirt suggest this area may be used in the training of warriors, as do the grass-stuffed forms of training dummies leaning against the hut.  The sharp spice from the swamp bay at the center of the commons does little to allay the mingled ancient smells of sweat and blood that have permeated the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Gai'y'rak'saar'adu, Storage Hut]]
description: Constructed near the looming logs of the palisade, a three-sided hut crammed with hides, food storage, and tribal crafts is shaded from the heat of the day by the softly waving fronds of a gum tree.  The area before the hut has been paved with broad flat stones, forming a patio holding the heat of the sun in the rock.

title: [[Storage Hut]]
description: Sharp and with a coppery scent, the air in here seems to have coagulated in the heat.  Bowls full of blood stand under animal bodies as they hang from pole racks in various stages of being dressed.  A small knife, its grip maroon with dried blood, lies thrown on the floor.  Pelts lie stacked in a huge basket in the corner and another basket holds entrails.

title: [[Villager's Hut]]
description: Order and purpose are evident here, created by habits refined during a lifetime of leading men in battle.  Sleeping mats, tied in a bundle, have been stacked against the back wall.  A large chest and an empty wall rack provide storage for weapons and armor when the residents are home.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Wilds]]
description: Centuries of fallen leaves, vines, branches and flowers have formed a spongy mat underfoot, a decaying record of the life of the trees and plants.  A dense, earthy scent fills the air, the ghost of the ever-dying jungle lingering to haunt, for the jungle is ever-living as well, the cycle of growing and dying rolling on into the past and future.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Wilds]]
description: Birds call back and forth from their nests high in the canopy and their perches on vines and branches.  Tiny little dark birds flitter from place to place, always ready to dart away if a predator appears.  Larger birds, gaudy in their plumage of blue and orange and yellow, and huge bills of black and yellow stripes, flap more leisurely from one perch to another, their caws and screeches ringing through the jungle.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Wilds]]
description: Huge trees draped with vines soar up to the sky, their massive trunks as wide as two caravans standing side by side.  Younger trees and sprawling bushes hide the unevenness of the ground, filling in ruts and perching on hummocks, the leaves and branches blending into each other to form a dense mass.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Wilds]]
description: An enormous carved rock squats here in the jungle, overgrown with vines and creepers.  The vegetation has encroached upon it from all sides, except to the east of it where a colossal pit plunges into the ground.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Wilds]]
description: Dozens of tall trees stand sentinel at the edge of an immense pit, although whether they are set to mark it or to hide it is difficult to say.  Twining vines carry bright flowers up the trunks and across from branch to branch, splashes of red and yellow and orange against the deep emerald green of the foliage.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Tree Stump]]
description: This narrow roost seems to be the remains of one of the massive trees which dominate the jungle.  Black charring suggests that a lightning strike, and a rather powerful one, cut this tree in two pieces.  The one on which you rather precariously perch is still rooted in the ground, while the other doubtless fell down into the surrounding pit.  The tree was wide enough for several people to stand on it, but the jagged cut made by the lightning left the surface steep and uneven, and footing treacherous.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Hummock]]
description: Towering trees and vines create a jungle canopy above this small patch of dry land surrounded by murky water, while flowers and plants create a lush oasis in the midst of gloom.  A graveyard hush and stillness pervade this tiny sanctuary.  A primitive statue, remarkably free of mold and dirt, stands in a small clearing.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Sandbar]]
description: Sturdy trees covered with tough, supple vines ring this sheltered cove where the river has laid down a big sandbar.  The stumps that stand here and there are unmistakeable signs that this is the best place to make and launch a raft.  The surging waters of the river race by the cove, sweeping away anything or anyone unlucky enough to be caught in the current.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, The South Beach]]
description: This small beach, like the one to the north of the gate, offers little more than a view of the lagoon and its enclosing walls.  But from this angle, it looks like some kind of trail runs along the top of the north crater wall.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: A small beach nearby offers a place to rest and regroup at the foot of the South Tower, which rises from the narrow strip to the crater rim far, far overhead.  The wall of the lagoon curves smoothly southward and westward, declining as it approaches the open western side, like the rim of a bowl tilted toward the west.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The forbiddingly high crater wall stretches east and west, a bastion that protects the lagoon against southerly storms.  Hardly a seam or crack mars the black surface, which looks almost polished, reflecting light deep into the water.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The crater wall rises high and straight from the water, curving to the north.  It may not be smooth as glass, but it is sheer enough to defeat any attempt, no matter how skillful, aided only by bare hands.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Although you are directly west of the water gate, the strong outflow from the river makes swimming up to the gate itself impossible.  The same currents that aided your passage into the lagoon bar that exit.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Here in the center of the lagoon, shoved back and forth by wayward currents, one could appreciate the exactness of nature's architecture, if the waves left any time for contemplation.  These waves that exhaust and defeat the swimmer would scarcely bother a ship sheltered from the ocean storm in this generous harbor.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The water at the western end of the lagoon roils like the wrath of Drogor.  The waves crash through the gap, thrown through the narrow breach in the crater wall.  Foam spins high into the air as the surf roars against the rock to either side.  Maybe a shark or dolphin could make headway against that tide, but nothing with legs could do it.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: A small strip of land lies at the base of the North Tower, which looms over the little beach like the upraised arm of a giant.  The wall of the lagoon curves smoothly northward and westward at the level of the giant's forearm, sloping down toward the open western side.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The high crater wall stretches east and west, shielding the lagoon against northerly storms.  The faintest ribbon of green lies upon the rim high above.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Here at the lowest part of the crater wall, foam washes a slim crevice just above the waterline.  Scarring on the sides of the crevice shows that something was once wedged within, perhaps as a handhold or a step to help mount to the crater's rim.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, The North Beach]]
description: A small beach, no more than a dozen yards long, has formed below the North Tower from sediment carried there by the river.  The view from this little strip of shingled rock must resemble that of a fly inside a rather lop-sided bowl since, except on the ocean side, the walls of the crater jut straight up from the water.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Sea water surges through the gap in the crater rim, making any further westward movement impossible.  A swimmer beyond that gap would risk being battered to death against the crater walls by wave after crashing wave.  The salt water is cleaner, though, and the rubble on the bottom is clearly visible.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, up.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Oysters have colonized a crease or wrinkle in the bottom of the crater, patiently opening and closing in a unison of mindless feeding.  No doubt they hold their own mysteries within their unknown purpose, like a lustrous pearl inside a dark shell.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, up.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The base of the towers and the lower grill waver dimly through the water to the east.  A few plants on the floor of the lagoon find an insecure hold in pockets of silt caught within the rubble.
paths: Obvious paths: southwest, west, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Far below in the blue-green waters of the lagoon, some curious objects are just visible: a series of perfectly round boulders.  These frozen bubbles are a mute witness to the long-forgotten birth of the island in fire and smoke when it rose from the sea in layer upon layer of ash and lava.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, northwest, up.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Currents sweep and swirl from every direction here at the heart of the lagoon.  A bird in a storm must feel the same helplessness before vast and impersonal powers that take no more notice of a man than of a minnow.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west, up.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: Outside the grill, the strong flow of the river has scoured the bottom clean, and rocks fallen from the crater walls cover the basin floor.  Silt in the water makes it hard to see in any direction, and the current flows powerfully westward.

title: [[Corsair Lagoon, In the Lagoon]]
description: The force of the current is checked dramatically as tide and stream strive for mastery.  The ocean pushes its way toward shore one moment only to be pushed back by the river in the next.  The muddy flow from the river still clouds the water, obscuring vision in every direction.

title: [[Cliff Face]]
description: Blotting out the light, the broken face of the cliff rises imposingly into the sky.  A fine web of cracks and ledges creates a pathway for an experienced climber to use.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Cliff Top]]
description: From this vantage point, the shimmering depths of the ocean lie spread out to the east.  Snow-capped mountain peaks jut high into the sky as the mountain range blocks all passage westward.  A faint path leads northward, running perilously close to the jagged edge of a steep cliff.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Mountain Path]]
description: The rocky trail twists and turns like a snake molting its skin, rising northward to a gap between two mountain peaks.  Tall trees rise beside the path, blanketing the mountain stone with a thick cushion of brown needles.  A haunting stillness fills the air, out of place in woods which normally should be teeming with wildlife.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gash]]
description: A deep chasm breaks the rocky surface of the path in two.  The remains of a rope bridge hang forlornly against the far side of the gash, the connecting planks reaching nearly to the bottom of the chasm.  Several trees grow at haphazard angles over the chasm, some reaching almost to the other side.

title: [[Gash, Tree Trunk]]
description: The bottom of the gash is cloaked in smoky shadows that occasionally belch forth noxious fumes.  The length of the tree trunk stretches across the gash to the north.  The southern edge of the chasm is within easy reach.

title: [[Gash, Tree Trunk]]
description: The bottom of the gash is cloaked in smoky shadows that occasionally belch forth noxious fumes.  The length of the tree trunk stretches across the gash to the south.  The northern edge of the chasm is within easy reach.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gash]]
description: The resinous scent of crushed pine needles fills the air.  Fuzzy green branches, part of a tree which spans the large chasm to the south, partially block the rocky mountain path as it wends its way northward.  A small nest lies crumpled beneath one branch.

title: [[Gash]]
