Access aft is provided by a pair of narrow walkways leading around the cabin, while a locked deobar gate blocks further forward progress.  A lone Halfling crewman works to apply a new coat of oil and wax to the deck.

title: [[The Gallaenia, Main Lounge]]
description: The silverwood wall panels are covered in fine sea foam-colored silks.  Around the room are couches decorated with carved motifs of shells, and covered in dark blue brocade.  Cedar tables, with chairs of ebonwood inlaid with bits of shell and covered in leather, are available for people to meet take up much of the remaining space.  The silver candleholders are all shaped like deobar trees.

title: [[The Gallaenia, Purser's Office]]
description: A large maple desk decorated with carved yaks and inlaid with the seal of the Zoluren Traders' Guild fills the office.  Seated at the desk, the purser is sorting notes into the pigeonholes.  Through the door of the next room can be seen Moon Mages holding open a moongate.

title: [[The Gallaenia, Aft Deck]]
description: Carved deobar railings decorated with leaping dolphins line the deck.  Overhead an awning provides shelter for the crew to relax under.  The captain, who is sitting in an ebonwood chair inlaid with bits of shell and carved with flowers, watches five of the Halfling crew play a game of cards.  Hanging from the ship's wheel is a wine flask.  Forward access is provided by two walkways that lead around the main cabin.  The sound of waves provides a contrast to the calls of the crewmen.

title: [[The Ghostly Galleria of Spiritual Souvenirs]]
description: The unmistakable salty tang of the sea hangs heavily in the air.  The small room sits at a slight angle, as a bulky crate would lean with a heavy load stacked atop it.  The ceiling on one side is higher than the other.  Despite the structure's physical condition, a fresh coat of white paint covers the walls, and a royal purple rug -- still curled at its edges -- sits in the center.

title: [[Minaret, Roof]]
description: A one-room hut of thin white bone squats on top of the brick roof.  Torchlight flickers through a series of lancet windows.  A horseshoe archway frames an entrance, outlined along its length by writing engraved in flowing gold foil calligraphy.

title: [[Limited Treasures, Sales Floor]]
description: Polished to a gleam, dark metal covers the walls, ceiling, and floor save for a spot in the very center of the room where a silversteel stand sits upon a white velvet rug trimmed in silver.  A steel candle-covered chandelier is suspended exactly above it, the lights glimmering across all the metal surfaces.

title: [[In Shining Armor, Showroom]]
description: Light from abundant gaethzen orbs glares off impeccably clean metal walls and reflects harshly off equally well-polished merchandise, often creating a halo effect.  A circular rug cowers apologetically in the center of the square room, a sole, meager bit of surface area not intended to shine.  Along the walls, six noble-looking mannequins display suits of armor for sale.

title: [[Altered Reactions]]
description: The aroma of analgesic ointments and smelling salts waft all around you, testament to the 'research' that occurs under this enterprise.  Hanging curtains separate the room into private testing chambers, though the sounds of hands clapping against faces and the elicited response are muted by cleverly arrayed wall coverings.  A series of locked doors line one wall, and attendants rush about soothing bruised faces and egos.

title: [[Gosling's Exotic Fish]]
description: Colorful fish dart amidst the greenery in a large tank along the far wall of the shop.  Above the tank, water trickles from tier to tier down a roughly carved blue sandstone waterfall, finally tumbling into the tank.  Light reflecting off the surface of the water sends flickering patterns dancing around the room.

title: [[Piralpa Tridents, Coral Showroom]]
description: Sculpted in bas-relief, images of fish with childlike faces adorn the coral walls, their glassy gem eyes following any motion in the room due to tricks of light and shadow.  The monotony of the rough walls is broken not only by these cheerful masques but by a series of thick colored bands, adding a rainbow of seafoam greens, ocean blues and pastel pinks to the otherwise pale coral room.

title: [[Stupid Terrestrian Tricks, Waiting Area]]
description: This temporary, three-sided structure acts as a waiting area for contestants, and as a place for the Mongers' assistants to loiter.  Near a water trough, a number of the stage crew mill about holding clay steins and chatting.  Periodically one slips though the stage door and back out again, nodding to his compatriots.

title: [[Sputkin's Splendors, Cramped Loft]]
description: Not a single cobweb mars this small loft, allowing a feeling of comfort to permeate throughout.  A single candle rises from a golden floor sconce, casting playfully dancing shadows on the walls.

title: [[Sketchy by Design, Backroom]]
description: Polished red oak sheathes the walls and floor of this spacious room.  Various wares sit on a table along the back wall, each filled to overflowing.

title: [[Jousting Grounds, Lances and Roses Souvenir Shop]]
description: Dolls, ribands and other souvenirs are laid out in neat groups atop the display tables in the shop.  Sales clerks work quickly to maintain the order as items are snatched up by prize-hungry spectators attending the competitions.

title: [[Sleeping Dragon Corn Maze, Rest Clearing]]
description: Set up as a small celebration area, the festival area for the corn maze is surrounded by a wooden fence.  Any grass in the area is thoroughly trampled by the heavy foot traffic, and the smell of ale hangs heavily in the air.

title: [[The Dolefaren, Common Room]]
description: The dim interior of the ship is lit by scattered brass lanterns hanging along the walls.  A Merelew woman with green hair and silver scales serves the delicacies of her people to the restaurant's guests at several wood tables.

title: [[Andreshlew's Grand Raffle]]
description: Like a pebble dropped into a pond, concentric circles of blue and white tile spread forth from the heart of a wide pavilion.  The epicenter of the glistening wave is a white-marbled domed roof covering a small counter.

title: [[Clearing, Darkling Wood]]
description: The faint path ends abruptly in a tangled clearing filled with decaying stumps.  Poking up from the earth are the remains of a stone foundation, its original purpose lost to time.

title: [[Clearing, Darkling Wood]]
description: Weird chirring and rasping noises issue from the shadowed underbrush, each one startling in its volume and unexpectedness.  A faint odor of decay drifts along the path, hinting at areas danker and damper lying beyond the twisted trees.

title: [[Clearing, Darkling Wood]]
description: Tendrils of moss drape from the twisted, darkened trees, seeming to reach for any travelers unwary enough to come within range.  Underbrush chokes the spaces between the trees, cutting off all movement except for a narrow path dark with shadows.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Pit]]
description: Three rocky mounds reside near the cavern's fall wall.  Atop each rests a mining pick and the rotted remains of cloth or leather gloves.  A message is scratched crudely into the floor in a circle surrounding the graves.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Pit]]
description: A vast hole plunges into a dark abyss.  Grooves the size of a horse are slashed into the rocky ground ringing the pit, and toppled stanchions still clinging to broken lengths of chain are scattered about.  Rhythmic dripping can be heard somewhere nearby, though its source is concealed.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Collapsed Tunnel]]
description: The narrow passage is cramped in places where rotted beams that once supported the mine have collapsed.  A perpetual cloud of dust hangs in the air, making it difficult to see more than a few paces away in any direction.  A small opening to the west allows passage back to the main tunnel.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Pit]]
description: A noxious, sulphurous odor clings to the air, threatening to overwhelm the senses.  Yellow-green pockets of the gas linger near the pit, though exactly what they are or where they come from is unclear.  Falling away into the abyss is a length of rope with rusty red discolorations marring the frayed knots that secure it topside.

title: [[Abandoned Mine, Pit]]
description: Discarded piles of tools litter the area.  The rusted heads of mining picks are lodged into the stone walls where their workers last struck, and no sign of their handles remain.  Wheelbarrows are upturned, their glittering prizes strewn about as if a child flung sand.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Climbing Path]]
description: Although it barely clings to the side of the cliff in some places, the trail still manages to allow passage up the craggy side of the plateau.  Trees sink deep roots into the rocks in an attempt to stay upright.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Twisted Ledge]]
description: A brief respite from the sheer verticality of the route is provided by a narrow ledge that juts out from the surrounding rocks.  A few small shrubs have established themselves in the shadows of the overhanging cliff.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Ledge]]
description: Wedged into a crevice, a large flat rock that fell from above now allows for relatively safe passage along the side of the cliff.  A random scattering of rocks and debris testifies to possiblity of further falls.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Narrow Ledge]]
description: Jumbled together in a random grouping, a pile of boulders rests atop a much larger rock jutting out from the bluff.  Winding amongst the rocks, a barely visible path allows for passage through the rubble of past landslides.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Rockslide]]
description: Masses of rock and mud have cascaded down from above, blocking passage further east along the cliffside.  Fortunately, a steep trail bypasses the blockage and gives access to the plateau above.  Little vegetation survived when the earth slipped but a few small shrubs still cling to the cliff on the edges of the landslide.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Narrow Crevice]]
description: Cutting deep into the edge of the plateau, a narrow crevice cleaves downward towards the precipice.  Right at the drop-off, a steep trail begins and zigzags down the cliff face towards the forest below.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches out from the edges of the plateau, a mass of undulating greenery that effectively hides the rocky soil beneath.  Songbirds dart amongst the stems, their melodious voices rising above the susurration of the swaying leaves.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches out from the edges of the plateau, with only a few shrubs to break the monotony of the whispering grasses swaying in the wind.  Birds soar above the cliff, using the updrafts to gain altitude above the forests spread at the feet of the plateau.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches out from the edges of the plateau, the thick growth almost hiding a winding trail that snakes towards a small vale cupped within the rocky outcrop.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassand stretches out from the plateau's edge, running right up to the edge of the vertical cliffs.  The crumbling edge is festooned with teetering rocks and boulders, poised to crash to the forest below.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches endlessly out from the plateau's edge, rippling in the wind.  Only a very few stumpy trees rise above the vegetation, their branches gnarled by the ever-present breeze.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassy Vale]]
description: Cupped within the surrounding grassland, a small vale enclosed by low rocky walls stetches around a small spring.  Tendrils of water flow out from the spring, feeding two meager rivulets winding amongst the savannah.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassy Vale]]
description: The meandering streamlet eventually peters out into nothingness, its moisture dispersing amongst the thirsty grasses.  A few stray boulders mark the edge of the plateau, providing some warning of the plunge into the surrounding forest lurking below.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassy Vale]]
description: Ending rather abruptly, the tiny stream drains away into a crevice, disappearing completely into the rocks of the plateau without a trace.  Not far from the crevice, the plateau itself ends in a sheer drop off to the forest far, far below.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Prize Concourse]]
description: Emblazoned along the eastern wall of the soaring arcade, a massive mural depicts several charioteers locked in fierce and glorious competition.  The chatter of contestants browsing the concourse echos softly off the marble tile underfoot.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Prize Concourse]]
description: Continuing from the southern end of the concourse, a massive mural depicts several charioteers locked in fierce and glorious competition.  The chatter of contestants browsing the concourse echos softly off the marble tile underfoot.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Prize Concourse]]
description: Further continuing from the southern end of the concourse, a massive mural depicts several charioteers locked in fierce and glorious competition along the eastern wall.  The chatter of contestants browsing the concourse echoes softly off the marble tile underfoot.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Prize Rotunda]]
description: The concourse terminates into an enormous round room encircled by sculpted marble pillars of polished white marble.  Covering the domed ceiling of the rotunda, a massive mural depicts a vividly painted labyrinth composed of golden keys.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Grand Hall]]
description: Suspended between jewel-toned pennants overhead, ornate oil lanterns softly illuminate the grand entry hall of Droughtman's Maze.  Eager contestants crowd the mahogany registration desk at the center of the chamber, while a gold-carpeted staircase dominates the northern wall, providing access to the observation deck.

title: [[Droughtman's Maze, Recovery Room]]
description: The noise from the cheering spectators, although muffled, can still be heard echoing off the walls of this comfortably cooled room.

title: [[Western Road, Cedar Branch]]
description: Flattened, finely divided leaves release a crisp, cool scent into the shadowed bower of the cedar's upper reaches.  The road below is barely visible, but through the branches stretches a rugged vista encompassing both mountains and sky.

title: [[High Mountains, Sloped Path]]
description: Sprays of rock occasionally fall from up above, sending the gravel on the ground tumbling further down and into the undergrowth beneath the trees that somehow cling to life here.  The trail veers toward both the east and the west from here, forking around a fairly sizable boulder.

title: [[High Mountains, Sloped Path]]
description: Looping to the north and the west, the trail here opens widely, providing a breathtaking view of the mountains in the distance.  A ramshackle fence set up along the edge of the path seems to have been set up to prevent accidental deaths.

title: [[High Mountains, Sloped Path]]
description: Circling around the boulder, the rocky path is littered with dried out and broken logs.  A series of small rocks line the path, and an oddly stacked bunch of rocks rests on the north side of the trail, as if serving as a trail marker.

title: [[House of the Rowan Branch, Entryway]]
description: Stark white walls frame the narrow hallway, fashioned from heavy paper framed by rowan beams.  Crafted from wooden slats, the dark red floor is carefully polished and lends a touch of color to the otherwise simple hall.  A small rack next to the entryway holds pairs of slippers, placed there to be used by guests.

title: [[House of the Rowan Branch, Hall of Meditation]]
description: A large painting of the House Crest adorns one wall, the only ornamentation in the otherwise simple room.  Constructed entirely of large sheets of rice paper stretched between rowan beams, the walls let in only a muted glow from the outside.  The narrow hallway continues east and west, though the small space is a little uninviting.

title: [[House of the Rowan Branch, Inner Foyer]]
description: Tanned from dark leather, a large mat lines the center of the floor, following the shape of the walls.  In the corner is a small square table, a tall glass pitcher of ice water set upon it.  A single paper lantern hangs from the ceiling, illuminating the way.  Clean walls of rice paper line beams of rowan, the hallway ending at a paper screen.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Pool Shallows]]
description: Wide steps lead upward onto a low-hanging balcony surrounding the narrow pool.  The current in this shallow pool runs from the west, continually flowing underneath the balcony to the east.  Patches of floating water lily nestled among kokona reeds have been planted opposite a narrow wooden railing, which serves to keep the delicate plants isolated.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Pool Shallows]]
description: The water is pleasantly warm, running in a steady stream from beneath the low-hanging balcony to the west and flowing eastward.  Thin kokona reeds bend slightly with the current, next to a small patch of golden flag planted in the shallow water.  A narrow wooden railing cordons off a narrow strip of the water at the west end, the water-bound foliage just beyond it.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Beneath the Bridge]]
description: Droplets of water fall in sheets from the underside of a bridge overhead, filling the air with a low-hanging mist.  The dark blue floor under the water slopes downward from the south, rendering the area slightly deeper.  Gold-colored fish swim lazily about in the water, most of them seeming unafraid of any intrusion.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Beneath the Bridge]]
description: Spanning overhead is narrow winding bridge, its underside artfully painted with a deep blue summer sky filled with white clouds.  The dark water is slightly deeper, and multicolored fish of various sizes swim lazily about.  Many swim near the surface, snatching floating bits of food from the otherwise clean water.  A wide wooden ramp leads upwards to the northern balcony.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, North Hall]]
description: The long balcony leading from the pool is rather plain, its north wall lined with split bamboo lashed together and hung with a large painting of Kukalakai's grove.  Painted in soft white, the side view of a narrow bridge over a slow-moving pool to the south is easily visible.  To the east is a wide arch leading into a lounge, while a door to the west leads into a conference room.  A wide ramp leads sharply down into the pool.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Lounge]]
description: Large stained glass windows on the north and east sides of the room are accented with a large potted fern set in the corner between them.  A trio of low couches surrounds a low coffee table in the center of the room, and a well-stocked bar at the south end of the room is lined with cushioned stools.  A wide silverwood arch leads back into the hallway.

title: [[House of the Floating Reed, Conference Room]]
description: In the center of this perfectly square room is a large wooden table that is elegantly embossed with the House crest.  Comfortable chairs have been set around it, each turned to face the front of the table.  A curtain of slender glass rods runs from ceiling to floor on the west side of the room, streams of water flowing down them and into an opening in the floor below.  Leading back into the hallway is a wooden door.

title: [[House of the Grey Storm, Water Garden]]
description: Sheltered between the mighty towers, brightly colored carp swim among the water lilies and hyacinths that rise gracefully from leathery pads in a placid, crescent-shaped pool.  Surrounding a large, water-filled basin at the center of the garden, several cherrywood benches sit near the pond's edge.  Opposite a stone arch leading deeper into the gardens, a lacquered footbridge reaches across the water to the south.

title: [[House of the Grey Storm, Earth Garden]]
description: On one side of the pathway, an undulating expanse of carefully raked sand encircles a massive clenched stone fist that juts from the ground.  On the other side, a long, low slab of dark stone provides seating for meditation.  Immaculately pruned shrubs and moss-covered boulders pack densely around the garden's border, framing the area with vibrant green.

title: [[House of the Grey Storm, Fire Garden]]
description: Crimson and vermillion spiraea tumble profusely from raised planters as vines of yellow and orange trumpet flowers lick their way up the slender pillars that form this circular, open-air colonnade.  The garden is focused around a courtyard of fused obsidian with an iron disc at its center.  From the disc erupts a perpetual flame.

title: [[House of the Grey Storm, Guest Room]]
description: Dark sisal mats partially cover the smooth slate floors of this room.  A low lacquered platform completely covered with an oversized cushion serves as a bed, piled high with round pillows of pale gold raw silk.  Plants native to Aesry, apparently intended for the comfort of visitors traveling from the islands, add a pleasant aroma and splash of color to the area.  Set near the narrow window is a gilded birdcage.

title: [[House of the Gilded Longleaf, Bog]]
description: The boardwalk leads to a flat hummock that juts out into a marshy bog resplendent with dragon mouth orchids growing in vivid abundance.  Marble urns, planted with dahlias and chrysanthemums, flank a Dwarf-sized menhir.  Short logs are placed around the stone for seating.  The sound of cranes, fishing in the shallow waters, completes the calm, serene atmosphere.

title: [[Shard, Under the Bridge of Rooks]]
description: High in a corner where the support meets the roadway, a large bird's nest dangles bits of straw and string that sway when touched by a breeze.  The deck above casts a dark shadow on the water as it ripples past carrying bits of debris that swirl around the center pilings.  Jutting from the arch's footing is a large pipe installed as an air vent that plunges deep beneath the ground to the span's underpinnings.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: This enormous oval of forged metal not only descends at a steep incline, but is slippery and noisily amplifies the echoes from any sound.  A small stream of moisture dribbles along in a desultory manner at the base of the curving floor.  Rust patterns on the walls form abstract works of natural art.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: Sounds from above mingle with those from below, creating a murmuring echo that is indecipherable.  A few stray leaves adhere to the wall where receding water left them plastered.  Underfoot, bits and pieces of debris crumble and mingle with the rivulet in the center, muddying the clarity of the stream.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: A small stream of moisture dribbles along in a desultory manner at the base of the curving floor.  Rust patterns on the walls form abstract works of natural art.  Branching off of the pipe is a large opening that leads east.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: The further one descends, the cooler it becomes.  The mix of moisture on the floor with the chilled air creates lace like patterns on the metal walls.  The flow of air vacillates between drifting lazily upward and blowing past as it heads down the vent.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: It is definitely damper here than the small trickle drizzling along underfoot would indicate.  Peaks and valleys of rust patterns on the walls form abstract mountain ranges some of which soar high overhead.  One side of this pipe appears to have been gouged from behind with enough persistence to open an irregular hole half way up the curve.

title: [[In the Vent]]
description: The pipe ends abruptly, having met the bridge's main support which is encircled by shallow water.  This vent was installed in an attempt to draw excess moisture to the surface, but its success is questionable as rust has leached into the stagnant water and at a minimum discolored the column.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: Light leaks through the hatch above, casting gloomy shadows across the unnaturally warm stones that form the curved wall and scarred floor.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: A single guttering torch struggles to illuminate this rather unadorned corner of the chamber.  Several heavy iron rings are bolted to the wall and faded bloodstains streak the floor towards a small drain.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: Several heavy metal frames contorted into humanoid postures encircle this section of the chamber.  Set into the south wall is a large weapon rack.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: A cloying maroon smoke oozes from a grating above, choking most of the light from this corner of the chamber.  Set into the north wall is a large weapon rack.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: Jutting from where the warm stone walls meet is a large round basin filled with tepid water.

title: [[The Black Spire, Initiation Chamber]]
description: A heavy heat hangs in the air and an occasional droplet of liquid drizzles from above to splatter into one of the shallow depressions in the floor before slowly bubbling away.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Stained Plateau]]
description: Huge streaks of brownish rust mar the top of the weathered plateau, the rock worn nearly smooth by the endless ages of erosion by the salty wind.  Dark and dangerous water can be seen far below the plateau's edge, churned continuously by the rough waves in this part of the ocean.  No birds fly through the air or sing their songs, making the island feel barren and lifeless.

Huge streaks of dark rust mar the top of the weathered plateau, the rock worn nearly smooth by the endless ages of erosion by the salty wind.  The sound of the ocean waves roaring against the island's edge can be heard coming from far below the plateau.  Any usual night sounds are all but nonexistent, making the island feel barren and lifeless.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Stained Plateau]]
description: Odd geometrical patterns form this bleak and arid plateau, with occasional bits of weedy foliage sticking up between the rocks of the natural formation.  Rusty markings of varying age litter the ground randomly, permanently soaked into the flat surface of the bleary stone.  The air is very dry despite the salty spray from far below, smelling of metallic dust mixed with the sharp scent of the sea.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Stained Plateau]]
description: The sheer basalt cliff drops off to the west, forming a completely vertical drop to the rocky ocean hundreds of feet below.  Random piles of broken columnar basalt litter the plateau here, resembling chopped stone logs from a nightmare's forest.  Harsh salty wind blows constantly through the air and wears the stone surface clean, ensuring nothing grows on this side of the plateau.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Stained Plateau]]
description: Occasional thin, withered trees grow at the eastern edge of the wide plateau, affording a small amount of respite from exposure to the elements.  Hairline cracks in the stone are stained an orangeish red with many layers of rust, settled in vague spiderweb patterns.  The trail slopes steeply upward to the north to lead to a small overlook, while another drops dramatically to the east to follow the treacherous cliffside.

Huge streaks of dark rust mar the top of the weathered plateau, the rock worn nearly smooth by the endless ages of erosion by the salty wind.  The sound of the ocean waves roaring against the island's edge can be heard coming from far below the plateau.  Any usual night sounds are all but nonexistent, making the island feel barren and lifeless.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Overlook]]
description: The entire island is visible from this small overlook, the jagged basalt spines jutting from the sea to the east while huge cracks run through the island's center to create dark, gaping chasms.  An ominous-looking castle can be seen far to the west at the top of a towering cliff, while a small fishing village huddles far below it.  Very little greenery pierces the flat grey landscape, and the sea appears harsh and unforgiving at every horizon.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Towering Pillars]]
description: Dark grey spines frame the eastern edge of the steep cliffside path, following the edge of the plateau and forming a measure of protection against falling.  Jagged rocks jut from the ocean below, coated thick with red algae and splitting the roiling waves.  A rocky reef rises out in the far distance, two distinct shipwrecks splintered apart on their treacherous edge.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Towering Pillars]]
description: Strange rock formations make up the cliff wall, needle-like basalt columns interspersed with harder crystals and softer limestone.  Runoff from rainwater has formed a sunken basin to the west, while the rocky trail follows the cliff to the southwest.  Huge fang-like rock formations jut directly from the ocean to the east, rendering the terrain there unnavigable and suicidally dangerous.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Sunken Basin]]
description: A small pool of stagnant water has formed in a small indentation in the cliffside here, slicked thick with red algae.  White foam cracks in its surface show the water's heavy salinity, allowing the slick scum to thrive in this wet basin high in the rocks.  Rocks and boulders poke through the sludge, their surfaces coated a rusty crimson from the heavily infested water.

A small pool of stagnant water has formed in a small indentation in the cliffside here, smelling heavily of algae.  Small cracks in the pool's surface are filled with foam, spiderwebbing across the dark water in a vivid contrast.  Strange fuzzy shapes poke through the surface of the water, unmoving but playing tricks with vision in the night's darkness.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Desolate Beach]]
description: The relentless pounding of the ocean waves has slowly worn away a small portion of the cliffside into a thin strip of dark grey sand, forming a poor excuse of a beach.  Scattered boulders and large stones litter the sand here and there, many worn smooth by the pounding ocean waves.  An eerie quiet reigns over this patch of desolation, the air completely empty of the usual seabirds.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Desolate Beach]]
description: The skeletal remains of a large beached animal lie washed up on the sand, picked clean and bleached by the harsh environment.  Eddies of salty sand pool around it in a slow and uncaring manner, preserving the creature's death throes in the salty brine.  The towering basalt cliffs rise sharply at the northern edge of the beach, dwarfing the creature's remains and making them seem small and insignificant.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Desolate Beach]]
description: At the western end of the lifeless grey beach is a gaping maw of a cavern, carved into the basalt columns by the sea's relentless waves.  The jagged interior is pitch black inside, greedily swallowing all light that enters it.  Water rushes into the huge opening with each wave, then slowly drains back out again, undulating in dangerous swells, though a thin strip of sand allow safe passage at its very edge.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Shattered Cavern]]
description: Huge and nearly pitch black, the vast majority of this cavern is filled with treacherous and unpassable water, the echoes from the waves resonating through the oversized hollow.  A narrow basalt ledge allows just enough room to sit or stand comfortably.  The underside of hexagonal basalt columns poke randomly through the darkness that shrouds the high ceiling, giving a glimpse of the island's massive weight above.

title: [[Basalt Isle, Decaying Dock]]
description: Originally made from sturdy wood, the dock here is splintered and ruined in places, and a large boulder has smashed through most of it near the bank.  Despite this, some of the structure appears somewhat useable, with a few sturdy pillars holding fast between the splintered boardwalk.  The water is relatively calm around the dock, providing a respite from the churning waves that plague the rest of the island.

title: [[Reach Forge, Forecavern]]
description: A pewter oil lamp hangs on a rusty chain from the shadows above, casting a hazy amber glow on a cluttered countertop and the one-armed attendant behind it.  The man's booted foot rests atop a sloppy stack of books on the counter.  Occasionally he glances at three hourglasses perched on a rock and grudgingly shuffles through a leather curtain when one runs down.

title: [[Reach Forge, Tunnel]]
description: The jagged stone walls are blackened with accumulated soot and coal ash.  Light spills in from three arches leading to the west, north and east, barely illuminating the hot, stuffy tunnel and several large buckets.  Wisps of cooler air seep in from beneath a leather curtain leading back out to the forecavern.

title: [[Reach Forge, Eastern Smithy]]
description: Brilliant red-orange light glows from a side-vented forge crafted from a natural shelf on the northern wall.  Above it, an assortment of fire-blackened tools hangs just out of arm's reach and a few steps away the large, iron anvil waits patiently to help shape metal into the form of men's dreams.

title: [[Reach Forge, Northern Smithy]]
description: A blackened iron anvil is bolted to a rise in the stone floor and dominates the cavern.  Red-orange firelight glows from the forge built into a natural shelf and recreates the anvil's shape in heroic size on the opposite wall.

title: [[Reach Forge, Western Smithy]]
description: The forge's builders took advantage of natural ledges in the cavern, hewing the unforgiving stone only to create the necessary chimneys.  A side-vented forge set on a natural shelf glows along the northern perimeter, throwing red-orange light across the massive iron anvil that dominates the center of the room.

title: [[Reach Forge, Supplies Shop]]
description: Though slightly cooler than the rest of the tunnel, the air in this cramped alcove is thick and dank.  Narrow airshafts drilled through the granite skin of the mountain provide entry for thin tendrils of light to illuminate a low counter along with a crate stuffed into a corner.

title: [[Reach Forge, Eastern Foundry]]
description: Waves of intense heat pour from the white-hot flames that flicker madly beneath the massive, polished granite crucible that hangs from a wooden swing-arm above.  Ready to be fed into the crucible, a healthy pile of fuel is shoved into the corner of the soot-darkened stone walls.

title: [[Reach Forge, Northern Foundry]]
description: Showers of angry red sparks fly from the fires raging beneath a large, black-veined crucible that hangs from a hinged wooden beam, ready to be swung onto the flames when needed.  Nearby, a platform is set up supporting the gears and lever of the cavern's ingot cutter.

title: [[Reach Forge, Western Foundry]]
description: Searing heat floods the cavern from the foundry fires, quickly warming whatever cool air enters from several airshafts drilled into the soot-blackened stone walls.  Raging flames dance below a large stone crucible hanging from a wooden beam so it can be moved on or off the fire.  At the far end of the room, a large pile of fuel waits to feed the flames.

title: [[Therenborough Inn, Sunken Fireplace]]
description: A brightly snapping fire of cedar logs burns in the red brick fireplace.  Recessed below the level of the common room, the fireplace hearth provides a quiet spot for rest and conversation.  Thickly furred animal pelts spread across the floor in front of the fire allow the weary traveler to recline in comfort.  Steps lead back up to the common room.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Main Hall]]
description: Thick glass windows reveal a view of the garden, sunlight streaming in to give the sparse room a warm glow.  Low wooden couches with sturdy maroon suede cushions create a space for the occasional moment of respite from the House's constant training regimen.  A sideboard carved with shesegri is perilously close to a red and black dartboard hung along a side stone wall.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Eastern Hall]]
description: A row of stately doors stands opposite the steeply arched, leaded windows that dominate the length of the long, narrow corridor.  Whitewashed plaster walls are undecorated save for the handsomely carved knotwork designs that grace the windowsills and door frames.  Stretching the length of the hall, a narrow grey carpet runs down the center of the immaculate wooden floor.  The occasional whisper of a hymn wafts from somewhere in the distance.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Chapel]]
description: Smooth stone walls and a simple wooden floor add to the serenity of the chapel.  A stained glass window displaying a vibrant image faces to the west.  Centered in the room is a broad stone altar, which, like its surroundings, is immaculate and unadorned.  Sparse, dark wooden benches are set alongside the walls, and thin woolen pillows are scattered on the hard floor.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Western Hall]]
description: The grey wood of the coarse floor stretches between a bank of doors and the row of tall, arched windows that looks down upon the garden outside.  Set amongst the panels of heavy silk-covered velvet that cover and insulate the bare slats of the walls, several large iron sconces support massive torches that offer both heat and light to the hall.  The occasional sounds of merriment drift from elsewhere in the building.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Meditation Garden]]
description: Darkness is dispersed by lanterns flanking the path around the lush lawn of the garden.  The scent of lavender perfumes the evening air, joining the sound of a bubbling fountain in the center of the garden.  Springy moss encircles the garden's focal point for any who care to kneel during their mediations.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Archery Range]]
description: The grassy field is completely flat except for the steeply angled berm to the south that has been designed to prevent missiles from escaping the area.  Numerous brightly painted targets stand along the stone wall that encircles the entire House proper, each kept ready for practice.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Dormitories]]
description: Flickering light from a torch mounted in a polished brass sconce adds to the meager light that filters through the leaded windows facing the street below.  Braided rugs of grey linen cover the clean wooden floors, the dull hue matching that of the stone walls.  A spiraling stair leads down to the first floor.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Dormitories]]
description: A narrow table supports a porcelain vase filled with fragrant lavender, the vibrant blue-violet brilliant against the dark wood and grey stone of the building.  A carved chandelier holds ivory candles overhead, providing light but little warmth.

title: [[House of the Steel Dove, Dormitories]]
description: Torches in polished brass sconces illuminate the stone hallway.  Rugs of woven grey linen pad the rich wood floor, and the faint scent of incense wafts from the stairs leading to the first level.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Blackened weeds poke up through the bog, clogging the terrain further still.  The area is still and quiet and the pools of stagnant water fetid.  No birds or wild animal calls can be heard, and a thick foggy haze clings near to the ground.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Faint whispers of the dried, dead reeds rustling in a short-lived breeze creep over the lifeless mire.  The stinking gloop is ever present and squelches grotesquely underfoot.  A dark silhouette fades into a darker sky far to the south.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: A great wall of reeds rises defiantly from the swamp, reaching well overhead.  Washes of color are visible through the occasional gap, and a heady fragrance permeates the air.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Peculiar amphibians occasionally peek out from behind patches of reeds, leaping into the sludge and swimming frantically for shelter elsewhere at any movement that disturbs the swampy quietness.  A dark object rises towards the sky far to the southwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: A small feeder of seemingly fresh water trickles into the area from the east, though a source of fresh water within the Zaulfung's reach is a rare commodity indeed.  The water mixes in a swirl with the polluted sludge common to the region, ruining any value it had.  Occasional bits of unidentifiable flotsam and jetsam drift lazily past.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mushroom Well]]
description: This small pocket vale is walled to the north and south by tall reeds that block some of the sludge that otherwise would overrun it.  The ground here is teeming with a veritable kaliedoscope of colored mushrooms in every stage of growth.  A peculiar greenish haze drifts along the caps of some of more mature mushrooms.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Stinking goo gurgles and slops with even the faintest movement.  Putrid smells from something long buried escape as small bubbles rise up and burst through the disturbed mush.  A stone marker is partially visible.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: To call the ground solid would be inaccurate, but the loose bog thickens to resemble something closer to dried out oatmeal.  Blackened weeds occasionally peek up from the dense fog of noxious swampy gas hugging the ground.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: A cloud of insects, one of the few signs of life in the area, hovers above a deteriorating length of bone that reaches skyward from the blackened sludge.  When a rare breeze swirls through, a faintly sweet odor mingles with the mire's noisome odors.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: A great wall of reeds rises defiantly from the swamp, reaching well overhead.  Washes of color are visible through the occasional gap, and a heady fragrance permeates the air.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Black, filthy sludge burbles atop the loose ground, forming a partial moat around a mound that rises to the south.  In the open expanse, light from the heavens above is muted considerably by the thick haze roiling over the ground as it fails to ascend the mound.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: Stinking goo gurgles and slops with even the faintest movement.  Putrid smells from something long buried escape as small bubbles rise up and burst through the disturbed mush.  A stone marker is partially visible.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Zaulfung, Monolith]]
description: Standing stolidly amongst wiry brown reeds, a stone monolith defies the erosion rampant in the swamp.  From the vantage of this mound, much of the surrounding area can be viewed, though there is little to see.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: In a patch of relatively stable ground, a single footprint remains forever visible as the mire refuses to reclaim it.  Or, perhaps, it's fresh from someone or something recently passing through.  Nearby, another mark looks as if something was dragged over the surface -- the blackened reeds are flattened along the path.

title: [[Zaulfung, Mire]]
description: The foul odor of decay hangs thick over a pile of compost littered with bones.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Zengmodaleth, Ancillary Rear Containment]]
description: A complex web of copper piping appears to cover the walls and ceiling, branching and merging as it traverses the length of the room.  The elastic ground appears to be composed of a darkly dyed fiber woven with strips of rubber.  Rippling blue and green light crackles throughout the area, strange shadows dancing around and emerging from the portal entrance.  You note the smell of ozone and lubricating solvents, and the warm air is extremely dry.

title: [[Zengmodaleth, T-Junction]]
description: The piping appears to abruptly bend here, running south and east.  A plaque made of polished oravir features a series of elemental symbols and a broad arrow pointing to the west, where the corridor appears to fade into a bright blue glow, the scent of oil thick in the air.  At semi-regular intervals, a loud metallic groan echoes through the area, trailing off to a series of rapid pops and clicks.

title: [[Zengmodaleth, Jalmor Olkan]]
description: The hallway abruptly ends here, and the splayed piping bends to the ground where it seems to feed a large pool from which emerge half a dozen stacked columns about a Gor'Tog's height across.  The pool is filled with a silvery-black liquid, and the columns crackle with energy and their surfaces churn as the strange fluid flows along narrow grooves etched along their sides.  Arrayed along the ceiling are gaethzen orbs, casting a bright, even light across the area.  A faint breeze swirls around, pushed by the motion of the fluid.

title: [[Zengmodaleth, Elbow Bend]]
description: From the north, a thick structure of flattened framework is mounted above, and as it approaches the hallway bend, branches outward into hundreds of pipes that splay across the wall and ceiling.  As the hallway continues, the piping runs through a series of access boxes, each encased in thick lead glass mounted on polished oravir hinges.  Visible behind the plate glass are brilliantly coruscating bands of energy, pulsating as they stream across the interior of the access box.  Sharp crackles and violent explosions can be heard to the north.

title: [[Zengmodaleth, Olkan Rae Audrus]]
description: The corridor abruptly ends, and you find yourself surrounded by an ephemeral bubble of blue energy, affording a view of an unfathomably vast metallic vertical structure composed of equal parts metal lattice, dodecahedrons crackling with electricity, and rippling spikes composed of pure energy.  Occasional errant whips of electricity soar outward from the structure and rake along the surface of the bubble, filling the area with blinding white light and a piercing whine that descends in tone as the incredible energy is shunted elsewhere.  Though only briefly visible as jagged arcs and lingering visual artifacts, the widening of the bolts as they cross from the column to your location suggests that the structure is unfathomably distant.  The bubble ripples and flexes with each strike, and you realize that the bolts are incredibly large.  In the distance, beyond the structure, there is simply emptiness.

title: [[Zeng Gelvit, Erest Kendia]]
description: Lashed by wrist, ankle, and waist, you are bound in seething electricity that shears and beats against a seemingly endless column of blinding energy.  Though you feel no sense of movement, you are vaguely aware of being snapped and forth along a tortuous zig-zag.

title: [[Plasma Vortex, Eastern Pylon]]
description: A softly glowing energy field pulses far above, behind which the pitch black and featureless sky is periodically crisscrossed with jagged bolts of filamentous lightning, unfurling in surges.  Thunder rattles the area both immediately and with delays, clouding any sense of scale or distance.  Ozone and lubricating solvents fill the air, and where the lightning strikes the field, blossoming sparks and ribbons of energy peel outward in mesmerizing displays.  To the west, a caged sphere of rapidly spinning purple screeches, incessantly lashing against four curved pylons placed in an enclosing square.

title: [[Plasma Vortex, Southern Pylon]]
description: A softly glowing energy field pulses far above, behind which the pitch black and featureless sky is periodically crisscrossed with jagged bolts of filamentous lightning, unfurling in surges.  Thunder rattles the area both immediately and with delays, clouding any sense of scale or distance.  Ozone and lubricating solvents fill the air, and where the lightning strikes the field, blossoming sparks and ribbons of energy peel outward in mesmerizing displays.  To the north, a caged sphere of rapidly spinning purple screeches, incessantly lashing against four curved pylons placed in an enclosing square.  A narrow walkway extends to the south.

title: [[Access Passage, Narrow Walkway]]
description: Barely wide enough to comfortably -- let alone safely -- walk across, the narrow bridge is build from wire-wrapped bars of silvery plated steel sunk into thick ceramic discs.  A single, thin silver cable railing provides slim security as one crosses the bridge.  Spanning a wide valley between the raging purple storm to the north and a blocky structure to the south, the overpass appears to be the only means across the divide, which stretches to the horizon to both the east and the west.  Errant gusts of dry air blast in random directions, carrying the scent of scorched metal, and a seething glow vibrates an indistinguishable distance below the walkway.

title: [[Access Passage, Middle of the Divide]]
description: Though fairly rigid, the narrow bridge sways slightly at this point, the cable railing bowing noticeably.  The air is warmer here, an upwelling of buoyant air providing a slight breeze.  To the far north, a purple storm rages atop a large platform, and to the far south, the bridge appears to enter a blocky structure.

title: [[Access Passage, Scador li Darva]]
description: The bridge seamlessly merges with the large building directly beneath a circular entryway, with no ledge, window, or feature otherwise marking the perfectly smooth silver walls of the structure.  An echoing reverberation can be heard deep within the building, a staccato pounding of metal on metal.

title: [[Plasma Vortex, Western Pylon]]
description: A softly glowing energy field pulses far above, behind which the pitch black and featureless sky is periodically crisscrossed with jagged bolts of filamentous lightning, unfurling in surges.  Thunder rattles the area both immediately and with delays, clouding any sense of scale or distance.  Ozone and lubricating solvents fill the air, and where the lightning strikes the field, blossoming sparks and ribbons of energy peel outward in mesmerizing displays.  To the east, a caged sphere of rapidly spinning purple screeches, incessantly lashing against four curved pylons placed in an enclosing square.

title: [[Plasma Vortex, Northern Pylon]]
description: A softly glowing energy field pulses far above, behind which the pitch black and featureless sky is periodically crisscrossed with jagged bolts of filamentous lightning, unfurling in surges.  Thunder rattles the area both immediately and with delays, clouding any sense of scale or distance.  Ozone and lubricating solvents fill the air, and where the lightning strikes the field, blossoming sparks and ribbons of energy peel outward in mesmerizing displays.  To the south, a caged sphere of rapidly spinning purple screeches, incessantly lashing against four curved pylons placed in an enclosing square.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Entrance]]
description: An expansive facility sprawls to the south, enormous workshops pumping and churning strangely glowing sheets of crackling energy into bizarre and unrecognizable constructions.  Rows of towering shelves hold perfect geometric forms bound in glossy silvery fiber, and a veritable army of custodians move in carefully choreographed service to the enterprise.  A circular entryway is the sole disruption to an otherwise perfectly featureless wall to the north.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Static Looms]]
description: Dozens of looms are arrayed here, silvery metal framework holding filament thin glowing wires of the warp taut, heddles vibrating too fast to follow, weft carriers oscillating back and forth in a blur.  Wound static fiber is delivered from below, the custodians ensuring a steady supply of the thread-like material for processing.  Performing esoteric adjustments to the machines, the custodians gather the finished weave on thick rollers and carry the cloth deeper into the facility.  To the southeast, a steady clanging of metal striking metal can be heard.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Charge Distaffs]]
description: Tall, inverted threaded ceramic cones are mounted on rotating bases below spikes protruding from the ceiling.  Fine, bristling clouds of branching lightning fan outward from the spikes and wind around the cones as static fiber.  The custodians gather the filled distaffs and transport them upstairs for processing, ensuring a steady flow of material.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Piezoelectric Bellows]]
description: Thick sheets of white metal and ceramic are mounted between thick pylons, crossed with long torque struts protruding from the ground.  Steadily pumping back and forth, the struts cause the sheets to flex.  With each cycle of deformation the sheets crackle with electricity, which surges along the pylons and up to the furnaces above.  The custodians tend to the assembly, ensuring smooth operation of the struts and proper contact of the sheets to the pylons.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Arc Furnace]]
description: Dozens of furnaces are arrayed here, thick, paired discs of silvery coated metal wrapped in copper and cambrinth wire and mounted a few yards apart.  The storms contained within are deafening, fed with glowing cables from below, pouring blindingly white liquid into channels for transport deeper into the facility.  The custodians maintain the forges, adjusting power levels and throughput via interactions that defy understanding.  To the southwest, a steady clanging of metal striking metal can be heard.

title: [[Scador li Darva, Ancillary Processing and Logistics]]
description: The focal point of the production to the north and above, the custodians gather processed materials and place them in a wide metal maw that regularly slams shut and opens, revealing an empty chamber.  Nearby shelving units are emptied and almost immediately refilled, and the custodians ensure a steady stream of deliveries.

title: [[Togball Field, Black Attack Zone South]]
description: Scraggly clumps of turf are interspersed with bare patches of dirt.  A hog skull on a stout blue pole marks the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Togball Field, Black Half-Forward South]]
description: Scraggly clumps of turf are interspersed with bare patches of dirt.  A cougar skull on a stout blue pole marks the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

description: Scraggly clumps of turf are interspersed with bare patches of dirt.  An ogre skull on a stout blue pole marks the area.

description: Scraggly clumps of turf are interspersed with bare patches of dirt.  A goblin skull on a stout blue pole marks the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Togball Field, Behind the Goal Line]]
description: There is little here other than a patchy covering of grass.  To the east is the field of play.  A stout log fence runs along the southern and western sides to prevent the attempted escape of panicked balls.

title: [[Togball Field, Behind the Goal]]
description: A stout log fence runs along the western edge of this area.  To the east are two thick orange logs embedded upright in the ground to serve as goalposts.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Togball Field, Orange Blood Zone]]
description: This part of the field is marred by numerous divots, leaving only a few hardy patches of grass undisturbed.  Two thick orange logs are embedded upright in the ground on the west side, forming the goal.  On the east end is a stout red pole with a goblin skull on top of it, signifying the edge of the Blood Zone.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Togball Field, Orange Half-Forward Center]]
description: Scraggly clumps of turf are interspersed with bare patches of dirt.  A faint track with no grass at all runs east-west down the center, likely the result of numerous 'Togs attempting to take the most direct route toward the goal.  A wolf skull on a stout red pole marks the area.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Togball Field, Midfield]]
description: This section of the field is virtually all dirt with almost no grass in evidence.  There is a small crater in the center, where countless scrambles for the ball have occurred.  A stout red pole with an ogre skull on it marks the area as Midfield.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.
