description: An upturned wheelbarrow has pinned down a torn length of floral print silk brocade, but the rest of its former load is nowhere to be seen.  Other bits of lightweight detritus have accumulated at the corners of the large room.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Shipping]]
description: Inexplicably windswept and smeared, a large chalkboard mounted to the eastern wall is now barely identifiable as a shipping schedule.  Scraps of fabric mill about the drafty, unfurnished room.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Packing Floor]]
description: Someone or something has cleanly sliced through several of the heavy cedar support beams here, resulting in a roof collapse at the northwestern end of the room.  A draft blows in through the impassible rubble.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Packing Floor]]
description: Overturned tables, packing crates, and textile racks clutter the workspace in disarray.  An oddly persistent draft sweeps through the area, accompanied by the soft rustle of windswept fabric.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Packing Floor]]
description: A long spool of Elothean lace is roughly strung around the area in a tangled zigzag, looking much like a shroud of cobwebs over the haphazard stacks of packing crates.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Packing Floor]]
description: Any signs of this drafty area's original purpose have long since been reduced to miscellaneous debris.  The wood-paneled northern wall rises several yards overhead to meet the edge of the storehouse's second tier, where a sheet of torn crimson cloth can be seen flapping from the guard railing above.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Lower Level Landing]]
description: A pile of wreckage has accumulated at the base of the cedar plank ramp that connects the two tiers of the storehouse, apparently having tumbled unceremoniously down the wooden incline.  Across the room, a collection of scales, measuring boards, and other implements of quality control is in a similar state of ravaged neglect.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Upper Level Landing]]
description: Snagged on the second tier guardrail, a sheet of torn crimson cloth flaps futilely from its captive position.  Movement is occasionally detectable far below, but from this distance it is difficult to tell if it's more billowing fabric or something else entirely.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Red Dye Room]]
description: A thin layer of Elothean-red mineral powder coats every visible surface of this derelict dye chamber.  The color is especially pronounced where the chalky pigment has collected in the cracks and corners of the hardwood flooring.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Blue Dye Room]]
description: Baskets of dried etrana blossoms flank the large copper dyeing vat that dominates the center of the workspace here.  Most of the woven vessels have long since tipped and spilled, their deep blue contents left to scatter to the furthest dusty corners of the room.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Green Dye Room]]
description: Errant fabric scraps litter the sparse workroom.  Near the eastern wall, a prominent jade-hued stain spreads outward from a capsized copper dyeing vat.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Purple Dye Room]]
description: Deep purple liquid is congealing in a large copper vat at the center of the room, developing a rather noticeable stench in the process.  The color of the stagnant ooze is a far cry from the attractive amaranthine and royal purple hues sported by the shredded skeins of silk suspended on nearby drying lines.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Workspace]]
description: More demolished furniture and snippets of loose cloth garnish this unremarkable corridor.  An occasional draft sweeps through, carrying new scraps in and old scraps out, perpetuating the decay.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Workspace]]
description: Broken glass mingles with discarded scraps of fabric along the western wall of this neglected workspace, where a long cutting table sits empty and disused beneath a row of shattered windows.  The doorway at the northern end of the room is nearly obstructed by the rubble.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Barricaded Corridor]]
description: Aside from a single lantern flickering at the center of the room, everything in this narrow hallway has been divided and pushed up against the two exits.  To the north, a towering stack of packing crates poses a formidable barricade, and to the south, a long table and some overturned lockers have almost, but not quite, managed to block the doorway.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Supply Room]]
description: A puddle of dried wax sealant is crusted to the floor beneath a tall supply shelf on the northern wall, and the lingering scent of bleach emanates from the mostly-broken bottles contained therein.  At the opposite end of the room, several large crates have been stacked to create a makeshift barricade across one of the exits.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Supply Room]]
description: Another expanse of fabric scraps covers the floor here, shards of glass mixed in with the debris.  Broken windows along the western wall allow the occasional gust of wind inside to stir the derangement.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, south.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Records Room]]
description: Only a few old fashion catalogs and inventory ledgers are recognizable amongst the massive piles of inscrutable paperwork that clutter every inch of this ravaged room.  Colorful cloth scraps, blown in from other parts of the storehouse, have joined the mess.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Argosy]]
description: Fallen kimono-clad mannequins lie among smashed chests expelling fine brocades and damask-woven silks, indicating that this back corner of the storehouse once functioned as a storage vault.  A single dress form has maintained an upright position, but its bejeweled silk samite robe has been slashed to miserable shreds.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Argosy]]
description: A line of resplendent tapestries along the northern wall has been neatly severed, showing only the slightest hint of fraying at the diagonal slash that runs along the hangings' new bottom hems.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Supply Room]]
description: A jumble of pins and needles carpets the hardwood floor here.  Scissors, clothes irons, and other heavier sewing tools have, for the most part, managed to hold their positions on the room's supply shelves and wall-mounted peg racks.

title: [[Kiora'ylen Storehouse, Supply Room]]
description: An intricately shelved assortment of embroidery thread has been reduced to a massive psychedelic snarl on the supply room floor.  Although it's suffered a noticeable slash, the shesegri design chart mounted to the eastern wall has apparently fared the destructive conditions of the storehouse far better.

title: [[Many Sign of Many Savage, Open Chamber]]
description: Holes in the chamber's roughly hewn walls allow air to circulate in and out from other nearby facilities.  Tapestries and maps depicting far off places are prominently displayed, and the shop's owner frequently pauses before one or another to stare wistfully.  As patrons come and go, he seems particularly excited by non-Dwarven visitors and does his best to speak to them in very broken common.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Summit Pathway]]
description: Set into a bermed nook, a simple wooden lean-to provides shelter against the elements, and affords travlers an opportunity to rest in the shade.  The andesite ground is faintly rippled and scoured from the elements.  The path continues to the north, curving around a bend, and an open reinforced wooden barricade allows passage back down to the vale.

Set into a bermed nook, a simple wooden lean-to provides shelter against the elements, and affords travelers an opportunity to rest in the shade.  The andesite ground is faintly rippled and scoured from the elements.  The track continues to the north, curving around a bend and an open reinforced wooden barricade allows passage back down to the vale while a steep, narrow path leads to a rocky ledge.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Summit Pathway]]
description: Revealed by weathering, thin hexagonal columnar joints form an outcropping on an otherwise effectively sheer face.  Carved steps allow for an easy climb up to a series of quarried platforms set into the cliff.  The air smells of sulfur and hot ash.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Cliff Face]]
description: Carved into the rock face, the columnar basalt has been rough hewn, resulting in numerous deep seated platforms.  Littered with large bones and lined with blackened fulgurite nodules spidering along the stone, the space appears to provide rest for more than just climbers scaling the cliff.  Further down the volcano, the waves beat against a black sand beach.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Cliff Edge]]
description: A largely flat and even surface set into the volcano marks a short, rough plain.  Haphazard boulders are scattered around, shattered as if dropped from great height.  Heavy winds have swept the area of smaller debris, revealing hexagonal jointing with largely even elevation, exacting lines abruptly ending with the cliff edge.  The height and unobstructed view affords an excellent vantage of the ocean.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Rockslide Plain]]
description: Set into the volcano's side, the flat plain appears to be caused by a rockslide, though the area has been largely cleared of debris.  The area is dotted with several large nests composed of thick branches and shredded wood.  The ground and wall face are crisscrossed with black and green glassy fulgurite spikes and droplets.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Cliff Edge]]
description: A tall menhir made of weathered marble overlooks the ocean view and is set neatly between the hexagonal lines of the columnar ground.  Seabirds soar along the coast and the littoral waves are battered by the prevailing winds and tides.  The ground is swept clean, ending abruptly at the cliff's edge.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, A Private Forge]]
description: Thick walls struggle to contain the blistering heat of the workshop where the fires blaze endlessly night and day.  The flickering flames give a reddish glow to the racks and shelves of tools and equipment, all neatly placed and ready for use.  Workers enter in their protective gear from time to time, checking the equipment and reporting back to a sentry at the entry.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Lodge Interior]]
description: The walls of the lodge are covered with the hides and skins of many different animals.  You recognize the pelts of otter, fox, deer and wolf.  Despite the spacious size of the lodge, the air in the windowless building is thick and hazy.  You can smell the residue of an aromatic, heavy smoke.  A large firepit in the center of the room is placed below the ceiling's smoke hole.  A massive rack attached to one wall holds enough weapons for a small army.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Firepit]]
description: The air around the firepit is heavy with a sweet-smelling smoke.  A hole in the ceiling, directly above the pit, provides some relief with an occasional breeze.  Carved pipes and rattles made from gourds have been left on the dirt floor.  A tall barbarian warrior sits next to the fire, carefully attaching some eagle feathers to the end of a lance.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Hidden Path]]
description: A narrow path has been cleared through the clumps of sage bushes, tall grasses, untended wildflowers that grow abundantly here.  The tall somber trees of Wildulf Woods form a wall beyond a clearing to the north.  A small, cramped doorway leads back into the lodge.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Secluded Clearing]]
description: A single aged willow tree stands in the center of this wide clearing, its drooping boughs sway and creak, reaching for the ground.  This ancient symbol of death and rebirth shelters an open-air shrine that has been erected at the base of the tree's gnarled trunk.  Small tufts of broad-leafed hosta plants surround the shrine.  Impenetrable walls of densely-packed trees and brush cut off any exit except to the south.

title: [[Wolf Clan Home, Seer's Circle]]
description: Within the densely-packed timberland sits a round, flat arena hemmed by a circle of hewn logs.  Two additional logs have been set at opposite sides of this circle, each adorned with talismans of feathers and beads affixed to the skulls of wolves.  Beneath them, leather strips dyed in bright colors dance and flutter in the soft breeze.  The arena itself is composed of hard-packed dirt which bears the scars of innumerable steps, slides and turns executed in some kind of precise, battle-inspired dance.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Fumarole Passage]]
description: Sulfur crystals encrust the walls, shattered and scraped bare in places by deep claw marks.  The passage extends into the volcano at a modest downward angle, illuminated by a red glow.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Borehole Overlook]]
description: Opening onto a glowing red abyss, a wide bell-like expansion stretches down into the depths.  Hot, dry, stinging air roars upward, a howling updraft that whistles along the walls and across the edge.  Riveted into the ground, a thick steelsilk rope allows for an easy descent to the chamber floor below.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Hav'roth's Bridge]]
description: The wide causeway extends as a large semi-circle across the magma, the rippled, black stone curving gently between the north and south chambers.  To the north, billowing clouds of choking gas swirl malevolently with ash and streaking embers, the ground cracked and glowing red as magma flows beneath barely cooled crust.  To the south, a mournful melody echoes along the walls, the chamber darker and cooler.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ushnish's Rage]]
description: Howling winds blast all around, and crevices burst with yellow hot liquid stone.  Cooling bubbles fade to black, illuminated softly from within with a dull red, occasionally blistering and pushing forward slightly, hissing in a sibilant rumble as the ground shifts in a precarious and mesmerizing flow.  Visibility is limited as hot embers and ash swirl chaotically.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ushnish's Rage]]
description: A large pit opens here, billowing lava welling upward, cooling as it hits the air to form a thin skin of stone that shifts with the undercurrent.  Crackling as it moves, the stone skin exposes lines of brighter red magma, jagged and constantly in motion.  Searingly hot air roars around chaotically, thick with noxious fumes.  The walls glisten with metal and gem formations.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ushnish's Rage]]
description: Several hollowed out boulders rise slightly from the ground, smoking and glowing with heat, but absent of the ever present magma.  Thick rock scales line the inside of the boulders, piled carefully around several egg-shaped black stones.  From deep within the swirling clouds and murky shadows echoes an angry hiss.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Peri'el's Calm]]
description: The air is merely warm here, the tortuous heat diffusing harmlessly.  Jingling bells tinkle in the distance, a melody muffling the chaos to the north.  The dark banded rocks of the ground twist and kink, metallic inclusions glimmering in the faint light.  The walls and ceiling waver slightly.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Peri'el's Calm]]
description: The ground is littered with blackened seashells and the area resounds with an oceanic hissing, reminiscent of the surf.  As the volcano's cacophonous sounds vie for attention, something akin to soft vocals pierce the din, but its source remains elusive.  Glimmering deep within the vaguely transparent banded walls, gemstones flicker with luminescence.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Peri'el's Calm]]
description: Striations of reds, yellows, lavenders, and blacks ripple along the floor, wall and ceiling, seeming to ebb and flow in the faint light.  Wafting through the area, a cool breeze gently carries a soft, soothing song.  A long, scorched gouge mars the wall, and a ragged chunk of stone is torn free.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Central Vault]]
description: Interspersed with painted almagarus flower tiles, glittering cobblestone flooring stretches across the cavernous hold.  A barrel vaulted ceiling adds more height to the already spacious chamber, its simple sloped arch curving between the stacked stone walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Southern Vault]]
description: Interspersed with painted horeb root tiles, glittering cobblestone flooring stretches across the cavernous hold.  A barrel vaulted ceiling adds more height to the already spacious chamber, its simple sloped arch curving between the stacked stone walls.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Eastern Vault]]
description: Interspersed with painted tamarind tree tiles, glittering cobblestone flooring stretches across the cavernous hold.  A barrel vaulted ceiling adds more height to the already spacious chamber, its simple sloped arch curving between the stacked stone walls.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Northern Vault]]
description: Interspersed with painted dirdel flower tiles, glittering cobblestone flooring stretches across the cavernous hold.  A barrel vaulted ceiling adds more height to the already spacious chamber, its simple sloped arch curving between the stacked stone walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Western Vault]]
description: Interspersed with painted Elvish urn tiles, glittering cobblestone flooring stretches across the cavernous hold.  A barrel vaulted ceiling adds more height to the already spacious chamber, its simple sloped arch curving between the stacked stone walls.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Continuing to spiral in a slight incline, the gilded deobar planks are flanked by stacked stone walls.  Thin streamers of glittery silk hang from gaethzen sconces in graceful twists and loops.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, The Vaults]]
description: Enclosed by stacked stone walls, gilded deobar planks form a graceful spiraling ramp with a gentle incline.  Thin streamers of glittery silk hang from gaethzen sconces in festive swoops and swags.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Crystal Chamber]]
description: The narrow, sloping sides of the vaulted ceiling create a mirror-like effect that amplifies the vivid colors that saturate the room's curved walls.  Constantly shifting in their prismatic dance, brilliant rainbows emerge from a massive, glittering crystal that is suspended in mid-air at the very center of the room.  Multiple open corridors branch away from the circular room, but an undulating, kaleidoscopic ward blocks access to all passageways except for the one to the north.  An ornately gilded ramp, located directly beneath the crystal, leads downwards into another area.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Corridor]]
description: Overlain with decorative wood slats, the stacked stone walls form a narrow passageway to traverse through.  Tiny glittering tiles are pieced together into a colorful mosaic floor, depicting a pattern of swirling orlog faces.  Flanked by gaethzen sconces, jewel-toned brocade tapestries bring a touch of softness to the long corridor.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting rainbow hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting violet hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting indigo hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting blue hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting green hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Aesthene's Close, Chronoscape]]
description: Shifting orange hues pulse overhead, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless ceiling.  Fractured orlogs are jumbled together and form a floor of wreckage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Foyer]]
description: The entrance area is a grand affair with an octagonal floorplan.  Strategic cutouts in the building's stone walls provide a view of the night sky beyond the brightly illuminated room.  To the east, a winding corridor leads to the supply shops, while a spiraling bronze staircase rises from the floor of blue marble.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Society Master's Office]]
description: Tastefully appointed, the circular room is ringed with shelves of books.  A throne-like chair of afrormosia inlaid with golden sigils sits behind a matching desk whose surface is covered in neat stacks of parchment.  Nearby, a marble plinth supports a hazy crystal ball set in a filigreed base.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Corridor]]
description: An azure carpet embroidered with elaborate geometric patterns runs the length of the hallway, flanked by a trio of arched doorways leading to the supply shops.  Hanging on the opposite wall is a silken tapestry depicting the crests of the Great Houses of Ratha.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Bookstore]]
description: Towering albarco bookshelves completely obscure the walls, the many codices and rolled parchments neatly organized by topic.  A sturdy ladder attached to the bookshelves on brass rollers allows the wizened Halfling shopkeeper to reach even the highest shelves when helping customers.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Tool Store]]
description: Bronze sconces ring the small room, casting a flickering light across the glass display cases that house the implements for sale.  Sitting nearby on a wooden stool with a padded seat, a bespeckled S'Kra Mur assistant idly reads the local newspaper when she is not assisting customers.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Supply Outlet]]
description: In the back of the room, several apprentice mages work diligently to prepare the sigil-scrolls, totems, and other supplies needed by patrons of the enchanting arts.  Finished products are stored in an ilombo counter with drawers labeled in several local languages.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Gathering Hall]]
description: Mirroring the octagonal floorplan of the room below, the room's parquet floor depicts an eight-pointed compass.  The cardinal points lead to gilded workroom doors, while the shorter intercardinal points face full-length stained glass windows.  The darkened windows depict the four septs of the Ru'atin Peri'el, their hands and voices upraised.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Elemental Workroom]]
description: Large hexahedra of gaethzen hang above the brightly polished worktable of flamewood, providing reliable illumination for those working at night.  A tile mosaic on the floor forms the havri'negh symbol of the elements -- rings of rich brown for earth, pale blue for air, bright red for fire, and deep blue for water joined by the gold serrated electricity circle, all surrounding a silver aethereal star.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Life Workroom]]
description: A large skylight offers a breathtaking view of the night sky, while gaethzen fireflies illuminate the sturdy worktable of greenheart.  Tropical plants grow along all of the walls and in pots hanging from the ceiling.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Lunar Workroom]]
description: A large skylight provides an expansive view of the heavens, while stars of gaethzen illuminate the silvery worktable, which has been engraved with constellations.  Festooning the walls are tapestries of starlight velvet that depict the moons -- Katamba, Xibar, Yavash, and Grazhir.

title: [[Ratha Enchanting Society, Holy Workroom]]
description: A large skylight provides an expansive view of the heavens.  Large spheres of gaethzen hang above the brightly polished worktable of white silver, providing unfaltering illumination.  Colorful frescoes depicting the principal deities of the S'Kra Mur adorn the walls and offer a source of inspiration to those working within.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Bank]]
description: A one-legged Gor'Tog bank clerk attends to the needs of patrons at a wooden counter from behind thin steel bars that terminate at the ceiling.  Along the counter sit various scales and ledgers and other implements of finance.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Coin Exchange]]
description: Separating the coin exchange from the bank counter is a heavy leather curtain that muffles the sound of transactions that would otherwise echo in the stone chamber.  The unmistakable glints of copper, bronze, gold, silver and platinum flash in the dim light.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Canteen]]
description: Brass hooks, small shelves, and niches filled with merchandise honeycomb the curved stone wall of the alcove.  In the center, neatly stacked crates and baskets surround a tall stool surmounted by an elderly Dwarf, who conducts transactions with a kind, gravelly voice.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Cavern of Gathering]]
description: Petrified peregan trees stand at even intervals down the length of the massive cavern, arching upward as if seeking the sky.  Hung with small lamps and thousands of brass leaves, their branches twine overhead and create a forest bower deep in the earth.  The metallic foliage seems to flutter in the breeze as the shifting lamplight dances over it and slight vibrations cause them to clink together musically.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Archery Yard]]
description: The yard is enclosed on three sides by the arching trees of the woods and to the south by the bark-covered rear wall of the longhouse.  Thick pillows of moss and tufts of grass patch the ground, except where a footpath leading downrange to the targets has been worn through, exposing the dark stony soil beneath.  A cord-bound ladder leads up to the roof of the guildhall.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Longhouse Roof]]
description: Tawny thatching slopes gently down either side of a rounded gable, looking more like a long meadow ridge than a rooftop.  In the center, a wood-framed smokehole is propped open to allow wispy grey curls of smoke to escape from the longhouse into the freedom of the open sky.  A post at the far end of the roof supports taut wires that disappear into the forest.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Small Cavern]]
description: A bathing pool glistens like liquid gold in the light of many lanterns suspended from the ceiling.  The soothing sound of water steadily running down the rock face echoes gently, punctuated by the occasional *plop!* in varied, musical tones.  Amid blankets and pelts on the floor sits a small table.

title: [[Ranger Guild, A Stony Ledge]]
description: Amid the lanterns hung high above a glistening bathing pool, the stony ledge offers a panoramic view of the cavern hollowed from the earth by the spring water dissolving minerals.  Arches, stalagmites and stalactites contribute to an oblique landscape with dramatic curves and folds of stone.  A natural rock slide funnels down to the pool below.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Bathing Pool]]
description: Golden shimmers of lamplight ripple across the surface of the pool.  Fed from a source below, the warm water swirls softly against the bank of the stony basin with a gentle shushing sound.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Underground Spring]]
description: The turbulent current churns rhythmically with pockets of warmer water constantly bubbling to the surface.  Small pebbles whirled with the force of the river become dangerous projectiles, capable of scarring the smooth stone walls as well as soft flesh.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Underground Spring]]
description: Hot spring water bubbles up from cracks in the stone and mingles with the chilly currents of the Liirewsag River flowing in through a narrow crevice.  The turbulent water roils and whirls steadily against the smooth rock walls.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Underground Spring]]
description: The water churns rhythmically with pockets of warmer water constantly bubbling to the surface.  Flecks of mica in the stone walls glimmer in the lamplight that easily penetrates the crystal clear water.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Hot Spring]]
description: A pale veil of mist hangs at the surface of the bubbling hot spring, washing everything in dreamlike clouds that drift slowly away.  On the bank of the pool cling thick pillows of moss, providing a soft cushion against the stone.  The sweet smell of jasmine scents the air.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Greenhouse]]
description: A steamy, bubbling pool sits in the center of the glass greenhouse surrounded by feathery ferns.  The warm, humid air rises and condenses on everything, fogging the panes of glass and making the leaves of the tropical plants glisten with moisture in the diffused daylight.  Thin tendrils of smoky green maiden's tress moss hang from beams and host plants.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Greenhouse]]
description: A bench swing nestles in a lush green corner filled with temperate plants, including a variety of ivy and roses in a wide array of colors, scents and sizes, from giant golden sun roses and delicate pink Hodierna's blush roses to petite DiSilveron black rosettes.  Rare watermist roses surround a small pool into which splashes a waterfall built from piles of riverstone.  The rich smells of damp earth underscore the heady, sweet aroma of the flowers.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Greenhouse]]
description: The long glass greenhouse is home to most of the realms' many varieties of plants and flowering shrubs.  Nearest the door, open vents keep the environment cooler and drier than further in, where more exotic plant collections are housed.  Native flora thrives year-round here and provides valuable specimens for study.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Garden]]
description: A long glass greenhouse sits in the center of a manicured lawn dotted with seasonal flowerbeds and a wide variety of small gardens.  Woody shrubs surrounding the clearing create a gentle transition into the tall trees of the forest.  Centered in a grassy circle in front of the greenhouse door is a granite sundial with a vine-carved border and a bronze plaque.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Garden]]
description: A sun-dappled lawn patched with clover and wood anemones spreads beneath fine native specimen trees.  Lofty hardwoods surround a soaring peregan tree whose branches shelter an ivy-clad garden shed with a rough plank door.

title: [['The Tiny Expedition', Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, while the oaken walls are unadorned.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Silent Ascent]]
description: Deep banks of snow choke the steep, narrow passage.  The surroundings are unnaturally still and perfectly soundless the ceaseless howling of the wind below conspicuously absent.  A tiny assortment of stunted trees and shrubs struggle to survive against all odds.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Silent Ascent]]
description: Deep banks of snow choke the steep, narrow passage.  The surroundings are unnaturally still and perfectly soundless the ceaseless howling of the wind below conspicuously absent.  Shimmering ice crystals float effortlessly above the hoar frost.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Silent Ascent]]
description: Deep banks of snow choke the steep, narrow passage.  The surroundings are unnaturally still and perfectly soundless the ceaseless howling of the wind below conspicuously absent.  Shimmering ice crystals float effortlessly above the hoar frost, and an aberrant chill seeps through air.

title: [[The Frozen Heavens, Silent Ascent]]
description: Deep banks of snow choke the steep, narrow passage.  The surroundings are unnaturally still and perfectly soundless the ceaseless howling of the wind below conspicuously absent.  Shimmering ice crystals hang effortlessly in the air, sparkling in the daylight.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: Short juniper and cedar hunker in snowdrifts, wind whipped but reaching for the available light.  Several pathways through the snow suggest heavy traffic, though the tracks are unclear.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: Sparse trees provide a poor windbreak, resulting in frequent icy gusts tearing across the area.  The ground is swept clean of snow, and the bare dirt is smooth and even.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: A pair of trees stands to the southwest, their surface roots cleanly pruned back.  Oval pebbles are scattered in radiating lines emanating from the east and southeast.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: All flora has been stripped from the area, and the ground is covered in oval pebbles, tightly packed in an intricate mosaic.  To the east, several large boulders block further passage.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: A lone aspen rises from the south and the ground is covered in oval pebbles, tightly packed in an intricate mosaic.  To the east, several large boulders block further passage, fine columnar red crystals growing between the gaps in the rocky wall.

title: [[Kruar Li Dael, Clearing]]
description: A line of birch and pine marks the southern boundary of the clearing providing a partial windbreak.  The ground is littered with oval pebbles, but is otherwise clean of debris.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, northwest.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: Bent and smashed rusty steel bars are all that remains of the barricade separating the pens from the togball field to the east.  The ground is churned to a thick mud, and is devoid of any plant growth.  The air reeks of animal waste and rotting flesh.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: Thick oak beams serve as a tall, impenetrable fence to the south and west, topped with sharpened iron pikes.  A large dug out pit filled with scattered bone and tufts of fur stretches to the north.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: Large gaps in the fence open to the thick forest to the west.  Muddy hoofprints fan out into the woods, with equivalent traffic coming back to the pens.  The nearby trees bear thick gouges, the bark peeled from their trunks.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: Several large branches and tree trunks lay shattered and splintered here, chewed to a pulp and scattered in the mud.  Bits of torn iron bands and thick chain links are scattered in the remains.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: A thick timbered feeding trough lays broken here, trampled into the mud.  Bits of gristle cling to several large, fresh animal bones which lay half buried nearby, mixed with wood pulp and thick rusted nails.

title: [[Boar Clan, Tusky Pens]]
description: Sunk deep into the muck and wide as an oak trunk, a post rests here at a sharp angle, its top adorned with a short steel chain with links as thick as a Gor'Tog's thumb.  The chain terminates at a broken link, the metal warped and twisted at the weld.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Buy The Way, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A black oak desk and an ironwood table sit on the stained oak floor, with a steel trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  Some black oak shelves hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a black oak cabinet along the edges of the room.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Training]]
description: Weights are stacked neatly against the walls, standing ready for whoever or whatever next wants to work on the ability to lift heavy masses.  Deep gouges on the floor testify to occasional misadventures in the past.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Training]]
description: Jutting out from the walls are a number of metal bars running parallel to the walls, each set at a different height.  The varied elevations allow for easy training by those of differing statures.  A bowl of powdered chalk stands off to one side, providing an aid for sweaty grips.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west.

title: [[The Black Spire, Intercessor Training]]
description: Ropes and cables drape and hang from the ceilings and snake across the area to sturdy bolts sunk into the masonry walls.  Thick mats cover the floor, cushioning any falls from the adventurous users of the training equipment. Subdued lighting comes from the gaethzen spheres scattered about the space.

title: [[The Black Spire, Top of Rope]]
description: Dusty cobwebs traverse this corner of the ceiling, which is shrouded in shadows.  A rugged bolt anchors a thick hempen rope that dangles down to the floor.

title: [[Gyfford's Bridge, Northwest Embankment]]
description: Ascending the steep bank of the ravine across the Mistwood Forest floor, a terraced abutment of stone and mortar supports the cobblestone embankment of the northwest face of this bridge.  Layers of stone follow the gradient of the bridge to provide support, with visible color variation from the granite and quartzite used in its construction.

title: [[Gyfford's Bridge, Deck]]
description: From atop the sturdy construction of the arching bridge, you can observe broken rocks scattered at the bottom of the ravine over a safety wall.  Wind whips through the narrow ravine.  Beneath you, quartzite and granite cobblestone provides a firm support in what would otherwise undoubtedly be a precarious position, a testament to engineering.  A plaque at the pinnacle of the arch marks the dedication of the bridge.

title: [[Gyfford's Bridge, Southeast Embankment]]
description: The forest has been cleared away from the approach of this bridge, allowing room for a wide abutment that supports an embankment that arcs over the ravine in the Mistwood Forest floor.  Granite and quartzite are layered in a cobblestone pattern, leading upward to a deck supported entirely from the stone construction on each side.

title: [[Sand Spit Tavern, The Raven's Nest]]
description: Strewn about the makeshift establishment is a variety of out of place looking chairs and tables that look like they have been nabbed at opportune moments and repurposed.  A heavy metallic smell emanates from a circle of rust-stained rags in this ramshackled speakeasy during its off hours.  Near the roughly carved entrance stands a nondescript box affixed with a hastily written note.

A cacophony of cheers and groans emanate from a crowd circled around a rust-stained ring of rags in the center of the makeshift speakeasy.  A series of grunts and shouts sound out over the gathering while groups of cloaked figures shy away from the commotion and cluster together at mismatched sets of well-crafted tables and chairs that are carelessly arranged around the perimeter.  Occasionally, a figure draped in a feathered cloak moves through the dim flickering light in the room to stand near a nondescript box at the jagged entrance.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Smooth Limb]]
description: Much of the outer bark of this limb has been stripped away, leaving exposed the smooth inner wood of the tree.  Though the limb extends far out to the north it would be dangerous to proceed further in that direction.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Twisted Limb]]
description: The growth of this limb has been twisted by the weight of several branches pressing against it.  It manages, however, to provide a stable perch for climbers despite its oddly configured dips and curves.  Moving further along the limb to the southwest would be practical only for birds and squirrels, but one might travel down the limb to the main trunk of the tree with ease.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Scarred Limb]]
description: Lightning from a long forgotten storm has left a legacy of scars along the length of this tree limb.  The limb thins quickly as it extends to the southeast, making it impossible to proceed any further in that direction.  It is, however, possible to go back down to the main trunk of the tree.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Center Branches]]
description: The spreading branches of the oak tree reach far out into the sunlit sky.  One main limb extends toward the east while another, badly scratched limb, grows to the west.  High in the foliage above is a small wooden platform and below can be seen the trampled ground of 'Neer's Hummock.

title: [[Wolf Oak, Treetop]]
description: Situated in the uppermost branches of the mighty oak the wooden platform has been well anchored and braced, obviously built to last.  The sun warms the structure while cooling breezes blow the scent of grass through the surrounding leaves.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Cloyingly thick, the omnipresent stench of the stream permeates the area with a sickening miasma.  Icy fingers of mist slither around once prospering trees, as if groping blindly for victims to choke.  Dim reflections float on the dark waters, shattering and reforming with the slow moving current.

title: [[Vela'Tohr Woods, Blighted Tangle]]
description: Icy fingers of water trickle down the sheer cliff and form a fetid rivulet that wends its way sluggishly south.  Chill winds tear at the brittle branches of dying silverwillows huddling close to the slow moving water.  Rotting leaves and branches form a loose tangle of debris in the rivulet, caught on stones slick with slimy black moss.

title: [[Hirems Holdings, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, and an ironwood rack hangs on the oaken walls.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Seashell Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Sienna Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Verdigris Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Raspberry Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Marigold Stand]]
description: Surrounding the stand, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Vermilion Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Charcoal Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Chestnut Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Lemon Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Hazel Shop]]
description: Surrounding the shop, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Peach Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[A'baya Esplanade, At a Puce Alcove]]
description: Surrounding the alcove, colorful tapestries advertise the wonders of the available merchandise.

title: [[Damaris' Temple, Altar Hall]]
description: A long narrow hall focuses attention on an altar at the western end.  The only ornament is the floor, an image of an elongated panther created from black marble floor tiles set against white shimmering stone.  The paws of the panther embrace the altar, and its tail curves around to the door leading outside the temple.

title: [[Damaris' Temple, Dream Hall]]
description: Three walls of the inner sanctum are hung with soft, black velvet drapes that muffle sound and still the air.  A silver floor reflects soft images of worshipers like a wavering mirror.  A rectangular shallow pool covers half the area, the silvery bottom sparkling beneath the water's ripples.  Black silk pillows are placed in perfect symmetry at the edge of the pool, facing the fourth blank, black wall.

title: [[Chadatru's Temple, Forecourt]]
description: A row of columns frames the tall, broad temple building that rises ahead.  Hundreds of burning candles rest on the low courtyard walls, illuminating this small forecourt and brightening the white pebbles underfoot.  A fountain above the altar on the western wall spills fresh water over its surface, keeping the altar glistening softly in the candle light.

title: [[Chadatru's Temple, Great Hall]]
description: A smooth, red tile floor, the color of fresh blood, flows underfoot.  A hewn statue of a lion stands amidst this apparent pool of life -- or death.  The lion is carved in great detail from a creamy marble and stands over seven feet high and spans more than ten feet.  The mane is tinged with dark streaks and its eye sockets are hollow, the eyes missing.  A plaque rests in the floor at the lion's right front foot.

title: [[Everild's Temple, Interior]]
description: This circular temple contains one mammoth-sized boulder with a small cave hollowed on one side.  A boar statue rests inside the cave, with one eye open, watching.

title: [[Everild's Temple, Inside the Cave]]
description: The small cave provides a rustic setting for the boar statue, which is made of cold bronze.  Although poised as if sleeping, its body is tense and a single open eye appears to watch every movement.

title: [[Paladins' Guild, Eamonn's Office]]
description: A black marble desk flanked by two large platinum braziers sits directly in front of a large open window that overlooks the city.  The vaulted four-paneled ceiling is decorated with beautiful images and deep green ivy overflows from gold-leaf planters in the corners of the room and winds its way up the adjacent marble columns.

title: [[Paladins' Guild, Second Floor Landing]]
description: The landing provides access to the second floor rooms of the guild, as well as to the Grand Hall, via a circular staircase.  A heavy bronze bound door leads to the Library, as indicated by the large word "LIBRARY" engraved on the bronze plate that has been mounted next to it.

title: [[Paladins' Guild, Grand Hall of Light]]
description: A magnificent chamber of great breadth and height crowns the guild, the walls almost totally comprised of windows which allow the room to be flooded with sunlight.  White stone floors are dotted with various skin throws and accented with gold inlay around the edges.  In the center of the room, a large round table is surrounded by several chairs and benches.

title: [[Paladins' Guild, Observation Deck]]
description: Surrounded by a heavy stone balustrade, the tower commands a three hundred sixty degree view of Ratha and the sparkling sea beyond. A brass standard, supporting an ancient spyglass is mounted on a raised pedestal in the center of the floor.

title: [[Dirge, Barracks Mess-hall]]
description: The mess-hall and dining room for the militia, the place now shows little sign of use.  The fireplace is cold and bare of ashes and the furniture is gone, leaving only some shelves and empty food lockers.

title: [[Dirge, Barracks Dormitory]]
description: This large upper room has only narrow windows looking out.  Really more arrow slits than windows, this was obviously meant to be a redoubt in case of attack.  In safer times it also served as the dormitory for those townsfolk who stood guard.  Someone still uses the place for there are several cots with rumpled and dirty bedding piled upon them.

title: [[Dirge, Barracks Roof]]
description: The roof of the barracks is of solid stone like most of the construction hereabouts.  A high stone wall set with embrasures and firing slits provides many vantage points for any defenders.  The remains of a wooden look-out tower still rise from the side of the building facing the town wall but it is no longer usable, as most of the upper-works have burned away in some past fire.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa Chapel, Antechamber]]
description: Scattered along the polished grey floor, nubby silk cushions provide a place for worshippers to rest and chat with each other.  A low table in the center of the antechamber holds a small brazier filled with resinous woods that perfumes the air as it warms the room, the smoke rising in lazy circles to escape through vents in the thatched roof.  Wavering light reflects up a blue-green stairway from the sanctum below.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa Chapel, Inner Sanctum]]
description: Blue-green stairs shimmer like ice as they curve around the outer perimeter of the room.  Something, either magic or mechanical, causes water to flow continuously down the outside of the sanctum's glass walls, flooding the interior with wavering light.  Concentric rows of benches angle down toward the central altar, a simple piece of polished grey driftwood decorated with scattered water lilies.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa Chapel, Library]]
description: Heavy oil lamps hang over each of the tables in the library, each suspended by three sturdy chains from hooks in the ceiling joists.  The arrangement of chains allows the lamps to sway freely as the building's bamboo supports flex before wind and wave, keeping the light steady yet reducing the chance of fire from an overturned candle.  Glass-fronted bookcases keep the chapel's precious books and scrolls safely tucked away until needed by a scholar.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa Chapel, Schoolroom]]
description: Rows of tables face a dais at the far side of the small room, each with a pair of low seats beneath it.  Here, the village priest doubles as a teacher to the young, instructing them in their letters as well as their heritage.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Workshop]]
description: The stench of sulfur vies with the tingling effect of ozone in this cluttered workshop.  An eclectic assortment of arcane ingredients line the cabinets and shelves.  Odd glowing stains mark the floor, most likely the result of past experiments possibly gone awry, reflecting the light from twin gaethzen spheres set on marble pedestals.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Storage]]
description: Crates of food are stacked in this place, leaving very little room to move about.  Some of the crates are marked "For Cats Only", obviously nourishment for familiars when the season grows too cold for them to hunt on their own.  A counter on one wall is piled with odds and ends not yet packed away for storage.

title: [[Capture the Bag, Shop]]
description: Planks of weathered driftwood line the walls although there are a number of gaps between the slabs.  Everything has a ramshackle look except for the merchandise offered on the driftwood displays covering the bare earth floor.

title: [[Hot Tropics, Sunkissed Sands]]
description: Sunlight streams through the avodire-framed windows and open doorway of this spacious room, highlighting the colorful shells arranged in an intricate swirl across the tall walls.  A tufted rug is stretched over the mottled yellow wooden floorboards.  Colorful sundresses and sarongs hang on metal racks arranged around the room.

title: [[Hot Tropics, Shifting Seas]]
description: White cumulus clouds painted along the top of the bright sky-blue walls shimmer under the warm candlelight like fluffy tufts of cotton caught on an errant sea breeze.  The pale yellow ayabere floors are polished to a high shine to best display the wood's natural mottling.  Various wares are displayed atop a trio of tables in the middle of the room.

title: [[A Second Round, Tent]]
description: Dingy canvas walls encircle a floor of uneven pine planks.  A few spots of mold or mildew spread across the fabric, adding a note of mustiness to the still air.  A few battered tables hold the merchandise which is heaped up with no sign of organization.

title: [[Tighten Up!, Salesfloor]]
description: Bare whitewashed walls accentuate the wild colors and patterns of the merchandise displayed on shelves and counters.  A few free-standing racks in the center of the room hold more wares for the milling customers to peruse and purchase.

title: [[Clothes By Any Other Flame, Showroom]]
description: The canvas walls are painted a brilliant red, similar to the shade of a leaping flame.  The wooden racks and shelves that hold the merchandise are colored in the same hue, while the floor is planks of broad pine.  Helpful salespeople circulate through the crowds, answering questions and making sales.

title: [[Trees Four Walls, Showroom]]
description: Large mockups of walls hang from the rafters, allowing the patrons to view the various offerings from a variety of distances.  The deep pile carpet on the floor muffles most sounds, helping to foster the mood of quiet contemplation amongst the shoppers.  The saleshelp unobtrusively circulates and are ready to answer questions or place orders.

title: [[Inkspressions, Written Wonders]]
description: Pale green walls stenciled with twining ivy enclose this spacious room, and a deep blue rug covers the majority of its goldenoak floor.  Gaethzen lanterns hang from the ceiling to illuminate the tables and stands displaying wares for sale.

title: [[To The Hammer Born, Salesfloor]]
description: Racks and stands displaying the merchandise are scattered across the plain plank floor.  The hide walls of the tent occasionally move slightly in the breeze, but little else disturbs the customers as they browse the selection of weapons on offer.

title: [[Fit to be Tied, Shop]]
description: Except for the canvas walls and the wooden racks, this narrow space is lacking in decoration.  The only color comes from the brilliant shades of the merchandise on the racks scattered about.

title: [[Tower of Terror, Shop]]
description: Sturdy racks and stands holding the merchandise are scattered around the shopfloor.  Careful lighting throws spotlights on the various items and draws attention to the exquisite craftsmanship on display.

title: [[Gift Me Up, Shop]]
description: A multitude of shelves and racks hold a variety of merchandise and goods for sale.  The whole shop is stuffed with items and the floor is piled with baskets and bins of overflow items.

title: [[Granny's Knot Spot, Cozy Shop]]
description: A rocking chair sits next to the fireplace, a basket of knitting beside it on the floor.  The whitewashed stone walls hold wooden shelves while some wooden racks and stands are scattered about the floor.

title: [[Unique-corn, Salesfloor]]
description: Oak shelving lines the walls, displaying the varied wares of the shop.  Globes filled with gaethzen dangle from the ceiling, providing illumination for the customers.  Clerks bustle about refreshing the merchandise supply and answering shoppers' questions.

title: [[Don't Spill The Tea, Gazebo]]
description: Freshly painted beams create a spacious octagonal enclosure, leaving plenty of room between tea tables draped with pistachio cloths and high-backed chairs tied with peach bows.  Porcelain tea settings and three-tiered stands offer decadent fare to the patrons.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Entry]]
description: A few benches along the walls provide seating for those who need a break from shopping.  Warm light from the hanging brass chandelier spreads throughout the entry, making the polished oak floors gleam.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Outerwear]]
description: Spread out around the room are wooden racks and stands displaying a wide variety of outerwear.  Rushing salesclerks move about, answering questions and restocking clothing.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Legwear]]
description: Piles of clothing are stacked up on shelves and counters, ready for purchase by customers.  Smiling clerks answer questions and help the buyers with their other requirements.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Doublets and Shirts]]
description: Garments hang from the racks and stands around the room, their colorful fabrics and trims dazzling to the eye.  Cheerful salespeople roam about, ready to answer questions or get a different item from the stockroom.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Jewelry]]
description: Glass cases and cabinets along the walls offer up jewelry and other adornments for perusal and purchase.  Several armed guards stand in the corners, their gimlet eyes keeping the customers under watch to prevent theft.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Accessories]]
description: A long walnut counter displays accessories and other extras for purchase.  A few bins and baskets on the floor provide extra display space for further items.

title: [[A Knight at the Club, Gowns and Robes]]
description: Long racks of robes and gowns line the walls, their wooden poles almost groaning under the weight of the merchandise.  The quiet murmur of voices fills the air as customers debate their purchases.

title: [[Tick Tock, Sales Floor]]
description: From behind a counter, a clerk carefully cleans fingerprints and other smudges from the wares proudly displayed throughout the small room.  A shadesatin-lined tray of fancy clockwork devices is set on a counter between a black bust and some alerce pegs showcasing similar mechanical creations.  Metal keys matching the various gadgets hang from some aldamdin hooks.

title: [[Sheepish Shep's Ship-shape Sheep Ship Shop, Sales]]
description: The plush wool tent walls are woven from undyed wool, giving the fabric a mottled look as the different shades of white and cream yarn were combined in the weaving process.  A few paintings of nautical themes grace the walls while wooden shelves display the extremely eclectic stock of the shop.

title: [[Haute Dogs and Fat Cats, Salesroom]]
description: The canvas walls are covered with murals of dogs jumping and playing while cats slumber on windowsills and chairs.  Brightly painted shelves and counters display the products for sale while the sales staff circulates to answer questions and make sales.

title: [[Bathed in Splendor, Submerged]]
description: Enclosed within water-filled glass walls, the shop is surrounded by a school of brightly colored tetras and a trio of tiny marbled-shell turtles as they dart through clusters of blue-green waterferns that rise from a bed of silvery sand.

title: [[Stitched by the Sea, Sewing Room]]
description: Decorated with delicate strings of gaethzen seashells that criss-cross a vaulted ceiling, the spacious room is filled with light that streams in from large stained glass windows depicting panoramic seascapes at each corner.  The comfortable sewing space has a variety of counters and a large bobbin cabinet pushed up against the walls to leave the center of the room easy to navigate.

title: [[Katy Gore The Door, Sales Area]]
description: Deep shadows linger in the corners where the fitful lighting does not quite reach.  Racks spread around the room display the doors for sale.

title: [[The Emperor's New Robes, Outlet]]
description: Lofty tentpoles hold up the striped roof which soars overhead.  Multi-hued bands of silk run vertically along the walls, making the interior a riot of color even without the kaleidoscopic hues of the merchandise.  Racks and stands display the wares on offer while salesclerks bustle about.

title: [[Field Fashion, Not-Really-Skirts]]
description: Palm fronds cover the walls, providing partial cover from the elements.  The raised floor is sanded teak planks which support a variety of racks and stands for the merchandise.

title: [[Field Fashion, Long Things That Might Trip You]]
description: Instead of palm frond walls, the room is enclosed with louvered panels that help to keep the elements out without impeding air flow.  The merchandise is displayed on counters and tables.

title: [[Field Fashion, Things That Are Still Not Skirts]]
description: Tucked into the back of the cabana is this airy room with large open screened windows.  A few shelves and racks showcase the items for sale.

title: [[In Gore Pouch, Inside Tent]]
description: Shelves and racks run along the hide walls of the tent, set there to display the merchandise without impeding the flow of customers.  A few clerks circulate through the crowds as they restock the wares and answer questions about the stock.  Gleaming gaethzen spheres hang from the tent poles and illuminate the corners with bright light.

title: [[Urn Back Time, Front Room]]
description: A framework of oak poles holds up the canvas sides, which are decorated with painted designs in red and black depicting people in flowing clothes marching in procession.  A few lanterns hanging from the roofpoles provide lighting for the shop's wares displayed on the wooden shelves and racks about the area.

title: [[Urn Back Time, Back Room]]
description: A framework of oak poles holds up the canvas sides, which are decorated with painted designs in red and black depicting people in long robes parading through a city street.  A few lanterns hanging from the roofpoles provide lighting for the shop's wares displayed on the wooden shelves and racks about the area.

title: [[Looty Booty, Entrance]]
description: Plain birch walls circumscribe the room, lacking any embellishment or adornment.  A square doorway leads further into the shop, while a simple chain dangling from the ceiling holds a gaethzen sphere that illuminates the sparse alcove.

title: [[Things That Go Bump in the Fight, Control Room]]
description: Set up in the middle of the floor are a number of utilitarian shelves and racks made of wood.  A few small cubicles are set up along the canvas tent walls so that patrons can try on the merchandise.  The scent of oiled canvas and freshly cut wood still drifts on the air in the confined space.

title: [[Farhana's Island Exquisites, Sales Room]]
description: Arched walls are hung with ivory gauze layered over pale rose silk, softening the light of the room and rippling with every breeze.  Tall seagrass baskets filled with honeysuckle blossoms and curls of sandalwood and cinnamon bark are tucked in the corners, lending a light and spicy fragrance to the air.  Big cushions covered with raw silk and edged with tiny golden bells are scattered near the merchandise racks, inviting shoppers to linger and choose.

title: [[Kilt From Scratch, Shop]]
description: Although the mortar between the bricks is a bit crumbly, the walls are stout and solid.  Counters and shelves display the products for sale, while the busy salespeople bustle about helping customers and replenishing merchandise.

title: [[Artistry of Flesh]]
description: The room is low and cell-like, an excess of gaethzen orbs hanging from the ceiling filling the small space with a harsh, sterile light.  The only piece of furniture is a large reclining chair bearing a range of gadgets both mundane and alien.  Samples of flash cover the far wall, the only break from the dull grey wood.  A thin young Kaldaran man, presumably the artist, stands rigidly out of the way with a flat expression.

title: [[Dying to Shop, Front of Tent]]
description: Black canvas walls have a few openings that allow air and light to come into this large tent.  Fresh grass mats cover the ground while various displays hold the merchandise for sale.  A large white banner hangs between the tentpoles.

title: [[Dying to Shop, Back of Tent]]
description: Black canvas walls have a few openings that allow air and light to come into this large tent.  Fresh grass mats cover the ground while various displays hold the merchandise for sale.  A large white banner hangs overhead.

title: [[Knotty Pirate, Entry]]
description: Plain oak paneling covers the walls with rich, yellow-brown wood while the floors are narrower planks of the same wood.  Occupying the central space of the entry is a tall mannequin, dressed in a flamboyant outfit.

title: [[Makeshift Killing Supplies Annex, Shop]]
description: Crafted of rough wooden boards cobbled together with rusted nails, this wagon looks as though it's ready to fall apart.  Wares are displayed in the center of the room, where they are slightly less likely to be attacked by the termites that infest the mobile shop.

title: [[Down on the Farm, Salesroom]]
description: Small pens and paddocks are set up on the floor, each one filled with tiny animals munching on fodder.  The space overloads the senses with the sounds and smells of a barnyard as the attendents rush around trying to simultaneously help the customers and care for the pets on offer.

title: [[Rite of Cravat, Salesfloor]]
description: Sturdy brickwork forms the walls around the shop, the bright red of the masonry contrasting with the pale color of the mortar.  Elegant brass sconces hold beeswax candles that illuminate the area with a bright clear light.  Polished wood shelves hold the merchandise while the cheerful clerks stand ready to assist in any way.

title: [[Dress for Success, Salesfloor]]
description: Sturdy walls of cut grey limestone are topped by large wooden beams supporting the roof.  A few lanterns hang from the roofbeams, illuminating the spacious room and the mannequins displaying the shop's merchandise.

title: [[Raw Silk, Shopfloor]]
description: Tall stands and racks scattered around the shop exhibit the product while keeping the delicate fabrics off the floor.  The bustle of the clerks as they circulate about mingles with the chatter of the patrons to create a constant background noise.

title: [[Stabbaticals, Sales Floor]]
description: Billowy white banners are draped along the walls, framing the wooden pegs and hooks affixed at even intervals around the room.  A trio of tables rests upon a dark blue rug stretched over the polished oak floor.  Running along the back wall is an intricate mural of a battlefield strewn with broken weaponry and fallen bodies.

title: [[Divine Design, Shop]]
description: Felt panels are placed over a framework of slender rods that rise in a dome.  Appliques of the many symbols of the gods cover the walls, while the floor is made up of finely polished oak planks laid in a circular pattern radiating from the center.  Wooden shelves hold the merchandise on offer.

title: [[Rizadi's Outfitters, Sales Floor]]
description: Brass lanterns hang in each corner, spreading a warm glow over the well-tended merchandise and handsomely framed provincial maps that dot the varnished honey-pine walls.  Rows of pewter, brass and copper hooks hang over the iron-banded oak chest that stands near a curtained alcove.  An elaborate globe, inlaid with precious gemstones, rests on the centrally located polished walnut counter.

title: [[Row Row Row Your Coat, Shop]]
description: Oilcloth walls devoid of decoration enclose the shop, the peaked roof upheld by long wooden poles.  Simple stands and shelves are dispersed around the room, each strategically placed under a lantern hanging from the tentpoles.  Clerks circulate throughout, always ready to answer a question or make a sale.

title: [[The Contented Sole, Salesfloor]]
description: Giant appliqued fish are affixed to the canvas walls, cut from colorful felt and decorated with googly eyes.  Paper lanterns shaped like various fish species hang from the tent poles, giving light to the room.  Shelves and racks crowd the salesfloor, each one stuffed with a wide selection of footwear.

title: [[The Lost Tavern]]
description: Dark and gloomy, the atmosphere reflects the abandoned appearance of the area.  Four dingy, vine-covered walls hide faded messages, once legible and now covered in dust and unreadable, while unlit torches are attached to the rounded wooden beams that support the tall roof of this forgotten building.  Small windows covered with dust and grim line the wall above a vine-covered display case.  Scattered around the large room are tables covered with various bottles in a variety of sizes.  A small bar stands next to the dilapidated door.

title: [[Red Fan Siegery Suppliers, Basalt Isle Room]]
description: Inside this poorly-constructed shack, a Merelew shopkeeper stands over a number of tiny figurines, idly carving on one and not particularly paying attention to you.  A single gaethzen lamp swings idly from the ceiling, casting shadows across the room.

title: [[Crossing Forging Society, Bulk Materials]]
description: A chamber with stone walls and a lofty, vaulted ceiling links the rooms of the forge.  Its high arches help to subdue the clangor, letting sounds rise and echo in the space overhead.  The flickering of flames and sounds of metal clanging against metal are more muted here, and the pace is less frantic.  Well-dressed tradesmen come and go as they place orders for large quantities of goods and supplies.

title: [[Shard Forging Society, Bulk Materials]]
description: The sounds of the nearby forges are muted in this roofed, open space.  Countless traders and wagons are efficiently directed through a loop from Xibar's Crescent Road, through a processing area where their wagons are unloaded and reloaded, and then back out onto the streets once again.  Clerks dash about with their paperwork to keep the assembly flowing, though one remains at a counter to take orders.  From time to time, the heat and soot from within the society proper are swirled through on a breeze.

title: [[Fang Cove Forging Society, Bulk Materials]]
description: A salty breeze swirls through the open space.  A freshly applied thatched roof hangs overhead and protects the countless pallets of heavy ingots, ores, and other supplies that are neatly stacked in rows by type.  From time to time, a line of wagons hauls more wares from the nearby docks as ships come and go from the small, growing community.

title: [[The Grove, Ancient Tree]]
description: Creaking limbs and branches intertwine to form a makeshift floor.  Within this airy landing, the cured hide of some long dead beast sways between two leafy boughs.  Scattered upon the floor, in several haphazard piles, lay mounds of various pelts.  Dangling from overhead like some macabre wind chime, a collection of skulls sways in the shifting breeze.

Several fireflies dart about the limbs and branches, lighting this airy landing.  An outline of a hide can be seen stretched between two branches.  Scattered along the floor are several lumpy mounds and a shadowy string of skulls hang from a nearby branch.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Workshop Entrance]]
description: Designed for storage, numerous benches, tables, shelves, and cabinets fill the walls and floor.  Packed with slabs of wet clay wrapped in oilskin, various sponges, loops, fettling knives and scrapers, much of the space is dedicated to storage of materials and tools used in the shaping of clay.  In contrast to the dry air from the south, a warm, damp breeze wafts from the north.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Shaping Station]]
description: A wide workbench stands in the center of the area, a large rotating stone disc centered in the middle of the table.  A fettling knife and wooden mold of a large torso stand off to one side, with several drying scraps of clay littering the table's surface.  Hot air wafts from the northwest.

title: [[Noldaet Ala, Glazing Station]]
description: A stained workbench sits against the eastern wall, several open pots and jars of various color paints and oils neatly pushed against the back of the table.  Adjacent wire racks hold several pieces of painted and glazed clay -- sections of finger, hand, wrist, and arm, all delicately arrayed to prevent dripping.  A single paintbrush sits on the workbench.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Kilns]]
description: Four large brick and mud-packed kilns stand against the northern wall, open and full of various fired clay body parts.  An open firebox has been largely cleaned of ash.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Submerged Pathway]]
description: Set at regular intervals, a road of wide, flat stones lies barely submerged beneath the lake surface.  Stalactites reach from above, the ceiling fading into darkness.  The light of the shoreline can be seen weakly to the north, a gloomy, mist filled darkness filling the south.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Submerged Pathway]]
description: Gentle waves, no more than ripples, play across the submerged stones.  In the midst of near utter silence, the strange acoustics of the surrounding gloom devour all noise.  Far above, glow worms cast pinpricks of slowly moving blue-green light, and to the south, a billowing wall of gloomy mist obscures the pathway, lit from within with faint flickers of swirled gaethzen light.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Island]]
description: A rocky platform emerges from the lake, smoothed by either careful handwork or aeons of steady erosion.  The waters lap silently against the little island, gently swaying almost imperceptibly up and down the gradual slope of the shoreline.  At the center of the island stands a dais, the epicenter of a perfect sphere of churning mists which enclose the space.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Island]]
description: The smooth shoreline sways slightly more rigorously here, pushed by an easterly current that swirls around the the island.  A mounted gaethzen orb provides a dim illumination, casting a weak light over the island.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Island]]
description: A large crack spiders outward from the southwestern portion of the dais, shattered flecks of rock and crystal glistening in the weak light of a gaethzen orb.  At its thickest, the crack sloshes with water, having split the small island open.

title: [[Noladet Ala, Dais]]
description: At the center of the dais rises a thick column of gypsum encrusted with smoothly polished fluorite and calcite crystals, atop which rests a small, carved, soapstone fox.  Perfectly marking the epicenter of the sphere of churning mists which enclose the space, the figurine surveys the near silent area.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Reception]]
description: Carved into the living stone, the large circular room has eight equally spaced exits.  A desk stands near the wall, situated to keep an eye on all the traffic moving through the outfitting society.  The mirror smooth walls are hung with bright tapestries that display the talents of the members of the society.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Weaving Hall]]
description: A few sturdy shelves rest against the stone walls of the chamber, providing space for supplies to be stored.  In the center of the room, a large loom stands under a series of hanging lanterns which bathe the room in brilliant light.  A bench stands in front of the loom, ready for someone to sit and weave.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Supply Emporium]]
description: Cubbyholes chiseled from the rock walls display the vast array of fabrics, leathers and other supplies available to members for their projects.  Swatches of some of the textiles and threads are set out on the counter for inspection before purchase.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Book Emporium]]
description: Racks hold the manuals and booklets available for purchase, allowing the patrons to peruse before taking their selections to the polished stone counter near the door.  A bearded Dwarf stands ready at the counter to assist shoppers with questions or to complete purchases.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Tool Emporium]]
description: Sturdy shelves behind the long wooden counter hold a variety of tools needed by the members of the society, all neatly stored away for easy access.  A burly looking Dwarf stands behind the counter, his beady eyes missing nothing that happens in the chamber.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Office]]
description: Thick tapestries cover the walls, obscuring the stone the chamber was carved from.  Papers are piled on the desk in haphazard stacks, threatening to spill over the floor at any moment.  Swatches of cloth and design sketches fill a small rolling cart next to the desk, ready for the next project.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Spinning Hall]]
description: Large wicker baskets stand near the spinning wheel in the center of the room, ready for holding supplies for artisans working on new projects.  While one stool is placed at the wheel, a few others of varied heights line the walls, allowing spinners of any height to sit comfortably at the wheel and work.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Large wicker baskets stand near the spinning wheel in the center of the room, ready for holding supplies for artisans working on new projects.  While one stool is placed at the wheel, a few others of varied heights line the walls, allowing spinners of any height to sit comfortably at the wheel and work.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Outfitting Society, Weaving Hall]]
description: A few sturdy shelves rest against the stone walls of the chamber, providing space for supplies to be stored.  In the center of the room, a wooden loom stands under a series of hanging lanterns which bathe the room in brilliant light.  A bench stands in front of the loom, ready for someone to sit and weave.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Entrance]]
description: Polished stone walls gleam in the diffused light cast by bronze lamps overhead.  A pair of frosted glass doors leads back out into the bustling caverns of Hibarnhvidar.  A long carpet runner, decorated with alchemical herbs and tools, runs from the doors deeper into the society.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Lobby]]
description: Cozy groupings of chairs and sofas provide a spot to socialize and network for those society members taking a break from alchemical processes.
