Wall sconces provide subdued lighting that helps relieve eyestrain from staring at too many retorts or stoves.  The quiet murmur of conversations fills the background as members relax and unwind.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Supplies]]
description: Shelves of spices, herbs, and other ingredients line the walls while clerks dart to and fro filling orders for customers.  A long counter allows for the inspection of the various supplies before final purchase.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Books]]
description: Shelves display books available for purchase while a chart shows techniques.  A clerk notes work order completions on a board.
paths: Obvious exits: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Workroom]]
description: A set of alchemical equipment is centered in this laboratory carved out of living rock.  Pipes along the ceiling are covered with holes that provide a way for any deadly gasses released to eventually be piped to the surface.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Tools]]
description: Stacks of supply crates line the walls while the counter displays various alchemical tools for sale.  Frazzled-looking clerks help customers with their purchases.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Workspace]]
description: A set of alchemical equipment is centered in this laboratory carved out of living rock.  Pipes along the ceiling are covered with holes that provide a way for any deadly gasses released to eventually be piped to the surface.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Workshop]]
description: A set of alchemical equipment is centered in this laboratory carved out of living rock.  Pipes along the ceiling are covered with holes that provide a way for any deadly gasses released to eventually be piped to the surface.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Alchemy Society, Office]]
description: Except for a desk, there is little to mark out this area as belonging to the Society Master.  The heaps of papers on the desk vie with bits of dried plants and various other ingredients, all of them fighting a losing battle to not slide off the messy desk onto the floor.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Entry]]
description: Scents of oils, ash, and other unidentifiable odors waft through the entryway, drifting from deeper within the Society.  A passageway to the east leads to the master's office, while a wider tunnel in the south wall provides access to the rest of the working areas.  A few chairs, battered from much use, sit on the polished stone floor.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Office]]
description: Metal racks line the walls, holding a variety of bins, boxes, and baskets.  Each container is labeled with a neatly-lettered tag denoting what is stored within.  A wide table in the center of the room is covered with paperwork while a comfortable chair is pushed back from the surface.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Depot]]
description: Standing in the center of the room is a large semi-circular counter, behind which busy clerks take and fulfill orders for the crafters.  A large crate stands at one end of the counter while a sign hangs on one wall.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Bookstore]]
description: Most of the room is blocked off by a long counter behind which stand tall bookshelves in neat rows.  Busy clerks move between the counter and the shelves, filling orders for the engineers.  An overpowering scent of ink and leather fills the area.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Toolstore]]
description: Tools hang from corkboard decorating this long, rectangular room.  A thick scent of oil clings to the air, and the scraping sound of stone sharpening metal drones on in the background.  Some nearby salespeople wait to help customers.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Workroom]]
description: Roughly in the center of the room stands a work bench covered with tools.  Gouges and scratches mar the thick planks of the worktable's surface.  Wood shavings and stone bits dot the polished stone floor.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Engineering Society, Workspace]]

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Entry and Maker's Mark Sales]]
description: High windows are set within the sturdy stone walls just below the vaulted ceilings, each window equiped with louvered vents to help improve the airflow within the working areas.  The walls display some of the many metallic products produced within the workshops, while a few employees bustle about on errands for craftspeople.  The noises of the forges, smithies, and foundries drown out the sounds of the city, making it difficult for anyone to carry on a conversation.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Northern Hallway]]
description: Narrow clerestory windows allow a little light into the long corridor that stretches towards some of the working areas of the building.  The walls are polished stone, with pale mortar between the blocks creating a contrast with the dark gleaming surfaces.  The acrid smell of molten metal mixes with the underlying smells of soot and fire.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Northern Foundry]]
description: Set into the floor in the center of the room is a brick-lined firepit in which a fire burns white-hot.  All the necessary tools are nearby, set within easy reach of the firepit for the convenience of the craftspeople who use this area.  The room is somewhat hazy from the everpresent ash and soot created from the metallurgical processes.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Northern Smithy]]
description: Set against the outer wall, a small forge allows for the heating of unfinished projects before they are worked on the anvils or other equipment situated around the room.  Large windows set within the thick stone walls help to circulate the air, in a vain attempt to keep the temperature comfortable.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Tool Store]]
description: Bins and shelves display the tools available for purchase, all of them covered with the thin layer of soot and ash that seems to permeate the whole building.  The walls are thick stone and somewhat muffle the din of the workshops enclosed within the large edifice.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Book Store]]
description: Bound instructions and manuals are stacked on shelves, neatly arranged for purchase.  Employees dart in and out in the course of their duties, staying busy while they assist the craftspeople in their crafts.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Supplies]]
description: Supplies for the craftspeople are sorted into bins and containers that line the walls, each labeled with a neatly-lettered notice detailing the properties of the various materials.  The sounds of the working areas drift into the room, muffled by the thick stone walls.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Southern Hallway]]
description: High walls meet overhead in an arched roof made from pale woods.  The sounds and smells of metalworking drift down the hallway from the workshop rooms to the south.  Nothing adorns the walls which are fashioned from large polished blocks set within pale mortar.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Southern Smithy]]

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Southern Forge]]
description: Arched openings are set into the thick outer stone walls, with the majority of the furnaces set outside the building in an attempt to keep the temperature lower.  Bellows set near the openings allow for air to be forced into the fire as needed.  Bins hold supplies for the working craftspeople.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, A Private Forge]]
description: Thick walls struggle to contain the blistering heat of the workshop where the fires blaze endlessly night and day.  The flickering flames give a reddish glow to the racks and shelves of tools and equipment, all neatly placed and ready for use.  Workers enter in their protective gear from time to time, checking the equipment and reporting back to a sentry at the entry.

title: [[Aesry Forging Society, Northern Forge]]

Bellows set near the openings allow for air to be forced into the fire as needed.  Bins hold supplies for the working craftspeople.

title: [[Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Waves of heat, blasting with an almost tangible force, roll from the flames of a brick-lined firepit.  Over the firepit, a blackened granite crucible hangs by stout chains from an oak beam high overhead.  Near the crucible's spout stand stone molds of different shapes, with a pile of fuel within easy reach.  Similar crucibles hang to the north and south.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

description: The south end of the grindstone room has a few more of the big stone wheels, all in good condition.  Apprentices of Yalda inspect them daily, treating them with oil and checking for chips on the grinding face.  Other grindstones stand to the north.

title: [[Forging Society, Forge]]
description: Several large grindstones on wooden frames stand in the middle of the workroom. A high-pitched keening and the smell of hot metal rise from those in use and from others to the south.

title: [[Crossing Outfitting Society, Spinning Room]]
description: Fanciful paintings of birds in flight flow across the dark green walls.  Beneath a large spinning wheel is a soft white rug trimmed with black fur.  Pressed against the back of the room is a large workbench and chair, a place to relax or work on a project that requires more attention to detail.  A polished marble door leads back out into the hallway.

A carved ivory door leads back out into the hallway.

title: [[Riverhaven Alchemy Society, Entrance and Tool Store]]
description: Shelves showcasing a variety of alchemical tools line the thick stone walls of this room that is otherwise void of additional furniture.  The ground shifts from dirt to rough-hewn stone outside a heavily reinforced passage leading downward into the laboratories themselves.  A bright-eyed Moon Mage stands at the entrance to the earthen tunnel, welcoming society prospects and veterans alike.

title: [[Riverhaven Alchemy Society, Tunnel]]
description: A series of sconces dot the heavily reinforced walls of the tunnel leading deep into the heart of the Alchemy Society's laboratories, ensuring that any disastrous explosions are safely contained away from the populace above.  Burly Human workers pass by intermittently, carefully guiding warning-labeled carts deep into the heart of the society.

title: [[Riverhaven Alchemy Society, Lobby and Supplies]]
description: Gaethzen spheres dot the ceiling of this the massive underground chamber, fully illuminating the heavy steel cases containing supplies located in the center of the room and brightening the long tunnels spreading outward to partitioned laboratories.  A group of young Warrior Mages stand beside a scowling Gnomish Barbarian, ready to respond to any disasters taking place.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Swimming Hole]]
description: Creamy white water lilies float lazily along the surface of the water, emitting a sweet, heady scent in the air.  Tall hedges edge the swimming hole here, blocking off the view of the surrounding greensward.

title: [[Arthe Dale, Swimming Hole]]
description: Tiny brown pondskippers hop along the cool clear water, creating ripples of outwardly expanding circles.  Tall hedges edge the swimming hole here, blocking off the view of the surrounding greensward.

description: Clear water fills this natural swimming hole - cool and briskly refreshing, it ripples over the smooth rock bottom.  Rays of light filter through the oak tree's branches that form a leafy roof overhead.

title: [[Brother Durantine's Shop]]
description: In this small adjunct to a local order of monks, Brother Durantine offers a variety of holy items and related things.  An assortment of holy symbols may be had as well as blessed waters, candles and ritual vestments for any who wish to serve their own religious needs.  Cool stone walls decorated with scenes from the life of the founder of the order doing various good deeds provide inspiration to all who see them.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]]
description: The well-worn path winds its way erratically between and around the few hardy bushes and shrubs that cling to the perpetually muddy riverbank.  Sparse vegetation interspersed with forgotten whiskey bottles and broken fishing poles lines the edges of the beaten track between the river to the west and the trail running southeast to the trade route.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, Footpath]]
description: The path continues along a slight slope as it winds its way beside the river.  Large rocks and mossy boulders make the way a bit more treacherous, and the shadows cast by the large trees to the south cause the area to stay quite moist.  The blaring of a ferry's horn can be heard occasionally, far in the distance.

title: [[Chizili's Alchemical Goods, Salesroom]]
description: An almost overwhelming array of scents attacks your nose the moment you enter this place.  While strikingly clean, the room is also filled with jars and barrels and pots and carboys of every size and description.  Bundles of dried herbs hang from racks overhead and glass amphorae are filled with strange animal parts being pickled.  Lore and Science, superstition and practicality meet in this place where alchemists can re-stock almost all their bizarre needs in one place.

title: [[Orielda's Blossoms, Front Room]]
description: Beautifully crafted earthen pots filled with brightly hued blossoms form a narrow walkway that curves from the doorway all the way to the counter of this tiny but airy shop.  Alongside the large cluttered counter, barrels overflowing with roses and carnations glisten with a delicate webbing of moisture, their luscious scent only slightly overpowered by the exquisite colors of the blooms themselves.

title: [[The True Bard D'Or, Fine Instruments]]
description: This is THE shop for Bards.  Famed far and wide for its range of instruments and things bardic, customers travel far just to shop here and to exchange tunes and to hear the latest gossip.  The walls are covered with dozens of music-making devices and glass counters hold strings and reeds and straps.  Rows of pigeonholes hold sheet music from a hundred cultures and more.  A backroom serves as a performance hall and a place for traveling bards to meet and catch up on goings-on.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Entrance]]
description: A steady breeze whips past, billowing out from the depths of the mine.  Rows of torches line the walls and cast dancing shadows down the long tunnel ahead.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Tunnel]]
description: The ceiling and walls gradually narrow towards the northeast.  Bits and pieces of broken rock litter the floor, remnants of recent mining activity.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Tunnel]]
description: Scattered debris litters the sloped rock floor.  Few torches remain lit here, and they appear to be extinguished entirely in the northern branch.  A marked difference in the coloration of the stone separates the mine entrance from the depths below.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Steep Slope]]
description: Jagged stalactites reach towards the floor and small pools of water collect along the ground of this natural cavern.  The clank of metal hammering rock echoes from farther into the mine.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Supplies Stand]]
description: This open section of the cavern houses a supply depot for storing mined-out materials.  Several merchants sell tools from a makeshift stand.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Slope]]
description: A thin layer of moss coats the damp walls in this section of natural tunnel.  Abruptly, the tunnel slopes downward and into the poorly-lit depths below.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Cramped between two walls, the pathway barely offers enough room to squeeze through.  The echoing of babbling voices filters through the hall, though what is being said cannot be discerned.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, A Ledge]]
description: Dangling from the pathway above, a frayed rope offers passage further up the wall, while a makeshift rope ladder leads further down into the cave.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Twisting in various directions, the tunnels each lead to individual sections of the cavern.  Several skeletal remains scattered upon the ground rest near the pile of rocks.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Tunnel]]
description: Sounds from rushing water fill the area, echoing off the walls in a chaotic chorus.  Every step becomes a potential hazard here from the excessive rubble strewn about the path.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Stream Bank]]
description: Water drips and pours from every inch of stone, all headed down the bank and into the fast-moving stream below.  A small bit of light shines in from the west, barely illuminating the barren walls.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Narrow Depths]]
description: Dropping down a steep distance, the pathway comes to a sudden halt.  Pebbles breaking off from the cavern walls ping against the rocks before landing on the ground below.  A fraying rope dangles over the edge, offering a way down into the bowels of the cavern.

title: [[The Kree'la, Main Deck]]
description: The deck is split down the middle by an open pit, bracketed on each end by the two masts.  The opening is more for ventilation for the rowers than for onlookers to look down on them, and rungs on each mast give access to the rower's pit.  Aft, a set of stairs climb up to the pilot's deck and underneath are located the only two cabins aboard the galley.  Rigging rises up to the masts, holding them in place, and a rope ladder ascends the forward mast.

title: [[The Kree'la, Captain's Cabin]]
description: Although the captain is the only crew member to have a private space, this tiny cabin does not offer much in the way of comfort.  A short bunk is built into the amidship's wall.  The ship's log rests on a small writing desk and map tubes hang on the wall above.  A sea chest sits under a little window on the aft wall while a lamp rests on a tiny shelf to shed a bit of light during the night.

title: [[Catrox's Forge, Entryway]]
description: The forge of Catrox the Dwarf is known throughout the lands.  Here mundane metal is transformed into tools, and weapons, damaged armor and shields are made whole again.  This entryway is covered by a tin roof, with no walls, in the hope of letting some air into the smoky, noisy and sweltering compound.  The ringing of metal on metal, the sputtering of cinders and slag, the hissing of steel meeting water, all are audible from within.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Wind-tossed sand obscures the path leading further into the rising dunes to the east.  Sun-blackened rocks of all sizes are scattered along the way, some barely peeking from beneath the blanket of sand, others lifting above the desert like rough sculptures.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Dunes rise around you like huge waves frozen in time, yet with each passing second, the waves of sand slowly sift across the desert floor as the wind moves the great dunes, grain by grain.  Footing is treacherous, and each step has to be taken carefully for fear of collapsing the walls of sand.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Ss'Thran's Locks, Workroom]]
description: This room is a place of shadows and darkness.  The few windows are heavily-curtained so that little light filters in.  A shaded lantern on a shelf throws dancing pools of light that illuminate little.  There is a glitter of scales, a flash of ivory fangs as Ss'Thran turns his chill gray eyes on you.  A faint hiss escapes him as he inquires your business.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, Wild Rose Thicket]]
description: Pale pink roses blossom against thorny green leaves, growing in profusion in the dense thicket.  The trail twists and turns, following the hoofprints of countless generations of deer.  An intense fragrance perfumes the air, but all the roses in the world can't conceal the sickly-sweet stench of rotting meat that underlies it.

paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[The Massive Metal Arachnid, Below the Spinneret]]
description: Iron chains with links as large as a Gor'Tog descend from the spinneret to connect to the thick bronze ramp below your feet.  People are milling about the entrance hawking their wares while small children run to and fro playing games and singing.  An air of frivolity and joy surrounds everyone present at the occasion.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Clearing]]
description: The wide clearing has random patches of lush grass intermingled with large bare spots.  Workers rush to and fro, deftly cutting festival goers from the sticky bonds that confine them to the treetops enclosing the area.  Children and adults alike are abuzz with excited chatter as they cross the brightly festooned bridge into the festival grounds.

title: [[The Massive Metal Arachnid, Entrance]]
description: Iron chains with links as large as a Gor'Tog descend from the spinneret to connect to the thick bronze ramp below.  People of all ages and races mill about, some gaping skyward at the massive abdomen of the metal beast while others talk excitedly about the wares they might find for sale.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick iron plates have been riveted together to form this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of pipes run from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of patched metalwork.  Thin jets of steam spew forth from a badly patched tube in the center of the tangled mess.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick iron plates have been riveted together to form this spacious hallway.  A bit cleaner than the rest of the structure, this section houses the permanent shops of the walking juggernaut.  An oddly placed potted plum tree gives the hallway a lived-in quality.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Wind-tossed sand obscures the path leading further into the rising dunes to the east.  Sun-blackened rocks of all sizes are scattered along the way, some barely peeking from beneath the blanket of sand, others lifting above the desert like rough sculptures.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Tall dunes rise in tan and gold waves, ranging fore and aft in an ocean of sand.  Dark shadows, seeming chiseled from the surface of the rounded hills, slant sharply across the surfaces where the sun does not touch.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Sparse, tenacious weeds clump sullenly around the protective shade provided by the steep crags thrusting up from the silver desert sand.  Survivors to the core, they cling to the rock and throw their narrow, olive leaves outward as if to ward off any that would challenge their meager presence.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: A large, flat expanse of sand stretches between two gigantic dunes here.  Rising smoothly up from the uneven ground around them, mammoth-like, they seem not to shift despite the most valiant attempts of the harsh desert wind that so often rips across this barren land.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Heat shimmers rise over the sandy plain, blurring the air and creating silvery pools of illusion on the ground in the far distance.  The massive Gemfire heights in the east mingle with the surely false blurry sights of treetops and rainfalls.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Rolling dunes of sun-blasted sand stretch as far as the eye can see.  The sheer solitude of the area is intimidating -- not a sound can be heard save the intermittent whistle of the wind and the resultant shift of sand.  Daylight seems to pummel down from overhead, heavy and implacable.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Wind-tossed sand obscures the path leading further into the rising dunes to the east.  Sun-blackened rocks of all sizes are scattered along the way, some barely peeking from beneath the blanket of sand, others lifting above the desert like rough sculptures.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Dust rises with each footstep as the soft powdery sand, worn away by wind and erosion and grinding against the other objects, fills the air.  The dunes are miniature mountains, their massive bulks rising high into air, constantly shifting as the wind moves them about.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Wind-tossed sand obscures the path leading further into the rising dunes to the east.  Sun-blackened rocks of all sizes are scattered along the way, some barely peeking from beneath the blanket of sand, others lifting above the desert like rough sculptures.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Broad dunes rise up abruptly from the sand, staining the bleached silver-white sand with their deep crimson presence.  Banded in scarlet, gold, and ochre, they seem to rip savagely up from the soft sand in crag-like spears and broad, flat surfaces.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: The wind that nearly always moves across these lands has rippled the surface of the ground into a series of semi-regular miniature dunes.  Seamed like the leathery hide of a yeehar, they texture the desert with a pattern of light and shadow.
paths: Obvious paths: north, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Wind-tossed sand obscures the path leading further into the rising dunes to the east.  Sun-blackened rocks of all sizes are scattered along the way, some barely peeking from beneath the blanket of sand, others lifting above the desert like rough sculptures.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Velaka Desert]]
description: Occasional swirls of white powder mingle with the red-orange dust of Velaka's dune sea, a subtle reminder of what happens to the mortal remains of the unwary in this harsh and unforgiving terrain.  All around, the sandy hills of the desert rise and fall like rhythmic waves.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Slope]]
description: Rivulets of water stream down the smooth cave walls and collect in small surface puddles.  Haphazardly placed torches illuminate the way deeper into a freshly hewn section of tunnel.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Tunnel]]
description: Generous flows of water pass through this section of the mine, making the floor slick and the air damp.  Sounds of cracking rock and groaning laborers echo out from deeper within the mine.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Crevice]]
description: The tunnel curves around to a narrow crevice illuminated by torches on both sides.  A burly man stands next to a sign indicating only Estate Holders may proceed past this point.

title: [[Ragge's Locksmithing, Salesroom]]
description: Through the mingled gloom of shadows and tobacco smoke, you can barely make out the vague outlines of some rather sinister looking figures as they skulk in and out of a room to the east.  On the heavily scarred counter, a single oil burning lamp provides the only pool of light in the room, which radiates only a few feet outward before being swallowed by the shadows.

title: [[Dirge, Darkstone Inn]]
description: The main room of the Inn, once well decorated and painted but now decayed and faded, still serves as a gathering place for those who dwell here or for the rare traveller.  A long wooden bar, now splintered and broken in many places, still stands at the far end of the room, while a scattering of tables gives the few patrons someplace to sit.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Dark Corner]]
description: Tucked in one dark corner of the main room, this table retains some signs of former glory.  A bit of shine still lingers in the surface and the top is less scarred by knives and burns than others here.  The chairs, each one different, are mostly comfortable and clean.  A faded painting, apparently of the town in happier days, brings a touch of color to the drab walls.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Bar]]
description: The bar itself was once a grand sight.  Being a solid slab of dark wood, polished and fitted with the traditonal brass rail, it was kept lovingly waxed and spotless.  The wood is now blotched and smeared with countless unwiped spills and the rail has long since been pulled up and sold for scrap.  Behind the bar, a few bottles and nondescript barrels and casks make up the liquid stock for sale here.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Hallway]]
description: This narrow hallway leads from the main bar back to the storerooms and the owner's office.  A cramped staircase leads to the upper story but looks treacherous.  A faded and water-spotted bit of carpet still lies on the floor, looking sad and ill-used.  The dark walls are scuffed and blotched with cracks in the paint.  A smell of must and mildew makes the air here thick in your nostrils.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Storeroom]]
description: The storeroom of the tavern makes the public areas look bright and cheerful.  A rusted old lantern, chimney caked with soot, provides a sputtering light that is barely enough to see by.  Rows of old beer kegs squat here waiting for the demand of the occasional patron outside.  Here and there, one has split from age or heat or simply from the effects of time and puddled the floor with spoiled ale.  Dozens of huge black roaches skitter about, half-drunk on the dregs left unmopped.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Office]]
description: This room is quite a surprise after the rest of the Inn.  Comfortable and even plush, it is furnished with heavy drapes hung on the walls and a large desk made of fine silverwood that gleams in the soft light shed by a brass oil lamp.  The owner seems to be doing a much better business than the outer rooms would indicate.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Upper Hall]]
description: In odd contrast to the squalor downstairs, this upper hall is relatively tidy and clean.  Worn but unsoiled carpet covers the floor, and the walls are laid with a faded but still elegant wallpaper done in silver and blue tones.  Several doors set widely apart show rooms of some size wait within, while the hallway itself continues on a bit.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Upper Hall]]
description: This end of the hall is well carpeted and clean.  Oak panelling frames a heavy oak door.  Set nearby is a serving tray full of empty glasses and flasks, the remains it seems, of some private party.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Blue Suite]]
description: This room is decorated in shades of cool blue, reminding you of the far distant ocean.  Thick blue carpet, sculpted into patterns of waves and shells, flows across the room to a large bed arrayed in the same motif.  A lamp made from cut and polished strips of translucent shell gives a golden light to the scene like sunlit waves.

title: [[Darkstone Inn, Pleasure Room]]
description: This is a very odd and unusual room.  The walls are covered entirely with leather in a dark wine color.  A massive four-poster bed dominates the room.  There are several padded benches scattered here and there as well as a pair of very comfortable looking chairs.  Darkly polished metal and burnished leather decorate every surface.  Even the bedstead is trimmed with metal and leather.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: An oppressive heat saturates the area, billowing upwards through an access ladder shaft.  Underfoot, gears laboriously clamor and churn in vehement protest, visible behind grates of rusted iron.  A rickety tin shack and several booths have been erected in one of the corners in a feeble attempt to seek shelter from the humid air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Overwhelming the tight corridor is a convoluted network of pipes and conduits that converges in a nexus along the northern wall.  Every so often, a puff of steam escapes, setting the pipes rattling.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Hoses and tubes throb overhead, transporting some sort of fluid to other areas of this mechanical beast.  The ceiling here is ominously low and disproportionate to the width of the chamber.  A crowd of spectators, several of them hunched over, surround something off in the corner.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: The air in this passageway is oppressively damp and muggy with no refuge from the heat to be found.  Most of the surfaces of the area are coated in a thin layer of oil and grime.  Atop a raised platform sits a sandbox, which reeks of wet cat.

title: [[The Upper Thorax, Corridor]]
description: Signs of a recent hull breach are evident here.  Curled strips of charred metal have been beaten back into place surrounding an unmarred plate of metal.  Sections of wall bulge inwards, and fragments of iron plate litter the floor.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Back Abdomen]]
description: The floor slopes southward in a noticeable manner, following the unsupported back of the clockwork Arachnid's abdomen.  Interlocking plates above form a thin shell of a ceiling, entirely devoid of pipes and gears.  Creaks and groans occasionally come from the stressed metal, resonating and amplifying through the interior of the hollow metal spider.

title: [[Hidisharon Desert, Dry Ditch]]
description: Most likely carved by wind rather than rain, a dusty ditch undercuts the road, its bottom filled by grey and tan pebbles, its top edged with grainy sand.  Curved as a worm might bend as it burrowed through the earth, the gulley arcs around several massive boulders embedded in the ground.  Oddly square, the stones shoulder against one another, defying the wind and elements from stealing any more dry land from their domain.

title: [[The Abdomen, Corridor]]
description: Thick iron plates have been riveted together to form this spacious hallway.  Against the wall, a series of pipes run from floor to ceiling in a twisted jumble of patched metalwork.  A large metal blade spider has been suspended from the ceiling by a thick steel cable.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the domed ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping very short of the concave dome high above.  A small but noticeable hole is corroded into the floor, corresponding to a leaky pipe overhead.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Middle Abdomen]]
description: Hollow metal columns rise from the platformed floor to the domed ceiling, forming a makeshift skeletal structure that holds up the roof of sliding steel sheets.  Walls rise up on either side of the hallway, stopping short of the concave dome high above.  The hallways form a crossroads, and each corner is covered with rubber tubing.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Back Abdomen]]
description: The floor slopes southward in a noticeable manner, following the unsupported back of the clockwork Arachnid's abdomen.  Interlocking plates above form a thin shell of a ceiling, entirely devoid of pipes and gears.  A small round skylight is open in one of the steel plates above, letting in a small shaft of light.

title: [[The Baby Metal Arachnid, Spinneret]]
description: Huge sheets of metal all converge at a point at the very back of the clockwork metal Arachnid, ending at a large machine called the spinneret.  Named for both its location and its function, the spinneret constantly whirrs and turns, driving numerous belts that filter through the walls and ceiling to other parts of the spider.  A large lever sticks out vertically from the floor next to the machine, used for some unclear function.

title: [[Herilo's Artifacts, Showroom]]
description: Herilo the Artificer Exemplar squints over the marble counter muttering over a tattered manuscript.  You feel powerful forces at work all around you in this atelier of arcana.  A low cabinet of satiny shaal wood holds scrolls and parchments, as well as a small carved statue.  On hooks and trays around the room are beads, talismans, amulets, crystals and odd ornaments fashioned from animal parts of assorted and disgusting nature, for use as catalysts in the practice of magical arts and divination.

title: [[Laakvor]]
description: Posies grow with wild abandon in this part of the hollow.  Now and then you find a wild rosebush, some birds of paradise or groups of nasturtiums bordering the path.  Crickets chirp softly in the darkness, stopping now and then to listen as you move through their territory.

title: [[Chasm, Gully Floor]]
description: Small fan shaped deposits of sand and silt have accumulated at the base of a steep rivulet-worn slope that rises up from the northern side of the chasm.  The southern wall is far more severe rising straight up to the lip of the small canyon.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Chasm, Ruined Bridge]]
description: Debris from the destroyed bridge that once crossed this ravine litters the floor of the chasm.  High on the chasm walls the remnants of the bridge still dangle precariously over head, periodically adding to the wooden rubble on the canyon floor.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Gwenalion]]
description: Chilled brownish water laps about, tossed by the strong westerly wind off the lake.  Back near the shore, fisherman ply their lines in the comfort of the sheltering cove.  A little ways further into the lake is the structure of the landing and the barge wharf.  The lake seems to teem with fish, many breaking the surface and then diving back into the dark waters.

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Gwenalion]]
description: Outside the shelter of the cove the lake bottom drops off sharply, and the water is rougher.  The waves break now and then into small white caps as a strong wind blows off the lake.  The chill of the water is not uncomfortable, but is very invigorating.  Nearby the silver slash of a fin creases the surface followed quickly by a diving heron seeking its dinner.

title: [[Lake Gwenalion, Near the Landing]]
description: Near the wharf the lake laps roughly against the pilings, tossing odds and ends dropped by those on the Landing back and forth on the waves.  Ducks paddle about the structure, but not out into the open water of the lake, afraid to brave the stronger current and the wind swept surface.

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Gwenalion]]
description: The rocky lake bottom was long ago covered with silt washed off the beach, providing a silky cushion and a rich home for hermit crabs.  Now and then a small fish breaks the surface quickly, attracting the attention of a duck paddling nearby.  The water is quiet, and the surface smooth, as the wind off the lake is gentled by the sheltering cove formed by the trees and hills of the surrounding Danduwen Forest.

title: [[Langenfirth, Lake Gwenalion]]
description: The water deepens farther from the shore, but the shelter of the cove calms the wind and lulls the lake into calmness.  The dark waters, colored brown by the decaying matter of the Danduwen Forest, obscure the lake bottom but small fish occasionally bump into whatever or whomever wades their way.

title: [[Middens, Crossbow Bend]]
description: Burly militiamen mingle with ethereal, robed figures, fresh-faced lads in pilgrim attire and maids of unworldly demeanor, all making their way to or from the Observatory.  Groups of Moon Mages walk by at a deliberate pace, and talk amongst themselves in low, dignified tones.  Those whose faces peek out of their hoods or cowls regard you with faraway, almost disdainful glances.
location: East Gate and Moon Mage Observatory

title: [[Middens, Crossbow Bend]]
description: Before you stands the Observatory of the Southern Crossbow.  It is a three-story edifice, its sixteen-sided walls capped with a crystal dome.  The top floor is also the nerve center of the Moon Mages' Guild, a most powerful and revered arcane circle throughout Elanthia.  All in all a rather quirky structure, it manages to inspire awe and curiosity at the same time.  A carved ivory door leads inside.
location: East Gate and Moon Mage Observatory

title: [[Foot of Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Huge claw and fang marks mar the rocky terrain, the telltale signs of battle littering the steep trail.  Several of the huge boulders bear numerous dried bloodstains, and portions of the path are blackened and charred.  Wyvern Mountain blocks nearly half the sky, and the thundering waterfall cascading down its front can be both clearly seen and heard.

title: [[Foot of Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Blotting out the night sky, the surrounding mountain peaks jut from the ground, with Wyvern Mountain towering high over them.  The trail takes a sharp incline, winding its way past a treacherous cliff.  Roaring thunder from a nearby waterfall echoes through the area, the noise constant but somewhat distant.

Long shadows are cast over the trail from the surrounding mountain peaks, pairing each rock and stone with a shadowy caricature of itself.  The trail continues its sharp incline, winding its way past the base of a treacherous cliff.  A lone scraggly bush clings to its side, tenaciously growing despite the constant shadow cast on it from the mountains above.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Plateau]]
description: Made from a solid but somewhat slippery sheet of shale, the ledge hugs the base of a cliff that towers high above.  Colorful striations mark the exposed bedrock overhead in bands of red and white, separating the greyish rock.  Layers of softer stone have worn away from constant weathering, leaving gaps on the cliffside that resemble enormous claw marks.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Plateau]]
description: Wide cracks split the plateau, with three ironwood support beams haphazardly spanning the gap to form a makeshift bridge.  A steady stream of water trickles through the rift, appearing to be runoff from the nearby Wyvern Falls.  Rusty stains speak of minerals in the water, the small trickle creating a small puddle against the cliff face before dribbling away out of sight down the ledge.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: The mountain trail forks sharply along the side of the cliff in zigzag patterns, the incline just gradual enough to climb without the use of handholds.  Fresh, clean water sprays through the air in a mist of droplets, making the cliffside slick and peppered with pockets of vegetation.  Darkness shrouds the path, making the footing rather treacherous.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: This portion of the slippery path passes through a gorge between two cliffs, the ground underfoot almost sandy.  Created when water washed away a layer of softer rock, the sides of the miniature canyon are streaked with flecks of minerals.  Three ironwood support beams haphazardly span the gap high overhead, apparently placed here to ensure the sides don't come crumbling down.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: The narrow trail follows the steep incline that ends at the base of a cliff, the branches of numerous evergreen trees gracing its top.  Made from shale layered with limestone and granite, the rocky wall glitters with minerals and is fairly free of vegetation.  Small runnels of water flow down the mountain's side, eventually disappearing into deep chasms in the rock.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Large bushes and clumps of tenacious vegetation have stabilized the mountainside, which drops off steeply to the southwest.  Numerous boulders line the edge of the path, half sunk into the earth and peppered with old moss.  The sound of water rushes through the area from the nearby Wyvern Falls, echoing off the cliff sides in a thunderous cacophony.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: The strong fragrant odor from a nearby patch of Elyhaar Wing orchids drifts through the air from the base of a nearby cliff.  Each of the delicate blooms is barely visible in the dim light, only the white tips easily seen in the darkness.  Hardy mountain bushes line the forking path, making the way treacherous.

Growing in the shadow of the nearby cliff is a large patch of Elyhaar Wing orchids, producing a strong fragrant odor in the thinning mountain air.  Each of the delicate blooms are just barely open, showing off the white interior that resembles a jackal's curled claws.  Hardy mountain bushes line the patch of flowers, giving them the appearance of a passing shadow.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Waterfall Edge]]
description: Constant spray from the nearby Wyvern Falls dampens the steep mountainside that follows it, most of the boulders worn completely smooth by the myriad of droplets.  The water runs down the side of the mountain in constant sheets, flowing downward through the air.  Several small lilies thrive in the damp area, clinging to the edges of the rocks and soaking up the abundant moisture.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Plateau]]
description: Thunderous noise echoes across the mountain plateau, and water constantly sprays the rocks from the enormous falls passing close by.  Visible far below, a small lake marks the bottom of Wyvern Falls, which flows down the mountain from a spectacular height.  The entirety of Shard can be seen in the distance to the east, its towers and walls making the city resemble a compass.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Waterfall Edge]]
description: The constant pounding spray from the nearby falls makes the footing treacherous, which zigzags sharply to provide some semblance of footing.  Moss grows thickly on the boulders in many different types, covering them in an array of multicolored speckles.  Small pine saplings occasionally jut from the side of the cliff, the young trees growing nearly horizontally before bending their branches upward toward the sky.

title: [[Wyvern Falls, Bridge]]
description: The sturdy stone bridge spans the very top of Wyvern Falls as it crests over the side of the mountain.  Water flows at a steady pace, roaring down the side of the cliff and drowning out all other sound.  The air is filled with a thick mist coming from the spray of the water, obscuring the dim twilight and drenching the sides of the lonely bridge.

The stone along the bank is somewhat treacherous, worn smooth and slick with the relentless passage of time and water.  This close to the precipice, the thunderous roar devours all other sound as the rapids race forward to plummet over the edge of the mountainside.  An impenetrable mist rises from the pool far below, tiny droplets trying in vain to resist the inevitable fall.

title: [[Wyvern Falls, Bank]]
description: Following the natural layers of the massive mountain, the bank drops off into an enormous cliff, while the snow-capped peak rises high above.  Wyvern Falls flows down the mountain in a steady stream, the water constantly free-falling down the cliffside in roaring sheets.  A misty spray continually shoots through the thin mountain air, creating a natural rain that dampens the surrounding rock.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Above the Rapids]]
description: The water-soaked bank follows a series of cascading rapids, blocked off by a steep drop that makes passage into the water impossible.  Sprays of water crest with white foam and flow constantly over the shallow and uneven boulders in the water.  Occasional sprays of water splash heavily against the path's edge, creating foaming white curtains that quickly fall again.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Breeding Grounds]]
description: Far above the treeline, the steep mountain is formed from large slabs of dolomite, a narrow canyon wending its way through two of the smaller peaks and serving as the wyvern breeding grounds.  Numerous cracked boulders are scattered over the hollow gorge, splitting it into many sections that are mostly blocked off from each other.  Bones are scattered across the canyon floor, the victims of adult wyverns feeding their young.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Above the Treeline]]
description: The expansive night sky stretches above the evergreen forest, the view clear and unhindered by any foliage.  A blanket of fine, bluish mist partially covers the forest, with only the tips of the trees visible through the haze.  Numerous claw marks mar the steep mountainside, permanently etched into the hard stone.

title: [[Foot of Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Wyvern Mountain towers high rises in the sky above, with a thundering waterfall cascading down its front.  Several smaller peaks rise around the mountain cap like dragon's teeth, framing its snowy top.  Massive boulders frame the narrow winding trail, which slopes steeply upward and appears to have been recently cleared of rubble.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Patches of grass and twiggy saplings cling tenaciously to the sides of this steep mountain trail, which winds up the rocky cliff face in a rough zigzag pattern.  Gushing water roars from somewhere nearby and the rocky trail is somewhat damp underfoot, making the climb up the cliff even more treacherous.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Steep Trail]]
description: Patches of grass and twiggy saplings cling tenaciously to the sides of this steep mountain trail, which winds up the rocky cliff face in a rough zigzag pattern.  Gushing water roars from somewhere nearby and the rocky trail is somewhat damp underfoot, making the climb up the cliff even more treacherous.

title: [[Wyvern Mountain, Narrow Plateau]]
description: The path forks sharply, with what looks like a man-made trail traveling steeply upward to follow the cliff to the west.  Narrow ledges made of shale lead to the east and south, marking a precarious journey through the rocky terrain.  Several small weeds cling to pockets in the harsh stones in the gaps between the rocks, speaking of a nearby source of water.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, Wild Rose Thicket]]
description: Pale pink roses blossom against thorny green leaves, growing in profusion in the dense thicket.  The trail twists and turns, following the hoofprints of countless generations of deer.  An intense fragrance perfumes the air, but all the roses in the world can't conceal the sickly-sweet stench of rotting meat that underlies it.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths Beyond]]
description: Layers of chipped rocks and pebbles that have fallen from the ledge above line the floor in a scattered mess.  A makeshift sign leans precariously against the wall.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths Beyond]]
description: Etched into thick stone walls, various amateurish depictions of trolls hunting their prey decorate the makeshift room.  Broken bones scatter the ground in such a way that it is nearly impossible to pass through without stepping upon them.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths Beyond]]
description: Weapon racks crafted from various bone types line the walls of the cavern hall.  Standing between the racks on either side are poorly carved stone statues depicting menacing cave trolls, which serve as nothing more then a decorative deterrent to all who trespass here.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths Beyond]]
description: Chipped stone tables and chairs line along the narrow hall leaving barely enough room to pass by.  Securely affixed to the wall is a life-sized replica of a skull and crossbones, perhaps hung in attempt to warn intruders of what awaits them.

title: [[Wilderness]]
description: Tangled brown undergrowth as thick as a Dwarven beard lines this region.  Fierce ripples occasionally flee across its surface, indicating that however impenetrable it may appear to travelers, small creatures still lurk beneath its surface -- perhaps following the remnant of an old, long unused trail.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, Slope]]
description: Tendrils of icy water rush forth from a large crack in the mine's walls.  A crescendo of noise echos from deeper into the mine as evidence of more turbulant water upstream.

timeto.15756: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 550 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Forest of Night, Path]]
description: Tangled trees of the famed black ironwood rise about you, their foliage twining and intertwining with each other.  Light struggles in vain to creep through the canopy, and the scent of loam is heavy and pungent.  The trail finally fades here, a living wall of gnarled trunk and leaf cutting off any further advancement through the wood.

title: [[Forest of Night, Path]]
description: The ironwood trees whisper to themselves in a language forgotten long ago, their glossy leaves glistening like fresh blood as they shiver in a gentle breeze.  A thick pall of uneasiness no mortal wind can disperse hangs in the air.  A thin, nearly invisible deer trail leaps away from the main road and vanishes into a thick stand of trees.

title: [[Forest of Night, Silent Glade]]
description: The trees quietly shuffle aside here, moving a graceful step back to allow the glade plenty of room.  Grass carpets the forest floor, and yellow and white wildflowers dot the ground in colorful abundance.  A ring of mushrooms circles a mossy hollow, releasing spore to float on a gentle forest breeze.

title: [[Wicked Burrow Mine, The Depths Beyond]]
description: Flat stone beds stacked three high span the far end of the room.  Within the middle of the chamber is a carefully crafted fire pit, over which hangs a spit dangling the daily dinner catch.  Various thick fur pelts cover the floor in attempt to create a homey feel for the otherwise dank space.

title: [[A Clear Pool]]
description: Around you stand the high hills of the countryside, their broken reflections rippling in the pool, while all about you spreads cool, cold water, running deep and moving slowly with unseen currents.  From time to time a bubble pops on the surface, creating a gentle stir over the water.

title: [[Rolling Hills, Inside a Small Cave]]
description: The floor of the cave is sandy, while the back of it seems to be made of dirt.  It is relatively small, but well-lit, its opening leading out into a lush vale.  A small firering composed of blackened stones and cold ashes occupies the center of the cave.

title: [[Rolling Hills, Inside a Small Cave]]
description: The floor of the cave is sandy, while the back of it seems to be made of dirt.  It is relatively small, but well-lit, its opening leading out into a lush vale.  A small firering composed of blackened stones and cold ashes occupies the center of the cave.

title: [[Jewel of the Faldesu, Gems and Fine Metals]]
description: What is most striking about this home-turned-business is the true elegance and refinement of the decor.  From the delicate mother-of-pearl animals inlaid into the rich rosewood of the crown molding to the ornamental framed portrait behind the counter, this is a high class establishment.  Appearing somewhat out of place, a number of surly guards constantly linger, each keeping a cautious eye always turned to the customers.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, Rangu's Repair Shop and Bookstore]]
description: A small forge in the corner of this room basks everything in its warmth.  Adjacent to it, a long counter sits cluttered with numerous tools and devices for repairing things.  Bundles of repaired goods rest against the far wall waiting for pickup.

title: [[Rangu's Repair Shop and Bookstore]]
description: A small forge in the corner of this room basks everything in its warmth.  Adjacent to it, a long counter sits cluttered with numerous tools and devices for repairing things.  Bundles of repaired goods rest against the far wall waiting for pickup.

title: [[Lava Forge, Forge]]
description: Silent figures in robes flit from room to room, apprentices bent on their labors.  Here, a black anvil set on an oak base stands near one wall, opposite a hulking iron forge.  Waves of heat wash across the room to be absorbed by the granite walls.

title: [[Old Oak Tree, Amongst the Branches]]
description: Boughs hung heavy with leaves tenderly enfold the old oak tree, much like a protective glove that is designed to provide a safe haven for the hands.  High overhead, a large branch leads further up into the tree for a better view of the countryside.

title: [[Pilgrimage Trail, The Vela'Tohr Feltery]]
description: Undyed wool rugs, woven in shades of russet and dull black, cover the floors.  The walls are cloaked with felted draperies of light brown adorned with bands of black kidskin embroidered with pale grey in a neat geometric pattern.  In the center of the shop, a cedar table covered with merchandise sits between two racks.  Shelves flank a stout door leading to the outside.

title: [[High Mountains, Obscured Trail]]
description: Dense, flower-laden bushes obscure the trail to the north, and a wide, rocky path leads toward the southeast.   Several pockets in the face of the mountain look as if someone were recently mining in the area, leaving the path covered with various bits of metals.

title: [[High Mountains, Waterfall]]
description: Seeming to end here, the trail runs directly toward a waterfall that crashes down from a cave high up.  Plummeting down forcefully with gouts of water, the trail washes away as a river flows from the falls and off another cliff toward the east.

title: [[Guard House, Office]]
description: Like most towns, this one spared every expense when decorating the office of the local guard.  An ancient desk, battered and scarred from years of neglect, is positioned a little too closely behind the counter that divides the room in half.  Scraps of yellowed parchment flutter from a massive cork board just inside the door, where one of the local militia is busily arranging and rearranging the jumble.

title: [[Guard House, Hallway]]
description: At the far end of the hallway, faint light illuminates the iron grating set into a heavily barred door.  Hideous green paint flakes from the walls, settling onto the stone floors and crunching underfoot with each step.

title: [[Guard House, Chamber of Justice]]
description: A chill races through your spine as you stare up at the platform from which justice is so mercilessly dispensed by the local magistrate.  A few low benches stretch out along the western wall, where a heavily-armed guard oversees visitors and defendants alike with a stern, watchful eye.

title: [[High Mountains, Behind the Waterfall]]
description: Hidden behind crashing torrents of water, the cavern opens up into a large area filled with stalactites and stalagmites.  The echoing sound of dripping water is interrupted only by the occasional loud crash from the waterfall outside.  Uneven ground leads further back into the mountain.

title: [[High Mountains, Cavern]]
description: Humid and stale air fills the cave along with the echos of dripping water and the distant sound of the roaring waterfall.  Broken ground falls away in several areas, while others seem impassable due to the stalagmites in the area.  A small flicker of light high up near the roof catches the eye, revealing a cliff with rudimentary footholds.

title: [[High Mountains, Sunfall Hub]]
description: Breaking open from the dank cavern below is a wide meadow neatly tucked in a valley between several surrounding mountains.  Visible from this perch, a collection of huts and tents and rising smoke reveal signs of life from somewhere betwixt the structures.  In the distance, several figures wander in and out of the circle of the buildings.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Claw District]]
description: Three large huts, constructed of stretched hide and wood encircle the area.  Each marked with its own symbol, the huts appear to house both resident and visiting members of the Claws.  Prydaen filter in and out each hut a few at a time, occasionally accompanied by an Elder.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Residential Area]]
description: Several hide tents and huts with thick straw roofs crop up across the grassy area.  Dozing Prydaen pay little mind to the creatures that wander through, leaving the prowling teenagers to dispatch them.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Residential Area]]

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Firepit Circle]]
description: At the dead center of the Hub, an expansive bonfire blazes, tended to by the resident Prydaen.  Several groups gather in the area to exchange trade, words, or to simply stop and share a meal.  Nearby, a small group of well-protected kits take instruction from two Claw members while nearby warriors keep a watchful eye on the area.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Sunfall Hub, Warrior District]]
description: Corralled in the area, several warriors spar, hone their weapons, or watch the others with avid interest.  The younger Prydaen, oblivious to the danger of running through the vicinity, chase after small creatures in the area, squealing with glee when successful, and hissing with frustration when defeated.

title: [[Hunting Preserve, Willow Tree Marsh]]
description: To the north, tall overgrown grassland blocks your view.  South, a line of willow trees, foliage long and dangling, obscures anything in that direction.  The high growth on all sides cuts off any hint of breeze and the air is thick and humid.  Clouds of gnats swarm and dart all about and their low drone washes over you, numbing your senses.  The ground squishes underfoot, dragging at your feet and making your footing uncertain.

title: [[Wilderness]]
description: Dank green moss grows over oak trees and boar-bristle bushes.  It drips slowly into the undergrowth, creating a damp sludge that makes walking unpleasant and hazardous.

title: [[Bobba's Arms and Armor]]
description: Three Halfling-size figures stand along the entranceway, each clad in a different style of armor with weapon poised to attack.  They do not move, however, the room's steady light betraying them as cunning display dummies crafted from straw and wooden poles.  Smallish weapon racks and diminutive suits of leather line the walls, indicating the proprietor's select group of clientele.

description: A tidy room more reminiscent of a country kitchen than a shop, this is a bright and cheerful place filled with the aroma of fresh cheeses, breads and other foods.  Attached to one wall, a straw basket of fresh flowers brings a splash of color to the room.  An open window reveals a clean, straw-filled stable.

title: [[Orem's Bathhouse, Lobby]]
description: White marble floors and clean white tile walls without a speck of dirt show the extreme care taken with cleanliness here.  A counter sits to one side where patrons may purchase bathing tickets, towels, soap, scrapers and other necessities for personal hygiene.

title: [[Shrine of Ushnish]]
description: In a dark, fetid alley, hard behind the Viper's Nest Inn, you happen upon a small shrine.  Kicking away what appears to be rubbish from around it, you reveal a sculpted granite image of the serpent god Ushnish.  Seeing that, you realize with a shudder that it is not rubbish you just pushed aside, but offerings of dead rats, uncured, fresh skins and other offal left by devotees of the viper-headed deity.

title: [[Lava Forge, Supplies]]
description: A rickety wooden table stands near a battered rack that leans against the granite wall.  A Human smithy attendant, looking rather harried, watches people pass by as he restocks the supplies.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, west, northwest.

description: Throughout this cavernous room the floor has been scuffed and scratched as boxes and crates of components needed for finally assembly of the various forged items have been hauled into place.  Groans can be heard often because restocking is constantly in progress.

description: Windows high up in the stone walls provide just a hint of fresh air over the stench of burning coal and molten metal.  Supported by chains from a wooden beam, a heavy ceramic crucible swings over the fire or over to the molds lined against the wall.

title: [[Smelting and Grinding Area]]
description: Metal shrieks against stone as the grindstones spin.  The industrious forge attendants, who bustle about while seeming not to move, keep the black, pitted lava floor clean.  Muffled pounding sounds from elsewhere in the forge, and a wall of heat comes from the foundry to the northeast, but this grinding room is a relative oasis of coolness in the granite building.

description: Feeble light from an ancient lantern does little to lessen the shadows filling the corners of the repair shop. title: [[Shard, First Bank of Ilithi]]
description: Creamy white walls and floors surmounted by a dome-shaped ceiling forms the bank of Shard.  Streaks of black and silver run through the natural marble used in the structure, and short halls branch off to the north and east.

title: [[Traders' Guild, The Pit]]
description: Several short steps lead to a sunken floor, where a handful of frazzled clerks scramble about in an attempt to deal with a constant flow of tiny parchments.  Traders from all parts of the province are gathered here, awaiting word on trade opportunities or seeking information on purchasing goods.

title: [[First Bank of Ilithi, Teller's Windows]]
description: Polished walnut windows and paneling separate the customers from the tellers and vault against the back of the wall.  Several young and pretty Elothean men and women stand behind bars of an anlora-avtoma and steel alloy to process transactions.  A gleaming brass sign is embedded into the west wall, stating the bank's policies.

title: [[First Bank of Ilithi, Teller's Windows]]

title: [[Marachek's Oak, Trader Outpost]]
description: Boxes, crates, sacks, packages and baskets float effortlessly in and out of the room.  Only upon disposal are their small, sturdy, efficient Halfling porters revealed, slightly winded but grinning broadly.  The room itself is a transit point for the rapid purchase and sale of bulk goods by Guild members.  A coolly efficient Halfling trade minister expedites member transactions with a wave of his quill pen and a click of his abacus mind, charting all fees owed, all monies paid.

title: [[Fayrin's Rest, Trader Pit]]
description: On this sunken, earth-packed floor, Halfling clerks scramble and collide, shout and wave freshly inked receipts.  They seek to keep on top of commodities futures and trading opportunities, catering to the demands of merchants who line the arena like frenzied spectators at a bear baiting.

title: [[First Bank of Ilithi, Coin Exchange]]
description: The walls of this relatively small alcove rise up in a smooth, rounded arch of glossy white marble.  A friendly-looking Elven man stands behind a desk with fifteen small drawers in it, taking coins and exchanging them for the local currency.

title: [[First Bank of Ilithi, Coin Exchange]]

title: [[Shard, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Shard Alchemy Society, Entrance]]
description: An austere lobby carved from solid granite supports the tower above.  Alchemists continually line the stairs leading up, waiting to claim a good spot at the crafting stations.  The sound of shuffling feet and disagreements over seasonal pricing can be heard from the floor above.

title: [[Shard, Xibar's Crescent Road]]
description: The white gleam of the Tower of Honor can be glimpsed around a bend to the southeast, its peak challenging the Great Tower at the heart of Shard for height.  A building painted a stark grey and featuring wooden beams carved with images of swords, helms, and armor has taken up residence here, its open doorway revealing flashes of bright metal.

The white glow of the Tower of Honor can be glimpsed around a bend to the southeast, its soft luster challenging the Great Tower's at the heart of Shard for height.  A building painted in shadows and featuring wooden beams carved with obscure images sits, closed for the night, on the east side of the path, its doorway darkened.

title: [[Shard Alchemy Society, Alchemical Materials]]
description: Softly glowing gaethzen spheres hang over glass-lidded pine cases that display a variety of materials for sale.  A dark wool carpet depicting a cornucopia of alchemical ingredients covers the floor, ready to mask any possible stains from careless hands.

title: [[Meiria's Gems and Jewelry, Fatimi the Dealer's Backroom]]
description: Sparsely furnitured by two chairs in which Meiria's partner, the Elven gemcutter Fatimi, entertains those who would sell her gems, there is a sense of opulent antiquity here.  The tireless Lady Fatimi waits from her seat as the local gold-diggers and adventurers arrive with their finds to sell.  A painted white door in the west wall leads into the jewelry store proper.

Sparsely furnitured by two chairs in which Fatimi's son Veilex the gemcutter entertains those who come selling gems, there is a sense of opulent antiquity here.  Sipping tea and looking a little ghostly in the oil lamp light, Veilex smiles with suave assurance at the local gold-diggers and adventurers who arrive to haggle with him.  A door in the west wall leads into the jewelry store proper, now closed for the evening.

title: [[Whitehall Commons, Way of Peace]]
description: The path is edged on both sides with a low fence fashioned from broken weapons of war.  The hafts of shattered swords, dented maces, and snapped staves have been buried in the ground with a thick mahogany rail placed across their tops providing a convenient place to rest.  A carved misty-green ignimbrite sundial in the middle of the pathway waits through the night for the coming of sunlight.

description: Small dwellings cluster about an ivory fountain topped with a crystal unicorn which rears in a triumphant salute to Hodierna.  The fine spray of the fountain glitters as the waters leap high into the sky, splashing down on the crystal and dispersing a cool mist into the quiet night air.  Tiny fish dart just under the surface of the pool surrounding the fountain.

title: [[Triage Building]]
description: A pervading sense of orderliness rests within the expansive single-room building.  The open floor plan is sectioned off into easily recognizable areas outfitted for distinct purposes.  To the east wall rests a large medicinal cabinet and a stack of pallets.  Several padded benches line the walls near the entrance and an ebony weapons rack appears on the western wall.  Towards the back, several pallets are set out for the care of terminal patients and dead bodies.

title: [[Shard Outfitting Society, Main Entrance]]
description: Enveloped in dark pink granite walls, the main entrance exudes a warmth of colors from the parquet bloodwood flooring to the multitude tapestries hanging from the ceiling.  Mannequins in one corner display a few of the masterpieces made by Ilithi's more promising tailors while display cases filled with jewelry items occupy another.  Overhead, a prestige board hangs from the intricately carved ceiling beams to display the names of the most dedicated to each outfitting discipline throughout each of the provinces.

title: [[Ristmuir's Armory, Showroom]]
description: Ristmuir's tidy establishment is a study of craftsmanship, from the riste racks cleverly built into the window casement to the fine detailing of the showroom's wide-planked floor.  Lanterns illuminate the array of weapons covering the back wall to draw the attention of evening shoppers.  In the corner, a tall bin holds a selection of ammunition for sale.

title: [[Tremagis's Furs, Showroom]]
description: The acrid scent of curing vats and tallow reeks in the air here, a heavenly perfume to people like Tremagis, who runs the commercial furmongering in Shard from his workshop in the next room over.  Trophies of his handiwork in the form of stretched, soft doeskin and stiff worked fur shells hang on the walls, all but covering them.

title: [[Crossing, Midton Circle]]
description: A gradual slope carries the water of a shallow creek over the cobblestone path to an opening beneath the honey-colored stones of a high wall to the west.  Moss creeps from the water's edge towards the surrounding homes, where its stealthy advance is brought to a halt by sturdy growths of berry bushes planted in a long line between the creek and the nearby dwellings.

description: Low hedges of lavender form a divider between the cobblestone path and the front gardens of the homes on the northwest side of the plaza.  A crisp, sweet fragrance rises from the silvery foliage, providing a floral counterpoint to the woody scents of oak and maple and the nose-tickling smell of fresh-cut grass.

description: A windswept fall of leaves creates a soft cushion over the cobblestone path that winds its way around the open plaza to the south.  The curved limbs of oak trees form a leafy canopy over the path, casting sun-dappled shadows across the ground.  To the north the trailing blossoms of a bramble rose soften the edges of the stacked stone wall that separates the neighborhood from the outer street.

description: A stretch of paving bricks trails off towards the homes on the southwest side of the path.  The occasional "Rat-Tat-Tat!" of a woodpecker drilling the trunk of one of the ubiquitous oaks provides a rhythmic counterpoint to the throaty warbling of a songbird perched high on another nearby tree.

title: [[Crossing, Midton Circle]]
description: A wide trail of closely-spaced stepping stones provides passage across the shallow creek that ripples across this portion of the cobblestone path.  The tangled roots of several maple trees have been exposed by the water running beneath their branches, causing several to lean across the streambed into a protective arch.  The homes lining either side of the creek are slightly stained around their stone foundations, evidence of seasons when heavy rains caused the little creek to overflow its customary bed.

title: [[Crossing, Midton Circle]]
description: Grapes growing in a small front yard garden spread fruit-laden branches over a low-lying wall to the southwest.  A few wayward green tendrils have crept onto the cobblestone path, their vines mingling with the purple stains of grapes crushed underfoot by passing pedestrians.  The faint smell of fermenting fruit drifts out of the little garden, mingling with the scent of woodsmoke rising from the hearth of a nearby home.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, Near the Wreck]]
description: In the tiny cove, the bulk of a wrecked ship lies beached along the shore to the west.  Lying on its side, it is an easy scramble up a pile of debris to the main deck.  Near the shore, a small firepit, surrounded by stumps, is filled with half-burned wood and ashes.  Snapped fishing lines and rusted hooks litter the ground, testifying to the normal usage of the cove.
