title: [[Shard Alchemy Society, Work Room]]
description: A fresh breeze flows through two high-cut windows and removes the musty smell of prepared herbs.  Three large stone wheels capable of grinding alchemical herbs and plants dominate one side of the room.  Along the other side several stoves equipped with flat-iron tops wait for crafters to dry things with them.

title: [[Damp Passage, Dark Tunnel]]
description: Coarsely hollowed out sandstone walls, covered in luminous crimson fungus, run from an opening in the foundation stones and disappear southward into a veil of darkness.  Water drips through tiny cracks between the blocks, creating a light condensation down the length of the rough passageway.  As if in dance, the drops trickle down the stone, sent into motion by the subtle vibrations from a low rumbling sound.

title: [[Brisson's Haberdashery, Sales Salon]]
description: If understated elegance has a home, this is certainly it.  Rich mahogany floors, polished to a soft gleam are accented by thick handwoven rugs in burgundy and dark grey, that cushion each footfall.  Heavy cabinets with their doors ajar display a variety of handsome accoutrements for gentlemen of all tastes, ranging from understated to the more flamboyant apparel preferred by dandies.

title: [[Grek's Food and Supplies]]
description: This store is larger on the inside than it seems from the outside, its wares proudly displayed on the walls or stacked neatly in corners.  Seated behind the counter on a specially-made stool is the proprietor, Grek the Dwarf.  He gives you a wary look as you enter, then seems to relax, the Dwarvish equivalent of a smile on his face.

title: [[Damp Passage, Dark Tunnel]]
description: A carpet of crimson fungus glows like fiery dragon's eye rubies to create an illusion of fire beneath the chilly waters.  Slopping to the south, the water and fungus churn into an ooze shining with the appearance of flowing lava.  There is no heat here, however, only the chill and moisture of soaking wet stonework.

title: [[Quellia's Thread Shop, Sales Room]]
description: Sturdy white fabric hangs on three of the walls in the shop, displaying colorful designs and patterns of embroidery stitchwork, and long swatches of masterfully dyed thread display a myriad of colors.  Nearly hidden by fabrics and patterns piled on the counter is the shop's catalog, embellished with a delicately embroidered cotton cover.

title: [[Barley Bulrush, Bardic Ballads]]
description: The walls of this small shop are lined with pigeonholes filled with scrolls.  The proprieter, Barley Bulrush, sits at the back behind a desk that also serves as a counter.  A carved wooden flute sits on the countertop, always near to him.  A thick black curtain behind him marks the division between the shop and the owner's dwelling.

title: [[Damp Passage, Dark Tunnel]]
description: Buried deeply within the earth, this dank tunnel is a refuge for things long forgotten.  The fetid scent of sludge and rot wafts through the passage.  Bent and rusting sconces along the wall provided illumination at one time, but now do little else but rattle gently under the constant thrumming that vibrates the walls.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Lobby]]
description: During performances, the lobby bustles with activity as customers view the souvenirs and necessities for sale displayed within and on top of the counter down one side of the room, and various other items in the glass display cases down the opposite side.  A long narrow carpet leads theatergoers toward the archway into the seating area.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Bar]]
description: A long oak bar extends the length of the room, each end decorated with a carved depiction of Glythtide.  Neatly stacked behind the bar, ornately labeled barrels line the wall, some with taps in them, others waiting to replace empties.  Oak bar stools and small tables fill most of the room, with the exception of a stage in the corner opposite the door.  Between the stage and the bar, a doorway reveals stairs leading upward.  A matching set of steps leading downward is roped off to limit access.

title: [[Old Sewers, Northern Conduit]]
description: Wedge-fit granite blocks form a waterway wide enough for Gor'Togs to splash from end to end five abreast.  Water seeps in drips down a long ladder leading above, to fall upon the water below.  Lapping at the walls, crimson ooze floats on the water's surface bathing the area in a fiery radiance.

title: [[Yulugri Wala, Smoking Room]]
description: Glass cabinets along the walls display cases of rolled cigars and loose tobacco.  Wing chairs of padded green leather face each other in small groupings, each accented with mahogany tables polished to a rich shine.  Matching paneling covers exposed portions of the walls, and frosted gaethzen orbs provide a soft light to the room.  Thick carpets dampen noise, allowing those who gather to debate the merits of one tobacco over another to do so in comfort and encouraging them to linger.

title: [[Marcipur's Stitchery, Workshop]]
description: Only one word could possibly describe the atmosphere of this charming establishment: chaos.  Fabric in every hue and pattern imaginable spills onto the floor from countertops and tables, making every step an exercise in coordination.  The diminutive proprietress happily scampers about from one customer to the next, pinning up a hem here, deftly stitching up a bodice there, and hopping up onto a crate to adjust a neckline over in the corner.

title: [[Old Sewers, Northern Conduit]]
description: Stuck in the gaps of the stones, the crimson fungi illuminate the vicinity, driving the shadows from their posts within the rock's nooks and crannies.  High overhead, still more of the red ooze lurks where it has clustered untouched for countless years.  Amid the swirling eddies, a massive sewer gate bars access to the corridor south.

title: [[Talmai's Cobblery, Salesroom]]
description: Wiping his hands on his leather apron, Talmai emerges from the stockroom at the first sound of an approaching customer.  With one ham-sized, callused hand, he points first to the catalog lying on the low counter, and then to a makeshift wooden rack with sample shoes, boots, slippers and sandals.  With the other hand, he brandishes a measuring stick, almost like a club.  You smile and examine his wares.

title: [[Fisherman's Trail, River Bank]]
description: Muddy riverbank gives way to a grassy path, as a footpath slopes down to the shore.  The call of shorebirds echoes through the area, mixed with the sounds of buzzing insects and scurrying rodents in the underbrush.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, west, northwest.

wayto.19075: ;e move e; move e; move e;

title: [[Old Sewers, Northern Conduit]]
description: Adhering to a twist in the conduit, a low creeping vapor clings to the surface of the water.  Lit from below by a crimson glow, the dense and heavy mist impresses the likeness of a fiery, gargantuan viper slowly passing.  Gradually to the south the fog tapers to a fading shimmering tendril, completing the illusion.

title: [[Segoltha River, South Bank]]
description: Tenacious reeds and rushes cling to the riverbed, holding fast while surrounded by the swift current.  Sand and mud mix along the curving shore of this sheltered cove.  Although there are scattered trees along the riverbank, the forest is thin enough to allow passage up the bank and into the forest.
paths: Obvious paths: south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Segoltha River, South Bank]]
description: Sheltered by the ruined bulk of a stranded ship, the current here is gentle compared to the rushing cataract in the middle of the river.  The protection of the hulk allows sand to accumulate, creating a small beach along the south shore.  Debris from the wrecked ship litters the bank with boards and timbers weathered from the elements.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Old Sewers, Northern Conduit]]
description: To the north a bright reddish glow fills the conduit like a setting autumn sun.  The bottom rungs of a wrought-iron ladder fixed into the wall are covered in a thick coating of dingy scum.  Next to the ladder, a bronze plaque is posted in the wall at about the normal chest height for humans.

title: [[Half Pint, Spiral Stair]]
description: The long spiral staircase seems to twist about for quite some time, with only a wrought-iron railing to keep travelers from taking a misstep off it to the floor below.  Many of those who climb tightly grip the rails as they make their way up, or down to their destinations.

title: [[Half Pint, Upstairs Hall]]
description: Richly flocked fabric covers the walls here, and all manner of greenery in ceramic pots line the floor.  Large enamel vases of foreign design hold aromatic bunches of dried flowers, branches and herbs.  A rich, velvety carpet muffles footsteps, permitting guests to come and go with the utmost discretion.

title: [[Old Sewers, Northern Conduit]]
description: Ending abruptly due to an immense cave-in, the northern route is completely filled with jagged rubble.  Blanketed in the sewer fungi, the visible half-oval of debris draws a picture much like the sun settling into the waters on her daily voyage.

title: [[Half Pint, Rainforest Suite]]
description: Gentle clucking noises from one corner draw attention to a gilded bird cage holding a riotously-colored parrot.  Approaching the bird sends it conversing in some unknown tongue.  The chamber is softly lit, like the light that filters down through the dense, leafy canopy of a tropical jungle.  Furnishings of rattan and bamboo surround a small, gurgling fountain in the midst of a pool, around which are potted palms and exotic dwarf fruit trees.

title: [[Foothills, Outside the Gate]]
description: Lit torches illuminate a rampart wall along the trail here, the stones likely cut away from the mountainside it encloses.  Flickering lights can be seen beyond the crenetated battlement, punctuating a dull glow that extends partially up the steep slope.  The stony silence of the area is often cut sharply with boisterous cheers or a collective gasp of shock coming from behind a palisade gate.

title: [[Steelclaw Clan, Trader Outpost]]
description: A master trader sips tea and chats with the shipping clerk, keeping a watchful eye on her apprentices as they bustle about the tiled floors of the outpost loading trade goods upon her caravan.  Both women ignore the loud voice of a local blacksmith as he argues with the commerce minister over the price of iron ore.  The minister listens calmly, then raises the price on the ore by fifty dokoras, seemingly oblivious to the smith's outraged bellow of protest.

title: [[Promado Village, Church of Hodierna]]
description: The church pews have been uprooted and stacked haphazardly against the walls, clearing the hardwood floor.  A sense of deep gloom pervades the otherwise undamaged building, a vaguely bittersweet fragrance hanging in the air.  A winding stair leads up to the bell tower, and a wooden door stands at the back of the room.

title: [[Promado Village, Cleric's Office]]
description: This lonely nook was once the village cleric's office, most of the furnishings now splintered to ruin.  A length of rope, frayed and swinging in a slight draft of air, hangs from its knot around a ceiling beam in the center of the room.  Beneath it, half-covered in dust, lies a tattered parchment note.

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: Thick and dense, a wide fringe of golden brown grass naturally creates privacy for the rustic neighborhood.  Large homesteads encircle the main dirt road, each structure separated by bountiful tracts of land and plenty of fresh open air.  Undertones of pleasant conversation waft from an open window nearby, along with the enticing aroma of a hearty home-cooked meal.

title: [[Promado Village, Bell Tower]]
description: A giant bronze bell, placed to be rung in times of celebration or danger, dominates the church belfry.  It has remained silent for so long that a family of fist-sized spiders has taken up residence inside, their webs stretching from the bell to the clapper.  The view from inside the belfry window shows the looming cliffs that tower over the village on all sides, and, not far to the north, the imposing black stone towers of Sorrow's Keep.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, Wild Rose Thicket]]
description: Pale pink roses blossom against thorny green leaves, growing in profusion in the dense thicket.  The trail twists and turns, following the hoofprints of countless generations of deer.  An intense fragrance perfumes the air, but all the roses in the world can't conceal the sickly-sweet stench of rotting meat that underlies it.

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: Golden grasses border the dirt path, with some stalks managing to survive the trampling of hooves and feet.  Neighbors move around the area at a relaxed pace to ensure the day is enjoyed to its fullest.  A few tree stumps, relieved of their burdensome trunks, stick out like sore thumbs from the wavy wash of sun-bleached flora.

Dark grasses border the path, nearly indistinguishable from the dirt.  A few tree stumps among the wavy stalks serve as perfect seats for neighbors to relax and watch the theater of stars.  Night brings calm to the circle, though the flora still sways in a restless dance upon the breeze.

title: [[Mistwood Forest, Wild Rose Thicket]]
description: Pale pink roses blossom against thorny green leaves, growing in profusion in the dense thicket.  The trail twists and turns, following the hoofprints of countless generations of deer.  An intense fragrance perfumes the air, but all the roses in the world can't conceal the sickly-sweet stench of rotting meat that underlies it.

title: [[Chasm, Passageway]]
description: The splintered wreckage of a rowboat lies keel upwards among jagged white rocks that continue to the north and south.  Mildew gives the craft a coat of moss-green paint, and huge, spotted mushrooms provide a new crew.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: A fat tomcat reclines in the shade of a red wooden door, keeping a nonchalant yet vigilant eye on the barn for any rodent trespassers.  Wagons and wheelbarrows occasionally clatter by and leave distinctive ruts in the hay-covered dirt path.  Energetic children often scurry along the road to run errands for their parents or continue games of tag or hide-and-seek with their mates.

A wooden door stands ajar, though the premises are no doubt under the strict watch of a diligent tomcat on the prowl for nocturnal trespassers.  The main road is mostly clear of the usual wagons and wheelbarrows save for the occasional weary traveler or nighttime delivery.  Beyond the homesteads, the dark sky seems to stretch forever above the expanse of grain and grass.

title: [[Chasm, Passageway]]
description: Strings of black-blistered seaweed hang from the rough-edged rocks overhead.  They drip slowly, endlessly, forming a slick mucus membrane that slithers treacherously along the sand underfoot.  Cracks in the ceiling allow a small amount of light from the night sky to squeeze into the area, though you can see no stars.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Chasm, Passageway]]
description: Small bushes dot the moist, sandy passageway as it curves east and southwest.  Their pale white, fleshy branches look like the outstretched fingers of a corpse caught in rictus.  A smell like decaying yak flesh rises from each, hanging heavily in the damp air.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Sunbeam Circle, Campfire]]
description: Wisps of smoke rise from the embers of the communal hearth in the center of the small neighborhood.  Ash mixes with dirt around the fire pit's bricks and clings to passersby like fond memories.  Children from the nearby homes occasionally test their mettle against the rising flames, at least until parental reprimands end their mischievous games.

Glowing embers inside the communal hearth fight the blackness, managing to persevere through the night.  Chilly breezes kick up the ash surrounding the fire pit's bricks and send the flakes skyward like backwards snow.  Candlelight flickers inside the nearby houses to match the stars above, at least in spirit.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Chasm, Passageway]]
description: The gravel that lines this portion of the corridor falls off to either side into muddy depressions.  The silt-stained rocks that line them are host to hundreds of tiny egg clusters, glistening like multicolored, speck-sized gems.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Chasm, Passageway]]
description: Rusty ooze covers the corridor as it swings north and southeast.  Colonies of black lichen form small patches across the sodden ground and upon the craggy granite walls.
location: Northern Trade Road, Vipers & Rock Guardians

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: Stray bits of hay carpet the dirt pathway, looking like tendrils of aether against a void of blackness.  A host of nighttime sounds drifts through the neighborhood, the typical people noises replaced by the nocturnal animal songs and insect rhythms.  The darkness offers a respite for the farmers and their kin, who will wake up to continue the daily grind at the first hint of dawn.

Stray bits of hay carpet the dirt pathway, looking like tendrils of aether against a void of blackness.  A host of nighttime sounds drifts through the neighborhood, the typical people noises replaced by the nocturnal animal songs and insect rhythms.  The darkness offers a respite for the farmers and their kin, who will wake up to continue the daily grind at the first hint of dawn.

Stray bits of hay carpet the dirt pathway to mask the muddy patches and fill in the furrows from carts and horseshoes.  A host of busy sounds drifts through the neighborhood as if carried on the backs of the many insects floating from tree to tree.  There is never a dull moment for the farmers and their kin with the abundance of work required to maintain a comfortable living.

title: [[Zaulfung, Crooked Treetop]]
description: Feeble branches are all that stand between yourself and a perilous fall to the marsh below.  From this altitude you are afforded a vantage of the swamp stretching out to the east and west, divided by a thick wall of scraggly brush that seems to rise around this very tree.  A single sturdy branch appears to bridge this gap, heading eastward.

title: [[Zaulfung, Crooked Treetop]]
description: Feeble branches are all that stand between yourself and a perilous fall to the marsh below.  From this altitude you are afforded a vantage of the swamp stretching out to the east and west, divided by a thick wall of scraggly brush that seems to rise around this very tree.  A single sturdy branch appears to bridge this gap, heading westward.

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: Waves of tall grass shudder like kite strings dangling from the night sky.  Barn owls hoot in the distance, and it's not hard to imagine rodents cowering at the warning.  Though normally a focal point of activity during the day, the community well stands unbothered at the edge of the dirt path.

Pollen gilds the tall grass like gold leaf, brightened even more by the effervescent daylight.  Friendly dogs whip up and down the dirt path, frolicking between houses and letting children chase their tails.  Shallow, muddy puddles surround the community well as a result of repeated usage and leaky buckets.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: An expanse of deep swamp and thick, tangled foliage stretches out to the east.  The shrubbery is much more dense here than to the west, and knobby trees twisted by the foul waters rise up like wicked claws draped with creeper vines, creating a canopy of shade to incubate the stagnating, muddy water.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Thick, tangled brush flourishes over this murky swamp, obscured by a lazy black mist that constantly rolls up from the sludge underfoot.  The sickly gas tendrils writhe through the air, incorporating themselves with the sky above like a thick shawl of shadow.

title: [[Prairie, Sunbeam Circle]]
description: Blue cornflowers appear as tiny soldiers infiltrating the confines of one resident's modest garden.  Visible in the lamplight from a nearby homestead, chalk dust outlines a rudimentary hopscotch course for use by the neighborhood's children when boredom strikes.  Creaking tree branches and whispering leaves accompany the hummed lullabies gliding through opened windows.

Blue cornflowers spread color and cheer from the confines of one resident's modest garden.  Chalk dust in the middle of the dirt path outlines a rudimentary hopscotch course for use by the neighborhood's children when boredom strikes.  Creaking porch floorboards and clapping barn doors accompany the hummed tunes and whistled melodies of people passing by.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Murky slime burbles below, seeming to grow deeper and thicker the more one stands still.  Wild foliage climbs in every direction, the wicked and unintended children of the Zaulfung's inadvertent nourishment.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: The bleak surroundings grow even more dismal, viewing the expanse of murky swamp laid out in all directions.  Twisted marsh-dwelling trees reach up like primitive claws, vying for respite in the clean air that exists far above the noxious gasses burbling up from the watery slime underfoot.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A Gor'Tog-sized bubble of brownish-green expands and contracts in the middle of the swamp here, breathing with a life of its own.  Vicious claws loom from the trees overhead, shielding the enigmatic bubble from the elements and incubating the foul stew.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: Brackish water rises roughly knee-high on a Human throughout this swamp, making it quite laborious to trudge through the slime.  It is unknown what lurks beneath its depths due to the sickly greenish-brown color the mud has taken on.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]
description: A single violet flower blooms from a creeper vine draped between the wretched, clawlike trees above, a faint semblance of unperverted life amidst a garden of death and gloom.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southwest.

title: [[Zaulfung, Dense Swamp]]

title: [[Zaulfung, Ruined Shrine]]
description: Shattered and broken, a large wooden altar lies desecrated and befouled here, partially sunken into the thick mud.  Deep gouges and claw scratches mar the surface of the sacrilegious monument, likely torn asunder by the wicked hand of a sluagh.

title: [[Zaulfung, Underwater]]
description: The murky waters end amongst a thick layer of decomposing sludge, heaped atop the uneven earth below.  Shadows rule here, allowing only a pale glimpse of the surroundings.

title: [[Zaulfung, Underwater]]
description: Very little light filters down this far through the muck, choking off your vision.  The outline of a rough massive slab of rock is barely visible to the east.  A jagged crack has crumbled in its side, seeming to lead into an underwater cavern of some sort.

title: [[Zaulfung, Underwater Cave]]
description: Dark, murky waters weigh heavily on all who venture into the confines of this narrow basalt cavern.  Shafts of feeble light stream through a jagged crack in the western wall.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Dark basalt walls covered in slime encompass the chamber, lending a claustrophobic feeling to the area.  Ominous ripples swirl in the fetid sludge covering the cavern floor, their cause unknown.

title: [[Zaulfung, Underwater]]
description: Tangles of decomposing weeds and vines threaten to grasp the unwary and hold them prisoner here.  A faint amount of light filters through the muck from above, while below it only grows darker.

title: [[Zaulfung, Underwater]]
description: The surface of the swamp is just overhead, and solid forms are visible above the murky waters.  Below, the swamp descends into tangles of shadow and decaying plants.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A huge cavern, its ceiling obscured by a foul mist, opens ominously before you.  Droplets of cloudy liquid trickle down the dark basalt walls into the putrid muck that covers the slippery floor.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Movement through the thick sludge raises the waterline that marks the sides of the cave walls.  Small pieces of debris slap against the hard stone and echo dully throughout the cavern.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Thick black sludge laps up against dark basalt walls covered in a slippery mucous substance.  The complete silence of the cave is broken only by the monotonous plop of water dripping from an unseen ledge overhead.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Thick black sludge laps up against dark basalt walls covered in a slippery mucous substance.  The complete silence of the cave is broken only by the monotonous plop of water dripping from an unseen ledge overhead.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Several deep scratches mar one of the cavern walls, as if someone or something had attempted to dig minerals out of the hard rock.  Rivulets of moisture from above trickle down and fill the indentations like a thick pus.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: About halfway along the dark passage are boulders wedged in a rift near the waterline.  Dark brown moss completely covers the protruding stone, giving the semblance of a deformed badger peeking from its den.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: The walls are jagged and sharp.  Several pointed outcrops, discolored with a reddish hue, have remnants of what appears to be clumps of matted hair.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Swirling eddies of brackish water, laden with unidentifiable refuse, appear haphazardly on the filthy sludge covering the cavern floor.  Occasionally a loose rock will fall from above, spattering black slime on the dark basalt walls.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: The cavern walls glisten with an unnatural light, seemingly undulating with a life of their own.  Sloshing through the thick, foul-smelling muck becomes more difficult.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Oozing matter seeps from the dark basalt walls and dribbles down to the murky sludge covering the cavern floor.  Walking becomes more treacherous -- a single misstep might be cause for a slimy bath.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Two huge slime-covered boulders partially block the passage, leaving only a small opening to squeeze through.  The basalt-veined walls are covered with a thin deposit of black silt.
Two huge slime-covered boulders partially block the passage, leaving only a small opening to squeeze through.  The basalt-veined walls are covered with a thin deposit of black silt.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: The slippery floor pitches dangerously downwards before tapering off to resume a slight incline.  The sludge is deeper here and the mire beneath the surface is soft, slowing travel considerably.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A small, unidentifiable drowned animal floats face down in the putrid sludge.  It slaps up against the cavern wall with a sickly smacking sound as the slightest movement causes small waves in the thick muck.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Relatively clean of the wet sludge covering the cavern floor, basalt boulders give evidence of a recent cave-in.  Overhead the din from a cluster of noisy bats echoes dully against the cavern walls.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Dark basalt walls covered in slime encompass the chamber, lending a claustrophobic feeling to the area.  Ominous ripples swirl in the fetid sludge covering the cavern floor, their cause unknown.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A thin layer of silt covers heavy stalactites hanging from the vaulted ceiling.  A steady plopping sound can be heard as moisture drips down from the long icicle-shaped forms and hits the putrid sludge covering the cavern floor.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A small alcove in the cavern wall has become a dumping ground for rotted debris.  The still water in the small fetid grotto is foul and reeks of mold and decay.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Several deep scratches mar one of the cavern walls, as if someone or something had tried to dig something out of the hard rock.  Rivulets of moisture from above trickle down and fill the indentations like a thick pus.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: Small, scattered stalagmites jut above the waterline in the darkness, making travel treacherous.  Dark veins of greenish black basalt are embedded deeply in the cavern walls.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: The slippery floor pitches dangerously downwards before tapering off to resume a slight incline.  The sludge is deeper here and the mire beneath the surface is soft, slowing travel considerably.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Charred Caverns]]
description: A small shelf just below the low ceiling juts out over a massive cavern below.  A thick stalactite descends from the ceiling, offering something to shimmy down on to the lower level.  The shelf opens into a cavern of its own to the southeast, whose charred basalt walls are nearly everywhere you look.

title: [[Tiger Clan, Riverbank]]
description: The trees in this area give way to a gently sloping riverbank.  Tufts of grass bravely peek through the sand in thick brownish clumps, adding a bit of traction on the perpetually muddy slope.  A slightly worn trail leads down the bank towards the murky river below.

timeto.19457: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 400 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Segoltha River, North Bank]]
description: Swirling eddies seethe underneath the dirty brown river lapping against the muddy bank.  At the water's edge, a minuscule shelf of mud hugs the slick slope.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

timeto.19373: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 405 && Script.exists?('bescort') then nil else 45.0 end

title: [[Tiger Clan, Grassy Trail]]
description: Along a trail lined with willows, the smells of soggy grass, dead fish and peat moss permeate the atmosphere.  The bubbling and splashing of the nearby river overpower the usual sounds of the wilderness, causing the shadowed areas of the trees and tall grasses to seem almost menacing in their silence.

title: [[Chasm, Vertical Pothole]]
description: A stand of tall trees comes into view overhead, further dimming the light and making it increasingly difficult to find a foothold up through the pothole.  Caution is absolutely necessary to prevent a case of vertigo from settling in and overwhelming the senses.

timeto.2245: ;e unless DRSkill.getmodrank('Athletics') >= 540 then nil else 0.2 end

title: [[Undergondola, Narrow Path]]
description: Widening and flattening out, the steep climb begins to level into a narrow path up the mountainside.  Tall purple lupine blossoms line the trail, their fragrance mingling with the crisp mountain air in a refreshing pause on an arduous journey.

title: [[Chasm, Vertical Pothole]]
description: The steep climb shows no signs of leveling out nor of providing any further assistance to a weary mountaineer.  Writhing gently inside a craggy niche, a large black snake attempts to wriggle out of a withered skin, its cloud-covered eyes both piercing and merciless.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Nature, with all its mysterious forces, works undisturbed in this remote wilderness.  The soft gurgle of nearby waters becomes welcome music to the ears, though the stand of towering silverwood and spruce trees on the horizon does not offer up the same invitation.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Deep shadows begin to fall long across the hillside as the foliage grows denser.  Birds chitter softly back and forth to each other from the safety of the trees, as if signaling a quiet warning to all who traverse the woodlands.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Utter stillness and the grandiose play of nature settles across the landscape.  Wildflowers form an elegant multicolored drapery across the towering bluff and lend a sweet aroma to the cool mountain air.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Willowy branches reach out from the low bushes lining both sides of the trail.  Slender fingers laced with thorns await any opportunity to snag an errant coat sleeve or a patch of bare flesh, claiming it for their own.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Tamarisk bushes display their feathery tendrils, nearly as delicate as the web of a spider.  Each footfall creates a rather hollow sound upon the nearly dry earth.  Stretched full-length across the trail lies a decaying old log.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Silverwood trees line the hard-packed rocky path, casting long pockets of shadow across the brush.  Red and black berries, in various stages of ripeness, dangle invitingly across the trail from the myriad of chokecherry bushes stealthily hidden in the brown grass.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: A persistent tap-tap-tap and then another, deeper tap-tap-tap throbs at the temple as some unseen woodpecker overhead forages for insects deep in the bark of a rowan tree.  Fescue grasses grow tall around the base of each tree, vying for any available moisture.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Rows of spruce and fir trees rise neatly towards a pinnacle far ahead over the horizon.  Silence looms, marred only by the occasional skitter of some small creature foraging for the rare morsel of food beneath the ice and snow.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: A bitter chill lingers in the air and sends shivers to creep along your spine.  Dense clusters of mountain ash trees, heavily laden with icicles, line the rocky trail and bow reverently towards the earth.

title: [[Dragon's Spine, Behind the Waterfall]]
description: Footing becomes quite treacherous here as each new step brings forth more uncertainty.  Tiny rivulets of icy water trickle down from the waterfall and freeze, adding to the already slippery sheet of ice on the ground.  The more adventurous traveler might either chance the dark woodlands ahead or ferret out some way to penetrate and attempt to swim the frozen river.  The less daring of souls will quickly retreat from whence they came.

title: [[Chasm, Vertical Pothole]]
description: Vegetation creeps in and out of the face of the rock.  One possible avenue for further exploration appears to be a narrow ledge, barely wide enough to place the toe of a boot-clad foot, that leads straight up the side of the deep chasm.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: The soft chitter of a frisky squirrel quickly flitting from tree to tree overhead captures your attention.  Deep green ground ivy clusters in neat patches across the rocky path, grasping relentlessly for any feasible handhold on the earth.

title: [[Dark Woodlands, Rugged Trail]]
description: Tiny pebbles crunch noisily underfoot as parcels of snow turn to patches of withered, brown grass.  Occasionally, your footsteps splash into a puddle of icy water, interrupting the solitude.

title: [[Dirge, Tromlyn's Tannery]]
description: Tromlyn, the proprietor of this small shop, sits behind a small wooden counter.  At one end of the counter sits a large rock troll skull which has been mounted on wood and rests beside a catalog.  Prepared hides have been stretched in wooden frames and mounted on the wall in between shelves displaying merchandise, while bearskin rugs cover the stone floor.

title: [[Dirge, Greyka's Jewelry]]
description: A low, lava stone counter rests near one of the walls.  Behind it is an elegantly carved rocking chair upon which sits a stout Dwarven woman.  Rugs made from animal pelts adorn the floor while the small window is covered with a curtain fashioned from troll skin.  In addition to the sparse decorations, a nondescript door leads to another room.

title: [[Obsidian Pass, Guard House]]
description: The jagged black mountains for which this pass is named jut to the east and west, just barely allowing passage for the north-south road.  A guard house is situated beside the path, looking as if it were melting out of the mountainside.  Elven runes are cut into the walls, and a sigil of warding has been carved over the doorway.

title: [[Ranger Guild, Tree Grove]]
description: Nature's soothing embrace surrounds this private reserve of young felenok pines.  The rare trees bear golden-tipped cones and the aromatic scent of their needles fills the air.  Near the center of the grove, a mature pine rises majestically above the others, its branches supporting a small treehouse that is accessed by a dangling rope.  A tattered note is tacked to the wall of the guildhall between the large picture window and the door.

title: [[Ranger's Guild, West Tree Grove]]
description: The large trees that soar to the sky are home to the songs of several species of birds.  High above, their branches weave together to create a soothing green canopy.  Below, roots that bulge from the ground are bedded with leaves, twigs, and ferns, offering a silent invitation to a comfortable rest.  A few deer pause in their feeding to look around, before moving on to consume nearby flora.

title: [[Wreck, Near the Bow]]
description: The one remaining mast juts upward from the ruined deck, leaning at an angle as it rises above the surrounding forest.  Missing planks on the deck make the footing treacherous, and the gaps provide glimpses into the sand- and muck-filled holds below.  Anything of value has long since been stripped from the ship, leaving only weathered wood and scraps of rope and canvas.

title: [[Wreck, Bow]]
description: Directly below the bow, a large, gaping hole opens in the hull, vivid testimony to the reason the ship lies beached on the shore.  Mud and muck spills from the breach, from which weeds and vines clinging to the dirt climb up the exposed wood surface.  Little remains of the rigging and tackle, just bits and pieces of rope scattered on the planks of the deck.  The stump of a bowsprit points at the surrounding forest.

title: [[Wreck, Near the Stern]]
description: Protruding from the tilted decking, the shattered remnant of the mainmast dominates the area.  Little remains of the cordage and spars that once graced the mast except some bits and pieces of wood scattered about the deck.

title: [[Wreck, Stern]]
description: Decking ends abruptly above the swirling water of the river as the stern of the ship drops off into the muddy brown waters of the Segoltha.  Broken planks and timbers give mute testimony to the power of the river.  Little remains of the name once emblazoned on the stern, only the faded letters CK and FI.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Cliff Face]]
description: Shrieking winds hurtle ice and snow, seeking to hammer all living things into oblivion or freeze them where they stand.  Finding a safe way up the mountainside becomes increasingly difficult, as the granite is slick with ice.  Scarred with deep gouges left by sharp climbing implements, a steep cliff offers a way downwards.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Broad Ledge]]
description: A broad ledge offers a brief respite from climbing, with minimal protection from the elements.  The wind howls continuously, hammering against the sleek rock and whistling despondently as it funnels its way down the steep mountainside.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Broad Ledge]]
description: Encrusted with ice and snow, a sheer granite cliff towers above.  Heavy with moisture, vaporous clouds encircle the area like ghostly fogbanks upon a churning sea, hindering movement and making travel hazardous.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Broad Ledge]]
description: Encrusted with ice and snow, a sheer granite cliff towers above.  Heavy with moisture, vaporous clouds encircle the area like ghostly fogbanks upon a churning sea, hindering movement and making travel hazardous.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Treacherous Cliff]]
description: Dense clouds obscure the view below, while an incredibly steep cliff soars out of sight into the icy mists overhead.  At eye level are slippery mountain walls, marred with craggy holes left by pitons and gouges left by ice axes.  Whistling winds rush down from the summit, trailing plumes of frost crystals that threaten to freeze the breath in one's lungs.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Broad Ledge]]
description: Encrusted with ice and snow, a sheer granite cliff towers above.  Heavy with moisture, vaporous clouds encircle the area like ghostly fogbanks upon a churning sea, hindering movement and making travel hazardous.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Plunging downwards in a near-vertical drop, a sheer granite cliff forms the southern face of the mountain's summit.  Thin, wispy clouds writhe about the summit, sometimes taking the form of ground-hugging fog and other times swirling through the wild currents of wind like ghoulish apparitions.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The darkened temple towers over the barren landscape, yet still the bone-chilling winds shriek wildly all about as if the temple were no deterrent at all to their ferocity.  Loose rubble shifts dangerously loudly with each step taken.  Jagged pillars of ice have been eternally frozen in a desperate grasp toward the heavens above.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The only evidence of a seasonal melt of the snow and ice is a worn crevice in the rock that slants ever more steeply towards the blighted lands around Asketi's mountain.  Little more than a trickle ever makes its journey downwards at any given time, though the years of the slow moving liquids have gradually eroded the ground to form the crevice.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Frozen shards of stone and ice form a fine, loose rubble over the ground.  Asketi's frozen North Wind shrieks out from around the temple and plummets over the edge of the lifeless mountaintop.  For those brave enough to look, a vast view of the surrounding lands stretches out as far as the eye can see.  Dark shadows blanket the forests below.  The bowing of the trees to the force of the winds gives the illusion of shadowy phantasms sweeping over the countryside.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Temple of the North Wind]]
description: Asketi's immaculate Temple of the North Wind towers above the flat summit, further dwarfing everything in the surrounding countryside.  Carved directly from the granite mountain, the strength and security of the structure is unquestionable.  Small ice crystals carried on the wind's updraft have coalesced to form a thin layer of frost on the temple's surface.  Twisted shadows race across the granite arch entrance, but in the absence of light, it's hard to discern whether the shadows are real or imagined.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Countless decades of fierce winds have worn the ground completely smooth.  The light rubble that dots a few small patches of the ice's surface is only discernable from the mixed snow and ice in some areas by its light discoloration under the surface.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Unlike the rubble-riddled ground near the temple, the mountain's surface becomes smooth and relatively free of debris save for dark swirls that wind their way through the frozen snow and ice towards the southern edge.  The surrounding ice is lessened by the swirls, sapped of its luster and purity.  Two boulders lean against one another near the massive granite structure, a narrow crevice remaining between the boulders and the ground beneath them.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The crippling blight that plagues the region emanates outward from the majestic Temple of the North Wind.  For as far as the eye can see towards the southwest the typically vibrant colors of the trees and other native foliage are dulled throughout the year.  In place of spring greens and autumn reds and oranges are muted olives and browns.  Even the white of snow-capped trees lower on the mountain is dingy and impure.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Some rocks have obviously been moved from their natural resting places into an arrow-like formation.  A rough, uneven mound of snow provides an incline for the southward-pointing arrow to rest upon.  Throughout most of the year the object being pointed to remains a mystery.  However, those lucky enough to catch the first light of dawn through the spring and summer will find the arrow pointing to the Adder constellation low on the southern horizon.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: When not blanketed with clouds, the sky remains a brilliant whitish blue throughout all but the final moments of the day.  In these uncharacteristically beautiful moments, deep purples and blues intermix with vibrant and fiery reds and oranges upon the sky's vast canvas.  A stone bench, which is new compared to the temple itself, rests midway between the temple and the summit's edge for those desiring to gaze upon the sight.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Unnaturally long shadows flit about the darkened area, though where the shadows' owners may be can only be left to speculation.  A solid sheet of ice blankets the ground here, freezing the rubble firmly into place.  The ice is mostly smooth and unmarred except where broken shards of rubble rest.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The looming temple partly shadows the surface during the morning hours of the day.  Even when the sun gazes down fully upon Elanthia from its throne at midday, shadows manage to creep westward from some of the more prominent spires of the temple.  As day descends into night, though, the shadows hastily retreat into the mica-flecked granite of the mighty fortress, patiently waiting for the time to creep out into the world again.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A haunting yet melodic whisper is carried on the wind as it gusts through the trees of the forests below.  In the brief reprieves from the vigorous gales, a thin, lingering fog wavers in and out of view just inches above the ice and rubble-covered ground.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Most of the ground is solid ice, as if a small stream of water had somehow erupted from the depths of the mountain and fallen prey to the wicked winds.  The rubble here has been frozen firmly into place and makes little noise beneath the moving feet of those who dare travel the region.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A small twig has been forcefully shoved into a rounded mound of ice.  A tiny, faded ribbon that desperately clings to the twig holds a broken medallion fluttering in the moaning winds.  Etched upon the half of the medallion that remains is the broad head of what once would have been an impressive unicorn.  A single ice crystal has frozen just under the unicorn's eye, as if it were a tear of sadness from the avatar's goddess.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A miniature shrine, if it could even be called that, rests dangerously close to the summit's edge.  Sheltered inside the shrine is a diminutive representation of a withered, grey hag bearing a rough burlap sack at her hip and a blood-stained scythe in her right hand that is poised for a strike above her head.  Propped at the base of the figure is a badly weathered crib filled with rotten vegetables that have been preserved only by the sheer lack of warmth to be found here atop the world.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The winding path continues to meander its way around the impressive temple.  The frigid temperatures bite to the very core of one's being, sapping the will to continue.  A light fog lingers in this slightly lower area of the mountain's summit, creeping eerily over the ground without direction like a ghostly apparition.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Gate of Souls]]
description: Three blackened granite spires rise up out of the ground to form a stunning gateway leading into the gaping maw of a large cave.  The fog that so heavily dominates this side of the mountain's summit recoils from the frigid blasts of air that emanate from within as if they were the expelled breath of Asketi herself.

title: [[Dirge's Solace, Garden of Souls]]
description: Light creeps in from the enormous gash that leads into the cavern, illuminating the chill vapors clinging to the floor with a diffuse glow.  Dripping from the ceiling like the stalactites of more conventional caves, massive icicles catch and reflect the light in a sparkling display.  The tinkling of cracking ice provides a staccato counterpoint to the moaning of the wind whipping through the entry.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A delicate fog hugs the ground with its ethereal tendrils, winding its way in and out of the larger rocks that dot the summit's surface.  Errant wisps of the grey substance occasionally spiral upward several feet above the ground.  The hiss of the winds as they blast through tiny holes in the rocks lends the illusion of great, hulking adders keeping a watchful gaze over the area.

title: [[Dirge's Solace, Garden of Souls]]
description: Blue icicles cascade down the walls onto the white drifts of frost covering the floor.  Carved from grey ice, a banshee clad in a tattered funereal shroud stands with her head thrown back in a soundless wail while snow adders writhe about her feet.  The tinkling of shattering ice is accompanied by the eerie fluting of the winds directed by holes drilled into the cavern walls.  A carved granite door is set in one cavern wall, leading deeper into the mountain.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The scattered debris of a fire lies near a grouping of three large boulders.  The tips of only a few branches show any signs of ever being touched by a flame's life-giving warmth.  Half-buried in a mound of snow and ice is a dulled sphere with a very faint yellow tinge to it, similar to that of a fading favor orb.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A serpentine column of ice twists and winds its way across the ground before arching up into the air.  A frozen, dark substance runs the length of the ice, contained almost precisely within the center of the structure.  An enigma in both form and purpose, the frozen mass is remarkably free of the gravelly debris present even on the very ground that supports the column.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Deep, rolling masses of spectral fog creep in and continue on over the mountain's edge.  Though the writhing mass is dense, the fog only comes up knee-high on a Human.  Still, each step is dangerous enough to be tested lest some poor soul join the fog in its flight over the mountain's ledge!
paths: Obvious paths: obscured by a thick fog

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Entombed within an area of the ice unmarred by the rocky debris are the remnants of some long-forgotten plant.  Perhaps in a much earlier time such plants were more prevalent here at the top of the world, or perhaps the pitiful thing is all that remains of someone's attempt to deny the brutal savagery of the unforgiving climate.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The temple's northern face looms above a series of massive statues.  Each statue is a black marble gargoyle captured in some moment of ferocity.  Expressions of rage, lust for battle, and savagery are spread across their faces.  Great taloned claws rake menacingly at the air while several of the statues sport widely spread wings.  The stalwart defenders have stood as guards for countless ages and show no signs of leaving their posts.

Drawn-out shadows stretch wildly across the northern face of the granite structure and leap completely over the mountain's cliff-like ledge.  No fewer than six black marble gargoyles are in sight down the northern face of the temple, each displaying vengeful glowers as they peer out hauntingly in the dim light of night.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The temple's northern face looms above a series of massive statues.  Each statue is a black marble gargoyle captured in some moment of ferocity.  Expressions of rage, lust for battle, and savagery are spread across their faces.  Great taloned claws rake menacingly at the air while several of the statues sport widely spread wings.  The stalwart defenders have stood as guards for countless ages and show no signs of leaving their posts.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: A small scrap of cloth has been half-frozen into the disheveled rubble and ice mixture.  The wild winds have blown the scrap into little more than tattered shreds of the garment to which it used to belong.  A single red stripe on the cloth's underside remains untouched by the harsh climate, seemingly a testament to hope not being entirely forsaken in these troubled lands.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Wraithlike wisps of thick fog blanket the side of the mountain and roll listlessly over the summit's edge.  Rather than dissipating into the swift currents of the mountain's winds, the wisps roll out to form a shroud around the face of the mountain against the day's morning sun.  Only during the peak of the sun's journey towards night is the veil pierced and the area illuminated.
paths: Obvious paths: obscured by a thick fog

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: Twin statues stand guard here, each gazing out upon the tainted lands surrounding the mountain.  Both statues have been carved from very fine obsidian, obviously not native to the mountaintop, and both resemble Asketi's black unicorns.  While one peers northeasterly towards the wholesome lands of Therengia far off in the distance, the other scrutinizes the lands of Zoluren and even Ilithi to the southeast.  A cool, gentle fog writhes about the two figures.

title: [[Asketi's Mount, Summit]]
description: The winds screech angrily about as a corner of the temple deflects their hurried course.  The dark granite structure has been worn smooth with the passage of both wind and time alike.  Rather than snowdrifts filling the wind-guarded niche, an angled mound of solid ice studded with bits of stone climbs the temple's surface.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Broad Steps]]
description: Chiseled from the mountain's bedrock, broad steps faced with marble tile ascend through several feet of solid black granite.  Polished to a soft gleam and carved to resemble undulating adders, ornate silverwillow banisters flow up the walls from the entry arch to the temple above.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Rows of tall pillars stretch off in either direction, forming a colonnade around the perimeter of the temple's lowest tier.  Standing at the top of a flight of broad steps, a silent figure of cold stone scrutinizes all who ascend.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Giant adders of black granite form the pillars along this stretch of the gallery.  The floor ends just beyond the western side of the columns, dropping a dizzying height to the peak below.  Life-sized statues are displayed on low pedestals situated between the pillars.  Stretching high overhead, a large frieze depicting Dergati graces the eastern wall.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Built to honor Asketi, Mistress of the North Wind, the lower tier of the temple is open to the air.  Scoured clean by the relentless wind, twisted monoliths rise dramatically from the outer ledge of the floor.  Only the bulk of the temple's second level provides a modicum of shelter from the icy blasts of air shrieking across the mountain's peak.  A meticulously carved frieze spans the foundation wall of the upper story.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: The drop beyond the soaring columns is sheer, a vertical buttress cleaving vacant air.  A cold wind whistles around the spires, plucking at hair and clothing like malevolent imps.  Carved into solid granite, a narrow stairway ascends to the temple's second level.  A large sculpture in the middle of the gallery commands attention.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Carved in bas-relief, a frieze detailing elaborate scenes of agony and torture covers the wall.  Arctic winds howl around the slim spires thrusting into the sky like spears of stone.  Stinging particles of ice carried by the wind find their way into clothing and armor to produce a bone-deep chill.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Scandalous by conservative standards, a frieze honoring Kerenhappuch and Idon covers much of the black granite wall.  Icicles reach down the grooves of the fluted pillars, spilling onto the floor and trickling over the edge where the floor ends abruptly.  A pair of marble gargoyles peer over the ledge, as if keeping watch for any foolish enough to attempt scaling the temple wall.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Featureless stone columns, each polished so perfectly smooth that their curves gleam like a dull mirror, line the broad ledge that makes up the temple's bottom tier.  Speckled with frost, the wall is covered with a frieze carved in high relief.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Last Sacrifice]]
description: Facing directly north, this corner of the temple has neither columns nor statuary to offer shelter from the deadly cold winds.  Close to the ledge stands an angled slab of granite.  Thick frost coats the iron manacles set into the slab, although the dark stone itself is free of rime.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Soaring spires form a wall of sorts along the brink of the precipice.  Like vigilant sentinels, misshapen marble beasts sculpted in wary attitudes crouch between the columns.  One statue, carved in the likeness of a winged orc, regards the frieze opposite him with a supercilious smile.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Intricately carved friezes depict natural disasters and the aftermath of devastation.  Bitterly cold wind swirls between the granite pillars, exceptionally strong gusts rattling the slender spires as if to underscore the tale of destruction told by the graven images.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Nothing but wide-set pillars stands between the open air and the dubious safety of the windswept gallery.  The ledge beyond the columns drops away sheer, plunging into the mists shrouding the base of the temple.  Freezing gusts of wind quickly numb any exposed skin.  Black granite soars overhead, carved with a frieze of malicious gremlins.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Colonnade]]
description: Turning sharply here, the broad ledge of the lower tier is lined with columns sculpted to resemble coiled adders.  The stone serpents overlook the mists rising from the glacial fields below.  A broad staircase has been chiseled into the heavy rock, ascending to the temple's second tier.  Carvings cover the walls on either side of the stairs.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Dark Sanctuary]]
description: This expanse of ground is perfectly flat, as if the mountain's topmost peak had been sliced away.  Rising up out of the snow is a mammoth stone edifice that spans almost the entire length and breadth of the summit.  Glittering with touches of frost, giant columns of black marble support the roof and leave the temple open to the winds.  To the west, a narrow staircase cut into the rock leads down.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Dark Sanctuary]]
description: Gargantuan pillars of hewn stone support a vast roof high overhead.  Bluish light emanates from glowing crystals set in iron sconces affixed to the mighty columns.  Polished smooth as glass, the glossy floor of silver-veined black marble reflects the glow back in pools and arcs that slither across the stone like living things.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, High Altar]]
description: Open to the elements on all sides, the chamber's only shelter is offered by a roof of stone supported by four pillars.  The seamless flow of granite from the floor to the ceiling bears silent witness that the temple had been hollowed out of the mountain's summit in some long-ago age.  Numerous bones are suspended from the ceiling by slender ropes of steelsilk.  An unadorned altar of ice-blue marble stands in the center of the room, a stark splash of color against the setting of black stone and ivory bone.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Secret Staircase]]
description: Featureless black granite walls are polished perfectly so that their smooth curves gleam like a dull mirror.  Four silver sconces set equidistant around the circular chamber provide excellent light.  Shallow steps run along the walls, gradually spiraling downward in a great winding arc.  In the center of the chamber a gaping pit descends into the bedrock.  A silken net hangs from a system of ropes and pulleys affixed by the top of the steps.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Ascending into shadows above, a staircase follows the walls of the circular chamber.  A low bier covered with black silk stands centered beneath the well formed by the spiraling stairs.  Fitful light cast by lanterns flanking the arch to the north does little to alleviate the darkness closing all around.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Pillars of blue-black granite line the white plastered walls, supporting an arching ceiling painted an exquisite shade of cerulean.  Outlined by silvery stars embedded in the ceiling, a dark adder writhes against the blue background, its silver-gilt fangs exposed in mute threat.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Contrasting sharply with the white plastered walls, blue-black granite pillars support an arching ceiling painted a dark shade of crimson.  Delineated by smoky crystal shards inlaid in the ceiling, a wild-eyed black unicorn is portrayed in mid-curvet, a vivid depiction of coiled violence preparing to unleash a devastating kick.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Contrasting sharply with the white plastered walls, blue-black granite pillars support an arching ceiling painted a dark shade of crimson.  Delineated by smoky crystal shards inlaid in the ceiling, a wild-eyed black unicorn is portrayed in mid-curvet, a vivid depiction of coiled violence preparing to unleash a devastating kick.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Smooth, white plaster covers the wall space between pillars of blue-black granite.  Overhead, the vaulted ceiling is painted to resemble a stormy sky.  A tall statue of Asketi stands guard over a carved granite arch.  Framed by a tangle of disheveled hair, the grim-faced goddess glares malevolently at all who approach.  In her hands is a blued steel scythe, the honed edge glittering in the dim light.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Polished walls of black granite shine with a reflective gloss.  Carved adders wrap an arch with stony coils, basking in the icy currents of air swirling through small holes cut in the ceiling.  A moaning dirge whispers through the tunnels, rising to a shriek then fading back to near inaudibility with no discernible rhythm or meaning.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Hewn from the mountain itself, polished black granite walls shine with such a high gloss that reflections are seen with almost crystal clarity.  Small shafts cut into the ceiling exhale frigid streams of air.  Faint whispers tease at the edge of hearing, distorted by the echoing length of the passage.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: The passage here is chill and damp, smelling faintly of snow.  Close to the ceiling, the glossy black walls are lightly starred with frost.  Icy air blows intermittently through shafts cut into the roof, carrying the occasional snowflake.  The cadences of these drafts hold a vague suggestion of a wild, almost musical piping.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: A broad circular staircase leads further down into the catacombs.  Grey stone forms a low barrier around the edge of the pit ringed by the steps.  Frayed hemp fibers are caught in the weathered iron rings embedded in the wall.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Deep recesses in the walls rise from floor to ceiling in this corner of the catacombs.  Bodies wrapped in fine wool are interred within these stone shelves.  Chill winds whistle through the shafts cut in the ceiling, skirling a wild lament for the dead.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Polished walls of black granite are lined with hollowed-out niches rising tier above tier, like berths in a ship, from floor to ceiling.  Bodies wrapped in fine wool are interred within these horizontal recesses.  Several are inaccessible from the floor, leaving one to wonder how they were chiseled out of the hard rock.

description: Polished granite walls taper up to a curved triangular point from which a silvery globe is suspended.  Beneath the globe is a narrow marble catafalque, upon which rest skeletal remains wrapped in a tattered winding-sheet.  A chill enfolds the area within its icy grasp, mercifully choking off any stench of decay.

A strong resemblance between the pair suggests a family relationship.  Veils of scented smoke drift up from a shallow bowl placed on the ledge beneath the carving.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Alive with statuary carved from the living earth itself, a great menagerie of animals stands watch over the tomb.  Life-sized sculptures of arzumos and leucros, giant serpents and scorpions seem to move in the flickering shadows, their gaze fixed in stony silence upon a plain sarcophagus covered with a flat marble slab.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Solid granite has been hewn away to form this spacious antechamber.  The dark walls are decorated with worn bas-reliefs, all covered with a layer of frost.  An occasional draft of frigid air swirls down the staircase, accompanied by a faint moaning whisper.  Lit candles flicker with shifts in the air current, causing the light pooling on the floor to dance frenetically before settling back into a steady glow.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Devoid of the familiar sights and sounds of the lands above, these subterranean chambers are ominously quiet.  Sepulchral recesses line the walls, chiseled into the mountain granite.  Each are filled with corpses in varying stages of decay.  Water drips slowly from the ceiling, covering the bodies in a thin veil of ice.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Dripping water echoes eerily through these subterranean chambers.  Shadowy niches, hollowed out of the mountain granite, line the walls from floor to ceiling.  Bodies in various phases of decomposition fill the shallow alcoves.  A thin layer of frost covers the stone and corpses indiscriminately, glittering in the dim light cast by earthenware lamps placed within small recesses carved from the walls.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Faint yet steady, the persistent sound of dripping water echoes in the cold stone passages.  Narrow recesses are carved from the walls, filled with the remains of the dead.  Thin veils of ice cover the bodies with a final burial shroud.  The air, chill and stale, seems to grow heavier with each passing moment.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Blue marble tiles, rectangles of ancient stone cut and placed with perfect symmetry, line the walls around and the ceiling above.  Shallow gutters score each side of the chamber while a series of drainage holes are visible overhead.  Placed within a semicircular recess carved in the wall, a pale stone casket gleams with a mantle of frost.

description: Oppressive silence fills these subterranean chambers, broken only by the faint sound of dripping water.  Untold numbers of corpses fill the sepulchral recesses lining the walls.  Cold and barren, the catacombs are devoid of the sense of light and life present above ground even during a winter's night.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Large tiles of golden marble interlock with scarcely visible seams along the walls and floor.  The scale of the stonework lends this alcove a sense of majesty requiring reverence.  Shallow gutters score each side of the chamber floor, while a series of drainage holes are visible in the ceiling overhead.  Placed within a semicircular recess carved in the wall, a pale stone casket gleams with a mantle of frost.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Illumination from the passage beyond bathes the walls with a pearlescent gleam, glinting along the edges of the polished dove-grey marble tiles.  Shallow gutters score each side of the chamber while a series of drainage holes are visible in the ceiling overhead.  Placed within a semicircular recess carved in the wall is a pale stone casket.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Winding serpentinely back and forth, frost-covered stairs lure one deeper into the catacombs.  Stale air wafts up from the subterranean passages below, carrying with it a hint of ice and decay.  The darkness of the tunnel is broken by a single lantern, which casts wavering shadows over the bone-filled niches lining the walls.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Winding serpentinely back and forth, frost-covered stairs lure one deeper into the catacombs.  Stale air wafts up from the subterranean passages below, carrying with it a hint of ice and decay.  The darkness of the tunnel is broken by a single lantern, which casts wavering shadows over the bone-filled niches lining the walls.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Ornate pillars carved from the mountain itself frame vertical alcoves lining both sides of the passage.  Skeletons are propped up within each, gazing sightlessly upon all who trespass within these halls of the dead.  One alcove is empty but for a dark silhouette traced by frost against the stone, leaving no clue as to where the previous occupant now resides.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Dense shadows creep in along every surface, disturbed by the flickering of faint illumination reflecting off the patches of ice covering the walls and floor.  Shallow gutters score each side of the chamber while icicles clog most of the drainage holes in the ceiling overhead.  A translucent curtain of ice seals a large, semi-circular recess.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Walls thickly coated with frost soar up to a vaulted ceiling.  Coiled adders of polished copper are laid into the floor, forming a visual barrier before the entry.  Centered in the chamber is a green marble catafalque, upon which rest fleshless remains wrapped in a rotting cerement.  The faint scent of sweet spices and bitter incense lingers in the air, despite the nose-numbing cold.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Polished black granite flecked with silvery mica encloses this alcove in bleakest midnight and stars.  A subtle draft of frigid air swirls through the chamber.  Covered with a thick layer of frost, a low casket rests upon the floor.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: A narrow winding staircase has been chiseled into the heavy rock.  Twisting around a corner, it spirals up into darkness.  Utilizing all available space for burial, bone-filled niches line the walls of the stairwell.  A thin layer of frost covers the rough granite floor.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: The warren of close-set corridors snakes deeper into the mountain.  Slender icicles stream from the soot-blackened ceiling, rippling gold in the candlelight.  The floors lit by the flickering glow are smooth stone starred with frost.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Delicate frost spreads across the walls like an opalescent veil, drifting down to cover the fleshless remains of the dead interred within the niches.  Tall candelabra are spaced along the length of the corridor.  Some thoughtful soul has lit a few of the tapers, although shadows still cling like cobwebs in the corners.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Panes of ice sheathe the stone walls from floor to ceiling, sealing most of the niches rising tier above tier.  Jagged edges frame one long recess half-filled with stacks of bones sorted by size.  A grinning skull peeks out from a fan of curved ribs, strangely reminiscent of a coy young woman's flirtations.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Skeletal fingers of ice reach down from the ceiling, dripping spatters of water onto the intricate mosaic covering the floor.  Wisps of smoke drift from beeswax candles, scenting the air with a hint of honey at odds with the eternal cold of stone and ice enfolding the catacombs.  Rough-hewn steps spiral down into darkness.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Twisting and turning, the claustrophobic burial hallway is filled with grim reminders of its purpose.  Bones spill from niches crammed full of fleshless remains.  Stacks of femurs placed against the wall are mortared with ice.  Silence weighs heavy in the frigid air as if intent on smothering all signs of life that dare intrude in this place of the dead.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Countless skeletons have been crammed tightly into the narrow niches lining the walls.  More bones lie along the walls, methodically sorted by size and type into geometrical designs that rise halfway to the ceiling.  A row of vacant-eyed skulls sits atop the macabre wainscotting.  Frost coats everything with a dusting of glittering white.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Like a garland of death, a swag of skulls is draped over a simple arch framed by ribs stacked to form tapering columns.  The deep recesses of the ossuary are filled with yellowing bones.  Flickering light emanates from an oil lamp placed upon a skeletal pyramid, lending a golden sheen to the frost-covered remains.  Chill silence spreads over the crypt like a pall.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Broken here and there by shallow horizontal alcoves, the catacomb walls are sheathed in curtains of glistening ice.  A jumble of bones fills each niche completely.  Formed by slow seeping moisture, which freezes over time, new sheets of ice will eventually form a final burial shroud for the remains.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Broken here and there by shallow horizontal alcoves, the catacomb walls are sheathed in curtains of glistening ice.  A jumble of bones fills each niche completely.  Formed by slow seeping moisture, which freezes over time, new sheets of ice will eventually form a final burial shroud for the remains.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Numerous alcoves filled with remains of souls long deceased line the walls.  Dark shadows behind curtains of ice descending from the ceiling indicate more bones are sealed within frozen stone.  Frozen pools fill the depressions in the uneven floor.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Numerous alcoves filled with remains of souls long deceased line the walls.  Dark shadows behind curtains of ice descending from the ceiling indicate more bones are sealed within frozen stone.  Frozen pools fill the depressions in the uneven floor.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Massive columns of black granite covered with serpentine markings brace the high ceiling overhead.  An arch fringed with icicles pierces the frozen western wall, while more tombs are visible to the north and south.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Sheathed in ice, stark black granite walls devoid of any ornamentation press in.  Surrounded by the crisp scent of frost and stale air, the warmth of the sun and the kiss of rain seem naught but a distant dream.  The sarcophagus in the center of the tomb is empty and unsealed, an icy vacancy waiting patiently for a tenant.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Granite pillars encircle a low dais upon which rest skeletal remains clad in the rotting remnants of sumptuous robes.  Gigantic statues of wind hounds crouch between the pillars, leaving only one opening at the foot of the dais through which to view the bones unobstructed.  Worn by countless visitors over the ages, a shallow trench stretches across the floor from the arch to the bier.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Faint streaks of golden lamplight play over granite walls obscured by sheer curtains of frost and shadow.  Burial niches contain an overflowing abundance of bones sheathed in ice.  Skulls, femurs, finger-bones and vertebrae litter the floor and make for treacherous footing.  Through some acoustic trick, the curvature of the rough-hewn steps magnifies even the slightest of sounds, generating echoes that reverberate eerily through the stone tunnels.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Centuries of burial have filled every nook and cranny of the ossuary with the grim relics of the dead.  One wall is decorated with curving rows of vertebrae forming stylized waves broken here and there by yellowing scapulae, grotesquely reminiscent of dorsal fins clearing the ocean's surface.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Gleaming like faint stars on the dank floor, a translucent layer of frost spreads across the stone and up along the walls.
