A group of Merelew hunters are gathered around a table showing off various crossbow designs and are engaged in a seemingly never-ending debate about how or if such devices could be used practically beneath the waves.  From time to time, as one moves away, another approaches and begins the debate anew.

title: [[Craftsmen's Academy, Tailors' Stich 'n Snitch]]
description: A trio of spinning wheels sit between a handful of looms, and all are arranged in a horseshoe shape around a platform that showcases various Merelew fashions intermixed with vibrant fabrics, thick furs and other textiles from the mainlands.  Several elderly ladies walk the circuit, taking turns sharing stories and showing off knitting techniques as they furiously work their needles with yarn carefully feeding out of satchels slung over their shoulders.  Some guarded doorways are tucked away along a back wall.

title: [[Craftsmen's Academy, Applied Artificing]]
description: A series of guarded doorways line a segment of the wall here.  Scattered between them are tables with differently styled magical founts, beads and wands of different metals, woods and stones, and other tools commonly used by artificers.  Several strange contraptions also serve as a gathering point where a Merelew Enchantress tries to explain their purpose, but the perplexed expressions of those gathered about her don't seem promising.

title: [[Craftsmen's Academy, Association of Alchemists]]
description: Shelves are lined with jars of pastes, unguents, potions and other finished remedies.  Tables set along a windowed wall display several variations of the Wayerd pyramid, some with cambrinth and others without.  Overhead, numerous clumps of colorful dried and drying herbs are bundled with lengths of seaweed that dangle from a large fishing net -- all of which provide a heady, medicinal aroma.  Additional stations lie beyond guarded doorways.

title: [[Craftsmen's Academy, Hall of Forges]]
description: A row of forges stands opposite a matching row of anvils, and curtains of thick hides are suspended from the ceiling to help contain and redirect the smoky air and heat towards windows and vents higher up.  They also serve to soften the constant clanging of metal striking metal as craftsmen show off specialized techniques to accomplish their creative designs.  Private forges lie beyond guarded doorways nearby for those unwilling to disclose their secrets in the more public spaces here.

title: [[Swish Slash and Stab, Salesroom]]
description: Sleek racks and neatly organized shelves showcase an array of stylish garments.  Bright lighting accentuates the vibrant colors and intricate designs, allowing each piece to shine in its own right.  Mirrors strategically placed around the space invite shoppers to envision themselves in the latest fashions.

title: [[Urbane Outfitters, Sales]]
description: Intricately patterned wallpaper in muted hues complements rich, dark wooden furniture adorned with luxurious upholstery.  Ornate chandeliers and sconces cast a warm glow over the space, highlighting the refined details and plush fabrics.  A few shelves and racks display the merchandise on offer.

title: [[The Eyes Have It, Salesfloor]]
description: Stepping into the shop, there is an inviting ambiance with soft, pastel hues adorning the walls and plush, cream-colored carpet underfoot.   Oil lanterns overhead create a warm and comforting glow, illuminating the tastefully arranged shelves and racks.  A few sales clerks mingle with the shoppers, answering questions and straightening merchandise.

title: [[Pack to Basics, Salesroom]]
description: The shed is a haven for adventure seekers and avid travelers, adorned with an array of rugged, versatile, and stylish containers.  Friendly and knowledgeable staff stand ready to assist, helping customers find the perfect container to accompany them on their journeys.

title: [[Animal Market, Main Room]]
description: Wooden walls, painted with realistic murals of mountains and forests, surround a planked floor decorated with a design of grass and pebbles.  Recessed lighting in the sky-blue ceiling allows for lighting to be focused on the surfaces displaying the shop's merchandise.  Salesclerks bustle about, answering questions and restocking the wares.

title: [[Cause for Locket, Salesroom]]
description: Displays and showcases fill this emporium, each one offering an array of merchandise.

title: [[Hunka's Seaside Delights, Front Room]]
description: Enclosed within smooth driftwood walls, the shop is dominated by a wraparound seaglass counter that is flanked by a large cookware display and some salvaged rope netting.  Colorful paper lanterns in the shape of various fish are suspended from the ceiling in playful clusters.

title: [[Creature's Pet, Main Tent]]
description: Oiled canvas walls encompass the interior, providing protection from the elements for both the customers and the living merchandise.  Sturdy cages are scattered throughout the area, each one displaying one of the pets on offer.  Shoppers inspect the various animals, while the animals growl, hiss, or screech back as the mood takes them.

title: [[What A Steel!, Shop]]
description: Sturdy displays showcase an array of weapons, from swords to pikes.  The space is organized and well-lit, allowing customers to carefully examine each item while knowledgeable staff provide information on functionality and proper usage.

title: [[Eylhaar's Rest, Dive Bar]]
description: The air in this dingy bar is thick with the acrid scent of spilled ale and the smoky residue of countless pipes.  Framed by rows of bottles with unrecognizable labels, a massive, weathered painting of a snarling jackal hangs on the wall behind the bar.  Dim lanterns flicker, casting elongated shadows that dance across the uneven stone floor.  Seashells and fishing nets haphazardly decorate the walls.

title: [[Goblin Treats, Sales Booth]]
description: Twisted nails barely hold together the charred woodwork of this crudely-built dilapidated stall.  Molten-red banners drape from the wooden overhang, surrounded by portraits of the face of a goblin warlord, each signed in an illegible script.  A single goblin, very clearly out of his element, staffs the booth.  Large braziers stand out front, roiling with a flame that smokes and hisses, fueled by a reservoir of naphtha.

title: [[The Enflamed Effigy, Sales Booth]]
description: The interior of this wooden stall carries the musty scent of straw.  Inside the small space, a large display holds rows of straw-stuffed dolls on shelves, their stitched faces bearing painted eyes.  Sunlight filters through the gaps in the cedar planks that form the walls, casting a warm, golden glow over the merchandise.

title: [[Sirit's Seafloor Leathers, Main Room]]
description: Perfectly tanned hide makes up the walls of this tent, lined along the inside with heavy cream colored cotton.  Rows of fringed scarlet and gold knotwork festoon the entrance, and polished sandalwood tent poles are wrapped in giltworked and embossed suede.  Little copper-tooled incense burners suspended from waxed silk cords send a gentle drift of musk across the room, blending pleasantly with the smell of leather.

title: [[Proud as a Peacock, Sales Floor]]
description: The room is a mesmerizing sanctuary of elegance and grace, with vibrant hues and intricate patterns reminiscent of the majestic peacock.  Walls adorned in rich turquoise and deep royal blue hues set the tone, while iridescent feather motifs grace the decor.  Every item  mirrors the splendor of a peacock in full display.  Shelves and racks display the merchandise while clerks help the shoppers.

title: [[More Tool You, Vestibule]]
description: A large canvas flap is pulled back to allow ingress and egress for the customers.  The plain canvas walls of the tent are undecorated and billow slightly in the breeze.  Sawdust has been spread across the ground in an effort to control the damage from the passing crowds.

title: [[More Tool You, Outfitting Supplies]]
description: Racks and shelves stand against the canvas walls, filled with tools and supplies for sale.  Sawdust covers the ground, the scent of wood mixing with the slightly musty odor of the area.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[More Tool You, Dyes]]
description: Splashes of paint in a myriad of colors cover the canvas walls while colored bins filled with vials are set about the sawdust-covered floor.  A few sales clerks move about, refilling the bins and answering questions from the customers.

title: [[More Tool You, Alchemical Supplies]]
description: Lanterns hang from the tent poles as they shed illumination throughout the area.  Tables and shelves display the alchemical tools for sale, with clerks kept busy keeping the items in stock.

title: [[More Tool You, Engineering Supplies]]
description: Metal shavings mix with the sawdust on the ground, while the canvas walls are marred by splotches of oil and grease.  Sales clerks bustle about, replenishing the merchandise on the counters and stands.

title: [[More Tool You, Forging Supplies]]
description: Stenciled on the canvas tent walls are stylized hammers, tongs, and anvils, matching the various tools displayed as merchandise throughout the area.  A few sales staff stand ready to answer questions or help with purchases.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, southwest.

title: [[More Tool You, Enchanting Supplies]]
description: The scent of the pine shavings scattered on the ground permeates the area, mingling with the faint hint of brimstone and smoke.  Wooden shelves and racks stand on the sawdust-covered ground, each surface displaying a range of goods for sale.

title: [[Tougher Than Weather, Main Tent]]
description: Murals of storm clouds over various landscapes cover the canvas walls.  Bright lanterns overhead illuminate the space, accentuating the vibrant colors and textures of the products on shelves and racks neatly organized throughout.  A large counter serves as the focal point, where attentive staff stand ready to assist customers.

title: [[Cup It!, Main Room]]
description: Wide windows are set within latice-work walls that allow the ocean breezes into the structure.  Overhead, palm fronds provide the roof which is upheld by sturdy beams.  A few shelves and racks display the merchandise while a bustling clerk keeps them supplied.

title: [[Cup It!, Side Room]]
description: A cooling breeze flows through this room which has latice-work walls holding up a frond-covered roof.  Windows allow for light to illuminate the tables and stands which display the wares for sale.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, A Private Forge]]
description: Thick walls struggle to contain the blistering heat of the workshop where the fires blaze endlessly night and day.  The flickering flames give a reddish glow to the racks and shelves of tools and equipment, all neatly placed and ready for use.  Workers enter in their protective gear from time to time, checking the equipment and reporting back to a sentry at the entry.

title: [[Crossing Engineering Society, A Private Engineering Room]]
description: A fine layer of wood and stone shavings covers most of the well-worn granite floor.  The white walls have seen better days, and black and grey scuff marks adorn much of the open space.  A large workstation along one wall is unnaturally free of clutter and holds several organized tools and implements.  Grunts, curses, and labored breathing from other patrons echo throughout the large workroom.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Trail]]
description: The atmosphere is heavy with the scents of smoldering wood and sulfur, as the desolate landscape is shrouded in a colorless layer of ash.  Once trees thrived in the valley, but now they stand lifeless and scorched, victims of the nearby volcanoes.  The game trail twists among the stumps as if it was a serpent chasing prey.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Trail]]
description: Here and there, a handful of decaying stumps rise above the volcanic detritus that litters the ground, their silent forms mute testimony to the destructive power of the nearby Fists of Heaven.  Every breath of breeze causes small puffs of ash to rise listlessly from the ground, but the ash soon settles back as if the effort to break free was too much.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Cliff]]
description: Ash and debris from the nearby volcanoes blankets the ground, choking the vegetation and muffling sound.  A short cliff rises above the dead trees, its sheer face sporting a few handholds that could allow a daring adventurer to ascend the cliff.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Trail]]
description: Once, a sheltered forest thrived here, but now, it lies transformed into a desolate stretch of ash, with only a handful of decaying stumps protruding from the leaden-hued wreckage.  Occasionally something drops from the bare branches, sending a small puff of ash up from the ground where it lands.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Trail]]
description: A once-thriving grove of trees has transformed into a chaotic maze of fallen logs, decomposing stumps, and heaps of ash that engulfed the region in the aftermath of a volcanic eruption.  The trail splits here, branching in many directions as if unsure of which is the best exit from this desolate landscape.  Now and then, a faint hint of sulfur drifts on the breeze, a distant reminder of the active volcanoes in the vicinity.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Trail]]
description: A pervasive odor of putrid eggs saturates the vicinity, emanating from the western mountains and the towering volcanic peaks known as the Fists of Heaven that command the horizon.  Cloven hoofprints on the game trail give evidence of some life still clinging to this ashen desert.

title: [[Ashen Valley, Deadfall]]
description: Heaped in large stacks, decaying logs and limbs block the trail.  The hoofprints mill about in the ash, indicating the confusion of the area's denizens when faced with the obstacle.  The odor of decay has driven out the sulfur scents that normally permeate this desolate valley.

title: [[Crossing, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked away in a corner of the square is a wide stone counter set into the conical carousel beneath an angled metal awning.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are visible within, and the intricate Dwarven mechanisms that shuffle the vaults also rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Riverhaven, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked away in a corner of the square is a wide stone counter set into the conical carousel beneath an angled metal awning.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are visible within, and the intricate Dwarven mechanisms that shuffle the vaults also rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Shard, Carousel Square]]
description: A massive conical building rises from the cobbles at the square's center, its snowy alabaster surfaces gleaming brilliantly against the drab backdrop of the surrounding stone and wood.  A bejeweled mosaic set above an oval doorway reads "THE CAROUSEL."

title: [[Shard, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked away in a corner of the square is a long alabaster counter set into the conical carousel beneath a colorful striped awning.  Wide yellow stripes contrast with deep crimson alternating bands across the sturdy canvas while bright blue tassels hang from the corners.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Fang Cove, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked up against the stone wall is an expansive stone counter decorated with low relief carvings.  Screens of bamboo surround the counter, partitioning it off from the bustle of the carousel traffic.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Riverbank Mudflats, Crates]]
description: Mildewed and nearly destroyed, old shipping crates and other discards have been stacked high and left to rot among the thin weeds.  In the scant shelter of ruined lumber, shreds of rancid cloth and strips of paper lie in tangled mats, evidence that at least the rodents of Crossing may find some appeal here.

title: [[Shard Housing Office, Entry]]
description: Designed to be functional and efficient, there's little in the way of decoration or frills to be found.  The walls are cleanly painted a light, calming shade of blue while the floor is tiled with alternating squares of white and black.  Desks, each manned by a single Dwarven clerk, lie on either side of the open space.

title: [[Shard Housing Office, Prospective Buyers]]
description: A shallow dish holds three candles, each a different thickness and height and only one of which is burning.  The clerk seated behind the desk meticulously checks and re-checks figures in a large tome.  From time to time, the clerk looks up and waves an eager patron closer to sort their paperwork before efficiently sending them on their way.

title: [[Shard Housing Office, Transfers]]
description: A small, potted cactus consisting of several prickly knobs growing off of one another is the only decoration to be seen here.  Otherwise, the desk is neatly organized with stacks of parchments, a feathered quill resting in a half-filled inkwell, and a heavy tome of records that the clerk casually pages through.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Foyer]]
description: Brightly colored mosaics surround the walls of the small foyer with images of cloaked figures with hands raised overhead, the myriad of color further emphasized by the glow of the marble tzgaa orb overhead.  A pair of cushioned camel-backed love seats surround a low rattan table that provides snacks and refreshments to the many crafters and visitors that frequent the society.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Corridor]]
description: Vibrant mosaics continue along the long corridor with images of various enchanters working their craft.  Adding a measure of decoration, potted plants are placed at varying intervals, lit by ornate lanterns overhead.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Gathering Hall]]
description: Vibrantly painted sandstone surrounds the gathering hall, the walls punctuated with rune-shaped wall planters spilling over with vines of rich green ivy.  Lit by ornate brass lanterns overhead, piles of large satin pillows surround a low wicker table with a slender glass hookah upon it, the redolent scents of citrus and berry wafting throughout the area.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Supply Store]]
description: Vibrant walls of teal blue and lush hanging plants surround the shop with color, while a small curtained window looks out over the nearby square.  In the rosy hue of the overhead lanterns, a young S'Kra Mur attendant sees to the organization of several shelves of scrolls and supply bins that stand along a far wall, beyond a long rattan counter.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Bookstore]]
description: Ornate bookshelves surround the store, their shelves overflowing with a variety of old and new tomes and carefully rolled scrolls.  A short assistant pores over several of the selections, while a cloaked S'Kra Mur attendant tends to the needs of visiting artisans from behind a rattan counter.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Workroom]]
description: Gleaming marble mingles with brilliant alexandrite and laced agates to create an ornate mosaic underfoot, culminating in a radiant star design that surrounds the central brazier.  Gradient hues of blue cover the sandstone walls, darkening as they spread to the domed ceiling of the workroom.  A multitude of tzgaa stars hang overhead, creating the vague illusion of a starlit night sky, while still providing enough illumination for enchanters to work their craft.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Workroom]]
description: Gradient hues of rich purple swirl amid brilliant bands of orchid alexandrites and violet amber along the sandstone walls, creating a mesmerizing wash of color throughout the small workroom.  An enchanter's brazier stands at the center of the room, illuminated by the marbled gaethzen spheres overhead.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Workroom]]
description: Brilliant veins of golden beryl and fire agate mingle amid a vibrant sunset mural painted along the surrounding sandstone walls of the small workroom.  Underfoot, polished marble creates an ornately patterned design that encompasses the enchanter's brazier at the center of the room, awash with the glow from the sun-hued tzgaa orbs overhead.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Workroom]]
description: Fiery hues of red, orange and yellow marble mingle with brilliant carnelian and citrine to create an ornate mosaic underfoot, culminating in a radiant fire design that surrounds the central brazier.  Similar gradients cover the painted sandstone walls, punctuated by gleaming gaethzen orbs overhead that provide a generous amount of light for enchanters to work their craft.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Tool Outlet]]
description: A multitude of shipping crates and shelves surround the small shop with all manner of supplies available to those visiting the society.  When not tending to the needs of visiting artisans, an elderly Elven woman sorts supplies from behind a makeshift counter.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, Society Master's Office]]
description: Cascading to the floor in each corner, rich swaths of silk scallop the upper walls in swags of jewel-toned color that complement the golden hue of the sandstone walls.  Two thickly-padded armchairs angle towards an ornately carved writing desk along a far wall, providing a place for the Society Master to meet with various members and see to official paperwork.  The heavy scent of sandalwood drifts from an incense burner on a nearby cart.

title: [[Muspar'i Enchanting Society, A Private Enchanting Room]]
description: Pieced together by a seemingly blind worker, the walls are covered with scraps of rugs, blankets, and carpets in a kaleidoscope of colors.  A burly, light pink feldspar table is stashed in a corner of the room, providing plenty of room to work.

title: [[Knight's Hall, Tower Room]]
description: Overlooking the plaza below, a handful of shopfronts are tucked into the recessed entryways of fanciful towers and spires that reach to the ceiling high above.  Though merely decorative and designed with the plaza's aesthetic, the stonework is masterfully done and could no doubt withstand the tests of time and nature if they were completed structures.  Colorful banners drape from each tower's face and are illuminated by fanciful dragon-headed sconces -- some clutching flickering torches and others glowing gaethzen orbs.

title: [[Knight's Hall, The Shieldery]]
description: Tall columns of polished stone bricks rise high up overhead, each supporting numerous thick and heavy wooden beams that link all of the pillars together.  Shields of all shapes and sizes are stacked atop the beams while others hang from either side for viewers below to see.  Still more dangle from thick leather straps below the beams and sway gently as the occasional breeze swirls through.  From time to time, workers cart out ladders and climb up into the rafters to retrieve a particular shield for one gesturing patron or another.

title: [[Knight's Hall, Skyward Atrium]]
description: Fancifully designed sconces brighten the nights with a mix of flickering flames and steady gaethzen globes.  A small fountain with crossed stone lightning bolts is perfectly positioned beneath the opened roof to catch any precipitation with funneling assistance from cleverly located, colorful canopies above.  The shop entries here are similarly themed with rainbows, glitter-covered raindrops, clouds of cotton and more.

title: [[Rolly's Warehouse, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A wall panel has been dented in by some heavy force, and a steady dripping noise indicates a leak in the roof.  An ironwood cabinet stands against the oaken walls.  A scattered pile of splintered wood is spread across the floor, and a large horsefly buzzes about the room.

title: [[House Of Goods And Antiquities, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with a black oak trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  An ironwood rack hangs on the silk-covered walls, with a deobar cabinet along the edges of the room.  Grime has collected along the walls.

title: [[Ve Aevan Gaenan, The High Altar]]
description: High above, the temple's great iris skylight ushers in the stars' cool illumination, bathing the large metallic altar in pale light.  Drawn as if to a lodestone, soft glints of color from the domed Eyes far overhead lend their prismatic overtones to the clarity of starlight.  Sweeping majestically upwards from this raised platform, the stairways and benches lining the massive chamber dwindle into deepest shadow as they climb to meet the vague outlines of archways arrayed in a surrounding ring far above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[The Raven's Court, Secluded Alcove]]
description: Delicate floral scents blend with a heavier musk, left to lurk in the air from the former occupants' perfume and cologne.  Dimly lit by the subtle glow of the library's lamps, the niche features a smattering of fat pillows upon the carpeted floor and little else.  Uninterrupted save for a small gap, shrouding drapes of rich velvet envelop the area, serving to mute all sound and prevent conversation from reaching potential eavesdroppers in the main room.

title: [[Raven's Court, Hallway]]
description: The fanfare of the outer club fades to memory along the quiet hallway, a place where some of the more esteemed members reside.  A repeating pattern of small, gilded fleur-de-lis imbeds the smooth marble walls, while channels of magnificent blue diamonds crisscross amid the design.  Tiny glowstone orbs create a starry effect against the dark ceiling overhead, the subdued lighting casting a soft glow along the length of the wide corridor.

title: [[Raven's Court, Hallway]]
description: Plush black carpet cuts a wide swath down the broad hallway, softening the footsteps of all who pass.  In the muted light of the glowstone orbs overhead, hues of vibrant azure glint along the diamond-jeweled marble walls, adding to the elegance of the area.  Tucked within an ornately sculpted niche is a breathtaking glaes statue, displayed behind a velvet stanchion rope.

title: [[Raven's Court, Hallway]]
description: Tiny glowstone orbs overhead create a soft glow along the quiet hallway, the rich black carpet underfoot and glinting channels of blue diamond that crisscross the walls adding to the starlit ambience.  A potted bougainvillea stands against a nearby wall, its velvety white petals scenting the area with their subtly sweet aroma.

title: [[Cold Laboratory, Hallway]]
description: Built into the side of the mountain, the narrow hallway winds through walls of solid stone.  Elegant paintings of Shard and the surrounding mountains hang in even intervals, lit by gaethzen orbs that shine brightly.  Narrow panels of clear glass line the bottom half of the walls, filled with snow that keeps the hallway very cold.

title: [[Cold Laboratory, Hallway]]
description: Built into the side of the mountain, the narrow hallway winds through walls of solid stone.  Elegant paintings of Leth Deriel and the surrounding forests hang in even intervals, lit by gaethzen orbs that shine brightly.  Narrow panels of clear glass line the bottom half of the walls, filled with ice floating on a thin layer of bluish water.

title: [[Cold Laboratory, Hallway]]
description: Built into the side of the mountain, the narrow hallway winds through walls of solid stone, ending at a solid wall.  Elegant paintings of the rolling hills and plains west of Shard hang in even intervals, lit by gaethzen orbs that shine brightly.  Narrow panels of clear glass line the bottom half of the walls, filled with extremely cold water from glass pipes that flow in from somewhere unseen.

title: [[Fang Cove Forging Society, A Private Forge]]
description: Thick walls struggle to contain the blistering heat of the workshop where the fires blaze endlessly night and day.  The flickering flames give a reddish glow to the racks and shelves of tools and equipment, all neatly placed and ready for use.  Workers enter in their protective gear from time to time, checking the equipment and reporting back to a sentry at the entry.

title: [[Stone Inn, Central Room]]
description: Wagon-wheel chandeliers, fitted with gaethzen lights, hang from the high, arched ceiling beams.  A glass counter containing hand-held foods faces the entrance while displays of other merchandise are placed nearby.  Stairs along the west wall climb upwards, and a small opening along the northeast wall leads deeper into the building.

title: [[Stone Inn, Upper Hallway]]
description: The north side of the carpeted hallway consists of large panes of glass that provide a breathtaking view of the Dragon Spine Mountains in the distance while a series of doors on either side lead to guest rooms for the inn's weary patrons.

title: [[Stone Inn, Ironwood Room]]
description: A grand tapestry hangs over the mantle along the dark grain of the polished wood walls, while rich burgundy curtains, draped with gold satin cords, hang across a nearby window.  The massive ironwood sleigh bed, with ornately carved accents, is covered with opulent damask bedding and adorned with several matching, tasseled pillows providing comfort to any weary traveler.  A sweet, intoxicating scent fills the room from the lotus blossom bouquet, arranged in a clay vase, on a nightstand near the bed.

title: [[Stone Inn, Silverwillow Room]]
description: Vibrant teal silk lines the walls, combining with the plush ivory carpet that covers the polished wood floors of the spacious room.  An oversized, canopied silverwillow bed stands against one wall, covered with a floral comforter and plump pillows, both edged with ivory eyelet lace.  On the other side of the room, a satin settee invites a comfortable rest next to an ornate pedestal holding a wing-swept raven statue.

title: [[Stone Inn, Goldenoak Room]]
description: Rich tones of gold, russet orange, and brown envelop the room with a warm ambiance.  Sweeping gilded brocades drape a large, half-round window beside a broad, potted palm.  Across the room, an oil painting overlooks a small nightstand tucked next to an ornately carved four-poster bed that is swathed in an opulent silk comforter and an array of plump pillows.

title: [[Marachek's Oak, Caravan Warehouse]]
description: The length of the warehouse has been roped off, preventing visitors from wandering into the nearby workspace.  Carpenters and blacksmiths move about the warehouse, applying their trades amongst several unfinished caravans.  Multiple displays of caravan customization adorn the eastern and western partition of this area.

title: [[Caravan Warehouse, Curtained Corner]]
description: This curtained area contains only two easels resting against the walls and a leather sign.  The distant sounds from the rest of the warehouse are muffled by the thick curtain.

title: [[Stone Inn, Northeast Hallway]]
description: A large stuffed snowbeast is positioned between the two doors at the end of this hallway, as if guarding them from unwanted intruders.  The ferocious specimen appears to be lunging forward with claws extended, making it difficult to discern the image on each door.  A thick rug extends along the length of the hallway, but the lack of illumination makes it hard to tell if anyone has used this area recently.

title: [[Stone Inn, Dappled Camel Locker Room]]
description: Bamboo poles line the perimeter of this room, creating the appearance of a hut.  Polished pea gravel covers the floor, and a thatched roof completes the scene.  Two doors sit opposite each other while a row of open lockers have been attached to one wall.

title: [[Stone Inn, Shaggy Dromedary Locker Room]]
description: Bamboo poles line the perimeter of this room, creating the appearance of a hut.  Polished pea gravel covers the floor, and a thatched roof completes the scene.  Two exits sit opposite each other while a row of open lockers have been attached to one wall.

title: [[Stone Inn, Lounge]]
description: An elaborately detailed mosaic surrounds the area with a vibrant backdrop of folks basking beneath a golden sun, while others appear to picnic under broad, multi-colored umbrellas.  Several bamboo lounge chairs rest beside a rattan serving cart, and the natural sandstone floors emulate a sandy beach that slopes towards a refreshing pool.

title: [[Stone Inn, Sauna]]
description: A column of steam rises from a large wrought-iron brazier that dominates the center of this octagonal room of white stone.  Slatted ironwood benches have been placed around the brazier to provide seating for clients wishing to relax or converse.  Occasionally, an attendant can be seen through the steam, making sure that everything is in its proper place.

title: [[Endrus Forest, Fox Den]]
description: The air is cooler in this enclosed space.  Large braids constructed from the massive roots of a large tree form the walls of this natural underground grotto.  Niches in the wall create recesses that serve as seats.  Sunlight filters in through the opening, illuminating a portrait of an Elven woman with strawberry-blonde hair hanging on the wall opposite the entrance.  Discerning silver-flecked celadon green eyes smile at you mischievously from under amber-hued lashes.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked away in a corner of the cavern is a long stone counter set out from the wall.  A colorful mural covers the wall behind the counter, depicting brawny dwarves at work at a variety of tasks.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Huge boulders and bands of jumbled rock hang suspended in solid blue-green ice.  Sharp slices of frigid air cut with every breath, and in the pale light, clouds of foggy mist churn as warm air collides with the cold.  The floor of the passageway is crisp with tiny snow-like particles, collected as condensation froze and fell.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The long, narrow tunnel snakes deeper into the glacier, the low ceiling requiring all except the shortest races to bend to avoid protrusions of ice flow hanging from the ceiling.  Ice so cold that touching it sucks the very strength from the living threatens to entomb any attempting this journey -- only sheer will prevails.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The dimensions of the cavern are hard to judge, as the walls soar into darkness.  Softly whispering frozen mist continues to fall from the air, coating everything it touches with a fine, white powder.  The floor slopes at a sharp angle to the north.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The narrow passage to the south opens out into a large echoing cavern, with icy walls soaring into darkness.  The soft brushing sound is that of falling particles of frozen mist -- it whispers as it touches the floor, the chunks of fallen rock, or your face.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Near the northern end of the cavern, the walls and floor converge to form an alcove.  A vertical crevice, barely wide enough to squeeze through, leads deeper into the rock.  Overhead, icicles hang like pointy teeth in a gaping maw, glistening hungrily and shedding a glowing blue-green light through the massive layers of ice.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: This high chamber appears to be carved out of solid ice.  Icicles of tremendous proportions hang overhead like stalactites from a dim, invisible ceiling.  Cubical chunks tumble about the floor and emerge from the wall, stuck fast.  Although the cold air penetrates all, closer examination reveals the crystalline structure is not frozen water, but clear quartz-like rocks that will never thaw even should the cold be banished.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Ice-clear rock lines the winding passageway that slopes deeper into the mountainside, allowing light from the surface to filter through and dimly illuminate all.  Northwards, warmer air brushes through, a sweet scented air that speaks of hope.  The floor is still slick underfoot with a sheet of ice.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A webbing of dripping spun-ice bars the passageway.  The barrier appears to melt and reform as tendrils creep from the floor and walls to join, and then dissolve into a dripping puddle.  Warm air seeps past it, though a frigid wind sails through the turns of the corridor to the south.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A "thud" of sound thrums through the rock walls, the purpose and rhythm mysterious.  From time to time, a swirl of air picks up the frozen particles littering the floor and spins them about in a small tornado storm.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, southwest, west, up, down.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The cold of the void, a cold no life could survive for long, fills the tunnel.  Bits of crystal glint where light touches them, the hard cold rock speaking of the unforgiving state of eternal winter.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The cold blue-green glow filtering through the mass of ice and tumbled rock casts a weird dead light on everything it touches.  No sound echoes -- the very vibrations freeze as if in the void.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: The cavern narrows slightly, with the floor ankle deep in piles of dry, powdery ice crystals.  Its walls, frosted like the sides of a cake, round and swell with the swirling formations of rime.  Light bounces off the tiny granules to sparkle like distant stars or diamond fragments.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A cathedral of ice rises around you, the ceiling lost in shadowy darkness.  The floor is smooth and slick underfoot, like polished marble.  Large sections of the side walls have peeled off under the enormous pressure, and an occasional echoing crack bears testimony to the slow movement of the ice.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Deep inside the cavern, only blue light filters in through the frozen ice mass.  The corners and niches are a deep, pure indigo, shading almost to azure on the more exposed surface of a pile of ice crystals.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A skeleton of white bones hangs caught on a shelf of rock above.  Coated in a light dusting of icy powder, it is fast becoming one with the bitter cold frost and rock that surrounds all.  Drifts of brittle ice particles hug the base of the walls.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A waterfall once fell through a crack in the rock overhead, but is now frozen in frothy turmoil into a solid chunk of hard glacial ice.  Only the imagination can recall the roar of sound such a torrent would have made as it flowed.  Underfoot, ice smooth as a mirror levels the floor.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Smooth, slick ice lines the walls of the small cavern, and the air seems dead and lifeless.  Buried deep within the glacier, narrow passageways leading eastward go further still.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: A ridge of packed ice creates a slippery slope to traverse.  Small holes bored into the frozen material emit a nasty-smelling odor, exhaling tendrils of smoky fog that freeze to tiny crystalized grains.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, southwest, down.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Geshiger]]
description: Within the cold ice cave, strange swirls and angular cuts sliced into the glassy walls speak an indecipherable tale.  Piles of ice-dust glimmer like anthills of diamond slivers, curiously scattered about the chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, west, up.

title: [[Crystal Plaza, Stormshine Room]]
description: A tile mosaic spans the curved walls and shifts from ominously dark grey storm clouds to billowing white clouds in a brilliant blue sky.  Overhead, a lantern shielded by cloudy crystal on one side and clear amber on the other complements the aesthetic as it casts dimmed light to the stormy side of the room and sunny yellow light to the other.  A single long bench curves around some protective railing that overlooks the rotunda below.

title: [[Crystal Plaza, Observatory Room]]
description: A false ceiling patterned to resemble a starry night sky hangs overhead.  Through impressive engineering, large crystalline orbs, each colored to simulate one of Elanthia's moons, move across the sky as their real counterparts would and provide tinted illumination for patrons to navigate by.  The varied aromas of the foods being prepared and served in the food court below suffuse the air.  Tall windows between the shopfronts grant a modest view of the true sky outside.

title: [[Crystal Plaza, River Room]]
description: Water falls thunderously from a spout in one wall near the ceiling, creating a small waterfall that still manages to cast misty spray around the pool in the floor.  A river speeds out from the pool and winds its way around the shop entrances, and small bridges cross it at key points to provide access.  While visually novel in its design, the crashing and rushing water creates enough noise that visitors frequently yell at their companions just to be heard.

title: [[Crystal Plaza, Treehouse Room]]
description: The canopy of the giant oak below explodes out from the floor here.  The overall design strongly resembles a treehouse with rope bridge-like pathways snaking through and around the branches.  Beyond the roped-off areas, varieties of ivy and colorfully flowering vines creep along the ground and over the shop entrances.  The air is filled with strong floral scents atop earthy undertones.

title: [[Southern Goods And Treasures, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A deobar table sits on the oaken floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A deobar rack hangs on the silk-covered walls.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Pathway]]
description: The sounds of Bosque Deriel and Leth Deriel further on are muted by the suddenly dense woods.  The brush-choked pathway makes its way further east, eventually opening up into a wide clearing.  Wooden bridges link some of the trees here, likely for the town's scouting guardsmen and hunters alike.  Crates of tools and supplies are nestled amongst the creeping vines and other undergrowth of the forest.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Gathering Pit]]
description: From time to time, the sounds of a team of woodsmen can be heard as they carefully choose and fell another of the forest's elder trees.  The pruning serves dual purposes -- to supply the needs of nearby Leth Deriel as well as to renew the woods with younger, stouter growth.  The small clearing here allows travelers and workers alike a brief respite from the day's duties while the stone-encircled firepit provides food, light, and warmth during the colder months.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Old Growth]]
description: Elder trees, some native and others clearly transported, dot the clearing at irregular intervals.  A mix of trees including spruce, pines, oaks and more are evident, as well as stumps of other, now unidentifiable ones.  An abundance of wildlife including raccoons, rabbits, birds, wolves and more are frequently seen or heard moving through without care for the woodsmen nearby.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Old Growth]]
description: A handful of cabins, each constructed from wood found nearby, provide shelter for those of the small encampment.  The trees encircling the broader clearing draw up against the backs of these dwellings, their intertwined canopies draping protectively over the roofs.  As the breeze shifts, both smells and smoke periodically fill the air from the nearby firepit.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Old Growth]]
description: Melodies that would make even members of the Bards' Guild jealous rise and fall in intensity, pacing, and volume as birds of all shapes, sizes and colors fill the clearing with their songs.  The cabins nearby blend into the trees along the edges of the small outpost.  Covered with creeping vines and flowering plants that weave throughout them, the foliage provides ample nesting space for the varied species bringing life to the space.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Old Growth]]
description: Aimlessly in trios and pairs, dragonflies of shimmering opalescent rainbow colors hover and dart from one lichen-covered trunk to the next in an endless dance.  Up above, a series of simple rope and wood bridges weave amongst the nearby trees and disappear into the denser woods beyond the clearing.  From time to time, the smells of charring meat accompany the sizzling sounds of a meal being prepared via the firepit at the heart of the clearing.

title: [[Forest Clearing, Rocky Mound]]
description: In this small corner of the clearing, a giant mound of boulders and rocks dominates the setting.  A majestic weave of different vines has been coaxed into covering most to soften their surfaces.  The weaving doesn't appear entirely natural, even for delicate Elven hands, but rather as if enhanced by a Nature Binder's skilled magical training.  One of the flat, rocky surfaces was left exposed, and small tools and trinkets are frequently left for others in need.

title: [[The Grove, Arched Pathway]]
description: Majestic trees line a wide gravel path, their thick branches arching high to mingle with one another and create a tunnel that leads deeper into the wooded copse.  Soft moss covers the ground, interspersed with clusters of delicate ferns and vibrant wildflowers.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: The gravel path meanders over the moss-covered ground and giant oaks grow along its borders, their thick branches stretching to form a dense canopy overhead.  Vibrant wildflowers peek out here and there, adding color to the verdant space.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: Tall trees reach up towards the sky, their thick branches covered in clumps of spongy moss.  Tiny pink and purple fairy slipper orchids sprout from the forest floor along a gravel path, their blooms adding a subtle, sweet aroma to the area.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: The wide path winds through densely populated trees, its route mimicking the twisted limbs reaching toward the sky and forming a lush canopy overhead.  Slender vines drape down from the branches to brush the ground.  A cozy bench swing hangs between two large birch trees, tiny flowers sprouting to each side of it.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: The dense canopy above blocks the sky, making it difficult to tell if it's night or day amongst the trees crowding the forest floor.  Snaking through the thick underbrush, the gravel path narrows considerably as its route is disrupted by rotting logs and protruding roots.  An unsettling silence hangs in the air, broken only by the occasional creak of the branches or the rustle of unseen creatures.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: Lofty trees stand proudly along the gravel path, thick moss hanging from their branches and forming long, wispy curtains that brush the spongy ground.  Fiddlehead ferns sprout beneath the sturdy trunks, along with patches of grass and small shrubs.

title: [[The Grove, Shaded Pathway]]
description: Clusters of tiny mushrooms grow around the trunks of the enormous trees comprising this portion of the grove, their red caps standing out against the lush greenery.  The gentle rustle of leaves in the breeze mixes with the soft chirping of birds and the chattering of chipmunks, creating a subtle symphony.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Balcony]]
description: Polished white marble tiles and an engraved ivory balustrade lend the Guildhall a sense of understated elegance.  Brightly glowing gaethzen spheres provide a stark contrast to the subdued lighting of the Entrance Hall.  Curving away to the north, the balcony leads deeper into the heart of the Guild.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Lounge]]
description: Several groups of chairs, each thickly padded with goose down, fill this otherwise-empty room.  A place for discourse and teaching, the lounge provides Warrior Mages with relaxation from the trying battles of the day.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Hall of Warriors]]
description: The focus of this oversized room is a circle of sand in the center of a ring of benches.  Used for friendly sparring or to illustrate lessons in strategy and tactics, the pit is a gathering place for those who follow the Path of the Warrior.  Several jars of multi-colored sand rest against the wall, beside crates storing miniatures of troops and buildings.  A small weapons rack rests to the south.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Study]]
description: Statues of the Guild's most famous mages line the walls of this study, their silent eyes weighing all who enter.  Several shelves, crafted from gleaming ebonwood, fill the walls of the room, holding rare scrolls and books filled with lore of combat, tactics and magic.  A great tapestry rests upon the northern wall, its threads gleaming brightly despite its age.

title: [[Dabrush Brawn, Inside]]
description: Haphazardly placed into crevices within the surrounding craggy stone walls, oil lanterns provide a steady light with no flickering.  A pair of displays are placed side by side at the center of the cavern, showcasing the fine wares of the shop.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Pathway]]
description: A narrow crevice winds through the volcanic cliffside, forming a steep, narrow path that descends to a rocky shelf.  Loose pebbles and ash coat the ground, while tufts of hardy grass cling to cracks in the weathered stone.  The distant rumble of waves crashing below mixes with the constant whistling of the coastal breeze.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Ledge]]
description: A wide, rocky shelf stretches out along the cliff, its surface uneven and pitted from erosion.  Sparse vegetation clings to the edges, offering small splashes of green and flax against the dark volcanic stone.  The sound of distant waves echoes from below, occasionally muffled by the wind.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Ledge]]
description: The ground here is uneven and sloped, littered with broken pieces of volcanic rock in various sizes.  Dark streaks of ash mark the path, while occasional patches of brittle grass grow among the stones.  A few scattered feathers are caught in the cracks, gently shifting with the breeze, their dark tips streaked with hints of scarlet.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Grotto]]
description: Partially obscured by a curtain of lichen drapery, this small grotto is protected from the wind by dark, porous walls of stone.  Faint, glowing embers are scattered along the floor, evidence of a recent cookfire.  Shallow alcoves carved into the stone on one side hold various tools and trinkets, while a roughly hewn table with cut logs for seats takes up the other.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Rookery]]
description: A nearly vertical cliff stretches below this rocky ledge, the steep slope pockmarked where the ground fell below to the rock-strewn beach.  Small structures made of scavenged timber and sea-worn stone are tucked along the narrow path, nestled into sheltered nooks, with intricately carved doors elevated too high for wingless visitors to enter without assistance.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Ledge]]
description: The narrow ledge is partially enclosed by jagged rock formations, offering some protection from the wind.  Ash and dust cover the ground, disturbed only by the occasional footprints.  The cliffs below drop steeply into the ocean, the waves crashing far below.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Cliffs]]
description: The ledge slopes gently toward the sea, faraway waves visible through cracks in the rocky ground.  Clusters of driftwood and seashells are strewn about the area, some artfully placed as decoration.  Further downhill and leaning against the cliff face, a portion of a tall driftwood obelisk looms, weathered but standing firm against the coastal winds.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Cliffs]]
description: The path widens into a small gathering space, with smoothed volcanic rock forming a natural floor underfoot.  Scattered around the area, small stone piles suggest past gatherings, their rough edges smoothed by years of wind and weather.  Flecks of dried seaweed cling to the edges, carried there by the gusting coastal breeze.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Cliffs]]
description: Nestled against a natural rock wall, a wide ledge offers reprieve from the constant wind.  Stacked stones form crude seats, their surfaces worn smooth by the elements.  A large driftwood obelisk is visible to the southwest, its sea-worn branches skillfully arranged to resemble an outstretched wing.

title: [[Pivilho Volcano, Ember Aerie Cliffs]]
description: This elevated corner of the ledge overlooks the sea below, unidentifiable specks dotting the distant horizon.  Fine cracks in the stone reveal veins of dark mineral deposits, their glossy surfaces reflecting in the light.  A driftwood obelisk stands to the east, its irregular form tucked against the cliff face.

title: [[Andreshlew, Lehojen Mitauli Meclagadau]]
description: The sounds of the festivities taking place outside are subdued and distorted here as they echo repeatedly off the cavernous stone walls.  A sloping tunnel descends further underground before curving back upwards.  From this vantage point, whatever lies at the end of the tunnel seems well lit as shadows are cast towards the inflection point.  A faint, sweet, and earthy scent lingers in the air.

title: [[Andreshlew, Lehojen Mitauli Meclagadau]]
description: Suspended from the ceiling high above are brilliantly illuminated globes, each a different color ranging from cool blues and royal purples to fiery reds and sunny yellows.  Merelew clad in armor pass through from time to time, moving further into the opening chamber and are frequently escorted by frantic visitors or fellow Merelew.  A heavy pollen scent fills the air.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Andreshlew, Lehojen Mitauli Meclagadau]]
description: Small puddles of water have formed throughout the area as the humidity forms condensation that drips from the walls and ceiling.  Some clever stonework successfully redirects much of the water into recessed, well-like structures carved into the walls.  Raised stone planters that once held plants, saplings and other specimens have been knocked from their pedestals, scattering soil -- now mud -- and dying plants alike.

title: [[Andreshlew, Lehojen Mitauli Meclagadau]]
description: Storage holes, slots, shelves and more are carved into the cavern's walls and stalagmites that rise up from the smoothed stone floor -- all packed full of neatly tied bundles of dried or drying herbs and medicinal plants.  Rows upon rows of cambrinth-capped Wayerd pyramids and mixing jars are lined up, though many have been toppled, smashed and substantially damaged.

title: [[Andreshlew, Lehojen Mitauli Meclagadau]]
description: Shovels, picks, and other gardening tools are scattered haphazardly from toppled crates.  Every pair of pruning shears seems to have been soundly broken or disassembled, their pieces tossed wildly about with some blades even lodged into the walls.  A heavy layer of pollen coats everything with colorful, glitter-like dust.  The overhead lighting casts ominous shadows, as if beasts were crawling amongst the illuminating orbs above.

title: [[The Upper Crust, Kitchen]]
description: A sweet aroma surrounds the area when walking through the tiny bakery door.  Glazed donuts, sweet treats, and freshly brewed coffee line the shelves behind a polished brinewood counter.  A large brick oven and baker's cabinet sit along the back wall while extensive cooking tools hang from a hook.  Near the door, a polished baker's rack, a smooth counter, some hooks, and a stand display a variety of wares.

title: [[Relief in the Dark, Arches and Carvings]]
description: Black canvas provides the walls of this cramped tent.  Usurping the little space available is a small statuary of alabaster and black stone that has been arrayed oddly among the wares.  The exiting canvas flap is wide enough to allow the carefree browsing of passing shoppers.

title: [[Pop Clothes the Weasel, Sales]]
description: High overhead a latticwork of interlocking poles holds up the exterior hides of the yurt.  Thick woven mats cover the floor where racks and stands display the wares on offer.

title: [[The Storied Spiral]]
description: Gracefully inked parchment scrolls showcasing a variety of elaborate knotwork designs adorn the walls of this tidy showroom.  A massive travertine vase abounding with jade and gaethzen flowers dominates the center of the space, a trio of semicircle display cases arrayed around it.  At the back of the shop, a long cedar clothing rack offers more wares for perusal.

title: [[The Laughing Nomlas, Dressing Rooms]]
description: The small room is adorned with rough wooden planks covering the walls.  Tree branches extend from the ceiling, creating the feeling of entering a forest hideaway.  The floor is covered with cedar needles, filling the air with an earthy fragrance.  Along the side walls, there are four colorful mannequins and a cedar hat rack, while a vibrant blue net hangs over a carved cedar shelf in the back of the room.  A large driftwood arch draped with a seasilk curtain leads back out.

title: [[Fussbudget Furnishings, Chamber of Mind]]
description: The teak-trimmed walls are clean and bare, lent a cool cyan hue at this end of the wagon by a tinted gaethzen lantern dangling from the ceiling.  Against this bluish backdrop, several furniture samples are displayed on the sales floor.

title: [[Fussbudget Furnishings, Chamber of Body]]
description: Ensconced along the walls, tinted gaethzen lanterns fill the area with a soft yellow light.  Clerks bustle through the wagon, occasionally stopping to assist a customer or tidy one of the furniture pieces displayed for sale in the golden illumination.

title: [[Fussbudget Furnishings, Chamber of Spirits]]
description: Warm magenta light suffuses the room, cast by a tinted gaethzen lantern suspended above.  An eclectic collection of furniture pieces and building supply samples sits on display in the pinkish glow, attended by smiling clerks.

title: [[Jade Dragon Jewelers, Island Collection]]
description: Gold silk banners emblazoned with the Estate Holder's crest adorn the walls of this little three-sided stall.  Facing the exit flap, a neatly disassembled marble mannequin lounges atop a pile of driftwood, its head, torso, arms, and hands each arrayed with a selection of glittering wares.

title: [[Limited Trejures, Caravan Interior]]
description: Rickety racks and shelves line the cramped interior which is lit by a couple of oil lanterns placed haphazardly about.  A slight musty scent pervades the area while the small windows are so grime-covered as to be opaque.

title: [[Curiosity Kilt the Cat, Main Room]]
description: Colorful stripes run vertically and horizontally across the tent's fabric, creating a colorful plaid design.  Clerks help customers make purchases as well as restocking the merchandise on the shelves and racks scattered about the tent.

title: [[Riptide Roasters, Brightwater Blend]]
description: The coffee shop is bright and airy, with light filtering through wide windows framed by seashells.  The walls are adorned with driftwood carvings and nautical maps, while woven hammocks sway gently in the corners.  Wooden tables shaped like surfboards line the sand-colored floors, and the scent of saltwater mingles with exotic brews steeping behind the lifesculpted coral counter.

title: [[Butterfly Meadow, Garden Room]]
description: The spacious room has walls painted in a soft, verdant green hue similar to that of a lush garden.  An intricately designed rug covers the floor, depicting a meadow in full bloom with vibrant wildflowers and fluttering butterflies.  Delicate paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling cast a soft, diffused light across the room, casting soft shadows that mimic dappled sunshine filtering through a canopy of leaves.  The room is filled with a sweet scent of flowers and fresh earth, creating an immersive experience similar to walking in a serene garden sanctuary.  Three shelves line a side wall, while some hooks hang above a small table next to a sturdy coat stand, all displaying clothing for sale.  A carved eucalyptus door painted like a giant tree leads out.

title: [[Shades of Night, Showroom]]
description: Airy white linens drape circular walls, brightening the interior of the dark-colored tent while several sand-colored rugs cover the ground.  Several branches are attached to the center support pole, a trio of lit gaethzen owlets lined up on each to cast a soft light over the area.

title: [[Shades of Night, Accessories Alcove]]
description: Tucked away from the main tent, this small alcove is just large enough to stand apart.  A stand of small gaethzen orbs hangs above the merchandise, softly illuminating the area.  A round gold-framed mirror is propped up on a spindly side table, ready for patron preening.

title: [[Beard in Action, Showroom]]
description: Thick logs, still covered with bark, form the stout walls while overhead exposed beams hold up the roof.  A few lanterns hanging down from the beams emit a fitful light.  A few shelves display the wares on offer.

title: [[Greetings For Sale, Front of the Shack]]
description: Vertical planks of wood support a slanting roof that shows a few gaps plugged by rags and paper.  One corner boasts a small counter behind which a surly clerk leans against a wall.  Shelves and racks of cards fill the rest of the space inside the confined shop.

title: [[Floral N Hardy, Sales Tent]]
description: Wildly colorful blossoms run riot over the heavy canvas tent walls while the carved wooden tent poles depict writhing vines.  A deep green carpet runs along the floor, its design mimicking that of a plush lawn of grass.  A few tables and counters display the merchandise.

title: [[The Gear Shop, The Intrepid Adventuress]]
description: Brightly hued paints depict a young female Gnome standing alone on a stretching savanna, small blobs of trees and animals only guessable by their colors.  She stands tall, for a Gnome, with high heeled boots and an umbrella perched jauntily over her shoulder while her long hair curls to the side as if caught by a wind.  Sandy hued, a rug covers the floor and allows the many short tables a place to rest.

title: [[Illusory Directions, Inside the Cart]]
description: A musty smell of incense fills the air inside the fortuneteller's cart, mixing the scent of old books and stale bread.  Gaethzen globes dimly light the interior, casting shadows across the room.  Trinkets line shelving, featuring broken seashells, Tokka cards, and jars of ichor.  A crystal ball, cracked and dusty, sits on a small card table at the center of the room.  A worn rug lines the floor.

title: [[Tiecoon, Shop]]
description: Cramped and confined, the tiny building barely has room for the table displaying the merchandise.  Shoppers jostle each other to inspect the wares while the harried salesclerk struggles to keep up with sales.

title: [[Natural Halberd, Salesroom]]
description: Rich red canvas provides the walls while tall poles hold up the roof.  Some woven grass mats help keep the grass from turning into mud underfoot.  Clerks bustle between the small salescounter and the various racks and stands displaying merchandise.

title: [[Kimme's Oh Noes!, Sales]]
description: Plain bamboo tent poles hold up the tent roof, the thick fabric blocking all light and weather.  Braided reed mats cover the ground while a few racks and stands display the merchandise.  Moving silently through the crowds, the salesclerks work to keep the wares restocked.

title: [[Bows Know Toes, Salesroom]]
description: Clerks bustle between the many tables and racks, restocking merchandise and answering customer questions.  The whitewashed plaster walls hold more shelves stacked with wares.

title: [[Comedy of Letters, Sales Floor]]
description: Simple whitewashed walls are covered with shelves and racks displaying the shop's wares.  Overhead the oil lanterns illuminate the shop with clear light while the clerks move about restocking merchandise.

title: [[Don't Miss A Ring, Salesroom]]
description: Thick canvas walls hang from the sturdy tent poles while the peaked roof soars overhead.  A few counters display the merchandise that glitters under the lantern light.

title: [[If You Beard It, Outlet]]
description: Whitewashed plaster walls encircle the pale pine planks of the floor on which a few small rugs are scattered.  Set against the walls are a number of racks and shelves that display merchandise.  Clerks circulate amongst the shoppers, refilling depleted wares and answering questions.

title: [[Bottles of Trouble, Salesroom]]
description: Brightly painted canvas walls encircle the tables displaying the shop's merchandise.  A few clerks move among the patrons distributing new stock and answering questions.

title: [[In The Hair Tonight, Sales]]
description: Small shelves and racks line the stone walls, each one displaying some of the shop's merchandise.  A couple of clerks circulate around the room as they replace sold items and answer customer questions.

title: [[Cry Me A Quiver, Shop]]
description: Thick stone walls enclose the area, providing lots of space to hang shelves, racks, and other displays.  Salesclerks move about sedately, helping customers and restocking sold merchandise.

title: [[Ritual Addiction, Theory]]
description: Smooth leather walls of overlaid straps with silver studs rise up around a dark haon floor.  Dim sconces cast irregular shadows across the room, revealing a collection of deliberately arranged tables.

title: [[Bar Homebug, Salesroom]]
description: Plain pine walls enclose the spacious sales area.  High up on the ceiling are a number of gaezthen spheres that illuminate the merchandise on display.

title: [[Who Clothes There?, Sales]]
description: Thick beams overhead support the white plastered ceiling that matches the surrounding walls.  Shelves line the walls while tables and racks display the clothing offered for sale.  A few salesclerks move about taking care of customers and replacing sold merchandise.

title: [[Jumping Jack's Sashes, Salesfloor]]
description: Bright blue canvas walls provide some shelter from the elements while the tent poles support hanging racks displaying the merchandise.  A few clerks busy themselves with restocking sold inventory.

title: [[Just Wanna Have Sun, Main Room]]
description: Cheerful yellow canvas walls are held up by orange-painted tent poles.  A myriad of lanterns help illuminate the interior and shine down on the tables and counters displaying the shop's wares.  Bright canary-yellow carpets cover the wooden plank floors and provide cushioning for the customer's feet as they peruse the merchandise.

title: [[Less Is Mortar, Showroom]]
description: The whitewashed brick walls support the exposed roofbeams overhead.  Dangling from the beams are long chains displaying gaethzen spheres that illuminate the various wall choices on display.

title: [[The Gallaenia, Postal Office]]
description: Tucked away in a compartment is a wooden counter.  Spread across the compartment walls is a sweeping mural of a noontide sky over a whitecapped ocean.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Yrs' Greatest Deals, Sales Floor]]
description: A wide sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table sits alone on the bare floor, and an oak locker stands against the oaken walls.

title: [[Yrs' Greatest Deals, Back Room]]
description: The oaken walls of the back room are unadorned, and the bare floor is similarly devoid of all but the most basic furniture.  Sheafs of paper sit in neat piles atop a low shelf along the back.

title: [[Foyer]]
description: Subdued lighting illuminates the tasteful wooden paneling of the room while a bevy of overstuffed furniture provides comfortable seating for those contemplating weighty choices.  Thick plush carpets in a myriad of hues cover the floor, almost totally obscuring the pale wooden planks of the flooring.  Around the walls, a number of colored archways contain magical portals that, when open, allow access to the prize rooms beyond.  A large set of double doors allows access to rooms devoted to dispenser activities while a round opening leads to the area devoted to workshops for alterations.

title: [[Red Suite, Coral Hall]]
description: Smooth coral-hued plaster walls delineate the spacious room devoted to exhibiting prizes.  Overhead, glass globes suspended from the ceiling provide plenty of light for inspection of the items.

title: [[Red Suite, Blood-red Vault]]
description: Suspended high above, a gleaming glass globe radiates ample light, casting a luminous glow upon the array of prizes.  Nestled within a snug alcove, the intimate space is enveloped by vibrant blood-toned plastered walls.

title: [[Red Suite, Sanguine Hall]]
description: Smooth sanguine-hued plaster walls delineate the spacious room devoted to exhibiting prizes.  Overhead, glass globes suspended from the ceiling provide plenty of light for inspection of the items.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Red Suite, Scarlet Cell]]
description: This cozy enclave is enclosed by scarlet walls.  Mounted on sconces, several glass globes emit soft illumination, spotlighting the prizes arranged throughout the room for inspection.

title: [[Red Suite, Cardinal Vault]]
description: Suspended high above, a gleaming glass globe radiates ample light, casting a luminous glow upon the array of prizes.  Nestled within a snug alcove, the intimate space is enveloped by rich cardinal-toned plastered walls.
