description: Smooth merlot-hued plaster walls delineate the spacious room devoted to exhibiting prizes.  Overhead, glass globes suspended from the ceiling provide plenty of light for inspection of the items.

title: [[Blue Suite, Royal-Blue Hall]]
description: Plain plastered walls have been painted a deep royal-blue hue and trimmed with narrow white baseboards.  Subtle indirect lighting of the displayed prizes is provided by gaezthen globes dangling from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Ocean-Blue Hall]]
description: Plain plastered walls have been painted a pale ocean-blue hue and trimmed with narrow white baseboards.  Subtle indirect lighting of the displayed prizes is provided by gaezthen globes dangling from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Turquoise Hall]]
description: Plain plastered walls have been painted a bright turquoise hue and trimmed with narrow white baseboards.  Subtle indirect lighting of the displayed prizes is provided by gaezthen globes dangling from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Periwinkle Hall]]
description: Plain plastered walls have been painted a cheery periwinkle hue and trimmed with narrow white baseboards.  Subtle indirect lighting of the displayed prizes is provided by gaezthen globes dangling from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Hyacinth Hall]]
description: Plain plastered walls have been painted a cheerful hyacinth hue and trimmed with narrow white baseboards.  Subtle indirect lighting of the displayed prizes is provided by gaezthen globes dangling from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Cyan Chamber]]
description: The spacious room has vibrant cyan-hued walls accented with a white wooden chair rail running across the plaster at waist-height.  The various prizes on offer are in the center of the room and are lit by a large gaethzen sphere suspended from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Cobalt Chamber]]
description: The spacious room has rich cobalt-hued walls accented with a white wooden chair rail running across the plaster at waist-height.  The various prizes on offer are in the center of the room and are lit by a large gaethzen sphere suspended from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Blue Suite, Indigo Chamber]]
description: The spacious room has deep indigo-hued walls accented with a white wooden chair rail running across the plaster at waist-height.  The various prizes on offer are in the center of the room and are lit by a large gaethzen sphere suspended from the coffered ceiling.

title: [[Red Suite, Cherry Vault]]
description: Suspended high above, a gleaming glass globe radiates ample light, casting a luminous glow upon the array of prizes.  Nestled within a snug alcove, the intimate space is enveloped by cherry-toned plastered walls.

title: [[Bika's, Barroom]]
description: Polished walls shrouded in nightsilk curtains and draped in slender creeper vines create a shadowy atmosphere for those who prefer to be left alone.  An elaborately carved bar sits between two flickering torches at the back of the room, casting just enough light for the bartender to do their job.  In the corners of the room, lifelike statues of black panthers crouch as if ready to pounce on unruly customers.

title: [[Bika's, Weapon Sales]]
description: Tidy and neat, the small space is dimly lit by a trio of nightingale-shaped gaethzen lanterns.  Exquisite panther statutes sculpted in lifelike detail crouch protectively over a series of racks and stands, their blackened moonsilver-limned eyes holding an eerie intelligence as they gaze outwards.

title: [[MAMAS Company, Therenborough Branch]]
description: Rough-hewn walls, a dusty floor, and a sign hanging by only one hook give the impression of a failing business.  Empty shelves and randomly placed tables occupy the vast amount of space, along with a tamboti counter surprisingly clear of any debris.  Despite the awkward appearance, the room is bristling with dwarven workers and various businesspeople and contractors.  One lone clerk stands apart from the others, leaning against the counter and tapping his fingers in a syncopated rhythm.

title: [[Ratha, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked away in a corner of the square is a wide stone counter set into the conical carousel beneath a wooden awning.  Spread across the awning's underside is a sweeping mural of a summer sky, with realistic white clouds set against a cerulean blue expanse.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Ratha, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Ratha, Carousel Desk]]
description: A long wooden desk spans the width of the western wall.  Brass lanterns hang from the ceiling, and the floor behind the desk is covered in spotless red tile.

title: [[Ratha, Item Registration Office]]
description: Large cabinets line every wall, some half open with papers barely hanging on.  Above the cabinets, brightly painted murals of high seas and dozens of large boats with billowing sails completely cover the walls.

title: [[Ratha, Registrar's Office]]
description: Several cabinets line the wall behind a desk made of driftwood.  A large map of several islands completely covers the wall above the cabinets.  A small brass lantern sits atop the desk, illuminating paperwork needed for the registration process.

title: [[Uasin Dock, Port of Ratha]]
description: Crates of all sorts, partially covered by dark canvas tarps, are being moved onto ships all along the dock.  The laborers, dressed in black clothing, work in only the small amount of light given off by the stars in the night sky.

title: [[Drogor's Bite, Hiring Hall]]
description: Walls crafted from planks salvaged over the years from various ships give this office a distinctive feel -- much like the inside of a clubhouse.  A net hangs over a rickety desk, holding shark jaws as decoration.  Behind the desk is a doorway leading further into the building.

title: [[Drogor's Bite, Hallway]]
description: Dark brown paint barely hides the crate-quality wood used to construct this hallway's walls and the plain packed dirt floor does little to improve the area's dingy coloration.  A cacophony of sounds penetrates from outside due to the shoddy construction.

title: [[Drogor's Bite, Caretaker's Room]]
description: So little light penetrates a filthy window above an equally filthy cot it is impossible to tell if it is day or night outside.  A wobbly wood chair, one slightly shorter leg unsuccessfully leveled by a small wood chip, tilts against the far wall.  A rain slicker and some tired-looking overalls hang from a rack.

title: [[Drogor's Bite, Historical Storage]]
description: Rows of bookcases fill this room in no observable pattern, creating a maze of paths and trapping dust motes in the dull light.  Unrolled scrolls and maps drape off most of the overburdened shelves, making the narrow passages even tighter.  A huge selection of charts lie one atop the other, their fraying edges giving the filled bookcase a feathery appearance.  A weather-beaten buoy tilts against the far wall beneath a mounted harpoon.

title: [[Drogor's Bite, Lounge]]
description: In keeping with the rough and ready atmosphere of its normal clientele, the three tables and assorted chairs that clutter this lounge all bear the scars of heavy usage.  Lying beneath one table is the splintered leg from an overturned chair while scattered across the tabletops are remnants of this room's last gathering.

title: [[Hermit's Shack]]
description: Ocean debris and the remains of ill-fated vessels washed ashore furnish the shack.  There are signs of recent occupancy, but nobody is currently home.  Whoever the resident is, his needs are simple: a table, a chair, and a set of shelves to display his homemade treasures.

title: [[Ratha, Narrow Alley off Kssintlee Way]]
description: A narrow alley runs along the back of Jack Tarr's Rest, passing by a peeling wooden door.  From the fragrant aromas, this must lead to the kitchens.  Chittering noises echo through the area as red-eyed rats dart out of sight.  At the end of the alley, a wooden bin stands before a ramshackle old wall, overflowing with trash awaiting disposal.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Kitchen]]
description: Copper kettles and cast iron pans hang from hooks embedded in the exposed oak beams which run along the ceiling.  Minyi Barberry, a portly Halfling woman, manages the kitchens of the inn, her wooden ladle sending fear into the hearts of the scullery maids as they scamper to do her bidding.  Brick ovens built into the walls give off an aroma of baked breads, and fish grills over an open fire on the stove.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Sandpiper's Chamber]]
description: Carved wooden figures of seabirds are scattered on shelves mounted on the pale green walls of the room.  A carved maple bed is covered with a vibrant yellow and white quilt in the "tall ships" pattern, and a few brightly colored throw rugs are scattered across the floor.  Leather chairs stand on either side of an open window, providing a comfortable place to sit and talk after a long journey.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Oceancaller's Chambers]]
description: Pale shades of color, identical to those seen in the fairest of sunsets, are lavishly painted on the walls.  In the center of this illusory twilight is a large couch, flanked by two nightstands, each covered with brilliantly tinted bottles.  It is within the bottle's glassy surfaces that light is reflected, sending a shower of prismatic spots across the heavy iron tub that rests in the corner.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Surfskimmer's Chamber]]
description: Comfortable blue chairs stand on either side of a smoke-stained brick fireplace.  Above the mantle is a picture of a swept-masted coaster.  The name on the bow identifies the vessel as the Surfskimmer.  In the corner of the room is a polished oak bed covered by a colorful velvet and silk crazy quilt.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Mistwalker's Chamber]]
description: The sea blue walls of the tiny chamber have been sponge-painted with a lighter color, making them appear to shift like the mist rising over the harbor on an autumn morning.  A wide four-poster bed covered with a mariner's compass quilt and piled high with cushions nearly fills the room, leaving just enough space for a comfortable reading chair beside the nightstand.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Seasinger's Chamber]]
description: Lace curtains move gently in the breeze from an open window overlooking the street below.  The walls of the room are painted a pale shade of amber with a soft gold glaze sponged on to give it a dappled effect.  A captain's bed stands on one side of the room, with a cheerful blue and green "sister's choice" quilt spread across the mattress.  On the other side of the room, a pair of leather chairs stand on either side of a low table.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Widow's Walk]]
description: A gentle wind blows from the south, carrying with it the scent of the harbor.  The widow's walk atop the inn gives a splendid view of the ships rocking at their anchors in the bay.  Many a seaman's wife has spent hours atop her house, gazing anxiously at the horizon for any sign of her husband returning from a long voyage.  Or perhaps not so anxiously -- the wooden chairs have been bolted to the floor, facing away from the ocean, and a wicker shade blocks the view on that side.

title: [[Jack Tarr's Rest, Private Parlor]]
description: The private parlor is quieter than the common room, providing the more fastidious guests a place to retreat from the noise and jostling of the crowd.  A polished mahogany table nearly fills the room, surrounded by captain's chairs pulled neatly under the edge of the varnished surface.  A fire crackling in the hearth makes this a cozy place for guests to relax.  Seascapes and pictures of various ships are scattered along the paneled walls.

title: [[Paganell's Carpets]]
description: Barely visible rays of moonlight filter through mirrored tubes to bathe the sandy floor of the tiny cavern.  Colorful carpets hang along the walls, softening the black stone surfaces.  In the center of the room, a young weaver works at a loom, creating an oval carpet in a jewel toned medallion design.

title: [[Functional Furniture, Ratha Branch]]
description: A thin layer of red dust, blown in from the street outside, covers everything in the shop.  Half-faded brush marks in the dirt on the floor indicate that the owner tries his best to keep the elements out, without much success.  A single counter in the room holds items for sale, and a large sign hangs on the wall behind it.

title: [[Sisters-in-Lore, Shallow Nook]]
description: This comfortable nook is located off to one side of the main shop.  A stained-glass lamp burns atop an old-fashioned ball and claw foot table, and a comfortable (though rather tattered) chair sits beside it.  Shelves line the walls of the nook, filled with books on healing and alchemy.

title: [[Ratha, Beneath the Rubble]]
description: The shattered remains of the building above litter the ground of this low crawlspace.  A Gor'Tog skeleton lies crushed across the middle by a wide beam, its two large hands resting below the wood as evidence of its last futile effort to free itself.  A much smaller skeleton lies curled atop the first, its arms wrapped around the large ribcage.

title: [[Onsuwayo's Clinic, Treatment Room Two]]
description: Someone has recently died a messy death here.  The walls and even the ceiling are festooned with thick streamers of drying blood.  One cot is soaked with the crimson spew and everyone else awaiting treatment edges away from it as if it were a leper at a wedding feast.  A harried looking drudge is mopping ineffectually at a coagulating puddle of gore in the middle of the room.  You also see the dispensary.

title: [[The Raven's Mask and Leatherworks, Embosser's Workshop]]
description: Hanging from a beam in the ceiling, a menu board sways gently in the breeze.  At the back of the alcove, a workbench cluttered with brushes, paints and other tools stands beside a mannequin.  The mannequin is currently adorned with a leather gambeson which is being decorated with the crest of the Pantel family.

title: [[Glythtide's Shrine]]
description: The shrine room is shaped like a burrow, all corners rounded and smooth.  Mown grasses and meadowsweet stems cover the floor in a fragrant strewing, but the main focus of the shrine remains the statue honoring the god Glythtide.

title: [[Divine Rialto, Odds and Ends]]
description: The back room of the Rialto caters to the fashion tastes of all who have money to spend.  Knick-knacks and other inexpensive items are sold here, as well as some highly fashionable vestments.  Mannequins neatly line the back wall and are adorned with fashions available for immediate purchase.

title: [[Fish Seller's Hut, Interior]]
description: The small hut smells overwhelmingly of fish.  Stinks might even be a better description.  A young lean S'Kra Mur fellow leans against a large barrel full of water and small silvery fish.

title: [[Eluned's Temple, Crevice]]
description: Murky darkness stretches in all directions.

title: [[Warrior Mage Guild, Tower]]
description: The opulent beauty of Z'hutoya Way lies spread out below.  The northern guard tower is manned by a S'Kra sentry who never takes her eyes off of the street's occupants.  A curved snrhhti horn hangs from a nail in the tower's roof, its surface engraved with ancient sigils.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Driveway]]
description: Rows of large, lush trees sway gently in the ocean's breeze, creaking as though they were old and tired.  The parade of foliage is but a brief line however, and ends abruptly, stopped by the massive walls of a large columnar building on one side and the ornate fencing surrounding the property on the other.  A sizeable oaken door in the front breaks the monotony of the marble structure.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Marble Foyer]]
description: Large loops of grey stone break up the floor's speckled surface into segments of polished marble and swaths of textured border.  The walls continue with this motif, broken by dark lines of mahogany trim and pale shades of white wood.  A lone mahogany door centered in the western wall mirrors a glass door on the eastern side of the room.  Two ornate stairways, one to the east and one to the west, curve gracefully over the doors.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Glass Arboretum]]
description: Dreamlike shadows dancing between neatly arranged rows of leafy plants mimic the motions of a flock of yellow and gold butterflies cavorting within the glass confines of the room.  The frosted panes of etched glass, though not transparent, are glossy enough to double the constant shifting and fluttering of delicate wings such that any circling swirl of the flock makes the room explode in showers of flickering color.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Upper Hall]]
description: Rising to this summit, a set of ornate stairs curves up from the foyer akin to the way a path might wind up a lonely and barren mountain.  It is the decorative banister that also speaks of such a pilgrimage, with its wooden figurines frozen in their upward journey for clerical transcendence.  If the gods look fondly upon the figures' destination, it is not seen in the architecture, as the upper hall is no different in design -- and perhaps no more holy but in the mind's eye -- than the lower floor.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Upper Hall]]
description: The upper hall is crescent-shaped, beginning at the base of the eastern stairs and sweeping up to this point and around to the west before descending once more to the foyer.  It would take no witty Moon Mage to draw insightful comparisons to Katamba or one of the other moons, but in the end, this basic curve is not a tribute to some lunar orb, nor is it some lofty aspiration to recreate one of their forms, but simply an aesthetically pleasing quirk of the home's design.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Master Bedroom]]
description: Sheer white linens drape a four poster bed in the center of the room, their forms so light that even the gentlest of motion sets them drifting like lost souls, clinging desperately to the posts as if the bed were the only thing that keeps them from the void.  Profoundly silent, the linen's immaterial suffering can be shut out with but a closed eye or a turned head, their resemblance to the unliving ignored.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Dining Room]]
description: Dark as the color of fresh blood, a deep red carpet turns the light from a pair of braziers a ruddy shade.  A red-mahogany dinner table, barren of features but for the flickering of maroon shadows, rests directly in the middle of the carpet.  A distinct coppery smell lingers in the air, perhaps from the heating of the brazier's metal trim.

title: [[Gamant Lisska'Vran, Kitchen]]
description: Thick, exposed beams of dark wood officially divide the kitchen from the dining room, but since there are no walls or doors blocking sight to the stove and utensils, the kitchen has been dealt the same opulent treatment as the rest of the home.  Still, a mahogany screen sits in the corner, folded up and ready to be used when dinner guests simply must be spared the sight of food being prepared.

title: [[Sshoi-sson Palace, Genealogy Office]]
description: Sectioning off the room is a long counter, creating a secure space for the elderly clerk whose slow movements have been known to anger citizens in a hurry to get on their way.  Mixing with the smell of old parchment is a lingering scent of stale tobacco coming from the direction of a cluttered, heavy desk tucked safely behind the barrier.  Hung above a wooden bench in the waiting area is a painted sign, lending low budget decoration to the plastered walls.

title: [[Sshoi-sson Palace, Registry Records Office]]
description: Not much bigger than a closet, this stark white office is dominated by a government issued desk that is covered in neatly stacked papers.  Secure filing cabinets line the back wall, leaving just enough room for the clerk on duty to move between them.  The cramped waiting area intentionally lacks furniture, encouraging citizens to take care of business as quickly as possible and be on their way.

title: [[Sshoi-sson Palace, Grand Provincial Bank, Vault]]
description: Away from the elegance of the bank's public areas, two burly guards with a no-nonsense air about them protect the iron-lined exchange vault.  Liveried tellers glide in and out, handing leather pouches to the guards, who in turn pass the coins through a flickering moongate at the far end of the room.  On one side, a languid S'Kra Mur Moon Mage reclines upon a plush quilted silk divan as she concentrates upon maintaining her part of the network of gates used by the bank.

title: [[Magical Art, Thuyza's Tattoo Place]]
description: The incessant droning of the crowds outside is hardly dulled by the rickety structure.  Attempts to mend the numerous rotted holes in the wood are evident, and many of the attempted fixes display signs of being patched as well.  From time to time, an errant beggar will peek through the door, only to have Thuyza hurl the nearest empty ink bottle in his or her face.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Entry Hall]]
description: This sparsely decorated room leads into the interior of the inn. Lamps hung on the walls illuminate a dirty carpet.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Bar]]
description: Crystal lamps hang from the ceiling of the bar, illuminating the room with rainbow sparkles of light.  The walls are paneled with varnished oak.  Soft music can be heard coming from the other rooms of the inn.  A long counter is set up in the middle of the room, with an elegantly lettered menu hanging behind it.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Dance Hall]]
description: The high ceiling has a crystal chandelier hanging from its center.  Tables circle the hall's wood-tiled floor, leaving a large area open for couples to dance.  Soft music is being pumped into the room from some unseen place.  The walls are covered with festive tapestries.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Dance Stage]]
description: This room is dominated by a large stage.  The only illumination for the area are the lights set up along the foot of the stage.  A few chairs are lined up on the floor for the audience's comfort.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Parlor]]
description: The room is painted a soft indigo and hung with shaded lamps.  A comfortable looking couch rests against one wall.  Thick carpeting, woven with a intricate design, covers the floor.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Corridor]]
description: The brightly lit hallway ends in a staircase that leads to the second floor.  A beautifully painted portrait hangs on the wood-paneled wall.  Music from other parts of the inn can be heard as soft background noise.  The air smells of freshly cut flowers.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Upstairs Corridor]]
description: Crystal lamps hung from the ceiling illuminate the hallway.  A staircase on one end of the hall leads back down to the main floor of the inn.  An intricately woven tapestry hangs the length of one wall while four doors are spaced evenly along the other.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Gold Room]]
description: The walls are painted a soft gold and hung with silky drapes.  A great oak bed, varnished a golden brown, takes up the greater portion of the room.  Large vases, veneered with gold leaf, are filled with beautiful yellow tulips that fill the air with a sweet scent.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Rose Room]]
description: The sweet smell of roses fills this room, coming from a number of vases full of freshly cut flowers.  A huge four-poster bed, draped with silken veils, fills up most of the chamber.  The walls are painted a soft pink with a rose-motif design.  All of the room's wood molding is beautifully carved with roses and leafy vines.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Common Room]]
description: This room smells of unwashed clothes and bedding in need of a good airing out.  A number of pallets are thrown about on the floor, leaving little room to move about.  Shaded lamps provide a small bit of illumination for the chamber.  The walls, once white, have faded to a dingy grey.

title: [[The Golden Heron Inn, Dragon Room]]
description: A black lacquered bed, carved with gold dragons, sits in the center of the room.  The walls, one of which is completely covered by a large tapestry, are painted a dark blue.  Dragon statues stand in every corner of the room with small lamps held in their mouths to illuminate the chamber.

title: [[Tap Room, Dark Booth]]
description: A single bronze sconce is mounted on the wall rendering a warm glow upon the redwood burl table.  A stuffed grendel is mounted on the wall high above the table and bench.  Hushed voices can be heard from nearby tables and booths.

title: [[Tap Room, Fireside Table]]
description: The heat radiating from the stone fireplace warms this section of the tap room nicely.  The light from the brass lantern on this rough-hewn redwood trestle table competes with the amber glow from the fire.  Barrels chairs line either side of the table to provide seating for many friends.

title: [[Walled Garden, Bamboo Pavilion]]
description: The walls of this simple pavilion are pale beige translucent parchment panes framed with lacquered bamboo.  Brightly-colored floor cushions lie upon woven split-reed mats to add comfort to the weary around a low standing glossy teak wood table.

title: [[Walled Garden, Stone Bench]]
description: Tall ferns and weeping willows provide a sheltered nook for this single stone bench from the outside world.  Small bunches of pure white lilies nestle beneath the ferns, releasing their light fragrance upon the breeze.  The walled garden can be seen through the branches of the willows as their graceful limbs sway in the gentle breezes.

title: [[Dining Room, Quiet Corner]]
description: Protected from the other patrons behind tall ferns, the dining table is adorned with a crisp blue linen tablecloth.  Blue silk cushioned chairs sit before each perfectly arranged place setting at the lime-washed table. The soft fragrance of roses drifts from the small porcelain vase at the center of the table.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Willow Suite]]
description: Pale mint-green walls greet a cream-colored ceiling with a molding of carved willow.  The bent willow furniture throughout the room is accented with celadon green and grey cotton cushions.  An unfinished willow canopy bed is draped with cream gauze across the top of the frame then secured at each post with a raffia tie.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Orchid Suite]]
description: Sparse in conventional furnishings, the room is dominated by a single piece.  A glossy teak platform sits in the center of the room, surrounded by deep red floor pillows.  A thick mattress, covered with a gold satin comforter, rests atop the black lacquered frame.  The walls are covered with a velvet-embossed crimson wallpaper and bordered at the crown with lacquered teak molding carved in intricate designs.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Rose Suite]]
description: Soft apple green painted walls provide a fresh bright background for a mix of rose reds, strawberry pinks and milky whites.  The red and white floral print drapes match the panels and duvet on the simple pine canopy bed.  White wicker chairs with their pink rose patterned chintz cushions create a cozy nook for conversations.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Iris Suite]]
description: White beaded board walls and floors are accented in pale blues and lavenders with just a whisper of grey.  Two short stout columns, parallel the floor-to-ceiling window, hold securely in their grasp a pale blue canvas hammock.  Two deck chairs made of driftwood sit to one side of the room.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Wisteria Suite]]
description: A plush deep forest green rug embroidered with wisteria blossom covers the mahogany parquet floor.  An ivory satin comforter lays beneath matching pillows stitched with a fern design which, in turn, lean elegantly upon the elaborately carved headboard of a large feather bed.  A royal purple velvet divan sits at the foot of the bed.

title: [[Imperial Palm Inn, Peony Suite]]
description: An oval-framed painting hangs upon the butternut colored walls above the simple oak mantled fireplace.  Smoothly sanded unfinished oak floors are covered with a scattering of soft pastel rugs.  Large splashes of bright pink peonies are embroidered across a cream colored coverlet upon an oak sleigh bed.  A crochet throw drapes casually across one of the small over-stuffed chairs that snuggle close to the fireplace.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Performance Hall]]
description: Long, tiered rows of cushioned benches cascade down to surround the stage in a semicircle, designed so that patrons from all walks of life will have a good view.  Softly glowing lamps are positioned low on the walls, allowing them to be easily shaded into total darkness during a performance so that sounds from the brightly lit stage seem to magnify outward like magic.  One aisle, surrounded by a red velvet rope, leads to a staircase accentuated by an arch that is decorated with a large, golden lyre.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Hallway]]
description: Littered with a few discarded playbills, the long, darkened hallway continues towards the rear of the theater.  Yards of heavy fabric do little to muffle the jumble of melodies periodically drifting from a curtained arch, drawing the attention of performers as they pass by it on their way to the brightly lit backstage door.  Hung low on one wall is a nondescript service vent used by in-house staff during their daily routine of caring for the building.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Rehearsal Hall]]
description: Heavily quilted pads strategically blanket each wall, aiding the area's overall acoustics and muting from the rest of the theater any disruptive off-key notes created by practicing musicians.  Donated by the Rathan High Council of Nine to encourage fledgling talents, a walnut harpsichord facing a padded bench, an ebonwood cello leaning against a straight-backed chair and some tall island drums hiding a bamboo stool are situated in front of shelves stacked with replacement tools needed to play them.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Backstage]]
description: Always being prepared for the next rehearsal or performance, this room constantly bustles with activity as performers, stagehands, scenery designers, prop handlers, costumers, wig and make-up artists rush to and fro, each with their own agenda.  Benches await those times when directors call everything to a halt for a meeting to track their production's progress.  Hung near the backstage door, a shelf is provided for those wishing to donate props to less fortunate entertainers in the chorus.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Dressing Room]]
description: On each side of the room, wooden partitions form individual cubicles complete with privacy curtains, allowing featured male and female performers to be attended to by their own assistants while collecting their thoughts before curtain call.  Bit players are relegated to the far wall where a mirror stands ready above the long counter cluttered with makeup cases and various other accessories that may be needed.  Tall chairs await entertainers to take a seat as dressers and hairdressers work their magic.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Wings]]
description: Dark curtains obscure the performer's view of the audience while still allowing them a clear-cut view of the stage as they practice their lines or wait for cues during rehearsals and performances.  Carpenters, painters, builders and designers work off to one side making sure that scenery, set decor, tableaus and backdrops are maintained.  A metal door keeps out those who would disrupt productions by climbing a flimsy ladder leading up to the catwalk or running down the stairs to the orchestra pit.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Stage]]
description: Dark crimson curtains frame the long opening that looks out into the performance hall.  Oak plank flooring has been polished to a mirror like finish, reflecting the bright candlelight from a row of copper lanterns edging the semi-circular stage.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Orchestra Pit]]
description: Arranged at the base of the raised stage, rows of straight-backed chairs form a half moon around a tall stool, allowing the conductor to make eye contact with each artiste during rehearsals and performances.  Thin metal stands, neatly placed in front of each seat, stand patiently awaiting the collected pages of sheet music used regularly by the theater's in-house musicians.  A narrow set of stairs leads discreetly to the wings while also making it easy for staff to access a small vent under the stage.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Understage]]
description: The stage above forms a wood ceiling for this cramped space.  Old furniture in need of repair and props from past performances are carelessly shoved towards the bare walls, becoming a forgotten document to the theater's history.  Sitting on a chipped table, placed conveniently near a worn-out divan, is a single oil lamp indicating that the space is still used for more than storage.

title: [[Hotagi'rath Theater, Catwalk]]
description: Hung high above the stage this catwalk consists of intersecting metal girders, allowing set designers, production crews and theater staff behind the scenes access to several props and lighting setups.  Not for the faint of heart, a flimsy ladder leads down to the wings so as not to disturb any rehearsals or performances that may be going on.  Due to the number of accidents that have occurred in the past, signs have been hung to remind the over confident of the dangers involved in working at this height.

title: [[Ehhrsk Highway]]
description: Green lichen growing on the walls glows with an eerie light, providing a small amount of illumination.  The darkness makes one part of the tunnels look the same as the rest.  A faint reek of sewage fills the air, but the area is clean of everything but a few cobwebs.

title: [[Ehhrsk Highway]]
description: Green lichen growing on the walls glows with an eerie light, providing a small amount of illumination.  The darkness makes one part of the tunnels look the same as the rest.  A faint reek of sewage fills the air, but the area is clean of everything but a few cobwebs.

title: [[Bay Cliffs, Projecting Rock]]
description: The granite of the cliff thrusts out over the water, projecting far enough to give a clear view of the bluegreen water and jagged rocks directly below.  The young men and women here on the rock are all very wet, which is odd considering the only source of water is a truly appalling distance away, straight down.

title: [[Ratha Stables]]
description: Sheltered by the mass of the wall surrounding the city of Ratha, inside the stable the sound of the sea wind that is so constant outside sinks to a low murmur.  Soft straw covers the ground, muffling footsteps and the soft "whump" of hooves.  Unused bales are stacked ready, next to an open doorway leading into a supply room.  A small corral contains the horses currently for sale.

title: [[Ratha Stables]]
description: Stretching off into dimness, rows of individual stalls line either side of a broad passageway.  Since this is the main stable for the city, a large number of horses are always present, along with workers scurrying about their duties of caring for them.

title: [[Ratha Stables, Supply Room]]
description: Barely more than a large closet, the supply room is crammed with baskets, boxes, trunks, and other containers, all holding everything required for the basic care and feeding of horses.  An open doorway leads back to the main stable area.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: Verdant sea vines crawl up the arching walls, finding welcome purchase in the crevices carved by rivulets of green-tinged water.  Thick and sinuous, the vines have wedged into small cracks and pried flakes of stone loose, littering the floor with shards of rock that crunch underfoot.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: The great slab of granite forming the wall is adorned with a series of fluidly twining designs and has a sense of permanence amid the dissolving limestone.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Broken curls of flowstone, shards of stalactites and shattered gypsum crystals litter the floor of the small stone shelf.  The piles occasionally shift with the currents, sending some pieces sliding off of the shelf into the black deep.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Shellfish line the inside of a thin crease in the stone like pearly white peas in a deep grey pod.  They glow softly in the thin film of light in the water and seem to flicker when shadows pass overhead.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, west, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: A granite precipice looms overhead, but the umbrageous ceiling is paled by darker shadows stirring below.  Without a clear path to the surface, the grip of the water's depth seems stronger and closer.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: The quiet blackness seems to voice itself in the patient shushing of the currents.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: The tenebrous deep reveals little but the vague outlines of rusting armor and bits of their former owners scattered across the cavern floor.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Shadows move with you in the darkness, accompanied by muffled barks and wails that bounce and warble through the depths.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Lying broken and slightly askew like a large cracked egg, a pale white Gor'Tog skull gleams through the darkness.  The former braincase has become home to a group of eyeless black fish that weave placidly in and out of the jagged-edged hollow.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Chilling currents pull and push, stealing body heat and making navigating the litter-strewn cavern floor more difficult.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: The swirling currents of cold water bear down on interlopers in their realm, seeking to impose their will.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Visible through the thick darkness are the outlines of pale bones strewn across the floor below.
paths: Obvious exits: west, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: The somber darkness swallows all light and color.  Everything, even one's own form, becomes one with the swirling black.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Something reflective glints weakly through the darkness of the water below.
paths: Obvious exits: east, southeast, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Muffled echoes bounce along the stone walls from every direction, ebbing and flowing with the gently whirling currents near the center of the cavern.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, southwest, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Shadows tint the waters in deepening shades of blue and violet, like veils of twilight lowered over evening.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Dusky water swirls against the stone, patiently wearing it away over the eons.  A thin vein of softer stone in the wall has all but dissolved, leaving a deep crevice that looks like a black scar in ebon skin.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Iridescent shells and yellowed splinters of bone collect in a small crevice in the stone, safe from the whirling current.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: A thin layer of sand shifts across an ebon-veined basalt shelf below that refused to be dissolved by the relentless water.  Strong currents pull across the sliver of stone, carrying loose debris off into the inky deep.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Deep shadows hugging the periphery consume the walls and shroud the edges of the dark water, making the cavern feel infinitely larger.  Even the stout of heart would be moved to a startling feeling of insignificance in the center of the great mountain hollow.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: What light permeates the deepening shadow catches on flecks of mica and metallic debris caught up in the current to the south.  Through the clear water, it looks like a dust storm whirling through the nighttime desert.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: Silt deposited on the stone floor by the dancing currents lays in concentric ripples pointing in the direction of the water's flow.  The striated sand looks much like the gills of a giant sea creature.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Only forty hands from the surface, the water cools considerably and descends another shade into darkness.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Itan Deep]]
description: A pile of rusting swords and armor sends a small tempest of ruddy flakes up into the whirling current.  Diminutive black fish dart voraciously through the maze of iron and steel, looking for smaller or slower kin to feed on.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: Deep shadows hugging the periphery consume the walls and shroud the edges of the dark water, making the cavern feel infinitely larger.  Even the stout of heart would be moved to a startling feeling of insignificance in the center of the great mountain hollow.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, west, northwest, down.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Satha Cavern]]
description: The sound of water sloshing against the stone walls echoes through the cavern, occasionally punctuated by loud plops of moisture dripping into the pool.  Other, muffled sounds linger just beyond the reach of recognition before drowning in the steady rhythm of the water.

title: [[Tembat Nai Itan, Ledge]]
description: Pale streams of light shift across the darkness from an aperture in the rock overhead, settling on no particular outline but glinting from the wet stone.  The dank salty-sour tang of wet stone and decaying algae permeates the cool air of the cave.

title: [[Satha Cavern, Underwater]]
description: Thin light permeates the threadbare cloak of darkness near the water's surface and alights on crystalline pool spar growing on the cave bottom.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Guard's Chamber]]
description: A massive weapons rack lies pushed up against the north wall, piled high with pole-arm weapons.  A great iron bell hangs from the ceiling, an alarm in times of need.  A spare stick cot has been erected off in the corner.

title: [[Abyssal Seed, Guard's Chamber]]
description: Shelves full of swords, maces, and other small weapons cover the dark stone walls.  A spare stick cot lies in an out-of-the way corner, surrounded by racks of plate and chain armor.

title: [[Baronial Tournament Arena, Knight's Pavilion]]
description: Amidst the clamor of competition, this spacious tent provides a place to rest and recoup between bouts.  Several field chairs await the champions whose souvenirs of competition need delicate tending, while refreshments for keeping up one's strength and spirits are provided on a cloth-covered sideboard.  Near the entrance flap, a small collapsible table stands on rickety legs, bearing the Field Marshall's thick book of cheques.

title: [[Winter Spice and Everything Nice, Main Floor]]
description: The cozy cabin features white cedar log walls and large windows framed by frostspun flannel curtains.  A towering riverstone fireplace dominates the space, its chimney stretching upward to the open beam ceiling.  Gaethzen lanterns shaped like icicles cast a warm glow, while the air carries a rich, inviting scent of cinnamon.

title: [[Winter Spice and Everything Nice, Cozy Loft]]
description: The loft's slanted ceilings create a snug retreat, with an overstuffed chair tucked into one corner, draped with a blue and white plaid blanket.  A small side table teeters with stacks of well-loved books and a plethora of gaethzen lanterns provide ample illumination.

title: [[Avaari's Sanctuary, Meandering Pathway]]
description: A lush meadow is covered in a veritable explosion of wildflowers with a path that winds its way past a thriving garden and a hot springs pool partially hidden by a wall of vines before ending near a large riverstone fire pit.  Tucked between the sprawling branches of several huge mimosa trees, an elaborate treehouse is raised on black ivy-covered pillars with a hand-hewn set of stairs meandering through branches to an arched door.  Beneath the house, an archway of braided roots rises from the ground to contain a spiraling portal patterned with endlessly shifting fractals in variegated viridescent hues.

title: [[Avaari's Sanctuary, Peaceful Hot Spring]]
description: Verdant vines heavy with sweetly scented white jasmine blooms cling to a large trellis to provide privacy within the pool tucked into the hillside.  Along one side of the steam-filled hot spring is a sturdy ironwood table stacked with fluffy cotton towels and an assortment of scented soaps.  Beyond the shelf, a sparkling waterfall cascades over a tall stone ledge and onto a bed of polished river rocks ringed with a lush carpet of moss.

title: [[Avaari's Sanctuary, Cozy Treehouse]]
description: Smoothly curved walls follow the bends and boughs of the trees surrounding the simple structure, with tall windows providing panoramic views of the canopy and an abundance of natural light.  Most of the space is taken up by a large kitchen, its shelves lined with glass bottles containing all manner of cooking ingredients.  In a corner nook, next to the large burnished copper brazier, is an oversized squashy armchair with sage green upholstery surrounded by uneven stacks of books and an eclectic collection of brightly patterned tea cups with sassy sayings painted in cheerful colors.  Beyond the kitchen is a beautifully curved spiral staircase leading upwards, while an arched door leads back outside.

title: [[Avaari's Sanctuary, Cozy Treehouse Loft]]
description: Workbenches of various heights ring the edge of the room, polished ribbon-stripe tops fitted seamlessly into the irregularly curving walls lined with windows.  In the center of the room, directly below a large solarium dome, is a large lifesculpted lirisan desk inlaid with a stunning hex lily wrought of magenta glaes.  A chair of matching viridescent wood is carved to resemble a throne of tangled vines, the back dotted with deep pink flowers carved from druzy quartz.  A spiraling staircase with an intricate cast iron railing leads downward through the leaf-patterned ghostspine floor.

title: [[Reshalia Trade Road, Farmland]]
description: Just to the southwest the road is rutted, with an obvious track passing crosswise over it.  This is where the farmers usually cross with wagons of refuse, and take their pigs to feed on the daaknuts, often in depressingly large herds.  Depressing for any travellers caught on the wrong side of the stream of porcine livestock, that is.  The farmers are doubtless quite happy with the fertility of their pigs.

title: [[Monastery, Blueberry Bushes]]
description: Brambly bushes create a close thicket criss-crossed by paths littered with fallen blueberries.  The smell of over-ripe fruit lingers in the air like drying honey.  Scraps of loosely woven netting -- an attempt to foil birds -- cling to the shrubs.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Monastery, Blueberry Bushes]]
description: Dark green moss dapples the high stone wall skirting one side of the path, and fronds from the bushes overhang the narrow trail in places.  Tiny black ants have built several mounds near the base of one bush.  One struggles with a plump blueberry, straining to haul it back to the nest.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west, northwest.

title: [[Monastery, Drained Field]]
description: Ruined stalks of corn lie crushed in the dirt, the ears torn from the stem and cast haphazardly about.  The furrow of stricken plants continues to the east and west.  From within the drainage ditch edging the field can be heard the sounds of insects buzzing and something rustling in the vegetation.

title: [[Monastery, Drained Field]]
description: Several forlorn stalks of corn still stand, seemingly huddled together for protection against whatever creatures roam the fields.  A fetid smell of stale water rises from the drainage ditch that skirts one side of the field.  Some blueberry bushes are visible to the northeast, just beyond a dirt path.

title: [[Monastery, Drainage Ditch]]
description: Water pools at the bottom of the ditch, just deep enough to soak feet and breed mosquitos.  Weeds sprout from the mud, and tufts of grass cling to the ditch walls.  An unseen frog croaks in the vegetation.  Small, almost invisible insects buzz near your ears.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, out.

title: [[Monastery, Drainage Ditch]]

description: Water pools at the bottom of the ditch, just deep enough to soak feet and breed mosquitos.  Weeds sprout from the mud, and tufts of grass cling to the ditch walls.  An unseen frog croaks in the vegetation.  Small, nearly invisible bugs buzz near your ears and nose.
paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, out.

title: [[Monastery, Drainage Ditch]]
