paths: Obvious paths: east, west, up, out.

title: [[Rossman's Landing, Carousel]]
description: Thick brick walls give way to a whitewashed plaster foyer.  Little effort was spent on furnishing the building, which contains only a platinum arch guarded by a Dwarven attendant and a small office off to one side.

title: [[Rossman's Landing, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Standing in the plain whitewashed room is a low stone counter made from cut stone blocks.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Rossman's Landing, Carousel Office]]
description: A dingy iron-barred window allows little light from outside to filter into the cramped office -- in fact, it's difficult to tell whether it's day or night through the grime.  The space is dominated by a large desk behind which sits a surly Dwarven woman busily scratching at her ledger.

title: [[Corik's Wall, Barracks]]
description: The long wooden structure is a single open room with bunks lining the walls and shuttered windows spaced every six paces.  The beds are not much more than planks covered with thin straw mattresses and a green wool blanket, but the barracks are dry and airy.  Colorful silk pennants hang from the rafters above, each marking a victorious battle in tarnished gilt thread and vibrant hues.

title: [[Blackthorn Canyon, Field Medic's Tent]]
description: The scents of drying herbs mingle with the sharp tinge of camphor and the heavy, coppery smell of gore that underlies it all.  Three labeled willow baskets sit at the base of the tent's center pole, within easy reach of several smooth deobar pallets.  The wooden floor is still damp in places from its most recent scrubbing.

title: [[Stormfells, Talus Trail]]
description: Small rocks and stones have settled in between the larger slabs and boulders, making the talus a treacherous climb.  Underfoot, loose rocks slide free and often mask voids in the pile that can easily swallow and crush a limb.

title: [[Stormfells, Talus Trail]]
description: Flecks of mica in the granite catch the dim light and glisten like silver stars amid a stony grey-black sky.  In this stark terrain, beauty walks softly like cats' steps in the night and those who rush past might easily miss it.

title: [[Stormfells, Talus Trail]]
description: The narrow route littered with scree and broken rock threads its way between boulders and great slabs of stone.  Howling like hounds in winter, the wind calls across the canyon and is answered by mournful echoes.

title: [[Nardel's Dwelling]]
description: Cooking smells and a low hum of activity fill the large single room.  A bench-lined table and hearth dominate the eastern wall opposite an ironwood cupboard and tall stacks of woven grass baskets filled with drying herbs.  In the back, several children sit on a ring of pelts stripping yew branches, while others gather near a window for a lesson taught by an older boy with a drawing slate.

title: [[Nardel's Dwelling]]
description: The low-ceilinged loft is lined with beds ranging in size from small bassinets and cribs near the fireplace to tall bunks near the stair, each bedpost hung with a small nightcap.  Mosaics of colorful drawings that narrate scenes from fables and folk tales adorn the plaster walls.

title: [[Reach Forge, A Private Forge]]
description: Thick walls struggle to contain the blistering heat of the workshop where the fires blaze endlessly night and day.  The flickering flames give a reddish glow to the racks and shelves of tools and equipment, all neatly placed and ready for use.  Workers enter in their protective gear from time to time, checking the equipment and reporting back to a sentry at the entry.

title: [[Reach Forge, Bulk Materials]]
description: The sweltering heat from the nearby forges is a constant -- the walls absorb and radiate the heat at all hours of the day and night, never cooling as smiths keep the flames stoked.  Most of the stone walls are still rough and the ceiling high, but a counter with a bored clerk behind it takes up space along a tapestry-draped wall tucked away in the back corner.  The pathway along the floor from the north leading to the desk has been worn smooth from the traffic.

title: [[The Gilded Unicorn, A Cozy Room]]
description: This room is set up with the intent of making one person comfortable and two people snug.  The floor is wooden but freshly swept, and a set of faded yellow curtains have been drawn back from the window.  A dresser with a water-filled basin set on top of it and a bed are the only pieces of furniture here, but you get the feeling that any more would have left the room cramped and cluttered.

title: [[Therenborough, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked up against the stone block wall is an low stone counter showing many dings and chips.  Fretwork screens carved from dark woods surround the counter, sectioning it off from the rest of the square.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Therenborough, The Carousel]]
description: Exotic tapestries of every possible description drape the wall ringing the Carousel's core.  A circular roof supports a vast framework of iron and timbers rising to the building's apex.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights within the structure form the strikingly complex and beautiful mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Therenborough, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Therenborough, Registrar's Office]]
description: Pristine white marble flows from the outer office into the room.  It appears as if the small white marble desk and cabinets are the same piece of marble that covers the floors.  A brass lantern sits on top of a cabinet, burning brightly, causing the area to be overly lit.

title: [[Riverhaven, A Narrow Passage]]
description: This cramped space is reasonably well enclosed, although the rough planks do little to hold back the dampness which seems to ooze out of the walls.  One end of this corridor ends at a small opening, giving access to the hovel outside.  The opposite corner is too deeply cloaked in shadows to judge what it contains.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[Riverhaven, A Wretched Hovel]]
description: The chill dirt floor is criss-crossed by slender lines of light as they pass through gaps in the wooden plank walls.  The 'door' is little more than a heavy piece of cloth with a few loose boards leaning against it to keep it from being blown inward by the occasional stiff breeze.  Deep shadows cloak the far corners of the hovel, undisturbed by light or wind in spite of nature's best efforts.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Beneath a Chicken Coop]]
description: An occasional feather and the rank smell of the chicken coop drift through the air of the bolthole.  Overhead, footsteps slap against the cobblestoned streets as the residents of the Halfling quarter make their way about their business.  Gaps between the floorboards allow a bit of light to filter in from outside.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Beneath a Chicken Coop]]
description: Crates are piled one atop the other along each wall, some marked with the seal of the Trader's guild, others conspicuous in their lack of any markings whatsoever.  Boards laid across the crates serve to shore up the ceiling, though bits of dirt still trickle down as wagons roll over the cobblestoned street above.  A shielded lantern provides illumination for those who seek to practice their skills, secure from prying eyes.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[Riverhaven, A Cramped Corridor]]
description: This cramped space runs in a straight line for the length of a moderately sized building.  The lighting provided by a pair of hanging lanterns is little better than complete darkness and the space is restrictive enough to make even the bravest of Gor'Togs feel a twinge of claustrophobia.  Though the space has received enough care to remain reasonably clean, long scratches on the floor reveal a history of somewhat less than gentle treatment.

title: [[Riverhaven, Storage Area]]
description: Shipping crates are stacked throughout the area in a manner that indicates either a very complex method of organization or total chaos.  Each crate is stamped with the names of several locations that were probably intended to indicate their origin, destination, and various outposts through which they passed.  Curiously, however, not a single crate is marked in such a way that indicates that it ought to have ended up here.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Near the Pawnshop]]
description: A group of men and women hunker down around a crate in one corner of this small shed, their attention focused on the cards in their hands.  The shack seems at first glance to be a flimsy affair, but despite the splintered boards, no drafts chill the interior of the structure.  Bales of straw piled around the door in the brick wall muffle the noise of the street outside and shield the glow of the lantern hanging from the ceiling.  Rickety wooden stairs lead down into darkness.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Small Cavern]]
description: Musty straw squelches unpleasantly underfoot, absorbing the water that trickles down the walls of the cavern.  Empty crates serve as tables to hold muslin-wrapped bolts of jewel-toned velvet, pale silk and white lace, rapidly tarnishing silver or small boxes filled with assorted jewelry.  Other crates are piled one atop the other, their contents hidden from view, with narrow aisles running between them.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Small Cavern]]
description: The floor slopes down to the west and south from this, the highest (and dryest) point in the cavern.  Smoked hams and sausages, bags of salt and spices, all hang from hooks in the ceiling.  Other perishable goods such as fabric are stacked in open crates which line the walls.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Small Cavern]]
description: A workbench at the back of the cavern contains an array of jeweler's tools -- a small vice, a brazier, a hammer and some pliers, and other less readily recognizable pieces of equipment for removing precious gems and melting down metals into unidentifiable lumps.  The lamp above the bench is unlit, and the jeweler nowhere in sight.  Wooden crates stacked one atop the other line the center of the cavern, forming small passages through the cave.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Muddy Cavern]]
description: The tunnel widens into a small cavern supported by an ingenious octagon arrangement of interlocking wooden beams along the walls and ceiling.  Mud forms an irregular moat spanned by wooden boards anchored to a rocky island piled high with barrels at the center of the cavern.  Fires burn around the perimeter of the space, helping to dry out the mud and keep the area warm.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, A Narrow Tunnel]]
description: Water trickles through the dirt ceiling, falling with a loud *plop* against the floor.  Someone has laid down rushes and wooden boards to reduce the chance of muddy footprints that could lead the guards to the guild's lair.  The passage is narrow enough to require well-fed Gor'Togs to sidle through sideways if they want to avoid knocking against the beams that support the walls and ceiling.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Basement of Noot's Teahouse]]
description: Boxes and crates have been carefully piled to leave this part of the basement hidden from view.  The low ceiling provides a definite hazard to the heads of taller races as they make their way over to a low door in the back corner.

title: [[The Rookery, Lookout Tower]]
description: From this vantage point on top of the tallest warehouse, the Riverhaven Docks can be viewed without obstruction through a narrow gap between two rooftops.  To the west, the Town Hall and the Temple rise grandly above other edifices around the Square, while to the east the roof of the Mausoleum peeks above its vanguard of trees.  In the far distance, a glimpse of Lake Gwenalion glitters against the rustic blue-grey shoreline of Langenfirth.

title: [[The Rookery, Gristle Grove]]
description: Someone has thoughtfully placed a few old benches in a tight semi-circle at the foot of the tallest warehouse in the area.  This is the one spot in the Rookery which receives any direct sunlight, and for those residents who are out and about during the day, it makes a reasonable place to sit and discuss clandestine transactions or quietly make arrangements for the next night's activities.

title: [[The Rookery, Dogleg Lane]]
description: Despite the efforts of some residents to brighten their surroundings with a splash of paint or a scrap of colored fabric hanging in a window, the area's silent and perilous nightly business overpowers the atmosphere with breathless suspense and no small measure of prickling fear.  Upon closer inspection, even the most meager dwelling has a sturdy lock on its door.

title: [[The Rookery, Dogleg Lane]]
description: Heaped in a corner, a tangled fishing net buzzes with flies and festers with the nauseating stench of rotting fish.  When it was first dumped here, a steady trickle of brackish water dripped off it and pooled into what is now a sticky brown stain in the dirt.  At least, the circumstances suggest it's a pool of water, but in the Rookery any stain on the ground could just as easily be blood.

title: [[The Rookery, Gristle Grove]]
description: Stacked in a corner, a selection of rusty handcarts and rickety wheelbarrows leans up against a wall, surrounded by old tobacco ashes and a few scattered food wrappers.  A coil of heavy jute rope hangs on an iron hook nailed to the side wall of a locked wooden shack.  Beneath it, a pile of neatly-folded but grimy hessian tarps awaits usage during the night.

title: [[The Rookery, Dogleg Lane]]
description: The impacted dirt pathway is treacherously pot-holed and as hard as stone underfoot.  Over the years, heavy rains and hot sun have petrified the deep ruts formed by heavily-laden handcarts passing this way under cover of darkness, their burdens of contraband moving silently through the side streets leading up from the docks, onward bound to unknown destinations in Riverhaven and beyond.

title: [[The Rookery, Dogleg Corner]]
description: This corner of the Rookery is particularly dank and unwelcoming.  The buildings crowd together in such a way as to prevent any breeze from blowing through and clearing out the moist mustiness from the air.  Various mosses and lichens thrive in a spreading green belt at the base of every wall here, using the rising damp to their best advantage.

title: [[The Rookery, Drekkhet's Prowl]]
description: The lane closes in a dead end of tawdry tradesmen's entrances.  Several large trash containers lean against one wall, strewing sodden bags and empty food wrappers all over the beginnings of a deeply rutted dirt path which leads off to the west.  The town's refuse collectors are clearly among those people who avoid the area as much as possible.

title: [[The Rookery, Drekkhet's Prowl]]
description: A ragged lean-to teeters against the back wall of Natron's Workyard, a yellowing ivy creeping around the ill-fitting door of the abode and poking inquisitive tendrils into the cracks in its roof.  A large clump of weeds has sprung up at the side of the lane, thriving in an open gutter which draws away the used washing-water and other refuse thrown from the upper windows of the taller buildings.

title: [[The Rookery, Drekkhet's Prowl]]
description: The alley widens into a narrow lane lined with coarse structures which crouch up against the backs of the larger streetfront buildings.  Many of the squat huts and shacks appear fairly well-established and even passably maintained, but most ordinary folk are ill-at-ease here and move on as soon as their circumstances permit.  A restless sense of impermanence prevails.

title: [[The Rookery, Drekkhet's Prowl]]
description: Barely a scrap of sky can be seen above what appears to be a tottering pile of randomly arranged building parts, so cramped and crowded is the Rookery.  Uglier still than the unkempt facades they present to Crescent Way and neighboring thoroughfares, the back ends of Riverhaven's buildings in this quarter are graceless and functional, much like the many workaday dwellings which have sprung up in their shadows.

title: [[Blind Alley, Corner Slip]]
description: If this narrow passageway and its equally slender opening onto the alley were originally intended to provide an escape route in the event of fire, Damaris help those caught off guard in the servants' quarters and wayfarers' shanties which form the cluttered and cramped area nicknamed the Rookery.  Only rats can run through here more than two abreast.

wayto.51538: ;e unless UserVars.riverhaven_password then echo('UserVars.riverhaven_password not set') && nil else fput('search'); pause 3; fput('knock door'); pause 1; fput("whisper door #{UserVars.riverhaven_password}") end

timeto.51538: ;e unless UserVars.riverhaven_password then nil else 3 end

title: [[Riverhaven, Blind Alley]]
description: A towering stack of tea chests and wooden pallets sprawls outward from a recess between two storehouses, creaking quietly with every slight settling of one box against another.  Innumerable sets of footprints and wheelmarks criss-cross the alley, etching the signs of frequent business into the dead end's flint and grit surface.  Overhead, a faded wooden sign screeches a protest at every scrap of breeze which sets it swinging on its rusty iron chains.

title: [[Riverhaven, Blind Alley]]
description: Enclosed almost completely by the backs of tall structures, the alley is shrouded in long shadows even during the day.  Underfoot, indiscernible discarded items make the footing treacherous and slippery, forcing passers-by to thrust their arms outward, as if sightless, in hopes of grabbing some handhold to keep from stumbling to the filthy floor.

title: [[Riverhaven, Blind Alley]]
description: A short step away from the bustle of Blackmoon Road, this sunless alley slips into the shadows like an asp.  A thick silence hangs heavily in the hot breath of the buildings it serves, muffling footsteps and muting the busy hum of the outside world.  The ever-present stench of salt and drying fish crowds in, clinging to clothing and chiding remembrance of the industrious warehouses which dominate this part of town.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, The Rookery]]
description: Built out of scraps from wooden crates and boxes, the bolthole is little more than a rough shelter from the wind.  An arch at the back of the shelter leads into a brick building in somewhat better repair than most around the neighborhood.  The smell of cooking onions and cabbages permeates the air, almost masking the sour stench of dirt and worse.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, A Cramped Apartment]]
description: No more than five paces from end to end, this tiny room on the first floor of the building is full of worn-out furniture.  Tufts of padding poke out of comfortable chairs, a sofa has a small chest propping up a missing leg, and the low table in the center of the room is marred by water rings.  A clear path has been left between the arch on the outer wall and the cellar stairs.  Curiously enough, there doesn't seem to be any entrance from this apartment into the main part of the tenement.

title: [[Thieves' Guild Bolthole, Cellar]]
description: A lantern hangs by the base of the stairs, casting a soft circle of light about ten paces across, but since the cellar is closer to twenty paces in width, much of the area is in shadows.  More lanterns would pose a risk of fire or the chance of outside notice, always something to be avoided by those who do business here.  The single lamp provides just enough light to see the piles of boxes, crates and barrels that fill the dank, dirt-floored basement.

title: [[Thieves' Guild, A Shadowed Corner]]
description: Dampness coats the walls and floors of the boltholes used by the Thieves' Guild, barely noticeable as a faint, musty odor overlain by the earthy fragrance of wine and spices.  A thick rush mat covers the floor in this shadowed corner, though it's hard to see through the piles of boxes and crates, barrels and bundles, all heaped atop each other.

title: [[The Broken Blade, Ishar's Suite]]
description: A tiny sitting area, an overstuffed chair and table, just barely qualifies this room for its designation as a suite yet it still manages to be comfortable and inviting.  Lace curtains flutter softly at the window, tapestries cover the walls adding splashes of color and a featherbed, easily large enough for three, occupies the remainder of the room.

title: [[The Broken Blade, Corner Room]]
description: Placed where the sloping roof meets an outside wall, the low oak-beamed ceiling is a rather tricky hazard to the tavern's taller guests.  Insuring that bare feet won't grow cold, an oversized hooked rug covers the floor and a carved ash rocker sits near a pot-bellied stove.  Pushed against the far wall, a brass frame daybed, covered with fat pillows, sits awaiting a tired body.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Dead End]]
description: Convoluted limbs shaped like skeletal arms extend into the narrowing canyon, grasping at passersby.  The path twists and turns until it reaches a dead end.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Dead End]]
description: Convoluted limbs shaped like skeletal arms extend into the narrowing canyon, grasping at passersby.  The path twists and turns until it reaches a dead end.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Base of the Spire]]
description: The rocky slope of the escarpment ends at an immense spire towering asymmetrically overhead.  At the base of the spire, some old bones document the untimely demise of unfortunate climbers.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Escarpment]]
description: The escarpment narrows into a rocky slope leading to a crooked spire that thrusts eerily toward the sky.  A singular collection of stones at the base of a stunted tree looks deliberate and purposeful in an otherwise disorganized landscape of broken rocks and rubble.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Spire]]
description: Towering over the surrounding bluffs and grasslands, this windswept spire provides a breathtaking view for any adventurers brave and agile enough to surmount it.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Escarpment]]
description: The escarpment narrows into a rocky slope leading to a crooked spire that thrusts eerily toward the night sky.  A stunted oak tree grows amidst the broken rocks and rubble.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Base of the Spire]]
description: The rocky slope of the escarpment ends at an immense spire blocking out an irregular swatch of the nighttime sky.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, On the Spire]]
description: The spire twists and turns perversely, while the darkness and the incessant wind make the laborious climb even more formidable.

title: [[Remcli Amarcen, Atop the Spire]]
description: Towering over the surrounding bluffs and grasslands, this windswept spire is the highest point around for many miles.

title: [[Ilaya Taipa, Pier]]
description: Blandly anonymous, as all such places are, the weathered boards of the pier creak underfoot.  Heavy pilings on either side are lashed together by layers of tarred rope.

title: [[Xerasyth's Private Library]]
description: Darkness can be seen through a small window on the side of the simple room, which is cozy without being cramped.  Large wooden shelves built into the walls hold numerous books, and the area is tastefully decorated, with simple couches that are arranged in front of low tables.  A small returns desk stands near the door, and a few books are piled onto it.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: To the south, a shallow pool sprawls beneath the forest canopy.  Its calm surface looks like a sheet of black glass until a falling leaf or skittering insect disturbs the illusion and sends concentric circles rippling outward from their movement.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Grease-clotted sticky black mud lies thickly on the stony ground and a dark mist hangs from the trees.  Moisture drips sluggishly from unseen sources and everything feels cold and clammy to the touch.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Filled with the ever-constant stench of rot, the unmoving air is humid and stifling.  Every surface close to the ground is coated with heavy moss or fuzzy mold that releases nose-tickling spores.  Iridescent slicks of slime reveal the paths of slugs across the smooth bark of a recently fallen ironwood limb.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Long knotted tendrils of grey-green maiden's tress moss hang from the unseen boughs above and fall gently to the ground where the dampness colors them a muddy brown.  A circle of spindly white mushrooms pushes through the spongy mat of rotting leaves and seems too bright and clean to belong in the understory.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The ancient forest seems to resonate with secrets gleaned from having witnessed many ages of men passing beneath.  Shadows cling to everything, making the darkness blacker and further shrouding the understory in mystery.
paths: Obvious paths: southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Sathmoor moss smothers the ground, feeding on the decaying mat of leaves and dead wood.  To the south, a large mound covered with the moss' invasive tendrils resembles a flattened ball of twine the color of dried blood.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Undulating rust-colored tendrils of sathmoor moss twist and tangle through tree roots and a copse of unfortunate mountain laurel that is being strangled by the parasitic vines.  Clusters of the moss' grape-like seeds occasionally drop from the canopy far above, landing with a series of thudding sounds that could easily be mistaken for footfalls.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: In the soggy landscape surrounding the forest pool, many species of frogs croak their gravelly songs from the darkness.  There is a great range in their varied voices.  Some have a deep, guttural tone and hold their note for a roisan or more, while others have a higher-pitched allegro song and still others carry the mid-range with a halting staccato.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The smell of death and decay undiluted by even the slightest breeze is chokingly strong.  Each squishy step releases a fresh plume of miasma that hangs low in the air and attracts a cloud of insects.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Gossamer strands of an immense spider web stretch between the gnarled black branches of a dead sourwood tree half-buried in the mud.  The fine lines of the perfectly formed web catch the faintest light and glisten with moisture rising from the wet ground.  Now and again, the web twitches with the movements of its architect, a black orb weaver hidden by the darkness.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The oppressive pall of darkness in the understory weighs as heavily on one's soul as does the muck on one's feet.  Travel is further slowed by tangles of sathmoor tendrils, fallen limbs and mud-clad stones that ambush the unwary.  But the towering trees forming the forest canopy soar above it all and selfishly keep the sunlight all to themselves.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: Though too dark to see, a plentitude of insects is evidenced by the constant humming and buzzing that underlies the croaking of frogs.  Other less recognizable sounds occasionally pierce the gloomy silence and echo through the wood.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: A fallen tree covered in tufted pillows of green and brown moss lays partially submerged in the dark waters of the shallow pond nearby.  Nearly as tall as two Gor'Togs, its gangly root ball has been pulled out of the soft mud and cleaned of soil by years of rainfall.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Understory]]
description: The ground slopes down toward a swampy pool to the east and the spongy carpet of decaying mulch covering the forest floor is so soggy here that each step is a struggle.  The towering trees nearby seem rooted in the black muck out of sheer unwillingness to fight against its sticky stubbornness.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Ravine]]
description: Thick clumps of grass cling to the rocky ground, interspersed with a multitude of boulders and rubble littering the terrain.  Surrounding the narrow valley are steep hills, their sides bare of trees.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Ravine]]
description: Spreading out between the bare hills surrounding it, the valley remains rocky and windswept, but a few shrubs cluster along a trickling stream that burbles between some boulders.  Insects dance above the water while overhead bats dart and flit.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Ravine]]
description: Grey hills empty of all but rocks curve around the valley floor.  Shrubs and grasses rise amongst the rocks and boulders of the valley bottom, clinging to whatever purchase they can find.

title: [[Foothills, Rocky Ravine]]
description: Hidden by a screen of reeds, the meager stream empties into a modest pool.  A few rocks break the surface while more reeds emerge from the muddy banks.  Barren hills rise above the valley but do nothing to block the ever-present wind.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Stone Cell]]
description: The cell is completely barren except for a pair of manacles hanging from one wall.  An oak door with a small barred window looks to be the only means of escape.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Prisoner's Hold]]
description: There's an ever present chill here that's more atmosphere than temperature.  Devices of torture lie scattered about the room, ranging from an iron maiden to thumbscrews.  Several branding irons sit idle in a cold fire pit.  Three identical oak doors, with small barred windows, overlook the room.  You also see a rusted iron door.

wayto.NOTES: [The three oak doors lead to identical cells.]

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dim Tunnel]]
description: Light bleeds in from the northern passage providing just enough illumination to make out a rusted iron door in the southern wall.  To one side of the door, which has been frozen open by the passage of time, lies a broken stool.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Brilliant Tunnel]]
description: The light is blinding in contrast to the gloom of the other passages as the excavations pass through an exposed vein of quartz crystals.  Phosphorescent fungi, in a rainbow of hues, join the profusion of lichens.  Their light reflects off the gleaming crystals in kaleidoscopic patterns.  The effect is both awe-inspiring and nightmarish.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Glowing Tunnel]]
description: The tunnel sinks ever deeper into the bowels of the world to the southeast.  Glowing lichens festoon the walls and ceilings of the passage, bathing everything in a sickly greenish light, making the area surprisingly bright.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Sloping Tunnel]]
description: There's a marked downward slope to this tunnel as it delves further into the cliffs.  Phosphorescent lichens emit a wan green light, minimal and rather ghastly, but barely adequate for exploration.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Cliffside Chamber]]
description: The high-ceilinged chamber is the collection point for a series of tunnels wandering yet deeper into the cliffs.  Ensconced torches flicker dimly, providing just enough light to reveal some dark markings along one wall.  A slow-moving stream of water meanders out of the southwestern tunnel.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Tunnel]]
description: The passage dead-ends at a rockfall.  Part of the ceiling has collapsed blocking any further exploration eastward.  Two heavy doors, one of oak and one of mahogany, are solidly embedded in the walls to either side of the passage.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Galley]]
description: A rusting iron stove sits in one corner of the room with an exhaust pipe leading up through a rift in the ceiling.  The stovepipe has split along one side and a soft moaning echoes through the tear as sea breezes wind their way down from the surface.  Bits of broken crockery lie scattered about, draped with veils of thick dust.  You also see an oak door.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dining Hall]]
description: A half dozen trestle tables stretch the length of the room.  Some wooden bowls and platters covered with petrified remains of an ancient meal are all that remain of interest.  At the northern end of the room, a smaller table has been raised upon a slight platform to oversee the forgotten banquet.  You also see a mahogany door.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dining Hall]]
description: A finely carved mahogany table oversees the rest of the dining hall and a skeleton occupies the captain's chair behind it.  The remains are pinned upright by a longsword jammed into its rib cage and through the rotting red velvet upholstery.  Moldering flags from various ships hang along the wall behind the table, the victims' identities long forgotten.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Damp Tunnel]]
description: A wall of coarse stone blocks is built across the passage.  Water trickles through the crumbling mortar of the wall in several spots, pooling at the base and wandering off as a small brackish stream.  The sounds of running water echo from behind the wall.  You also see a large granite arch.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Barracks]]
description: Rotten wooden cots covered in moldering canvas fill the room with the scent of decay.  A wooden locker handcrafted from pine stands to one side of the room and a stained sea chest lies at the foot of one cot.  You also see a large granite arch.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Sandy Tunnel]]
description: The ground here is much drier and covered with fine sand.  Small flecks of granite from the unfinished walls pepper the white sands.  A slight draft carries the tang of salt air.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dusty Tunnel]]
description: Cobwebs are draped across the roof of the tunnel in a thick canopy.  The webs are occupied although the source of their builder's sustenance isn't obvious.  Hundreds of tiny black weavers scramble through the curtain of webbing alerted to the passage of potential prey.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Drafty Passage]]
description: Any further passage is halted by a vein of smooth alabaster stone cutting across the tunnel.  A slight breeze, redirected by the rough construction of the passage, comes from no particular direction.  A dwarven skeleton lies on the floor before the wall, a broken dagger still stuck between its ribs.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Alabaster Passage]]
description: A short passageway, smoothly crafted of fine alabaster stone, opens onto a shadowed room to the west.  The eastern wall is covered with an intricate set of gear and pulley mechanisms set within the faint outline of a door.  You also see a stone lever set into the floor and a circular stone door.

wayto.51589: ;e fput('pull stone lever'); fput('go stone door')

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Alabaster Passage]]
description: The passage ends at a stone staircase leading dimly up to the gloom of the ceiling.  The muted sounds of trickling water come from somewhere above.  To the east, the passage runs off into darkness.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dank Tunnel]]
description: The sounds of the shore fade away as the dank walls close in and the passage wanders farther into the cliffside.  The dampness, darkness and close quarters combine for an atmosphere indistinguishable from a crypt.

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Dank Tunnel]]
description: A faint trickle of water can be heard through the gloom.  The walls of the tunnel are slick with moisture and small puddles collect to the sides of the passage.  The rushing tides whisper occasional warnings from a narrow gap in the stone.

wayto.7448: ;e move('go gap'); move('northwest'); move('northwest'); move('climb handholds')

title: [[Deadman's Confide, Beach]]
description: A cliff wall rises into the fog at the southern end of the fog-shrouded beach.  Every so the fog thins a bit, revealing shadowy outlines of uncertain origin.  Muffled sounds of surf, sea gulls, and tolling buoys sneak through the fog, echoing off the walls.

The sounds of the shore fade away as the dank walls close in and the passage wanders farther into the cliffside.  The dampness, darkness and close quarters combine for an atmosphere indistinguishable from a crypt.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest.
Obvious exits: obscured by a thick fog

wayto.NOTES: [Deadman Confide's Maze Room] - SCOUT AREA reveals room exits. Can lose sense of direction. A BESCORT is needed.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Faint Trail]]
description: A faint trail winds its way up the hillside, barely discernible through the dense undergrowth of shrubs and low grasses.  Weathered roots from nearby trees cross the path, creating uneven steps.  Scattered tufts of wildflowers cling to the slope, their petals trembling with every breeze.  Small stones displaced by passing feet dot the trail, rolling toward the forest's shadowy edge.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Faint Trail]]
description: The trail opens into a wide clearing surrounded by towering oaks and slender birches.  Clusters of ferns line the edges, their delicate fronds brushing against moss-covered stones.  The ground here is packed dirt, interrupted by patches of hardy grass.  Scattered animal tracks mark the earth, while a hollowed log lies to one side, its interior home to small claw marks and broken twigs.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Sylvan Arch]]
description: At the heart of the forest, slender saplings intertwine to form a graceful living arch.  Their braided trunks rise in perfect harmony, bark patterns blending where they meet.  Fresh green shoots sprout from the weave, forming delicate fronds that dangle like ornaments.  The ground beneath is clear of debris, marked only by soft mosses that thrive in the embrace of the arch's shelter.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Northern Slope]]
description: The forest climbs a gentle slope, where large boulders protrude from the soil like ancient sentinels.  Their surfaces are mottled with patches of pale lichen and streaked with weathered cracks.  Between the stones, small saplings push upward, their leaves trembling in a faint breeze.  Evidence of burrowing animals shows in the loose dirt around the roots.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Brambles]]
description: A narrow path snakes through dense thickets of brambles, their thorn-laden vines twisting in a chaotic weave.  The air is faintly sweet with the scent of crushed berries underfoot.  Stripped bark on the lower trunks of nearby trees hints at the passage of foraging animals.  In places, the trail is barely visible, partially obscured by clusters of creeping ivy.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Beside a Stream]]
description: A shallow stream cuts through the forest, its pebbled banks lined with water-smoothed stones.  Narrow reeds and patches of cattails grow in the calmer pools.  Fallen leaves float lazily downstream, brushing against the occasional piece of driftwood lodged in the current.  Small pawprints in the muddy bank suggest a recent visit from thirsty creatures.

title: [[Shadethorn Forest, Silver Grove]]
description: At the base of the mountainside, a grove of silver-barked trees stands in quiet contrast to the rugged stone backdrop.  The trunks curve gracefully upward, their branches tangled with wispy vines.  A faint trail skirts the rocky incline, marked by scattered flakes of stone from above.  The low sound of rustling leaves accompanies the occasional movements of unseen woodland creatures.

title: [[Vale, Ravine]]
description: Wisps of fog drift above the rock-strewn ground, while denser banks of mist roil overhead, obscuring the sky and the upper walls of the canyon.  Scrubby bushes and clumps of grass cling desperately to the loose scree at the foot of the cliffs, their stunted size and pale leaves testimony to the barren nature of the area.

title: [[Vale, Ravine]]
description: Large boulders cover the ground, having fallen from the steep cliffs lining the ravine.  One has crashed into a tree, splintering it and scattering limbs and branches across the ground.  A few clumps of grass grow near a few small puddles formed in some of the craters created when rocks from above hit the ground.

title: [[Vale, Rock Pile]]
description: Some long-forgotten catastrophe has brought down one cliff, creating a rockslide that blocks further progress.  A small start has been made at clearing the rockfall, but the small piles that have been removed only serve to show how much more remains in clearing the blockade.  What is unclear is who or what would be working to clear the impediment and why they would want to.

title: [[Vale, Ravine]]
description: Granite walls loom out of the ever-present mist, towering high above the stony canyon floor.  Mist and fog flow across the ground and ooze amongst the occasional bush that grows in the scanty soil.  An occasional crash echoes through the ravine, but the source remains unknown.

title: [[Curious Woods, Pathway]]
description: A wide arbor of bent oak marks a curious corridor, moss dripping from branches and thick vines curling up trunks lending a near total wash of green.  A rustling can be heard all around, and faint snickers echo from the trees.

title: [[Curious Woods, Clearing]]
description: At the center of the clearing, a dense copse of poplar grows intertwined, forming a massive spiral of foliage that seems to shake with constant movement.  The forest is otherwise somewhat sparse here, the grass curiously picked clean of bristle or burr.

title: [[Curious Woods, Clearing]]
description: At the center of the clearing, a dense copse of poplar grows intertwined, covering a large boulder at the base.  The trees appear to have grown around the stone, nearly entirely engulfing it.

title: [[Curious Woods, Clearing]]
description: The dense copse at the center of the clearing bears several gaps in the foliage, allowing a view of the inside of the twisted trees.  Curiously, there is a total lack of any nests in the trees branches.

title: [[Golden Phoenix, Corridor]]
description: A quiet passage lined with plush gold-edged maroon carpeting and polished rosewood paneling runs along the back of the inn.  Trophies from hunting expeditions hang upon the walls -- a snarling snowbeast captured in a lifelike pose, and a buffalo head looming over those who pass through the corridor.  Unlike the upstairs rooms, these apartments are owned by their residents, local citizens who prefer the convenience of life at the inn.

title: [[Golden Phoenix, Corridor]]
description: Carved mahogany moldings run the length of the hallway, the dark wood contrasting with the polished rosewood paneling on the walls.  The head and claws of a black leucro are mounted upon a wooden shield on the wall, the green glass eyes balefully surveying all who pass beneath its stretch of hall.  On the opposite wall, a hunting scene is mounted in a gilded frame.

title: [[Golden Phoenix, Corridor]]
description: The corridor bends to the northeast past the majestic figure of a desumos.  A triumph of the taxidermist's art, the golden mane and tawny pelt maintain their original sheen, while the glittering blue glass eyes and ivory fangs add to the realism.  Residents have donated crested wooden shields which hang upon rich silk banners along the walls.

title: [[Golden Phoenix, Corridor]]
description: A golden sunburst is inlaid into the rosewood paneling at the end of the hallway.  Carved within the sunburst is the image of a phoenix rising from the flames, its wings outstretched toward the sky.  The soft gleam of the gold is reflected in the rosewood walls.  In the corner, a brass pot holds an oversized fern.  The feathery fronds tumble over the sides of the pot to gently brush the deep maroon carpet.

title: [[Vaalrin House, Grand Foyer]]
description: Sunlight spills down into the room from the domed skylight far overhead, bathing the impressive collection of rare blooms that occupy the periphery of the foyer.  The vines of climbing plants have been allowed to entwine the elegant columns that buttress the high roof, lifting the greenery high above the marble floors.  A small artful waterfall and pond fills the space between a split marble staircase leading to the balcony above.

The night's dim light settles gently down into the room from the skylight in the darkness overhead, adding a softer edge to the glow of the wall mounted gaethzen lamps that ring the room.  Surrounded by the lingering scents of the daytime blooms and only the sound of the waterfall by the stair breaking the silence of the night, the room takes on the feel of a darkened forest glade.

title: [[Vaalrin House, Duph's Taproom]]
description: The taproom is smoky, dimly lit by lanterns hung upon the walls, and the heavy beams that support the floor above are low enough to make a Gor'Tog duck when entering.  Still, the room is kept clean, right down to the scarred but patiently cared for hardwood floor.  Opposite the bar, a cozy fire crackles merrily in the soapstone fireplace beneath an old oil painting.

title: [[Vaalrin House, Foyer Balcony]]
description: Thick red woolen rugs with interweaving patterns of blue and green cover the marble floor of the balcony all the way from the intricately wrought iron railings to the tapestries that hang against the back wall.  Busts of several notable citizens of years past perch atop alabaster pedestals along the length of the wall, flanking both sides of a wide arch.

title: [[Vaalrin House, Spire Ballroom]]
description: A gorgeous parquet dance floor stretches the entire width of the building, flanked on either side by tall windows letting in the daylight that gives the wood floor a honey-colored glow.  At the far end of the room, a long buffet table stands ready to refresh the guests of the house beneath a large gold framed painting of the great tower.  Hanging above the dance floor is a crystal and silver chandelier, dazzling the eye even though it remains unlit during the day.

The crystal and silver of the chandelier blazes like a thousand stars, generously lighting the room's every corner.  Flickering candlelight plays across the parquet pattern of the floor, creating momentary illusions of life and movement.  The tall windows to either side of the room are little more than dark panes against the night, but have been left cracked open to air the room.

title: [[Vaalrin House, Drawing Room]]
description: Dominating the room is a heavy mahogany table surrounded by several high-backed chairs, placed here for smaller semi-formal gatherings.  Panels of dark wood cover the walls on one side of the room while a set of leaded glass windows framed by heavy draperies fronts the street on the other.  A large rough-cut granite fireplace next to a suit of armor at one end of the room contains a low fire to keep any chills out of the room.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, South of the Fountain]]
description: Dim twilight shrouds the fountain to the north, and the sound and smell of rushing water fills the air.  Small gaethzen orbs are set around the room, illuminating the edge while keeping the center shrouded in shadow.  An arched walnut door leads back into the foyer, while northwest and northeast lead around the fountain.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, East of the Fountain]]
description: Dim twilight shrouds the center of the large room in shadow, though the sound of rushing water can be easily heard from a nearby fountain.  To the east, twin oil lanterns hang from the mirrored underside of a low balcony, lighting a prominent display case in front of a row of small statues.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, North of the Fountain]]
description: The balcony's overhang in this area recedes somewhat, giving a good view of the dome above.  The sound of rushing water from a cascading waterfall comes from the back of an ornately carved fountain in the center of the room.  A large arch leads northward into a low hallway, while southeast and southwest lead around the fountain.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, West of the Fountain]]
description: Obsidian tiling running along the wall's lower border depicts many different phases of Xibar, Katamba, and Yavash, ranging from new to full.  Small gaethzen orbs set near the base of the wall illuminate the black marble floor.  In the exact center of the room, an intricate mosaic set in the floor forms a large image of a waxen conjunction of all three moons eclipsing the sun.  A double set of pillars leads into a well-lit hallway west of the large round room, opposite a large fountain shrouded in shadow.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, West Hall]]
description: A faint scent of cedar fills the air of a narrow hallway lit by dim torchlight.  Pushed against the west wall is a small table, which has an elegant vase sitting upon it, but the room has little decoration otherwise.  Rich mahogany carpeting continues southward down the hallway, while a narrow door leading into the library is at the north end of this narrow hall.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Wares]]
description: The hallway ends abruptly in a simple dead end, with no doors leading into other rooms.  The rich carpeting changes from dark red to a deep Katamba-black shade, but no curtains or other decorations distinguish this space.  Standing alone, a small table has been set up in this area, and a small tray sits on a shelf.  Elegant robes and other clothing have been hung on a rack bolted to the wall, while a stand holds a variety of hooded cloaks.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Hall of Portraits]]
description: Gracing the walls of this narrow hallway is a long row of portraits, which depict the faces of several stern-looking Elothean nobles.  Despite the lack of windows, the room is well lit by several torches on either side of the walls.  The air has an overly clean, somber feeling, and the hall appears to be freshly dusted.  To the west is an elegant set of double doors and to the east the hallway narrows somewhat.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Spiral Staircase]]
description: The torchlight is somewhat dimmer at this end of the hallway, where a row of portraits continues from the west.  A thin slash cuts diagonally through the canvas of the two portraits furthest east, both of which have been set behind thin panes of glass.  A large stylized image of the House crest hangs at the end of the hallway, and a spiral staircase of cast iron leads upward.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Observatory Entrance]]
description: The expanse of glass overhead is very dark, very little of the outside world visible through the large dome.  Small gaethzen orbs illuminate the path, periodically set into posts on the burnished hand railings.  Standing watch over a cast-iron spiral staircase is a pair of potted mistwood saplings, each decorated with an array of small crystals which refract the light from a small lamp behind each tree, illuminating the leaves like a swarm of fireflies.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Observatory]]
description: Subtle scents mix together from pale-colored flowers in a narrow garden bed, which is well tended.  Planted near the wall, pruned bushes of blueberries and white bleeding heart are backed by a thin trellis covered in white moonflower ivy.  Save for the twilight from the glass dome overhead, the path is lit only by a few paper lanterns, making the delicate blooms stand out.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Garden]]
description: Paper lanterns on poles line a large garden with ferns surrounding mock orange flowers on this side of the balcony.  Water runs through the garden, passing beneath a trellis hung with thick silver lace vines that stand out in the dim light.  At the edge of the balcony, below the opening in the dome, is a low marble bench next to a small telescope.

title: [[House of the Waxen Moons, Observatory]]
description: Set into the shale tiling on the floor is a wide stream, which has been closed in with a single sheet of thick glass.  Red-stained gaethzen orbs are set periodically in the water, making the rushing stream glow like liquid fire.  A burnished railing glimmers faintly in the light from the stream, leading around an open area in the center of the room.

description: Plaster walls painted a rich amber hue enclose a spacious area designed to showcase the items on display.  Overhead lighting allows for the proper inspection of the various prizes on offer.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Foyer]]
description: Soft, even light bathes the foyer, given off by a shimmering portal in the center of the north wall.  A large tapestry hangs beside a tall statue of a S'Kra Mur Bard, her mouth open in song and one arm reaching out toward the colorful fabric.  To the east, an ornate door stands open.

title: [[Bards' Guild, Guildleader's Office]]
description: A large curved desk is positioned to face visitors entering the office of the Guildleader.  Several worn benches and chairs line the walls for students to wait or assemble for an impromptu class.  Just inside the doorway, a glass display rests on a scorched iron tripod.

title: [[Ratha, The Rusted Tumbler]]
description: The rough-hewn wooden walls of the lean-to tilt at uneven angles, the packed dirt floor worn smooth in places and scuffed in others.  A rusted lantern flickers weakly on a crooked, scratched table, casting uneven light that dances across the area.  Stale air carries the tang of salt and the ubiquitous stench of rotting rubbish.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Foundry]]
description: Windows high up in the stone walls provide just a hint of fresh air over the stench of burning coal and molten metal.  Supported by chains from a wooden beam, a heavy ceramic crucible swings over the fire or over to the molds lined against the wall.  Shovels protrude from a pile of fuel nearby, the blackened coal waiting to be added to the fire.

title: [[Muspar'i Forging Society, Forge]]
description: A massive iron anvil mounted on a granite pedestal stands in the center of the tiled floor.  Against the wall, a iron forge awaits things to heat, casting a reddish glow over the room.  Small windows high in the wall and open stacks overhead draw some of the heat outside to mingle with the dusty air.

title: [[Hibarnhvidar Forging Society, Bulk Materials]]
description: Sparsely furnished, the space was designed to serve its function with little fanfare.  A wide counter staffed by a rotating crew of clerks sits along one wall.  As one clerk disappears to fetch the wares their patron has requested, another swiftly takes the space to maintain a steady, efficient flow of wares and customers.

title: [[Merit Badges, Sacred Mementos]]
description: Neatly pressed, the colorful folds of the pavilion drape in precise lines, forming an octagonal floorplan over a tightly woven rush mat dyed with heraldic patterns.  The air hums with quiet chatter as discerning shoppers drift between displays, appraising the neatly arranged wares.

title: [[Merit Badges, Spiritual Visions]]
description: Neatly pressed, the muted folds of the pavilion fall in orderly pleats, forming an octagonal floorplan atop a rush mat dyed in soft greys and pale gold.  The hush of reverent voices threads through the air as robed patrons move with care among low tables and raised pedestals.  Each display bears tokens of solemn devotion.

title: [[Magikul Stuff, Dilapidated Stall]]
description: Bits and pieces of lumber have been haphazardly nailed into a makeshift stall that creaks anytime a moderate breeze passes.  Most patrons observe the merchandise on display from just outside the perforated ceiling before stepping forward to rapidly make their purchases.  Luckily, the staff is quick to help shoppers and only a few dozen nails erupting from the walls pose any other danger.

title: [[A Cleared Field]]
description: The mowed field has piles of hay stacked all over.  Poles hung with colorful paper lanterns line the edge of the range.  Chalk lines have been put down and marked with numbered flags from one end of the clearing to the other.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest.

title: [[A Cleared Field, Picnic Path]]
description: At the edge of a neatly mowed hayfield, a wide swath of tall grass stretches between trimmed rows of golden stubble and a line of broad-limbed trees.  Sprawling boughs offer shelter to a flat patch of ground, ideal for spreading picnic blankets.  Several stakes are placed throughout the area, each hung with colorful paper lanterns.

title: [[A Cleared Field, Picnic Path]]
description: Worn footpaths thread through the grass, converging in a small hollow at the field's edge.  The ground is firm and open, ringed by low posts that mark the space without enclosing it.  Tufts of clover and wildflowers dot the fringes of the area, and the trampled earth hints at frequent use.  A few lanterns sway overhead, strung between slender poles.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, southeast, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Juicy Loot, Fruit Hoops]]
description: Ornate leaded glass surrounds the area with decorative floral motifs, allowing the outside light to completely immerse the shop's interior.  A raised wooden path wends its way through landscaped gardens that display a variety of colorful mosses and exotic plants, each seaming to highlight the many items available for purchase.

title: [[Juicy Loot, From The Vine]]
description: Colorful arches incorporating bits of stained glass create a vibrant walled backdrop for several arrangements of lifesculpted trees.  The occasional hummingbird or butterfly flits between the trees and colorful flowers before making their way out through the ceiling panels raised to allow plenty of fresh air into the shop.

title: [[Two Doors Guild Fest, Main Room]]
description: Wide aisles allow the customers to see all sides of the merchandise on display.  Doors in all shapes and sizes hang from the ceiling, each one lit with elaborate lighting to allow any imperfections to be seen by the discriminating clientele.

title: [[Affair Of The Art Annex, Salesfloor]]
description: Hanging from the wooden sides are numerous tapestries and other wall hangings.  A line of lamps dangle from the center of the wagon, illuminating the wares for the crowds of shoppers.

title: [[Dyeing to Stitch, Color Ready]]
description: Several lamps placed around the room cast soft light onto pink-washed walls and a polished satinwood floor.  A collection of elaborate, vibrantly colored paintings spans the shop's interior.  Each piece of artwork displays a delicate hibiscus flower depicted in a different color of the rainbow, vividly contrasted against a greyscale foliage backdrop.

title: [[Dyeing to Stitch, Colorful Creations]]
description: In the center of the space, a colorful braided rag rug lies atop a gleaming satinwood floor, its woven pattern echoing the hues of vibrant tropical flora.  One wall is lined with ribbon-stripe shelving, each tier crowded with hibiscus plants in varying stages of bloom, some still curled in bud, others fully unfurled in vivid shades from pale blush to sunset-crimson.

title: [[Dyeing to Stitch, Supplies]]
description: A large corkboard framed in glossy ribbon-stripe hangs on one wall, random skeins of colorful thread pinned to hastily drawn sketches.  Over the archway leading west is an arrangement of silk hibiscus flowers, their gold-limned petals arrayed in a gradient ranging from bright white to fairy-floss pink to deep fuchsia.

title: [[Loot N Flee, Main Room]]
description: Canvas walls enclosing the rough plank floors billow lightly in the wind, moving slightly in tune with the exterior weather.  Scattered around the cavernous tent are a number of wooden racks, each carved in a stylized representation of an object.  Hanging from the tentpoles overhead are polished lanterns that provide lighting to better see the wares displayed.

title: [[Loot N Flee, Back Room]]
description: Tucked into this rear alcove are a few polished wood shelves, each displaying more refined merchandise than that set forth in the main room.  Elegant lamps shine from the tent poles, letting the customers peruse the wares at their leisure.

title: [[Thorn and Thistle, Sylvan Stowings]]
description: Sun-faded canvas stretches overhead, while underfoot, the floor is covered in braided grass rugs.  Ivymere vines wind along the walls, interspersed with small leaf-shaped mirrors and several gaethzen orbs, creating an effect like dappled sunlight filtering through a forest canopy.

title: [[Thorn and Thistle, Mossy Mayhem]]
description: The yurt's canvas walls are stained in mottled greens and earthy browns, resembling bark and undergrowth.  Patches of moss cling to the seams at the base, blending into a floor layered with pebble-patterned mats.  Silk fern fronds and ivymere vines drape from the rafters, swaying slightly with the slightest breeze.

title: [[Thorn and Thistle, Perilous Petals]]
description: The interior walls of the canvas structure are hand-painted with curling vines and bursts of scarlet and violet blooms.  Pressed flower panels hang between the seams, their delicate forms preserved in intricate detail.  Overhead, dried blossoms dangle in colorful bunches, their petals crinkled yet still fragrant with faded sweetness.

title: [[A Cleared Field]]
description: The mowed field has piles of hay stacked all over.  Poles hung with colorful paper lanterns line the edge of the range.  Chalk lines have been put down and marked with numbered flags from one end of the clearing to the other.

title: [[Beneath The Zaulfung, Murky Caverns]]
description: A small alcove in the cavern wall has become a dumping ground for rotted debris.  The still water in the small fetid grotto is foul and reeks of mold and decay.

title: [[Mer'Kresh Forging Society, Bulk Materials]]
description: Tucked into the corner between two stacks of pallets, this cramped space displays a large sign beside a wooden door.  Several clerks stand ready to take orders, while others shuttle through the door to retrieve items from the storage spaces beyond.

title: [[Riverhaven Forging Society, Bulk Metals]]
description: A small counter and clerk sit beneath a tarp strung across the alley of Silvermoon Road.  Carts and wagons trickle through at a relaxed but steady pace.  The drivers hand over paperwork which the clerks quickly review, stamp and pass along to teams of workers.  With practiced efficiency, the workers navigate rows of pre-assembled pallets to retrieve and load the proper materials.  Two quick raps on the wagon signal that the order is complete, and the driver prods his beasts into motion to make way for the next in line.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Front Garden]]
description: Standing an august three stories tall, a charming old boarding house with rounded gables looms over the boxwood-hemmed lawn laid out before it.  Despite needing a fresh coat of teal paint, it still manages to present a warm and attractive facade to the adjoining Strand.  Ivy climbs the drain pipes and dangles capriciously from the house's gutters and eaves, while a shingled wraparound porch converges on its front steps, welcoming residents and visitors alike through the wide front door.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Entry Hall]]
description: A foyer full of whimsical knick-knacks greets visitors to the Two Rivers Boarding House, widely reputed as a cozy haven for sojourning Estate Holders.  The appointments are lived-in but tidy, the colorful drapes and upholstery showing more quirk and character than meaningful wear.  Enticing newcomers further into the house, the aromas of a freshly cooked meal waft down one end of the hall while a gentle glow and warmth emanate from the other.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, northwest, up, out.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Second Floor]]
description: A beige rug tapestried with twining ivy skirts along the well-trod hardwood, passing beneath a quaint painting of the Siergelde Mountains on display by the landing.  Coated in road dust, an elegant three-piece set of luggage is stacked against the opposite wall a little further down, its owner's whereabouts uncertain.
paths: Obvious exits: southeast, northwest, up, down.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Third Floor]]
description: Boarders occasionally stop to engage in polite small talk as they meet in passing at this upstairs juncture.  Complementing the floral wallpaper, some potted geraniums sit atop a little round side table by the stairwell landing, a ceramic tabby cat nearly concealed beneath their red-orange blooms.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Third Floor]]
description: Soft daylight illuminates this tidy stretch of corridor.  The window at the end of the hall affords a clear view of the Segoltha below, and one can see the ferries going back and forth toward Leth Deriel, dauntlessly fighting the strong river currents with each persistent crossing.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Third Floor]]
description: Muffled conversation is just barely audible through the walnut-wainscoted walls here.  Propped open with a large book, a wide window at the end of the hall invites a draft that flutters its broadcloth curtains and stirs the heady scent of pipe tobacco lingering in the corridor.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Second Floor]]
description: Sage-green wallpaper patterned with gladioli complements the fine walnut wainscoting that runs along this quiet corridor.  A quilt-draped rocking chair rests at the edge of the tapestry runner, its window-facing position affording it a picturesque view of the Strand below.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Second Floor]]
description: Heavy broadcloth curtains are drawn across the windows at this end of the hall, suffusing the area with eerie gloom.  An oil lantern sputters weakly atop a shallow side table in the corner and casts oozing shadows over a raggedy doll and some wooden blocks scattered across the floor, apparent leftovers from a forgetful child's playtime.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Parlor]]
description: Beside a low tea table draped in homespun lace, a worn-in pair of mismatched sofas provides visitors a homey fireside spot to sit and socialize.  Opposite the massive slate fireplace, a rosewood clavichord stands against the parlor wall near a corner alcove serving as the doorstep for several boarders' suites.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Dining Room]]
description: Flanked by two long benches and piled high with hearty fare, an oaken table dominates this cheery communal dining room.  A fire crackles in the stacked flagstone hearth, and faint chatter from the nearby scullery drifts through the warm air along with the smell of baking bread.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Scullery]]
description: Crowded but orderly, the scullery is astir with the bustle of constant meal preparations.  Stooped over a sudsy sink in the corner, an apron-clad Gor'Tog hums to himself as he washes a stack of dirty dishes that never seems to diminish thanks to a steady stream of new arrivals from the dining room.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Cellar]]
description: Muted through the floorboards above, footsteps and the occasional snippet of conversation carry down from the dining hall and scullery.  A sooty oil lantern dangles from the rafters at the base of the cellar's wood plank stairs, its feeble flame tasked with illuminating the entire stone-walled chamber.

title: [[Two Rivers Boarding House, Cellar]]
description: Meager lamplight barely reaches this end of the cold, damp cellar.  Tucked away in the shadows against the far wall, a collection of dusty mead casks rests beside several long shelves laden with provisions for the house.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Ice Caves, Frozen Cavern]]
description: Walls coated in black ice surround the massive cavern, closing it off from the rest of the caves.  Faint glimmers of light illuminate the area as torches in the cavern's heart reflect the glow off the ice.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Nexus]]
description: Shifting colors pulse across the sky, oscillating in a fluctuating random pattern admidst the shattered shards of the sky.  More shards jumbled together comprise a floor drifting above the bottomless void.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Front Lawn]]
description: Nothing seems to be alive in this gloom-filled yard.  Large skeletal trees crowd the path which is covered with a detritus of their decaying leaves.  The walkway's paving stones are broken or missing in random spots, and occasionally a large flat stone protrudes upright, as if it had been heaved up out of the ground.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Clearing]]
description: A vast field spreads outwards, another anomalous area within the fractured pocket.  At the heart of the green clearing, a massive metal contraption lies curled up.  Glistening scales reveal themselves as exquisitely machined metal plates, and the great eyes of the crafted beast reflect light from their flat glass surfaces.  A giant mouth leads within.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Akigwe's Tower]]
description: A layer of dust covers everything here.  High above, a crystal sits atop the tower before you and slowly flickers from one color to another, endlessly casting odd shadows throughout the cavern.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Outside the Manor]]
description: Floating fragments of shattered glass create a backdrop of mysterious color that slowly shifts as each sliver rotates, separating the area from the void beyond.  A small road paved with mossy cobbles leads up to an imposing manor.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Docks]]
description: Fractured slivers of translucent crystal are frozen in place, creating the outlines of long docks reaching out into a complete void.  Ropes and nets litter the docks between crates and other cargo waiting to be loaded, blocking access to the piers waiting for ships.  An obvious path through the mess leads to a cobbled road.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Battered Grey Raven Prison]]
description: The smells of death and decay are heavy in the air, and smoke rises from towers set at the corners of a wall high above you.  Guards have the small office here locked down behind a series of gates and barricades that lead further into the prison.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Wilderness Path]]
description: Enclosing the area, floating shards create a scenery that changes from forest green to fern to moss in hue all around you.  Beneath the fluctuating canopy are what appear to be suspended shards of pine-colored glass, creating a transparent boundary that divides the temporal zone from a bottomless void beneath.

title: [[Temporal Pocket, Grey Raven Prison]]
description: Fractured shards of floating glass-like crystal form high walls with rising towers, obscuring the roar of shouting and crashing objects from within the bustling prison.

title: [[Temporal Prizes, Lormandu]]
description: Shifting colors pulse overhead, oscillating in a swirling floral pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless sky.  Fragrant wildflowers are heaped together and form a floor of blossoms that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Temporal Prizes, Anlandu]]
description: Shifting colors pulse overhead, oscillating in a dynamic sunburst pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless sky.  Sheaves of grain are stacked together and form a harvest floor that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Temporal Prizes, Blufandu]]
description: Shifting colors pulse overhead, oscillating in a falling leaf pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless sky.  Red and gold leaves are piled together and form a floor of foliage that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Temporal Prizes, Jeolandu]]
description: Shifting colors pulse overhead, oscillating in an intricate snowflake pattern amidst the shattered shards of a dark fathomless sky.  Jagged sheets of ice form a frosty floor that drifts aimlessly above a bottomless void.

title: [[Deep Forest, Derelict Garden]]
description: What was once a garden lies in disarray, its beds little more than outlines in the soil.  A few twisted stakes jut up from the earth, tangled with brittle vines long gone to seed.  Scattered stones trace the faint remains of a boundary wall, half-buried beneath moss and leaf litter.

title: [[Deep Forest, Collapsed Shed]]
description: Near the edge of the clearing, a small outbuilding has given way to time.  Its sagging roof folds inward, beams rotted through and swallowed by creeping ivy under the open sky.  Rusted tools jut from the debris, their edges dulled and spotted, as if left in place on the last day they were used.

title: [[Siergelde Cliffs, Meander]]
description: The riverbed continues its lazy maneuver over the landscape at the cliff's edge.  Clipped grasses spread along the outer edge of the path, but everything adjacent to the riverbed is dry and dusty.
