title: [[Siergelde Cliffs, Great Break]]
description: A sudden break in the cliffs prohibits any further travel.  Known as the Great Break, this jagged rift separates the southern end of the riverbed from its northern part.  Far down at the bottom of the Great Break is a landscape of treetops, and the hint of a small lake.  Beyond it, the riverbed continues its winding course into a dusty, far-off horizon.

title: [[Emberclaw Expedition, Bonfire Pit]]
description: Sand-worn driftwood benches and low stumps line the central bonfire, spaced to allow easy movement.  A tall bamboo palisade borders the area, draped with long fishnets in various stages of cleaning.  The steady murmur of waves drifts from the nearby beach, carrying the tang of salt on the breeze.  Off to one side rests a sculpted stone sea turtle, its central shell scute hollowed while the surrounding plates gleam with iridescent mother-of-pearl inlay.

title: [[Emberclaw Expedition, Bonfire Pit]]
description: Driftwood logs are arranged at the edge of an enormous bonfire, each makeshift bench weathered by wind and sea.  A tall bamboo palisade forms a protective barrier with small lanterns hung at intervals along its length.  Clusters of colorful seaglass and large white shells are wired into flower-like patterns and woven into the fence with long vines.

title: [[Emberclaw Expedition, Food and Flame]]
description: Tucked against the base of the cliff with the bonfire close enough for light and warmth, the ground is compacted and level, while a small sail is suspended at a strategic angle to provide some shelter over the area.  A long bamboo table and a two-high row of salt-stained crates are set along the perimeter palisade, neatly displaying goods for sale.

title: [[Emberclaw Expedition, Bonfire Beverages]]
description: Tables fashioned from empty barrels are shaded by colorful canvas umbrellas.  A short bar is crafted from bamboo and covered by a palm frond awning, with a collection of empty glasses on the counter awaiting a fresh beverage.  Wide pathways between tables and the bar allow patrons easy access to the central bonfire.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Thicket]]
description: A forbidding fortress of winding tendrils wraps about tree trunks and locks them in a continuous mesh, defying all but the sharpest machetes.  Even now, the twisting vines have begun the work of reclosing the gap just created, except for a subtly braided archway holding open a sliver of space.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gravevine Mire]]
description: Massive trees with sprawling buttress roots loom overhead, their tangled limbs draped in curtains of thorny vines, heavy with mottled leaves of black, purple, and green.  Pools of murky water collect in muddy hollows where broken branches lie partly buried.  The narrow path, half-swallowed by creeping ferns, winds through the dense undergrowth without a clear destination.

title: [[Jalren'rae'Taisidon, Gravevine Mire]]

description: Massive trees with sprawling buttress roots loom overhead, their tangled limbs draped in curtains of thorny vines, heavy with mottled leaves of black, purple, and green.  Pools of murky water collect in muddy hollows where broken branches lie partly buried.  The narrow path, half-swallowed by creeping ferns, winds through the dense undergrowth without a clear destination.  A large heap of detritus has accumulated to one side, the mishmash of downed limbs vaguely resembling a ladder.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Carousel Family Services]]
description: A series of guarded arches line the southern wall.  The complicated framework of iron and timbers spans across the ceiling.  Countless gears, pulleys and weights form the strikingly complex mechanism which drives the Carousel.

title: [[Sana'ati Dyaus, Rundmolen Post Office]]
description: Tucked up against the conic building is a low stone counter made from green and white marble.  Potted plants ring the area, their lush foliage sectioning off the area from the bustling square beyond.  Vast, countless rows of differently sized shelves are behind the counter, and complex Dwarven mechanisms can be heard as they rearrange the package-covered storage.  Clerks shuffle endlessly back and forth between the counters and shelving as they assist patrons with their packaging and mailing needs.

title: [[Blue Fire Cove, Steep Trail]]
description: A narrow, steep path winds down the cliffside, its surface uneven with jagged stone and loose gravel.  Sharp rocks jut from the sheer walls on either side, while beneath, the water lies far below, stretching along the base of the cliff.  Sparse tufts of hardy coastal vegetation cling to cracks in the rock.  The trail narrows in places, forcing careful footing as it descends toward the beach.

title: [[Blue Fire Cove, Sheltered Shore]]
description: A narrow strip of sand curves beneath the stone overhang, its surface scattered with smooth pebbles and pale driftwood.  The rocky ceiling arches low in places, shaped by years of falling spray.  Channels carved into the sand suggest the steady pull of the tide, while dark pools gather near the cliff base, their edges ringed with mossy stone.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Blue Fire Cove, Lagoon's Heart]]
description: The lagoon forms a shallow pool bordered by rock and packed sand, its water sheltered by the protective cliff walls.  Large boulders break the surface near the center, creating natural stepping stones.  A narrow channel at the far edge connects to the open sea, its rocky mouth partially masked by tangled marine growth clinging to the stone.

title: [[Blue Fire Cove, Tide-Carved Ledge]]
description: A flat shelf of rock hugs the lagoon's inner rim, worn by centuries of water grinding against its edge.  Pitted surfaces reveal pockets of trapped shells, and shallow grooves run parallel to the shoreline.  The ledge rises only a few feet above the beach, yet offers a clear view of the cove's circular basin and its sheltered waters.

title: [[Blue Fire Cove, Overhang Hollow]]
description: A recessed alcove rests beneath a sweeping curve of stone, its walls streaked with muted blue-grey mineral deposits that form natural patterns.  Loose sand gathers near the back where the rock bends inward, mingling with scattered feathers and faint claw marks that suggest frequent winged visitors.

title: [[The Unwritten Library, Sales Floor]]
description: Shelves of all shapes and sizes line the small room, and all are filled with neatly arranged journals, diaries, logs and more.  Dusty smells of aged parchment mingle with those of leathers, glues and other materials used to craft the wares.  Hanging from the rafters, a series of softly glowing gaethzen orbs provide illumination.

title: [[Crypticats, Front Room]]
description: Softly faded stripes of warm cream and tawny brown run along the fabric walls, their pattern echoing the sleek markings of a small, well-groomed, feline predator.  A ribbon-stripe display table sits at the center, its lacquered surface marred by faint claw gouges along the edge.  Small tufts of pale fur cling stubbornly to the corners of a woven mat, evidence of a frequent and unbothered occupant.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, Conviction]]
description: The lighting in this room burns softly from hanging oil lanterns, and casts a warm glow over a crystal case along the far wall.  Strangely, the items on the altar are illuminated with more brilliance than the three lanterns can provide, creating the illusion that the light comes from within the objects, themselves.  A lone display case sits opposite a vanity, embedded within the shadows and shrouded with a sable cloth.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, Valor]]
description: Mounted over the door is a massive broadsword, its blade serrated and set into a golden hilt.  So enormous is its size, it is obvious it is a piece meant for show and not for battle, for clearly no warrior could lift it alone.  An long table covers the far end of the room, displaying an assortment of melee weapons, while a nearby sturdy rack holds a variety of ranged weapons over a linen-covered counter.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, Fortitude]]
description: Hanging from the wall are many heavy shields, each with a differing design and some symbolic emblem of the Paladin guild.  The light shimmers over them brightly, accenting their unique craftsmanship and flawless design.  A plush wolf-skin rug covers the floor, muffling heavy footsteps from boot-clad customers.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, The Gallant Steed]]
description: A crystal chandelier dangles from the ceiling, its brilliant light bouncing over the highly polished armor positioned over the metallic destriers that dominate the center of the room.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, Garments for Lords and Ladies]]
description: Several hanging tapestries decorate the walls, their bright colors portraying vivid scenes of battle.  Resting near the entrance is an overstuffed velvet chair, with woven shawls carefully draped over the back and a matching footrest at the base.  A heavy oak wardrobe dominates a nearby corner, its doors propped open on both sides by a shoe rack and a display case.

title: [[Iprilu's Emporium, Vessels of Distinction]]
description: Large mahogany panels dominate the back of the room, which is carpeted in fine rugs woven with patterns of knotwork laurel.  Nearby, several steel hooks have been stocked with merchandise, the colors bright against the darkened wood grain.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Front Room]]
description: The Arthe Hollow Inn has a warm, homey atmosphere, accentuated by the comfortably low ceilings and the acanth wood paneling.  The murmur of conversation and a ripple of laughter come from an open archway.  Wilibald Burdock, the exceptionally short (even by Halfling standards) and completely round innkeeper, is carefully polishing the paneling to a glossy finish.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Secluded Corner]]
description: A pitted brass sconce bearing a sputtering candle casts a cheerful glow upon this cozy niche.  Nestled close to a small oak table is a wooden chair with a colorful soft cushion tied to the seat with bright orange twine.  Securely attached to the acanth wood paneling is a sturdy shelf.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Hallway]]
description: The small low hallway leads to some of the guests' chambers.  Judging from the height of the ceiling, only a Halfling would enjoy a stay in this section of the inn.  A round green door leads to one of the rooms.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Corridor]]
description: The upward sloping ceilings and tall doors make this area more comfortable for the guests of a larger size.  The acanth wood paneling from the front room continues down the hall, and the walls above it are painted a creamy pale yellow.  A carved wooden door is trimmed with a flowery design.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Sicle Room]]
description: The apple green walls of this cheerful room are accented with three still-life paintings of bright red sicle fruit.  A small feather bed is covered with a soft down comforter, and a canary yellow chair sits next to a round window.  A bowl of fresh sicle fruit has been placed on a small table next to the chair.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Common Room]]
description: The room is filled with jovial conversation, laughter, much toasting and a layer of smoky haze.  Guests of all races mingle at the long, low tables.  A Halfling holding a very large mug of beer jumps in front of the stone fireplace, lets out a whoop and bursts into a spontaneous song.  Daisy Burdock, the inn's waitress, maneuvers adeptly through the crowd carrying a tray of mugs and occasionally glancing out the window.  A menu is posted at the archway next to a prominent sign.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Dance Hall]]
description: This low, snug hall is filled with music and laughter at all hours of the day and night, as the village residents never seem to lose their passion for dance and drink.  Silk streamers dyed with vibrant reds, blues and yellows drape out from the center of the ceiling and hang down the walls.  Lively music is provided by a group of Halfling minstrels, and the heady aroma of roasted meat wafts through the air.

title: [[Arthe Hollow Inn, Cellar]]
description: Candle sconces light the stone cellar, revealing walls lined with wine racks and rows of beer kegs.  A worktable takes up the center of the room, and a wooden cabinet sits nearby.  Despite the dimly lit dampness, the room is immaculately neat with not a cobweb in sight.

title: [[Bard's Guild, The Quill and Quaver]]
description: Ruby-red banners hang from the upper walls, edged with thin gold trim, while brass windchimes shaped like tiny harps and lute silhouettes are suspended from overhead beams.  The floor is composed of dark hardwood planks, and one wall bears a series of mounted, polished metal strings stretched across small frames, their tension creating straight, taut lines strung with glass music notes.

title: [[Bard's Guild, The Quill and Quaver]]
description: Dark hardwood covers the floor in wide, uniform boards, intersected by a narrow strip of lighter inlay along the perimeter.  The walls are painted deep ruby and punctuated with small golden sconces, each shaped like giant zills.  Hanging from iron brackets are metal wind bells shaped like tiny flutes, their surfaces polished to a reflective shine.  Sections of the wall feature vertical panels of ruby-colored fabric with fine gold embroidery in repeating stave and clef motifs.

title: [[Hag's Crag, Star Shrine]]
description: Carved into the mountainside, a simple shrine is set in reverence to the heavens.  Swirled channels carved into the broad plinth gather frost, and a deep alcove provides modest shelter against the howling winds, set with a pair of sconces holding wide burning flames.  Though open to the elements, the shelter is clean and warm.

title: [[Luthier's, Performance Room]]
description: Tucked behind the Luthier's shop, this room serves as impromptu performance hall and lounge for wandering Bards.  Occasional performances are given here and sometimes the public is invited in for a few coins.  Wine and ale can be had, albeit discreetly since the place is not licensed.  A dozen or so comfortable benches are scattered about and in one corner a rather rag-tag troubadour seems to be sleeping off yesterday's tipple.

title: [[Western Road, Valley Path]]
description: Winding between some low hills, the faint path climbs slowly as it passes amongst the thick grass.  The rolling foothills lack trees, although an occasional low shrub clings to the rocky soil.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: A grass-covered valley opens up between the rolling foothills.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: Bent by the wind, a lone shrub stands surrounded by thick clumps of bluestem and switchgrass.  The constant winds have bent the branches almost sideways, but the bush clings stubbornly to life even in the face of adversity.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, west.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: Swaying in the constant wind, the tall grasses lap up against the rocky foothills.  A few birds cling to the stems, searching for bugs or other food amongst the verdant vegetation.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: A tall cliff rises to the east, its granite face almost sheer as it rises from the valley floor.  High atop the bluff, some large nests perch precariously above the grassy valley.
paths: Obvious paths: north, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: Tumbled down from the granite cliff, a few rough boulders rise above the verdant grasses of the valley.  The thick vegetation completely covers the ground, the thick stems providing cover for an unknown number of animals and insects.

title: [[Valley, Meadow]]
description: Surrounded on most sides by steep hillsides, the prairie grasses cover the valley floor in a deep mat of vegetation.  The sounds of scurrying animals can be heard within the plants, but the thick stems and leaves hide the animals from sight.

title: [[Smaragdaus' Joy, Alcove]]
description: The surrounding walls are painted a soft pink and feature a large stained glass window in the shape of a heart.  Carefully arranged alongside the walls, two wide cases and an enormous display show off their wares.

title: [[Leth Deriel, The Crafty Cat]]
description: Long worktables line the whitewashed stone walls, one side of the open room arranged with weapon racks and armor stands, the other hosting a colorful array of partially completed craft projects.  A brick-lined opening in the far wall provides access to a forge, while the main body of the fire pit extends behind the building.  Tall open-beam ceilings rise overhead with vents near the peak, and expansive accordion windows admit ambient light and fresh air.

title: [[Crystal Cavern]]
description: This tiny cavern inside the stone outcropping is alive with the sparkle of a thousand tiny crystals embedded into every facet of rock.  The deep, cool waters of the hidden pool surround you, brushing against your skin and lapping at the base of a polished limestone statue of a dolphin emerging from the water.  The pleasant echo of dripping water rolls through the cave.

title: [[Castaways' Tattoo Parlor]]
description: Thick canvas is stretched tautly over a frame of tropical wood, its bright blue hue a stark contrast to the golden sand below.  Fresh air flows in from the open tent flap, filling the room with the briny scent of the sea.

title: [[Dintacui Apartments, Garden Room]]
description: This garden is furnished with thick pillows laid upon a tiled floor.  They form a hexagonal pattern around a single rosebush, fragrant with flowers.  Orange trees form a canopy, supplying sustenance and shelter from inclement weather.

title: [[Korhege Apartments, Garden]]
description: Oralana and climbers of maugwort, gravid with brown berries, tumble in profusion over gently eroded stone benches and tables in this central garden area.  The fragrance is mellow yet spicy, like standing downwind of a distant caravan loaded with herbs and costly fabrics.

title: [[Dark Thicket, Shrouded Clearing]]
description: The trees form a horseshoe around the dark green clearing, the heavy foliage from the various oaks and ash that grow abundantly here weaving a tangled canopy which blocks light with the completeness of death.  Pushed up against the very center of the "shoe" is a magnificent statue of a proud-faced woman holding a basin in her hands.  A faint forest trail leads off from where the grove opens up, slicing neatly through a second growth of trees before vanishing into the woods.

title: [[Old Throne City, Vagabond's Row]]
description: Rubbish and blankets are strewn across the alleyway, possibly left by littering hands or blown by the wind.  A tarp-covered statue stands near the street.  Between this marble monstrosity and the empty crates stacked nearby, it is unlikely that passers-by would notice this area at all.  Serving as one side of this man-made canyon is the wall of the nearby museum, a makeshift wooden scaffolding ascending its surface.

title: [[Museum of Imperial History, Rooftop]]
description: By day, the view would certainly be a commanding one, but now consists only of the distant twinkling lights of passing boats on the Faldesu.  Much closer, a makeshift wooden scaffolding peaks at the edge of the wall, very nearly matching the height of the museum itself.

title: [[Museum of Imperial History, Northern Rooftop]]
description: Though the ornamentation on the roof's edge effectively forms a parapet, the street below can be surveyed easily by quick glances between the stone alfars and soldiers.  Anyone on Dahl Aeliy would be hard pressed to spot a lurker hiding on this building, and such a task would be even harder for those living in the luxurious residential areas further north.  From the rooftops, leisurely study of Throne City's layout can be taken for granted.

title: [[Museum of Imperial History, Rooftop]]
description: Shady figures move along other rooftops, their faces hidden by deep cloaks of various sullen hues.  Luckily for anyone at this vantage point, the forms take no notice of other rooftops as their attentions are aimed downward and south.  They blink in and out of view, appearing on other buildings, moving in utter silence like ghosts, their goals equally ethereal.

title: [[Museum of Imperial History, Southern Rooftop]]
description: The mingling, contrary scents of roses and horses arise from below, drifting from private gardens nestled behind the Palace as well as the nearby palatial stalls.  Though ivy and flowering vines cover the stone, the walls of the Palace are notably unrestored, bearing centuries of chips and marks.  Those who did the restoration certainly never intended to impress anyone who might be on the rooftop of the museum.

title: [[Museum of Imperial History, Archive]]
description: This dimly lit but organized space is dedicated to the preservation and management of the museum's historical and cultural materials.  The room is kept at a cool temperature and low humidity levels to ensure the artifacts are preserved over time.  Carefully labeled and cataloged materials are stored in specialized containers that protect them from damage and deterioration.  There are several workspaces where researchers and scholars can access the materials and conduct their studies.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Snarl]]
description: Dense undergrowth spreads across the area, a layered tangle of brush, shrubs, and low trees bound together by looping vines and trailing creepers.  Narrow, winding trails cut through the growth in branching paths, their packed surfaces weaving between roots and thickets.  Overhead, interlaced limbs form a broken canopy, partially sheltering the uneven ground.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Snarl]]
description: Clusters of shrubs and closely set trees form a continuous thicket, their growth interlaced with trailing vines and creeping stems.  Worn passages curve through the undergrowth, splitting and rejoining as they follow the contours of the land.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Snarl]]
description: Thick growth crowds the area, where tangled shrubs and young trees press close beneath a web of climbing vines.  A network of narrow tracks threads through the brush, bending around dense clusters and dipping between exposed roots.  The ground is uneven, layered with compressed debris.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Snarl]]
description: A dense sprawl of brush and low-reaching limbs blankets the area, bound tight with creeping growth.  Slender trails wind through the tangle in intersecting lines, their paths worn smooth where movement has pressed them into the earth.

title: [[Dove's Delightful Dwellings]]
description: At first glance, one might easily mistake this charming shop for a private home, so discreet and well-placed are the displays of quality building materials.  Thin slabs of stone form colorful tiled patterns up the walls, and thick logs of expensive woods form an attractive border around the floor.  Dove, a slender Elven woman, busies herself about her wares with a jar of lemon oil and a soft cotton cloth.

title: [[Dove's Doors]]
description: The pleasing fragrance of fresh-cut elm and wild flowers fills the back room of Dove's charming shop, drifting in on a light breeze from the woods beyond the wide-open windows.  A young Elf closely resembling the proprietor leans against a low counter at the back of the room, her face alight with an impish smile as customers peruse the selection of hand-turned doors on display.

title: [[Leth Deriel Crafting Society Outpost, Main Room]]
description: Hooks shaped like small leaves hold decorative tools more ornamental than useful, their polished handles gleaming softly.  A faint scent of cedar drifts from the smooth plank floor, grounding the room in simple craftsmanship.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Leth Deriel Crafting Society Outpost, Enchanting Emporium]]
description: Exposed rafters span the ceiling, supporting an assortment of hanging lanterns.  Wide boards cover the floor in even rows, their surfaces worn smooth from use.  Along one wall, sheets of worked metal display etched symbols arranged in precise, deliberate patterns.

title: [[Leth Deriel Crafting Society Outpost, Engineering Enclave]]
description: Panels of brushed steel form a decorative border along the walls, their matte finish accented by precise rivetwork.  The walls are covered in detailed diagrams, and anchored with sprocket-headed brass pins.

title: [[Leth Deriel Crafting Society Outpost, Outfitting Outlet]]
description: Soft plum and ivory stripes accent the plank walls, bordered with intricate filigree trim painted in stitch-like strokes.  Delicate silhouettes of spools, needles, and looping thread are woven into the decorative motif.

title: [[Leth Deriel Crafting Society Outpost, Alchemy Annex]]
description: Wood plank walls bear faint scorch marks that form curling patterns across their surface, as if left by careful experimentation.  Large wooden plaques hang in neat alignment, each carved to resemble a piece of parchment inscribed with simple geometric symbols.

title: [[Horse Barn, Inside]]
description: Delightfully fragrant to a horse, the barn's humid air is redolent with the aroma of manure mingled with sweat.  Several wooden stalls heaped with fresh, dry straw line this oblong room.  Each stall has a feedbag hanging from the back wall, and a stone trough filled with water.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Hidden Canyon]]
description: Buried by an enormous pile of rocks, one end of the twisting canyon now allows a somewhat precarious passage in and out.  Massive tree trunks crowd the rest of the gorge, their branches filling the space overhead.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Hidden Canyon]]
description: Carved long ago, the steep sides of the canyon enclose a lush, almost tropical forest.  Trunks topped by verdant growth tower overhead while the sounds of birds and animals echo throughout.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Hidden Canyon]]
description: Little grows on the forest floor as most sunlight is blocked by the towering canopy overhead.  A few scraggly bushes struggle for life amongst the leaf litter while the trunks of the colossal trunks host mosses and lichens that grow profusely in the damp climate.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Hidden Canyon]]
description: High overhead there is a break in the canopy as one of the forest's titans has fallen, its thick trunk splayed across the ground where it fell.  Saplings and other scrubby plants grow thickly around the giant's remains, each one striving to crowd out the others and reach the sky.

title: [[Wyvern Trail, Hidden Canyon]]
description: Chirps and cheeps sound overhead as birds flit between the branches.  An occasional drip of moisture falls from above as the muggy air condenses into a liquid drop.

title: [[Bewla's Dye Cases, Stall]]
description: Sturdy wooden planks support an awning that provide shelter from the elements for the wares offered.  Behind the counter, a clerk is perched atop a cushioned stool and gleefully greets visitors as they come and go.  Warm light radiating from a small gaethzen orb keeps the stall illuminated day or night.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches out from the edges of the plateau, stems waving in the ever-present wind.  Thick mats of dead vegetation pad the ground, decaying reminders of the savannah's past.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches endlessly out from the plateau's edge, the wind blowing through the stalks creating a low rustling sound that blends into the background.  An occasional animal wallow testifies to the sheer size of the prairie's inhabitants.
paths: Obvious paths: east, southeast, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassland]]
description: Grassland stretches out from the edges of the plateau, stems and leaves undulating in the constant wind.  A few boulders rise above the tops of the grasses, each one serving as a waypoint in the otherwise featureless savannah.

title: [[Wyvern Plateau, Grassy Vale]]
description: Grasses choke the ground, completely covering the floor of the tiny dell.  Sheer rock faces climb skyward, forming the escarpments that enclose the valley.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Front Walk]]
description: A cobblestone path winds toward the entrance of a cozy whitewashed cottage, its irregular stones worn smooth and shiny.  On both sides, colorful flower beds spill a riot of blossoms over the scalloped border, nearly obscuring the walkway.  A carved garden gnome, a flower pot balanced on its head sprouting lemongrass, sits between a small lizard statue with onyx eyes and a playful granite fox balancing a tangle of vines on its nose.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Butterfly Garden]]
description: A lush tangle of flowering plants fills the garden, their blossoms and leaves crowding together in layered abundance.  A tall wall of woven vines rises along the edges, enclosing the outer edge of the garden in a verdant green barrier.  Nestled among the growth, several shallow dishes hold water scattered with flat pebble perches.  Beneath the shade of a broad tree, a wooden bench swing, with a profusion of colorful cushions, hangs suspended from sturdy chains.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Backyard]]
description: A flourishing garden spreads away from the back of the cottage, the rear door not visible from this vantage, with flower beds and creeping vines filling every spare space.  An enormous greenhouse dominates one side, its heavily frosted windows hiding the interior entirely.  Across the back, an unusually tall wall of dense, impenetrable greenery rises, blocking sight and passage.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Cottage]]
description: Numerous windows line this spacious main room, where pale wood floors and white walls meet a knotty-beam ceiling overhead.  Potted plants fill much of the space, all carefully arranged with the shop's merchandise stacked haphazardly among the planters.  Small traces of potting soil are scattered across the floor, and more than one half-empty cup of tea is visible.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Cottage Workroom]]
description: Tall windows allow natural light into the cluttered space with pale wood floors and white walls.  Potted plants in various stages of growth cover tables and shelves, with gardening tools scattered throughout.  On the largest worktable, a neat row of surgical implements lies in one corner, contrasting with the surrounding greenery and soil-streaked surfaces.  A heavy ironwood door at the far end of the room is secured by both a stout lock and a sturdy bar laid across steel hooks.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Behind the Cottage]]
description: A tidy stone path winds through an overflowing garden thick with tangled blossoms, sprawling vines, and carefully arranged beds of unusual growth.  One side of the space is dominated by an enormous greenhouse fitted with heavily frosted windows and a door secured beneath a thick iron bar.  Purple pollen is splattered heavily across the rear entrance of the cottage.  Opposite the greenhouse, an unusually tall wall of impenetrable greenery rises in a dense mass of interwoven foliage and thorned stems.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Noxious Snarl]]
description: Dense walls of tangled greenery rise around a large passage worn through the undergrowth.  Thick vines drape between clusters of pale blossoms, partially concealing the remnants of an abandoned picnic.  A torn blanket lies tangled beneath the foliage beside an overturned basket missing its handle, while several broken ceramic plates are scattered nearby among crushed stems and leaves.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Noxious Snarl]]
description: A winding tunnel cuts between towering masses of interwoven brush and flowering vines, the passage wide and tall enough to fit a caravan.  Near one edge of the trail stands a crude figure assembled from crooked sticks and bound lengths of root, its head formed from a heavily rusted helmet tilted at an unnatural angle above the surrounding flowers.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Noxious Snarl]]
description: Heavy curtains of ivy and sprawling vines press close around the path, their growth threaded with clusters of vivid blossoms and broad waxy leaves.  Thick roots twist across the ground in uneven ridges, disappearing beneath mats of moss and scattered petals.  Here and there, plump purple pods hang from dangling stems, their fragile husks dark against the surrounding greenery.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Noxious Snarl]]
description: The passage broadens slightly where dense flowering growth has been bent back into an arched corridor through the wilderness.  Layers of trailing vines hang overhead beside tangled sprays of tiny blossoms in pale pink and deep violet.  Along the edges of the trail, weathered garden markers lean at crooked angles beneath blankets of creeping vegetation.

title: [[Fenwyrthie's, Knickknacks]]
description: An eclectic assortment of tiny treasures crowds every available space.  Polished stones, carved figures, curious tools, and countless unidentifiable objects are wedged onto shelves, stacked upon counters, and scattered among baskets and bins.  Oddments and baubles from distant places mingle with common trinkets, forming a patchwork display that stretches from floor to rafters.  Only a few narrow paths remain between the cluttered arrangements.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Rough Tunnel]]
description: Roughly hacked out walls meet with the unevenly finished floor in this crudely crafted passageway.  A faint odor of smoke mingles with a musky, animal scent.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Rough Tunnel]]
description: Cut through the stone with a minimum of care and a maximum of haste, the passage burrows deeper into the ground.  On one wall, an opening into a natural cavern shows where the excavators intersected with a pre-existing grotto.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Limestone Cave]]
description: Limestone walls enclose this naturally formed grotto deep underground.  Through the opening, a crudely hacked out tunnel can be glimpsed.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Near a Pool]]
description: Occasionally disturbed by a drip from one of the stalactites overhead, the still waters of the pool are dark and deep.  Flowstone covers much of the floor, the product of many years of deposited sediments forming into wavy formations.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, southwest, west.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Limestone Cave]]
description: Stalactites thrust up from the ground, some almost touching the stalagmites reaching down from the ceiling.  A faint musky scent hints of the animals that make this cavern their home.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, west, northwest.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Limestone Cave]]
description: Periodically, a gentle *drip*drip*drip* echoes through the area from somewhere else in the cavern.  Overhead, bats dart and zip about as they flit through the space.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Limestone Cave]]
description: Piles of bones lie in irregular stacks in the corners of the cavern.  Each mound is jumbled up with other debris and rotting bits of meat and other noxious matter.

title: [[Cavern of Fire, Limestone Cave]]
description: Water seeps from the walls, collecting into a tiny pool before snaking across the floor in a tiny rivlet and disappearing deeper in the cavern.

title: [[Alteration Wagon, Waiting Room]]
description: Bright lanterns hang from the surprisingly tall ceiling, illuminating the room below.  Silk panels draped along the walls absorb the general noise of the room, while plush cushions scattered across the polished oak floor provide seating for those awaiting their chance at working with a merchant.  A thick curtain hangs between an archway across from the door leading out.

title: [[Explorers' Outfitters, Willow Room]]
description: Curving willow limbs create an abstract pattern across the walls and ceiling, while thicker branches are crafted into rounded tables that seem to flow up from the polished floor.  A single piece of the same wood is used to create the arching willow doorway that leads back outside.

title: [[The Book Wyrm, Punderful Gifts]]
description: Gaethzen orbs strung from the ceiling give off a soft light, illuminating the rainbow-hued dragon painted across one wall with a veritable trove of books scattered around its feet.  Beneath one of the dragon's wings is an artfully arranged display of greeting cards, the other wing is opened protectively over some tables full of books.  A small oak bench sits in the corner tucked out of the way.

title: [[Call Of The Wild, Showroom]]
description: Covering the wagon's ceiling an abundance of pine boughs have been hung to recreate the look of a forest's canopy, lending a fresh scent to the air and hiding all sources of artificial light spotlighting the displayed merchandise.  A variety of painted trees cover the walls, their muted shades of green helping to reinforce the woodland scene.  Roughly-hewn containers are carefully arranged to form paths through the room, directing shoppers through the available stock for sale.

title: [[Head to Toe, Showroom]]
description: Grey and silver silk panels frame the walls of this shop.  Stands are arranged in front of a mahogany counter polished to a high sheen that is bare except for a silver tray in one corner.  Racks behind the counter are draped with different fabrics.  Clerks talk in muted voices pointing out the mannequins and then step back to wait quietly.

title: [[Call Of The Wild, Fur Salon]]
description: Mirrors panel the walls, their reflective surface framed by pooling drapes of white gauze.  Tiny crystals sprinkled along the sheer fabric gives it the glittering effect of freshly fallen snow, which is repeated in a thick covering of plush carpet on the floor.  Statuesque racks, fashioned from an assortment of materials, show the available merchandise to its best advantage.

title: [[Wild Couture, Atelier]]
description: The exclusive boutique is nestled inside an enormous silverbirch tree with pale bark walls and carpeted by a lush profusion of soft green moss.  Strewn with glowing gaethzen leaves, a waxed satin canopy is draped across the tree's taller branches, illuminating a collection of delicate silver displays.

title: [[Workshop, Vestibule]]
description: Round pegs stick out from one side wall, set into the weathered planks to provide a place to hang cloaks or aprons.  A cloak, dusty and almost rotted away from age, still hangs forlornly as if waiting for its owner.  Dust covers the floor and settles into the gaps between the floorboards.

title: [[Workroom, Workspace]]
description: Open floorspace is ringed by dust-covered equipment, some of it decayed into piles of rotting or rusted parts that are utterly incapable of identification.  Dried leaves mix with the dirt and filth to form a thick layer of detrius on the floors.  A few holes in the roof show where the leaves gained entrance.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west.

title: [[Workroom, Workspace]]
description: Racks containing dusty tools stand against the walls.  A few worktables stand nearby with equipment haphazardly scattered atop them as if abandoned in mid-task.  High overhead, the exposed roof beams provide a staging area for the complex lattice of spiderwebs.

title: [[Workroom, Storage]]
description: Bins and barrels hold the rotting and decaying remains of materials once used in this working area.  A few burlap sacks lie in crumbling heaps against the walls, what they once contained long since decayed away.

title: [[Workroom, Workspace]]
description: Pegs on one wall hold the remains of tools, although a few have lost handles or other parts.  Dangling ropes hang from the roofbeams, their exact purpose long since lost to time.  Dust covers everything in a thick shroud of concealing grime and grit.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Workroom, Workspace]]
description: Two sawhorses are set up in the middle of the area, spaced far apart.  A rusting saw leans against one leg, its blade warped and bent from its long wait.  Two lanterns, long since guttered out, hang suspended on chains from the exposed beams overhead.

title: [[Workroom, Storage]]
description: Once these shelves held parts and materials for use in the workshop, but now they are covered with corroded and crumbling lumps.  The shelving itself shows signs of disrepair, with some uprights leaning dangerously and others appearing ready to buckle at any moment.

title: [[Enclosed Pathway, Cavern]]
description: A tight pathway crushes all around, the rock face revealing deep cracks and sparkling minerals.  A breathless sigh can be felt ahead as the air is pulled forward, stirring the dust around your feet.  Something shimmers in the air, and there is an odd pressure behind your eyes.

title: [[Enclosed Pathway, Cavern]]
description: The pathway narrows, making it difficult to squeeze forward.  The walls are brecciated and catch at your clothing.  Faint whispers angrily echo ahead.

title: [[Crushing Pathway, Cavern]]
description: There is barely enough space to progress along the pathway.  Thin branches writhe through cracks in the tunnel, grasping at you.  A repeated command beckons you to continue on, but you cannot remember the exact words.

title: [[At the foot of the Ziggurat, Cavern]]
description: A massive cavern stretches in all directions, wide and large enough to engulf a massive ziggurat that stretches upward, an enormous stairwell leading to the top.  The gigantic steps are clearly for something greater than a mortal such as yourself, and the steps are well worn in the middle.  The ziggurat is without adornment, save a single strip of unknown symbols written in a tight script along the center of the staircase.  The cavern walls seethe with writhing branches, which glows with a gentle but steady light.  Nearby stands a simple plinth, atop which rests a stone and ivy crown.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Needlethorn Warren]]
description: An open stretch of woodland is overtaken by sprawling vegetation trained into looping arches and low tunnels of living greenery.  Thick mats of moss soften the ground beneath them, while dozens of slender vine tendrils descend from above, each adorned with scattered pink blossoms and delicate curling shoots.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Needlethorn Warren]]
description: The undergrowth parts around a narrow stream no wider than a single stride, crossed by a simple bridge formed from intertwined roots and flexible saplings.  Broad-leafed plants crowd the banks, their stems tangled with flowering creepers that trail low over the gently moving water.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Needlethorn Warren]]
description: Dense vegetation crowds close around the trail, interrupted only by a shallow clearing where countless smooth stones have been gathered into untidy spirals and winding patterns.  Creeping vines thread between the carefully arranged shapes, while clusters of tiny blossoms spill across their edges.

title: [[Wildspire Hollow, Needlethorn Warren]]
description: A winding trail narrows between towering shrubs woven together by thick flowering vines, their tangled growth arching overhead.  One side of the path opens onto a broad den fashioned entirely from curiously braided branches and living stems, its interior lined with deep cushions of springy moss scattered with a few pale petals.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Polished granite walls taper up to a curved triangular point from which a silvery globe is suspended.  Beneath the globe is a narrow marble catafalque, upon which rest skeletal remains wrapped in a tattered winding-sheet.  A chill enfolds the area within its icy grasp, mercifully choking off any stench of decay.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Polished granite walls taper up to a curved triangular point from which a silvery globe is suspended.  Beneath the globe is a narrow marble catafalque, upon which rest skeletal remains wrapped in a tattered winding-sheet.  A chill enfolds the area within its icy grasp, mercifully choking off any stench of decay.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Snowy marble tiles line the walls, gleaming beneath an opalescent veil of ice.  Shallow gutters score each side of the chamber while a series of drainage holes are visible in the ceiling overhead.  Placed within a semicircular recess carved in the wall, a pale stone casket gleams with a mantle of frost.

title: [[Temple of the North Wind, Catacombs]]
description: Scores of corpses have been haphazardly crammed into the deep recesses lining the walls.  Ice fills most of the niches, spilling out of the openings in glistening waves of dirty white.  The tunnel terminates at a wall, coated lightly with frost and carved with a bas-relief depicting Asketi astride a snorting unicorn.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The once crowded, chaotic bazaar now stands silent, both merchant and shopper resting with the sun.  The colorful pennants marking the marketplace are now nothing more than shades of black, waiting to regain their luster in a new day.
paths: Obvious paths: north, east, southeast, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The once crowded, chaotic bazaar now stands silent, both merchant and shopper resting with the sun.  The colorful pennants marking the marketplace are now nothing more than shades of black, waiting to regain their luster in a new day.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, south, west.

title: [[Ratha, Bazaar]]
description: The scents of the day mingle with the silence of night as the smells of the bazaar linger long after the merchants have turned in.  Shards of lamp light sporadically pierce the confines of the marketplace, causing both illumination and shadow.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, south, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Moon Mage Guild, Seers' Study]]
description: The skylights above curve down to form the exterior wall of this wedge-shaped chamber, offering a breathtaking view of the western half of the city and Wyvern Mountain beyond.  One interior wall is lined with sturdy bookcases, while the other features a large cork board next to a desk stocked with paper and writing implements.  A complicated web-patterned mosaic on the floor converges on a black marble lectern near the crystal wall.

title: [[The Singing Raven, Private Parlor]]
description: The sounds of activity from the common room are muted here, although the pungent smell of tobacco smoke drifts in on a slight draft.  Small and windowless, the room is lit by a stone fireplace on the far wall, and a hurricane lamp placed in the middle of the centered round table.

title: [[Vast Cavern, Sandstone Ledge]]
description: Excavated back into the depths of the earth, a crude vault has been wrestled from the ancient sandstone.  Craggy and discolored by the dampness of the ages, the stone cavity begins far below to embrace the dank above.

title: [[Vast Cavern, Scarred Chamber]]
description: Whether by design or simply from random creation, intricate patterns circle the dank ruins that litter the floor of the cavern.  Hundreds of massive claw marks interweave with each other, tracking back and forth between the cavern walls, the ruins, and up along a sizable length of the ceiling.

title: [[Vast Cavern, Central Collapse]]
description: Upon the floor of this uneven and jumbled cavern are the cluttered remains of a collapse, the heavy stone and block shattered and cracked from the obvious force of their fall.  Despite the mammoth rocks' weight, they quiver and shudder with the constant vibrations that echo throughout this vast underground.  Humming audibly and partially buried, lies a slagged pile of translucent material.

title: [[Vast Cavern, Sidereal Collapse]]
description: Deeply embedded in the walls is an array of translucent shards, stuck fast as if hurled like arrows from a giant crossbow.  Chime-like overtones ring out from the shards as they quiver and pulse in sympathy with a deep, persistent thrumming that fills the air.  Rubble lies strewn everywhere, and so pockmarked is the ceiling and walls that it's a wonder the cavern is actually able to support itself against the constant vibrations.

title: [[Vast Cavern, Sunken Collapse]]
description: Massive blocks of stone and shattered rock fill this sunken pit incompletely, revealing dark gaps through which pebbles and debris slide into occasionally.  Wedged between some of the choking collapse is a partially crushed glove, frozen in a grasping gesture as it lies pinned into place.  The remains of its owner are certainly buried beneath the ruin nearby.

title: [[Half Pint, Dewdrop Suite]]
description: The room is bright and cheery, bedecked with lace and eyelet drapes, curtains and ruffles.  Soft white and pale green decor brings to mind the early morn on summer's first day.  Verdant ferns and vines trail down from glazed pots suspended from the ceiling, leaving cool, welcoming drops of moisture.  A huge canopy bed stands against one wall with the blankets turned down, beckoning weary travelers to rest.

title: [[Arnack's Tavern, Mud Pit]]
description: A large banner is suspended directly above the large, muddy pit that dominates the room.  Arranged in a semicircle around the pit, wooden benches are placed on platforms for better viewing.

title: [[Arnack's Tavern, Washroom]]
description: Faint, lingering traces of dried mud mar the otherwise pristine tile flooring.  Neatly arranged next to each other, a sturdy wooden counter, towel stand, and soap basin are placed near the entrance of the room.

title: [[Arnack's Tavern, Wooden Tub]]
description: Preventing the steaming, hot water from overflowing and spilling out of the tub, the tub's tall staves are carved with convenient handholds and footholds for bathers to exit easily.

title: [[Ancient Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Chipped and broken stone steps spiral up and down the round interior of the ancient tower.  Here and there along the walls gaps remain where mighty stone blocks have slipped from their mortar and fallen to the ground below.  You also see some steps leading up and some stairs leading down.

title: [[Ancient Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Chipped and broken stone steps spiral up and down the round interior of the ancient tower.  Here and there along the walls gaps remain where mighty stone blocks have slipped from their mortar and fallen to the ground below.  You also see some steps leading up and some stairs leading down.

title: [[Ancient Tower, Stairwell]]
description: Chipped and broken stone steps spiral up and down the round interior of the ancient tower.  Here and there along the walls gaps remain where mighty stone blocks have slipped from their mortar and fallen to the ground below.  You also see some steps leading up and some stairs leading down.

title: [[Ancient Tower, Abandoned Workshop]]
description: Before continuing its up and downward spirals, the staircase breaks open onto a stone platform which may have served at one time as a magical workshop.  Blackened walls, floor, and ceiling speak eloquently of a powerful magic gone awry and backfiring on its caster.  The room is empty but for a single rosewood case, which stands as if left untouched by magic and time.  You also see some steps leading up and some stairs leading down.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Entrance]]
description: Smooth cobblestones pave a modest courtyard enclosed by a tall stone wall that stretches in either direction, surrounding the entire manicured space.  Near the entrance, a decorative trebuchet fashioned entirely from tightly braided plants stands upon a low circular bed, while trimmed shrubs and carefully maintained borders frame the open space.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Spire Walk]]
description: A broad path of white pebbles defines a generous walkway through a meticulously maintained landscape of burgundy foliage, silver-green shrubs, and scarlet flowers.  Poised beneath a tall black iron spire, an intricate statue of the World Dragon rests upon a raised stone table.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Island Siege]]
description: A large slab of dark basalt rises from a bed of neatly maintained oshu'mary plants, their trailing greenery dotted with countless tiny white blossoms.  Its polished face bears an expansive mural depicting a sailing warship approaching a rugged island, an ogre grappling an undead kraken, and a gnome fleeing on the wings of an intricate ornithopter.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Starry Path]]
description: White pebbles line a gently curved pathway that crosses an elegant garden where clipped hedges, sculpted shrubs, and flowering borders surround an immense bed of blood-red roses.  Carefully planted to create a flawless seven-pointed star, the vibrant display is enclosed by a narrow ring of pale stone and neatly maintained greenery.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Knots of Philosophy]]
description: Dominating the space is a sculpture of concentric bands formed from woven vines and flowering plants.  The outer ring spirals with alternating clusters of vivid orange and pristine white blossoms, interrupted at regular intervals by broad facets planted with rich red-gold blooms.  Within, a second ring of dark foliage and smooth stone supports a series of slender spokes converging upon a perfectly rounded sphere of densely tangled reddish-brown tendrils.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Beyond the Trellis]]
description: A towering wall of interwoven golden flowers rises from an intricately crafted trellis, dividing the garden into two distinct landscapes.  One side is planted with dense dark foliage punctuated by incarnadine blossoms, while the other flourishes with sweeping drifts of vibrant wildflowers in countless shapes and colors.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Arrow's Fall]]
description: A broad lawn is bordered by neatly trimmed hedges and carefully maintained flowering beds, their orderly appearance interrupted by countless claw-tipped arrows embedded throughout the surrounding greenery and stonework.  To one side, an elaborate hedge forms the Northeast Gate of Crossing.  An innocent-looking gidii topiary stands within the open gateway, while an azurelle longbow carved with rearing dragons lies discarded.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Screamer's Demise]]
description: A miniature mountain of weathered boulders of varying sizes rises from carefully raked beds of pale gravel interspersed with hardy shrubs and sparse alpine greenery.  A lifelike glass statue of a cornered S'lai screamer is surrounded by a band of warriors forming a veritable wall of weapons that closes in on the grounded creature from every side.

title: [[Walled Memory Garden, Fountain of Tears]]
description: Curving beds of blooming Elven tears blossoms surround a circular fountain enclosed by neatly maintained greenery and pale stone edging.  Rising from its center, an ethereal Elven woman, crowned with a delicate diadem, wraps her arms around a human man with a sheathed short sword resting against his hip.

title: [[RKM Curios, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  An oaken table and a glass worktable sit on the stained oak floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.  A oak rack hangs on the silk-covered walls.

title: [[Osija Ameshi Kashik, Sales Floor]]
description: An engraved oaken sales counter sits prominently in the back of the shop, providing a surface for merchant and customer to haggle or exchange goods for coin.  A lunat endtable and an ironwood bar line the oaken walls.  An oaken table sits on the bare floor, with an ironwood trunk placed nearby to provide a variety of browsing options.

title: [[Paasvadh Forest, Treetops]]
description: Stretching beneath a star-studded night sky, the forest canopy bobs and sways in the wind.  A dense cloak of leaves conceals the interwoven network of branches below and makes any movement a feat of skill and agility.  Far in the distance to the south and east, celestial light glints off snow-mantled peaks.

description: Tall and straight, the cypress seems unwilling to be distracted in its pursuit of the open sky.  Widely spaced limbs and thin, papery bark that hangs in overlapping shreds like a gypsy skirt make it difficult to climb.

title: [[The Book Nook, Book Room]]
description: Rough wooden walls enclose the space, holding crooked racks and shelves of old oak.  Covering the floor from wall to wall is a dirty rug that is giving off the faint smell of mold and cheese.  Tables have been haphazardly set up to either side of the doorway.

title: [[Zand's Exotic Pets, Hoppy Things]]
description: Small cages and aquariums line the walls, each displaying a specimen of an exotic animal gathered from the far corners of the world.  Each enclosure displays a small card cataloging the creature's needs and habitat.

title: [[Zand's Exotic Pets, Fluffy-Cuddly Things]]
description: Cages line the walls and run along the floor, each displaying a different exotic animal destined to become someone's house pet.  On the front of each display is a handwritten card cataloging the creature's needs and habitat, as well as commentary on its capture.

title: [[Zand's Exotic Pets, Slinky Things]]
description: Tiny cages and enclosures line the walls, each displaying a different exotic animal destined to become someone's house pet.  Each animal's display carries a handwritten card cataloging the creature's needs and habitat.

title: [[Why So Blue, Showroom]]
description: Dominated by various shades of blue, the wagon interior is packed with shelves, pegs, and a long counter showcasing assorted clothing and accessories.  In one corner, a silver tray lined with sapphire-hued velvet is crammed beneath a teal-painted hat rack, while gaethzen lanterns encased in azure glass dangle from the low arched ceiling and cast a coolly tinted glow over the already-blue merchandise.

title: [[Stone and Thread, Showroom]]
description: Light plastered walls complement wide warm grey plank floors, while a pair of thick oak beams run horizontally across the pale green-painted ceiling.  Domed copper lanterns are mounted high on the walls, casting a soft glow over the merchandise.

title: [[Stone and Thread, Alcove]]
description: Pale canvas panels extend outward from the main pavilion to form a wide alcove, their edges sharply folded against light timber framing.  Evenly spaced ceiling beams cross above smooth stone slabs, where pale oat-colored runners stretch end to end.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: Sharp shadows cut through the landscape, accenting the twisted silhouettes of the grotesquely haggard trees while concealing the hazards that lie hidden within the patches of tall grass.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: The dusky scent of nightshade seems to manifest visually as the rolling, dark mists that are omnipresent over the wild moor.  The grasses waver in a lilting motion, enchanted by the intoxicating aroma.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: Swaths of dark mist drape the moor in layers of shadow, concealing the source of a malignant rustling that waits in nearby tangles of nightshade.

title: [[Segoltha River, Near the South Bank]]
description: Distant treetops show above the swirling water, shrouded in mist and haze.  The seething waves are heavy with silt and debris carried downstream from distant mountains.  Little eddies on the river's surface conceal dangerous currents below.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, west, northwest.

title: [[Segoltha River, Midstream]]
description: Twisting currents of silt-laden water surge just below the river's surface.  A churning, heaving mass of dirty brown waves, the torrent of water stretches as far as the eye can see.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Segoltha River, Near the Boulder]]
description: Rising majestically above the rushing water, a massive rock outcropping emerges from the muddy river in the distance.  Forming a small islet in the watercourse, the top is crowned by a colossal tree.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Segoltha River, Near the Boulder]]
description: Scattered driftwood piled along the muddy shore testifies to the power of the river, each pile deposited high above the current waterline by vanished floods.  Tiny tracks of unknown animals spread a delicate tracery across the mud and sand.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, southwest.

title: [[Segoltha River, Near the Boulder]]
description: Towering over the river's surface, the looming bulk of the rocky island creates a sheltered area in the churning currents of the river.  Silt has been deposited in the refuge, forming a small muddy shoreline.  Mud gives way to drier sand of a bank that hugs the edge of the rock.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, southeast, south, northwest.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: Tendrils of blooming nightshade climb high through the dark mists into the vacant claw-like trees, appearing to give the deceased husks some semblance of life, however perverted.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: The dark mists cast a bluish-lavender pall through the air.  The motion of every shadow is magnified, twitching in wait just beyond your field of vision.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: Sinuous tendrils of dark purple mist swim through the air, entangling themselves in the deformed limbs of barren trees like ethereal serpents.  The dusky scent of nightshade carries over the moor.

title: [[Darkmist Moor, Nightshade Tangle]]
description: The soft mist makes everything seem muted and far away, disconnected and tinged with the illusion of a dream world.

title: [[Boxwood Maze]]
description: Tunnels have been carved within a tall hedge of boxwood.  The green branches cover the roof of the tunnel, allowing little light to filter through.  That, combined with the twisting turns of the passages, make it difficult to keep your bearings as you wander through the maze.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A myriad of decayed cadavers lie in hastily constructed alcoves along both sides of the passage.  Twisting and turning, these halls of the dead quickly disorient and confuse.  Small pools of water, putrid with rot, fill the depressions in the uneven floor, and the odor of decay is overpowering.  An occasional alcove sits empty, giving one cause to wonder where the previous occupant now lies.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: The narrow confines of these twisting maze-like tunnels cause every sound to reverberate eerily, as if the dead that line the walls are repeating the sounds in childlike imitation.  The putrefying flesh of hundreds of corpses has served as an immeasurable feast for the incalculable vermin inhabiting this subterranean realm.  Each alcove passed provides another glimpse into the long, dark past of the temple residents.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: This cluttered chamber was used to store many of the personal possessions of the deceased.  Water seeping through the cracks in the walls has long ago warped and sprung many of the barrels, chests, and boxes stacked about the room.  Piles of moldering cloth, leather, and other apparel have become the nesting materials for many of the catacombs' less savory inhabitants.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: A myriad of decayed cadavers lie in hastily constructed alcoves along both sides of the passage.  Twisting and turning, these halls of the dead quickly disorient and confuse.  Small pools of water, putrid with rot, fill the depressions in the uneven floor, and the odor of decay is overpowering.  An occasional alcove sits empty, giving one cause to wonder where the previous occupant now lies.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: The claustrophobic confines of the twisting hallways serve as an unnerving reminder of their purpose.  Hundreds of corpses have been crammed tightly into the narrow niches lining the walls.  The sheer number lends credence to the dark efficiency of the temple's previous inhabitants.  Rodents and vermin -- well-fed and vicious -- dart menacingly about in the shadows.

title: [[Catacombs, Labyrinth]]
description: The narrow passageways of these burial chambers give rise to new horrors at every turn.  Crudely carved niches lining the walls are each filled to overflowing with corpses in varying stages of decay.  Water drips slowly from the ceiling, covering the bodies in a thin veil of mineral deposits, while large colonies of fungus-like growths thrive in the darkness and corruption.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Outcrop]]
description: A broad cave mouth opens beneath a low ceiling of rough stone, the rocky overhang covered in a vibrant green tapestry of leafy vines.  The ground is rocky and uneven, scattered with gnawed bones and loose feathers.  Jagged stone presses down from above, narrowing the space beneath the overhang.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Outcrop]]
description: The cave mouth narrows slightly, its low ceiling casting heavy shadows across the uneven floor visible from the entrance.  At the farthest point from the opening, small pairs of yellow eyes blink intermittently, appearing and vanishing within the recesses of the stone.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Outcrop]]
description: Rough stone walls curve beneath a low, rocky overhang, forming a shallow chamber decorated with a wall of interwoven vines.  The ground bears many gouges, grouped in parallel slashes, and scattered bones dotted with golden feathers.  Small fragments of teeth and hide collect in shallow depressions along the edges of the chamber.

title: [[Fang Cove, Verdant Outcrop]]
description: The low-roofed cavern extends inward beyond your vantage point at the entrance, its ceiling dipping close above a floor worn smooth in places.  Barely visible against the deep gloom at the back of the natural room, the edge of a large nest cradles the cracked remains of a giant egg.

title: [[Charred Caverns, Rope Bridge]]
description: A fraying rope has been anchored on each side of a wide chasm, allowing one to shuffle hand-to-hand while hanging above the unknown darkness.  The western edge of the chasm is just within reach here.

title: [[Charred Caverns, Rope Bridge]]
description: A fraying rope has been anchored on each side of a wide chasm, allowing one to shuffle hand-to-hand while hanging above the unknown darkness.  The eastern edge of the chasm is just within reach here.

title: [[Beyond the Marble Gate, Trail]]
description: Stretching between the walls of the ravine is a large marble gate with a matching door set inside it.  The trail winds through the ravine and heads deeper into the hills.

title: [[Beyond the Marble Gate, Trail]]
description: Along one side of the trail, the branches of a flowering shrub have captured matted strands of brightly colored hair.  Even with a strong breeze, the wispy lengths hardly flutter and at times appear more akin to gremlin bristles.  To the other side of the dirt pathway lies the remains of a giant marble slab.  Large portions of the stone have been crudely hacked away, and broken fragments lie strewn in a rough line leading down the ravine.

title: [[Journalai Hills, Pine Forest]]
description: Tall pine trees tower to either side of the path, their silhouettes standing straight and unyielding, sentinels of the surrounding forest.  Tiny purple wood violets grow at the roots of one particularly large pine, scattered across the loamy earth.

title: [[Journalai Hills, Pine Forest]]
description: Mottled beams of gold pierce the dense canopy, illuminating columns of dancing dust motes above the needle-strewn ground.  The crisp mountain air carries the chatter of unseen canopy birds and the sharp, hot scent of baking pine sap from the older trees.  Shadows stretch and pool between the rolling knolls, masking the true depth of the treacherous, root-choked paths that wind through the hills.

title: [[Journalai Hills, Pine Forest]]
description: A gently worn path winds beneath towering pines, where a blanket of needles and scattered cones muffles each footstep.  The distant sounds of woodland creatures drift through the otherwise tranquil forest.

title: [[Journalai Hills, Meadow]]
description: A break in the trees opens into a large, grassy glade.  Wildflowers dot the periphery, bowing in the breeze.  A small hole in the hilly landscape that appears to have once been the entrance to a burrow lies filled with moss-covered rocks and debris, abandoned to the elements.

title: [[Journalai Hills, Forest Pond]]
description: At the edge of the meadow, a small pond glitters in the wan sunlight that filters through the leafy canopy of the surrounding trees.  Every so often, ripples form in the otherwise placid water, as tiny silvery fish break the surface.

title: [[Foothills Cave, Crevice]]
description: Granite walls twist and turn as the narrow space runs deeper underground.  Musky scents of animals mingle with the smells of decaying refuse dragged in by the cave system's denizens.  A few tufts of fur are caught in the rough outcrops of stone.

title: [[Foothills Cave, Cleft]]
description: Piles of fetid debris lie heaped against the walls, mingling with animal dung and rotting carcasses to permeate the area with a pungent odor.  In the distance, an occasional *plink* sounds as water drips within the cave system.  Bones and other refuse make the footing treacherous underfoot.

title: [[Underground River]]
description: A swift river blasts through the narrow chasm, roiling madly in its stoney bed.  Glowing lichens growing on the high walls cast a dim illumination on the raging torrent.  High above, a wide ledge protrudes from the wall, hanging out over the river.

title: [[Underground River]]
description: A swift river blasts through the narrow chasm, roiling madly in its stoney bed.  Glowing lichens growing on the high walls cast a dim illumination on the raging torrent.

title: [[Underground River]]
description: A swift river blasts through the narrow chasm, roiling madly in its stoney bed.  Glowing lichens growing on the high walls cast a dim illumination on the raging torrent.

title: [[Underground River]]
description: The crevice comes to an abrupt end, but the river punches through the rock, rushing noisily through a wide opening in the wall of stone.

title: [[Underground River, Underwater]]
description: A torrent of water rushes through the wide tunnel dragging all along with it.  Scouring the rock as it goes, the river wears down the stone, occasionally tearing off a chunk and pushing it along in the flood.

title: [[Underground River, Underwater]]
description: A torrent of water rushes through the wide tunnel dragging all along with it.  Scouring the rock as it goes, the river wears down the stone, occasionally tearing off a chunk and pushing it along in the flood.

title: [[Underground River, Underwater]]
