title: [[Chasm River]]
description: The deep water rushes wildly between the craggy walls rising to either side.  High above, the bridge arches over the chasm, its underside dimly lit.  Water splashes high up the wall as it tumbles through, bashing against the rough stone.  Debris in the water, propelled by the swift current, strikes swimmers with great force.  Water gushes from a low opening in the south wall.  A strange luminescence glows faintly from under the water.

title: [[Chasm River]]
description: The deep water rushes wildly between the craggy walls rising to either side.  High above, the bridge arches over the chasm, its underside dimly lit.  Water splashes high up the wall as it tumbles through, bashing against the rough stone.  Debris in the water, propelled by the swift current, strikes swimmers with great force.  A strange luminescence glows faintly from under the water.

title: [[Chasm River]]
description: The deep water rushes wildly between the craggy walls rising to either side.  High above, the bridge arches over the chasm, its underside dimly lit.  Water splashes high up the wall as it tumbles through, bashing against the rough stone.  Debris in the water, propelled by the swift current, strikes swimmers with great force.  The swirling waters drain out through a low tunnel in the wall.  A strange luminescence glows faintly from under the water.

title: [[Underground River]]
description: Strong jets of water from underground streams emptying into the river below the surface cause powerful swirls and chop.  The deep waters move swiftly between the sheer walls of the high crevice.  Glowing lichens cast their dim illumination on the river below.

title: [[Underground Streams]]
description: Glowing lichens, high above, cast a dim illumination on the gushing streams below.  Water cascades in frothy veils and powerful sprays from large holes in the sides of the fissure.  The torrent swells to several feet in depth, churning mightily as it tumbles away.

title: [[Underground Streams, Source]]
description: Hundreds of fountains of water pour from holes in the rock walls at the end of the crevice.  The water gathers in an ankle deep pool before rushing away to the north.  Glowing lichens, high above, cast a dim illumination on the streams below.

title: [[Upper Caverns]]
description: A deep crevice runs across the open end of the chamber, spanned by an arched stone bridge.  The roof of the cavern is considerably lower on this side of the bridge.  The walls form a smooth hemisphere, as if the area were carved from the rock much like the bridge.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the wide column.  A vast network of thick webbing spans the upper reaches of the high cavern.  Anchored on the stone column, stalactites, and the rock walls, the strands create easy access paths for the creatures dwelling therein.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the wide column.  Thick strands of silk, anchored to the sturdy stone, create difficult obstacles.  Several planes of webbing stretch across the upper reaches of the high cavern, providing easy access to all areas by whatever creature fashioned them.

title: [[Upper Caverns, On the Column]]
description: The ledge curls its way up and around the wide column.  A vast network of webs fans across the upper reaches of the cavern, glistening damply from water caught falling from small stalactites above.  Only a sparse layer of thick grey strands spans the space between this ledge and the roof of the high chamber.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Very faint illumination is provided by a flaking patch of glowing fungus clinging to a fallen rock.  An enormous cavern spreads out of sight into the darkness, stony floor and soaring walls fading into the unlit areas beyond.  Nearly hidden behind some crumbling stalagmites, a narrow opening sinks into the floor near the wall of the wide cavern.  A huge stalagmite and stalactite pair occupy the center of the chamber.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: A pile of rubble litters the area where a falling stalactite or roof plate has shattered on the ground.  The walls at this end of the long cavern are smooth and dry.  Silver-grey dust coats everything in a soft film.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Occupying this dark corner of the huge chamber is a heaping stack of bones.  Small insects skitter in and over the gleaming white remains.  The sweet scent of decay tickles the nose faintly in the otherwise dank air.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Smokey quartz and fool's gold gleam from a multitude of small outcrops in an ancient rock curtain draped down the wall.  Like dripping candle wax, the sediment crawled down the wall millenia ago and solidified in odd lumps and long streams, even pooling on the floor in a thick, rippled mass of stone.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southeast, south.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Numerous small stalagmites crowd the space between the base of the great fang in the center of the chamber and the jagged wall of the cavern.  The floor is dry and dusty, the thick layers of webbing strewn across the upper cavern catching any water droplets which might have fallen from stalactites hidden above.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Wide Cavern, The Fangs]]
description: A gigantic stalagmite erupts from the floor, reaching high up towards the point of an equally massive stalactite.  Hanging from the web-shrouded ceiling, the stalactite is an awesome reflection of the lower fang on a silvery pond of silk.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Puddles of dust dot the uneven floor.  Bits of fractured stone lie scattered about the area.  Carved into the wall of the chamber is a skeletal fish.
paths: Obvious exits: north, south, southwest, west, northwest.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Blanketing the area is a thick carpet of fine-textured black pumice.  A few short stalagmites poke up through the layer of powder.  The huge, echoing chamber expands to the north and west where an awe-inspiring paired stalactite and stalagmite reach towards each other in a much awaited embrace.

title: [[Wide Cavern]]
description: Luminous lichens grow on the rocks, stalagmites and walls, providing a dim yellow glow.  In the shadows of a pile of rubble, a narrow hole cuts down into the earth, its smooth sides providing little purchase.

title: [[The Fangs, The Pinnacle]]
description: The irregular surface provides many tiny ledges and hand holds near the tip of the stalagmite.  Only a few feet above, a drop of water slowly forms at the slender tip of the fang, gradually growing in size until gravity finally wrests it away to fall upon the rock below.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, A Courtyard]]
description: An uncommon tree, known as the sharktooth tree, shelters the overhanging roofs of the homes facing the courtyard.  Unusual specimens are prominent here, as lifesculpted shrubbery borders the walls of one ondjai, and maiden's tress vines dangle from two small trees that guard the entry to another.  Radiating paths connect the homes at the center -- an oval shell-paved contemplation area features a small shrub, just beginning its lifesculpted transformation to the shape of a leaping fish.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Barn]]
description: Weathered grey boards muffle the ever-present sound of the sea just over the dunes to the west, creating a cozy and secure haven from the elements.  From their individual stalls come the faint sounds of horses stamping their hooves or swishing their tails at a bothersome fly.  In one corner is a holding pen with several horses and ponies offered for sale.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Barn]]
description: Carefully maintained horse stalls line both sides of a broad, straw-covered passage.  Pungent smells rise around you -- the sweetness of hay, the earthiness of manure, leather, oil, and sweat.  Bales of fresh straw are stacked along the far wall, ready for use.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cove]]
description: Though hardly calm, the cove is still sheltered and the waves gentle enough to avoid the dangers of a lonely death, dashed against the rocks.  The water is very deep, the bottom unseen in the dark below.  Upon its surface, the swells set all afloat drifting.
paths: Obvious paths: north, northeast, east, west.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, West of Cove]]
description: Beyond the gentler swells of the cove, the waters grow rough and cold as the northern ocean current curls around Surlaenis.  The angle of the island's ascent is apparent from this distance, its conical shape recalling a long dead volcano.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, West of Cove]]
description: Boats traveling the Reshal sea shift upon the swells, rising and falling from view as they enter the distant harbor.  Closer by, harbor seals bark from the rocky shores of a narrow inlet to the southeast.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Inlet]]
description: The inlet narrows to a finger as it slices towards the shore.  The sea pounds against a rocky promontory to the south, but the waves look less perilous closer to land.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Inlet]]
description: The water is deep and cold, the currents swift.  A dangerous rock cliff cuts the inlet off from the rest of the open sea, but does little to shelter it from the rough seas.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Inlet]]
description: The waves slosh against the rocks with salty spray ever present in the air.  The large sheer cliff cuts off the view to the south and is uninhabitable except by the seabirds that fly in sweeping curves to nest there.  A boulder on the slope of the island is within reach, however.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Underwater]]
description: Salt water churns all about as the sea drives against the submerged rocks.  Strands of seaweed caught in the cracks swirl in a fantastical dance as the motion surges and retreats.  Below is only dark, deep water.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a]]
description: Lush green forests cover the outer slope of Aesry Surlaenis'a, down to the golden sands of the beach.  The dark stone of the harbor breaks the clean line formed as the ocean's waves meet the ground.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff Boulder]]
description: This large boulder rises above the spray and slosh of the waves from the cove below and forms the first step up a severe climb along the island's western edge.  The frothing waves beat upon the wet rocks emerging from the sea water with a constant thrumming and roar, but the light glints off the wave caps with a sparkle and wink.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: A ledge runs along the face of the cliff, rising upwards to the south.  Salty wind presses the shrubs clinging to patches of soil against the vertical face, but the ledge is wide enough to traverse safely.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: The ledge is wide enough to make the shuddering sea breeze less risky, but cracks in the rock squeal in torment every time a harsh gust blows across.  A passage upwards leads safely away from the pounding waves below.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: A gouge in the cliff overhead looks like a difficult climb.  Trees and shrubs trail down the side of the palisade from the wooded growth there -- quite a pleasant spot if one can attain the heights.  Below, the ocean waves flicker with white caps as flecks of foam cling to the partly-submerged rocks.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Cliff]]
description: This area gouged in the cliff is abundant with trees and vegetation, beginning a long curving path into a forest.  A flat, barren patch of stone hangs over the cliff face like a diving platform -- one for the fearless or insane.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: Birch, rowan and willow trees cover the slope upwards to the east.  The soil is rich, almost black, wherever the leaves do not dance in a light blanket over the ground.  Salt air still whispers in a stinging wind, but the trees sing along with a cheerful reply to each gust.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The path winds through the trees in a pleasant amble, the further from the sea cliffs, the quieter the loquacious ocean and wind.  A bird sings out occasionally, its melody soft and sweet over the rustle of tree branches.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The path ends here at a ravine -- like a crack in a glacier, or a deep cleft scar, the ground falls far, far away to a distant bottom.  Trees border the path and grow along the gap in a line.  The width of the gash is too far to jump, but... perhaps a way can be discovered across it.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The trees grow tall here south of the ravine that divides the forest into two halves.  Deeper into the woods, large rowans grow along the sloping ground and shade the plentiful shrubs and herbs thriving on the damp leaf-strewn floor.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The air has a fresh crispness to it, and the light filters through the trees in dancing patterns.  Sometimes a branch pops loudly, breaking the deep quiet.  Startled, birds singing or creatures rustling in their hidden shelters grow still and alert.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: Although the slope of the ground is severe, the narrow path winds along a flattened ridge.  Broken twigs on a bush near the trail betray the earlier passage of an explorer or an animal.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The path runs past a log building, simple in construction but large enough to hold many gatherers.  An old willow tree guards the entrance.  The area otherwise looks undisturbed, and without careful observation, the building might well have never been noticed.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: A stand of towering rowan trees spreads in all directions.  The sweet scent of mint and damp earth mingles with composting leaf mould enriching the already thick soil.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: Young aspens that quiver with each breeze grow in the space beneath the towering rowans.  The smaller growth screens and shelters the area from the forest beyond, forming a natural sanctuary.

title: [[Aesry Surlaenis'a, Wooded Path]]
description: The leaf-covered slope is broken at one point by rocks where the soil has worn away.  A single slate beneath it is wet with the splash of spring water that spills from the rocky ground.  The patter of water counterpoints the shivering rowan and aspen trees that continue into the distant forest.
